articles.title: Learning and Coordinated Dispatch of Fusion Power Plants and Energy Storage With Delayed Tritium Circulation
articles.title_zh: 延迟氚循环聚变电站和储能的学习与协调调度
articles.abstract: Tritium circulation couples fusion power delivery to the timing of fuel recovery. Material inside recycling and breeding equipment contributes to total inventory but remains unavailable for immediate withdrawal. This paper develops a mass-conserving compartment model and connects joint state–parameter estimation to thermal storage, battery operation, and extended dispatch. The formulation retains causal withdrawals, auxiliary consumption, conversion losses, and compartment-specific terminal resources. A prefix bound establishes the role of return timing in fuel availability. In an exact example, equal total inventories of 0.50 kg support different withdrawal sequences: only the earlier-return state supplies consecutive 0.15 kg requests. An energy bound then relates usable fuel to the support available from precharged storage. A 72 h numerical benchmark combines protected command-driven simulations with synthetic uncertainty and sensitivity calculations. The simulations separate rejected fuel requests from realized reserve violations and show how storage allocation changes delivery loss. The synthetic forecast experiment also quantifies the difference between marginal and complete-path coverage. These results identify fuel maturity, storage discharge limits, and temporal uncertainty as distinct constraints on dependable delivery. The resulting formulation links each electricity commitment to the material and energy available before that commitment falls due.
articles.abstract_zh: 氚循环将聚变能输送与燃料回收的时间结合起来。回收和养殖设备内的材料构成了总库存，但仍无法立即提取。本文开发了一种质量守恒舱模型，并将联合状态参数估计与热存储、电池运行和扩展调度联系起来。该公式保留了因果提取、辅助消耗、转换损失和特定车厢的终端资源。前缀界限确定了返回时间在燃料可用性中的作用。在一个确切的例子中，相同的 0.50 千克总库存支持不同的提款顺序：只有较早返回的状态提供连续的 0.15 千克请求。然后，能量界限将可用燃料与预充电存储中可用的支持相关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氚循环将聚变能输送与燃料回收的时间结合起来。回收和养殖设备内的材料构成了总库存，但仍无法立即提取。本文开发了一种质量守恒舱模型，并将联合状态参数估计与热存储、电池运行和扩展调度联系起来。该公式保留了因果提取、辅助消耗、转换损失和特定车厢的终端资源。前缀界限确定了返回时间在燃料可用性中的作用。在一个确切的例子中，相同的 0.50 千克总库存支持不同的提款顺序：只有较早返回的状态提供连续的 0.15 千克请求。然后，能量界限将可用燃料与预充电存储中可用的支持相关联。 72 小时数值基准将受保护的命令驱动模拟与综合不确定性和灵敏度计算相结合。模拟将被拒绝的燃料请求与已实现的储备违规分开，并显示存储分配如何改变交付损失。综合预测实验还量化了边际覆盖率和完整路径覆盖率之间的差异。这些结果将燃料成熟度、存储排放限制和时间不确定性确定为可靠交付的明显限制。由此产生的公式将每项电力承诺与该承诺到期之前可用的材料和能源联系起来。

articles.title: Aerosol Inversion Based on Vector Radiative Transfer Model and Machine Learning Method
articles.title_zh: 基于矢量辐射传递模型和机器学习方法的气溶胶反演
articles.abstract: While geostationary imagers can track diurnal aerosol optical depth (AOD), separating atmospheric and surface signals remains challenging. Here, we combine a vector radiative transfer model (VRTM) with multi-spectral machine learning to enhance AOD retrieval from FengYun-4A (FY-4A) AGRI observations and evaluate the algorithm across different operational scenarios. In VRTM-based synthetic inversions, AOD recovery reached numerical precision with a known surface, whereas jointly fitting AOD and surface reflectance increased the root mean square error (RMSE) to 0.121, highlighting the need for multi-channel constraints. For independent FY-4A AGRI pairs at 550 nm, our five-channel random forest algorithm improved retrieval accuracy to a predictive coefficient of determination (R2pred) of 0.601 and an RMSE of 0.212, compared with 0.519 and 0.232 for the single blue-channel model. Scenario-specific validation further showed that the five-channel algorithm achieved high accuracy for temporal retrieval at monitored pixels (R2pred = 0.704 in date-grouped validation) and an R2pred of 0.497 when applied to unmonitored locations. Overall, this framework improves geostationary AOD retrieval accuracy and provides clear guidance for deploying machine learning retrievals across temporal monitoring and spatial transfer applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 虽然对地静止成像仪可以跟踪每日气溶胶光学深度（AOD），但分离大气和表面信号仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将矢量辐射传输模型（VRTM）与多光谱机器学习相结合，以增强风云四号A（FY-4A）AGRI观测的AOD检索，并在不同的操作场景下评估该算法。在基于 VRTM 的合成反演中，AOD 恢复在已知表面上达到了数值精度，而联合拟合 AOD 和表面反射率将均方根误差 (RMSE) 增加到 0.121，突出了多通道约束的需要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虽然对地静止成像仪可以跟踪每日气溶胶光学深度（AOD），但分离大气和表面信号仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将矢量辐射传输模型（VRTM）与多光谱机器学习相结合，以增强风云四号A（FY-4A）AGRI观测的AOD检索，并在不同的操作场景下评估该算法。在基于 VRTM 的合成反演中，AOD 恢复在已知表面上达到了数值精度，而联合拟合 AOD 和表面反射率将均方根误差 (RMSE) 增加到 0.121，突出了多通道约束的需要。对于 550 nm 处的独立 FY-4A AGRI 对，我们的五通道随机森林算法将检索精度提高到预测决定系数 (R2pred) 为 0.601，RMSE 为 0.212，而单蓝色通道模型的预测系数 (R2pred) 为 0.519 和 0.232。特定场景的验证进一步表明，五通道算法在受监控像素处实现了时间检索的高精度（在日期分组验证中，R2pred = 0.704），并且当应用于未监控位置时，R2pred 为 0.497。总体而言，该框架提高了对地静止 AOD 检索的准确性，并为跨时间监测和空间传输应用程序部署机器学习检索提供了明确的指导。

articles.title: Multi-objective workflow scheduling in heterogeneous clouds through billing-aware task-group reassignment
articles.title_zh: 通过计费感知任务组重新分配在异构云中进行多目标工作流调度
articles.abstract: Task dependencies, heterogeneous resources, and discrete billing jointly complicate multi-objective workflow scheduling in clouds. This paper proposes archive-guided billing-aware ant colony optimization (AGBACO) to minimize makespan, cost, and energy consumption. The method inherits complete task-to-virtual-machine mappings from a nondominated archive and reassigns tasks sharing the same virtual machine as a group. This operation explores opportunities to release the source virtual machine and reuse the target's existing billing intervals. Adjustments involving one or two tasks further refine resource matching. Quantum-inspired genetic exploration establishes the initial archive, while conventional ant colony construction and archive-based reassignment jointly generate candidates for three-objective evaluation and archive updates. Parameter sensitivity is examined on five scientific workflows, followed by algorithm comparisons and component ablations at four task scales. Relative to five multi-objective comparison algorithms, the mean paired hypervolume gain, averaged across inputs, ranges from 8.01% to 12.24%. Solution-set quality and resource-occupancy results show that AGBACO accommodates different workflow structures and achieves favorable trade-offs between execution efficiency and resource overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 任务依赖性、异构资源和离散计费共同使云中的多目标工作流调度变得复杂。本文提出了存档引导的计费感知蚁群优化 (AGBACO)，以最大限度地减少完工时间、成本和能源消耗。该方法从非支配存档继承完整的任务到虚拟机映射，并重新分配作为一个组共享同一虚拟机的任务。此操作探索释放源虚拟机并重用目标现有计费间隔的机会。涉及一到两项任务的调整进一步细化资源匹配。受量子启发的遗传探索建立了初始档案，而传统的蚁群构建和基于档案的重新分配共同生成了用于三目标评估和档案更新的候选者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 任务依赖性、异构资源和离散计费共同使云中的多目标工作流调度变得复杂。本文提出了存档引导的计费感知蚁群优化 (AGBACO)，以最大限度地减少完工时间、成本和能源消耗。该方法从非支配存档继承完整的任务到虚拟机映射，并重新分配作为一个组共享同一虚拟机的任务。此操作探索释放源虚拟机并重用目标现有计费间隔的机会。涉及一到两项任务的调整进一步细化资源匹配。受量子启发的遗传探索建立了初始档案，而传统的蚁群构建和基于档案的重新分配共同生成了用于三目标评估和档案更新的候选者。在五个科学工作流程中检查参数敏感性，然后在四个任务规模上进行算法比较和组件消融。相对于五种多目标比较算法，平均配对超体积增益（跨输入平均）范围为 8.01% 至 12.24%。解决方案集质量和资源占用结果表明，AGBACO 可以适应不同的工作流结构，并在执行效率和资源开销之间实现有利的权衡。

articles.title: Recombinant Expression of Cliotide U1 in Pichia pastoris: Antibacterial Activity and Mechanistic Insights
articles.title_zh: 克利肽 U1 在毕赤酵母中的重组表达：抗菌活性和机制见解
articles.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance has increased the need for new antibacterial agents and scalable production methods. Cliotide U1 (CU1), a plant-derived antimicrobial peptide, has reported activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, but its production has relied on low-yield extraction or chemical synthesis. Here, CU1 was recombinantly expressed in Pichia pastoris, and the antibacterial activity and properties of the CU1-containing fermentation supernatant (CU1-FS) were characterized. CU1-FS inhibited all six tested bacterial strains, with apparent minimum inhibitory concentrations of 3–8 µg/mL based on ELISA-estimated His-tagged products. Antibacterial activity was retained to varying degrees after temperature, pH, salt, and protease treatments, and CU1-FS showed low hemolysis of human erythrocytes under the tested conditions. Scanning electron microscopy showed changes in bacterial cell morphology; propidium iodide staining and measurements of extracellular nucleic acid- and protein-associated absorbance supported increased membrane permeability and leakage of intracellular components. Agarose gel electrophoresis showed altered migration of bacterial genomic DNA, consistent with a potential in vitro interaction. Molecular docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations provided predicted interaction models for CU1 with selected bacterial proteins and a model lipid membrane. Because the tested material was unpurified CU1-FS, contributions from other supernatant components cannot be excluded. These findings establish a recombinant production approach for bioactive CU1-containing supernatant and support further study of CU1-associated membrane effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 抗菌素耐药性增加了对新型抗菌剂和可扩展生产方法的需求。 Cliotide U1 (CU1) 是一种植物源性抗菌肽，据报道具有对抗革兰氏阳性和革兰氏阴性细菌的活性，但其生产依赖于低产提取或化学合成。在这里，CU1在毕赤酵母中重组表达，并对含有CU1的发酵上清液（CU1-FS）的抗菌活性和特性进行了表征。 CU1-FS 抑制所有六种测试的细菌菌株，根据 ELISA 估计的 His 标记产品，表观最低抑制浓度为 3–8 µg/mL。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 抗菌素耐药性增加了对新型抗菌剂和可扩展生产方法的需求。 Cliotide U1 (CU1) 是一种植物源性抗菌肽，据报道具有对抗革兰氏阳性和革兰氏阴性细菌的活性，但其生产依赖于低产提取或化学合成。在这里，CU1在毕赤酵母中重组表达，并对含有CU1的发酵上清液（CU1-FS）的抗菌活性和特性进行了表征。 CU1-FS 抑制所有六种测试的细菌菌株，根据 ELISA 估计的 His 标记产品，表观最低抑制浓度为 3–8 µg/mL。经过温度、pH、盐和蛋白酶处理后，抗菌活性均不同程度地保留，并且CU1-FS在测试条件下表现出对人红细胞的低溶血作用。扫描电子显微镜显示细菌细胞形态的变化；碘化丙啶染色以及细胞外核酸和蛋白质相关吸光度的测量支持膜通透性增加和细胞内成分渗漏。琼脂糖凝胶电泳显示细菌基因组 DNA 的迁移发生改变，这与潜在的体外相互作用一致。分子对接和 100 纳秒分子动力学模拟提供了 CU1 与选定细菌蛋白和模型脂质膜的相互作用预测模型。由于测试材料是未纯化的 CU1-FS，因此不能排除其他上清液成分的贡献。这些发现建立了含有生物活性 CU1 的上清液的重组生产方法，并支持对 CU1 相关膜效应的进一步研究。

articles.title: Influence of drying technology on the bioactive composition and microstructural characteristics of West Indian cherry (Malpighia emarginata) powders
articles.title_zh: 干燥工艺对西印度樱桃（Malpighia emarginata）粉末生物活性成分和微观结构特征的影响
articles.abstract: West Indian Cherry (WIC), Malpighia emarginata, commonly called acerola, is a tropical, highly perishable fruit rich in vitamin C and bioactive compounds. The current research aimed to compare the hot-air oven, spray, and freeze-drying methods to produce acerola pulp powder, assess changes in its composition and bioactive compounds, and evaluate the antioxidant activity and microstructure of the final product. The moisture content of the fresh pulp and the levels of ash, fibre, protein, and carbohydrates were also determined. Potassium, sodium, and magnesium were the most abundant minerals. Freeze-drying retained the highest levels, while hot-air drying led to the most deformed microstructure due to extended exposure to elevated temperatures. The powder microstructures differed significantly at the scanning electron microscopy level, ranging from consolidated, irregular surfaces to deformed, porous surfaces. Therefore, the current study revealed that the choice of drying technologies and conditions impacts the levels of most nutrients and the microstructure of acerola pulp powder. Among the methods, freeze-drying was found to be the most efficient in terms of retaining the properties of the original pulp. Meanwhile, the differences in the microstructure of the powders suggested the need to select the appropriate technologies for producing acerola-based functional food ingredients.
articles.abstract_zh: 西印度樱桃 (WIC)、Malpighia emarginata，通常称为针叶樱桃，是一种热带、极易腐烂的水果，富含维生素 C 和生物活性化合物。目前的研究旨在比较热风炉、喷雾和冷冻干燥方法生产针叶樱桃果肉粉，评估其成分和生物活性化合物的变化，并评估最终产品的抗氧化活性和微观结构。还测定了新鲜果肉的水分含量以及灰分、纤维、蛋白质和碳水化合物的水平。钾、钠和镁是最丰富的矿物质。冷冻干燥保留了最高水平，而热风干燥由于长时间暴露在高温下而导致显微结构变形最大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 西印度樱桃 (WIC)、Malpighia emarginata，通常称为针叶樱桃，是一种热带、极易腐烂的水果，富含维生素 C 和生物活性化合物。目前的研究旨在比较热风炉、喷雾和冷冻干燥方法生产针叶樱桃果肉粉，评估其成分和生物活性化合物的变化，并评估最终产品的抗氧化活性和微观结构。还测定了新鲜果肉的水分含量以及灰分、纤维、蛋白质和碳水化合物的水平。钾、钠和镁是最丰富的矿物质。冷冻干燥保留了最高水平，而热风干燥由于长时间暴露在高温下而导致显微结构变形最大。粉末微观结构在扫描电子显微镜水平上存在显着差异，从固结的不规则表面到变形的多孔表面。因此，目前的研究表明，干燥技术和条件的选择会影响针叶樱桃果肉粉的大多数营养成分和微观结构。在这些方法中，冷冻干燥被发现在保留原始纸浆的特性方面是最有效的。同时，粉末微观结构的差异表明需要选择合适的技术来生产基于针叶樱桃的功能性食品成分。

articles.title: Minor Surface Defect Detection for Power Line Insulators UsingFrequency-Space Fusion and Focused Diffusion Pyramids
articles.title_zh: 使用频率空间融合和聚焦扩散金字塔检测电力线绝缘子的微小表面缺陷
articles.abstract: Abstract. To address the challenges of insulator defect detection in complex backgrounds and resource-constrainededge scenarios, this paper proposes a lightweight and high-precision detection method based on the RT-DETR frame-work. An efficient feature extraction network, FSNet, is designed to enhance feature representation through dynamicrouting and adaptive fusion of spatial- and frequency-domain information. Furthermore, a Feature-Focused Diffu-sion Pyramid Network is introduced to improve multi-scale contextual interaction, thereby strengthening the local-ization and classification capability for defects of varying sizes. Experimental results on a self-built insulator datasetdemonstrate that the proposed method achieves a 4.8 percentage point improvement in mAP@0.5 over the baselinemodel, while reducing computational cost by 2.8%. In addition, extensive experiments on a public dataset furthervalidate the strong generalization ability of the proposed method. Compared with several representative CNN-basedand Transformer-based detectors, the proposed method consistently achieves a superior trade-off between detectionaccuracy and efficiency. Finally, edge deployment on the NVIDIA Jetson Nano platform confirms its feasibility andpractical value for real-time UAV-based transmission line inspection.

Whether human alveolar bone exhibits a reproducible immune-to-bone-remodeling transcriptional transition, and whether a core program of osteoblast–osteoclast coupling is conserved across anatomical sites and species, remain insufficiently characterized using oral data. This study aimed to identify early transcriptional changes in human alveolar bone and evaluate their cross-site and cross-species conservation.Methods A site-stratified transcriptomic integration strategy was adopted. The human alveolar bone dataset GSE41446, comprising 44 samples from 11 participants, two implant surfaces, and day 3 (D3) and day 7 (D7), served as the core discovery dataset. Rat maxillary bone dataset GSE304968 and rat tibial and femoral datasets were used for cross-site comparisons. Analyses included differential expression analysis, directional validation paired by participant and implant surface, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), robust rank aggregation, and machine-learning feature selection. A rat tibial osseointegration time series (GSE35976) was further used to assess the cross-species directional concordance of candidate hub genes.Results From D3 to D7, the reparative macrophage marker MRC1 was upregulated, whereas the inflammatory genes TNF and IL1B were downregulated. articles.title: Durability enhancement of ancient masonry via in-situ synthesized silicon- magnesium composite gel: Interfacial chemistry and long-term field monitoring
articles.title_zh: 通过原位合成硅镁复合凝胶增强古代砖石的耐久性：界面化学和长期现场监测
articles.abstract: Repeated drying-wetting and freeze-thaw cycles severely deteriorate ancient masonry structures, threatening the long-term conservation of architectural heritage. Addressing this, a novel silicon-magnesium composite gel was developed for the deep rehabilitation of historic gray bricks via in-situ copolymerization and vacuum-assisted pressure infiltration. The chemical evolution and structural stability of the composite network were systematically characterized using FTIR, XRD, and XRF, which confirmed the formation of stable covalent bonds (Si-O-Mg and Si-O-C) bridging the organic and inorganic phases. Orthogonal experimental design optimized the formulation, yielding a practical operable curing time (5.33–6.41 h) suitable for deep penetration. SEM observations revealed a continuous interpenetrating network that effectively filled microcracks and connected pores, significantly densifying the matrix. Uniaxial compression tests demonstrated a substantial improvement in the mechanical integrity of the modified bricks. Furthermore, an outdoor experimental wall was constructed for long-term durability monitoring. Moisture sensor data and infrared thermal imaging after rainfall verified that the treated wall exhibited substantially reduced internal moisture content, inhibited capillary water rise, and dampened diurnal temperature fluctuations compared to the untreated control. This work provides a sustainable and extensible reinforcement strategy for the engineering conservation of ancient masonry buildings.
articles.abstract_zh: 反复的干湿和冻融循环严重破坏了古代砖石结构，威胁着建筑遗产的长期保护。针对这一问题，开发了一种新型硅镁复合凝胶，通过原位共聚和真空辅助压力渗透对历史灰砖进行深度修复。使用 FTIR、XRD 和 XRF 系统地表征了复合网络的化学演化和结构稳定性，证实了桥接有机相和无机相的稳定共价键（Si-O-Mg 和 Si-O-C）的形成。正交实验设计优化了配方，得到了适合深度渗透的实用可操作固化时间（5.33-6.41小时）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反复的干湿和冻融循环严重破坏了古代砖石结构，威胁着建筑遗产的长期保护。针对这一问题，开发了一种新型硅镁复合凝胶，通过原位共聚和真空辅助压力渗透对历史灰砖进行深度修复。使用 FTIR、XRD 和 XRF 系统地表征了复合网络的化学演化和结构稳定性，证实了桥接有机相和无机相的稳定共价键（Si-O-Mg 和 Si-O-C）的形成。正交实验设计优化了配方，得到了适合深度渗透的实用可操作固化时间（5.33-6.41小时）。 SEM 观察揭示了连续的互穿网络，有效填充了微裂纹并连接了孔隙，显着致密了基质。单轴压缩试验表明改性砖的机械完整性得到了显着改善。此外，还建造了室外实验墙以进行长期耐久性监测。降雨后的湿度传感器数据和红外热成像证实，与未处理的对照相比，经过处理的墙体表现出显着降低的内部水分含量、抑制毛细管水上升和抑制昼夜温度波动。本工作为古砖石建筑的工程保护提供了可持续、可扩展的加固策略。

articles.title: S-matrix constrained equivariant graph neural network for Hamiltonian inversion of Kagome and quasiperiodic non-Hermitian systems
articles.title_zh: 用于 Kagome 和准周期非厄米系统哈密顿反演的 S 矩阵约束等变图神经网络
articles.abstract: Reconstructing Hamiltonian parameters from noisy scattering data is an ill-posed inverse problem in non-Hermitian quantum systems. We propose an S-matrix constrained equivariant graph neural network that embeds two architectural hard constraints to reduce the solution ambiguity. An equivariant message-passing encoder incorporates lattice point-group symmetry and permutation-invariant aggregation (for the Aubry–André–Harper quasiperiodic chain), thereby suppressing symmetry-induced parameter variability. A deterministic S-matrix solver serves as a fixed decoder that enforces the scattering equations within the assumed model, eliminating the need for physics-based residual loss terms. Inference is performed via a two-stage hybrid optimization: offline pre-training on synthetic data, followed by online single-sample fine-tuning in a low-dimensional latent space. On a 48-site Kagome supercell and a 50-site Aubry–André–Harper quasiperiodic chain, using a synthetic dataset of 120 000 samples (100 000 training, 10 000 validation, 10 000 test) with additive white Gaussian noise (0%–10%), the mean absolute percentage error of reconstructed parameters remains around 5% for both systems under 10% noise, with per-parameter standard deviations below across 20 independent repetitions, and with an empirical inconsistency ratio around . The transmission spectrum reconstruction RMSE is 0.026± 0.003 (Kagome) and 0.029± 0.003 (Aubry–André–Harper) at 10% noise. Single-sample CPU inference takes 23 s (offline simulation scenario), achieving a 5.6-fold speedup over least-squares fitting with five restarts. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes to the reported performance. For the AAH quasiperiodic chain, we consider two scenarios: a uniform-dissipation scenario with two independent parameters ( and ), which serves as our primary benchmark. Unless otherwise stated, all numerical results reported in the main text for the AAH chain correspond to the uniform-dissipation scenario. All experiments are conducted on synthetic data; the method is validated as a proof-of-concept for the two benchmark systems under the wide-band approximation, which is adopted as the forward map of the benchmark systems and is adequate for the parameter ranges studied, without claiming general 1% accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 从噪声散射数据重建哈密顿参数是非厄米量子系统中的不适定逆问题。我们提出了一种 S 矩阵约束等变图神经网络，它嵌入了两个架构硬约束以减少解决方案的模糊性。等变消息传递编码器结合了晶格点群对称性和排列不变聚合（对于奥布里-安德烈-哈珀准周期链），从而抑制了对称引起的参数变异。确定性 S 矩阵求解器充当固定解码器，在假设模型内强制执行散射方程，从而消除了基于物理的剩余损失项的需要。推理是通过两阶段混合优化进行的：对合成数据进行离线预训练，然后在低维潜在空间中进行在线单样本微调。

articles.title: Schrödinger’s Continuous Electron Revisited: A Fourth Spatial Direction Recovers Exchange, Exclusion and the Born Rule Without Configuration Space
articles.title_zh: 薛定谔的连续电子重温：第四空间方向恢复交换、排斥和无构型空间的诞生规则
articles.abstract: In 1926, Schrödinger interpreted his wave as a real, continuous distribution of electronic matter. This interpretation was soon challenged for four reasons: the many-electron wave exists in configuration space, electrons are detected as whole entities, a charged cloud would be expected to repel itself, and classical charged matter cannot possess spin or exhibit magnetism. The objective of this study is to determine the conditions under which the electron can be treated as a continuous body that addresses these objections and aligns with spectroscopic evidence, as well as to introduce a corresponding physical model of the atom. By conceptualizing the vacuum as an unbounded resonator vibrating at Ω₀, electronic matter as maintaining this resonance, and the nucleus as a compact 1/r source, the vacuum-resonance continuous-matter (VRCM) model provides a physical foundation for the atom. This model further conceptualizes the electron as a continuous body extending into a real fourth spatial direction (w), with a maximum extent of 2.6 × 10–19 m, and whose portions are defined by pattern, fold, and side. A single calibrated action unit, G, reproduced fifteen lines of H, He⁺, and Li²⁺ within 2.9 ppm, and one value of Γ fitted five measured hydrogen transitions within 1.3 × 10–9. Unlike non-relativistic quantum mechanics, which postulates the sign reversal upon exchanging two electrons, VRCM derives it from the geometry of its body, which is non-orientable and returns only after 720°. With each place holding one hydrogen-equivalent of matter and a face rule taken as a premise, each pattern accommodates only two portions, one on each side, which accounted for the shells from hydrogen to neon, lithium’s 2s below its 2p within 3%, the ground terms from boron to fluorine through Hund’s first two rules, and the triplet ground state of O₂. The diamagnetism of helium and the paramagnetic susceptibility of O₂ agreed within 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively, and the ionization energy of lithium came out at 5.409 eV against the measured 5.392 eV. Helium’s two portions share one three-dimensional region and are separated only along w; without w, its energy rises by at least 20 eV. A coupling of the vibrations of the two portions through w, fixed on helium alone, brought the correlation energies of the helium-like ions from Li+ to Ne+8 within 0.1% and of H– within 1.6%. Within one side, the self-repulsion of the body is cancelled exactly by exchange, while portions on opposite sides repel with full strength. With the coupling between the two faces taken as a premise, a two-face law gave g = 2, the two kinds of charge as the two faces, and Dirac’s small component as matter spilled onto the second face. The vacuum’s zero-point vibrations gave the Lamb shift of hydrogen as 1050.74 MHz at one loop, against the measured 1057.8 MHz, and the electron’s anomalous magnetic moment as α/2p. Aside from spectra, the same body accounted for its detection as a whole: its wavelength followed from the vacuum’s wave rule, and the Born odds from the body remaining whole as it contracts onto one place at capture, given a detection threshold taken as a premise. Each premise in this model was adopted only after its alternative failed by a stated margin. These results suggest that continuous electronic matter connected through the fourth spatial direction (w) can recover the exchange sign, exclusion and the Born rule without configuration space, while accounting for spin, magnetism and the absence of self-repulsion.
articles.abstract_zh: 1926 年，薛定谔将他的波解释为电子物质真实、连续的分布。这种解释很快就受到四个原因的挑战：多电子波存在于构型空间中，电子被检测为完整的实体，带电云预计会排斥自身，经典带电物质不能拥有自旋或表现出磁性。这项研究的目的是确定在什么条件下电子可以被视为一个连续体，以解决这些异议并与光谱证据保持一致，并引入相应的原子物理模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 1926 年，薛定谔将他的波解释为电子物质真实、连续的分布。这种解释很快就受到四个原因的挑战：多电子波存在于构型空间中，电子被检测为完整的实体，带电云预计会排斥自身，经典带电物质不能拥有自旋或表现出磁性。这项研究的目的是确定在什么条件下电子可以被视为一个连续体，以解决这些异议并与光谱证据保持一致，并引入相应的原子物理模型。通过将真空概念化为以 Ω₀ 振动的无界谐振器，将电子物质概念化为维持这种共振，将原子核概念化为紧凑的 1/r 源，真空共振连续物质 (VRCM) 模型为原子提供了物理基础。该模型进一步将电子概念化为延伸到真正的第四空间方向（w）的连续体，最大范围为 2.6 × 10-19 m，其部分由图案、折叠和侧面定义。单个校准的作用单元 G 在 2.9 ppm 范围内再现了 15 条 H、He⁺ 和 Li2⁺ 线，并且 Γ 的一个值适合在 1.3 × 10-9 范围内测量到的 5 个氢跃迁。与非相对论量子力学假设交换两个电子时符号反转不同，VRCM 是从其主体的几何形状中得出符号反转的，该几何形状是不可定向的，并且仅在 720° 后才返回。每个位置都包含一个氢当量的物质，并以面规则为前提，每个图案只容纳两部分，每侧一个，这占了从氢到氖的壳层，锂的2s低于其2p的3%以内，通过洪德前两条规则从硼到氟的基态项，以及O2的三重态基态。氦的抗磁性和 O 2 的顺磁性磁化率分别在 0.7% 和 0.5% 范围内一致，并且锂的电离能为 5.409 eV，而测量值为 5.392 eV。氦的两部分共享一个三维区域并且仅沿 w 分开；没有w，它的能量至少上升20 eV。两个部分的振动通过 w 耦合，仅固定在氦上，使类氦离子从 Li+ 到 Ne+8 的相关能在 0.1% 以内，H- 的相关能在 1.6% 以内。在一侧，身体的自斥力通过交换完全抵消，而相对两侧的部分则全力排斥。以两个面之间的耦合为前提，双面定律给出g = 2，两种电荷作为两个面，狄拉克的小分量作为物质溢出到第二个面上。真空的零点振动使氢的兰姆位移在一个循环中为 1050.74 MHz，而测量的为 1057.8 MHz，电子的反常磁矩为 α/2p。除了光谱之外，同一物体将其检测作为一个整体来解释：它的波长遵循真空的波动规则，以及当物体在捕获时收缩到一个位置时保持完整的玻恩几率，假设检测阈值作为前提。该模型中的每个前提只有在其替代方案以规定的幅度失败后才被采用。这些结果表明，通过第四空间方向（w）连接的连续电子物质可以在没有构型空间的情况下恢复交换符号、排斥和玻恩规则，同时考虑到自旋、磁性和自排斥的缺失。

articles.title: Electrode potential governs oxygen–oxygen bond formation through coupled interfacial dynamics
articles.title_zh: 电极电位通过耦合界面动力学控制氧-氧键的形成
articles.abstract: Understanding how electrode potential regulates bond formation and cleavage is central to diverse technological processes, ranging from energy storage and conversion to electrosynthesis, corrosion and electrochemical materials processing. Yet whether and how electrode potential, conventionally regarded as a thermodynamic driving force, governs the microscopic mechanisms and kinetics of these transformations remains poorly understood. Here, we address this fundamental question through the direct coupling of adjacent surface oxo species, an alternative pathway for oxygen evolution during water splitting. We combine first-principles molecular dynamics, enhanced-sampling simulations and nonadiabatic coupling analysis to investigate O--O bond formation at a hydrated ceNb2Se2C interface. We demonstrate that constant-potential conditions facilitate the formation of adjacent oxo species and drastically reduce the O--O coupling barrier from 3.43 to 0.49~eV relative to constant-charge conditions. This pronounced change is accompanied by interfacial water reorganization, enhanced electron--nuclear coupling and nonlocal charge redistribution extending beyond the immediate reaction centre. These results highlight the importance of electrode charge regulation and coupled interfacial dynamics in understanding chemical bond formation under electrochemical conditions. Thus, our work is the demonstration that electrode potential is not merely an external thermodynamic driving force but an essential electrochemical boundary condition that governs the pathway of catalytic bond formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解电极电位如何调节键的形成和断裂对于各种技术过程（从能量存储和转换到电合成、腐蚀和电化学材料加工）至关重要。然而，传统上被视为热力学驱动力的电极电势是否以及如何控制这些转变的微观机制和动力学仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们通过相邻表面含氧物质的直接耦合来解决这个基本问题，这是水分解过程中氧气析出的替代途径。我们结合第一原理分子动力学、增强采样模拟和非绝热耦合分析来研究水合 ceNb2Se2C 界面上的 O--O 键形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解电极电位如何调节键的形成和断裂对于各种技术过程（从能量存储和转换到电合成、腐蚀和电化学材料加工）至关重要。然而，传统上被视为热力学驱动力的电极电势是否以及如何控制这些转变的微观机制和动力学仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们通过相邻表面含氧物质的直接耦合来解决这个基本问题，这是水分解过程中氧气析出的替代途径。我们结合第一原理分子动力学、增强采样模拟和非绝热耦合分析来研究水合 ceNb2Se2C 界面上的 O--O 键形成。我们证明，相对于恒电荷条件，恒电位条件有利于相邻氧物种的形成，并将 O--O 耦合势垒从 3.43 大幅降低至 0.49~eV。这种显着的变化伴随着界面水重组、增强的电子-核耦合以及延伸到直接反应中心之外的非局部电荷重新分布。这些结果凸显了电极电荷调节和耦合界面动力学对于理解电化学条件下化学键形成的重要性。因此，我们的工作证明电极电势不仅是外部热力学驱动力，而且是控制催化键形成途径的重要电化学边界条件。

articles.title: Advancing Circular and Sustainable Surface Engineering through Machine Learning-Assisted Plasma Electrolytic Polishing of TC4 Alloy: Reusability, Stirring and Immersion Properties
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习辅助的 TC4 合金等离子电解抛光推进循环和可持续表面工程：可重复使用性、搅拌和浸泡特性
articles.abstract: Plasma electrolytic polishing (PeP) is an anodic finishing process in which surface asperities are dissolved beneath a vapor–gaseous envelope (VGE). Previous studies have mainly addressed voltage and electrolyte properties, whereas immersion conditions and stirring remain less explored. This study investigated the effects of immersion depth, electrolyte reusability, immersion cycle, and stirring on the PeP of TC4 alloy using a 27-run full factorial design. Surface roughness, gloss, morphology, and elemental composition were evaluated. After PeP, Ra decreased from 13.18 µm to 1.214–3.173 µm, reaching its minimum at 50 mm depth, 600 rpm stirring, and single cycle, owing to a thinner VGE at greater depths and electrolyte renewal through agitation. Fluorine residues decreased from 9.8 to 0.8 wt.% with increasing depth and stirring, while Al and V contents remained nearly unchanged. Edge erosion cavities at 10 mm without stirring were suppressed by deeper immersion and stirring. Twenty-three regression models and a target-specific hybrid approach were compared for predicting Ra and gloss using stirring-stratified nine-fold cross-validation. The selected configurations achieved pooled out-of-fold R2 values of 0.7159 (Ra) and 0.9009 (gloss). SHAP analysis identified stirring as the most influential predictor for both responses, followed by depth for Ra and cycle for gloss.

articles.title: Nanostructure-engineered telecom quantum platform with room-temperature optical quantum coherence
articles.title_zh: 具有室温光量子相干性的纳米结构工程电信量子平台
articles.abstract: Achieving μs-scale quantum coherence at room temperature in the telecom C band remains a central challenge for solid state quantum platforms, previously demonstrated only under vacuum cryogenic conditions. Here we introduce a CMOS-compatible nanoengineering approach that deterministically controls the number of erbium ions within a nanoscale volume and their electromagnetic environment using sub 5 nm silicon based hollow nanopillars. This achieves the first geometry-defined spatial isolation of single erbium ions, suppressing ion-ion interactions and local electromagnetic field noise under ambient conditions. Individually addressable single-ion devices exhibit a record room temperature optical coherence time of T2*= 32 μs, limited by laser coherence, while photon-echo measurements yield coherence exceeding 60 μs at few-ion sites. We further demonstrate the first background free, upconversion enabled single photon emission from multi-energy-level single erbium ions. The results establish nanostructure-engineered control of the local ion environments as a pathway toward scalable, manufacturable, telecom-compatible quantum networks, distributed sensing, and cryogenic-free quantum photonic integrated circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 在电信 C 波段室温下实现 μs 级量子相干性仍然是固态量子平台的一个核心挑战，此前仅在真空低温条件下进行了演示。在这里，我们介绍了一种与 CMOS 兼容的纳米工程方法，该方法使用亚 5 nm 硅基空心纳米柱来确定性地控制纳米级体积内的铒离子数量及其电磁环境。这首次实现了单个铒离子的几何定义空间隔离，抑制了环境条件下的离子间相互作用和局部电磁场噪声。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在电信 C 波段室温下实现 μs 级量子相干性仍然是固态量子平台的一个核心挑战，此前仅在真空低温条件下进行了演示。在这里，我们介绍了一种与 CMOS 兼容的纳米工程方法，该方法使用亚 5 nm 硅基空心纳米柱来确定性地控制纳米级体积内的铒离子数量及其电磁环境。这首次实现了单个铒离子的几何定义空间隔离，抑制了环境条件下的离子间相互作用和局部电磁场噪声。受激光相干性限制，可单独寻址的单离子器件表现出创纪录的室温光学相干时间 T2*= 32 μs，而光子回波测量在少数离子位点产生超过 60 μs 的相干性。我们进一步展示了第一个无背景、上转换的多能级单铒离子单光子发射。结果建立了对局部离子环境的纳米结构工程控制，作为实现可扩展、可制造、电信兼容的量子网络、分布式传感和无低温量子光子集成电路的途径。

articles.title: Investigating ionizable lipid chemical environment in lipid nanoparticles using multiphase nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 使用多相核磁共振波谱研究脂质纳米粒子中的可电离脂质化学环境
articles.abstract: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are a leading platform for nucleic acid delivery, yet molecular-level characterization of their internal organization remains inaccessible using conventional methods. We developed a multiphase NMR spectroscopy toolbox for the non-destructive, atomic-resolution characterization of LNPs in their native formulations. The toolbox combines diffusion-filtered perfect-echo CPMG for layer-dependent 1H T₂ relaxation measurements, a multiplicity-edited HSQC experiment in combination with an HSQC-iDOSY pulse sequence to isolate LNP-associated signals, saturation transfer difference (STD) and diffusion-filtered waterLOGSY experiments for signal assignment; and proton spin diffusion-driven NOESY for assigning the backbone connectivity of the ionizable lipid (IZL). Applied to LNPs produced under varied formulation and manufacturing conditions, this toolbox revealed multiple ionizable lipid populations residing in heterogeneous chemical environments. Spatial constriction of the PEG lipid was detected in selected formulations and was distinguished from PEG shedding through total lipid quantification. Semi-quantitative HSQC analysis estimated that 7–30% of the ionizable lipid resides at the particle surface, with surface enrichment factors correlating with in vitro transfection efficiency. These results suggest that manufacturing parameters influence LNP structure through molecular-level changes that are not resolved by conventional analytical methods, demonstrating the utility of this NMR toolbox for elucidating how formulation and manufacturing parameters govern LNP structure and function. Correspondence to Peyman Sakhaii (peyman.sakhaii@sanofi.com) or Dan Zarraga (dan.zarraga@sanofi.com)
articles.abstract_zh: 脂质纳米粒子（LNP）是核酸递送的领先平台，但使用传统方法仍然无法对其内部组织进行分子水平表征。我们开发了多相核磁共振波谱工具箱，用于对天然配方中的 LNP 进行无损、原子分辨率表征。该工具箱结合了用于层相关 1H T2 弛豫测量的扩散过滤完美回波 CPMG、多重编辑的 HSQC 实验以及用于隔离 LNP 相关信号的 HSQC-iDOSY 脉冲序列、饱和传递差 (STD) 和用于信号分配的扩散过滤水 LOGSY 实验；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脂质纳米粒子（LNP）是核酸递送的领先平台，但使用传统方法仍然无法对其内部组织进行分子水平表征。我们开发了多相核磁共振波谱工具箱，用于对天然配方中的 LNP 进行无损、原子分辨率表征。该工具箱结合了用于层相关 1H T2 弛豫测量的扩散过滤完美回波 CPMG、多重编辑的 HSQC 实验以及用于隔离 LNP 相关信号的 HSQC-iDOSY 脉冲序列、饱和传递差 (STD) 和用于信号分配的扩散过滤水 LOGSY 实验；质子自旋扩散驱动的 NOESY 用于分配可电离脂质 (IZL) 的主干连接。该工具箱应用于在不同配方和制造条件下生产的 LNP，揭示了存在于异质化学环境中的多种可电离脂质群体。在选定的配方中检测到 PEG 脂质的空间收缩，并通过总脂质定量将其与 PEG 脱落区分开。半定量 HSQC 分析估计 7-30% 的可电离脂质驻留在颗粒表面，表面富集因子与体外转染效率相关。这些结果表明，制造参数通过传统分析方法无法解决的分子水平变化影响 LNP 结构，证明了该 NMR 工具箱在阐明配方和制造参数如何控制 LNP 结构和功能方面的实用性。通讯作者：Peyman Sakhaii (peyman.sakhaii@sanofi.com) 或 Dan Zarraga (dan.zarraga@sanofi.com)

articles.title: Early-Age Strength and Chloride-Related Performance of Particle-Packing-Designed Self-Compacting Concrete with FC3R and Recycled Coarse Aggregate for Marine Caissons
articles.title_zh: 海洋沉箱用颗粒填充设计的 FC3R 和再生粗骨料自密实混凝土的早期强度和氯化物相关性能
articles.abstract: Marine caissons require rapid strength development and early resistance to chloride-related deterioration. This study investigates particle-packing-designed self-compacting concrete containing fluid catalytic cracking catalyst residue (FC3R) and recycled coarse aggregate (RCA). Eighteen mixtures were prepared using a central composite design with 0–20% FC3R, 0–40% RCA, and water-to-binder ratios of 0.26–0.30. Compressive strength was assessed at 1 and 7 days; charge passed under ASTM C1202 at 3 and 7 days; and polarized-light petrography and X-ray diffraction were used for microstructural interpretation. Compressive strength reached 23–37 MPa at 1 day and 43–63 MPa at 7 days, with 15 mixtures approaching or exceeding 50 MPa after one week. Mean charge passed decreased from 4569.81 C to 2834.25 C between 3 and 7 days. Increasing FC3R from 0 to 20% reduced 7-day charge by 77.14% at central RCA and water contents. Although RCA penalized 1-day strength, its effect diminished as the FC3R-modified binder developed. Petrography indicated compact interfaces, and diffraction patterns showed portlandite depletion and Friedel's salt after chloride exposure. The findings support FC3R-modified recycled aggregate concrete as a potential early-age material for marine caissons.
articles.abstract_zh: 海洋沉箱需要快速的强度发展和早期抵抗氯化物相关的恶化。本研究研究了颗粒填充设计的含有流化催化裂化催化剂残渣（FC3R）和再生粗骨料（RCA）的自密实混凝土。采用中心复合材料设计制备了 18 种混合物，其中 FC3R 含量为 0–20%，RCA 含量为 0–40%，水与粘合剂的比例为 0.26–0.30。第 1 天和第 7 天评估抗压强度；充电第 3 天和第 7 天根据 ASTM C1202 通过；偏振光岩相学和 X 射线衍射用于微观结构解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 海洋沉箱需要快速的强度发展和早期抵抗氯化物相关的恶化。本研究研究了颗粒填充设计的含有流化催化裂化催化剂残渣（FC3R）和再生粗骨料（RCA）的自密实混凝土。采用中心复合材料设计制备了 18 种混合物，其中 FC3R 含量为 0–20%，RCA 含量为 0–40%，水与粘合剂的比例为 0.26–0.30。第 1 天和第 7 天评估抗压强度；充电第 3 天和第 7 天根据 ASTM C1202 通过；偏振光岩相学和 X 射线衍射用于微观结构解释。 1 天时抗压强度达到 23-37 MPa，7 天时达到 43-63 MPa，一周后有 15 种混合物接近或超过 50 MPa。 3 至 7 天内，通过的平均电荷从 4569.81 C 降至 2834.25 C。 FC3R 从 0% 增加到 20%，中心 RCA 和水含量的 7 天充电量减少了 77.14%。尽管 RCA 会影响 1 天强度，但随着 FC3R 改性粘合剂的发展，其影响逐渐减弱。岩相学显示了致密的界面，衍射图显示了氯化物暴露后的氢氧磷石消耗和弗里德尔盐。研究结果支持 FC3R 改性再生骨料混凝土作为海洋沉箱的潜在早龄材料。

articles.title: Nonlinear harmonic signatures of energy dissipation and barrier-controlled heating in magnetic nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 磁性纳米粒子中能量耗散和势垒控制加热的非线性谐波特征
articles.abstract: The nonlinear magnetic relaxation and energy dissipation of single-domain ferromagnetic nanoparticles subjected to an alternating magnetic field are investigated within the framework of the stochastic Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert equation. The effects of thermal fluctuations, magnetic anisotropy, damping, and excitation frequency on the dynamic magnetization response are examined using complementary analytical and numerical approaches. Analytical expressions for the weakly nonlinear response are obtained from a perturbative treatment of the associated Fokker–Planck equation and compared with numerical solutions of the stochastic equations of motion. Particular attention is given to the relationship between higher-order magnetization harmonics and the energy dissipated during a field cycle. It is shown that the normalized third-harmonic amplitude and the nonlinear correction to the field-normalized hysteresis loss exhibit the same quadratic dependence on field amplitude in the weakly nonlinear limit. Their relationship provides a means of characterizing departures from linear-response theory and identifying the influence of anisotropy-controlled relaxation on magnetic heating. The corresponding specific absorption rate is calculated over a range of field amplitudes, frequencies, and damping parameters, and the theoretical predictions are compared with published experimental measurements. The results establish a connection between nonlinear magnetic susceptibility, dynamic hysteresis, and thermal energy dissipation, providing a systematic basis for assessing magnetic heating beyond the linear-response approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 在随机 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程的框架内研究了单畴铁磁纳米粒子在交变磁场下的非线性磁弛豫和能量耗散。使用互补的分析和数值方法检查热波动、磁各向异性、阻尼和激励频率对动态磁化响应的影响。弱非线性响应的解析表达式是通过相关福克-普朗克方程的微扰处理获得的，并与随机运动方程的数值解进行比较。特别关注高阶磁化谐波与磁场周期期间耗散的能量之间的关系。结果表明，归一化三次谐波幅度和场归一化磁滞损耗的非线性校正在弱非线性极限下表现出与场幅度相同的二次相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在随机 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程的框架内研究了单畴铁磁纳米粒子在交变磁场下的非线性磁弛豫和能量耗散。使用互补的分析和数值方法检查热波动、磁各向异性、阻尼和激励频率对动态磁化响应的影响。弱非线性响应的解析表达式是通过相关福克-普朗克方程的微扰处理获得的，并与随机运动方程的数值解进行比较。特别关注高阶磁化谐波与磁场周期期间耗散的能量之间的关系。结果表明，归一化三次谐波幅度和场归一化磁滞损耗的非线性校正在弱非线性极限下表现出与场幅度相同的二次相关性。它们的关系提供了一种表征线性响应理论偏差和识别各向异性控制弛豫对磁加热的影响的方法。在一系列场振幅、频率和阻尼参数上计算相应的比吸收率，并将理论预测与已发表的实验测量值进行比较。结果建立了非线性磁化率、动态磁滞和热能耗散之间的联系，为评估线性响应近似之外的磁加热提供了系统基础。

articles.title: Calibrated machine learning for entanglement andmagnetic-field information in a noisy moving-atomKerr optomechanical cavity
articles.title_zh: 噪声运动原子克尔光机械腔中纠缠和磁场信息的校准机器学习
articles.abstract: In a hybrid cavity, the controls that generate atom--cavity entanglement can differ from those that make the atom sensitive to a magnetic field. We study this distinction for a moving two-level atom in a Kerr optomechanical cavity with photon loss, atomic dephasing and shot-to-shot velocity variation. We propagate the density operator and its Zeeman derivative together, average both over the unrecorded velocity, and compute atom--cavity negativity and atom-only quantum Fisher information (QFI). At the reference control, adding loss, dephasing and 10% velocity uncertainty reduces the final negativity from 0.31374 to 0.20709. At the fixed interrogation time and midpoint Hamiltonian controls, increased photon loss lowers negativity but raises atomic QFI across the sampled loss--dephasing grid. The entanglement response to Kerr coupling changes sign with the mean transit frequency. A Gaussian-process model trained on 56 trajectories yields test-set R² values of 0.915 for negativity and 0.934 for QFI. Split conformal intervals with nominal 95% marginal coverage contain 37 of 40 test labels for each target. A single equal-budget comparison leaves the advantage of variance-based acquisition over random sampling unresolved. Direct propagation of nine candidate controls increases the best checked weighted score from 0.2618 at the midpoint to 0.4026. That control strengthens atom--cavity entanglement while reducing atomic QFI relative to the midpoint. However, its fixed-basis atomic population readout has classical Fisher information only 0.0666, compared with atomic QFI 0.7799; the highest-QFI proposal gives 1.9610 and 1.9886, respectively. Thus practical readout and objective weighting must both be specified, and no computational speedup over direct search is established.
articles.abstract_zh: 在混合腔中，产生原子腔纠缠的控制可能不同于使原子对磁场敏感的控制。我们研究了克尔光机械腔中运动的两能级原子的这种区别，其中包括光子损失、原子相移和逐次速度变化。我们一起传播密度算子及其塞曼导数，对未记录的速度进行平均，并计算原子腔负性和纯原子量子费希尔信息（QFI）。在参考控制中，添加损耗、移相和 10% 速度不确定性将最终负值从 0.31374 降低到 0.20709。在固定询问时间和中点哈密顿量控制下，增加的光子损失会降低负性，但会提高采样损失相移网格上的原子 QFI。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在混合腔中，产生原子腔纠缠的控制可能不同于使原子对磁场敏感的控制。我们研究了克尔光机械腔中运动的两能级原子的这种区别，其中包括光子损失、原子相移和逐次速度变化。我们一起传播密度算子及其塞曼导数，对未记录的速度进行平均，并计算原子腔负性和纯原子量子费希尔信息（QFI）。在参考控制中，添加损耗、移相和 10% 速度不确定性将最终负值从 0.31374 降低到 0.20709。在固定询问时间和中点哈密顿量控制下，增加的光子损失会降低负性，但会提高采样损失相移网格上的原子 QFI。克尔耦合的纠缠响应随着平均渡越频率的变化而改变符号。在 56 个轨迹上训练的高斯过程模型产生的负性测试集 R² 值为 0.915，QFI 测试集 R² 值为 0.934。标称边缘覆盖率为 95% 的分割保角间隔包含每个目标 40 个测试标签中的 37 个。单一的等预算比较未能解决基于方差的采集相对于随机抽样的优势。九个候选控件的直接传播将最佳检查加权分数从中点的 0.2618 增加到 0.4026。这种控制增强了原子腔纠缠，同时减少了相对于中点的原子 QFI。然而，其固定基原子布居读数的经典Fisher信息仅为0.0666，而原子QFI为0.7799；最高的 QFI 提案分别给出 1.9610 和 1.9886。因此，必须指定实际读数和客观加权，并且不会建立比直接搜索更快的计算速度。

articles.title: Photovoltaic power forecasting using Bayesian optimized hybrid decomposition and a convolutional Transformer
articles.title_zh: 使用贝叶斯优化混合分解和卷积变压器进行光伏功率预测
articles.abstract: Accurate photovoltaic power forecasting supports the operation of electricity systems with variable renewable generation. We combine weighted similar-day selection, Bayesian optimized signal decomposition and a convolutional neural network–Transformer forecasting model. Pearson correlation analysis screens candidate features, and six complementary similarity measures identify historical days with comparable conditions. Bayesian optimization tunes variational mode decomposition, while multiscale permutation entropy identifies complex components for further processing by complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise. The resulting components are used to train recurrent, attention-based and convolutional hybrid forecasting models. Evaluation uses the SOLETE photovoltaic dataset from Denmark, with 15-minute sampling and a target period of 24–30 June 2019. The convolutional Transformer achieves a mean absolute error of 0.4761, a root mean square error of 0.6582 and a coefficient of determination of 0.8888. Hybrid decomposition reduces its mean absolute error by 10.3% relative to variational mode decomposition alone and by 30.3% relative to adaptive-noise ensemble decomposition alone. Among the six forecasting models, the convolutional Transformer has the lowest root mean square error, whereas the convolutional gated recurrent unit has the lowest mean absolute error. For this dataset and target week, these results support further evaluation of local feature extraction, attention and selective signal decomposition.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的光伏发电预测支持具有可变可再生能源发电的电力系统的运行。我们结合了加权相似日选择、贝叶斯优化信号分解和卷积神经网络 – Transformer 预测模型。皮尔逊相关分析筛选候选特征，并通过六个互补的相似性度量来识别具有可比条件的历史日期。贝叶斯优化调整变分模式分解，而多尺度排列熵通过使用自适应噪声的完整集成经验模式分解来识别复杂组件以进行进一步处理。所得组件用于训练循环、基于注意力和卷积混合预测模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的光伏发电预测支持具有可变可再生能源发电的电力系统的运行。我们结合了加权相似日选择、贝叶斯优化信号分解和卷积神经网络 – Transformer 预测模型。皮尔逊相关分析筛选候选特征，并通过六个互补的相似性度量来识别具有可比条件的历史日期。贝叶斯优化调整变分模式分解，而多尺度排列熵通过使用自适应噪声的完整集成经验模式分解来识别复杂组件以进行进一步处理。所得组件用于训练循环、基于注意力和卷积混合预测模型。评估使用丹麦的 SOLETE 光伏数据集，采样时间为 15 分钟，目标周期为 2019 年 6 月 24 日至 30 日。卷积 Transformer 的平均绝对误差为 0.4761，均方根误差为 0.6582，决定系数为 0.8888。与单独的变分模态分解相比，混合分解的平均绝对误差降低了 10.3%，与单独的自适应噪声集成分解相比，混合分解的平均绝对误差降低了 30.3%。在六种预测模型中，卷积 Transformer 具有最低的均方根误差，而卷积门控循环单元具有最低的平均绝对误差。对于该数据集和目标周，这些结果支持对局部特征提取、注意力和选择性信号分解的进一步评估。

articles.title: Year-Resolved Quasi-Static Time-Series Assessment of Photovoltaic Hosting Capacity in a 59-Bus 22 kV Egyptian Distribution Network Model
articles.title_zh: 59 总线 22 kV 埃及配电网模型中光伏托管容量的年分辨准静态时间序列评估
articles.abstract: A year-resolved quasi-static time-series (QSTS) assessment of the 59-bus, 22 kV Cairo distribution network model of [11] (peak load 50.34 MW) gives an overvoltage-limited photovoltaic (PV) hosting capacity (HC) of 165% of peak load (HC95 over 200 random placements, 1.02 p.u. substation setpoint, 95% bootstrap CI 150-189%). Each scenario uses 8760 hourly AC load flows with PVGIS-SARAH3 irradiance and a national-scale load shape built from Ember monthly demand and the EEHC peak-day curve; no feeder measurements were available. A snapshot at the year's lowest daytime load with peak PV output reproduces the level (160%), so a well-chosen snapshot is adequate on this network, while an arbitrary 25%-load snapshot (115%) is far too conservative and a 24 h mean day (215%) overestimates the HC. Overvoltage occurs on average in about 4 h per year, at 11:00-12:00 local time in spring (mostly April), and the full-year HC95 stays within 165-170% across all 19 simulated years (2005-2023). Sensitivities to tilt, load level, time alignment and substation setpoint are reported; thermal limits, whose ratings are not published, are examined only under assumed values. To the author's knowledge, this is the first year-resolved AC QSTS HC study of an Egyptian MV network model found in the literature searched. The results are conditional on the stated assumptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 对 [11] 的 59 总线、22 kV 开罗配电网模型（峰值负载 50.34 MW）进行的年分辨准静态时间序列 (QSTS) 评估给出了峰值负载 165% 的过压限制光伏 (PV) 托管容量 (HC)（超过 200 个随机布置的 HC95、1.02 p.u. 变电站设定值、95% 自举 CI） 150-189%）。每个场景均使用 8760 小时交流负载流，具有 PVGIS-SARAH3 辐照度以及根据 Ember 月度需求和 EEHC 高峰日曲线构建的全国范围负载形状；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 [11] 的 59 总线、22 kV 开罗配电网模型（峰值负载 50.34 MW）进行的年分辨准静态时间序列 (QSTS) 评估给出了峰值负载 165% 的过压限制光伏 (PV) 托管容量 (HC)（超过 200 个随机布置的 HC95、1.02 p.u. 变电站设定值、95% 自举 CI） 150-189%）。每个场景均使用 8760 小时交流负载流，具有 PVGIS-SARAH3 辐照度以及根据 Ember 月度需求和 EEHC 高峰日曲线构建的全国范围负载形状；没有可用的馈线测量。当年最低白天负载和峰值光伏输出的快照再现了该水平 (160%)，因此精心选择的快照在该网络上就足够了，而任意 25% 负载快照 (115%) 则过于保守，而 24 小时平均日负载快照 (215%) 则高估了 HC。过电压平均每年发生约4小时，发生时间为春季当地时间11:00-12:00（主要是4月），全年HC95在所有19个模拟年份（2005-2023）中都保持在165-170%之间。报告对倾斜、负载水平、时间对准和变电站设定点的敏感性；热极限的额定值未公布，仅在假设值下进行检查。据作者所知，这是在文献检索中发现的第一个针对埃及 MV 网络模型的年度解析 AC QSTS HC 研究。结果以所述假设为条件。

articles.title: Waste wheat fermentation starter valorization: Conversion into regenerable biochar for CO2 capture
articles.title_zh: 废弃小麦发酵剂的增值：转化为可再生生物炭以捕获二氧化碳
articles.abstract: Converting waste wheat fermentation starter into reusable adsorbents provides an opportunity to recover material value from fermentation waste while developing sorbents for CO2 capture. Here, waste wheat fermentation starter was valorized into biochar (Bio@JQ) through direct pyrolysis under nitrogen without externally added activating or doping agents. A three-factor Box–Behnken design was employed to optimize the BET specific surface area by varying pyrolysis temperature, nitrogen flow rate, and heating rate. The selected biochar exhibited a BET specific surface area of 141.93 m2 g− 1 and a total pore volume of 0.0568 cm3 g− 1. Structural characterization revealed a disordered carbon framework with accessible micropores and retained nitrogen- and oxygen-containing surface species. At 1 bar, Bio@JQ achieved CO2 adsorption capacities of 2.32, 1.76, and 1.36 mmol g− 1 at 273.15, 303.15, and 318.15 K, respectively, with the temperature-dependent uptake indicating exothermic adsorption. The combined structural and adsorption results were consistent with micropore filling and noncovalent interactions, with surface heteroatoms potentially contributing to CO2 affinity. Bio@JQ retained 91.88% of its initial adsorption capacity after 45 adsorption–regeneration cycles, demonstrating repeated use under the tested conditions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of converting waste wheat fermentation starter into a regenerable CO2 adsorbent through an activation-free pyrolysis route, linking fermentation-waste valorization with the development of reusable carbon-based sorbents.
articles.abstract_zh: 将废小麦发酵剂转化为可重复使用的吸附剂，提供了从发酵废物中回收材料价值的机会，同时开发用于二氧化碳捕获的吸附剂。在这里，废小麦发酵剂通过在氮气下直接热解转化为生物炭（Bio@JQ），无需外部添加活化剂或掺杂剂。采用三因素 Box-Behnken 设计通过改变热解温度、氮气流速和加热速率来优化 BET 比表面积。所选生物炭的 BET 比表面积为 141.93 m2 g− 1，总孔体积为 0.0568 cm3 g− 1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将废小麦发酵剂转化为可重复使用的吸附剂，提供了从发酵废物中回收材料价值的机会，同时开发用于二氧化碳捕获的吸附剂。在这里，废小麦发酵剂通过在氮气下直接热解转化为生物炭（Bio@JQ），无需外部添加活化剂或掺杂剂。采用三因素 Box-Behnken 设计通过改变热解温度、氮气流速和加热速率来优化 BET 比表面积。所选生物炭的 BET 比表面积为 141.93 m2 g− 1，总孔体积为 0.0568 cm3 g− 1。结构表征揭示了具有可进入微孔的无序碳框架，并保留了含氮和含氧的表面物种。在 1 bar 压力下，Bio@JQ 在 273.15、303.15 和 318.15 K 下分别实现了 2.32、1.76 和 1.36 mmol g− 1 的 CO2 吸附容量，且与温度相关的吸收表明是放热吸附。组合的结构和吸附结果与微孔填充和非共价相互作用一致，表面杂原子可能有助于二氧化碳亲和力。 Bio@JQ 在 45 次吸附再生循环后保留了 91.88% 的初始吸附能力，证明了在测试条件下的重复使用。这些发现证明了通过免活化热解途径将废小麦发酵剂转化为可再生二氧化碳吸附剂的可行性，将发酵废物增值与可重复使用的碳基吸附剂的开发联系起来。

articles.title: Electronic force fields and their associated local charge densities in small molecules featuring conventional covalent and charge-shift bonds and in contact ion pairs
articles.title_zh: 具有传统共价键和电荷转移键以及接触离子对的小分子中的电子力场及其相关的局部电荷密度
articles.abstract: This article first reviews the theoretical formalism based on electronic force fields and their associated local charge densities and identifies promising directions for further research. Within this framework, the Slater total static potential (:ϕ:ₑₘleft(rright)) acting on an electron in an (:N)-electron chemical system is formally defined here by averaging the Coulomb interaction energy operator for electron (:i), (:widehatVᵢ), over the conditional probability distribution of the remaining (:N-1) electrons, given that electron (:i) is at (:r). This definition provides a rigorous basis for deriving chemically significant physical quantities. The article then presents quantum-chemical calculations at a correlated level of theory for LiF, LiH, HF, BN, CO, NO, N2, N2H4, N2O4, H2O2, and F2. Particular attention is given to the phenomena of interatomic electron transfer and consequent quantum chemical response, as revealed by the superposition of the electron density gradient field (:nabla:ρ:left(rright)), the per-electron electrostatic force field (:Fₑₛleft(rright)), and the Slater total static force field (:Fleft(rright)=-nabla:ϕ:ₑₘleft(rright)). The analysis further addresses electron-pair density condensation and decondensation in the many-electron cloud, which are represented by regions where the Slater exchange–correlation charge density (:qₓcleft(rright)=nabla:·:left[Fleft(rright)-Fₑₛleft(rright)right]/left(4π:right)) takes negative and positive values, respectively. Importantly, charge-shift bonding is shown to manifest itself in real space as electron-pair density decondensation within internuclear binding regions, with this decondensation apparently driven by Coulomb correlation. On this basis, covalent bonds whose internuclear binding regions exhibit such decondensation, as indicated by positive values of (:qₓcleft(rright)), are proposed to constitute a distinct class, here termed electron-pair-deficient covalent bonds. Finally, theoretical analysis of (:Fleft(rright)) allows tensile and compressive principal modes of the local linear variation of the scalar Cartesian components of this force field to be distinguished along their respective principal directions. These modes are characterized by the eigenvalues of the Hessian of (:ϕ:ₑₘleft(rright)) at the corresponding saddle-type Lagrange point of (:Fleft(rright)). In this context, the tensile principal mode is more pronounced relative to the compressive principal modes in charge-shift bonds than in conventional homoatomic covalent bonds, with the former representing attraction of the electron cloud toward the nuclei and the latter representing attraction of the electron cloud toward the bond axis. Thus, the force-field and charge-density perspective on chemical structure yields robust orbital-free descriptors of interatomic interactions, thereby enabling the charge-shift character of electron-pair-deficient covalent bonds to be captured and quantified outside the framework of valence bond theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首先回顾了基于电子力场及其相关局部电荷密度的理论形式，并确定了进一步研究的有希望的方向。在此框架内，作用于 (:N)-电子化学系统中的电子的 Slater 总静态电势 (:ψ:ₑₘleft(rright)) 在这里通过对电子 (:i)、(:widehatVᵢ) 的库仑相互作用能量算子在剩余 (:N-1) 个电子的条件概率分布上进行平均来正式定义，假设电子 (:i) 位于 (:r)。该定义为推导具有化学意义的物理量提供了严格的基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文首先回顾了基于电子力场及其相关局部电荷密度的理论形式，并确定了进一步研究的有希望的方向。在此框架内，作用于 (:N)-电子化学系统中的电子的 Slater 总静态电势 (:ψ:ₑₘleft(rright)) 在这里通过对电子 (:i)、(:widehatVᵢ) 的库仑相互作用能量算子在剩余 (:N-1) 个电子的条件概率分布上进行平均来正式定义，假设电子 (:i) 位于 (:r)。该定义为推导具有化学意义的物理量提供了严格的基础。然后，本文介绍了 LiF、LiH、HF、BN、CO、NO、N2、N2H4、N2O4、H2O2 和 F2 的相关理论水平的量子化学计算。特别关注原子间电子转移和随之而来的量子化学反应的现象，如电子密度梯度场 (:nabla:ρ:left(rright))、每电子静电力场 (:Fₑₛleft(rright)) 和 Slater 总静力场 (:Fleft(rright)=-nabla:phi:ₑₘleft(rright)) 的叠加所揭示的。该分析进一步解决了多电子云中的电子对密度凝聚和解凝聚问题，这由斯莱特交换相关电荷密度 (:qₓcleft(rright)=nabla:·:left[Fleft(rright)-Fₑₛleft(rright)right]/left(4π:right)) 分别取负值和正值的区域表示。重要的是，电荷转移键合在真实空间中表现为核间结合区域内的电子对密度去凝聚，这种去凝聚显然是由库仑相关性驱动的。在此基础上，核间结合区域表现出这种解缩合的共价键，如 (:qₓcleft(rright)) 的正值所示，被提议构成一个独特的类别，这里称为电子对缺陷共价键。最后，(:Fleft(rright)) 的理论分析允许沿各自的主方向区分该力场的标量笛卡尔分量的局部线性变化的拉伸和压缩主模式。这些模态的特征在于 (:Fleft(rright)) 相应鞍型拉格朗日点处 (:ψ:ₑₘleft(rright)) 的 Hessian 特征值。在这种情况下，电荷转移键中的拉伸主模式比传统同原子共价键中的压缩主模式更明显，前者代表电子云朝向原子核的吸引力，后者代表电子云朝向键轴的吸引力。因此，化学结构的力场和电荷密度视角产生了原子间相互作用的稳健的无轨道描述符，从而使得缺电子对共价键的电荷转移特征能够在价键理论框架之外被捕获和量化。

articles.title: Development and testing of a low-cost RGB–depth camera and concept of operations for lunar south polar exploration in support of the Artemis program
articles.title_zh: 开发和测试低成本 RGB 深度相机以及支持阿耳忒弥斯计划的月球南极探索操作概念
articles.abstract: Acquiring high-spatial-resolution three-dimensional (3D) surface data at the lunar south pole is a critical enabler for in situ resource utilization (ISRU), geological field work, and immersive virtual reality mission operations support, capabilities identified as priorities by the Artemis III Science Definition Team Report. Here we report the development, ground-based testing, and spaceflight deployment of a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) RGB-depth (RGBD) time-of-flight camera (the Microsoft Azure Kinect) aboard the Lunar Outpost MAPP rover on the Intuitive Machines IM-2 mission. The instrument was ruggedized for spaceflight to Technology Readiness Level 6, and a custom software application (AKALL) was developed to minimize power and data demands. Four testing campaigns validated a four-mode concept of operations covering dust interference, power and bandwidth constraints, field acquisition methodology, and optimal imaging parameters, with sub-centimeter reconstruction fidelity confirmed. Although the MAPP rover could not be deployed after the IM-2 lander tipped on landing, thermal telemetry confirmed camera survivability and a successful command uplink verified software integration. These results provide a validated, low-cost framework for RGBD depth-data collection on future CLPS missions in direct support of crewed Artemis surface operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在月球南极获取高空间分辨率三维 (3D) 表面数据是原位资源利用 (ISRU)、地质现场工作和沉浸式虚拟现实任务操作支持的关键推动因素，这些功能被《阿尔忒弥斯 III》科学定义团队报告确定为优先事项。在此，我们报告了 Intuitive Machines IM-2 任务中月球前哨站 MAPP 漫游车上商用现成 (COTS) RGB 深度 (RGBD) 飞行时间相机（Microsoft Azure Kinect）的开发、地面测试和航天部署。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在月球南极获取高空间分辨率三维 (3D) 表面数据是原位资源利用 (ISRU)、地质现场工作和沉浸式虚拟现实任务操作支持的关键推动因素，这些功能被《阿尔忒弥斯 III》科学定义团队报告确定为优先事项。在此，我们报告了 Intuitive Machines IM-2 任务中月球前哨站 MAPP 漫游车上商用现成 (COTS) RGB 深度 (RGBD) 飞行时间相机（Microsoft Azure Kinect）的开发、地面测试和航天部署。该仪器经过加固，可用于航天，达到技术准备级别 6，并开发了定制软件应用程序 (AKALL)，以最大程度地减少功率和数据需求。四项测试活动验证了四模式操作概念，涵盖灰尘干扰、功率和带宽限制、现场采集方法和最佳成像参数，并确认了亚厘米重建保真度。尽管 IM-2 着陆器倾斜着陆后 MAPP 漫游车无法部署，但热遥测确认了相机的生存能力和成功的命令上行链路验证软件集成。这些结果为未来 CLPS 任务中的 RGBD 深度数据收集提供了一个经过验证的低成本框架，以直接支持载人 Artemis 地面操作。

articles.title: Effects of dopants and composite formulations on heat transfer and reaction kinetics in calcium hydroxide thermochemical energy storage
articles.title_zh: 掺杂剂和复合配方对氢氧化钙热化学储能传热和反应动力学的影响
articles.abstract: Dopants and composite formulations are widely proposed to accelerate the dehydration and hydration of Ca(OH)2 and to overcome the poor heat transfer of its powder beds, but each additive is usually tested in a single study, which makes reported gains hard to compare. We compiled and harmonised a dataset of 20,904 records from 90 publications (1994–2026) and analysed its 15,170 experimental records (69 publications, 483 samples). Each modified sample was compared only with the unmodified reference of its own publication, effects were pooled at publication level with cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, predictive models were validated on withheld publications, and a coupled heat-transfer and reaction model translated the pooled effects to bed scale. Chemical dopants lowered the dehydration onset temperature in all four publications that allowed the comparison (median − 30 K). Apparent activation energies fell in 6 of 8 publications (median − 29 kJ mol− 1, not significant), but a kinetic compensation effect (R2 = 0.80; isokinetic temperature 387°C) offset most of this change. Conductive fillers raised effective thermal conductivity up to 3.8-fold, and energy-density losses matched inert dilution. For a 10 mm bed charged at 500°C, the model predicts that a ten-fold faster rate constant shortens charging by only 11%, whereas a three-fold higher conductivity shortens it by 69%, because beds thicker than about 1 mm are conduction-controlled. Under publication-grouped validation, the best machine-learning model explained 32% of the variance in conversion, compared with 87% for row-level random splits.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们广泛提出使用掺杂剂和复合配方来加速 Ca(OH)2 的脱水和水合，并克服其粉末床传热不良的问题，但每种添加剂通常在一项研究中进行测试，这使得报告的增益难以比较。我们编制并协调了来自 90 篇出版物（1994-2026 年）的 20,904 条记录的数据集，并分析了其 15,170 条实验记录（69 篇出版物，483 个样本）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们广泛提出使用掺杂剂和复合配方来加速 Ca(OH)2 的脱水和水合，并克服其粉末床传热不良的问题，但每种添加剂通常在一项研究中进行测试，这使得报告的增益难以比较。我们编制并协调了来自 90 篇出版物（1994-2026 年）的 20,904 条记录的数据集，并分析了其 15,170 条实验记录（69 篇出版物，483 个样本）。每个修改后的样本仅与其自己出版物的未修改参考进行比较，在出版物水平上通过聚类引导置信区间汇总效应，在保留的出版物上验证预测模型，并且耦合传热和反应模型将汇总效应转化为床规模。化学掺杂剂降低了所有四篇可进行比较的出版物中的脱水起始温度（中值 − 30 K）。 8 篇出版物中有 6 篇的表观活化能下降（中位值 − 29 kJ mol− 1，不显着），但动力学补偿效应（R2 = 0.80；等速温度 387°C）抵消了大部分变化。导电填料将有效导热率提高了 3.8 倍，能量密度损失与惰性稀释相匹配。对于在 500°C 下充电的 10 毫米床，该模型预测，速率常数提高 10 倍，充电时间仅缩短 11%，而电导率提高三倍，则充电时间缩短 69%，因为厚度超过 1 毫米的床是受传导控制的。在按出版物分组的验证下，最好的机器学习模型解释了 32% 的转换方差，而行级随机分割的解释率为 87%。

articles.title: Biomass Map Calibration Cannot Recover Omitted Trees: Evidence from a Tropical University Campus
articles.title_zh: 生物量地图校准无法恢复遗漏的树木：来自热带大学校园的证据
articles.abstract: Background Credible accounting of tree carbon stocks is essential for evaluating nature-based climate mitigation. Satellite biomass maps provide spatial coverage for such assessments, but their estimates often require calibration against field observations to account for local vegetation characteristics. However, when field data are limited or unrepresentative, calibration may produce apparently consistent estimates while leaving substantial tree carbon unaccounted for. This study examined this problem at a tropical university campus in Ghana using archived tree measurements, georeferenced stem counts, and ESA CCI biomass maps.Results Six unlocated garden plots containing 325 measured stems yielded a field-to-map biomass ratio of 1.49, closely matching the ratio of 1.47 obtained from four georeferenced garden polygons using counted stems and plot-derived stem mass. Both approaches estimated 18.6–18.8 kt C of aboveground tree carbon across the 1000 ha. Despite this agreement, individual polygon ratios ranged from 0.96 to 3.34, and alternative microsite assumptions shifted the location estimate from 7.4 to 29.6 kt C. The biomass map assigned zero biomass to 43% of the campus from 2019 to 2024, including two parkland polygons containing 384 stems counted during subsequent fieldwork. Multiplicative calibration could not recover biomass in these areas, with assumption-dependent scenarios indicating 0.1–9.6 kt C of potentially omitted carbon dioxide. Changes in mapped carbon between 2005 and 2024 were not detectable under the tested uncertainty scenarios in this study.Conclusions Agreement between biomass map calibration factors does not establish inventory accuracy or completeness. Reliable tree carbon accounting requires spatially matched measurements, explicit treatment of unmapped trees, and recognition of structural uncertainty. Measuring tree diameters outside forests is essential for quantifying omitted carbon.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景 树木碳储量的可靠核算对于评估基于自然的气候缓解措施至关重要。卫星生物量地图为此类评估提供了空间覆盖范围，但它们的估计通常需要根据现场观测进行校准，以考虑当地植被特征。然而，当现场数据有限或不具有代表性时，校准可能会产生明显一致的估计，同时留下大量的树木碳未被计算在内。本研究在加纳的一所热带大学校园中使用存档的树木测量值、地理参考茎计数和 ESA CCI 生物量图研究了这个问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景 树木碳储量的可靠核算对于评估基于自然的气候缓解措施至关重要。卫星生物量地图为此类评估提供了空间覆盖范围，但它们的估计通常需要根据现场观测进行校准，以考虑当地植被特征。然而，当现场数据有限或不具有代表性时，校准可能会产生明显一致的估计，同时留下大量的树木碳未被计算在内。本研究在加纳的一所热带大学校园中使用存档的树木测量值、地理参考茎计数和 ESA CCI 生物量图研究了这个问题。 结果 包含 325 个测量茎的 6 个未定位花园地块得出的田地与地图生物量比率为 1.49，与使用计数的茎和地块衍生的茎质量从四个地理参考花园多边形获得的 1.47 的比率非常接近。两种方法均估计 1000 公顷地上树木碳含量为 18.6–18.8 kt C。尽管达成了这一协议，但各个多边形比率的范围为 0.96 至 3.34，并且替代微站点假设将位置估计值从 7.4 kt C 更改为 29.6 kt C。生物量地图将 2019 年至 2024 年期间校园 43% 的生物量分配为零生物量，其中包括在后续实地工作中计数的包含 384 个茎的两个公园用地多边形。乘法校准无法恢复这些地区的生物量，假设相关情景表明可能省略了 0.1-9.6 kt C 的二氧化碳。在本研究中测试的不确定性情景下，无法检测到 2005 年至 2024 年绘制的碳的变化。结论 生物量地图校准因子之间的一致性并不能确定清单的准确性或完整性。可靠的树木碳核算需要空间匹配的测量、对未绘制地图的树木的明确处理以及结构不确定性的识别。测量森林外的树木直径对于量化遗漏的碳至关重要。

articles.title: Do Pretrained Encoders Absorb Thermodynamic Priors? A Controlled Study of Physics-Inspired Features for Image Splicing Localization
articles.title_zh: 预训练编码器是否吸收热力学先验？图像拼接定位的物理启发特征的受控研究
articles.abstract: unboldmath Localization networks for image splicing often add an entropy or noise stream to an RGB backbone, yet few studies test whether such physics-inspired priors add information a high-capacity encoder cannot learn. We model local image statistics as a canonical ensemble: patch Shannon entropy splits into mean pixel entropy and mixing entropy, residual variance estimates a local noise temperature, and a splice boundary acts as an interface between regions of different Helmholtz free energy. We test this thermodynamic prior under four controls. Used alone, fixed thermodynamic maps localize splicing no better than an uninformative all-forged mask on five of six benchmarks. A linear probe shows that a frozen ImageNet-pretrained HRNet-W32 already encodes patch entropy ((R²=0.83)) and noise temperature ((R²=0.71)), versus (0.56) and (0.44) for a random encoder. Across encoder capacities, the prior helps only weak encoders (trained from scratch or on 10% of the data), mainly on Columbia ((+0.056± 0.016) (F₁) over three seeds), but not fully trained pretrained ones ((-0.005) mean zero-shot (F₁)). Removing a learnable thermodynamic layer from a pretrained SegFormer never lowers (F₁) by more than (0.004) on eight benchmarks and cuts training cost by 63%. Scale-matched controls show that the maps' boundary evidence is largely explained by patch brightness and contrast; noise temperature beats these controls by only (0.015)--(0.023) at boundaries on two datasets. Uncertainty-based loss weighting lets the physics terms starve the segmentation loss. Trained only on CASIA v2, our baseline reaches zero-shot (F₁) of (0.766) on CASIA v1, (0.349) on NIST16 and (0.568) on IMD2020.
articles.abstract_zh: unboldmath 用于图像拼接的定位网络通常会向 RGB 主干添加熵或噪声流，但很少有研究测试这种受物理启发的先验是否添加了高容量编码器无法学习的信息。我们将局部图像统计建模为规范系综：补丁香农熵分裂为平均像素熵和混合熵，残差方差估计局部噪声温度，并且拼接边界充当不同亥姆霍兹自由能区域之间的界面。我们在四个控制下测试了这个热力学先验。单独使用时，固定热力学图在六个基准测试中的五个上定位拼接并不比无信息的全锻造掩模好。
articles.abstract_zh_full: unboldmath 用于图像拼接的定位网络通常会向 RGB 主干添加熵或噪声流，但很少有研究测试这种受物理启发的先验是否添加了高容量编码器无法学习的信息。我们将局部图像统计建模为规范系综：补丁香农熵分裂为平均像素熵和混合熵，残差方差估计局部噪声温度，并且拼接边界充当不同亥姆霍兹自由能区域之间的界面。我们在四个控制下测试了这个热力学先验。单独使用时，固定热力学图在六个基准测试中的五个上定位拼接并不比无信息的全锻造掩模好。线性探针显示，冷冻 ImageNet 预训练的 HRNet-W32 已经编码了补丁熵 ((R²=0.83)) 和噪声温度 ((R²=0.71))，而随机编码器则为 (0.56) 和 (0.44)。在编码器能力方面，先验仅帮助弱编码器（从头开始训练或在 10% 的数据上训练），主要是在哥伦比亚（超过三个种子的（+0.056±0.016）（F₁）），但不能帮助完全训练的预训练编码器（（-0.005）平均零样本（F₁））。在八个基准测试中，从预训练的 SegFormer 中删除可学习的热力学层不会使 (F₁) 降低超过 (0.004)，并将训练成本降低 63%。比例匹配的控制表明，地图的边界证据很大程度上是由斑块的亮度和对比度来解释的；在两个数据集的边界处，噪声温度仅比这些控制高出 (0.015)--(0.023)。基于不确定性的损失加权可以让物理术语减少分割损失。仅在 CASIA v2 上进行训练，我们的基线在 CASIA v1 上达到 (0.766)、在 NIST16 上达到 (0.349) 以及在 IMD2020 上达到 (0.568) 的零样本 (F₁)。

articles.title: Critical parameters of thermomagnetic convection in a ferrofluid inside a stationary cylindrical annulus
articles.title_zh: 静止圆柱环内铁磁流体热磁对流的关键参数
articles.abstract: A ferrofluid (water-based or oil-based) is confined in a cylindrical annulus subject to a radial temperature gradient and a magnetic field created by a stack of magnets inserted inside the inner cylinder. The interaction of magnetic field with the ferrofluid magnetization generates the Kelvin force, non-conservative component of which, plays the role of the magnetic buoyancy with a magnetic gravity. This magnetic buoyancy can generate thermo-magnetic convection in the ferrofluid. The conditions for triggering thermo-gravitational and thermo-magnetic convective flows induced by the Archimedean buoyancy and the magnetic buoyancy are analyzed with linear stability analysis (LSA). Thermo-gravitational modes are oscillatory axisymmetric rolls while thermo-magnetic modes appear in form of stationary helical convective rolls. For moderate Archimedean buoyancy, thermo-magnetic modes appear in form of stationary columnar rolls.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁磁流体（水基或油基）被限制在圆柱环内，受到径向温度梯度和插入内圆柱内的一堆磁体产生的磁场的影响。磁场与铁磁流体磁化强度的相互作用产生开尔文力，其非保守分量起到磁浮力和磁重力的作用。这种磁浮力可以在铁磁流体中产生热磁对流。利用线性稳定性分析（LSA）分析了阿基米德浮力和磁浮力引起的热重力和热磁对流的触发条件。热重力模式是振荡轴对称辊，而热磁模式以固定螺旋对流辊的形式出现。对于中等阿基米德浮力，热磁模式以固定柱状辊的形式出现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁磁流体（水基或油基）被限制在圆柱环内，受到径向温度梯度和插入内圆柱内的一堆磁体产生的磁场的影响。磁场与铁磁流体磁化强度的相互作用产生开尔文力，其非保守分量起到磁浮力和磁重力的作用。这种磁浮力可以在铁磁流体中产生热磁对流。利用线性稳定性分析（LSA）分析了阿基米德浮力和磁浮力引起的热重力和热磁对流的触发条件。热重力模式是振荡轴对称辊，而热磁模式以固定螺旋对流辊的形式出现。对于中等阿基米德浮力，热磁模式以固定柱状辊的形式出现。

articles.title: Spatially validated machine learning distinguishes texture-controlled from texture-independent metals in coastal sediments of Bohai Bay, China
articles.title_zh: 经空间验证的机器学习可区分中国渤海湾沿海沉积物中纹理控制的金属和纹理无关的金属
articles.abstract: Machine-learning models of heavy metals in sediments are usually evaluated with a single random train–test split, which ignores spatial autocorrelation and says little about why a metal is, or is not, predictable. We re-analysed an open dataset of 161 surface sediments from the coast off Tangshan (Bohai Bay, China) to test how well Al2O3, grain size, water depth and location predict Cr, Cu, Zn, Ni, Pb, As, Cd and Hg. Seven learners were tuned by nested cross-validation and scored under random and spatial leave-block-out designs. Under spatial validation the best models explained 83–92% of the variance of Cr, Cu and Zn, 56% of Ni (83% when one geochemically anomalous sample was not scored), 38–62% of Pb and As, at most 32% of Cd, and none of Hg. Across 200 repetitions of a single 80/20 split, test R² ranged from 0.54 to 0.94 for Cr and from − 0.13 to 0.94 for Ni. Predictor ablation and exact Shapley values attributed Cr, Cu, Zn and Ni mainly to Al2O3 and grain size and As to a west–east gradient, whereas Hg showed no spatial structure; this grouping agrees with the published receptor-model apportionment. Conformalised quantile regression brought the coverage of nominal 90% intervals to 0.87–0.93, against 0.68–0.79 without calibration. A baseline conditioned on texture alone flagged ten stations where at least three metals exceeded their expected concentrations, most of them in the western sector, and avoided the false enrichment that linear Al normalisation produced in low-Al sands. The contrast between texture-based and location-based predictability is a simple, spatially validated complement to receptor modelling.
articles.abstract_zh: 沉积物中重金属的机器学习模型通常通过单个随机训练-测试分割进行评估，该模型忽略了空间自相关性，并且很少说明为什么金属是可预测的或不可预测的。我们重新分析了唐山（中国渤海湾）沿海 161 个表层沉积物的开放数据集，以测试 Al2O3、颗粒尺寸、水深和位置预测 Cr、Cu、Zn、Ni、Pb、As、Cd 和 Hg 的效果。七名学习者通过嵌套交叉验证进行调整，并根据随机和空间留出设计进行评分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沉积物中重金属的机器学习模型通常通过单个随机训练-测试分割进行评估，该模型忽略了空间自相关性，并且很少说明为什么金属是可预测的或不可预测的。我们重新分析了唐山（中国渤海湾）沿海 161 个表层沉积物的开放数据集，以测试 Al2O3、颗粒尺寸、水深和位置预测 Cr、Cu、Zn、Ni、Pb、As、Cd 和 Hg 的效果。七名学习者通过嵌套交叉验证进行调整，并根据随机和空间留出设计进行评分。在空间验证下，最佳模型解释了 Cr、Cu 和 Zn 的 83-92% 的方差，Ni 的 56%（当未对一个地球化学异常样本进行评分时为 83%），Pb 和 As 的 38-62%，最多 32% 的 Cd，并且没有解释 Hg。在单次 80/20 分割的 200 次重复中，Cr 的测试 R² 范围为 0.54 至 0.94，Ni 的测试 R² 范围为 - 0.13 至 0.94。预测烧蚀和精确的 Shapley 值将 Cr、Cu、Zn 和 Ni 主要归因于 Al2O3 和晶粒尺寸，将 As 归因于东西梯度，而 Hg 则没有表现出空间结构；该分组与已发表的受体模型分配一致。保形分位数回归使标称 90% 区间的覆盖范围达到 0.87-0.93，而未经校准时为 0.68-0.79。仅以纹理为条件的基线标记了十个站点，其中至少三种金属超出了预期浓度，其中大多数位于西部地区，并避免了线性铝标准化在低铝砂中产生的错误富集。基于纹理的可预测性和基于位置的可预测性之间的对比是对受体建模的简单、经空间验证的补充。

articles.title: Calcium-enriched whey protein hydrolysate enhances calcium transport across Caco-2 monolayers: identification of calcium-binding peptides using a perfused intestine-on-chip
articles.title_zh: 富钙乳清蛋白水解物增强跨 Caco-2 单层的钙转运：使用灌注肠芯片鉴定钙结合肽
articles.abstract: Calcium transport from food matrices may be influenced by the protein hydrolysates with which it is consumed. This study compared calcium transport from a commercial bovine whey protein hydrolysate, with and without calcium chloride enrichment, across Caco-2 monolayers cultured in commercial Transwell inserts and in two low-cost, perfused intestine-on-chip (IoC) devices: a single-use acrylic device and a reusable polydimethylsiloxane device. Calcium was quantified by electrospray ionization mass spectrometry following complexation with ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid, and transported peptides were examined by matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization tandem mass spectrometry. In the static Transwell model, apparent calcium permeability from the hydrolysate was 10.2 ± 1.0 × 10⁻⁵ cm s⁻¹, compared with 3.8 ± 1.7 × 10⁻⁵ cm s⁻¹ for calcium chloride alone at the same calcium load. Perfused IoC culture supported confluent, tight-junction-positive monolayers by day 8, compared with day 21 in static Transwell culture, demonstrating faster establishment of the epithelial barrier. Two casein-derived peptide sequences were detected in transport samples, with calcium-associated ions providing candidates for further investigation. Together, these findings indicate greater apparent calcium permeability with hydrolysate in the Transwell model and demonstrate the potential of both perfused IoC devices for food-related transport studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 食物基质中的钙转运可能会受到与其一起食用的蛋白质水解产物的影响。这项研究比较了商业牛乳清蛋白水解物（有或没有氯化钙富集）在商业 Transwell 插入物和两种低成本灌注肠片 (IoC) 装置（一次性丙烯酸装置和可重复使用的聚二甲基硅氧烷装置）中培养的 Caco-2 单层细胞中的钙转运。与乙二胺四乙酸络合后，通过电喷雾电离质谱法对钙进行定量，并通过基质辅助激光解吸/电离串联质谱法检查转运的肽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 食物基质中的钙转运可能会受到与其一起食用的蛋白质水解产物的影响。这项研究比较了商业牛乳清蛋白水解物（有或没有氯化钙富集）在商业 Transwell 插入物和两种低成本灌注肠片 (IoC) 装置（一次性丙烯酸装置和可重复使用的聚二甲基硅氧烷装置）中培养的 Caco-2 单层细胞中的钙转运。与乙二胺四乙酸络合后，通过电喷雾电离质谱法对钙进行定量，并通过基质辅助激光解吸/电离串联质谱法检查转运的肽。在静态 Transwell 模型中，在相同钙负载量下，水解产物的表观钙渗透率为 10.2±±1.0 × 10-5 cm s-1，而单独氯化钙的表观钙渗透率为 3.8±1.7 × 10-5 cm s-1。与静态 Transwell 培养中第 21 天相比，灌注 IoC 培养在第 8 天支持汇合、紧密连接阳性单层细胞，这表明上皮屏障的建立更快。在运输样品中检测到两种酪蛋白衍生的肽序列，其中钙相关离子为进一步研究提供了候选物。总之，这些发现表明 Transwell 模型中水解产物具有更大的表观钙渗透性，并证明了两种灌注 IoC 装置在食品相关运输研究中的潜力。

articles.title: QUBO-EASE: Per-Term Ensemble Weighting as a Quantum-Ready Binary Optimisation Problem for Hierarchical Protein Function Prediction
articles.title_zh: QUBO-EASE：每项集成加权作为分层蛋白质功能预测的量子就绪二元优化问题
articles.abstract: Quantum machine learning models for protein function prediction must compress protein language model embeddings to fit a few qubits, and matched-control studies have found no standalone advantage for them. We move the quantum-compatible component from feature processing to ensemble construction. In the proposed framework, QUBO-EASE, five classical base models are trained on full 1280-dimensional ESM-2 embeddings. For each Gene Ontology term, combination weights are obtained by minimising a quadratic energy built from weighted error correlation, pairwise synergy and model merit, encoded with three bits per model (15 binary variables per term). The weighted scores are refined by multi-channel fusion, a closed-form label co-occurrence model (EASE), logistic calibration, prior adjustment and per-protein normalisation. On 40,000 CAFA6 proteins and 180 terms, with a random 70/15/15 split and one seed, the framework reached an aspect-mean maximum F-measure of 0.5592, above logistic stacking (0.5479), simple averaging (0.5280), XGBoost (0.5252), a reimplemented DeepGOPlus (0.5236) and 14 other methods; the reported paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero. Removing calibration and post-processing lowered the score by 0.0147, and replacing exhaustive search with simulated annealing lowered it by 0.0040. A 10-qubit quantum neural network did not differ significantly from its parameter-matched control (+ 0.0043), and a ZZ quantum kernel scored below an RBF kernel (− 0.0199). The QUBO instances were solved by classical exhaustive search, no quantum hardware or simulator was used for them, and the separate contributions of QUBO weighting and EASE were not isolated. We attribute the gain to the pipeline as a whole and not to quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 用于蛋白质功能预测的量子机器学习模型必须压缩蛋白质语言模型嵌入以适应几个量子位，并且匹配控制研究发现它们没有独立的优势。我们将量子兼容组件从特征处理转移到集成构建。在所提出的 QUBO-EASE 框架中，五个经典基础模型在完整的 1280 维 ESM-2 嵌入上进行训练。对于每个基因本体术语，通过最小化由加权误差相关性、成对协同作用和模型优点构建的二次能量来获得组合权重，每个模型用三位编码（每个术语 15 个二进制变量）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于蛋白质功能预测的量子机器学习模型必须压缩蛋白质语言模型嵌入以适应几个量子位，并且匹配控制研究发现它们没有独立的优势。我们将量子兼容组件从特征处理转移到集成构建。在所提出的 QUBO-EASE 框架中，五个经典基础模型在完整的 1280 维 ESM-2 嵌入上进行训练。对于每个基因本体术语，通过最小化由加权误差相关性、成对协同作用和模型优点构建的二次能量来获得组合权重，每个模型用三位编码（每个术语 15 个二进制变量）。加权分数通过多通道融合、封闭式标签共现模型 (EASE)、逻辑校准、事先调整和每个蛋白质归一化进行细化。在 40,000 个 CAFA6 蛋白和 180 个术语上，随机 70/15/15 分割和一个种子，该框架达到了 0.5592 的方面平均最大 F 测量值，高于逻辑堆叠 (0.5479)、简单平均 (0.5280)、XGBoost (0.5252)、重新实现的 DeepGOPlus (0.5236) 和 14 种其他方法；报告的配对引导间隔不包括零。删除校准和后处理将分数降低了 0.0147，用模拟退火替换穷举搜索将分数降低了 0.0040。 10 量子位量子神经网络与其参数匹配控制 (+ 0.0043) 没有显着差异，并且 ZZ 量子内核的得分低于 RBF 内核 (− 0.0199)。 QUBO 实例是通过经典穷举搜索来解决的，没有使用量子硬件或模拟器，并且 QUBO 加权和 EASE 的单独贡献也不是孤立的。我们将增益归因于整个管道，而不是量子计算。
