articles.title: Direct amplification of octave-spanning coherent infrared spectra enabled by chirped quasi-phase matching
articles.title_zh: 通过啁啾准相位匹配直接放大倍频程相干红外光谱
articles.abstract: Broadband coherent laser sources spanning optical octaves are essential for advancing ultrafast spectroscopy, waveform synthesis, and attosecond science. However, direct amplification of octave-spanning spectra remains a fundamental challenge because the finite phase-matching bandwidth of nonlinear crystals prevents conventional optical parametric amplification (OPA) from simultaneously providing efficient gain over an ultrabroadband spectral range. Here, we introduce chirped quasi-phase matching (CQPM) for direct amplification of octave-spanning coherent spectra. By engineering the nonlinear reciprocal lattice through a tailored chirped polarization structure, different spectral components satisfy their optimal phase-matching conditions at different positions inside a single nonlinear crystal, enabling distributed spectral amplification. Using a dispersion-poling co-designed chirped periodically poled lithium niobate crystal in a two-stage OPA, we demonstrate broadband parametric amplification covering signal and idler spectra from 1.3 to 4.2 μm with a pulse energy of 65 μJ at 1 kHz repetition rate. The CEP-stabilized mid-infrared idler pulses support a transform-limited duration approaching a single optical cycle.
articles.abstract_zh: 跨越光学倍频程的宽带相干激光源对于推进超快光谱、波形合成和阿秒科学至关重要。然而，倍频程光谱的直接放大仍然是一个基本挑战，因为非线性晶体的有限相位匹配带宽阻止了传统的光学参量放大（OPA）同时在超宽带光谱范围内提供有效的增益。在这里，我们引入了啁啾准相位匹配（CQPM）来直接放大倍频程相干光谱。通过定制的啁啾偏振结构设计非线性倒易晶格，不同的光谱分量在单个非线性晶体内的不同位置满足其最佳相位匹配条件，从而实现分布式光谱放大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 跨越光学倍频程的宽带相干激光源对于推进超快光谱、波形合成和阿秒科学至关重要。然而，倍频程光谱的直接放大仍然是一个基本挑战，因为非线性晶体的有限相位匹配带宽阻止了传统的光学参量放大（OPA）同时在超宽带光谱范围内提供有效的增益。在这里，我们引入了啁啾准相位匹配（CQPM）来直接放大倍频程相干光谱。通过定制的啁啾偏振结构设计非线性倒易晶格，不同的光谱分量在单个非线性晶体内的不同位置满足其最佳相位匹配条件，从而实现分布式光谱放大。在两级 OPA 中使用色散极化共同设计的啁啾周期性极化铌酸锂晶体，我们演示了宽带参量放大，覆盖 1.3 至 4.2 μm 的信号和闲频光谱，脉冲能量为 65 μJ，重复频率为 1 kHz。 CEP 稳定的中红外空闲脉冲支持接近单个光学周期的变换有限持续时间。

articles.title: Incremental, persistent and concurrent finite element connectivity for mesh cutting and crack growth
articles.title_zh: 用于网格切割和裂纹扩展的增量、持续和并发有限元连接
articles.abstract: In three-dimensional crack growth, the solver connectivity of a conforming mesh is usually recomputed at every increment. We update it after each local edit at a cost per edited element independent of the mesh size, plus a directory copy per commit. Counting relations (counts of the elements that contain each node pair) provide exact update rules, with proofs, for inverse incidence, the sparsity pattern, assembly destinations and facet adjacency; unedited elements keep their destinations. Versions are committed and restored in constant time, so one rollback undoes a rejected growth step. A local Steiner-point-free cutter, proved equivalent to our batch cutter, inserts and grows cracks and cuts independent edge groups concurrently. With elements of 1/64 of the crack radius, the stress intensity factors, which the interaction integral averages along the front, differ from the equally averaged penny-crack solutions of Sneddon and of Kassir and Sih by at most 0.29% of the normal-tension factor K0. With a free-surface term, two surface cracks give factors within 3.14 and 1.53% of Newman and Raju's values on the finest meshes. A corner crack grown by the Erdogan–Sih criterion on 6.5 million tetrahedra demonstrates cutting and versioning; its path has no reference solution. On 10⁷ tetrahedra, updating the connectivity after a crack advance by node duplication takes 3.0 ms, against 849 ms for recomputation by our earlier framework and 300 ms for a tuned 16-thread recomputation. In the Paris-law examples, fitting, crack increment and commit take 0.5 to 1.6% of a step.
articles.abstract_zh: 在三维裂纹扩展中，一致网格的求解器连通性通常在每次增量时重新计算。我们在每次本地编辑后更新它，每个编辑元素的成本与网格大小无关，加上每次提交的目录副本。计数关系（包含每个节点对的元素的计数）提供精确的更新规则，并提供逆关联、稀疏模式、组装目的地和构面邻接的证明；未经编辑的元素保留其目的地。版本是在恒定时间内提交和恢复的，因此一次回滚就会撤消被拒绝的增长步骤。本地无 Steiner 点刀具，经证明与我们的批量刀具等效，可同时插入和生长裂纹以及切割独立的边缘组。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在三维裂纹扩展中，一致网格的求解器连通性通常在每次增量时重新计算。我们在每次本地编辑后更新它，每个编辑元素的成本与网格大小无关，加上每次提交的目录副本。计数关系（包含每个节点对的元素的计数）提供精确的更新规则，并提供逆关联、稀疏模式、组装目的地和构面邻接的证明；未经编辑的元素保留其目的地。版本是在恒定时间内提交和恢复的，因此一次回滚就会撤消被拒绝的增长步骤。本地无 Steiner 点刀具，经证明与我们的批量刀具等效，可同时插入和生长裂纹以及切割独立的边缘组。对于裂纹半径为 1/64 的单元，相互作用积分沿前端平均的应力强度因子与 Sneddon 以及 Kassir 和 Sih 的等平均便士裂纹解的差异最多为法向张力因子 K0 的 0.29%。对于自由表面项，两个表面裂纹给出的因子在最精细网格上的 Newman 和 Raju 值的 3.14% 和 1.53% 之间。根据埃尔多安-西赫准则在 650 万个四面体上生长的角裂纹演示了切割和版本控制；其路径无参考解。在 10⁷ 四面体上，通过节点复制进行裂纹推进后更新连接需要 3.0 毫秒，而我们早期框架的重新计算需要 849 毫秒，调整的 16 线程重新计算需要 300 毫秒。在巴黎法的示例中，拟合、破解增量和提交占用步长的 0.5% 到 1.6%。

articles.title: Designing a Boundary Negotiating Artifact for Collaborative Socio-Technical Sense-Making in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
articles.title_zh: 设计用于人工智能监管沙箱中协作社会技术意义构建的边界谈判工件
articles.abstract: The rapid, unpredictable advancements in AI system capabilities has seen regulators take adaptive and experimental approaches to policymaking. Established in other domains as instruments balancing regulation with innovation, regulatory sandboxes are estimated as viable solutions for AI regulation. However, analyses mostly focus on the legal and institutional design of AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRSes). With the legal framework leaving the socio-technical interpretation to stakeholders, this creates a gap on the sense-making required to fulfill the AIRS purpose. In this paper, we approach this by designing the prototype of a technical Boundary Negotiating Artifact as a way to mediate meaning in AIRS. We adopt a Research-through-Design approach to iteratively develop a prototype, providing an interface for the different stakeholders to collaborate in AI assessment. We then position it as technical backbone in an AIRS framework synthesized from the literature, structuring the collaborative sense-making of the involved stakeholders. We further report the insights gained from our design process and engagement with stakeholders, specifically how the proposed prototype serves as a technical BNA to help cooperation among different communities of practice.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能系统功能的快速、不可预测的进步促使监管机构采取适应性和实验性的政策制定方法。监管沙箱在其他领域被建立为平衡监管与创新的工具，被认为是人工智能监管的可行解决方案。然而，分析主要集中在人工智能监管沙箱（AIRSes）的法律和制度设计上。由于法律框架将社会技术解释留给了利益相关者，这在实现 AIRS 目的所需的意义建构方面造成了差距。在本文中，我们通过设计技术边界协商工件的原型来解决这个问题，作为在 AIRS 中调解意义的一种方式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能系统功能的快速、不可预测的进步促使监管机构采取适应性和实验性的政策制定方法。监管沙箱在其他领域被建立为平衡监管与创新的工具，被认为是人工智能监管的可行解决方案。然而，分析主要集中在人工智能监管沙箱（AIRSes）的法律和制度设计上。由于法律框架将社会技术解释留给了利益相关者，这在实现 AIRS 目的所需的意义建构方面造成了差距。在本文中，我们通过设计技术边界协商工件的原型来解决这个问题，作为在 AIRS 中调解意义的一种方式。我们采用“研究到设计”的方法来迭代开发原型，为不同利益相关者在人工智能评估中进行协作提供界面。然后，我们将其定位为根据文献综合的 AIRS 框架中的技术骨干，构建相关利益相关者的协作意义构建。我们进一步报告从我们的设计过程和与利益相关者的接触中获得的见解，特别是所提出的原型如何作为技术 BNA 来帮助不同实践社区之间的合作。

articles.title: Sea-level rise forces global landward expansion of mangroves
articles.title_zh: 海平面上升迫使全球红树林向陆地扩张
articles.abstract: Mangroves are widespread tropical ecosystems that thrive along shorelines and coastal rivers. Since the late 2000s, their net global extent are expanding, yet the drivers of this expansion remain unclear in the context of sea-level rise. Analysing four decades of worldwide changes in mangrove extent alongside sea surface heights, we provide a body of evidence that in many regions, rising sea levels have driven a net increase in mangrove cover, primarily through their landward expansion. Globally, sea-level rise pushed mangroves landward by up to ~2,970 m, with ~14,670 km² of landward gains since 1985 (13.7%), vastly outstripping seaward losses (1.7%). Furthermore, we found that short-term climate variability and the post-2010 climate shift modulated the pace of this expansion by temporarily altering local rates. Based on observational data, these findings underscore sea-level rise as a primary catalyst for global mangrove change. Sustaining this new adaptation mechanism will critically depend on preserving unobstructed landward accommodation space in coastal planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 红树林是广泛分布的热带生态系统，沿着海岸线和沿海河流繁衍生息。自 2000 年代末以来，它们的全球净范围不断扩大，但在海平面上升的背景下，这种扩张的驱动因素仍不清楚。通过分析四十年来全球红树林范围和海面高度的变化，我们提供了大量证据表明，在许多地区，海平面上升主要通过红树林向陆地扩张推动了红树林覆盖面积的净增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 红树林是广泛分布的热带生态系统，沿着海岸线和沿海河流繁衍生息。自 2000 年代末以来，它们的全球净范围不断扩大，但在海平面上升的背景下，这种扩张的驱动因素仍不清楚。通过分析四十年来全球红树林范围和海面高度的变化，我们提供了大量证据表明，在许多地区，海平面上升主要通过红树林向陆地扩张推动了红树林覆盖面积的净增加。在全球范围内，海平面上升使红树林向陆地移动了约 2,970 m，自 1985 年以来向陆地移动了约 14,670 km²（13.7%），远远超过了向海移动的损失（1.7%）。此外，我们发现短期气候变化和 2010 年后的气候变化通过暂时改变当地比率来调节这种扩张的速度。基于观测数据，这些发现强调海平面上升是全球红树林变化的主要催化剂。维持这种新的适应机制将主要取决于在沿海规划中保留无障碍的陆地住宿空间。

articles.title: Application of modified phosphogypsum for efficient removal of methyl blue from aqueous solutions
articles.title_zh: 改性磷石膏在水溶液中高效去除甲基蓝的应用
articles.abstract: Phosphogypsum (PG), an abundant industrial solid waste, is a promising substrate for dye remediation through interfacial modification. Herein, cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB)-modified PG (CTAB@PG) was prepared via a microwave-assisted hydrothermal route and applied for the removal of methyl blue (MB), an anionic triarylmethane dye. Under identical adsorption conditions, CTAB modification increased MB uptake by 124.6%, from 215.0 to 482.8 mg·g-1, despite a 55.7% decrease in specific surface area from 20.92 to 9.27 m2·g-1. CTAB@PG achieved 96.6% removal within 20 min at 298 K and pH 6, using an adsorbent dosage of 0.02 g in 50 mL of 200 mg·L-1 MB solution. The kinetic data were well described by the pseudo-second-order model, while the Freundlich isotherm provided the best fit to the equilibrium data (R2 > 0.99), consistent with heterogeneous adsorption. Fixed-loading thermodynamic analyses based on Freundlich and Langmuir isotherms yielded positive transfer enthalpies of 17.16–17.96 kJ·mol-1, with relative differences below 3% at matched loadings, demonstrating consistent endothermic behavior across both models. Furthermore, CTAB@PG retained approximately 90% removal efficiency after six regeneration cycles using 0.1 mol·L− 1 NaOH. Enhanced uptake was attributed to electrostatic attraction between CTAB-derived quaternary ammonium groups and dye sulfonate groups, complemented by hydrophobic association with alkyl-rich regions. These findings highlight the role of interfacial modification in enhancing dye uptake and demonstrate a route for converting PG into a reusable adsorbent.
articles.abstract_zh: 磷石膏（PG）是一种丰富的工业固体废物，是通过界面改性进行染料修复的有前途的基质。在此，通过微波辅助水热路线制备了十六烷基三甲基溴化铵（CTAB）改性的PG（CTAB@PG），并用于去除阴离子三芳基甲烷染料甲基蓝（MB）。在相同吸附条件下，CTAB改性使MB吸收量增加了124.6%，从215.0 mg·g-1增加到482.8 mg·g-1，尽管比表面积从20.92 m2·g-1减少到9.27 m2·g-1 55.7%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磷石膏（PG）是一种丰富的工业固体废物，是通过界面改性进行染料修复的有前途的基质。在此，通过微波辅助水热路线制备了十六烷基三甲基溴化铵（CTAB）改性的PG（CTAB@PG），并用于去除阴离子三芳基甲烷染料甲基蓝（MB）。在相同吸附条件下，CTAB改性使MB吸收量增加了124.6%，从215.0 mg·g-1增加到482.8 mg·g-1，尽管比表面积从20.92 m2·g-1减少到9.27 m2·g-1 55.7%。 CTAB@PG 在 298 K、pH 6 的条件下，在 20 分钟内实现了 96.6% 的去除率，在 50 mL 的 200 mg·L-1 MB 溶液中使用 0.02 g 的吸附剂剂量。准二阶模型很好地描述了动力学数据，而Freundlich等温线提供了与平衡数据的最佳拟合（R2 > 0.99），与非均相吸附一致。基于 Freundlich 和 Langmuir 等温线的固定负载热力学分析产生了 17.16–17.96 kJ·mol-1 的正传递焓，匹配负载下的相对差异低于 3%，表明两个模型具有一致的吸热行为。此外，使用0.1 mol·L− 1 NaOH进行六次再生循环后，CTAB@PG仍保持约90%的去除效率。增强的吸收归因于 CTAB 衍生的季铵基团和染料磺酸盐基团之间的静电吸引力，并通过与富含烷基的区域的疏水缔合来补充。这些发现强调了界面改性在增强染料吸收方面的作用，并证明了将 PG 转化为可重复使用的吸附剂的途径。

articles.title: Molecularly Tailored Halogen Bond Interactions Enabling Highly Reversible Four-Electron Iodine Conversion
articles.title_zh: 分子定制的卤键相互作用实现高度可逆的四电子碘转换
articles.abstract: Aqueous four-electron zinc−iodine (Zn−I2) batteries represent a promising route for sustainable grid-scale energy storage but remain fundamentally constrained by the long-standing interhalogen-stabilization paradigm, which relies on high-concentration, corrosive chloride electrolytes (up to 30 M) to stabilize hypervalent iodine species. This dependence poses sustainability and practical bottlenecks, necessitating fundamental breakthrough in stabilization strategy compatible with dilute, halogen-free electrolytes. Here, we establish a molecularly tailored halogen bond stabilization chemistry based on directional donor–acceptor interactions between nucleophilic amide molecules and electrophilic I+ species. Within this framework, amide molecules act as halogen bond acceptors coordinatively deactivating the axial σ-holes of I+ species to suppress irreversible hydrolysis while reconstructing the interfacial molecular environment. In situ spectroscopy, electrochemical investigations, and theoretical simulations establish a molecular-level relationship between halogen bond and hypervalent iodine reversibility, revealing that extended alkyl chains of halogen bond acceptor fortify the halogen bond interactions while mitigating interfacial H2O, ensuring higher redox reversibility and interfacial stability. As a demonstration of this stabilization mechanism, four-electron Zn−I2 cells achieve an energy density of 597.7 Wh kg− 1 and stable operation in a 1.01 Ah pouch cell under dilute halogen-free electrolytes. This work provides a new stabilization paradigm to harness hypervalent iodine conversion through molecularly tailored halogen bond interactions, extending the scope of halogen bond chemistry toward electrochemical systems while providing new design principles for sustainable aqueous batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 水系四电子锌碘 (Zn−I2) 电池代表了可持续电网规模储能的一条有前途的途径，但从根本上仍然受到长期存在的卤间稳定范式的限制，该范式依赖高浓度、腐蚀性氯化物电解质（高达 30 M）来稳定高价碘物质。这种依赖性带来了可持续性和实际瓶颈，需要在与稀无卤电解液兼容的稳定策略上取得根本性突破。在这里，我们基于亲核酰胺分子和亲电 I+ 物质之间的定向供体-受体相互作用建立了分子定制的卤键稳定化学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 水系四电子锌碘 (Zn−I2) 电池代表了可持续电网规模储能的一条有前途的途径，但从根本上仍然受到长期存在的卤间稳定范式的限制，该范式依赖高浓度、腐蚀性氯化物电解质（高达 30 M）来稳定高价碘物质。这种依赖性带来了可持续性和实际瓶颈，需要在与稀无卤电解液兼容的稳定策略上取得根本性突破。在这里，我们基于亲核酰胺分子和亲电 I+ 物质之间的定向供体-受体相互作用建立了分子定制的卤键稳定化学。在此框架内，酰胺分子充当卤素键受体，协调地使 I+ 物质的轴向 σ 孔失活，以抑制不可逆水解，同时重建界面分子环境。原位光谱、电化学研究和理论模拟建立了卤素键和高价碘可逆性之间的分子水平关系，揭示了卤素键受体的延伸烷基链增强了卤素键相互作用，同时减少了界面H2O，确保了更高的氧化还原可逆性和界面稳定性。作为这种稳定机制的证明，四电子 Zn−I2 电池实现了 597.7 Wh kg− 1 的能量密度，并在稀无卤电解质下在 1.01 Ah 软包电池中稳定运行。这项工作提供了一种新的稳定范例，通过分子定制的卤素键相互作用来利用高价碘转化，将卤素键化学的范围扩展到电化学系统，同时为可持续水性电池提供新的设计原理。

articles.title: Mechanical, Thermal, and Structural Characterization of Hybrid Jute/Betel Nut Fiber-Reinforced Polyester Composites
articles.title_zh: 混合黄麻/槟榔纤维增强聚酯复合材料的机械、热和结构表征
articles.abstract: This study investigates the mechanical, thermal, and structural properties of hybrid jute/betel nut fiber-reinforced polyester composites, developed as a sustainable alternative to synthetic fiber composites. Alkali-treated jute and betel nut fibers were incorporated into a polyester matrix at a fixed 10% total fiber volume fraction, at five fiber weight ratios: 100J, 75J-25B, 50J-50B, 25J-75B, and 100B (J = jute, B = betel nut). Composites were fabricated via hand lay-up and compression molding, and evaluated by tensile, flexural, and impact testing per ASTM standards, alongside Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, thermogravimetric/differential thermal analysis (TGA/DTA), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Hybrid composites showed improved flexural properties relative to single-fiber composites, with maximum flexural strength (52.56 MPa) at 25J-75B and maximum tensile strength (29.56 MPa) at 50J-50B. FTIR confirmed characteristic hydroxyl, C–H, and carbonyl functional groups consistent across all compositions. TGA/DTA revealed a three-stage thermal decomposition profile, with major mass loss occurring between 300°C and 500°C and comparable thermal stability among the three hybrid formulations. SEM analysis of fracture surfaces indicated improved fiber-matrix adhesion in hybrid formulations relative to single-fiber composites. These findings demonstrate that hybridization of jute and betel nut fibers can enhance the mechanical and thermal performance of natural fiber-reinforced polyester composites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了混合黄麻/槟榔纤维增强聚酯复合材料的机械、热和结构性能，该复合材料是作为合成纤维复合材料的可持续替代品而开发的。将碱处理的黄麻和槟榔纤维以固定的 10% 总纤维体积分数、五种纤维重量比掺入聚酯基质中：100J、75J-25B、50J-50B、25J-75B 和 100B（J = 黄麻，B = 槟榔）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了混合黄麻/槟榔纤维增强聚酯复合材料的机械、热和结构性能，该复合材料是作为合成纤维复合材料的可持续替代品而开发的。将碱处理的黄麻和槟榔纤维以固定的 10% 总纤维体积分数、五种纤维重量比掺入聚酯基质中：100J、75J-25B、50J-50B、25J-75B 和 100B（J = 黄麻，B = 槟榔）。复合材料通过手糊和压缩成型制造，并根据 ASTM 标准通过拉伸、弯曲和冲击测试以及傅里叶变换红外 (FTIR) 光谱、热重/差热分析 (TGA/DTA) 和扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 进行评估。相对于单纤维复合材料，混合复合材料表现出更好的弯曲性能，在25J-75B时具有最大弯曲强度（52.56 MPa），在50J-50B时具有最大拉伸强度（29.56 MPa）。 FTIR 证实了所有组合物中特征羟基、C-H 和羰基官能团的一致性。 TGA/DTA 显示了三阶段热分解曲线，主要质量损失发生在 300°C 至 500°C 之间，三种混合配方之间的热稳定性相当。断裂表面的 SEM 分析表明，相对于单纤维复合材料，混合配方中的纤维基体粘合力有所提高。这些发现表明，黄麻和槟榔纤维的杂交可以增强天然纤维增强聚酯复合材料的机械和热性能。

articles.title: Bio-prospecting Seaweed-Associated Marine Bacteria for Polyhydroxyalkanoate Biosynthesis: Process Optimization and Biopolymer Characterization
articles.title_zh: 用于聚羟基脂肪酸酯生物合成的海藻相关海洋细菌的生物勘探：工艺优化和生物聚合物表征
articles.abstract: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) are biodegradable polyesters that many microorganisms accumulate as intracellular granules during fermentation. Bacteria associated with the seaweeds Ulva sp. and Sargassum sp. from the Arokiapuram shore (Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu, India) were isolated, screened for PHA production and identified. All twenty morphologically different isolates were tested with Sudan Black B and Nile Blue A stains. Sudan Black B stained twelve isolates positively, and four of them (U5, U9, S4 and S6) also fluoresced with Nile Blue A. Isolate S4 yielded the most PHA (13.6 g/L); morphological, biochemical and 16S rRNA sequence data identified it as Bacillus thuringiensis PHB CMST2 (GenBank accession OQ804398). In one-variable-at-a-time (OVAT) trials, glucose and ammonium chloride proved the most effective carbon and nitrogen sources, and PHA accumulation was highest at pH 6, 5% salinity and 35°C. These variables (glucose, ammonium chloride and salinity) were then tuned with a central composite design within response surface methodology (RSM-CCD). Validation at the predicted optimum (1% glucose, 0.1% ammonium chloride, 5% salinity) gave 20 g/L PHA, close to the model prediction of 19.86 g/L (R² = 98.23%). The polymer was characterised as polyhydroxybutyrate by UV-visible spectroscopy, TLC and FT-IR (ester C = O stretch at 1724.24 cm⁻¹), together with thermogravimetry (complete degradation by 550°C), XRD (amorphous), GC-MS and SEM-EDS (porous surface; C 55.6%, O 34.5%). These results suggest that the seaweed-associated B. thuringiensis PHB CMST2 is a promising, low-cost source of PHA from marine biomass.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚羟基脂肪酸酯 (PHA) 是可生物降解的聚酯，许多微生物在发酵过程中以细胞内颗粒的形式积累。与海藻石莼属相关的细菌。和马尾藻属。对来自 Arokiapuram 海岸（印度泰米尔纳德邦 Kanyakumari 区）的 PHA 生产进行了分离、筛选和鉴定。使用苏丹黑 B 和尼罗蓝 A 染色剂测试了所有 20 种形态不同的分离株。苏丹黑 B 对 12 个分离株呈阳性染色，其中 4 个（U5、U9、S4 和 S6）也用尼罗蓝 A 发出荧光。分离株 S4 产生最多的 PHA（13.6 g/L）；分离株 S4 产生最多的 PHA（13.6 g/L）；形态学、生化和16S rRNA序列数据鉴定其为苏云金芽孢杆菌PHB CMST2（GenBank登录号OQ804398）。在一次一变量 (OVAT) 试验中，葡萄糖和氯化铵被证明是最有效的碳源和氮源，PHA 积累在 pH 6、5% 盐度和 35°C 时最高。然后使用响应面方法 (RSM-CCD) 内的中心复合设计来调整这些变量（葡萄糖、氯化铵和盐度）。在预测的最佳浓度（1% 葡萄糖、0.1% 氯化铵、5% 盐度）下进行验证，得到 20 g/L PHA，接近模型预测的 19.86 g/L (R² = 98.23%)。通过紫外-可见光谱、TLC和FT-IR（酯C = O拉伸在1724.24 cm-1）、热重分析（550°C完全降解）、XRD（无定形）、GC-MS和SEM-EDS（多孔表面；C 55.6%，O 34.5%）将聚合物表征为聚羟基丁酸酯。这些结果表明，与海藻相关的苏云金芽孢杆菌 PHB CMST2 是一种有前途的、低成本的海洋生物质 PHA 来源。

articles.title: pH-Dependent Effects of Molecular Nitrogen on Nitrate Radiolysis: H2O2 and NO2⁻ Formation under Irradiation
articles.title_zh: 氮分子对硝酸盐辐射分解的 pH 依赖性影响：辐照下 H2O2 和 NO2⁻ 的形成
articles.abstract: The influence of molecular nitrogen on nitrate radiolysis was investigated by comparing 1×10⁻3 mol/L nitrate solutions saturated with Ar or N2 at pH 3, 7, and 11. Product formation was examined under 9 MeV electron irradiation, and 230 MeV proton irradiation was used to test whether the observed trends were qualitatively consistent across beam types. Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and nitrite (NO2⁻) were quantified using the Ghormley and modified Shinn methods. Under electron irradiation, N2 enhanced H2O2 accumulation at pH 3 and 11 but had little effect at pH 7. For NO2⁻, N2 suppressed accumulation at pH 3 and enhanced it at pH 7 and 11. A kinetic model containing more than 140 reactions reproduced the main electron-irradiation trends, with a maximum endpoint deviation of 27% at pH 3. The model attributes these changes to N2-derived species altering the competing formation and consumption pathways of H2O2 and NO2⁻. Proton irradiation showed qualitatively consistent pH-dependent responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过比较 pH 为 3、7 和 11 的 Ar 或 N2 饱和的 1×10 -3 mol/L 硝酸盐溶液，研究分子氮对硝酸盐辐射分解的影响。在 9 MeV 电子辐照下检查产物形成，并使用 230 MeV 质子辐照来测试观察到的趋势在不同束流类型上是否定性一致。使用 Ghormley 和改进的 Shinn 方法对过氧化氢 (H2O2) 和亚硝酸盐 (NO2-) 进行定量。在电子辐照下，N2 在 pH 3 和 11 时增强了 H2O2 的积累，但在 pH 7 时几乎没有影响。

articles.title: Morphology, elemental composition, and gamma-exposure response of an MXene/Cu-MOF-coated quartz crystal microbalance
articles.title_zh: MXene/Cu-MOF 涂层石英晶体微天平的形态、元素组成和伽马暴露响应
articles.abstract: The radiation-sensing capability of a functionalized quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) depends on distinguishing irradiation-associated responses from coating equilibration, moisture interactions, and instrumental drift. In this study, bare Cu-MOF and an MXene/Cu-MOF composite were synthesized using the same hydrothermal approach and characterized before and after gamma irradiation using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX). The resonance frequency and resonance width of an MXene/Cu-MOF-coated QCM were monitored during 1 h of exposure to a Cs-137 gamma source and for an additional hour following source removal. The EDX spectra exhibited substantial silicon-substrate contributions, while comparisons of Cu/Si ratios showed variations of + 4.9% and − 10.3% without establishing a systematic irradiation-induced compositional change. The QCM exhibited a frequency decrease of 367 Hz during irradiation and a further decrease of 401 Hz following source removal. Resonance broadening from 2.2 to 3.7 kHz and a subsequent abrupt frequency decrease of approximately 332 Hz, accompanied by resonance narrowing, indicated changes in the acoustic response of the composite coating. The persistence of frequency variations after irradiation suggests that coating equilibration and changes in interfacial mechanical properties may contribute substantially to the observed response. During the late monitoring period, the baseline drift and residual standard deviation were approximately − 0.14 Hz min⁻¹ and 2.2 Hz, respectively, corresponding to an estimated noise-based frequency threshold of approximately 7 Hz. These findings highlight the importance of coating stabilization and acoustic characterization in developing MXene/Cu-MOF-functionalized QCM platforms for radiation-sensing applications.

articles.title: Land Surface Temperature, Vegetation and Drought Dynamics in the Forest–Savanna Transition Zone of Afadzato South District, Ghana (2006–2026): the limits of TVDI for temporal drought monitoring
articles.title_zh: 加纳阿法扎托南区森林-稀树草原过渡区的地表温度、植被和干旱动态（2006-2026）：TVDI 对时间干旱监测的限制
articles.abstract: Satellite drought monitoring in data-scarce regions increasingly relies on the Temperature–Vegetation Dryness Index (TVDI), yet the index is routinely read as a time series without testing whether its construction permits temporal interpretation. Because the dry and wet edges of the NDVI–LST feature space are re-fitted to every scene, each year is internally renormalized, a property that can remove the between-year signal the index is assumed to carry. This study tests that assumption in the forest–savanna transition zone of Afadzato South District, Ghana, over the 2006–2026 dry seasons. Land surface temperature (LST) and the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) were derived from Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 imagery in Google Earth Engine for three decadal epochs and as a continuous annual series; TVDI was built from the NDVI–LST feature space; and each indicator was validated against Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) rainfall and ERA5-Land soil moisture. The district greened significantly (Mann–Kendall p = 0.010) as the surface warmed and the soil dried. Crucially, district-mean TVDI did not track the independent references across years, whereas LST correlated with rainfall and soil moisture in the physically expected direction; LST, with NDVI, is therefore the dependable temporal indicator and district-mean TVDI is not. TVDI nonetheless validated spatially, ranking land-cover types coherently from open water to built-up land and cropland. We recommend pairing an absolute thermal indicator for temporal monitoring with TVDI for spatial mapping, a transferable protocol for drought assessment in data-scarce districts of sub-Saharan Africa.

articles.title: Fluorinated Silicate Nanoparticles for Wettability Alteration and Condensate-Bank Mitigation in Sandstone Gas-Condensate Reservoirs
articles.title_zh: 用于砂岩气凝析油藏中润湿性改变和凝析油堆积缓解的氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒
articles.abstract: Condensate banking and water blockage significantly reduce gas productivity in gas-condensate reservoirs by decreasing gas relative permeability and increasing capillary trapping near the wellbore. Although wettability alteration is an effective mitigation approach, the performance of fluorinated nanomaterials under reservoir-representative conditions remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates fluorinated silicate nanoparticles and perfluoroalkylsilane-based chemicals for altering sandstone wettability toward an intermediate gas-wet state and reducing liquid blockage. Fluorochemical solutions and fluorinated silicate nanoparticles were synthesized and characterized using contact-angle measurements, compatibility analysis, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), spontaneous imbibition, and core-flooding experiments on sandstone representative of gas-condensate reservoirs. The effects of solvent type, fluorochemical concentration, catalyst, nanoparticle concentration, temperature, and salinity were systematically investigated. The optimum formulation comprised 2 wt% perfluorodecyltrimethoxysilane with an ammonia catalyst, while the addition of 0.2 wt% silicate nanoparticles further enhanced wettability alteration. Contact-angle measurements showed successful conversion of the sandstone surface to a strongly water-repellent, intermediate gas-wet condition, with water and n-decane contact angles of approximately 147° and 96°, respectively. FTIR and SEM analyses confirmed adsorption of fluorinated functional groups and surface modification. Spontaneous imbibition decreased by approximately 65% for water and 30% for n-decane, indicating reduced capillary-driven liquid uptake. Core-flooding experiments showed pressure-drop reductions of approximately 30% during brine injection and 20% during n-decane injection, demonstrating improved fluid mobility and lower flow resistance. These results indicate that fluorinated silicate nanoparticles are a promising treatment for mitigating condensate banking and enhancing gas deliverability in sandstone gas-condensate reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 凝析油堆积和水堵塞会降低天然气相对渗透率并增加井眼附近的毛细管圈闭，从而显着降低凝析气藏的天然气产能。尽管润湿性改变是一种有效的缓解方法，但氟化纳米材料在典型储层条件下的性能仍知之甚少。这项研究评估了氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒和全氟烷基硅烷基化学品，以将砂岩润湿性改变为中间气润状态并减少液体堵塞。通过接触角测量、相容性分析、傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR)、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)、自发吸入和代表凝析气藏砂岩的岩心驱替实验，合成和表征了含氟化合物溶液和氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 凝析油堆积和水堵塞会降低天然气相对渗透率并增加井眼附近的毛细管圈闭，从而显着降低凝析气藏的天然气产能。尽管润湿性改变是一种有效的缓解方法，但氟化纳米材料在典型储层条件下的性能仍知之甚少。这项研究评估了氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒和全氟烷基硅烷基化学品，以将砂岩润湿性改变为中间气润状态并减少液体堵塞。通过接触角测量、相容性分析、傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR)、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)、自发吸入和代表凝析气藏砂岩的岩心驱替实验，合成和表征了含氟化合物溶液和氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒。系统地研究了溶剂类型、含氟化合物浓度、催化剂、纳米粒子浓度、温度和盐度的影响。最佳配方包含 2 wt% 全氟癸基三甲氧基硅烷和氨催化剂，而添加 0.2 wt% 硅酸盐纳米颗粒进一步增强了润湿性改变。接触角测量表明，砂岩表面成功转化为强防水、中等气湿状态，水和正癸烷接触角分别约为 147° 和 96°。 FTIR 和 SEM 分析证实了氟化官能团的吸附和表面改性。水的自发吸入减少了约 65%，正癸烷的自发吸入减少了约 30%，表明毛细管驱动的液体吸收减少。岩心驱替实验表明，盐水注入期间压降降低了约 30%，正癸烷注入期间压降降低了 20%，这表明流体流动性得到改善，流动阻力降低。这些结果表明，氟化硅酸盐纳米颗粒是一种有前途的处理方法，可用于缓解砂岩凝析气藏中的凝析油堆积和提高天然气输送能力。

articles.title: Neonicotinoid insecticides in water and vegetables from Zambia: LC–MS/MS method validation and residue patterns
articles.title_zh: 赞比亚水和蔬菜中的新烟碱类杀虫剂：LC-MS/MS 方法验证和残留模式
articles.abstract: Five neonicotinoid insecticides were investigated in 225 water and 375 vegetable samples from Zambia using liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry. Water and vegetable samples were prepared by solid-phase extraction and modified QuEChERS, respectively. Calibration coefficients of determination were 0.998–0.999, recoveries were 85–109%, and reported intraday relative standard deviations were 3.7–8.1%. Reported mean numerical concentrations differed among water sources and vegetable species, with surface water and spinach having the highest values in their respective matrices. However, reported water concentrations were below the stated detection limits, and the treatment of censored observations was not documented. The results therefore require verification against original analytical records before quantitative contamination or risk conclusions can be drawn. The study highlights analytical quality assurance requirements for pesticide residue surveillance in Zambia.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用液相色谱-串联质谱法对来自赞比亚的 225 个水和 375 个蔬菜样品中的五种新烟碱类杀虫剂进行了研究。水和蔬菜样品分别通过固相萃取和改进的 QuEChERS 制备。测定的校准系数为 0.998-0.999，回收率为 85-109%，报告的日内相对标准偏差为 3.7-8.1%。报告的平均数值浓度因水源和蔬菜种类而异，地表水和菠菜在各自的基质中具有最高值。然而，报告的水浓度低于规定的检测限，并且没有记录审查观察结果的处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用液相色谱-串联质谱法对来自赞比亚的 225 个水和 375 个蔬菜样品中的五种新烟碱类杀虫剂进行了研究。水和蔬菜样品分别通过固相萃取和改进的 QuEChERS 制备。测定的校准系数为 0.998-0.999，回收率为 85-109%，报告的日内相对标准偏差为 3.7-8.1%。报告的平均数值浓度因水源和蔬菜种类而异，地表水和菠菜在各自的基质中具有最高值。然而，报告的水浓度低于规定的检测限，并且没有记录审查观察结果的处理。因此，在得出定量污染或风险结论之前，需要根据原始分析记录对结果进行验证。该研究强调了赞比亚农药残留监测的分析质量保证要求。

articles.title: Where wild garlic (Allium ursinum L.) thrives: pedological and hydrological determinants of its occurrence in the Western Bieszczady Mts, SE Poland
articles.title_zh: 野生大蒜 (Allium ursinum L.) 繁衍生息的地方：波兰东南部 Bieszczady 山西部的土壤学和水文决定因素
articles.abstract: Purpose The aim of the study was to identify the pedological and hydrological properties favouring the wild garlic (A. ursinum) presence.Methods Research was conducted at four sites located in the Western Bieszczady Mts. At each site, paired plots with and without A. ursinum were selected. Representative soil profiles and surface soil samples were analyzed to determine soil organic carbon (SOC) and total nitrogen (TN) content using an elemental CHN analyzer. Soil mineral composition was determined using the X-ray diffraction (XRD), while exchangeable cations concentration was quantified using flame atomic absorption spectroscopy (FAAS). Additionally, water samples collected from A. ursinum habitats and areas without this species were analyzed using ion chromatography to characterize their chemical composition.Results Characteristic features of A. ursinum habitats include higher soil pH, lower SOC content and greater base saturation of the cation exchange complex by alkaline Mg2+ and Ca2+ cations. Statistically significant differences regarding the hydrochemical water characteristics were not observed.Conclusion Our results suggest that hydrological conditions are important for A. ursinum habitats, but not only because of chemical composition of water, but rather due to water availability, subsurface water flow rate, and ability to maintain constant moderate moisture. Such hydrological conditions may be supported by certain topographic setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 目的 本研究的目的是确定有利于野生大蒜 (A. ursinum) 存在的土壤学和水文特性。方法 研究在位于西 Bieszczady 山的四个地点进行。在每个地点，选择有和没有熊熊果蝇的配对地块。使用元素 CHN 分析仪对代表性土壤剖面和表层土壤样品进行分析，以确定土壤有机碳 (SOC) 和总氮 (TN) 含量。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 测定土壤矿物成分，同时使用火焰原子吸收光谱 (FAAS) 定量可交换阳离子浓度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 目的 本研究的目的是确定有利于野生大蒜 (A. ursinum) 存在的土壤学和水文特性。方法 研究在位于西 Bieszczady 山的四个地点进行。在每个地点，选择有和没有熊熊果蝇的配对地块。使用元素 CHN 分析仪对代表性土壤剖面和表层土壤样品进行分析，以确定土壤有机碳 (SOC) 和总氮 (TN) 含量。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 测定土壤矿物成分，同时使用火焰原子吸收光谱 (FAAS) 定量可交换阳离子浓度。此外，还使用离子色谱法分析了从熊熊属栖息地和没有该物种的地区收集的水样，以表征其化学成分。结果熊熊熊栖息地的特征包括较高的土壤 pH 值、较低的 SOC 含量以及碱性 Mg2+ 和 Ca2+ 阳离子的阳离子交换复合物的碱饱和度较高。没有观察到关于水化学水特征的统计学上的显着差异。结论我们的结果表明，水文条件对于熊熊栖息地很重要，但不仅因为水的化学成分，还因为水的可用性、地下水流速和保持恒定适度湿度的能力。这种水文条件可能受到某些地形环境的支持。

articles.title: Quantum-inspired whale optimization framework applied to the qubit mapping problem
articles.title_zh: 受量子启发的鲸鱼优化框架应用于量子位映射问题
articles.abstract: Qubit mapping under hardware connectivity constraints is a core bottleneck in the physical compilation pipeline of near-term quantum computing, as restricted physical topologies require inserting auxiliary SWAP operations that inevitably degrade overall gate fidelity. To address this NP-hard combinatorial problem, this paper proposes a quantum-inspired whale optimization framework (QI-WOF) that models discrete mapping configurations as continuous probability amplitudes within a unified Hilbert space. Specifically, we design a triple cooperative search paradigm. Within this paradigm, directional convergence is achieved via a quantum interference encircling mechanism utilizing constructive and destructive phase interference. Meanwhile, exploration diversity is sustained through a stochastic search driven by state collapse to escape local extrema. Furthermore, a phase-driven spiral tracking mechanism is introduced for continuous local refinement, which is supported by a nonlinear adaptive factor and quantum-state differential mutation to ensure stable state evolution. Numerical simulations on benchmark circuits demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently suppresses SWAP and CNOT gate overheads. Specifically, the proposed QI-WOF reduces the number of SWAP gates by an average of 68.27% compared to the baseline IBM_QX method, outperforming the industrial compilers t|ket > and Qiskit by 37.26% and 48.51%, respectively. These results confirm that applying continuous state evolutions to discrete qubit routing offers a robust, scalable, and high-performance solution for quantum compiler design.
articles.abstract_zh: 硬件连接限制下的量子位映射是近期量子计算物理编译管道的核心瓶颈，因为受限的物理拓扑需要插入辅助交换操作，这不可避免地会降低整体门保真度。为了解决这个 NP 难组合问题，本文提出了一种受量子启发的鲸鱼优化框架（QI-WOF），它将离散映射配置建模为统一希尔伯特空间内的连续概率幅度。具体来说，我们设计了三重合作搜索范例。在此范例中，方向收敛是通过利用相长和相消相位干涉的量子干涉环绕机制来实现的。与此同时，探索多样性是通过状态崩溃驱动的随机搜索来维持的，以逃避局部极值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硬件连接限制下的量子位映射是近期量子计算物理编译管道的核心瓶颈，因为受限的物理拓扑需要插入辅助交换操作，这不可避免地会降低整体门保真度。为了解决这个 NP 难组合问题，本文提出了一种受量子启发的鲸鱼优化框架（QI-WOF），它将离散映射配置建模为统一希尔伯特空间内的连续概率幅度。具体来说，我们设计了三重合作搜索范例。在此范例中，方向收敛是通过利用相长和相消相位干涉的量子干涉环绕机制来实现的。与此同时，探索多样性是通过状态崩溃驱动的随机搜索来维持的，以逃避局部极值。此外，引入相位驱动螺旋跟踪机制进行连续局部细化，并由非线性自适应因子和量子态差分突变支持，以确保稳定的状态演化。对基准电路的数值模拟表明，所提出的框架一致地抑制了 SWAP 和 CNOT 门开销。具体来说，与基线 IBM_QX 方法相比，所提出的 QI-WOF 平均减少了 SWAP 门的数量 68.27%，分别优于工业编译器 t|ket >  和 Qiskit 37.26% 和 48.51%。这些结果证实，将连续状态演化应用于离散量子位路由为量子编译器设计提供了稳健、可扩展且高性能的解决方案。

articles.title: Orbital vs. Terrestrial AI Computing: Lifecycle Carbon Break-Even Analysis and Workload Placement
articles.title_zh: 轨道与地面人工智能计算：生命周期碳盈亏平衡分析和工作负载分配
articles.abstract: Orbital AI computing has been proposed as an alternative to terrestrial infrastructure, yet published assessments of its carbon footprint range from near neutrality to emissions an order of magnitude above ground-based systems. This paper develops a unified lifecycle carbon break-even framework and traces that divergence to two accounting choices: the launch-emissions boundary and the climate metric applied to rocket emissions. Applying the climate-equivalence multiplier to the combustion-related share alone reproduces both published positions within one model, separated by a ratio of 11.5, and places the break-even grid intensity between 0.06 and 0.70 kg CO₂/kWh. A two-stage placement rule then screens workloads for operational feasibility, from data provenance and latency, before weighing carbon competitiveness under Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation. A geometric correction follows: dawn-dusk orbits near 650 km are not eclipse-free. The open OrbitOrEarth calculator reproduces every reported figure and lets readers substitute their own assumptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道人工智能计算已被提议作为地面基础设施的替代方案，但已发布的碳足迹评估结果范围从接近中性到排放量比地面系统高出一个数量级。本文开发了一个统一的生命周期碳收支平衡框架，并追踪了两种核算选择的差异：发射排放边界和应用于火箭排放的气候指标。仅将气候当量乘数应用于与燃烧相关的份额即可重现一个模型中的两个已发布位置，其比例为 11.5，并将盈亏平衡电网强度置于 0.06 至 0.70 kg CO2/kWh 之间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道人工智能计算已被提议作为地面基础设施的替代方案，但已发布的碳足迹评估结果范围从接近中性到排放量比地面系统高出一个数量级。本文开发了一个统一的生命周期碳收支平衡框架，并追踪了两种核算选择的差异：发射排放边界和应用于火箭排放的气候指标。仅将气候当量乘数应用于与燃烧相关的份额即可重现一个模型中的两个已发布位置，其比例为 11.5，并将盈亏平衡电网强度置于 0.06 至 0.70 kg CO2/kWh 之间。然后，在蒙特卡罗不确定性传播下权衡碳竞争力之前，两阶段放置规则会根据数据来源和延迟来筛选工作负载的操作可行性。几何校正如下：接近 650 公里的黎明-黄昏轨道并非没有日食。开放的 OrbitOrEarth 计算器重现了每个报告的数字，并让读者替换他们自己的假设。

articles.title: What do historical shark records really show? Reassessing shark interactions in Chilean waters
articles.title_zh: 历史上的鲨鱼记录到底显示了什么？重新评估智利水域的鲨鱼相互作用
articles.abstract: Historical records of shark–human interactions can provide valuable information on ecological patterns, but uncertainties in documentary evidence and species identification may limit their interpretation. We critically reassessed 13 shark–human and shark–vessel events reported from Chilean waters between 1934 and 2026, evaluating their documentary reliability, taxonomic attribution, and environmental context. We examined whether these events were associated with anomalous sea surface temperatures, marine heatwaves, or increased exposure to South American sea lion (Otaria flavescens) colonies. Several dates, localities, and species assignments differed among sources, and the involvement of the white shark (Carcharodon carcharias) was strongly supported in only a small subset of events. Of the seven events with reliable sea surface temperature data, only one coincided with a marine heatwave, although shark involvement in this event remains unconfirmed. All eight coastal events included in the sea lion analysis occurred within 10 km of a colony. However, neither marine heatwave coincidence nor distance-weighted sea lion exposure exceeded random expectations. These findings highlight the limitations of using heterogeneous historical records to identify ecological drivers of shark interactions and emphasize the importance of explicitly accounting for documentary and taxonomic uncertainty before drawing ecological inferences.
articles.abstract_zh: 鲨鱼与人类相互作用的历史记录可以提供有关生态模式的宝贵信息，但文献证据和物种鉴定的不确定性可能会限制其解释。我们严格地重新评估了 1934 年至 2026 年间智利水域报告的 13 起鲨鱼与人类和鲨鱼与船只的事件，评估了它们的文献可靠性、分类学归属和环境背景。我们研究了这些事件是否与海面温度异常、海洋热浪或与南美海狮（Otaria flavescens）群体的接触增加有关。
authors: María José Tapia De la Jara
articles.abstract_zh_full: 鲨鱼与人类相互作用的历史记录可以提供有关生态模式的宝贵信息，但文献证据和物种鉴定的不确定性可能会限制其解释。我们严格地重新评估了 1934 年至 2026 年间智利水域报告的 13 起鲨鱼与人类和鲨鱼与船只的事件，评估了它们的文献可靠性、分类学归属和环境背景。我们研究了这些事件是否与海面温度异常、海洋热浪或与南美海狮（Otaria flavescens）群体的接触增加有关。多个日期、地点和物种分配因来源而异，并且仅在一小部分事件中强烈支持大白鲨（Carcharodon carcharias）的参与。在具有可靠海面温度数据的七起事件中，只有一次与海洋热浪同时发生，尽管鲨鱼参与这一事件尚未得到证实。海狮分析中包含的所有 8 次沿海事件都发生在距离海狮栖息地 10 公里范围内。然而，海洋热浪的巧合和距离加权的海狮暴露都没有超出随机预期。这些发现强调了使用异质历史记录来识别鲨鱼相互作用的生态驱动因素的局限性，并强调在得出生态推论之前明确解释文献和分类学不确定性的重要性。

articles.title: Lessons from terrestrial GPR void detection for lava tube exploration on the Moon and Mars
articles.title_zh: 月球和火星熔岩管探索中地面探地雷达空洞探测的经验教训
articles.abstract: Orbital and rover radars have found the first candidate lava tubes and cavities beneath the lunar surface, where crews could shelter. Terrestrial ground penetrating radar locates voids routinely under roads and buildings. Field sections from four countries and lunar simulations show that roof polarity alone cannot separate vacuum from porous fill, that boulders limit detection depth, and that one profile cannot constrain width. Recommendations for cavity reconnaissance follow.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道和月球车雷达已经在月球表面下发现了第一批候选熔岩管和洞穴，宇航员可以在那里避难。地面探地雷达通常可以定位道路和建筑物下方的空隙。来自四个国家的现场剖面和月球模拟表明，仅靠屋顶极性无法将真空与多孔填充物分开，巨石限制了探测深度，并且单一剖面无法限制宽度。以下是空腔勘察的建议。

articles.title: Coordinated Adaptive VSG Control Strategy with SOC- Constrained Virtual Inertia and Damping
articles.title_zh: 具有 SOC 约束虚拟惯性和阻尼的协调自适应 VSG 控制策略
articles.abstract: In modern microgrids with a high penetration of renewable energy, traditional Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) parameter-adaptive strategies enhance frequency stability by dynamically tuning virtual inertia (J) and damping (D). However, these approaches exclusively prioritize AC-side electromechanical responses and neglect the physical battery state of charge operational boundaries of the DC-link energy storage system (BESS). Commanding violent transient inertia support under depleted battery states induces severe battery current surges, thermal stress, and high-frequency parameter chattering from measurement noise. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes an SOC-constrained coordinated adaptive VSG control strategy with an anti-chattering mechanism. First, a non-linear SOC penalty function dynamically scales virtual parameters based on real-time BESS operational limits, protecting battery health during critical SOC conditions. Second, a frequency deadband combined with a discrete low-pass filter eliminates boundary-crossing parameter chattering in noisy environments. Closed-loop small-signal stability across the full operating range is analytically proven via eigenvalue analysis. Time-domain simulations under step active power disturbances and noisy conditions demonstrate that the proposed strategy virtually eliminates active power overshoot, reduces the peak dynamic frequency deviation depth by 64.7% (0.06 Hz vs. 0.17 Hz), relieves transient battery power stress by 25.3%, and attenuates parameter chattering by over 90%, successfully decoupling AC-side frequency regulation from DC-side electrical stress.
articles.abstract_zh: 在可再生能源渗透率较高的现代微电网中，传统的虚拟同步发电机（VSG）参数自适应策略通过动态调整虚拟惯量（J）和阻尼（D）来增强频率稳定性。然而，这些方法专门优先考虑交流侧机电响应，而忽略了直流链路储能系统 (BESS) 的物理电池充电状态操作边界。在电池电量耗尽的状态下命令剧烈的瞬态惯性支持会导致严重的电池电流浪涌、热应力以及测量噪声引起的高频参数抖动。为了克服这些挑战，本文提出了一种具有抗抖振机制的 SOC 约束协调自适应 VSG 控制策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在可再生能源渗透率较高的现代微电网中，传统的虚拟同步发电机（VSG）参数自适应策略通过动态调整虚拟惯量（J）和阻尼（D）来增强频率稳定性。然而，这些方法专门优先考虑交流侧机电响应，而忽略了直流链路储能系统 (BESS) 的物理电池充电状态操作边界。在电池电量耗尽的状态下命令剧烈的瞬态惯性支持会导致严重的电池电流浪涌、热应力以及测量噪声引起的高频参数抖动。为了克服这些挑战，本文提出了一种具有抗抖振机制的 SOC 约束协调自适应 VSG 控制策略。首先，非线性 SOC 惩罚函数根据实时 BESS 操作限制动态调整虚拟参数，从而在关键 SOC 条件下保护电池健康。其次，频率死区与离散低通滤波器相结合，消除了噪声环境中的跨边界参数抖动。通过特征值分析证明了整个工作范围内的闭环小信号稳定性。阶跃有功功率扰动和噪声条件下的时域仿真表明，该策略几乎消除了有功功率过冲，将峰值动态频率偏差深度降低了64.7%（0.06 Hz vs. 0.17 Hz），将瞬态电池功率应力减轻了25.3%，并将参数颤振衰减了90%以上，成功地将交流侧频率调节与直流侧电应力解耦。

articles.title: RGB--Infrared Photovoltaic Defect Detection via Edge-Aware Feature Extraction and Multi-Scale Fusion
articles.title_zh: RGB——通过边缘感知特征提取和多尺度融合进行红外光伏缺陷检测
articles.abstract: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) defect detection is essential for maintaining solar power system performance. However, variations in defect appearance, loss of fine-grained spatial details, and limited interaction between visible and thermal features make accurate detection challenging. To address these issues, this study proposes Photovoltaic Multi-modal Feature-enhanced YOLO (PVMF-YOLO), a YOLO11n-based RGB--infrared detector. It incorporates three modifications: a Laplacian-of-Gaussian stem (LoGStem) in the RGB backbone to enhance shallow structural features; P3 cross-modal fusion and an additional P2 detection branch to improve high-resolution feature representation; and an SOEP--RFPN neck for multi-scale feature aggregation. Experiments on the six-category DM-PV dataset show that PVMF-YOLO achieves a Precision of 0.868, Recall of 0.862, F1-score of 0.865, mAP₅₀ of 0.906, and mAP₅₀:₉₅ of 0.645 on the independent test set. The proposed model improves Precision, Recall, F1-score, mAP50, and mAP50:95 by 6.5, 5.3, 5.9, 5.5, and 5.4 percentage points, respectively, compared with the dual-modal YOLO11n-MM baseline. All seven YOLO architectures achieve higher values for both mAP metrics when using dual-modal inputs than when using RGB or infrared inputs alone. The ablation results show that combining P3 fusion with P2 detection brings the largest improvements in mAP. The effect of SOEP--RFPN varies depending on the other modifications used with it. These improvements also require more computation, showing a trade-off between detection performance and model complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 可靠的光伏 (PV) 缺陷检测对于维持太阳能发电系统的性能至关重要。然而，缺陷外观的变化、细粒度空间细节的丢失以及可见光和热特征之间有限的相互作用使得准确检测具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，本研究提出了光伏多模态特征增强型 YOLO (PVMF-YOLO)，这是一种基于 YOLO11n 的 RGB 红外探测器。它包含三个修改：RGB 主干中的拉普拉斯高斯主干 (LoGStem)，用于增强浅层结构特征； P3跨模态融合和附加的P2检测分支以提高高分辨率特征表示；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可靠的光伏 (PV) 缺陷检测对于维持太阳能发电系统的性能至关重要。然而，缺陷外观的变化、细粒度空间细节的丢失以及可见光和热特征之间有限的相互作用使得准确检测具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，本研究提出了光伏多模态特征增强型 YOLO (PVMF-YOLO)，这是一种基于 YOLO11n 的 RGB 红外探测器。它包含三个修改：RGB 主干中的拉普拉斯高斯主干 (LoGStem)，用于增强浅层结构特征； P3跨模态融合和附加的P2检测分支以提高高分辨率特征表示；以及用于多尺度特征聚合的 SOEP--RFPN 颈部。在六类 DM-PV 数据集上的实验表明，PVMF-YOLO 在独立测试集上的 Precision 为 0.868，Recall 为 0.862，F1-score 为 0.865，mAP₅₀ 为 0.906，mAP₅₀:₉₅ 为 0.645。与双模态 YOLO11n-MM 基线相比，所提出的模型将 Precision、Recall、F1-score、mAP50 和 mAP50:95 分别提高了 6.5、5.3、5.9、5.5 和 5.4 个百分点。使用双模态输入时，所有七种 YOLO 架构的两个 mAP 指标均比单独使用 RGB 或红外输入时实现更高的值。消融结果表明，将 P3 融合与 P2 检测相结合带来了 mAP 的最大改进。 SOEP--RFPN 的效果因与其一起使用的其他修改而异。这些改进还需要更多的计算，显示了检测性能和模型复杂性之间的权衡。

articles.title: Polymer Banknote Recognition and Tear Detection under Adverse Illumination: A Dataset and Local-Contrast Gated Attention
articles.title_zh: 不利照明下的聚合物钞票识别和撕裂检测：数据集和局部对比度门控注意力
articles.abstract: Thin, low-contrast structures on glossy surfaces are easily lost when specular highlights saturate the camera sensor. We study this problem on polymer banknotes and introduce VN-Polymer-Adverse, a dataset of 1,812 images of Vietnamese notes (six denominations and tears) captured in six acquisition regimes, together with IR-YOLOv8n, a YOLOv8n variant with two Local-Contrast Gated Attention (LCGA) blocks in the neck. LCGA passes a local gradient-energy map to a signed spatial gate that can raise or lower neck activations. With 3.02 M parameters, IR-YOLOv8n reaches 98.76% mean average precision at an intersection-over-union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@50), against 97.24% for YOLOv8n, and raises tear average precision (AP@50–95) under glare from 62.47% to 67.96%. Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalisation preprocessing gave no gain. IR-YOLOv8n is comparable to YOLOv8s on tears but trails it on denominations, and its latency on a graphics processing unit (GPU) is 42% higher than that of YOLOv8n. Each model was trained once, and the feature-level analysis did not confirm the mechanism that motivated the gate, so we present LCGA as a component that helps empirically.
articles.abstract_zh: 当镜面高光使相机传感器饱和时，光滑表面上的薄、低对比度结构很容易丢失。我们在聚合物纸币上研究这个问题，并引入了 VN-Polymer-Adverse，这是一个包含 1,812 张越南纸币图像（六种面额和泪痕）的数据集，在六种采集模式中捕获，以及 IR-YOLOv8n，一种 YOLOv8n 变体，在颈部有两个局部对比度门控注意力 (LCGA) 块。 LCGA 将局部梯度能量图传递到有符号的空间门，该空间门可以提高或降低颈部激活。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当镜面高光使相机传感器饱和时，光滑表面上的薄、低对比度结构很容易丢失。我们在聚合物纸币上研究这个问题，并引入了 VN-Polymer-Adverse，这是一个包含 1,812 张越南纸币图像（六种面额和泪痕）的数据集，在六种采集模式中捕获，以及 IR-YOLOv8n，一种 YOLOv8n 变体，在颈部有两个局部对比度门控注意力 (LCGA) 块。 LCGA 将局部梯度能量图传递到有符号的空间门，该空间门可以提高或降低颈部激活。凭借 3.02 M 参数，IR-YOLOv8n 在交叉联合阈值为 0.5 (mAP@50) 时达到 98.76% 的平均精度，而 YOLOv8n 为 97.24%，并将眩光下的撕裂平均精度 (AP@50–95) 从 62.47% 提高到 67.96%。对比度限制自适应直方图均衡预处理没有带来任何增益。 IR-YOLOv8n 在性能上与 YOLOv8 相当，但在面额上落后，并且其在图形处理单元 (GPU) 上的延迟比 YOLOv8n 高 42%。每个模型都训练过一次，并且特征级分析没有确认激发门的机制，因此我们将 LCGA 作为一个在经验上有帮助的组件。

articles.title: Improving the wear resistance of cutting tools during steels machining
articles.title_zh: 提高钢材加工过程中切削刀具的耐磨性
articles.abstract: This article examines tungsten carbide (WC-Co) inserts coated by physical vapor deposition (PVD - AlTiN) and chemical vapor deposition (CVD - TiCN + Al₂O₃) as two major solutions for improving the wear resistance of carbide cutting tools. One of the main technical and economic challenges of modern machining lies in improving the durability of cutting tools when machining corrosion resistant stainless steels. By analyzing cutting forces ((:FC)), interface temperature ((:θ:ᵢ)), and monitoring wear kinetics ((:VB)), we evaluate the performance of these coatings to optimize tool life under severe cutting conditions. The results demonstrate that while the PVD coating performs well during the first few minutes by limiting work hardening, the alumina thermal barrier of the CVD coating extends the overall tool life by nearly 35% under stationary and severe cutting conditions. The breakdown of the cobalt bond between the tungsten carbide grains leads to fractures on the surface of the cutting tool, which causes fractures and mechanical detachment of the grains from the cutting edge surface, corresponding to crack wear. Combined technologies for modifying the cutting tool surface are of major practical interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了物理气相沉积 (PVD - AlTiN) 和化学气相沉积 (CVD - TiCN + Al2O₃) 涂层碳化钨 (WC-Co) 刀片，作为提高硬质合金切削刀具耐磨性的两种主要解决方案。现代机械加工的主要技术和经济挑战之一在于提高加工耐腐蚀不锈钢时切削刀具的耐用性。通过分析切削力 ((:FC))、界面温度 ((:θ:ᵢ)) 和监测磨损动力学 ((:VB))，我们评估这些涂层的性能，以优化恶劣切削条件下的刀具寿命。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了物理气相沉积 (PVD - AlTiN) 和化学气相沉积 (CVD - TiCN + Al2O₃) 涂层碳化钨 (WC-Co) 刀片，作为提高硬质合金切削刀具耐磨性的两种主要解决方案。现代机械加工的主要技术和经济挑战之一在于提高加工耐腐蚀不锈钢时切削刀具的耐用性。通过分析切削力 ((:FC))、界面温度 ((:θ:ᵢ)) 和监测磨损动力学 ((:VB))，我们评估这些涂层的性能，以优化恶劣切削条件下的刀具寿命。结果表明，虽然 PVD 涂层通过限制加工硬化在最初几分钟内表现良好，但 CVD 涂层的氧化铝热障在静止和严酷的切削条件下将整体刀具寿命延长了近 35%。碳化钨晶粒之间钴键的破坏导致切削刀具表面断裂，从而导致晶粒从切削刃表面发生断裂和机械脱离，对应于裂纹磨损。用于修改切削刀具表面的组合技术具有重大的实际意义。

articles.title: Effect of Casting Cavity Volume on the Solidification Structure and Hardness of a T6- Treated Multi-Walled Carbon Nanotube-Reinforced Al–Cu Alloy
articles.title_zh: 铸造型腔体积对T6处理多壁碳纳米管增强铝铜合金凝固组织和硬度的影响
articles.abstract: The effect of mold cavity volume on the solidification behavior, microstructural evolution, phase formation, and hardness of an Al–4wt.%Cu alloy reinforced with 0.1wt.% multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) were investigated using a variable-volume green sand-casting process followed by T6 heat treatment. Seven cylindrical cavity volumes ranging from 6.3 to 100.5 cm³ were designed to generate different heat extraction conditions while maintaining identical alloy composition and pouring parameters. Thermal analysis, CALPHAD simulations (Thermo-Calc), optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM/EDS), and Rockwell F hardness testing were employed for characterization. Thermodynamic simulations predicted the precipitation of Al₄C₃ above 1400°C followed by α-Al, Fe-rich intermetallics, and θ-Al₂Cu. Experimental liquidus and solidus temperatures showed excellent agreement with the simulations with deviations within the thermocouple uncertainty (± 2°C). SEM/EDS analysis confirmed the presence of the predicted phases including Al₄C₃. The alloy exhibited a predominantly equiaxed macrostructure while the dendritic microstructure became progressively coarser with increasing cavity volume. The secondary dendrite arm spacing (SDAS) increased from 69.7 to 105.7 µm and followed a power-law relationship with cavity volume (R² = 0.92). Hardness decreased with increasing SDAS and exhibited a Hall–Petch-type dependence on SDAS⁻¹ᐟ² indicating that dendrite refinement is the primary strengthening mechanism in the as-cast condition. The T6 treatment (520°C/5 h, water quenching, and aging at 190°C/3 h) significantly increased hardness through precipitation hardening. The results showed that cavity volume and T6 heat treatment jointly control microstructural refinement and mechanical performance in MWCNT-reinforced investigated alloy.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用变体积湿砂铸造工艺和 T6 热处理，研究了模具型腔体积对 0.1wt.% 多壁碳纳米管 (MWCNT) 增强的 Al-4wt.%Cu 合金的凝固行为、显微结构演变、相形成和硬度的影响。设计了七个体积从 6.3 到 100.5 cm3 的圆柱形型腔，以产生不同的排热条件，同时保持相同的合金成分和浇注参数。采用热分析、CALPHAD 模拟 (Thermo-Calc)、光学显微镜、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM/EDS) 和洛氏 F 硬度测试进行表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用变体积湿砂铸造工艺和 T6 热处理，研究了模具型腔体积对 0.1wt.% 多壁碳纳米管 (MWCNT) 增强的 Al-4wt.%Cu 合金的凝固行为、显微结构演变、相形成和硬度的影响。设计了七个体积从 6.3 到 100.5 cm3 的圆柱形型腔，以产生不同的排热条件，同时保持相同的合金成分和浇注参数。采用热分析、CALPHAD 模拟 (Thermo-Calc)、光学显微镜、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM/EDS) 和洛氏 F 硬度测试进行表征。热力学模拟预测在 1400°C 以上会析出 Al₄C₃，随后析出 α-Al、富铁金属间化合物和 θ-Al2Cu。实验液相线和固相线温度与模拟结果非常吻合，偏差在热电偶不确定度 (± 2°C) 范围内。 SEM/EDS 分析证实了包括 Al4C3 在内的预测相的存在。该合金表现出主要为等轴宏观结构，而枝晶微观结构随着空腔体积的增加而逐渐变粗。二次枝晶臂间距 (SDAS) 从 69.7 µm 增加到 105.7 µm，并且与空腔体积呈幂律关系 (R² = 0.92)。硬度随着 SDAS 的增加而降低，并表现出对 SDAS⁻1ᐟ² 的 Hall-Petch 型依赖性，表明枝晶细化是铸态条件下的主要强化机制。 T6处理（520℃/5小时，水淬，190℃/3小时时效）通过沉淀硬化显着提高了硬度。结果表明，空腔体积和 T6 热处理共同控制 MWCNT 增强合金的微观结构细化和机械性能。

articles.title: Dynamic Behavior of Functionally Graded Beams Supported by Three-Parameter Viscoelastic Foundations
articles.title_zh: 三参数粘弹性基础支撑的功能梯度梁的动态行为
articles.abstract: This paper presents two refined shear deformation theories for investigating the free vibration behavior of functionally graded (FG) beams resting on three-parameter viscoelastic foundations (VEFs). The proposed theories employ sinusoidal and parabolic distributions of transverse shear strains through the beam thickness and satisfy the zero-shear-stress conditions at the upper and lower surfaces without requiring shear correction factors. The formulations also reduce the number of unknowns and governing equations, simplifying the computational process. The material properties are assumed to vary continuously across the beam thickness according to a power-law distribution. The foundation is modeled using Winkler and Pasternak parameters, together with a damping coefficient. The governing equations are derived using Hamilton’s principle, and analytical solutions are obtained through the Navier method. The accuracy of the proposed models is validated against existing solutions. Finally, a comprehensive parametric study examines the effects of material gradation, slenderness ratio, foundation stiffness, shear interaction, and damping on the natural frequencies of FG beams.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了两种改进的剪切变形理论，用于研究基于三参数粘弹性基础（VEF）的功能梯度（FG）梁的自由振动行为。所提出的理论采用整个梁厚度的横向剪应变的正弦和抛物线分布，并满足上表面和下表面的零剪应力条件，而不需要剪切校正因子。该公式还减少了未知数和控制方程的数量，简化了计算过程。假设材料属性根据幂律分布在梁厚度上连续变化。使用 Winkler 和 Pasternak 参数以及阻尼系数对基础进行建模。利用哈密顿原理推导了控制方程，并通过纳维法获得了解析解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了两种改进的剪切变形理论，用于研究基于三参数粘弹性基础（VEF）的功能梯度（FG）梁的自由振动行为。所提出的理论采用整个梁厚度的横向剪应变的正弦和抛物线分布，并满足上表面和下表面的零剪应力条件，而不需要剪切校正因子。该公式还减少了未知数和控制方程的数量，简化了计算过程。假设材料属性根据幂律分布在梁厚度上连续变化。使用 Winkler 和 Pasternak 参数以及阻尼系数对基础进行建模。利用哈密顿原理推导了控制方程，并通过纳维法获得了解析解。所提出模型的准确性根据现有解决方案进行了验证。最后，综合参数研究检验了材料级配、长细比、基础刚度、剪切相互作用和阻尼对 FG 梁固有频率的影响。

articles.title: New quantum network entangles 123 qubits that store information in atoms' positions
articles.title_zh: 新量子网络纠缠 123 个量子位，将信息存储在原子位置
articles.abstract: Researchers are constantly getting closer to making practical quantum computers. Now, a team of researchers has overcome another hurdle in the process. Their study, published in Physical Review Letters, describes a new platform for manipulating entangled atomic networks in measurement-based quantum computation—a process usually hindered by difficulties manipulating only one atom or one group of atoms at a time.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员正在不断接近制造实用的量子计算机。现在，一组研究人员克服了这一过程中的另一个障碍。他们的研究发表在《物理评论快报》上，描述了一种在基于测量的量子计算中操纵纠缠原子网络的新平台——这一过程通常因一次仅操纵一个原子或一组原子的困难而受到阻碍。
