articles.title: Spontaneous Time-Reversal-Symmetry-Breaking State in Proximity-Induced Superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 邻近感应超导中的自发时间反转对称破缺态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33288v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on superconducting heterostructures formed by an s-wave superconductor and a Dirac semimetal suggest that in these systems the superconducting state can break time-reversal symmetry even though no magnetic order or unconventional pairing is present in any of the structure's components. We present a minimal mechanism for a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking superconducting state in multiband systems proximity-coupled to a conventional s-wave superconductor. We derive the conditions for this state, find that it is the ground state wherever it exists, and obtain the phase diagrams. We find that in some situations the phase diagrams describe reentrant behavior: by continuously varying a parameter the system can undergo multiple transitions between a time-reversal-symmetric state and a state that spontaneously breaks time-reversal symmetry. The results help identify heterostructures that can be engineered to obtain nonreciprocal superconducting transport effects even when no magnetic field or magnetization is present.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近对由 s 波超导体和狄拉克半金属形成的超导异质结构的实验表明，在这些系统中，即使任何结构的组件中不存在磁序或非常规配对，超导状态也可以打破时间反转对称性。我们提出了一种在与传统 s 波超导体邻近耦合的多带系统中时间反转对称性破缺超导态的最小机制。我们推导出该状态的条件，发现无论它存在哪里，它都是基态，并获得相图。我们发现，在某些情况下，相图描述了可重入行为：通过连续改变参数，系统可以在时间反转对称状态和自发打破时间反转对称状态之间经历多次转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近对由 s 波超导体和狄拉克半金属形成的超导异质结构的实验表明，在这些系统中，即使任何结构的组件中不存在磁序或非常规配对，超导状态也可以打破时间反转对称性。我们提出了一种在与传统 s 波超导体邻近耦合的多带系统中时间反转对称性破缺超导态的最小机制。我们推导出该状态的条件，发现无论它存在哪里，它都是基态，并获得相图。我们发现，在某些情况下，相图描述了可重入行为：通过连续改变参数，系统可以在时间反转对称状态和自发打破时间反转对称状态之间经历多次转变。这些结果有助于识别异质结构，即使在不存在磁场或磁化强度的情况下，也可以设计这些异质结构以获得非互易超导输运效应。

articles.title: Can the chemical potential and the many-body correlated phases of a two-dimensional dipolar fluid be approximated analytically? A Quantum Monte-Carlo study of a universal behavior of dipolar excitons
articles.title_zh: 二维偶极流体的化学势和多体关联相能否通过分析近似？偶极激子普遍行为的量子蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A central challenge in quantum many-body physics is to connect microscopic interactions to experimentally accessible macroscopic states of matter, where correlations extend across multiple length scales. Using quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations of two-dimensional repulsive dipolar bosons, recently realized across various experimental platforms, we show that correlations within the dipolar fluid lead to an unexpected simplification. Specifically, we find that these correlations induce a pronounced depletion region around each particle that suppresses short-range physics and yields an emergent universality, where the fluid is governed by dipolar interactions rather than material-specific details. Exploiting this universality, we establish a unified, quantitatively validated analytical framework for the dipolar fluid, taking indirect (interlayer) excitons as a model system. We show that analytical interaction energies derived in an earlier study agree with exact QMC results across three correlation regimes: a classical gas, a quantum gas, and a high-density liquid. In contrast, the widely used uncorrelated plate capacitor formula severely overestimates the numerical values. Building on these expressions, we show that the chemical potential is accurately captured by a three-component decomposition: an ideal Bose-gas kinetic term, a regime-dependent dipolar interaction term, and a high-density quantum confinement term. Finally, we address a key experimental challenge: extracting exciton densities from measured energy shifts. Our QMC-benchmarked calibration curves for typical gallium arsenide (GaAs) and transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures offer a reliable tool for experimentalists to determine both the fluid's density and collective state. This universal framework extends to other two-dimensional systems, including ultracold dipolar atoms and polar molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子多体物理学的一个核心挑战是将微观相互作用与可通过实验获得的宏观物质状态联系起来，其中相关性延伸到多个长度尺度。使用最近在各种实验平台上实现的二维排斥偶极玻色子的量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）模拟，我们表明偶极流体内的相关性导致了意想不到的简化。具体来说，我们发现这些相关性会在每个粒子周围引起明显的耗尽区域，从而抑制短程物理并产生新兴的普遍性，其中流体受偶极相互作用而不是特定于材料的细节控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子多体物理学的一个核心挑战是将微观相互作用与可通过实验获得的宏观物质状态联系起来，其中相关性延伸到多个长度尺度。使用最近在各种实验平台上实现的二维排斥偶极玻色子的量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）模拟，我们表明偶极流体内的相关性导致了意想不到的简化。具体来说，我们发现这些相关性会在每个粒子周围引起明显的耗尽区域，从而抑制短程物理并产生新兴的普遍性，其中流体受偶极相互作用而不是特定于材料的细节控制。利用这种普遍性，我们建立了一个统一的、定量验证的偶极流体分析框架，以间接（层间）激子作为模型系统。我们表明，早期研究中得出的分析相互作用能与三种相关机制（经典气体、量子气体和高密度液体）中的精确 QMC 结果一致。相反，广泛使用的不相关平板电容器公式严重高估了数值。在这些表达式的基础上，我们表明化学势可以通过三分量分解准确地捕获：理想的玻色气体动力学项、依赖于状态的偶极相互作用项和高密度量子限制项。最后，我们解决了一个关键的实验挑战：从测量的能量变化中提取激子密度。我们针对典型砷化镓 (GaAs) 和过渡金属二硫族化物 (TMD) 异质结构的 QMC 基准校准曲线为实验人员确定流体密度和集体状态提供了可靠的工具。这种通用框架扩展到其他二维系统，包括超冷偶极原子和极性分子。

articles.title: Spin superfluid transport of magnons in altermagnetic insulators
articles.title_zh: 交变磁绝缘体中磁振子的自旋超流体传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the spin superfluidity for Lieb and inverse Lieb lattices in altermagnets, which enables coherent transport of spin angular momentum carried by the phase of an easy-plane Néel order. The easy-plane anisotropy supplies the U(1) platform, while the nonrelativistic spin splitting generates sublattice-alternating exchange imbalance with B₁g symmetry. Via a continuum theory and Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we find that the Goldstone mode becomes quadratic at the critical stability boundary. An axial phase gradient transfers phase-channel spectral weight to the gapped mode, whereas a diagonal flow leaves these signatures absent. The spin superfluid exhibits momentum-space anisotropy due to the chiral-splitting magnon dispersion, while strong fields or elevated temperatures suppress phase coherence. Accounting for the contribution of thermal magnons at the interface, we present that the critical spin flow varies with the injection angle under the altermagnetic crystal-field effects. The spin-superfluid decay length scales with the interfacial spin-mixing conductance, which can be measured by the spin Hall magnetoresistance and spin Seebeck effect. Our findings establish altermagnetic insulators, particularly La₂O₃FeMnSe₂, as promising platforms for low-dissipation spin transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了交流磁体中利布晶格和逆利布晶格的自旋超流性，这使得易平面尼尔阶的相位所携带的自旋角动量能够进行相干传输。易平面各向异性提供了 U(1) 平台，而非相对论性自旋分裂则产生具有 B₁g 对称性的亚晶格交替交换不平衡。通过连续介质理论和 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 模拟，我们发现 Goldstone 模式在临界稳定边界处变成二次型。轴向相位梯度将相位通道谱权重转移到间隙模式，而对角线流则不存在这些特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了交流磁体中利布晶格和逆利布晶格的自旋超流性，这使得易平面尼尔阶的相位所携带的自旋角动量能够进行相干传输。易平面各向异性提供了 U(1) 平台，而非相对论性自旋分裂则产生具有 B₁g 对称性的亚晶格交替交换不平衡。通过连续介质理论和 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 模拟，我们发现 Goldstone 模式在临界稳定边界处变成二次型。轴向相位梯度将相位通道谱权重转移到间隙模式，而对角线流则不存在这些特征。由于手性分裂磁振子色散，自旋超流体表现出动量空间各向异性，而强场或高温会抑制相位相干性。考虑到界面处热磁振子的贡献，我们提出在交变磁晶体场效应下临界自旋流随注入角变化。自旋超流体衰减长度与界面自旋混合电导成比例，可以通过自旋霍尔磁阻和自旋塞贝克效应来测量。我们的研究结果确立了交磁绝缘体，特别是 La2O3FeMnSe2，作为低耗散自旋输运的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Magnetically Guided Sequential Multi-Filler Alignment Enables Anisotropic Heat Pathways in Stretchable Composites for Soft Electronics
articles.title_zh: 磁引导顺序多填料排列可实现软电子可拉伸复合材料中的各向异性热路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stretchable, skin-conformal electronics demand thermal interface materials that combine high through-plane heat transport with mechanical softness and lateral electrical insulation. In particle-filled composites, these requirements are typically antagonistic. Heat transport is governed not only by the intrinsic thermal conductivity of the fillers but, more critically, by thermal resistance at the interparticle interface. As the interparticle distance is reduced by increasing the particle content, mechanical reinforcement and in-plane electrical conductivity become unavoidable. The existing particle alignment processing strategies result in inefficient uncoupling of multifunctionality. Here, we present a hierarchical two-step process strategy to induce strong conductivity anisotropy in a soft composite. First, an align-before-blend process forms a scaffold of magnetically aligned nickel (Ni) microparticles in air before polymer infiltration. The absence of the viscous elastomer matrix during the particle alignment facilitates handling large amounts of particles, which assemble into highly ordered and densely packed vertical heat-conduction pathways. Second, a liquid metal (LM)/Ni mixture is infiltrated into the aligned scaffold to bridge interparticle gaps, minimizing interparticle thermal resistance. The composite reaches 7.5 W/(m K) through-plane thermal conductivity with lateral electrical conductivity below 10⁻¹² S/m and ultrasoft mechanical compliance (approximately 160 kPa), enabling coupling layers in thermoelectric generators and finger-mounted heat-spreading pads for wearable technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 可拉伸、贴合皮肤的电子产品需要热界面材料，将高平面热传输与机械柔软性和横向电绝缘性结合起来。在颗粒填充复合材料中，这些要求通常是相互矛盾的。热传输不仅受填料固有导热率的影响，更重要的是受颗粒间界面热阻的影响。由于通过增加颗粒含量来减小颗粒间距离，因此机械增强和面内导电性变得不可避免。现有的粒子排列处理策略导致多功能性的低效解耦。在这里，我们提出了一种分层两步工艺策略，以在软复合材料中诱导强电导率各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可拉伸、贴合皮肤的电子产品需要热界面材料，将高平面热传输与机械柔软性和横向电绝缘性结合起来。在颗粒填充复合材料中，这些要求通常是相互矛盾的。热传输不仅受填料固有导热率的影响，更重要的是受颗粒间界面热阻的影响。由于通过增加颗粒含量来减小颗粒间距离，因此机械增强和面内导电性变得不可避免。现有的粒子排列处理策略导致多功能性的低效解耦。在这里，我们提出了一种分层两步工艺策略，以在软复合材料中诱导强电导率各向异性。首先，在聚合物渗透之前，混合前对齐工艺在空气中形成磁性排列的镍 (Ni) 微粒支架。在颗粒排列过程中不存在粘性弹性体基质有利于处理大量颗粒，这些颗粒组装成高度有序且密集的垂直热传导路径。其次，将液态金属（LM）/镍混合物渗透到对齐的支架中以桥接颗粒间间隙，从而最大限度地减少颗粒间热阻。该复合材料的平面导热系数达到 7.5 W/(m K)，横向电导率低于 10⁻12 S/m，具有超软机械柔量（约 160 kPa），可实现热电发生器中的耦合层和用于可穿戴技术的指装散热垫。

articles.title: Unveiling ferroelectricity in wafer-scale beta-phase In₂Se₃
articles.title_zh: 揭示晶圆级 β 相 In2Se₃ 中的铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pushing ferroelectricity to the ultimate thickness limit is a central challenge for memory hardware, because conventional three-dimensional ferroelectrics degrade through depolarization and interfacial effects when thinned. Here we identify β-In₂Se₃, a van der Waals semiconductor regarded as centrosymmetric, as a host of bistable polar order arising from a picometre-scale distortion within each quintuple layer. The polar state has out-of-plane and in-plane components, is switched by a vertical electric field, and persists to the bilayer limit (~1.9 nm) with an estimated coercive field of 0.9 MV/cm and an apparent remanent polarization of 11.0 μC/cm². Films grown by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition on 2-inch wafers yield capacitor arrays with a switching-voltage spread below 5% across 100 devices, an endurance of 10⁷ cycles and a projected ten-year retention. Because the polar state coexists with a semiconducting gap, one film serves as both the switching layer of a capacitor and the channel of a ferroelectric semiconductor transistor.
articles.abstract_zh: 将铁电体推向最终厚度极限是存储硬件面临的主要挑战，因为传统的三维铁电体在变薄时会因去极化和界面效应而退化。在这里，我们确定了β-In2Se₃，一种被认为是中心对称的范德华半导体，作为由每个五层内皮米级畸变产生的一系列双稳态极序。极性态具有面外和面内分量，通过垂直电场切换，并持续至双层极限（~1.9 nm），估计矫顽场为 0.9 MV/cm，表观剩余极化为 11.0 μC/cm²。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将铁电体推向最终厚度极限是存储硬件面临的主要挑战，因为传统的三维铁电体在变薄时会因去极化和界面效应而退化。在这里，我们确定了β-In2Se₃，一种被认为是中心对称的范德华半导体，作为由每个五层内皮米级畸变产生的一系列双稳态极序。极性态具有面外和面内分量，通过垂直电场切换，并持续至双层极限（~1.9 nm），估计矫顽场为 0.9 MV/cm，表观剩余极化为 11.0 μC/cm²。通过金属有机化学气相沉积在 2 英寸晶圆上生长的薄膜，可生产出电容器阵列，其在 100 个器件上的开关电压分布低于 5%，耐用性为 10⁷ 周期，预计保持期为 10 年。由于极性态与半导体能隙共存，一层薄膜既可作为电容器的开关层，又可作为铁电半导体晶体管的沟道。

articles.title: Large-deformation constitutive modeling of viscoelastic foams: Application to an open-cell foam material
articles.title_zh: 粘弹性泡沫的大变形本构建模：在开孔泡沫材料中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-cell elastomeric foams are widely utilized for impact protection and cushioning applications. These foams can demonstrate remarkable elastic compressibility and rate sensitivity over a wide range of force and acceleration protection levels. They often exhibit volumetric-distortional coupling in their mechanical response and potentially compaction banding when subjected to dynamic loads. Here, a phenomenological modeling framework, adopted previously for closed-cell foams, is specified using an experimental characterization-based approach for calibrating and validating the large-deformation, viscoelastic material model. Homogeneous simple compression and tension experiments were performed on isotropic, open-cell viscoelastic foam materials, and stress-strain and lateral-axial strain data were used for model calibration. Data were collected at decadal strain rates to inform the rate-sensitive aspects of the model. The modeling approach involved decomposing the total material response into an equilibrium hyperelastic contribution and several nonlinear, Maxwell-like contributions and utilized invariants of the logarithmic strain to account for large deformations and the strong volumetric-distortional coupling effect. A new strain localization detection algorithm was developed and used to check for the formation of compaction bands, which would invalidate modeling assumptions for the calibration experiments. To validate the predictive capability of the constitutive model, experiments were conducted that involved intentionally inhomogeneous deformations over a spectrum of strain rates and deformation types. The consistency between the measured responses from the validation experiments and the model predictions obtained from finite-element-based numerical simulations was largely within the experimental uncertainty bounds, demonstrating the predictive capability of the model.
articles.abstract_zh: 开孔弹性体泡沫广泛用于冲击保护和缓冲应用。这些泡沫可以在各种力和加速度保护水平下表现出卓越的弹性压缩性和速率敏感性。它们经常在机械响应中表现出体积扭曲耦合，并且在承受动态载荷时可能会出现压实带。在这里，使用基于实验表征的方法来指定以前用于闭孔泡沫的唯象建模框架，用于校准和验证大变形粘弹性材料模型。对各向同性、开孔粘弹性泡沫材料进行均质简单压缩和拉伸实验，并使用应力应变和横向轴向应变数据进行模型校准。以十年应变率收集数据，以了解模型的速率敏感方面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开孔弹性体泡沫广泛用于冲击保护和缓冲应用。这些泡沫可以在各种力和加速度保护水平下表现出卓越的弹性压缩性和速率敏感性。它们经常在机械响应中表现出体积扭曲耦合，并且在承受动态载荷时可能会出现压实带。在这里，使用基于实验表征的方法来指定以前用于闭孔泡沫的唯象建模框架，用于校准和验证大变形粘弹性材料模型。对各向同性、开孔粘弹性泡沫材料进行均质简单压缩和拉伸实验，并使用应力应变和横向轴向应变数据进行模型校准。以十年应变率收集数据，以了解模型的速率敏感方面。建模方法涉及将总材料响应分解为平衡超弹性贡献和几个非线性、类麦克斯韦贡献，并利用对数应变不变量来解释大变形和强体积扭曲耦合效应。开发了一种新的应变定位检测算法并用于检查压实带的形成，这将使校准实验的建模假设无效。为了验证本构模型的预测能力，进行了涉及一系列应变率和变形类型的故意不均匀变形的实验。验证实验的测量响应与基于有限元的数值模拟获得的模型预测之间的一致性很大程度上在实验不确定性范围内，证明了模型的预测能力。

articles.title: Spectroscopic Signatures of Polaronic Density Wave Fluctuations in Superconducting Bismuthates
articles.title_zh: 超导铋酸盐中极化子密度波涨落的光谱特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The bismuthate high-temperature superconductors have been identified as potential bipolaron systems, where hole pairs are bound to local breathing distortions of the BiO₆ octahedra in their metallic phase. However, obtaining definitive evidence for these quasiparticles and their excitations remains challenging. Here, we report on periodic modulations of the spectral intensities and scattering rates of quasiparticles on the Fermi surfaces of doped bismuthates Ba₁₋ₓKₓBiO₃ and BaPb₁₋yBi_yO₃, which are reminiscent of ``hot spot'' patterns that have been observed in cuprate superconductors. We show that these features can be well described by a model where electrons couple to fluctuating density wave modulations with short-range coherence along a (π,π,π)-oriented wavevector. The results are consistent with the existence of a two-component fluid where unpaired electrons interact with a fluctuating density wave created by residual bipolarons and their breathing distortions of the BiO₆ octahedra.
articles.abstract_zh: 铋酸盐高温超导体已被认为是潜在的双极子系统，其中空穴对与金属相 BiO₆ 八面体的局部呼吸变形有关。然而，获得这些准粒子及其激发的明确证据仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了掺杂铋Ba₋ₓKₓBiO₃和BaPb₁₋yBi_yO₃费米表面上准粒子的光谱强度和散射率的周期性调制，这让人想起在铜酸盐超导体中观察到的“热点”图案。我们表明，这些特征可以通过一个模型很好地描述，其中电子沿着（π，π，π）方向的波矢量耦合到具有短程相干性的脉动密度波调制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铋酸盐高温超导体已被认为是潜在的双极子系统，其中空穴对与金属相 BiO₆ 八面体的局部呼吸变形有关。然而，获得这些准粒子及其激发的明确证据仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了掺杂铋Ba₋ₓKₓBiO₃和BaPb₁₋yBi_yO₃费米表面上准粒子的光谱强度和散射率的周期性调制，这让人想起在铜酸盐超导体中观察到的“热点”图案。我们表明，这些特征可以通过一个模型很好地描述，其中电子沿着（π，π，π）方向的波矢量耦合到具有短程相干性的脉动密度波调制。结果与双组分流体的存在一致，其中不成对的电子与残余双极子及其 BiO₆ 八面体的呼吸扭曲产生的波动密度波相互作用。

articles.title: Exact high-order spectral moments and moment-based reconstruction of polaron spectra at finite temperature for arbitrary linear electron-phonon coupling
articles.title_zh: 任意线性电子声子耦合的有限温度下极化子谱的精确高阶谱矩和基于矩的重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a family of exact and efficient recurrence relations for the frequency moments of the single-electron addition spectral function of a generic single-band electron-phonon Hamiltonian with linear coupling to harmonic phonons. Working in the limit of zero carrier density, the formulation applies at zero and finite temperature and generalizes to arbitrary dimensions and lattice geometry. Using the Holstein and Peierls models coupled to Einstein and dispersive phonons as examples, we obtain closed-form expressions for moments of far higher order than those available in the literature, at modest computational cost. Beyond providing stringent benchmarks for numerical methods and experimental spectra, the high-order moments serve as input to approximate reconstructions of polaron spectra at weak-to-intermediate coupling and low temperature. The resulting spectral functions are exact in the weak-coupling and atomic limits, and respect rigorous bounds on the polaron energy and weight that we show the self-consistent Born approximation violates throughout the coupling-adiabaticity plane. The approach therefore offers an inexpensive yet accurate approximation, especially for unexplored or numerically intractable models, before computationally demanding exact methods are applied.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一系列精确有效的递推关系，用于与谐波声子线性耦合的通用单带电子声子哈密顿量的单电子加法谱函数的频率矩。该公式在零载流子密度的极限下工作，适用于零温度和有限温度，并可推广到任意维度和晶格几何形状。以与爱因斯坦和色散声子耦合的 Holstein 和 Peierls 模型为例，我们以适度的计算成本获得了比文献中可用的阶数高得多的矩的闭合形式表达式。除了为数值方法和实验光谱提供严格的基准之外，高阶矩还可以作为弱中耦合和低温下极化子光谱近似重建的输入。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一系列精确有效的递推关系，用于与谐波声子线性耦合的通用单带电子声子哈密顿量的单电子加法谱函数的频率矩。该公式在零载流子密度的极限下工作，适用于零温度和有限温度，并可推广到任意维度和晶格几何形状。以与爱因斯坦和色散声子耦合的 Holstein 和 Peierls 模型为例，我们以适度的计算成本获得了比文献中可用的阶数高得多的矩的闭合形式表达式。除了为数值方法和实验光谱提供严格的基准之外，高阶矩还可以作为弱中耦合和低温下极化子光谱近似重建的输入。由此产生的谱函数在弱耦合和原子极限下是精确的，并且遵守极化子能量和重量的严格界限，我们证明自洽玻恩近似在整个耦合绝热平面上违反了这一界限。因此，在应用计算要求严格的精确方法之前，该方法提供了一种廉价但准确的近似，特别是对于未探索的或数值上难以处理的模型。

articles.title: Extrinsic thermodynamic geometry, symmetry, and the cost of constraint
articles.title_zh: 外在热力学几何、对称性和约束成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33443v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driving a stochastic system in finite time costs excess work; exactly how much depends on which system parameters, and hence which paths in distribution space, a controller can access. In the friction-tensor formalism for slow driving, the space of equilibrium distributions is a Riemannian manifold and constraints on a controller define submanifolds. Whether a constrained controller is forced onto suboptimal paths is a question of the extrinsic thermodynamic geometry of the submanifold, which we develop for discrete systems. We show that submanifolds with zero extrinsic curvature can be identified from symmetries of the transition network, before any optimization. A minimum-work protocol on such a submanifold is therefore stationary in the excess work even when the constraints are lifted. The stationarity of symmetric optima holds exactly, beyond slow driving. In the slow-driving regime, we show that the ambient curvature transverse to a symmetric submanifold determines whether nearby symmetry-broken protocols have lower excess work. This curvature, which separates into independent contributions from each pattern of symmetry breaking, thus acquires an operational meaning as a measure of the thermodynamic incentive to break a given symmetry. A thermodynamic comparison theorem provides an inexpensive test of local minimality that weighs the extremal curvatures along the symmetric protocol against its excess work. There is no need for such tests under certain convexity conditions on the transition rates and control parameters, which guarantee that a symmetric optimum is a global optimum. These results certify the global optimality of a five-parameter protocol previously observed to match 15-parameter full control of a four-spin Ising system, and explain why partial symmetry breaking is optimal for the same system under local-field control.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限的时间内驱动随机系统会耗费过多的工作；具体多少取决于控制器可以访问哪些系统参数，以及分配空间中的哪些路径。在慢速驾驶的摩擦张量形式中，平衡分布空间是黎曼流形，控制器上的约束定义子流形。受约束的控制器是否被迫进入次优路径是子流形的外在热力学几何问题，我们为离散系统开发了子流形。我们表明，在任何优化之前，可以根据过渡网络的对称性来识别具有零外在曲率的子流形。因此，即使解除约束，这种子歧管上的最小工作协议在过量工作中也是固定的。对称最优的平稳性在慢速驾驶之外完全成立。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在有限的时间内驱动随机系统会耗费过多的工作；具体多少取决于控制器可以访问哪些系统参数，以及分配空间中的哪些路径。在慢速驾驶的摩擦张量形式中，平衡分布空间是黎曼流形，控制器上的约束定义子流形。受约束的控制器是否被迫进入次优路径是子流形的外在热力学几何问题，我们为离散系统开发了子流形。我们表明，在任何优化之前，可以根据过渡网络的对称性来识别具有零外在曲率的子流形。因此，即使解除约束，这种子歧管上的最小工作协议在过量工作中也是固定的。对称最优的平稳性在慢速驾驶之外完全成立。在慢速驾驶状态下，我们表明横向于对称子流形的环境曲率决定了附近的对称破缺协议是否具有较低的多余功。这种曲率将对称性破缺的每种模式分成独立的贡献，因此获得了操作意义，作为破坏给定对称性的热力学激励的度量。热力学比较定理提供了一种廉价的局部极小性测试，该测试将沿对称协议的极值曲率与其过量功进行权衡。在某些凸性条件下不需要对转移率和控制参数进行此类测试，这保证了对称最优是全局最优。这些结果证明了先前观察到的五参数协议的全局最优性，以匹配四自旋伊辛系统的 15 参数完全控制，并解释了为什么部分对称性破缺对于局部场控制下的同一系统是最优的。

articles.title: Electron--phonon interactions in a pseudo--atomic orbital basis: superconductivity, transport, spectroscopy and thermal emission from one interpolated vertex
articles.title_zh: 赝原子轨道基础上的电子-声子相互作用：来自一个插值顶点的超导性、输运、光谱学和热发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron--phonon interactions govern superconductivity, electrical resistivity, optical absorption and electronic excitation lifetimes in solids. First--principles calculations require interpolating this coupling onto dense Brillouin--zone grids, traditionally using maximally localized Wannier functions that demand material--specific tuning. Here we show that a fixed basis of pseudo--atomic orbitals--automatically generated from pseudopotentials and implemented in the open--source code PAOFLOW captures the electron--phonon vertex with equivalent accuracy and no manual tuning. Computed from density--functional perturbation theory or displaced supercells, and incorporating long--range fields and spin--orbit coupling, the vertex matches established codes on identical inputs. We validate the method on lead, reproducing its phonon dispersion, superconducting gap, critical temperature, resistivity, photoemission kink and cyclotron masses, and on silicon, capturing phonon--assisted optical absorption, wafer emissivity and carrier mobilities. This parameter--free framework enables high--throughput, automated electron--phonon calculations across large materials databases.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-声子相互作用控制着固体中的超导性、电阻率、光吸收和电子激发寿命。第一原理计算需要将这种耦合插值到密集的布里渊区网格上，传统上使用需要特定材料调整的最大局部化万尼尔函数。在这里，我们展示了从赝势自动生成并在开源代码 PAOFLOW 中实现的赝原子轨道的固定基础，以同等精度捕获电子声子顶点，无需手动调整。根据密度泛函微扰理论或位移超晶胞计算，并结合长程场和自旋轨道耦合，顶点与相同输入上的既定代码相匹配。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子相互作用控制着固体中的超导性、电阻率、光吸收和电子激发寿命。第一原理计算需要将这种耦合插值到密集的布里渊区网格上，传统上使用需要特定材料调整的最大局部化万尼尔函数。在这里，我们展示了从赝势自动生成并在开源代码 PAOFLOW 中实现的赝原子轨道的固定基础，以同等精度捕获电子声子顶点，无需手动调整。根据密度泛函微扰理论或位移超晶胞计算，并结合长程场和自旋轨道耦合，顶点与相同输入上的既定代码相匹配。我们在铅上验证了该方法，再现了其声子色散、超导间隙、临界温度、电阻率、光电发射扭结和回旋加速器质量，并在硅上验证了该方法，捕获了声子辅助光学吸收、晶片发射率和载流子迁移率。这种无参数框架可实现跨大型材料数据库的高通量、自动化电子声子计算。

articles.title: Low-barrier-height Hf₁-xZrₓO₂ ferroelectric tunnel junctions with large ON-state currents
articles.title_zh: 具有大导通电流的低势垒高度 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 铁电隧道结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) hold great promise for nonvolatile memory, neuromorphic computing, and other applications. Hf₁-xZrₓO₂ (HZO) has become a leading candidate for the tunnel barrier due primarily to its compatibility with CMOS technology. Recent advances on HZO based FTJs have highlighted the importance of understanding the electrical transport through a ferroelectric tunnel barrier for fulfilling the technological promises of FTJs. In this paper we report investigation of HZO FTJs featuring a barrier of ultrathin HZO (≤5nm) measured down to a temperature of 2 K. Direct quantum tunneling was found to dominate at low temperatures, along with contributions from trap-assisted tunneling. As the temperature increases, conduction by thermal activation takes over. We developed a minimal model that accounts for all experimental observations, revealing a barrier height significantly lower than that of the band alignment picture, an unexpected finding attributable to the emergence of a shallow trap band. This finding reveals a previously unexplored pathway toward simultaneously achieving large ON-state currents, high tunnel electroresistance and improved temperature stability for the high-speed memory applications of FTJs.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器、神经形态计算和其他应用中具有广阔的前景。 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 (HZO) 已成为隧道势垒的主要候选者，这主要是由于它与 CMOS 技术的兼容性。基于 HZO 的 FTJ 的最新进展凸显了了解通过铁电隧道势垒的电传输对于实现 FTJ 技术承诺的重要性。在本文中，我们报告了对 HZO FTJ 的研究，其特点是在低至 2 K 的温度下测量了超薄 HZO (≤5 nm) 势垒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器、神经形态计算和其他应用中具有广阔的前景。 Hf₁-xZrₓO2 (HZO) 已成为隧道势垒的主要候选者，这主要是由于它与 CMOS 技术的兼容性。基于 HZO 的 FTJ 的最新进展凸显了了解通过铁电隧道势垒的电传输对于实现 FTJ 技术承诺的重要性。在本文中，我们报告了对 HZO FTJ 的研究，其特点是在低至 2 K 的温度下测量了超薄 HZO (≤5 nm) 势垒。发现直接量子隧道效应在低温下占主导地位，同时陷阱辅助隧道效应也有贡献。随着温度升高，热激活传导开始发挥作用。我们开发了一个最小模型来解释所有实验观察结果，揭示了势垒高度明显低于能带对准图的高度，这是一个意外的发现，归因于浅陷阱带的出现。这一发现揭示了一条以前未探索过的途径，可以同时实现 FTJ 高速存储器应用的大导通电流、高隧道电阻和改进的温度稳定性。

articles.title: ILMlip: fast and universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: ILMlip：快速通用的机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials keep growing more accurate as new models appear at a rapid pace, and more expensive: the current leader of Matbench Discovery as of November 2026 (F1 score 0.935) has 9.9×10⁷ parameters and took 3.6 thousand GPU-hours to train. The ILMlip potentials presented here are optimised for speed as well as zero-shot accuracy. They are equivariant, conservative message-passing potentials in which every component is arranged for throughput: little work per pair of atoms and as much as needed per atom. Through ASE on one GPU, they run molecular dynamics up to about 10³ times faster than state-of-the-art message-passing potentials such as MACE (medium) and up to five times faster than NEP89 and DPA-4.1C. At the same time, six sizes with 1.4×10⁵ to 2.8×10⁷ parameters, pretrained on materials, molecules and solid acids, reach F1 scores of 0.75 to 0.91 on Matbench Discovery, placing the largest within 0.03 of the current leader. They therefore suit high-throughput, large or long simulations, and, being transferable, they are strong starting points for fine-tuning. Fine-tuned to six materials, the model of size S comes close to the ab initio force errors of a fine-tuned MACE, so it reaches reference-level accuracy at about 50 ns per atom and step (Cu fcc). Their components can be adopted separately, as a starting point for architectures with even better ratios of speed to accuracy. The ILMlip implementation is available at https://github.com/jhaens/ilmlip
articles.abstract_zh: 随着新模型的快速出现，大规模预训练的机器学习原子间势不断变得更加准确，而且成本也越来越高：截至 2026 年 11 月，Matbench Discovery 的当前领先者（F1 分数 0.935）拥有 9.9×10⁷ 参数，需要 3600 个 GPU 小时来训练。这里介绍的 ILMlip 势针对速度和零射击精度进行了优化。它们是等变的、保守的消息传递潜力，其中每个组件都按照吞吐量进行排列：每对原子的工作量很少，而每个原子所需的工作量则尽可能多。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着新模型的快速出现，大规模预训练的机器学习原子间势不断变得更加准确，而且成本也越来越高：截至 2026 年 11 月，Matbench Discovery 的当前领先者（F1 分数 0.935）拥有 9.9×10⁷ 参数，需要 3600 个 GPU 小时来训练。这里介绍的 ILMlip 势针对速度和零射击精度进行了优化。它们是等变的、保守的消息传递潜力，其中每个组件都按照吞吐量进行排列：每对原子的工作量很少，而每个原子所需的工作量则尽可能多。通过在一个 GPU 上运行 ASE，它们的分子动力学运行速度比 MACE（中）等最先进的消息传递潜力快约 10 倍，比 NEP89 和 DPA-4.1C 快五倍。与此同时，参数为 1.4×10⁵ 至 2.8×10⁷ 的六种尺寸，在材料、分子和固体酸上进行预训练，在 Matbench Discovery 上达到 0.75 至 0.91 的 F1 分数，与当前领先者的最大差距在 0.03 以内。因此，它们适合高通量、大型或长时间的模拟，而且由于可转移，它们是微调的有力起点。对六种材料进行微调后，尺寸 S 的模型接近微调 MACE 的从头算力误差，因此它达到每个原子和步长 (Cu fcc) 约 50 ns 的参考级精度。它们的组件可以单独采用，作为具有更好的速度与精度比的架构的起点。 ILMlip 实现位于 https://github.com/jhaens/ilmlip

articles.title: Machine-Learning Spin-Fermion Models for Strongly Disordered Magnets: Sb-Doped MnTe
articles.title_zh: 适用于强无序磁体的机器学习自旋费米子模型：掺锑 MnTe
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic altermagnets are promising for spintronics, but most altermagnets are insulating. Doping can induce metallicity, but introduces chemical and magnetic disorder that is challenging to model from first principles. Here, we introduce a machine-learning approach that renormalizes first-principles calculations onto disordered spin-fermion models. The learned models accurately reproduce first-principles magnetic and electronic properties and enable predictions of millions of inequivalent long-range exchange couplings in large disordered supercells. Applied to Sb-doped MnTe, the approach shows that altermagnetism persists up to about 25% Sb, and reveals disorder broadening as a new factor controlling spin selectivity. More broadly, our work opens a route to combining renormalization with machine-learned Hamiltonians for strongly disordered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属交变磁体在自旋电子学方面很有前景，但大多数交变磁体都是绝缘的。掺杂可以诱导金属丰度，但会引入化学和磁性无序，这很难根据第一原理进行建模。在这里，我们引入了一种机器学习方法，将第一原理计算重新规范化为无序自旋费米子模型。学习的模型准确地再现了第一原理的磁和电子特性，并能够预测大型无序超级电池中数百万个不等价的远程交换耦合。应用于 Sb 掺杂 MnTe 时，该方法表明交变磁性持续高达约 25% Sb，并揭示无序展宽是控制自旋选择性的新因素。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属交变磁体在自旋电子学方面很有前景，但大多数交变磁体都是绝缘的。掺杂可以诱导金属丰度，但会引入化学和磁性无序，这很难根据第一原理进行建模。在这里，我们引入了一种机器学习方法，将第一原理计算重新规范化为无序自旋费米子模型。学习的模型准确地再现了第一原理的磁和电子特性，并能够预测大型无序超级电池中数百万个不等价的远程交换耦合。应用于 Sb 掺杂 MnTe 时，该方法表明交变磁性持续高达约 25% Sb，并揭示无序展宽是控制自旋选择性的新因素。更广泛地说，我们的工作开辟了一条将重正化与机器学习的哈密顿量相结合的途径，用于强无序材料。

articles.title: Graphical Rules for Zero-energy Quantum-Interference Patterns in Bipartite Lattices
articles.title_zh: 二分晶格中零能量量子干涉图样的图形规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum interference(QI) plays an important role in electron transport in molecules, where conductance is determined by the coherent superposition of different quantum-walk paths connecting the source and drain sites. In some systems, the pronounced even-odd conductance oscillation with the walk length can be observed; meanwhile destructive QI can lead to a dramatic suppression of conductance, resulting in a huge on/off ratio. In this paper, we extend the investigation from individual molecules to bipartite lattice systems, providing an abstract framework for exploring QI in a broad range of two-dimensional systems. We propose a simple graphical rule for predicting the QI pattern-the conductance map obtained by varying the drain site while keeping the source site fixed-in bipartite structures with arbitrary boundaries and holes. The analysis can be completed in three steps. First, a unit-cell-replicated bipartite subset is constructed by removing a subset of atoms from the input network, and its Green's function map is efficiently obtained from a local recurrence relation. Second, the removed atoms and local structural modifications are coupled back as local degrees of freedom, generating zero-mode vectors through the same Green's function map. Finally, the surviving zero-mode combinations are selected by an effective coupling matrix, whose projectors correct the reference map to yield the final QI pattern. This rule applies to finite flakes with arbitrary boundaries and holes and extends naturally to infinite lattices and vacancy defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子干涉（QI）在分子中的电子传输中起着重要作用，其中电导由连接源极和漏极位置的不同量子行走路径的相干叠加决定。在一些系统中，可以观察到明显的奇偶电导随行走长度的振荡；同时，破坏性的 QI 会导致电导的急剧抑制，从而产生巨大的开/关比。在本文中，我们将研究范围从单个分子扩展到二分晶格系统，为探索广泛的二维系统中的量子质量提供了一个抽象框架。我们提出了一个简单的图形规则来预测 QI 模式，即通过改变漏极位置同时保持源位置固定在具有任意边界和孔的二分结构中获得的电导图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子干涉（QI）在分子中的电子传输中起着重要作用，其中电导由连接源极和漏极位置的不同量子行走路径的相干叠加决定。在一些系统中，可以观察到明显的奇偶电导随行走长度的振荡；同时，破坏性的 QI 会导致电导的急剧抑制，从而产生巨大的开/关比。在本文中，我们将研究范围从单个分子扩展到二分晶格系统，为探索广泛的二维系统中的量子质量提供了一个抽象框架。我们提出了一个简单的图形规则来预测 QI 模式，即通过改变漏极位置同时保持源位置固定在具有任意边界和孔的二分结构中获得的电导图。分析可以分三步完成。首先，通过从输入网络中删除原子子集来构造单位单元复制的二分子集，并从局部递归关系中有效地获得其格林函数图。其次，移除的原子和局部结构修改作为局部自由度耦合回来，通过相同的格林函数图生成零模式向量。最后，通过有效耦合矩阵选择幸存的零模式组合，其投影仪校正参考图以产生最终的 QI 模式。该规则适用于具有任意边界和孔的有限薄片，并自然延伸到无限晶格和空位缺陷。

articles.title: Electron exchange matters in electron spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 电子光谱中的电子交换很重要
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) conventionally considers classical Coulomb interactions between probe and material electrons, overlooking their fermionic exchange at relativistic energies. Here, we develop a relativistic theory of magnon EELS incorporating both magnetic dipole and electron exchange interactions. We show that the two channels leave distinguishable electron spin states, suppressing their interference in conventional EELS. However, spin-resolved detection erases this which-path information, revealing first-order interference despite the weak exchange amplitude. Remarkably, the same interference produces a left-right intensity asymmetry with a spin-polarized incident beam, without requiring outgoing-spin analysis. We demonstrate that this signal directly probes magnon angular momentum and distinguishes excitations of opposite handedness, opening a route to nanoscale measurements of chiral magnetic excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子能量损失谱（EELS）通常考虑探针和材料电子之间的经典库仑相互作用，忽略它们在相对论能量下的费米子交换。在这里，我们开发了一种结合磁偶极子和电子交换相互作用的磁振子 EELS 相对论理论。我们证明这两个通道留下了可区分的电子自旋态，从而抑制了它们对传统 EELS 的干扰。然而，自旋分辨检测消除了该路径信息，尽管交换幅度较弱，但仍揭示了一阶干扰。值得注意的是，相同的干涉会通过自旋偏振入射光束产生左右强度不对称，而无需进行出自自旋分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子能量损失谱（EELS）通常考虑探针和材料电子之间的经典库仑相互作用，忽略它们在相对论能量下的费米子交换。在这里，我们开发了一种结合磁偶极子和电子交换相互作用的磁振子 EELS 相对论理论。我们证明这两个通道留下了可区分的电子自旋态，从而抑制了它们对传统 EELS 的干扰。然而，自旋分辨检测消除了该路径信息，尽管交换幅度较弱，但仍揭示了一阶干扰。值得注意的是，相同的干涉会通过自旋偏振入射光束产生左右强度不对称，而无需进行出自自旋分析。我们证明该信号可以直接探测磁振子角动量并区分相反旋向的激发，从而为手性磁激发的纳米级测量开辟了道路。

articles.title: Crystal-Symmetry-Dependent Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect in CoPt/Nb Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: CoPt/Nb 异质结构中晶体对称性相关的无场超导二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting diodes convert nonreciprocal critical currents into current-polarity-selective switching between zero-resistance and resistive states. However, realizing the superconducting diode effect often requires complex device architectures and an external magnetic field to break spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetry, substantially limiting its integration into cryogenic electronics and superconducting quantum circuits. Here, we demonstrate precise control of the field-free superconducting diode effect in epitaxial [111]-oriented A1-CoPt/Nb heterostructures. The critical-current asymmetry obeys the magnetic-point-group symmetry relation: it is finite along low-symmetry directions, suppressed along magnetic mirror axes, and reverses under either a 60deg in-plane rotation or reversal of the CoPt magnetization. The same threefold symmetry dependence is observed in field-free current-induced magnetization switching in A1-CoPt films, indicating a common crystallographic origin for the superconducting and normal-state transport responses. Current- and temperature-dependent second-harmonic transport measurements are consistent with vortex-mediated nonreciprocity arising from an orientation-dependent interfacial edge landscape. We further exploit the magnetization-dependent diode polarity for proof-of-concept superconducting readout of electrically written magnetic states. These results establish crystallographic symmetry as an effective degree of freedom for engineering the superconducting diode effect, expanding the accessible materials space and providing a practical route toward field-free superconducting electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导二极管将不可逆临界电流转换为零电阻和电阻状态之间的电流极性选择性切换。然而，实现超导二极管效应通常需要复杂的器件架构和外部磁场来打破空间反转和时间反转对称性，这大大限制了其与低温电子学和超导量子电路的集成。在这里，我们展示了外延[111]取向的A1-CoPt/Nb异质结构中无场超导二极管效应的精确控制。临界电流不对称性遵循磁点群对称关系：它沿着低对称性方向是有限的，沿着磁镜轴受到抑制，并且在 60 度面内旋转或 CoPt 磁化强度反转的情况下反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管将不可逆临界电流转换为零电阻和电阻状态之间的电流极性选择性切换。然而，实现超导二极管效应通常需要复杂的器件架构和外部磁场来打破空间反转和时间反转对称性，这大大限制了其与低温电子学和超导量子电路的集成。在这里，我们展示了外延[111]取向的A1-CoPt/Nb异质结构中无场超导二极管效应的精确控制。临界电流不对称性遵循磁点群对称关系：它沿着低对称性方向是有限的，沿着磁镜轴受到抑制，并且在 60 度面内旋转或 CoPt 磁化强度反转的情况下反转。在 A1-CoPt 薄膜中的无场电流感应磁化转变中观察到相同的三重对称依赖性，表明超导和正常状态输运响应具有共同的晶体学起源。电流和温度相关的二次谐波传输测量与由方向相关的界面边缘景观引起的涡旋介导的非互易性一致。我们进一步利用磁化相关的二极管极性来验证电写入磁状态的超导读出。这些结果将晶体学对称性确立为设计超导二极管效应的有效自由度，扩大了可访问的材料空间，并为无场超导电子学提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: Superconductivity from the Berry connection from many-electron wave functions: U(1) gauge fluctuation, gauge invariance, and superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 来自多电子波函数的 Berry 连接的超导性：U(1) 规范波动、规范不变性和超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electromagnetic U(1) gauge invariance and superconductivity are examined by employing the Berry connection from many-electron wave functions and the fluctuations of it that give rise to the probabilistic random transitions among quantum states. The gauge invariance in the classical electrodynamics is regarded as the requirement that extracts unaffected parts by the gauge fluctuation. In quantum mechanics, dissipation-free states from the gauge fluctuation exist, and we identify them as superconducting states. We explain the reversible superconducting-normal phase transition in a magnetic field including the force balance. The present superconductivity theory lifts two fundamental disagreements between theory and experiment existing in the current standard theory with keeping the major results by the BCS theory. Thus, it may be considered as a superconductivity theory encompassing the current standard one.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过使用多电子波函数的贝里联系及其引起量子态之间概率随机跃迁的涨落来检验电磁 U(1) 规范不变性和超导性。经典电动力学中的规范不变性被认为是通过规范波动提取不受影响部分的要求。在量子力学中，存在来自规范涨落的无耗散态，我们将它们识别为超导态。我们解释了磁场中的可逆超导-正常相变，包括力平衡。现有的超导理论消除了现行标准理论中理论与实验之间的两个根本分歧，同时保留了BCS理论的主要结果。因此，它可以被认为是一种涵盖当前标准理论的超导理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过使用多电子波函数的贝里联系及其引起量子态之间概率随机跃迁的涨落来检验电磁 U(1) 规范不变性和超导性。经典电动力学中的规范不变性被认为是通过规范波动提取不受影响部分的要求。在量子力学中，存在来自规范涨落的无耗散态，我们将它们识别为超导态。我们解释了磁场中的可逆超导-正常相变，包括力平衡。现有的超导理论消除了现行标准理论中理论与实验之间的两个根本分歧，同时保留了BCS理论的主要结果。因此，它可以被认为是一种涵盖当前标准理论的超导理论。

articles.title: Solvent-Mediated Disintegration of a Vitrimer Network
articles.title_zh: Vitrimer 网络的溶剂介导崩解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vitrimers are dynamic polymer networks characterized by associative bond exchange, which enables topological rearrangement while preserving the overall network connectivity. However, how this dynamic connectivity evolves in the presence of a solvent, particularly as a function of temperature, remains poorly understood. Here, we employ hybrid molecular dynamics Monte Carlo simulations to elucidate the temperature-dependent restructuring and dissociation of vitrimer networks in solution. By constructing temperature composition phase diagrams, we demonstrate that the critical temperature for network dissolution increases nonlinearly with crosslink concentration. We find that the network disintegration begins well below the critical dissolution temperature, indicating that the loss of network connectivity can occur even before the onset of macroscopic dissolution. However, the network undergoes extensive restructuring around the critical temperature for a highly crosslinked system, resulting in the formation of numerous smaller, disconnected networks. Concurrently, the number of intrachain dynamic bonds increases with temperature. Interestingly, complete disintegration into individual polymer chains is not observed; instead, the solution comprises a broad distribution of smaller network fragments. These findings reveal the complex interplay between solvent-induced network disintegration and dynamic bond redistribution, providing molecular level insights into the dissolution of vitrimer networks and their potential for solvent assisted recycling.
articles.abstract_zh: Vitrimer 是动态聚合物网络，其特征是缔合键交换，可实现拓扑重排，同时保持整体网络连接性。然而，这种动态连接性在溶剂存在下如何演变，特别是作为温度的函数，仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们采用混合分子动力学蒙特卡罗模拟来阐明溶液中 vitrimer 网络的温度依赖性重组和解离。通过构建温度组成相图，我们证明网络溶解的临界温度随交联浓度非线性增加。我们发现网络解体开始于远低于临界溶解温度，这表明网络连通性的丧失甚至可能在宏观溶解开始之前发生。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Vitrimer 是动态聚合物网络，其特征是缔合键交换，可实现拓扑重排，同时保持整体网络连接性。然而，这种动态连接性在溶剂存在下如何演变，特别是作为温度的函数，仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们采用混合分子动力学蒙特卡罗模拟来阐明溶液中 vitrimer 网络的温度依赖性重组和解离。通过构建温度组成相图，我们证明网络溶解的临界温度随交联浓度非线性增加。我们发现网络解体开始于远低于临界溶解温度，这表明网络连通性的丧失甚至可能在宏观溶解开始之前发生。然而，网络在高度交联系统的临界温度附近经历广泛的重组，导致形成许多较小的、断开的网络。同时，链内动态键的数量随着温度的增加而增加。有趣的是，没有观察到完全分解成单个聚合物链；相反，该解决方案包括广泛分布的较小网络片段。这些发现揭示了溶剂诱导的网络分解和动态键重新分布之间复杂的相互作用，为 vitrimer 网络的溶解及其溶剂辅助回收的潜力提供了分子水平的见解。

articles.title: Exact subtraction of electron self-interaction from the Kohn-Sham equations
articles.title_zh: 从 Kohn-Sham 方程中精确减去电子自相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The self-interaction error (SIE) of Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) leads to a non-physical, non-linear dependence of an orbital's energy on its own fractional occupation [Dabo et al., Phys. Rev. B, 82:115121, 2010]. The generalized Koopmans condition (GKC) ensures an atomic orbital's eigenenergy is independent of its fractional occupation- and is free of self-interaction. The constrained search of the Levy spin-density-functional theory yields orbital densities and delivers the ground-state energy to generalize the Hohenberg-Kohn theorems. In this work, the electron density of the Kohn-Sham equations is constrained to be orbital-density dependent, with a total energy functional linear with respect to variation of its orbital densities. That is, the KS multiplicative effective potential vₛ[n] for an orbital ϕᵢ[n] is constrained to a functional vₑff[n - nᵢ]. The result complies with the generalized Koopmans condition (GKC). This approach improves LDA and GGA mean absolute errors (MAEs) in fundamental band gaps by sim 1 eV, with respect to KS-DFT. Equations free of electron self-interaction provide the basis for improvements in the accuracy, efficiency, and simplicity of density functional theories.
articles.abstract_zh: Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论 (KS-DFT) 的自相互作用误差 (SIE) 导致轨道能量对其自身分数占据的非物理、非线性依赖性 [Dabo et al., Phys.修订版 B，82：115121，2010]。广义库普曼条件（GKC）确保原子轨道的本征能与其占据的分数无关，并且没有自相互作用。 Levy 自旋密度泛函理论的约束搜索产生轨道密度并提供基态能量以推广 Hohenberg-Kohn 定理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论 (KS-DFT) 的自相互作用误差 (SIE) 导致轨道能量对其自身分数占据的非物理、非线性依赖性 [Dabo et al., Phys.修订版 B，82：115121，2010]。广义库普曼条件（GKC）确保原子轨道的本征能与其占据的分数无关，并且没有自相互作用。 Levy 自旋密度泛函理论的约束搜索产生轨道密度并提供基态能量以推广 Hohenberg-Kohn 定理。在这项工作中，Kohn-Sham 方程的电子密度被限制为与轨道密度相关，总能量相对于其轨道密度的变化呈线性函数关系。也就是说，轨道 phiᵢ[n] 的 KS 乘法有效势 vₛ[n] 被约束为函数 vₑff[n - nᵢ]。结果符合广义库普曼斯条件（GKC）。相对于 KS-DFT，该方法将基本带隙中的 LDA 和 GGA 平均绝对误差 (MAE) 提高了 sim 1 eV。没有电子自相互作用的方程为提高密度泛函理论的准确性、效率和简单性提供了基础。

articles.title: Spin-vibronic order in Ba₂MgReO₆
articles.title_zh: Ba2MgReO₆ 中的自旋振动顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong spin-orbit coupling in 5d ions produces multipolar orders that conventional probes barely detect. In cubic 5d¹ double perovskites, the spin-orbit quartet couples to Jahn-Teller vibrations, and resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) has established the resulting spin-orbit-lattice entangled (vibronic) states [Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 036501 (2024)]. We proposed that these vibronic states order cooperatively and thereby explain the hidden quadrupole and canted magnetic phases of Ba₂MgReO₆ [Phys. Rev. B 107, L220404 (2023)], but that proposal rested on a simplified model. Here, we show that a spin-vibronic Hamiltonian derived from first principles, with a single scale factor for the elastic coupling, reproduces the ordered phases of Ba₂MgReO₆ with the same vibronic states that describe its RIXS spectra. With this factor bringing the quadrupolar transition to 34.7 K, near the measured 33 K, the theory predicts the magnetic transition at 19.3 K, against the measured 18 K, and reproduces the antiferro distortion and the ferro elongation between the transitions. These results support spin-vibronic order in Ba₂MgReO₆ and point to it as the origin of the hidden multipolar phases of 5d¹ double perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 5d 离子中的强自旋轨道耦合会产生传统探针几乎无法检测到的多极有序。在立方 5d1 双钙钛矿中，自旋轨道四重奏与 Jahn-Teller 振动耦合，共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 建立了由此产生的自旋轨道晶格纠缠（振动）态 [Phys.莱特牧师。 133, 036501 (2024)]。我们提出这些电子振动态协同排序，从而解释了 Ba2MgReO6 的隐藏四极和倾斜磁相 [Phys. Rev. B 107, L220404 (2023)]，但该提案基于简化模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 5d 离子中的强自旋轨道耦合会产生传统探针几乎无法检测到的多极有序。在立方 5d1 双钙钛矿中，自旋轨道四重奏与 Jahn-Teller 振动耦合，共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 建立了由此产生的自旋轨道晶格纠缠（振动）态 [Phys.莱特牧师。 133, 036501 (2024)]。我们提出这些电子振动态协同排序，从而解释了 Ba2MgReO6 的隐藏四极和倾斜磁相 [Phys. Rev. B 107, L220404 (2023)]，但该提案基于简化模型。在这里，我们证明了从第一原理导出的自旋振动哈密顿量，具有弹性耦合的单一比例因子，可以重现 Ba MgReO 的有序相，其振动状态与描述其 RIXS 谱相同。利用这个因素使四极转变温度达到 34.7 K，接近测量的 33 K，该理论根据测量的 18 K 预测了 19.3 K 的磁转变，并再现了转变之间的反铁畸变和铁伸长。这些结果支持 Ba2MgReO6 中的自旋电子有序性，并指出它是 5d1 双钙钛矿隐藏多极相的起源。

articles.title: Self-Assembled Triangular Sc-rich Nanodomains: The Orign of Anomalous Alloy Scattering in ScAlN/GaN Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 自组装三角形富Sc纳米域：ScAlN/GaN异质结构中异常合金散射的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wurtzite scandium aluminium nitride (ScAlN) alloys hold substantial potential for GaN heterostructure high-electron mobility transistors, owing to their large spontaneous polarization gradient and the ability to achieve precise lattice matching at heterointerface. Nevertheless, despite continuous advances in epitaxy and device fabrication, the two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) mobility in ScAlN/GaN heterostructures remains persistently limited, and the underlying microscopic origin remains elusive. Here, we uncover an anomalous electron scattering mechanism from laterally correlated alloy disorder that spontaneously develops within the ScAlN barrier driven by strain-field undulations imposed by threading dislocations. Dislocation strain field partitions the growth front into nanoscale domains with distinct strain states, driving anisotropic diffusion of Sc adatoms and yielding crystallographically oriented triangular Sc-rich nanodomains. Reducing the threading dislocation density from 2.8E10 to 4.4E8 cm⁻² suppresses areal density of nanodomains by more than two orders of magnitude. As a result, low-temperature Hall mobility increases from 1800 to 11995 cm²*V⁻¹*s⁻¹. These findings establish dislocation-mediated Sc-rich nanodomains as the dominant source of anomalously strong alloy scattering, resolving the mobility bottleneck for high-performance nitride electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 纤锌矿氮化钪铝（ScAlN）合金由于其较大的自发极化梯度以及在异质界面实现精确晶格匹配的能力，在GaN异质结构高电子迁移率晶体管方面具有巨大的潜力。然而，尽管外延和器件制造不断取得进展，ScAlN/GaN 异质结构中的二维电子气 (2DEG) 迁移率仍然持续受到限制，并且潜在的微观起源仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了横向相关合金无序的异常电子散射机制，该机制在由螺纹位错施加的应变场波动驱动的 ScAlN 势垒内自发发展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纤锌矿氮化钪铝（ScAlN）合金由于其较大的自发极化梯度以及在异质界面实现精确晶格匹配的能力，在GaN异质结构高电子迁移率晶体管方面具有巨大的潜力。然而，尽管外延和器件制造不断取得进展，ScAlN/GaN 异质结构中的二维电子气 (2DEG) 迁移率仍然持续受到限制，并且潜在的微观起源仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了横向相关合金无序的异常电子散射机制，该机制在由螺纹位错施加的应变场波动驱动的 ScAlN 势垒内自发发展。位错应变场将生长前沿划分为具有不同应变状态的纳米级域，驱动钪吸附原子的各向异性扩散并产生晶体取向的三角形富钪纳米域。将穿透位错密度从 2.8E10 降低到 4.4E8 cm-2 可将纳米域的面密度抑制两个数量级以上。结果，低温霍尔迁移率从 1800 cm²*V⁻1*s⁻1 增加到 11995 cm2*V⁻1*s⁻1。这些发现将位错介导的富钪纳米域确定为异常强合金散射的主要来源，解决了高性能氮化物电子器件的迁移率瓶颈。

articles.title: Phono3GPU: GPU-Accelerated Linear Tetrahedron Integration for Phonon Thermal Transport
articles.title_zh: Phono3GPU：用于声子热传输的 GPU 加速线性四面体集成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials with high or low thermal conductivity are increasingly important for thermal management and energy technologies. Machine-learned interatomic potentials have accelerated anharmonic force-constant calculations, shifting the bottleneck toward phonon transport calculations for large materials datasets. Existing GPU solvers often rely on smearing, whose width can require material-dependent choices, while the linear tetrahedron method used in phono3py avoids this parameter but becomes costly for complex structures. Here we introduce Phono3GPU, which reformulates three-phonon scattering and linear tetrahedron integration for massively parallel GPU execution. Across benchmark crystals, Phono3GPU accelerates total calculations by up to 41 times relative to a CPU implementation, with larger gains for complex unit cells, and by 2 to 6 times relative to a recent GPU plug-in for phono3py. We further demonstrate atom-resolved scattering analysis in defective silicon supercells as an application enabled by the reduced computational cost. Phono3GPU thus lowers the cost of tetrahedron-based thermal-conductivity calculations and of detailed investigations of structure-dependent phonon transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 高导热率或低导热率的材料对于热管理和能源技术越来越重要。机器学习的原子间势加速了非谐力常数计算，将瓶颈转向大型材料数据集的声子输运计算。现有的 GPU 求解器通常依赖于涂抹，其宽度可能需要根据材料进行选择，而 phono3py 中使用的线性四面体方法避免了此参数，但对于复杂结构而言成本高昂。在这里，我们介绍 Phono3GPU，它重新表述了三声子散射和线性四面体积分，以实现大规模并行 GPU 执行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高导热率或低导热率的材料对于热管理和能源技术越来越重要。机器学习的原子间势加速了非谐力常数计算，将瓶颈转向大型材料数据集的声子输运计算。现有的 GPU 求解器通常依赖于涂抹，其宽度可能需要根据材料进行选择，而 phono3py 中使用的线性四面体方法避免了此参数，但对于复杂结构而言成本高昂。在这里，我们介绍 Phono3GPU，它重新表述了三声子散射和线性四面体积分，以实现大规模并行 GPU 执行。在基准晶体中，Phono3GPU 相对于 CPU 实现，总计算速度提高了 41 倍，对于复杂的单位单元有更大的增益，相对于最新的 phono3py GPU 插件，提高了 2 到 6 倍。我们进一步证明了有缺陷的硅超级电池中的原子分辨散射分析是一种通过降低计算成本实现的应用。因此，Phono3GPU 降低了基于四面体的热导率计算和结构相关声子输运详细研究的成本。

articles.title: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
articles.title_zh: PerovAgent：卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体的自主配体设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing surface-capping ligands for high-performance halide perovskite nanocrystals requires navigating a vast molecular space while discovering design rules that govern ligand-surface interactions. Here, we introduce PerovAgent, an autonomous multi-agent framework that combines large language model (LLM)-driven scientific reasoning with computational tools for atomistic model construction, machine-learned interatomic potential evaluation, and statistical validation. Across ten independent campaigns on CsPbBr3 surfaces, PerovAgent adaptively explored and refined diverse ligand chemistries while progressively improving the binding-energy objective. Beyond optimization, the framework converts recurring chemical observations into explicit design principles that can be statistically evaluated. Of 35 formulated principles, 19 were prospectively supported, of which seven also passed the confound audit, highlighting the need to systematically validate plausible LLM-generated hypotheses during autonomous discovery. A recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate principle was further examined using density functional theory, which reproduced the predicted energetic preference. These results demonstrate an autonomous discovery framework that not only searches molecular space and optimizes the scalar objective but also transforms its search trajectory into systematically testable design principles. The framework can also be extended to more complex ligands, including zwitterionic, multidentate, and polymerizable ligands, to explore a wider range of ligand-surface interactions and uncover new design principles for halide perovskite nanocrystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体设计表面覆盖配体需要探索广阔的分子空间，同时发现控制配体-表面相互作用的设计规则。在这里，我们介绍 PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，它将大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在 CsPbBr3 表面的十次独立活动中，PerovAgent 适应性地探索和完善了不同的配体化学，同时逐步提高了结合能目标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体设计表面覆盖配体需要探索广阔的分子空间，同时发现控制配体-表面相互作用的设计规则。在这里，我们介绍 PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，它将大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在 CsPbBr3 表面的十次独立活动中，PerovAgent 适应性地探索和完善了不同的配体化学，同时逐步提高了结合能目标。除了优化之外，该框架还将重复的化学观察结果转化为可以进行统计评估的明确设计原则。在 35 条制定的原则中，有 19 条得到了前瞻性支持，其中 7 条还通过了混杂审计，这凸显了在自主发现过程中系统地验证法学硕士生成的合理假设的必要性。使用密度泛函理论进一步检验了循环炔基膦酸酯原理，再现了预测的能量偏好。这些结果展示了一个自主发现框架，该框架不仅搜索分子空间并优化标量目标，而且还将其搜索轨迹转化为系统可测试的设计原理。该框架还可以扩展到更复杂的配体，包括两性离子、多齿和可聚合配体，以探索更广泛的配体-表面相互作用，并揭示卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体的新设计原理。

articles.title: Revisiting the Schottky-Mott Relation for Metal/ Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Interfaces: The Role of Interface Dipoles
articles.title_zh: 重新审视金属/过渡金属二硫族化物界面的肖特基-莫特关系：界面偶极子的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High contact resistance, predominantly stemming from Fermi-level pinning (FLP), becomes a critical bottleneck in the contact engineering of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) based two-dimensional field-effect transistors (2DFETs). Our study re-examines the inherent nature of FLP in 2D semiconductors, particularly focusing on regimes where the material thickness is commensurate with the interface thickness. Through the synergistic application of first-principles calculations and experimental validation via ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS) and scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS), we rigorously establish the metal effective work function (eWF) as the definitive figure of merit for substantiating the Schottky-Mott relation. Our findings indicate that FLP is intrinsically governed by both long-range dipole interactions and extended short-range Lennard-Jones potentials. This framework, in conjunction with the linear Schottky-Mott relation, improves predictive capabilities in contact engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 主要源于费米能级钉扎 (FLP) 的高接触电阻成为基于过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 的二维场效应晶体管 (2DFET) 接触工程的关键瓶颈。我们的研究重新审视了二维半导体中 FLP 的固有性质，特别关注材料厚度与界面厚度相称的情况。通过协同应用第一性原理计算以及通过紫外光电子能谱（UPS）和扫描隧道光谱（STS）进行的实验验证，我们严格建立了金属有效功函数（eWF）作为证实肖特基-莫特关系的决定性品质因数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 主要源于费米能级钉扎 (FLP) 的高接触电阻成为基于过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 的二维场效应晶体管 (2DFET) 接触工程的关键瓶颈。我们的研究重新审视了二维半导体中 FLP 的固有性质，特别关注材料厚度与界面厚度相称的情况。通过协同应用第一性原理计算以及通过紫外光电子能谱（UPS）和扫描隧道光谱（STS）进行的实验验证，我们严格建立了金属有效功函数（eWF）作为证实肖特基-莫特关系的决定性品质因数。我们的研究结果表明，FLP 本质上受长程偶极子相互作用和扩展的短程 Lennard-Jones 势的控制。该框架与线性肖特基-莫特关系相结合，提高了接触工程的预测能力。

articles.title: Toward a quantum resistance standard above liquid nitrogen temperature
articles.title_zh: 迈向高于液氮温度的量子电阻标准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Hall effect (QHE) -- the pioneering demonstration of one-dimensional topologically-protected edge channels -- manifest a transversal resistance quantized solely by two universal constants e and h (the elementary charge and the Planck constant, respectively), referred to as the von Klitzing constant R_K=h/e². For decades, this has enabled a unique route for realizing quantum Hall resistance (QHR) standard in the Système international d'unitès (SI), yet high precision QHR under relaxed conditions, especially temperature higher than 30 K, has not been possible. Here, we show that interfacial charge-order coupling inbetween CrOCl and monolayer graphene offers enhanced Fermi velocity, creating a robust Landau cyclotron gap. Using a customized direct current comparator (DCC, mounted at room temperature), we obtain relative deviation of the Hall resistance from R_K/2 of (15 ± 23),nΩ Ω⁻¹ (23 parts per billion of relative uncertainty) at 50 K, with an external magnetic field of 12 T and a dc current of 10 μA. At 100 K, the system exhibits QHR with 2 parts per million of relative uncertainty. Our results therefore suggest a platform toward a next-generation quantum resistance standard that may work at above liquid nitrogen temperature and free of conventional compressor refrigerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子霍尔效应 (QHE)——一维拓扑保护边缘通道的开创性演示——表现出仅由两个通用常数 e 和 h（分别为基本电荷和普朗克常数）量化的横向电阻，称为 von Klitzing 常数 R_K=h/e²。几十年来，这为在国际统一系统 (SI) 中实现量子霍尔电阻 (QHR) 标准开辟了一条独特的途径，但在宽松条件下，特别是高于 30 K 的温度下，高精度 QHR 一直是不可能的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子霍尔效应 (QHE)——一维拓扑保护边缘通道的开创性演示——表现出仅由两个通用常数 e 和 h（分别为基本电荷和普朗克常数）量化的横向电阻，称为 von Klitzing 常数 R_K=h/e²。几十年来，这为在国际统一系统 (SI) 中实现量子霍尔电阻 (QHR) 标准开辟了一条独特的途径，但在宽松条件下，特别是高于 30 K 的温度下，高精度 QHR 一直是不可能的。在这里，我们证明了 CrOCl 和单层石墨烯之间的界面电荷序耦合提供了增强的费米速度，从而产生了强大的朗道回旋能隙。使用定制的直流比较器（DCC，在室温下安装），我们获得了 50 K、外部磁场 12 T 和直流电流 10 μA 时霍尔电阻与 R_K/2 的相对偏差为 (15 ± 23),nΩ Ω⁻1（十亿分之 23 的相对不确定度）。在 100 K 时，系统的 QHR 具有百万分之二的相对不确定性。因此，我们的结果提出了一个面向下一代量子电阻标准的平台，该平台可以在高于液氮的温度下工作并且无需传统的压缩机冰箱。

articles.title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Néel-Order-Driven Magneto-Optical Response in MnTe
articles.title_zh: MnTe 中尼尔阶驱动磁光响应的量子几何起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-optical (MO) responses provide a direct probe of magnetic order, yet resolving compensated antiferromagnetic order remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate in altermagnetic MnTe that the symmetry of the Néel order is imprinted on the MO response through distinct quantum-geometric contributions. Combining first-principles calculations with a Landau symmetry framework, we demonstrate that the quantum metric gives rise to a twofold optical anisotropy, with its diagonal and symmetric off-diagonal components forming an E₂g doublet associated with the quadratic Néel-order invariants, providing a characteristic MO Voigt signature of the Néel-vector orientation. In contrast, the Berry curvature generates a complementary threefold Hall response governed by the cubic A₂g Néel-order invariant. Although the Hall conductivity and the out-of-plane weak-ferromagnetic moment share the same symmetry and angular dependence, constraining the latter to zero leaves the optical Hall response essentially unchanged demonstrating that the Hall response originates directly from the compensated Néel order rather than the net magnetization. Our results establish quantum geometry as a direct link between Néel order and MO response, revealing distinct twofold and threefold optical signatures of Néel order in altermagnetic MnTe.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁光（MO）响应提供了磁序的直接探测，但解析补偿反铁磁序仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们在交变磁 MnTe 中证明，尼尔级的对称性通过不同的量子几何贡献而印在 MO 响应上。将第一原理计算与朗道对称框架相结合，我们证明量子度量会产生双重光学各向异性，其对角线和对称非对角线分量形成与二次尼尔阶不变量相关的 E2g 双峰，提供尼尔矢量方向的特征 MO Voigt 签名。相比之下，贝里曲率产生由三次 A2g 尼尔阶不变量控制的互补三重霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁光（MO）响应提供了磁序的直接探测，但解析补偿反铁磁序仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们在交变磁 MnTe 中证明，尼尔级的对称性通过不同的量子几何贡献而印在 MO 响应上。将第一原理计算与朗道对称框架相结合，我们证明量子度量会产生双重光学各向异性，其对角线和对称非对角线分量形成与二次尼尔阶不变量相关的 E2g 双峰，提供尼尔矢量方向的特征 MO Voigt 签名。相比之下，贝里曲率产生由三次 A2g 尼尔阶不变量控制的互补三重霍尔响应。尽管霍尔电导率和面外弱铁磁矩具有相同的对称性和角度依赖性，但将后者限制为零使得光学霍尔响应基本不变，这表明霍尔响应直接源自补偿的尼尔阶而不是净磁化强度。我们的结果建立了量子几何作为尼尔级和 MO 响应之间的直接联系，揭示了互磁 MnTe 中尼尔级的独特的双重和三重光学特征。

articles.title: Tunable quantum metric driven nonlinear valley Hall effect in the PT-symmetric sliding antiferroelectric MoS₂
articles.title_zh: PT 对称滑动反铁电 MoS2 中可调谐量子度量驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum metric, the real part of a quantum geometric tensor, plays an important role in fundamental transport and optical responses of quantum materials. While net quantum metric effects are typically realized by breaking both time-reversal (T) and inversion (P) symmetries, valley-contrast mechanisms enable the probing of quantum geometry in centrosymmetric, nonmagnetic systems, revealing physical signatures beyond Berry curvature. Here, we design a four-layer MoS₂ platform that combines sliding antiferroelectric order with strain-induced C₃z breaking to realize a quantum metric driven nonlinear valley Hall effect (NVHE) under preserved P and T symmetries. Reversible interlayer sliding (ABBA ↔ BAAB) provides nonvolatile electrical control of the valley response. First-principles calculations reveal an outer-layer-dominated NVHE with tunable sign and magnitude. This symmetry-preserving, sliding-tunable strategy activates hidden quantum geometric phenomena in realistic two-dimensional materials and opens a clean pathway for tunable valleytronics and quantum information devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子度量是量子几何张量的实部，在量子材料的基本输运和光学响应中发挥着重要作用。虽然净量子度量效应通常是通过打破时间反转（T）和反演（P）对称性来实现的，但谷对比机制使得能够探测中心对称、非磁性系统中的量子几何，揭示贝里曲率之外的物理特征。在这里，我们设计了一个四层 MoS2 平台，将滑动反铁电序与应变诱导的 C₃z 断裂相结合，以在保留 P 和 T 对称性的情况下实现量子度量驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应 (NVHE)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子度量是量子几何张量的实部，在量子材料的基本输运和光学响应中发挥着重要作用。虽然净量子度量效应通常是通过打破时间反转（T）和反演（P）对称性来实现的，但谷对比机制使得能够探测中心对称、非磁性系统中的量子几何，揭示贝里曲率之外的物理特征。在这里，我们设计了一个四层 MoS2 平台，将滑动反铁电序与应变诱导的 C₃z 断裂相结合，以在保留 P 和 T 对称性的情况下实现量子度量驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应 (NVHE)。可逆层间滑动 (ABBA ↔ BAAB) 提供谷响应的非易失性电气控制。第一原理计算揭示了外层主导的 NVHE，其符号和幅度可调。这种保持对称性的滑动可调策略激活了现实二维材料中隐藏的量子几何现象，并为可调谷电子学和量子信息器件开辟了一条干净的途径。

articles.title: Quantum Metric Connects Bond Delocalization to Phonon Softening
articles.title_zh: 量子度量将键离域与声子软化联系起来
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Delocalized bonding electrons have long been associated with soft bonds and low phonon frequencies. However, a quantitative connection between electron delocalization and phonon softening remains elusive. We identify such a connection through the momentum-space quantum metric, which measures the intrinsic delocalization of the occupied electronic states. We show that a quantum geometric contribution to phonon softening is proportional to the integrated quantum metric. First-principles calculations of more than a hundred compounds demonstrate that greater quantum metric generally accompanies softer phonons. Localized Wannier orbitals reveal the bonding environments associated with this delocalization. In ferroelectric GeTe, LiBeSb, and BaTiO₃, polar distortion localizes the bonding orbitals, reduces quantum metric, and stabilizes the soft mode of the nonpolar structure. In PbSe, pressure-induced band inversion is accompanied by an enhanced quantum metric and phonon softening without change in crystal symmetry and bonding. These results establish a common quantum geometric interpretation of bond delocalization and phonon softening across distinct bonding environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 离域键合电子长期以来一直与软键和低声子频率相关。然而，电子离域和声子软化之间的定量联系仍然难以捉摸。我们通过动量空间量子度量来识别这种联系，该度量测量所占据电子态的固有离域性。我们表明，量子几何对声子软化的贡献与积分量子度量成正比。对一百多种化合物的第一原理计算表明，更大的量子度量通常伴随着更软的声子。局域万尼尔轨道揭示了与这种离域相关的成键环境。在铁电 GeTe、LiBeSb 和 BaTiO₃ 中，极性畸变使键合轨道局域化，降低量子度量，并稳定非极性结构的软模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离域键合电子长期以来一直与软键和低声子频率相关。然而，电子离域和声子软化之间的定量联系仍然难以捉摸。我们通过动量空间量子度量来识别这种联系，该度量测量所占据电子态的固有离域性。我们表明，量子几何对声子软化的贡献与积分量子度量成正比。对一百多种化合物的第一原理计算表明，更大的量子度量通常伴随着更软的声子。局域万尼尔轨道揭示了与这种离域相关的成键环境。在铁电 GeTe、LiBeSb 和 BaTiO₃ 中，极性畸变使键合轨道局域化，降低量子度量，并稳定非极性结构的软模式。在 PbSe 中，压力引起的能带反转伴随着增强的量子度量和声子软化，而不改变晶体对称性和成键。这些结果建立了不同键合环境中键离域和声子软化的通用量子几何解释。

articles.title: Foundation interatomic potentials capture structural disorder in metallic glasses
articles.title_zh: 基础原子间势捕获金属玻璃中的结构紊乱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials transfer well across chemical and structural space, yet their reliability for highly disordered metallic states is less established. Metallic glasses are a demanding benchmark: they have traditionally been modeled with Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potentials fitted to specific compositions, while ab initio molecular dynamics remains too expensive at the required sizes and timescales. Using the prototypical Cu-Zr-Al glass, we show that foundation potentials capture structural disorder, reproducing the structure, quenching dynamics, and elastic, mechanical and thermal properties of the amorphous state at near first-principles accuracy. We benchmark MACE foundation models against a classical EAM potential along molecular dynamics quenches, validating against density functional theory and experiment, first at Cu46Zr46Al8 and then across the good glass-forming region of the ternary. We further test two specialization routes: fine-tuning on glass structures generated with Lennard-Jones surrogate models, and on automatically generated small periodic cells (ASSYST). Models pre-trained on databases that include non-equilibrium liquid and amorphous configurations, such as OMAT, are accurate and transferable across composition out of the box, clearly outperforming the composition-specific EAM potential. Fine-tuning on target glass structures brings only modest gains, while specialization on small crystalline cells degrades the description of disorder. The readiness of foundation potentials for disordered metals is therefore set mainly by the diversity of their pre-training data rather than by system-specific fine-tuning, shifting the modeling effort from bespoke dataset generation to pre-training coverage and careful validation of the resulting dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础机器学习原子间势能在化学和结构空间之间很好地传递，但其对于高度无序金属态的可靠性尚不明确。金属玻璃是一个要求很高的基准：传统上，它们是使用适合特定成分的嵌入式原子方法（EAM）势来建模的，而从头算分子动力学在所需的尺寸和时间尺度上仍然过于昂贵。使用原型 Cu-Zr-Al 玻璃，我们表明基础电势可以捕获结构无序，以接近第一原理的精度再现非晶态的结构、淬火动力学以及弹性、机械和热性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势能在化学和结构空间之间很好地传递，但其对于高度无序金属态的可靠性尚不明确。金属玻璃是一个要求很高的基准：传统上，它们是使用适合特定成分的嵌入式原子方法（EAM）势来建模的，而从头算分子动力学在所需的尺寸和时间尺度上仍然过于昂贵。使用原型 Cu-Zr-Al 玻璃，我们表明基础电势可以捕获结构无序，以接近第一原理的精度再现非晶态的结构、淬火动力学以及弹性、机械和热性能。我们将 MACE 基础模型与沿分子动力学淬火的经典 EAM 势进行基准测试，根据密度泛函理论和实验进行验证，首先在 Cu46Zr46Al8 处，然后穿过三元材料的良好玻璃形成区域。我们进一步测试了两条专业化路线：对使用 Lennard-Jones 代理模型生成的玻璃结构进行微调，以及对自动生成的小周期单元 (ASSYST) 进行微调。在包含非平衡液体和无定形配置（例如 OMAT）的数据库上预先训练的模型是准确的，并且可以开箱即用地跨成分转移，明显优于特定成分的 EAM 潜力。对目标玻璃结构的微调只能带来适度的增益，而对小晶体细胞的专业化会降低对无序的描述。因此，无序金属的基础潜力的准备情况主要取决于其预训练数据的多样性，而不是通过特定于系统的微调，将建模工作从定制数据集生成转移到预训练覆盖和对所得动态的仔细验证。

articles.title: Quantum-centric assessment of saturated ferromagnetism beyond the flat-band limit
articles.title_zh: 超越平带极限的饱和铁磁性的量子中心评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Saturated ferromagnetism has been proven for every on-site repulsion U > 0 in Hubbard models with a flat lowest band, and the interaction required for it grows with the band width W when the band becomes dispersive. We study the dispersive case at quarter filling by quantum-selected configuration interaction and sample-based quantum diagonalization with IBM Quantum's Heron processors, focusing on the quantized square of the total spin of the computed states. We treat a sawtooth chain of 16 unit cells on 64 qubits, whose full configuration space of 1.1× 10¹⁴ determinants exceeds that of one of the largest full configuration interaction calculations, and obtain the stability diagram of saturated ferromagnetism on the decorated square lattice in the plane of U and W. For the chain, a subspace of only 3× 10⁻⁵ of the full configuration space gives a state with more than 97% of its weight in the sector of maximal spin. For the decorated square lattice of 4× 3 unit cells on 48 qubits, the computed states in subspaces of less than 1% of the full configuration space switch from low-spin states to nearly fully polarized states at U simeq 2W. The calculations also give a rigorous lower bound of 1.9W on the critical interaction of the 4× 3 lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 饱和铁磁性已被证明适用于哈伯德模型中具有平坦最低能带的每个现场排斥 U > 0，并且当能带变得色散时，其所需的相互作用随着能带宽度 W 的增加而增长。我们通过使用 IBM Quantum 的 Heron 处理器进行量子选择配置交互和基于样本的量子对角化来研究四分之一填充时的色散情况，重点关注计算状态的总自旋的量化平方。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 饱和铁磁性已被证明适用于哈伯德模型中具有平坦最低能带的每个现场排斥 U > 0，并且当能带变得色散时，其所需的相互作用随着能带宽度 W 的增加而增长。我们通过使用 IBM Quantum 的 Heron 处理器进行量子选择配置交互和基于样本的量子对角化来研究四分之一填充时的色散情况，重点关注计算状态的总自旋的量化平方。我们处理 64 个量子位上 16 个晶胞的锯齿链，其 1.1× 10⁴ 行列式的全配置空间超过了最大的全配置相互作用计算之一，并获得了 U 和 W 平面上装饰方晶格上饱和铁磁性的稳定性图。对于该链，仅全配置空间的 3× 10⁻⁵ 的子空间给出了超过其 97% 的状态。最大旋转部分的重量。对于 48 个量子位上 4×3 晶胞的装饰方晶格，小于完整配置空间 1% 的子空间中的计算状态在 U simeq 2W 处从低自旋状态切换到几乎完全极化状态。计算还给出了 4×3 晶格临界相互作用的严格下限 1.9W。

articles.title: Anisotropic magnetic-field modulation of hysteretic sheet resistance in few-layer ferroelectric WTe2
articles.title_zh: 少层铁电WTe2磁滞方块电阻的各向异性磁场调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectricity in few-layer WTe2, a polar semimetal, originates from interlayer sliding and can be probed through gate-dependent resistance hysteresis. Yet the role of magnetic fields in this transport signature remains largely unexplored. Here, we examine magnetic-field-induced changes in the hysteresis in exfoliated few-layer WTe2. Applying an out-of-plane magnetic field produces a pronounced hysteresis enhancement, while an in-plane field yields a negligible response. Analysis of the individual hysteresis branches reveals distinct magnetotransport responses of the two ferroelectric states, which increase their resistance separation under magnetic field. The enhancement exhibits a robust power-law field dependence and a temperature evolution closely resembling that of magnetoresistance. Our results reveal a close association between anisotropic magnetotransport and ferroelectric hysteresis, underscoring the interplay between magnetic response and ferroic order in a two-dimensional polar semimetal.
articles.abstract_zh: 少层 WTe2（一种极性半金属）中的铁电性源自层间滑动，可以通过与栅极相关的电阻磁滞来探测。然而，磁场在这种传输特征中的作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们研究了磁场引起的剥落几层 WTe2 磁滞变化。应用平面外磁场会产生明显的磁滞增强，而平面内磁场则产生可忽略不计的响应。对各个磁滞分支的分析揭示了两种铁电态的不同磁输运响应，这增加了它们在磁场下的电阻分离。这种增强表现出强大的幂律场依赖性和与磁阻非常相似的温度演化。

articles.title: Magnetization, susceptibility, and entanglement entropy in antiferromagnetic star-shaped homometallic tetranuclear and pentanuclear Cu(II) complexes
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁星形同金属四核和五核 Cu(II) 配合物中的磁化强度、磁化率和纠缠熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of the magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and quantum entanglement entropy in antiferromagnetic star-shaped tetranuclear (Cu₄) and pentanuclear (Cu₅) Cu(II) clusters, motivated by experimentally realized molecular spin systems. In both cases, the study presents a discussion of the comparison between experimental data and theoretical analytical calculations of magnetic susceptibility as a function of temperature. The correlation between magnetization jumps and magnetic susceptibility peaks, along with the presence of entanglement entropy plateaus as a function of external magnetic fields, is analyzed in the low-temperature regime. Overall, the results demonstrate that the cluster size, geometry, and interaction anisotropy play a crucial role in shaping both the thermodynamic and the entanglement properties. In addition, the study is based on antiferromagnetic Heisenberg spin Hamiltonians, with the inclusion of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 在实验实现的分子自旋系统的推动下，我们对反铁磁星形四核 (Cu₄) 和五核 (Cu₅) Cu(II) 簇中的磁化强度、磁化率和量子纠缠熵进行了理论研究。在这两种情况下，该研究都讨论了磁化率随温度变化的实验数据和理论分析计算之间的比较。在低温状态下分析了磁化跃迁和磁化率峰值之间的相关性，以及作为外部磁场函数的纠缠熵平台的存在。总体而言，结果表明簇尺寸、几何形状和相互作用各向异性在塑造热力学和纠缠性质方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在实验实现的分子自旋系统的推动下，我们对反铁磁星形四核 (Cu₄) 和五核 (Cu₅) Cu(II) 簇中的磁化强度、磁化率和量子纠缠熵进行了理论研究。在这两种情况下，该研究都讨论了磁化率随温度变化的实验数据和理论分析计算之间的比较。在低温状态下分析了磁化跃迁和磁化率峰值之间的相关性，以及作为外部磁场函数的纠缠熵平台的存在。总体而言，结果表明簇尺寸、几何形状和相互作用各向异性在塑造热力学和纠缠性质方面发挥着至关重要的作用。此外，该研究基于反铁磁海森堡自旋哈密顿量，其中包括 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用。

articles.title: Collective relaxation dynamics and vitrification in hexatic smectic binary equimolar mixtures containing component with varying C₃F₇CH₂OCₘH₂ₘ- chain length
articles.title_zh: 含有不同 C₃F₇CH2OCₘH2ₘ- 链长组分的六方近晶二元等摩尔混合物中的集体弛豫动力学和玻璃化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Differential scanning calorimetry, polarizing optical microscopy, and broadband dielectric spectroscopy are applied for investigation of phase transitions in equimolar binary mixtures consisting of the MHPOBC liquid crystal as one component and 3FmHPhH6 homologs as a second component with different C₃F₇CH₂OCₘH₂ₘ- chain length (m = 2-7). The paraelectric smectic A* - ferroelectric smectic C* - antiferroelectric smectic C_A* - hexatic smectic X_A* - glassy smectic X_A* sequence is observed for all mixtures. The appearance of the bond-orientational order in smectic X_A* is accompanied by an additional relaxation process Pₕₑₓ in dielectric spectra at the low-frequency side of the P_H phason, consistent with its assignment to bond-orientational fluctuations. The empirical exponential-power relationship is proposed for the ratio between the relaxation times of Pₕₑₓ and P_H. The behavior of the structural α-relaxation and secondary β-relaxation in smectic X_A* depends on the m parameter, changing from overlapping α and β processes for m = 2 to well-separated for m = 6, 7. A double glass transition is observed by calorimetry on heating for m = 5-7. The calorimetric glass transition temperature shows a composition-dependent correspondence with temperatures at which either the P_H or α-relaxation time reaches 100 s, suggesting that different relaxation processes may contribute to vitrification.

articles.title: Designing quantum dynamics in squeezed potentials
articles.title_zh: 在压缩势中设计量子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometry offers a versatile platform to control quantum transport. We investigate the ground-state properties and out-of-equilibrium dynamics of interacting bosons in a two-dimensional channel with two localized squeezes. The squeezes generate effective barriers along the longitudinal direction. These geometry-induced barriers modify the ground-state density distribution and lead to the emergence of many-body fragmentation. The squeezed channel also provides control over the transport dynamics, including the degree of self-trapping and the oscillation period. At the many-body level, the transport develops dynamical fragmentation, leading to the collapse of the density oscillations. We further demonstrate that introducing the two squeezes from opposite transverse directions generates oscillatory angular momentum during transport. The modified geometry also exhibits distinct many-body collapse behaviors associated with different patterns of fragmentation. Together, these results establish engineered squeezed confinement as a powerful tool for designing the ground-state properties and controlling the quantum transport, including angular-momentum generation and rich many-body transport dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 几何提供了一个通用平台来控制量子传输。我们研究了具有两个局部挤压的二维通道中相互作用的玻色子的基态特性和非平衡动力学。挤压沿纵向产生有效的屏障。这些几何引起的势垒改变了基态密度分布并导致多体碎片的出现。压缩通道还提供对传输动力学的控制，包括自捕获程度和振荡周期。在多体水平上，传输会产生动态碎片，导致密度振荡崩溃。我们进一步证明，从相反的横向引入两个挤压会在运输过程中产生振荡角动量。修改后的几何结构还表现出与不同碎片模式相关的独特的多体塌陷行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何提供了一个通用平台来控制量子传输。我们研究了具有两个局部挤压的二维通道中相互作用的玻色子的基态特性和非平衡动力学。挤压沿纵向产生有效的屏障。这些几何引起的势垒改变了基态密度分布并导致多体碎片的出现。压缩通道还提供对传输动力学的控制，包括自捕获程度和振荡周期。在多体水平上，传输会产生动态碎片，导致密度振荡崩溃。我们进一步证明，从相反的横向引入两个挤压会在运输过程中产生振荡角动量。修改后的几何结构还表现出与不同碎片模式相关的独特的多体塌陷行为。总之，这些结果确立了工程挤压约束作为设计基态特性和控制量子输运（包括角动量生成和丰富的多体输运动力学）的强大工具。

articles.title: Seebeck and Hall effects in charge-neutral ballistic graphene as probes of electron-electron interactions
articles.title_zh: 电荷中性弹道石墨烯中的塞贝克效应和霍尔效应作为电子-电子相互作用的探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-hole asymmetry of the Coulomb velocity renormalization is responsible for finite Seebeck and Hall coefficients in charge-neutral graphene. In the ballistic regime the thermopower is small, 0.1--1~μV/K, because the chemical-potential shift required by nₑ=nₕ cancels its leading part. When the electron-electron scattering length falls below the sample length, the thermopower crosses over to a collision-dominated value of 4--10~μV/K, that is an order of magnitude larger. This crossover is a direct thermoelectric marker of the breakdown of ballistic transport and a baseline for identifying the Dirac fluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 库仑速度重整化的电子空穴不对称性是电荷中性石墨烯中有限塞贝克和霍尔系数的原因。在弹道状态下，热电势很小，为 0.1--1~μV/K，因为 nₑ=nₕ 所需的化学势位移抵消了其主导部分。当电子-电子散射长度低于样品长度时，热电势跨越碰撞主导值 4--10~μV/K，即大一个数量级。这种交叉是弹道输运故障的直接热电标记，也是识别狄拉克流体的基线。

articles.title: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center
articles.title_zh: 单一顺磁中心的模式分辨自旋波谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate mode-resolved ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) spectroscopy using optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) of a single nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in (111)-oriented diamond. A two-tone drive couples the magnetization dynamics to the NV spin resonance via the magnon Kerr effect. We show that the NV can detect the static stray field produced by this effect down to precession cone angles θ approx SI1degree, providing a generic scheme to measure the linear FMR spectrum with the spatial resolution of an atomic-size probe. We validate the approach on a normally magnetized yttrium iron garnet (YIG) microdisk, resolving its intrinsic quantized spin-wave modes. Scanning the probe across the surface, we map the spatial profile of the modes and find quantitative agreement with analytical models.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用 (111) 取向金刚石中单个氮空位 (NV) 中心的光学检测磁共振 (ODMR) 演示了模式分辨铁磁共振 (FMR) 光谱。双音驱动通过磁振子克尔效应将磁化动力学与 NV 自旋共振耦合。我们证明，NV 可以检测到由这种效应产生的静态杂散场，其进动锥角 θ 约为 SI1 度，提供了一种通用方案，以原子尺寸探针的空间分辨率来测量线性 FMR 频谱。我们在正常磁化的钇铁石榴石（YIG）微盘上验证了该方法，解析了其固有的量子化自旋波模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 (111) 取向金刚石中单个氮空位 (NV) 中心的光学检测磁共振 (ODMR) 演示了模式分辨铁磁共振 (FMR) 光谱。双音驱动通过磁振子克尔效应将磁化动力学与 NV 自旋共振耦合。我们证明，NV 可以检测到由这种效应产生的静态杂散场，其进动锥角 θ 约为 SI1 度，提供了一种通用方案，以原子尺寸探针的空间分辨率来测量线性 FMR 频谱。我们在正常磁化的钇铁石榴石（YIG）微盘上验证了该方法，解析了其固有的量子化自旋波模式。通过扫描整个表面的探针，我们绘制了模式的空间轮廓，并找到了与分析模型的定量一致性。

articles.title: LetzElPhC: an electron-phonon code for efficient exciton-phonon workflows
articles.title_zh: LetzElPhC：用于高效激子-声子工作流程的电子-声子代码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present textttLetzElPhC, an open-source software package that computes electron-phonon matrix elements from the output of density functional perturbation theory calculations performed with the textttQuantum ESPRESSO code. By interfacing directly with the textttYambo code and exploiting crystal symmetries, textttLetzElPhC enables a scalable workflow for evaluating exciton-phonon matrix elements while enforcing strict gauge consistency between one-electron Bloch states and Bethe-Salpeter excitonic wave functions across the full Brillouin zone. This symmetry-preserving approach avoids phase ambiguities and significantly reduces both computational costs and memory requirements. To support large-scale simulations on dense momentum grids, the package incorporates Fourier interpolation of dynamical matrices and perturbed Kohn-Sham potentials, accounting for long-range dipole and quadrupole interactions in both two- and three-dimensional materials, combined with multi-level parallelization and efficient parallel I/O. Together, these capabilities seamlessly complement the textttYambo code to enable first-principles simulations of phonon-assisted optical spectroscopies, which we demonstrate through applications to resonant Raman scattering in monolayer WSe₂ and phonon-assisted luminescence in cubic AgBr.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 textttLetzElPhC，这是一个开源软件包，可以根据使用 textttQuantum ESPRESSO 代码执行的密度泛函微扰理论计算的输出来计算电子声子矩阵元素。通过直接与 textttYambo 代码连接并利用晶体对称性，textttLetzElPhC 实现了可扩展的工作流程，用于评估激子-声子矩阵元素，同时在整个布里渊区的单电子 Bloch 态和 Bethe-Salpeter 激子波函数之间强制执行严格的规范一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推出了 textttLetzElPhC，这是一个开源软件包，可以根据使用 textttQuantum ESPRESSO 代码执行的密度泛函微扰理论计算的输出来计算电子声子矩阵元素。通过直接与 textttYambo 代码连接并利用晶体对称性，textttLetzElPhC 实现了可扩展的工作流程，用于评估激子-声子矩阵元素，同时在整个布里渊区的单电子 Bloch 态和 Bethe-Salpeter 激子波函数之间强制执行严格的规范一致性。这种保持对称性的方法避免了相位模糊，并显着降低了计算成本和内存需求。为了支持密集动量网格上的大规模模拟，该软件包结合了动态矩阵的傅立叶插值和扰动 Kohn-Sham 势，考虑了二维和三维材料中的长程偶极子和四极子相互作用，并结合了多级并行化和高效并行 I/O。这些功能一起无缝补充了 textttYambo 代码，以实现声子辅助光学光谱的第一原理模拟，我们通过单层 WSe2 中的共振拉曼散射和立方 AgBr 中的声子辅助发光的应用来演示这一点。

articles.title: Magnetic Reconfiguration Controls Spin Splitting and Spin-Orbit-Coupled Responses in Compensated Magnets
articles.title_zh: 磁重配置控制补偿磁体中的自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compensated magnets provide a versatile platform for spin-dependent electronic and transport phenomena. Here, we show that magnetic reconfiguration, i.e., selective reversal of local moments without changing the underlying crystal structure, can profoundly transform the nonrelativistic spin splitting and spin-orbit-coupled responses of spin-degenerate antiferromagnets (AFMs), altermagnets (AMs), and compensated ferrimagnets (cFIMs). Strikingly, magnetic configurations with nearly degenerate energies can exhibit qualitatively different spin-split band structures and anomalous Hall responses, allowing a small magnetic-energy scale to produce large changes in physical properties. Combining tight-binding models, oriented spin space group analysis, and first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that converting an AM configuration into cFIM states activates staggered onsite-potential contributions to spin splitting, complementing the anisotropic-hopping mechanism of AMs and removing symmetry-enforced degeneracies. Moreover, cFIM symmetry permits an anomalous Hall response at first order in spin-orbit coupling, in contrast to the higher-order or orientation-constrained responses of corresponding AM states.
