We demonstrate this regime in Mn2Mo3O8, one of 12 cFIM candidates identified in the MAGNDATA database, and further demonstrate its generality by designing cFIMs from collinear AFMs, exemplified by MnGeO3 and Co2Mo3O8. Our results establish magnetic reconfiguration as a powerful symmetry-guided strategy for dramatically reshaping electronic and transport responses in compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 补偿磁体为自旋相关电子和传输现象提供了一个多功能平台。在这里，我们证明磁重构，即在不改变底层晶体结构的情况下选择性反转局部矩，可以深刻地改变自旋简并反铁磁体（AFM）、交流磁体（AM）和补偿亚铁磁体（cFIM）的非相对论自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应。引人注目的是，具有近简并能量的磁性结构可以表现出性质不同的自旋分裂能带结构和反常霍尔响应，从而允许小的磁能尺度产生物理性质的大变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 补偿磁体为自旋相关电子和传输现象提供了一个多功能平台。在这里，我们证明磁重构，即在不改变底层晶体结构的情况下选择性反转局部矩，可以深刻地改变自旋简并反铁磁体（AFM）、交流磁体（AM）和补偿亚铁磁体（cFIM）的非相对论自旋分裂和自旋轨道耦合响应。引人注目的是，具有近简并能量的磁性结构可以表现出性质不同的自旋分裂能带结构和反常霍尔响应，从而允许小的磁能尺度产生物理性质的大变化。结合紧束缚模型、定向自旋空间群分析和第一原理计算，我们证明将 AM 配置转换为 cFIM 态会激活对自旋分裂的交错现场电位贡献，补充 AM 的各向异性跳跃机制并消除对称性强制的简并性。此外，cFIM 对称性允许自旋轨道耦合中的一阶异常霍尔响应，这与相应 AM 态的高阶或方向约束响应相反。我们在 Mn2Mo3O8（MAGNDATA 数据库中确定的 12 个 cFIM 候选者之一）中证明了这种机制，并通过从共线 AFM 设计 cFIM（以 MnGeO3 和 Co2Mo3O8 为例）进一步证明了其通用性。我们的结果将磁重构确立为一种强大的对称引导策略，可显着重塑补偿磁体中的电子和传输响应。

articles.title: EGQCA Code: automated high-throughput thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions
articles.title_zh: EGQCA 代码：固溶体的自动化高通量热力学建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modeling disordered systems from first principles across the full composition range is a long-standing computational challenge. We present a code package implementing the extended generalized quasichemical approximation (EGQCA), which describes solid solutions through the statistics of a finite set of clusters and enables their thermodynamic modeling at arbitrary compositions and temperatures. The package automates the complete workflow and interfaces with both DFT codes and universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). We show that replacing DFT with uMLIPs reduces the cost of the cluster calculations by up to five orders of magnitude while preserving the thermodynamic predictions. To make computationally demanding properties tractable, we additionally introduce a cluster-selection algorithm that identifies the most relevant configurations. Together, these developments establish EGQCA as a fast and accurate framework for the thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions and a practical route toward high-throughput screening of disordered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 根据第一原理在整个组成范围内对无序系统进行建模是一项长期存在的计算挑战。我们提出了一个实现扩展广义准化学近似（EGQCA）的代码包，它通过有限簇集的统计来描述固溶体，并使其能够在任意成分和温度下进行热力学建模。该软件包自动化了整个工作流程，并与 DFT 代码和通用机器学习原子间势 (uMLIP) 接口。我们证明，用 uMLIP 替换 DFT 可以将簇计算的成本降低多达五个数量级，同时保留热力学预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 根据第一原理在整个组成范围内对无序系统进行建模是一项长期存在的计算挑战。我们提出了一个实现扩展广义准化学近似（EGQCA）的代码包，它通过有限簇集的统计来描述固溶体，并使其能够在任意成分和温度下进行热力学建模。该软件包自动化了整个工作流程，并与 DFT 代码和通用机器学习原子间势 (uMLIP) 接口。我们证明，用 uMLIP 替换 DFT 可以将簇计算的成本降低多达五个数量级，同时保留热力学预测。为了使计算要求较高的属性易于处理，我们还引入了一种簇选择算法来识别最相关的配置。总之，这些进展使 EGQCA 成为固溶体热力学建模的快速、准确的框架，以及无序材料高通量筛选的实用途径。

articles.title: Measuring the Roughness of Quasi-Circular Interfaces at Finite Resolution
articles.title_zh: 以有限分辨率测量准圆形界面的粗糙度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interface roughness characterizes the boundary fluctuations across different length scales, which can reveal information about a material''s pinning landscape and collective interfacial behaviour. Finite sampling and image resolution can bias the measured scaling properties, however. These effects can particularly complicate comparisons between circular domains of different sizes, where the number of resolved boundary points, and the relationship between angular and physical separations vary with the interface radius. Here, we benchmark the recovery of the roughness exponent and amplitude using synthetic self-affine interfaces generated by Fourier synthesis, mapped onto circular contours, and rasterized onto a pixel grid. We first compare displacement-correlation (B(r)) and structure-factor (S(q)) estimates for different interface lengths. To address non-uniform angular and radial spacing in a circular interface, we assess a reconstruction procedure that weights slope minimization against medial interface position. We find that while spectral estimates were most effective in the original interfaces, this advantage did not persist after circular mapping. Moderate smoothing was found to improve parameter recovery, but stronger smoothing can bias both the scaling exponent and roughness amplitude. These results, verified on both synthetic datasets, and an experimental ferroelectric system, identify limitations of circular-interface roughness measurements and provide a basis for further investigations into the evolution of circular domains under finite resolution experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 界面粗糙度表征了不同长度尺度上的边界波动，这可以揭示有关材料的钉扎景观和集体界面行为的信息。然而，有限的采样和图像分辨率可能会使测量的缩放特性产生偏差。这些效应会使不同尺寸的圆形域之间的比较变得特别复杂，其中解析的边界点的数量以及角度和物理间隔之间的关系随着界面半径的变化而变化。在这里，我们使用傅里叶合成生成的合成自仿射接口对粗糙度指数和振幅的恢复进行基准测试，映射到圆形轮廓上，并光栅化到像素网格上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 界面粗糙度表征了不同长度尺度上的边界波动，这可以揭示有关材料的钉扎景观和集体界面行为的信息。然而，有限的采样和图像分辨率可能会使测量的缩放特性产生偏差。这些效应会使不同尺寸的圆形域之间的比较变得特别复杂，其中解析的边界点的数量以及角度和物理间隔之间的关系随着界面半径的变化而变化。在这里，我们使用傅里叶合成生成的合成自仿射接口对粗糙度指数和振幅的恢复进行基准测试，映射到圆形轮廓上，并光栅化到像素网格上。我们首先比较不同界面长度的位移相关性 (B(r)) 和结构因子 (S(q)) 估计。为了解决圆形界面中的不均匀角度和径向间距，我们评估了一种重建程序，该程序根据内侧界面位置对坡度最小化进行加权。我们发现，虽然光谱估计在原始接口中最有效，但这种优势在圆形映射后并没有持续存在。研究发现，适度的平滑可以改善参数恢复，但更强的平滑可能会使缩放指数和粗糙度幅度产生偏差。这些结果在合成数据集和实验铁电系统上得到了验证，确定了圆形界面粗糙度测量的局限性，并为进一步研究有限分辨率实验下圆形域的演化提供了基础。

articles.title: Origin of the anomalous shape of the γ-loop in paramagnetic Fe1-xCrx alloys from coupled Atomistic Spin Dynamics and ab initio Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 耦合原子自旋动力学和从头算分子动力学研究顺磁 Fe1-xCrx 合金中 γ 环异常形状的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The region of fcc stability in Fe-rich Fe-Cr alloys, the γ-loop, has an anomalous shape: at low temperatures, Cr addition initially stabilizes fcc, but above 8 at.% Cr it stabilizes bcc. At high temperatures, Cr always stabilizes bcc. This behavior reflects a delicate balance between magnetic, vibrational and configurational free-energy contributions that is challenging to capture from first principles. We investigate phase stability in Fe1-xCrx (x = 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) using coupled atomistic spin dynamics and ab initio molecular dynamics with thermodynamic integration. Gibbs free energy differences between fcc and bcc are calculated from 800 to 1800 K. Our calculations reproduce the experimental γ-loop and its compositional dependence, with near-quantitative accuracy for the γ-δ transition. The α-γ boundary, including its anomalous shape, is reproduced qualitatively, although transition temperatures are underestimated by approximately 200 K. Static calculations of magnetically ordered and disordered states provide an explanation: in ordered states, increasing Cr initially reduces the energetic preference for bcc over fcc, whereas in disordered states, Cr progressively stabilizes bcc at all compositions. Vibrational effects contribute to phase stability, while atomic short-range clustering at higher Cr content (x ≥ 0.15) may explain the observed closing of the γ-loop from below. The simulations reveal finite Cr moments in the paramagnetic state, whose magnitudes depend on their local magnetic environment. The results demonstrate that the anomalous γ-loop arises from the interplay of magnetic energetics, magnetic disorder, lattice vibrations and chemical clustering, which must be treated on equal footing to capture phase stability from first principle
articles.abstract_zh: 富铁 Fe-Cr 合金中的 fcc 稳定性区域（γ 环）具有异常形状：在低温下，添加 Cr 最初稳定 fcc，但高于 8 at.% Cr 则稳定 bcc。在高温下，Cr 始终稳定 bcc。这种行为反映了磁性、振动和构型自由能贡献之间的微妙平衡，这是从第一原理中很难捕捉到的。我们利用耦合原子自旋动力学和热力学积分从头算分子动力学研究了 Fe1-xCrx (x = 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) 的相稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 富铁 Fe-Cr 合金中的 fcc 稳定性区域（γ 环）具有异常形状：在低温下，添加 Cr 最初稳定 fcc，但高于 8 at.% Cr 则稳定 bcc。在高温下，Cr 始终稳定 bcc。这种行为反映了磁性、振动和构型自由能贡献之间的微妙平衡，这是从第一原理中很难捕捉到的。我们利用耦合原子自旋动力学和热力学积分从头算分子动力学研究了 Fe1-xCrx (x = 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) 的相稳定性。 fcc 和 bcc 之间的吉布斯自由能差异在 800 到 1800 K 范围内计算。我们的计算重现了实验 γ 环及其成分依赖性，对 γ-δ 转变具有近乎定量的精度。尽管转变温度被低估了约 200 K，但定性地再现了 α-γ 边界，包括其异常形状。磁有序和无序态的静态计算提供了解释：在有序态中，增加 Cr 最初会降低 bcc 相对于 fcc 的能量偏好，而在无序态中，Cr 逐渐稳定所有成分的 bcc。振动效应有助于相稳定性，而较高 Cr 含量 (x ≥ 0.15) 下的原子短程聚集可以解释观察到的 γ 环从下方闭合的现象。模拟揭示了顺磁状态下的有限 Cr 矩，其大小取决于其局部磁环境。结果表明，异常γ环是由磁能学、磁无序、晶格振动和化学团簇的相互作用产生的，必须平等对待才能从第一原理捕获相稳定性

articles.title: Data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo with Rydberg-atom measurements
articles.title_zh: 具有里德伯原子测量的数据增强自学习投影量子蒙特卡罗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo (PQMC) method that incorporates projective measurements from programmable quantum simulators into the guiding wavefunction of a ground-state projection. We demonstrate the approach for a two-dimensional Rydberg-atom array using restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) and recurrent neural network (RNN) guiding wavefunctions. Experimental pretraining reduces finite-population effects and accelerates self-learning convergence, allowing unbiased estimation of ground-state properties to be obtained with fewer walkers and fewer self-learning iterations. The improvement is particularly pronounced for the RBM, while the more accurate RNN guiding wavefunction exhibits a smaller, though still observable, benefit from pretraining. Simulations across different system sizes suggest that the relative advantage of experimental pretraining may increase with system size. Improvements are also observed for the checkerboard order parameter, despite deviations of the experimental measurements from the equilibrium numerical results. Finally, finite-size scaling with self-learning PQMC without experimental pretraining yields the critical point and critical exponents of the disordered-to-checkerboard transition in agreement with previous numerical studies. Our results show that limited and imperfect experimental measurements can provide an effective initialization for self-learning PQMC, while imaginary-time projection combined with subsequent unsupervised learning progressively refines the guiding wavefunction toward the ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种数据增强型自学习投影量子蒙特卡罗（PQMC）方法，该方法将可编程量子模拟器的投影测量合并到基态投影的引导波函数中。我们演示了使用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）和循环神经网络（RNN）引导波函数的二维里德堡原子阵列的方法。实验性预训练减少了有限群体效应并加速了自学习收敛，从而可以通过更少的步行者和更少的自学习迭代来获得基态属性的无偏估计。 RBM 的改进尤其明显，而更准确的 RNN 引导波函数从预训练中获得的收益虽然较小，但仍然可观察到。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一种数据增强型自学习投影量子蒙特卡罗（PQMC）方法，该方法将可编程量子模拟器的投影测量合并到基态投影的引导波函数中。我们演示了使用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）和循环神经网络（RNN）引导波函数的二维里德堡原子阵列的方法。实验性预训练减少了有限群体效应并加速了自学习收敛，从而可以通过更少的步行者和更少的自学习迭代来获得基态属性的无偏估计。 RBM 的改进尤其明显，而更准确的 RNN 引导波函数从预训练中获得的收益虽然较小，但仍然可观察到。不同系统规模的模拟表明，实验预训练的相对优势可能会随着系统规模的增加而增加。尽管实验测量结果与平衡数值结果存在偏差，但棋盘顺序参数也得到了改善。最后，在没有实验预训练的情况下，通过自学习 PQMC 进行有限尺寸缩放，产生了无序到棋盘转变的临界点和临界指数，与之前的数值研究一致。我们的结果表明，有限且不完善的实验测量可以为自学习 PQMC 提供有效的初始化，而虚数时间投影与随后的无监督学习相结合，逐步细化引导波函数朝向基态。

articles.title: Transverse Shifts Driven by Geometric Orbital Torque in Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交变磁体中几何轨道扭矩驱动的横向位移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalous transverse shifts in interface reflection are conventionally attributed to spin-orbit coupling or its pseudospin analogue. Here, we uncover a distinct geometric mechanism driven solely by an orbital torque arising from Fermi-surface anisotropy. During total reflection, an incident wave packet penetrates the anisotropic transmitted medium as an evanescent wave. There, the broken rotational symmetry about the interface normal exerts an orbital torque, and the accumulated angular impulse---the product of the torque and the dwell time---leads to a transverse spatial shift. Applying this mechanism to altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling, we show that the orbital torque is odd in spin. As a consequence, the two spin channels are deflected to opposite sides of the incident plane, giving an intrinsic spatial spin separation in altermagnets. The shift also inherits the angular symmetry of the altermagnetic spin splitting and is strongly enhanced near the onset of total reflection. Our work thus uncovers a new mechanism for transverse shifts, predicts a novel spin separation effect in altermagnets, and offers a direct probe of the altermagnetic order.
articles.abstract_zh: 界面反射中的异常横向位移通常归因于自旋轨道耦合或其赝自旋类似物。在这里，我们发现了一种独特的几何机制，该机制仅由费米表面各向异性产生的轨道扭矩驱动。在全反射期间，入射波包作为倏逝波穿透各向异性透射介质。在那里，关于界面法线的破缺旋转对称性施加了轨道扭矩，并且累积的角脉冲（扭矩和停留时间的乘积）导致横向空间移位。将这种机制应用于没有自旋轨道耦合的交流磁体，我们表明轨道扭矩在自旋中是奇数。因此，两个自旋通道偏转到入射平面的相对侧，从而在交变磁体中产生固有的空间自旋分离。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 界面反射中的异常横向位移通常归因于自旋轨道耦合或其赝自旋类似物。在这里，我们发现了一种独特的几何机制，该机制仅由费米表面各向异性产生的轨道扭矩驱动。在全反射期间，入射波包作为倏逝波穿透各向异性透射介质。在那里，关于界面法线的破缺旋转对称性施加了轨道扭矩，并且累积的角脉冲（扭矩和停留时间的乘积）导致横向空间移位。将这种机制应用于没有自旋轨道耦合的交流磁体，我们表明轨道扭矩在自旋中是奇数。因此，两个自旋通道偏转到入射平面的相对侧，从而在交变磁体中产生固有的空间自旋分离。该偏移还继承了交变自旋分裂的角对称性，并且在全反射开始附近强烈增强。因此，我们的工作揭示了一种新的横向位移机制，预测了交变磁体中的新型自旋分离效应，并提供了对交变磁序的直接探测。

articles.title: Emergent Chern metal in strongly correlated moiré bilayers
articles.title_zh: 强相关莫尔双层中出现的陈金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the topological properties of a strongly correlated moiré transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) bilayer (such as twisted MoTe₂ or WSe₂) hosting a spin-charge separated state coupled to a layer-polarized helical spin texture. Analyzing an effective low-energy Hamiltonian for mobile spinless holons moving through this non-coplanar spinon background, we reveal pronounced asymmetric band warping. This warping closes the global indirect band gap across most of the parameter space, restricting true topological insulators to fine-tuned critical trajectories. However, a finite local direct gap persists, stabilizing broad regions of a topological Chern metal (C = ± 1). Computing the Chern number and density of states, we demonstrate that this phase naturally yields a sizable, non-quantized anomalous Hall response accompanied by finite longitudinal conduction, providing a purely electronic strong-coupling mechanism for dissipative anomalous Hall states in moiré systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了强相关的莫尔过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 双层（例如扭曲的 MoTe2 或 WSe2）的拓扑特性，该双层具有与层偏振螺旋自旋纹理耦合的自旋电荷分离态。通过分析移动无自旋完整子穿过非共面自旋背景的有效低能哈密顿量，我们揭示了明显的不对称能带扭曲。这种扭曲关闭了大部分参数空间的全局间接带隙，将真正的拓扑绝缘体限制在微调的临界轨迹上。然而，有限的局部直接间隙仍然存在，稳定了拓扑陈金属的大范围区域 (C = ± 1)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了强相关的莫尔过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 双层（例如扭曲的 MoTe2 或 WSe2）的拓扑特性，该双层具有与层偏振螺旋自旋纹理耦合的自旋电荷分离态。通过分析移动无自旋完整子穿过非共面自旋背景的有效低能哈密顿量，我们揭示了明显的不对称能带扭曲。这种扭曲关闭了大部分参数空间的全局间接带隙，将真正的拓扑绝缘体限制在微调的临界轨迹上。然而，有限的局部直接间隙仍然存在，稳定了拓扑陈金属的大范围区域 (C = ± 1)。通过计算陈省身数和态密度，我们证明这一阶段自然会产生相当大的非量化反常霍尔响应，并伴有有限的纵向传导，为莫尔系统中的耗散反常霍尔态提供纯电子强耦合机制。

articles.title: Localization of an Individual Charge Fluctuator in a Si/SiGe Spin Qubit Device
articles.title_zh: Si/SiGe 自旋量子位器件中单个电荷波动器的定位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge noise from two-level fluctuators (TLFs) limits gate fidelities in semiconductor spin qubits, yet locating individual fluctuators within a device remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a spatial triangulation method that combines the gate dependence of a TLF's detuning with the chemical potential shifts it induces in a sensing dot. Applying this method to previously reported measurements from a gated Si/SiGe quantum dot device, we use electrostatic simulations to jointly constrain the fluctuator's three-dimensional position and the magnitude of its electric dipole moment. We localize the fluctuator to a region spanning 31 nm by 1 nm laterally and 4 nm vertically within the bulk of the atomic layer deposited aluminum oxide, identifying the material hosting this individual charge-noise source. The measurements are consistent with a vertically oriented TLF with a magnitude of 3 to 4 emathringA. This approach provides a route to determining which materials and interfaces host active charge fluctuators in semiconductor spin qubit devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 来自两级波动器 (TLF) 的电荷噪声限制了半导体自旋量子位中的栅极保真度，但在设备内定位单个波动器仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了一种空间三角测量方法，该方法将 TLF 失谐的栅极依赖性与其在传感点中引起的化学势变化相结合。将该方法应用于之前报道的门控 Si/SiGe 量子点器件的测量，我们使用静电模拟来共同约束波动器的三维位置及其电偶极矩的大小。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 来自两级波动器 (TLF) 的电荷噪声限制了半导体自旋量子位中的栅极保真度，但在设备内定位单个波动器仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了一种空间三角测量方法，该方法将 TLF 失谐的栅极依赖性与其在传感点中引起的化学势变化相结合。将该方法应用于之前报道的门控 Si/SiGe 量子点器件的测量，我们使用静电模拟来共同约束波动器的三维位置及其电偶极矩的大小。我们将波动器定位在原子层沉积的氧化铝主体内横向跨度为 31 nm x 1 nm、垂直跨度为 4 nm 的区域，从而识别出承载该单独电荷噪声源的材料。测量结果与震级为 3 至 4 emathringA 的垂直定向 TLF 一致。这种方法提供了一种确定半导体自旋量子位器件中哪些材料和界面具有活性电荷波动器的途径。

articles.title: Monotonic probes of asymmetry and robustness of the quantum Mpemba effect
articles.title_zh: 量子 Mpemba 效应的不对称性和鲁棒性的单调探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement asymmetry has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry restoration and the quantum Mpemba effect. However, its conventional Rényi generalizations, defined as differences of Rényi entropies, are not monotones in the resource-theoretic sense. Here, we investigate an alternative family of asymmetry quantifiers based on sandwiched Rényi divergences, which satisfy monotonicity under symmetry-preserving quantum channels. Developing a two-parameter replica approach, we show how these quantities can be computed from charged moments and establish a remarkable correspondence with conventional Rényi asymmetries under the inversion of the Rényi index, α↔ 1/α. This relation, exact for pure states, holds at leading order in the relevant scaling limits for homogeneous quantum quenches, including interacting integrable systems, and for Haar-random states. Applying these results to quenches from tilted ferromagnetic states, we demonstrate that the quantum Mpemba effect is remarkably robust, occurring throughout the entire family of sandwiched Rényi asymmetry monotones. We identify dynamical regimes in quenches from spatially inhomogeneous initial states where conventional Rényi asymmetries and genuine monotones exhibit qualitatively different behaviours. We also investigate a solvable toy model illustrating the possible dependence of Mpemba crossings on the Rényi index. Our findings establish a connection between conventional Rényi asymmetries and quantum resource theory, explaining their effectiveness in broad classes of nonequilibrium protocols while highlighting the additional information provided by genuine asymmetry monotones.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠不对称性已成为对称性恢复和量子姆彭巴效应的有力探针。然而，其传统的 Rényi 概括（定义为 Rényi 熵的差异）在资源理论意义上并不是单调的。在这里，我们研究了基于夹层 Rényi 散度的另一类不对称量词，它满足对称性保持量子通道下的单调性。通过开发一种双参数复制方法，我们展示了如何从带电矩计算这些量，并在 Rényi 指数的反演 α↔ 1/α 下与传统的 Rényi 不对称性建立显着的对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠不对称性已成为对称性恢复和量子姆彭巴效应的有力探针。然而，其传统的 Rényi 概括（定义为 Rényi 熵的差异）在资源理论意义上并不是单调的。在这里，我们研究了基于夹层 Rényi 散度的另一类不对称量词，它满足对称性保持量子通道下的单调性。通过开发一种双参数复制方法，我们展示了如何从带电矩计算这些量，并在 Rényi 指数的反演 α↔ 1/α 下与传统的 Rényi 不对称性建立显着的对应关系。这种关系对于纯态来说是精确的，在同质量子猝灭（包括相互作用的可积系统）和哈尔随机态的相关标度极限中保持领先顺序。将这些结果应用于倾斜铁磁态的淬灭，我们证明量子 Mpemba 效应非常强大，发生在整个夹层 Rényi 不对称单调家族中。我们从空间不均匀的初始状态中识别淬灭的动力学机制，其中传统的 Rényi 不对称性和真正的单调表现出性质不同的行为。我们还研究了一个可解的玩具模型，说明 Mpemba 交叉点对 Rényi 指数的可能依赖性。我们的研究结果建立了传统 Rényi 不对称性和量子资源理论之间的联系，解释了它们在广泛的非平衡协议中的有效性，同时强调了真正的不对称单调提供的附加信息。

articles.title: Magnons in solids with correlated atomic and nanoscale disorder
articles.title_zh: 具有相关原子和纳米级无序的固体中的磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic defects and disorder affect both the microscopic magnon excitations and the macroscopic physical properties of real-world magnetic materials. The rationalization of this relation has hitherto remained elusive, because of the intertwined challenges of simulating with quantum accuracy atomic- and nanoscale inhomogeneities and correlations, and their effect on the magnon spectral function determining observables such as spin stiffness. Here, we introduce a theoretical and computational framework to address these challenges. First, we develop the Coupled Optimization of SpIN Environment (COSINE) algorithm for efficiently relaxing the atomic structure and magnetic configuration of a solid with defects or disorder to a local energy minimum. Then, we discuss how to efficiently obtain exchange interactions accounting for local compositional, structural, and magnetic-moment inhomogeneities. Finally, we develop a paraunitary unfolding approach for Bogoliubov bosons, which allows us to predict the magnon spectral function in materials with any magnetic order, including systems with canting and full, partial, or no magnetic-moment compensation. We showcase our approach in a representative defective ferrimagnet for generality, and then combine it with state-of-the-art spin-informed machine-learning potentials to quantitatively predict how nonuniformities in the spatial distribution of vacancy defects control blurring of effective magnon bandstructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子缺陷和无序会影响微观磁振子激发和现实世界磁性材料的宏观物理性质。迄今为止，这种关系的合理化仍然难以捉摸，因为以量子精度模拟原子和纳米尺度的不均匀性和相关性及其对确定自旋刚度等可观测值的磁振子谱函数的影响是相互交织的挑战。在这里，我们介绍一个理论和计算框架来应对这些挑战。首先，我们开发了 SpIN 环境耦合优化 (COSINE) 算法，用于有效地将具有缺陷或无序的固体的原子结构和磁构型放松到局部能量最小值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子缺陷和无序会影响微观磁振子激发和现实世界磁性材料的宏观物理性质。迄今为止，这种关系的合理化仍然难以捉摸，因为以量子精度模拟原子和纳米尺度的不均匀性和相关性及其对确定自旋刚度等可观测值的磁振子谱函数的影响是相互交织的挑战。在这里，我们介绍一个理论和计算框架来应对这些挑战。首先，我们开发了 SpIN 环境耦合优化 (COSINE) 算法，用于有效地将具有缺陷或无序的固体的原子结构和磁构型放松到局部能量最小值。然后，我们讨论如何有效地获得考虑局部成分、结构和磁矩不均匀性的交换相互作用。最后，我们为博戈柳博夫玻色子开发了一种准统一展开方法，该方法使我们能够预测具有任何磁序的材料中的磁振子谱函数，包括具有倾斜和完全、部分或无磁矩补偿的系统。我们在具有代表性的缺陷亚铁磁体中展示了我们的方法，以实现通用性，然后将其与最先进的自旋信息机器学习势相结合，以定量预测空位缺陷空间分布的不均匀性如何控制有效磁振子能带结构的模糊。

articles.title: A microscopic continuum model for moiré transition metal dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 莫尔过渡金属二硫化物的微观连续模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted transition metal dichalcogenides (tTMDs) have emerged as a fascinating platform for many-body phases --- displaying fractional Chern insulators and superconductivity as a function of doping. Here, we give a microscopic derivation of a continuum model which accurately describes their bandstructure across a range of twist angles with angle-independent parameters. This angle-independent description rests on retaining both the monolayer valence and conduction bands, which introduce tunnelling paths through AB-stacked regions; upon downfolding to the valence band, these paths supply a substantial twist-tunable contribution to the interlayer coupling. We show that the model is a perturbation of a chiral model with a magic angle, explaining the near-ideal quantum geometry of the moiré bands. The model further produces a strongly different orbital magnetic moment to the single-orbital theory --- predicting an anomalous Landau level slope --- and a redistribution of charge between the layers, modifying the moiré ferroelectric potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 扭曲过渡金属二硫化物 (tTMD) 已成为多体相的一个令人着迷的平台——显示分数陈绝缘体和超导性作为掺杂的函数。在这里，我们给出了连续介质模型的微观推导，该模型通过与角度无关的参数准确地描述了它们在一系列扭转角度上的能带结构。这种与角度无关的描述依赖于保留单层价带和导带，这引入了穿过AB堆叠区域的隧道路径；当向下折叠到价带时，这些路径为层间耦合提供了显着的扭转可调贡献。我们证明该模型是具有魔角的手性模型的扰动，解释了莫尔带的近乎理想的量子几何结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扭曲过渡金属二硫化物 (tTMD) 已成为多体相的一个令人着迷的平台——显示分数陈绝缘体和超导性作为掺杂的函数。在这里，我们给出了连续介质模型的微观推导，该模型通过与角度无关的参数准确地描述了它们在一系列扭转角度上的能带结构。这种与角度无关的描述依赖于保留单层价带和导带，这引入了穿过AB堆叠区域的隧道路径；当向下折叠到价带时，这些路径为层间耦合提供了显着的扭转可调贡献。我们证明该模型是具有魔角的手性模型的扰动，解释了莫尔带的近乎理想的量子几何结构。该模型进一步产生了与单轨道理论截然不同的轨道磁矩——预测了异常的朗道能级斜率——以及层间电荷的重新分布，从而改变了莫尔铁电势。

articles.title: A computer-assisted proof of one-cell snaking and lattice trapping for a nonlinear square lattice
articles.title_zh: 非线性方晶格的单细胞蛇行和晶格捕获的计算机辅助证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33208v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish a computer-assisted proof of lattice trapping in an infinite nonlinear square lattice with interaction potential φ(t)=(1-e⁻³t^²)/6 and an antiplane crack far field Ksqrtrsin(θ/2). We construct a connected branch of equilibria whose single-cell segment contains exactly two nondegenerate quadratic folds, with a stability sequence of stable, Morse index one, and stable in the full energy space. The fold loads satisfy 0.45897<0.45923 and 0.46219<0.46242, establishing a strictly positive lattice-trapping width K₊-K₋>0.00296. A uniqueness argument establishes exact translation closure and smooth continuation across lattice cells. The proof combines renormalized energy, Schur complement estimates, analytic infinite-tail bounds, interval arithmetic, and exact integer positivity certificates. All finite input data, verification programs, and recorded certificate outputs are provided in the accompanying certificate archive.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们建立了无限非线性方晶格中晶格捕获的计算机辅助证明，其相互作用势为 φ(t)=(1-e⁻3t^²)/6 和反平面裂纹远场 Ksqrtrsin(θ/2)。我们构建了一个平衡的连通分支，其单细胞段恰好包含两个非简并二次折叠，其稳定性序列为稳定、莫尔斯指数一和在全能量空间中稳定。折叠载荷满足 0.458970.00296。唯一性论证建立了精确的平移闭包和跨晶格单元的平滑延续。该证明结合了重正化能量、Schur 补估计、解析无限尾界、区间算术和精确整数正性证明。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了无限非线性方晶格中晶格捕获的计算机辅助证明，其相互作用势为 φ(t)=(1-e⁻3t^²)/6 和反平面裂纹远场 Ksqrtrsin(θ/2)。我们构建了一个平衡的连通分支，其单细胞段恰好包含两个非简并二次折叠，其稳定性序列为稳定、莫尔斯指数一和在全能量空间中稳定。折叠载荷满足 0.458970.00296。唯一性论证建立了精确的平移闭包和跨晶格单元的平滑延续。该证明结合了重正化能量、Schur 补估计、解析无限尾界、区间算术和精确整数正性证明。所有有限输入数据、验证程序和记录的证书输出均在随附的证书档案中提供。

articles.title: Two Timescales of Forgetting in Fine-tuning of Language Models: Fast Behavioral Suppression and Slow Representational Drift
articles.title_zh: 语言模型微调中遗忘的两个时间尺度：快速行为抑制和缓慢表征漂移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33302v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. While during pretraining the model's ability to generate with the correct grammar rules coincides with building the internal representations of the corresponding latent, we find that SFT exhibits a very different dynamics: (i) the generation of deleted rules changes on a fast timescale inversely proportional to the magnitude of the token-latent correlation; meanwhile, their corresponding representations stay intact; (ii) the hidden representations of the deleted rules become forgotten on a much longer timescale, associated with a slow drift of the network parameters. Finally, we observe analogous results in a realistic setup with natural language, suggesting that this timescale separation in forgetting is a more general phenomenon of fine-tuning language models.
articles.abstract_zh: 如今，人工智能系统的核心流程是对广泛的文本语料库进行预训练，然后对特定任务或所需行为进行微调。然而，我们对有限数据分布的微调如何修改预训练期间获得的表示的理解仍然有限。特别是，目前尚不清楚表面行为抑制是否与支持它的潜在表征的消除同时发生。在这项工作中，我们通过在具有分层潜在结构的受控上下文无关语法（随机层次模型（RHM））上预训练 Transformer 来研究监督微调（SFT），并使用其生成规则的受限子集进行微调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 如今，人工智能系统的核心流程是对广泛的文本语料库进行预训练，然后对特定任务或所需行为进行微调。然而，我们对有限数据分布的微调如何修改预训练期间获得的表示的理解仍然有限。特别是，目前尚不清楚表面行为抑制是否与支持它的潜在表征的消除同时发生。在这项工作中，我们通过在具有分层潜在结构的受控上下文无关语法（随机层次模型（RHM））上预训练 Transformer 来研究监督微调（SFT），并使用其生成规则的受限子集进行微调。虽然在预训练过程中，模型生成正确语法规则的能力与构建相应潜在变量的内部表示相一致，但我们发现 SFT 表现出非常不同的动态：（i）删除规则的生成在快速时间尺度上变化，与令牌潜在相关性的大小成反比；同时，它们相应的表示保持不变； (ii) 已删除规则的隐藏表示在更长的时间尺度上被遗忘，这与网络参数的缓慢漂移相关。最后，我们在自然语言的现实设置中观察到类似的结果，这表明遗忘中的这种时间尺度分离是微调语言模型的更普遍的现象。

articles.title: Nitrogen-Vacancy Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy of ¹⁵N Spins in Potassium Nitrite Solution
articles.title_zh: 亚硝酸钾溶液中 15N 自旋的氮空位核磁共振谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33360v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nitrogen is essential in agricultural fertilizers, yet its nanoscale interfacial dynamics remain largely unexplored. Although quadrupolar broadening complicates ¹⁴N nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) detection, ¹⁵N (I=1/2) provides well-defined nuclear-spin signatures but remains challenging to detect at the nanoscale due to its low natural abundance and small gyromagnetic ratio. Here, we use a microfluidic quantum sensing platform based on shallow nitrogen vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to detect ¹⁵N NMR from KNO₃ solution at room temperature and in a low magnetic field regime. Within femtoliter-scale sensing volumes, we measure a magnetic-field variance of up to ~442 nT², ~43 times greater than the expected statistical polarization. The ¹⁵N spin correlation decays within ~500 mus, mainly limited by the NV spin lattice relaxation time and not by the molecular diffusion of the KNO₃ molecules. This is consistent with the formation of a KNO₃ adsorption layer on the diamond surface, supported by surface characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮对于农业肥料至关重要，但其纳米级界面动力学在很大程度上仍未得到探索。尽管四极展宽使 15N 核磁共振 (NMR) 检测变得复杂，但 15N (I=1/2) 提供了明确的核自旋特征，但由于其自然丰度低和旋磁比小，在纳米尺度上检测仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用基于金刚石浅氮空位（NV）中心的微流体量子传感平台在室温和低磁场条件下检测 KNO₃ 溶液中的 15 N NMR。在飞升级传感体积内，我们测量到的磁场方差高达约 442 nT²，比预期统计极化大约 43 倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氮对于农业肥料至关重要，但其纳米级界面动力学在很大程度上仍未得到探索。尽管四极展宽使 15N 核磁共振 (NMR) 检测变得复杂，但 15N (I=1/2) 提供了明确的核自旋特征，但由于其自然丰度低和旋磁比小，在纳米尺度上检测仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用基于金刚石浅氮空位（NV）中心的微流体量子传感平台在室温和低磁场条件下检测 KNO₃ 溶液中的 15 N NMR。在飞升级传感体积内，我们测量到的磁场方差高达约 442 nT²，比预期统计极化大约 43 倍。 15N 自旋相关性在约 500 mu 内衰减，主要受 NV 自旋晶格弛豫时间的限制，而不是受 KNO3 分子扩散的限制。这与金刚石表面 KNO₃ 吸附层的形成一致，并得到表面表征的支持。

articles.title: Optimal Controlled Quantum Instrument for Monitored Many-Body Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于监测多体动力学的最佳受控量子仪器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-selecting rare trajectories of monitored quantum dynamics requires exponentially many repeated experiments. We extend Bayes' rule to monitored many-body dynamics and bias the quantum trajectories by nonlinear functions of the post-measurement state. For functions that are constant on the sets of a suitable finite partition of the post-measurement states, we construct a quantum instrument on the system and an additional register that produces the biased trajectories at the optimal rates without post-selection. This optimal controlled quantum instrument has a natural tensor-network representation as the left canonical form of the system--register tensors. We illustrate the construction with two examples: a precessing qubit, biased by its spin component along the field, and free fermions with gain and loss, biased by the particle number, where the biased trajectories undergo a phase transition. We also argue, under one assumption, that biasing a measured Majorana chain by its von Neumann entropy leads to entanglement transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 后选择受监控的量子动力学的稀有轨迹需要指数级的多次重复实验。我们将贝叶斯规则扩展到监测多体动力学，并通过测量后状态的非线性函数来偏置量子轨迹。对于在测量后状态的适当有限分区集合上恒定的函数，我们在系统上构造了一个量子仪器和一个附加寄存器，该寄存器可以在没有后选择的情况下以最佳速率产生偏置轨迹。这种最优受控量子仪器具有自然的张量网络表示作为系统的左规范形式——寄存器张量。我们用两个例子来说明这一结构：一个进动量子位，由其沿场的自旋分量偏置；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 后选择受监控的量子动力学的稀有轨迹需要指数级的多次重复实验。我们将贝叶斯规则扩展到监测多体动力学，并通过测量后状态的非线性函数来偏置量子轨迹。对于在测量后状态的适当有限分区集合上恒定的函数，我们在系统上构造了一个量子仪器和一个附加寄存器，该寄存器可以在没有后选择的情况下以最佳速率产生偏置轨迹。这种最优受控量子仪器具有自然的张量网络表示作为系统的左规范形式——寄存器张量。我们用两个例子来说明这一结构：一个进动量子位，由其沿场的自旋分量偏置；以及具有增益和损耗的自由费米子，由粒子数偏置，其中偏置轨迹经历相变。我们还认为，在一个假设下，通过冯诺依曼熵对测量的马约拉纳链进行偏置会导致纠缠跃迁。

articles.title: Infrared-absorption magnetometry in a diamond nanocavity: demonstration and limits at the nanoscale
articles.title_zh: 金刚石纳米腔中的红外吸收磁力测量：纳米尺度的演示和限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33481v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diamond quantum sensors promise both high spatial resolution and high sensitivity; however, conventional photoluminescence-based spin readout can be difficult to integrate efficiently. Infrared absorption by nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond provides a promising alternative, although the sensitivity of compact absorption-based sensors is limited by the short optical interaction length between the probe field and the NV ensemble. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate, for the first time, singlet-absorption magnetometry using spin-dense diamond nanocavities. By probing cavity modes near the 1042 nm NV singlet transition, we observe spin-dependent cavity transmission and perform cavity-enhanced magnetic field sensing. We further develop and experimentally validate a model that accurately predicts the spin-dependent cavity response, describes the optimal operating conditions, and identifies the practical limitations of different optically detected magnetic resonance modalities. Together, these results establish cavity-enhanced singlet absorption as a scalable readout mechanism for integrated diamond quantum sensors and provide a practical framework for engineering next-generation nanophotonic diamond quantum magnetometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石量子传感器兼具高空间分辨率和高灵敏度；然而，传统的基于光致发光的自旋读出可能难以有效集成。金刚石中氮空位 (NV) 中心的红外吸收提供了一种有前途的替代方案，尽管基于紧凑吸收的传感器的灵敏度受到探测场和 NV 系综之间的短光学相互作用长度的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们首次展示了使用自旋致密金刚石纳米腔的单重态吸收磁力测量。通过探测 1042 nm NV 单重态跃迁附近的腔模式，我们观察到自旋相关的腔传输并执行腔增强磁场传感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石量子传感器兼具高空间分辨率和高灵敏度；然而，传统的基于光致发光的自旋读出可能难以有效集成。金刚石中氮空位 (NV) 中心的红外吸收提供了一种有前途的替代方案，尽管基于紧凑吸收的传感器的灵敏度受到探测场和 NV 系综之间的短光学相互作用长度的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们首次展示了使用自旋致密金刚石纳米腔的单重态吸收磁力测量。通过探测 1042 nm NV 单重态跃迁附近的腔模式，我们观察到自旋相关的腔传输并执行腔增强磁场传感。我们进一步开发并通过实验验证了一个模型，该模型可以准确预测自旋相关的腔响应，描述最佳操作条件，并确定不同光学检测磁共振模态的实际局限性。总之，这些结果将腔增强单线态吸收确立为集成金刚石量子传感器的可扩展读出机制，并为设计下一代纳米光子金刚石量子磁力计提供了实用框架。

articles.title: Geometry Sets the Neutral MLIP-DFT Gap in Non-Covalent Binding, and Charged Systems Fail
articles.title_zh: 几何结构在非共价结合中设置中性 MLIP-DFT 间隙，带电系统失败
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33830v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are widely expected to substitute for explicit quantum chemistry when screening molecular interactions. On non-covalent binding we find that this expectation holds for neutral chemistry and fails for charged chemistry. We audit the FAIRChem UMA OMol head, without task-specific fine-tuning, on 5,567 probe-target dimers from 18 benchmarks across nine fidelity arms, using RAPIDS (Rapid Atomistic Probe-target Interaction Discovery Scaffold), a training-free inference-time scaffold. First, on neutral chemistry RAPIDS reaches a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.37 kcal/mol, matching or beating every explicit DFT single-point fidelity (1.42-1.50 kcal/mol), so the remaining MLIP-DFT gap is geometric rather than a learned-surface error. Second, charged systems form a qualitatively different regime: MAE jumps to 8.5-22.9 kcal/mol across three charged benchmarks; DFT single-point rescoring does not restore accuracy, geometry reoptimization restores it for ionic hydrogen bonds and ion-molecule dimers, and the failure persists across all three MLIP backbones. Third, the residual failures are structured: signed biases cluster by chemistry family, and whether a fidelity fails catastrophically transfers across families more reliably than error magnitude, enabling cost-aware fidelity selection. RAPIDS-Select, a closed-form rule on cheap precomputed features, uses about 37% less compute than a strong static DFT baseline at matched accuracy, and on a newly computed charged benchmark cuts the catastrophe rate from 68% to 5.7%. On WetSenseBench, a wet-lab-grounded host-guest selectivity benchmark from eight sensing studies, RAPIDS without DFT follow-up recovers 82.9% pair-level agreement on the seven studies above its ~1 kcal/mol precision floor.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，在筛选分子相互作用时，预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）将取代显式量子化学。对于非共价结合，我们发现这种期望对于中性化学成立，而对于带电化学则失败。我们使用 RAPIDS（快速原子探针-目标交互发现支架）（一种无需训练的推理时间支架）对来自 9 个保真臂的 18 个基准的 5,567 个探针-目标二聚体进行审核，无需针对特定任务进行微调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们普遍认为，在筛选分子相互作用时，预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）将取代显式量子化学。对于非共价结合，我们发现这种期望对于中性化学成立，而对于带电化学则失败。我们使用 RAPIDS（快速原子探针-目标交互发现支架）（一种无需训练的推理时间支架）对来自 9 个保真臂的 18 个基准的 5,567 个探针-目标二聚体进行审核，无需针对特定任务进行微调。首先，在中性化学上，RAPIDS 达到 1.37 kcal/mol 的平均绝对误差 (MAE)，匹配或击败每个显式 DFT 单点保真度 (1.42-1.50 kcal/mol)，因此剩余的 MLIP-DFT 间隙是几何误差，而不是学习表面误差。其次，带电系统形成了一个性质不同的体系：在三个带电基准上，MAE 跃升至 8.5-22.9 kcal/mol； DFT 单点重新评分不能恢复准确性，几何重新优化可以恢复离子氢键和离子分子二聚体的准确性，并且故障在所有三个 MLIP 主干上持续存在。第三，残余故障是结构化的：有符号偏差按化学族聚集，保真度是否灾难性地失败在族之间的转移比误差幅度更可靠，从而实现成本意识的保真度选择。 RAPIDS-Select 是一种针对廉价预计算特征的封闭式规则，在匹配的精度下，它使用的计算量比强静态 DFT 基线减少了约 37%，并且在新计算的收费基准上，灾难率从 68% 降低到 5.7%。在 WetSenseBench（来自八项传感研究的基于湿实验室的主客体选择性基准）上，没有 DFT 后续研究的 RAPIDS 在高于其约 1 kcal/mol 精度下限的七项研究中恢复了 82.9% 的配对水平一致性。

articles.title: Unified preparation of exact and asymptotic quantum many-body scars from Dicke states
articles.title_zh: 迪克态精确渐近量子多体疤痕的统一制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33987v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a unified quantum algorithm for preparing exact and asymptotic quantum many-body scar (QMBS) states in the spin-1 it XY, domain-wall-conserving, and Onsager scar models. Model-dependent isometries map the exact scar states to Dicke states and the target asymptotic QMBS states to gapless magnon excitations of the spin-1/2 ferromagnetic Heisenberg chain. Exact QMBS states are prepared by applying the inverse isometries to Dicke states. For asymptotic QMBS states, block encoding first prepares the magnon excitations from Dicke states to a prescribed fidelity, after which the inverse isometries map the prepared states back to the physical chains. At fixed target fidelity, the block-encoding success probability has a positive lower bound independent of system size and scar index, implying that a constant number of amplitude amplification rounds suffices. Our algorithm enables systematic studies of nonergodic dynamics on programmable quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的量子算法，用于在 spin-1 it XY、域壁守恒和 Onsager 疤痕模型中准备精确且渐进的量子多体疤痕 (QMBS) 态。模型相关的等距将精确的疤痕状态映射到迪克状态，并将目标渐近 QMBS 状态映射到自旋 1/2 铁磁海森堡链的无间隙磁振子激发。精确的 QMBS 状态是通过将逆等距应用于 Dicke 状态来准备的。对于渐近 QMBS 状态，块编码首先将 Dicke 状态的磁振子激励准备到规定的保真度，然后逆等距将准备好的状态映射回物理链。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种统一的量子算法，用于在 spin-1 it XY、域壁守恒和 Onsager 疤痕模型中准备精确且渐进的量子多体疤痕 (QMBS) 态。模型相关的等距将精确的疤痕状态映射到迪克状态，并将目标渐近 QMBS 状态映射到自旋 1/2 铁磁海森堡链的无间隙磁振子激发。精确的 QMBS 状态是通过将逆等距应用于 Dicke 状态来准备的。对于渐近 QMBS 状态，块编码首先将 Dicke 状态的磁振子激励准备到规定的保真度，然后逆等距将准备好的状态映射回物理链。在固定目标保真度下，块编码成功概率具有独立于系统大小和疤痕指数的正下限，这意味着恒定数量的幅度放大轮数就足够了。我们的算法可以在可编程量子模拟器上系统地研究非遍历动力学。

articles.title: The transverse spin-gradient approximation in noncollinear spin density functional theory
articles.title_zh: 非共线自旋密度泛函理论中的横向自旋梯度近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34301v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove a quantitative error bound for a fixed-axis variant of the transverse spin-gradient approximation (TSGA) in noncollinear spin density functional theory. Inspired by Eich and Gross, we use a spin-spiral wave (SSW) as the local reference for the grand-canonical Levy-Lieb energy with the Hartree term subtracted. We construct the thermodynamic limit of the electron gas with constant total density and a prescribed SSW magnetization. Its energy per unit volume eᵣₘ SSW is evaluated at the local wavevector nablaϕ, where ϕ is the spiral phase. When ϕ is the azimuthal angle of the magnetization m=(m₁,m₂,m₃), the approximation reads [ E(ρ,m)approxintR^₃eᵣₘ SSWbig(ρ(x),m(x),nablaϕ(x)big),d x. ] Here nablaϕ measures the local rotation of m about the third axis. Wherever m₁²+m₂²>0, it equals (m₁nabla m₂-m₂nabla m₁)/(m₁²+m₂²). The approximation thus depends only on the total density ρ, the magnetization and its first derivatives. When the spin-polarized density in the rotating frame and the local wavevector vary on the length scale N¹/³, with N the mean number of particles, we obtain an error O(N⁵/⁶) for an energy of order N. Setting the phase to zero gives the noncollinear local spin density approximation (LSDA) for arbitrary magnetization directions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了非共线自旋密度泛函理论中横向自旋梯度近似（TSGA）的固定轴变体的定量误差界。受 Eich 和 Gross 的启发，我们使用自旋螺旋波 (SSW) 作为减去 Hartree 项的大正则 Levy-Lieb 能量的局部参考。我们构建了具有恒定总密度和指定 SSW 磁化强度的电子气的热力学极限。其每单位体积的能量 eᵣₘ SSW 在局部波矢量 nablaΦ 处评估，其中 Φ 是螺旋相位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了非共线自旋密度泛函理论中横向自旋梯度近似（TSGA）的固定轴变体的定量误差界。受 Eich 和 Gross 的启发，我们使用自旋螺旋波 (SSW) 作为减去 Hartree 项的大正则 Levy-Lieb 能量的局部参考。我们构建了具有恒定总密度和指定 SSW 磁化强度的电子气的热力学极限。其每单位体积的能量 eᵣₘ SSW 在局部波矢量 nablaΦ 处评估，其中 Φ 是螺旋相位。当 phi 是磁化强度 m=(m₁,m2,m₃) 的方位角时，近似值为 [ E(ρ,m)approxintR^₃eᵣₘ SSWbig(ρ(x),m(x),nablaphi(x)big),d x。 ] 这里 nablaphi 测量 m 绕第三轴的局部旋转。当 m₁²+m²²>0 时，它等于 (m₁nabla m²-m²nabla m₁)/(m₁²+m²²)。因此，近似值仅取决于总密度 ρ、磁化强度及其一阶导数。当旋转坐标系中的自旋极化密度和局部波矢在长度尺度 N1/3 上变化时，其中 N 是粒子的平均数量，我们得到 N 阶能量的误差 O(N⁵/⁶)。将相位设置为零给出任意磁化方向的非共线局部自旋密度近似 (LSDA)。

articles.title: Inverted Pendulum in the Sky: Floquet Stabilization of Cosmological Axions
articles.title_zh: 天空中的倒立摆：宇宙轴子的花束稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34439v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many cosmological scenarios require a scalar field to sit near the top of its potential, which usually requires a fine-tuned initial condition. We ask whether the hilltop of an axion potential can be dynamically stabilized by a rapidly oscillating coupling, as for the inverted pendulum of Kapitza, and to what extent this can reduce the fine-tuning. Using Floquet theory, we determine the stability window of the hilltop and analyze several realizations: an oscillating coupling, a spinning or oscillating second field, and a gyroscopic analogue, an inverted spinning top realized by a sigma model on a squashed three-sphere. In an expanding Universe the stabilized phase lasts for a number of e-folds logarithmic in the hierarchy of scales, independently of the cosmological background. Classifying the stabilizers by how their effective frequency redshifts, we show that in these realizations the hilltop cannot both attract the field and leave it frozen by the Hubble friction during radiation or matter domination, and that during inflation the attraction is limited by the Hubble friction and the energy budget. Thus the simple realizations studied here do not generically remove the hilltop fine-tuning. They can instead delay the onset of the oscillation and enhance the relic abundance as n_φ/nφ,ᵣₘ ₛₜdpropto(tilde m/H_c)³/² in radiation domination. We discuss the implications for axion dark matter, inflation, quintessence and curvatons.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多宇宙学场景要求标量场位于其势能的顶部附近，这通常需要微调初始条件。我们询问轴子势的山顶是否可以通过快速振荡耦合来动态稳定，就像卡皮查倒立摆一样，以及这可以在多大程度上减少微调。使用 Floquet 理论，我们确定了山顶的稳定窗口并分析了几种实现：振荡耦合、旋转或振荡第二场以及陀螺仪模拟，即通过压扁的三球体上的 sigma 模型实现的倒置旋转陀螺。在膨胀的宇宙中，稳定相持续了尺度层次中对数的 e 折叠数，与宇宙学背景无关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多宇宙学场景要求标量场位于其势能的顶部附近，这通常需要微调初始条件。我们询问轴子势的山顶是否可以通过快速振荡耦合来动态稳定，就像卡皮查倒立摆一样，以及这可以在多大程度上减少微调。使用 Floquet 理论，我们确定了山顶的稳定窗口并分析了几种实现：振荡耦合、旋转或振荡第二场以及陀螺仪模拟，即通过压扁的三球体上的 sigma 模型实现的倒置旋转陀螺。在膨胀的宇宙中，稳定相持续了尺度层次中对数的 e 折叠数，与宇宙学背景无关。根据稳定器的有效频率红移方式对稳定器进行分类，我们表明，在这些认识中，山顶不能既吸引场又使其在辐射或物质支配期间被哈勃摩擦冻结，并且在膨胀期间吸引力受到哈勃摩擦和能量预算的限制。因此，这里研究的简单实现通常不会消除山顶微调。相反，它们可以延迟振荡的开始并增强辐射支配中的遗迹丰度，如 n_φ/nφ,ᵣₘ ₛₜdpropto(tilde m/H_c)3/2。我们讨论轴子暗物质、暴胀、精髓和曲率的影响。

articles.title: Quantum dynamics of a charged particle on rotating curved surfaces and space curves in electromagnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 电磁场中旋转曲面和空间曲线上带电粒子的量子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34448v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a gauge-consistent framework for a charged particle confined to a rotating curved manifold in an electromagnetic field, starting from the covariant Klein--Gordon equation. The non-relativistic reduction casts the rotational effects as effective gauge potentials while preserving the U(1) symmetry, so that rotation and the external field enter alike, the geometry entering separately as the da Costa potential. The obstruction to dimensional reduction is gauge--geometry entanglement: transverse magnetic fields on a two-dimensional (2D) surface and structural torsion on a one-dimensional (1D) curve couple the tangential dynamics to the transverse degrees of freedom. We remove this entanglement by three mechanisms---a generalized transverse Poincaré gauge, the rotation-minimizing Bishop frame, and the parity of the transverse ground state, the last of which annihilates the residual first-order magnetic coupling for a single inversion-symmetric well. On a torus, an axial field generates a joint Sagnac--Aharonov--Bohm residual of tunable sign without spoiling the poloidal--azimuthal separability, whereas an in-plane field couples only through the out-of-plane extent of the structure: it breaks the axial symmetry there but leaves a planar curve unaffected to first order. The same torus shows the axial field tuning the curvature-induced localization, and a corrugated quantum ring converts periodic geometric and flux modulations into an artificial superlattice whose in-plane-field immunity follows from planarity and parity, not from the smallness of the field. Non-inertial quantum dynamics on surfaces and curves of arbitrary shape is thus reduced, within the thin-layer regime, to two ingredients: an effective gauge potential and a geometric potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从协变克莱因-戈登方程开始，为限制在电磁场中旋转弯曲流形内的带电粒子开发了一个规范一致的框架。非相对论性约简将旋转效应转化为有效规范势，同时保留 U(1) 对称性，因此旋转和外部场输入相同，几何形状分别作为 da Costa 势输入。维度缩减的障碍是规范几何纠缠：二维 (2D) 表面上的横向磁场和一维 (1D) 曲线上的结构扭转将切向动力学与横向自由度耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从协变克莱因-戈登方程开始，为限制在电磁场中旋转弯曲流形内的带电粒子开发了一个规范一致的框架。非相对论性约简将旋转效应转化为有效规范势，同时保留 U(1) 对称性，因此旋转和外部场输入相同，几何形状分别作为 da Costa 势输入。维度缩减的障碍是规范几何纠缠：二维 (2D) 表面上的横向磁场和一维 (1D) 曲线上的结构扭转将切向动力学与横向自由度耦合。我们通过三种机制消除这种纠缠——广义横向庞加莱规范、旋转最小化主教框架和横向基态宇称，最后一个机制消除了单个反演对称阱的残余一阶磁耦合。在环面上，轴向场产生可调谐符号的联合萨格纳克-阿哈罗诺夫-博姆残差，而不破坏极向-方位角可分离性，而面内场仅通过结构的面外范围耦合：它打破了那里的轴对称性，但留下不影响一阶的平面曲线。相同的环面显示了调整曲率引起的局域化的轴向场，并且波纹量子环将周期性几何和通量调制转换为人造超晶格，其面内场免疫性来自平面性和宇称性，而不是来自场的小度。因此，在薄层范围内，任意形状的表面和曲线上的非惯性量子动力学被简化为两个成分：有效规范势和几何势。

articles.title: SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN: A Double-Group SU(2) Hyper-/Meta-Graph Neural Network for Cooperative Spin-Crossover Potential Energy Surfaces
articles.title_zh: SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN：用于协作自旋交叉势能面的双群 SU(2) 超/元图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34547v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning potential energy surfaces for magnetic materials requires resolving coupled local spin manifolds and geometric frustration. We introduce SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN, a geometry-only architecture combining a pretrained O(3)-equivariant backbone with SU(2) spinor Hamiltonians and cooperative hyper-/meta-graph interactions. Analytic thermal spinor density matrices provide non-polynomial two- and three-body structural invariants, while frustrated-triangle hyperedges and a multi-shell sideway gate couple geometric representations to local spin manifolds. A variationally consistent, doubly-centered zero-gauge free-energy functional couples multiplet occupations and signed spin orientations, yielding conservative autograd forces without spin inputs at inference. On a first-principles Co-Cr-Ni benchmark comprising 346 training and 59 held-out validation supercells across crystalline, amorphous, glassy, and liquid regimes, compact models with 56k-77k parameters outperform a 207k-parameter spin-conditioned magnetic MACE baseline. Energy MAE decreases by 37-44%, reaching 3.82 versus 6.83 meV/atom, and force MAE decreases by 10.8-14.2 meV/Angstrom, reaching 165.8-169.2 versus 180.0 meV/Angstrom. The models preserve Kramers degeneracy to within 6×10⁻¹⁵ eV, predict equilibrium local magnetic moments from geometry alone with an absolute-moment MAE of 0.181,μ_B, and support stable molecular dynamics up to 2,200 K. This framework integrates local spinor symmetry and cooperative magnetic interactions into geometry-only interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 学习磁性材料的势能表面需要解决耦合的局部自旋流形和几何挫折。我们引入了 SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN，这是一种纯几何架构，将预训练的 O(3) 等变主干与 SU(2) 自旋哈密顿量和协作超/元图交互相结合。解析热旋量密度矩阵提供非多项式二体和三体结构不变量，而受抑三角形超边和多壳侧向门将几何表示耦合到局部自旋流形。变分一致的双中心零规范自由能函数耦合了多重占据和有符号自旋方向，在推理时无需自旋输入即可产生保守的自动梯度力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 学习磁性材料的势能表面需要解决耦合的局部自旋流形和几何挫折。我们引入了 SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN，这是一种纯几何架构，将预训练的 O(3) 等变主干与 SU(2) 自旋哈密顿量和协作超/元图交互相结合。解析热旋量密度矩阵提供非多项式二体和三体结构不变量，而受抑三角形超边和多壳侧向门将几何表示耦合到局部自旋流形。变分一致的双中心零规范自由能函数耦合了多重占据和有符号自旋方向，在推理时无需自旋输入即可产生保守的自动梯度力。在由 346 个训练和 59 个跨越晶体、非晶态、玻璃态和液体状态的验证超级单元组成的第一原理 Co-Cr-Ni 基准上，具有 56k-77k 参数的紧凑模型优于 207k 参数自旋条件磁性 MACE 基线。能量 MAE 下降 37-44%，达到 3.82 meV/atom，而力 MAE 下降 10.8-14.2 meV/Angstrom，达到 165.8-169.2 vs 180.0 meV/Angstrom。该模型将 Kramers 简并性保持在 6×10⁻15 eV 以内，仅从几何结构预测平衡局部磁矩，绝对矩 MAE 为 0.181,μ_B，并支持高达 2,200 K 的稳定分子动力学。该框架将局部旋量对称性和协作磁相互作用集成到仅几何结构的原子间势中。

articles.title: Slow mixing of Gibbs sampling for the quantum Curie-Weiss model
articles.title_zh: 量子居里-魏斯模型的吉布斯采样的缓慢混合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34682v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hamiltonian evolution can spread local operators across a dense quantum magnet. We show that this global support does not remove the bottleneck to thermalization in the quantum Curie-Weiss model: at fixed low temperature and weak transverse field, the Chen-Kastoryano-Gilyen Gibbs sampler [arXiv: 2311.09207] has an exponentially large mixing-time lower bound. A dynamical quantum bottleneck theory that generalizes the classical notion of conductance has been proposed alongside existing frameworks that rely on spatial locality. We also give a complementary interpretation of slow mixing using an effective Fokker-Planck equation.
articles.abstract_zh: 哈密顿演化可以将局部算子分布在密集的量子磁体上。我们表明，这种全局支持并没有消除量子 Curie-Weiss 模型中热化的瓶颈：在固定低温和弱横向场下，Chen-Kastoryano-Gilyen Gibbs 采样器 [arXiv: 2311.09207] 具有指数级大的混合时间下界。与依赖空间局部性的现有框架一起，提出了概括经典电导概念的动态量子瓶颈理论。我们还使用有效的福克-普朗克方程对缓慢混合给出了补充解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 哈密顿演化可以将局部算子分布在密集的量子磁体上。我们表明，这种全局支持并没有消除量子 Curie-Weiss 模型中热化的瓶颈：在固定低温和弱横向场下，Chen-Kastoryano-Gilyen Gibbs 采样器 [arXiv: 2311.09207] 具有指数级大的混合时间下界。与依赖空间局部性的现有框架一起，提出了概括经典电导概念的动态量子瓶颈理论。我们还使用有效的福克-普朗克方程对缓慢混合给出了补充解释。

articles.title: Discotic columnar phase in a three-dimensional monomer-tetramer model of Heilmann and Lieb with side-to-side attraction
articles.title_zh: 具有侧向吸引力的 Heilmann 和 Lieb 三维单体四聚体模型中的盘状柱状相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34796v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study Model III of Heilmann--Lieb (1979), a lattice model for liquid crystals consisting of tetramers (plaquettes) on the cubic lattice at chemical potential μ, interacting via a hard-core repulsion and a lateral attraction of strength a>0 between coplanar, aligned tetramers. The model was conjectured to exhibit liquid-crystalline order at low temperature provided that μ+2a>0. We establish discotic columnar order throughout this regime, fully resolving the conjecture. Specifically, we prove the existence of exactly twelve extremal and periodic Gibbs measures, each breaking rotational symmetry, with one of three tetramer orientations dominant, and translational symmetry in exactly two directions, with one of four tetramer parities dominant within that orientation. Thus, the tetramers form one-dimensional columns arranged on a square lattice. This arrangement is not a priori evident from the zero-temperature picture, where energy only enforces a layered structure: each layer is fully packed and crystalline, but different layers are free to shift independently within their planes. The main novelty here lies in showing how thermal fluctuations lift this degeneracy in favor of the twelve ground states in which all tetramers share a common parity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Heilmann--Lieb (1979) 的模型 III，这是一种液晶晶格模型，由化学势为 μ 的立方晶格上的四聚体（板）组成，通过共面、对齐的四聚体之间的硬核排斥和强度 a>0 的横向吸引力相互作用。据推测，只要 μ+2a>0，该模型就会在低温下表现出液晶有序。我们在整个政权中建立了盘状柱状秩序，完全解决了这个猜想。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 Heilmann--Lieb (1979) 的模型 III，这是一种液晶晶格模型，由化学势为 μ 的立方晶格上的四聚体（板）组成，通过共面、对齐的四聚体之间的硬核排斥和强度 a>0 的横向吸引力相互作用。据推测，只要 μ+2a>0，该模型就会在低温下表现出液晶有序。我们在整个政权中建立了盘状柱状秩序，完全解决了这个猜想。具体来说，我们证明了恰好十二个极值和周期性吉布斯测度的存在，每个吉布斯测度都打破旋转对称性，三个四聚体方向之一占主导地位，并且在两个方向上具有平移对称性，四个四聚体宇称之一在该方向内占主导地位。因此，四聚体形成排列在方形晶格上的一维柱。这种排列在零温度图像中并不是先验明显的，在零温度图像中，能量仅强制形成层状结构：每一层都完全堆积且结晶，但不同的层可以在其平面内独立地自由移动。这里的主要新颖之处在于展示热波动如何提升这种简并性以有利于所有四聚体共享共同宇称的十二个基态。

articles.title: Tomographic Electron Flow in Confined Geometries: Beyond the Dual-Relaxation-Time Approximation
articles.title_zh: 受限几何结构中的层析电子流：超越双弛豫时间近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.14461v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrodynamiclike electron flows are typically modeled using the Stokes-Ohm equation or a kinetic description that is based on a dual-relaxation-time approximation. Such models assume a short intrinsic mean free path ellₑ due to momentum-conserving electronic scattering and a large extrinsic mean free path ell_MR due to momentum-relaxing impurity scattering. This assumption, however, is overly simplistic and falls short at low temperatures, where it is known from exact diagonalization studies of the electronic collision integrals that another large electronic mean free path ellₒ emerges that describes long-lived odd electron modes---this is sometimes known as the tomographic effect. Here, using a matched asymptotic expansion of the underlying Fermi-liquid kinetic equation with multiple electron relaxation times, we derive a transport theory for tomographic flows in arbitrary smooth boundary geometries. Our key results are a set of governing equations for the electron density and electron current, their slip boundary conditions (which are applied at diffuse boundaries), and boundary layer corrections near diffuse edges. We find that the tomographic effect strongly modifies previous hydrodynamic theories for electron flows: In particular, (i) a local equilibrium is established in the bulk, where the flow is governed by Stokes-Ohm-like equations with significant finite-wavelength corrections, (ii) the velocity slip condition at the boundary is strongly modified and not accounted for by the widely used hydrodynamic slip-length condition, (iii) a large kinetic boundary layer of width simsqrtellₑ ellₒ arises near diffuse boundaries, which is much larger than in conventional near-hydrodynamic theories, and (iv) all these effects are strongly suppressed by an external magnetic field. We illustrate our findings for electron flow in a channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 类流体动力学电子流通常使用 Stokes-Ohm 方程或基于双弛豫时间近似的动力学描述进行建模。这些模型假设由于动量守恒电子散射而导致较短的内在平均自由程 ellₑ 和由于动量弛豫杂质散射而导致的较大外在平均自由程 ell_MR。然而，这种假设过于简单化，并且在低温下是不够的，从电子碰撞积分的精确对角化研究中得知，出现了另一个大的电子平均自由程 ellₒ，它描述了长寿命的奇电子模式——这有时被称为断层扫描效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 类流体动力学电子流通常使用 Stokes-Ohm 方程或基于双弛豫时间近似的动力学描述进行建模。这些模型假设由于动量守恒电子散射而导致较短的内在平均自由程 ellₑ 和由于动量弛豫杂质散射而导致的较大外在平均自由程 ell_MR。然而，这种假设过于简单化，并且在低温下是不够的，从电子碰撞积分的精确对角化研究中得知，出现了另一个大的电子平均自由程 ellₒ，它描述了长寿命的奇电子模式——这有时被称为断层扫描效应。在这里，使用具有多个电子弛豫时间的基础费米液体动力学方程的匹配渐近展开，我们推导了任意光滑边界几何形状的层析流的输运理论。我们的主要结果是一组电子密度和电子电流的控制方程、它们的滑移边界条件（应用于扩散边界）以及扩散边缘附近的边界层校正。我们发现层析成像效应强烈修改了以前的电子流流体动力学理论：特别是，（i）在整体中建立了局部平衡，其中流动由带有显着有限波长校正的斯托克斯-欧姆方程控制，（ii）边界处的速度滑移条件被强烈修改，并且没有被广泛使用的流体动力学滑移长度条件所解释，（iii）宽度为 simsqrtellₑ ellₒ 的大动力学边界层在扩散附近出现边界，比传统的近流体动力学理论大得多，并且（iv）所有这些效应都受到外部磁场的强烈抑制。我们展示了我们对通道中电子流动的发现。

articles.title: Multiscale Numerical Modelling of Ultrafast Laser-Matter Interactions: Maxwell Two Temperature Model Molecular Dynamics (M-TTM-MD)
articles.title_zh: 超快激光与物质相互作用的多尺度数值模拟：麦克斯韦二温模型分子动力学 (M-TTM-MD)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.20763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive numerical framework that couples numerical solutions of Maxwell's equations using the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) approach, Molecular Dynamics (MD), and the Two-Temperature Model (TTM) to describe ultrafast laser-matter interactions in metallic systems at the atomic scale. The proposed Maxwell-Two-Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics (M-TTM-MD) bridges the gap between electromagnetic field propagation, electron-phonon energy exchange, and atomic motion, allowing for a self-consistent treatment of energy absorption, transport, and structural response within a unified simulation environment. The calculated electromagnetic fields incorporate dispersive dielectric properties derived using the Auxiliary Differential Equation (ADE) technique, while the electronic and lattice subsystems are dynamically coupled through spatially and temporally resolved energy exchange terms. The changes in the material topography are then reflected in the updated grid for the FDTD scheme. The developed M-TTM-MD model provides a self-consistent numerical framework that offers insights into laser-induced phenomena in metals, including energy transport and surface dynamics under extreme nonequilibrium conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全面的数值框架，该框架使用时域有限差分（FDTD）方法、分子动力学（MD）和双温度模型（TTM）耦合麦克斯韦方程组的数值解，以描述原子尺度金属系统中的超快激光-物质相互作用。提出的麦克斯韦双温度模型分子动力学（M-TTM-MD）弥合了电磁场传播、电子声子能量交换和原子运动之间的差距，允许在统一的模拟环境中对能量吸收、传输和结构响应进行自洽处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全面的数值框架，该框架使用时域有限差分（FDTD）方法、分子动力学（MD）和双温度模型（TTM）耦合麦克斯韦方程组的数值解，以描述原子尺度金属系统中的超快激光-物质相互作用。提出的麦克斯韦双温度模型分子动力学（M-TTM-MD）弥合了电磁场传播、电子声子能量交换和原子运动之间的差距，允许在统一的模拟环境中对能量吸收、传输和结构响应进行自洽处理。计算的电磁场包含使用辅助微分方程 (ADE) 技术导出的色散介电特性，而电子和晶格子系统通过空间和时间解析的能量交换项动态耦合。然后，材料形貌的变化会反映在 FDTD 方案的更新网格中。开发的 M-TTM-MD 模型提供了一个自洽的数值框架，可以深入了解金属中的激光诱导现象，包括极端非平衡条件下的能量传输和表面动力学。

articles.title: A van der Waals photon-ratchet for enhancing spin defect emission and quantum sensing
articles.title_zh: 用于增强自旋缺陷发射和量子传感的范德华光子棘轮
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02256v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin defects in two-dimensional materials are promising platforms for quantum information technologies and nanoscale sensing. The negatively charged boron vacancy (VB-) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is particularly attractive due to its sensitivity to temperature, magnetic fields, and pressure, but its application is limited by intrinsically weak photoluminescence (PL). Here we demonstrate a van der Waals heterostructure that enhances the PL intensity of VB- by up to 45x at 4 Kelvin while preserving compatibility with ultrathin optoelectronic platforms. A type-I band alignment at the PbI2-hBN interface facilitates efficient interlayer coupling to the defect, and strong spectral overlap supports fluorescence resonance energy transfer. Ab initio calculations indicate that this coupling enables a photon-ratcheting mechanism, in which optical absorption in PbI2 generates a nonlinear polarization that drives VB- excitation. This process is consistent with interlayer energy transfer while maintaining minimal electronic and spin hybridization and preserving optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) contrast. The heterostructure further exhibits improved sensitivity to external magnetic fields. These results establish a route for the enhancement of defect emission via interlayer optical coupling and introduce a general materials strategy for amplifying weak quantum defect signals in nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子信息技术和纳米级传感的有前途的平台。六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB-）由于其对温度、磁场和压力的敏感性而特别有吸引力，但其应用受到本质上较弱的光致发光（PL）的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种范德华异质结构，可将 VB- 的 PL 强度在 4 开尔文下增强高达 45 倍，同时保持与超薄光电平台的兼容性。 PbI2-hBN 界面处的 I 型能带排列有利于与缺陷的有效层间耦合，并且强光谱重叠支持荧光共振能量转移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子信息技术和纳米级传感的有前途的平台。六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB-）由于其对温度、磁场和压力的敏感性而特别有吸引力，但其应用受到本质上较弱的光致发光（PL）的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种范德华异质结构，可将 VB- 的 PL 强度在 4 开尔文下增强高达 45 倍，同时保持与超薄光电平台的兼容性。 PbI2-hBN 界面处的 I 型能带排列有利于与缺陷的有效层间耦合，并且强光谱重叠支持荧光共振能量转移。从头计算表明，这种耦合实现了光子棘轮机制，其中 PbI2 中的光学吸收产生驱动 VB 激发的非线性偏振。该过程与层间能量转移一致，同时保持最小的电子和自旋杂交并保持光学检测的磁共振（ODMR）对比度。该异质结构进一步表现出对外部磁场的改进的敏感性。这些结果建立了一条通过层间光耦合增强缺陷发射的途径，并引入了放大纳米材料中弱量子缺陷信号的通用材料策略。

articles.title: Coulomb Interaction and Density-Independent Exciton-Scattering Processes in Atomically Thin Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 原子薄半导体中的库仑相互作用和密度无关的激子散射过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13763v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum-kinetic approaches to the dynamics of Coulomb-bound many-body correlations such as excitons, trions, biexcitons or higher-order correlations, a detailed knowledge of the many-body Coulomb Hamiltonian serving as a starting point is important. In this manuscript, the second-quantized description of the Coulomb interaction between Bloch electrons in a Heisenberg-equation-of-motion approach in atomically thin semiconductors is derived and reviewed. Emphasis is put on a discussion of Umklapp processes and the dielectric screening including all local-field effects. A link between ab initio methods of screening and few-band models in effective-mass approximations for the quantum kinetics is established and important Coulomb scattering processes contributing to the exciton energy landscape and density-independent exciton scattering are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 在库仑束缚多体关联（例如激子、三重子、双激子或高阶关联）的动力学的量子动力学方法中，以多体库仑哈密顿量的详细知识作为起点非常重要。在这份手稿中，导出并回顾了原子薄半导体中海森堡运动方程方法中布洛赫电子之间库仑相互作用的第二量子化描述。重点讨论了 Umklapp 工艺和介电屏蔽，包括所有局部场效应。建立了从头算筛选方法和量子动力学有效质量近似中的少能带模型之间的联系，并讨论了对激子能量景观和密度无关的激子散射有贡献的重要库仑散射过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在库仑束缚多体关联（例如激子、三重子、双激子或高阶关联）的动力学的量子动力学方法中，以多体库仑哈密顿量的详细知识作为起点非常重要。在这份手稿中，导出并回顾了原子薄半导体中海森堡运动方程方法中布洛赫电子之间库仑相互作用的第二量子化描述。重点讨论了 Umklapp 工艺和介电屏蔽，包括所有局部场效应。建立了从头算筛选方法和量子动力学有效质量近似中的少能带模型之间的联系，并讨论了对激子能量景观和密度无关的激子散射有贡献的重要库仑散射过程。

articles.title: Breaking of clustering and macroscopic coherence under the lens of asymmetry measures
articles.title_zh: 不对称测量视角下聚类和宏观一致性的打破
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15969v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In one-dimensional systems, spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) states are fragile by nature, as the injection of a non-zero energy density above the ground state is expected to restore the symmetry. This instability implies that local perturbations can lead to macroscopic correlation profiles, a breaking of clustering properties and even macroscopic quantum superpositions. In this work, we investigate the effect of interaction on this phenomenology by considering an interacting model with conserved domain wall number, that possesses a ferromagnetic ground state breaking the Z2 symmetry of the Hamiltonian. We first show that a local quench in this system amplifies quantum interferences, producing a macroscopic magnetisation profile that directly reflects the scattering phase of the model. Then, we use two asymmetry measures, namely the Entanglement Asymmetry (EA) and Quantum Fisher Information (QFI), to characterise the quantum coherence associated with the fluctuations of the magnetisation. By focusing on subsystems comparable in size to the light-cone of the perturbation, we confirm the emergence of macroscopic quantum coherence throughout the whole perturbed region. Finally, we discuss the link between EA and QFI and show that the variance/EA inequality for pure state can be generalised to a QFI/EA inequality for mixed states.
articles.abstract_zh: 在一维系统中，自发对称破缺（SSB）态本质上是脆弱的，因为在基态之上注入非零能量密度有望恢复对称性。这种不稳定性意味着局部扰动可能导致宏观相关分布、聚类特性的破坏甚至宏观量子叠加。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑具有保守畴壁数的相互作用模型来研究相互作用对这种现象的影响，该模型具有打破哈密顿量的 Z2 对称性的铁磁基态。我们首先表明，该系统中的局部淬灭会放大量子干涉，产生直接反映模型散射相位的宏观磁化强度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在一维系统中，自发对称破缺（SSB）态本质上是脆弱的，因为在基态之上注入非零能量密度有望恢复对称性。这种不稳定性意味着局部扰动可能导致宏观相关分布、聚类特性的破坏甚至宏观量子叠加。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑具有保守畴壁数的相互作用模型来研究相互作用对这种现象的影响，该模型具有打破哈密顿量的 Z2 对称性的铁磁基态。我们首先表明，该系统中的局部淬灭会放大量子干涉，产生直接反映模型散射相位的宏观磁化强度分布。然后，我们使用两种不对称性度量，即纠缠不对称性（EA）和量子费希尔信息（QFI）来表征与磁化强度波动相关的量子相干性。通过关注与扰动光锥大小相当的子系统，我们确认了整个扰动区域中宏观量子相干性的出现。最后，我们讨论 EA 和 QFI 之间的联系，并表明纯状态的方差/EA 不等式可以推广到混合状态的 QFI/EA 不等式。

articles.title: Rotational Phonons Activated by Magnetism as a Key Ingredient of Cuprate Physics
articles.title_zh: 磁性激活的旋转声子是铜酸盐物理的关键成分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21438v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Circularly polarized lattice vibrations carry angular momentum and can link lattice dynamics to collective responses in strongly correlated materials, particularly cuprate superconductors. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals ubiquitous quasiparticle "kinks" near ~70 and ~40 meV in cuprates, often accompanied by peak-dip-hump (PDH) features, indicating strong coupling between electrons and low-energy bosonic excitations. However, the relevant phonon modes and the role of circularly polarized vibrations in these spectral anomalies remain largely elusive. Here, we investigate electron-phonon coupling (EPC) in hole-doped infinite-layer CaCuO2 at four selective hole dopings (12.5%-56.25%) using the Strongly Constrained and Appropriately Normed (SCAN) density functional with explicit magnetic interactions. At 25% doping, the magnetic phase exhibits substantially stronger EPC (lambda ~ 0.5), five times that of the nonmagnetic phase, producing kinks and PDH features over 40-80 meV, with self-energy magnitudes comparable to experiment. Oxygen rotational phonons dominate the coupling over 50-65 meV, while breathing modes play a lesser role; the rotational modes emerge exclusively in the magnetic phase. At 37.5% doping, lambda increases to ~1.6 due to strong coupling of low-frequency phonons near the Fermi-surface nesting wave vector, whereas at 56.25%, where Cu magnetic moments vanish, lambda decreases to ~0.4. The rotational modes carry staggered angular momentum that cancels in the unperturbed lattice; a time-reversal-breaking gyrotropic coupling on Cu sites lifts this cancellation, yielding a finite phonon thermal Hall conductivity. Our findings establish magnetism-enhanced EPC as an important ingredient of cuprate physics and identify rotational oxygen phonons as relevant to spectral anomalies, superconductivity, and the pseudogap thermal Hall effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 圆偏振晶格振动携带角动量，可以将晶格动力学与强相关材料（特别是铜酸盐超导体）中的集体响应联系起来。角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 揭示了铜氧化物中 ~70 和 ~40 meV 附近普遍存在的准粒子“扭结”，通常伴随着峰-谷-驼峰 (PDH) 特征，表明电子和低能玻色子激发之间存在强耦合。然而，相关的声子模式和圆偏振振动在这些光谱异常中的作用仍然很大程度上难以捉摸。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 圆偏振晶格振动携带角动量，可以将晶格动力学与强相关材料（特别是铜酸盐超导体）中的集体响应联系起来。角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 揭示了铜氧化物中 ~70 和 ~40 meV 附近普遍存在的准粒子“扭结”，通常伴随着峰-谷-驼峰 (PDH) 特征，表明电子和低能玻色子激发之间存在强耦合。然而，相关的声子模式和圆偏振振动在这些光谱异常中的作用仍然很大程度上难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用具有显式磁相互作用的强约束和适当规范 (SCAN) 密度泛函，研究了四种选择性空穴掺杂 (12.5%-56.25%) 的空穴掺杂无限层 CaCuO2 中的电子声子耦合 (EPC)。掺杂量为 25% 时，磁性相表现出更强的 EPC (lambda ~ 0.5)，是非磁性相的五倍，产生超过 40-80 meV 的扭结和 PDH 特征，自能大小与实验相当。氧旋转声子在 50-65 meV 的耦合中占主导地位，而呼吸模式的作用较小；旋转模式仅出现在磁相中。掺杂浓度为 37.5% 时，由于费米表面嵌套波矢量附近低频声子的强耦合，λ 增加至约 1.6，而掺杂浓度为 56.25% 时，铜磁矩消失，λ 减小至约 0.4。旋转模式携带交错的角动量，在未受扰动的晶格中抵消；铜位点上打破时间反转的陀螺耦合提升了这种抵消，产生有限的声子热霍尔电导率。我们的研究结果确立了磁增强 EPC 作为铜酸盐物理学的重要组成部分，并确定了与光谱异常、超导性和赝能隙热霍尔效应相关的旋转氧声子。

articles.title: Stability and superstructural ordering of alkali-triel-pnictide clathrates A₈T₂₇Pn₁₉
articles.title_zh: 碱金属-三烯-磷元素笼形物A₈T2₇Pn₁₉的稳定性和超结构有序性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05264v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Clathrates are a class of inclusion compounds that offer various useful and surprising phenomena, including superconductivity, thermoelectricity, and the potential for high-density ion storage. Stability conditions within the Alkali-Triel-Pnictide A₈T₂₇Pn₁₉ family of unconventional clathrates are investigated with high-throughput density functional theory calculations, establishing trends in formation energy, structural and electronic properties, and identifying several new potential candidates. Electronic structure calculations and first-principles molecular dynamics simulations show that all alkali guests are fully ionized in the framework, and that the stability of electron-exact clathrates correlates with the ionization potential of the guest atoms, while their rattling behavior is governed primarily by the size of the guest ions relative to the cages. Targeted reactive synthesis from elemental precursors is attempted, resulting in four previously unreported ternary phases, two of which are structurally characterized. However, the predicted clathrate phases are not obtained. Further analysis reveals that the stability of ATPn clathrate compounds containing heavy elements, such as bismuth, depends strongly on relativistic spin-orbit coupling, which is often neglected in high-throughput studies that compute formation energies. Finally, chemically induced superstructural ordering is described in relation to Wyckoff sites in the prototypical type-I clathrate unit cell.
articles.abstract_zh: 包合物是一类包合物，可提供各种有用且令人惊讶的现象，包括超导性、热电性和高密度离子存储的潜力。通过高通量密度泛函理论计算研究了非常规包合物 A₈T2₇Pn₁9 家族内的稳定性条件，确定了形成能、结构和电子特性的趋势，并确定了几种新的潜在候选物。电子结构计算和第一原理分子动力学模拟表明，所有碱金属客体在框架中都完全电离，并且电子精确包合物的稳定性与客体原子的电离势相关，而它们的振动行为主要由客体离子相对于笼的尺寸决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 包合物是一类包合物，可提供各种有用且令人惊讶的现象，包括超导性、热电性和高密度离子存储的潜力。通过高通量密度泛函理论计算研究了非常规包合物 A₈T2₇Pn₁9 家族内的稳定性条件，确定了形成能、结构和电子特性的趋势，并确定了几种新的潜在候选物。电子结构计算和第一原理分子动力学模拟表明，所有碱金属客体在框架中都完全电离，并且电子精确包合物的稳定性与客体原子的电离势相关，而它们的振动行为主要由客体离子相对于笼的尺寸决定。尝试从元素前体进行定向反应合成，产生了四个先前未报道的三元相，其中两个进行了结构表征。然而，没有获得预测的包合物相。进一步的分析表明，含有重元素（例如铋）的 ATPn 笼形化合物的稳定性很大程度上取决于相对论性自旋轨道耦合，而这一点在计算形成能的高通量研究中经常被忽视。最后，描述了与典型 I 型笼形晶胞中威科夫位点相关的化学诱导的超结构排序。

articles.title: Exascale Multi-Task Graph Foundation Models for Imbalanced, Multi-Fidelity Atomistic Data
articles.title_zh: 用于不平衡、多保真度原子数据的百亿亿级多任务图基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15380v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exascale workflow for atomistic graph foundation models using HydraGNN. Multi-task learning enables joint training across 16 heterogeneous first-principles datasets representing over 467 million unique structures (over 544 million cumulative branch records) and covering 85+ elements. A shared graph neural network backbone with dataset-specific prediction heads accommodates the strongly imbalanced, multi-source, multi-fidelity corpus, supported by scalable ADIOS2/DDStore data management. Composition-conditioned weighting combines source-specific predictions into a single deployable model. Six large-scale hyperparameter optimization campaigns, followed by resource-aware continual training on 2,048 Frontier nodes, identify PaiNN as the lead architecture under a fixed computational budget. We evaluate scalability across Frontier, Aurora, and Perlmutter and characterize transfer across twelve down-stream tasks, including comparisons with pretrained UMA and MACE models under different adaptation strategies. These results reveal task-dependent transfer benefits and highlight the importance of matching adaptation strategies to downstream applications. Finally, we assess inference optimizations and BF16/FP32/FP64 precision tradeoffs, achieving the screening of 1.1 billion atomistic structures in approximately 50 seconds on Frontier. Together, these results establish a scalable framework for multi-source atomistic foundation model training, evaluation, and high-throughput deployment, thereby allowing for a fast and reliable exploration of vast chemical design spaces that are otherwise inaccessible to first-principles methods
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了使用 HydraGNN 的原子图基础模型的百亿亿次工作流程。多任务学习支持跨 16 个异构第一原理数据集进行联合训练，这些数据集代表超过 4.67 亿个独特结构（超过 5.44 亿条累积分支记录）并涵盖超过 85 个元素。具有特定于数据集的预测头的共享图神经网络主干可容纳强不平衡、多源、多保真度语料库，并由可扩展的 ADIOS2/DDStore 数据管理支持。组合条件加权将特定于源的预测合并到单个可部署模型中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了使用 HydraGNN 的原子图基础模型的百亿亿次工作流程。多任务学习支持跨 16 个异构第一原理数据集进行联合训练，这些数据集代表超过 4.67 亿个独特结构（超过 5.44 亿条累积分支记录）并涵盖超过 85 个元素。具有特定于数据集的预测头的共享图神经网络主干可容纳强不平衡、多源、多保真度语料库，并由可扩展的 ADIOS2/DDStore 数据管理支持。组合条件加权将特定于源的预测合并到单个可部署模型中。六次大规模超参数优化活动，以及对 2,048 个 Frontier 节点进行资源感知持续训练，将 PaiNN 确定为固定计算预算下的领先架构。我们评估了 Frontier、Aurora 和 Perlmutter 的可扩展性，并描述了 12 个下游任务的传输特性，包括与不同适应策略下预训练的 UMA 和 MACE 模型进行比较。这些结果揭示了任务相关的转移效益，并强调了将适应策略与下游应用相匹配的重要性。最后，我们评估了推理优化和 BF16/FP32/FP64 精度权衡，在 Frontier 上实现了约 50 秒内筛选 11 亿个原子结构。这些结果共同为多源原子基础模型训练、评估和高通量部署建立了一个可扩展的框架，从而可以快速可靠地探索第一原理方法无法访问的广阔化学设计空间

articles.title: Anisotropic Crystallization Kinetics and Interfacial Dynamics of Phase-Change Material Sb₂S₃
articles.title_zh: 相变材料Sb2S₃的各向异性结晶动力学和界面动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20785v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antimony sulfide (Sb₂S₃), an Earth-abundant and sustainable chalcogenide, has emerged as a promising phase change material (PCM) due to its ultra-low optical losses, broadband transparency, and reversible phase-change capacity. In this work, we developed a machine learning force field based on the moment tensor potential approach, allowing us to understand the atomistic origin of the structural evolution and crystallization kinetics in Sb₂S₃ for the first time, by enabling large-scale molecular dynamics simulations (up to 7680 atoms for 40 ns). Sb₂S₃ has anisotropic growth rates with the (100) facet (Pnma space group) exhibiting the fastest growth due to the strong Sb-S covalent bonding along its quasi-1D ribbon-like structure of its crystalline phase. The maximum growth rate was observed at 875 K, with an optimal undercooling degree of ~100 K, significantly lower than other PCMs like Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ (GST) and GeTe. The activation energy for crystal growth was calculated be around 0.56 eV. Interfacial atomic dynamics revealed an Arrhenius-to-non-Arrhenius transition at ~800 K, with the (100) facet showing the highest diffusion activation energy of 1.56 eV. Unlike the GST and GeTe, the lower activation energy for crystal growth in Sb₂S₃ indicates that its heterogeneous crystallization is interface-controlled rather than diffusion-limited, with atomic attachment at the solid-liquid interface being energetically favoured over long-range atomic transport. Bonding and ring statistics analyses confirmed that directional covalent bonding plays a fundamental role in guiding structural ordering during crystal growth. These findings provide key insights into the structural, thermodynamic, and kinetic properties of Sb₂S₃, paving the way for optimizing its functionality including switching speed, reliability, and energy efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 硫化锑 (Sb2S₃) 是一种地球上储量丰富且可持续的硫族化物，由于其超低光学损耗、宽带透明度和可逆相变能力，已成为一种有前途的相变材料 (PCM)。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于矩张量势方法的机器学习力场，通过大规模分子动力学模拟（40 ns 最多 7680 个原子），使我们首次了解 Sb2S₃ 结构演化和结晶动力学的原子起源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硫化锑 (Sb2S₃) 是一种地球上储量丰富且可持续的硫族化物，由于其超低光学损耗、宽带透明度和可逆相变能力，已成为一种有前途的相变材料 (PCM)。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于矩张量势方法的机器学习力场，通过大规模分子动力学模拟（40 ns 最多 7680 个原子），使我们首次了解 Sb2S₃ 结构演化和结晶动力学的原子起源。 Sb2S₃ 具有各向异性的生长速率，其中 (100) 面（Pnma 空间群）表现出最快的生长，这是由于沿着其晶相的准一维带状结构的强 Sb-S 共价键合。在 875 K 时观察到最大生长速率，最佳过冷度约为 100 K，显着低于其他 PCM，如 Ge2Sb2Te5 (GST) 和 GeTe。计算出晶体生长的活化能约为0.56 eV。界面原子动力学揭示了约 800 K 时的阿伦尼乌斯到非阿伦尼乌斯转变，(100) 面显示出最高的扩散激活能，为 1.56 eV。与 GST 和 GeTe 不同，Sb2S3 晶体生长的较低活化能表明其异质结晶是界面控制的而不是扩散限制的，固液界面上的原子附着比长程原子传输更受能量支持。键合和环统计分析证实，定向共价键在晶体生长过程中引导结构有序化方面发挥着重要作用。这些发现为 Sb2S₃ 的结构、热力学和动力学特性提供了重要见解，为优化其功能（包括开关速度、可靠性和能源效率）铺平了道路。

articles.title: Probing spin dynamics in MnSi under pressure by energy-integrated time-of-flight small-angle neutron scattering
articles.title_zh: 通过能量积分飞行时间小角中子散射探测压力下 MnSi 中的自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07660v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate that energy-integrated time-of-flight small-angle neutron scattering can determine the long-wavelength spin-wave stiffness of field-polarized MnSi inside a pressure cell. A forward model maps neutron energy loss and gain into the recorded time-of-flight coordinates, allowing a joint fit of radial profiles in several apparent-wavelength windows to constrain a common stiffness. Ambient-pressure powder and polycrystal measurements reproduce the established stiffness scale of MnSi. At effective pressures of 3.5 and 7.8 kbar, the fitted stiffness spans 43--61 meV mathringA² across the measured states and is comparable in magnitude to the scale inferred from the helical wave vector and applied upper critical field. The characteristic SANS ordering temperature decreases from 28.8 K at ambient pressure to 17.4 K at 7.8 kbar. The long-wavelength gradient stiffness alone therefore does not account for the pressure evolution of helimagnetic ordering. These results demonstrate a route to quantitative studies of spin-wave dynamics under pressure on time-of-flight SANS instruments without final-energy analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，能量积分飞行时间小角度中子散射可以确定压力盒内场极化 MnSi 的长波长自旋波刚度。正演模型将中子能量损失和增益映射到记录的飞行时间坐标中，允许在几个表观波长窗口中联合拟合径向轮廓以约束共同的刚度。环境压力粉末和多晶测量再现了已建立的 MnSi 刚度尺度。在 3.5 和 7.8 kbar 的有效压力下，拟合的刚度在测量状态上跨度为 43--61 meV mathringA²，并且在大小上与从螺旋波矢量和应用的上临界场推断的尺度相当。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，能量积分飞行时间小角度中子散射可以确定压力盒内场极化 MnSi 的长波长自旋波刚度。正演模型将中子能量损失和增益映射到记录的飞行时间坐标中，允许在几个表观波长窗口中联合拟合径向轮廓以约束共同的刚度。环境压力粉末和多晶测量再现了已建立的 MnSi 刚度尺度。在 3.5 和 7.8 kbar 的有效压力下，拟合的刚度在测量状态上跨度为 43--61 meV mathringA²，并且在大小上与从螺旋波矢量和应用的上临界场推断的尺度相当。特征 SANS 排序温度从环境压力下的 28.8 K 降至 7.8 kbar 下的 17.4 K。因此，长波长梯度刚度本身并不能解释螺旋磁序的压力演化。这些结果展示了在飞行时间 SANS 仪器上定量研究压力下自旋波动力学的途径，而无需最终能量分析。

articles.title: Magnetic Contributions to Phase Stability in the Co-Ni Binary: A First-Principles CALPHAD Study
articles.title_zh: 磁性对 Co-Ni 二元相稳定性的贡献：第一性原理 CALPHAD 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12388v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a simple method to employ ab-initio calculations to determine magnetic contributions to free energy of alloys. Validation on the Co-Ni binary demonstrates that this ab initio approach reproduces experimental FCC-HCP phase equilibria while providing physically transparent, structure-dependent magnetic parameters suitable for multicomponent extrapolation. Our results demonstrate that physically grounded magnetic parametrization, derived directly from electronic structure calculations, enables predictive phase diagram modeling for magnetic alloy systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种简单的方法，采用从头计算来确定磁性对合金自由能的贡献。对 Co-Ni 二元的验证表明，这种从头开始的方法重现了实验性 FCC-HCP 相平衡，同时提供了适合多组分外推的物理透明、结构相关的磁参数。我们的结果表明，直接从电子结构计算得出的物理接地磁参数化可以实现磁性合金系统的预测相图建模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种简单的方法，采用从头计算来确定磁性对合金自由能的贡献。对 Co-Ni 二元的验证表明，这种从头开始的方法重现了实验性 FCC-HCP 相平衡，同时提供了适合多组分外推的物理透明、结构相关的磁参数。我们的结果表明，直接从电子结构计算得出的物理接地磁参数化可以实现磁性合金系统的预测相图建模。

articles.title: Computational Study of Water Adsorption and Dissociative Mechanisms Impacting g-C3N4's Optical and Electronic Properties
articles.title_zh: 影响 g-C3N4 光学和电子性能的水吸附和解离机制的计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26667v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the quest for sustainable energy solutions, water splitting emerges as a crucial process for generating clean hydrogen a versatile and renewable fuel essential for energy storage, emissions reduction, and achieving sustainability goals. This study employs a comprehensive computational approach, utilizing atomistic simulations to systematically investigate the effects of water absorption on the electronic and optical properties of g-C3N4 nanosheets. Our methodology integrates ab initio computations grounded in density functional theory (DFT), which allows for a detailed characterization of the nanosheet and serves as a benchmark for self-consistent charge density functional tight binding (SCC-DFTB) simulations. This approach provides valuable insights into the behavior of the nanosheet under the influence of absorbed OH and H2O molecules by considering calculated parameters for photocatalytic efficiency. Additionally, we extend our investigation to classical molecular dynamics simulations within the ReaxFF framework, modeling the emission of multiple H2O molecules and assessing the subsequent rate of H2 evolution. A key finding of our study reveals that the dissociation of H2O into HO and O molecules significantly enhances both the optical absorbance and conductance of the nanosheet compared to its pristine state. These results underscore the potential of g-C3N4 nanosheets as effective materials for water splitting applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在寻求可持续能源解决方案的过程中，水分解成为产生清洁氢气的关键过程，而清洁氢气是能源存储、减少排放和实现可持续发展目标所必需的多功能可再生燃料。本研究采用综合计算方法，利用原子模拟系统地研究吸水率对 g-C3N4 纳米片电子和光学性质的影响。我们的方法集成了基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头计算，它允许对纳米片进行详细表征，并作为自洽电荷密度泛函紧密结合 (SCC-DFTB) 模拟的基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在寻求可持续能源解决方案的过程中，水分解成为产生清洁氢气的关键过程，而清洁氢气是能源存储、减少排放和实现可持续发展目标所必需的多功能可再生燃料。本研究采用综合计算方法，利用原子模拟系统地研究吸水率对 g-C3N4 纳米片电子和光学性质的影响。我们的方法集成了基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头计算，它允许对纳米片进行详细表征，并作为自洽电荷密度泛函紧密结合 (SCC-DFTB) 模拟的基准。该方法通过考虑光催化效率的计算参数，为了解纳米片在吸收的 OH 和 H2O 分子影响下的行为提供了有价值的见解。此外，我们将研究扩展到 ReaxFF 框架内的经典分子动力学模拟，对多个 H2O 分子的发射进行建模并评估随后的 H2 演化速率。我们研究的一个重要发现表明，与原始状态相比，H2O 解离为 H2O 和 O 分子显着增强了纳米片的光学吸光度和电导。这些结果强调了 g-C3N4 纳米片作为水分解应用的有效材料的潜力。

articles.title: Many-Anyon Braiding in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect with Hybrid Monte Carlo Simulation
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔效应中的多任意子编织与混合蒙特卡罗模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17424v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use the hybrid Monte Carlo method to efficiently compute the many-anyon non-Abelian braiding matrices for different Moore-Read quasiholes braiding schemes. Using both a traditional two-anyon braiding scheme and a newly proposed braiding scheme based on global rotation, we approximate the non-Abelian characteristic length of Moore-Read quasiholes around 2.8 times the magnetic length. We also apply this method to braiding schemes involving six anyons and explicitly show that the well-known ``even-odd effect'' can be flipped by tuning electrostatic potentials. This phenomenon emphasizes the importance of accounting for all anyons within a non-Abelian system, even if the braiding involves only several anyons locally.
