Our results are relevant to the experimental realization of non-Abelian physics in fractional quantum Hall and other analogous systems, including the fast-growing field of fractional quantum anomalous Hall states in moiré materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用混合蒙特卡罗方法来有效计算不同 Moore-Read 准空穴编织方案的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。使用传统的双任意子编织方案和新提出的基于全局旋转的编织方案，我们将摩尔-里德准空穴的非阿贝尔特征长度近似为磁长度的2.8倍。我们还将这种方法应用于涉及六个任意子的编织方案，并明确表明可以通过调整静电势来翻转众所周知的“偶奇效应”。这种现象强调了考虑非阿贝尔系统内所有任意子的重要性，即使编织仅涉及局部任意子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用混合蒙特卡罗方法来有效计算不同 Moore-Read 准空穴编织方案的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。使用传统的双任意子编织方案和新提出的基于全局旋转的编织方案，我们将摩尔-里德准空穴的非阿贝尔特征长度近似为磁长度的2.8倍。我们还将这种方法应用于涉及六个任意子的编织方案，并明确表明可以通过调整静电势来翻转众所周知的“偶奇效应”。这种现象强调了考虑非阿贝尔系统内所有任意子的重要性，即使编织仅涉及局部任意子。我们的结果与分数量子霍尔和其他类似系统中非阿贝尔物理的实验实现相关，包括莫尔材料中快速增长的分数量子反常霍尔态领域。

articles.title: Excited-state structure and photoluminescence of the M-center in Si
articles.title_zh: Si 中 M 中心的激发态结构和光致发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30790v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Color centers in silicon offer great possibilities for scalable quantum technologies. The M-center, proposed to originate from a carbon-hydrogen complex, offers telecommunications-band emission and a paramagnetic ground state similar to the T-center. Here, we report on photoluminescence lines in the vicinity of the M-center and investigate their properties, including their dependence on temperature, implantation fluence, implantation isotope, and annealing temperature. Three emission lines are observed that are blue-shifted by 1.1, 2.8 and 3.6 meV relative to the 761 meV zero phonon line of the M center. The 2.8 meV line exhibits negative thermal quenching with an activation energy of 1.5 meV, strengthening the assignment of the line to a second excited state of the M-center. However, the remaining blue-shifted emission lines, together with two additional red-shifted (4.7 and 6.4 meV) emission lines display normal thermal quenching, and are unaffected by an isotope shift of the implanted carbon atom (¹²C versus ¹³C implantation) and implantation fluence. Thus, they likely arise either from other defects with similar emission energies or from a perturbed configuration of the M-center.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅中的色心为可扩展的量子技术提供了巨大的可能性。 M 中心被认为源自碳氢复合物，提供与 T 中心类似的电信频段发射和顺磁基态。在这里，我们报告了 M 中心附近的光致发光线并研究了它们的特性，包括它们对温度、注入注量、注入同位素和退火温度的依赖性。观察到三个发射线相对于 M 中心的 761 meV 零声子线蓝移 1.1、2.8 和 3.6 meV。 2.8 meV 线表现出负热猝灭，活化能为 1.5 meV，加强了该线对 M 中心第二激发态的分配。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硅中的色心为可扩展的量子技术提供了巨大的可能性。 M 中心被认为源自碳氢复合物，提供与 T 中心类似的电信频段发射和顺磁基态。在这里，我们报告了 M 中心附近的光致发光线并研究了它们的特性，包括它们对温度、注入注量、注入同位素和退火温度的依赖性。观察到三个发射线相对于 M 中心的 761 meV 零声子线蓝移 1.1、2.8 和 3.6 meV。 2.8 meV 线表现出负热猝灭，活化能为 1.5 meV，加强了该线对 M 中心第二激发态的分配。然而，其余的蓝移发射线以及另外两条红移（4.7 和 6.4 meV）发射线显示出正常的热猝灭，并且不受注入碳原子的同位素位移（12C 与 13C 注入）和注入注量的影响。因此，它们可能是由具有相似发射能量的其他缺陷产生的，或者是由 M 中心的扰动配置产生的。

articles.title: Probing the wave-vector gap in nanoscale magnonics
articles.title_zh: 探测纳米级磁振子中的波矢间隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15945v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Short-wavelength spin waves are central to miniaturizing magnonic devices and to studying exchange-dominated magnetization dynamics. Yet the wave-vector range between roughly 30 and 300 radians per micrometre has remained difficult to access experimentally, posing challenges for both excitation and detection. This Perspective reviews recent advances in emerging measurement techniques and discusses prospects for their future development. Optical and microwave techniques are restricted to the vicinity of the Brillouin-zone centre. Inelastic neutron, electron and resonant hard x-ray scattering cover the full Brillouin zone but lack the energy resolution needed for low-frequency magnons at intermediate wave vectors. This Perspective examines five emerging approaches that are beginning to close this gap: Mie-enhanced Brillouin light scattering, colour-centre magnetometry, magnon momentum microscopy, extreme-ultraviolet transient-grating spectroscopy, and time-resolved scanning transmission x-ray microscopy. For each, we discuss the physical principle, demonstrated capabilities, current limitations and prospects for development. Compared side by side, the techniques give complementary access to magnon frequencies, local stray fields, real-space dynamics and momentum-space distributions, and they differ in their sensitivity to coherent and incoherent excitations. We therefore discuss the main advantages and use cases of each technique and consider the practical requirements for addressing different scientific questions. We highlight opportunities for further development, including higher sensitivity, improved spatial and temporal resolution, and broader frequency and wave-vector coverage. Together, these advances could enable, for example, systematic studies of nonlinear magnon interactions at nanoscale wavelengths and investigations of emerging magnetic materials such as altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 短波长自旋波对于小型化磁振子器件和研究交换主导的磁化动力学至关重要。然而，每微米大约 30 到 300 弧度之间的波矢量范围仍然难以通过实验获得，这给激发和检测带来了挑战。本视角回顾了新兴测量技术的最新进展，并讨论了其未来发展的前景。光学和微波技术仅限于布里渊区中心附近。非弹性中子、电子和共振硬 X 射线散射覆盖整个布里渊区，但缺乏中波矢量低频磁振子所需的能量分辨率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 短波长自旋波对于小型化磁振子器件和研究交换主导的磁化动力学至关重要。然而，每微米大约 30 到 300 弧度之间的波矢量范围仍然难以通过实验获得，这给激发和检测带来了挑战。本视角回顾了新兴测量技术的最新进展，并讨论了其未来发展的前景。光学和微波技术仅限于布里渊区中心附近。非弹性中子、电子和共振硬 X 射线散射覆盖整个布里渊区，但缺乏中波矢量低频磁振子所需的能量分辨率。本视角研究了五种正在开始缩小这一差距的新兴方法：米氏增强布里渊光散射、色心磁力测量、磁振子动量显微镜、极紫外瞬态光栅光谱和时间分辨扫描透射 X 射线显微镜。对于每一个，我们都讨论了物理原理、展示的功能、当前的局限性和发展前景。并排比较时，这些技术可以互补地获取磁振子频率、局部杂散场、实空间动力学和动量空间分布，并且它们对相干和非相干激励的敏感性不同。因此，我们讨论每种技术的主要优点和用例，并考虑解决不同科学问题的实际要求。我们强调进一步发展的机会，包括更高的灵敏度、改进的空间和时间分辨率以及更广泛的频率和波矢量覆盖范围。总之，这些进步可以实现纳米级波长下非线性磁振子相互作用的系统研究以及交流磁体等新兴磁性材料的研究。

articles.title: Orientation-Dependent Universality of Spin-Conductance Fluctuations in d-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: d 波交变磁体中自旋电导涨落的方向相关普遍性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19793v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Universal conductance fluctuations reflect the symmetry and geometry of phase-coherent transport. However, it remains unclear whether crystal orientation relative to the device can tune fluctuation plateaus in spin-conserving altermagnets. Here, using quantum transport simulations of a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with scalar disorder, we show that crystal orientation tunes longitudinal and spin-Hall fluctuation plateaus while each spin sector remains in the orthogonal symmetry class. At intermediate disorder, tuning the crystal orientation toward the device diagonal weakens longitudinal spin-conductance fluctuations and enhances spin-Hall fluctuations. Both responses exhibit well-defined plateaus at the diagonal orientation, with amplitudes that depend only weakly on disorder and altermagnetic strength over the ranges studied. A variance decomposition shows that, at this orientation, increasing disorder drives the longitudinal spin-channel covariance toward zero, while the transverse covariance shifts from enhancing to suppressing the spin-Hall variance. Our findings suggest that spin-conductance fluctuations can probe transport anisotropy in altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用电导波动反映了相位相干传输的对称性和几何形状。然而，目前尚不清楚相对于器件的晶体取向是否可以调节自旋守恒交流磁体中的涨落平台。在这里，使用具有标量无序的二维 d 波交替磁体的量子输运模拟，我们表明晶体取向调整纵向和自旋霍尔涨落平台，而每个自旋扇区仍保持正交对称类。在中间无序状态下，将晶体取向调整为器件对角线会减弱纵向自旋电导波动并增强自旋霍尔波动。两种响应都在对角线方向上表现出明确的平台，其幅度仅微弱地依赖于所研究范围内的无序和交变磁场强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用电导波动反映了相位相干传输的对称性和几何形状。然而，目前尚不清楚相对于器件的晶体取向是否可以调节自旋守恒交流磁体中的涨落平台。在这里，使用具有标量无序的二维 d 波交替磁体的量子输运模拟，我们表明晶体取向调整纵向和自旋霍尔涨落平台，而每个自旋扇区仍保持正交对称类。在中间无序状态下，将晶体取向调整为器件对角线会减弱纵向自旋电导波动并增强自旋霍尔波动。两种响应都在对角线方向上表现出明确的平台，其幅度仅微弱地依赖于所研究范围内的无序和交变磁场强度。方差分解表明，在这个方向上，增加的无序度驱动纵向自旋通道协方差趋向于零，而横向协方差从增强到抑制自旋霍尔方差。我们的研究结果表明，自旋电导波动可以探测交流磁体中的输运各向异性。

articles.title: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格磁体 CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ 中隐藏的 Triakontadipole 顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom, and establish a dipole--triakontadipole XXZ model with Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K and J_c simeq -0.13 K via precision tensor-network calculations. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus offer a hidden-order caveat for spin-liquid searches and provide a new platform for exploring high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到被忽视的多极自由度，并通过精密张量网络计算建立了 Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K 和 J_c simeq -0.13 K 的偶极子 - triakontadipole XXZ 模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到被忽视的多极自由度，并通过精密张量网络计算建立了 Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K 和 J_c simeq -0.13 K 的偶极子 - triakontadipole XXZ 模型。由此产生的平面三孔二极超流体序对偶极探针来说是隐藏的，这解释了中子散射中不存在磁布拉格峰的原因。零场激发分为低能三触偶极波和广泛的高能连续谱。我们进一步提出核自旋晶格弛豫和自旋电流实验来探测这种隐藏的三康他偶极超流体的无间隙激发。因此，我们的发现为自旋液体搜索提供了隐藏序警告，并为探索稀土三角晶格磁体中的高阶多极物理提供了一个新平台。

articles.title: Non-Perturbative Resolution of Luttinger's Theorem Violations in Strongly Correlated Systems
articles.title_zh: 强相关系统中 Luttinger 定理违规的非微扰解析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07933v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many-body physics faces an apparent paradox concerning violations of Luttinger's theorem in strongly correlated systems. The theorem relates the electron number to the Luttinger count---the monodromy of the logarithm of the imaginary-frequency Green's function bdG(iϵ)---and, at finite magnetic field, connects the Hall conductivity to the magnetic-field derivative of the Luttinger count via the Streda formula. Luttinger's theorem seemingly follows from particle-number conservation alone, without resorting to perturbation theory, and yet it is found to be violated. Here, we provide a non-perturbative solution to this paradox. We show that the Luttinger integral, which accounts for the mismatch between the particle number and the Luttinger count, is a pure zero-frequency boundary term, which the conventional proof implicitly discards. Hence, violations of Luttinger's theorem do not require a breakdown of the skeleton-diagram formalism, whose validity is independent of the convergence of the skeleton-diagram expansion to the exact solution. This advancement in understanding resolves a longstanding point of contention in many-body theory. We also find that the Luttinger integral is a genuine topological invariant, tied to the Luttinger-Ward functional rather than to the Green's function alone; like the monodromy of bdln G(iϵ), it stems exclusively from the zero-frequency point where the Matsubara trajectory crosses the branch cut of the logarithm. Correspondingly, the magnetic-field derivative of the Luttinger integral makes the Hall number in topological insulators differ from its Green's-function expression by a vertex correction, itself invariant, which can take fractional values.
articles.abstract_zh: 在强关联系统中，多体物理学面临着一个与违反吕廷格定理有关的明显悖论。该定理将电子数与吕廷格数（虚频格林函数bdG(iϵ)的对数的单值性）联系起来，并在有限磁场下，通过斯特雷达公式将霍尔电导率与吕廷格数的磁场导数联系起来。卢廷格定理似乎仅由粒子数守恒得出，无需诉诸微扰理论，但却发现它被违反了。在这里，我们为这一悖论提供了一个非微扰解。我们证明，Luttinger积分（它解释了粒子数与Luttinger计数之间的不匹配）是一个纯零频边界项，而传统证明则隐式地舍弃了该项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强关联系统中，多体物理学面临着一个与违反吕廷格定理有关的明显悖论。该定理将电子数与吕廷格数（虚频格林函数bdG(iϵ)的对数的单值性）联系起来，并在有限磁场下，通过斯特雷达公式将霍尔电导率与吕廷格数的磁场导数联系起来。卢廷格定理似乎仅由粒子数守恒得出，无需诉诸微扰理论，但却发现它被违反了。在这里，我们为这一悖论提供了一个非微扰解。我们证明，Luttinger积分（它解释了粒子数与Luttinger计数之间的不匹配）是一个纯零频边界项，而传统证明则隐式地舍弃了该项。因此，违反吕廷格定理并不需要破坏骨架图形式主义，其有效性独立于骨架图展开式收敛到精确解。这一认识上的进步解决了多体理论中一个长期存在的争议点。我们还发现，卢廷格积分是一个真正的拓扑不变量，它与卢廷格-沃德泛函相关，而非仅与格林函数相关；与bdln G(iϵ)的单值性一样，它仅源于松原轨迹与对数的分支割线相交的零频点。相应地，吕廷格积分的磁场导数使拓扑绝缘体中的霍尔数与格林函数表达式之间存在一个顶点修正的差异，该修正本身是不变的，可以取分数值。

articles.title: Genuine multientropy, dihedral invariants and Lifshitz theory
articles.title_zh: 真多熵、二面角不变量和利夫希茨理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.00593v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-invariants are local-unitary invariants of state replicas introduced as potential probes of multipartite entanglement and correlations in quantum many-body systems. In this paper, we investigate two multi-invariants for tripartite pure states, namely multientropy and dihedral invariant. We compute the (genuine) multientropy for Lifshitz groundstates, and obtain its analytical continuation to noninteger values of Rényi index. We show that the genuine multientropy can be expressed in terms of mutual information and logarithmic negativity, a relation that also holds for stabilizer states. For general tripartite pure states, we demonstrate that dihedral invariants are related to Rényi reflected entropies. In particular, we show that the dihedral permutations of replicas are equivalent to the reflected construction, or alternatively to the realignment of density matrices.
articles.abstract_zh: 多重不变量是态副本的局部幺正不变量，被引入作为量子多体系统中多体纠缠和关联的潜在探测工具。本文研究了三体纯态的两个多重不变量，即多重熵和二面体不变量。我们计算了Lifshitz基态的（真正）多重熵，并得到了其对Rényi指数非整数值的解析延拓。我们证明，真正的多重熵可以用互信息和对数负性来表示，这种关系也适用于稳定子态。对于一般的三分纯态，我们证明了二面体不变量与雷尼反射熵相关。特别地，我们证明了副本的二面体置换等同于反射构造，或者等同于密度矩阵的重排。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多重不变量是态副本的局部幺正不变量，被引入作为量子多体系统中多体纠缠和关联的潜在探测工具。本文研究了三体纯态的两个多重不变量，即多重熵和二面体不变量。我们计算了Lifshitz基态的（真正）多重熵，并得到了其对Rényi指数非整数值的解析延拓。我们证明，真正的多重熵可以用互信息和对数负性来表示，这种关系也适用于稳定子态。对于一般的三分纯态，我们证明了二面体不变量与雷尼反射熵相关。特别地，我们证明了副本的二面体置换等同于反射构造，或者等同于密度矩阵的重排。

articles.title: Robust quantum metrology using disordered probes
articles.title_zh: 使用无序探头的稳健量子计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.11635v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Disorder is ubiquitous in quantum devices including quantum probes designed and fabricated for quantum parameter estimation and sensing. We investigate the robustness of a quantum probe against the presence of glassy disorder. We define a disorder marker quantifying the effect of the disorder by expanding the quantum Fisher information in terms of different orders of the standardized central moments of the disorder-distributions. We classify the quantum probes in terms of the possible values of the disorder marker, and analytically show, for a disorder-sensitive probe with identical and weak disorder on all or a subset of the parameters of the probe-Hamiltonian, that the absolute value of the disorder marker exhibits a quadratic dependence on the disorder strength. We derive a robustness scale intrinsic to the probe that competes with the disorder, and provide a prescription for estimating the maximum disorder strength that the probe can withstand from the disorder-free probe-Hamiltonian for a given initial state of the probe, which can be computed without the disorder averaging. We also extend the prescription to classical Fisher information, and provide an operational perspective to the proposed marker in experiments. We demonstrate our results in the case of a single-qubit probe under disordered magnetic field, and a multi-qubit probe described by a disordered one-dimensional Kitaev model with nearest-neighbor interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序在量子器件中无处不在，包括为量子参数估计和传感而设计和制造的量子探针。我们研究了量子探针在存在玻璃态无序情况下的鲁棒性。我们通过将量子Fisher信息展开为无序分布标准化中心矩的不同阶，定义了一个量化无序影响的无序标记。我们根据无序标记的可能值对量子探针进行分类，并对具有相同和弱无序的无序敏感探针（其探针-哈密顿量的所有参数或参数子集均具有相同和弱无序）进行分析性证明，表明无序标记的绝对值对无序强度表现出二次依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无序在量子器件中无处不在，包括为量子参数估计和传感而设计和制造的量子探针。我们研究了量子探针在存在玻璃态无序情况下的鲁棒性。我们通过将量子Fisher信息展开为无序分布标准化中心矩的不同阶，定义了一个量化无序影响的无序标记。我们根据无序标记的可能值对量子探针进行分类，并对具有相同和弱无序的无序敏感探针（其探针-哈密顿量的所有参数或参数子集均具有相同和弱无序）进行分析性证明，表明无序标记的绝对值对无序强度表现出二次依赖性。我们推导出了与无序竞争的探针固有鲁棒性标度，并提供了在给定探针初始状态下，从无无序探针-哈密顿量估计探针所能承受的最大无序强度的方案，该方案无需进行无序平均即可计算。我们还将该方法扩展到经典费雪信息，并为实验中提出的标记提供了操作视角。我们展示了在无序磁场下单量子比特探针以及由具有最近邻相互作用的无序一维Kitaev模型描述的多量子比特探针的情况下的结果。

articles.title: Time-Dependent Classical and Quantum Integrability in Sigma Models: From the λ-Model to the Perturbed SU(2)₁ WZW Model
articles.title_zh: Σ模型中的时间相关经典可积性和量子可积性：从λ模型到微扰SU(2)₁ WZW模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05111v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Using the Hamiltonian formulation of the λ-model with time-dependent coupling, we compare classical Lax and quantum integrability in the isotropic current-current deformation of the SU(2)₁ Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) model. From the classical WZW current algebra at fixed level, we derive equations of motion for the coupled left- and right-moving currents and construct a generalized Lax connection whose flatness fixes the integrable time-dependent coupling. Equal-time Lax-matrix Poisson brackets take the generalized Maillet form, and the r/s kernels satisfy the extended classical Yang-Baxter relation. A coupling redefinition and time reparametrization relate it to the λ-model with local couplings. At level one, non-Abelian bosonization identifies the deformed model with the interacting isospin sector of the chiral-invariant SU(2) Gross-Neveu model. In its exact generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) solution, the quantum Yang-Baxter equation constrains the time-dependent coupling. In the universal weak-coupling regime, it shares the leading inverse-affine time dependence imposed by classical Lax flatness of the λ-model. This common weak-coupling equation coincides with the one-loop renormalization-group equation of the static model, with time identified with the logarithm of the UV cutoff. Periodic boundary conditions in the GBA yield the quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations, whose solution gives an exact many-body wavefunction admitting a Yang-Yang representation at any nonzero drive rate. In the slow-drive limit, dynamical dimensional transmutation generates an isospin mass gap decaying exponentially in time on the decreasing-coupling branch, while in the fast-drive limit the isospin sector approaches the SU(2)₁ WZW UV fixed point. We also compare classical and quantum integrability of higher-level WZW and noncompact-group sigma models.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用具有时间相关耦合的λ模型的哈密顿形式，在SU(2)₁ Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW)模型的各向同性电流-电流变形中比较了经典Lax可积性和量子可积性。从固定水平的经典WZW电流代数出发，我们推导出耦合的左移和右移电流的运动方程，并构造一个广义Lax联络，其平坦性确定了可积的时变耦合。等时Lax矩阵泊松括号采用广义Maillet形式，并且r/s核满足扩展的经典杨-巴克斯特关系。耦合的重新定义和时间的重新参数化将其与具有局部耦合的λ模型联系起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用具有时间相关耦合的λ模型的哈密顿形式，在SU(2)₁ Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW)模型的各向同性电流-电流变形中比较了经典Lax可积性和量子可积性。从固定水平的经典WZW电流代数出发，我们推导出耦合的左移和右移电流的运动方程，并构造一个广义Lax联络，其平坦性确定了可积的时变耦合。等时Lax矩阵泊松括号采用广义Maillet形式，并且r/s核满足扩展的经典杨-巴克斯特关系。耦合的重新定义和时间的重新参数化将其与具有局部耦合的λ模型联系起来。在第一级，非阿贝尔玻色化将变形模型与手性不变SU(2)格罗斯-内夫模型（Gross-Neveu model）的相互作用同位旋扇区联系起来。在其精确的广义Bethe ansatz（GBA）解中，量子杨-Baxter方程约束了随时间变化的耦合。在普遍的弱耦合情形下，它与λ模型的经典Lax平坦性所施加的主要反仿射时间依赖性相同。这个通用的弱耦合方程与静态模型的一圈重整化群方程一致，其中时间被等同于紫外截止的对数。GBA中的周期性边界条件产生量子Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov方程，其解给出了一个精确的多体波函数，该波函数在任何非零驱动速率下都允许Yang-Yang表示。在慢驱动极限下，动力学维数转变会在耦合减弱分支上产生随时间呈指数衰减的同位旋质量间隙，而在快驱动极限下，同位旋扇区则会趋近于SU(2)₁ WZW紫外线（UV）不动点。我们还比较了高阶WZW和非紧群σ模型的经典可积性和量子可积性。

articles.title: Statistical Mechanics of Non-Abelian Learnability Transitions
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔可学习性跃迁的统计力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19325v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Monitored many-body quantum systems can undergo sharp learnability transitions characterized by how much information can be learned by the observer. When the dynamics conserves a non-Abelian charge, such as an SU(2) spin, understanding how the observer learns the total charge remains an outstanding problem. Unlike the Abelian case, where charge measurements on distinct sites commute, the SU(2)-symmetric readouts are noncommuting fusion measurements, making learning a genuinely quantum inference problem. We propose a theory of 1+1d monitored quantum dynamics with SU(2) symmetry, and show that it can be described by an effective replicated loop model comprised of a replica-pairing field and a diffusive (z=2) background sector that carries the SU(2) charge and remains gapless throughout the phase diagram. Our theory predicts that the "spin-sharpening" and entanglement transitions coincide as a single transition, which is supported by numerics. Ordering of the pairing field produces volume-law entanglement and hides the background sector from measurements, leading to a learning time of tsim L³ for the total spin. When the pairing field disorders, the background sector alone gives logarithmic entanglement and a diffusive learning time tsim L². Our analysis is controlled by a large-loop-fugacity expansion.
articles.abstract_zh: 受监测的多体量子系统可能经历尖锐的可学习性跃迁，其特征在于观察者可以学习多少信息。当动力学守恒一个非阿贝尔电荷（例如SU(2)自旋）时，了解观察者如何学习总电荷仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。与阿贝尔情形不同，在阿贝尔情形中，对不同位置的电荷测量是可交换的，而SU(2)对称的读出则是不可交换的融合测量，这使得学习成为一个真正意义上的量子推理问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受监测的多体量子系统可能经历尖锐的可学习性跃迁，其特征在于观察者可以学习多少信息。当动力学守恒一个非阿贝尔电荷（例如SU(2)自旋）时，了解观察者如何学习总电荷仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。与阿贝尔情形不同，在阿贝尔情形中，对不同位置的电荷测量是可交换的，而SU(2)对称的读出则是不可交换的融合测量，这使得学习成为一个真正意义上的量子推理问题。我们提出了一种具有SU(2)对称性的1+1维受监测量子动力学理论，并表明其可以用一个有效的复制环路模型来描述，该模型由一个复制配对场和一个携带SU(2)电荷并在整个相图中保持无能隙的扩散（z=2）背景扇区组成。我们的理论预测，“自旋锐化”和纠缠跃迁作为单一跃迁重合，这得到了数值计算的支持。配对场的有序性产生体积定律纠缠，并使背景扇区不被测量所察觉，从而导致总自旋的学习时间为tsim L³。当配对场无序时，仅背景部分就会产生对数纠缠和扩散学习时间tsim L²。我们的分析由大环逸度展开控制。

articles.title: Shower Shapes and Data-Driven Simulation Studies using a Highly Granular Crystal ECAL
articles.title_zh: 使用高度精细的晶体ECAL进行淋浴形状和数据驱动模拟研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron shower shapes were measured using standard shower profile models for events observed with a highly granular crystal electromagnetic calorimeter prototype, with data taken from a 2025 test beam at the CERN Proton Synchrotron T9 beamline. The shower maximum, longitudinal shape parameter, and lateral variance were found to be well approximated by log-normal distributions. From these distributions, properties of the absorber were measured to be in agreement with existing literature. Energy-dependent correlations were observed between all parameters and most strongly between the shower maximum and the shower shape parameter. The distributions of energy and event-by-event pairwise log ratios of energy fractions in individual active volumes of the calorimeter conditional on the shower shape were found to be consistent with shifted and scaled Gamma and Fisher's-z distributions, respectively. Generative methods were developed to simulate the logarithm of shower shape variables using Gaussian copulas. Copula sampling for shower shape parameters was found to produce superior modeling of heavy tails observed for the shower maximum and longitudinal shape parameter distributions when compared to direct sampling from a correlated multivariate normal distribution. A copula method was also devised to sample full shower events conditional on the shower shape parameters by exploiting the observation that the vector of energy fractions follows a logistic Log-Gamma distribution, the joint relation implied by the observed Fisher's-z form of the pairwise log-ratios. The generative model was evaluated using standard manifold and classifier metrics and was found to approach the data-versus-data ceiling. The fastest generation time was found to be around 30 μs per particle shower.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用标准簇射剖面模型测量了通过高粒度晶体电磁量热仪原型观测到的事件的电子簇射形状，数据取自欧洲核子研究组织（CERN）质子同步加速器T9束线上的2025年测试束。研究发现，淋浴峰值、纵向形状参数和横向方差可以用对数正态分布很好地近似。根据这些分布，测得的吸收体特性与现有文献一致。在所有参数之间观察到与能量相关的相关性，在簇峰和簇形状参数之间相关性最强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用标准簇射剖面模型测量了通过高粒度晶体电磁量热仪原型观测到的事件的电子簇射形状，数据取自欧洲核子研究组织（CERN）质子同步加速器T9束线上的2025年测试束。研究发现，淋浴峰值、纵向形状参数和横向方差可以用对数正态分布很好地近似。根据这些分布，测得的吸收体特性与现有文献一致。在所有参数之间观察到与能量相关的相关性，在簇峰和簇形状参数之间相关性最强。研究发现，在以淋浴形状为条件的量热仪各个活性体积中，能量分布和逐事件成对能量分数对数比分别与平移和缩放的伽马分布以及Fisher's-z分布一致。开发了生成方法，使用高斯Copula函数模拟淋浴形状变量的对数。与从相关多元正态分布中直接抽样相比，发现对淋浴形状参数进行Copula抽样可产生对淋浴峰值和纵向形状参数分布所观察到的重尾的优越建模。还设计了一种Copula方法，通过利用能量分数向量服从Logistic Log-Gamma分布这一观测结果，以及成对对数比的观测Fisher's-z形式所隐含的联合关系，有条件地对具有瀑布形状参数的完整瀑布事件进行采样。使用标准流形和分类器指标对生成模型进行了评估，发现其接近数据与数据之间的上限。发现最快的生成时间约为每粒粒子束30 μs。

articles.title: Quantization concealment of angular momentum: dynamic origin of spins
articles.title_zh: 角动量的量子化掩蔽：自旋的动态起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since their introduction, spins of elementary particles remain a phenomenological addition to modern quantum theories. While relatively recent studies on Dirac and other linearized equations of motion have revealed the spatial current nature of the spin magnetic moment (instead of the commonly pictured self-rotation), the dynamical origin of this circulating current remains unresolved. Here, we expose a long-overlooked generic shortcoming of wave mechanics ("quantization concealment of angular momentum") that undesirably reduces the canonical angular momentum of bound eigen-modes and renders incomplete the minimal coupling to magnetic fields. Recovering the kinetic orbital angular momentum resolves 1s-orbital's counterintuitive "zero" angular momentum and reproduces all planar modes' anomalous Zeeman splitting. Regarding spins as effective remedy to the concealment offers natural explanations to their main puzzles: 1) dynamical origin of spin magnetic moment and 2) frame invariance of spin angular momentum. This implies absence of spin magnetic moment for free particles, a strong prediction verifiable through Stern-Gerlach experiments on electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 自提出以来，基本粒子的自旋一直是现代量子理论的现象学补充。虽然最近对狄拉克方程和其他线性化运动方程的研究揭示了自旋磁矩的空间电流性质（而非通常所认为的自旋），但这种环流电流的动力学起源仍未得到解决。本文揭示了波动力学长期被忽视的一个普遍缺陷（“角动量的量子化掩蔽”），该缺陷会不适当地降低束缚本征态的正则角动量，并使与磁场的最小耦合不完整。恢复动能轨道角动量解决了1s轨道反直觉的“零”角动量问题，并重现了所有平面模式的异常塞曼（Zeeman）裂分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自提出以来，基本粒子的自旋一直是现代量子理论的现象学补充。虽然最近对狄拉克方程和其他线性化运动方程的研究揭示了自旋磁矩的空间电流性质（而非通常所认为的自旋），但这种环流电流的动力学起源仍未得到解决。本文揭示了波动力学长期被忽视的一个普遍缺陷（“角动量的量子化掩蔽”），该缺陷会不适当地降低束缚本征态的正则角动量，并使与磁场的最小耦合不完整。恢复动能轨道角动量解决了1s轨道反直觉的“零”角动量问题，并重现了所有平面模式的异常塞曼（Zeeman）裂分。将自旋视为隐蔽性的有效补救措施，为自旋的主要谜题提供了自然的解释：1) 自旋磁矩的动力学起源；2) 自旋角动量的参照系不变性。这意味着自由粒子不具备自旋磁矩，这是一个强有力的预测，可以通过对电子的斯忒恩-格拉赫实验来验证。

articles.title: Butterfly Effect in Kinetic Plasma Turbulence
articles.title_zh: 动力学等离子体湍流中的蝴蝶效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The butterfly effect is a fundamental process in chaotic systems, but it has not previously been characterized in detail for a collisionless turbulent plasma. In this work, we apply particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations of driven turbulence to study the emergence of the butterfly effect from a small initial perturbation to the simulated particles. In particular, we compare pairs of (baseline and perturbed) simulations that differ only by a localized initial perturbation (down to the single-particle level). We find that the effect of the localized perturbation spreads radially throughout the PIC simulation, causing a difference between each simulation pair that is exponentially amplified over time within the affected region. The fields, including the electric current density, eventually become statistically decorrelated. We construct an analytical model combining spatial expansion with exponential amplification to approximate the early-time evolution. Varying the initial perturbation primarily affects the early-time evolution, while having little effect on the final, decorrelated state. We describe parameter scans with varying plasma beta and temperature (covering sub-relativistic and ultra-relativistic regimes). Our results show that remarkably small perturbations will grow to decorrelate each pair of simulations within a few dynamical times; the imposed perturbation can no longer be resolved once it falls below the numerical precision floor set by the machine precision. These results confirm that the butterfly effect is very strong and robust in a collisionless plasma, with implications for the predictability of turbulent plasma systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 蝴蝶效应是混沌系统中的一个基本过程，但此前尚未对无碰撞湍流等离子体进行详细表征。在本文中，我们应用驱动湍流的粒子团（PIC）模拟，研究蝴蝶效应如何从模拟粒子的小初始扰动中出现。具体而言，我们比较了（基线和扰动）模拟的成对结果，这些模拟仅因局部初始扰动（低至单粒子水平）而存在差异。我们发现，局部扰动的影响在整个PIC模拟中呈径向传播，导致每对模拟之间存在差异，并且这种差异在受影响区域内随着时间的推移呈指数级放大。包括电流密度在内的场最终在统计上变得不相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蝴蝶效应是混沌系统中的一个基本过程，但此前尚未对无碰撞湍流等离子体进行详细表征。在本文中，我们应用驱动湍流的粒子团（PIC）模拟，研究蝴蝶效应如何从模拟粒子的小初始扰动中出现。具体而言，我们比较了（基线和扰动）模拟的成对结果，这些模拟仅因局部初始扰动（低至单粒子水平）而存在差异。我们发现，局部扰动的影响在整个PIC模拟中呈径向传播，导致每对模拟之间存在差异，并且这种差异在受影响区域内随着时间的推移呈指数级放大。包括电流密度在内的场最终在统计上变得不相关。我们构建了一个将空间扩展与指数放大相结合的分析模型，以近似模拟早期演化。改变初始扰动主要影响早期演化，而对最终的去相关状态影响很小。我们描述了具有不同等离子体β和温度（涵盖亚相对论和超相对论状态）的参数扫描。我们的结果表明，极小的扰动将在几个动力学时间内增长，使每对模拟不再具有相关性；一旦施加的扰动低于机器精度所设定的数值精度下限，就无法再对其进行分辨。这些结果证实，蝴蝶效应在无碰撞等离子体中非常强大且稳健，这对湍流等离子体系统的可预测性具有重要意义。

articles.title: Data-free continuous-time physics-informed neural networks for vortex shedding: a consistent pressure across time windows
articles.title_zh: 用于涡旋脱落的无数据连续时间物理信息神经网络：跨时间窗口的一致压力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Without data, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in continuous time have so far failed to develop vortex shedding past a circular cylinder in a domain symmetric about the wake centerline: the training converges to the steady symmetric solution. We obtain shedding at Re=100 with a continuous-time PINN trained over successive time windows, without any reference data and without temporal discretization, the symmetry being broken by an analytical, divergence-free initial condition. The Strouhal number and the mean drag coefficient agree with an OpenFOAM solution computed on the same domain to within 0.5%. The pressure, however, is discontinuous at the junctions between windows, and the lift coefficient is a staircase. We relate this discontinuity to the differential-algebraic structure of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, of index 2 after spatial discretization: a consistent initial condition of each window must satisfy the constraint nablacdotv=0 for the velocity, and the hidden constraint nabla·partial_tv=0, with partial_tv given by the momentum equation, then determines the pressure. Imposing the pressure alone makes the solution continuous but not consistent; our remedy imposes the pressure at the junctions and adds this hidden constraint to the loss. Over five shedding periods, the jumps of the lift coefficient become 20 times smaller.
articles.abstract_zh: 到目前为止，在没有数据的情况下，连续时间的物理信息神经网络（PINN）未能发展出在关于尾流中心线对称的区域内圆柱体后方涡旋脱落的现象：训练收敛于稳态对称解。我们使用在连续时间窗口上训练的连续时间PINN，在Re=100时获得了涡落现象，无需任何参考数据，也无需时间离散化，对称性被一个无散度的解析初始条件打破。斯特劳哈尔数和平均阻力系数与在同一域上计算的OpenFOAM解的误差在0.5%以内。然而，压力在窗口之间的接合处不连续，升力系数呈阶梯状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 到目前为止，在没有数据的情况下，连续时间的物理信息神经网络（PINN）未能发展出在关于尾流中心线对称的区域内圆柱体后方涡旋脱落的现象：训练收敛于稳态对称解。我们使用在连续时间窗口上训练的连续时间PINN，在Re=100时获得了涡落现象，无需任何参考数据，也无需时间离散化，对称性被一个无散度的解析初始条件打破。斯特劳哈尔数和平均阻力系数与在同一域上计算的OpenFOAM解的误差在0.5%以内。然而，压力在窗口之间的接合处不连续，升力系数呈阶梯状。我们将这种不连续性与不可压缩的纳维-斯托克斯方程的微分-代数结构联系起来，该方程在空间离散化后具有2的指数：每个窗口的一致初始条件必须满足速度的约束nabla·v=0，而隐式约束nabla·partial_tv=0（其中partial_tv由动量方程给出）则决定了压力。仅施加压力使解连续但不一致；我们的补救措施在节点处施加压力，并将这一隐性约束添加到损失中。经过五个脱落周期，升力系数的跳跃幅度缩小了 20 倍。

articles.title: Symmetry-Aware Residual Learning of Few-Body Molecular Wave Functions
articles.title_zh: 少体分子波函数的对称性感知残差学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33576v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultracold polar molecules are a highly controllable platform for engineering quantum matter, but modeling their few-body properties remains computationally challenging. Their anisotropic long-range interactions and rich internal structure lead to high-dimensional eigenvalue problems for which conventional grid-based solvers are largely restricted to two-molecule systems. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics-informed neural variational method that exploits known physical structure of the molecular wave function. Our key idea is to factor the wave function into analytic and neural components. The analytic component encodes rotational symmetry and asymptotic decay, while the neural residual learns the remaining intermediate-range behavior. This decomposition reduces the effective dimensionality of the problem without relying on ad hoc approximations or problem-specific discretization grids. We benchmark our method against high-accuracy two-molecule solvers and recover both ground and excited bound states with mean relative errors below 0.01%. We further demonstrate the method's applicability to three-body systems by computing field-linked trimer ground-state energies in percent-level agreement with an independent grid-based calculation. This provides a systematic route to larger molecular systems and opens opportunities to study correlations and dynamics in interacting quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 超冷极性分子是工程量子物质的高度可控平台，但对其少体特性进行建模在计算上仍然具有挑战性。它们的各向异性长程相互作用和丰富的内部结构导致高维特征值问题，而传统的基于网格的求解器在很大程度上仅限于两分子系统。为了解决这个限制，我们引入了一种基于物理的神经变分方法，该方法利用分子波函数的已知物理结构。我们的关键思想是将波函数分解为解析分量和神经分量。分析组件对旋转对称性和渐近衰减进行编码，而神经残差则学习剩余的中间范围行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超冷极性分子是工程量子物质的高度可控平台，但对其少体特性进行建模在计算上仍然具有挑战性。它们的各向异性长程相互作用和丰富的内部结构导致高维特征值问题，而传统的基于网格的求解器在很大程度上仅限于两分子系统。为了解决这个限制，我们引入了一种基于物理的神经变分方法，该方法利用分子波函数的已知物理结构。我们的关键思想是将波函数分解为解析分量和神经分量。分析组件对旋转对称性和渐近衰减进行编码，而神经残差则学习剩余的中间范围行为。这种分解减少了问题的有效维度，而不依赖于临时近似或特定于问题的离散化网格。我们将我们的方法与高精度双分子求解器进行基准测试，并恢复基态和激发态束缚态，平均相对误差低于 0.01%。我们通过使用独立的基于网格的计算以百分比水平协议计算场连接的三聚体基态能量，进一步证明了该方法对三体系统的适用性。这为研究更大的分子系统提供了一条系统途径，并为研究相互作用的量子物质的相关性和动力学提供了机会。

articles.title: Numerical Studies of Ground State Atomic Parity Violation Measurements in Cesium
articles.title_zh: 铯基态原子宇称不守恒测量的数值研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report results of numerical simulations of an ongoing measurement designed to measure the electric dipole (E1) transition moment between hyperfine components of the ground state of atomic cesium. This E1 moment is non-zero solely due to nuclear weak interactions between the nucleons, leading to a nuclear anapole moment of the cesium nucleus. Through these simulations, we explore the effect on the microwave spectrum of a static transverse magnetic field, a spatial offset of the atomic beam from the axis of the radio-frequency (rf) cavity, the angular tilt of the rf cavity, and the ac Stark shift by the Raman-coupling beams used to generate the initial superposition state between ground state components. The results of these simulations help place limits on the experimental parameters, and help guide the future experimental procedures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了正在进行的测量的数值模拟结果，该测量旨在测量原子铯基态超精细成分之间的电偶极子（E1）跃迁矩。该 E1 矩不为零，仅仅是由于核子之间的核弱相互作用，导致铯核的核阿纳极矩。通过这些模拟，我们探索了静态横向磁场、原子束相对射频 (rf) 腔轴的空间偏移、射频腔的角度倾斜以及用于生成基态分量之间初始叠加态的拉曼耦合光束的交流斯塔克位移对微波频谱的影响。这些模拟的结果有助于限制实验参数，并有助于指导未来的实验程序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了正在进行的测量的数值模拟结果，该测量旨在测量原子铯基态超精细成分之间的电偶极子（E1）跃迁矩。该 E1 矩不为零，仅仅是由于核子之间的核弱相互作用，导致铯核的核阿纳极矩。通过这些模拟，我们探索了静态横向磁场、原子束相对射频 (rf) 腔轴的空间偏移、射频腔的角度倾斜以及用于生成基态分量之间初始叠加态的拉曼耦合光束的交流斯塔克位移对微波频谱的影响。这些模拟的结果有助于限制实验参数，并有助于指导未来的实验程序。

articles.title: Global self-organisation via driven interchange turbulence in a hard-core Z-pinch
articles.title_zh: 通过硬核 Z 箍缩中的驱动交换湍流实现全球自组织
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whereas most magnetic-confinement concepts seek to suppress turbulent transport, the levitated dipole exploits it, with plasma turbulently self-organising to concentrate into the stronger-field region near the levitating coil. In a sufficiently large device, this can create the conditions needed for fusion, despite stiff and vigorous transport. We study this process in global simulations of a driven hard-core Z-pinch using compressible ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) with self-consistent evolution of the magnetic field. The results reveal how plasma and field jointly settle onto a continuously turbulent, finite-beta interchange-marginal family. Across a wide drive scan in two-dimensional simulations, quasi-universal pressure and density profiles result, with the magnetic-field profile changing from a decreasing vacuum-like form to one with an interior minimum at increasing beta. These profiles are robust to large changes to the heat and particle sources (including moving both to the outside of the device) as well as to different exhaust and boundary prescriptions. A designer consequently has little direct control over the selected profiles, including the final separation between the pressure maximum and coil, which is set by a turbulent boundary layer. We show that such results persist in the presence of three-dimensional fluctuations at modest beta, but that high-beta states become unstable to a field-parallel m=1 instability that is the analogue of the ballooning instability in a true dipole; this evacuates the core, destroying confinement. Based on a near-marginal expansion and a geometrical remapping, we argue that many features of our results should apply to any shearless closed-field-line system.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数磁约束概念都试图抑制湍流传输，而悬浮偶极子则利用了它，等离子体湍流自组织集中到悬浮线圈附近的更强场区域。在足够大的设备中，尽管运输过程坚硬且剧烈，但这仍可以创造融合所需的条件。我们使用具有磁场自洽演化的可压缩理想磁流体动力学 (MHD) 在驱动硬核 Z 箍缩的全局模拟中研究了这一过程。结果揭示了等离子体和场如何共同稳定在一个连续湍流、有限β交换边缘族上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数磁约束概念都试图抑制湍流传输，而悬浮偶极子则利用了它，等离子体湍流自组织集中到悬浮线圈附近的更强场区域。在足够大的设备中，尽管运输过程坚硬且剧烈，但这仍可以创造融合所需的条件。我们使用具有磁场自洽演化的可压缩理想磁流体动力学 (MHD) 在驱动硬核 Z 箍缩的全局模拟中研究了这一过程。结果揭示了等离子体和场如何共同稳定在一个连续湍流、有限β交换边缘族上。在二维模拟中的宽驱动扫描中，产生了准通用压力和密度分布，磁场分布从类似真空的递减形式变为在β增加时具有内部最小值的形式。这些配置文件对于热源和颗粒源的巨大变化（包括将两者移动到设备外部）以及不同的排气和边界规定具有鲁棒性。因此，设计者几乎无法直接控制所选的轮廓，包括由湍流边界层设置的最大压力和线圈之间的最终分离。我们证明，这样的结果在存在适度β的三维涨落的情况下仍然存在，但是高β状态变得不稳定，达到场平行m=1不稳定性，这与真正偶极子中的膨胀不稳定性类似；这会疏散核心，破坏限制。基于近边际扩展和几何重新映射，我们认为我们结果的许多特征应该适用于任何无剪切闭场线系统。

articles.title: OrbACE: Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion
articles.title_zh: OrbACE：轨道和原子团簇扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate electronic-structure reference data are expensive, motivating interatomic potentials that learn effectively from limited training sets. We introduce OrbACE (Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion), a framework that supplements an E(3)-equivariant cluster-expansion backbone with inexpensive electronic-structure descriptors. On ANI-1x at the ωB97X/6-31G* level, its atom-centered variant, OrbACE-A, trained on 10,000 configurations and evaluated on 442,000 held-out configurations, achieves energy and force mean absolute errors of 3.16 meV/atom and 76 meV/angstrom in direct learning, compared with 9.61 meV/atom and 146 meV/angstrom for MACE with matched backbone settings. This reduces the energy error by a factor of three and approximately halves the force error. Its energy error is also below that of the best delta-corrected MACE baseline, 5.00 meV/atom, although its force error is slightly higher. Combining OrbACE-A with a Hartree-Fock delta baseline further reduces the errors to 1.48 meV/atom and 35 meV/angstrom. OrbACE-A builds atom- and pair-resolved invariants from a non-self-consistent extended-Hueckel model evaluated within the differentiable forward pass, yielding forces consistent with the predicted energy. The orbital variant, OrbACE-O, instead uses localized Hartree-Fock orbitals as graph nodes, with scalar and equivariant electronic descriptors. Its forces are evaluated at fixed descriptors, omitting their response to nuclear motion. In direct learning on ANI-1x, its energy error is approximately three times that of OrbACE-A. The three benchmarks considered (ANI-1x, revised MD17, and 3BPA) cover neutral, closed-shell, non-periodic molecules containing H, C, N, and O. Performance outside this domain remains to be established.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的电子结构参考数据价格昂贵，激发了从有限的训练集中有效学习的原子间势。我们引入了 OrbACE（轨道和原子簇扩展），这是一个用廉价的电子结构描述符补充 E(3) 等变簇扩展主干的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的电子结构参考数据价格昂贵，激发了从有限的训练集中有效学习的原子间势。我们引入了 OrbACE（轨道和原子簇扩展），这是一个用廉价的电子结构描述符补充 E(3) 等变簇扩展主干的框架。在 ωB97X/6-31G* 级别的 ANI-1x 上，其以原子为中心的变体 OrbACE-A 在 10,000 个配置上进行训练并在 442,000 个保留配置上进行评估，在直接学习中实现了 3.16 meV/原子和 76 meV/埃的能量和力平均绝对误差，而对于 9.61 meV/原子和 146 meV/埃MACE 具有匹配的主干设置。这将能量误差减少了三倍，力误差大约减半。尽管其力误差略高，但其能量误差也低于最佳 Delta 校正 MACE 基线 5.00 meV/原子。将 OrbACE-A 与 Hartree-Fock delta 基线相结合，可进一步将误差降低至 1.48 meV/atom 和 35 meV/angstrom。 OrbACE-A 根据在可微分前向传播中评估的非自洽扩展 Hueckel 模型构建原子和对解析不变量，产生与预测能量一致的力。轨道变体 OrbACE-O 使用局域 Hartree-Fock 轨道作为图节点，并具有标量和等变电子描述符。它的力是用固定的描述符来评估的，忽略了它们对核运动的响应。在ANI-1x上直接学习时，其能量误差约为OrbACE-A的三倍。所考虑的三个基准（ANI-1x、修订版 MD17 和 3BPA）涵盖包含 H、C、N 和 O 的中性、闭壳、非周期分子。该领域之外的性能仍有待确定。

articles.title: AI Buckingham: Agentic Discovery of Dimensionless Scaling Laws Across Physical Regimes
articles.title_zh: AI Buckingham：跨物理体系无量纲缩放定律的代理发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical dimensional analysis defines admissible dimensionless representations but does not determine which combinations capture the dominant physical dependence, whether it changes across physical regimes, or when dependent-variable rescaling is required. We present AI Buckingham, an agentic framework for autonomous dimensionless discovery from natural-language descriptions of physical problems and observational data. It couples reasoning and planning by a large language model (LLM) with predefined symbolic and numerical tools. Literature-based knowledge retrieval supports dimensional checking, gradient-based clustering identifies physical regimes, and mutual information provides an objective, reparameterization-invariant criterion for identifying dominant dimensionless groups. Explicit numerical criteria determine the group count and assess simplification. Across ten physical systems spanning fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, thermal convection and additive manufacturing, AI Buckingham recovers established similarity representations and resolves regime-dependent scalings. For the longstanding challenge of predicting turbulent drag on rough surfaces, it identifies informative reparameterizations of surface statistics that improve equivalent sand-grain roughness estimates for engineering-oriented drag modelling.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典量纲分析定义了可接受的无量纲表示，但无法确定哪些组合捕获了主要的物理依赖性，无论它是否随物理状态变化，或者何时需要因变量重新缩放。我们提出了 AI Buckingham，这是一个从物理问题和观测数据的自然语言描述中自主无量纲发现的代理框架。它将大型语言模型 (LLM) 的推理和规划与预定义的符号和数字工具结合起来。基于文献的知识检索支持维度检查，基于梯度的聚类识别物理状态，而互信息为识别主导无量纲组提供了客观的、重新参数化不变的标准。明确的数字标准确定组数并简化评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典量纲分析定义了可接受的无量纲表示，但无法确定哪些组合捕获了主要的物理依赖性，无论它是否随物理状态变化，或者何时需要因变量重新缩放。我们提出了 AI Buckingham，这是一个从物理问题和观测数据的自然语言描述中自主无量纲发现的代理框架。它将大型语言模型 (LLM) 的推理和规划与预定义的符号和数字工具结合起来。基于文献的知识检索支持维度检查，基于梯度的聚类识别物理状态，而互信息为识别主导无量纲组提供了客观的、重新参数化不变的标准。明确的数字标准确定组数并简化评估。在涵盖流体动力学、磁流体动力学、热对流和增材制造的十个物理系统中，AI Buckingham 恢复了已建立的相似性表示并解决了与状态相关的缩放问题。针对预测粗糙表面上的湍流阻力这一长期挑战，它确定了表面统计信息的重新参数化，从而改进了面向工程的阻力建模的等效沙粒粗糙度估计。

articles.title: Formation of Electron Velocity Distribution Functions at low-beta Quasi-Perpendicular Shocks From Physical-Mass-Ratio PIC Simulations
articles.title_zh: 从物理质量比 PIC 模拟中形成低贝塔准垂直激波下的电子速度分布函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At low-beta quasi-perpendicular shocks, the origins of upstream field-aligned electron beams and downstream flat-top distributions remain unresolved. Using 2D fully kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations at the physical ion-to-electron mass ratio (mi/me = 1836), we found that the shock transition region is dominated by electromagnetic whistler-mode turbulence driven by the modified two-stream instability (MTSI) of reflected ions, not by the electrostatic instabilities as suggested by some previous studies using a reduced mass ratio. Beams in the upstream are produced mainly by shock-drift acceleration (SDA) at the ramp, whereas we attribute the downstream flat-top distributions to nonuniform acceleration by the parallel electric field. Electrons experience different field strengths, polarities, and interaction durations along their trajectories, leading to a spread of parallel velocity changes that broadens and flattens the distribution. These results highlight the importance of using the physical mass ratio in exploring the electron dynamics of low-beta shocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 在低β准垂直激波下，上游场对准电子束和下游平顶分布的起源仍未解决。使用物理离子与电子质量比 (mi/me = 1836) 下的二维全动力学粒子内细胞 (PIC) 模拟，我们发现激波转变区域主要由电磁哨声模式湍流主导，该湍流由反射离子的修正双流不稳定性 (MTSI) 驱动，而不是像之前一些使用降低的质量比的研究所表明的那样由静电不稳定性驱动。上游的光束主要是由斜坡上的冲击漂移加速度（SDA）产生的，而我们将下游的平顶分布归因于平行电场的不均匀加速。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在低β准垂直激波下，上游场对准电子束和下游平顶分布的起源仍未解决。使用物理离子与电子质量比 (mi/me = 1836) 下的二维全动力学粒子内细胞 (PIC) 模拟，我们发现激波转变区域主要由电磁哨声模式湍流主导，该湍流由反射离子的修正双流不稳定性 (MTSI) 驱动，而不是像之前一些使用降低的质量比的研究所表明的那样由静电不稳定性驱动。上游的光束主要是由斜坡上的冲击漂移加速度（SDA）产生的，而我们将下游的平顶分布归因于平行电场的不均匀加速。电子沿着其轨迹经历不同的场强、极性和相互作用持续时间，导致平行速度变化的扩散，从而使分布变宽和变平。这些结果强调了使用物理质量比在探索低β激波的电子动力学中的重要性。

articles.title: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography Using Deep Learning-Assisted Amplitude Estimation
articles.title_zh: 使用深度学习辅助振幅估计的梯度光学衍射断层扫描
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography (GODT) enables the non-invasive reconstruction of a spatial derivative of the 3D sample's refractive index distribution, providing enhanced sensitivity to subtle refractive index variations through gradient-based contrast. Implemented using lateral shearing interferometry (LSI), GODT benefits from a common-path architecture that provides environmental stability and high signal-to-noise ratio measurements. Unlike conventional optical diffraction tomography (ODT), which requires numerical integration of LSI-derived phase gradients to recover the object phase, GODT enables direct tomographic reconstruction from the LSI data. Notably, GODT requires derivatives of both the phase and amplitude of the object fields as input. While the phase derivative can be readily extracted from LSI data, the amplitude gradient cannot be directly retrieved. Thus, in the original GODT formulation, the amplitude gradient was assumed to be negligible, limiting the accuracy of the resulting 3D reconstruction. In this work, we introduce amplitude-informed GODT (AI-GODT), which employs physics-informed supervised deep learning to estimate the missing amplitude gradient based on accessible LSI data, specifically the fringe modulation. The proposed approach, applying a ResNet architecture and training on computer-generated data, is validated through numerical simulation and experimental measurements of both a well-characterized test object and primary neuronal cell culture, demonstrating the network's ability to generalize to diverse samples. We show that incorporation of the recovered amplitude gradient into the GODT reconstruction pipeline improves the 3D reconstruction quality, especially in its out-of-focus regions. The software and datasets are openly available to facilitate reproducibility and further development.
articles.abstract_zh: 梯度光学衍射断层扫描 (GODT) 能够对 3D 样品折射率分布的空间导数进行非侵入性重建，通过基于梯度的对比度增强对细微折射率变化的灵敏度。 GODT 使用横向剪切干涉测量 (LSI) 实现，受益于可提供环境稳定性和高信噪比测量的共路径架构。传统的光学衍射断层扫描 (ODT) 需要对 LSI 导出的相位梯度进行数值积分以恢复物相，而 GODT 则不同，它可以从 LSI 数据直接进行断层扫描重建。值得注意的是，GODT 需要物场的相位和幅度的导数作为输入。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 梯度光学衍射断层扫描 (GODT) 能够对 3D 样品折射率分布的空间导数进行非侵入性重建，通过基于梯度的对比度增强对细微折射率变化的灵敏度。 GODT 使用横向剪切干涉测量 (LSI) 实现，受益于可提供环境稳定性和高信噪比测量的共路径架构。传统的光学衍射断层扫描 (ODT) 需要对 LSI 导出的相位梯度进行数值积分以恢复物相，而 GODT 则不同，它可以从 LSI 数据直接进行断层扫描重建。值得注意的是，GODT 需要物场的相位和幅度的导数作为输入。虽然可以很容易地从 LSI 数据中提取相位导数，但不能直接检索幅度梯度。因此，在最初的 GODT 公式中，假设幅度梯度可以忽略不计，从而限制了最终 3D 重建的准确性。在这项工作中，我们引入了振幅通知 GODT (AI-GODT)，它采用物理通知的监督深度学习来根据可访问的 LSI 数据（特别是边缘调制）来估计缺失的振幅梯度。所提出的方法应用 ResNet 架构并对计算机生成的数据进行训练，通过数值模拟和对充分表征的测试对象和原代神经元细胞培养物的实验测量进行验证，证明了网络泛化到不同样本的能力。我们表明，将恢复的幅度梯度合并到 GODT 重建管道中可以提高 3D 重建质量，尤其是在失焦区域。该软件和数据集是公开可用的，以促进再现性和进一步开发。

articles.title: Minimum Effective-Susceptibility Bounds for Arbitrary Polarization Transformations in Metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 超表面中任意偏振变换的最小有效磁化率界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metasurfaces are increasingly employed for sophisticated polarization transformations, including general unitary and nonunitary Jones operations. Despite substantial advances in analytical synthesis methods, inverse design of these transformations remains challenging. Here, we show that the particular mathematical structure of Jones polarization transformations makes optimal effective-susceptibility synthesis analytically tractable within the generalized sheet transition condition (GSTC) framework. For reciprocal, lossless dipolar metasurfaces, we establish exact feasibility and global minimum attainment, and derive sharp effective-susceptibility bounds for representative unitary and nonunitary transformations. We identify when magnetoelectric coupling lowers the minimum susceptibility, when it offers no resource advantage, and how the required material response depends on the prescribed polarization transformation. Applications to polarization rotations, tunable compensators, and polarization-state separation, including unambiguous discrimination, demonstrate sharp physical limits and material-resource trade-offs. These results provide geometry-independent theoretical benchmarks that can guide numerical inverse design and the selection of metasurface architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 超表面越来越多地用于复杂的偏振变换，包括一般的酉和非酉琼斯运算。尽管分析合成方法取得了巨大进步，但这些转换的逆向设计仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明了琼斯偏振变换的特殊数学结构使得最佳有效磁化率合成在广义片转变条件（GSTC）框架内易于分析处理。对于互易的、无损偶极超表面，我们建立了精确的可行性和全局最小达到，并为代表性的酉和非酉变换导出了尖锐的有效磁化率界限。我们确定磁电耦合何时降低最小磁化率，何时不提供资源优势，以及所需的材料响应如何取决于规定的极化变换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超表面越来越多地用于复杂的偏振变换，包括一般的酉和非酉琼斯运算。尽管分析合成方法取得了巨大进步，但这些转换的逆向设计仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明了琼斯偏振变换的特殊数学结构使得最佳有效磁化率合成在广义片转变条件（GSTC）框架内易于分析处理。对于互易的、无损偶极超表面，我们建立了精确的可行性和全局最小达到，并为代表性的酉和非酉变换导出了尖锐的有效磁化率界限。我们确定磁电耦合何时降低最小磁化率，何时不提供资源优势，以及所需的材料响应如何取决于规定的极化变换。偏振旋转、可调补偿器和偏振态分离（包括明确的辨别）的应用表明了尖锐的物理限制和材料资源权衡。这些结果提供了与几何无关的理论基准，可以指导数值逆设计和超表面架构的选择。

articles.title: PineIR: 3D molecular structures from an infrared spectrum alone
articles.title_zh: PineIR：仅来自红外光谱的 3D 分子结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing the infrared (IR) spectrum of a molecule from its structure is routine. The inverse problem is not. In practice, IR spectra are used to identify the functional groups present in a molecule, while the determination of its complete structure requires additional measurements. Machine-learning models that return 3D structures from IR spectra exist, but all of them need extra input, such as Raman, ultraviolet or nuclear magnetic resonance spectra, the molecular formula, or the number of atoms. In this work we present PineIR, a generative model that returns 3D molecular structures from the IR spectrum alone. PineIR builds the molecule atom by atom, and each atom is associated with its contribution to the IR spectrum. This contribution is subtracted from the input spectrum before the next atom is generated. To train it, we computed with a machine-learned interatomic potential the IR spectra of 4.6 million structures of 3.1 million molecules, including conformer ensembles. On computed spectra of held-out molecules, the best-ranked of fifty candidates has the correct connectivity in 43% of the cases, and the generated geometries reproduce the conformer and the diastereomer that produced the input spectrum. After fine-tuning on 161k spectra calculated with the hybrid functional B3LYP, the model can also be applied to spectra at this level of theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 根据分子结构计算分子的红外 (IR) 光谱是常规做法。反问题则不然。在实践中，红外光谱用于识别分子中存在的官能团，而确定其完整结构则需要额外的测量。存在从红外光谱返回 3D 结构的机器学习模型，但所有这些模型都需要额外的输入，例如拉曼、紫外或核磁共振光谱、分子式或原子数。在这项工作中，我们提出了 PineIR，这是一种仅从红外光谱返回 3D 分子结构的生成模型。 PineIR 逐个原子地构建分子，每个原子都与其对红外光谱的贡献相关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 根据分子结构计算分子的红外 (IR) 光谱是常规做法。反问题则不然。在实践中，红外光谱用于识别分子中存在的官能团，而确定其完整结构则需要额外的测量。存在从红外光谱返回 3D 结构的机器学习模型，但所有这些模型都需要额外的输入，例如拉曼、紫外或核磁共振光谱、分子式或原子数。在这项工作中，我们提出了 PineIR，这是一种仅从红外光谱返回 3D 分子结构的生成模型。 PineIR 逐个原子地构建分子，每个原子都与其对红外光谱的贡献相关联。在生成下一个原子之前，从输入光谱中减去该贡献。为了训练它，我们使用机器学习的原子间势计算了 310 万个分子的 460 万个结构的红外光谱，其中包括构象异构体系综。在保留分子的计算光谱上，排名最好的 50 个候选分子在 43% 的情况下具有正确的连接性，并且生成的几何形状再现了产生输入光谱的构象异构体和非对映异构体。在对混合泛函 B3LYP 计算的 161k 光谱进行微调后，该模型也可以应用于该理论水平的光谱。

articles.title: Angular dependence of the Wigner time delay upon tunnel ionization of CO
articles.title_zh: 维格纳时间延迟对 CO 隧道电离的角度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on Wigner time delays in the strong-field ionization of carbon monoxide. Using co-rotating two-color laser fields (395 and 790 nm), we retrieve time delays that depend on the electron emission direction in the molecular frame, with variations of up to ±70 as. The measured angular dependence agrees with predictions from a simple model based on molecular Ammosov-Delone-Krainov (MO-ADK) theory. Our results demonstrate that the directional dependence of electron emission times in asymmetric molecular potentials can be experimentally accessed in the strong-field regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一氧化碳强场电离的维格纳时间延迟。使用同向旋转的双色激光场（395 和 790 nm），我们检索了取决于分子框架中电子发射方向的时间延迟，变化高达 ±70 as。测量的角度依赖性与基于分子 Ammosov-Delone-Krainov (MO-ADK) 理论的简单模型的预测一致。我们的结果表明，不对称分子势中电子发射时间的方向依赖性可以在强场状态下通过实验获得。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一氧化碳强场电离的维格纳时间延迟。使用同向旋转的双色激光场（395 和 790 nm），我们检索了取决于分子框架中电子发射方向的时间延迟，变化高达 ±70 as。测量的角度依赖性与基于分子 Ammosov-Delone-Krainov (MO-ADK) 理论的简单模型的预测一致。我们的结果表明，不对称分子势中电子发射时间的方向依赖性可以在强场状态下通过实验获得。

articles.title: Optimization of a Locally Shielded 16-Channel Transmit Array for Human Brain MRI at 10.5 T via Electromagnetic/Circuit Co-Simulation and Parallel Transmission Strategies
articles.title_zh: 通过电磁/电路联合仿真和并行传输策略优化用于 10.5 T 人脑 MRI 的局部屏蔽 16 通道传输阵列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern neuroimaging and neuroscience increasingly demand high spatial and temporal resolution, driving the use of ultrahigh-field (7 T and above) MRI for improved signal-to-noise ratio. Realizing this advantage depends critically on advanced radiofrequency (RF) and gradient technologies, particularly multi-channel transmit arrays and high-performance head-gradient systems. In integrated systems, a local RF shield must provide sufficient field confinement while preserving transmit performance and minimizing sensitivity to nearby conductive structures. In this work, we sought to optimize a locally shielded 16-channel transmit RF array for human neuroimaging at 10.5 T using electromagnetic/circuit co-simulation combined with parallel-transmission strategies. Candidate transmit-array and RF-shield configurations were evaluated before and after gradient-shield integration to identify a configuration with suitable RF transmit and shielding performance for the integrated system. The results show that no single standalone metric, including static RF shimming performance, dynamic parallel transmission (pTx) performance, or external-field leakage, reliably predicts robustness after gradient-shield integration. Progressive screening identified the aligned loop-folded dipole (LFD) array combined with a compact cylindrical shield featuring a conical top and three windows (160-mm radius and 70-mm window length) as the final configuration. Without RF-circuit retuning, the selected design maintained external-field leakage below 1% and after gradient shield integration achieved whole-brain excitation coefficient of variation (CoV) of approximately 27% with static RF shimming and 9% with dynamic pTx. Experimental validation of the unshielded LFD array showed good agreement between simulated and measured B1+ efficiency distributions, with a normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) of approximately 8%.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代神经影像和神经科学越来越需要高空间和时间分辨率，推动使用超高场（7 T 及以上）MRI 来提高信噪比。实现这一优势关键取决于先进的射频 (RF) 和梯度技术，特别是多通道发射阵列和高性能头部梯度系统。在集成系统中，局部射频屏蔽必须提供足够的场限制，同时保持传输性能并最大限度地降低对附近导电结构的敏感性。在这项工作中，我们寻求使用电磁/电路协同仿真与并行传输策略相结合，优化用于 10.5 T 人体神经成像的局部屏蔽 16 通道发射射频阵列。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代神经影像和神经科学越来越需要高空间和时间分辨率，推动使用超高场（7 T 及以上）MRI 来提高信噪比。实现这一优势关键取决于先进的射频 (RF) 和梯度技术，特别是多通道发射阵列和高性能头部梯度系统。在集成系统中，局部射频屏蔽必须提供足够的场限制，同时保持传输性能并最大限度地降低对附近导电结构的敏感性。在这项工作中，我们寻求使用电磁/电路协同仿真与并行传输策略相结合，优化用于 10.5 T 人体神经成像的局部屏蔽 16 通道发射射频阵列。在梯度屏蔽集成之前和之后对候选发射阵列和射频屏蔽配置进行了评估，以确定具有适合集成系统的射频发射和屏蔽性能的配置。结果表明，没有任何单一的独立指标，包括静态射频匀场性能、动态并行传输 (pTx) 性能或外场泄漏，能够可靠地预测梯度屏蔽集成后的鲁棒性。渐进筛选确定了对齐的环折叠偶极子 (LFD) 阵列与紧凑的圆柱形屏蔽相结合，该屏蔽具有圆锥形顶部和三个窗口（半径为 160 毫米，窗口长度为 70 毫米）作为最终配置。在没有射频电路重新调谐的情况下，所选设计将外场泄漏保持在 1% 以下，并且在梯度屏蔽集成后，静态射频匀场的全脑激励变异系数 (CoV) 约为 27%，动态 pTx 的全脑激励变异系数 (CoV) 约为 9%。非屏蔽 LFD 阵列的实验验证表明，模拟和测量的 B1+ 效率分布之间具有良好的一致性，归一化均方根误差 (NRMSE) 约为 8%。

articles.title: Full-waveform inversion with adaptive anisotropic Gaussian primitives
articles.title_zh: 使用自适应各向异性高斯原语的全波形反演
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reparameterizing the velocity model has emerged as an effective way to regularize full-waveform inversion (FWI) and reduce its sensitivity to the starting model. Existing parameterizations, however, either fix the position and shape of every basis function in advance, as in grids and splines, or control the spatial structure of their updates only indirectly through the shared weights of a neural network. We propose Gauss-FWI, which represents the velocity perturbation as a sum of anisotropic Gaussian primitives with learnable amplitudes, centres, scales, and orientations. The basis itself thus adapts to the subsurface. Primitives move onto interfaces, stretch along layers, and rotate with the dip, so model updates follow the geological structure without a hand-designed regularizer. A gradient-energy criterion adds finer zero-amplitude primitives where the data call for more detail, increasing resolution progressively without perturbing the current model. All parameters receive analytic gradients through the adjoint-state method on a fixed simulation grid, so the representation fits into existing FWI workflows and combines directly with frequency continuation. Each primitive keeps an explicit position, extent, and orientation, and the representation Jacobian links the waveform gradient to the resulting model update, which makes the behaviour of the inversion interpretable. In two-dimensional acoustic examples, Gauss-FWI uses about fifty times fewer parameters than implicit FWI and recovers the Marmousi, Overthrust, and BP salt models more accurately than grid, multiscale, B-spline, and implicit parameterizations. It remains accurate under missing low frequencies, noise, and discretization mismatch, and it recovers the main structure from starting models where the other methods fail, such as a linear model without the BP salt body.
articles.abstract_zh: 重新参数化速度模型已成为规范全波形反演（FWI）并降低其对起始模型的敏感性的有效方法。然而，现有的参数化要么提前固定每个基函数的位置和形状，如网格和样条曲线，要么仅通过神经网络的共享权重间接控制其更新的空间结构。我们提出了 Gauss-FWI，它将速度扰动表示为具有可学习幅度、中心、尺度和方向的各向异性高斯基元的总和。因此，基础本身会适应地下。基元移动到界面上，沿层拉伸并随倾角旋转，因此模型更新遵循地质结构，无需手工设计的正则化器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 重新参数化速度模型已成为规范全波形反演（FWI）并降低其对起始模型的敏感性的有效方法。然而，现有的参数化要么提前固定每个基函数的位置和形状，如网格和样条曲线，要么仅通过神经网络的共享权重间接控制其更新的空间结构。我们提出了 Gauss-FWI，它将速度扰动表示为具有可学习幅度、中心、尺度和方向的各向异性高斯基元的总和。因此，基础本身会适应地下。基元移动到界面上，沿层拉伸并随倾角旋转，因此模型更新遵循地质结构，无需手工设计的正则化器。梯度能量标准添加了更精细的零幅度基元，其中数据需要更多细节，从而在不干扰当前模型的情况下逐步提高分辨率。所有参数都通过固定模拟网格上的伴随状态方法接收解析梯度，因此该表示适合现有的 FWI 工作流程并直接与频率延续相结合。每个基元都保留明确的位置、范围和方向，并且雅可比行列式将波形梯度链接到结果模型更新，这使得反演的行为可解释。在二维声学示例中，Gauss-FWI 使用的参数比隐式 FWI 少约 50 倍，并且比网格、多尺度、B 样条和隐式参数化更准确地恢复 Marmousi、Overthrust 和 BP 盐模型。它在丢失低频、噪声和离散化失配的情况下仍然保持准确，并且从其他方法失败的起始模型中恢复主要结构，例如没有 BP 盐体的线性模型。

articles.title: Theory of Observability of Voigt-Wave Propagation in a Homogeneous Dielectric Material
articles.title_zh: 均匀介电材料中伏伊特波传播的可观测性理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Voigt wave can propagate in a dissipative anisotropic dielectric material when a 4×4 propagation matrix is defective, as happens for a uniform plane wave along a singular axis, and the field depends on the propagation distance linearly as well as exponentially. Whether it is observable outside a slab of that material generally depends on whether the defectiveness is inherited by the 2×2 reflection and transmission matrices, which are extracted from the 2×2 blocks of a 4×4 transfer matrix that relates the fields at the two faces of the slab. Explicit tests exist for each type of defectiveness, and a counting argument shows that excitation and observability co-occur at oblique incidence only for isolated combinations of constitutive parameters and slab thickness. Normal incidence is exceptional: Voigt-wave excitation then generally implies a defective transmission matrix for almost all thicknesses, which explains Voigt's 1902 experiment on andalusite. Numerical searches for andalusite, β-gallium oxide, terbium orthoaluminate in a magnetostatic field, and hexagonal boron nitride show that a Voigt wave may be excited without being observable and that a defective reflection or transmission matrix need not signal the excitation of a Voigt wave.
articles.abstract_zh: 当 4×4 传播矩阵有缺陷时，福伊特波可以在耗散各向异性介电材料中传播，就像沿奇异轴的均匀平面波所发生的情况一样，并且场与传播距离呈线性和指数关系。是否可以在该材料的板外观察到该缺陷通常取决于缺陷是否由 2×2 反射和透射矩阵继承，这些矩阵是从与板两个面的场相关的 4×4 传输矩阵的 2×2 块中提取的。每种类型的缺陷都存在显式测试，并且计数论证表明，仅对于本构参数和板厚度的孤立组合，激励和可观测性在斜入射时同时发生。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当 4×4 传播矩阵有缺陷时，福伊特波可以在耗散各向异性介电材料中传播，就像沿奇异轴的均匀平面波所发生的情况一样，并且场与传播距离呈线性和指数关系。是否可以在该材料的板外观察到该缺陷通常取决于缺陷是否由 2×2 反射和透射矩阵继承，这些矩阵是从与板两个面的场相关的 4×4 传输矩阵的 2×2 块中提取的。每种类型的缺陷都存在显式测试，并且计数论证表明，仅对于本构参数和板厚度的孤立组合，激励和可观测性在斜入射时同时发生。垂直入射是例外：Voigt 波激励通常意味着几乎所有厚度的传输矩阵都有缺陷，这解释了 Voigt 1902 年对红柱石的实验。对静磁场中的红柱石、β-氧化镓、原铝酸铽和六方氮化硼的数值搜索表明，福伊特波可能在无法观察到的情况下被激发，并且有缺陷的反射或传输矩阵不需要发出福伊特波激发的信号。

articles.title: Automatic dual basis sets for self-consistent field calculations
articles.title_zh: 用于自洽场计算的自动双基组
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) has long been the workhorse of electronic structure theory, and it is experiencing a new boom thanks to big data applications and machine learning. A DFT calculation requires the iterative solution of the self-consistent field (SCF) problem, whose cost is the product of (i) the number of SCF steps and (ii) the cost of a single step. The number of SCF steps depends strongly on the initial guess, regardless of the SCF algorithm, and quantitative DFT accuracy is known to require at least a polarized triple-ζ basis set. However, a qualitatively correct solution may often be found already in a smaller emphdual basis (DB), which can then bootstrap a calculation in the full basis set. Traditionally, the DB is chosen by hand for each application to enable robust convergence to the ground state. In this work, we pursue automatic generation of DBs for SCF calculations. Our generator constructs a pruned orbital basis from the target orbital basis for a predefined precision threshold and a given Fock matrix. As expected, the larger the basis set is, the smaller the fraction of kept basis functions. The DBs produced by our algorithm exhibit similar performance for a wide range of systems from the first 4 periods of the periodic table. Ultimately, we find that presently available initial guesses for the Fock matrix are not accurate enough to unlock the use of adaptive basis sets, and believe that the same limitation may hold for similar attempts for basis compactification.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）长期以来一直是电子结构理论的主力，由于大数据应用和机器学习，它正在经历新的繁荣。 DFT 计算需要迭代解决自洽场 (SCF) 问题，其成本是 (i) SCF 步骤数和 (ii) 单步成本的乘积。无论 SCF 算法如何，SCF 步骤的数量在很大程度上取决于初始猜测，并且已知定量 DFT 精度至少需要一个极化三重 z 基组。然而，通常可以在较小的 emphdual 基 (DB) 中找到定性正确的解决方案，然后可以在完整基组中引导计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论（DFT）长期以来一直是电子结构理论的主力，由于大数据应用和机器学习，它正在经历新的繁荣。 DFT 计算需要迭代解决自洽场 (SCF) 问题，其成本是 (i) SCF 步骤数和 (ii) 单步成本的乘积。无论 SCF 算法如何，SCF 步骤的数量在很大程度上取决于初始猜测，并且已知定量 DFT 精度至少需要一个极化三重 z 基组。然而，通常可以在较小的 emphdual 基 (DB) 中找到定性正确的解决方案，然后可以在完整基组中引导计算。传统上，数据库是为每个应用手动选择的，以实现稳健地收敛到基态。在这项工作中，我们追求自动生成用于 SCF 计算的 DB。我们的生成器根据预定义精度阈值和给定 Fock 矩阵的目标轨道基构造修剪轨道基。正如预期的那样，基组越大，保留基函数的比例就越小。对于周期表前 4 个周期的各种系统，我们的算法生成的 DB 表现出相似的性能。最终，我们发现目前对 Fock 矩阵的初始猜测不够准确，无法解锁自适应基组的使用，并且相信对于基压缩的类似尝试可能存在相同的限制。

articles.title: Observation of a Förster Resonance in a Heated Rydberg Atom Ensemble
articles.title_zh: 加热里德伯原子系综中福斯特共振的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg atoms in thermal vapour are of increasing relevance for a range of emerging technologies including compact electric field sensors, where state energies are detected via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT). However, at increased atomic number densities, the Rydberg EIT response becomes non-linear, resulting in distortion of the spectral lineshape. It is thought that this non-linearity mainly arises due to ionisation, although accurate quantitative modelling of the spectrum and assessment of other physical processes remains challenging. In this work, we address these issues in a combined theoretical and experimental study, constructing a model that accurately reproduces observed EIT spectral profiles. We show from analysis of lineshape shifts that while ionisation accounts for most of the non-linearity, it is also possible to observe Rydberg interaction effects for strongly-coupled states near a Förster resonance.
articles.abstract_zh: 热蒸汽中的里德伯原子对于一系列新兴技术越来越重要，包括紧凑型电场传感器，其中通过电磁感应透明（EIT）检测状态能量。然而，随着原子序数密度的增加，里德堡 EIT 响应变得非线性，导致光谱线形失真。人们认为这种非线性主要是由于电离引起的，尽管准确的光谱定量建模和其他物理过程的评估仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们通过理论和实验相结合的研究来解决这些问题，构建了一个模型，可以准确地再现观察到的 EIT 光谱轮廓。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热蒸汽中的里德伯原子对于一系列新兴技术越来越重要，包括紧凑型电场传感器，其中通过电磁感应透明（EIT）检测状态能量。然而，随着原子序数密度的增加，里德堡 EIT 响应变得非线性，导致光谱线形失真。人们认为这种非线性主要是由于电离引起的，尽管准确的光谱定量建模和其他物理过程的评估仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们通过理论和实验相结合的研究来解决这些问题，构建了一个模型，可以准确地再现观察到的 EIT 光谱轮廓。我们通过线形变化的分析表明，虽然电离解释了大部分非线性，但也可以观察到福斯特共振附近强耦合态的里德伯相互作用效应。

articles.title: A general-purpose electron density model for molecular chemistry
articles.title_zh: 分子化学的通用电子密度模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learning potentials predict molecular structure and stability at the accuracy of quantum mechanics, for a fraction of the cost. Properties derived instead from knowledge of the electronic structure give profound insights into chemical reactivity, but are not accessible with the same ease or transferability. We train PET-rho-OMol25, a model of the ground-state electron density and spin polarization of molecular systems on four million OMol25 structures in multiple charge and spin states. The model makes predictions for entire proteins in a few seconds on a single GPU, and enables estimation of important diagnostics of molecular structure and reactivity, such as vibrational Stark measurements, halogen σ-holes, hydrogen-bond basicities and core-level shifts, as well as spin density for redox chemistry and magnetism. PET-rho-OMol25 has an accuracy close to density-functional theory, with its least reliable predictions flagged by its built-in uncertainty estimator, for most properties and classes of compounds. It can be used as a drop-in replacement for electronic-structure calculations of the density, making insightful analyses available for larger and more complex structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习潜力可以以量子力学的精度预测分子结构和稳定性，而成本却很低。来自电子结构知识的属性可以对化学反应性提供深刻的见解，但无法以同样的容易性或可转移性获得。我们在 400 万个处于多种电荷和自旋状态的 OMol25 结构上训练 PET-rho-OMol25，这是分子系统的基态电子密度和自旋极化模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习潜力可以以量子力学的精度预测分子结构和稳定性，而成本却很低。来自电子结构知识的属性可以对化学反应性提供深刻的见解，但无法以同样的容易性或可转移性获得。我们在 400 万个处于多种电荷和自旋状态的 OMol25 结构上训练 PET-rho-OMol25，这是分子系统的基态电子密度和自旋极化模型。该模型可以在单个 GPU 上在几秒钟内对整个蛋白质进行预测，并能够估计分子结构和反应性的重要诊断，例如振动 Stark 测量、卤素 σ 孔、氢键碱度和核心能级变化，以及氧化还原化学和磁性的自旋密度。 PET-rho-OMol25 的精度接近密度泛函理论，对于大多数化合物的性质和类别，其内置的不确定性估计器会标记出最不可靠的预测。它可以用作密度电子结构计算的直接替代品，为更大、更复杂的结构提供深入的分析。

articles.title: Plasma transport by carrier electrons: Nernst advection beyond the heat-flow analogy due to kinetic stress
articles.title_zh: 载流子电子的等离子体传输：由于动应力而超越热流类比的能斯特平流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nernst advection of magnetic fields down temperature gradients is lowered by kinetic stress from the underlineunderlinef₂ electron distribution harmonic, which allows fluxes to stream past one another without isotropizing their lateral momentum. The long-held tie between heat-flow and Nernst advection is disrupted. When the distance between electron collisions is comparable to the magnetic field length-scale L_B, the kinetic stress affects magnetic transport in plasmas otherwise regarded as classical. This is from carrier electrons being deflected back and forth over the course of their trajectory. The field structure Knudsen number is defined: Kn_B=14.8fracλₑᵢL_BfracZ+0.40Z+4.86, with Nernst velocity halved by kinetic effects at Kn_B=1. The kinetic stress is relocalized by magnetization, following the relocalization of heat-flux. Righi-Leduc heat-flow is found to be similarly suppressed by kinetic stress. The linear results of this paper are found to faithfully represent the non-linear evolution of magnetic field at a heat-front, indicating that low-Z plasmas throughout magnetized-HED are demagnetized more slowly than previously anticipated.
articles.abstract_zh: 沿着温度梯度的磁场的能斯特平流被下划线下划线f2电子分布谐波的动应力降低，这使得磁通量可以彼此流过，而不会使其横向动量各向同性。热流与能斯特平流之间长期存在的联系被打破了。当电子碰撞之间的距离与磁场长度尺度 L_B 相当时，动应力会影响等离子体中的磁输运，否则被视为经典等离子体。这是由于载流子电子在其轨迹过程中来回偏转。场结构克努森数定义为：Kn_B=14.8fracλₑᵢL_BfracZ+0.40Z+4.86，Kn_B=1 时能斯特速度因动力学效应减半。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沿着温度梯度的磁场的能斯特平流被下划线下划线f2电子分布谐波的动应力降低，这使得磁通量可以彼此流过，而不会使其横向动量各向同性。热流与能斯特平流之间长期存在的联系被打破了。当电子碰撞之间的距离与磁场长度尺度 L_B 相当时，动应力会影响等离子体中的磁输运，否则被视为经典等离子体。这是由于载流子电子在其轨迹过程中来回偏转。场结构克努森数定义为：Kn_B=14.8fracλₑᵢL_BfracZ+0.40Z+4.86，Kn_B=1 时能斯特速度因动力学效应减半。随着热通量的重新定位，动应力通过磁化重新定位。人们发现里吉-勒杜克热流同样受到动应力的抑制。我们发现本文的线性结果忠实地代表了热锋处磁场的非线性演化，表明整个磁化 HED 中的低 Z 等离子体的退磁速度比之前预期的要慢。

articles.title: A Reconfigurable Four-State Sensor Based on Orthogonal Thermal and Chemical Stimuli
articles.title_zh: 基于正交热和化学刺激的可重构四态传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article presents a novel four-state refractive index (RI) sensor based on distinct phases of palladium (Pd) and vanadium dioxide (VO₂), controlled by orthogonal thermal and chemical stimuli. This is a numerical, simulation-only study: all results are obtained from two-dimensional finite-element method (FEM) simulations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported multi-state reconfigurable RI sensor tuned by external control. VO₂ serves as a phase change material (PCM) offering two thermally switchable phases with highly contrasting optical properties, while the hydrogen absorption property of Pd provides two additional phases. Combining these, four operational states are realized: (i) α-Pd/low-T VO₂; (ii) β-PdHₓ/low-T VO₂; (iii) α-Pd/high-T VO₂; and (iv) β-PdHₓ/high-T VO₂. Thermal crosstalk between Pd and VO₂ is mitigated through tungsten (W) doping of VO₂. This work further introduces conditional state sensitivity (CSS), a novel figure of merit quantifying the optical contrast between each state transition. The proposed sensor achieves a peak sensitivity of 2871 nm/RIU for the undoped reference configuration and 2798 nm/RIU for the practical W-doped device, together with a peak CSS of 16,872 nm/RIU, establishing it as a multi-state reconfigurable platform with reduced thermal crosstalk and potential applications in industrial safety monitoring and optical logic gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新型四态折射率 (RI) 传感器，该传感器基于不同相的钯 (Pd) 和二氧化钒 (VO2)，由正交热和化学刺激控制。这是一项纯数值模拟研究：所有结果均通过二维有限元法 (FEM) 模拟获得。据我们所知，这是第一个报道的由外部控制调节的多状态可重构 RI 传感器。 VO2 作为相变材料 (PCM)，提供两个具有高度对比光学特性的热可切换相，而 Pd 的氢吸收特性则提供两个额外的相。结合这些，实现了四种操作状态：(i) α-Pd/低-T VO2；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种新型四态折射率 (RI) 传感器，该传感器基于不同相的钯 (Pd) 和二氧化钒 (VO2)，由正交热和化学刺激控制。这是一项纯数值模拟研究：所有结果均通过二维有限元法 (FEM) 模拟获得。据我们所知，这是第一个报道的由外部控制调节的多状态可重构 RI 传感器。 VO2 作为相变材料 (PCM)，提供两个具有高度对比光学特性的热可切换相，而 Pd 的氢吸收特性则提供两个额外的相。结合这些，实现了四种操作状态：(i) α-Pd/低-T VO2； (ii) β-PdHₓ/低-T VO2； (iii) α-Pd/高-T VO2； (iv) β-PdHₓ/高-T VO2。通过 VO2 中的钨 (W) 掺杂，可以减轻 Pd 和 VO2 之间的热串扰。这项工作进一步介绍了条件状态灵敏度（CSS），这是一种量化每个状态转换之间光学对比度的新颖品质因数。所提出的传感器在未掺杂参考配置中实现了 2871 nm/RIU 的峰值灵敏度，在实际 W 掺杂器件中实现了 2798 nm/RIU 的峰值灵敏度，以及 16,872 nm/RIU 的峰值 CSS，使其成为具有减少热串扰的多状态可重构平台，并在工业安全监控和光逻辑门中具有潜在应用。

articles.title: How Many Keys Must a Quantum Computer Break to Take Over a Blockchain? A Quantum Nakamoto Coefficient for Fifteen Proof-of-Stake Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机必须破解多少个密钥才能接管区块链？十五个权益证明网络的量子中本聪系数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33413v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Blockchains that run on proof of stake, among them Ethereum and Solana, are secured by a vote: a transaction becomes irreversible once computers holding two thirds of the deposited money have signed it. Each signature is made with a secret key whose public counterpart is permanently visible, and a large quantum computer could compute the secret from the public key. We ask a simple question: how many such keys would it have to break to take over the vote? We call the answer the quantum Nakamoto coefficient and measure it on live data from fifteen networks, collected on 15 November 2026. For fourteen of them, 2 to 18 keys are enough to break the network's security guarantee and 7 to 77 to control it outright; at one key every 12 minutes, the pace implied by recent resource estimates, a single quantum computer would defeat the guarantee of any of these networks in less than four hours and take full control in less than sixteen hours. Ethereum is far more robust, but a 2025 change that lets operators merge their deposits into fewer keys has cut the number of keys at its first threshold from about 465,000 to 7,682, a factor of 60. We derive a simple formula for this effect, and another for the small rotating committee on which wallets rely, and confirm both on the data. For fourteen of the fifteen networks, the first large quantum computer would be less than a day away from total control. Their validator signatures should therefore be migrated to post-quantum schemes before such a machine exists, since once it does, the time to respond is measured in hours.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于权益证明运行的区块链（其中包括以太坊和 Solana）通过投票来保证安全：一旦持有三分之二存入资金的计算机签署了交易，交易就变得不可逆转。每个签名都是用一个秘密密钥制成的，其公共密钥永久可见，并且大型量子计算机可以根据公共密钥计算出秘密。我们问一个简单的问题：需要破解多少个这样的密钥才能接管投票？我们将答案称为量子中本聪系数，并根据 2026 年 11 月 15 日收集的 15 个网络的实时数据进行测量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于权益证明运行的区块链（其中包括以太坊和 Solana）通过投票来保证安全：一旦持有三分之二存入资金的计算机签署了交易，交易就变得不可逆转。每个签名都是用一个秘密密钥制成的，其公共密钥永久可见，并且大型量子计算机可以根据公共密钥计算出秘密。我们问一个简单的问题：需要破解多少个这样的密钥才能接管投票？我们将答案称为量子中本聪系数，并根据 2026 年 11 月 15 日收集的 15 个网络的实时数据进行测量。对于其中 14 个网络，2 到 18 个密钥足以打破网络的安全保证，7 到 77 个密钥足以彻底控制它；按照最近的资源估计所暗示的速度，每 12 分钟一个密钥，一台量子计算机将在不到 4 小时的时间内击败任何这些网络的保证，并在不到 16 小时的时间内完全控制。以太坊要强大得多，但 2025 年的一项改革允许运营商将存款合并到更少的密钥中，从而将第一个阈值的密钥数量从大约 465,000 个减少到 7,682 个，减少了 60 倍。我们为这种效果推导了一个简单的公式，并为钱包所依赖的小型轮换委员会推导了另一个公式，并根据数据确认了这两个公式。对于 15 个网络中的 14 个，第一台大型量子计算机将在不到一天的时间内实现完全控制。因此，在这样的机器存在之前，他们的验证器签名应该迁移到后量子方案，因为一旦实现，响应时间以小时为单位。

articles.title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
articles.title_zh: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围的光子轨道方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33953v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, ddotu = G(u, dotu), which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below 10⁻³ in u = rₛ/r (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 通常难以应对长视野领域，通常需要随着领域的增长对网络进行重新训练。我们提出了 PINN-Slicer，一种二阶自治常微分方程 ddotu = G(u, dotu) 的方法，它利用了此类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。嵌入在显式强制执行初始条件的解决方案 ansatz 中的单个 PINN，使用 Sobol 采样初始条件在自变量的薄片上进行训练。然后，PINN 会在整个域中逐片递归部署。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 通常难以应对长视野领域，通常需要随着领域的增长对网络进行重新训练。我们提出了 PINN-Slicer，一种二阶自治常微分方程 ddotu = G(u, dotu) 的方法，它利用了此类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。嵌入在显式强制执行初始条件的解决方案 ansatz 中的单个 PINN，使用 Sobol 采样初始条件在自变量的薄片上进行训练。然后，PINN 会在整个域中逐片递归部署。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上演示了 PINN-Slicer，并在 u = rₛ/r（以史瓦西半径为单位的逆径向坐标）中相对于有限差分参考解达到低于 10⁻3 的逐点均方根误差 (RMSE)。 PINN-Slicer 的一个关键优势是单个经过训练的网络可以推广到训练范围内的任何轨道初始条件，而无需重新训练。此外，PINN-Slicer 可以应对先验未知的解决方案领域。

articles.title: Quantum chaotic signature in non-empirical ensemble of DNA base pairs
articles.title_zh: DNA 碱基对非经验系综中的量子混沌特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The statistical study of many-body chaotic quantum systems would indicate important phenomena such as short-range level repulsion and long-range spectral rigidity. We investigate such behavior in an ensemble of gas-phase guanine-cytosine (GC) and adenine-thymine (AT) Watson-Crick (WC) base pairs by calculating their Kohn-Sham molecular orbital energy levels via ab initio density functional theory (DFT). We track the probability distribution, adjacent-gap ratios (AGR), number variance, and spectral compressibility of the unfolded level spacings to see whether their statistics follow the statistics of the eigenvalues of random matrices. After comparing the results to Poisson, semi-Poisson (SP), and Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE) statistics, it becomes evident that the statistics of orbital energy levels agree closely with the semi-Poisson distribution, pointing to an intermediate regime between integrability and chaos, characterized by level repulsion and strong long-range correlations. Potential biophysical implications for charge transfer and related biological processes are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体混沌量子系统的统计研究将表明诸如短程能级排斥和长程谱刚性等重要现象。我们通过从头算密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算 Kohn-Sham 分子轨道能级，研究气相鸟嘌呤-胞嘧啶 (GC) 和腺嘌呤-胸腺嘧啶 (AT) Watson-Crick (WC) 碱基对集合中的此类行为。我们跟踪展开水平间距的概率分布、相邻间隙比（AGR）、数量方差和谱压缩性，以查看它们的统计数据是否遵循随机矩阵特征值的统计数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体混沌量子系统的统计研究将表明诸如短程能级排斥和长程谱刚性等重要现象。我们通过从头算密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算 Kohn-Sham 分子轨道能级，研究气相鸟嘌呤-胞嘧啶 (GC) 和腺嘌呤-胸腺嘧啶 (AT) Watson-Crick (WC) 碱基对集合中的此类行为。我们跟踪展开水平间距的概率分布、相邻间隙比（AGR）、数量方差和谱压缩性，以查看它们的统计数据是否遵循随机矩阵特征值的统计数据。将结果与泊松、半泊松（SP）和高斯正交系综（GOE）统计数据进行比较后，很明显，轨道能级的统计数据与半泊松分布非常吻合，表明处于可积性和混沌之间的中间状态，其特征是能级排斥和强长程相关性。还讨论了电荷转移和相关生物过程的潜在生物物理影响。

articles.title: Squeezing-preserving coherent control in Fourier-shaped optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 傅里叶形光学晶格中的压缩保持相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34343v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motional squeezed states of atoms in optical lattices are affected by the anharmonicity of the trapping potential. Unequal vibrational energy spacings cause dephasing among the occupied motional-state coherences, leading to distortion of the wavepacket and a reduction in squeezing. We show numerically that adding a weak second or third spatial harmonic to a one-dimensional lattice slows the initial decay of the squeezing. Squeezed states are prepared by one or two sudden changes of the lattice depth. For each harmonic and each preparation scheme, we choose the harmonic amplitude that keeps the evolved state closest, on average over 1 ms, to its evolution in a harmonic trap. We then compare the squeezing with that in a sinusoidal lattice with the same initial squeezing and trap frequency. In all four cases studied, the successive squeezing maxima initially decay more slowly in the shaped lattice. The improvement arises because the optimal harmonic nearly equalizes the two dominant vibrational level spacings over the region occupied by the squeezed wave packet, which canceling the quartic term of the potential alone does not achieve. Because the amplitude of the added harmonic is static and can be produced with existing Fourier-synthesis techniques, lattice shaping offers a simple way to preserve motional squeezing without additional time-dependent control.
