Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 diverse datasets, our method demonstrates exceptional zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets, clearly surpassing state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and detail preservation.

articles.title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.34414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

articles.title: Staged Solar Pumping vs Water Trucking to Jebel Jais: A Life-Cycle Sustainability Assessment
articles.abstract: Water for the tourism facilities on Jebel Jais, the highest mountain in the United Arab Emirates, is delivered by road tankers that climb about 1,500 m on every trip. This study compares that supply with staged solar pumping: a chain of photovoltaic (PV) pumping stations with break tanks that lifts water from the foot of the mountain to an upper tank at 1,770 m. The pump rating per station was varied from 0.5 to 10 hp, and each layout was sized for the worst month and assessed over 25 years for energy, carbon, cost, structural safety, wildlife water and resilience to road closures. A loaded 22.7 m³ tanker burns about 54 L of diesel per round trip, or 8.7 kg CO₂e per cubic metre delivered. Staged solar pumping with 5–10 hp stations emits 1.7–1.8 kg CO₂e/m³ over its life cycle, about 80% less, with a carbon payback of about 5 years; a 1 hp limit would need 132 stations at 40 m³/day. A 26 km pipeline along the road beats tankers above about 92 m³/day (67 m³/day with a carbon price of USD 190/t), and a 12 km direct route above about 39 m³/day. The GRP tanks pass all structural checks, five troughs supply 0.5 m³/day to wildlife, and the chain keeps supplying water through the rain and rockfall closures that stop tankers. Staged solar pumping is therefore the low-carbon and more resilient option, and its cost advantage depends on demand and route.

articles.title: Benchmark Validation of the Direct Mathematical Method for HPGe Detector Efficiency Calibration Against Experimental Data, EFFTRAN, and Geant4-Based RayXpert Simulations
articles.abstract: Accurate full-energy peak efficiency (FEPE) calibration of high-purity germanium (HPGe) detectors is essential for quantitative gamma-ray spectrometry and numerous applications in nuclear science and technology. Although Monte Carlo radiation-transport simulations and efficiency-transfer techniques are widely employed for detector efficiency determination, their implementation often requires detailed detector characterization and considerable computational effort. In the present study, the Direct Mathematical Method (DMM) was evaluated as an analytical alternative through comparison with experimental measurements, EFFTRAN calculations, and Geant4-based RayXpert simulations reported for a 78.5% relative-efficiency n-type coaxial HPGe detector. The detector-response parameter required by the DMM, namely the effective photopeak attenuation coefficient, was derived from the experimental efficiency data and subsequently used to predict FEPE values over a wide gamma-ray energy range. Calculated efficiencies were compared with experimental, EFFTRAN, and RayXpert results using relative-deviation analysis together with statistical performance indicators, including the coefficient of determination (R²), root-mean-square error (RMSE), and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). The DMM accurately reproduced the experimental efficiency curve across the investigated energy range, yielding absolute relative deviations ranging from 0.09% to 0.92%, with a mean absolute deviation of only 0.38%. These results demonstrate substantially better agreement with the experimental data than both RayXpert and EFFTRAN. The findings indicate that the DMM provides a reliable and computationally efficient framework for HPGe detector efficiency calibration and detector-response characterization, demonstrating that the DMM constitutes an accurate and computationally efficient alternative to both Monte Carlo-based and efficiency-transfer methodologies for HPGe detector efficiency calibration.

articles.title: Topology Optimization Design of Four-Branch Cast Steel Joints Based on Target Volume Fraction Constraints
articles.abstract: This study considers multiple volume fraction values as constraints and establishes a mathematical model with the objective of minimizing structural compliance (maximizing stiffness) to carry out lightweight design of joints.By analyzing isosurface maps of elements in the joint design domain, the elemental density threshold at which the elements are most efficient in load bearing and the stress distribution is relatively uniform is identified; that is, the topological shape is reasonable. Static analysis is performed on the joints with reasonable topological shapes and compared with the original joint to investigate whether the mechanical performance of the topologically optimized joint is significantly reduced and how effective the weight reduction is. Finally, the topology optimization design of cast steel branching joints under each volume fraction constraint is verified. By comparing and analyzing the mechanical performance of the topologically optimized cast steel branching joints under different volume fraction constraints, the optimal topological form under different volume fraction constraints is determined, the most reasonable target volume fraction is found, and the most suitable new topological configuration is determined.

articles.title: TiO₂ Catalysts Derived from Pyrolysis of Photovoltaic Backsheet PVF Films for Pollutant Degradation
articles.abstract: Waste poly(vinyl fluoride) (PVF) photovoltaic backsheets are difficult to degrade and inefficient to recycle. Herein, a one-step pyrolysis strategy is proposed to convert waste PVF films directly into carbon-supported TiO₂ photocatalysts. Thermal analysis was used to determine the optimal preparation conditions, and multiple characterizations were performed to clarify the optical absorption, band structure, elemental distribution, pore architecture and surface chemical states of the products. Photocatalytic tests combined with intermediate identification revealed the degradation pathway of the target pollutant. The results show that rutile TiO₂ is anchored on a carbon skeleton. The pristine pyrolyzed sample exhibits a dense surface and a low specific surface area, and thus limited activity. Acid leaching narrows the direct bandgap from 2.17 to 1.93eV and extends the photoresponse range. Meanwhile, the specific surface area increases by 40% (from 1.1312 to 1.5878 m²·g⁻¹) and the surface oxygen content rises by 77.7% (from 18% to 32%), introducing abundant hydroxyl groups that promote molecular oxygen adsorption and enrich the active sites, while the Ti⁴⁺ valence state of the TiO₂ matrix remains essentially unchanged. Under near-neutral conditions, the modified catalyst degrades 87.7% of low-concentration ofloxacin within 90 min, compared with 30.5% for the unmodified sample, without tedious pH adjustment. Decarboxylation, hydroxylation and side-chain cleavage are identified as the main degradation pathways, and a mineralization rate of 16.7% is reached. This work confirms the feasibility of upgrading waste PVF films into photocatalytic materials and provides a basis for building a green recycling system for PVF solid waste.

articles.title: A 28.0%-efficiency THBC cell enabled by submicron scale bevel engineering
articles.abstract: Hybrid back contact architectures uniquely integrate a genuine hole-selective emitter and a broad fabrication process window within a single device stack. Building on this platform, we introduce a submicrometre-scale bevel passivation strategy that further suppresses parasitic recombination at the tunnelling junction edge. Together with nanotexturing of the n-type polycrystalline silicon contact, we achieve a certified cell efficiency of 28.0% and a fill factor exceeding 88% on large-area rectangular wafers (105 mm by 182 mm). These advances are enabled by substantial progress toward Auger recombination dominance, alongside extreme optimization of contact resistivity. As a result, the product of the open-circuit voltage and fill factor for our device reaches 98.5% of the Shockley–Queisser limit. Leveraging these cell-level improvements, we demonstrate a large-area module with a third-party certified efficiency of 26.74%, a marked advance over the existing record for single-junction silicon photovoltaic modules, featuring a normalized VOC above 748 mV and an FF approaching 85%. This device is reconstructed from the silicon heterojunction and TOPCon passivated contact precursors and the module is immune from damp-heat degradation with a silver paste metallization. Remarkably, the implementation of a patented CSTL gap-protection layer renders the architecture fully compatible with copper-paste metallization, positioning it as a viable pathway toward terawatt-scale clean energy deployment while remaining within a striking distance of the 29.4% crystalline silicon efficiency limit.

articles.title: Metal-composition-regulated Au-based nanozymes for enzyme-cascade colorimetric determination of uric acid and sarcosine
articles.abstract: Rational regulation of nanozyme catalytic preference is essential for developing sensitive and adaptable colorimetric biosensors. Here, we developed a metal-composition-regulated nanozyme platform (Au@Ru/Pt/PRTM) integrating multimetallic catalysis with protamine (PRTM)-mediated biomimetic functionalization for the determination of uric acid (UA) and sarcosine (SA). By incorporating different metal species (Ru, Pd, and Ir) into Au-based nanozymes, distinct peroxidase (POD)- and oxidase (OXD)-like catalytic profiles were achieved, demonstrating the influence of metal composition on catalytic preference. The arginine-rich PRTM provided a biomimetic interfacial environment, while the optimized Au@Ru/Pt/PRTM nanozyme exhibited pronounced POD-like activity and favorable catalytic kinetics. By coupling the nanozyme with urate oxidase and sarcosine oxidase, enzyme–nanozyme cascade colorimetric biosensors were established for UA and SA detection, achieving limits of detection of 0.0927 and 0.75 µM, respectively. The assays demonstrated satisfactory selectivity, resistance to interference, and analytical recoveries in spiked artificial urine samples. This work highlights metal-composition engineering combined with biomimetic interfacial functionalization as a promising strategy for tailoring nanozyme catalytic behavior and developing sensitive colorimetric biosensors for biochemical analysis.

articles.title: Effect of heat re-pressing and thermocycling on the mechanical properties of high-density micronized heat-pressed ceramics: an in vitro study
articles.abstract: Background Heat re-pressing discarded high-density micronized (HDM) glass ceramic could reduce waste and cost, but whether re-pressed material retains equivalent properties is unclear. We assessed the effects of heat re-pressing and thermocycling on the mechanical properties of HDM glass ceramic.Methods Forty-two HDM glass ceramic discs (GC Initial LiSi Press) were single (control), double, or triple heat-pressed (n = 14/group), with each group subdivided before and after thermocycling (5000 cycles, 5–55°C; n = 7/group). Elemental content, microstructure, biaxial flexural strength, and surface hardness were assessed. A separate sample set was prepared for µtensile testing (n = 12/group). Data were analyzed by two-way ANOVA and Tukey’s post hoc test.Results Re-pressing altered the microstructure, changing lithium disilicate crystal shape, decreasing crystal size, and increasing crystal density. Re-pressing had no effect on biaxial flexural strength (p = 0.074) but increased surface hardness (p < 0.001) and reduced µtensile strength (p < 0.001). Thermocycling decreased crystal size and density and, although it did not affect biaxial flexural strength (p = 0.384), reduced both surface hardness and µtensile strength (p < 0.001).Conclusions Heat re-pressing altered the microstructure and mechanical properties of HDM glass ceramic. Future studies should confirm whether these alterations are clinically beneficial or detrimental.

articles.title: Hydrogen Evolution and Photochemical Stability of Sepiolite/UiO-66-NH2 Composites
articles.abstract: Adding a metal–organic framework (MOF) to sepiolite may offer new ways to tune its photocatalytic properties, but a greater MOF content does not necessarily lead to more hydrogen. Here, sepiolite/UiO-66(Zr)-NH2 composites with different nominal compositions were examined to establish how MOF distribution affects their structure, photoresponse and behaviour during irradiation. Structural and microscopic analyses revealed a gradual change from exposed sepiolite fibres to MOF-rich aggregates, accompanied by changes in pore accessibility. SUiO-32 showed the strongest photocurrent and retained its relative linker-associated infrared features more effectively than the other composites after irradiation. Yet its photoelectrochemical response was not matched by a corresponding advantage in hydrogen evolution from aqueous methanol. Photocatalyst-free irradiation of the same mixture also generated substantial hydrogen, complicating any assignment of the total yield to catalysis. In pure water, hydrogen formation increased with MOF enrichment, but changes in MOF-derived domains raised the possibility that framework-associated organics participated in the reaction. The results demonstrate why hydrogen evolution, photolysis and catalyst stability need to be considered together when evaluating MOF–clay photocatalysts.

articles.title: Hydrochemical Assessment of Groundwater Quality and Salinization Risk for Drinking and Irrigation Uses in the Arid Yazd-Ardakan Plain, Central Iran
articles.abstract: Groundwater quality deterioration and salinization are major environmental concerns in arid and semi-arid regions, where limited surface water resources increase dependence on aquifers for drinking and irrigation. This study provides an integrated hydrochemical assessment of groundwater quality and salinization risk in the Yazd-Ardakan plain, central Iran, as a representative arid aquifer system under severe water stress. A total of 142 groundwater samples collected from 10 monitoring stations between 2002 and 2018 were evaluated using physicochemical parameters, major ions, hydrochemical facies, and irrigation water quality indices, including sodium adsorption ratio (SAR), sodium percentage (Na%), residual sodium carbonate (RSC), and permeability index (PI). The results indicate that groundwater is predominantly characterized by Chloride-Sulfate facies, reflecting strong salinization processes. For drinking purposes, all samples had total dissolved solids above 1000 mg/L, the level above which the World Health Organization describes increasing palatability problems, with concentrations ranging from 1080 to 13,924 mg/L. Elevated chloride, sulfate, and sodium concentrations further indicate poor drinking water quality, particularly at stations W5, W6, W8, W9, and W10. Irrigation suitability assessment showed contrasting results: although 64% of samples had acceptable SAR values and most samples showed favorable RSC and PI conditions, only 17% were classified as excellent to good based on Na%, indicating a significant risk of long-term soil degradation. These findings highlight the importance of long-term groundwater monitoring, salinity-risk management, advanced treatment for drinking use, and controlled irrigation practices to protect soil and water resources in arid aquifer systems.

articles.title: Iodine vacancies loosen positional confinement of adsorbed ammonia on CsPbI₃(100) without enhancing binding strength: a classical molecular dynamics study
articles.abstract: All-inorganic halide perovskites such as CsPbI₃ are attractive photovoltaic absorbers, but their surfaces are exposed to residual solvents, moisture and molecular passivants. Iodine vacancies, ubiquitous at these surfaces, are commonly assumed to bind such molecules more strongly through local undercoordination. We tested this assumption with classical molecular dynamics, using a Buckingham–Coulomb CsPbI₃ force field validated against the experimental cubic lattice constant (6.267 Å vs. 6.29 Å, −0.36%), an OPLS-AA ammonia model and universal force field cross terms. NH₃ adsorption was simulated on a PbI₂-terminated (100) slab, with and without a surface iodine vacancy, at 250, 300 and 400 K. Across ten replicas per condition at 300 K, sampling different sites and orientations, the mean NH₃–surface interaction energy did not differ significantly between pristine and defective surfaces (−5.70 ± 1.30 vs. −5.93 ± 1.39 kcal mol⁻¹; p = 0.71). Positional analysis gave a different picture. The molecule sat significantly farther from the vacancy surface at 250 K and 300 K (p = 0.0063 and 0.0067), with the same trend at 400 K. On the defective surface its adsorbed fraction fell from 98.4% at 250 K to 92.7% at 400 K (individual replicas as low as 80.5%), whereas the pristine surface retained the molecule 100% of the time. The vacancy therefore does not act as a stronger thermodynamic trap, but it does degrade the positional confinement of the adsorbate, an effect invisible to single-configuration energetics. This binding-strength/confinement distinction may help explain adsorbate displacement on perovskite surfaces.

articles.title: Hot cracking in high strength carbon steel weld joints
articles.abstract: In the present study, the hot cracking susceptibility of the submerged arc weld metal in steel plates for the shipbuilding and wind tower industries was investigated. The susceptibility was predominantly determined by the chemical composition of the fusion zone, particularly the carbon, phosphorus, and sulfur contents. The weld metal composition was governed by the wire and flux compositions, flux basicity, and the extent of base metal dilution. Transverse Varestraint tests were performed to quantitatively analyze the cracking behavior, determine the weld metal compositions required to prevent hot cracking, and identify the optimum welding consumables for each steel grade. The effects of alloying elements and impurity contents on hot cracking susceptibility were investigated by comparing the brittle temperature range (BTR) obtained from the Varestraint tests with thermodynamic calculations of solidification behavior as a function of weld metal composition.

articles.title: ReaxFF molecular modeling of hemp lignin transformations in supercritical CO₂–ethanol–water compared with 2D HSQC NMR observations
articles.abstract: Context: Supercritical CO₂–ethanol–water media can promote both cleavage and condensation of lignin, but the sequence of covalent reactions is difficult to resolve experimentally. Reactive molecular modeling was therefore used to examine solvent-associated transformations of hemp lignin and to compare the simulated event order with 2D HSQC NMR observations. Ether-bond cleavage preceded extensive fragmentation, followed by ethanol- and CO₂-associated reactions, phenolic-hydroxyl formation, carboxyl conversion, formaldehyde formation, and condensation at progressively higher simulated severity. Increasing treatment temperature decreased β-O-4 abundance, promoted condensed syringyl signals, and altered p-coumarate, aldehyde, and weak stilbene-like correlations. At high simulated severity, the CO₂-containing system formed more formaldehyde and retained fewer net lignin C–C bonds than the ethanol–water system. The simulation-to-experiment mapping is condition-specific and represents event ordering rather than a universal temperature conversion. Methods: A ten-molecule hemp lignin model was constructed and equilibrated with Materials Studio and PACKMOL. Reactive molecular dynamics trajectories using a C/H/O ReaxFF parameterization were run in LAMMPS for CO₂–ethanol–water and ethanol–water boxes under continuous NVT heating from 300 to 2300 K at 2 K ps⁻¹ for 1000 ps. Molecular species and reaction pathways were analyzed with MATLAB and Open Babel. Purified milled wood lignin treated at 373.15–453.15 K was analyzed by 2D HSQC NMR, and relative linkage abundances were obtained from cross-peak integrals using JEOL Delta 5.0.

articles.title: Stress alleviation via FCC-twinning in additively manufactured alloy
articles.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process inevitably introduces residual stresses, which could be alleviated largely by multi-layer scanning thermal cycling. Such alleviation is found to be originated from the directional growth of the α'' columnar precipitates, while the continuous FCC-twinning structures multiply and are segmented into subgrains by sheared pyramidal stacking faults. The successive extended partial dislocations react at the junction of basal and pyramidal stacking faults outside FCC-twinning subgrains to form a Basal-Pyramidal (B–P) lock configuration. Such subgrain pattern is driven by the evolution of dislocations and stacking faults alongside continuous stress fluctuations underpinning the stress relief, which has been verified via molecular dynamics simulations and in situ characterization.

articles.title: Improved Electrocatalytic Nitrogen Reduction to Ammonia over Cu-Fe-Mn-Ni-Co High-Entropy Alloy Anchored on Activated Carbon
articles.abstract: Electrochemical nitrogen reduction reaction (eNRR) under atmospheric conditions is a sustainable substitute for traditional ammonia production techniques. This study reports an efficient eNRR performed over a cost-efficient, noble metal-free high-entropy alloy (HEA), comprising Cu, Fe, Mn, Ni, and Co (CFMNC), anchored on activated carbon particles (ACP). The CFMNC/ACP electrocatalyst is synthesized via suspension polymerization with the in situ addition of the respective metal nitrates at the onset of polymeric gel formation, followed by thermal processing. The physicochemical characterization tests confirm the formation of HEA with a configurational entropy of 1.58 R and the composition of each constituent metal within 5–35 mol%, satisfying the necessary and sufficient conditions for HEA formation. CFMNC/ACP demonstrates an enhanced eNRR activity with the NH3 production rate of 33.82 µg.h− 1.mgcat−1 and Faradaic efficiency of 26.39% at -0.30 V vs RHE in 0.1 M KOH electrolyte. The catalyst showed a stable eNRR activity over eight consecutive cycles with less than 4% decline measured in the electrocatalytic activity. The significantly high eNRR activity of CFMNC/ACP is ascribed to the synergistic interactions between HEA nanoparticles and ACP. This study demonstrates a scalable and energy-efficient strategy for sustainable NH3 production over noble metal-free HEA electrocatalyst.

articles.title: Three-Dimensional RANS Simulation of the Flow Field and Bed Shear Stress Around a Bridge Pier Combined with Abutments, with Collars and a Vertical Flow Deflector
articles.abstract: Purpose Local scour at a bridge pier that shares a contracted section with abutments is driven by a flow field that experiments alone cannot describe. This study uses numerical simulation to explain laboratory measurements of scour around a rectangular pier (3 cm × 20 cm) placed between two equal abutments in a 40 cm wide flume, without protection and with bed-level collars and a vertical plate flow deflector.Methods The steady Reynolds-averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) equations were solved with the open-source code OpenFOAM (Open Source Field Operation and Manipulation), using the k–ω shear-stress transport (SST) turbulence model and Spalding’s wall function. The model was validated against published velocity and bed-shear measurements in an equilibrium scour hole around a cylinder, and the numerical uncertainty was quantified with the grid convergence index (GCI) on three meshes. Flat-bed, scoured-bed and collar-in-hole cases were simulated at Froude numbers of 0.19–0.53.Results The model reproduced the peak downflow at the cylinder face (− 0.59U versus − 0.60U measured), its elevation and radial decay, and the onset of reversed bed shear. The approach-flow shear and the bed shear beyond about one pier width from the structures were mesh-independent (GCI < 5%), whereas the peak at the sharp pier corners was not. Bed shear was amplified about five times at the upstream corners, and the downflow at the pier nose increased from 0.41–0.43V on a flat bed to 0.82V in the equilibrium scour hole. Collars of width Bc/b ≥ 4 reduced the peak shear on the exposed bed to about 2.5–2.8 times the approach value, and a collar inside the scour hole halved the downflow reaching the hole bottom and lowered the bottom shear from 0.93τc to 0.41τc. The computed excess shear explained the measured relative scour depth for 27 conditions (r = 0.95, R2 = 0.89). A vertical plate deflector reduced the peak downflow by about 20%, and a plate height d/b ≈ 0.33 gave the lowest shear ahead of the nose.Conclusions Collars and deflectors act mainly by intercepting the downflow at the pier nose; a collar of about 4b covers the strongly amplified region, and a deflector of height 0.33b agrees with the experimental optimum. Peak values at sharp corners are mesh-dependent and are interpreted qualitatively, and the results are limited to fixed beds and a rigid water surface.

articles.title: Spectroscopic Characterization and DFT Quantum Study of New Isoindigo Polymer: Promising Materials for High Optoelectronic Device Performance
articles.abstract: In this work we deal with the synthesis, structural photovoltaic properties and quantum chemical modeling of new low band gap isoindigo-based polymer, derived from electron-accepting isoindigo units and several electron-donating groups, for renewable energy technologies and applications. The first isoindigo derivative polymer denoted as PPID were obtained in moderate heck reaction followed by photocyclodehydrogenation. As part of our analysis, the resulting polymer was characterized by thermal (ATG), cyclic voltammetry (CV), UV-Vis absorption and photoluminescence spectroscopies. The obtained polymer possesses good solubility in common organic solvents, high thermal stability, and broad absorption in the range of 300 to 750 nm. Some fundamental DFT/B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) calculated parameters matched well the experimental measurements, showing good structure-properties correlation. Then, a series of isoindigo-based donor polymers were systematically investigated where five new isoindigo-based polymers with a D-A structure were designed by engineering the donor groups in order to modulate their optoelectronic and charge-transport properties for use in photovoltaic device. Photophysical, electrochemical, and computational analyses were conducted to investigate the effect of donor units on the isoindigo-polymer derivatives. Their optoelectronic properties and other indispensable characteristic parameters were studied indicating that these D-A polymers can be promising active layer for organic solar cells (OSCs). These results not only provide a pathway for new polymer design but also serve as a theoretical foundation for future experimental development of high-efficiency electronic device.

articles.title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00636v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. We extend the benchmark to four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. In a workflow, the agent runs all simulations itself. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on nine LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 62.8-97.9% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the stronger agents fall only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes more failures to scientific errors than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.

articles.title: An Integrated RSM–ANN Approach for Predicting and Optimizing Double-Tool Turning Performance of Medium-Carbon Steel
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of machining performance is essential for improving productivity and product quality in double-tool turning (DTT), where complex nonlinear interactions among machining parameters significantly influence process responses. This study presents predictive modeling of surface roughness (Ra), material removal rate (MRR), and tool-tip temperature during dry double-tool turning of AISI 1043 medium carbon steel using Response Surface Methodology (RSM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Experimental data were generated using a four-factor, three-level Box–Behnken Design comprising 27 experimental runs with cutting speed (Vc), feed rate (f), primary depth of cut (d₁), and secondary depth of cut (d₂) as input variables. Quadratic RSM models were developed to establish statistically significant relationships between machining parameters and responses, while a feed-forward multilayer perceptron ANN with a 4–10–3 architecture was trained to capture the nonlinear behavior of the machining process. The developed RSM models demonstrated high statistical adequacy, with coefficients of determination (R²) exceeding 0.96 and non-significant lack-of-fit, confirming their suitability for prediction. The ANN model achieved superior predictive performance, with R² values of 0.991, 0.996, and 0.994 for surface roughness, material removal rate, and tool-tip temperature, respectively, together with lower prediction errors than the RSM models. Comparative evaluation showed that ANN provided more accurate predictions because of its ability to model complex nonlinear interactions, whereas RSM offered interpretable mathematical relationships useful for process analysis. Validation experiments confirmed close agreement between predicted and experimental values, demonstrating the reliability and robustness of both predictive approaches. The proposed predictive framework provides an effective decision-support tool for estimating machining performance and selecting appropriate cutting conditions in double-tool turning using conventional lathes, thereby contributing to improved manufacturing efficiency and sustainable machining practices.

articles.title: Investigating the Impact of Electric Micromobility Vehicle Fires in a Single-Level Passenger Railcar
articles.abstract: Passenger trains and subways are an attractive option for many commuters; however, station proximity is often too limited to be convenient. To address first/last mile travel needs, commuters are increasingly using electric micromobility vehicles (EMVs), including bringing personal EMVs onto public transport. This raises the question of the risk posed by an EMV fire in a passenger railcar. In this study, three EMV types---a standing e-scooter, an e-bike, and a seated e-scooter---were forced into thermal runaway in a 72-passenger railcar to assess the hazard to passengers from an EMV fire. Tenability within the railcar was assessed using video observations, gas temperature, thermal radiation, and gas species measurements to evaluate visibility loss, asphyxiant fractional effective dose (FED), and thermal fractional effective dose (FED-T). The results quantify differences in tenability among devices stored in typical onboard locations and show that untenable conditions can develop throughout the railcar. Occupants in close proximity to the EMV, within a few rows, may be immediately threatened by the fireball resulting from ignition of the initial battery gas release.

articles.title: Locality from Nonlocality: Symmetry Relocalization and Gauging of Lattice Dirac Fermions
articles.title_zh: 来自非局域性的局域性：晶格狄拉克费米子的对称重定位和测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially nonlocal symmetries need not imply nonlocal gauge dynamics. Nonlocal canonical transformations make certain exact nonlocal compact symmetries of free lattice Dirac fermions onsite while retaining sufficient Hamiltonian locality for gauging. Symmetry relocalization yields exact or emergent gauge locality in 1D, 2D, and 3D, subject to lattice structure, topology, and anomalies. In 1D, a Hamiltonian-preserving transformation exchanges onsite vector and nonlocal spectral axial charges of a half-filled chain, enabling local gauging of each and exposing their mixed anomaly. Bosonization identifies momentum-winding T-duality, with a parity-projected operator flowing to a noninvertible topological defect. A nonperturbative norm-resolvent bound proves emergent dynamical gauge locality at finite chemical potential, while a doubled Chern-insulator parent reveals the duality's bulk origin and superconducting extensions reveal hidden compact symmetries. In 2D, the square π-flux Majorana model shares the Kitaev honeycomb model's single Dirac fermion and odd Pfaffian parity but supports sharp and exponentially local compact charges, the latter with nontrivial Chern topology. Relocalization retains Schwartz locality for asymptotically local gauging, while AIII/AII parents clarify bulk charge origin and parity-anomaly inflow. Two flavors yield compact U(2), a quaternionic invariant, and asymptotically local non-Abelian gauging. In 3D, an exact mixed vector-axial flux response is derived, while a distinct model supports an exponentially local vector U(1) charge with strong quaternionic topology. A nonlocal map makes the charge and Kramers symmetry onsite while preserving exponential Hamiltonian locality. For a compact SU(2) Weyl doublet, a no-go theorem forbids translation-preserving Gaussian onsite relocalization retaining Weyl content and Hamiltonian locality.

articles.title: Tunneling signatures of the Lifshitz transition in a superconducting vortex
articles.title_zh: 超导涡旋中利夫希茨转变的隧道特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon states bound to a vortex line in a clean type-II superconductor form one-dimensional minibands that disperse along the vortex. The lowest miniband is separated from the Fermi level by a minigap E₀simΔ²/E_F. A magnetic field shifts the minibands of the two spin projections in opposite directions. At the threshold field B^* the Zeeman energy equals E₀. Estimates for FeSe place B^* at a few tesla. The lowest miniband of one spin projection then crosses the Fermi level, and a spin-polarized one-dimensional Fermi sea forms inside the vortex core. We develop the theory of tunneling spectra across this Lifshitz transition. We solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations numerically in the quantum limit for all momenta along the vortex and compute the local density of states with thermal and instrumental broadening. The zero-bias conductance at the vortex center is absent below B^*. It has a maximum near B^* with the inverse-square-root field dependence of a one-dimensional van Hove singularity and decreases at higher fields. The next miniband produces a second onset at a finite distance from the center. The zero-bias signal is carried by one spin projection at the center and by the opposite one in the surrounding ring. We then project the screened electron interaction onto the filled miniband. The resulting Luttinger parameter is close to unity, so the core hosts a weakly interacting one-dimensional Fermi gas. Its quasiparticles relax through three-particle collisions in analogy with thermalization in quantum wires and at quantum Hall edges. The corresponding relaxation rates are established analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: 在干净的 II 型超导体中，与涡旋线结合的 Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon 态形成沿涡旋分散的一维微带。最低的迷你能带与费米能级之间有一个迷你能隙 E₀simΔ²/E_F。磁场使两个自旋投影的微带沿相反方向移动。在阈值场 B^* 处，塞曼能量等于 E₀。 FeSe 的估计值 B^* 为几特斯拉。然后，一个自旋投影的最低微带穿过费米能级，并且在涡核内部形成自旋极化的一维费米海。我们发展了跨越 Lifshitz 跃迁的隧道光谱理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在干净的 II 型超导体中，与涡旋线结合的 Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon 态形成沿涡旋分散的一维微带。最低的迷你能带与费米能级之间有一个迷你能隙 E₀simΔ²/E_F。磁场使两个自旋投影的微带沿相反方向移动。在阈值场 B^* 处，塞曼能量等于 E₀。 FeSe 的估计值 B^* 为几特斯拉。然后，一个自旋投影的最低微带穿过费米能级，并且在涡核内部形成自旋极化的一维费米海。我们发展了跨越 Lifshitz 跃迁的隧道光谱理论。我们在量子极限下对沿涡旋的所有动量求解 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程进行数值求解，并通过热展宽和仪器展宽计算局部态密度。涡流中心处的零偏置电导不存在于 B^* 以下。它在 B^* 附近具有最大值，与一维范霍夫奇点的反平方根场相关，并且在较高场处减小。下一个迷你带在距中心有限距离处产生第二个起始点。零偏置信号由中心的一个自旋投影和周围环中的相对的一个自旋投影承载。然后，我们将屏蔽的电子相互作用投影到填充的迷你带上。由此产生的卢廷格参数接近于1，因此核心具有弱相互作用的一维费米气体。其准粒子通过三粒子碰撞而松弛，类似于量子线和量子霍尔边缘的热化。通过分析确定相应的弛豫率。

articles.title: Tunable first-order transitions and magnetic hysteresis in Bernal pentalayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 伯纳尔五层石墨烯中可调节的一阶跃迁和磁滞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31376v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In two-dimensional electron systems, strong Coulomb interactions can spontaneously lift flavor degeneracies such as spin and valley, producing first-order transitions with hysteretic switching of interest for memory devices. The subband degree of freedom in multiband systems may be viewed as a flavor that not only participates in such transitions but also enables control of the hysteretic behavior, as a displacement field can shift the energy difference between subbands. Here, we demonstrate this principle in Bernal-stacked pentalayer graphene, whose low-energy spectrum comprises a monolayer-like Dirac sub-band together with light and heavy bilayer-like sub-bands. Local compressibility measurements resolve a fully symmetry-broken Landau-level spectrum and a sequence of phase transitions that occur when Landau levels of different subbands cross, at which strong interactions redistribute the occupation among flavors. We show that these transitions exhibit hysteretic Hall responses in magnetic field, confirming their first-order character, and that the magnitude and sign of the hysteresis are tuned by the displacement field, as expected from the subband Landau-level ordering determined in compressibility measurements. Our work establishes the subband degree of freedom in multiband systems as a resource for engineering hysteretic switching, and highlights how local thermodynamic measurements can link microscopic insights to macroscopic responses in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在二维电子系统中，强库仑相互作用可以自发地提升诸如自旋和谷等简并性，从而产生具有存储设备感兴趣的滞后切换的一阶跃迁。多带系统中的子带自由度可以被视为一种风味，它不仅参与这种转变，而且还能够控制滞后行为，因为位移场可以改变子带之间的能量差。在这里，我们在伯纳尔堆叠五层石墨烯中证明了这一原理，其低能光谱包括单层狄拉克子带以及轻和重双层状子带。局部压缩性测量解决了完全对称破缺的朗道能级谱以及不同子带的朗道能级交叉时发生的一系列相变，其中强相互作用重新分配了风味之间的占据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在二维电子系统中，强库仑相互作用可以自发地提升诸如自旋和谷等简并性，从而产生具有存储设备感兴趣的滞后切换的一阶跃迁。多带系统中的子带自由度可以被视为一种风味，它不仅参与这种转变，而且还能够控制滞后行为，因为位移场可以改变子带之间的能量差。在这里，我们在伯纳尔堆叠五层石墨烯中证明了这一原理，其低能光谱包括单层狄拉克子带以及轻和重双层状子带。局部压缩性测量解决了完全对称破缺的朗道能级谱以及不同子带的朗道能级交叉时发生的一系列相变，其中强相互作用重新分配了风味之间的占据。我们表明，这些转变在磁场中表现出磁滞霍尔响应，证实了它们的一阶特征，并且磁滞的大小和符号由位移场调整，正如在可压缩性测量中确定的子带朗道级排序所预期的那样。我们的工作建立了多带系统中的子带自由度作为工程迟滞切换的资源，并强调了局部热力学测量如何将微观洞察与量子材料中的宏观响应联系起来。

articles.title: Non-integer high harmonic generation from many-body nonadiabatic gating
articles.title_zh: 多体非绝热门控产生非整数高次谐波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High harmonic generation (HHG) in solids typically produces a rigid frequency comb locked to exact integer multiples of the drive photon energy. In strongly correlated materials, however, the light field can dynamically transform the electronic state on the timescale of harmonic generation itself, potentially violating this rule. Here, we report giant blueshifted, non-integer HHG in a cuprate Mott insulator Sr₂CuO₃ produced by mid-infrared excitations. Concurrent transient reflectivity measurements and time-dependent exact-diagonalization simulations of a driven Hubbard model support a many-body temporal gating mechanism that suppresses light emission on the trailing edge of the pulse, thereby blueshifting radiated harmonics in the frequency domain. Our findings establish HHG emission energy as a sensitive probe of quantum many-body dynamics and pave the way for exploration and manipulation of correlated electronic phases of matter with strong-field spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 固体中的高次谐波产生（HHG）通常会产生锁定到驱动光子能量的精确整数倍的刚性频率梳。然而，在强相关材料中，光场可以在谐波产生本身的时间尺度上动态地改变电子状态，这可能违反了这一规则。在这里，我们报告了由中红外激发产生的铜酸盐莫特绝缘体 Sr2CuO₃ 中巨大的蓝移、非整数 HHG。驱动哈伯德模型的并发瞬态反射率测量和时间相关的精确对角化模拟支持多体时间选通机制，该机制抑制脉冲后沿的光发射，从而使频域中的辐射谐波蓝移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体中的高次谐波产生（HHG）通常会产生锁定到驱动光子能量的精确整数倍的刚性频率梳。然而，在强相关材料中，光场可以在谐波产生本身的时间尺度上动态地改变电子状态，这可能违反了这一规则。在这里，我们报告了由中红外激发产生的铜酸盐莫特绝缘体 Sr2CuO₃ 中巨大的蓝移、非整数 HHG。驱动哈伯德模型的并发瞬态反射率测量和时间相关的精确对角化模拟支持多体时间选通机制，该机制抑制脉冲后沿的光发射，从而使频域中的辐射谐波蓝移。我们的研究结果将 HHG 发射能量确立为量子多体动力学的敏感探针，并为利用强场光谱探索和操纵物质的相关电子相铺平了道路。

articles.title: Localization in one-dimensional magnetic quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 一维磁性准晶的局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The celebrated Aubry-André-Harper model undergoes a metal-insulator transition akin to Anderson localization due to an energetic competition between nearest-neighbor hopping and a quasiperiodic on-site potential. In this work, we consider the problem of a one-dimensional lattice subject to a quasiperiodic external field, where the topology of the underlying graph mediates the competition between insulating and conducting phases. In particular, we present examples for which all dispersive eigenstates are critically localized, as well as models in which they are exponentially localized. We also demonstrate the coexistence of these phenomena with an extensive set of degenerate finitely supported eigenstates forming a flat band. Finally, we construct models with exactly solvable mobility edges arising only from graph structure. Going beyond these single-particle results, we show---using exact-diagonalization calculations of the bosonic dynamics---that, as in the conventional Aubry-André-Harper case, on-site interactions drive localized eigenstates toward extendedness. Our results provide a framework for exploring how magnetic interference and interactions jointly constrain transport in quasiperiodic lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于最近邻跳跃和准周期现场势之间的激烈竞争，著名的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀模型经历了类似于安德森局域化的金属-绝缘体转变。在这项工作中，我们考虑了受准周期外场影响的一维晶格问题，其中底层图的拓扑介导了绝缘相和导电相之间的竞争。特别是，我们提出了所有色散本征态都临界局域化的示例，以及它们指数局域化的模型。我们还证明了这些现象与形成平带的大量简并有限支撑本征态的共存。最后，我们构建具有仅由图结构产生的完全可解的移动边的模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于最近邻跳跃和准周期现场势之间的激烈竞争，著名的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀模型经历了类似于安德森局域化的金属-绝缘体转变。在这项工作中，我们考虑了受准周期外场影响的一维晶格问题，其中底层图的拓扑介导了绝缘相和导电相之间的竞争。特别是，我们提出了所有色散本征态都临界局域化的示例，以及它们指数局域化的模型。我们还证明了这些现象与形成平带的大量简并有限支撑本征态的共存。最后，我们构建具有仅由图结构产生的完全可解的移动边的模型。除了这些单粒子结果之外，我们使用玻色子动力学的精确对角化计算表明，与传统的奥布里-安德烈-哈珀案例一样，现场相互作用驱动局域本征态走向扩展。我们的结果为探索磁干扰和相互作用如何共同约束准周期晶格中的输运提供了一个框架。

articles.title: Origin of quadrupolar order in the 5d¹ double perovskite Ba₂MgReO₆
articles.title_zh: 5d1 双钙钛矿 Ba2MgReO₆ 中四极有序的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite extensive experimental and theoretical studies of quadrupolar order in Ba₂MgReO₆, the microscopic origin and relative energy scales of the interactions driving it remain unresolved. In particular, the observed ferroic ordering of the z² quadrupole has remained difficult to explain, as the relative contributions of superexchange, classical quadrupole-quadrupole interactions, vibronic couplings, and virtual excitations to higher-energy levels have not been established quantitatively. Here, we determine all these interactions from first principles and solve the resulting microscopic Hamiltonian. The calculated ground state reproduces the experimentally observed quadrupolar order parameters and the associated structural distortions with quantitative accuracy. Disentangling the individual contributions, we find that ferroic z² order originates from a linear-quartic coupling, generated by virtual excitations to the Jₑff= 1/2 doublet and driven by vibronic interactions. Our results establish the hierarchy of microscopic interactions underlying quadrupolar order in Ba₂MgReO₆ and provide a unified ab  initio description of its coupled electronic and lattice degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管对 Ba MgReO 中的四极有序进行了广泛的实验和理论研究，但驱动其相互作用的微观起源和相对能量尺度仍未解决。特别是，观察到的 z² 四极杆的铁序仍然难以解释，因为超交换、经典四极杆-四极杆相互作用、振动耦合和对更高能级的虚拟激发的相对贡献尚未定量确定。在这里，我们根据第一原理确定所有这些相互作用，并求解所得的微观哈密顿量。计算的基态以定量精度再现了实验观察到的四极有序参数和相关的结构畸变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管对 Ba MgReO 中的四极有序进行了广泛的实验和理论研究，但驱动其相互作用的微观起源和相对能量尺度仍未解决。特别是，观察到的 z² 四极杆的铁序仍然难以解释，因为超交换、经典四极杆-四极杆相互作用、振动耦合和对更高能级的虚拟激发的相对贡献尚未定量确定。在这里，我们根据第一原理确定所有这些相互作用，并求解所得的微观哈密顿量。计算的基态以定量精度再现了实验观察到的四极有序参数和相关的结构畸变。理清各个贡献，我们发现铁质 z2 阶源自线性四次耦合，由 Jₑff= 1/2 双峰的虚拟激励产生并由振动相互作用驱动。我们的结果建立了 Ba MgReO 中四极有序的微观相互作用的层次结构，并提供了其耦合电子和晶格自由度的统一从头开始描述。

articles.title: Three-phase contact lines as distinct molecular adsorption environments
articles.title_zh: 三相接触线作为不同的分子吸附环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In wetting and multiphase systems, three-phase contact lines form where liquid, solid, and gas phases meet, creating effectively one-dimensional boundaries with distinct molecular environments. Despite their ubiquity in droplets, liquid menisci, capillary bridges, porous materials, and confined multiphase systems, molecular adsorption at these lower-dimensional boundaries has remained largely unexplored. Here, we use molecular dynamics simulations to show that the contact line on a hydrophobic substrate is not merely the geometric intersection of two interfaces but a distinct thermodynamic adsorption environment with a substantially stronger affinity for amphiphilic molecules than either neighboring interface. The investigated amphiphiles of different molecular structures exhibit a common scaling relation between line and surface adsorption in the dilute regime, while their behavior becomes molecule-specific at higher concentrations. Furthermore, contact-line affinity increases exponentially with alkyl-chain length, leading to crowding at progressively lower concentrations and making contact lines extraordinarily sensitive to trace amphiphilic impurities. Because line, surface, and bulk populations scale differently with system size, contact-line adsorption becomes increasingly important at small length scales, where it can substantially alter molecular partitioning. Contact-line enrichment is predicted to reduce the line tension by an amount comparable to its intrinsic magnitude, with potentially substantial consequences for heterogeneous nucleation. Our results establish molecular adsorption as a fundamental property of three-phase contact lines with implications for wetting and multiphase systems across length scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 在润湿和多相系统中，三相接触线在液相、固相和气相相遇处形成，从而与不同的分子环境形成有效的一维边界。尽管它们在液滴、液体弯月面、毛细管桥、多孔材料和受限多相系统中普遍存在，但这些低维边界处的分子吸附在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们使用分子动力学模拟来表明，疏水基材上的接触线不仅仅是两个界面的几何交叉点，而且是一个独特的热力学吸附环境，其对两亲分子的亲和力比任何一个相邻界面都要强得多。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在润湿和多相系统中，三相接触线在液相、固相和气相相遇处形成，从而与不同的分子环境形成有效的一维边界。尽管它们在液滴、液体弯月面、毛细管桥、多孔材料和受限多相系统中普遍存在，但这些低维边界处的分子吸附在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们使用分子动力学模拟来表明，疏水基材上的接触线不仅仅是两个界面的几何交叉点，而且是一个独特的热力学吸附环境，其对两亲分子的亲和力比任何一个相邻界面都要强得多。所研究的不同分子结构的两亲物在稀释状态下表现出线吸附和表面吸附之间常见的比例关系，而它们的行为在较高浓度下变得具有分子特异性。此外，接触线亲和力随着烷基链长度呈指数增加，导致浓度逐渐降低，并使接触线对痕量两亲性杂质异常敏感。由于线、表面和整体总体规模随系统尺寸的不同而不同，因此接触线吸附在小长度尺度上变得越来越重要，它可以显着改变分子分配。预计接触线富集可将线张力降低与其固有强度相当的量，这可能对异质成核产生重大影响。我们的结果表明分子吸附是三相接触线的基本特性，对跨长度尺度的润湿和多相系统具有影响。

articles.title: Ground state and thermal phase diagrams of the magnetized spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格上磁化自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体的基态和热相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice in a magnetic field is a paradigmatic frustrated quantum magnet, yet its ground-state phase diagram at generic anisotropy and its thermal phase structure remain incompletely understood. Here, using infinite density-matrix renormalization group, infinite projected entangled-pair operator, and exponential tensor renormalization group methods, supported by exact diagonalization, we resolve both issues. At zero temperature, we map the phase diagram continuously from the Ising limit to the Heisenberg point and find that the nonclassical Ψ supersolid is a stable phase just below saturation at all anisotropies studied: it borders the one-third-magnetization up-up-down plateau directly in the strongly easy-axis regime and the semiclassical V phase toward the Heisenberg point. In the strongly easy-axis regime, we uncover an intrinsically finite-temperature bond-nematic phase above the zero-temperature plateau--Ψ boundary, in which the three bond directions become spontaneously inequivalent without transverse spin coherence or three-sublattice order. A hard-core-boson mapping reveals its origin: once thermal fluctuations destroy phase coherence, the field-doped holes settle on domain walls of the local up-up-down order, which are stabilized by quantum kink delocalization and aligned by its Z₃ registry. Our results call for reexamining high-field states in triangular-lattice cobaltates such as Na₂BaCo(PO₄)₂ and K₂Co(SeO₃)₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁场中三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体是典型的受挫量子磁体，但其一般各向异性的基态相图及其热相结构仍未完全了解。在这里，使用无限密度矩阵重整化群、无限投影纠缠对算子和指数张量重整化群方法，在精确对角化的支持下，我们解决了这两个问题。在零温度下，我们连续绘制从伊辛极限到海森堡点的相图，发现非经典 Ψ 超固体在所研究的所有各向异性下都是略低于饱和度的稳定相：它直接与强易轴区域中的三分之一磁化上下平台和朝向海森堡点的半经典 V 相接壤。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁场中三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体是典型的受挫量子磁体，但其一般各向异性的基态相图及其热相结构仍未完全了解。在这里，使用无限密度矩阵重整化群、无限投影纠缠对算子和指数张量重整化群方法，在精确对角化的支持下，我们解决了这两个问题。在零温度下，我们连续绘制从伊辛极限到海森堡点的相图，发现非经典 Ψ 超固体在所研究的所有各向异性下都是略低于饱和度的稳定相：它直接与强易轴区域中的三分之一磁化上下平台和朝向海森堡点的半经典 V 相接壤。在强易轴状态下，我们发现了零温平台-Ψ边界之上的本质上有限温度的键向列相，其中三个键方向自发地变得不等价，没有横向自旋相干性或三亚晶格顺序。硬核玻色子映射揭示了它的起源：一旦热波动破坏了相位相干性，场掺杂空穴就会沉积在局部上下顺序的畴壁上，这些畴壁通过量子扭结离域稳定并通过其 Z₃ 注册表对齐。我们的结果要求重新检查三角晶格钴酸盐（例如 Na2BaCo(PO4)2 和 K2Co(SeO3)2）的高场态。

articles.title: Strain-enabled dynamical magnetoelectric coupling in BaFe₁₂O₁₉
articles.title_zh: BaFe₁₂O₁₉ 中的应变驱动动态磁电耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical excitation has emerged as a powerful tool for manipulating and creating non-equilibrium phases of matter. Yet, the pathways available for optical control are intrinsically limited by the symmetries and interactions of the equilibrium system. Here, we demonstrate that these pathways can be redesigned through atomic-structural engineering to access hidden dynamical properties. By combining resonant vibrational excitation with epitaxial strain, we realize a light-induced, room-temperature multiferroic state in strained thin films of the technologically relevant hexagonal ferrimagnet, barium hexaferrite (BaFe₁₂O₁₉, BaM). Time-resolved second harmonic generation and magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements reveal an enhanced ferroelectric polarization together with a weakening of the magnetic moment upon exciting mid-infrared phonons in strained BaM thin films, but not in the bulk material. Structural analysis and first-principles-based theory show that this effect is enabled by strain-generated displacement of Fe³⁺ ions, which break the local symmetry and facilitate an emergent dynamical magnetoelectric coupling. Both the strong lattice excitation and strain-induced symmetry breaking are essential for enabling this dynamical coupling, promising an important template for designing otherwise inaccessible non-equilibrium phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 光激发已成为操纵和创建物质非平衡相的强大工具。然而，可用于光学控制的途径本质上受到平衡系统的对称性和相互作用的限制。在这里，我们证明这些途径可以通过原子结构工程重新设计，以获取隐藏的动力学特性。通过将谐振振动激发与外延应变相结合，我们在技术相关的六方铁磁体、六方铁氧体钡（BaFe₁2O₁₉，BaM）的应变薄膜中实现了光诱导的室温多铁态。时间分辨二次谐波产生和磁光克尔效应测量表明，在应变 BaM 薄膜中激发中红外声子时，铁电极化增强，磁矩减弱，但在块体材料中则不然。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光激发已成为操纵和创建物质非平衡相的强大工具。然而，可用于光学控制的途径本质上受到平衡系统的对称性和相互作用的限制。在这里，我们证明这些途径可以通过原子结构工程重新设计，以获取隐藏的动力学特性。通过将谐振振动激发与外延应变相结合，我们在技术相关的六方铁磁体、六方铁氧体钡（BaFe₁2O₁₉，BaM）的应变薄膜中实现了光诱导的室温多铁态。时间分辨二次谐波产生和磁光克尔效应测量表明，在应变 BaM 薄膜中激发中红外声子时，铁电极化增强，磁矩减弱，但在块体材料中则不然。结构分析和基于第一性原理的理论表明，这种效应是由 Fe3+ 离子应变产生的位移实现的，它打破了局部对称性并促进了动态磁电耦合的出现。强晶格激发和应变引起的对称性破缺对于实现这种动态耦合至关重要，为设计其他难以实现的非平衡现象提供了重要的模板。

articles.title: A fermionic framework for quantum machine learning benchmarks
articles.title_zh: 用于量子机器学习基准的费米子框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a framework for building and benchmarking scalable machine learning (ML) models based on simulating free-fermion systems. Our fermionic ML (FermiML) framework is (i) versatile enough to encompass kernel methods and neural networks, (ii) applicable to classification and regression, and (iii) scalable to real-world datasets. FermiML models are quantum circuits sharing the building blocks of most quantum ML (QML) models: (parameterized) qubit rotations and entangling gates. This allows us to build fermionic surrogates that mimic the architecture, and hence the quantum resources and inductive bias, of any QML model while remaining efficiently classically simulable. We thus benchmark QML models against close fermionic counterparts on equal footing and ascertain whether a purported QML gain truly stems from classically inaccessible resources or is an accidental side-effect. Across 31 configurations from five classification datasets, we benchmark quantum kitchen sinks (QKS), instantaneous quantum polynomial (IQP) and generic parameterized quantum circuit (PQC) models against fermionic surrogates. fQKS significantly outperforms QKS and is statistically indistinguishable from IQP and PQC; fPQC outperforms IQP and QKS and ties PQC in 28 configurations. We also introduce fermionic fidelity and Pfaffian covariance kernels for regression and establish QML baselines for this harder task. Finally, we introduce a fermionic energy-based classifier scalable to large text and image datasets, which outperforms prominent QML models on images, beats or closely trails them on text, and stays close to classical baselines throughout. Our results show that while performance depends sensitively on architecture, FermiML yields fermionic surrogates that challenge or outperform their unrestricted counterparts and fermionic QML models that match the scale of classical baselines on real-world datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个基于模拟自由费米子系统来构建和基准测试可扩展机器学习（ML）模型的框架。我们的费米子机器学习 (FermiML) 框架 (i) 用途广泛，足以涵盖核方法和神经网络，(ii) 适用于分类和回归，以及 (iii) 可扩展到现实世界的数据集。 FermiML 模型是量子电路，共享大多数量子 ML (QML) 模型的构建块：（参数化）量子位旋转和纠缠门。这使我们能够构建模拟任何 QML 模型的架构以及量子资源和归纳偏差的费米子代理，同时保持有效的经典可模拟性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个基于模拟自由费米子系统来构建和基准测试可扩展机器学习（ML）模型的框架。我们的费米子机器学习 (FermiML) 框架 (i) 用途广泛，足以涵盖核方法和神经网络，(ii) 适用于分类和回归，以及 (iii) 可扩展到现实世界的数据集。 FermiML 模型是量子电路，共享大多数量子 ML (QML) 模型的构建块：（参数化）量子位旋转和纠缠门。这使我们能够构建模拟任何 QML 模型的架构以及量子资源和归纳偏差的费米子代理，同时保持有效的经典可模拟性。因此，我们在平等的基础上将 QML 模型与接近的费米子模型进行基准测试，并确定所谓的 QML 增益是否真正源于传统上无法访问的资源，或者是偶然的副作用。在来自五个分类数据集的 31 个配置中，我们对量子厨房水槽 (QKS)、瞬时量子多项式 (IQP) 和通用参数化量子电路 (PQC) 模型与费米子替代物进行了基准测试。 fQKS 显着优于 QKS，并且在统计上与 IQP 和 PQC 没有区别； fPQC 的性能优于 IQP 和 QKS，并在 28 种配置中与 PQC 持平。我们还引入了用于回归的费米子保真度和 Pfaffian 协方差内核，并为这项艰巨的任务建立了 QML 基线。最后，我们引入了一种可扩展至大型文本和图像数据集的基于费米子能量的分类器，该分类器在图像上优于著名的 QML 模型，在文本上击败或紧密跟踪它们，并且始终保持接近经典基线。我们的结果表明，虽然性能敏感地取决于体系结构，但 FermiML 产生的费米子代理挑战或优于其不受限制的对应模型，以及与现实数据集上的经典基线规模相匹配的费米子 QML 模型。

articles.title: Strong Co-O exchange interaction in P4/nmm KCoO₂ and its effect on spin wave and Néel temperature
articles.title_zh: P4/nmm KCoO2 中强 Co-O 交换相互作用及其对自旋波和尼尔温度的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exchange interactions of a classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian in KCoO₂ in the P4/nnm structure are calculated using a linear response approach, derived from the transverse spin susceptibility, integrated over atomic spheres using a projector proportional the local magnetization and including all atoms as magnetic atoms. The exchange interaction between Co and its apical O is found to be by far the largest interaction and ferromagnetic. Its effect on the Néel temperature and the spin wave spectrum are evaluated. The Co-O exchange is found to strongly enhance the critical temperature in the mean field approximation but not in the random phase approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: P4/nnm 结构中 KCoO2 中经典海森堡哈密顿量的交换相互作用是使用线性响应方法计算的，该方法源自横向自旋磁化率，使用与局部磁化强度成比例的投影仪在原子球上积分，并将所有原子作为磁性原子。 Co 与其顶端 O 之间的交换相互作用被发现是迄今为止最大的相互作用和铁磁性。评估了它对尼尔温度和自旋波谱的影响。研究发现，Co-O 交换会强烈提高平均场近似中的临界温度，但不会显着提高随机相近似中的临界温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: P4/nnm 结构中 KCoO2 中经典海森堡哈密顿量的交换相互作用是使用线性响应方法计算的，该方法源自横向自旋磁化率，使用与局部磁化强度成比例的投影仪在原子球上积分，并将所有原子作为磁性原子。 Co 与其顶端 O 之间的交换相互作用被发现是迄今为止最大的相互作用和铁磁性。评估了它对尼尔温度和自旋波谱的影响。研究发现，Co-O 交换会强烈提高平均场近似中的临界温度，但不会显着提高随机相近似中的临界温度。

articles.title: Spin Hamiltonian, magnetic anisotropy and excitation spectrum in altermagnetic α-MnTe from first principles
articles.title_zh: 第一原理中互磁 α-MnTe 的自旋哈密顿量、磁各向异性和激发谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hexagonal altermagnet α-MnTe combines a near-room-temperature collinear order with a strongly spin-split electronic structure, yet the microscopic origin of its easy-plane anisotropy, its zone-center magnon gap and its anomalously large magnetostriction have remained unexplained. We derive the complete low-energy magnetic Hamiltonian of α-MnTe from first principles, combining density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory with a force-theorem evaluation of the full anisotropic intersite exchange, single-ion terms and classical dipolar couplings. The isotropic exchange, including the altermagnetic splitting of the tenth-neighbor coupling, agrees with inelastic neutron scattering data. Contrary to the common single-ion picture, we find that the easy-plane anisotropy and the magnon gap at Γ are governed by classical dipole-dipole interactions, which enhance the zone-center magnon splitting threefold leading to quantitative agreement with experiment, while the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya term is irrelevant despite its size. The same Hamiltonian reproduces the chiral magnon splitting along antinodal directions, mirroring the electronic spin splitting, and quantitatively accounts for the giant magnetovolume coupling of α-MnTe through the volume dependence of superexchange.
articles.abstract_zh: 六方相变磁体 α-MnTe 将近室温共线有序与强自旋分裂电子结构结合在一起，但其易平面各向异性、区中心磁振子间隙和异常大磁致伸缩的微观起源仍无法解释。我们根据第一原理，结合密度泛函理论和动态平均场理论，以及完全各向异性位点间交换、单离子项和经典偶极耦合的力定理评估，推导了 α-MnTe 的完整低能磁性哈密顿量。各向同性交换，包括第十邻耦合的交磁分裂，与非弹性中子散射数据一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方相变磁体 α-MnTe 将近室温共线有序与强自旋分裂电子结构结合在一起，但其易平面各向异性、区中心磁振子间隙和异常大磁致伸缩的微观起源仍无法解释。我们根据第一原理，结合密度泛函理论和动态平均场理论，以及完全各向异性位点间交换、单离子项和经典偶极耦合的力定理评估，推导了 α-MnTe 的完整低能磁性哈密顿量。各向同性交换，包括第十邻耦合的交磁分裂，与非弹性中子散射数据一致。与常见的单离子图像相反，我们发现 γ 处的易平面各向异性和磁振子能隙受经典偶极子-偶极子相互作用控制，这将区域中心磁振子分裂增强三倍，从而与实验定量一致，而 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 项尽管其大小却无关紧要。相同的哈密顿量再现了沿波腹方向的手性磁振子分裂，反映了电子自旋分裂，并通过超交换的体积依赖性定量地解释了 α-MnTe 的巨磁体积耦合。

articles.title: Majorana flat bands from mirror-particle-hole antisymmetry
articles.title_zh: 镜面粒子孔反对称性的马约拉纳平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana flat bands, zero modes across the whole edge Brillouin zone, usually rest on chiral symmetry. We show that a fully gapped class-D superconductor can host such a flat band without chiral symmetry or time reversal, provided its superconducting gap is odd under a mirror and translation along the edge is preserved. Combined with particle--hole conjugation, the mirror forms an antiunitary antisymmetry that squares to +1 and preserves the momentum along the edge, so it fixes the Kitaev index of every slice of fixed edge momentum. In a gapped bulk, this slice index cannot change with the edge momentum, and the edge zero modes form a band across the whole edge Brillouin zone. We construct a four-band model with exactly these symmetries, a helical p-wave superconductor with Rashba coupling in an in-plane exchange field, from which no term can be removed without restoring an additional symmetry. On the mirror lines, its two mirror sectors are exact Kitaev chains. This yields a closed-form phase diagram. Besides the flat band, the model hosts a phase with two Majoranas at each end of a wire, although its class-D index is trivial, and a second-order phase with Majorana corner modes. The spectral localizer detects all these indices in real space, directly on finite-size samples as relevant for experiments. On open rectangular flakes of two widths, it reproduces the phase diagram even though translational symmetry is broken. In the nodal regions, its reading depends on the flake size, so they are left unread. The readings persist under disorder several times the bulk gap. Without translation along the edge, the symmetries protect no more than Majorana parities, and we quantify the signatures that remain specific to the antisymmetry. A minimal model of magnetic adatoms on a triplet superconductor realizes the flat-band and second-order phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 马约拉纳平带，整个边缘布里渊区的零模式，通常依赖于手性对称性。我们证明，完全带隙的 D 类超导体可以在没有手性对称性或时间反转的情况下容纳这样的平带，只要其超导带隙在镜子下是奇数并且沿边缘的平移得以保留。与粒子-空穴共轭相结合，镜子形成了反酉反对称，其平方为+1并保留了沿边缘的动量，因此它固定了每片固定边缘动量的基塔耶夫指数。在有间隙的块体中，该切片指数不能随边缘动量变化，并且边缘零模式形成横跨整个边缘布里渊区的带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 马约拉纳平带，整个边缘布里渊区的零模式，通常依赖于手性对称性。我们证明，完全带隙的 D 类超导体可以在没有手性对称性或时间反转的情况下容纳这样的平带，只要其超导带隙在镜子下是奇数并且沿边缘的平移得以保留。与粒子-空穴共轭相结合，镜子形成了反酉反对称，其平方为+1并保留了沿边缘的动量，因此它固定了每片固定边缘动量的基塔耶夫指数。在有间隙的块体中，该切片指数不能随边缘动量变化，并且边缘零模式形成横跨整个边缘布里渊区的带。我们构建了一个恰好具有这些对称性的四能带模型，即在面内交换场中具有 Rashba 耦合的螺旋 p 波超导体，在不恢复额外对称性的情况下无法从中删除任何项。在镜像线上，它的两个镜像扇区正是基塔耶夫链。这产生了封闭形式的相图。除了平带之外，该模型还在线材两端具有两个马约拉纳相位（尽管其 D 类指数微不足道），以及具有马约拉纳角模式的二阶相位。光谱定位器直接在与实验相关的有限尺寸样本上检测真实空间中的所有这些指数。在两种宽度的开放矩形薄片上，即使平移对称性被打破，它也能再现相图。在节点区域，其读数取决于薄片尺寸，因此它们未被读取。在无序的情况下，读数仍然是大间隙的几倍。如果没有沿着边缘的平移，对称性仅仅保护马约拉纳奇偶性，并且我们量化仍然特定于反对称性的签名。三重态超导体上磁性吸附原子的最小模型实现了平带和二阶相。

articles.title: Adaptive ghost Gutzwiller dynamics of Hubbard model quenches across coupling strengths over extended times
articles.title_zh: 哈伯德模型的自适应幽灵古茨威勒动力学在长时间内会淬灭耦合强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Following the real-time dynamics of correlated electrons to extended times, at all interaction strengths, remains an open challenge. We address it with an adaptive time-dependent ghost Gutzwiller approximation (td-gGA). The method extends the Gutzwiller approximation by auxiliary ghost orbitals. It adds more of them whenever the correlations that build up during the dynamics exceed a threshold. This is computationally far more efficient than keeping their number fixed. As a demonstration we take the interaction quench of the half-filled Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. For this paradigmatic problem, numerically exact nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) serves as the reference. A previous td-gGA study with a fixed set of 6 ghost orbitals per spin largely reproduced the available DMFT data. It lacked, however, an error estimate that would support predictions beyond them. With up to 16 ghost orbitals per spin, adaptive td-gGA agrees with DMFT wherever DMFT data are available, from the weak-coupling prethermal regime to the strong-coupling collapse-and-revival regime. At strong coupling it remains converged up to three and a half times as long as the DMFT data. Near the crossover between the two regimes, the system relaxes to thermal values that agree with DMFT. Resolving the dynamics in the number of ghost orbitals shows how the sharp dynamical transition of the Gutzwiller approximation turns into this smooth crossover. In the extended time window at strong coupling, we observe that the oscillation frequency is renormalized as predicted by our second-order strong-coupling expansion. With its built-in error estimate, adaptive td-gGA offers a systematically improvable route to the extended-time dynamics of driven and multi-orbital correlated systems, especially when combined with tensor-network or quantum solvers for the embedding problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 在所有相互作用强度下，长时间跟踪相关电子的实时动态仍然是一个开放的挑战。我们使用自适应时间相关鬼 Gutzwiller 近似（td-gGA）来解决这个问题。该方法通过辅助鬼轨道扩展了 Gutzwiller 近似。每当动态过程中建立的相关性超过阈值时，它就会添加更多的相关性。这在计算上比保持其数量固定要有效得多。作为演示，我们以 Bethe 晶格上半填充 Hubbard 模型的相互作用淬灭为例。对于这个典型问题，数值精确的非平衡动态平均场理论（DMFT）可以作为参考。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在所有相互作用强度下，长时间跟踪相关电子的实时动态仍然是一个开放的挑战。我们使用自适应时间相关鬼 Gutzwiller 近似（td-gGA）来解决这个问题。该方法通过辅助鬼轨道扩展了 Gutzwiller 近似。每当动态过程中建立的相关性超过阈值时，它就会添加更多的相关性。这在计算上比保持其数量固定要有效得多。作为演示，我们以 Bethe 晶格上半填充 Hubbard 模型的相互作用淬灭为例。对于这个典型问题，数值精确的非平衡动态平均场理论（DMFT）可以作为参考。之前的 td-gGA 研究每次旋转有一组固定的 6 个鬼轨道，很大程度上再现了可用的 DMFT 数据。然而，它缺乏支持超出其预测的误差估计。每个自旋最多有 16 个鬼轨道，只要有 DMFT 数据，自适应 td-gGA 就与 DMFT 一致，从弱耦合预热状态到强耦合塌陷和复兴状态。在强耦合下，它的收敛时间是 DMFT 数据的三倍半。在两个状态之间的交叉点附近，系统松弛到与 DMFT 一致的热值。解析鬼轨道数量的动力学表明古茨维勒近似的急剧动力学转变如何转变为这种平滑的交叉。在强耦合的扩展时间窗口中，我们观察到振荡频率被重整化，正如我们的二阶强耦合展开式所预测的那样。凭借其内置的误差估计，自适应 td-gGA 为驱动和多轨道相关系统的延长时间动态提供了一条系统性可改进的途径，特别是与张量网络或量子求解器结合解决嵌入问题时。

articles.title: Universal spectrum of weakly coupled quantum critical Ising chains
articles.title_zh: 弱耦合量子临界伊辛链的通用谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the spectrum of arrays of critical transverse field Ising chains perturbed by a weak inter-chain coupling in the scaling limit, using an exact diagonalization algorithm based on Hamiltonian truncation. As the number of chains is made large, we confirm the existence of excitations below the two particle continuum that can be identified with the celebrated Zamalodchikov E₈ theory with small corrections. In addition, we find a distinct ψ-particle, with mass M_ψ which is not contained in the E₈ theory. Its ratio to the lowest E₈ mass (M₁) is a universal number, which we have computed numerically to be M_ψ/M₁ = 1.819cdots for a one dimensional array of critical chains. We present evidence that this new state fundamentally involves excitations on neighboring chains, explaining why it has no analogue in the single chain problem. Interestingly the M_ψ mass has a characteristic scaling dependence on detuning from the critical point that is qualitatively distinct from the E₈ masses, which can help identify it in spectroscopic experiments on easy-axis magnetic chain materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用基于哈密顿截断的精确对角化算法，研究了在缩放极限下受弱链间耦合扰动的临界横向场伊辛链阵列的谱。随着链的数量变大，我们确认了两个粒子连续体下方存在激发，这可以通过著名的 Zamalodchikov E₈ 理论进行少量修正来识别。此外，我们还发现了一个独特的 ψ 粒子，其质量为 M_ψ，这不包含在 E₈ 理论中。它与最低 E₈ 质量 (M₁) 的比率是一个通用数，对于一维关键链数组，我们通过数值计算得出 M_ψ/M₁ = 1.819cdots。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用基于哈密顿截断的精确对角化算法，研究了在缩放极限下受弱链间耦合扰动的临界横向场伊辛链阵列的谱。随着链的数量变大，我们确认了两个粒子连续体下方存在激发，这可以通过著名的 Zamalodchikov E₈ 理论进行少量修正来识别。此外，我们还发现了一个独特的 ψ 粒子，其质量为 M_ψ，这不包含在 E₈ 理论中。它与最低 E₈ 质量 (M₁) 的比率是一个通用数，对于一维关键链数组，我们通过数值计算得出 M_ψ/M₁ = 1.819cdots。我们提供的证据表明，这种新状态从根本上涉及相邻链的激励，这解释了为什么它在单链问题中没有类似物。有趣的是，M_ψ 质量具有与临界点失谐相关的特征缩放依赖性，这在质量上与 E₈ 质量不同，这有助于在易轴磁链材料的光谱实验中识别它。

articles.title: Interface and film engineering for improved spin-charge interconversion in sputtered GeTe nanodevices
articles.title_zh: 用于改进溅射 GeTe 纳米器件中自旋电荷相互转换的界面和薄膜工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-logic devices promise non-volatile logic-in-memory computing with ultra-low power consumption, offering a route to circumvent the von Neumann bottleneck. Magnetoelectric and ferroelectric spin-orbit (MESO/FESO) devices, however, require spin-charge interconversion materials that combine a large output signal with properties that survive nanoscale integration. Tellurides are particularly fragile in this respect, as processing readily introduces defects that degrade their spin-charge interconversion properties. Here we demonstrate room-temperature spin-charge interconversion in patterned FESO nanoscale devices based on sputtered GeTe, with feature sizes down to 100 nm. By introducing a Ti interfacial layer between the CoFe electrode and GeTe, and by using GeTe films of improved crystalline quality, we increase the interconversion output signal from 3 mΩ to 24 mΩ, exceeding values reported for platinum at comparable device size. These results establish large-scale-deposited GeTe as a viable material platform for spin-logic devices and identify interface quality and film crystallinity as key levers for optimizing their performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋逻辑器件有望实现具有超低功耗的非易失性内存逻辑计算，从而提供了绕过冯·诺依曼瓶颈的途径。然而，磁电和铁电自旋轨道（MESO/FESO）器件需要将大输出信号与能够承受纳米级集成的特性相结合的自旋电荷互变材料。碲化物在这方面特别脆弱，因为加工过程容易引入缺陷，从而降低其自旋电荷互变性能。在这里，我们展示了基于溅射 GeTe 的图案化 FESO 纳米级器件中的室温自旋电荷互变，其特征尺寸小至 100 nm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋逻辑器件有望实现具有超低功耗的非易失性内存逻辑计算，从而提供了绕过冯·诺依曼瓶颈的途径。然而，磁电和铁电自旋轨道（MESO/FESO）器件需要将大输出信号与能够承受纳米级集成的特性相结合的自旋电荷互变材料。碲化物在这方面特别脆弱，因为加工过程容易引入缺陷，从而降低其自旋电荷互变性能。在这里，我们展示了基于溅射 GeTe 的图案化 FESO 纳米级器件中的室温自旋电荷互变，其特征尺寸小至 100 nm。通过在 CoFe 电极和 GeTe 之间引入 Ti 界面层，并使用改善晶体质量的 GeTe 薄膜，我们将互变输出信号从 3 mΩ 增加到 24 mΩ，超过了在可比器件尺寸下铂的报告值。这些结果将大规模沉积的 GeTe 确立为自旋逻辑器件的可行材料平台，并将界面质量和薄膜结晶度确定为优化其性能的关键杠杆。

articles.title: Fluids under tension: dynamics, mechanics, and structure of sparse active adhesive networks
articles.title_zh: 张力下的流体：稀疏活性粘合网络的动力学、力学和结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse mechanical networks under tension are inherently prone to gelation/clustering instabilities as bonds break, so they typically cannot reconfigure without collapsing. Subverting this expectation, several biological materials have recently been found to maintain tension and uniformity while flowing. Here, we identify key ingredients needed to generate this fluid under tension and explore how details of the implementation affect ma- terial dynamics, structure, and mechanics. We find that activity must counteract the clustering instability, and that adhesive unbinding must be sufficiently stochastic so that it does not cancel out the activity and drive the system to a quiescent absorbing state. We find that the nature of the activity dramatically changes the material properties and glassy dynamics: self-propelled crawling, implemented as a force monopole, drives collective motion over long wavelengths, resulting in anti-hyperuniform density, whereas a force dipole representing par- ticles pulling on each other drives scale-free collective motion and more uniform density. Both models exhibit exotic mechanics: stresses in each bond relax only through bond turnover, but the global tension never relaxes. In addition, in the crawling model the structure of the network relaxes faster than the pattern of stresses, sug- gesting the material retains a memory of its stress state even as the particle positions reconfigure. Together, this work shows that we can distinguish between activity mechanisms in biological systems by analyzing emergent materials properties, and design exotic emergent properties in reconfigurable active matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 张力下的稀疏机械网络本质上容易在键断裂时出现凝胶/聚集不稳定，因此它们通常无法在不崩溃的情况下重新配置。颠覆了这一预期，最近发现几种生物材料在流动时保持张力和均匀性。在这里，我们确定了在张力下产生这种流体所需的关键成分，并探讨了实施细节如何影响材料动力学、结构和力学。我们发现活性必须抵消簇的不稳定性，并且粘合剂解绑必须足够随机，这样它就不会抵消活性并将系统驱动到静态吸收状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张力下的稀疏机械网络本质上容易在键断裂时出现凝胶/聚集不稳定，因此它们通常无法在不崩溃的情况下重新配置。颠覆了这一预期，最近发现几种生物材料在流动时保持张力和均匀性。在这里，我们确定了在张力下产生这种流体所需的关键成分，并探讨了实施细节如何影响材料动力学、结构和力学。我们发现活性必须抵消簇的不稳定性，并且粘合剂解绑必须足够随机，这样它就不会抵消活性并将系统驱动到静态吸收状态。我们发现，活动的本质极大地改变了材料特性和玻璃动力学：以力单极子的形式实现的自推进爬行，驱动长波长的集体运动，从而产生反超均匀密度，而代表粒子相互拉扯的力偶极子则驱动无标度的集体运动和更均匀的密度。这两种模型都表现出奇特的机制：每种债券的压力只能通过债券周转而放松，但全球紧张局势永远不会放松。此外，在爬行模型中，网络结构比应力模式松弛得更快，这表明即使粒子位置重新配置，材料仍保留其应力状态的记忆。总之，这项工作表明，我们可以通过分析突现材料特性来区分生物系统中的活动机制，并在可重构活性物质系统中设计奇异的突现特性。

articles.title: Superconductivity with valley-imbalanced Fermi surfaces in thick rhombohedral graphene
articles.title_zh: 厚菱面体石墨烯中具有谷不平衡费米面的超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity in spin-polarized metals challenges conventional opposite-spin pairing, particularly when a magnetic field strengthens rather than suppresses it. In graphene, the additional valley degree of freedom broadens the possible pairing channels, making the valley occupation of the parent metal central to understanding such superconductivity. Here we report in-plane-field-enhanced superconductivity in hBN-aligned 17-layer rhombohedral graphene. Normal-state quantum oscillations reveal unequal Fermi pockets consistent with a valley-imbalanced, spin-polarized parent metal. Calculations show that the parent electron pocket is predominantly localized on the bottom surface and largely preserved by electrostatic screening as additional Fermi pockets emerge. Superconductivity persists in this regime but is suppressed when carriers are polarized toward the hBN-aligned surface, where the parent bands undergo strong moire reconstruction. An adjacent nonlinear metallic response evolves continuously into superconducting critical-current features and persists above the superconducting transition temperature. The combination of valley imbalance and in-plane-field-enhanced superconductivity motivates a phenomenological magnon-assisted equal-spin intervalley pairing scenario. These findings provide experimental constraints on pairing in valley-imbalanced metals and open a route to testing magnetic pairing mechanisms through layer-selective control of the parent electronic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋极化金属中的超导性对传统的相反自旋配对提出了挑战，特别是当磁场增强而不是抑制它时。在石墨烯中，额外的谷自由度拓宽了可能的配对通道，使得母体金属的谷占据对于理解这种超导性至关重要。在这里，我们报告了六方氮化硼排列的 17 层菱面体石墨烯的面内场增强超导性。正常态量子振荡揭示了与谷不平衡、自旋极化母体金属一致的不等费米口袋。计算表明，母电子袋主要位于底部表面，并且随着额外费米袋的出现，大部分通过静电屏蔽得以保留。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋极化金属中的超导性对传统的相反自旋配对提出了挑战，特别是当磁场增强而不是抑制它时。在石墨烯中，额外的谷自由度拓宽了可能的配对通道，使得母体金属的谷占据对于理解这种超导性至关重要。在这里，我们报告了六方氮化硼排列的 17 层菱面体石墨烯的面内场增强超导性。正常态量子振荡揭示了与谷不平衡、自旋极化母体金属一致的不等费米口袋。计算表明，母电子袋主要位于底部表面，并且随着额外费米袋的出现，大部分通过静电屏蔽得以保留。在这种情况下，超导性仍然存在，但当载流子向六方氮化硼排列的表面极化时，超导性受到抑制，其中母带经历了强烈的莫尔重构。相邻的非线性金属响应不断演变为超导临界电流特征，并持续高于超导转变温度。谷不平衡和面内场增强超导性的结合激发了唯象磁振子辅助的等自旋间隔配对场景。这些发现为谷不平衡金属的配对提供了实验限制，并开辟了一条通过母体电子态的层选择性控制来测试磁配对机制的途径。

articles.title: Accelerating Equivariant Interatomic Potentials for Molecular Dynamics through Radial tabulation and Kernel Fusion
articles.title_zh: 通过径向制表和核融合加速分子动力学的等变原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equivariant machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) achieve near-quantum-chemical accuracy, but their computational cost and GPU memory footprint restrict molecular dynamics (MD) at extended length and time scales. Even when the tensor product (TP) is accelerated, both bottlenecks remain governed by evaluating and storing per-edge radial weights in the NequIP convolution. We introduce JET-MLIPs (Joint-Kernel Equivariant Convolution with Tabulated Radial Weights for MLIP simulation), a GPU backend applicable to pretrained NequIP-family potentials without retraining. JET-MLIPs replaces the radial multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a piecewise cubic Hermite table and fuses table lookup, spherical harmonics, TP and neighbor aggregation into a single kernel, eliminating per-edge radial-weight and MLP-intermediate storage during force evaluation. Across 15 released potentials from SevenNet, MACE, NequIP-OAM, Nequix and EquFlash on a 5632-atom liquid electrolyte, LAMMPS MD attains 1.5-5.9× step-time speed-ups and 2.4-24× peak memory reductions relative to each family's existing TP-accelerated backend on a single H200 GPU while preserving single-precision (fp32) accuracy and dynamical stability. These reductions enable multi-nanosecond transport-property simulations of roughly 10⁴-atom systems on a single GPU and broaden access to large-scale equivariant MLIP MD on widely available GPUs.
articles.abstract_zh: 等变机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 实现了接近量子化学的精度，但其计算成本和 GPU 内存占用限制了分子动力学 (MD) 在扩展长度和时间尺度上的发展。即使张量积 (TP) 加速，这两个瓶颈仍然是通过评估和存储 NequIP 卷积中的每边径向权重来控制的。我们引入了 JET-MLIP（用于 MLIP 模拟的带有列表径向权重的联合核等变卷积），这是一种适用于预训练 NequIP 系列势的 GPU 后端，无需重新训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等变机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 实现了接近量子化学的精度，但其计算成本和 GPU 内存占用限制了分子动力学 (MD) 在扩展长度和时间尺度上的发展。即使张量积 (TP) 加速，这两个瓶颈仍然是通过评估和存储 NequIP 卷积中的每边径向权重来控制的。我们引入了 JET-MLIP（用于 MLIP 模拟的带有列表径向权重的联合核等变卷积），这是一种适用于预训练 NequIP 系列势的 GPU 后端，无需重新训练。 JET-MLIP 用分段立方 Hermite 表取代了径向多层感知器 (MLP)，并将表查找、球谐函数、TP 和邻居聚合融合到单个内核中，从而消除了力评估过程中每边径向权重和 MLP 中间存储。在来自 SevenNet、MACE、NequiIP-OAM、Nequix 和 EquFlash 的 15 个在 5632 个原子液体电解质上发布的潜力中，相对于单个 H200 GPU 上每个系列现有的 TP 加速后端，LAMMPS MD 实现了 1.5-5.9 倍的步长加速和 2.4-24 倍的峰值内存减少，同时保持了单精度 (fp32) 精度和动态稳定性。这些减少使得能够在单个 GPU 上对大约 10⁴ 原子系统进行多纳秒传输特性模拟，并扩大在广泛使用的 GPU 上对大规模等变 MLIP MD 的访问。

articles.title: Upper and lower bounds for the critical point of the three-dimensional Ising model
articles.title_zh: 三维伊辛模型临界点的上下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that the critical point K_c of the nearest-neighbour Ising ferromagnet on Z³ satisfies 0.2164203058<0.2293910295, equivalently 1.541630483<1.582145851, with both endpoints given by explicit rational numbers. To our knowledge these are the sharpest rigorous bounds available. They improve the classical bounds of Fisher (1967) and of Fröhlich, Simon and Spencer (1976), narrowing the rigorously known interval by a factor of about 3.5, and the interval contains the numerical estimate of the critical point. For the lower bound we refine Fisher's self-avoiding-walk argument. A shortest path in the high-temperature expansion forbids all bonds spanned by its vertices, and the resulting gain is estimated through local correlation integrals and summed over paths by a finite-memory transfer bound. As a by-product, the connective constant of Z³ is shown to be at most 4.73195. For the upper bound we prove an infrared bound whose coefficient involves the nearest-neighbour correlation. We keep the zero Fourier mode as an unknown and force it to be positive by exact local relations for the spins on a small shell.
