The finite inequalities entering the proof are verified in exact rational arithmetic, and the passage to the thermodynamic limit is proved analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明Z³上最近邻伊辛铁磁体的临界点K_c满足0.2164203058<0.2293910295，相当于1.541630483<1.582145851，两个端点都由显式有理数给出。据我们所知，这些是可用的最严格的界限。他们改进了 Fisher (1967) 和 Fröhlich、Simon 和 Spencer (1976) 的经典界限，将严格已知的区间缩小了约 3.5 倍，并且该区间包含了临界点的数值估计。对于下界，我们改进了费舍尔的自我回避行走论证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明Z³上最近邻伊辛铁磁体的临界点K_c满足0.2164203058<0.2293910295，相当于1.541630483<1.582145851，两个端点都由显式有理数给出。据我们所知，这些是可用的最严格的界限。他们改进了 Fisher (1967) 和 Fröhlich、Simon 和 Spencer (1976) 的经典界限，将严格已知的区间缩小了约 3.5 倍，并且该区间包含了临界点的数值估计。对于下界，我们改进了费舍尔的自我回避行走论证。高温膨胀中的最短路径禁止其顶点跨越的所有键，并且通过局部相关积分来估计所得增益，并通过有限内存传输界限对路径求和。作为副产品，Z3 的连接常数最多为 4.73195。对于上限，我们证明了一个红外界限，其系数涉及最近邻相关性。我们将零傅里叶模式保持为未知数，并通过小壳上自旋的精确局部关系迫使其为正。进入证明的有限不等式通过精确有理算术得到验证，并且解析地证明了到达热力学极限的过程。

articles.title: Moiré-Induced Interlayer Electron-Phonon Coupling in Graphene/hBN Superlattices
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯/六方氮化硼超晶格中莫尔感应层间电子声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-phonon coupling (EPC) plays a vital role in the electrical and optical properties of materials, ranging from superconductivity to charge dynamics. In moiré superlattices, out-of-plane vibrations can modulate the moiré potential and enhance interlayer EPC. Here we report the first direct observation of a resonance arising from coupling between moiré electronic excitations and phonons in graphene-based moiré superlattices. Using Fourier-transform infrared photocurrent spectroscopy, we detect the nominally silent hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) out-of-plane optical (ZO) phonon as a pronounced absorption peak. The phonon interferes with moiré flat-band excitations to form a characteristic Fano resonance. Displacement field-dependent measurements confirm that the feature originates from coupling to the moiré electronic continuum rather than simple zone folding. We further observe similar resonances in devices with different graphene layer numbers and twist configurations. This enhanced EPC provides a pathway for understanding and controlling emerging quantum phenomena, such as superconductivity, and engineering novel optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子声子耦合 (EPC) 在材料的电学和光学性质（从超导性到电荷动力学）中发挥着至关重要的作用。在莫尔超晶格中，面外振动可以调节莫尔势并增强层间 EPC。在这里，我们报告了首次直接观察到石墨烯莫尔超晶格中莫尔电子激发和声子之间耦合产生的共振。使用傅里叶变换红外光电流光谱，我们检测到名义上静音的六方氮化硼 (hBN) 面外光学 (ZO) 声子作为明显的吸收峰。声子干扰莫尔平带激发，形成特征性的法诺共振。位移场相关测量证实该特征源自与莫尔电子连续体的耦合，而不是简单的区域折叠。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子声子耦合 (EPC) 在材料的电学和光学性质（从超导性到电荷动力学）中发挥着至关重要的作用。在莫尔超晶格中，面外振动可以调节莫尔势并增强层间 EPC。在这里，我们报告了首次直接观察到石墨烯莫尔超晶格中莫尔电子激发和声子之间耦合产生的共振。使用傅里叶变换红外光电流光谱，我们检测到名义上静音的六方氮化硼 (hBN) 面外光学 (ZO) 声子作为明显的吸收峰。声子干扰莫尔平带激发，形成特征性的法诺共振。位移场相关测量证实该特征源自与莫尔电子连续体的耦合，而不是简单的区域折叠。我们进一步观察到具有不同石墨烯层数和扭曲配置的器件中的类似共振。这种增强的 EPC 为理解和控制超导等新兴量子现象和工程新型光电器件提供了途径。

articles.title: Environmentally assisted transport in a diamond chain
articles.title_zh: 钻石链中的环境辅助运输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum transport in a diamond chain coupled to Markovian reservoirs at its boundaries. The system is subject to uniform dephasing and an external magnetic field threading a flux Φ per plaquette. We derive exact analytical solutions for Φ=0 and Φ=π. We show that in the all-bands-flat regime at Φ=π, dephasing destroys Aharonov-Bohm caging, leading to environment-assisted quantum transport. Our results demonstrate that coupling a flat-band system to a dissipative environment provides a viable route for controlling transport in regimes where coherent dynamics alone would result in complete localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究与边界马尔可夫储层耦合的钻石链中的量子输运。该系统受到均匀相移和外部磁场的影响，每个小板的通量为 Φ。我们推导出 Φ=0 和 Φ=π 的精确解析解。我们证明，在 Φ=π 的全带平坦状态下，移相破坏了阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆笼，从而导致环境辅助的量子传输。我们的结果表明，将平带系统耦合到耗散环境提供了一种在仅相干动力学即可实现完全定位的情况下控制输运的可行途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究与边界马尔可夫储层耦合的钻石链中的量子输运。该系统受到均匀相移和外部磁场的影响，每个小板的通量为 Φ。我们推导出 Φ=0 和 Φ=π 的精确解析解。我们证明，在 Φ=π 的全带平坦状态下，移相破坏了阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆笼，从而导致环境辅助的量子传输。我们的结果表明，将平带系统耦合到耗散环境提供了一种在仅相干动力学即可实现完全定位的情况下控制输运的可行途径。

articles.title: From Weighted Frontier d-States to Geometric Descriptors for Atomically Dispersed Catalysts at the Molecule-Solid Crossover
articles.title_zh: 从加权前沿 d 态到分子-固体交叉原子分散催化剂的几何描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically dispersed catalysts exhibit molecule-solid crossover character when localized metal orbitals hybridize with support-derived bands, a regime not fully captured by either a d-band-center description or a frontier-orbital picture. We establish an electronic-to-geometric framework for oxygen reduction across fourteen metals. N-to-P substitution in M-N4 sites raises theoretical onset potentials in 13 systems, with Rh-N3P reaching 0.88 V, comparable to the Pt(111) benchmark. Scaling relations reduce *OOH, *O, and *OH thermodynamics to ΔG*OH. M-N4 follows a dyz-dominated frontier-orbital picture, whereas M-N3P requires a weighted frontier d-state representation built from adsorption-relevant orbitals and their occupancies. The resulting ϵWFDS correlates with ΔG*OH at R² = 0.92, compared with 0.83 for the d-band center and 0.64 for the frontier-orbital. The identified roles of orbital occupancy and local coordination suggest an interpretable geometric descriptor, ζM-N3P = nd/rM-P, that predicts ΔG*OH at R² = 0.96. The ORR volcano analysis identifies strong-binding systems and motivates axial oxygen coordination. This design raises onset potentials by 0.70-2.46 V, and the M-N3PO descriptor predicts ΔG*OH at R² = 0.91. By bridging frontier-orbital and d-band-center descriptions, the framework provides a physically grounded electronic representation and a geometry-based screening route compatible with machine-learned interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 当局域金属轨道与载体衍生的能带杂化时，原子分散的催化剂表现出分子-固体交叉特征，这种状态不能被 d 能带中心描述或前沿轨道图完全捕获。我们建立了一个电子到几何框架，用于十四种金属的氧还原。 M-N4 位点中的 N 到 P 取代提高了 13 个系统中的理论起始电位，其中 Rh-N3P 达到 0.88 V，与 Pt(111) 基准相当。比例关系将 *OOH、*O 和 *OH 热力学简化为 ΔG*OH。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当局域金属轨道与载体衍生的能带杂化时，原子分散的催化剂表现出分子-固体交叉特征，这种状态不能被 d 能带中心描述或前沿轨道图完全捕获。我们建立了一个电子到几何框架，用于十四种金属的氧还原。 M-N4 位点中的 N 到 P 取代提高了 13 个系统中的理论起始电位，其中 Rh-N3P 达到 0.88 V，与 Pt(111) 基准相当。比例关系将 *OOH、*O 和 *OH 热力学简化为 ΔG*OH。 M-N4 遵循 dyz 主导的前沿轨道图，而 M-N3P 需要根据吸附相关轨道及其占据构建的加权前沿 d 态表示。得到的 ϵWFDS 与 R² = 0.92 处的 ΔG*OH 相关，而 d 带中心的相关系数为 0.83，前沿轨道的相关系数为 0.64。轨道占用和局部协调的确定作用提出了一个可解释的几何描述符，zM-N3P = nd/rM-P，它预测 R2 = 0.96 时的 ΔG*OH。 ORR 火山分析可识别强结合系统并激发轴向氧协调。该设计将起始电位提高了 0.70-2.46 V，M-N3PO 描述符预测 R² = 0.91 时的 ΔG*OH。通过桥接前沿轨道和 d 带中心描述，该框架提供了物理接地的电子表示和与机器学习的原子间势兼容的基于几何的筛选路线。

articles.title: Emergent Electric-Field-Tunable p-Wave Magnetism in Twisted Bilayer NiPS₃
articles.title_zh: 扭曲双层 NiPS₃ 中的新兴电场可调谐 p 波磁力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A perpendicular electric field can reorient a momentum-space spin texture without changing the local magnetic configuration. In this Letter, we investigate this mechanism in a 21^circ-twisted NiPS₃ bilayer with zigzag order and coplanar, nonparallel layer Néel vectors. In the ideal nonrelativistic limit, an antiunitary in-plane half-translation enforces opposite-spin pairing at opposite momenta, while a layer-exchanging twofold operation pins the leading p-wave spin splitting to a crystallographic direction. A perpendicular layer bias lifts this orientational constraint while preserving the antiunitary symmetry, allowing a transverse component of the splitting vector. First-principles calculations show gate-dependent reorientation and deformation of spin-resolved isoenergy contours. Wannier-based linear-response calculations further reveal field-activated diagonal spin conductivities and a polarity-dependent tilt in the angular profile of the transverse spin-current response. The spin-texture axis, dispersion axes, and transport-response axis are distinct quantities governed by the same symmetry reduction. These results identify layer bias as a route to controlling odd-parity spin textures and spin-current anisotropy, provided that the coplanar magnetic state remains stable.
articles.abstract_zh: 垂直电场可以在不改变局部磁配置的情况下重新定向动量空间自旋纹理。在这封信中，我们研究了具有锯齿形顺序和共面非平行层 Néel 向量的 21^circ-twisted NiPS₃ 双层中的这种机制。在理想的非相对论极限中，反酉面内半平移强制以相反动量进行相反自旋配对，而层交换双重操作将领先的 p 波自旋分裂固定到晶体学方向。垂直层偏置解除了这种方向约束，同时保留了反酉对称性，从而允许分裂向量的横向分量。第一原理计算显示了自旋分辨等能轮廓的门相关重新定向和变形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 垂直电场可以在不改变局部磁配置的情况下重新定向动量空间自旋纹理。在这封信中，我们研究了具有锯齿形顺序和共面非平行层 Néel 向量的 21^circ-twisted NiPS₃ 双层中的这种机制。在理想的非相对论极限中，反酉面内半平移强制以相反动量进行相反自旋配对，而层交换双重操作将领先的 p 波自旋分裂固定到晶体学方向。垂直层偏置解除了这种方向约束，同时保留了反酉对称性，从而允许分裂向量的横向分量。第一原理计算显示了自旋分辨等能轮廓的门相关重新定向和变形。基于 Wannier 的线性响应计算进一步揭示了场激活的对角自旋电导率和横向自旋电流响应的角度分布中与极性相关的倾斜。自旋纹理轴、色散轴和传输响应轴是受相同对称性约简控制的不同量。这些结果将层偏置确定为控制奇宇称自旋纹理和自旋电流各向异性的途径，前提是共面磁态保持稳定。

articles.title: Network topology imposes spectral constraints on collective nonequilibrium responses
articles.title_zh: 网络拓扑对集体非平衡响应施加谱约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective nonequilibrium dynamics in Langevin systems depend on both network topology and stochastic driving. Understanding the role of topology in responses to stochastic driving and in the emergence of nonequilibrium is essential. Starting from the principle of microscopic reversibility and linear Langevin dynamics on networks, we derive a mode decomposition for both the asymmetry of short-time cross-correlations and heat currents at steady state. This decomposition reveals two sources of nonequilibrium---fluctuations of individual modes and correlated fluctuations between distinct modes. For reciprocal networks with independent local driving, we derive two nonequilibrium response operators that yield explicit expressions for the global asymmetry intensity and the entropy production rate. These operators are weighted Laplacians independent of stochastic driving. Their spectra determine attainable upper and lower bounds on nonequilibrium at fixed driving heterogeneity. These bounds are exact for asymmetry intensity at arbitrary deviations from equilibrium and hold to leading order near equilibrium for entropy production rate. Finally, we find that the hierarchical modular organization of human structural connectomes broadens the brain's nonequilibrium operating range, with resting-state brain activity supporting this topological advantage for sustaining a lower nonequilibrium level. Our study provides a basis for understanding biological network organization and designing networks with targeted nonequilibrium operating points.
articles.abstract_zh: 朗之万系统中的集体非平衡动力学取决于网络拓扑和随机驱动。了解拓扑在随机驱动响应和非平衡出现中的作用至关重要。从微观可逆性原理和网络线性朗之万动力学出发，我们推导出短时互相关不对称性和稳态热流的模态分解。这种分解揭示了非平衡的两个来源——单个模式的波动和不同模式之间的相关波动。对于具有独立局部驱动的互易网络，我们推导了两个非平衡响应算子，它们产生全局不对称强度和熵产生率的显式表达式。这些算子是独立于随机驱动的加权拉普拉斯算子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 朗之万系统中的集体非平衡动力学取决于网络拓扑和随机驱动。了解拓扑在随机驱动响应和非平衡出现中的作用至关重要。从微观可逆性原理和网络线性朗之万动力学出发，我们推导出短时互相关不对称性和稳态热流的模态分解。这种分解揭示了非平衡的两个来源——单个模式的波动和不同模式之间的相关波动。对于具有独立局部驱动的互易网络，我们推导了两个非平衡响应算子，它们产生全局不对称强度和熵产生率的显式表达式。这些算子是独立于随机驱动的加权拉普拉斯算子。它们的光谱确定了在固定驱动异质性下可达到的非平衡上限和下限。这些界限对于任意偏离平衡时的不对称强度来说是精确的，并且在熵产生率方面保持在接近平衡的主导顺序。最后，我们发现人类结构连接体的分层模块化组织扩大了大脑的非平衡操作范围，静息态大脑活动支持这种拓扑优势，以维持较低的非平衡水平。我们的研究为理解生物网络组织和设计具有目标非平衡工作点的网络提供了基础。

articles.title: Symmetry-dependent field-induced elastic renormalization in the quantum-critical medium-entropy alloy NiCoCr₀.₈
articles.title_zh: 量子临界中熵合金 NiCoCr₀.₈ 中对称相关场诱导的弹性重正化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the elastic response of cubic NiCoCr₀.₈, a quantum-critical medium-entropy alloy, by high-precision ultrasound velocity measurements. At zero magnetic field, the three symmetrically independent elastic moduli C₁₁, (C₁₁-C₁₂)/2=Cₜ, and C₄₄ monotonically harden upon cooling without pronounced elastic softening or anomalies. In magnetic fields applied along [110], however, a minute but systematic elastic renormalization of the order of 10⁻⁵ is resolved at low temperatures. The tetragonal E_g mode Cₜ softens with increasing field, whereas the derived bulk A₁g mode C_B hardens, revealing an opposite field response between the two strain-symmetry channels. Comparison with the previously reported quantum-critical-Fermi-liquid crossover scale shows that the field-induced elastic renormalization develops already in the quantum-critical regime and evolves continuously across the crossover region, without a sharp elastic anomaly or threshold behavior. These results demonstrate that symmetry-resolved ultrasound provides a sensitive probe of subtle strain-dependent changes in the electronic and magnetic free energy of a chemically disordered itinerant quantum-critical metal.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过高精度超声速度测量研究了立方 NiCoCr₀.₈（一种量子临界中熵合金）的弹性响应。在零磁场下，三个对称独立的弹性模量C11、(C11-C12)/2=C5和C44在冷却时单调硬化，没有明显的弹性软化或异常。然而，在沿[110]施加的磁场中，在低温下可以解决10-5量级的微小但系统的弹性重正化。四方 E_g 模式 Cₜ 随着场的增加而软化，而衍生的体 A₁g 模式 C_B 则变硬，揭示了两个应变对称通道之间相反的场响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过高精度超声速度测量研究了立方 NiCoCr₀.₈（一种量子临界中熵合金）的弹性响应。在零磁场下，三个对称独立的弹性模量C11、(C11-C12)/2=C5和C44在冷却时单调硬化，没有明显的弹性软化或异常。然而，在沿[110]施加的磁场中，在低温下可以解决10-5量级的微小但系统的弹性重正化。四方 E_g 模式 Cₜ 随着场的增加而软化，而衍生的体 A₁g 模式 C_B 则变硬，揭示了两个应变对称通道之间相反的场响应。与先前报道的量子临界费米液体交叉尺度的比较表明，场致弹性重正化已经在量子临界状态中发展，并且在交叉区域中连续演化，没有尖锐的弹性异常或阈值行为。这些结果表明，对称分辨超声波提供了一种灵敏的探针，可以探测化学无序流动量子临界金属的电子和磁性自由能中微妙的应变相关变化。

articles.title: Periodic and quasiperiodic structures produced by microphase separation in one-component simple liquids with competing interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有竞争相互作用的单组分简单液体中微相分离产生的周期性和准周期性结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing interactions can generate frustration which suppresses macroscopic-scale phase separation, superseding it with separation patterns on the microscopic scale. This phenomenon, referred to as microphase separation, produces thermodynamically stable mesoscopic-scale periodic patterns in systems of different physical nature. The studies of this effect follow two paradigms. First, in block copolymers, the macroscopic-scale separation of chemically distinct components is prevented by the covalent bonds between them. In the other, the microscopic-scale separation is produced in simple single-component liquids by the competition between a short-range attraction and a long-range repulsion (SALR) in the pair potential, the separation occurring between a dense phase and a gas. The interest in the simple liquid models with SALR interaction was inspired by the apparent universality of the modulated structures generated by competing interactions in different systems. Simple particle models are tractable by theory and thereby make it possible to discern the microscopic mechanisms of pattern formation; particle-based simulations give access to systems beyond the reach of experiments. In this Perspective we review the recent advances in the molecular-dynamics simulation of microphase separation in single-component simple liquids using SALR potentials. We show that these simulations reproduce the mesophases typical of block copolymers and liquid crystals, which demonstrates that the complexity of the constituent particles of real liquids is not a necessary condition for their formation, and that they produce novel periodic morphologies of both conceptual interest and technological relevance; we discuss how simulated mesophases can serve as templates for metamaterials whose properties are governed by topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 竞争性相互作用会产生挫败感，抑制宏观尺度的相分离，并用微观尺度的分离模式取代它。这种现象被称为微相分离，在不同物理性质的系统中产生热力学稳定的介观尺度周期性模式。这种效应的研究遵循两个范式。首先，在嵌段共聚物中，化学上不同的组分之间的共价键阻止了它们的宏观尺度分离。另一方面，微观尺度的分离是在简单的单组分液体中通过电势对中的短程吸引力和长程排斥（SALR）之间的竞争产生的，分离发生在密相和气体之间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 竞争性相互作用会产生挫败感，抑制宏观尺度的相分离，并用微观尺度的分离模式取代它。这种现象被称为微相分离，在不同物理性质的系统中产生热力学稳定的介观尺度周期性模式。这种效应的研究遵循两个范式。首先，在嵌段共聚物中，化学上不同的组分之间的共价键阻止了它们的宏观尺度分离。另一方面，微观尺度的分离是在简单的单组分液体中通过电势对中的短程吸引力和长程排斥（SALR）之间的竞争产生的，分离发生在密相和气体之间。人们对 SALR 相互作用的简单液体模型的兴趣是由不同系统中竞争相互作用产生的调制结构的明显普遍性激发的。简单的粒子模型易于理论处理，从而使辨别图案形成的微观机制成为可能；基于粒子的模拟可以访问实验无法达到的系统。在这篇文章中，我们回顾了使用 SALR 势对单组分简单液体微相分离进行分子动力学模拟的最新进展。我们表明，这些模拟再现了嵌段共聚物和液晶的典型中间相，这表明真实液体的组成颗粒的复杂性并不是它们形成的必要条件，并且它们产生了具有概念意义和技术相关性的新颖的周期性形态；我们讨论了模拟中间相如何作为超材料的模板，其属性由拓扑控制。

articles.title: Covalent Welding of Two-Dimensional Molecular Sheets into Ultra-Stiff, Super-Tough Polymeric Networks
articles.title_zh: 将二维分子片共价焊接成超硬、超韧的聚合物网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the inception of macromolecular science, polymers have been constructed from zero-dimensional monomers, a paradigm that funnels all stress through discrete one-dimensional chains. Driven by conformational entropy, polymer chains inevitably coil in three-dimensional space, precluding effective stress transfer, thereby compromising the ultimate mechanical performance. Two-dimensional (2D) molecular sheets, with intrinsic in-plane rigidity, could in principle circumvent this constraint. Yet in existing assemblies, where stress transfers efficiently within each molecular sheet but poorly between them, their exceptional properties fail to translate to the macroscale. Here, we demonstrate a 2D highly oriented molecular network (2D HOMN), an ultra-stiff, super-tough polymeric material constructed by the solid-state covalent welding of assembled 2D polyaramid sheets with flexible linkers pre-grafted at their peripheries. Enabled by efficient intersheet load sharing and energy dissipation, the welded films rival the modulus and strength of Kevlar 29 fibers, reaching 69.8 and 3.9 GPa, with impact toughness up to an order of magnitude beyond Kevlar composites. This designed intersheet covalent connectivity further renders the 2D HOMN impermeable to gas molecules and ions, resilient to radiation and efficient in thermal transport. This work establishes 2D molecular motifs as heterogeneous monomeric building blocks and provides a general strategy for constructing multifunctional polymeric networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 自大分子科学诞生以来，聚合物都是由零维单体构建的，这是一种通过离散的一维链传递所有应力的范例。在构象熵的驱动下，聚合物链不可避免地在三维空间中盘绕，阻碍了有效的应力传递，从而损害了最终的机械性能。具有内在面内刚性的二维（2D）分子片原则上可以规避这一限制。然而，在现有的组件中，应力在每个分子片内有效传递，但在分子片之间传递较差，因此它们的特殊性能无法转化为宏观尺度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自大分子科学诞生以来，聚合物都是由零维单体构建的，这是一种通过离散的一维链传递所有应力的范例。在构象熵的驱动下，聚合物链不可避免地在三维空间中盘绕，阻碍了有效的应力传递，从而损害了最终的机械性能。具有内在面内刚性的二维（2D）分子片原则上可以规避这一限制。然而，在现有的组件中，应力在每个分子片内有效传递，但在分子片之间传递较差，因此它们的特殊性能无法转化为宏观尺度。在这里，我们展示了一种 2D 高度定向分子网络 (2D HOMN)，这是一种超硬、超韧的聚合物材料，由组装的 2D 聚芳酰胺片材进行固态共价焊接而成，并在其外围预接枝了柔性连接器。通过有效的片间负载共享和能量耗散，焊接薄膜的模量和强度可与 Kevlar 29 纤维相媲美，分别达到 69.8 和 3.9 GPa，冲击韧性比 Kevlar 复合材料高出一个数量级。这种设计的片间共价连接进一步使 2D HOMN 对气体分子和离子具有不可渗透性，具有抗辐射能力和高效的热传输能力。这项工作将二维分子基序建立为异质单体构建块，并提供了构建多功能聚合物网络的一般策略。

articles.title: Dynamic scaling behaviors induced by periodic drivings at continuous Ising quantum transitions
articles.title_zh: 连续伊辛量子跃迁的周期性驱动引起的动态缩放行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the out-of-equilibrium scaling behaviors induced by periodic driving protocols in quantum many-body systems near continuous quantum phase transitions at zero temperature. We consider two paradigmatic one-dimensional systems: the quantum Ising chain subject to periodic longitudinal fields and the Kitaev fermionic wire with periodically driven chemical potentials, equivalent to a quantum Ising chain with a periodic transverse field. Within a renormalization-group (RG) framework, we develop a dynamic scaling theory for both finite-size systems and the thermodynamic limit, identifying scaling variables associated with the driving amplitude and period. We distinguish between protocols that break the global mathbb Z₂ symmetry by coupling to the order parameter and those that preserve it. These two classes of driving exhibit distinct scaling behaviors, with power-law exponents determined by the RG dimensions of the corresponding perturbations. We verify the proposed dynamic scaling theory through numerical simulations of both smooth single-frequency and discontinuous square-wave periodic drivings.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在零温度下接近连续量子相变的量子多体系统中由周期性驱动协议引起的不平衡缩放行为。我们考虑两个典型的一维系统：受周期性纵向场影响的量子伊辛链和具有周期性驱动化学势的基塔耶夫费米线，相当于具有周期性横向场的量子伊辛链。在重正化群（RG）框架内，我们开发了一种适用于有限尺寸系统和热力学极限的动态标度理论，识别与驱动幅度和周期相关的标度变量。我们区分通过耦合阶参数来打破全局 mathbb Z2 对称性的协议和保留它的协议。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在零温度下接近连续量子相变的量子多体系统中由周期性驱动协议引起的不平衡缩放行为。我们考虑两个典型的一维系统：受周期性纵向场影响的量子伊辛链和具有周期性驱动化学势的基塔耶夫费米线，相当于具有周期性横向场的量子伊辛链。在重正化群（RG）框架内，我们开发了一种适用于有限尺寸系统和热力学极限的动态标度理论，识别与驱动幅度和周期相关的标度变量。我们区分通过耦合阶参数来打破全局 mathbb Z2 对称性的协议和保留它的协议。这两类驱动表现出不同的缩放行为，幂律指数由相应扰动的 RG 维数决定。我们通过平滑单频和不连续方波周期驱动的数值模拟验证了所提出的动态标度理论。

articles.title: Angular Momentum Hall Effect of Axial Ferrons in Ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 铁电体中轴向铁电子的角动量霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon thermal and angular-momentum (AM) Hall effects are known in non-ferroelectric insulators, yet whether terahertz soft modes of displacive ferroelectrics, i.e., ``ferrons", share them remains open. We report axial ferrons that hold polarization-momentum locking in uniaxial ferroelectrics and show that both effects exist: a longitudinal temperature gradient drives a transverse AM flow without any field, whereas an out-of-plane magnetic field switches on the thermal Hall response. Two competitive channels emerge for the AM Hall effect: self-radiated magnetic fields hybridize two branches into circular modes whose momentum-locked Berry curvature deflects opposite magnetic moments to opposite edges, while temperature-gradient-induced mode quantum coherence adds a magnetic-moment dipole that leads to an opposite transverse AM current. An out-of-plane magnetic field breaks the exact polarization-momentum locking and yields a polarization Hall current. Numerical calculations show these effects are significant in both LiNbO₃ and van der Waals ferroelectrics. Edge magnetization or polarization accumulation can switch adjacent magnets or ferroelectrics, enabling low-power magnetoelectric functionality by thermal current in the future.
articles.abstract_zh: 声子热效应和角动量 (AM) 霍尔效应在非铁电绝缘体中是已知的，但位移铁电体（即“铁电子”）的太赫兹软模式是否共享它们仍然悬而未决。我们报道了在单轴铁电体中保持极化动量锁定的轴向铁电子，并表明这两种效应都存在：纵向温度梯度在没有任何场的情况下驱动横向 AM 流，而面外磁场则在热霍尔上切换AM 霍尔效应出现两个竞争通道：自辐射磁场将两个分支混合成圆形模式，其动量锁定贝里曲率将相反的磁矩偏转到相对的边缘，而温度梯度诱导模式量子相干性增加了磁矩偶极子，导致相反的横向 AM 电流，面…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 声子热效应和角动量 (AM) 霍尔效应在非铁电绝缘体中是已知的，但位移铁电体（即“铁电子”）的太赫兹软模式是否共享它们仍然悬而未决。我们报道了在单轴铁电体中保持极化动量锁定的轴向铁电子，并表明这两种效应都存在：纵向温度梯度在没有任何场的情况下驱动横向 AM 流，而面外磁场则在热霍尔上切换AM 霍尔效应出现两个竞争通道：自辐射磁场将两个分支混合成圆形模式，其动量锁定贝里曲率将相反的磁矩偏转到相对的边缘，而温度梯度诱导模式量子相干性增加了磁矩偶极子，导致相反的横向 AM 电流，面外磁场打破了精确的极化动量锁定并产生极化霍尔电流。德瓦尔斯铁电体。边缘磁化或极化积累可以切换相邻的磁体或铁电体，从而在未来通过热电流实现低功率磁电功能。

articles.title: X-ray induced structural and dynamical changes in supramolecular polymer networks
articles.title_zh: X 射线诱导超分子聚合物网络的结构和动力学变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Beam-induced effects are key considerations in X-ray scattering studies of soft matter. Because these experiments typically aim to probe the unperturbed system, the structural and dynamic changes induced by the beam often remain underexplored. In the study at hand, the influence of X-rays on metallo-supramolecular tetra-arm poly(ethylene glycol) (tetra-PEG) networks is studied in dependence of the dose rate. Based on their transient interlinkage, such materials have the ability to reconnect and self-heal mechanical damage. Here, wide- and small-angle X-ray Scattering were employed to understand the effect of X-rays on the micro- and mesoscale structure of such polymer networks. Dynamical effects were probed using X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy. A restructuring of the polymer chains in the network is observed over several length scales, indicating a pre-crystallization step induced by the ionizing radiation, accompanied by expulsion of water from the network. In conjunction, a complex dynamical behavior is observed, consisting of an initial fast process, followed by an overall slow-down during the restructuring process. The two-time correlation functions exhibit an oscillatory behavior related to the development of multiple dynamic populations in the polymer network.
articles.abstract_zh: 束诱导效应是软物质 X 射线散射研究的关键考虑因素。由于这些实验通常旨在探测未受扰动的系统，因此梁引起的结构和动态变化通常仍未得到充分探索。在当前的研究中，研究了 X 射线对金属超分子四臂聚乙二醇（tetra-PEG）网络的影响与剂量率的关系。基于它们的瞬态互连，此类材料具有重新连接和自愈机械损伤的能力。在这里，采用广角和小角 X 射线散射来了解 X 射线对此类聚合物网络的微观和介观结构的影响。使用 X 射线光子相关光谱法探测动力学效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 束诱导效应是软物质 X 射线散射研究的关键考虑因素。由于这些实验通常旨在探测未受扰动的系统，因此梁引起的结构和动态变化通常仍未得到充分探索。在当前的研究中，研究了 X 射线对金属超分子四臂聚乙二醇（tetra-PEG）网络的影响与剂量率的关系。基于它们的瞬态互连，此类材料具有重新连接和自愈机械损伤的能力。在这里，采用广角和小角 X 射线散射来了解 X 射线对此类聚合物网络的微观和介观结构的影响。使用 X 射线光子相关光谱法探测动力学效应。在多个长度尺度上观察到网络中聚合物链的重组，表明电离辐射引起的预结晶步骤，同时伴随着水从网络中排出。结合起来，观察到复杂的动态行为，包括最初的快速过程，然后是重组过程中的整体减速。两次相关函数表现出与聚合物网络中多个动态群体的发展相关的振荡行为。

articles.title: AI-assisted formal proofs for static and time-dependent density functional theory on lattices
articles.title_zh: 人工智能辅助的格子静态和瞬态密度泛函理论的形式证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem fails on lattices, where two potentials that differ by more than a constant can share a ground state. We prove that such potentials are exceptional. We consider spinless fermions on any connected lattice, at any filling other than empty or full, with hopping amplitudes of a common sign and any density-density interaction. The potentials whose ground state is shared with a potential differing by more than a constant lie in a closed, nowhere dense set of zero Lebesgue measure. The densities of non-degenerate shared ground states form a set of codimension at least two. The statement about the potentials also holds for the Kohn-Sham potential and for spin-density functional theory, where a uniform shift of the magnetic field is the only additional freedom. In time-dependent density functional theory on lattices, we show that not every ground state of a connected lattice can serve as the initial state of the density-potential map. A counterexample is the ground state of two fermions on a square that Penz and van Leeuwen found as a counterexample to the Hohenberg-Kohn theorem. For almost every static potential, however, every real ground state can serve as an initial state, also for spin-resolved densities. We also give formal proofs that the time-dependent Kohn-Sham potential exists, locally in time, for almost every static Kohn-Sham potential, and of known results: local existence and uniqueness of the time-dependent potential for an admissible initial state, continuation in time up to the boundary of the set of admissible states, and the convergence properties of a regularized Kohn-Sham iteration. All theorems and propositions are formalized in the proof assistant Lean 4 and checked by computer.
articles.abstract_zh: 霍恩伯格-科恩定理在晶格上失败，在晶格中，相差超过一个常数的两个势能共享一个基态。我们证明这种潜力是非凡的。我们考虑任何连接晶格上的无自旋费米子，在除空或满之外的任何填充下，具有公共符号的跳跃幅度和任何密度-密度相互作用。其基态与相差超过一个常数的电势共享的电势位于封闭的、无处密集的零勒贝格测度集中。非简并共享基态的密度形成一组至少为二的余维。关于势的陈述也适用于 Kohn-Sham 势和自旋密度泛函理论，其中磁场的均匀移动是唯一的附加自由度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 霍恩伯格-科恩定理在晶格上失败，在晶格中，相差超过一个常数的两个势能共享一个基态。我们证明这种潜力是非凡的。我们考虑任何连接晶格上的无自旋费米子，在除空或满之外的任何填充下，具有公共符号的跳跃幅度和任何密度-密度相互作用。其基态与相差超过一个常数的电势共享的电势位于封闭的、无处密集的零勒贝格测度集中。非简并共享基态的密度形成一组至少为二的余维。关于势的陈述也适用于 Kohn-Sham 势和自旋密度泛函理论，其中磁场的均匀移动是唯一的附加自由度。在晶格的时间相关密度泛函理论中，我们表明并非连接晶格的每个基态都可以作为密度势图的初始状态。一个反例是彭茨和范列文发现的正方形上两个费米子的基态，作为霍恩伯格-科恩定理的反例。然而，对于几乎每个静态势，每个真实基态都可以作为初始态，对于自旋分辨密度也是如此。我们还给出了形式证明，证明对于几乎每个静态 Kohn-Sham 势，时间相关 Kohn-Sham 势在局部时间上都存在，并且给出了已知结果：可允许初始状态的时间相关势的局部存在性和唯一性、时间上的延续性直到允许状态集的边界，以及正则化 Kohn-Sham 迭代的收敛特性。所有定理和命题均在证明助手 Lean 4 中形式化并由计算机检查。

articles.title: Contribution to the GdTe₃ magnetic phase diagram from electronic transport measurements
articles.title_zh: 电子输运测量对 GdTe₃ 磁相图的贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic phase diagrams of the three antiferromagnetic (AFM) transitions of GdTe₃ that occur at zero magnetic field at TN₁=12 K, TN₂=10.5 K and T₁=7 K are investigated by means of resistance measurements in a magnetic field oriented along the three crystallographic directions. With the magnetic field applied in the basal plane we found re-entrance of an intermediate phase which may be a result of the coupling between the TN₂ AFM and the charge density wave with possibly a ferroaxial order. A spin flop transition is also observed at a temperature that presumably converges towards a triple point in vicinity of 2.5-3.0 T and T between T₁ and TN₂. Our results help complete a complex phase diagram of GdTe₃ and advance a method for investigating magnetic ordering via transport measurements -- a technique applicable to many other compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过沿三个晶体方向的磁场中的电阻测量，研究了在 TN1=12 K、TN2=10.5 K 和 T1=7 K 的零磁场下发生的 GdTe3 的三个反铁磁 (AFM) 转变的磁相图。当在基面施加磁场时，我们发现了中间相的重新进入，这可能是 TN2 AFM 与可能具有铁轴级的电荷密度波之间耦合的结果。在可能会聚于2.5-3.0T附近的三相点且T在T1和TN2之间的温度下也观察到自旋随角异型跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过沿三个晶体方向的磁场中的电阻测量，研究了在 TN1=12 K、TN2=10.5 K 和 T1=7 K 的零磁场下发生的 GdTe3 的三个反铁磁 (AFM) 转变的磁相图。当在基面施加磁场时，我们发现了中间相的重新进入，这可能是 TN2 AFM 与可能具有铁轴级的电荷密度波之间耦合的结果。在可能会聚于2.5-3.0T附近的三相点且T在T1和TN2之间的温度下也观察到自旋随角异型跃迁。我们的结果有助于完成 GdTe₃ 的复杂相图，并提出一种通过输运测量研究磁有序的方法，该技术适用于许多其他化合物。

articles.title: Continuum model for disconnection structures of hetero-interfaces
articles.title_zh: 异质界面断开结构的连续体模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hetero-interfaces, as planar defects between dissimilar materials, accommodate the lattice misfit through networks of line defects of disconnections (a combination of structural ledges/step and dislocation characters). We develop a continuum model that predicts the hetero-interface structures, including disconnection networks, the interface inclination and misorientation angles. The model is based on the interfacial energy minimization with respect to all possible disconnection modes, subject to the interface structure constraint of the generalized Frank-Bilby equation that describes the lattice correspondence across the interface including both dislocation and step characters of disconnections and the inclination and misorientation angles. Numerical simulations are performed to determine the equilibrium configurations of three different types of hetero-interfaces: the α/β (orthorhombic/monoclinic) interface in ZrO₂, α/β hetero-interfaces in Ti and Au/Pd (001) twist-misfit interfaces. Comparisons with experiments, atomistic simulations and theoretical predictions show that our continuum model provides excellent predictions of the hetero-interface structures including disconnection networks and inclination, misorientation angles. Furthermore, systematic analysis reveals the functional dependence of hetero-interface structural properties on inclination and misorientation angles.
articles.abstract_zh: 异质界面作为不同材料之间的平面缺陷，通过断开的线缺陷网络（结构壁架/台阶和位错特征的组合）来调节晶格失配。我们开发了一个连续体模型来预测异质界面结构，包括断开网络、界面倾斜和定向错误角度。该模型基于所有可能的断开模式的界面能量最小化，受到广义 Frank-Bilby 方程的界面结构约束，该方程描述了界面上的晶格对应关系，包括断开的位错和阶跃特征以及倾斜和取向角。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异质界面作为不同材料之间的平面缺陷，通过断开的线缺陷网络（结构壁架/台阶和位错特征的组合）来调节晶格失配。我们开发了一个连续体模型来预测异质界面结构，包括断开网络、界面倾斜和定向错误角度。该模型基于所有可能的断开模式的界面能量最小化，受到广义 Frank-Bilby 方程的界面结构约束，该方程描述了界面上的晶格对应关系，包括断开的位错和阶跃特征以及倾斜和取向角。进行数值模拟以确定三种不同类型异质界面的平衡构型：ZrO2 中的 α/β（斜方/单斜）界面、Ti 中的 α/β 异质界面和 Au/Pd (001) 扭曲失配界面。与实验、原子模拟和理论预测的比较表明，我们的连续体模型提供了对异质界面结构的出色预测，包括断开网络和倾斜、定向误差角。此外，系统分析揭示了异质界面结构特性对倾角和取向角的函数依赖性。

articles.title: Reconfigurable Chiral Phonons and Their Selection in Asymmetrically Stacked Graphene MoirMoiré Superlattices
articles.title_zh: 不对称堆叠石墨烯莫尔莫尔超晶格中的可重构手性声子及其选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral phonons, lattice vibrations carrying angular momentum, offer a new handle for controlling phonon-mediated phenomena in condensed matter, yet their on-demand generation and deterministic control remain challenging. Here we show, using helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy, that asymmetrically stacked graphene moiré superlattices provide a reconfigurable platform for chiral phonons. We observe a finite degree of circular polarization for both chiral interlayer shear phonons and intralayer optical phonons. A chiral-phonon Raman-tensor model attributes this response to interfacial C₂-symmetry breaking together with Raman resonance within the van Hove singularity region. Reversing either the twist sense or the stacking order inverts the degree of circular polarization through the spatial transformations linking the corresponding stacking geometries. By tuning the excitation energy and twist angle, we achieve nearly full-range control of the degree of circular polarization of interlayer shear phonons, from -1 to 1, while gate-induced interlayer potential redistribution enables substantial and reversible in situ modulation. These results establish asymmetrically stacked graphene moiré superlattices as a versatile platform for generating and controlling chiral phonons, with implications for optoelectronic and quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性声子（携带角动量的晶格振动）为控制凝聚态物质中声子介导的现象提供了一种新的方法，但它们的按需生成和确定性控制仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用螺旋分辨拉曼光谱表明，不对称堆叠的石墨烯莫尔超晶格为手性声子提供了可重构的平台。我们观察到手性层间剪切声子和层内光学声子都具有有限程度的圆偏振。手性声子拉曼张量模型将这种响应归因于界面 C2 对称性破缺以及范霍夫奇点区域内的拉曼共振。反转扭曲方向或堆叠顺序会通过链接相应堆叠几何形状的空间变换来反转圆偏振度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性声子（携带角动量的晶格振动）为控制凝聚态物质中声子介导的现象提供了一种新的方法，但它们的按需生成和确定性控制仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用螺旋分辨拉曼光谱表明，不对称堆叠的石墨烯莫尔超晶格为手性声子提供了可重构的平台。我们观察到手性层间剪切声子和层内光学声子都具有有限程度的圆偏振。手性声子拉曼张量模型将这种响应归因于界面 C2 对称性破缺以及范霍夫奇点区域内的拉曼共振。反转扭曲方向或堆叠顺序会通过链接相应堆叠几何形状的空间变换来反转圆偏振度。通过调节激发能和扭转角，我们实现了层间剪切声子圆偏振度的近乎全范围控制，从-1到1，而栅极引起的层间电势重新分布实现了实质性和可逆的原位调制。这些结果建立了不对称堆叠的石墨烯莫尔超晶格作为生成和控制手性声子的通用平台，对光电和量子技术具有影响。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of complex crystals from a generalized mean-field bond model
articles.title_zh: 来自广义平均场键模型的复杂晶体的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend our previously introduced mean-field bond model from unary fcc lattices to crystals with multiple chemical species and sublattices, accurately predicting finite-temperature thermodynamics without statistical sampling. Our generalization reformulates the model in terms of the Wyckoff positions of the crystal, representing each by one atom, and solving for the bond density of the reference bond of each of its neighbor shells. Bond-bond correlation functions are built from the zero-temperature force constants, allowing the deviation of every bond in the crystal to be expressed through linear functions of the reference bond of a shell. Thermodynamic self-consistency is enforced by requiring a single virial temperature for the whole crystal, and compatibility of average bond lengths with crystal volume. Model predictions are validated against molecular dynamics simulations of unary, binary, and ternary crystals using Morse-type bonding potentials, parametrized for each shell from the force constants of empirical interatomic potentials at several isotropic strains. In each case, the predicted bond densities and thermodynamics agree with the simulations to within their statistical uncertainty. We discuss strategies for combining the model with bonding potentials parametrized from first principles and foundation models to predict the finite-temperature thermodynamics of complex crystals at ab initio accuracy without statistical sampling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将之前引入的平均场键模型从一元面心立方晶格扩展到具有多种化学物质和亚晶格的晶体，无需统计采样即可准确预测有限温度热力学。我们的概括根据晶体的威科夫位置重新表述了模型，用一个原子代表每个原子，并求解其每个相邻壳层的参考键的键密度。键-键相关函数是根据零温力常数构建的，允许晶体中每个键的偏差通过壳参考键的线性函数来表达。通过要求整个晶体具有单一维里温度以及平均键长与晶体体积的兼容性来增强热力学自一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将之前引入的平均场键模型从一元面心立方晶格扩展到具有多种化学物质和亚晶格的晶体，无需统计采样即可准确预测有限温度热力学。我们的概括根据晶体的威科夫位置重新表述了模型，用一个原子代表每个原子，并求解其每个相邻壳层的参考键的键密度。键-键相关函数是根据零温力常数构建的，允许晶体中每个键的偏差通过壳参考键的线性函数来表达。通过要求整个晶体具有单一维里温度以及平均键长与晶体体积的兼容性来增强热力学自一致性。使用莫尔斯型键合势针对一元、二元和三元晶体的分子动力学模拟验证了模型预测，并根据几个各向同性应变下的经验原子间势的力常数对每个壳进行了参数化。在每种情况下，预测的键密度和热力学在其统计不确定性范围内与模拟一致。我们讨论了将模型与根据第一原理和基础模型参数化的键合势相结合的策略，以从头开始准确预测复杂晶体的有限温度热力学，而无需统计采样。

articles.title: Spin-Group versus Magnetic-Group Selection Rules for Nonlinear Photocurrents in Compensated Ferrimagnets
articles.title_zh: 补偿亚铁磁体中非线性光电流的自旋群与磁群选择规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical excitation offers a contact-free, ultrafast route to charge and spin currents, with symmetry determining which nonlinear photocurrents are allowed and whether they carry charge, spin, or both. Spin-group symmetry describes the limit without spin-orbit coupling (SOC), whereas magnetic-group symmetry accounts for SOC. We show that the two descriptions yield different selection rules for both charge and spin photocurrents in the multiferroic compensated ferrimagnet GaFeO₃. Without SOC, only linear shift and circular injection currents are allowed, with identical components for charge and spin, so every charge current is spin polarized along the moments. SOC leaves these charge currents nearly unchanged, activates magnetic linear injection and circular shift charge currents, and enables pure spin currents polarized perpendicular to the moments. Ferroelectric switching reverses the linear shift and circular injection charge currents and their spin polarization. These findings establish the importance of magnetic-group symmetry for a complete description of nonlinear charge and spin photocurrents in compensated ferrimagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 光激发提供了一种无接触、超快的电荷和自旋电流路径，其对称性决定了允许哪些非线性光电流以及它们是否携带电荷、自旋或两者。自旋群对称性描述了没有自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 的极限，而磁群对称性则说明了 SOC。我们表明，这两种描述对多铁补偿亚铁磁体 GaFeO₃ 中的电荷和自旋光电流产生不同的选择规则。如果没有 SOC，则仅允许线性移位和循环注入电流，充电和自旋具有相同的分量，因此每个充电电流都会沿时刻自旋极化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光激发提供了一种无接触、超快的电荷和自旋电流路径，其对称性决定了允许哪些非线性光电流以及它们是否携带电荷、自旋或两者。自旋群对称性描述了没有自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 的极限，而磁群对称性则说明了 SOC。我们表明，这两种描述对多铁补偿亚铁磁体 GaFeO₃ 中的电荷和自旋光电流产生不同的选择规则。如果没有 SOC，则仅允许线性移位和循环注入电流，充电和自旋具有相同的分量，因此每个充电电流都会沿时刻自旋极化。 SOC 使这些充电电流几乎保持不变，激活磁线性注入和循环移位充电电流，并实现垂直于力矩极化的纯自旋电流。铁电开关反转线性移位和圆形注入充电电流及其自旋极化。这些发现确立了磁群对称性对于补偿亚铁磁体中非线性电荷和自旋光电流的完整描述的重要性。

articles.title: Electrons in a hard-wall cylinder with helicoidal metric: time-reversal pairing, cubic anticrossings, and twist-activated dipole transitions
articles.title_zh: 具有螺旋度量的硬壁圆柱体中的电子：时间反转配对、立方反交叉和扭转激活偶极子跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the scalar Schrödinger equation in a helicoidal metric when the axial direction is closed by Dirichlet walls built into the operator domain. With hard walls, the axial derivative cannot be replaced by a traveling-wave factor, and in a rotationally symmetric spinless cavity, time reversal makes the levels with azimuthal numbers m and -m exactly degenerate. We write the Hamiltonian as a Hermitian coupled-subband matrix and give an exact gauge-adapted variational representation. For a finite radius, the leading twist correction is quadratic, and changes sign at a critical aspect ratio; for an unbounded radial domain, it is linear in |Ω_g|. Retuning the aspect ratio through an isolated radial--axial resonance within one m sector opens an avoided crossing with gap Δgₐₚ/E_R=1.648775ldots|Ω_gR²/L|³ to leading order. A transverse dipole transition forbidden without twist acquires an oscillator strength quadratic in the twist, with leading coefficient 0.0559408010 for R/L=2 from perturbation theory. Dipole sum rules and the convergence of the currents serve as checks on the numerics. We also give the inverse-mass tensor required for a scalar realization and re-examine each statement and figure of the earlier article [Opt. Quantum Electron. 58, 113 (2026)] within the corrected model.
articles.abstract_zh: 当轴向方向被算子域中内置的狄利克雷壁封闭时，我们研究螺旋度量中的标量薛定谔方程。对于硬壁，轴向导数不能用行波因子代替，并且在旋转对称的无旋转腔中，时间反转使得方位角数为 m 和 -m 的能级精确退化。我们将哈密顿量写为埃尔米特耦合子带矩阵，并给出精确的规范自适应变分表示。对于有限半径，主扭曲校正是二次的，并且在临界纵横比处改变符号；对于无界径向域，它在 |Ω_g| 中呈线性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当轴向方向被算子域中内置的狄利克雷壁封闭时，我们研究螺旋度量中的标量薛定谔方程。对于硬壁，轴向导数不能用行波因子代替，并且在旋转对称的无旋转腔中，时间反转使得方位角数为 m 和 -m 的能级精确退化。我们将哈密顿量写为埃尔米特耦合子带矩阵，并给出精确的规范自适应变分表示。对于有限半径，主扭曲校正是二次的，并且在临界纵横比处改变符号；对于无界径向域，它在 |Ω_g| 中呈线性。通过一米扇区内的隔离径向-轴向共振重新调整纵横比，可以避免与间隙 Δgₐₚ/E_R=1.648775ldots|Ω_gR²/L|3 的交叉到前导顺序。没有扭曲的横向偶极子跃迁被禁止，在扭曲中获得振荡强度的二次方，根据微扰理论，对于 R/L=2，主导系数为 0.0559408010。偶极子和规则和电流收敛可作为对数字的检查。我们还给出了标量实现所需的反质量张量，并重新检查了先前文章 [Opt.1] 中的每个陈述和图形。量子电子。 58, 113 (2026)]在修正模型内。

articles.title: Comparative Molecular Dynamics Study of Initial Oxide Film Growth on Al, Mg, and Ti Using a Universal Neural Network Potential
articles.title_zh: 使用通用神经网络势对 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上初始氧化膜生长进行比较分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spontaneous formation of an oxide film, which may be passive, is found in many metals such as Al and Ti. We report direct computational observation of oxide film formation on the three major light structural metals, Al, Mg, and Ti, with molecular dynamics (MD) using a universal neural network potential (NNP). O2 molecules were supplied during MD simulations to replenish O consumed by the metal. Al and Ti formed a 1-2 nm thick film within a few ps of the simulation with O2 gas pressure of 102-103 atm. The film thicknesses of all metal oxides continued to increase proportionally to the logarithm of simulation time, consistent with Cabrera-Mott theory. Al and Ti oxides grow at the surface, while Mg oxide grows into the Mg metal. Al, Mg, and Ti are approximately 4.4, 4.3, and 5.2-fold coordinated, respectively, in the oxide.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多金属（例如铝和钛）会自发形成氧化膜，该氧化膜可能是钝化的。我们报告了使用通用神经网络势 (NNP) 通过分子动力学 (MD) 对三种主要轻结构金属 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上氧化膜形成的直接计算观察。在 MD 模拟过程中提供 O2 分子以补充金属消耗的 O2。在氧气压力为 102-103 atm 的情况下，Al 和 Ti 在模拟的几皮秒内形成了 1-2 nm 厚的薄膜。所有金属氧化物的薄膜厚度继续与模拟时间的对数成比例增加，与卡布雷拉-莫特理论一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多金属（例如铝和钛）会自发形成氧化膜，该氧化膜可能是钝化的。我们报告了使用通用神经网络势 (NNP) 通过分子动力学 (MD) 对三种主要轻结构金属 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上氧化膜形成的直接计算观察。在 MD 模拟过程中提供 O2 分子以补充金属消耗的 O2。在氧气压力为 102-103 atm 的情况下，Al 和 Ti 在模拟的几皮秒内形成了 1-2 nm 厚的薄膜。所有金属氧化物的薄膜厚度继续与模拟时间的对数成比例增加，与卡布雷拉-莫特理论一致。 Al 和 Ti 氧化物在表面生长，而 Mg 氧化物则生长到 Mg 金属中。 Al、Mg和Ti在氧化物中分别配位约4.4、4.3和5.2倍。

articles.title: Probing the Rung-Mott Insulator in Bosonic Two-Leg Ladders
articles.title_zh: 探测玻色子两腿梯中的 Rung-Mott 绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mott insulators typically appear at integer densities, but certain lattice geometries or non-local interactions can stabilise Mott insulators at fractional densities. In this work, we study strongly interacting two-leg ladders using ultracold bosonic atoms around half-filling, and identify the rung-Mott insulating (RMI) phase through its characteristic rung occupation in site-resolved measurements. We probe its excitation spectrum via lattice modulation spectroscopy, and interpret the observed spectra using numerical simulations that include the driven dynamics, coupling to multiple excited states, and energy offsets. As with other Mott insulators, the RMI phase is characterized through its incompressibility, which we probe via a site-resolved analysis of densities and chemical potentials. Our results provide direct insight into the excitation dynamics of a strongly correlated ladder system, and pave the way for studying transport and further dynamical properties in low-dimensional quantum systems with programmable lattice geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 莫特绝缘体通常以整数密度出现，但某些晶格几何形状或非局部相互作用可以使莫特绝缘体稳定在分数密度。在这项工作中，我们使用半填充周围的超冷玻色子原子研究强相互作用的两腿梯，并通过其在位点分辨测量中的特征梯级占据来识别梯级-莫特绝缘（RMI）相。我们通过晶格调制光谱探测其激发光谱，并使用数值模拟解释观察到的光谱，其中包括驱动动力学、与多个激发态的耦合和能量偏移。与其他莫特绝缘体一样，RMI 相的特点是其不可压缩性，我们通过密度和化学势的位点解析分析来探讨这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫特绝缘体通常以整数密度出现，但某些晶格几何形状或非局部相互作用可以使莫特绝缘体稳定在分数密度。在这项工作中，我们使用半填充周围的超冷玻色子原子研究强相互作用的两腿梯，并通过其在位点分辨测量中的特征梯级占据来识别梯级-莫特绝缘（RMI）相。我们通过晶格调制光谱探测其激发光谱，并使用数值模拟解释观察到的光谱，其中包括驱动动力学、与多个激发态的耦合和能量偏移。与其他莫特绝缘体一样，RMI 相的特点是其不可压缩性，我们通过密度和化学势的位点解析分析来探讨这一点。我们的结果提供了对强相关梯系统的激发动力学的直接洞察，并为研究具有可编程晶格几何结构的低维量子系统中的输运和进一步动力学特性铺平了道路。

articles.title: Intrinsic longitudinal Hall effect in ferroaxial metals with high-order rotation axes
articles.title_zh: 具有高阶旋转轴的铁轴金属的固有纵向霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-field Hall resistivity of non-magnetic metals has an intrinsic quantum contribution that derives from the field-corrected Berry curvature and intrinsic magnetic moment of the Bloch states near the Fermi surface. However, its effect is usually overshadowed by the classical Lorentz-force contribution. Here we show that for the longitudinal Hall effect, which occurs in ferroaxial crystals when the applied magnetic field lies in the Hall plane, the Lorentz force contribution vanishes for the eight ferroaxial groups with a 3,4 or 6-fold rotation axis. This provides an opportunity to measure the quantum correction in isolation, but so far all measured instances of the effect fall in the remaining five ferroaxial groups of lower symmetry, where the Lorentz force dominates the signal. We compile a list of candidate ferroaxial metals with such high-order rotation axis and compute the Hall effect from first principles for representative candidates, identifying Ni₃P with σrm Hₓzₓ = 28.4 S/m/T as a promising material to unambiguously measure the intrinsic longitudinal Hall effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 非磁性金属的低场霍尔电阻率具有本征量子贡献，该贡献源自费米表面附近布洛赫态的场校正贝里曲率和本征磁矩。然而，它的效果通常被经典洛伦兹力的贡献所掩盖。在这里，我们表明，对于纵向霍尔效应（当施加的磁场位于霍尔平面时，铁轴晶体中会发生这种效应），对于具有 3,4 或 6 倍旋转轴的八个铁轴组，洛伦兹力的贡献消失。这提供了单独测量量子校正的机会，但到目前为止，所有测量到的效应实例都落在其余五个较低对称性的铁轴组中，其中洛伦兹力在信号中占主导地位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非磁性金属的低场霍尔电阻率具有本征量子贡献，该贡献源自费米表面附近布洛赫态的场校正贝里曲率和本征磁矩。然而，它的效果通常被经典洛伦兹力的贡献所掩盖。在这里，我们表明，对于纵向霍尔效应（当施加的磁场位于霍尔平面时，铁轴晶体中会发生这种效应），对于具有 3,4 或 6 倍旋转轴的八个铁轴组，洛伦兹力的贡献消失。这提供了单独测量量子校正的机会，但到目前为止，所有测量到的效应实例都落在其余五个较低对称性的铁轴组中，其中洛伦兹力在信号中占主导地位。我们编制了具有此类高阶旋转轴的候选铁轴金属列表，并根据代表性候选物的第一原理计算霍尔效应，将 σrm Hₓzₓ = 28.4 S/m/T 的 Ni₃P 确定为一种有前景的材料，可以明确测量固有的纵向霍尔效应。

articles.title: Mixing and Preserving Properties of Non-van der Waals 2D Materials in Sandwich-like Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 类三明治异质结构中非范德华二维材料的混合和保持性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heterostructure interfaces created by stacking two-dimensional (2D) materials outline an appealing route towards achieving advanced electronic and magnetic functionalities at the nanoscale. Non-van der Waals (non-vdW) sandwich-like heterostructures (HSs) are build out of non-vdW 2D materials derived from non-layered crystals and establish a new frontier enabling strong interfacial coupling. Employing ab initio density functional theory (DFT), we investigate two classes of such trilayer HSs: purely non-vdW assemblies and hybrid vdW/non-vdW/vdW stacks. We show that non-vdW sandwiches undergo pronounced geometric reconstruction forming chemically bonded interfaces with large absolute binding energies up to an order of magnitude larger than those of conventional vdW HSs. These strong interactions drive extensive electronic hybridization, band gap renormalization, and tunable interlayer magnetic coupling. In contrast, vdW encapsulation largely protects the intrinsic atomic and electronic structure of the non-vdW sheet from the environment , while enabling charge transfer doping of the vdW layers. Our results thus establish sandwich HSs a versatile interface design platform, spanning interaction regimes from weakly perturbed encapsulation to strongly interacting chemically bonded systems with emergent electronic and magnetic behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过堆叠二维 (2D) 材料创建的异质结构界面概述了实现纳米级先进电子和磁性功能的有吸引力的途径。非范德华 (non-vdW) 夹层状异质结构 (HS) 由源自非层状晶体的非 vdW 二维材料构建而成，并建立了一个新的前沿，可实现强界面耦合。采用从头算密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们研究了两类此类三层 HS：纯非 vdW 组件和混合 vdW/非 vdW/vdW 堆栈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过堆叠二维 (2D) 材料创建的异质结构界面概述了实现纳米级先进电子和磁性功能的有吸引力的途径。非范德华 (non-vdW) 夹层状异质结构 (HS) 由源自非层状晶体的非 vdW 二维材料构建而成，并建立了一个新的前沿，可实现强界面耦合。采用从头算密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们研究了两类此类三层 HS：纯非 vdW 组件和混合 vdW/非 vdW/vdW 堆栈。我们表明，非 vdW 三明治经历了明显的几何重构，形成了化学键合界面，其绝对结合能比传统的 vdW HS 高出一个数量级。这些强相互作用驱动了广泛的电子杂化、带隙重正化和可调谐层间磁耦合。相比之下，vdW 封装在很大程度上保护了非 vdW 片材的固有原子和电子结构免受环境影响，同时实现了 vdW 层的电荷转移掺杂。因此，我们的结果建立了夹层 HS 的多功能界面设计平台，涵盖从弱扰动封装到具有新兴电子和磁性行为的强相互作用化学键合系统的相互作用机制。

articles.title: Neutron Spectroscopy Transformed: Deuterated ZIF-8 and Machine-Learned Potentials Catch Nitrogen Threading Its Gates
articles.title_zh: 中子光谱学的变革：氘代 ZIF-8 和机器学习势捕获氮穿过它的大门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a step change in what inelastic neutron scattering (INS) can reveal, by combining machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with deliberate deuteration of the sample. INS's prowess in charting framework and guest motions within porous materials during in situ dosing has historically had one caveat: costly density-functional-theory calculations are a major bottleneck in the speed and depth of analysis. We show that rapid frontier MLIPs remove this bottleneck on both counts, keeping pace with the experiment while bringing a new level of insight. Deuterating the linkers of ZIF-8 pries apart bands that overlap in the hydrogenous framework, and we test four MLIPs against eight stages of nitrogen dosing at 77 K. On loading, a previously unobserved band appears at 270 cm⁻¹ and grows gradually through the dosing series. The simulations trace it to single N2 molecules threaded end-on through four-ring windows, each turning its ring of linkers and propping the window open, and unbiased dynamics catch molecules threading into the windows on their own, finding a free-energy trap that crowding stabilizes. This is the first vibrational signature of the threaded state and, crucially, its intensity directly counts the threading over the slow, macroscopic timescale of gas uptake, in situ. More broadly, the simulations explain how each framework band responds to its guests, establishing MLIP-assisted inelastic neutron scattering as a route to mechanism, not just assignment.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了通过将机器学习的原子间势 (MLIP) 与样品的有意氘化相结合，非弹性中子散射 (INS) 所揭示的内容发生了阶跃变化。 INS 在原位定量过程中绘制框架和多孔材料内客体运动方面的能力历来有一个警告：昂贵的密度泛函理论计算是分析速度和深度的主要瓶颈。我们表明，快速前沿 MLIP 在两个方面消除了这一瓶颈，与实验保持同步，同时带来了新的洞察力。氘化 ZIF-8 的连接体撬开氢框架中重叠的谱带，我们在 77 K 下针对八个阶段的氮剂量测试了 4 个 MLIP。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了通过将机器学习的原子间势 (MLIP) 与样品的有意氘化相结合，非弹性中子散射 (INS) 所揭示的内容发生了阶跃变化。 INS 在原位定量过程中绘制框架和多孔材料内客体运动方面的能力历来有一个警告：昂贵的密度泛函理论计算是分析速度和深度的主要瓶颈。我们表明，快速前沿 MLIP 在两个方面消除了这一瓶颈，与实验保持同步，同时带来了新的洞察力。氘化 ZIF-8 的连接体撬开氢框架中重叠的谱带，我们在 77 K 下针对八个阶段的氮剂量测试了 4 个 MLIP。加载时，之前未观察到的谱带出现在 270 cm -1 处，并在剂量系列中逐渐增长。模拟将其追踪到单个 N2 分子，该分子尾端穿过四环窗口，每个分子转动其连接环并将窗口撑开，无偏动力学捕获自行穿入窗口的分子，找到一个使拥挤稳定的自由能陷阱。这是螺纹态的第一个振动特征，至关重要的是，它的强度直接计算了原位气体吸收的缓慢、宏观时间尺度上的螺纹。更广泛地说，模拟解释了每个框架带如何响应其客体，建立 MLIP 辅助的非弹性中子散射作为机制的途径，而不仅仅是分配。

articles.title: Lattice models of chiral random motion: A short review
articles.title_zh: 手性随机运动的晶格模型：简短回顾
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias, is ubiquitous in many random motion patterns, from bacteria cells, that swim in circles near surfaces and spinning colloids, to charged particles diffusing under the influence of magnetic fields. In two dimensions, chirality renders random transport odd: the diffusion tensor acquires an antisymmetric part that leaves the mean-squared displacement invariant but modifies fluxes and boundary currents. Lattice models for random motion are a natural setting to study chirality, since they are exactly solvable, connect directly to heterogeneous media, cellular automata, and programmable robots, and in discrete time admit fully chiral limits with a localised bulk and edge transport. Lattice walks with a rotational bias have been introduced in different communities several times since 1960, yet without a common language or conceptual connection between them. Here we review these models from the perspective that on the lattice, chirality requires memory. Taking the recently introduced chiral random walk model as a template, we describe the walker with an internal degree of freedom. With a chiral biased updating rule, the full diffusion tensor of this chiral walker turns odd. Within this picture, we can unite persistent and chiral walks, run-and-tumble motion, and cyclic random motions in one framework. We discuss how the memory is followed into the environment; in Lorentz lattice gases, kinetic and rotor walks, and random odd environments; and into the path; in spiral self-avoiding walks.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性是一种系统性旋转偏差，在许多随机运动模式中无处不在，从在表面附近绕圈游动和旋转胶体的细菌细胞，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机传输变得奇怪：扩散张量获得反对称部分，使均方位移不变，但会改变通量和边界电流。随机运动的晶格模型是研究手性的自然环境，因为它们完全可解，直接连接到异构介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并且在离散时间内通过局部体和边缘传输承认完全手性限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性是一种系统性旋转偏差，在许多随机运动模式中无处不在，从在表面附近绕圈游动和旋转胶体的细菌细胞，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机传输变得奇怪：扩散张量获得反对称部分，使均方位移不变，但会改变通量和边界电流。随机运动的晶格模型是研究手性的自然环境，因为它们完全可解，直接连接到异构介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并且在离散时间内通过局部体和边缘传输承认完全手性限制。自 1960 年以来，具有旋转偏差的格子游走已多次在不同的社区中引入，但它们之间没有共同的语言或概念联系。这里我们从晶格上手性需要记忆的角度回顾这些模型。以最近引入的手性随机游走模型为模板，我们描述具有内部自由度的游走者。通过手性偏置更新规则，该手性步行者的完整扩散张量变得奇数。在这张图中，我们可以将持久和手性行走、跑动和翻滚运动以及循环随机运动统一在一个框架中。我们讨论记忆如何进入环境；在洛伦兹晶格气体、动力学和转子行走以及随机奇数环境中；并进入路径；螺旋式的自我回避行走。

articles.title: Lattice Thermal Conductivity of MgO and the MgSiO₃ Polymorphs Bridgmanite and Post-Perovskite at Lower-Mantle Conditions Using Fine-Tuned MACE Potentials
articles.title_zh: 使用微调 MACE 势在下地幔条件下 MgO 和 MgSiO₃ 多晶型桥锰矿和后钙钛矿的晶格热导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heat flow across the core-mantle boundary (CMB) depends on the lattice thermal conductivity (κₗₐₜₜ) of lowermost-mantle minerals, yet calculated CMB values for MgO differ severalfold, and high-temperature estimates of the conductivity increase across the bridgmanite-post-perovskite transition range from about 20 to 50%. Direct solutions of the linearized phonon Boltzmann transport equation (LBTE) require thousands of density functional theory (DFT) force evaluations per thermodynamic state. Here we replace these evaluations with phase-specific, fine-tuned MACE potentials for MgO, MgSiO3 bridgmanite (Pv), and MgSiO3 post-perovskite (PPv). The potentials reproduce DFT energies, forces, stresses, pressure-volume relations, and compressed-state phonons for all three phases. For MgO at 0 GPa, replacing MACE forces with DFT forces in otherwise identical transport calculations changes κₗₐₜₜ by 0.2% at 300 K and 1.9% at 2000 K. PPv is 44-55% more conductive than Pv at the same pressure and temperature and strongly anisotropic, with κ[₁₀₀]/κ[₀₁₀] ranging from 1.7 to 2.1. The quasi-harmonic phase boundary has a Clapeyron slope of (7.4 ± 0.1) MPa/K and intersects a model geotherm at 116.2 GPa and 2660 K, where the transition raises the silicate conductivity by 47%, to 8.6 W/(m K). Heating in the basal thermal boundary layer lowers the MgO and PPv conductivities to 37.3 and 6.7 W/(m K) at the CMB, where Hashin-Shtrikman bounds of 9.5-11.4 W/(m K) for an Fe-free aggregate of 80 vol% silicate and 20 vol% MgO encompass the 10 W/(m K) used in earlier heat-flow estimates. The density-temperature parameterizations provide an intrinsic end-member reference for lower-mantle thermal models.
articles.abstract_zh: 穿过核幔边界 (CMB) 的热流取决于最下地幔矿物的晶格热导率 (κₗₐₜₜ)，但计算出的 MgO CMB 值却相差数倍，而且桥锰矿-后钙钛矿转变范围内热导率的高温估计增加了约 20% 至 50%。线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程 (LBTE) 的直接求解需要对每个热力学状态进行数千次密度泛函理论 (DFT) 力评估。在这里，我们用 MgO、MgSiO3 桥锰矿 (Pv) 和 MgSiO3 后钙钛矿 (PPv) 的特定相、微调的 MACE 电势代替这些评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 穿过核幔边界 (CMB) 的热流取决于最下地幔矿物的晶格热导率 (κₗₐₜₜ)，但计算出的 MgO CMB 值却相差数倍，而且桥锰矿-后钙钛矿转变范围内热导率的高温估计增加了约 20% 至 50%。线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程 (LBTE) 的直接求解需要对每个热力学状态进行数千次密度泛函理论 (DFT) 力评估。在这里，我们用 MgO、MgSiO3 桥锰矿 (Pv) 和 MgSiO3 后钙钛矿 (PPv) 的特定相、微调的 MACE 电势代替这些评估。势能再现所有三相的 DFT 能量、力、应力、压力-体积关系和压缩态声子。对于 0 GPa 的 MgO，在其他相同的输运计算中用 DFT 力替换 MACE 力，会使 κₗₐₜₜ 在 300 K 时改变 0.2%，在 2000 K 时改变 1.9%。在相同压力和温度下，PPv 的电导率比 Pv 高 44-55%，并且具有强各向异性， κ[₁₀₀]/κ[₀₀₀]范围为 1.7 至 2.1。准调和相界的克拉佩龙斜率为 (7.4 ± 0.1) MPa/K，并在 116.2 GPa 和 2660 K 处与模型地温相交，其中的转变使硅酸盐电导率提高了 47%，达到 8.6 W/(m·K)。基底热边界层中的加热将 CMB 处的 MgO 和 PPv 电导率降低至 37.3 和 6.7 W/(m·K)，其中对于 80 vol% 硅酸盐和 20 vol% MgO 的无铁骨料，Hashin-Shtrikman 界限为 9.5-11.4 W/(m·K)，涵盖了早期热流估计中使用的 10 W/(m·K)。密度-温度参数化为下地幔热模型提供了内在的端元参考。

articles.title: Space-Time Point Defects as Probes of Criticality: Application to the Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg Transition
articles.title_zh: 时空点缺陷作为临界探针：在 Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg 转变中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At criticality, a local field acting at a single point in Euclidean space-time is irrelevant and induces a modulation in space and time that decays with twice its scaling dimension. This turns two-point correlation functions into one-point measurements: one operator insertion enters the Boltzmann weight, the other is measured. For the local magnetization the relation is exact at any source strength. Implemented in auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo, the approach yields the static spin susceptibility and imaginary-time-displaced correlations with unprecedented precision. We apply it to the Dirac-semimetal to antiferromagnetic-Mott-insulator transition of the half-filled π-flux Hubbard model. This lattice model provides a regularization of the N_f=2 Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg universality class. A finite-size scaling analysis estimates the critical exponents as  ν=1.10(3) and η_φ=1.09(4), close to field-theory predictions of η_φsimeq1. Since η_φ>1, the equal-time structure factor at criticality does not diverge with the system size. Hence, the equal-time structure factor at the ordering wave vector is dominated by background contributions and cannot be used for extracting critical exponents. Consistently, the spin dynamics at the transition is strongly incoherent and the quantum Fisher information remains bounded.
articles.abstract_zh: 在临界点，作用于欧几里得时空中单个点的局部场是无关的，并且会引起空间和时间的调制，其衰减幅度是其尺度维度的两倍。这将两点相关函数转变为单点测量：一个算子插入进入玻尔兹曼权重，另一个被测量。对于局部磁化强度，该关系在任何源强度下都是精确的。该方法在辅助场量子蒙特卡罗中实施，以前所未有的精度产生静态自旋敏感性和虚时间位移相关性。我们将其应用于半填充 π 磁通哈伯德模型的狄拉克半金属到反铁磁莫特绝缘体的转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在临界点，作用于欧几里得时空中单个点的局部场是无关的，并且会引起空间和时间的调制，其衰减幅度是其尺度维度的两倍。这将两点相关函数转变为单点测量：一个算子插入进入玻尔兹曼权重，另一个被测量。对于局部磁化强度，该关系在任何源强度下都是精确的。该方法在辅助场量子蒙特卡罗中实施，以前所未有的精度产生静态自旋敏感性和虚时间位移相关性。我们将其应用于半填充 π 磁通哈伯德模型的狄拉克半金属到反铁磁莫特绝缘体的转变。该点阵模型提供了 N_f=2 Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg 普适性类的正则化。有限尺寸缩放分析估计临界指数为 ν=1.10(3) 和 η_φ=1.09(4)，接近 η_φsimeq1 的场论预测。由于 η_φ>1，临界点的等时结构因子不随系统规模而发散。因此，有序波矢量处的等时结构因子主要由背景贡献决定，不能用于提取临界指数。一致地，跃迁时的自旋动力学是强烈不相干的，并且量子费希尔信息仍然是有界的。

articles.title: Zone-folded Goldstone mode of the field-induced spin supersolid in the square-lattice S=1 antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体中场致自旋超固体的区域折叠戈德斯通模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The field-induced spin supersolid of the square-lattice S=1 antiferromagnet with single-ion and exchange anisotropy has so far been characterized only by static observables, among them a two-peak transverse structure factor. We compute its dynamic spin structure factors, and those of the neighboring phases, by stochastic analytic continuation of stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo data on a 16×16 lattice at inverse temperature β=32, at one field in each of the supersolid, the m_z=1/2 Ising plateau and the canted XY phase. The supersolid has a single Goldstone mode, which the checkerboard folds onto both the ordering wave vector Q=(π,π) and q=(0,0), so that it appears in both spin channels at both points with one velocity v=1.36±0.01. The canted phase shows half of this pattern and the plateau none, the latter carrying instead a gapped magnon band and a two-magnon longitudinal continuum. Exactly at Q and (0,0) the finite-lattice spectra are governed by a rotor tower of the condensate in the transverse channel and an Ising doublet of the checkerboard in the longitudinal one, both present at Q in the supersolid. Three parameter-free comparisons with the stiffness and the uniform susceptibility of the same runs, for the velocity, the sound-mode weight and the thermal decay of the rotor tower, tie the continued spectra to raw Monte Carlo observables. The folded Goldstone mode is the dynamical fingerprint of the supersolid.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有单离子和交换各向异性的方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体的场致自旋超固体迄今为止仅通过静态可观测量来表征，其中包括双峰横向结构因子。我们通过在反温度 β=32 的 16×16 晶格上，在超固体、m_z=1/2 伊辛平台和倾斜 XY 相的每个场中，对 16×16 晶格上的随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗数据进行随机解析延拓，计算其动态自旋结构因子以及邻近相的动态自旋结构因子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有单离子和交换各向异性的方晶格 S=1 反铁磁体的场致自旋超固体迄今为止仅通过静态可观测量来表征，其中包括双峰横向结构因子。我们通过在反温度 β=32 的 16×16 晶格上，在超固体、m_z=1/2 伊辛平台和倾斜 XY 相的每个场中，对 16×16 晶格上的随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗数据进行随机解析延拓，计算其动态自旋结构因子以及邻近相的动态自旋结构因子。超固体具有单一戈德斯通模式，棋盘折叠到有序波矢量 Q=(π,π) 和 q=(0,0) 上，因此它以一个速度 v=1.36±0.01 出现在两个点的两个自旋通道中。倾斜相位显示了该图案的一半，而平台则没有，后者携带有间隙的磁振子带和两个磁振子纵向连续体。恰好在 Q 和 (0,0) 处，有限晶格谱由横向通道中凝结物的转子塔和纵向通道中棋盘的伊辛双峰控制，两者都存在于超固体中的 Q 处。对于相同运行的速度、声模重量和转子塔的热衰减，对刚度和均匀磁化率进行了三个无参数比较，将连续光谱与原始蒙特卡罗可观测值联系起来。折叠戈德斯通模式是超固体的动力学指纹。

articles.title: From Fermions to Vortices: Microscopic Simulations of Phase Ordering in a d-Wave Superconductor
articles.title_zh: 从费米子到涡旋：d 波超导体中相序的微观模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Describing bath-induced superconducting phase ordering directly from a microscopic fermionic Hamiltonian remains a formidable challenge. Here we develop a microscopic framework for this problem using the recently introduced adiabatic variational principle (AVP) and demonstrate its application to a two-dimensional d-wave superconductor. The central construction maps evolving, spatially inhomogeneous bond-pairing fields onto constrained Bogoliubov-de Gennes states, with the associated Lagrange multipliers determining the thermodynamic driving forces. This enables dissipative evolution of the superconducting order while retaining its microscopic electronic structure, without assuming a phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau free-energy functional. Starting from disordered pairing configurations, we resolve the emergence of phase coherence through vortex-antivortex annihilation and the accompanying evolution of local electronic spectra. Vortex decay and dynamical scaling recover the characteristic kinetics of two-dimensional phase ordering, providing a nontrivial benchmark of the framework. The solver-independent AVP formulation opens a route to microscopic studies of dissipative ordering and metastability in superconductors with intertwined stripe and pair-density-wave orders.
articles.abstract_zh: 直接从微观费米子哈密顿量描述浴诱导的超导相序仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们使用最近引入的绝热变分原理（AVP）开发了这个问题的微观框架，并演示了其在二维 d 波超导体中的应用。中心结构将不断变化的空间不均匀键配对场映射到受约束的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 态上，并用相关的拉格朗日乘子确定热力学驱动力。这使得超导序的耗散演化成为可能，同时保留其微观电子结构，而无需假设唯象金兹堡-朗道自由能泛函。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接从微观费米子哈密顿量描述浴诱导的超导相序仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们使用最近引入的绝热变分原理（AVP）开发了这个问题的微观框架，并演示了其在二维 d 波超导体中的应用。中心结构将不断变化的空间不均匀键配对场映射到受约束的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 态上，并用相关的拉格朗日乘子确定热力学驱动力。这使得超导序的耗散演化成为可能，同时保留其微观电子结构，而无需假设唯象金兹堡-朗道自由能泛函。从无序配对构型开始，我们通过涡旋-反涡旋湮灭以及随之而来的局域电子能谱演化来解决相位相干性的出现。涡旋衰减和动态缩放恢复了二维相序的特征动力学，为该框架提供了一个重要的基准。独立于求解器的 AVP 公式为具有交织的条纹和成对密度波阶的超导体中的耗散有序和亚稳态的微观研究开辟了道路。

articles.title: Entanglement Asymmetry and the Quantum Mpemba Effect in Inhomogeneous Quenches
articles.title_zh: 非均匀淬火中的纠缠不对称性和量子姆潘巴效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement asymmetry is a powerful probe of symmetry breaking and its dynamical restoration following quantum quenches. While extensively studied for homogeneous initial states, its evolution from inhomogeneous initial configurations remains largely unexplored. We investigate a spin-1/2 XX chain whose two halves are initially prepared in tilted ferromagnetic states with different tilt angles. Combining generalized hydrodynamics (GHD) and the quasiparticle picture with exact fermionic correlation-matrix calculations, we study the dynamics of entanglement asymmetry. We find good agreement between the two approaches for generic initial configurations and observe the quantum Mpemba effect, whereby states with stronger initial symmetry breaking can restore the symmetry faster. This effect now depends on the subsystem position: while the homogeneous behavior is recovered when the subsystem lies entirely within one of the initially tilted halves, the entanglement-asymmetry curves for subsystems straddling the interface can exhibit multiple crossings or no crossings at all. A notable exception occurs for subsystems entirely within an initially non-tilted half. In this case, GHD predicts vanishing asymmetry, but the exact dynamics generates a small, nonzero asymmetry that can develop a plateau before decaying toward zero. This feature reveals contributions beyond the leading-order hydrodynamic description.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠不对称性是对称性破缺及其在量子淬灭后动态恢复的有力探针。虽然对均质初始态进行了广泛研究，但其从非均质初始构型的演化在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们研究了一个自旋 1/2 XX 链，其两半最初是在具有不同倾斜角度的倾斜铁磁态下制备的。将广义流体动力学（GHD）和准粒子图像与精确的费米子相关矩阵计算相结合，我们研究了纠缠不对称的动力学。我们发现这两种通用初始配置方法之间具有良好的一致性，并观察到量子 Mpemba 效应，即具有更强初始对称性破缺的状态可以更快地恢复对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠不对称性是对称性破缺及其在量子淬灭后动态恢复的有力探针。虽然对均质初始态进行了广泛研究，但其从非均质初始构型的演化在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们研究了一个自旋 1/2 XX 链，其两半最初是在具有不同倾斜角度的倾斜铁磁态下制备的。将广义流体动力学（GHD）和准粒子图像与精确的费米子相关矩阵计算相结合，我们研究了纠缠不对称的动力学。我们发现这两种通用初始配置方法之间具有良好的一致性，并观察到量子 Mpemba 效应，即具有更强初始对称性破缺的状态可以更快地恢复对称性。这种效应现在取决于子系统的位置：虽然当子系统完全位于最初倾斜的半部之一内时会恢复均匀行为，但跨接界面的子系统的纠缠不对称曲线可能会表现出多个交叉或根本没有交叉。对于完全位于最初非倾斜一半内的子系统，会发生一个值得注意的例外。在这种情况下，GHD 预测不对称性会消失，但精确的动力学会产生一种小的非零不对称性，这种不对称性会在衰减到零之前形成一个平台期。这一特征揭示了超出主阶流体动力学描述的贡献。

articles.title: Anomalous front propagation in many-body quantum transport with memory-dependent resetting
articles.title_zh: 具有记忆依赖性重置的多体量子传输中的异常前传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an exactly solvable framework for non-Markovian quantum many-body dynamics based on stochastic resetting with memory. Applicable to arbitrary time-independent Hamiltonians, including interacting systems, our framework provides an exact representation of the dynamics with memory in terms of the corresponding reset-free evolution, which can be accessed either analytically or numerically. We demonstrate the power of this approach by studying domain-wall melting in a one-dimensional chain of noninteracting fermions, obtaining exact analytical results for the density profile, the local structure of the front edge, the extreme-value statistics of the rightmost fermion, and the integrated current. Remarkably, memory transforms ballistic transport into logarithmically slow propagation without arresting spreading. While the macroscopic density profile retains its original scaling function, the front edge broadens as sqrtln t rather than t¹/³ at late times and develops a qualitatively different edge structure. Furthermore, the extreme-value statistics change from Tracy--Widom to Gaussian, while both the mean and variance of the integrated current grow logarithmically in time. Our predictions are in excellent agreement with numerical simulations. These results reveal how memory can fundamentally alter quantum many-body transport and its fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种基于记忆随机重置的非马尔可夫量子多体动力学的精确可解框架。我们的框架适用于任意时间无关的哈密顿量，包括相互作用的系统，根据相应的无重置演化提供了记忆动力学的精确表示，可以通过分析或数值方式访问。我们通过研究非相互作用费米子一维链中的畴壁熔化，获得密度分布、前沿局部结构、最右边费米子的极值统计和积分电流的精确分析结果，展示了这种方法的威力。值得注意的是，记忆将弹道传输转变为对数缓慢的传播，而不会阻止传播。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一种基于记忆随机重置的非马尔可夫量子多体动力学的精确可解框架。我们的框架适用于任意时间无关的哈密顿量，包括相互作用的系统，根据相应的无重置演化提供了记忆动力学的精确表示，可以通过分析或数值方式访问。我们通过研究非相互作用费米子一维链中的畴壁熔化，获得密度分布、前沿局部结构、最右边费米子的极值统计和积分电流的精确分析结果，展示了这种方法的威力。值得注意的是，记忆将弹道传输转变为对数缓慢的传播，而不会阻止传播。虽然宏观密度分布保留了其原始的缩放函数，但前沿在后期以 sqrtln t 而不是 t1/3 的形式变宽，并形成了一种性质不同的边缘结构。此外，极值统计量从特雷西-维多姆变为高斯，而积分电流的均值和方差均随时间呈对数增长。我们的预测与数值模拟非常吻合。这些结果揭示了记忆如何从根本上改变量子多体传输及其波动。

articles.title: Investigating competing order in the Kanamori-Hubbard model with the multiorbital multichannel fluctuating field theory
articles.title_zh: 用多轨道多通道脉动场理论研究 Kanamori-Hubbard 模型中的竞争阶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The multichannel fluctuating field (MCFF) approach treats selected collective fluctuations in interacting quantum lattice models nonperturbatively, but has so far been applied only to single-band systems. Here, we extend MCFF theory to multiorbital systems, accounting for the orbital structure of charge and spin instabilities. We apply it to the half-filled two-orbital Kanamori-Hubbard model with repulsive intra-orbital interaction U, and both positive and negative Hund's coupling J, addressing the competing orders and their interplay. The ability to selectively retain individual fluctuation channels and control their interplay allows us to disentangle their respective contributions and identify the mechanisms underlying competing instabilities. The model features a simple competition between charge density wave and antiferromagnetic fluctuations in the vicinity of J=U, and a more intricate competition between antiferromagnetic, orbital, and spin-orbital fluctuations near J=0, where the model acquires a higher SU(4) symmetry. The proposed multiorbital extension thus provides a computationally inexpensive and efficient framework for exploring how orbital and spin character shape competing collective fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 多通道涨落场（MCFF）方法以非微扰方式处理相互作用的量子晶格模型中选定的集体涨落，但迄今为止仅应用于单带系统。在这里，我们将 MCFF 理论扩展到多轨道系统，解释了电荷和自旋不稳定性的轨道结构。我们将其应用于具有排斥性轨道内相互作用 U 以及正负洪德耦合 J 的半填充双轨道 Kanamori-Hubbard 模型，解决了竞争级及其相互作用。有选择地保留个体波动通道并控制它们相互作用的能力使我们能够理清它们各自的贡献并确定竞争不稳定性的潜在机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多通道涨落场（MCFF）方法以非微扰方式处理相互作用的量子晶格模型中选定的集体涨落，但迄今为止仅应用于单带系统。在这里，我们将 MCFF 理论扩展到多轨道系统，解释了电荷和自旋不稳定性的轨道结构。我们将其应用于具有排斥性轨道内相互作用 U 以及正负洪德耦合 J 的半填充双轨道 Kanamori-Hubbard 模型，解决了竞争级及其相互作用。有选择地保留个体波动通道并控制它们相互作用的能力使我们能够理清它们各自的贡献并确定竞争不稳定性的潜在机制。该模型的特点是在 J=U 附近电荷密度波和反铁磁涨落之间存在简单的竞争，而在 J=0 附近反铁磁、轨道和自旋轨道涨落之间存在更复杂的竞争，其中模型获得了更高的 SU(4) 对称性。因此，所提出的多轨道扩展提供了一个计算成本低廉且有效的框架，用于探索轨道和自旋特征如何形成竞争的集体涨落。

articles.title: Nanoparticles with a BANG: Detonation-Driven Synthesis of Metals and Metal Oxides
articles.title_zh: 具有爆炸性的纳米粒子：爆炸驱动的金属和金属氧化物的合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bristol Accelerated Nanoparticle Generation (BANG) method is a solvent- and capping-agent-free nanoparticle synthesis. Previous work was limited mostly to gold, silver and copper particles. Here, the method is extended to ten further elements, including Pb, Bi, Tl, Mn, Fe, Zn, Pt, Ni, Cd and Pd. Detonation in air favoured metal formation for less oxophilic metals, whereas detonation of silver azide under nitrogen suppressed detectable silver oxide formation while retaining locally identified hexagonal close-packed (HCP) Ag alongside face-centred cubic (FCC) Ag. The outcome of the synthesis can be modified by changing the detonation environment, while the highly non-equilibrium conditions provide access to phases that are difficult to obtain using conventional synthetic routes. BANG is a broadly applicable, highly non-equilibrium nanoparticle synthesis method whose products are governed by precursor chemistry and atmosphere, with potential access to kinetically trapped phases and direct supported-particle deposition.
articles.abstract_zh: 布里斯托尔加速纳米颗粒生成 (BANG) 方法是一种无溶剂和无封端剂的纳米颗粒合成方法。以前的工作主要限于金、银和铜颗粒。在这里，该方法扩展到另外十种元素，包括 Pb、Bi、Tl、Mn、Fe、Zn、Pt、Ni、Cd 和 Pd。在空气中爆炸有利于亲氧性较低的金属形成金属，而在氮气下爆炸叠氮化银抑制了可检测的氧化银形成，同时保留了局部确定的六方密排（HCP）银和面心立方（FCC）银。合成的结果可以通过改变爆炸环境来改变，而高度非平衡的条件提供了使用传统合成路线难以获得的相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 布里斯托尔加速纳米颗粒生成 (BANG) 方法是一种无溶剂和无封端剂的纳米颗粒合成方法。以前的工作主要限于金、银和铜颗粒。在这里，该方法扩展到另外十种元素，包括 Pb、Bi、Tl、Mn、Fe、Zn、Pt、Ni、Cd 和 Pd。在空气中爆炸有利于亲氧性较低的金属形成金属，而在氮气下爆炸叠氮化银抑制了可检测的氧化银形成，同时保留了局部确定的六方密排（HCP）银和面心立方（FCC）银。合成的结果可以通过改变爆炸环境来改变，而高度非平衡的条件提供了使用传统合成路线难以获得的相。 BANG 是一种应用广泛、高度非平衡的纳米颗粒合成方法，其产物受前体化学和气氛控制，有可能获得动力学捕获相和直接支撑颗粒沉积。

articles.title: Topological Anderson Superconductor in Landau Levels
articles.title_zh: 朗道能级的拓扑安德森超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: There is much interest in two-dimensional superconductors with odd integer values of the Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) Chern number Cᵣₘ BdG, often termed topological superconductors, as these are predicted to harbor Majorana zero modes. Because a magnetic field produces Landau levels (LL) with nonzero Chern numbers, it is natural to ask if a conventional two-dimensional superconductor of spinful fermions with Rashba spin-orbit coupling can be driven topological by application of a magnetic field. Self-consistent solutions of the BdG equations for an on-site attractive interaction produce a phase diagram consisting almost everywhere of superconducting states with even integer values of Cᵣₘ BdG, transitioning from one value to another as parameters such as the chemical potential are varied. We predict that introducing Anderson-type on-site disorder, which broadens as well as mixes LLs, produces, in the transition region, states wherein topological superconductivity percolates. This topological Anderson superconducting state provides another example where disorder can produce topologically nontrivial states.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们对具有 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 陈数 Cᵣₘ BdG 奇整数值的二维超导体非常感兴趣，通常被称为拓扑超导体，因为它们被预测具有马约拉纳零模式。由于磁场产生具有非零陈数的朗道能级 (LL)，因此很自然地会问是否可以通过应用磁场来驱动具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的自旋费米子的传统二维超导体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们对具有 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 陈数 Cᵣₘ BdG 奇整数值的二维超导体非常感兴趣，通常被称为拓扑超导体，因为它们被预测具有马约拉纳零模式。由于磁场产生具有非零陈数的朗道能级 (LL)，因此很自然地会问是否可以通过应用磁场来驱动具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的自旋费米子的传统二维超导体。现场吸引相互作用的 BdG 方程的自洽解产生了一个相图，其中几乎所有超导态都具有 Cᵣₘ BdG 的偶数整数值，随着化学势等参数的变化，从一个值过渡到另一个值。我们预测，引入安德森型现场无序，它会扩大并混合LL，在过渡区域产生拓扑超导渗透的状态。这种拓扑安德森超导态提供了另一个例子，其中无序可以产生拓扑上非平凡的状态。

articles.title: Energy transport from an active medium
articles.title_zh: 来自活性介质的能量传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the energy current through a harmonic chain whose left end is coupled, via a short-range contact potential, to a medium of overdamped run-and-tumble particles moving on a ring, while the right end is attached to a zero-temperature Langevin reservoir. The activity is parametrized by the propulsion speed v₀ and the persistence time τ. Using nonequilibrium response theory at weak system-medium coupling, we predict the stationary current and simulations reproduce it over a large part of the (v₀,τ) plane. That includes the possible nonmonotonicity of the current as function of v₀ and τ, and occurrence of resonances with the normal modes of the chain, most significantly at large τ and small v₀. There is a critical propulsion speed v_c at which the ring-crossing frequency of the particles leaves the phonon band: for v₀v_c it decays as (v₀²τ)⁻¹. We also explain where the theoretical prediction fails, especially due to an oscillatory instability originating from a sufficiently strong negative friction induced on the leftmost oscillator. Finally, the persistent medium produces strongly non-Gaussian velocity statistics and long-range, oscillating velocity correlations in the bulk of the chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究通过谐波链的能量电流，谐波链的左端通过短程接触电势耦合到在环上移动的过阻尼运行翻滚粒子介质，而右端连接到零温朗之万储层。活动由推进速度 v₀ 和持续时间 τ 参数化。利用弱系统-介质耦合的非平衡响应理论，我们预测了稳态电流，并通过模拟在 (v₀,τ) 平面的大部分区域重现了它。这包括电流作为 v₀ 和 τ 函数的可能的非单调性，以及与链的正常模式发生共振，在大 τ 和小 v0 时最显着。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究通过谐波链的能量电流，谐波链的左端通过短程接触电势耦合到在环上移动的过阻尼运行翻滚粒子介质，而右端连接到零温朗之万储层。活动由推进速度 v₀ 和持续时间 τ 参数化。利用弱系统-介质耦合的非平衡响应理论，我们预测了稳态电流，并通过模拟在 (v₀,τ) 平面的大部分区域重现了它。这包括电流作为 v₀ 和 τ 函数的可能的非单调性，以及与链的正常模式发生共振，在大 τ 和小 v0 时最显着。存在一个临界推进速度 v_c，在该速度下粒子的环交叉频率离开声子带：对于 v₀v_c，它衰减为 (v₀²τ)-1。我们还解释了理论预测失败的地方，特别是由于最左侧振荡器上引起的足够强的负摩擦引起的振荡不稳定性。最后，持久介质在链的大部分中产生强烈的非高斯速度统计数据和长程、振荡速度相关性。

articles.title: Multistable Thermoelectric Josephson Automata
articles.title_zh: 多稳态热电约瑟夫森自动机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multistable systems can store and process information, yet their elements usually only burn the drive energy. Here, we build an automaton whose elements actively convert heat into electrical power. Heat alone stabilizes the states at zero bias, and each state routes generation and dissipation to different junctions. The elements, gap-asymmetric superconducting tunnel junctions, deliver up to 2.6 pW at either polarity under fixed heating and support a magnetic-field-tunable Josephson current. Two junctions sharing a heated island split the bias hysteretically and, even at zero bias, lock into opposite voltages encoding the sweep direction. With a load and current bias, the automaton accesses states spanning junction polarity combinations, including zero voltage; the magnetic field sets which are available and the bias history selects the occupied one.
articles.abstract_zh: 多稳态系统可以存储和处理信息，但其元件通常只消耗驱动能量。在这里，我们构建了一个自动机，其元件主动将热量转化为电能。仅靠热量就能将状态稳定在零偏压下，并且每个状态都会将生成和耗散路由到不同的结点。这些元件是间隙不对称超导隧道结，在固定加热条件下，任一极性均可提供高达 2.6 pW 的功率，并支持磁场可调的约瑟夫森电流。共享一个加热岛的两个结点会滞后地分割偏置，即使在零偏置下，也会锁定到编码扫描方向的相反电压。通过负载和电流偏置，自动机可以访问跨越结极性组合的状态，包括零电压；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多稳态系统可以存储和处理信息，但其元件通常只消耗驱动能量。在这里，我们构建了一个自动机，其元件主动将热量转化为电能。仅靠热量就能将状态稳定在零偏压下，并且每个状态都会将生成和耗散路由到不同的结点。这些元件是间隙不对称超导隧道结，在固定加热条件下，任一极性均可提供高达 2.6 pW 的功率，并支持磁场可调的约瑟夫森电流。共享一个加热岛的两个结点会滞后地分割偏置，即使在零偏置下，也会锁定到编码扫描方向的相反电压。通过负载和电流偏置，自动机可以访问跨越结极性组合的状态，包括零电压；可用的磁场设置和偏置历史选择占用的磁场设置。

articles.title: Native vacancy energetics and association in TiN and CrN: chemical potential dependence, clustering, and surface effects
articles.title_zh: TiN 和 CrN 中的原生空位能量学和缔合：化学势依赖性、聚类和表面效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Native vacancy populations in transition-metal nitride coatings reflect vacancy formation, association, and depth-dependent stability. Using density functional theory (DFT), we compare these effects in rocksalt TiN and CrN in bulk and at (001) surfaces, within phase-stability-constrained chemical potential ranges. In TiN, V_N is favoured under N-poor and V_Ti under N-rich conditions; in CrN, V_N remains preferred throughout its stability range. Association energies are referenced to corresponding isolated vacancies where positive values mean association lowers the energy and negative values favour separation. Mean bulk association energies for mixed metal-nitrogen pairs are +0.132 eV in TiN and +1.053 eV in CrN. At (001) surfaces, V_N in TiN prefers the surface and V_Ti the first subsurface layer. In CrN, V_N has similar formation energies at the surface and first subsurface layer, with a slight preference for the latter; V_Cr slightly prefers the second subsurface layer. Surface cluster energies are referenced to separated vacancies at their preferred depths. The compact 2V_Ti+2V_N cluster in TiN has favourable association in bulk (+0.217 eV per vacancy) but unfavourable association at the surface (-0.346 eV per vacancy). By contrast, 2V_Cr+2V_N in CrN remains stabilised, with its association energy decreasing from +1.188 to +0.431 eV per vacancy. CrN's stronger association occurs without larger structural distortions and is accompanied by distinct Cr-centred magnetic responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属氮化物涂层中的原生空位数量反映了空位形成、缔合和深度依赖性稳定性。使用密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们在相稳定性限制的化学势范围内比较了岩盐 TiN 和 CrN 的块体和 (001) 表面的这些影响。在TiN中，贫氮条件下有利于V_N，富氮条件下有利于V_Ti；在 CrN 中，V_N 在整个稳定范围内仍然是首选。缔合能参考相应的孤立空位，其中正值意味着缔合降低能量，负值有利于分离。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属氮化物涂层中的原生空位数量反映了空位形成、缔合和深度依赖性稳定性。使用密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们在相稳定性限制的化学势范围内比较了岩盐 TiN 和 CrN 的块体和 (001) 表面的这些影响。在TiN中，贫氮条件下有利于V_N，富氮条件下有利于V_Ti；在 CrN 中，V_N 在整个稳定范围内仍然是首选。缔合能参考相应的孤立空位，其中正值意味着缔合降低能量，负值有利于分离。混合金属-氮对的平均体缔合能在 TiN 中为 +0.132 eV，在 CrN 中为 +1.053 eV。在(001)表面，TiN中的V_N优先于表面，而V_Ti优先于第一亚表面层。在 CrN 中，V_N 在表面和第一亚表面层具有相似的形成能，略偏向后者； V_Cr 稍微喜欢第二次表面层。表面团簇能量参考其首选深度处的分离空位。 TiN 中紧凑的 2V_Ti+2V_N 团簇在体积上具有有利的关联（每个空位 +0.217 eV），但在表面具有不利的关联（每个空位 -0.346 eV）。相比之下，CrN 中的 2V_Cr+2V_N 保持稳定，其缔合能从每个空位的 +1.188 eV 降至 +0.431 eV。 CrN 更强的缔合不会产生较大的结构变形，并且伴随着明显的以 Cr 为中心的磁响应。

articles.title: Signatures of Kitaev quantum spin liquid states in α-RuCl₃ revealed by nitrogen-vacancy spin-noise spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 氮空位自旋噪声光谱揭示α-RuCl₃中Kitaev量子自旋液态的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33085v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bond-dependent magnetic interactions, strong spin-orbit coupling, and quantum fluctuations in α-RuCl₃ make it an archetypical candidate for exotic Kitaev quantum spin liquid (QSL) states. While electronic transport, neutron scattering, optical and tunneling spectroscopies were used to probe global QSL signatures in large scale α-RuCl₃ samples, nanoscale evidence of local QSL behavior via a non-invasive experimental probe is still missing. Here, we use diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) spin-noise spectroscopy to probe QSL states in α-RuCl3 nanoflakes with thicknesses ranging from 8 to 150 nm over a temperature range of 4.3-250 K. Our measurements reveal a pronounced decrease in the NV spin-lattice relaxation time (T₁) below ~100 K in proximity to the α-RuCl₃ flakes, indicating enhanced GHz-frequency magnetic fluctuations. This temperature scale is consistent with the energy scale associated with Kitaev interactions (~8 meV) and the emergence of low-energy fractionalized excitations. Below 50 K, thicker (> 90 nm) flakes exhibit a distinct bi-exponential T₁ decay, unlike the single-exponential behavior observed for off-flake and thinner (8 nm) flake measurements, suggesting an increasingly heterogeneous magnetic noise environment.
