These results establish NV spin-noise spectroscopy as a local, non-invasive probe of low-energy spin dynamics in α-RuCl₃ nanoflakes and open a route to testing predicted noise signatures of fractionalized excitations in atomically thin QSL candidates.
articles.abstract_zh: α-RuCl₃ 中依赖键的磁相互作用、强自旋轨道耦合和量子涨落使其成为奇异基塔耶夫量子自旋液体 (QSL) 态的典型候选者。虽然电子输运、中子散射、光学和隧道光谱被用来探测大规模 α-RuCl₃ 样品中的全局 QSL 特征，但仍然缺少通过非侵入性实验探针获得局部 QSL 行为的纳米级证据。在这里，我们使用金刚石氮空位（NV）自旋噪声光谱在 4.3-250 K 的温度范围内探测厚度为 8 至 150 nm 的 α-RuCl3 纳米片中的 QSL 态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: α-RuCl₃ 中依赖键的磁相互作用、强自旋轨道耦合和量子涨落使其成为奇异基塔耶夫量子自旋液体 (QSL) 态的典型候选者。虽然电子输运、中子散射、光学和隧道光谱被用来探测大规模 α-RuCl₃ 样品中的全局 QSL 特征，但仍然缺少通过非侵入性实验探针获得局部 QSL 行为的纳米级证据。在这里，我们使用金刚石氮空位（NV）自旋噪声光谱在 4.3-250 K 的温度范围内探测厚度为 8 至 150 nm 的 α-RuCl3 纳米片中的 QSL 态。我们的测量结果表明，靠近 α-RuCl3 片的 NV 自旋晶格弛豫时间 (T₁) 显着降低到低于 100 K，这表明 GHz 频率磁波动增强。该温标与基塔耶夫相互作用（~8 meV）和低能分级激发的出现相关的能标一致。低于 50 K，较厚（> 90 nm）的薄片表现出明显的双指数 T₁ 衰减，与在片外和较薄（8 nm）薄片测量中观察到的单指数行为不同，这表明磁噪声环境越来越不均匀。这些结果将 NV 自旋噪声光谱学确立为 α-RuCl₃ 纳米薄片中低能自旋动力学的局部、非侵入性探针，并为测试原子薄 QSL 候选物中分段激发的预测噪声特征开辟了一条途径。

articles.title: Anharmonic enhancement of thermal conductivity in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅: A consistent picture from molecular dynamics and Wigner transport
articles.title_zh: 非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te₅ 热导率的非谐增强：分子动力学和维格纳输运的一致图景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anharmonicity limits heat conduction in crystals, but its role in amorphous solids, where heat is carried mainly by tunneling between quasi-degenerate vibrations, remains unsettled. Here we disentangle the contributions of structural disorder, quantum statistics, and anharmonicity to the thermal conductivity of amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ (aGST), the prototypical phase-change memory material. Using a single machine-learned potential trained on first-principles data, we compare classical equilibrium and nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (MD), which include anharmonicity to all orders, with harmonic Allen-Feldman theory and the anharmonic Wigner transport equation, both of which include quantum statistics. Four MD approaches agree on a conductivity of 0.171-0.181 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ at room temperature, about 16% above the harmonic Allen-Feldman value for the same model, and the Wigner formulation bridges the two: with classical statistics, it agrees with MD to within 5%. We trace this anharmonic enhancement to vibrational couplings that grow with the frequency difference between modes, so that anharmonic broadening opens additional channels for heat conduction. A comparison with silica, alumina, and disordered carbons reveals three regimes, in which anharmonicity reduces, barely affects, or enhances the conductivity. The predicted glass-like increase of the conductivity with temperature is consistent with thermoreflectance measurements. These results show that anharmonicity has no universal effect in disordered solids, and can promote rather than limit heat transport in strongly disordered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 非谐性限制了晶体中的热传导，但它在非晶固体中的作用仍然不稳定，其中热量主要通过准简并振动之间的隧道传输。在这里，我们理清了结构无序、量子统计和非谐性对原型相变存储材料非晶 Ge2Sb2Te5 (aGST) 热导率的影响。使用在第一原理数据上训练的单个机器学习势，我们将经典平衡和非平衡分子动力学（MD）（包括所有阶的非调和性）与调和艾伦-费尔德曼理论和非调和维格纳输运方程（两者都包括量子统计）进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非谐性限制了晶体中的热传导，但它在非晶固体中的作用仍然不稳定，其中热量主要通过准简并振动之间的隧道传输。在这里，我们理清了结构无序、量子统计和非谐性对原型相变存储材料非晶 Ge2Sb2Te5 (aGST) 热导率的影响。使用在第一原理数据上训练的单个机器学习势，我们将经典平衡和非平衡分子动力学（MD）（包括所有阶的非调和性）与调和艾伦-费尔德曼理论和非调和维格纳输运方程（两者都包括量子统计）进行比较。四种 MD 方法在室温下的电导率一致为 0.171-0.181 W m⁻1 K⁻1，比同一模型的谐波 Allen-Feldman 值高出约 16%，而 Wigner 公式将两者联系起来：根据经典统计，它与 MD 的一致性在 5% 以内。我们将这种非谐波增强追溯到振动耦合，该耦合随着模式之间的频率差而增长，因此非谐波展宽打开了额外的热传导通道。与二氧化硅、氧化铝和无序碳的比较揭示了三种状态，其中非谐性降低、几乎不影响或增强电导率。预测的电导率随温度的增加与玻璃状增加与热反射测量一致。这些结果表明，非调和性在无序固体中没有普遍影响，并且可以促进而不是限制强无序材料中的热传输。

articles.title: Classification of spin space groups and crystal magnetic orders
articles.title_zh: 自旋空间群和晶体磁序的分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin space groups (SSGs) describe magnetic crystals in the limit of negligible spin-orbit coupling, where spatial and spin rotations decouple. Although algebraic enumerations of SSGs exist, their abstract mathematical approaches obscure the physical meaning of the resulting classifications, leaving the direct correspondence between SSGs and real-space magnetic orders unestablished. Here, we present a physically motivated framework for enumerating and classifying SSGs based on their translation holonomy---the image of the spatial lattice translation group under the spin homomorphism. The three classes of abelian images in SO(3) divide SSGs into three basic translation types. Translation holonomy constrains the spin operations associated with point-group elements, yielding a complete enumeration of SSGs organized by a physical hierarchy. Within this framework, translation holonomy classifies SSGs and magnetic orders into 17 universal spin-lattice types, each with unambiguous Bragg-peak geometries and polarization signatures in neutron diffraction. Beyond organizing known magnetic orders, this framework directly predicts four universal physical phenomena: (i) exact magnetization compensation enforced by certain spin-lattice types; (ii) an exact group-theoretic criterion for the emergence of noncommuting Brillouin zones; (iii) a new type of 3Q magnetic order with vanishing octupoles; and (iv) the realization of strictly collinear momentum-space spin textures protected by reflection-staggered coplanar spin lattices. We also construct a spin space group database organized according to this physical hierarchy.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋空间群（SSG）描述了可忽略的自旋轨道耦合极限下的磁性晶体，其中空间和自旋旋转解耦。尽管存在 SSG 的代数枚举，但它们的抽象数学方法模糊了所得分类的物理意义，导致 SSG 与真实空间磁序之间的直接对应关系尚未建立。在这里，我们提出了一个基于物理驱动的框架，用于根据平移完整性（自旋同态下的空间晶格平移群的图像）对 SSG 进行枚举和分类。 SO(3) 中的三类阿贝尔图像将 SSG 分为三种基本翻译类型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋空间群（SSG）描述了可忽略的自旋轨道耦合极限下的磁性晶体，其中空间和自旋旋转解耦。尽管存在 SSG 的代数枚举，但它们的抽象数学方法模糊了所得分类的物理意义，导致 SSG 与真实空间磁序之间的直接对应关系尚未建立。在这里，我们提出了一个基于物理驱动的框架，用于根据平移完整性（自旋同态下的空间晶格平移群的图像）对 SSG 进行枚举和分类。 SO(3) 中的三类阿贝尔图像将 SSG 分为三种基本翻译类型。平移完整约束与点群元素相关的自旋运算，产生由物理层次结构组织的 SSG 的完整枚举。在此框架内，平移完整学将 SSG 和磁序分为 17 种通用自旋晶格类型，每种类型都具有明确的布拉格峰几何形状和中子衍射中的偏振特征。除了组织已知的磁序之外，该框架还直接预测了四种普遍的物理现象：（i）由某些自旋晶格类型强制执行的精确磁化补偿； (ii) 非通勤布里渊区出现的精确群论标准； (iii) 一种新型的消失八极子 3Q 磁序； (iv) 实现由反射交错共面自旋晶格保护的严格共线动量空间自旋纹理。我们还构建了一个根据该物理层次结构组织的自旋空间群数据库。

articles.title: Compositionally Tunable Synthesis of High-Entropy Transition Metal Dichalcogenides Exhibiting Above-Room-Temperature Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 具有高于室温磁性的高熵过渡金属二硫属化物的成分可调合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As silicon-based electronics approach their physical limits, low-dimensional magnetic materials have attracted increasing attention for next-generation electronic and information technologies. Realizing these opportunities requires two-dimensional (2D) materials with robust and tunable room-temperature magnetism. Here, we report a two-step synthesis strategy for fabricating 2D high-entropy transition metal dichalcogenides (HE-TMDs) incorporating magnetic elements beyond conventional groups 4-6. High-entropy layered double hydroxides (HE-LDHs) are first synthesized via hydrothermal coprecipitation, enabling atomic-level mixing of diverse transition metals across groups 4-12. Subsequent chalcogenization yields 2D HE-TMDs while preserving homogeneous elemental distribution. This approach circumvents the constraints of solid-state reaction, chemical vapor transport methods, enabling the synthesis of compositionally complex and structurally controlled 2D magnets. Representative (VCrFeCoNi)S2-x exhibits robust magnetism above room temperature, demonstrating the potential of this high-entropy design strategy for expanding the compositional and functional diversity of 2D magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着硅基电子产品接近其物理极限，低维磁性材料越来越受到下一代电子和信息技术的关注。实现这些机会需要具有强大且可调节室温磁性的二维 (2D) 材料。在这里，我们报告了一种两步合成策略，用于制造二维高熵过渡金属二硫属化物（HE-TMD），其中包含超出常规第 4-6 族的磁性元素。首先通过水热共沉淀合成高熵层状双氢氧化物 (HE-LDH)，从而实现 4-12 族不同过渡金属的原子级混合。随后的硫属化产生 2D HE-TMD，同时保持均匀的元素分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着硅基电子产品接近其物理极限，低维磁性材料越来越受到下一代电子和信息技术的关注。实现这些机会需要具有强大且可调节室温磁性的二维 (2D) 材料。在这里，我们报告了一种两步合成策略，用于制造二维高熵过渡金属二硫属化物（HE-TMD），其中包含超出常规第 4-6 族的磁性元素。首先通过水热共沉淀合成高熵层状双氢氧化物 (HE-LDH)，从而实现 4-12 族不同过渡金属的原子级混合。随后的硫属化产生 2D HE-TMD，同时保持均匀的元素分布。这种方法规避了固态反应、化学气相传输方法的限制，能够合成成分复杂且结构受控的二维磁体。代表性的 (VCrFeCoNi)S2-x 在室温以上表现出强大的磁性，证明了这种高熵设计策略在扩大二维磁性材料的成分和功能多样性方面的潜力。

articles.title: Parametric neural-network wavefunctions across a bosonic phase transition
articles.title_zh: 玻色相变中的参数神经网络波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Boseformer, a universal attention-based neural-network architecture for representing the wavefunctions of particles with bosonic quantum statistics, including superfluid and crystal phases. The model is trained to generate the wavefunction as a function of a Hamiltonian parameter across the quantum phase transition between these phases. Once trained with variational Monte Carlo optimization, it can serve as a foundation model describing the phase transition without the need to retrain it for individual parameter values. We demonstrate our method on a system of two-dimensional bosons with 1/r³ repulsive interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 Boseformer，一种基于注意力的通用神经网络架构，用于用玻色量子统计表示粒子的波函数，包括超流体和晶相。该模型经过训练，生成波函数作为这些相之间量子相变的哈密顿参数的函数。一旦使用变分蒙特卡罗优化进行训练，它就可以作为描述相变的基础模型，而无需针对各个参数值对其进行重新训练。我们在具有 1/r3 排斥相互作用的二维玻色子系统上演示了我们的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了 Boseformer，一种基于注意力的通用神经网络架构，用于用玻色量子统计表示粒子的波函数，包括超流体和晶相。该模型经过训练，生成波函数作为这些相之间量子相变的哈密顿参数的函数。一旦使用变分蒙特卡罗优化进行训练，它就可以作为描述相变的基础模型，而无需针对各个参数值对其进行重新训练。我们在具有 1/r3 排斥相互作用的二维玻色子系统上演示了我们的方法。

articles.title: Topological insulators on site-eliminated, projected, and patterned fractal lattices
articles.title_zh: 点消除、投影和图案化分形晶格上的拓扑绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying fractal lattices of fractional (Hausdorff) dimension as geometric descendants of parent crystals, we showcase the successful realization of canonical topological insulators in one-, two-, and three-dimensional crystals on their self-similar descents using three complementary approaches, starting from lattice-regularized models in integer dimensions. (a) In the first approach, we construct the fractal Hamiltonian by removing all parent-lattice sites that do not belong to such a network (method of site elimination). (b) In the second one, we integrate or project out the same set of sites to obtain an effective Hamiltonian for the fractal lattice (method of projection or renormalization). (c) In the third approach, we retain the parent-crystal lattice intact but spatially pattern the on-site mass parameter, which controls the topology of the parent insulating system, such that it assumes two topologically distinct values on the fractal network and its complement (patterned fractal lattices). By numerically diagonalizing the resulting Hamiltonians and computing appropriate topological invariants or local markers, corroborating the bulk-boundary correspondence through gapless modes at outer or inner boundaries, we establish Su-Schrieffer-Heeger topology on the Cantor set using all three approaches, Haldane topology on the hexaflake [using (a) and (b)] and Qi-Wu-Zhang topology on the Sierpiński carpet [using (c)], and strong Z₂ topological insulating phases on the tiled Menger sponge from methods (a), (b), and (c). These findings complement and substantially extend the previously reported realization of Qi-Wu-Zhang topology on the Sierpiński carpet using methods (a) and (b) [Phys. Rev. B 110, L241302 (2024)].
articles.abstract_zh: 将分数维（Hausdorff）分形晶格识别为母晶体的几何后代，我们展示了从整数维晶格正则化模型开始，使用三种互补方法成功实现了一维、二维和三维晶体中的规范拓扑绝缘体的自相似下降。 (a) 在第一种方法中，我们通过删除所有不属于此类网络的父晶格站点（站点消除方法）来构造分形哈密顿量。 (b) 在第二个中，我们整合或投影出同一组位点以获得分形晶格的有效哈密顿量（投影或重整化方法）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将分数维（Hausdorff）分形晶格识别为母晶体的几何后代，我们展示了从整数维晶格正则化模型开始，使用三种互补方法成功实现了一维、二维和三维晶体中的规范拓扑绝缘体的自相似下降。 (a) 在第一种方法中，我们通过删除所有不属于此类网络的父晶格站点（站点消除方法）来构造分形哈密顿量。 (b) 在第二个中，我们整合或投影出同一组位点以获得分形晶格的有效哈密顿量（投影或重整化方法）。 (c) 在第三种方法中，我们保留母晶格完整，但在空间上图案化现场质量参数，该参数控制母体绝缘系统的拓扑，使得它在分形网络及其补体（图案化分形晶格）上呈现两个拓扑上不同的值。通过对所得哈密顿量进行数值对角化并计算适当的拓扑不变量或局部标记，通过外部或内部边界处的无间隙模式证实体边界对应关系，我们使用所有三种方法在 Cantor 集上建立了 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 拓扑，六片上的 Haldane 拓扑[使用 (a) 和 (b)] 和 Sierpiński 地毯上的 Qi-Wu-Zhang 拓扑[使用 (c)]，以及强 Z2 拓扑绝缘相方法 (a)、(b) 和 (c) 中的平铺门格尔海绵。这些发现补充并大大扩展了先前报道的使用方法 (a) 和 (b) 在 Sierpiński 地毯上实现 Qi-Wu-Zhang 拓扑的方法 [Phys.修订版 B 110，L241302 (2024)]。

articles.title: Antiferromagnetic phase of MnTe2: spin-order-induced renormalization of phonon Raman spectrum
articles.title_zh: MnTe2 的反铁磁相：自旋序诱导的声子拉曼光谱重正化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.33156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two modes of spin wave excitations (magnons) were detected in Raman scattering spectra of MnTe2. It is an unconventional magnet that features a pyrite-type crystal structure hosting a non-collinear, non-coplanar antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin order below the Néel temperature. In this brief communication, the focus is primarily on the effect of spin ordering on lattice dynamics (phonons) that has been established through temperature (5 - 300 K), linear polarization angle (0 deg - 360 deg) and external magnetic field (up to 16 T) dependent measurements. It has been found that below the magnetic transition temperature, the frequencies of four out of five Raman-active lattice vibrations (i.e., Eg and three Tg phonon modes) revealed significant departure from the mechanism of the three-phonon anharmonic decay described by Klemens model. Here, we propose a new model considering spin-phonon coupling to explain frequency renormalization of the phonon part of the Raman spectrum upon the para-/antiferro- (PM/AFM) magnetic phase transition change in MnTe2. Through employing Green's function formalism, we show that a simple two-sublattice collinear antiferromagnet approach follows well both spin ordering induced hardening and softening of phonon modes observed in AFM phase of MnTe2 upon cooling. Additionally, the detailed temperature and field dependences of the energy for both magnon modes are presented. In addition to unexpected twofold anisotropy of the higher energy magnon mode (approx. 3.5 meV) unveiled in crossed configuration, our magneto-optical measurements revealed a subtle, yet definite softening trend for the lower energy mode (approx. 2.6 meV). Although the precise reasons for these effects remain unclear, we put forward a symmetry reduction in the local atomic surroundings as a possible mechanism for discussion.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，在 MnTe2 的拉曼散射光谱中检测到两种模式的自旋波激发（磁振子）。它是一种非常规磁体，具有黄铁矿型晶体结构，在尼尔温度以下具有非共线、非共面反铁磁 (AFM) 自旋序。在这篇简短的交流中，重点主要是自旋排序对晶格动力学（声子）的影响，该影响是通过温度（5 - 300 K）、线性偏振角（0 度 - 360 度）和外部磁场（高达 16 T）相关测量建立的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，在 MnTe2 的拉曼散射光谱中检测到两种模式的自旋波激发（磁振子）。它是一种非常规磁体，具有黄铁矿型晶体结构，在尼尔温度以下具有非共线、非共面反铁磁 (AFM) 自旋序。在这篇简短的交流中，重点主要是自旋排序对晶格动力学（声子）的影响，该影响是通过温度（5 - 300 K）、线性偏振角（0 度 - 360 度）和外部磁场（高达 16 T）相关测量建立的。研究发现，在磁转变温度以下，五分之四的拉曼活性晶格振动（即 Eg 和三个 Tg 声子模式）的频率与克莱门斯模型描述的三声子非谐衰变机制显着背离。在这里，我们提出了一种考虑自旋声子耦合的新模型，以解释拉曼光谱声子部分在 MnTe2 中对/反铁（PM/AFM）磁相变变化时的频率重整化。通过采用格林函数形式，我们证明了一种简单的双亚晶格共线反铁磁体方法很好地遵循了冷却时在 MnTe2 AFM 相中观察到的自旋排序引起的声子模式的硬化和软化。此外，还介绍了两种磁振子模式能量的详细温度和场依赖性。除了交叉配置中揭示的高能磁振子模式（约 3.5 meV）出人意料的双重各向异性之外，我们的磁光测量还揭示了低能模式（约 2.6 meV）的微妙但明确的软化趋势。尽管这些效应的确切原因尚不清楚，但我们提出局部原子环境的对称性降低作为讨论的可能机制。

articles.title: Systematic and accurate anharmonic formation free energies of metastable defects via a constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force framework
articles.title_zh: 通过受约束的贝叶斯自适应偏置力框架系统且准确地获得亚稳态缺陷的非谐波形成自由能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20902v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Computing the formation free energies of metastable defects at finite temperature remains challenging due to anharmonicity, the multiplicity of basins and the frequent occurrence of migration events. Using the previously introduced constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force method (BABFc), we establish a practical thermodynamic integration framework for computing restricted anharmonic formation free energies associated with individual metastable defect basins. We demonstrate that BABFc can be exploited as a robust, systematic and numerically efficient tool for addressing a long standing bottleneck in atomistic materials science: the finite temperature thermodynamic characterization of metastable defects in complex, highly anharmonic energy landscapes. The proposed workflow requires only a reference local minimum and a confinement strategy and does not rely on defect specific collective variables. It therefore provides a general route to assign well-defined free energies to individual metastable basins, even when these basins are separated by low barriers and embedded in a dense landscape of competing configurations. In this setting, BABFc enables stable, bias corrected free energy estimates with statistical accuracies at the meV/atom level and a very low failure rate, including for systems containing approximately one thousand atoms. We demonstrate this capability through thousands of independent free energy calculations covering hundreds of four-interstitial and four-vacancy configurations in bcc α-Fe over a broad temperature range, using both a traditional empirical potential and a data driven force field.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于不和谐性、盆地的多样性和迁移事件的频繁发生，计算有限温度下亚稳态缺陷的地层自由能仍然具有挑战性。使用先前介绍的约束贝叶斯自适应偏置力方法（BABFc），我们建立了一个实用的热力学积分框架，用于计算与单个亚稳态缺陷盆地相关的受限非谐形成自由能。我们证明，BABFc 可以作为一种强大、系统和数值高效的工具来解决原子材料科学中长期存在的瓶颈：复杂、高度非和谐能量景观中亚稳态缺陷的有限温度热力学表征。所提出的工作流程仅需要参考局部最小值和限制策略，并且不依赖于缺陷特定的集体变量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于不和谐性、盆地的多样性和迁移事件的频繁发生，计算有限温度下亚稳态缺陷的地层自由能仍然具有挑战性。使用先前介绍的约束贝叶斯自适应偏置力方法（BABFc），我们建立了一个实用的热力学积分框架，用于计算与单个亚稳态缺陷盆地相关的受限非谐形成自由能。我们证明，BABFc 可以作为一种强大、系统和数值高效的工具来解决原子材料科学中长期存在的瓶颈：复杂、高度非和谐能量景观中亚稳态缺陷的有限温度热力学表征。所提出的工作流程仅需要参考局部最小值和限制策略，并且不依赖于缺陷特定的集体变量。因此，它提供了一条将明确的自由能分配给各个亚稳态盆地的通用途径，即使这些盆地被低势垒隔开并嵌入竞争配置的密集景观中。在此设置中，BABFc 能够实现稳定的、偏差校正的自由能估计，统计精度达到 meV/原子水平，故障率非常低，包括包含大约 1000 个原子的系统。我们使用传统的经验势和数据驱动力场，通过数千次独立的自由能计算展示了这种能力，计算涵盖了 bcc α-Fe 在广泛的温度范围内的数百种四间隙和四空位配置。

articles.title: Entanglement between distant spins in a polarized magnet forms a d-wave clover
articles.title_zh: 极化磁体中远距离自旋之间的纠缠形成了 d 波三叶草
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32190v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin-orbit coupling makes a polarized magnet a source of virtual spin-flip pairs. These pairs entangle distant spins: the symmetry of the coupling fixes the angular pattern, and the flips they leave behind end it at a distance of order the inverse spin-orbit angle. For a spin-1/2 square-lattice ferromagnet we prove, at leading order, a d-wave inverse-square law, 1.376 times the spin-wave amplitude, a clover-shaped entangled region, exact without the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya term, and that each spin's entanglement is entirely pairwise. Four qubits can test the d-wave signs at present error rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道耦合使极化磁体成为虚拟自旋翻转对的来源。这些对使遥远的自旋纠缠在一起：耦合的对称性固定了角度模式，并且它们留下的翻转以逆自旋轨道角的量级的距离结束了它。对于自旋 1/2 方格铁磁体，我们在主阶上证明了 d 波平方反比定律，是自旋波振幅的 1.376 倍，三叶草形状的纠缠区域，在没有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 项的情况下是精确的，并且每个自旋的纠缠完全是成对的。四个量子位可以测试当前错误率下的 d 波符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道耦合使极化磁体成为虚拟自旋翻转对的来源。这些对使遥远的自旋纠缠在一起：耦合的对称性固定了角度模式，并且它们留下的翻转以逆自旋轨道角的量级的距离结束了它。对于自旋 1/2 方格铁磁体，我们在主阶上证明了 d 波平方反比定律，是自旋波振幅的 1.376 倍，三叶草形状的纠缠区域，在没有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 项的情况下是精确的，并且每个自旋的纠缠完全是成对的。四个量子位可以测试当前错误率下的 d 波符号。

articles.title: Augmented Imaginary-Time Evolution of Neural Quantum States with Implicit Time Steps
articles.title_zh: 具有隐式时间步长的神经量子态的增广虚时演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32236v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Finding the ground states of quantum many-body systems remains a central challenge in physics and quantum chemistry. Imaginary-time evolution (ITE) offers a natural, widely used route, but its convergence is typically asymptotic. Variational approaches restrict this evolution to parameterized manifolds, with neural quantum states (NQS) providing flexible representations commonly optimized via stochastic reconfiguration (SR). Their performance depends on the geometry of the variational manifold, the convergence properties of ITE, and the stability of finite-step explicit (forward) integrators. By exploiting local geometric information of the energy landscape, the recently introduced augmented imaginary-time evolution (AITE) can, in principle, reach the ground state in finite imaginary time. To exploit the accelerated convergence of AITE in NQS optimization, we first combine an implicit Euler step with Galerkin projection to derive an implicit SR scheme that permits large, stable steps and substantially outperforms conventional methods. We use it to formulate an implicit version of AITE and show that its acceleration persists under variational projection and finite-step integration with asymptotically quadratic convergence of the energy error. With finite sampling, implicit schemes yield consistent gains, and implicit AITE becomes increasingly advantageous.
articles.abstract_zh: 寻找量子多体系统的基态仍然是物理学和量子化学领域的核心挑战。虚时间演化（ITE）提供了一条自然的、广泛使用的路线，但其收敛通常是渐近的。变分方法将这种演化限制在参数化流形上，神经量子态（NQS）提供灵活的表示，通常通过随机重构（SR）进行优化。它们的性能取决于变分流形的几何形状、ITE 的收敛特性以及有限步显式（前向）积分器的稳定性。通过利用能量景观的局部几何信息，最近引入的增强虚数时间演化（AITE）原则上可以在有限虚数时间内达到基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 寻找量子多体系统的基态仍然是物理学和量子化学领域的核心挑战。虚时间演化（ITE）提供了一条自然的、广泛使用的路线，但其收敛通常是渐近的。变分方法将这种演化限制在参数化流形上，神经量子态（NQS）提供灵活的表示，通常通过随机重构（SR）进行优化。它们的性能取决于变分流形的几何形状、ITE 的收敛特性以及有限步显式（前向）积分器的稳定性。通过利用能量景观的局部几何信息，最近引入的增强虚数时间演化（AITE）原则上可以在有限虚数时间内达到基态。为了在 NQS 优化中利用 AITE 的加速收敛，我们首先将隐式欧拉步骤与 Galerkin 投影相结合，得出隐式 SR 方案，该方案允许大而稳定的步骤，并且大大优于传统方法。我们用它来制定 AITE 的隐式版本，并表明其加速度在变分投影和有限步积分以及能量误差渐近二次收敛的情况下持续存在。通过有限采样，隐式方案产生一致的增益，并且隐式 AITE 变得越来越有利。

articles.title: First-principles phase diagram of monolayer CrS₂ polymorphs under biaxial strain and its sensitivity to the Hubbard U parameter
articles.title_zh: 双轴应变下单层 CrS2 多晶型物的第一性原理相图及其对 Hubbard U 参数的敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32265v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In correlated two-dimensional magnets the balance between competing electronic and magnetic phases is often set by the strength of the on-site Coulomb interaction, so that the predicted ground state can hinge on a parameter that is not uniquely defined. Monolayer CrS₂ lies squarely in this regime, hosting several energetically close polymorphs whose character ranges from non-magnetic semiconducting to magnetically ordered metallic. We therefore investigate, using DFT+U within the generalized gradient approximation, the structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the 1H, 1T, 1T', and 1T'' polymorphs of monolayer CrS₂ under varying Hubbard interactions (U=0--8~eV) and biaxial strain (-10% to +10%). The 1T-derived structures remain metallic and magnetic throughout, with U acting mainly as a spectral renormalization. The 1H phase behaves differently, passing from a non-magnetic semiconductor through an antiferromagnetic semiconducting regime before metallizing, so that the gap closes as U increases while the local Cr moment grows monotonically. Biaxial tensile strain at fixed U induces a similar sequence of transitions. Along both tuning pathways, the two inequivalent nearest-neighbor Cr--Cr exchange channels progressively separate and cross, with the parallel-spin channel becoming dominant, accompanied by a breathing-type bond disproportionation. Independent calculations with a localized-orbital implementation reproduce the overall evolution but yield shifted critical values of U and of strain, demonstrating the robustness of the phase diagram while highlighting the implementation dependence of the transition thresholds.
articles.abstract_zh: 在相关二维磁体中，竞争的电子相和磁相之间的平衡通常由现场库仑相互作用的强度决定，因此预测的基态可能取决于未唯一定义的参数。单层 CrS2 正好处于这种状态，具有几种能量上接近的多晶型物，其特征范围从非磁性半导体到磁性有序金属。因此，我们使用广义梯度近似中的 DFT+U，研究了单层 CrS2 的 1H、1T、1T' 和 1T'' 多晶型物在不同哈伯德相互作用 (U=0--8~eV) 和双轴应变（-10% 至 +10%）下的结构、磁性和电子特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在相关二维磁体中，竞争的电子相和磁相之间的平衡通常由现场库仑相互作用的强度决定，因此预测的基态可能取决于未唯一定义的参数。单层 CrS2 正好处于这种状态，具有几种能量上接近的多晶型物，其特征范围从非磁性半导体到磁性有序金属。因此，我们使用广义梯度近似中的 DFT+U，研究了单层 CrS2 的 1H、1T、1T' 和 1T'' 多晶型物在不同哈伯德相互作用 (U=0--8~eV) 和双轴应变（-10% 至 +10%）下的结构、磁性和电子特性。 1T 衍生结构始终保持金属性和磁性，U 主要充当光谱重正化作用。 1H 相的行为有所不同，在金属化之前从非磁性半导体穿过反铁磁半导体区域，因此随着 U 的增加，间隙闭合，而局部 Cr 矩单调增长。固定 U 处的双轴拉伸应变会引发类似的转变序列。沿着两条调谐路径，两个不等价的最近邻 Cr-Cr 交换通道逐渐分离和交叉，平行自旋通道成为主导，并伴有呼吸型键歧化。使用局域轨道实现的独立计算再现了整体演化，但产生了 U 和应变的临界值变化，证明了相图的稳健性，同时强调了转变阈值的实现依赖性。

articles.title: Topological terahertz fields from tunable vectorial currents
articles.title_zh: 可调谐矢量电流的拓扑太赫兹场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32586v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Future information processing calls for photonic architectures with greater capacity, intrinsic resilience to noise, and direct integration with quantum materials and devices. Topological light pulses have recently emerged as promising candidates to meet these demands, yet the complexity underlying their unique properties also makes them challenging to generate, tune, and fully resolve in space and time. Here, we generate and actively tune topological light fields through transient vectorial currents in an optoelectronic metasurface. Incident linear polarization steers the local direction of photocurrents in graphene via nanoplasmonic resonators with triangular symmetry, while a global winding pattern enables continuous tuning between compressional and circulating charge flows. Under ultrafast excitation, these currents radiate single-cycle terahertz toroidal pulses spanning electric- and magnetic-dominant modes with dynamically evolving skyrmion textures. Full spatiotemporal mapping and reconstruction provide a complete visualization of the toroidal structure of light, directly tracing the closed field surfaces while continuously tracking skyrmion number and helicity throughout a single cycle. These results connect two-dimensional vectorial currents to rich three-dimensional electromagnetic field structures, while establishing a versatile integrated platform for higher-dimensional photonic information processing and emerging material spectroscopies.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的信息处理需要具有更大容量、固有的抗噪声能力以及与量子材料和设备直接集成的光子架构。拓扑光脉冲最近成为满足这些需求的有希望的候选者，但其独特性质背后的复杂性也使得它们在空间和时间上的生成、调整和完全解析具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过光电超表面中的瞬态矢量电流生成并主动调整拓扑光场。入射线性偏振通过具有三角形对称性的纳米等离子体谐振器引导石墨烯中光电流的局部方向，而全局缠绕模式能够在压缩和循环电荷流之间进行连续调谐。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 未来的信息处理需要具有更大容量、固有的抗噪声能力以及与量子材料和设备直接集成的光子架构。拓扑光脉冲最近成为满足这些需求的有希望的候选者，但其独特性质背后的复杂性也使得它们在空间和时间上的生成、调整和完全解析具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过光电超表面中的瞬态矢量电流生成并主动调整拓扑光场。入射线性偏振通过具有三角形对称性的纳米等离子体谐振器引导石墨烯中光电流的局部方向，而全局缠绕模式能够在压缩和循环电荷流之间进行连续调谐。在超快激励下，这些电流辐射单周期太赫兹环形脉冲，跨越电和磁主导模式，具有动态演化的斯格明子纹理。完整的时空映射和重建提供了光的环形结构的完整可视化，直接跟踪闭场表面，同时在单个周期中连续跟踪斯格明子数和螺旋度。这些结果将二维矢量电流与丰富的三维电磁场结构连接起来，同时为高维光子信息处理和新兴材料光谱学建立了多功能集成平台。

articles.title: Packing the Bragg sphere: complete three-dimensional photonic band gaps at the refractive index of polymers (1.55)
articles.title_zh: 堆积布拉格球：聚合物折射率 (1.55) 下的完整三维光子带隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32789v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Complete 3D photonic band gaps have so far been found only at refractive-index contrasts of about 1.9 and above, reached by rod-connected diamond lattice structures. Reciprocal-space design of quasiperiodic structures recently achieved considerable emission attenuation at much lower contrasts [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]. Here we implement systematic search and reciprocal-space design of periodic 3D structures with complete band gaps, solving a discrete optimization problem on an integer lattice. A gap above a high band needs the strongest Fourier components of the dielectric close to the Bragg sphere of that band. Crystals with large cells, started from Fourier peaks at the vertices of a polyhedron on this sphere and optimized against densely refined band edges, open complete gaps down to an index contrast of 1.55, that of common polymers against air. A rational approximant of an icosidodecahedron gave the most efficient location of the Fourier peaks among the polyhedra tested. Numerical calculations confirm the gaps over a resolution series, with band edges searched over the whole Brillouin zone. The best designs are connected porous networks, suited to a microwave test with printed polymer. A rigorous bound, valid for any structure, does not exclude gaps at lower index, and the next rational approximants of the icosidodecahedron, whose Bragg zones match bands 576 and 2440 almost exactly, point to where gaps at even lower contrast may be sought.
articles.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，仅在折射率对比度约为 1.9 及以上时才发现完整的 3D 光子带隙，这是通过杆连接的金刚石晶格结构达到的。准周期结构的倒易空间设计最近在低得多的对比度下实现了相当大的发射衰减[L.麦瓦尔德等人，Adv。光学材料。 10、2100785（2022）]。在这里，我们实现了具有完整带隙的周期性 3D 结构的系统搜索和倒易空间设计，解决了整数晶格上的离散优化问题。高频带以上的间隙需要接近该频带布拉格球的最强电介质傅立叶分量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 迄今为止，仅在折射率对比度约为 1.9 及以上时才发现完整的 3D 光子带隙，这是通过杆连接的金刚石晶格结构达到的。准周期结构的倒易空间设计最近在低得多的对比度下实现了相当大的发射衰减[L.麦瓦尔德等人，Adv。光学材料。 10、2100785（2022）]。在这里，我们实现了具有完整带隙的周期性 3D 结构的系统搜索和倒易空间设计，解决了整数晶格上的离散优化问题。高频带以上的间隙需要接近该频带布拉格球的最强电介质傅立叶分量。具有大晶胞的晶体，从该球体上多面体顶点的傅里叶峰开始，针对密集细化的带边缘进行优化，打开完整的间隙，折射率对比度降至 1.55，这是普通聚合物与空气的折射率对比度。二十面体的有理近似给出了测试的多面体中傅里叶峰的最有效位置。数值计算确认了分辨率系列上的间隙，并在整个布里渊区搜索了带边缘。最好的设计是连接的多孔网络，适合使用印刷聚合物进行微波测试。对任何结构都有效的严格界限并不排除较低指数处的间隙，而二十面体的下一个有理近似值（其布拉格区域几乎完全匹配带 576 和 2440）指出可以在更低对比度下寻找间隙。

articles.title: Hidden universality in large-deformation soft contact
articles.title_zh: 大变形软接触中隐藏的普遍性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.18581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large-deformation soft contact mediates how biological and robotic systems interact with their environments, underpinning embodied intelligence, wearables, human-machine interactions and tactile sensing. The same coupling between contact area and remaining thickness shapes the response of physical interaction interfaces in wearable sensors and soft robots. Yet predictive theories remain confined to small strains or specific geometries, and a general law for nonlinear soft contact has remained elusive. Here we reveal hidden universality in large-deformation soft-body contact: after normalization by a simple geometric correction, diverse force-displacement responses collapse onto a master curve. By extending the method of dimensionality reduction into the nonlinear regime, the framework yields analytical solutions for contact force and radius. Finite element analyses and experiments across canonical geometries, non-axisymmetric structures and irregular gummy candies validate the scaling law up to 50% compression. These results establish a universal principle for nonlinear soft contact and a mechanics-guided route to wearable devices, tactile systems and soft robotics interactions beyond empirical calibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 大变形软接触调节生物和机器人系统如何与其环境交互，支撑体现智能、可穿戴设备、人机交互和触觉传感。接触面积和剩余厚度之间的相同耦合决定了可穿戴传感器和软机器人中物理交互界面的响应。然而，预测理论仍然局限于小应变或特定的几何形状，并且非线性软接触的一般定律仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了大变形软体接触中隐藏的普遍性：通过简单的几何校正进行归一化后，不同的力-位移响应折叠到主曲线上。通过将降维方法扩展到非线性领域，该框架产生了接触力和半径的解析解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大变形软接触调节生物和机器人系统如何与其环境交互，支撑体现智能、可穿戴设备、人机交互和触觉传感。接触面积和剩余厚度之间的相同耦合决定了可穿戴传感器和软机器人中物理交互界面的响应。然而，预测理论仍然局限于小应变或特定的几何形状，并且非线性软接触的一般定律仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了大变形软体接触中隐藏的普遍性：通过简单的几何校正进行归一化后，不同的力-位移响应折叠到主曲线上。通过将降维方法扩展到非线性领域，该框架产生了接触力和半径的解析解。跨规范几何形状、非轴对称结构和不规则软糖的有限元分析和实验验证了高达 50% 压缩的缩放定律。这些结果建立了非线性软接触的通用原理，以及超越经验校准的可穿戴设备、触觉系统和软机器人交互的力学引导途径。

articles.title: Intrinsic spin accumulation in the magnetic spin Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 磁自旋霍尔效应中的本征自旋累积
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.24719v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The magnetic spin Hall effect is a time-reversal-odd phenomenon in which spin current is induced by the charge current. In the presence of a spin-orbit coupling and/or noncolinear magnetism, however, spin current is not uniquely defined. Instead, we study an intrinsic response of spin to an electric field gradient that describes the spin accumulation at the boundaries of magnetic systems. We derive a generic formula expressed by Bloch wave functions and apply it to a minimal model for representative altermagnets, RuO₂ and MnF₂. Our results show that the intrinsic spin accumulation can be nonzero in magnetic insulators in sharp contrast to the magnetic spin Hall conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁自旋霍尔效应是一种时间反转奇数现象，其中充电电流感应自旋电流。然而，在存在自旋轨道耦合和/或非共线磁性的情况下，自旋流并不是唯一定义的。相反，我们研究自旋对电场梯度的固有响应，该电场梯度描述了磁系统边界处的自旋累积。我们推导了一个由布洛赫波函数表示的通用公式，并将其应用于代表性交流磁体 RuO2 和 MnF2 的最小模型。我们的结果表明，磁绝缘体中的本征自旋累积可以是非零的，与磁自旋霍尔电导率形成鲜明对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁自旋霍尔效应是一种时间反转奇数现象，其中充电电流感应自旋电流。然而，在存在自旋轨道耦合和/或非共线磁性的情况下，自旋流并不是唯一定义的。相反，我们研究自旋对电场梯度的固有响应，该电场梯度描述了磁系统边界处的自旋累积。我们推导了一个由布洛赫波函数表示的通用公式，并将其应用于代表性交流磁体 RuO2 和 MnF2 的最小模型。我们的结果表明，磁绝缘体中的本征自旋累积可以是非零的，与磁自旋霍尔电导率形成鲜明对比。

articles.title: Design of Chalcopyrite-Inspired Tellurides for Solar Cells: A First-Principles and Coupled FDTD-CHARGE Device Study
articles.title_zh: 用于太阳能电池的黄铜矿启发碲化物设计：第一原理和耦合 FDTD-CHARGE 器件研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.18078v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The defect-chalcopyrite tellurides XGa₂Te₄ (X = Cd, Zn) are evaluated as photovoltaic absorbers by combining first-principles calculations with coupled optical and electrical device simulations. Density functional theory (PBEsol) yields tetragonal Ibar4 structures with negative formation energies and phonon spectra free of imaginary modes. Both compounds have direct band gaps at Γ of 1.046 and 1.032 eV (PBEsol) and 2.21 and 1.895 eV (HSE06), with absorption coefficients above 10⁵ cm⁻¹ in the visible. Wannier-Mott estimates give exciton binding energies of 18.85 and 26.81 meV, comparable to k_BT at 300 K, and Bohr radii of 3.43 and 2.30 nm. Constant-relaxation-time Boltzmann transport gives Seebeck coefficients up to ~255 μV K⁻¹ near 350-400 K. Mulliken-electronegativity estimates place both band edges outside the water redox potentials at pH 0, with hydrogen-evolution driving forces of 0.83 and 0.60 eV but oxygen-evolution margins of only 0.16 and 0.07 eV. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) optical simulations coupled to drift-diffusion (CHARGE) electrical simulations of FTO/IGZO/XGa₂Te₄/CuAlO₂/Pt cells reveal a small conduction-band spike at the front junction (+0.15 and +0.33 eV), reflection losses governed by interference in the front oxide stack, electron collection confined to ~0.5 μm from the junction, and a fill-factor loss in the CdGa₂Te₄ device caused by the CuAlO₂ hole contact. Because the imported optical constants retain the PBEsol absorption edge, the simulated photocurrents exceed the detailed-balance limit; absolute efficiencies are therefore treated as upper bounds, whereas the identified loss mechanisms and design trends are robust. These results identify CdGa₂Te₄ and ZnGa₂Te₄ as candidate thin-film absorbers and define the contact engineering required to exploit them.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过将第一原理计算与耦合光学和电学器件模拟相结合，对缺陷黄铜矿碲化物 XGa2Te4 (X = Cd, Zn) 作为光伏吸收剂进行了评估。密度泛函理论 (PBEsol) 产生具有负形成能和无虚模的声子谱的四方 Ibar4 结构。两种化合物的直接带隙分别为 1.046 和 1.032 eV (PBEsol) 以及 2.21 和 1.895 eV (HSE06)，可见光吸收系数高于 10⁵ cm-1。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过将第一原理计算与耦合光学和电学器件模拟相结合，对缺陷黄铜矿碲化物 XGa2Te4 (X = Cd, Zn) 作为光伏吸收剂进行了评估。密度泛函理论 (PBEsol) 产生具有负形成能和无虚模的声子谱的四方 Ibar4 结构。两种化合物的直接带隙分别为 1.046 和 1.032 eV (PBEsol) 以及 2.21 和 1.895 eV (HSE06)，可见光吸收系数高于 10⁵ cm-1。 Wannier-Mott 估计给出的激子结合能分别为 18.85 和 26.81 meV，与 300 K 时的 k_BT 相当，玻尔半径为 3.43 和 2.30 nm。恒定弛豫时间玻尔兹曼输运使塞贝克系数在 350-400 K 附近达到约 255 μV K⁻1。马利肯电负性估计将两个能带边缘置于 pH 0 时的水氧化还原电位之外，析氢驱动力为 0.83 和 0.60 eV，但析氧裕度仅为 0.16 和 0.07 eV。 FTO/IGZO/XGa2Te₄/CuAlO2/Pt 电池的时域有限差分 (FDTD) 光学模拟与漂移扩散 (CHARGE) 电学模拟相结合，揭示了前结处的小导带尖峰（+0.15 和 +0.33 eV）、反射损耗受前氧化物堆中干扰的影响、电子收集限制在距结约 0.5 μm 的范围内，以及前结处的填充因子损失由 CuAlO2 孔接触引起的 CdGa2Te4 器件。由于导入的光学常数保留了PBEsol吸收边，模拟的光电流超出了详细平衡极限；因此，绝对效率被视为上限，而已确定的损失机制和设计趋势是稳健的。这些结果将 CdGa2Te4 和 ZnGa2Te4 确定为候选薄膜吸收体，并定义了利用它们所需的接触工程。

articles.title: Nanoindentation induced plasticity in equiatomic MoTaW alloys by experimentally guided machine learning molecular dynamics simulations
articles.title_zh: 通过实验引导的机器学习分子动力学模拟，纳米压痕诱导等原子 MoTaW 合金的塑性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06846v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Refractory complex concentrated alloys (RCCA) exhibit exceptional strength and thermal stability, yet their plastic deformation mechanisms under complex contact loading remain insufficiently understood. Here, the nanoindentation response of an equiatomic MoTaW alloy is investigated through a combined experimental and atomistically resolved modeling approach. Spherical nanoindentation experiments are coupled with large scale molecular dynamics simulations employing a tabulated low dimensional Gaussian Approximation Potential (tabGAP), enabling near DFT accuracy. A physics based similarity criterion, implemented via PCA of load-displacement curves, is used to identify mechanically representative experimental responses for quantitative comparison with simulations. Indentation stress-strain curves are constructed yielding excellent agreement in the elastic regime between experiment and simulation, with reduced Young's moduli of approximately 270 GPa. Generalized stacking fault energy calculations reveal elevated unstable stacking- and twinning-fault energies in MoTaW relative to pure refractory elements, indicating suppressed localized shear and a preference for dislocation-mediated plasticity. Atomistic analyses demonstrate a strong crystallographic dependence of plastic deformation, with symmetric 110<111> slip activation and four-fold rosette pile-ups for the [001] orientation, and anisotropic slip, strain localization, and enhanced junction formation for [011]. Local entropy and polyhedral template matching analyses further elucidate dislocation network evolution and deformation-induced local structural transformations. Overall, this study establishes a direct mechanistic link between fault energetics, orientation-dependent dislocation activity, and experimentally observed nanoindentation behavior in RCCA.
articles.abstract_zh: 难熔复合浓缩合金（RCCA）表现出卓越的强度和热稳定性，但其在复杂接触载荷下的塑性变形机制仍不清楚。在这里，通过实验和原子解析相结合的建模方法研究了等原子 MoTaW 合金的纳米压痕响应。球形纳米压痕实验与采用表格低维高斯近似势 (tabGAP) 的大规模分子动力学模拟相结合，可实现接近 DFT 的精度。通过载荷-位移曲线的主成分分析 (PCA) 实现的基于物理的相似性准则用于识别机械代表性的实验响应，以便与模拟进行定量比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 难熔复合浓缩合金（RCCA）表现出卓越的强度和热稳定性，但其在复杂接触载荷下的塑性变形机制仍不清楚。在这里，通过实验和原子解析相结合的建模方法研究了等原子 MoTaW 合金的纳米压痕响应。球形纳米压痕实验与采用表格低维高斯近似势 (tabGAP) 的大规模分子动力学模拟相结合，可实现接近 DFT 的精度。通过载荷-位移曲线的主成分分析 (PCA) 实现的基于物理的相似性准则用于识别机械代表性的实验响应，以便与模拟进行定量比较。构建的压痕应力-应变曲线在实验和模拟之间的弹性状态中产生了极好的一致性，杨氏模量降低了约 270 GPa。广义堆垛层错能计算表明，MoTaW 中的不稳定堆垛层错能和孪生层错能相对于纯难熔元素较高，表明局部剪切受到抑制，并且倾向于位错介导的塑性。原子分析表明塑性变形具有很强的晶体学依赖性，[001] 取向具有对称 110 滑移激活和四重玫瑰花堆积，[011] 取向具有各向异性滑移、应变局部化和增强的结形成。局部熵和多面体模板匹配分析进一步阐明位错网络演化和变形引起的局部结构转变。总体而言，这项研究在 RCCA 中的断层能量学、方向相关位错活动和实验观察到的纳米压痕行为之间建立了直接的机制联系。

articles.title: Floquet Engineering of a Quasiequilibrium Superradiant Phase Transition in Landau Polaritons
articles.title_zh: 朗道极化子中准平衡超辐射相变的 Floquet 工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08635v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superradiant phase transitions (SRPTs), characterized by photon condensation and macroscopic matter polarization, are forbidden in equilibrium for homogeneous fields by no-go theorems. Here, we show that Floquet driving can circumvent this constraint in a Landau polariton system consisting of a two-dimensional electron gas coupled to a terahertz cavity in a DC magnetic field. An off-resonant AC magnetic field modulates the cyclotron frequency and light--matter coupling strength while leaving the diamagnetic term unchanged, generating an additional DC coupling contribution. This drives the system across a critical threshold into a superradiant phase, characterized by photon condensation and Landau-level polarization in the ground state of the Floquet Hamiltonian. This quasiequilibrium approach offers a route to SRPTs distinct from driven-dissipative schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 超辐射相变（SRPT）以光子凝聚和宏观物质极化为特征，根据 no-go 定理，在均匀场的平衡中是被禁止的。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet 驱动可以在由耦合到直流磁场中太赫兹腔的二维电子气组成的朗道极化子系统中规避这一限制。非共振交流磁场调制回旋加速器频率和光-物质耦合强度，同时保持抗磁项不变，产生额外的直流耦合贡献。这驱动系统跨过临界阈值进入超辐射阶段，其特征是弗洛奎哈密顿量基态下的光子凝聚和朗道级偏振。这种准平衡方法提供了一条不同于驱动耗散方案的 SRPT 途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超辐射相变（SRPT）以光子凝聚和宏观物质极化为特征，根据 no-go 定理，在均匀场的平衡中是被禁止的。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet 驱动可以在由耦合到直流磁场中太赫兹腔的二维电子气组成的朗道极化子系统中规避这一限制。非共振交流磁场调制回旋加速器频率和光-物质耦合强度，同时保持抗磁项不变，产生额外的直流耦合贡献。这驱动系统跨过临界阈值进入超辐射阶段，其特征是弗洛奎哈密顿量基态下的光子凝聚和朗道级偏振。这种准平衡方法提供了一条不同于驱动耗散方案的 SRPT 途径。

articles.title: A Generalized Coherent State Framework for Many-Body Density of States
articles.title_zh: 国家多体密度的广义相干国家框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14367v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a general framework to calculate the many-body density of states (DOS) of isolated and interacting quantum systems. Based on the generalized coherent state formalism and the Simon-Lieb bounds for a quantum partition function, our method provides a general method of calculation for the DOS in high-dimensional irreducible sectors. This framework further provides rigorous bounds for the ground state energy in each sector and enables the calculation of microcanonical observables across the entire spectrum. Using the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick (LMG) model as a test bed, we validate our framework by successfully identifying quantum phase transitions (QPTs) and excited-state quantum phase transitions (ESQPTs) across spin sectors. We then study the ferromagnetic transverse field Ising chain with power law interactions, where the hamiltonian ceases to be block diagonal in irreducible sectors. We generalize our coherent states to explicitly track the permutation symmetry group. For the strongly long range interacting case, we demonstrate that the DOS in highest-spin sectors is qualitatively identical to that of LMG-type Hamiltonians in the thermodynamic limit. Unlike existing model-specific numerical or analytical techniques, our formalism relies on general underlying symmetries, making it broadly applicable. It establishes a versatile and computationally efficient bridge between algebraic structure and many-body thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个通用框架来计算孤立和相互作用的量子系统的多体态密度（DOS）。基于广义相干态形式主义和量子配分函数的 Simon-Lieb 界，我们的方法提供了高维不可约扇区中 DOS 的通用计算方法。该框架进一步为每个扇区的基态能量提供了严格的界限，并能够计算整个光谱中的微正则可观测值。使用 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick (LMG) 模型作为测试台，我们通过成功识别自旋扇区的量子相变 (QPT) 和激发态量子相变 (ESQPT) 来验证我们的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个通用框架来计算孤立和相互作用的量子系统的多体态密度（DOS）。基于广义相干态形式主义和量子配分函数的 Simon-Lieb 界，我们的方法提供了高维不可约扇区中 DOS 的通用计算方法。该框架进一步为每个扇区的基态能量提供了严格的界限，并能够计算整个光谱中的微正则可观测值。使用 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick (LMG) 模型作为测试台，我们通过成功识别自旋扇区的量子相变 (QPT) 和激发态量子相变 (ESQPT) 来验证我们的框架。然后，我们研究具有幂律相互作用的铁磁横向场伊辛链，其中哈密顿量不再是不可约扇区中的块对角线。我们概括我们的相干态以明确地跟踪排列对称群。对于强长程相互作用的情况，我们证明了最高自旋扇区中的 DOS 在质量上与热力学极限下的 LMG 型哈密顿量相同。与现有的特定于模型的数值或分析技术不同，我们的形式主义依赖于一般的基础对称性，使其具有广泛的适用性。它在代数结构和多体热力学之间建立了一座通用且计算高效的桥梁。

articles.title: Quantum integrable matrix models of spinor Bose gases in one spatial dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维旋量玻色气体的量子可积矩阵模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.27885v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Degenerate spinor Bose gases with repulsive density-density interaction and anti-ferromagnetic spin-spin coupling in one spatial dimension are shown to be described by a quantum integrable matrix extension of the nonlinear Schrödinger model, whose fundamental fields are described by an m,×,n matrix of bosonic field operators. The eigenstates of this model are constructed for arbitrarily sized matrix field operators by means of algebraic Bethe-ansatz techniques, and the corresponding Bethe equations governing the spectra of conserved quantities are derived. The approach thus generalizes previously chosen techniques to account for arbitrary spin multiplets and their spin-spin interaction. Focusing on the specific case of the 2×2 model, which is shown to correspond to a spin-1 Bose gas, a set of integral equations is derived, which describe its equilibrium thermodynamic properties. From these, the ground state phase diagram is computed both, numerically and analytically in the parameter plane spanned by the chemical potential and an external magnetic field. Furthermore, we establish a sufficient condition for interacting bosons in one dimension to obey the Pauli exclusion principle. In particular, we show that in the presence of paired bound states, no two quasiparticle rapidities can coincide, provided that the Lieb parameter satisfies γ>4/3.
articles.abstract_zh: 在一个空间维度上具有排斥性密度-密度相互作用和反铁磁自旋-自旋耦合的简并自旋玻色气体被证明是由非线性薛定谔模型的量子可积矩阵扩展来描述的，其基本场由玻色子场算子的 m,×,n 矩阵来描述。该模型的本征态是通过代数Bethe-ansatz技术为任意大小的矩阵场算子构造的，并导出了相应的控制守恒量谱的Bethe方程。因此，该方法概括了先前选择的技术来解释任意自旋多重态及其自旋-自旋相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在一个空间维度上具有排斥性密度-密度相互作用和反铁磁自旋-自旋耦合的简并自旋玻色气体被证明是由非线性薛定谔模型的量子可积矩阵扩展来描述的，其基本场由玻色子场算子的 m,×,n 矩阵来描述。该模型的本征态是通过代数Bethe-ansatz技术为任意大小的矩阵场算子构造的，并导出了相应的控制守恒量谱的Bethe方程。因此，该方法概括了先前选择的技术来解释任意自旋多重态及其自旋-自旋相互作用。着眼于 2×2 模型的具体情况，该模型对应于自旋 1 玻色气体，导出了一组积分方程，描述了其平衡热力学性质。由此，在由化学势和外部磁场跨越的参数平面中以数值和解析方式计算基态相图。此外，我们建立了在一维相互作用的玻色子遵守泡利不相容原理的充分条件。特别是，我们表明，在存在成对束缚态的情况下，只要利布参数满足 γ>4/3，两个准粒子速度就不可能重合。

articles.title: Frustrated neurons: Energy landscapes and relaxation dynamics in repulsive phase oscillators
articles.title_zh: 受挫的神经元：排斥相振荡器中的能量景观和松弛动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02512v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Geometrical frustration, a central paradigm in condensed matter physics, provides a unifying language for systems in which locally preferred interactions cannot be made globally compatible. Here, we use this language to formulate a minimal theory of frustrated neural timing, mapping repulsively coupled rhythmic units onto antiferromagnetic XY models. In this formulation, the condensed-matter concepts of local constraints, degenerate ground-state manifolds, metastability, and quench dynamics are used to guide our analysis of structured neural phase dynamics. This paper analyzes a hierarchy of geometries, beginning with a triangle as the minimal frustrated motif with two chiral 120deg timing states, then a tetrahedron whose reduced ground-state manifold consists of intersecting continuous branches associated with antipodal pairings, and finally a kagome lattice on which local constraints define a constrained three-coloring manifold. The kagome lattice reveals that zero-temperature relaxation suppresses global synchrony but typically selects low-energy metastable torque-balanced states rather than exact ground states. We then show how the phase theory can be carried back towards biophysical neural models by treating the minimal framework as an effective-interaction target, where geometrical timing frustration arises from preferred phase lags that become incompatible around closed motifs. Our results suggest that weak global coherence in neural systems doesn't necessarily signal disordered activity, but can instead reflect structured local timing order within a frustrated dynamical landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 几何挫败是凝聚态物理学的一个中心范式，它为系统提供了一种统一的语言，在这些系统中，局部首选的相互作用无法实现全局兼容。在这里，我们使用这种语言来制定受挫神经时序的最小理论，将排斥耦合的节律单元映射到反铁磁 XY 模型上。在这个公式中，局部约束、简并基态流形、亚稳态和失超动力学的凝聚态概念被用来指导我们对结构化神经相动力学的分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何挫败是凝聚态物理学的一个中心范式，它为系统提供了一种统一的语言，在这些系统中，局部首选的相互作用无法实现全局兼容。在这里，我们使用这种语言来制定受挫神经时序的最小理论，将排斥耦合的节律单元映射到反铁磁 XY 模型上。在这个公式中，局部约束、简并基态流形、亚稳态和失超动力学的凝聚态概念被用来指导我们对结构化神经相动力学的分析。本文分析了几何结构的层次结构，首先是一个具有两个手性 120 度定时状态的最小受挫图案的三角形，然后是一个四面体，其简化基态流形由与对映体配对相关的相交连续分支组成，最后是一个 kagome 晶格，在该晶格上局部约束定义了受约束的三色流形。 kagome 晶格揭示了零温度弛豫抑制了全局同步，但通常选择低能量亚稳态扭矩平衡态而不是精确的基态。然后，我们展示了如何通过将最小框架视为有效交互目标，将相位理论带回生物物理神经模型，其中几何定时挫败是由于首选相位滞后而产生的，而这些相位滞后在封闭主题周围变得不兼容。我们的结果表明，神经系统中弱的全局一致性并不一定意味着无序的活动，而是可以反映受挫的动态景观中结构化的局部时序顺序。

articles.title: Endowing phase-field fracture models with custom strength criteria
articles.title_zh: 赋予相场断裂模型自定义强度标准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06169v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: By now, several approaches have been proposed to endow phase-field fracture models with the ability to describe crack nucleation under multiaxial stress states. These include techniques for splitting the free energy, direct modifications of the phase-field driving or resisting forces, and the introduction of additional internal variables, such as plastic strains or other nonlinear strains. In this paper, we propose a fundamentally different strategy for incorporating arbitrary elastic domains into phase-field fracture models, formulated within the energetic framework of generalized standard materials. The proposed approach relies on letting the dissipation potential depend on the current state of the material. In this way, the elastic degradation and the strength criterion remain two distinct and independently controllable aspects of the material response, while the governing equations directly descend from a local stability condition and energy balance. Simple yet representative models are presented and thoroughly discussed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology. The resulting evolution of the elastic domain is investigated in both strain and stress spaces under proportional and non-proportional loading paths, with the latter highlighting the path dependence of the dissipated work. Moreover, numerical simulations demonstrate a range of crack nucleation processes under multiaxial loading conditions for various analytical strength surfaces. The present work paves the way for future developments and applications in several directions, including crack propagation studies and dedicated numerical solution strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 到目前为止，已经提出了几种方法来赋予相场断裂模型描述多轴应力状态下裂纹形核的能力。其中包括分裂自由能的技术、相场驱动或阻力的直接修改以及引入额外的内部变量，例如塑性应变或其他非线性应变。在本文中，我们提出了一种根本不同的策略，将任意弹性域纳入相场断裂模型中，并在广义标准材料的能量框架内制定。所提出的方法依赖于让耗散势取决于材料的当前状态。这样，弹性退化和强度准则仍然是材料响应的两个不同且独立可控的方面，而控制方程直接从局部稳定性条件和能量平衡推导出来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 到目前为止，已经提出了几种方法来赋予相场断裂模型描述多轴应力状态下裂纹形核的能力。其中包括分裂自由能的技术、相场驱动或阻力的直接修改以及引入额外的内部变量，例如塑性应变或其他非线性应变。在本文中，我们提出了一种根本不同的策略，将任意弹性域纳入相场断裂模型中，并在广义标准材料的能量框架内制定。所提出的方法依赖于让耗散势取决于材料的当前状态。这样，弹性退化和强度准则仍然是材料响应的两个不同且独立可控的方面，而控制方程直接从局部稳定性条件和能量平衡推导出来。提出了简单但具有代表性的模型并进行了深入讨论，以证明所提出方法的有效性。在比例和非比例加载路径下的应变和应力空间中研究了弹性域的演化，后者强调了耗散功的路径依赖性。此外，数值模拟演示了各种分析强度表面在多轴加载条件下的一系列裂纹成核过程。目前的工作为未来多个方向的发展和应用铺平了道路，包括裂纹扩展研究和专用数值求解策略。

articles.title: Graphene Josephson diodes from asymmetric disorder
articles.title_zh: 不对称紊乱的石墨烯约瑟夫森二极管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17673v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Josephson diodes are non-reciprocal superconducting devices characterized by different switching currents depending on the current flow direction. They recently attracted considerable theoretical and experimental attention, in view of their possible application as rectifying elements in the field of superconducting electronics, and as probes to investigate symmetry breaking mechanisms in mesoscopic systems. In this work, we show that graphene Josephson junctions provide rectification of supercurrent with an efficiency exceeding 20%. The effect appears applying a mT out-of-plane magnetic field and is enhanced close to the nodes of the Fraunhofer interference pattern. Our findings are consistent with a theoretical model that considers long-range scattering potentials in the junction as the symmetry-breaking mechanism, which yields supercurrent rectification in highly transparent junctions. While graphene stands out as an ultra-clean transmission medium, our work shows that unavoidable residual disorder is sufficient to promote this effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森二极管是不可逆超导器件，其特征在于根据电流流动方向而具有不同的开关电流。鉴于它们可能作为超导电子学领域的整流元件以及作为研究介观系统中对称破缺机制的探针，它们最近引起了相当多的理论和实验关注。在这项工作中，我们证明石墨烯约瑟夫森结可以提供超电流整流，效率超过 20%。该效应在施加 mT 面外磁场时出现，并且在靠近弗劳恩霍夫干涉图样的节点处增强。我们的研究结果与理论模型一致，该模型将结中的长程散射电势视为对称破缺机制，从而在高度透明的结中产生超电流整流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 约瑟夫森二极管是不可逆超导器件，其特征在于根据电流流动方向而具有不同的开关电流。鉴于它们可能作为超导电子学领域的整流元件以及作为研究介观系统中对称破缺机制的探针，它们最近引起了相当多的理论和实验关注。在这项工作中，我们证明石墨烯约瑟夫森结可以提供超电流整流，效率超过 20%。该效应在施加 mT 面外磁场时出现，并且在靠近弗劳恩霍夫干涉图样的节点处增强。我们的研究结果与理论模型一致，该模型将结中的长程散射电势视为对称破缺机制，从而在高度透明的结中产生超电流整流。虽然石墨烯是一种超洁净的传输介质，但我们的工作表明，不可避免的残余无序足以促进这种效应。

articles.title: Stacking-Directed Polarization and Excitonic Engineering in MoS₂/MoSe₂ van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: MoS2/MoSe2 范德华异质结构中的堆叠定向极化和激子工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22014v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The stacking-dependent polarization and excitonic response of MoS₂/MoSe₂ heterostructures were investigated using GW+BSE many-body perturbation theory. While homobilayer MoS₂ exhibited a switchable interlayer dipole driven by registry-induced symmetry breaking, the MoS₂/MoSe₂ hetero-interface remained pinned by the intrinsic chemical potential mismatch between sulfur and selenium. In 2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂ trilayers, the stacking sequence enabled a deterministic control of photogenerated electrons between the central and bottom MoS₂ layers, governed by internal electric fields and quasiparticle band-edge shifts of 60--70~meV. Our calculations predicted a 36~meV interlayer excitonic shift, in remarkable agreement with recent experiments. These results elucidate the microscopic link between atomic registry and many-body interactions, establishing transition metal dichalcogenide trilayers as a potential platform for sliding ferroelectricity and programmable optoelectronic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用GW+BSE多体微扰理论研究了MoS₂/MoSe₂异质结构的堆叠依赖性极化和激子响应。虽然同层MoS₂表现出由配向诱导的对称性破缺驱动的可切换层间偶极矩，但MoS₂/MoSe₂异质界面仍因硫和硒之间固有的化学势不匹配而被钉扎。在2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂三层结构中，堆叠顺序实现了对中间层和底层MoS₂层之间光生电子的确定性控制，这种控制受内部电场和60--70~meV的准粒子带边位移的支配。我们的计算预测了36~meV的层间激子位移，与最近的实验结果非常吻合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用GW+BSE多体微扰理论研究了MoS₂/MoSe₂异质结构的堆叠依赖性极化和激子响应。虽然同层MoS₂表现出由配向诱导的对称性破缺驱动的可切换层间偶极矩，但MoS₂/MoSe₂异质界面仍因硫和硒之间固有的化学势不匹配而被钉扎。在2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂三层结构中，堆叠顺序实现了对中间层和底层MoS₂层之间光生电子的确定性控制，这种控制受内部电场和60--70~meV的准粒子带边位移的支配。我们的计算预测了36~meV的层间激子位移，与最近的实验结果非常吻合。这些结果阐明了原子配向与多体相互作用之间的微观联系，确立了过渡金属二硫属化物三层结构作为滑动铁电性和可编程光电功能潜在平台的地位。

articles.title: Magnetoelectric flat band induced by a sqrt3×sqrt3 charge density wave in monolayer CrSe₂
articles.title_zh: 由单层CrSe₂中的sqrt3×sqrt3电荷密度波诱导的磁电平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24494v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the electronic and magnetic properties of the polar sqrt3×sqrt3 charge-density-wave (CDW) phase of CrSe₂ using ab initio calculations. The CDW introduces a polar distortion out of the van der Waals plane that couples to the spin-polarized Cr d states resulting in a remarkably flat electronic band exactly at the Fermi level. We provide a microscopic understanding of the origin of the flat band by analyzing in detail the structural reconstruction, the effects of orbital hybridization, crystal-field splittings, spin-orbit coupling and electronic correlations. Our calculations show that due to the polar nature of the CDW distortion, an electric field can act as an external switch to induce the CDW phase, providing a way to manipulate strong correlations in the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用从头计算研究了 CrSe2 极性 sqrt3×sqrt3 电荷密度波 (CDW) 相的电子和磁性。 CDW 在范德华平面之外引入了极性畸变，该畸变耦合到自旋极化的 Cr d 态，从而在费米能级处产生非常平坦的电子能带。我们通过详细分析结构重建、轨道杂化的影响、晶体场分裂、自旋轨道耦合和电子相关性，提供了对平带起源的微观理解。我们的计算表明，由于 CDW 失真的极性性质，电场可以充当外部开关来诱发 CDW 相位，从而提供了一种操纵系统中强相关性的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用从头计算研究了 CrSe2 极性 sqrt3×sqrt3 电荷密度波 (CDW) 相的电子和磁性。 CDW 在范德华平面之外引入了极性畸变，该畸变耦合到自旋极化的 Cr d 态，从而在费米能级处产生非常平坦的电子能带。我们通过详细分析结构重建、轨道杂化的影响、晶体场分裂、自旋轨道耦合和电子相关性，提供了对平带起源的微观理解。我们的计算表明，由于 CDW 失真的极性性质，电场可以充当外部开关来诱发 CDW 相位，从而提供了一种操纵系统中强相关性的方法。

articles.title: Inner sublattice competition: a minimal mechanism for reentrant localizations in Aubry-André lattice
articles.title_zh: 内亚晶格竞争：Aubry-André 晶格中可重入定位的最小机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct a double mosaic Aubry-André (DMAA) model with two independent quasiperiodic potentials assigned to corresponding even and odd sublattices of the AA lattice, and show that the competition between them gives rise to multiple localization-delocalization transitions under single-parameter tuning. Such reentrant localizations are verified by comprehensive numerical characterizations including the inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, fractal dimension, and real-space wavefunction distributions. Simulations based on a continuous polariton model yield consistent results, confirming the experimental feasibility of the predicted phenomena. This inner sublattice competition mechanism works in a minimal way for reentrant localizations without additional ingredients or dynamical modifications such as long-range hopping, mixed quasiperiodic and random disorder, or non-Hermitian gain and loss, offering a concise route to engineer reentrant localization based on the canonical AA lattice family.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个双马赛克 Aubry-André (DMAA) 模型，将两个独立的准周期势分配给 AA 晶格的相应偶数和奇数子晶格，并表明它们之间的竞争在单参数调整下引起了多个局域-离域转变。这种重入定位通过全面的数值表征进行了验证，包括逆参与比、归一化参与比、分形维数和实空间波函数分布。基于连续极化子模型的模拟产生了一致的结果，证实了预测现象的实验可行性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一个双马赛克 Aubry-André (DMAA) 模型，将两个独立的准周期势分配给 AA 晶格的相应偶数和奇数子晶格，并表明它们之间的竞争在单参数调整下引起了多个局域-离域转变。这种重入定位通过全面的数值表征进行了验证，包括逆参与比、归一化参与比、分形维数和实空间波函数分布。基于连续极化子模型的模拟产生了一致的结果，证实了预测现象的实验可行性。这种内部子晶格竞争机制以最小的方式实现可重入定位，无需额外的成分或动态修改，例如长程跳跃、混合准周期和随机无序或非厄米增益和损失，为基于规范 AA 晶格族的工程可重入定位提供了一条简洁的途径。

articles.title: Short-range spin correlations and temperature-driven interlayer exchange crossover in the van der Waals magnet CrCl₃
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体CrCl₃中的短程自旋关联和温度驱动的层间交换跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09421v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the evolution of spin correlations and the nature of the multi-stage magnetic transition in the quasi-two-dimensional easy-plane van der Waals magnet rm CrCl₃. By combining broadband magnetic resonance spectroscopy and DC SQUID magnetometry on mechanically exfoliated microflakes with non-local dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) calculations, we analyze both long- and short range magnetic order in CrCl₃. Experimentally, SQUID and magnetic resonance measurements confirm the presence of the crossover to a spin polarized phase with the subsequent transition into an antiferromagnetic ground state upon cooling, but show robust short-range correlations at temperatures far above the magnetic ordering temperatures. Theoretically, we show the existence of highly stable local magnetic moments at room temperature, with a giant room temperature lifetime τ of 130--300 ps due to a wide Mott bandgap. Below room temperature, a rapid growth of the in-plane correlation length ξ signals the formation of strong short range magnetic order consistent with the experimental observations. We also obtain a temperature-driven crossover of the interlayer exchange interaction, which changes from positive (ferromagnetic) at high temperatures to negative (antiferromagnetic) in the low-temperature ordered phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了准二维易平面范德华磁体 rm CrCl₃ 中自旋关联的演化和多级磁转变的性质。通过将机械剥离微米薄片上的宽带磁共振光谱和 DC SQUID 磁力测量与非局域动态平均场理论 (DFT+DMFT) 计算相结合，我们分析了 CrCl₃ 中的长程和短程磁序。实验上，SQUID和磁共振测量证实了与自旋极化相的交叉的存在，随后在冷却时转变为反铁磁基态，但在远高于磁有序温度的温度下显示出强大的短程相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了准二维易平面范德华磁体 rm CrCl₃ 中自旋关联的演化和多级磁转变的性质。通过将机械剥离微米薄片上的宽带磁共振光谱和 DC SQUID 磁力测量与非局域动态平均场理论 (DFT+DMFT) 计算相结合，我们分析了 CrCl₃ 中的长程和短程磁序。实验上，SQUID和磁共振测量证实了与自旋极化相的交叉的存在，随后在冷却时转变为反铁磁基态，但在远高于磁有序温度的温度下显示出强大的短程相关性。理论上，我们证明了室温下高度稳定的局部磁矩的存在，由于莫特带隙较宽，室温寿命 τ 为 130--300 ps。在室温以下，面内相关长度 xi 的快速增长表明与实验观察结果一致的强短程磁序的形成。我们还获得了温度驱动的层间交换相互作用的交叉，其从高温下的正（铁磁）变化到低温有序相中的负（反铁磁）。

articles.title: Local magnetic correlations and light-sensitive centers in the Cr2AlC MAX phase
articles.title_zh: Cr2AlC MAX相中的局部磁关联和光敏中心
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15110v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cr2AlC MAX phase is synthesized by high-pressure solid-state annealing and investigated as a candidate platform for optically responsive magnetism. Structural characterization confirms the formation of the Cr2AlC phase, while magnetic and optical-magnetic properties are examined by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) magnetometry, electron spin resonance (ESR), and first principles calculations. SQUID magnetometry identifies Cr 2AlC as a weak, field-linear metallic paramagnet dominated by Pauli-like susceptibility of itinerant Cr-derived states. Its non-monotonic temperature dependence is described by an additional contribution from antiferromagnetically coupled Cr-Cr dimers, whereas the low-temperature Curie-like upturn originates from only a trace population of localized Cr centers. Under red-light illumination, SQUID magnetometry does not reveal an intrinsic macroscopic optomagnetic response. In contrast, ESR at 4 K shows a reversible light-induced reduction of a local magnetic signal, but the optically modified spin population corresponds only to several tens of ppm of the Cr sublattice. Ab initio Bethe-Salpeter equation (ai-BSE) calculations combined with the maximally localized Wannier function analysis suggest that optical excitation can redistribute spin polarization between neighboring Cr sites with the opposite local moments. The combined experiment-theory approach therefore establishes the hierarchy of magnetic contributions in Cr 2AlC and identifies the microscopic origin of its local optical sensitivity.
articles.abstract_zh: Cr2AlC MAX 相通过高压固态退火合成，并作为光响应磁性的候选平台进行研究。结构表征证实了 Cr2AlC 相的形成，同时通过超导量子干涉装置 (SQUID) 磁力测量、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 和第一原理计算来检查磁性和光磁特性。 SQUID 磁力测定法将 Cr 2AlC 识别为弱场线性金属顺磁体，由流动 Cr 衍生态的类泡利磁化率主导。其非单调温度依赖性由反铁磁耦合 Cr-Cr 二聚体的额外贡献来描述，而低温居里样上升仅源自局部 Cr 中心的痕量群体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Cr2AlC MAX 相通过高压固态退火合成，并作为光响应磁性的候选平台进行研究。结构表征证实了 Cr2AlC 相的形成，同时通过超导量子干涉装置 (SQUID) 磁力测量、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 和第一原理计算来检查磁性和光磁特性。 SQUID 磁力测定法将 Cr 2AlC 识别为弱场线性金属顺磁体，由流动 Cr 衍生态的类泡利磁化率主导。其非单调温度依赖性由反铁磁耦合 Cr-Cr 二聚体的额外贡献来描述，而低温居里样上升仅源自局部 Cr 中心的痕量群体。在红光照射下，SQUID 磁力测量没有揭示内在的宏观光磁响应。相比之下，4 K 下的 ESR 显示局部磁信号可逆光致减少，但光学修改的自旋布居仅对应于 Cr 亚晶格的几十 ppm。从头算 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (ai-BSE) 计算结合最大局域 Wannier 函数分析表明，光激发可以重新分布具有相反局部矩的相邻 Cr 位点之间的自旋极化。因此，实验与理论相结合的方法建立了 Cr 2AlC 中磁性贡献的层次结构，并确定了其局部光学灵敏度的微观起源。

articles.title: Electrothermal control of spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ heterostructures
articles.title_zh: Co/Fe₃GaTe₂异质结构中自旋重取向转变的电热控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15844v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrical control of magnetic anisotropy in van der Waals (vdWs) magnets is a key step toward reconfigurable two-dimensional spintronics, yet how a conventional metallic ferromagnet competes with a van der Waals magnet across a direct interface has remained largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate reversible thermal and electrothermal control of a spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ (FGaT) heterostructures. As Joule heating weakens the FGaT anisotropy, the heterostructure switches from an out-of-plane- to an in-plane-dominated state at a reorientation temperature of approximately 311 K, well below the Curie temperature, consistent with an exchange-mediated anisotropy competition between the Co overlayer and FGaT. An electrically driven device shows a closely matching loop evolution within an 80-100 mW power window, reversibly over five measurement cycles, consistent with an electrothermal origin. In a Co-free FGaT device, Kerr microscopy traces the switching to a power-tunable domain nucleation barrier and demonstrates power-thresholded, field-assisted magnetization reversal at a threshold near 15 mW. These results demonstrate electrothermal anisotropy competition as a route to heat-assisted and device-level control of vdWs magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 对范德华（vdWs）磁体中磁各向异性的电控是实现可重构二维自旋电子学的关键一步，但传统金属铁磁体如何通过直接界面与范德华磁体竞争，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文展示了在Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ (FGaT)异质结构中对自旋重取向转变的可逆热控和电热控。随着焦耳热削弱FGaT的各向异性，异质结构在约311 K的重取向温度下从面外主导状态切换到面内主导状态，该温度远低于居里温度，这与Co覆盖层和FGaT之间由交换介导的各向异性竞争相一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对范德华（vdWs）磁体中磁各向异性的电控是实现可重构二维自旋电子学的关键一步，但传统金属铁磁体如何通过直接界面与范德华磁体竞争，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文展示了在Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ (FGaT)异质结构中对自旋重取向转变的可逆热控和电热控。随着焦耳热削弱FGaT的各向异性，异质结构在约311 K的重取向温度下从面外主导状态切换到面内主导状态，该温度远低于居里温度，这与Co覆盖层和FGaT之间由交换介导的各向异性竞争相一致。一种电驱动器件在80-100 mW的功率窗口内显示出高度匹配的磁滞回线演变，在五个测量周期内可逆，与电热起源一致。在无钴FGaT器件中，克尔显微镜跟踪了向功率可调畴成核势垒的转变，并展示了在接近15 mW的阈值下发生的功率阈值场辅助磁化反转。这些结果表明，电热各向异性竞争是实现热辅助和器件级控制范德瓦耳斯磁性的途径。

articles.title: Circular phonon dichroism in d-wave altermagnets
articles.title_zh: d波交错磁体中的圆声子二向色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.21221v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets, a new class of collinear antiferromagnets, exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting and offer compelling advantages for antiferromagnetic spintronics. However, the magnetic order is intrinsically difficult to read out, which hinders practical applications. We propose finite-momentum circular phonon dichroism as a direct probe that distinguishes the two opposite out-of-plane Néel vector configurations in two-dimensional d-wave altermagnets. Combining Onsager reciprocity with C₂z lattice symmetry, we find that the dichroic signal reverses sign when the Néel vector is flipped for the in-plane phonon wave vectors. Moreover, a channel-resolved decomposition identifies the circular phonon dichroism originates from the interband coherent transitions. Representative finite-momentum cuts show pronounced dichroic asymmetric ratio, with |ηCPD|=36%. Our work reveals that the circular-ultrasound absorption can distinguish the two opposite out-of-plane Néel vector configurations of d-wave altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 可变磁体是一类新型的共线反铁磁体，表现出与动量相关的自旋劈裂，为反铁磁自旋电子学提供了引人注目的优势。然而，磁序本质上难以读出，这阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出有限动量圆声子二向色性作为一种直接探测方法，用于区分二维d波交错磁体中两个相反的平面外奈尔矢量构型。将昂萨格倒易关系与C₂z晶格对称性相结合，我们发现，当平面声子波矢量的奈尔矢量翻转时，二向色性信号的符号发生反转。此外，通道分辨分解表明，圆偏振声子二向性源自带间相干跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可变磁体是一类新型的共线反铁磁体，表现出与动量相关的自旋劈裂，为反铁磁自旋电子学提供了引人注目的优势。然而，磁序本质上难以读出，这阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出有限动量圆声子二向色性作为一种直接探测方法，用于区分二维d波交错磁体中两个相反的平面外奈尔矢量构型。将昂萨格倒易关系与C₂z晶格对称性相结合，我们发现，当平面声子波矢量的奈尔矢量翻转时，二向色性信号的符号发生反转。此外，通道分辨分解表明，圆偏振声子二向性源自带间相干跃迁。具有代表性的有限动量截面显示出明显的二向色性不对称比，其中|ηCPD|=36%。我们的工作表明，圆偏振超声吸收可以区分d波交错磁体中两个相反的面外奈尔矢量构型。

articles.title: Uncertainty-quantified J-integral computation for quasicontinuum and finite element methods
articles.title_zh: 用于准连续介质法和有限元法的量化不确定性J积分计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23003v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The J-integral is a fundamental concept in fracture mechanics, quantifying the energy release rate that drives crack propagation. This work presents a rigorous implementation and validation of the J-integral within the multiscale three-dimensional (3D) quasicontinuum (QC3D) method, along with an uncertainty quantification analysis applicable to both QC3D and conventional FE methods. We compute the 3D J-integral under plane-strain assumptions, utilizing continuum mechanics fields (stress and strain energy density) derived from the underlying interatomic potential through the Cauchy--Born rule. Our implementation is comprehensively validated against both linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) theory and the virtual crack extension (VCE) method for three regimes of increasing complexity: small-strain elasticity, and nonlinear deformation without and with atomic relaxation in the region near the crack tip. Excellent agreement is demonstrated in all cases. Further, we introduce a novel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) framework to statistically assess the uncertainty in J-integral results for a given mesh and integration domain in QC3D and conventional FE methods. Our implementation's predictive capability is demonstrated through a QC3D simulation of a three-point bending test on silicon, where the computed critical energy release rate is shown to be in excellent agreement with the Griffith criterion. This work establishes a reliable and efficient framework for evaluating crack driving forces in multiscale fracture simulations with quantified uncertainty, enabling large-scale fracture simulations while resolving atomistic mechanisms at the crack tip.
articles.abstract_zh: J积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。本研究在多尺度三维（3D）准连续体（QC3D）方法中严格实施和验证了J积分，并进行了适用于QC3D和传统有限元（FE）方法的不确定性量化分析。我们利用通过柯西-伯恩规则从潜在的原子间势能导出的连续介质力学场（应力和应变能密度），在平面应变假设下计算 3D J 积分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: J积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。本研究在多尺度三维（3D）准连续体（QC3D）方法中严格实施和验证了J积分，并进行了适用于QC3D和传统有限元（FE）方法的不确定性量化分析。我们利用通过柯西-伯恩规则从潜在的原子间势能导出的连续介质力学场（应力和应变能密度），在平面应变假设下计算 3D J 积分。对于三种复杂度递增的模式（小应变弹性以及裂纹尖端附近区域有或无原子弛豫的非线性变形），我们的实现方法均已根据线性弹性断裂力学（LEFM）理论和虚拟裂纹扩展（VCE）方法进行了全面验证。在所有情况下都表现出极佳的一致性。此外，我们还引入了一种新颖的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）框架，用于在QC3D和传统有限元方法中对给定网格和积分域的J积分结果的不确定性进行统计评估。通过对硅进行三点弯曲试验的QC3D模拟，展示了我们实现的预测能力，其中计算出的临界能量释放率与格里菲斯准则非常吻合。这项工作为在多尺度断裂模拟中评估具有量化不确定性的裂纹驱动力建立了一个可靠且高效的框架，从而能够进行大规模断裂模拟，同时解析裂纹尖端的原子机制。

articles.title: Scanning Gate Microscopy Modulation of Supercurrent in Graphene Josephson Junctions
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯约瑟夫森结中超电流的扫描栅极显微镜调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26689v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graphene Josephson junctions (JJs) represent an excellent platform for quantum technologies, thanks to the combination of high carrier mobility, ballistic transport, and gate-tunable critical currents, preserved even under quantizing magnetic fields. Investigating the spatial distribution of supercurrent flow could be crucial for elucidating transport mechanisms and advancing the engineering of these devices. In this work, we employ a scanning gate microscope to investigate supercurrent transport in hexagonal boron nitride-encapsulated graphene JJs. We study the supercurrent modulation as a function of tip voltage bias and tip-to-sample distance and provide a complete characterization of the tip-induced modulation. Our experimental results are quantitatively consistent with numerical simulations and pave the way toward local mapping and manipulation of gate-tunable superconducting phenomena with unprecedented spatial resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯约瑟夫森结（JJ）是量子技术的绝佳平台，这得益于其结合了高载流子迁移率、弹道输运和栅极可调临界电流，即使在量子化磁场下也能保持这些特性。研究超电流的空间分布对于阐明输运机制和推进这些器件的工程设计可能至关重要。在本文中，我们使用扫描栅极显微镜研究了六方氮化硼封装石墨烯JJ中的超电流输运。我们研究了超电流调制作为探针电压偏压和探针与样品距离的函数，并对探针诱导的调制进行了全面表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯约瑟夫森结（JJ）是量子技术的绝佳平台，这得益于其结合了高载流子迁移率、弹道输运和栅极可调临界电流，即使在量子化磁场下也能保持这些特性。研究超电流的空间分布对于阐明输运机制和推进这些器件的工程设计可能至关重要。在本文中，我们使用扫描栅极显微镜研究了六方氮化硼封装石墨烯JJ中的超电流输运。我们研究了超电流调制作为探针电压偏压和探针与样品距离的函数，并对探针诱导的调制进行了全面表征。我们的实验结果在定量上与数值模拟一致，为以空前空间分辨率对栅极可调超导现象进行局部映射和操纵铺平了道路。

articles.title: Interferometry reveals spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall edges in graphene
articles.title_zh: 干涉测量揭示了石墨烯中的自旋单态分数量子霍尔边缘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01233v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The edge modes of spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall (FQH) phases are manifestations of multicomponent topological order and SU(2) spin symmetry. An archetype is the spin-unpolarized state at ν=2/3, whose edge is expected to host spatially coexisting yet counter-propagating charge and neutral spin modes. Despite efforts, its edge properties, including spin coherence and spin-charge separation, have remained elusive owing to the difficulty of resolving spins in FQH edge transport. Here, we develop a spin-sensitive probe of graphene FQH edges by using a p-n junction to interface a target FQH state with a probe integer quantum Hall (QH) state of opposite polarity. An Aharonov-Bohm (AB) interferometer forms along the interface, when the target and probe edge channels carry the same spin. We identify the spin-unpolarized and polarized edges of the ν=2/3 states at lower and higher magnetic fields, respectively, through spin-dependent interference. A novel multiparticle AB interference between two electrons of opposite spin emerges from spin-charge separation and recombination on the unpolarized edge, featuring a spin swap. Our results establish edge transport as a probe of spin-singlet topological orders, with implications for parafermion platforms in graphene-superconductor hybrids.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋单态分数量子霍尔（FQH）相的边缘模式是多组分拓扑序和SU(2)自旋对称性的表现。一个原型是ν=2/3时的自旋非极化态，其边缘预计将承载在空间上共存但反向传播的电荷模式和中性自旋模式。尽管作出了努力，但由于在FQH边缘输运中难以分辨自旋，其边缘特性（包括自旋相干性和自旋-电荷分离）仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们通过使用p-n结将目标FQH态与相反极性的探测整数量子霍尔（QH）态相连，开发了一种对石墨烯FQH边缘具有自旋敏感性的探测方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋单态分数量子霍尔（FQH）相的边缘模式是多组分拓扑序和SU(2)自旋对称性的表现。一个原型是ν=2/3时的自旋非极化态，其边缘预计将承载在空间上共存但反向传播的电荷模式和中性自旋模式。尽管作出了努力，但由于在FQH边缘输运中难以分辨自旋，其边缘特性（包括自旋相干性和自旋-电荷分离）仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们通过使用p-n结将目标FQH态与相反极性的探测整数量子霍尔（QH）态相连，开发了一种对石墨烯FQH边缘具有自旋敏感性的探测方法。当目标和探测边缘通道具有相同的自旋时，沿界面形成一个阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（AB）干涉仪。我们通过自旋相关的干涉，分别在较低和较高磁场下识别出ν=2/3态的自旋非极化和极化边缘。在非极化边缘上，由于自旋-电荷分离和复合，两个自旋相反的电子之间出现了一种新颖的多粒子AB干涉，其特点是自旋交换。我们的结果确立了边缘输运作为自旋单重态拓扑序的探测手段，这对石墨烯-超导体杂化材料中的拟费米子平台具有重要意义。

articles.title: ZStar: A unified toolkit for polarization, Born effective charges, dielectric and piezoelectric responses, and infrared and Raman spectra
articles.title_zh: ZStar：用于极化、本虚电荷、介电和压电响应以及红外和拉曼光谱的统一工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.16802v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polarization and the response to atomic displacements determine the dielectric, piezoelectric, and vibrational spectroscopy of materials, yet these quantities are usually obtained through separate workflows within ABACUS. Here, we present ZStar, an open-source Python toolkit that unifies these calculations. Using ABACUS and PYATB, ZStar derives Born effective charges (BECs) and zone-center force constants from one symmetry-adapted displacement set, and reuses the displaced electronic matrices for Raman spectra. Berry phases in periodic directions combined with charge-density dipoles in nonperiodic directions extend the method from bulk crystals (3D) to 2D and 1D materials and molecules (0D). These BECs and phonon modes give infrared intensities and the lattice contribution to the dielectric response. From finite strains, ZStar further obtains clamped-ion and relaxed-ion piezoelectric coefficients. This unified workflow reduces the computational cost by up to 4.2× for BECs and zone-center phonons and 8.4× for combined infrared and Raman calculations. ZStar also supports machine-learned models by generating training data and post-processing prediction results into physical properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 极化和对原子位移的响应决定了材料的介电、压电和振动光谱，但这些量通常是通过ABACUS中的独立工作流程获得的。在此，我们介绍ZStar，这是一个将这些计算统一起来的开源Python工具包。ZStar使用ABACUS和PYATB，从一个对称适配的位移集推导出波恩有效电荷（BEC）和区中心力常数，并重复使用位移电子矩阵来计算拉曼光谱。周期性方向上的贝里相位与非周期性方向上的电荷密度偶极子相结合，将该方法从体晶体（3D）扩展到2D和1D材料以及分子（0D）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极化和对原子位移的响应决定了材料的介电、压电和振动光谱，但这些量通常是通过ABACUS中的独立工作流程获得的。在此，我们介绍ZStar，这是一个将这些计算统一起来的开源Python工具包。ZStar使用ABACUS和PYATB，从一个对称适配的位移集推导出波恩有效电荷（BEC）和区中心力常数，并重复使用位移电子矩阵来计算拉曼光谱。周期性方向上的贝里相位与非周期性方向上的电荷密度偶极子相结合，将该方法从体晶体（3D）扩展到2D和1D材料以及分子（0D）。这些 BEC 和声子模式提供了红外强度以及晶格对介电响应的贡献。从有限应变中，ZStar进一步获得了钳制离子和弛豫离子的压电系数。这种统一的工作流程可将BEC和布里渊区中心声子的计算成本降低多达4.2倍，将红外和拉曼联合计算的成本降低多达8.4倍。ZStar 还通过生成训练数据并将预测结果后处理为物理属性来支持机器学习模型。

articles.title: Projective representation theory of spin space groups
articles.title_zh: 自旋空间群的射影表示理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.21289v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin space groups provide the symmetry framework for magnetic crystals with weak spin-orbit coupling, but extracting their physical consequences requires a general theory of irreducible representations. The central difficulty is that spin space groups are represented projectively: their factor systems can render lattice translations noncommuting, induce nonsymmorphic actions in momentum space, and modify the projective structure of little cogroups. These effects lie beyond conventional space-group representation theory. Here, using Mackey's theory of group extensions, we develop a unified constructive framework for all collinear, coplanar, and noncoplanar spin space groups, including antiunitary symmetries and general factor systems. A central result is a canonical decomposition of the relevant factor system ν into a translational factor σ, a mixed factor γ coupling translations to point-group operations, and a point-group factor α. This decomposition makes transparent how ordinary representation theory is modified: σ determines the projective translation algebra and the appropriate Brillouin zone, γ controls the momentum-space group action and can make it nonsymmorphic, and α contributes to the factor systems of little cogroups. On this basis, we construct all projective irreducible corepresentations by induction over momentum-space orbits. The framework identifies which nonsymmorphic momentum-space symmetries can be realized by spin space groups and how they reconstruct high-symmetry momenta. It reveals Brillouin spaces that are compact flat manifolds, Weyl points of the same chirality locked by projective translation symmetry, and spin space group symmetry-enforced Zak phases as well as Chern insulators. Our results establish the representation-theoretic foundation for systematic studies of weak-spin-orbit-coupled magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋空间群为具有弱自旋轨道耦合的磁性晶体提供了对称性框架，但要提取其物理结果，则需要一个不可约表示的一般性理论。主要困难在于自旋空间群以射影方式表示：它们的因子系统可以使晶格平移不交换，在动量空间中诱发非同构作用，并改变小余群的射影结构。这些效应超出了常规空间群表示理论的范畴。在这里，我们利用Mackey的群扩张理论，为所有共线、共面和非共面自旋空间群（包括反幺正对称性和一般因子系统）建立了一个统一的构造性框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋空间群为具有弱自旋轨道耦合的磁性晶体提供了对称性框架，但要提取其物理结果，则需要一个不可约表示的一般性理论。主要困难在于自旋空间群以射影方式表示：它们的因子系统可以使晶格平移不交换，在动量空间中诱发非同构作用，并改变小余群的射影结构。这些效应超出了常规空间群表示理论的范畴。在这里，我们利用Mackey的群扩张理论，为所有共线、共面和非共面自旋空间群（包括反幺正对称性和一般因子系统）建立了一个统一的构造性框架。一个核心结果是将相关因子系统ν标准分解为一个平移因子σ、一个将平移与点群运算耦合的混合因子γ和一个点群因子α。这种分解清楚地揭示了普通表示理论是如何被修改的：σ决定了射影平移代数和适当的布里渊区，γ控制了动量空间群作用，并可以使其非对称，而α则对小余群的因子系统做出了贡献。在此基础上，我们通过对动量空间轨道的归纳来构造所有射影不可约核心表示。该框架确定了哪些非对称动量空间对称性可以通过自旋空间群实现，以及它们如何重构高对称性动量。它揭示了作为紧致平坦流形的布里渊空间、被射影平移对称性锁定且具有相同手性的Weyl点，以及由自旋空间群对称性所强制的Zak相位和陈绝缘体。我们的研究结果为弱自旋轨道耦合磁性材料的系统性研究奠定了表示论基础。

articles.title: Lattice in Line: Optimized DMRG ordering for complex lattice geometries
articles.title_zh: Lattice in Line：针对复杂晶格几何结构的优化DMRG排序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.25384v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) is a one-dimensional tensor-network technique, but it is not limited to one-dimensional systems: it can be applied to periodic 2D and 3D clusters and molecules, provided their sites are first enumerated along a line; a step one may call ``lattice compilation''. This paper discusses three proxy loss functions for finding this optimal enumeration: the graph bandwidth B (maximum interaction range), the cutwidth C (maximum number of bonds crossing a cut), and the average interaction range R. Constructing the Hamiltonian MPO (matrix-product operator) for a large set of clusters that are of interest in frustrated magnetism, I find that C determines the peak SU(2) Heisenberg MPO bond dimension and R the average one. Targeting (C,R) lexicographically yields the best energies. Targeting B indirectly reduces C, but not as efficiently as targeting C directly. Otherwise, the value of B itself is largely irrelevant in the sense that good DMRG energies can have large B. To perform the optimization, classic heuristics (e.g. reverse Cuthill--McKee) prove unreliable even for small clusters, and I find that a QUBO formulation improves them only marginally. Instead I propose a staged optimization built on Boolean satisfiability (SAT) and constraint-programming (CP) solvers, CP-SAT of Google's OR-Tools (a hybrid of CP propagation and SAT clause learning) and the SAT solvers CaDiCaL and Glucose. This approach yields significantly better orderings together with rigorous bounds. The corresponding Lattice in Line code is available at https://github.com/spinflip/lattice_in_line and was designed with extensive use of the Fable 5 large language model.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）是一种一维张量网络技术，但它并不局限于一维系统：它可以应用于周期性二维和三维簇和分子，前提是它们的位点首先沿一条线枚举；这一步可以称为“晶格编译”。本文讨论了用于寻找这一最优枚举的三个代理损失函数：图带宽B（最大相互作用范围）、割宽C（穿过割集的边最大数目）和平均相互作用范围R。通过为受阻磁性中关注的大量簇构造哈密顿MPO（矩阵积算符），我发现C决定了峰值SU(2)海森堡MPO边维数，而R决定了平均边维数。按字典顺序针对(C,R)可得到最佳能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）是一种一维张量网络技术，但它并不局限于一维系统：它可以应用于周期性二维和三维簇和分子，前提是它们的位点首先沿一条线枚举；这一步可以称为“晶格编译”。本文讨论了用于寻找这一最优枚举的三个代理损失函数：图带宽B（最大相互作用范围）、割宽C（穿过割集的边最大数目）和平均相互作用范围R。通过为受阻磁性中关注的大量簇构造哈密顿MPO（矩阵积算符），我发现C决定了峰值SU(2)海森堡MPO边维数，而R决定了平均边维数。按字典顺序针对(C,R)可得到最佳能量。针对B间接降低C，但效率不如直接针对C。否则，B的值本身基本上无关紧要，因为良好的DMRG能量可以有较大的B。要进行优化，经典的启发式方法（例如逆Cuthill--McKee）即使对于小簇来说也证明是不可靠的，我发现QUBO公式只能略微改善它们。相反，我提出了一种基于布尔可满足性 (SAT) 和约束编程 (CP) 求解器的分阶段优化方法，即 Google OR-Tools 的 CP-SAT（CP 传播和 SAT 子句学习的混合）以及 SAT 求解器 CaDiCaL 和 Glucose。这种方法可以得到明显更好的排序，同时具有严格的界限。相应的 Lattice in Line 代码可在 https://github.com/spinflip/lattice_in_line 获取，其设计广泛使用了 Fable 5 大型语言模型。

articles.title: Microphase Separation and Ionic Aggregation in Oppositely Charged End-Functionalized Polymer Blends
articles.title_zh: 带相反电荷的端基官能化聚合物共混物中的微相分离和离子聚集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24361v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using an ion-correlation-augmented self-consistent field theory (IC-SCFT), we study the phase behavior of binary blends of A and B polymers carrying single end groups of opposite charge. Under the low dielectric conditions typical for organic polymer melts, strong ion correlations drive association of multiple chain ends, leading to emergent multichain architectures that go beyond a simple ion-paired diblock copolymer picture previously used to interpret recent experiments.
