At moderate to strong polymer segregation, the resulting phase diagram differs considerably from this effective-diblock prediction: ion clustering broadens the lamellar and cylindrical windows while suppressing the network phases, the reverse of the trend for end-charged diblock copolymers. At weak segregation, the two polymers remain miscible even as ion clustering persists, and decreasing chain length drives the clusters themselves through a sphere-to-cylinder-to-lamella shape transition, connecting continuously to the aggregation behavior of classical terminally charged ionomers in the limit when one of the polymer species shrinks to just the charged end. These results reveal that ion clustering - beyond simple pairwise bonding - shapes the self-assembly of end-charged polymer blends.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用离子关联增强自洽场理论（IC-SCFT）研究了带有异性电荷单端基的A和B聚合物二元共混物的相行为。在有机聚合物熔体典型的低介电常数条件下，强离子关联性驱动多个链端的缔合，从而形成超越先前用于解释近期实验的简单离子对偶嵌段共聚物图景的新型多链结构。在中等至强聚合物偏析下，所得相图与这种有效双嵌段预测有很大不同：离子聚集拓宽了层状和柱状窗口，同时抑制了网络相，这与端基带电双嵌段共聚物的趋势相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用离子关联增强自洽场理论（IC-SCFT）研究了带有异性电荷单端基的A和B聚合物二元共混物的相行为。在有机聚合物熔体典型的低介电常数条件下，强离子关联性驱动多个链端的缔合，从而形成超越先前用于解释近期实验的简单离子对偶嵌段共聚物图景的新型多链结构。在中等至强聚合物偏析下，所得相图与这种有效双嵌段预测有很大不同：离子聚集拓宽了层状和柱状窗口，同时抑制了网络相，这与端基带电双嵌段共聚物的趋势相反。在弱分离的情况下，即使离子聚集持续存在，两种聚合物仍保持可混溶性，并且链长的缩短会促使聚集体本身经历从球形到柱形再到薄片的形状转变，在其中一种聚合物种类收缩至仅带电端部的极限情况下，与经典端基带电的离子聚合物的聚集行为连续性地联系起来。这些结果表明，离子聚集（而非简单的成对键合）决定了端基带电聚合物共混物的自组装。

articles.title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
articles.title_zh: 原子作为代理：通过集体预测编码产生的秩序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。在所有这些例子中，包括副本重叠在内的适当的宏观顺序参数仅通过观察到的自旋配置通过 CPC 的通信信息自动出现。我们将学习到的宏观坐标称为集体预测顺序。此外，对于铁磁和反铁磁伊辛模型，集体预测顺序的平衡分布产生了具有朗道势的对称性和热演化特征的涌现势。值得注意的是，集体预测秩序的出现并不涉及微观哈密顿量/拉格朗日量的任何结构。因此，我们的“原子作为代理”（AaaA）原理为宏观秩序的出现提供了一种完全数据驱动的方法，即机器学习物理学。

articles.title: Electron-electron interactions mediated by vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
articles.title_zh: 由振动介导的电子-电子相互作用：对手性诱导的自旋选择性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40990v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Molecular vibrations that modulate both electronic hopping and spin--orbit coupling (SOC) have been proposed as an ingredient of chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). We study a four-site bridge coupled to a single Peierls mode that modulates both terms, with amplitudes g and χ. An exact Lang--Firsov transformation yields the transformed Hamiltonian in closed form; in the antiadiabatic limit, it reduces to a purely fermionic model with instantaneous vibration-mediated interactions, whose two-body part separates into g², χ², and gχ channels, the last containing a Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI) and correlated hopping. For a common SOC axis, local spin rotations mix these channels, so that the DMI is not separately gauge invariant; the invariant content lies in the components g_parallel and g_perp of the Peierls coupling parallel and perpendicular to the static bond. For spin-independent injection and extraction, the acceptor polarization P_A is odd in both components, vanishes on two nodal lines, and reverses with the handedness of the bridge. We also prove that, for a common SOC axis and a single irreversible exit, a single electron transferred through an empty bridge acquires no long-time polarization, at any coupling strength. Donor--bridge--acceptor simulations with a half-filled bridge and the mode treated explicitly obey the symmetry rule. At weak coupling, P_A scales as g_parallel g_perpsimeq gχ, and, for the transfer rates considered, on-site Coulomb repulsion enhances it by a factor of about three. Within the model, a long-time polarization of the transferred charge is thus a many-electron effect: it requires spin exchange between the transferred electron and the other bridge electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 调节电子跳跃和自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的分子振动已被提议作为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的一个组成部分。我们研究了与单个 Peierls 模式耦合的四站点电桥，该模式可调制两项，幅度为 g 和 χ。精确的 Lang-Firsov 变换产生封闭形式的变换后的哈密顿量；在抗绝热极限下，它简化为具有瞬时振动介导的相互作用的纯费米子模型，其二体部分分为 g²、χ² 和 gχ 通道，最后一个包含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 和相关跳跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 调节电子跳跃和自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的分子振动已被提议作为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的一个组成部分。我们研究了与单个 Peierls 模式耦合的四站点电桥，该模式可调制两项，幅度为 g 和 χ。精确的 Lang-Firsov 变换产生封闭形式的变换后的哈密顿量；在抗绝热极限下，它简化为具有瞬时振动介导的相互作用的纯费米子模型，其二体部分分为 g²、χ² 和 gχ 通道，最后一个包含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 和相关跳跃。对于公共 SOC 轴，局部自旋旋转混合了这些通道，因此 DMI 不是单独的规范不变性；不变的内容在于与静态键平行和垂直的 Peierls 耦合的分量 g_parallel 和 g_perp。对于与自旋无关的注入和提取，受主极化 P_A 在两个分量中都是奇数，在两条节点线上消失，并随着电桥的旋向性而反转。我们还证明，对于共同的 SOC 轴和单个不可逆出口，通过空桥转移的单个电子在任何耦合强度下都不会获得长时间极化。使用半填充桥进行供体-桥-受体模拟，并且所处理的模式明确遵守对称规则。在弱耦合时，P_A 缩放为 g_parallel g_perpsimeq gχ，并且对于所考虑的传输速率，现场库仑斥力将其增强约三倍。在该模型中，转移电荷的长时间极化是一种多电子效应：它需要转移电子和其他桥电子之间的自旋交换。

articles.title: Light-Matter Interactions Beyond the Electric Dipole Approximation in Extended Systems Without Multipole Expansion
articles.title_zh: 在没有多极扩展的扩展系统中超越电偶极近似的光-物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.10271v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a general theoretical framework to capture light-matter interactions beyond the electric-dipole approximation, applicable to extended materials interacting with spatially structured electric fields without truncation at finite multipolar order. The approach is based on the Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) Hamiltonian for light-matter interactions and a representation of the material Hamiltonian in a basis of maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs). We utilize this novel approach to clarify the limitations of the ubiquitous dipole approximation. We consider electric fields with both uniform and non-uniform intensity profiles and a range of ratios of system size to the wavelength of light. We identify the precise conditions under which the dipole approximation breaks down, leading to significant errors in the light-induced dynamics. Contrary to conventional belief, we find that the dipole approximation is robust for uniformly illuminated 1D or 2D materials if light propagates perpendicular to the material. For 3D materials or non-perpendicular illumination, the dipole approximation starts to break down when the wavelength of light becomes comparable to the system size. Furthermore, the dipole approximation fails to capture the light-matter interaction when the material is illuminated partially or non-uniformly. For slowly varying field intensities this failure can be corrected by the finite-order multipolar corrections. However, for fields that vary substantially over the system size, correcting via finite order multipolar terms becomes computationally impractical. In contrast, our approach captures the beyond-dipole light-matter interactions at a computational cost of a standard dipole calculation. This efficiency paves the way for accurate first-principles simulations of spatially-structured light-matter dynamics in nanoscale devices, quantum materials, and interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个通用的理论框架来捕获超越电偶极近似的光与物质的相互作用，适用于与空间结构电场相互作用的扩展材料，而无需在有限多极阶上截断。该方法基于用于光与物质相互作用的 Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) 哈密顿量以及基于最大局域 Wannier 函数 (MLWF) 的材料哈密顿量表示。我们利用这种新颖的方法来阐明普遍存在的偶极子近似的局限性。我们考虑具有均匀和非均匀强度分布的电场以及一系列系统尺寸与光波长的比率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个通用的理论框架来捕获超越电偶极近似的光与物质的相互作用，适用于与空间结构电场相互作用的扩展材料，而无需在有限多极阶上截断。该方法基于用于光与物质相互作用的 Power-Zienau-Woolley (PZW) 哈密顿量以及基于最大局域 Wannier 函数 (MLWF) 的材料哈密顿量表示。我们利用这种新颖的方法来阐明普遍存在的偶极子近似的局限性。我们考虑具有均匀和非均匀强度分布的电场以及一系列系统尺寸与光波长的比率。我们确定了偶极子近似失效的精确条件，从而导致光致动力学产生重大误差。与传统观念相反，我们发现，如果光垂直于材料传播，则偶极近似对于均匀照明的一维或二维材料是稳健的。对于 3D 材料或非垂直照明，当光的波长与系统尺寸相当时，偶极子近似开始失效。此外，当材料被部分或不均匀照亮时，偶极近似无法捕获光与物质的相互作用。对于缓慢变化的场强度，可以通过有限阶多极校正来校正这种故障。然而，对于随系统大小变化很大的场，通过有限阶多极项进行校正在计算上变得不切实际。相比之下，我们的方法以标准偶极子计算的计算成本捕获超偶极子光与物质的相互作用。这种效率为纳米级器件、量子材料和界面中空间结构光物质动力学的精确第一原理模拟铺平了道路。

articles.title: Current-Dependent Meta-GGA and Local Hybrid Functionals for Relativistic NMR Shifts
articles.title_zh: 用于相对论 NMR 位移的电流相关 Meta-GGA 和局部混合泛函
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NMR chemical shifts are key for the characterization of novel compounds. Especially for molecules with heavy elements, the experimental data is often corroborated with computational studies in density functional theory (DFT). However, modern meta-generalized gradient approximations (meta-GGAs) and local hybrid functionals are not widely supported in relativistic calculations with quantum chemistry program suites. So far, their current-dependent generalization in the spirit of Dobson, Becke, and Tao was not presented at all. This generalization ensures gauge invariance and does not introduce artifacts--unlike the more popular field-dependent generalization of the kinetic-energy density. In non-relativistic and scalar-relativistic calculations, the first was shown to be superior but the current density only arises due to the magnetic field perturbation. In contrast, spin--orbit coupling also induces current densities in the preceding ground-state calculation and the DFT framework needs to be generalized to a current density functional theory (CDFT) for consistency with the current-dependent response equations. Herein, we present the two-component relativistic generalization of the current-dependent kinetic-energy density of a Kramers-restricted Kohn--Sham reference for meta-GGAs and local hybrid functionals in NMR calculations. The extension is invariant under a position-dependent phase and a position-dependent spin rotation of the spinors, or a local U(1)×SU(2) transformation. Relativistic effects are considered with exact two-component theory using a superposition of atomic potentials to include the two-electron picture-change correction (SAP-X2C).
articles.abstract_zh: NMR 化学位移是表征新型化合物的关键。特别是对于含有重元素的分子，实验数据通常与密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算研究相证实。然而，现代元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）和局部混合泛函在量子化学程序套件的相对论计算中并未得到广泛支持。到目前为止，他们本着多布森、贝克和陶的精神进行的当前依赖的概括还没有被提出。这种概括确保了规范不变性并且不会引入伪影——与更流行的动能密度的场相关概括不同。在非相对论和标量相对论计算中，第一个被证明是优越的，但电流密度仅由于磁场扰动而产生。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NMR 化学位移是表征新型化合物的关键。特别是对于含有重元素的分子，实验数据通常与密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算研究相证实。然而，现代元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）和局部混合泛函在量子化学程序套件的相对论计算中并未得到广泛支持。到目前为止，他们本着多布森、贝克和陶的精神进行的当前依赖的概括还没有被提出。这种概括确保了规范不变性并且不会引入伪影——与更流行的动能密度的场相关概括不同。在非相对论和标量相对论计算中，第一个被证明是优越的，但电流密度仅由于磁场扰动而产生。相反，自旋轨道耦合也会在前面的基态计算中引入电流密度，并且需要将 DFT 框架推广到电流密度泛函理论 (CDFT)，以与电流相关的响应方程保持一致。在此，我们提出了用于 NMR 计算中元 GGA 和局部混合泛函的 Kramers 限制 Kohn-Sham 参考的电流相关动能密度的二分量相对论推广。外延在位置相关的相位和旋量的位置相关的自旋旋转或局部 U(1)×SU(2) 变换下是不变的。相对论效应通过精确的二分量理论来考虑，使用原子势的叠加来包括二电子图像变化校正 (SAP-X2C)。

articles.title: Exact force-free three-dimensional toroidal equilibria and the sawtooth q(0) problem
articles.title_zh: 精确无力三维环形平衡和锯齿q(0)问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct exact, closed-form solutions of curl of B=lambda B with nested toroidal flux surfaces around a closed magnetic axis, finite rotational transform and, in general, no continuous Euclidean symmetry. They are counterexamples to Grad's conjecture in its pressureless form. Inside a regular flux surface that fits in a ball of radius r_b with |lambda| r_b<4.49, each is the unique minimum of magnetic energy at fixed toroidal flux and helicity, so each is a Taylor state. The rotational transform is a ratio of one-dimensional integrals. Our primary application is the sawtooth q(0) problem in tokamaks. In one configuration, q crosses unity on a smooth torus of closed field lines, with no island and no current sheet. Across the family, minimum-energy fixed-boundary states with q(0)<1
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了 B=lambda B 旋度的精确封闭式解，具有围绕闭合磁轴的嵌套环形磁通表面、有限旋转变换，并且通常没有连续欧几里德对称性。它们是无压力形式的格雷德猜想的反例。在规则通量表面内，该表面适合半径为 r_b 且 |lambda| 的球体r_b<4.49，每个都是固定环形磁通和螺旋度下磁能的唯一最小值，因此每个都是泰勒态。旋转变换是一维积分的比率。我们的主要应用是托卡马克中的锯齿 q(0) 问题。在一种配置中，q 在闭合场线的平滑圆环上交叉统一，没有岛也没有电流片。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了 B=lambda B 旋度的精确封闭式解，具有围绕闭合磁轴的嵌套环形磁通表面、有限旋转变换，并且通常没有连续欧几里德对称性。它们是无压力形式的格雷德猜想的反例。在规则通量表面内，该表面适合半径为 r_b 且 |lambda| 的球体r_b<4.49，每个都是固定环形磁通和螺旋度下磁能的唯一最小值，因此每个都是泰勒态。旋转变换是一维积分的比率。我们的主要应用是托卡马克中的锯齿 q(0) 问题。在一种配置中，q 在闭合场线的平滑圆环上交叉统一，没有岛也没有电流片。在整个族中，q(0)<1 的最小能量固定边界态

articles.title: Compact Slow-Wave Hybrid Magnonics on Ultrahigh-Permittivity Substrates
articles.title_zh: 超高介电常数衬底上的紧凑型慢波混合磁振子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid magnonics based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) enables strong, broadband magnon-photon coupling, but the centimeter-scale device footprints required at low gigahertz frequencies hinder integration. Here, we demonstrate miniaturized slow-wave hybrid magnonic devices using an ultrahigh-permittivity ceramic substrate (ε = 140). Owing to the inverse-square-root dependence of the SSPP plasma frequency on effective permittivity, the required corrugation finger length is reduced by nearly a factor of four compared with conventional microwave substrates. The ceramic is thick and brittle, and conventional thin-film processes cannot easily pattern thick, low-loss conductors on it. We overcome this challenge with additively manufactured electronics (AME). In a customized AME workflow, a multi-material inkjet printer first prints a dielectric fixture that holds and registers the ceramic. After the ceramic is loaded, the printer prints thick silver SSPP patterns directly onto it. Measurements on six printed devices with different finger lengths confirm the predicted geometry-frequency scaling. Moreover, the enhanced field confinement of the compact SSPP waveguide nearly doubles the magnon-photon coupling strength and yields ultrastrong coupling with g/fₚ approx 22%. Notably, this performance is achieved using a YIG film whose magnetic volume is more than an order of magnitude smaller than that employed in previous SSPP demonstrations. These results establish AME on ultrahigh-permittivity substrates as a practical route toward compact, strongly coupled hybrid magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于欺骗表面等离子体激元 (SSPP) 的混合磁振子可实现强宽带磁振子-光子耦合，但低千兆赫频率所需的厘米级器件占用空间阻碍了集成。在这里，我们展示了使用超高介电常数陶瓷基板 (ε = 140) 的小型化慢波混合磁振子器件。由于 SSPP 等离子体频率与有效介电常数呈平方根倒数关系，与传统微波基板相比，所需的波纹指长度减少了近四倍。陶瓷又厚又脆，传统的薄膜工艺无法轻松地在其上形成厚的低损耗导体图案。我们通过增材制造电子产品 (AME) 克服了这一挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于欺骗表面等离子体激元 (SSPP) 的混合磁振子可实现强宽带磁振子-光子耦合，但低千兆赫频率所需的厘米级器件占用空间阻碍了集成。在这里，我们展示了使用超高介电常数陶瓷基板 (ε = 140) 的小型化慢波混合磁振子器件。由于 SSPP 等离子体频率与有效介电常数呈平方根倒数关系，与传统微波基板相比，所需的波纹指长度减少了近四倍。陶瓷又厚又脆，传统的薄膜工艺无法轻松地在其上形成厚的低损耗导体图案。我们通过增材制造电子产品 (AME) 克服了这一挑战。在定制的 AME 工作流程中，多材料喷墨打印机首先打印用于固定和记录陶瓷的介电夹具。装入陶瓷后，打印机会直接在其上打印厚厚的银色 SSPP 图案。在具有不同手指长度的六种印刷设备上进行的测量证实了预测的几何频率缩放。此外，紧凑型 SSPP 波导的增强场限制几乎使磁子-光子耦合强度增加了一倍，并产生 g/fₚ 约 22% 的超强耦合。值得注意的是，这种性能是使用 YIG 薄膜实现的，其磁体积比之前 SSPP 演示中使用的磁体积小一个数量级以上。这些结果将超高介电常数基底上的 AME 确立为实现紧凑、强耦合混合磁振子器件的实用途径。

articles.title: Sum rules for the relativistic and retarded Bethe approximation in electron-neutral-atom collisions
articles.title_zh: 电子-中性-原子碰撞中相对论和延迟贝特近似的求和规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For high partial waves the reactance matrix for electron-atom collisions may be replaced by the Bethe approximation, and for optically allowed transitions the slowly convergent sum over partial waves can then be performed exactly by means of the sum rules of Burgess. For neutral targets the Bethe integrals and the sum rules take a particularly simple form in terms of Legendre functions of the second kind of a single argument χ=(k²+k'²)/2kk'. We show that this structure survives in a fully relativistic description. For a projectile described by free Dirac waves interacting through the retarded Møller interaction, the Bethe integrals of every multipole order are obtained from the static ones by the replacement χ→χ_q=(k²+k'²-q²)/2kk', where q is the energy transfer divided by c. For dipole transitions we give closed-form sum rules over all partial waves above any l₀ge2 for the Coulomb (charge-density) interaction, for the magnetic dipole interaction and for the long-range transverse electric interaction, including its interference with the Coulomb term. In each case the sum reduces to a quadratic form in Qₗ_₀₋₁(χ_q) and Qₗ_₀(χ_q) with coefficients rational in l₀. As the impact energy increases χ_q→1 and the partial-wave sums converge ever more slowly, so that the sum rules become most useful precisely in the relativistic regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于高分波，电子-原子碰撞的电抗矩阵可以用贝特近似代替，并且对于光学允许的跃迁，分波上的缓慢收敛和可以通过伯吉斯求和规则精确地执行。对于中性目标，贝特积分和求和规则采用第二类单参数 χ=(k²+k'²)/2kk' 的勒让德函数的特别简单的形式。我们证明这种结构在完全相对论的描述中仍然存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于高分波，电子-原子碰撞的电抗矩阵可以用贝特近似代替，并且对于光学允许的跃迁，分波上的缓慢收敛和可以通过伯吉斯求和规则精确地执行。对于中性目标，贝特积分和求和规则采用第二类单参数 χ=(k²+k'²)/2kk' 的勒让德函数的特别简单的形式。我们证明这种结构在完全相对论的描述中仍然存在。对于通过延迟 Møller 相互作用相互作用的自由狄拉克波描述的射弹，每个多极阶的 Bethe 积分是通过替换 χ→χ_q=(k²+k'²-q²)/2kk' 从静态积分获得的，其中 q 是能量传递除以 c。对于偶极子跃迁，我们针对库仑（电荷密度）相互作用、磁偶极子相互作用和长程横向电相互作用，包括其对库仑项的干扰，给出了高于任何 l₀ge2 的所有分波的闭合形式求和规则。在每种情况下，总和都简化为 Qₗ_₀₋₁(χ_q) 和 Qₗ_₀(χ_q) 的二次形式，系数为 l0 有理数。随着冲击能量增加 χ_q→1 并且分波和收敛得越来越慢，因此和规则在相对论状态下变得最有用。

articles.title: Three-Dimensional Wake Reconstruction and Cross-Scale Transfer for Floating Offshore Wind Turbines via Physics-Informed Fourier Neural Operators
articles.title_zh: 通过基于物理的傅立叶神经算子进行浮式海上风力发电机的三维尾流重建和跨尺度传递
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupled surge-pitch motions drive unsteady vortex interactions and dynamic wake meandering behind floating offshore wind turbines, complicating three-dimensional wake reconstruction from limited measurements and transfer across turbine scales. Large-eddy simulations coupled with an actuator line model generate fixed and surge-pitch wakes at motion-based Strouhal numbers St=fD/U_infty of 0.2-0.6 (where f, D, and U_infty are the motion frequency, rotor diameter, and inflow velocity) for the National Renewable Energy Laboratory 5 MW (D=126 m) and International Energy Agency 22 MW (D=284 m) turbines. A physics-informed Fourier neural operator framework combines four-dimensional spectral convolutions with incompressible continuity and rotor-forced momentum-residual regularization to reconstruct three-dimensional unsteady wakes from two observation planes. Trained on the 5 MW fixed and St=0.2-0.5 cases, the framework recovers near-wake double-peak deficits, motion-driven wake expansion, and coherent vortices through St=0.6 (mean wake-center and half-width errors within 1.3% and 1.0% of D), while 10% planar sampling preserves near-dense accuracy (relative L₂ error 0.0689 versus 0.0684). Applying transfer learning from the 5 MW to the 22 MW turbine lowers the three-dimensional streamwise-velocity error at St=0.6 by 36% relative to zero-shot inference (0.1066 to 0.0682), halves scratch-training error with one fixed case (0.0835 versus 0.1693), and restores wake-center tracking and motion-locked harmonics (St-3St). Large-scale motion-induced dynamics transfer cleanly across turbine scales, whereas fine-scale vortex breakdown remains damped. The framework shows potential for three-dimensional wake reconstruction and downstream-inflow assessment in floating wind farms.
articles.abstract_zh: 耦合的喘振-桨距运动驱动浮动海上风力涡轮机后面的不稳定涡流相互作用和动态尾流蜿蜒，使有限测量的三维尾流重建和跨涡轮机尺度的传输变得复杂。大涡模拟与执行器线模型相结合，为国家可再生能源实验室 5 MW (D=126 m) 和国际能源机构 22 MW (D=284 m) 涡轮机生成固定和喘振桨距尾流，基于运动的 Strouhal 数 St=fD/U_infty 为 0.2-0.6（其中 f、D 和 U_infty 是运动频率、转子直径和流入速度）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耦合的喘振-桨距运动驱动浮动海上风力涡轮机后面的不稳定涡流相互作用和动态尾流蜿蜒，使有限测量的三维尾流重建和跨涡轮机尺度的传输变得复杂。大涡模拟与执行器线模型相结合，为国家可再生能源实验室 5 MW (D=126 m) 和国际能源机构 22 MW (D=284 m) 涡轮机生成固定和喘振桨距尾流，基于运动的 Strouhal 数 St=fD/U_infty 为 0.2-0.6（其中 f、D 和 U_infty 是运动频率、转子直径和流入速度）。基于物理的傅立叶神经算子框架将四维谱卷积与不可压缩连续性和转子强制动量残差正则化相结合，以从两个观察平面重建三维非稳态尾流。在 5 MW 固定和 St=0.2-0.5 情况下进行训练，该框架通过 St=0.6 恢复近尾流双峰缺陷、运动驱动的尾流扩展和相干涡旋（平均尾流中心和半宽误差在 D 的 1.3% 和 1.0% 以内），而 10% 平面采样保持近密集精度（相对 L2 误差 0.0689 与 0.0684）。将迁移学习从 5 MW 应用于 22 MW 涡轮机，相对于零样本推理（0.1066 到 0.0682），St=0.6 时的三维流向速度误差降低了 36%，将一种固定情况下的划痕训练误差减半（0.0835 与 0.1693），并恢复尾流中心跟踪和运动锁定谐波 (St-3St)。大规模运动引起的动力学在涡轮机尺度上干净地传递，而精细尺度的涡流破坏仍然受到抑制。该框架显示了浮动风电场三维尾流重建和下游流入评估的潜力。

articles.title: SPARK: Spectral Preconditioned Analytic Residual Kolmogorov Arnold Networks for incompressible Navier Stokes equations
articles.title_zh: SPARK：用于不可压缩纳维斯托克斯方程的谱预条件分析残差 Kolmogorov Arnold 网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Spectral Jet KAN (SJ-KAN) to reduce the cost of differentiation and the network complexity of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for the Navier-Stokes (NS) equations. The input coordinates are embedded through Chebyshev bases whose spatial derivatives are known in closed form, and all differentiation matrices are computed once for the collocation points before training. A single linear layer compresses the Chebyshev bases into a few latent features, and a single nonlinear Chebyshev Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (CKAN) layer maps these features to the physical variables. Because the basis derivatives are known in advance and the compression is linear, the spatial derivatives in the NS equations are carried through the network analytically by a fixed sequence of matrix products and elementwise operations. Automatic differentiation (AD) is used only in backpropagation, to compute the gradients of the loss with respect to the network weights. We examine three variants of SJ-KAN (JetKAN, JetKAN-F, JetKAN-H), which differ in how the output layer maps the latent features to the physical variables. All variants are tested on the Taylor-Green vortex and on the lid driven cavity at Reynolds numbers Re = 100, 1000, 5000 and 10,000. The results are compared with a KAN that uses AD (PIKAN) and with a standard PINN. The SJ-KAN variants reach comparable or better accuracy than both, with up to 47 times fewer parameters and up to 8.2 times faster training per epoch. SJ-KAN also solves the lid driven cavity flow at Re = 10,000 without any reference data and with fewer than 9,000 trainable parameters. These results show that analytic derivative propagation, a small spectral input layer and a single KAN layer give a faster and simpler solver than methods based on AD, also for flows at high Reynolds numbers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Spectral Jet KAN (SJ-KAN) 来降低纳维-斯托克斯 (NS) 方程的微分成本和物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的网络复杂性。输入坐标通过切比雪夫基嵌入，切比雪夫基的空间导数以封闭形式已知，并且在训练之前针对配置点计算一次所有微分矩阵。单个线性层将切比雪夫基压缩为一些潜在特征，单个非线性切比雪夫·柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络 (CKAN) 层将这些特征映射到物理变量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出 Spectral Jet KAN (SJ-KAN) 来降低纳维-斯托克斯 (NS) 方程的微分成本和物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的网络复杂性。输入坐标通过切比雪夫基嵌入，切比雪夫基的空间导数以封闭形式已知，并且在训练之前针对配置点计算一次所有微分矩阵。单个线性层将切比雪夫基压缩为一些潜在特征，单个非线性切比雪夫·柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络 (CKAN) 层将这些特征映射到物理变量。由于基导数是预先已知的，并且压缩是线性的，因此 NS 方程中的空间导数通过网络通过固定的矩阵乘积序列和元素运算进行解析。自动微分（AD）仅用于反向传播，以计算损失相对于网络权重的梯度。我们研究了 SJ-KAN 的三种变体（JetKAN、JetKAN-F、JetKAN-H），它们的不同之处在于输出层如何将潜在特征映射到物理变量。所有变体均在泰勒-格林涡流和雷诺数 Re = 100、1000、5000 和 10,000 的盖驱动腔上进行测试。将结果与使用 AD (PIKAN) 的 KAN 以及标准 PINN 进行比较。 SJ-KAN 变体达到了与两者相当或更好的精度，参数减少了 47 倍，每个 epoch 的训练速度提高了 8.2 倍。 SJ-KAN 还可以在没有任何参考数据且可训练参数少于 9,000 个的情况下求解 Re = 10,000 时的盖驱动腔流。这些结果表明，与基于 AD 的方法相比，解析导数传播、小型谱输入层和单个 KAN 层提供了更快、更简单的求解器，对于高雷诺数的流动也是如此。

articles.title: Finite amplitude shape oscillations of magnetic microbubble under uniform magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 均匀磁场下磁性微泡的有限振幅形状振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study presents a theoretical model for the non-spherical oscillations of a lipid-encapsulated bubble infused with magnetic particles and subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Since the applied magnetic field is uniform, its gradient vanishes, making the existing weakly magnetic membrane theory inapplicable. To overcome this limitation, an alternative formulation that accounts for both the thinness and weak magnetic nature of the bubble shell is developed. Using this formulation, the induced magnetic field is calculated for a spherical bubble and incorporated into a Lagrangian framework for describing the non-spherical oscillations. The resulting governing equations for the radial and shape modes are then derived. The analysis shows that both the natural frequencies and exponential stability of the shape modes increase with increasing applied magnetic field. The frequency response of the shape modes shifts towards higher frequencies as the applied magnetic field is increased, consistent with the increase in their natural frequencies. Furthermore, finite-amplitude oscillations exhibit a period-doubling sequence and progressively transition towards chaotic behaviour with increasing magnetic field strength.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项研究提出了注入磁性颗粒并受到均匀磁场作用的脂质封装气泡的非球形振荡的理论模型。由于施加的磁场是均匀的，其梯度消失，使得现有的弱磁膜理论不再适用。为了克服这一限制，开发了一种替代公式，该公式可以同时考虑气泡壳的薄度和弱磁性。使用该公式，计算球形气泡的感应磁场，并将其纳入拉格朗日框架中以描述非球形振荡。然后导出径向和形状模式的控制方程。分析表明，形状模式的固有频率和指数稳定性随着施加磁场的增加而增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项研究提出了注入磁性颗粒并受到均匀磁场作用的脂质封装气泡的非球形振荡的理论模型。由于施加的磁场是均匀的，其梯度消失，使得现有的弱磁膜理论不再适用。为了克服这一限制，开发了一种替代公式，该公式可以同时考虑气泡壳的薄度和弱磁性。使用该公式，计算球形气泡的感应磁场，并将其纳入拉格朗日框架中以描述非球形振荡。然后导出径向和形状模式的控制方程。分析表明，形状模式的固有频率和指数稳定性随着施加磁场的增加而增加。随着施加的磁场增加，形状模式的频率响应向更高频率移动，这与其固有频率的增加一致。此外，有限振幅振荡表现出倍周期序列，并随着磁场强度的增加逐渐过渡到混沌行为。

articles.title: Physics-informed neural networks for strong normal shocks in kinetic relaxation models and the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
articles.title_zh: 用于动力学弛豫模型和硬球玻尔兹曼方程中强法向冲击的物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for kinetic equations have mostly been applied near equilibrium and judged by density, velocity and temperature. Here a network trained on the kinetic equation alone, with no reference data in the loss, solves steady normal shock waves and is assessed in eight fields: density, velocity, temperature, heat flux, stress, a third-order moment and two fourth-order moments. The network corrects a mixture of the two end-state Maxwellians by an unbounded, signed factor with exact inflow; the loss, the residual in three norms with conservation terms, is minimised by Adam and a self-scaled quasi-Newton method with continuation in the Mach number. For the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation at Mach 8, in a comparison made once after reference-free tests, the largest relative L² difference from direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) over the eight fields is 0.19 per cent; at Mach 10 it is 0.34 per cent. The distribution function itself agrees with the reference over six decades in velocity space. For the Bhatnagar--Gross--Krook (BGK) model, a blind prediction at Mach 50 gives density, velocity and temperature to about 0.1 per cent and exposes a loss of accuracy confined to the two fourth-order moments. Its origin is identified as a passive reduced distribution that carries little weight in the loss; with a larger weight on that distribution and a longer optimisation, both moments are within 3.2 per cent of the discrete-velocity solution up to Mach 70 and 7.1 per cent at Mach 100. The Shakhov model is solved to Mach 20 and a Rykov-type model of nitrogen to Mach 15.
articles.abstract_zh: 用于动力学方程的物理信息神经网络（PINN）大多应用于接近平衡状态，并通过密度、速度和温度来判断。这里，仅根据动力学方程进行训练的网络，在损失中没有参考数据，求解稳定法向冲击波，并在八个字段中进行评估：密度、速度、温度、热通量、应力、一个三阶矩和两个四阶矩。网络通过具有精确流入的无界、有符号因子来校正两个最终状态麦克斯韦量的混合；损失（具有守恒项的三个范数中的残差）通过 Adam 和马赫数连续的自缩放拟牛顿方法最小化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于动力学方程的物理信息神经网络（PINN）大多应用于接近平衡状态，并通过密度、速度和温度来判断。这里，仅根据动力学方程进行训练的网络，在损失中没有参考数据，求解稳定法向冲击波，并在八个字段中进行评估：密度、速度、温度、热通量、应力、一个三阶矩和两个四阶矩。网络通过具有精确流入的无界、有符号因子来校正两个最终状态麦克斯韦量的混合；损失（具有守恒项的三个范数中的残差）通过 Adam 和马赫数连续的自缩放拟牛顿方法最小化。对于马赫数为 8 的硬球玻尔兹曼方程，在无参考测试后进行一次比较，在 8 个场上与直接模拟蒙特卡罗 (DSMC) 的最大相对 L² 差异为 0.19%； 10 马赫时为 0.34%。分布函数本身与速度空间中 6 个十年的参考一致。对于 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) 模型，50 马赫的盲预测给出的密度、速度和温度约为 0.1%，并暴露出仅限于两个四阶矩的精度损失。它的起源被认为是一种被动的减少分配，在损失中几乎没有影响；由于该分布的权重较大且优化时间较长，因此两个力矩均在 70 马赫以下离散速度解的 3.2% 范围内，在 100 马赫以下为 7.1% 以内。Shakhov 模型求解为马赫 20，而 Rykov 型氮模型求解为马赫 15。

articles.title: Measuring the tug-of-war between two nonlinearities in a monopolar plasma vortex
articles.title_zh: 测量单极等离子体涡旋中两个非线性之间的拉锯战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: From planetary atmospheres to magnetized plasmas, single-core vortices organize flows and transport heat and matter. Understanding their persistence requires identifying the nonlinear interactions that sustain a single core. The Charney--Hasegawa--Mima equation, shared by drift waves and Rossby waves, admits steadily propagating localized vortex solutions only in dipole form. Theories of monopolar drift vortices attribute the additional nonlinearity to either the electron-temperature gradient or density-profile curvature, but their respective roles remain experimentally unresolved. Here we show that the coupling sustaining a monopolar drift vortex results from the near cancellation of two much larger nonlinear contributions. We measure three-wave coupling among the vortex harmonics using simultaneous probe signals acquired around the full azimuth of a laboratory plasma and compare it with predictions of an extended drift-wave equation derived for the measured equilibrium conditions. The equation reproduces the sign, magnitude and triad dependence of the observed coupling without adjustable parameters, whereas neither contribution alone accounts for the measured coupling pattern. This coupling transfers fluctuation power from the linearly driven fundamental to damped harmonics, maintaining the single-core waveform. These results establish an experimental route to distinguishing mechanisms that produce similar vortex structures by resolving the nonlinear interactions within them.
articles.abstract_zh: 从行星大气层到磁化等离子体，单核涡流组织流动并传输热量和物质。了解它们的持久性需要识别维持单个核心的非线性相互作用。漂移波和罗斯贝波共有的查尼-长谷川-美马方程承认仅以偶极子形式稳定传播局域涡旋解。单极漂移涡流理论将额外的非线性归因于电子温度梯度或密度剖面曲率，但它们各自的作用在实验上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们表明，维持单极漂移涡旋的耦合是由两个更大的非线性贡献几乎抵消造成的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从行星大气层到磁化等离子体，单核涡流组织流动并传输热量和物质。了解它们的持久性需要识别维持单个核心的非线性相互作用。漂移波和罗斯贝波共有的查尼-长谷川-美马方程承认仅以偶极子形式稳定传播局域涡旋解。单极漂移涡流理论将额外的非线性归因于电子温度梯度或密度剖面曲率，但它们各自的作用在实验上仍未得到解决。在这里，我们表明，维持单极漂移涡旋的耦合是由两个更大的非线性贡献几乎抵消造成的。我们使用在实验室等离子体的全方位角周围获取的同步探针信号来测量涡旋谐波之间的三波耦合，并将其与根据测量的平衡条件导出的扩展漂移波方程的预测进行比较。该方程在没有可调参数的情况下再现了观察到的耦合的符号、幅度和三元依赖性，而这两种贡献都单独解释了测量的耦合模式。这种耦合将波动功率从线性驱动的基波传输到阻尼谐波，从而保持单芯波形。这些结果建立了一条实验途径，通过解决内部的非线性相互作用来区分产生类似涡流结构的机制。

articles.title: Efficient spin-lattice dynamics and spin thermometry with machine-learned magnetic potentials
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习的磁势进行高效的自旋晶格动力学和自旋测温
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In finite-temperature spin-lattice dynamics, conventional force-only spin thermometers fail for energies nonlinear in each spin, while the standard semi-implicit SIB integrator requires two model evaluations per step. Here we introduce a geometric-probe spin temperature that is exact for arbitrary high-order smooth Hamiltonians using first-order spin forces alone without Hessians, making it naturally suited for nonlinear many-body machine-learning (ML) magnetic potentials. Complementarily, our cached-field integrator (CFI) stays second-order accurate with a single model evaluation per step, about halving the time per step with ML potentials. Extensive benchmarks against Monte Carlo across analytic and ML systems confirm both exact thermometry and accurate thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限温度自旋晶格动力学中，传统的仅受力自旋温度计因每次自旋中的能量非线性而失效，而标准半隐式 SIB 积分器每步需要两次模型评估。在这里，我们引入了一种几何探针自旋温度，该温度对于仅使用一阶自旋力而不使用 Hessians 的任意高阶平滑哈密顿量来说是精确的，使其自然适合非线性多体机器学习 (ML) 磁势。作为补充，我们的缓存字段积分器 (CFI) 通过每步进行单个模型评估来保持二阶精度，大约可利用 ML 潜力将每步时间减半。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在有限温度自旋晶格动力学中，传统的仅受力自旋温度计因每次自旋中的能量非线性而失效，而标准半隐式 SIB 积分器每步需要两次模型评估。在这里，我们引入了一种几何探针自旋温度，该温度对于仅使用一阶自旋力而不使用 Hessians 的任意高阶平滑哈密顿量来说是精确的，使其自然适合非线性多体机器学习 (ML) 磁势。作为补充，我们的缓存字段积分器 (CFI) 通过每步进行单个模型评估来保持二阶精度，大约可利用 ML 潜力将每步时间减半。跨分析和机器学习系统针对蒙特卡罗的广泛基准证实了精确的测温和准确的热力学。

articles.title: OMNI-P3x universal neural network potential for large-scale computational photochemistry workflows
articles.title_zh: OMNI-P3x 通用神经网络在大规模计算光化学工作流程中的潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational photochemistry supports the design and understanding of new materials. However, the high cost of excited-state quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations makes screening large molecular libraries prohibitively expensive. To address this limitation, we introduce OMNI-P3x, a universal machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) for singlet ground- and excited-state simulations of neutral and charged organic molecules. Trained on both ground- and excited-state conformations, it performs complete computational photochemistry workflows with accuracy approaching TD-DFT. We demonstrate its practical applicability by screening a combinatorial library of 234,375 flavylium derivatives, where the pretrained model performs ground-state geometry optimization and predicts absorption properties without additional QM calculations. Following fine-tuning, we further screen 162,960 xanthene-based dyes, identifying new candidates for red, near-infrared and short-wavelength infrared emission. Furthermore, state-dependent neural charges, learned without reference atomic charges, provide an interpretable picture of intramolecular charge redistribution upon excitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算光化学支持新材料的设计和理解。然而，激发态量子力学（QM）计算的高昂成本使得筛选大型分子库的成本过高。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 OMNI-P3x，这是一种通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)，用于中性和带电有机分子的单线态基态和激发态模拟。它经过基态和激发态构象的训练，可以执行完整的计算光化学工作流程，精度接近 TD-DFT。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算光化学支持新材料的设计和理解。然而，激发态量子力学（QM）计算的高昂成本使得筛选大型分子库的成本过高。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 OMNI-P3x，这是一种通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)，用于中性和带电有机分子的单线态基态和激发态模拟。它经过基态和激发态构象的训练，可以执行完整的计算光化学工作流程，精度接近 TD-DFT。我们通过筛选 234,375 个 flavylium 衍生物的组合库来证明其实际适用性，其中预训练模型执行基态几何优化并预测吸收特性，而无需额外的 QM 计算。经过微调，我们进一步筛选了 162,960 种呫吨基染料，确定了红色、近红外和短波长红外发射的新候选染料。此外，在没有参考原子电荷的情况下学习的状态依赖神经电荷提供了激发时分子内电荷重新分布的可解释图片。

articles.title: Toward light-controlled transverse Wigner ordering in attosecond electron beams
articles.title_zh: 阿秒电子束中光控横向维格纳排序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kinetic fluctuations and space-charge expansion hinder Wigner ordering in free-electron beams. Here we propose a laser-driven route toward transient, substrate-free Wigner ordering that combines photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (PINEM) attosecond bunching, synchronized magnetic focusing, and spatial preconditioning. Classical relaxation and zero-temperature fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo trap benchmarks show that sixfold order survives quantum fluctuations from 1 T to sub-Tesla fields, defining ultrafast preparation targets.
articles.abstract_zh: 动力学波动和空间电荷膨胀阻碍了自由电子束中的维格纳有序化。在这里，我们提出了一种激光驱动的瞬态、无基底维格纳有序路线，该路线结合了光子诱导近场电子显微镜（PINEM）阿秒聚束、同步磁聚焦和空间预处理。经典弛豫和零温度固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗陷阱基准表明，六重阶能够承受从 1 T 到亚特斯拉场的量子涨落，从而定义了超快制备目标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动力学波动和空间电荷膨胀阻碍了自由电子束中的维格纳有序化。在这里，我们提出了一种激光驱动的瞬态、无基底维格纳有序路线，该路线结合了光子诱导近场电子显微镜（PINEM）阿秒聚束、同步磁聚焦和空间预处理。经典弛豫和零温度固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗陷阱基准表明，六重阶能够承受从 1 T 到亚特斯拉场的量子涨落，从而定义了超快制备目标。

articles.title: Magnetometry and slow light in PT-symmetric cavity optomechanics
articles.title_zh: PT 对称腔光力学中的磁力测量和慢光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The generation of optical higher-order sidebands, which produces new frequencies with regular spectral separation, holds significant promise for applications in optical communication and quantum metrology. We investigate second-order sideband generation and tunable slow-fast light effects in a parity-time (PT)-symmetric cavity optomechanics and propose an enhanced magnetometer scheme. We demonstrate that the PT-symmetric structure, an external magnetic field, and the photon tunneling strength provide powerful and flexible control over both the second-order sideband efficiency, as well as the broadening and switching of slow-fast light propagation. Operating in the PT-symmetry-protected phases, our magnetometer based on the second-order sideband achieves a theoretical sensitivity at the picotesla level, surpassing the performance of previous optomechanical approaches. Our results offer new strategies for magnetic field sensing and optical transmission control, paving the way toward applications in quantum sensing and optical information storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学高阶边带的产生可以产生具有规则光谱分离的新频率，为光通信和量子计量领域的应用带来了巨大的希望。我们研究了奇偶时间（PT）对称腔光力学中的二阶边带生成和可调谐慢快光效应，并提出了一种增强的磁力计方案。我们证明，PT 对称结构、外部磁场和光子隧道强度可以对二阶边带效率以及慢速光传播的展宽和切换提供强大而灵活的控制。我们基于二阶边带的磁力计在 PT 对称性保护相位下工作，理论灵敏度达到皮特斯拉级别，超越了以前的光机械方法的性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学高阶边带的产生可以产生具有规则光谱分离的新频率，为光通信和量子计量领域的应用带来了巨大的希望。我们研究了奇偶时间（PT）对称腔光力学中的二阶边带生成和可调谐慢快光效应，并提出了一种增强的磁力计方案。我们证明，PT 对称结构、外部磁场和光子隧道强度可以对二阶边带效率以及慢速光传播的展宽和切换提供强大而灵活的控制。我们基于二阶边带的磁力计在 PT 对称性保护相位下工作，理论灵敏度达到皮特斯拉级别，超越了以前的光机械方法的性能。我们的研究结果为磁场传感和光传输控制提供了新的策略，为量子传感和光信息存储的应用铺平了道路。

articles.title: Annular-curvature effects on high-frequency azimuthal fluctuations in 3D PIC simulations of Hall-thruster plasmas
articles.title_zh: 霍尔推进器等离子体 3D PIC 模拟中环形曲率对高频方位波动的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32385v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Azimuthal instabilities and associated plasma fluctuations play an important role in anomalous cross-field electron transport in Hall thrusters. Kinetic studies often approximate the annular discharge using local Cartesian domains, but the influence of the neglected curvature on threedimensional fluctuation dynamics remains insufficiently quantified. Here, three-dimensional cylindrical electrostatic particle-in-cell simulations assess this geometric effect in a reduced channel-plume model by varying the minimum computational-domain radius rmin at fixed channel width and imposed magnetic-field profile. The dominant channel wavenumbers on the centerline-reference scale remain similar, while pronounced radial amplitude asymmetry develops in the smaller-radius configurations. At rmin = 10 cm and 2 cm, the outer-channel electric-field amplitudes in the dominant wavenumber band exceed the inner-channel values by 26% and 53%, respectively. In the plume, low-wavenumber fluctuations favor the inner region, whereas high-wavenumber components favor the outer region. Density-electric-field covariance is preferentially concentrated in the outer channel and inner plume, with outer-to-inner magnitude ratios of 2.71 and 0.58 at rmin = 2 cm. These persistent spatial preferences connect the geometric redistribution of fluctuations to the correlated axial ExB drift contribution. For the 1.28 cm channel width studied, these results support retaining cylindrical geometry at rmin = 10 cm and 2 cm to resolve local fluctuations and transport-related correlations, even when the imposed magnetic-field profile is unchanged.
articles.abstract_zh: 方位角不稳定性和相关的等离子体波动在霍尔推进器的反常交叉场电子传输中发挥着重要作用。动力学研究通常使用局部笛卡尔域来近似环形放电，但忽略的曲率对三维波动动力学的影响仍然没有充分量化。在这里，三维圆柱形静电颗粒细胞模拟通过改变固定通道宽度和施加的磁场分布下的最小计算域半径 rmin 来评估简化通道羽流模型中的这种几何效应。中心线参考尺度上的主通道波数保持相似，而在较小半径配置中出现明显的径向振幅不对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方位角不稳定性和相关的等离子体波动在霍尔推进器的反常交叉场电子传输中发挥着重要作用。动力学研究通常使用局部笛卡尔域来近似环形放电，但忽略的曲率对三维波动动力学的影响仍然没有充分量化。在这里，三维圆柱形静电颗粒细胞模拟通过改变固定通道宽度和施加的磁场分布下的最小计算域半径 rmin 来评估简化通道羽流模型中的这种几何效应。中心线参考尺度上的主通道波数保持相似，而在较小半径配置中出现明显的径向振幅不对称性。在 rmin = 10 cm 和 2 cm 时，主波数带中的外通道电场幅度分别超过内通道值 26% 和 53%。在羽流中，低波数波动有利于内部区域，而高波数波动有利于外部区域。密度电场协方差优先集中在外部通道和内部羽流中，在 rmin = 2 cm 时，外部与内部的幅度比分别为 2.71 和 0.58。这些持久的空间偏好将波动的几何重新分布与相关的轴向 ExB 漂移贡献联系起来。对于所研究的 1.28 cm 通道宽度，这些结果支持在 rmin = 10 cm 和 2 cm 时保留圆柱形几何形状，以解决局部波动和传输相关的相关性，即使所施加的磁场轮廓不变。

articles.title: A library-based approach for inverse reconstruction of cavity depth using angle-resolved cathodoluminescence
articles.title_zh: 使用角度分辨阴极发光进行腔深度逆重建的基于库的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In nanofabrication processes, accurate metrology is a crucial step for obtaining control over the required critical dimensions in a device. Traditionally, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is used to obtain high resolution measurements of the lateral dimension, but obtaining depth information on a thick sample is more complex. In this work, we use angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (AR-CL) spectroscopy to resolve this third dimension. Using 30 keV electrons in the SEM, CL is created at the bottom of a micrometer scale cavity milled in a gold surface. We show that reflections of the CL off the cavity sidewalls produce an interferogram which is a sensitive probe for the cavity geometry. The interferograms can be modelled using the finite-difference time-domain method, and we demonstrate that a neural network trained on a library of these simulated patterns can be used to reconstruct the cavity depth. This approach establishes a proof of concept for AR-CL based depth reconstruction within a prescribed geometry and could form a route towards advanced three-dimensional metrology of complex nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 在纳米制造过程中，精确计量是控制器件所需关键尺寸的关键步骤。传统上，扫描电子显微镜（SEM）用于获得横向尺寸的高分辨率测量，但获得厚样品的深度信息更为复杂。在这项工作中，我们使用角分辨阴极发光（AR-CL）光谱来解析这个三维。在 SEM 中使用 30 keV 电子，在金表面铣削的微米级空腔底部产生 CL。我们证明了 CL 从腔侧壁的反射会产生干涉图，这是腔几何形状的敏感探针。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在纳米制造过程中，精确计量是控制器件所需关键尺寸的关键步骤。传统上，扫描电子显微镜（SEM）用于获得横向尺寸的高分辨率测量，但获得厚样品的深度信息更为复杂。在这项工作中，我们使用角分辨阴极发光（AR-CL）光谱来解析这个三维。在 SEM 中使用 30 keV 电子，在金表面铣削的微米级空腔底部产生 CL。我们证明了 CL 从腔侧壁的反射会产生干涉图，这是腔几何形状的敏感探针。可以使用有限差分时域方法对干涉图进行建模，并且我们证明了在这些模拟图案库上训练的神经网络可以用于重建腔深度。这种方法为基于 AR-CL 的深度重建在规定的几何形状内建立了概念验证，并且可以形成复杂纳米结构的先进三维计量学的途径。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal state-selective splitting of eigenstates at a polarization exceptional point
articles.title_zh: 极化异常点处本征态的非互易态选择性分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Hermitian photonic systems can be engineered to exhibit exceptional points (EPs), where eigenvalues and eigenstates coalesce. Although perturbations near EPs have mainly been characterized through eigenvalue splitting, the branch-resolved evolution of the coalesced eigenstates under a tunable reciprocity-breaking perturbation remains less systematically explored. Here, we show that tunable nonreciprocal coupling can produce state-selective splitting of the coalesced eigenstates near a second-order polarization EP. Using temporal coupled-mode theory, we find that the corresponding off-diagonal perturbation produces a triangular Hamiltonian in the circular-polarization basis. In the ideal limit, one eigenstate remains pinned to the EP state, whereas the other is continuously reoriented by the perturbation. In a realistic scattering system, residual reverse-polarization conversion weakly displaces the nominally pinned branch, resulting in quasi-pinning. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in a reflective magneto-optical metasurface supporting a circular-polarization EP of the reflection matrix near 582 nm. Full-wave simulations show that a perpendicular magneto-optical bias leaves one reflection eigenstate close to the EP state while reversibly displacing the other on the Poincare sphere. This asymmetric eigenstate evolution manifests as a magnetically tunable circular-dichroic reflection response. Our results establish a nonreciprocal route to state-selective eigenstate control near polarization EPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米光子系统可以设计为表现出特异点（EP），即特征值和特征态合并的地方。尽管EP附近的扰动主要通过特征值分裂来表征，但在可调谐互易破坏扰动下合并本征态的分支解析演化仍然很少被系统地探索。在这里，我们证明可调谐的不可逆耦合可以在二阶偏振 EP 附近产生合并本征态的状态选择性分裂。使用时间耦合模式理论，我们发现相应的非对角扰动在圆偏振基础上产生三角哈密顿量。在理想极限下，一种本征态保持固定在 EP 态，而另一种则通过扰动不断重新定向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米光子系统可以设计为表现出特异点（EP），即特征值和特征态合并的地方。尽管EP附近的扰动主要通过特征值分裂来表征，但在可调谐互易破坏扰动下合并本征态的分支解析演化仍然很少被系统地探索。在这里，我们证明可调谐的不可逆耦合可以在二阶偏振 EP 附近产生合并本征态的状态选择性分裂。使用时间耦合模式理论，我们发现相应的非对角扰动在圆偏振基础上产生三角哈密顿量。在理想极限下，一种本征态保持固定在 EP 态，而另一种则通过扰动不断重新定向。在现实的散射系统中，残余反向偏振转换微弱地取代了名义上钉扎的分支，从而导致准钉扎。我们在支持 582 nm 附近反射矩阵圆偏振 EP 的反射磁光超表面中以数值方式演示了这种机制。全波模拟表明，垂直磁光偏置使一个反射本征态接近 EP 态，同时在庞加莱球上可逆地取代另一个。这种不对称本征态演化表现为磁可调圆二向色反射响应。我们的结果建立了一种在极化 EP 附近进行状态选择性本征态控制的非互易途径。

articles.title: AI-Assisted Topological High-Harmonic Spectroscopy for Characterizing Crystal Symmetries and Nonlinear Responses
articles.title_zh: 用于表征晶体对称性和非线性响应的人工智能辅助拓扑高次谐波光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured light has emerged as a unique tool for probing nonlinear light-matter interactions. Particularly interesting is its interaction with anisotropic media, such as crystalline materials, whose anisotropic responses encode information about their electronic properties. Recently, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy was introduced as an all-optical approach to extract the anisotropic nonlinear response of graphene from harmonic spatial intensity profiles. Here, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy is combined with artificial intelligence (AI) to retrieve the anisotropic non-linear response and crystal symmetry of atomically thin materials. A convolutional neural network is trained and validated to learn the inverse mapping between harmonic far-field intensity profiles and the nonlinear response of materials exhibiting different rotational symmetries. Comparisons with microscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations demonstrate the accurate retrieval of distinct effective nonlinear responses in single-symmetry crystals, such as single-layer graphene and bilayer graphene with different stacking orders, and in crystals exhibiting multiple symmetry components, such as monolayer hexagonal boron nitride. Macroscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations assess the robustness and applicability limits of the technique. These results establish AI-assisted topological high-harmonic spectroscopy as a fast, contactless tool for characterizing nonlinear optical responses and crystal symmetries without phase-resolved measurements, opening prospects for applications to complex systems such as polycrystals and van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构光已成为探测非线性光与物质相互作用的独特工具。特别有趣的是它与各向异性介质（例如晶体材料）的相互作用，其各向异性响应编码有关其电子特性的信息。最近，拓扑高次谐波光谱作为一种全光学方法被引入，从谐波空间强度分布中提取石墨烯的各向异性非线性响应。在这里，拓扑高次谐波光谱与人工智能（AI）相结合，以检索原子薄材料的各向异性非线性响应和晶体对称性。卷积神经网络经过训练和验证，可以学习谐波远场强度分布与表现出不同旋转对称性的材料的非线性响应之间的逆映射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构光已成为探测非线性光与物质相互作用的独特工具。特别有趣的是它与各向异性介质（例如晶体材料）的相互作用，其各向异性响应编码有关其电子特性的信息。最近，拓扑高次谐波光谱作为一种全光学方法被引入，从谐波空间强度分布中提取石墨烯的各向异性非线性响应。在这里，拓扑高次谐波光谱与人工智能（AI）相结合，以检索原子薄材料的各向异性非线性响应和晶体对称性。卷积神经网络经过训练和验证，可以学习谐波远场强度分布与表现出不同旋转对称性的材料的非线性响应之间的逆映射。与微观高次谐波产生模拟的比较表明，可以准确检索单对称晶体（例如具有不同堆叠顺序的单层石墨烯和双层石墨烯）以及表现出多种对称成分的晶体（例如单层六方氮化硼）中不同的有效非线性响应。宏观高次谐波产生模拟评估了该技术的稳健性和适用性限制。这些结果确立了人工智能辅助拓扑高次谐波光谱作为一种快速、非接触式工具，无需相位分辨测量即可表征非线性光学响应和晶体对称性，为多晶和范德华异质结构等复杂系统的应用开辟了前景。

articles.title: Recipe for near-unity efficient frequency conversion via transient molecular modulation
articles.title_zh: 通过瞬态分子调制实现近乎一致的高效频率转换的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frequency transduction technologies are an essential element for interfacing devices operating at distinct spectral regions. Specifically, the conversion of weak signals between different wavelengths is a fundamental requirement of quantum networks, where conversion efficiency is critical for preserving the statistical properties of light. In this regard, molecular modulation in gas-filled hollow-core fibers offers a promising approach for highly-tunable linear frequency conversion of classical and quantum light. However, recent experimental studies in this subject have struggled to overcome a saturation in conversion efficiency to about 70%, which, although high, might impair the faithful transfer of quantum properties upon conversion. In this work, we discuss a route to surpass this limitation that identifies the key factors to consider for obtaining quantum efficiencies exceeding 99%. These results might pave the way to viable fiber-based quantum transduction schemes for next-generation quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 频率转换技术是在不同频谱区域运行的接口设备的基本要素。具体来说，不同波长之间微弱信号的转换是量子网络的基本要求，其中转换效率对于保持光的统计特性至关重要。在这方面，充气空心光纤中的分子调制为经典光和量子光的高度可调线性频率转换提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，最近该主题的实验研究一直在努力克服转换效率达到约 70% 的饱和度，尽管该饱和度很高，但可能会损害转换时量子特性的忠实传递。在这项工作中，我们讨论了超越这一限制的途径，确定了获得超过 99% 的量子效率时需要考虑的关键因素。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 频率转换技术是在不同频谱区域运行的接口设备的基本要素。具体来说，不同波长之间微弱信号的转换是量子网络的基本要求，其中转换效率对于保持光的统计特性至关重要。在这方面，充气空心光纤中的分子调制为经典光和量子光的高度可调线性频率转换提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，最近该主题的实验研究一直在努力克服转换效率达到约 70% 的饱和度，尽管该饱和度很高，但可能会损害转换时量子特性的忠实传递。在这项工作中，我们讨论了超越这一限制的途径，确定了获得超过 99% 的量子效率时需要考虑的关键因素。这些结果可能为下一代量子网络的可行的基于光纤的量子传导方案铺平道路。

articles.title: Path-probability gradients for optimizing force fields against dynamical observables
articles.title_zh: 针对动态可观测值优化力场的路径概率梯度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning force fields inherit the errors of the electronic-structure methods used to generate their training data, and refining them against experimental measurements provides a direct route beyond this limit. However, such refinement remains difficult for dynamical observables because differentiating chaotic molecular trajectories yields unstable gradients. Here, we introduce PathGrad, which differentiates Langevin path probabilities instead of the trajectories themselves. The resulting gradient estimator is accumulated on the fly from thermal noise and force derivatives, and its variance remains stable as the trajectory length increases. We validated the gradient estimator against finite-difference calculations and used it to fine-tune molten-copper and water potentials against experimental diffusion coefficients together with structural constraints. For water, jointly optimizing diffusion and the oxygen-oxygen radial distribution function also improves the predictions of shear viscosity and rotational relaxation, neither of which is included in the optimization objective. Alignment at a single temperature also improves the apparent activation energies of multiple dynamical observables, bringing their temperature dependences closer to experiments. Moreover, the optimized potential exhibits smaller force errors relative to an independent, higher-level quantum-chemical reference, indicating that alignment with experiments improves the fidelity of the potential energy surface beyond the fitted targets. PathGrad thus establishes a general framework for incorporating experimental observables directly into force field optimizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习力场继承了用于生成训练数据的电子结构方法的误差，并根据实验测量对其进行改进，提供了超越此限制的直接途径。然而，这种细化对于动态可观测量仍然很困难，因为微分混沌分子轨迹会产生不稳定的梯度。在这里，我们引入 PathGrad，它区分 Langevin 路径概率而不是轨迹本身。所得的梯度估计器是根据热噪声和力导数即时累积的，并且随着轨迹长度的增加，其方差保持稳定。我们根据有限差分计算验证了梯度估计器，并用它根据实验扩散系数和结构约束来微调熔融铜和水势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习力场继承了用于生成训练数据的电子结构方法的误差，并根据实验测量对其进行改进，提供了超越此限制的直接途径。然而，这种细化对于动态可观测量仍然很困难，因为微分混沌分子轨迹会产生不稳定的梯度。在这里，我们引入 PathGrad，它区分 Langevin 路径概率而不是轨迹本身。所得的梯度估计器是根据热噪声和力导数即时累积的，并且随着轨迹长度的增加，其方差保持稳定。我们根据有限差分计算验证了梯度估计器，并用它根据实验扩散系数和结构约束来微调熔融铜和水势。对于水，联合优化扩散和氧-氧径向分布函数还改进了剪切粘度和旋转弛豫的预测，但这两者都不包含在优化目标中。单一温度下的对齐还提高了多个动态可观测量的表观活化能，使它们的温度依赖性更接近实验。此外，相对于独立的、更高级别的量子化学参考，优化后的势表现出更小的力误差，这表明与实验的对齐提高了势能表面超出拟合目标的保真度。因此，PathGrad 建立了一个将实验观测值直接纳入力场优化的通用框架。

articles.title: Whistler instability driven by electron trapping in magnetic dips
articles.title_zh: 磁倾角中电子俘获驱动的惠斯勒不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using fully kinetic particle-in-cell simulations, we show how free energy released by an ion-scale instability reaches electron scales through its effect on the electron distribution. An initial ion temperature anisotropy drives partly compressional ion cyclotron waves, which form magnetic dips. Electrons trapped in these dips develop an enhanced temperature anisotropy and butterfly-shaped distributions, similar to those observed by spacecraft in the Earth's magnetosheath. By tracking the energy transfer in velocity space, we show that the gradients created by trapping drive whistler waves through cyclotron resonance. The whistlers in turn scatter the electrons in pitch angle, flattening velocity-space gradients and heating the electrons along the magnetic field. As a result, the electron anisotropy drops to about half of the double-adiabatic prediction once the whistler power peaks. Our results show that it is the shape of the electron distribution in magnetic dips, rather than its temperature anisotropy alone, that drives the whistlers.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用全动力学的细胞内粒子模拟，我们展示了离子尺度不稳定性释放的自由能如何通过其对电子分布的影响到达电子尺度。初始离子温度各向异性驱动部分压缩离子回旋波，形成磁倾角。被困在这些凹陷中的电子会产生增强的温度各向异性和蝴蝶形分布，类似于航天器在地球磁鞘中观察到的情况。通过跟踪速度空间中的能量传递，我们表明捕获产生的梯度通过回旋共振驱动哨声波。哨声依次以俯仰角散射电子，使速度空间梯度变平并沿磁场加热电子。因此，一旦哨声功率达到峰值，电子各向异性就会下降到双绝热预测的一半左右。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用全动力学的细胞内粒子模拟，我们展示了离子尺度不稳定性释放的自由能如何通过其对电子分布的影响到达电子尺度。初始离子温度各向异性驱动部分压缩离子回旋波，形成磁倾角。被困在这些凹陷中的电子会产生增强的温度各向异性和蝴蝶形分布，类似于航天器在地球磁鞘中观察到的情况。通过跟踪速度空间中的能量传递，我们表明捕获产生的梯度通过回旋共振驱动哨声波。哨声依次以俯仰角散射电子，使速度空间梯度变平并沿磁场加热电子。因此，一旦哨声功率达到峰值，电子各向异性就会下降到双绝热预测的一半左右。我们的结果表明，驱动哨声的是磁陷中电子分布的形状，而不是其温度各向异性本身。

articles.title: Making Reconnection Cooler: A relativistic resistive magnetohydrodynamics model for radiative collisionless reconnection
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28035v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Relativistic magnetic reconnection around astrophysical compact objects is a likely site for particle energization and multiwavelength emission. Kinetic theory has substantially modelled such collisionless radiative relativistic reconnection using a radiative drag force countering the acceleration of the particles. Here, we systematically derive an energy-momentum sink term in relativistic resistive magnetohydrodynamics (RRMHD), informed by kinetic theory and coupled with a charge-starved resistivity prescription which reproduces the fast reconnection rate seen in kinetic calculations, to model radiative losses. We show that our radiative loss term accurately captures important macroscopic properties -- including the temperature in the reconnection layer and the bulk motion energy distribution of the out-flowing plasma -- for inverse Compton cooling applied to two-dimensional RRMHD simulations of a reconnection layer and benchmarked to kinetic simulations. Our results hold in various cooling regimes with a one-to-one mapping to kinetic theory. Our radiative model lays a foundation for future RRMHD simulations of plasma in the relativistic radiative regime, such as in reconnection sites in a local turbulent flow or globally in the magnetospheres of black holes and neutron stars.

articles.title: Spin-adapted state preparation for quantum chemistry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.30014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum phase estimation for strongly-correlated molecules requires an initial state of high overlap with the true ground state, and preparing one is a significant fault-tolerant cost. Matrix product states (MPS) produced by the density matrix renormalisation group (DMRG) are a leading choice, yet existing circuits treat their tensors as dense or do not use the full symmetries present in molecular electronic Hamiltonians. In quantum chemistry, DMRG also exploits total spin, a non-abelian symmetry, storing one amplitude per spin multiplet instead of one per state. We show that the reduced tensors of such a spin-adapted MPS, labelled by the steps of the unitary group approach, form an abelian-symmetric MPS, which existing block-sparse preparation protocols can load at a cost set by the multiplet count. One state-independent rotation per site, determined by a Clebsch-Gordan coefficient, then returns the state to the occupation basis. We provide resource estimates for our circuits on singlet ground states of active space models of iron-sulphur clusters, finding improvements in Toffoli count up to 135× compared to dense methods and 4.9× compared to block-sparse methods applied to the same states, with up to 3.7× fewer ancilla qubits required.

articles.title: Beyond Quantum Mechanics: From Nonlinear to Emergent and Solitonic Approaches
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31304v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This thesis investigates the role of nonlinearity in approaches beyond standard quantum mechanics, following a path from modifications of quantum dynamics to the possibility of an emergent statistical description. We first examine Weinberg's nonlinear formulation and its implications for the statistical interpretation of quantum states. We then discuss de Broglie-Bohm theory and the Madelung formulation, which provide a framework for comparing guided trajectories with ensemble descriptions involving momentum fluctuations. The Hall-Reginatto exact uncertainty approach identifies the fluctuation energy associated with the quantum potential. We then investigate whether quantum dynamics can emerge from the collective statistics of solitons in a fluctuating background, using a Galilean formulation of the complex sine-Gordon model. Within a weak-noise approximation, we identify a regime in which the statistics of the soliton centres reproduce the Schrödinger equation, with an effective action scale determined by the background fluctuations. This correspondence is established for Gaussian ensembles and potentials at most quadratic. These results provide a concrete setting for exploring how quantum dynamics can emerge as a statistical description of underlying nonlinear field dynamics.

articles.title: CHORD: Learning Latent Spaces for Constrained Stellarator Design
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31486v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In high-dimensional, PDE-constrained design, interpolating between known feasible solutions can reveal trade-offs without repeating expensive optimization campaigns. In stellarator design for fusion energy, direct interpolation of plasma boundary parameters can violate physical constraints even when both endpoints are feasible. Learned latent representations can capture nonlinear relationships among design variables, but latent interpolation can still cross infeasible regions, and conditioning on target metrics can become inconsistent with the decoded design. We introduce CHORD, a conditional variational autoencoder that penalizes predicted constraint violations along decoded latent interpolants during training, paired with self-consistent inference that aligns conditioning with the decoded design's predicted metrics. Geometric benchmarks show the benefit of regularizing latent interpolants. In stellarator interpolation between distinct geometry families, CHORD reaches up to 81% simulator-validated mid-segment feasibility, compared with 50% for an unregularized conditional VAE and 28% for direct interpolation of boundary parameters. Ablations show that both ingredients are needed for this gain. Beyond interpolation, latent-space optimization finds simulator-feasible designs, while self-consistent sampling produces more diverse feasible alternatives. On the ConStellaration benchmark, chord-regularized models with linear conditioning reuse data from five optimization campaigns and simulator-labeled rescalings to populate the Pareto front more densely. After low-fidelity screening, 93% of 1.2k generated candidates pass the benchmark's high-fidelity feasibility test. We release code and over 600k designs for stellarator generation, surrogate training, and front-filling evaluation. These results support feasibility-aware latent learning for exploring constrained design trade-offs.

articles.title: Neural-operator acceleration of bidirectional phonon Boltzmann-Fourier coupling for multiscale heat transport in silicon fin arrays
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Localized heating in semiconductor devices can produce non-diffusive phonon transport near heat-generating regions, while heat spreading through the surrounding substrate remains well described by Fourier conduction. We present a hybrid framework that couples a pretrained neural operator for the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) within individual fins to a Fourier model of a shared substrate. To reduce the cost of repeated BTE solves across fin positions and coupling iterations, a DeepONet maps each fin's substrate-interface temperature and heating state to its temperature and heat-flux fields. The operator is trained on interface temperatures generated by a linearized proxy of the coupled problem, which avoids explicit training data collection from full coupled runs. An energy-balance penalty regularizes the learned operator, and a mixed finite-element formulation represents substrate heat flux in an H(div)-conforming space. The two models exchange temperature and normal heat flux through a non-overlapping Schwarz iteration with adaptive Aitken relaxation. We evaluate the framework on an idealized three-dimensional array of 100 silicon fins. For a held-out switching configuration, the neural-operator-Fourier solution differs from the direct BTE-Fourier reference by a maximum of 0.3 K in temperature and 0.6% in relative flux across all fins. Excluding the one-time substrate factorization, the coupled surrogate run takes about 50 s, compared with 2 h 28 min for direct coupling, a speedup of approximately 180x. Additional held-out switching patterns converge with the same trained operator. These results demonstrate neural-operator acceleration of bidirectional kinetic-continuum coupling for the tested geometry and material. This bidirectional strategy may extend to other multiscale materials problems coupling learned local neural models with continuum solvers.

articles.title: Parton Physics in the Schwinger Model from Matrix Product States
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Parton distribution functions (PDFs) and light-cone distribution amplitudes (LCDAs) encode the non-perturbative structure of hadrons in terms of their partonic constituents. They are defined through matrix elements containing parton operators that are connected by a Wilson line along a light-front direction, which makes them difficult to access in Euclidean lattice calculations. We demonstrate how parton functions can be directly obtained in Minkowski space using the Hamiltonian framework. We compute fermion and antifermion PDFs, LCDAs, and decay constants of the vector meson in the Schwinger model for several fermion masses. States in Hilbert space are efficiently represented by tensor networks, with an expressivity that is systematically controlled by a bond dimension. The light-front Wilson line is implemented as a stepwise evolution on the lattice that alternates spatial shifts of an external charge with Trotterized time-evolution steps acting on a matrix product state. All systematic uncertainties are quantified by varying and extrapolating in the lattice spacing, volume, bond dimension, gauge-field truncation, and Trotter step width. The slow growth of the entanglement entropy makes moderate bond dimensions sufficient, which supports the feasibility of using tensor networks for computing light-front matrix elements in more general settings. We confirm that the computed distributions fulfill the expected normalizations, momentum sum rules, and symmetry properties.

articles.title: A quantum-inspired spiking variational autoencoder for robust anomaly detection at the LHC
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Model-agnostic searches for new physics at the Large Hadron Collider utilise unsupervised anomaly detection, where quantum and neuromorphic detectors represent potential approaches. We develop the first fully spiking variational autoencoder, a quantum-inspired spiking variational autoencoder (QSVAE), built on the quantum-inspired leaky integrate-and-fire (QLIF) neuron. In this work we recast the neuron from a measurement-based circuit to a differentiable computational unit. This neuron is benchmarked against other classical, spiking, and quantum models on an LHC di-jet latent space. We show that under noise perturbations the QLIF network retains 0.95 of its clean accuracy, while accuracy retention for twelve classical models falls to 0.74-0.85. The QLIF anomaly scores respond 3.5-fold less to the noise perturbation than any of the control model's scores. We compare against a periodic classical control that reproduces the QLIF effect, isolating it to the sin² membrane map. This membrane map is a native regulariser that decouples robustness from model capacity supplied by the qubit state space. We demonstrate this through several benchmarks and ablation studies to characterise the performance landscape of the quantum-neuromorphic model space.

articles.title: Plasma Heating by Magnetic Reconnection and Alfven Waves in Collisionless Shocks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32287v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In collisionless shock waves, the ion and electron temperatures generally differ, and the mechanisms governing their energy partitioning remain one of the central unresolved problems in shock physics. Although energy can be exchanged through various plasma waves generated upstream and downstream of the shock, large-amplitude Alfven waves excited by ions reflected at the shock front play a particularly important role in high-Mach-number shocks. In this study, we focus on these large-amplitude Alfven waves and examine not only plasma heating through conventional wave-particle interactions but also preferential ion heating driven by magnetic reconnection within current sheets formed by trains of such waves. Using particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, we find a correlation between ion heating and X-type magnetic field structures in the downstream region, and we suggest that magnetic reconnection and magnetic annihilation within these current sheets influence the energy partitioning between ions and electrons.

articles.title: Programmable multipartite entanglement analogues
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.32759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum entanglement underpins the quantum information science. Its multipartite forms distribute coherence across several subsystems, but controlling their composition and order is increasingly difficult as more subsystems participate. Classical nonseparable waves provide accessible analogues of these structures, although existing implementations largely fix the participating degrees of freedom through their generating architectures. Here we overcome this constraint by making multipartiteness itself programmable in electromagnetic fields. A spatiotemporal metasurface reconfigures the identity and number of coherently linked state spaces independently across polarization, frequency, orbital angular momentum, wavevector direction, and orthogonal envelope modes. We realize complete Bell-like and Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger-like families from bipartite to five-partite order and exchange constituents at fixed order. To our knowledge, the five-partite state has the highest multipartite order experimentally realized in classical electromagnetic fields. These results establish the distribution of coherence across physical state spaces as a programmable property of classical waves and provide a platform for studying selected structures of multipartite quantum states without invoking quantum entanglement or nonlocality.

articles.title: How gravity stabilises instability: the case of magnetic micro-convection
articles.abstract: arXiv:2310.15323v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finding solutions for better mixing in microfluidics remains an important challenge, including understanding fundamental aspects of these processes. Here we investigate the magnetic micro-convection on water and miscible magnetic fluid interface in a vertical microfluidic chip to understand what is the role of gravity, as fluids have different densities. Our model is reduced to two dimensionless quantities - magnetic and gravitational Rayleigh numbers. Numerical simulation results show that static magnetic field generate rich dynamics. This is confirmed quantitatively with careful experiments in initially stagnant fluids. We also show that the length of resulting mixing is limited by gravity. For this we construct a master curve, exploiting the measurements of critical field. A three-fluid layer model and linear stability analysis on its interfaces allows us to explain the limitation mechanism. Our results can help in the development of instability based micromixers.

articles.title: High-energy electron-positron beam collisions with large-angle disruptions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10988v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate that the beam and field dynamics in high-energy electron-positron collisions are governed by a new dimensionless parameter ε. In the high-disruption regime, particles are deflected transversely at angles of order ε while simultaneously undergoing longitudinal deceleration which scales as ε², accompanied by the emergence of a longitudinal electric field with amplitude proportional to ε. We identify the large-angle disruptions (ε ge 1) as a novel extreme regime in which transverse motion becomes strongly relativistic and the braking effect fully arrests, and subsequently reverses, beam propagation. Our theoretical model is in good agreement with three-dimensional electromagnetic particle-in-cell simulations. Existing beam-beam studies are valid only in the ε ll 1 limit. For proposed plasma-based linear colliders operating in the quantum regime, notable beam-beam effects generate low-energy secondary particles whose ε can approach unity; the collision dynamics and behavior of these particles may therefore require fully electromagnetic particle-in-cell simulations for accurate modeling.

articles.title: Identifiability Limits of Physics-Informed Inference for Spatial Stochastic Dynamics from Static Snapshots
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01749v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Despite increasing scale and resolution, many biological measurements provide only a static snapshot of molecular positions rather than the dynamics that produced them. By combining flexible representations with mechanistic constraints, physics-informed machine learning offers a promising route to inferring these dynamics from static snapshots. Motivated by subcellular imaging of gene expression, we ask when a static spatial pattern of molecules can identify spatially varying diffusivity, creation, destruction, and boundary exchange, and how different inference schemes perform on the task. A structural identifiability analysis shows that distributed sources are non-identifiable, whereas a point source such as a transcription site can restore identifiability. These limits are further shaped by seemingly innocuous modeling choices: the boundary conditions, the spatial regularity of the underlying dynamics, and even the stochastic calculus convention. We then adapt several physics-informed schemes, differing in how they represent the solution and enforce the governing equations, and demonstrate effective inference from a single snapshot. Physics-informed approaches can thus recover spatial heterogeneities of biological dynamics from static data, but their use should be accompanied and guided by careful identifiability analysis for meaningful interpretation of the results.

articles.title: A broadband, individually addressable 2D-3D photonic integrated circuit for trapped-ion qubit control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25062v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Trapped ions provide a high-fidelity platform for quantum information processing, yet delivery of multiple, distinct wavelengths across large networks of interaction zones remains a bottleneck. Conventional free-space light delivery lacks scalability, while on-chip grating couplers suffer from narrow operational bandwidth that increases circuit footprint and optical interfacing complexity. Here we show a broadband photonic integrated circuit capable of addressing individual ion locations. The circuit combines a planar waveguide lens with a micromirror fabricated using two-photon polymerization at wafer scale. Optical characterization demonstrates three individual addressing spots from λ = 405- 880,nm with -25,dB average intensity crosstalk at 5,mum pitch. We trap ⁴⁰Ca⁺ above the mirror to demonstrate preferential repumping and utilize ¹³⁸Ba⁺ ions to characterize optical crosstalk far away from the mirror. Charging of the dielectric and silicon structures currently limits a full experimental demonstration of the devices' capabilities but could be mitigated in future designs. This monolithic photonic architecture could bring broadband addressing in an on-chip modality to trapped-ion technology. More broadly, combining additive manufacturing with established quantum device fabrication techniques could open new possibilities for implementing advanced quantum architectures.

articles.title: 2D Magnetic Reconnection and Plasmoid Evolution in Partially Ionized Plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08448v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Magnetic reconnection in partially ionized plasmas is an important channel for energy release. While the plasmoid instability is well characterized in 2D fully ionized plasmas, its behavior in the presence of neutral-dominated plasma remains poorly understood in the nonlinear, high-Lundquist-number (S = 10⁵) regime. We present high-resolution (16384 × 4096 cells) isothermal two-dimensional two-fluid (ion + neutral) simulations of Harris-sheet reconnection without ionization or recombination, comparing fully ionized and partially ionized (ionization fraction ξ = 10⁻¹ and 10⁻²) regimes. Ambipolar drift promotes early current-sheet thinning, while ion-neutral decoupling modifies the subsequent plasmoid evolution. During the simulated interval, the ξ=10⁻² run remains fragmented into a chain of small plasmoids, whereas the fully ionized run develops a macroscopic ``monster'' plasmoid. Below the neutral-ion decoupling scale ellᵣₘ dₑc, ions concentrate into the plasmoids, reaching peak overdensities ρᵢ/ρᵢ,₀ approx 10 (ξ = 10⁻¹) and 3-5×10³ (ξ = 10⁻²), while the neutrals remain comparatively smooth. This local pile-up raises the ionization fraction and recouples the two fluids within the plasmoids. Measured from the out-of-plane electric field at the reconnection sites, the reconnection rate in the ξ = 10⁻² case achieves Rᵣₘ ᵣₑcapprox0.01, whereas the ξ = 10⁻¹ case rises to a rate approx0.02 and further to 0.035 when apparent coalescence occurs. In the ξ = 10⁻² case, the ambipolar drift drives a rapid ion inflow sim0.5,vA,₀ into the layer at the same reconnection sites, far above the neutral inflow velocity sim0.1,vA,₀. Here, vA,₀ is the upstream total Alfvén speed.

articles.title: GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.

articles.title: Boundary Representation-Driven Graph Transformer Modeling for Machining Operation Sequencing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31661v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machining process planning is inherently complex due to the interdependence between part geometry, machining operations, and evolving manufacturable states. Traditional approaches rely heavily on expert knowledge and rule-based systems, limiting scalability and automation. While recent machine learning methods have shown promise, most operate on simplified geometric representations, such as voxels or hand-crafted features, which fail to fully exploit the rich geometric and topological information encoded in Boundary Representation (B-Rep) models. In this work, we propose a graph transformer-based framework for geometry-to-sequence learning that directly predicts machining operation sequences from B-Rep design geometry. The proposed method constructs topology-aware graphs from B-Rep entities, where faces and their adjacencies are encoded as node and edge features capturing both geometric and relational information. A graph neural network encoder learns geometry-aware embeddings, which are then used to condition a dual-decoder transformer that autoregressively generates machining operation sequences. This formulation enables the model to capture both operation-type prediction and process-level ordering constraints directly from design geometry, without requiring intermediate feature extraction or machining-state representations. Experiments on a dataset of 2,991 synthetic machined parts demonstrate strong performance, achieving 95% accuracy for main operation prediction, 64% accuracy for sub-operation prediction, and 93% accuracy for sequence length prediction. Further analysis shows that the model effectively captures precedence relationships and geometry-dependent constraints inherent in machining processes. These results highlight the potential of B-Rep-driven graph learning for scalable and automated machining process planning.

articles.title: Neural Interoperability Protocols: Specifying Compatibility Before Training
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.31670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks are increasingly developed as reusable components, yet their intermediate representations remain difficult to exchange across independently trained models. Existing approaches can align representations or encourage compatible features, but successful transfer between particular models does not by itself define what future implementations must satisfy to interoperate. We introduce Neural Interoperability Protocols (NIPs), a specification-first framework that treats neural compatibility as a set of public interface obligations rather than a property inferred solely from model-pair performance. A NIP specifies an exchange boundary, the semantics and admissibility conditions of exchanged packets, and the downstream computations that recipients must support, independently of the architectures and training procedures implementing it. We investigate this distinction through controlled retrieval, vision, and continuous-memory experiments involving independently trained models, differing architectures and objectives, and later training cohorts.
