articles.title: Strain-transfer at the Cu nanoparticle-Si(111) interface: static atomistic modelling and simulated Bragg CDI
articles.title_zh: 铜纳米颗粒-硅(111)界面处的应变传递：静态原子建模和模拟布拉格相干衍射成像（CDI）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Substrate strain offers a route to control deformation in supported metallic nanoparticles, provided that interfacial coupling transmits the imposed loading into the particle. We assess this feasibility using five static Cu/Si(111) configurations spanning 0-2% biaxial tensile substrate strain. A 211,288-atom Cu particle is supported by a nominally 50 x 50 x 20 nm Si slab with its bottom 1 nm fixed, using the Jelinek modified embeddedatom potential. Relative to the relaxed supported 0% state, Cu-only local fits reveal heterogeneous, anisotropic deformation: particle-wide mean hydrostatic strain is negative at every nonzero loading, from -3.12 x 10-6 to -8.84 x 10-6, while the upper-particle mean varies nonmonotonically. Simulated Bragg CDI of Cu(111), obtained by inversion of known complex atomic scattering amplitudes, maps loading-dependent projected displacement and strain. The combined atomistic and Bragg CDI representations provide strong preliminary support for the feasibility of substrate-mediated strain transfer in this idealized system and identify spatial signatures for experimental investigation. Experiments remain indispensable to confirm transfer in real Cu/Si(111) nanoparticles and determine its magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 基底应变提供了一种控制负载金属纳米颗粒变形的途径，前提是界面耦合将施加的载荷传递到颗粒中。我们使用跨越 0-2% 双轴拉伸基底应变的五种静态 Cu/Si(111) 配置来评估这种可行性。一个 211,288 个原子的 Cu 粒子由标称尺寸为 50 x 50 x 20 nm 的 Si 板支撑，其底部 1 nm 固定，使用 Jelinek 修改的嵌入原子势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基底应变提供了一种控制负载金属纳米颗粒变形的途径，前提是界面耦合将施加的载荷传递到颗粒中。我们使用跨越 0-2% 双轴拉伸基底应变的五种静态 Cu/Si(111) 配置来评估这种可行性。一个 211,288 个原子的 Cu 粒子由标称尺寸为 50 x 50 x 20 nm 的 Si 板支撑，其底部 1 nm 固定，使用 Jelinek 修改的嵌入原子势。相对于松弛支撑的 0% 状态，仅 Cu 局部拟合揭示了异质、各向异性变形：在每个非零载荷下，颗粒范围平均流体静力学应变为负，从 -3.12 x 10-6 到 -8.84 x 10-6，而上部颗粒平均值非单调变化。 Cu(111) 的模拟布拉格 CDI 通过已知复杂原子散射振幅的反演获得，可绘制依赖于载荷的投影位移和应变。结合的原子和布拉格 CDI 表示为该理想化系统中底物介导的应变转移的可行性提供了强有力的初步支持，并确定了实验研究的空间特征。实验对于确认真实 Cu/Si(111) 纳米粒子中的转移并确定其大小仍然是必不可少的。

articles.title: From raw magnetoresistance to reliable cyclotron masses: A practical guide to processing quantum oscillation data
articles.title_zh: 从原始磁阻到可靠的回旋加速器质量：处理量子振荡数据的实用指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum oscillations are an essential probe of the Fermi surface in conductors, and cyclotron masses extracted using the Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formula are used to evaluate correlation strength and the assignment of topological states. These masses depend on choices in signal processing, including the field window, method of background subtraction, and spectral window applied before the Fourier transform. These choices are often guided by visual inspection, yet they can alter spectral features and bias the extracted masses. We show that (1) representing a finite field interval by a single effective field can underestimate the cyclotron mass; (2) polynomial background subtraction can attenuate and shift low-frequency peaks; and (3) spectral tapering can reduce mass bias from leakage between neighboring peaks, at the cost of frequency resolution. We demonstrate these effects using numerical calculations and Shubnikov-de Haas experiments on the rare-earth tritellurides RTe3 (R = Pr, Nd, Gd, Tb) with a dense low-frequency spectrum in the charge ordered state. The examples reveal masses shifting by tens of percent with the field window, apparent peak shifts produced only by the background fit, and a reported departure from LK behavior that resolves into two neighboring frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子振荡是导体费米面的重要探针，使用 Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) 公式提取的回旋质量用于评估相关强度和拓扑态分配。这些质量取决于信号处理中的选择，包括场窗口、背景扣除方法以及傅立叶变换之前应用的光谱窗口。这些选择通常以目视检查为指导，但它们可能会改变光谱特征并使提取的质量产生偏差。我们证明（1）用单个有效场表示有限场间隔会低估回旋加速器质量； (2)多项式背景扣除可以衰减和移动低频峰值； (3)谱锥化可以减少相邻峰之间泄漏造成的质量偏差，但代价是频率分辨率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子振荡是导体费米面的重要探针，使用 Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) 公式提取的回旋质量用于评估相关强度和拓扑态分配。这些质量取决于信号处理中的选择，包括场窗口、背景扣除方法以及傅立叶变换之前应用的光谱窗口。这些选择通常以目视检查为指导，但它们可能会改变光谱特征并使提取的质量产生偏差。我们证明（1）用单个有效场表示有限场间隔会低估回旋加速器质量； (2)多项式背景扣除可以衰减和移动低频峰值； (3)谱锥化可以减少相邻峰之间泄漏造成的质量偏差，但代价是频率分辨率。我们通过数值计算和 Shubnikov-de Haas 实验对稀土三碲化物 RTe3（R = Pr、Nd、Gd、Tb）在电荷有序状态下具有密集的低频频谱来证明这些效应。这些例子揭示了质量随着视场窗口的变化百分之几十，明显的峰值变化仅由背景拟合产生，以及报告的与 LK 行为的偏离，分解为两个相邻频率。

articles.title: Physically Informed Data-Driven Modeling of Low-Pressure Carburizing (LPC): A Self-Calibrating Boundary Condition for Carbon Flux
articles.title_zh: 低压渗碳 (LPC) 的物理知情数据驱动建模：碳通量的自校准边界条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper formulates an extended framework for a hybrid physically informed data-driven model of low-pressure carburizing (LPC), in which diffusive carbon transport in austenite is described by a physical equation, whereas the effective carbon flux across the gas-metal interface is treated as an unknown boundary forcing to be identified from experimental and process data. The basis for this formulation is that, in LPC, the most uncertain part of the model is not bulk diffusion but the transient surface kinetics of carbon uptake by the metal. In contrast to direct empirical relationships of the 'process regime-result' type, the proposed scheme uses machine learning as a closure operator for the boundary condition in the diffusion problem. This operator is calibrated using carbon concentration profiles, integral mass gain, surface concentration, effective case depth, and additional process measurements. Theoretically, the model is positioned as an operator-learning problem in a system constrained by a partial differential equation, physical flux constraints, inverse-problem regularization, and uncertainty quantification. The relationships between the proposed approach and physics-informed neural networks, operator learning, dynamic-system identification, boundary-operator learning, and boundary-control problems are considered. The mathematical formulation, calibration functional, identifiability conditions, preliminary tuning algorithm, and online adaptation scheme are formulated. The proposed approach is considered as a computational basis for developing interpretable digital support for LPC processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为低压渗碳（LPC）的混合物理信息数据驱动模型制定了扩展框架，其中奥氏体中的扩散碳传输由物理方程描述，而穿过气体-金属界面的有效碳通量被视为未知边界强迫，可从实验和过程数据中识别。该公式的基础是，在 LPC 中，模型中最不确定的部分不是体积扩散，而是金属吸收碳的瞬态表面动力学。与“过程状态-结果”类型的直接经验关系相反，所提出的方案使用机器学习作为扩散问题中边界条件的闭包算子。该算子使用碳浓度分布、积分质量增益、表面浓度、有效渗层深度和附加过程测量进行校准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文为低压渗碳（LPC）的混合物理信息数据驱动模型制定了扩展框架，其中奥氏体中的扩散碳传输由物理方程描述，而穿过气体-金属界面的有效碳通量被视为未知边界强迫，可从实验和过程数据中识别。该公式的基础是，在 LPC 中，模型中最不确定的部分不是体积扩散，而是金属吸收碳的瞬态表面动力学。与“过程状态-结果”类型的直接经验关系相反，所提出的方案使用机器学习作为扩散问题中边界条件的闭包算子。该算子使用碳浓度分布、积分质量增益、表面浓度、有效渗层深度和附加过程测量进行校准。理论上，该模型被定位为受偏微分方程、物理通量约束、反问题正则化和不确定性量化约束的系统中的算子学习问题。考虑了所提出的方法与物理信息神经网络、算子学习、动态系统识别、边界算子学习和边界控制问题之间的关系。制定了数学公式、标定函数、可辨识条件、初步调整算法和在线自适应方案。所提出的方法被认为是为 LPC 过程开发可解释的数字支持的计算基础。

articles.title: Defect Engineering of the Water-Carbon Interface: Insights from First-Principles Calculations
articles.title_zh: 水-碳界面的缺陷工程：第一性原理计算的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactions at solid-liquid interfaces are fundamental to hydrovoltaic and catalytic technologies. While carbon nanomaterials have been extensively studied, the role of abundant defects in amorphous carbon remains poorly understood. Here, using first-principles calculations, we systematically investigate how various defects (topological, point, line, edge, and doping defects) modulate water-carbon interactions. We find that armchair-edge defects with dangling bonds reduce the energy barrier for water dissociation by up to 30 times compared with pristine carbon, while di-vacancies exhibit a near-zero Gibbs free energy for hydrogen evolution, enabling potential hydrogen evolution reaction activity on a purely carbon-based interface. Moreover, mono-vacancy defects, characterized by reduced electronic localization, enhance charge transfer to evaporating water molecules by up to 12.4 times, a key factor in evaporation-induced electricity generation. Crucially, we demonstrate that coupling distinct defects produces synergistic effects that outperform individual defects, revealing a promising strategy for designing multifunctional interfaces. These insights establish a defect-engineering framework for the rational design of high-efficiency hydrovoltaic and catalytic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 固液界面的相互作用是水力发电和催化技术的基础。尽管碳纳米材料已被广泛研究，但对无定形碳中大量缺陷的作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，系统地研究了各种缺陷（拓扑缺陷、点缺陷、线缺陷、边缘缺陷和掺杂缺陷）如何调节水-碳相互作用。我们发现，与原始碳相比，具有悬空键的扶手椅边缘缺陷将水解离的能垒降低了多达 30 倍，而双空位则表现出接近于零的析氢吉布斯自由能，从而在纯碳基界面上实现了潜在的析氢反应活性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固液界面的相互作用是水力发电和催化技术的基础。尽管碳纳米材料已被广泛研究，但对无定形碳中大量缺陷的作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，系统地研究了各种缺陷（拓扑缺陷、点缺陷、线缺陷、边缘缺陷和掺杂缺陷）如何调节水-碳相互作用。我们发现，与原始碳相比，具有悬空键的扶手椅边缘缺陷将水解离的能垒降低了多达 30 倍，而双空位则表现出接近于零的析氢吉布斯自由能，从而在纯碳基界面上实现了潜在的析氢反应活性。此外，以电子局域化减少为特征的单空位缺陷可将蒸发水分子的电荷转移增强高达 12.4 倍，这是蒸发诱导发电的关键因素。至关重要的是，我们证明耦合不同的缺陷会产生优于单个缺陷的协同效应，揭示了设计多功能界面的有前途的策略。这些见解为高效水力发电和催化装置的合理设计建立了缺陷工程框架。

articles.title: Metal to Semiconductor Transition in Niobium Sulfoselenide Alloy Films by Compositional Control
articles.title_zh: 通过成分控制实现铌硫硒化物合金薄膜的金属-半导体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have garnered significant interest due to their tunable bandgaps, optical anisotropy, and mechanical flexibility. This study explores the relationship between stoichiometry, structural phase, and electronic transport in niobium sulfoselenide (NbSxSe2-x) thin films. In this study, low-dimensional TMD films were grown with molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) to investigate the effects of varying chalcogen (sulfur and selenium) content in NbSxSe2-x alloys. We focus on tuning electrical resistivity along with the transition from metallic-to-semiconducting behavior through compositional control. These MBE grown films were characterized using in-vacuo x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to analyze the chemical composition. Electrical resistivity of the films and their temperature coefficient of resistance (TCR) were extracted to determine their metallic and semiconducting behavior. Our results show that increasing sulfur content induces a transition from metallic to semiconducting behavior in NbSe2, accompanied by a rise in resistivity. This work highlights the potential for compositional tuning of TMDs for applications in tunable nanoelectronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）由于其可调谐带隙、光学各向异性和机械灵活性而引起了人们的极大兴趣。本研究探讨了硫硒化铌 (NbSxSe2-x) 薄膜的化学计量、结构相和电子输运之间的关系。在本研究中，采用分子束外延 (MBE) 生长低维 TMD 薄膜，以研究不同硫族元素（硫和硒）含量对 NbSxSe2-x 合金的影响。我们专注于通过成分控制来调节电阻率以及从金属到半导体行为的转变。使用真空 X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 来分析这些 MBE 生长的薄膜的化学成分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）由于其可调谐带隙、光学各向异性和机械灵活性而引起了人们的极大兴趣。本研究探讨了硫硒化铌 (NbSxSe2-x) 薄膜的化学计量、结构相和电子输运之间的关系。在本研究中，采用分子束外延 (MBE) 生长低维 TMD 薄膜，以研究不同硫族元素（硫和硒）含量对 NbSxSe2-x 合金的影响。我们专注于通过成分控制来调节电阻率以及从金属到半导体行为的转变。使用真空 X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 来分析这些 MBE 生长的薄膜的化学成分。提取薄膜的电阻率及其电阻温度系数（TCR）以确定其金属和半导体行为。我们的结果表明，硫含量的增加会导致 NbSe2 从金属行为转变为半导体行为，并伴随着电阻率的上升。这项工作凸显了 TMD 成分调整在可调谐纳米电子学应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Oscillatory superconducting proximity effects in a buried Pt interlayer detected by FMR
articles.title_zh: FMR 检测埋藏 Pt 夹层中的振荡超导邻近效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate superconducting proximity effects in NbN/Pt/Py and NbN/Cu/Py trilayers using broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR). The reduction of the spin-pumping contribution to the Py damping below the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) is used to probe the superconducting correlations and electronic density of state in the buried metallic interlayer. For a Cu interlayer, the damping reduction remains finite up to at least 20 nm, in agreement with the large coherence length above 100nm in Cu. In contrast, the damping reduction for a Pt interlayer exhibits a non-monotonic thickness dependence and is fully suppressed above 5 nm. Using the quasiclassical theory, we are able to explain the oscillation in damping reduction below Tc with the coexistence of superconducting and magnetic proximity effects in Pt, which generates oscillations of the superconducting order parameter and electronic density of state in the exchange-splitted Pt interlayer. Our results establish spin-pumping damping as a sensitive probe of superconducting proximity effects in buried metallic layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用宽带铁磁共振 (FMR) 研究 NbN/Pt/Py 和 NbN/Cu/Py 三层中的超导邻近效应。在超导转变温度 (Tc) 以下，自旋泵浦对 Py 阻尼的贡献降低，用于探测埋入金属夹层中的超导相关性和电子态密度。对于 Cu 夹层，阻尼降低在至少 20 nm 范围内仍然有限，这与 Cu 中超过 100 nm 的大相干长度一致。相比之下，Pt 中间层的阻尼降低表现出非单调的厚度依赖性，并且在 5 nm 以上被完全抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用宽带铁磁共振 (FMR) 研究 NbN/Pt/Py 和 NbN/Cu/Py 三层中的超导邻近效应。在超导转变温度 (Tc) 以下，自旋泵浦对 Py 阻尼的贡献降低，用于探测埋入金属夹层中的超导相关性和电子态密度。对于 Cu 夹层，阻尼降低在至少 20 nm 范围内仍然有限，这与 Cu 中超过 100 nm 的大相干长度一致。相比之下，Pt 中间层的阻尼降低表现出非单调的厚度依赖性，并且在 5 nm 以上被完全抑制。利用准经典理论，我们能够用 Pt 中超导和磁邻近效应的共存来解释 Tc 以下阻尼减少的振荡，从而在交换分裂 Pt 夹层中产生超导有序参数和电子状态密度的振荡。我们的结果将自旋泵浦阻尼确立为掩埋金属层中超导邻近效应的敏感探针。

articles.title: Intertwined Magneto-Structural Criticality Driving Heterogeneous Collective-Pseudospin Dynamics in Sr2IrO4
articles.title_zh: 相互交织的磁结构临界驱动 Sr2IrO4 中的异质集体赝自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correlated quantum phenomena arising from spin-orbit-coupled degrees of freedom provide foundational paradigms in emerging quantum technologies and spin-based functionalities. Elucidating the cooperative behaviors of these systems requires a precise probing of their intertwined magnetic and structural configurations. Using complementary resonant X-ray diffraction and high-energy total scattering measurements on single crystals of Sr2IrO4, we observe that spontaneous structural distortions scale quadratically with the magnetic order parameter. Importantly, the lattice distortion inherits the characteristic 2D XY -like critical behavior of the underlying antiferromagnetic order. X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) reveals multiscale, temperature- and wave-vector-dependent magnetic dynamics characterized by compressed-exponential relaxation and signatures of critical slowing down near the magnetic transition. These findings suggest the role of spin-orbit coupling and local structural distortions as the possible mechanism orchestrating such unconventional dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道耦合自由度产生的相关量子现象为新兴量子技术和基于自旋的功能提供了基础范例。阐明这些系统的协作行为需要精确探测它们相互交织的磁性和结构配置。通过对 Sr2IrO4 单晶进行互补共振 X 射线衍射和高能全散射测量，我们观察到自发结构畸变与磁序参数呈二次方关系。重要的是，晶格畸变继承了底层反铁磁序的特征 2D XY 临界行为。 X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 揭示了多尺度、温度和波矢量相关的磁动力学，其特征是压缩指数弛豫和磁转变附近临界减速的特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道耦合自由度产生的相关量子现象为新兴量子技术和基于自旋的功能提供了基础范例。阐明这些系统的协作行为需要精确探测它们相互交织的磁性和结构配置。通过对 Sr2IrO4 单晶进行互补共振 X 射线衍射和高能全散射测量，我们观察到自发结构畸变与磁序参数呈二次方关系。重要的是，晶格畸变继承了底层反铁磁序的特征 2D XY 临界行为。 X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 揭示了多尺度、温度和波矢量相关的磁动力学，其特征是压缩指数弛豫和磁转变附近临界减速的特征。这些发现表明自旋轨道耦合和局部结构扭曲是协调这种非常规动力学的可能机制。

articles.title: A Covalent Bonding Network Using p-Block Elements to Stabilize Lithium-Rich Cathode Materials
articles.title_zh: 使用 p 区元素的共价键合网络来稳定富锂正极材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Li-rich battery cathodes (LixMyOz, where x > y) have sparked significant attention for their high energy densities, but their practical application is currently limited by structural instabilities associated with high-valent redox. Recent work has demonstrated reversible high-potential (de)lithiation with low voltage hysteresis in Li4FeSbO6 (LFSO), but the stabilization mechanism for this unique charging behavior is not fully understood, limiting our ability to apply insights from LFSO to more earth-abundant cathodes. In this paper, we present a covalent Sb-O bonding network in LFSO which is facilitated by the p-block orbital character of Sb. Using ab initio computational modeling, we identify this bonding state and indicate its contributions to crystal stability; we also identify a signature for this bonding network using theoretical and experimental element-specific X-ray spectroscopy. Substituting Sb with other p-block elements preserves this stabilizing bond, pointing to a family of new cathode chemistries beyond LFSO. This work establishes a design principle for development of sustainable energy-dense batteries: p-block elements like Sb possess specific orbital-mediated oxygen bonding which contributes to stability of high-valent layered oxide cathodes.
articles.abstract_zh: 富锂电池正极（LixMyOz，其中x>y）因其高能量密度而引起了人们的广泛关注，但其实际应用目前受到与高价氧化还原相关的结构不稳定性的限制。最近的工作证明了 Li4FeSbO6 (LFSO) 具有低电压滞后的可逆高电位（脱）锂化作用，但这种独特充电行为的稳定机制尚未完全了解，限制了我们将 LFSO 的见解应用到地球资源丰富的阴极的能力。在本文中，我们提出了 LFSO 中的共价 Sb-O 键合网络，这是由 Sb 的 p 区轨道特征促进的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 富锂电池正极（LixMyOz，其中x>y）因其高能量密度而引起了人们的广泛关注，但其实际应用目前受到与高价氧化还原相关的结构不稳定性的限制。最近的工作证明了 Li4FeSbO6 (LFSO) 具有低电压滞后的可逆高电位（脱）锂化作用，但这种独特充电行为的稳定机制尚未完全了解，限制了我们将 LFSO 的见解应用到地球资源丰富的阴极的能力。在本文中，我们提出了 LFSO 中的共价 Sb-O 键合网络，这是由 Sb 的 p 区轨道特征促进的。使用从头计算模型，我们识别了这种键合状态并指出了它对晶体稳定性的贡献；我们还使用理论和实验特定元素 X 射线光谱确定了该键合网络的特征。用其他 p 区元素替代 Sb 可以保留这种稳定键，这表明了 LFSO 之外的一系列新型阴极化学物质。这项工作为开发可持续能量密集型电池建立了设计原则：Sb 等 p 区元素具有特定的轨道介导的氧键，有助于高价层状氧化物阴极的稳定性。

articles.title: Curling Superconducting Vortices by Nematic Fluxon-Skyrmion Interaction
articles.title_zh: 通过向列流子-斯格明子相互作用卷曲超导涡旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting vortex represents a topological entity in type-II superconductors, where the prototypical manifestation of such a macroscopic quantum state holds great promise for applications in future quantum technologies. Deterministic control of the vortex dynamics at the nanoscale is central to enhance superconductors' critical thresholds and design next-generation superconducting quantum devices. However, it is still scientifically challenging due to the intrinsic nature of the vortex pinning landscapes in superconductors. Here, we observe an even-in-field Hall-like signal with about two order of magnitude enhancement in a type-II superconductor/chiral magnet heterostructure, which confines to the field-temperature window where the flux flow coexists with magnetic skyrmions. The polarity of such a giant even-in-field transverse response reverses between orthogonal current directions, suggesting an on-track vortex flow driven by a nematic fluxon-skyrmion interaction analyzed via the extended vortex-viscosity tensor. More critically, a deterministic manipulation of skyrmions at the nanoscale within the hybrid system enables selective and reversible controls over the dissipative behavior and therefore the reconfigurable fluxon transport, mimic the precise control of curling stone in winter Olympic, thereby opening a new avenue towards the exploration of programmable topological and superconducting quantum devices.

articles.abstract_zh_full: Superconducting vortex represents a topological entity in type-II superconductors, where the prototypical manifestation of such a macroscopic quantum state holds great promise for applications in future quantum technologies. Deterministic control of the vortex dynamics at the nanoscale is central to enhance superconductors' critical thresholds and design next-generation superconducting quantum devices.然而，由于超导体中涡旋钉扎景观的本质，这在科学上仍然具有挑战性。 Here, we observe an even-in-field Hall-like signal with about two order of magnitude enhancement in a type-II superconductor/chiral magnet heterostructure, which confines to the field-temperature window where the flux flow coexists with magnetic skyrmions. articles.title: Interstitial Magnetoelectricity in Altermagnetic Electrides
articles.title_zh: 交变磁性电子化合物中的间隙磁电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrides and altermagnets are two distinct yet intriguing classes of quantum materials, characterized by interstitial anionic electrons and nonrelativistic spin splitting, respectively. The recent prediction of Stoner-instability-driven altermagnetic electride provides a natural bridge between these two fields. Here, we investigate the magnetoelectric response and its related spin-polarized transport in the altermagnetic electride Zr₂N monolayer. Using the tight-binding Hubbard model and first-principles calculations, we find that the electric field can break the magnetic compensation between the two interstitial anionic electrons, inducing a finite net magnetization and giving rise to an interstitial electron mediated magnetoelectric response. The magnetoelectric response is further demonstrated through the electrical control of spin conductivity. Our results reveal a magnetoelectric effect in altermagnetic electrides, paving a way towards electride-based spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子化合物和交变磁体是两种不同但有趣的量子材料，其特征分别是间隙阴离子电子和非相对论性自旋分裂。最近对斯托纳不稳定性驱动的交变磁电子的预测为这两个领域之间提供了天然的桥梁。在这里，我们研究了互变磁性电子化合物 Zr2N 单层中的磁电响应及其相关的自旋极化输运。利用紧束缚哈伯德模型和第一性原理计算，我们发现电场可以打破两个间隙阴离子电子之间的磁补偿，诱导有限的净磁化强度并产生间隙电子介导的磁电响应。通过自旋传导性的电控制进一步证明了磁电响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子化合物和交变磁体是两种不同但有趣的量子材料，其特征分别是间隙阴离子电子和非相对论性自旋分裂。最近对斯托纳不稳定性驱动的交变磁电子的预测为这两个领域之间提供了天然的桥梁。在这里，我们研究了互变磁性电子化合物 Zr2N 单层中的磁电响应及其相关的自旋极化输运。利用紧束缚哈伯德模型和第一性原理计算，我们发现电场可以打破两个间隙阴离子电子之间的磁补偿，诱导有限的净磁化强度并产生间隙电子介导的磁电响应。通过自旋传导性的电控制进一步证明了磁电响应。我们的结果揭示了交变磁性电子化合物中的磁电效应，为基于电子化合物的自旋电子器件铺平了道路。

articles.title: Hartree--Fock analysis of the bilayer Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: Hartree--双层哈伯德模型的Fock分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the half-filled Hubbard model on two parallel square lattices with on-site repulsion U>0 and with nearest-neighbor hopping specified by a constant t>0 within each plane and by another constant t_perp ≥ 0 between the planes. Working in the Hartree--Fock approximation, we obtain asymptotic formulas for the Néel temperature and the antiferromagnetic gap ratio in the weak coupling limit. We also determine the behavior of the antiferromagnetic gap ratio near the critical curve separating the paramagnetic and antiferromagnetic regions in the phase diagram. Furthermore, we present numerical phase diagrams away from half-filling, and we make an analytical conjecture regarding their structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了两个平行方格上的半填充哈伯德模型，其现场斥力 U>0，最近邻跳跃由每个平面内的常数 t>0 和平面之间的另一个常数 t_perp ≥ 0 指定。采用 Hartree--Fock 近似，我们获得了弱耦合极限下尼尔温度和反铁磁间隙比的渐近公式。我们还确定了相图中分离顺磁区域和反铁磁区域的临界曲线附近反铁磁间隙比的行为。此外，我们提出了远离半填充的数值相图，并对它们的结构做出了分析猜想。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了两个平行方格上的半填充哈伯德模型，其现场斥力 U>0，最近邻跳跃由每个平面内的常数 t>0 和平面之间的另一个常数 t_perp ≥ 0 指定。采用 Hartree--Fock 近似，我们获得了弱耦合极限下尼尔温度和反铁磁间隙比的渐近公式。我们还确定了相图中分离顺磁区域和反铁磁区域的临界曲线附近反铁磁间隙比的行为。此外，我们提出了远离半填充的数值相图，并对它们的结构做出了分析猜想。

articles.title: Quantum Hall Effect in a 3D Cross-Dimensional Quantum Anomalous Hall System
articles.title_zh: 3D 跨维量子反常霍尔系统中的量子霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We systematically investigate cross-dimensional transport and the resulting quantum Hall effect in 3D quantum anomalous Hall effect systems, which are constructed by coupling two Weyl-semimetal Hamiltonians. Our study unveils that the system hosts highly anisotropic surface states and chiral modes, leading to rich quantum Hall responses. Crucially, we clarify how magnetic fields applied along three high-symmetry directions dictate the evolution of the Chern numbers, chiral modes, and Hall responses. We discover that chiral modes along different directions can originate from distinct mechanisms, giving rise to various magnetic modulation characteristics. Furthermore, we unveil the breakdown of the conventional Chern-number-based bulk-boundary correspondence under magnetic fields, where the Chern numbers alone fail to fully characterize the evolution of the chiral states. This anomalous behavior is attributed to the unique momentum-space distributions of surface bands. These insights are further validated numerically through multi-terminal Hall transport simulations. Our findings expand the understanding of magnetic-field-driven mechanisms in 3D topological systems and provide deeper insights into the interplay between quantized Hall effects and Chern numbers in 3D systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们系统地研究了 3D 量子反常霍尔效应系统中的跨维度输运和由此产生的量子霍尔效应，该系统是通过耦合两个 Weyl 半金属哈密顿量构建的。我们的研究表明，该系统具有高度各向异性的表面态和手性模式，从而产生丰富的量子霍尔响应。至关重要的是，我们阐明了沿三个高对称方向施加的磁场如何决定陈数、手性模式和霍尔响应的演变。我们发现沿不同方向的手性模式可能源自不同的机制，从而产生各种磁调制特性。此外，我们揭示了磁场下传统的基于陈数的体边界对应的分解，其中陈数本身无法完全表征手性态的演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们系统地研究了 3D 量子反常霍尔效应系统中的跨维度输运和由此产生的量子霍尔效应，该系统是通过耦合两个 Weyl 半金属哈密顿量构建的。我们的研究表明，该系统具有高度各向异性的表面态和手性模式，从而产生丰富的量子霍尔响应。至关重要的是，我们阐明了沿三个高对称方向施加的磁场如何决定陈数、手性模式和霍尔响应的演变。我们发现沿不同方向的手性模式可能源自不同的机制，从而产生各种磁调制特性。此外，我们揭示了磁场下传统的基于陈数的体边界对应的分解，其中陈数本身无法完全表征手性态的演化。这种异常行为归因于表面能带独特的动量空间分布。这些见解通过多终端霍尔传输模拟得到了进一步的数值验证。我们的研究结果扩展了对 3D 拓扑系统中磁场驱动机制的理解，并为 3D 系统中量化霍尔效应和陈数之间的相互作用提供了更深入的见解。

articles.title: Local Pressure Induced Quantum Dot to Ring Transition and Aharonov Bohm Effect in Reconfigurable MoTe2 Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 可重构 MoTe2 双层中局部压力诱导量子点到环的跃迁和阿哈罗诺夫玻姆效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that local pressure provides an effective means of engineering reconfigurable quantum confinement in MoTe2 homobilayers. By applying a smooth, spatially varying pressure profile, we show that the confinement geometry can be continuously tuned from a conventional quantum dot to a quantum ring, with the emergence of annular confinement being a distinctive feature of AB-stacked bilayers. This crossover originates from the pressure-induced spatial modulation in the electronic parameters, which produces an off-center minimum in the effective confinement potential, thereby redistributing the ground-state probability density away from the center and giving rise to an annular confinement geometry. In the quantum-ring regime, a perpendicular magnetic field gives rise to a flux-periodic energy spectrum and persistent currents, providing characteristic signatures of the Aharonov-Bohm effect. By coupling the pressure-induced quantum ring to source and drain leads, we further demonstrate pronounced Aharonov-Bohm conductance oscillations, accompanied by real-space current patterns exhibiting constructive and destructive interference at integer and half-integer magnetic flux quanta, respectively. These findings establish locally pressurized MoTe2 bilayers as a lithography-free platform for reconfigurable quantum confinement and realizing pressure-tunable Aharonov-Bohm interferometry in two dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，局部压力提供了一种在 MoTe2 同双层中设计可重构量子限制的有效方法。通过应用平滑的、空间变化的压力分布，我们表明限制几何形状可以从传统的量子点连续调整到量子环，其中环形限制的出现是AB堆叠双层的一个显着特征。这种交叉源于电子参数中压力引起的空间调制，它在有效限制势中产生偏心最小值，从而将基态概率密度重新分布在远离中心的位置，并产生环形限制几何形状。在量子环体系中，垂直磁场产生通量周期能谱和持续电流，提供阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应的特征特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，局部压力提供了一种在 MoTe2 同双层中设计可重构量子限制的有效方法。通过应用平滑的、空间变化的压力分布，我们表明限制几何形状可以从传统的量子点连续调整到量子环，其中环形限制的出现是AB堆叠双层的一个显着特征。这种交叉源于电子参数中压力引起的空间调制，它在有效限制势中产生偏心最小值，从而将基态概率密度重新分布在远离中心的位置，并产生环形限制几何形状。在量子环体系中，垂直磁场产生通量周期能谱和持续电流，提供阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应的特征特征。通过将压力引起的量子环耦合到源极和漏极引线，我们进一步证明了明显的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆电导振荡，并伴随着真实空间电流模式，分别在整数和半整数磁通量量子处表现出相长和相消干涉。这些发现将局部加压的 MoTe2 双层建立为无光刻平台，用于可重构量子限制并在二维材料中实现压力可调的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆干涉测量。

articles.title: Floquet-Induced Valley Polarization and Topological Phases in Twisted Bilayer Graphene Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 扭曲双层石墨烯异质结构中的 Floquet 诱导谷极化和拓扑相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate twisted bilayer graphene (tTBG) heterostructures subjected to circularly polarized light. Inversion symmetry is broken through the combined application of an out-of-plane electric field and the incorporation of insulating substrates, enabling precise control of the valley degrees of freedom and associated topological phases. We identify a regime in which the valley degeneracy is lifted: one valley retains a gapless, linear Dirac-like dispersion, whereas the other develops a finite band gap and becomes electronically inactive. The interplay between Floquet driving and inversion-symmetry breaking induces topological phase transitions characterized by Chern numbers C = -2, C = -1, and C = 0, together with the emergence of perfectly valley-polarized domain-wall channels. Furthermore, magnetic asymmetry arising from proximity to adjacent two-dimensional ferromagnetic contacts enables spin-valley filtering. These findings establish the potential of graphene-based heterostructures as highly tunable systems for controlling spin and valley degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了圆偏振光下的扭曲双层石墨烯（tTBG）异质结构。通过面外电场和绝缘基板的结合，打破了反演对称性，从而能够精确控制谷自由度和相关的拓扑相。我们确定了一种谷简并性被解除的机制：一个谷保留了无带隙、线性狄拉克色散，而另一个谷则形成有限带隙并变得电子不活跃。 Floquet 驱动和反演对称破缺之间的相互作用引起了以陈数 C = -2、C = -1 和 C = 0 为特征的拓扑相变，同时出现了完美的谷极化畴壁通道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了圆偏振光下的扭曲双层石墨烯（tTBG）异质结构。通过面外电场和绝缘基板的结合，打破了反演对称性，从而能够精确控制谷自由度和相关的拓扑相。我们确定了一种谷简并性被解除的机制：一个谷保留了无带隙、线性狄拉克色散，而另一个谷则形成有限带隙并变得电子不活跃。 Floquet 驱动和反演对称破缺之间的相互作用引起了以陈数 C = -2、C = -1 和 C = 0 为特征的拓扑相变，同时出现了完美的谷极化畴壁通道。此外，由于邻近二维铁磁接触而产生的磁不对称性使得自旋谷滤波成为可能。这些发现确立了基于石墨烯的异质结构作为控制自旋和谷自由度的高度可调系统的潜力。

articles.title: Learning free energy across a differentiable temperature range by deep generative modeling
articles.title_zh: 通过深度生成模型学习可微分温度范围内的自由能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free energy governs the directionality, stability, and temperature sensitivity of physical, chemical, and biological transformations. Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an extensive set of thermodynamic states. Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization. TD-FEP thereby unifies one-shot state generation and free energy calculation across a continuous temperature range. We validated TD-FEP across a broad range of applications, including isolated molecules, periodic materials, and chemical reactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由能控制着物理、化学和生物转化的方向性、稳定性和温度敏感性。 Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an ext…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由能控制着物理、化学和生物转化的方向性、稳定性和温度敏感性。 Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an extensive set of thermodynamic states. Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization.因此，TD-FEP 统一了连续温度范围内的一次性状态生成和自由能计算。我们在广泛的应用中验证了 TD-FEP，包括孤立分子、周期性材料和化学反应。

articles.title: Thickness-Dependent Morphology and Electrical Transport in Ultrathin Amorphous MoSi Films
articles.title_zh: 超薄非晶态MoSi薄膜中厚度依赖性形貌和电输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the thickness-dependent surface morphology and electrical transport of ultrathin amorphous Mo50Si50 films deposited by magnetron co-sputtering. Atomic force microscopy of Si-capped heterostructures on Si/SiO2 reveals smooth surfaces throughout the investigated thickness range, with RMS roughness below 0.2 nm and a non-monotonic thickness dependence characterized by a minimum at 1.92 nm. Room-temperature sheet resistance follows an approximately inverse-thickness dependence for films with nominal thicknesses of about 1.9-5 nm, whereas a pronounced deviation from this scaling develops below approximately 1.5-2 nm. Temperature-dependent measurements further reveal a superconducting transition in the 30-nm film, while the 1.54-nm film shows a strong resistance increase upon cooling clearly indicates a superconductor-insulator transition. In the 2-20 K range, the sheet conductance of the 1.54-nm film exhibits a reproducible logarithmic temperature dependence, Gs(T)=G0+Bln(T/T0), consistent with quantum corrections to diffusive transport in a strongly disordered quasi-two-dimensional conductor. These results identify a thickness-sensitive transport regime in ultrathin MoSi while demonstrating that the corresponding heterostructures retain comparatively smooth surface morphology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了磁控共溅射沉积的超薄非晶 Mo50Si50 薄膜的厚度依赖性表面形貌和电传输。 Si/SiO2 上硅封端异质结构的原子力显微镜揭示了整个研究厚度范围内的光滑表面，RMS 粗糙度低于 0.2 nm，非单调厚度依赖性的最小值为 1.92 nm。对于标称厚度约为 1.9-5 nm 的薄膜，室温薄层电阻遵循近似反厚度依赖性，而在低于约 1.5-2 nm 时会出现与此比例的明显偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了磁控共溅射沉积的超薄非晶 Mo50Si50 薄膜的厚度依赖性表面形貌和电传输。 Si/SiO2 上硅封端异质结构的原子力显微镜揭示了整个研究厚度范围内的光滑表面，RMS 粗糙度低于 0.2 nm，非单调厚度依赖性的最小值为 1.92 nm。对于标称厚度约为 1.9-5 nm 的薄膜，室温薄层电阻遵循近似反厚度依赖性，而在低于约 1.5-2 nm 时会出现与此比例的明显偏差。与温度相关的测量进一步揭示了 30 nm 薄膜中的超导转变，而 1.54 nm 薄膜在冷却时显示出强烈的电阻增加，清楚地表明超导体-绝缘体转变。在 2-20 K 范围内，1.54 nm 薄膜的片电导表现出可重复的对数温度依赖性，Gs(T)=G0+Bln(T/T0)，与强无序准二维导体中扩散传输的量子校正一致。这些结果确定了超薄 MoSi 中的厚度敏感传输机制，同时证明相应的异质结构保留了相对光滑的表面形态。

articles.title: Tuning of superconducting and physical properties of Mo₁₋ₓSiₓ thin films for Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于超导纳米线单光子探测器应用的 Mo₁₋ₓSiₓ 薄膜的超导和物理特性的调节
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.28927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the normal-state electrical properties of ultrathin amorphous Mo₁₋ₓSiₓ films deposited by DC magnetron co-sputtering over a broad range of compositions and thicknesses. Films with Si contents of x = 0.14 to 0.5 were deposited on Si/SiO₂ and Si/Si₃N₄ substrates (monocrystalline Si with SiO₂ and S₃N₄ buffer layers respectfully); X-ray diffraction confirms an amorphous structure across the full composition range, while X-ray reflectometry is used to verify film thicknesses. The room-temperature sheet resistance ranges from 110 to 1990 Ω/square, corresponding to resistivities of 125-478 μΩ·cm. The sheet resistance generally increases with increasing Si content and decreasing film thickness, although the coupled variation of composition and thickness limits the quantitative separation of these effects. Additional measurements on thicker reference films show superconducting transition temperatures between 5.2 and 7.7 K, with T_c decreasing monotonically at higher Si contents. A comparison of films on different substrate types shows no systematic difference between Si/SiO₂ and Si/Si₃N₄, while films on Al₂O₃ exhibit elevated sheet resistance at the lower thicknesses. These results characterize the accessible parameter space of our deposition process and provide a basis for the selection of film stoichiometry for detector fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过直流磁控管共溅射沉积的超薄非晶 Mo₁ₓₓSiₓ 薄膜在广泛的成分和厚度范围内的常态电性能。在Si/SiO 2 和Si/Si 3 N 4 衬底（分别具有SiO 2 和S 3 N 4 缓冲层的单晶硅）上沉积Si含量x＝0.14至0.5的薄膜； X 射线衍射证实了整个成分范围内的非晶结构，而 X 射线反射计则用于验证薄膜厚度。室温方块电阻范围为110至1990Ω/平方，对应电阻率为125-478μΩ·cm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了通过直流磁控管共溅射沉积的超薄非晶 Mo₁ₓₓSiₓ 薄膜在广泛的成分和厚度范围内的常态电性能。在Si/SiO 2 和Si/Si 3 N 4 衬底（分别具有SiO 2 和S 3 N 4 缓冲层的单晶硅）上沉积Si含量x＝0.14至0.5的薄膜； X 射线衍射证实了整个成分范围内的非晶结构，而 X 射线反射计则用于验证薄膜厚度。室温方块电阻范围为110至1990Ω/平方，对应电阻率为125-478μΩ·cm。薄层电阻通常随着硅含量的增加和膜厚度的减小而增加，尽管成分和厚度的耦合变化限制了这些效应的定量分离。对较厚参考薄膜的额外测量显示超导转变温度在 5.2 至 7.7 K 之间，T_c 在较高 Si 含量下单调下降。对不同基材类型上的薄膜进行比较表明，Si/SiO2 和 Si/Si3N4 之间没有系统差异，而 Al2O3 上的薄膜在较低厚度下表现出较高的薄层电阻。这些结果表征了我们的沉积过程的可访问参数空间，并为探测器制造的薄膜化学计量的选择提供了基础。

articles.title: Finite-size reversal of a multiparticle correction to local spin spectra in a flux-disordered Kitaev honeycomb model
articles.title_zh: 通量无序 Kitaev 蜂窝模型中局部自旋谱多粒子校正的有限尺寸反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A spin flip in the Kitaev honeycomb model changes the flux background and therefore the Hamiltonian seen by the matter fermions. Can a one-particle approximation with the correct total spin intensity nevertheless misestimate the depth of a depression in the local spin spectrum? We test this question in a frozen, flux-disordered ensemble by retaining the actual one-particle transition energies and relative spectral weights after the spin flip, then rescaling those weights to match the full intensity. We measure the depression by subtracting the central intensity from the average at two flanking frequencies. For spin-created states with odd final quasiparticle number and nonzero one-particle weight, restoring multiparticle weight shallows the depression on 24 sites and deepens it on both 1,536-site shapes and the 3,456- and 6,144-site tori, as judged by the median paired correction at each of two energy resolutions. For these states, the one-particle approximation overestimates the mean dip depth by about 16-18% on 24 sites and underestimates it by 33-56% in the 6,144-site sample. Extrapolating from 24 sites would therefore give the wrong sign for this correction on those four larger tori under the same disorder prescription.
articles.abstract_zh: 在Kitaev蜂窝模型中，自旋翻转会改变磁通背景，从而改变物质费米子所看到的哈密顿量。具有正确总自旋强度的单粒子近似是否仍会错误估计局部自旋谱中凹陷的深度？我们在一个冻结的、磁通无序的系综中检验这个问题，方法是保留自旋翻转后的实际单粒子跃迁能量和相对谱权重，然后对这些权重进行重新标度，使其与全强度相匹配。我们通过从两个侧翼频率的平均值中减去中心强度来测量凹陷。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在Kitaev蜂窝模型中，自旋翻转会改变磁通背景，从而改变物质费米子所看到的哈密顿量。具有正确总自旋强度的单粒子近似是否仍会错误估计局部自旋谱中凹陷的深度？我们在一个冻结的、磁通无序的系综中检验这个问题，方法是保留自旋翻转后的实际单粒子跃迁能量和相对谱权重，然后对这些权重进行重新标度，使其与全强度相匹配。我们通过从两个侧翼频率的平均值中减去中心强度来测量凹陷。对于具有奇数最终准粒子数和非零单粒子权重的自旋产生态，根据两种能量分辨率的每种分辨率的中值配对校正来判断，恢复多粒子权重会使24个格点的凹陷变浅，并使1,536个格点的形状以及3,456个和6,144个格点的环面上的凹陷变深。对于这些态，单粒子近似在24个位点上高估了平均凹陷深度约16-18%，在6144个位点的样本中低估了33-56%。因此，在相同的无序条件下，从24个位点进行外推将为这四个较大的环面上的该修正给出错误的符号。

articles.title: Interface invariants of rhombohedral graphene with layer-dependent potentials and couplings
articles.title_zh: 具有层相关势和耦合的菱面体石墨烯的界面不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Domain walls in the perpendicular bias of rhombohedral (ABC-stacked) graphene bind valley-resolved interface modes whose signed number is fixed by a bulk-difference invariant. We determine which values of this invariant are reachable when the layer potentials are arbitrary monotone profiles, as produced by screening, and when the interlayer couplings vary from bond to bond. Within the single-particle continuum model, the invariant of an m-layer stack equals the difference of occupied angular weights of the zero-momentum levels, which reduces the classification to the ordering of those levels. At equal coupling, nonlinear monotone potentials reproduce exactly the set of invariants of linear potentials, also under the requirement of a common energy gap: screening moves phase boundaries but creates no new invariant values. With bond-dependent coupling, we characterize all occupied configurations. The range of attainable invariants is unchanged, but the gaps inside it are filled, beginning at five layers. Reflection-symmetric stacks realize a large subfamily with a guaranteed common gap, and lower bounds on single-bulk gaps complete the set of invariants with a common global gap for five and six layers. Among the examples is an eight-layer domain wall defined purely by gates, whose number of co-propagating channels per valley switches from 8 to 16 as the gate strength increases. Exact transfer-matrix calculations of the interface spectrum reproduce every predicted signed crossing count. A norm bound gives the minimum spread of interlayer coupling compatible with a prescribed gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱面体（ABC 堆叠）石墨烯垂直偏置中的畴壁结合谷解析界面模式，其符号数由体积差异不变量固定。我们确定当层电势是通过筛选产生的任意单调分布时，以及当层间耦合因键而异时，可以达到该不变量的哪些值。在单粒子连续介质模型中，m 层堆栈的不变量等于零动量级别的占用角权重之差，这将分类简化为这些级别的排序。在等耦合时，非线性单调势精确地再现了线性势的不变量集，同样是在公共能隙的要求下：筛选移动相边界但不产生新的不变量值。通过键依赖性耦合，我们表征了所有占据的构型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱面体（ABC 堆叠）石墨烯垂直偏置中的畴壁结合谷解析界面模式，其符号数由体积差异不变量固定。我们确定当层电势是通过筛选产生的任意单调分布时，以及当层间耦合因键而异时，可以达到该不变量的哪些值。在单粒子连续介质模型中，m 层堆栈的不变量等于零动量级别的占用角权重之差，这将分类简化为这些级别的排序。在等耦合时，非线性单调势精确地再现了线性势的不变量集，同样是在公共能隙的要求下：筛选移动相边界但不产生新的不变量值。通过键依赖性耦合，我们表征了所有占据的构型。可达到的不变量的范围没有变化，但从五层开始，其中的空白已被填充。反射对称堆栈实现了具有保证的公共间隙的大型子族，并且单块间隙的下限完成了具有五层和六层公共全局间隙的不变量集。示例中有一个完全由栅极定义的八层畴壁，随着栅极强度的增加，每个谷的同向传播通道数从 8 切换到 16。界面光谱的精确传递矩阵计算再现了每个预测的有符号交叉计数。范数界限给出了与规定间隙兼容的层间耦合的最小扩展。

articles.title: A Fiber-Optic Platform for Cryogenic Laser-Pump Neutron-Probe Magneto-Optical Measurements
articles.title_zh: 用于低温激光泵中子探针磁光测量的光纤平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a fiber-optic laser-pump neutron-probe method for momentum- and frequency-resolved magneto-optical measurements. The technique uses inelastic neutron scattering to measure time-dependent two-point magnetization correlations, S(Q,ω), after resonant photoexcitation at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate it by measuring nonequilibrium thermalization dynamics in Yb-based quantum magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一种用于动量和频率分辨磁光测量的光纤激光泵中子探针方法。该技术使用非弹性中子散射来测量低温下共振光激发后随时间变化的两点磁化相关性 S(Q,ω)。我们通过测量镱基量子磁体中的非平衡热化动力学来证明这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一种用于动量和频率分辨磁光测量的光纤激光泵中子探针方法。该技术使用非弹性中子散射来测量低温下共振光激发后随时间变化的两点磁化相关性 S(Q,ω)。我们通过测量镱基量子磁体中的非平衡热化动力学来证明这一点。

articles.title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: DeepDOSReasoner：用于状态密度预测和材料发现的物理推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. DeepDOSReasoner achieves the highest prediction accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both eDOS and phDOS, recovers element-resolved contributions without supervision, and most reliably identifies rare valence-band (VB) gaps. In a prospective screen of 8,106 uncharted materials validated by new DFT calculations, its predictions remain the most accurate among the methods evaluated, with 25 of its top 50 candidates confirmed as VB-gap materials. Three case studies spanning substituted compounds, photovoltaic chalcogenides, and a high-entropy alloy demonstrate transfer across materials classes. Ablations confirm that both stages are necessary, while the model retains comparable accuracy when trained on only 25% of the data. Predicting spectra in milliseconds enables exhaustive screening; we release predictions filling the missing eDOS for 91,405 and phDOS for 127,768 Materials Project entries. DeepDOSReasoner provides a blueprint for integrating machine learning with physical reasoning toward high-throughput spectral screening and autonomous materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。在这里，我们介绍 DeepDOSReasoner，这是一个基于物理的框架，它通过原子到能量源的关注来解码光谱，并通过学习的连续性方程传输来细化归一化 DOS，通过构造强制非负性和全状态守恒。 DeepDOSReasoner 在 eDOS 和 phDOS 的所有评估指标中实现了最高的预测精度，无需监督即可恢复元素解析的贡献，并且最可靠地识别罕见的价带 (VB) 间隙。在通过新的 DFT 计算验证的 8,106 种未知材料的前瞻性筛选中，其预测仍然是评估方法中最准确的，其前 50 种候选材料中有 25 种被确认为 VB-gap 材料。涵盖取代化合物、光伏硫属化物和高熵合金的三个案例研究证明了跨材料类别的转移。消融证实这两个阶段都是必要的，而模型在仅使用 25% 的数据进行训练时仍保持相当的准确性。在几毫秒内预测光谱可以实现详尽的筛选；我们发布了预测，填补了 91,405 个材料项目条目缺失的 eDOS 和 127,768 个材料项目条目的 phDOS。 DeepDOSReasoner 提供了将机器学习与物理推理相结合以实现高通量光谱筛选和自主材料发现的蓝图。

articles.title: Graph Neural Networks for Accurate Quasiparticle Energy Levels in Large Supercells of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物大型超晶胞中精确准粒子能级的图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The GW method is the one of the main workhorses of the materials science community to accurately calculate the electronic bandgap of materials, as it overcomes the gap underestimation problem from Density Functional Theory (DFT). Despite its accuracy, its computational cost becomes prohibitive when calculations have more than 10-100 atoms, which makes more difficult its use for defects, surfaces and moiré systems that demand large supercells. To overcome this problem, we developed a Graph Neural Network trained with smaller GW calculations which can make accurate predictions on large supercells at a small fraction of the computational cost. Our model uses as features the projection of DFT wavefunctions into localized atomic orbitals, while graph nodes represent the atomic positions and edges represent atom to atom distances, which captures the system geometry. We explore how to do "small AI", providing a workflow of how to create a personal and convenient dataset of GW calculations to train the model that can be applied to different materials so that the final user does not need to rely on massive datasets. We define what must be included in the training dataset to capture the physics of our objective simulation, and perform a Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters. In the case of monolayer MoS₂ with a sulfur vacancy our GNN models achieve high accuracy (MAE ranging 10 to 50 meV) with a simplified workflow applicable to other materials, accelerating accurate large electronic structure calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。我们的模型使用 DFT 波函数到局部原子轨道的投影作为特征，而图节点表示原子位置，边表示原子到原子的距离，从而捕获系统几何形状。我们探索如何做“小AI”，提供了如何创建个性化且方便的GW计算数据集来训练可应用于不同材料的模型的工作流程，以便最终用户不需要依赖海量数据集。我们定义训练数据集中必须包含的内容，以捕获目标模拟的物理原理，并对超参数执行贝叶斯优化。对于具有硫空位的单层 MoS2，我们的 GNN 模型可通过适用于其他材料的简化工作流程实现高精度（MAE 范围为 10 至 50 meV），从而加速精确的大型电子结构计算。

articles.title: Fully solid-state all-2D micro-supercapacitors for on-chip energy storage
articles.title_zh: 用于片上储能的全固态全二维微型超级电容器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrating energy storage directly into microelectronic platforms remains a major challenge. Although solid-state micro-supercapacitors (MSCs) have been previously demonstrated, most still rely on liquid or solvent-containing gel electrolytes, which require additional encapsulation and complicate device integration. Here, we demonstrate wafer-scale fabrication of all-2D, fully solid-state MSCs by combining conductive Ti3C2Tz MXene electrodes with a natural vermiculite (VMT) clay solid electrolyte. Both materials are solution-processable and can be independently patterned using microelectronics compatible fabrication techniques, allowing for their integration across 4-inch Si/SiO2 wafers. The resulting devices showcase an active stack of only 28 nm thick, with an areal capacitance of 205 uF/cm2 and volumetric energy density of ~15.5 mWh/cm3. Notably, this work introduces a patterned 2D clay as a solid electrolyte in an on-chip electrochemical energy-storage device, extending the role of layered materials beyond electrodes to ion-conducting components. To investigate device behavior and degradation, we employ non-destructive imaging ellipsometry to map individual layer thicknesses and extract the spatial distribution of MXene conductivity across the chip. This approach reveals localized changes in electrode properties following prolonged electrochemical cycling, providing insight into degradation processes that are difficult to capture using conventional spatially averaged measurements. Together, these results establish a route towards fully solid-state, all-2D energy-storage devices and highlight the potential of solution-processable layered materials for integration into microelectronic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 将储能直接集成到微电子平台中仍然是一个重大挑战。尽管固态微型超级电容器（MSC）之前已经被证明，但大多数仍然依赖于液体或含溶剂的凝胶电解质，这需要额外的封装和复杂的设备集成。在这里，我们通过将导电 Ti3C2Tz MXene 电极与天然蛭石 (VMT) 粘土固体电解质相结合，展示了全二维、全固态 MSC 的晶圆级制造。这两种材料均可进行溶液加工，并且可以使用微电子兼容制造技术独立图案化，从而可以在 4 英寸 Si/SiO2 晶圆上进行集成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将储能直接集成到微电子平台中仍然是一个重大挑战。尽管固态微型超级电容器（MSC）之前已经被证明，但大多数仍然依赖于液体或含溶剂的凝胶电解质，这需要额外的封装和复杂的设备集成。在这里，我们通过将导电 Ti3C2Tz MXene 电极与天然蛭石 (VMT) 粘土固体电解质相结合，展示了全二维、全固态 MSC 的晶圆级制造。这两种材料均可进行溶液加工，并且可以使用微电子兼容制造技术独立图案化，从而可以在 4 英寸 Si/SiO2 晶圆上进行集成。由此产生的器件展示了厚度仅为 28 nm 的有源堆栈，面积电容为 205 uF/cm2，体积能量密度约为 15.5 mWh/cm3。值得注意的是，这项工作引入了一种图案化的二维粘土作为片上电化学储能装置中的固体电解质，将层状材料的作用从电极扩展到离子传导组件。为了研究器件行为和退化，我们采用无损成像椭偏仪来绘制各个层的厚度并提取整个芯片上 MXene 电导率的空间分布。这种方法揭示了长时间电化学循环后电极性能的局部变化，提供了对使用传统空间平均测量难以捕获的降解过程的洞察。总之，这些结果建立了一条通往全固态、全二维能量存储器件的路线，并凸显了可溶液加工的层状材料集成到微电子系统中的潜力。

articles.title: Population of spin orbit-split-electron branches in semimetallic HgTe quantum wells
articles.title_zh: 半金属 HgTe 量子阱中自旋轨道分裂电子分支的分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the results of experimental studies on magnetoresistance, the Hall effect, and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations performed in gated heterostructures with HgTe-based gapless semiconductor quantum wells. We show that in quantum wells with widths corresponding to a semimetallic charge carrier spectrum, electrons, in contrast to the idealized model, populate both spin-orbit-split branches of the spectrum. This occurs regardless of whether the Fermi level lies exclusively in the conduction band or within the conduction-valence band overlap region.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们展示了在基于 HgTe 的无间隙半导体量子阱的门控异质结构中进行的磁阻、霍尔效应和 Shubnikov-de Haas 振荡的实验研究结果。我们表明，在宽度与半金属载流子光谱相对应的量子阱中，与理想化模型相反，电子填充了光谱的两个自旋轨道分裂分支。无论费米能级是仅位于导带还是导带-价带重叠区域内，都会发生这种情况。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了在基于 HgTe 的无间隙半导体量子阱的门控异质结构中进行的磁阻、霍尔效应和 Shubnikov-de Haas 振荡的实验研究结果。我们表明，在宽度与半金属载流子光谱相对应的量子阱中，与理想化模型相反，电子填充了光谱的两个自旋轨道分裂分支。无论费米能级是仅位于导带还是导带-价带重叠区域内，都会发生这种情况。

articles.title: Ground-State Manifold Curvature and Phase Transitions in the Kitaev Honeycomb Model
articles.title_zh: Kitaev 蜂窝模型中的基态流形曲率和相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kitaev honeycomb model is an exactly solvable spin model whose ground state realizes a quantum spin liquid with gapped Abelian phases and a gapless phase that becomes a non-Abelian phase in a magnetic field. Here we study its phase transitions through the geometry of the ground-state manifold, using the Ricci scalar of the quantum metric. In the three gapped phases we obtain closed-form expressions for the curvature, which is negative and diverges at the critical lines; the three phases are related to one another by an exact change of coordinates. In the gapless phase, the curvature of the infrared-regularized metric is positive and decays inversely with the logarithm of the system size, with a size-independent amplitude that diverges at the phase boundaries, with an exponent different from that of the gapped side. The change of sign and the divergences together reproduce the complete phase diagram. A magnetic field gaps out the gapless phase and plays the role of the infrared cutoff, so that away from the critical lines the curvature of the non-Abelian phase becomes finite and positive, while around the critical lines it opens a crossover region whose width scales quadratically with the field. Since divergences of geometric quantities are often regarded as signatures of phase transitions, the divergence of the Ricci scalar at the critical lines provides a geometric signature of these transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: Kitaev 蜂窝模型是一个精确可解的自旋模型，其基态实现了具有带隙阿贝尔相和无带隙相的量子自旋液体，该无带隙相在磁场中变成非阿贝尔相。在这里，我们使用量子度量的里奇标量通过基态流形的几何形状研究其相变。在三个间隙相中，我们获得曲率的闭合形式表达式，该表达式为负并且在临界线处发散；这三个阶段通过坐标的精确变化相互关联。在无间隙相中，红外正则化度量的曲率是正的，并且与系统尺寸的对数成反比地衰减，其与尺寸无关的幅度在相边界处发散，其指数与有间隙侧的指数不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kitaev 蜂窝模型是一个精确可解的自旋模型，其基态实现了具有带隙阿贝尔相和无带隙相的量子自旋液体，该无带隙相在磁场中变成非阿贝尔相。在这里，我们使用量子度量的里奇标量通过基态流形的几何形状研究其相变。在三个间隙相中，我们获得曲率的闭合形式表达式，该表达式为负并且在临界线处发散；这三个阶段通过坐标的精确变化相互关联。在无间隙相中，红外正则化度量的曲率是正的，并且与系统尺寸的对数成反比地衰减，其与尺寸无关的幅度在相边界处发散，其指数与有间隙侧的指数不同。符号的变化和发散共同再现了完整的相图。磁场将无间隙相隔开，并起到红外截止的作用，因此远离临界线，非阿贝尔相的曲率变得有限且正，而在临界线周围，它打开了一个交叉区域，其宽度与场呈二次方关系。由于几何量的散度通常被视为相变的特征，因此临界线处的里奇标量的散度提供了这些转变的几何特征。

articles.title: AmorphGen: A Python package for amorphous structure generation with machine-learning and classical interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: AmorphGen：利用机器学习和经典原子间势生成非晶结构的 Python 包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AmorphGen is an open-source Python package for generating and analyzing amorphous structures from a composition or a crystal. Chemically informed rules estimate initial densities and assign separation and coordination constraints. Three routes are available: random placement followed by relaxation, melt-quench from a crystal, and a hybrid route that anneals and quenches random structures. ASE provides access to classical and machine-learning potentials, with GPU batching for selected backends. Analysis tools compute coordination numbers, bond angles, rings, and X-ray or neutron structure factors for comparison with measurements. An optional interface to the FEFF code computes extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra. For amorphous Ga2O3, TiO2 and InGaZnO4, the cation coordination numbers are close to reference models and measurements, and the X-ray structure factors reproduce the main measured peaks. The EXAFS spectra for Ga2O3 and InGaZnO4 also capture the dominant first-shell features observed experimentally. The hybrid route reduces bonding defects in SiO2 and As and builds the first sharp diffraction peak of SiO2. By simplifying ensemble generation and standardizing structural assessment, AmorphGen makes it practical to compare amorphous models across compositions, potentials, and preparation routes, and to screen new amorphous compositions.
articles.abstract_zh: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。对于非晶 Ga2O3、TiO2 和 InGaZnO4，阳离子配位数接近参考模型和测量结果，X 射线结构因子再现了主要测量峰。 Ga2O3 和 InGaZnO4 的 EXAFS 光谱也捕获了实验观察到的主要第一壳层特征。该混合路线减少了 SiO2 和 As 中的键合缺陷，并建立了 SiO2 的第一个尖锐衍射峰。通过简化系综生成和标准化结构评估，AmorphGen 使得比较不同成分、电位和制备路线的非晶态模型以及筛选新的非晶态成分变得切实可行。

articles.title: MagPot: A magnetoelastic potential generator for molecular dynamics simulations
articles.title_zh: MagPot：用于分子动力学模拟的磁弹性势发生器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelastic phenomena originate from the coupling between atomic displacements and magnetic degrees of freedom, and their atomistic simulation requires interatomic models in which magnetic interactions depend explicitly on interatomic distance. This paper presents MagPot, a Python program that generates Bethe-Slater parameter sets for spin-lattice molecular dynamics simulations using the SPIN package of the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS). From a compact set of material properties, the program determines the radial functions describing Heisenberg exchange and the dipole and quadrupole contributions of the two-ion Néel interaction. Version 1.0 supports simple-cubic, body-centred-cubic and face-centred-cubic lattices with ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic configurations. A central feature of MagPot is its modular architecture, which allows the magnetic contribution it generates to be combined additively with a broad range of compatible non-magnetic interatomic potentials. The parameterisation workflow is assessed through equation-of-state, Curie-temperature, volume-magnetostriction, pressure-dependent magnetocrystalline-anisotropy and anisotropic-magnetoelastic tests. By automating the construction of the magnetic contribution to the interatomic model, MagPot offers a straightforward and reproducible route from material properties to LAMMPS-ready magnetic interactions, facilitating large-scale atomistic simulations of magnetoelasticity and magnetostriction, as well as physical phenomena associated with magnon-phonon coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁弹性现象源于原子位移和磁自由度之间的耦合，其原子模拟需要原子间模型，其中磁相互作用明确取决于原子间距离。本文介绍了 MagPot，这是一个 Python 程序，它使用大型原子/分子大规模并行模拟器 (LAMMPS) 的 SPIN 包生成用于自旋晶格分子动力学模拟的 Bethe-Slater 参数集。该程序从一组紧凑的材料属性中确定描述海森堡交换的径向函数以及双离子尼尔相互作用的偶极子和四极子贡献。 1.0 版支持具有铁磁和反铁磁配置的简单立方、体心立方和面心立方晶格。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁弹性现象源于原子位移和磁自由度之间的耦合，其原子模拟需要原子间模型，其中磁相互作用明确取决于原子间距离。本文介绍了 MagPot，这是一个 Python 程序，它使用大型原子/分子大规模并行模拟器 (LAMMPS) 的 SPIN 包生成用于自旋晶格分子动力学模拟的 Bethe-Slater 参数集。该程序从一组紧凑的材料属性中确定描述海森堡交换的径向函数以及双离子尼尔相互作用的偶极子和四极子贡献。 1.0 版支持具有铁磁和反铁磁配置的简单立方、体心立方和面心立方晶格。 MagPot 的一个核心特征是其模块化架构，它允许其产生的磁性贡献与各种兼容的非磁性原子间势相加地结合。参数化工作流程通过状态方程、居里温度、体积磁致伸缩、压力相关磁晶各向异性和各向异性磁弹性测试进行评估。通过自动构建原子间模型的磁性贡献，MagPot 提供了从材料属性到 LAMMPS 就绪磁相互作用的直接且可重复的途径，促进磁弹性和磁致伸缩以及与磁振子-声子耦合相关的物理现象的大规模原子模拟。

articles.title: Elastic crumple pair potentials
articles.title_zh: 弹性褶皱对势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thin structures across scales and materials, from graphene sheets to clothing to aircraft skins, respond to forcing and confinement by crumpling, with deformation localized into zones of characteristic shape. Much attention has been paid to isolated crescent vertex and ridge shapes, but there has been almost no investigation into the dynamics, creation/destruction, and interactions between multiple vertices (``crumples'') that are inherent in nearly all deformation processes. The next step beyond single crumples are pair interactions, mediated by background curvature. Of these, we focus on two common types, using a quasi-1D setup allowing controlled boundary motion and force measurement coupled with tracking of crumple positions. We provide experimental evidence for non-monotonic pair potentials, with short-range attraction, long-range repulsion, and an intermediate forbidden region. We construct a phenomenological energy that reproduces the bifurcations and the interrelations between observed quantities. These results provide a new insight and input towards understanding and building reduced descriptions of dynamic deformation and pattern formation and evolution in thin elastic plate and shell structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 从石墨烯片到衣服再到飞机蒙皮，跨尺度和材料的薄结构通过压皱来响应力和限制，变形局限于特征形状的区域。人们对孤立的新月形顶点和脊形状给予了很多关注，但几乎没有对几乎所有变形过程中固有的动力学、创建/破坏以及多个顶点之间的相互作用（“褶皱”）进行研究。超越单皱褶的下一步是由背景曲率介导的成对相互作用。其中，我们重点关注两种常见类型，使用准一维设置，允许控制边界运动和力测量，并跟踪溃缩位置。我们提供了非单调对势的实验证据，具有短程吸引、长程排斥和中间禁区。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从石墨烯片到衣服再到飞机蒙皮，跨尺度和材料的薄结构通过压皱来响应力和限制，变形局限于特征形状的区域。人们对孤立的新月形顶点和脊形状给予了很多关注，但几乎没有对几乎所有变形过程中固有的动力学、创建/破坏以及多个顶点之间的相互作用（“褶皱”）进行研究。超越单皱褶的下一步是由背景曲率介导的成对相互作用。其中，我们重点关注两种常见类型，使用准一维设置，允许控制边界运动和力测量，并跟踪溃缩位置。我们提供了非单调对势的实验证据，具有短程吸引、长程排斥和中间禁区。我们构建了一种现象学能量，可以再现观测量之间的分歧和相互关系。这些结果为理解和建立薄弹性板壳结构动态变形和图案形成和演化的简化描述提供了新的见解和输入。

articles.title: Giant magnetic anisotropy in layered polar metal Sr₃Co₂O₇ from Charge-disproportionation orbital unquenching
articles.title_zh: 电荷歧化轨道未淬灭层状极性金属 Sr₃Co2O₇ 中的巨磁各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal-field quenching usually suppresses orbital angular momentum and limits magnetic anisotropy in transition-metal oxides. Here we identify charge disproportionation as a route to giant magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the layered polar metal Sr₃Co₂O₇. First-principles calculations reveal an energy preference of 234.0 meV per cell for in-plane [110] magnetization over [001]. Charge disproportionation and the associated polar displacement reconstruct the local cobalt crystal fields, creating inequivalent sites with distinct orbital hierarchies. This reconstruction enables a strongly directional orbital response, particularly at the displaced cobalt site, where orbital angular momentum is recovered for in-plane magnetization. Spin--orbit coupling converts this response into a large magnetic anisotropic energy. In the centrosymmetric reference, the orbital moments remain nearly quenched and the anisotropy is strongly reduced. A local Green-function and orbital-moment analysis connects the large energy scale to orbital unquenching, while the conventional second-order contribution is small within the adopted approximation. These results identify charge-disproportionation-driven orbital reconstruction as a design principle for large anisotropy and motivate layered perovskites and magnetic polar metals as platforms in the search for rare-earth-free permanent magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体场猝灭通常会抑制轨道角动量，并限制过渡金属氧化物中的磁各向异性。本文中，我们确定电荷歧化是层状极性金属Sr₃Co₂O₇中产生巨磁晶各向异性的一种途径。第一性原理计算表明，对于面内[110]磁化相对于[001]磁化，每个晶胞的能量偏好为234.0 meV。电荷歧化和相关的极性位移重构了局部钴晶体场，形成了具有不同轨道层次的不等价位点。这种重构实现了强方向性轨道响应，特别是在位移钴位点，该位点的轨道角动量在面内磁化时得以恢复。自旋-轨道耦合将这种响应转化为较大的磁各向异性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体场猝灭通常会抑制轨道角动量，并限制过渡金属氧化物中的磁各向异性。本文中，我们确定电荷歧化是层状极性金属Sr₃Co₂O₇中产生巨磁晶各向异性的一种途径。第一性原理计算表明，对于面内[110]磁化相对于[001]磁化，每个晶胞的能量偏好为234.0 meV。电荷歧化和相关的极性位移重构了局部钴晶体场，形成了具有不同轨道层次的不等价位点。这种重构实现了强方向性轨道响应，特别是在位移钴位点，该位点的轨道角动量在面内磁化时得以恢复。自旋-轨道耦合将这种响应转化为较大的磁各向异性能。在中心对称的参考系中，轨道角动量几乎保持猝灭状态，各向异性大大降低。局部格林函数和轨道角动量分析将大能量尺度与轨道角动量未猝灭联系起来，而在所采用的近似中，传统的二阶贡献很小。这些结果将电荷歧化驱动的轨道重构确定为大各向异性的设计原理，并推动了层状钙钛矿和磁性极性金属作为寻找不含稀土的永磁体的平台。

articles.title: Principles of Material Memory
articles.title_zh: 物质记忆原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials keep traces of how they were driven: a field leaves a magnetization behind, and a sequence of forces can leave a pattern that records the order in which they acted. It remains open what such a history records, which interactions create the record and which dynamics preserve it. This review relates the three. Forces applied in different orders can leave different states after the drive is removed, and in a spatial network the preferred local arrangements may not be reconcilable around a closed loop. Both effects compare two paths, one in time and one around a loop in space, and both are described by commutators, curvature and holonomy. Restoring forces and fluctuations then set how long the trace survives: a displacement relaxes, a phase diffuses, and barriers protect a pattern against rare thermal transitions. Near an instability, a weak writing bias is amplified while the coordinate that carries the state has no restoring force, and the barriers that retain the chosen state form only afterwards. The choice is therefore as accurate as the detection of the bias against the noise during the time for which the coordinate is free. Once a state is stored behind a barrier, a static bias replaces it through the same thermal channel by which it would be lost. The ratio of the mean retention time to the mean rewriting time is then bounded, up to a prefactor close to one, by the Boltzmann factor of an effective energy bias, whatever the height of the barrier. Calculations for capillary rotors and point-dipole arrays show how the geometry of the interactions constrains the patterns that a material can store. In a model of three coupled amplitudes, a weak bias makes two mirror-image patterns lose stability at slightly different coupling strengths, so that a coupling pulse between the two thresholds erases one pattern and preserves the other.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料保留了它们被驱动的痕迹：磁场留下磁化强度，一系列力可以留下记录它们作用顺序的模式。这样的历史记录了什么，哪些相互作用创造了记录，哪些动态保存了记录，这些仍然是开放的。这篇评论将三者联系起来。在移除驱动器后，以不同顺序施加的力可能会留下不同的状态，并且在空间网络中，优选的局部布置可能无法在闭环周围协调。这两种效应都比较两条路径，一条在时间上，一条在空间上绕环，并且两者都通过换向器、曲率和完整来描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料保留了它们被驱动的痕迹：磁场留下磁化强度，一系列力可以留下记录它们作用顺序的模式。这样的历史记录了什么，哪些相互作用创造了记录，哪些动态保存了记录，这些仍然是开放的。这篇评论将三者联系起来。在移除驱动器后，以不同顺序施加的力可能会留下不同的状态，并且在空间网络中，优选的局部布置可能无法在闭环周围协调。这两种效应都比较两条路径，一条在时间上，一条在空间上绕环，并且两者都通过换向器、曲率和完整来描述。然后，恢复力和波动决定迹线的存活时间：位移松弛，相扩散，并且屏障保护图案免受罕见的热转变。接近不稳定状态时，弱写入偏差会被放大，而承载状态的坐标没有恢复力，并且只有在之后才会形成保留所选状态的障碍。因此，该选择与在坐标空闲期间检测噪声偏差一样准确。一旦状态被存储在势垒后面，静态偏置就会通过与状态丢失相同的热通道来取代它。然后，平均保留时间与平均重写时间的比率受到有效能量偏差的玻尔兹曼因子的限制，直到接近于 1 的前置因子，无论势垒的高度如何。毛细管转子和点偶极子阵列的计算显示了相互作用的几何形状如何限制材料可以存储的模式。在三个耦合幅度的模型中，弱偏置会使两个镜像图案在耦合强度略有不同的情况下失去稳定性，因此两个阈值之间的耦合脉冲会擦除一个图案并保留另一个图案。

articles.title: A phenomenological decomposition of SRC-inspired occupation effects in imbalanced Fermi superfluids
articles.title_zh: 不平衡费米超流体中受 SRC 启发的占据效应的唯象分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Imbalanced two-component Fermi superfluids are usually formulated with sharp Fermi-step occupations, although interacting systems exhibit depletion below the Fermi surface and a high-momentum tail. We introduce a sector-resolved phenomenological framework in which one prescribed short-range-correlation (SRC)-inspired momentum distribution modifies either the anomalous pairing contribution (model P), the imbalance-induced blocking term (model B), or both (model P+B). The four realizations---ideal, P, B, and P+B---are compared through the grand-potential landscape and through a fixed-density reconstruction of the paired/phase-separated to polarized-normal boundary in three and two dimensions. In both dimensionalities, the pairing-sector modification accounts for nearly all of the reduction in the critical polarization, whereas the blocking-sector correction remains subdominant. Consequently, the phase boundaries form two nearly degenerate pairs, ideal simeq B and P simeq P+B. These results quantify, within the stated phenomenological construction, how a prescribed SRC-inspired occupation propagates separately through the pairing and blocking sectors of an imbalanced superfluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管相互作用的系统在费米表面以下表现出耗尽和高动量尾部，但不平衡的双组分费米超流体通常采用尖锐的费米步占据来配制。我们引入了一种扇区解析的现象学框架，其中一个规定的短程相关（SRC）启发的动量分布修改了异常配对贡献（模型 P）、不平衡引起的阻塞项（模型 B）或两者（模型 P+B）。四种实现——理想、P、B 和 P+B——通过大势景观以及通过在三维和二维中成对/相分离到偏振法向边界的固定密度重建进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管相互作用的系统在费米表面以下表现出耗尽和高动量尾部，但不平衡的双组分费米超流体通常采用尖锐的费米步占据来配制。我们引入了一种扇区解析的现象学框架，其中一个规定的短程相关（SRC）启发的动量分布修改了异常配对贡献（模型 P）、不平衡引起的阻塞项（模型 B）或两者（模型 P+B）。四种实现——理想、P、B 和 P+B——通过大势景观以及通过在三维和二维中成对/相分离到偏振法向边界的固定密度重建进行比较。在这两个维度中，配对扇区修正几乎解释了所有临界偏振的减少，而阻塞扇区修正仍然占主导地位。因此，相边界形成两个近简并对：理想 simeq B 和 P simeq P+B。这些结果在规定的现象学结构内量化了受 SRC 启发的指定占据如何通过不平衡超流体的配对和阻塞部分单独传播。

articles.title: Mixed-State Magnetotransport Below T_c in Type-II Superconducting NbN Thin Films
articles.title_zh: II型超导NbN薄膜在T_c以下的混合态磁输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29817v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transport properties of type-II superconductors in the mixed state below the superconducting transition temperature, T_c, remain difficult to interpret because superconducting and dissipative processes coexist in the presence of a magnetic field. To investigate this regime in NbN thin films, we measured the field-dependent sheet resistance (R^Mₓₓ) and Hall resistance (R^Mₓy) below T_c in Van der Pauw geometry for 4-nm-thick NbN films on sapphire and silicon substrates at driving currents of 1 mA and 2 mA. By combining the longitudinal response with the antisymmetrized Hall signal, we use a phenomenological current-partition model to estimate the dissipative and superconducting current contributions. From this analysis, we estimate the field-dependent superconducting current together with the Hall-derived effective dissipative carrier density and mobility. We also observe an even-in-field transverse signal whose magnitude depends strongly on the driving current. We discuss this signal as a possible mixed-state response involving the magnetic and supercurrent texture of Abrikosov vortices, vortex dynamics, and Cooper-pair current redistribution. The present measurements do not uniquely distinguish vortex, condensate, or combined contributions. The model provides a practical way to compare the longitudinal and transverse mixed-state responses without implying a direct spatial separation of the two current channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 在低于超导转变温度 T_c 的混合状态下，II 型超导体的输运特性仍然难以解释，因为超导过程和耗散过程在磁场存在下共存。为了研究 NbN 薄膜中的这种状态，我们在范德堡几何结构中，在 1 mA 和 2 mA 的驱动电流下，测量了蓝宝石和硅衬底上 4 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜在低于 T_c 时的场相关薄层电阻 (R^Mₓₓ) 和霍尔电阻 (R^Mₓy)。通过将纵向响应与反对称霍尔信号相结合，我们使用唯象电流分配模型来估计耗散电流和超导电流的贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在低于超导转变温度 T_c 的混合状态下，II 型超导体的输运特性仍然难以解释，因为超导过程和耗散过程在磁场存在下共存。为了研究 NbN 薄膜中的这种状态，我们在范德堡几何结构中，在 1 mA 和 2 mA 的驱动电流下，测量了蓝宝石和硅衬底上 4 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜在低于 T_c 时的场相关薄层电阻 (R^Mₓₓ) 和霍尔电阻 (R^Mₓy)。通过将纵向响应与反对称霍尔信号相结合，我们使用唯象电流分配模型来估计耗散电流和超导电流的贡献。根据该分析，我们估计了场相关超导电流以及霍尔衍生的有效耗散载流子密度和迁移率。我们还观察到均匀场横向信号，其幅度很大程度上取决于驱动电流。我们将该信号讨论为可能的混合状态响应，涉及阿布里科索夫涡旋的磁性和超电流纹理、涡旋动力学和库珀对电流重新分布。目前的测量并不能唯一区分涡流、冷凝物或组合贡献。该模型提供了一种比较纵向和横向混合状态响应的实用方法，而不意味着两个电流通道的直接空间分离。

articles.title: Sondheimer oscillations in Weyl semimetal films
articles.title_zh: 外尔半金属薄膜中的松德海默振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In conducting films subject to an out-of-plane magnetic field, electron motion between the surfaces gives rise to conductance oscillations periodic in magnetic field, known as Sondheimer oscillations. While this size effect has been investigated in conventional metals, its dependence on the Berry curvature of topological materials remains less explored. In this work, we extend the semiclassical Boltzmann description of Sondheimer oscillations to type-I Weyl semimetal films. We account for the Berry curvature, the orbital magnetic moment and the effect of the Zeeman coupling on the Fermi wavevector and the electronic group velocity. The Berry curvature and the orbital magnetic moment generate a beating pattern and chirping in the Sondheimer oscillations. In the thick-film and thin-film regimes, we provide analytical expressions for the longitudinal conductivity, which highlight the interplay between electronic band topology and boundary-scattering in magnetotransport.
articles.abstract_zh: 在受到面外磁场作用的导电薄膜中，表面之间的电子运动会引起磁场中周期性的电导振荡，称为桑德海默振荡。虽然这种尺寸效应已经在传统金属中得到了研究，但它对拓扑材料贝里曲率的依赖性仍然很少被研究。在这项工作中，我们将 Sondheimer 振荡的半经典玻尔兹曼描述扩展到 I 型 Weyl 半金属薄膜。我们考虑了贝里曲率、轨道磁矩以及塞曼耦合对费米波矢和电子群速度的影响。贝里曲率和轨道磁矩在桑德海默振荡中产生跳动模式和啁啾。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在受到面外磁场作用的导电薄膜中，表面之间的电子运动会引起磁场中周期性的电导振荡，称为桑德海默振荡。虽然这种尺寸效应已经在传统金属中得到了研究，但它对拓扑材料贝里曲率的依赖性仍然很少被研究。在这项工作中，我们将 Sondheimer 振荡的半经典玻尔兹曼描述扩展到 I 型 Weyl 半金属薄膜。我们考虑了贝里曲率、轨道磁矩以及塞曼耦合对费米波矢和电子群速度的影响。贝里曲率和轨道磁矩在桑德海默振荡中产生跳动模式和啁啾。在厚膜和薄膜体系中，我们提供了纵向电导率的解析表达式，突出了磁输运中电子能带拓扑和边界散射之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Unveiling the Complex high-pressure phases of Sodium at the Melting Curve Minimum via Data-Drive Crystal Structure Prediction
articles.title_zh: 通过数据驱动的晶体结构预测揭示熔化曲线最小值处的复杂高压相钠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.29889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sodium exhibits a remarkable concentration of complex crystalline phases near its melting-curve minimum, yet the atomic arrangements of several experimentally observed phases remain unresolved. Here, we combine CALYPSO crystal structure prediction with Deep Potential models developed through concurrent learning to explore this structural landscape. Searches over more than 1.6 million configurations recover the previously reported I4/m structure of tI50 and identify candidate atomic arrangements for oC120 and aP90, together with three additional low-enthalpy structures, tI52, oP72, and oP92. The proposed candidates reproduce key features of the experimentally indexed cell geometries. First-principles enthalpy calculations, Gibbs free-energy comparisons, and solid--liquid coexistence simulations reveal close competition among these structures and established sodium phases. Near the calculated reference melting minimum, tI50 is favored over cI16 and oP8, whereas oC120 and aP90 remain closely competitive, with their relative stability sensitive to model accuracy. These results provide testable structural models for unresolved experimental phases and reveal multiple closely competing low-enthalpy configurations near sodium's melting minimum
articles.abstract_zh: 钠在其熔化曲线最小值附近表现出显著的复杂晶相聚集，但实验中观察到的几种相的原子排列仍未得到解决。在这里，我们将CALYPSO晶体结构预测与通过并行学习开发的深势模型相结合，以探索这种结构格局。对超过160万种构型的搜索恢复了先前报道的tI50的I4/m结构，并鉴定了oC120和aP90的候选原子排列，以及另外三种低焓结构tI52、oP72和oP92。所提出的候选结构再现了实验标定的晶胞几何形状的关键特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钠在其熔化曲线最小值附近表现出显著的复杂晶相聚集，但实验中观察到的几种相的原子排列仍未得到解决。在这里，我们将CALYPSO晶体结构预测与通过并行学习开发的深势模型相结合，以探索这种结构格局。对超过160万种构型的搜索恢复了先前报道的tI50的I4/m结构，并鉴定了oC120和aP90的候选原子排列，以及另外三种低焓结构tI52、oP72和oP92。所提出的候选结构再现了实验标定的晶胞几何形状的关键特征。第一性原理焓值计算、吉布斯自由能比较以及固-液共存模拟表明，这些结构与已知的钠相之间存在激烈的竞争。在接近计算的参考熔点最小值时，tI50比cI16和oP8更受青睐，而oC120和aP90仍然具有很强的竞争力，它们的相对稳定性对模型精度很敏感。这些结果为未解决的实验相提供了可检验的结构模型，并揭示了钠熔点最小值附近存在多个紧密竞争的低焓构型。

articles.title: Nonmonotonic In-Plane Thermal Transport in Metal-Embedded Graphitic Carbon Nitride
articles.title_zh: 金属嵌入石墨氮化碳中的非单调面内热输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.30015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Embedding metal atoms within the intrinsic cavities of graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) modifies its local bonding and vibrational properties, yet its consequences for lattice thermal transport remain poorly understood. Here, we combine a machine-learned potential (MLP) with homogeneous nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (HNEMD) to investigate in-plane thermal transport in Cu-embedded g-C3N4 across the full range of cavity occupation. The thermal conductivity exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence on Cu occupation, decreasing at intermediate occupation and partially recovering as the cavities approach full occupation. Frequency-resolved analysis reveals that this behavior originates from the competition between two phonon contributions. The low-frequency vibrations introduced by Cu couple to the intrinsic modes of g-C3N4, reconstructing the phonon dispersion and suppressing thermal transport below 10 THz. With increasing Cu occupation, the collective mechanical response of the N atoms surrounding the cavities is enhanced, accompanied by increased phonon group velocities in the 20-30 THz range and a corresponding recovery of the high-frequency thermal contribution. The competition between the saturating low-frequency suppression and the increasing high-frequency contribution gives rise to the nonmonotonic thermal conductivity. A similar occupation dependence and spectral redistribution are observed for Ag-embedded g-C3N4. These results identify competing phonon contributions as the microscopic origin of nonmonotonic thermal transport in metal-embedded g-C3N4 and suggest that occupation of intrinsic cavities provides a route to redistributing phonon transport in porous crystalline materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 将金属原子嵌入石墨氮化碳（g-C3N4）的固有空腔中会改变其局部键合和振动特性，但其对晶格热输运的影响仍不甚明了。本文将机器学习势（MLP）与均匀非平衡分子动力学（HNEMD）相结合，研究了在整个空穴占据范围内Cu嵌入g-C3N4的面内热输运。热导率对Cu占位表现出明显的非单调依赖性，在中等占位时降低，而在空位接近完全占位时部分恢复。频率分辨分析表明，这种行为源于两种声子贡献之间的竞争。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将金属原子嵌入石墨氮化碳（g-C3N4）的固有空腔中会改变其局部键合和振动特性，但其对晶格热输运的影响仍不甚明了。本文将机器学习势（MLP）与均匀非平衡分子动力学（HNEMD）相结合，研究了在整个空穴占据范围内Cu嵌入g-C3N4的面内热输运。热导率对Cu占位表现出明显的非单调依赖性，在中等占位时降低，而在空位接近完全占位时部分恢复。频率分辨分析表明，这种行为源于两种声子贡献之间的竞争。Cu引入的低频振动与g-C3N4的本征模式耦合，重构了声子色散，并抑制了10 THz以下的热输运。随着Cu占据率的增加，空腔周围N原子的集体力学响应增强，同时20-30 THz范围内的声子群速度增加，高频热贡献相应地恢复。饱和的低频抑制与不断增加的高频贡献之间的竞争导致了非单调热导率。在嵌入银的g-C3N4中观察到类似的占有率依赖性和谱分布。这些结果确定了竞争性声子贡献是金属嵌入g-C3N4中非单调热传输的微观起源，并表明本征空腔的占据为多孔晶体材料中声子传输的再分配提供了一条途径。

articles.title: NEP-Spin: A spin-dependent neuroevolution potential for large-scale spin--lattice simulations
articles.title_zh: NEP-Spin：用于大规模自旋-晶格模拟的自旋依赖性神经进化势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.30076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NEP-Spin is a glsentrylongnep for coupled atomic motion and variable-length magnetic moments. Local bond and spin tensors give an energy invariant under independent spin and spatial rotations without glsentrylongsoc and under joint rotations with it. We benchmark energies, atomic forces, and magnetic forces on public datasets for collinear Fe--Al and noncollinear Fe. In multiferroic glsentrylongbfo, the predicted zero-field cycloid period is 69.7~nm, compared with 62--63~nm from neutron scattering. An electric field of 20~mV/Å{} opposite to the polarization lengthens the period to 93.2~nm, while imposing the same polar displacement at zero field gives 85.1~nm. In a uniform antiferromagnetic cell at fixed lattice vectors, 6~T magnetic fields along orthogonal basal axes reorient the Fe moments and give opposite signs of the ionic polarization change Δ P_y. First-principles ionic relaxations at the predicted moment vectors reproduce both signs. In a 2.79-million-atom ferroelectric twin, the cycloid rotation planes tilt by different amounts from their shared initial plane and remain distinct over 10~ps at 100~K. At 10~ps the propagation axes lie within about 7^circ of their initial directions. With inertial spin dynamics, GPUMD advances a 5.93-million-atom BiFeO₃ cell at 21.8 million atom-steps per second on four RTX 4090 GPUs.
articles.abstract_zh: NEP-Spin是一种用于耦合原子运动和可变长度磁矩的glsentrylongnep。局部键张量和自旋张量在没有glsentrylongsoc的独立自旋和空间旋转下，以及在与其联合旋转下，提供一个能量不变量。我们对共线Fe--Al和非共线Fe的公共数据集进行了能量、原子力和磁力的基准测试。在多铁性glsentrylongbfo中，预测的零场旋晶周期为69.7~nm，而中子散射得到的周期为62--63~nm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NEP-Spin是一种用于耦合原子运动和可变长度磁矩的glsentrylongnep。局部键张量和自旋张量在没有glsentrylongsoc的独立自旋和空间旋转下，以及在与其联合旋转下，提供一个能量不变量。我们对共线Fe--Al和非共线Fe的公共数据集进行了能量、原子力和磁力的基准测试。在多铁性glsentrylongbfo中，预测的零场旋晶周期为69.7~nm，而中子散射得到的周期为62--63~nm。与极化相反的 20~mV/Å{} 电场将周期延长至 93.2~nm，而在零场下施加相同的极性位移则得到 85.1~nm。在具有固定晶格矢量的均匀反铁磁晶胞中，沿正交基轴的6~T磁场使Fe磁矩重新定向，并产生离子极化变化Δ P_y的相反符号。在预测的磁矩矢量处的第一性原理离子弛豫再现了这两个符号。在一个由279万个原子组成的铁电孪晶中，旋轮线旋转平面相对于其共有的初始平面以不同的角度倾斜，并且在100~K下保持超过10~ps的显著性。在 10~ps 时，传播轴位于其初始方向的约 7^circ 范围内。借助惯性自旋动力学，GPUMD 在四块 RTX 4090 GPU 上以每秒 2180 万个原子步长的速度推进一个由 593 万个原子组成的 BiFeO₃ 晶胞。

articles.title: Indentation-induced polar domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe4
articles.title_zh: 压痕诱导的电荷密度波半导体EuTe4极性畴重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.30121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling polar domains in conducting materials by external fields could unlock polarization-based electronic functionalities, yet remains experimentally challenging. While mechanical actuation driven by local strain, stress, or strain gradients has been proposed as an external-voltage-free route, its experimental demonstration in relatively conducting polar materials remains limited. Here we demonstrate mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave (CDW) semiconductor EuTe4 at room temperature, whose resistivity is on the order of 10 mΩcm. Polarized-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements reveal CDW-induced in-plane polarization domains with an approximately 90 ^circ domain configuration. Local indentation with a sim1 μm-apex-radius needle reconfigures these domains, producing write/erase-like changes in wedge-shaped regions. These results establish local mechanical-field domain engineering in a relatively conducting CDW semiconductor, with possible contributions from both ferroelastic-like and flexoelectric mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过外加电场控制导电材料中的极性畴可以实现基于极化的电子功能，但仍存在实验上的挑战。虽然人们已提出由局部应变、应力或应变梯度驱动的机械致动作为一种无需外加电压的途径，但其在相对导电的极性材料中的实验示范仍然有限。本文展示了在室温下，电荷密度波（CDW）半导体EuTe4中机械诱导的极性畴重构，其电阻率在10 mΩcm量级。偏振光显微镜和二阶谐波产生测量揭示了CDW诱导的平面内极化畴，其畴构型约为90 ^circ。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过外加电场控制导电材料中的极性畴可以实现基于极化的电子功能，但仍存在实验上的挑战。虽然人们已提出由局部应变、应力或应变梯度驱动的机械致动作为一种无需外加电压的途径，但其在相对导电的极性材料中的实验示范仍然有限。本文展示了在室温下，电荷密度波（CDW）半导体EuTe4中机械诱导的极性畴重构，其电阻率在10 mΩcm量级。偏振光显微镜和二阶谐波产生测量揭示了CDW诱导的平面内极化畴，其畴构型约为90 ^circ。使用尖端半径为1 μm的针头进行局部压痕，可重构这些畴，在楔形区域产生类似写入/擦除的变化。这些结果在相对导电的CDW半导体中建立了局部机械场畴工程，其中可能存在类铁弹性和挠曲电性机制的贡献。

articles.title: Projecting Fermions into Exact Scar Towers: Local Protection across Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 将费米子投影到精确疤痕塔：跨相变的局部保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.30143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct exact scar towers in SO(n) (nge3) spin chains by Gutzwiller projection of n-flavor flat-band Kitaev chains.
