articles.title: Phenol degradation using an immobilized Bacillus cereus–PVA–alginate system: Process optimization, kinetic modeling, and repeated-batch performance
articles.abstract: Phenol removal from wastewater remains a challenge because of the toxicity of this compound and its effects on aquatic systems. Physical and chemical treatments have been used for this purpose, but they may require high energy consumption and chemical reagents. In this work, Bacillus cereus cells were immobilized in a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)–sodium alginate matrix, and their ability to degrade phenol was evaluated at concentrations of 500, 750, and 1000 mg/L. Degradation efficiencies of 99.78, 99.88, and 99.89% were obtained, respectively. The immobilized cells were reused for 13 cycles and maintained degradation efficiencies above 97% at the three concentrations. When the degradation percentages obtained in each cycle were added, cumulative values higher than 1200% were reached. Phenol concentration and number of reuse cycles were analyzed using response surface methodology. The model identified 737.37 mg/L phenol at 13 cycles and 997.14 mg/L phenol at 12.99 cycles as the conditions with the highest cumulative degradation responses, with predicted values of 1286.86 and 1283.00%, respectively. During experimental validation, the corresponding values were 1279.40 and 1288.82%, which were close to those predicted by the model. The validation data were also fitted to the Haldane–Andrews model. The estimated (Ki) values were 715.21 and 835.58 mg/L, the (Ks) values were 30.76 and 25.65 mg/L, and the µmax values were 0.37 and 0.42, with (R2) values of 0.99 and 0.97, respectively. Overall, immobilization in PVA–sodium alginate allowed Bacillus cereus cells to maintain their phenol-degrading activity during repeated use.

articles.title: A simple analytical solution for the evolution of the mean eccentricity vector in extremely low lunar orbits
articles.abstract: Orbital dynamics in extremely Low Lunar Orbits (eLLOs), whose altitudes are typically lower than 50 km, is dominated by the Moon's gravity field, where the presence of "mascons" can cause instabilities of the motion and lead satellites to collide with the lunar surface. This work presents a compact analytical solution for the evolution of the mean eccentricity vector of near-circular eLLOs under the effect of zonal, sectorial and tesseral harmonics of the lunar gravity field. It represents an extension of the theories by G.E. Cook (1966) and R.A. Cook (1992), who considered only zonal harmonics. The analytical model is validated against numerical propagations of a broad set of initial conditions, showing that it reproduces the main long-and medium-period features of the mean eccentricity vector as long as the assumptions of the model remain satisfied. The results highlight the importance of odd-degree tesseral harmonics in shaping the eccentricity evolution and support the use of this model as a complementary tool for understanding and predicting the motion of near-circular eLLOs.

articles.title: Targeted In-Context Poisoning of Tabular Foundation Models: An Empirical Study
articles.abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict the label of a query row conditioned on a context of labelled rows, without training on them. Drawn from operational data, the context becomes an attack surface. We study targeted in-context poisoning in its simplest form: an attacker with write access to the context's source places exact copies of a target row there with the wrong label. On zDS OpenML datasets for binary classification, one such poison row flips on average 53 % (TabICL) and 65 % (TabPFN) of the predictions correct without attack, and three poison rows flip almost all. The same copy with the true label flips almost none, and performance on the remaining rows hardly changes. Predictions flip by two routes: in TabICL, the target row's embedding rotates towards the mean of the wrong class; in TabPFN, the poison row pulls genuine rows of the wrong class along. The TFMs thus infer soundly, but from forged evidence. Predictions of trained models flip as well: almost always for a random forest, for CatBoost as often as for the TFMs, hardly for a logistic regression. New with TFMs is not the kind of vulnerability but the timing: the data take effect at the moment of prediction, not through training, and a poison row in a live context can be deleted afterwards. Three established requirements must therefore cover the context: access control for its source, traceability per prediction, which can also deter, and validation at prediction time. A detection mechanism shows how such validation can work.

articles.title: Surface waters expose ambiguity in global satellite-based groundwater estimates
articles.abstract: Groundwater storage is commonly estimated by subtracting modeled soil moisture, snow and canopy water from terrestrial water storage (TWS) observed by the GRACE satellite missions, implicitly assuming that residuals represent groundwater. This assumption is problematic because land surface models (LSMs) partition water differently and often omit surface water storage (SWS). Here, we couple four global LSMs with a hydrodynamic model and quantify how model-consistent river and floodplain storage alters TWS during 2003–2014. The models generate markedly different runoff and SWS contributions, with global SWS impact indices ranging from 14% to 27% of modeled seasonal TWS variability. Nevertheless, adding each model’s corresponding SWS generally improves agreement with GRACE and increases multi-model consistency. Degradation is concentrated in snow- and ice-dominated regions and strongly regulated basins, where cryospheric processes remain uncertain and reservoir operations are not represented. These results show that SWS is a necessary, model-dependent component of TWS and that residual differences between GRACE and model-consistent TWS (i.e., accounting for SWS) should not be interpreted as groundwater without consideration for various sources of uncertainty. These may include model structural limitations, forcing and parameterization errors, unresolved human influences and satellite uncertainty. This challenges the common practice of estimating groundwater variations as a GRACE-LSM residual.

articles.title: Diurnal Land Surface Temperature Signals in Drought Propagation across Southeast Australia
articles.abstract: Drought propagation links precipitation deficits to changes in soil moisture, vegetation, and terrestrial water storage (TWS), but the timing and relative severity of thermal responses remain insufficiently quantified. We examined these responses across southeast Australia using the Himawari-8/9 diurnal temperature range index (DTRI), precipitation anomaly (PA), surface soil moisture anomaly (SMA), normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) anomaly, and TWS anomaly. Event-based analysis of the 2017–2019 Tinderbox drought quantified response delays and relative severity, expressed as response area ratios. DTRI responded after surface soil moisture drying and before vegetation greenness decline, with response delays of 4, 15, and 42 days for SMA, DTRI, and NDVI anomaly, respectively. The DTRI response was also weaker than the SMA response but stronger than the NDVI anomaly response in terms of relative severity. This ordering persisted across six climate zones wherever NDVI anomaly crossed the drought threshold. Soil moisture and NDVI responses were generally weaker in wetter zones. These findings place diurnal thermal responses between soil moisture depletion and greenness decline within drought propagation and support their complementary role in characterizing drought development.

articles.title: Productivity and surface-texture trade-offs in jet-electrodeposited copper tracks: a replicated factorial study
articles.abstract: Jet electrodeposition offers localized, low-temperature fabrication of metallic features, but selecting operating conditions requires balancing deposition productivity, geometrical development, surface texture, and repeatability. This study investigates the combined effects of applied current (2–6 mA) and nozzle scanning speed (0.6–1.4 mm/min) on single-pass copper tracks fabricated on copper substrates. A replicated 5 × 5 full-factorial design (125 trials) was evaluated using volume-derived apparent material deposition rate (MDR), maximum track height (Hmax ), profile roughness (Ra), and waviness (Wa). Factorial analysis of variance, variability metrics, and an experimental three-objective Pareto classification were employed; quadratic response surfaces were also assessed for model adequacy. Mean MDR increased from 0.017 to 0.058  mg/min between the lowest and highest scanning speeds, although this change was strongly influenced by deposition-time normalization. The highest MDR (0.08845 mg/min; 6 mA, 1.4 mm/min) exhibited substantially greater variability than a lower-throughput alternative at 5 mA and the same speed. Maximum track height ranged from 8.955 to 15.923 µm and was weakly correlated with MDR (r = 0.122). Minimum Ra (0.673 µm) and Wa (1.133 µm) occurred at different current–speed settings, with significant interactions between the processing factors for both texture responses. Ten of the 25 conditions were non-dominated when maximizing MDR while minimizing Ra and Wa. Because the quadratic models exhibited significant lack of fit, recommendations were confined to experimentally tested combinations. These findings establish an application-oriented framework for identifying transparent productivity–quality trade-offs in localized copper manufacturing.

articles.title: Visualizing Motivational Interviewing: A Two-Study Evaluation of Progress Bars and Behavior Change Features in a Procrastination Conversational Interface
articles.abstract: Procrastination is a common self-regulation challenge, yet many digital interventions emphasize reflection more than action. We present ProactiMate, an MI (Motivational Interviewing)-based conversational system designed to help users overcome procrastination. Through two studies, we examine how conversational AI can better support motivation and action. Study 1 evaluated a progress bar that visualizes users’ advancement through the MI process. Results show that it improved usability, confidence, and positive emotional responses, while fostering a greater sense of progress. Study 2 evaluated an expanded system with features such as progress tracking, micro-interventions, if–then planning, a Pomodoro timer, rewards, and avatar personalization. Findings highlight a persistent gap between reflection and action: although users valued reflective dialogue, they primarily needed concise, actionable guidance to begin tasks. They preferred features that translated reflection into concrete actions. We then discuss design implications for conversational behavior change systems, emphasizing actionability, reduced cognitive load, and meaningful progress feedback.

articles.title: Reachability of complete quantum operations under dynamical error correction
articles.abstract: Which complete quantum operations remain reachable when control errors in multi-qubit systems are cancelled to a prescribed order? We develop a manifold framework mapping corrected control sets to reachable full-register operations and distinguishing their logical action on a computational subspace. It covers separately corrected modules, joint cancellation across sequences and permitted subspace excursions. For signed, drift-free unitary controls with shared quasistatic errors and primitive-dependent linear gains, we classify the reachable set and prove its invariance across positive finite orders. In collective spin dynamics, relative phases distinguish correctable extensions of the same logical gate. Local fibers at regular controls describe implementation freedom. For a three-qubit target, we certify a continuous family of implementations with worst-case channel error below 0.01 throughout ±1% gain offsets, including bounded control perturbations and local dephasing. In four- and five-qubit simulations, first-order initialization lowers maximum sampled depth-32 errors in seven of eight matched comparisons with full-range training.

articles.title: Corn-Stalk-Derived Porous Carbon Coupled Spinel NiCo 2 O 4 Hierarchical Microspheres as Advanced Electrodes for Aqueous Asymmetric Supercapacitors
articles.abstract: Spinel NiCo2O4 combines the Ni²+/Ni³+ and Co²+/Co³+ redox couples and is a leading pseudocapacitive candidate for supercapacitor positive electrodes, but its poor intrinsic conductivity and the restacking of microsphere-assembled nanosheets limit rate capability and long cycling. We follow a chain of screening experiments, structural analysis, kinetic analysis and device validation. NiCo2O4 microspheres were prepared by a solvothermal-calcination route and porous carbon (BC, BET surface area 327.6 m² g−¹) was derived from corn stalk by KOH activation; composite electrodes were made by physical blending, and two screening experiments covered hydrothermal temperature (120–180°C) and oxide:carbon mass ratio (1:9–9:1). Structures were resolved by XRD, XPS, SEM/TEM and BET; CV, GCD and EIS measurements were performed in a three-electrode cell in 2 M KOH, and charge-storage mechanisms were quantified with the power-law model and the surface-capacitive contribution separation. Experiments and analysis jointly show that 160°C and the 7:3 ratio give the best overall performance; BC preserves the spinel phase and the mixed Ni and Co oxidation states while forming conductive bridges between microspheres and preserving a 1.4/3.6/8 nm hierarchical pore set; the 7:3 electrode delivers 1136 F g−¹ at 1 A g−¹, about 82% above the pure phase, with 79.4% retention at 5 A g−¹; a power-law exponent b of 0.71, a 75.4% surface-capacitive contribution at 50 mV s−¹, a charge-transfer resistance reduced from about 140 to about 30 Ω, and 87.7% retention after 3000 cycles at 2 A g-¹. The commercial activated-carbon anode delivers 165 F g−¹ at 1 A g−¹, with 94.6% retention after 3000 cycles. An asymmetric device (m+:m− = 1:2.3) with a commercial activated-carbon negative electrode operates over 0–1.4 V; its cell capacitance is 47.7 F g−¹ on the total active mass (157.3 F g−¹ referred to the positive electrode), corresponding to 13.0 Wh kg−¹ at 212 W kg−¹ and 8.6 Wh kg−¹ at 2.1 kW kg−¹. The cell retains 89.4% after 10 000 cycles. With a raw-material cost about 36% of graphene-based counterparts, the device offers a low-cost, reproducible power-buffering unit for microgrid frequency-regulation scenarios.

articles.title: Climate Cooperation under Heterogeneity Enforcement versus Technology Sharing
articles.abstract: This contribution investigates under what policy and institutional conditions climate cooperation among heterogeneous sovereign countries can be preserved and sustained over time, in a repeated strategic environment with non-perfect compliance. We focus on the 19 sovereign members of the G20 - which account for about three-quarters of global greenhouse gas emissions - and the study examines whether alternative policy mechanisms can overcome free-riding incentives coming from the asymmetry between domestic costs and global benefits. The analysis employs a repeated-game framework where countries choose between cooperation and defection during an infinite horizon. We compare two different institutional configurations, C0 and C1: i) C0, a benchmark regime combining sanctions (τ) and monetary transfers as incentives (ρ); and ii) C1, a technology-sharing regime reducing mitigation costs ex ante through a calibrated knowledge spillover (δ_club). The dynamic evaluation of these configurations is conducted via Monte Carlo simulations (T = 5,000, R = 300), assuming a three-period tolerance rule, and it provides the common basis for the cross-regime comparison. Results suggest that without enforcement, cooperation collapses immediately. The technology-sharing regime achieves comparable cooperation rates (coop_rate_avg ≈ 0.985) and collapse probabilities (prob_collapse ≈ 0.030) with less than half the policy intensity (τ = 0.22 vs τ + ρ = 0.5) and no transfers. The main contribution of our analysis is to show that policy design can matter as much as enforcement strength. These findings support designing climate clubs as cooperative structures that reduce individual mitigation costs, and not as agreements based primarily on punishment or redistribution.

articles.title: Taxonomic and functional alteration of bird communities in photovoltaic power plants
articles.abstract: The construction of photovoltaic (PV) power plants induces habitat conversion and degradation, which consequently affect species communities and ecosystem functioning. However, the impacts of PV power plants on species diversity remain poorly understood. This study investigates the effects of a PV power plant on taxonomic and functional composition of bird communities. We conducted bird surveys in PV power plants located in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP) of China, which encompasses two major microhabitat types – Caragana-dominated shrubland and Stipa-Achnatherum steppe, along with adjacent natural habitats. Our findings demonstrate: (i) bird taxonomic diversity remained stable but functional diversity increased within PV power plants; (ii) The PV power plants selectively attracted smaller species, herbivores and understory foragers while filtering out larger species, granivores and ground foragers, it also attracted species with weak dispersal abilities, likely due to spatial and resource changes induced by artificial structures; (iii) These impacts were similar across both microhabitat types but exhibited variations due to their ecological characteristics. Notably, PV power plants within the Caragana-dominated shrubland supported less vertebrate-consuming species, while PV effects within Stipa-Achnatherum steppe were more pronounced on granivores and ground dwellers. With a more comprehensive analysis of functional traits, our results unravel the underlying process driving PV-induced community-level alteration in avian assemblages, which has rarely been explored in previous studies. It also highlights the need to investigate the spatiotemporal trajectory of PV induced impacts on avian diversity.

articles.title: Compact representation of material-state fields in dexel-based virtual manufacturing of hybrid components
articles.abstract: Virtual manufacturing of components with locally varying material compositions requires the representation of material states that vary along the component. These states include quantities such as residual stresses, microstructure, and hardness. Finite element simulations can resolve these states, but they become too costly at full component scale. Existing approaches are therefore limited to local process regions. This work presents a method for storing material-state information in a dexel-based representation. The material-state data are encoded as parametric functions along the build direction, reducing data volume and memory requirements. The approach is demonstrated using temperature data obtained from a voxel-based thermal simulation, with B-splines used as a representative function class. Applied to one-dimensional temperature profiles, the method achieves a reduction of 84% in stored data at a maximum RMSD of 0.1% of the peak temperature. The proposed method enables an efficient and scalable representation of heterogeneous material states and provides a foundation for property-aware virtual manufacturing and process planning of hybrid structures.

articles.title: A dissolved anion replaces gas feeds in hydrocarbon electrosynthesis
articles.abstract: Electrosynthesis of hydrocarbons by Fischer–Tropsch-type chain growth has largely used CO or CO2 gas feeds, whose C–O bonds must be broken to make surface carbon. Here we show that a dissolved anion bearing a C–S bond can supply that carbon instead. On iron foil in water under argon, thiocyanate (SCN−), a pseudohalide of industrial effluents, is converted into C1–C7 alkanes and alkenes under near-ambient conditions; without it no hydrocarbon forms. Dual 13C/D labelling assigns 94–99% of the carbon in the C4–C6 products to thiocyanate and most of the hydrogen to water, and resolves two weakly mixing carbon pools when CO is co-fed. A precursor series (KSCN ≫ thiourea ≈ KSeCN ≫ KOCN) indicates that a reducible C–S or C–Se bond, not the C≡N group, makes a donor active, and operando impedance separates light-associated rate gains from bulk heating. Soluble chalcogen–carbon donors can thus replace the gas feed of hydrocarbon electrosynthesis.

articles.title: Thermodynamically driven typhoon wind hazard projections over the China seas and southeast coast under CMIP6 scenarios using a random forest full-track framework
articles.abstract: Typhoon wind hazards over the China seas threaten massive offshore wind fleets and coastal infrastructure, yet their response to climate change remains inadequately quantified for coastal and offshore engineering. This study investigates how thermodynamic climate forcing reshapes typhoon wind hazards over the China seas and southeast coast. Monthly mean sea surface temperatures from ten CMIP6 global climate models (1979–2100) drive a random forest-based tropical cyclone (TC) full-track simulation framework (RFFT). For the historical period (1979–2015) and the mid- (2019–2055) and late-21st century (2064–2100) under SSP245 and SSP585, 10,000-year synthetic TC ensembles are generated to derive 0.2°-resolution onshore and offshore extreme wind fields. Relative to the baseline, the fraction of western North Pacific TCs reaching typhoon intensity or above rises by 6.0 percentage points by mid-century and exceeds 60% by late century under SSP245. Projected extreme-wind changes show a pronounced positive latitudinal gradient. Under SSP585, wind speeds at an annual exceedance probability of 0.01 increase by up to 11% by mid-century and 15% by late century along the northern Jiangsu coast. Offshore extremes rise by up to 14%, whereas changes south of Fujian lie within the inter-model spread. These projections provide spatially continuous design-wind modification factors for coastal hazard mitigation.

articles.title: Effects of Sediment Preparation Protocol on Cyanobacterial Microfossil Recovery from Lake Sediments
articles.abstract: Increasing prevalence of harmful cyanobacteria algal blooms in global waters poses a significant threat to aquatic life and to human and animal health. Despite considerable progress in monitoring and detection, many freshwater systems lack long-term records of bloom development. In principle, paleolimnological studies based on sediment proxies, including biochemical indicators (e.g., fossil pigments, eDNA) and microfossils (akinetes, heterocytes, sheaths), are a valuable tool for investigating past cyanobacterial bloom dynamics, nutrient fluctuations, and water quality changes. However, relatively little is known of how sediment preparation techniques may affect estimation of historical population densities. Here we use a two-by-two factorial experiment to evaluate the unique and interactive effects of sediment sieving and acetolysis on the recovery of cyanobacterial microfossils from surface (0–1 cm) sediments of two eutrophic lakes (Lough Aghery, Ballysaggart Lough) in Northern Ireland, UK. Each of four treatments were run in triplicate and included a common mild preliminary treatment with KOH to disperse sediments, an addition of Lycopodium clavatum spores to standardise counts, and a brief (5 sec) sonication to reduce clumping of akinetes. Results show substantial variation in microfossil abundance across treatments, with consistently and significantly higher microfossil recovery in the least intensive treatment (-sieve, -acetolysis), while acetolysis reduced akinete concentrations 85–95% and biased taxonomic representations due to selective loss of Aphanizomenon spp. akinetes relative to those from Anabaena / Dolichospermum spp. or sheaths from Gloeotrichia spp. Together, analyses suggest that minimal processing (+ KOH, +sonication, -sieve, -acetolysis) produces the least-biased recovery of cyanobacterial remains, at least for these genera and similar sedimentary environments.

articles.title: Evaluating the Confidence-Interval Performance of the Double LASSO Estimator in High-Dimensional Linear Models
articles.abstract: High-dimensional control settings have become standard in empirical economics, yet reliable inference on low-dimensional parameters remains challenging when model selection is required. This paper evaluates the finite-sample confidence interval performance of the Double LASSO estimator in high-dimensional linear models. Using a comprehensive Monte Carlo design, we examine coverage probability, interval length, bias, and RMSE across data-generating processes that vary in dimensionality, covariate correlation, signal structure, and tail behavior. The results show that Double LASSO generally delivers coverage close to the nominal level when theoretically calibrated (plug-in) penalties are used. In heavy-tailed environments, empirical coverage tends to increase, primarily due to wider confidence intervals rather than systematic improvements in estimator accuracy. Performance is most stable in designs with moderate covariate correlation, while weak-signal and low-correlation settings reveal finite sample sensitivity to regularization choices. In contrast, ordinary least squares becomes unstable or infeasible as dimensionality approaches the sample size, leading to unreliable or excessively wide intervals. Overall, the findings indicate that Double LASSO provides a robust framework for inference in high-dimensional linear models, though its finite-sample performance remains sensitive to tuning and design characteristics.

articles.title: Universal electrical transport of composite Fermi liquid to Metal transition in Moiré systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15334v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study universal electrical transport at continuous transitions between a composite Fermi liquid and a Fermi liquid in moiré Chern bands at fillings ν=-1/2 and -3/4. The critical theory couples Dirac fermions at a boson Laughlin--superfluid transition to a spinon Fermi surface through Chern--Simons gauge fields. We derive the Ioffe--Larkin rule for the full resistivity tensor and solve a quantum Boltzmann equation at leading order in a large-N expansion. Spinon Landau damping adds a quasistatic scattering channel with weight independent of the spinon Fermi energy. At N=1 we obtain clean-limit resistivity jumps Δρₓₓapprox5.896,h/e² and 0.1274,h/e² at the two fillings.

articles.title: Mixed-state Phases from Higher-order SSPTs with Kramers-Wannier Symmetry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03455v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixed-state phases have recently attracted significant attention as a generalization beyond their pure-state counterparts. Prominent examples include mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (mSPT) phases and the strong-to-weak symmetry breaking (SWSSB) phases. It has been shown recently that mSPT phases admit a holographic dual description in terms of higher-order subsystem SPT phases. In this work, we investigate the mixed-state phases obtained by tracing out the bulk degrees of freedom of higher-order subsystem SPT phases protected by non-invertible symmetries. We find that the resulting mixed-states exhibit the coexistence of the symmetry-protected topological order and SWSSB. We also use the interface as a probe to characterize the mixed-state phases, and specifically, when there is no local modification to preserve the symmetries across the interface, the two sides of the interface are in distinct phases.

articles.title: Scaling Density Functional Theory with Gaussian Splatting
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31483v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) strikes a practical balance between accuracy and computational cost in many problems of computational chemistry and materials science. However, many DFT calculations are limited by fixed atom-centered basis sets, which dictate how accuracy and cost scale with system size. We propose Gaussian Splatting for Density Functional Theory (GS-DFT), which represents molecular orbitals as a cloud of Gaussians whose positions, shapes, and mixing coefficients are optimized jointly by gradient descent to minimize the energy without training data. Conceptually, GS-DFT is 3D Gaussian splatting with the renderer replaced by quantum mechanics. We introduce two key solver components: adaptive density fitting with screening for efficient evaluation of two-electron integrals, and a regularized differentiable orthogonalization of the molecular orbitals. Empirically, the optimized basis reaches the accuracy of the largest conventional basis sets with a fraction of the parameters, converging systematically in energy, density, and nuclear forces. At equal parameter count, it captures the stretched-bond and anion physics that fixed bases only recover with specialized basis augmentation. The resulting solver exhibits quadratic peak memory scaling in the cloud size, allowing us to simulate systems of up to 2,742 atoms (10,406 electrons) without any modifications at triple-zeta scale using a single four-GPU node.

articles.title: High-fidelity simulation and reduced-order modeling of optical pumping in quantum devices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41778v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting spin polarization and light attenuation in optically pumped atomic devices requires solving the coupled diffusive quantum master equation (DQME)--light system. Its nonlinearity, spatially nonlocal coupling, and physical admissibility constraints make high-fidelity numerical simulation challenging. We develop a structure-preserving high-fidelity solver that combines second-order finite differences for three-dimensional atomic diffusion, explicit pseudo-time marching for atomic populations, and an exponential integrator for light propagation. Under a derived time-step restriction, the solver preserves population normalization and nonnegativity, as well as the positivity and monotonic attenuation of the light intensity. Three complementary test cases based on an analytical reduction, asymptotic limits, and an analytical invariant are constructed to verify the solver. To accelerate repeated parameter queries, we eliminate the light field and construct a reduced-order model (ROM) using proper orthogonal decomposition and Galerkin projection of the resulting integro-differential formulation involving only atomic populations. An exact quadratic expansion of the spin-exchange term and discrete empirical interpolation of the optical-pumping term make the cost of evaluating the reduced operators independent of the full-order dimension. Numerical tests verify the solver and demonstrate ROM accuracy outside the training set. The GPU implementation completes simulations with millions of unknowns in minutes, while single-core ROM evaluations take seconds, achieving respective speedup factors exceeding 150 and 7000 relative to the single-core high-fidelity solver.

articles.title: Efficient all-electron Bethe-Salpeter implementation using crystal symmetries
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jörn Stöhler, Stefan Blügel, and Christoph Friedrich The authors describe here an all-electron implementation of the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) within the full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave (FLAPW) method, using a mixed basis for the Coulomb interaction potentials and an analytical treatment of the Coulomb divergence. Group theory is exploited to block-diagonalize the two-particle Hamiltonian, substantially reducing the computational cost. The parallelized code supports spin-orbit coupling and distributed memory. Calculated optical spectra and exciton binding energies for Si, LiF, and MoS 2 agree well with available theoretical and experimental results. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 285127] Published Tue Nov 24, 2026

articles.abstract: Author(s): Sanchar Sharma Entangling distant spins via a shared magnonic bus typically faces a trade-off: stronger spin-magnon coupling increases the entanglement fidelity, but also the spin decay rate. articles.title: Controlling vertical and lateral growth of copper and ruthenium on tungsten dichalcogenide monolayers for interconnects and metal contacts
articles.abstract: Tungsten-based transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers (TMDs) show significant promise in applications including catalysis, semiconductors, and sensors. A key requirement is interfacing the TMDs with metals. Controlling the morphology of the interfaced metal is critical for performance. Atomic level simulations can be used to predict how metals interact and grow on TMDs. First principles studies of metal-TMDs have focused on single metal adatom interactions, or pristine metal–monolayer interfaces. Consequently, there persists a gap in predicting metal growth on TMDs, limiting optimization of TMD-metal interfaces for new technologies. We present a density functional theory study of Cu and Ru deposit adsorption and dynamics on WS 2 and WSe 2 monolayers. By characterizing the behavior of metal deposits that display a variety of potential morphologies with an ensemble of analytical shape descriptors derived from the gyration tensor, we develop a quantitative description of the morphology and dynamics of deposited metals on TMDs. This approach allows direct comparison of metal deposit morphologies on different substrates. On both TMDs, Cu prefers to form compact, vertically growing clusters, suitable for catalysis and sensing, while Ru prefers lateral growth suitable for interconnects and contacts in next-generation semiconductors. Dynamics simulations show that temperature promotes further growth in the favored direction, providing a route for interface optimization after initial deposition.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Phase behavior of a two-dimensional suspension of active pentagons
articles.abstract: Applying insights acquired when studying idealized particle systems to real-world amorphous materials remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the complex interplay between particles’ shape and interaction mechanisms. It is known that regular pentagons do not tessellate the two dimensional plane, making them the simplest regular polygons unable to form periodic tilings. This geometric constraint, combined with the complexity of interactions among non-spherical particles, may give rise to rich emergent behaviors, especially when dealing with self-propelled pentagons. Thus, geometry, interactions, and self-propulsion collectively lead to novel dynamical emergent phases. In this context, we investigate how activity and excluded-volume interactions affect the collective behavior of a two-dimensional suspension of active pentagon-shaped particles. Our results reveal that active pentagons not only undergo an arrested motility-induced phase separation but, under given conditions, also form traveling/rotating clusters exhibiting translational/chiral motion. Interestingly, both phases present an enhanced stability due to particles’ activity, shape, and excluded-volume interactions, forming an ice-ray lattice whose internal structure represents the densest packing fraction a two-dimensional pentagon suspension may achieve.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Membrane thickness strain from protein inclusions: A multiscale simulation and x-ray scattering study of proteoliposomes
articles.abstract: Integral membrane proteins remodel the surrounding lipid bilayer, but quantifying the resulting deformations and linking them to protein density in the membrane has remained challenging. Here, we introduce an integrative methodology that combines all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with multiscale small-angle x-ray scattering (SAXS) analysis to connect membrane thickness strain to the protein/lipid ratio in proteoliposomes. Using outer membrane phospholipase A (OmpLA) reconstituted into lipid bilayers with either larger or smaller hydrophobic thickness, we systematically probe the effects of positive and negative hydrophobic mismatch. MD simulations demonstrate that OmpLA causes anisotropic, oscillatory thickness deformations extending up to eight times the radius of the first lipid shell surrounding the protein, yet the net change in average membrane thickness remains below 1%. Through our multiscale SAXS analysis, we quantitatively extract structural parameters, ranging from proteoliposome size to internal membrane architecture, using constrained Bayesian inference, with priors derived from MD findings. Specifically, we determine the average membrane thickness strain, yielding values consistent with MD simulations, and the protein/lipid molar ratio. In thinner bilayers, substantial protein loss limits the analysis, highlighting the role of bilayer stability in sample preparation. Moreover, the predominance of OmpLA monomers in the thicker membranes is consistent with weak, membrane-mediated repulsive interactions between protein inclusions. Collectively, this integrative approach establishes a framework for quantifying protein–lipid interactions across molecular and mesoscale dimensions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Planar brushes of barbwire bottlebrush polymers with bidisperse side chains
articles.abstract: The developed analytical strong-stretching-renormalized self-consistent field (SSR-SCF) approach is applied to investigate the equilibrium structure of dry (solvent-free) brushes formed by double bottlebrush (DB) polymers with compartmentalized polydispersity of the side chains. The stretching of side chains normally to the backbone allows for renormalization of DB polymers into a linear chain of impermeable superblobs of different sizes. It is demonstrated that depending on the relative sizes of superblobs in two domains of tethered chains and the composition of the backbone, distributions of backbone end-points exhibit qualitatively different behavior. DB chains with a lighter proximal to the surface domain and a heavier peripheral domain demonstrate end-point distributions with no dead zone, while DB chains with a lighter peripheral domain could exhibit a dead zone in the brush central region. The SSR-SCF approach could be extended to compartmentalized polydispersity of side chains with multiple domains (tapered polymers) and applied to study micro-phase segregated melts of diblock copolymers with tapered blocks.

articles.title: Ionic serially improved Gaussian-type orbitals for molecular applications: Sodium chloride clusters
articles.abstract: A new ionic basis set family designed for accurate molecular calculations in ionic systems is presented. This family extends the Serially Improved Gaussian Orbitals for Molecular Applications (SIGMA) basis sets by explicitly accounting for the distinctive features of ionic environments. Basis sets of different cardinalities have been developed, together with auxiliary basis sets for resolution-of-the-identity calculations at the HF, PBE, and MP2 levels of theory. Good agreement with experiment is obtained for the physicochemical properties of NaCl clusters, together with an accurate description of ionic charges and the predominantly anionic character of the frontier molecular orbitals. Combined with the PBE method, the ionic SIGMA basis sets provide a reliable description of (NaCl) n clusters containing up to 792 NaCl units without numerical difficulties arising from near-linear dependencies. The proposed basis sets thus provide an efficient and numerically robust framework for accurate electronic-structure calculations on large ionic systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Is there a density-gradient expansion for the electronic exchange energy?
articles.abstract: An old but recurring question in ground-state density functional theory, relevant to the construction of density functional approximations, is the existence of a second-order gradient expansion for the exchange energy that is exact for densities that vary slowly over space. Here, we will argue that there is such an expansion, with a gradient coefficient 10/7 of Sham’s, as suggested by theoretical/mathematical derivations and by numerical calculations on model slowly varying metallic densities, although some standard derivations do not quite capture the correct gradient coefficient. We also discuss long-range anomalies in the gradient expansions for the exchange and correlation holes around an electron. It is plausible that, as suggested earlier and recently, standard derivations are still correct for the coefficient of the second-order gradient expansion for exchange and correlation together, in which case the correct gradient coefficient for correlation is Cc=Cxc−Cx. We propose possible numerical evaluations of Cxc and Cx that are free from long-range anomalies, and discuss implications for density functional approximations. Axel Becke’s 1988 generalized gradient approximation (the B88 GGA) for the exchange energy brought density functional theory into chemistry, with a gradient coefficient for exchange that is optimal at the GGA level for atoms and molecules but too large for solids. Meta -GGAs seem to work as well for molecules as for solids, but may not be perfected yet. The article concludes with a few memories that the first author has of discussions with Axel Becke.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Metadynamics for vacancy dynamics in crystals
articles.abstract: We propose a metadynamics-based (MetaD) approach to construct the free energy surface (FES) for vacancy dynamics in crystals. In this approach, the vacancy FES can be constructed without explicitly defining a unique vacancy coordinate by introducing a set of parameters that strongly govern the FES, which is enabled by parallel bias MetaD with partitioned families . In addition, the proposed approach is made more efficient and effective by multihill strategy that exploits crystallographic symmetry. We demonstrate the validity and efficacy of the proposed approach through its applications to self-diffusion and impurity diffusion via monovacancies and divacancies in metallic and ionic crystals.

articles.title: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过基于黎曼梯度的优化进行自主量子机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability. We propose a framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning, based on Riemannian gradient optimization, in which the optimization proceeds entirely within the quantum domain without requiring quantum measurements or classical feedback. We derive the Riemannian gradient update rules for a broad class of learning tasks and identify sufficient conditions under which the resulting training dynamics can be realized fully autonomously. Within this regime, we establish an exponential convergence guarantee, in the training iterations, for sufficiently small step sizes, and further analyze the training cost in terms of the growth of the circuit depth. Importantly, we further show that the trained model can automatically discover symmetries hidden in the training data without a priori specification. For the canonical examples of quantum phase classification and unitary learning with a hidden symmetry, our numerical study indicates that learning can be achieved at low circuit depths with only a few distinct training examples. Our results thus establish autonomous quantum machine learning as a promising paradigm that removes the classical optimization loop while retaining strong theoretical guarantees and practical performances.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习模型通常依赖于训练期间重复的量子测量和经典优化，使得量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的基本瓶颈。我们提出了一个基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，其中优化完全在量子域内进行，不需要量子测量或经典反馈。我们推导了广泛的学习任务的黎曼梯度更新规则，并确定了可以完全自主地实现训练动态的充分条件。在此体系内，我们在训练迭代中为足够小的步长建立指数收敛保证，并进一步分析电路深度增长方面的训练成本。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子机器学习模型通常依赖于训练期间重复的量子测量和经典优化，使得量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的基本瓶颈。我们提出了一个基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，其中优化完全在量子域内进行，不需要量子测量或经典反馈。我们推导了广泛的学习任务的黎曼梯度更新规则，并确定了可以完全自主地实现训练动态的充分条件。在此体系内，我们在训练迭代中为足够小的步长建立指数收敛保证，并进一步分析电路深度增长方面的训练成本。重要的是，我们进一步表明，经过训练的模型可以自动发现训练数据中隐藏的对称性，而无需先验指定。对于量子相分类和具有隐藏对称性的酉学习的典型示例，我们的数值研究表明，只需几个不同的训练示例就可以在低电路深度下实现学习。因此，我们的结果将自主量子机器学习确立为一种有前途的范例，它消除了经典的优化循环，同时保留了强有力的理论保证和实际性能。

articles.title: Recovering Direct Price Effects of Environmental Amenities in Housing Markets: Regression and Causal Machine Learning Model Assessment with Empirical Monte Carlo Simulation
articles.title_zh: 恢复住房市场中环境设施的直接价格影响：使用经验蒙特卡罗模拟进行回归和因果机器学习模型评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hedonic price models are widely used to value environmental amenities, yet practical guidance for estimating direct unconfounded price effects remains sparse. We conduct an empirical Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate traditional regression and causal machine learning (CML) approaches for estimating the direct unmediated price effect of spatially delineated amenities on treated properties (DUET), a lower-bound approximation of welfare change with direct applications to benefit-cost analysis. Whereas previous simulations rely on parametric assumptions, we preserve the actual data-generating process underlying over 1 million property transactions from upstate New York (1990--2024) and randomly assign treatment locations across iterations, establishing a ground truth against which estimation error can be measured precisely. Generalized difference-in-differences (DID) regression consistently outperforms baseline DID and two-way fixed effects models across all scenarios. Causal forest DID performs comparably to generalized DID in most scenarios and, in larger samples (at least 3,000 treated observations) increasingly common in contemporary hedonic studies, achieves significantly lower estimation error and better confidence interval coverage. Its advantage widens further when the treatment induces a nonlinear shift in the hedonic price function. The performance of causal forest DID, however, hinges on specification choices that differ from regression practice, such as including geographic attributes only in the price models and avoiding high-dimensional fixed effects. We translate these findings into method-specific best-practice recommendations for both regression and CML approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 特征价格模型被广泛用于评估环境设施的价值，但用于估计直接无混杂价格影响的实用指导仍然很少。我们进行了实证蒙特卡罗模拟，以评估传统的回归和因果机器学习（CML）方法，以估计空间描绘的便利设施对处理财产的直接无中介价格影响（DUET），这是福利变化的下限近似值，可直接应用于效益成本分析。尽管之前的模拟依赖于参数假设，但我们保留了纽约州北部（1990--2024）超过 100 万笔房产交易的实际数据生成过程，并在迭代中随机分配处理位置，建立了可以精确测量估计误差的基本事实。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 特征价格模型被广泛用于评估环境设施的价值，但用于估计直接无混杂价格影响的实用指导仍然很少。我们进行了实证蒙特卡罗模拟，以评估传统的回归和因果机器学习（CML）方法，以估计空间描绘的便利设施对处理财产的直接无中介价格影响（DUET），这是福利变化的下限近似值，可直接应用于效益成本分析。尽管之前的模拟依赖于参数假设，但我们保留了纽约州北部（1990--2024）超过 100 万笔房产交易的实际数据生成过程，并在迭代中随机分配处理位置，建立了可以精确测量估计误差的基本事实。在所有场景中，广义双重差分 (DID) 回归始终优于基线 DID 和双向固定效应模型。在大多数情况下，因果森林 DID 的表现与广义 DID 相当，并且在当代特征研究中越来越常见的较大样本（至少 3,000 个处理的观测值）中，可实现显着更低的估计误差和更好的置信区间覆盖。当治疗引起特征价格函数的非线性变化时，其优势进一步扩大。然而，因果森林 DID 的性能取决于与回归实践不同的规范选择，例如仅在价格模型中包含地理属性并避免高维固定效应。我们将这些发现转化为针对回归和 CML 方法的特定方法的最佳实践建议。

articles.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions
articles.title_zh: 行动胜于雄辩：LLM 代理通过 Web 交互中的行为隐蔽通道进行状态隐私嗅探
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on Web interaction, issuing searches, following links, and reading pages, to complete complex user tasks. Since each action is driven by the agent's private context, including the user's prompt, dialogue history, memory, and connected data, it also opens a new privacy exposure surface. Prior attacks either passively analyze network traffic, which yields only coarse correlations, or hijack the agent through indirect prompt injection, which must place sensitive content in an outgoing field and is blocked by content-level defenses. Whether an attacker can actively recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission thus remains insufficiently understood. Our insight is that an agent's benign Web decisions themselves leak private context, as what it chooses to visit encodes whether, which, and in what order it acts, forming a behavioral covert channel. Building on this, we design SNOOP, a stateful hierarchical probing framework that narrows a coarse-to-fine hypothesis tree per task and reconstructs user queries and profiles from the agent's observable paths. Across four agents and three LLM backbones on 500 StackExchange queries and 378 multi-turn iKAT dialogues, SNOOP recovers query concepts with an average F1 of 0.89 and user profiles with an F1 of 0.80, while four representative agent defenses change its recovery by less than 0.03 F1. Since no sensitive content is ever transmitted, content-level inspection cannot detect this leakage; we therefore propose Selection-Obfuscated Retrieval (SOR), which acquires resources under a fixed budget independent of private context and confines the agent's selection to a local snapshot, cutting SNOOP's F1 to 0.39 without additional LLM inference.
articles.abstract_zh: LLM 代理越来越依赖 Web 交互、发布搜索、跟踪链接和阅读页面来完成复杂的用户任务。由于每个动作都是由代理的私有上下文驱动的，包括用户的提示、对话历史、记忆和连接的数据，因此它也打开了一个新的隐私暴露表面。先前的攻击要么被动地分析网络流量（仅产生粗略的相关性），要么通过间接提示注入劫持代理，这必须将敏感内容放置在传出字段中并被内容级防御阻止。
articles.abstract_zh_full: LLM 代理越来越依赖 Web 交互、发布搜索、跟踪链接和阅读页面来完成复杂的用户任务。由于每个动作都是由代理的私有上下文驱动的，包括用户的提示、对话历史、记忆和连接的数据，因此它也打开了一个新的隐私暴露表面。先前的攻击要么被动地分析网络流量（仅产生粗略的相关性），要么通过间接提示注入劫持代理，这必须将敏感内容放置在传出字段中并被内容级防御阻止。 Whether an attacker can actively recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission thus remains insufficiently understood.我们的见解是，代理的良性网络决策本身会泄漏私有上下文，因为它选择访问的内容编码了它是否、以什么顺序以及以什么顺序行动，从而形成了行为隐蔽通道。在此基础上，我们设计了 SNOOP，这是一个有状态的分层探测框架，它可以缩小每个任务从粗到细的假设树，并根据代理的可观察路径重建用户查询和配置文件。在 500 个 StackExchange 查询和 378 个多轮 iKAT 对话的四个代理和三个 LLM 主干上，SNOOP 以平均 F1 为 0.89 恢复查询概念，以 F1 为 0.80 恢复用户配置文件，而四个代表性代理防御将其恢复改变不到 0.03 F1。 Since no sensitive content is ever transmitted, content-level inspection cannot detect this leakage;因此，我们提出选择模糊检索（SOR），它在独立于私有上下文的固定预算下获取资源，并将代理的选择限制在本地快照，将 SNOOP 的 F1 削减到 0.39，而无需额外的 LLM 推理。

articles.title: When Are Images Needed in Multimodal Machine Translation? Text-Only Routing for On-Demand Visual Context
articles.title_zh: 多模态机器翻译何时需要图像？用于按需视觉上下文的纯文本路由
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Image-guided multimodal machine translation (MMT) leverages visual context to resolve translation-relevant uncertainty. However, prevailing systems either process images unconditionally or apply gating only after visual encoding, leaving redundant visual computation unavoidable. To mitigate this computational overhead, routing decisions must rely on a pre-visual source signal. Crucially, surface-level ambiguity does not equate to visual dependence, as intra-sentence textual context often suffices for disambiguation. We therefore formulate visual invocation as source-text sufficiency prediction: determining exclusively from the source text whether translation-relevant uncertainty remains unresolved. To support this formulation, we construct a visual-dependency dataset with three fine-grained labels (no_ambiguity, text_resolved, and vision_needed) and verify discriminative visual evidence for vision_needed instances. We further propose PreVIR, a lightweight, backend-agnostic text-only router that selects between text-only and multimodal branches before computing visual features. Experiments on English-to-Chinese MMT demonstrate that PreVIR achieves a favorable COMET-budget trade-off relative to strong routing baselines. At its default operating point, it substantially reduces visual calls while maintaining translation quality comparable to always-on multimodal inference. Label-wise and case analyses show that this trade-off stems from distinguishing genuine visual dependency from contextually resolved ambiguity.
articles.abstract_zh: 图像引导多模式机器翻译 (MMT) 利用视觉上下文来解决与翻译相关的不确定性。然而，主流系统要么无条件处理图像，要么仅在视觉编码后应用门控，不可避免地会出现冗余的视觉计算。为了减轻这种计算开销，路由决策必须依赖于预视觉源信号。至关重要的是，表面的歧义并不等于视觉依赖性，因为句子内的文本上下文通常足以消除歧义。因此，我们将视觉调用表述为源文本充分性预测：仅根据源文本确定与翻译相关的不确定性是否仍未解决。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图像引导多模式机器翻译 (MMT) 利用视觉上下文来解决与翻译相关的不确定性。然而，主流系统要么无条件处理图像，要么仅在视觉编码后应用门控，不可避免地会出现冗余的视觉计算。为了减轻这种计算开销，路由决策必须依赖于预视觉源信号。至关重要的是，表面的歧义并不等于视觉依赖性，因为句子内的文本上下文通常足以消除歧义。因此，我们将视觉调用表述为源文本充分性预测：仅根据源文本确定与翻译相关的不确定性是否仍未解决。为了支持这个公式，我们构建了一个具有三个细粒度标签（no_ambiguity、text_resolved 和 Vision_needed）的视觉依赖性数据集，并验证 Vision_needed 实例的判别性视觉证据。我们进一步提出了 PreVIR，一种轻量级的、与后端无关的纯文本路由器，它在计算视觉特征之前在纯文本和多模式分支之间进行选择。英汉 MMT 实验表明，相对于强大的路由基线，PreVIR 实现了有利的 COMET 预算权衡。在默认操作点，它大大减少了视觉调用，同时保持与始终在线的多模态推理相当的翻译质量。标签和案例分析表明，这种权衡源于区分真正的视觉依赖性和上下文解决的模糊性。

articles.title: BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: BioEmu2：生物分子动力学的可扩展模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge. We introduce BioEmu2, a generative model for atomically resolved biomolecular structures combining static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling and time evolution, that samples orders of magnitude faster than molecular dynamics (MD). Trained on experimental and synthetic structures and extensive MD data, it supports multi-component systems containing proteins, nucleic acids, modified residues, ligands and ions. Structure-prediction accuracy is comparable to top open-weight biomolecular folding models, and a context parallel mode enables prediction of megadalton complexes. Equilibrium distributions approximate MD references with free-energy errors near 1 kcal/mol across tested proteins and complexes. Time propagation predicts long-timescale dynamical trajectories and kinetics of binding and conformational changes. Generated structures can be controlled by conditioning on residue contacts or steering with user-defined bias potentials. Enhanced sampling enables free energy calculation involving rare states. BioEmu2 makes the study of biomolecular ensembles and dynamics scalable.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管结构预测方面取得了重大进展，但对大规模驱动生物分子功能的运动和相互作用进行建模仍然是一个核心挑战。我们引入了 BioEmu2，这是一种原子分辨生物分子结构的生成模型，结合了静态结构预测、平衡采样和时间演化，其采样速度比分子动力学 (MD) 快几个数量级。它经过实验和合成结构以及广泛的 MD 数据的培训，支持包含蛋白质、核酸、修饰残基、配体和离子的多组分系统。结构预测精度可与顶级开放重量生物分子折叠模型相媲美，并且上下文并行模式可以预测兆道尔顿复合物。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管结构预测方面取得了重大进展，但对大规模驱动生物分子功能的运动和相互作用进行建模仍然是一个核心挑战。我们引入了 BioEmu2，这是一种原子分辨生物分子结构的生成模型，结合了静态结构预测、平衡采样和时间演化，其采样速度比分子动力学 (MD) 快几个数量级。它经过实验和合成结构以及广泛的 MD 数据的培训，支持包含蛋白质、核酸、修饰残基、配体和离子的多组分系统。结构预测精度可与顶级开放重量生物分子折叠模型相媲美，并且上下文并行模式可以预测兆道尔顿复合物。平衡分布近似 MD 参考值，测试蛋白质和复合物的自由能误差接近 1 kcal/mol。时间传播预测长期尺度的动力学轨迹以及结合和构象变化的动力学。生成的结构可以通过对残留接触进行调节或使用用户定义的偏置电位进行控制来控制。增强采样可以实现涉及稀有状态的自由能量计算。 BioEmu2 使生物分子整体和动力学的研究具有可扩展性。

articles.title: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.title_zh: ForRe：视觉-语言-动作模型中自主抓取恢复的力引导框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27011v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. To avoid inappropriate stage progression, a controller combines force feedback with grasp-command status at inference to coordinate the stage policies, detect grasp failures, and invoke the retry policy. We also construct LIBERO-SUCTION, a force-augmented suction manipulation benchmark adapted from LIBERO, with complete demonstration trajectories for policy training. FoRe consistently improves task success rates for VLA-Adapter and π₀.₅ on LIBERO-SUCTION, LIBERO, and real-world tasks. On LIBERO-SUCTION, average absolute gains are 18.4% and 6.5%, respectively. The corresponding real-world absolute gains are 25.0% and 21.7%. FoRe also remains effective with only one demonstration per task on both simulation benchmarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在基于抓取的操作中表现出了强大的性能，但从局部抓取失败中可靠恢复仍然具有挑战性。具体来说，在拾取和放置任务中，策略可能会在抓取失败后继续传输而不是重试，这可能反映出对阶段进展的本体感觉线索的过度依赖和有限的重试监督。现有的恢复方法通常依赖于部署时指导或演示增强。我们引入了力引导恢复（FoRe），这是一种从局部抓取失败中自主恢复的框架。使用力反馈，FoRe 将演示分为接近抓取和运输放置阶段，以训练单独的策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在基于抓取的操作中表现出了强大的性能，但从局部抓取失败中可靠恢复仍然具有挑战性。具体来说，在拾取和放置任务中，策略可能会在抓取失败后继续传输而不是重试，这可能反映出对阶段进展的本体感觉线索的过度依赖和有限的重试监督。现有的恢复方法通常依赖于部署时指导或演示增强。我们引入了力引导恢复（FoRe），这是一种从局部抓取失败中自主恢复的框架。使用力反馈，FoRe 将演示分为接近抓取和运输放置阶段，以训练单独的策略。为了补充有限的重试监督，FoRe 然后从接近掌握策略初始化专用重试策略，并通过失败后状态的本地强化学习 (RL) 对其进行细化。为了避免不适当的阶段进展，控制器将力反馈与推理时的抓取命令状态相结合，以协调阶段策略、检测抓取失败并调用重试策略。我们还构建了 LIBERO-SUCTION，这是一个改编自 LIBERO 的力增强吸力操纵基准，具有用于政策培训的完整演示轨迹。 FoRe 不断提高 VLA-Adapter 和 π₀.₅ 在 LIBERO-SUCTION、LIBERO 和实际任务上的任务成功率。在 LIBERO-SUCTION 上，平均绝对增益分别为 18.4% 和 6.5%。相应的现实世界绝对收益为25.0%和21.7%。 FoRe 在两个模拟基准测试中每项任务仅进行一次演示，仍然有效。

articles.title: Structure Over Scale: Rethinking Adaptation for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.title_zh: 结构大于规模：重新思考具有可验证奖励的强化学习的适应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27148v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is often framed as a choice between the expressivity of Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) and the efficiency of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). We find that this framing misses an important variable: the geometry of the update. Under a common cold-start GRPO protocol, LoRA exhibits rank collapse: performance remains broadly stable at low rank, then fails abruptly as rank increases. On DeepMath-Hard, for example, accuracy drops from 73.1% at r=64 to 4.7% at r=128. In contrast, Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA) and Quantum-Informed Tensor Adaptation (QuanTA) remain stable over a wider tested optimization region and are competitive with FFT while updating less than 0.6% of the model parameters. Spectral analysis reveals a corresponding difference in learned update structure: collapsed LoRA concentrates its update energy into relatively few effective directions, whereas structured adapters produce substantially more distributed updates. These results suggest that nominal rank and parameter count alone are insufficient to characterize adaptation in RLVR - the structure imposed on the reachable update manifold also matters. Finally, across three 8B base models, adapter behavior aligns with both frozen-weight spectral structure and reported pre-training scale, motivating the Model Maturity Hypothesis: the adaptation geometry that works best may depend on properties already encoded during pre-training. We present this as a falsifiable hypothesis rather than a causal conclusion. The code can be found here https://github.com/Shrimpstanot/structure-over-scale
articles.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常被认为是完全微调（FFT）的表达能力和低秩适应（LoRA）的效率之间的选择。我们发现这个框架遗漏了一个重要的变量：更新的几何形状。在常见的冷启动 GRPO 协议下，LoRA 表现出排名崩溃：性能在低排名时保持大致稳定，然后随着排名增加而突然失败。例如，在 DeepMath-Hard 上，准确率从 r=64 时的 73.1% 下降到 r=128 时的 4.7%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常被认为是完全微调（FFT）的表达能力和低秩适应（LoRA）的效率之间的选择。我们发现这个框架遗漏了一个重要的变量：更新的几何形状。在常见的冷启动 GRPO 协议下，LoRA 表现出排名崩溃：性能在低排名时保持大致稳定，然后随着排名增加而突然失败。例如，在 DeepMath-Hard 上，准确率从 r=64 时的 73.1% 下降到 r=128 时的 4.7%。相比之下，权重分解低秩自适应 (DoRA) 和量子信息张量自适应 (QuanTA) 在更广泛的测试优化区域内保持稳定，并且在更新不到 0.6% 的模型参数的同时，与 FFT 具有竞争力。谱分析揭示了学习更新结构的相应差异：折叠的 LoRA 将其更新能量集中到相对较少的有效方向，而结构化适配器则产生更多的分布式更新。这些结果表明，仅标称等级和参数计数不足以表征 RLVR 中的适应 - 强加于可达更新流形的结构也很重要。最后，在三个 8B 基本模型中，适配器行为与冻结权重谱结构和报告的预训练规模保持一致，从而激发了模型成熟度假设：效果最好的适应几何结构可能取决于预训练期间已编码的属性。我们将其视为可证伪的假设，而不是因果结论。代码可以在这里找到 https://github.com/Shrimpstanot/struct-over-scale

articles.title: When the magnetic force theorem fails: dressed exchange in the induced-moment magnets FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd
articles.title_zh: 当磁力定理失效时：感应力矩磁体 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 中的交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective spin Hamiltonians for itinerant magnets are commonly parameterized by magnetic-force-theorem (MFT) exchange constants, which are subsequently used to compute the behavior of complex and delicate spin textures, for example skyrmions. We show that for systems containing atoms with large spin susceptibility, such as Pd or Pt, this approach misses important parts of the energetics. For FePt, it even predicts the wrong ground state. Benchmarking against fully self-consistent spin-spiral density-functional calculations - in which the electronic structure, including the induced Pd/Pt moments, relaxes for every spin configuration - we quantify the missing energetics for the ordered L1₀ alloys FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd. By comparing a family of models that differ only in their treatment of the induced Pt moment, including the configuration-dependent models of Mryasov and Polesya, we identify the origin: the energetics of the induced moments are governed by the exchange-enhanced (dressed) susceptibility, of which the frozen-potential MFT captures only the bare part - about one third of the Pt-mediated interaction in FePt. We derive a general bound showing that no on-site (intra-atomic) refinement can supply the missing strength. The dressing decides the magnetic ground state in FePt, where the interlayer ordering rests entirely on the Pt-mediated interactions, and shifts the Curie temperatures of the other alloys by several hundred kelvin. Computed ordering temperatures, magnon spectra and spin wave stiffness for all four compounds are provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 流动磁体的有效自旋哈密顿量通常由磁力定理 (MFT) 交换常数参数化，随后用于计算复杂而微妙的自旋纹理（例如斯格明子）的行为。我们表明，对于含有自旋敏感性较大的原子（例如 Pd 或 Pt）的系统，这种方法忽略了能量学的重要部分。对于 FePt，它甚至预测了错误的基态。对完全自洽的自旋螺旋密度泛函计算进行基准测试（其中电子结构，包括诱导的 Pd/Pt 矩，对于每种自旋配置都是松弛的），我们量化了有序 L1₀ 合金 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 缺失的能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 流动磁体的有效自旋哈密顿量通常由磁力定理 (MFT) 交换常数参数化，随后用于计算复杂而微妙的自旋纹理（例如斯格明子）的行为。我们表明，对于含有自旋敏感性较大的原子（例如 Pd 或 Pt）的系统，这种方法忽略了能量学的重要部分。对于 FePt，它甚至预测了错误的基态。对完全自洽的自旋螺旋密度泛函计算进行基准测试（其中电子结构，包括诱导的 Pd/Pt 矩，对于每种自旋配置都是松弛的），我们量化了有序 L1₀ 合金 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 缺失的能量。通过比较仅在诱导 Pt 矩处理方面不同的一系列模型，包括 Mryasov 和 Polesya 的构型依赖模型，我们确定了起源：诱导矩的能量学由交换增强（修饰）磁化率控制，其中冻结电势 MFT 仅捕获裸露部分 - 约占 FePt 中 Pt 介导相互作用的三分之一。我们得出了一个一般界限，表明没有任何现场（原子内）细化可以提供缺失的强度。敷料决定了 FePt 中的磁性基态，其中层间排序完全取决于 Pt 介导的相互作用，并将其他合金的居里温度改变了数百开尔文。提供了所有四种化合物的计算有序温度、磁振子谱和自旋波刚度。

articles.title: Impact of spin fluctuations on spectral functions and transport in a model altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 自旋涨落对模型交流磁体中光谱函数和输运的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding spin dependent transport in altermagnets is important for incorporating them in next generation spintronic technologies. Motivated by the discovery of altermagnetism in strongly correlated quantum materials, we explore this physics in the checkerboard lattice Hubbard model using a fermion Monte Carlo approach which tracks the full spatial dependence of spin fluctuations as a function of temperature. We present results for the evolution of the spin-dependent single particle spectral functions and transport as we go from the ordered ground state into the high temperature disordered paramagnetic phase. Our results could be tested in future spin-selective angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and spin transport experiments in candidate altermagnets realized in solid state quantum materials or in proposed ultracold atomic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解交流磁体中的自旋相关输运对于将其纳入下一代自旋电子技术非常重要。受强相关量子材料中交变磁性发现的启发，我们使用费米子蒙特卡罗方法在棋盘格哈伯德模型中探索这种物理现象，该方法跟踪自旋波动作为温度函数的完整空间依赖性。我们提出了当我们从有序基态进入高温无序顺磁相时，自旋相关的单粒子光谱函数和输运演化的结果。我们的结果可以在未来的自旋选择角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和在固态量子材料或拟议的超冷原子系统中实现的候选交替磁体的自旋输运实验中进行测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解交流磁体中的自旋相关输运对于将其纳入下一代自旋电子技术非常重要。受强相关量子材料中交变磁性发现的启发，我们使用费米子蒙特卡罗方法在棋盘格哈伯德模型中探索这种物理现象，该方法跟踪自旋波动作为温度函数的完整空间依赖性。我们提出了当我们从有序基态进入高温无序顺磁相时，自旋相关的单粒子光谱函数和输运演化的结果。我们的结果可以在未来的自旋选择角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和在固态量子材料或拟议的超冷原子系统中实现的候选交替磁体的自旋输运实验中进行测试。

articles.title: Pharos: Learning to Control Rare Events at Scale
articles.title_zh: Pharos：学习大规模控制罕见事件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare events drive transformations across physics, chemistry and biology, yet predicting their mechanisms and rates remains a fundamental challenge. Here we introduce Pharos, a framework that learns to make rare transitions accessible while predicting how frequently they occur under physical dynamics. Through stochastic optimal control, Pharos jointly learns the probability of completing a transition and how to steer simulations toward it, allowing sampling and learning to improve one another. Across biomolecular benchmarks, Pharos learns accurate transition probabilities with order-of-magnitude gains in convergence speed over previous algorithms. It transfers across ion assembly systems in explicit solvent while maintaining accurate reaction rate predictions, scales to host-guest binding systems that span millisecond timescales, and enables chemical reaction studies with a computationally demanding machine learning interatomic potential. By combining efficient sampling, quantitative kinetics, and transferability, Pharos opens a route toward foundation models of rare event mechanisms and rates across molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 罕见事件推动了物理、化学和生物学的转变，但预测其机制和速率仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们介绍 Pharos，这是一个框架，它学习如何使罕见的转变变得容易实现，同时预测它们在物理动力学下发生的频率。通过随机最优控制，Pharos 共同学习完成转变的概率以及如何引导模拟实现这一转变，从而使采样和学习能够相互改进。在生物分子基准测试中，Pharos 可以学习准确的转移概率，并且收敛速度比以前的算法有数量级的提升。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 罕见事件推动了物理、化学和生物学的转变，但预测其机制和速率仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们介绍 Pharos，这是一个框架，它学习如何使罕见的转变变得容易实现，同时预测它们在物理动力学下发生的频率。通过随机最优控制，Pharos 共同学习完成转变的概率以及如何引导模拟实现这一转变，从而使采样和学习能够相互改进。在生物分子基准测试中，Pharos 可以学习准确的转移概率，并且收敛速度比以前的算法有数量级的提升。它在显式溶剂中跨离子组装系统转移，同时保持准确的反应速率预测，可扩展到跨越毫秒时间尺度的主客体结合系统，并能够通过计算要求较高的机器学习原子间势进行化学反应研究。通过结合高效采样、定量动力学和可转移性，Pharos 为跨分子系统的罕见事件机制和速率的基础模型开辟了一条道路。

articles.title: Prediction of lattice thermal conductivity of half-Heusler compounds by machine learning and transfer-function calibration
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput searches for half-Heusler thermoelectrics increasingly rely on lattice thermal conductivity (κ_L) from first-principles calculations, or from machine-learning models trained on them. These calculations describe an ideal single crystal, whereas measurements are made on polycrystalline samples, in which grain boundaries and defects scatter heat as well. The resulting gap between calculated and measured κ_L has been noted for individual compounds but not, to our knowledge, quantified across a materials class, so the values used for screening carry an unknown, systematic bias. Here we quantify and correct this bias for cubic half-Heusler compounds with 18 valence electrons. Using a curated literature corpus that keeps calculated and measured values apart, we show that calculations overestimate measured κ_L in most bonding families, and that the excess shrinks with temperature. Scattering by defects, added to the intrinsic scattering between lattice vibrations, would give such a trend, but the data do not single out one cause. A simple transfer function with this temperature dependence removes the median offset, and refitting its magnitude within a bonding family lowers the median error further, though not consistently compound by compound. Combined with a machine-learning model that predicts the calculated value from crystal structure, and tested on chemistries withheld from all fitting, the method predicts measured κ_L in this class about as closely as independent laboratories agree with one another, and provides testable predictions for compounds not yet measured.
articles.abstract_zh: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。使用将计算值和测量值分开的精选文献语料库，我们表明计算高估了大多数键合族中的测量 κ_L，并且超出部分随着温度而缩小。缺陷的散射加上晶格振动之间的固有散射，会给出这样的趋势，但数据并没有指出一个原因。具有这种温度依赖性的简单传递函数消除了中值偏移，并且在键合族中重新拟合其大小进一步降低了中值误差，尽管化合物之间的复合并不一致。该方法与根据晶体结构预测计算值的机器学习模型相结合，并对所有拟合中保留的化学物质进行测试，预测此类中测量的 κ_L 与独立实验室之间的一致程度接近，并为尚未测量的化合物提供可测试的预测。

articles.title: Tuning the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in CoFeB thin film heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 调节 CoFeB 薄膜异质结构中的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction (DMI) is essential for stabilizing chiral spin textures in spintronics, yet achieving consistent quantitative measurements across different techniques remains a significant challenge. Heterostructures consisting of magnetic thin films sandwiched between non-magnetic heavy metals have been shown to possess substantial DMI; however, these vary in both magnitude and handedness for supposedly identical samples, indicating the sensitivity of DMI to both interfacial properties and measurement techniques. Here, systematic tuning of the DMI in ultra-thin magnetic heterostructures of Pt/CoFeB/Ta/Pt is achieved by varying the thickness of a tantalum sub-monolayer with thicknesses ranging from 0.1,nm to 0.4,nm. The magnitude and sign of the DMI are measured using three independent methods: the parallel stripe domain model, edge nucleation field analysis, and Brillouin light scattering. The three independent approaches reveal excellent agreement within the experimental error. This ability to controllably tune and reliably quantify DMI provides a viable route toward engineering chiral magnetic textures, including domain walls and skyrmions, for next-generation spintronic devices. The necessity for precise measurements of magnetic parameters and careful attention to detail are discussed because calculations of the DMI for each technique depend on different parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 对于稳定自旋电子学中的手性自旋结构至关重要，但在不同技术中实现一致的定量测量仍然是一个重大挑战。由夹在非磁性重金属之间的磁性薄膜组成的异质结构已被证明具有大量的 DMI；然而，对于假定相同的样品，这些值在大小和旋向方面都有所不同，这表明 DMI 对界面特性和测量技术的敏感性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 对于稳定自旋电子学中的手性自旋结构至关重要，但在不同技术中实现一致的定量测量仍然是一个重大挑战。由夹在非磁性重金属之间的磁性薄膜组成的异质结构已被证明具有大量的 DMI；然而，对于假定相同的样品，这些值在大小和旋向方面都有所不同，这表明 DMI 对界面特性和测量技术的敏感性。在这里，通过改变厚度范围从 0.1 nm 到 0.4 nm 的钽亚单层的厚度，实现了 Pt/CoFeB/Ta/Pt 超薄磁性异质结构中 DMI 的系统调谐。 DMI 的大小和符号使用三种独立的方法进行测量：平行条纹域模型、边缘成核场分析和布里渊光散射。三种独立的方法在实验误差内显示出极好的一致性。这种可控调节和可靠量化 DMI 的能力为设计下一代自旋电子器件的手性磁性纹理（包括畴壁和斯格明子）提供了一条可行的途径。由于每种技术的 DMI 计算取决于不同的参数，因此讨论了精确测量磁性参数和仔细关注细节的必要性。

articles.title: Artificial Spin-Glass of Antiferromagnetic Co3O4 Nanocubes Using Spin-Polarized Oxygen
articles.title_zh: 使用自旋极化氧的反铁磁 Co3O4 纳米立方体的人工自旋玻璃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preferentially exposing (100) surface terminations of Co₃O₄ using cube-shaped nanoparticles yields an unconventional rearrangement of ions that generates spin-glass-like magnetism from the antiferromagnetic nanocubes. The necessary magnetic frustration arises out of competition between polarized Co-O bonds from charge transfer between O 2p and Co 3d orbitals, and highly anisotropic Co²⁺ ions combined with anomalous high spin Co³⁺ ions in octahedral sites. Size control permits tuning this novel combination of ions via preferentially polarizing Co-O bonds. The presence of control over frustrated magnetism among antiferromagnetic nanocubes yields an artificial spin glass platform for exploring unconventional nanomagnetism and engendering new opportunities for emerging technologies like spintronics and physical reservoir computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用立方体形状的纳米粒子优先暴露 Co3O4 的 (100) 表面终端，产生非常规的离子重排，从而从反铁磁性纳米立方体产生旋转玻璃状的磁性。必要的磁挫败是由于 O 2p 和 Co 3d 轨道之间的电荷转移引起的极化 Co-O 键之间的竞争以及高度各向异性的 Co²⁺ 离子与八面体位点中异常高自旋 Co³⁺ 离子的结合而产生的。尺寸控制允许通过优先极化的 Co-O 键来调节这种新颖的离子组合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用立方体形状的纳米粒子优先暴露 Co3O4 的 (100) 表面终端，产生非常规的离子重排，从而从反铁磁性纳米立方体产生旋转玻璃状的磁性。必要的磁挫败是由于 O 2p 和 Co 3d 轨道之间的电荷转移引起的极化 Co-O 键之间的竞争以及高度各向异性的 Co²⁺ 离子与八面体位点中异常高自旋 Co³⁺ 离子的结合而产生的。尺寸控制允许通过优先极化的 Co-O 键来调节这种新颖的离子组合。对反铁磁纳米立方体中受挫磁性的控制产生了一个人工自旋玻璃平台，用于探索非常规纳米磁性，并为自旋电子学和物理储层计算等新兴技术带来新的机遇。

articles.title: Length and Sequence-Dependent Dipolar and Electronic Properties of α-helical Polypeptides
articles.title_zh: α-螺旋多肽的长度和序列依赖性偶极和电子特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helical polypeptides combine the chemical tunability of synthetic macromolecules with the highly ordered backbone architecture of natural proteins. Here, density-functional tight-binding calculations are used to determine how chain length and sequence chemistry govern the dipolar and electronic properties of three α-helical polypeptide families: polyalanine [AAAAA]ₙ, leucine-modified [AAAAL]ₙ, and cysteine-capped, lysine-containing C[AAAAK]ₙ. Increasing chain length produces systematic shifts and splitting of the molecular orbital levels together with an approximately additive increase in the molecular dipole. Analysis of the C[AAAAK]₃ helix shows that aligned backbone carbonyl groups provide the dominant contribution to the macro dipole, whose growing electrostatic potential is consistent with an intrinsic Stark-like contribution to the length-dependent orbital-energy evolution. Side-chain and terminal modifications introduce localized perturbations to frontier electronic states while preserving this global backbone-driven trend. Residue-resolved frontier levels additionally form a staircase-like energy landscape along the helical scaffold: individual peptide units retain large local HOMO-LUMO gaps of approximately 5 eV, whereas spatially proximate hydrogen-bonded residues exhibit smaller inter-residue energy separations. Application of external electrostatic fields modifies the frontier-level separation in a direction-dependent manner and induces structural distortions predominantly near the flexible termini, while the helical core remains comparatively robust. By establishing these fundamental sequence-structure-property relationships, this work provides a foundational blueprint for the rational design of peptide-based biomacromolecules tailored for next-generation bio-electronic interfaces, biosensors, and artificial electron-transfer systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 螺旋多肽将合成大分子的化学可调性与天然蛋白质的高度有序的主链结构结合起来。在这里，密度功能紧结合计算用于确定链长和序列化学如何控制三个 α-螺旋多肽家族的偶极和电子特性：聚丙氨酸 [AAAAA]ₙ、亮氨酸修饰的 [AAAAL]ₙ 和半胱氨酸加帽、含赖氨酸的 C[AAAAK]ₙ。增加链长度会产生系统的位移和分子轨道能级的分裂，以及分子偶极子的近似加性增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 螺旋多肽将合成大分子的化学可调性与天然蛋白质的高度有序的主链结构结合起来。在这里，密度功能紧结合计算用于确定链长和序列化学如何控制三个 α-螺旋多肽家族的偶极和电子特性：聚丙氨酸 [AAAAA]ₙ、亮氨酸修饰的 [AAAAL]ₙ 和半胱氨酸加帽、含赖氨酸的 C[AAAAK]ₙ。增加链长度会产生系统的位移和分子轨道能级的分裂，以及分子偶极子的近似加性增加。对 C[AAAAK]₃ 螺旋的分析表明，排列的主链羰基对宏观偶极子提供了主要贡献，其不断增长的静电势与对长度依赖的轨道能量演化的内在斯塔克式贡献一致。侧链和末端修改给前沿电子状态带来了局部扰动，同时保留了这种全球骨干驱动的趋势。残基解析的前沿水平还沿着螺旋支架形成阶梯状的能量景观：单个肽单元保留约5 eV的大局部HOMO-LUMO间隙，而空间上接近的氢键残基表现出较小的残基间能量分离。外部静电场的应用以方向相关的方式改变了前沿水平分离，并主要在柔性末端附近引起结构扭曲，而螺旋芯保持相对坚固。通过建立这些基本的序列-结构-性质关系，这项工作为合理设计针对下一代生物电子接口、生物传感器和人工电子转移系统的基于肽的生物大分子提供了基础蓝图。

articles.title: High-Sensitivity Magnetometry with Scalable Mixed SQUID Arrays
articles.title_zh: 采用可扩展混合 SQUID 阵列的高灵敏度磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The utilisation of Superconducting Quantum Interference Devices (SQUIDs), a loop of superconducting material hosting two Josephson junctions, has long been at the forefront of quantum sensing. To enhance performance and signal power, modern architectures connect multiple SQUIDs into two-dimensional series-parallel arrays called Superconducting Quantum Interference Filters (SQIFs). A major recent advancement, called a mixed-SQUID array, integrates junction-free ``bare" loops alongside active SQUID loops, offering a promising strategy to engineer high-performance alternatives to traditional SQIF technology. However, a rigorous theoretical optimization and performance scaling analysis for this novel geometry remains lacking. In this work, an analytical framework, validated against full numerical simulations, is developed to establish fundamental design rules for this technology. This work systematically examines how key quantum sensing parameters evolve as a function of loop inductance, parasitic coupling, and overall array dimensions. Crucially, it is demonstrated that these mixed SQUID arrays circumvent the severe inductive screening losses inherent to conventional SQIF designs, achieving a performance boost in flux sensitivity in the range of 2-4:× under realistic device parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子干涉装置（SQUID）是一种由两个约瑟夫森结组成的超导材料环，其使用长期以来一直处于量子传感的前沿。为了增强性能和信号功率，现代架构将多个 SQUID 连接成二维串并联阵列，称为超导量子干涉滤波器 (SQIF)。最近的一项重大进展，称为混合 SQUID 阵列，将无结“裸”环路与有源 SQUID 环路集成在一起，为设计传统 SQIF 技术的高性能替代方案提供了一种有前途的策略。然而，仍然缺乏针对这种新颖几何形状的严格理论优化和性能扩展分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导量子干涉装置（SQUID）是一种由两个约瑟夫森结组成的超导材料环，其使用长期以来一直处于量子传感的前沿。为了增强性能和信号功率，现代架构将多个 SQUID 连接成二维串并联阵列，称为超导量子干涉滤波器 (SQIF)。最近的一项重大进展，称为混合 SQUID 阵列，将无结“裸”环路与有源 SQUID 环路集成在一起，为设计传统 SQIF 技术的高性能替代方案提供了一种有前途的策略。然而，仍然缺乏针对这种新颖几何形状的严格理论优化和性能扩展分析。在这项工作中，开发了一个分析框架，并针对完整的数值模拟进行了验证，以建立该技术的基本设计规则。这项工作系统地研究了关键量子传感参数如何作为环路电感的函数演变，至关重要的是，这些混合 SQUID 阵列规避了传统 SQIF 设计固有的严重感应屏蔽损耗，在实际器件参数下实现了 2-4:× 范围内的通量灵敏度性能提升。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement of Amortized Bayesian Inference Across Physics
articles.title_zh: 物理引导的跨物理摊销贝叶斯推理的递归自我改进
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Across physics, from the orbits of imaged exoplanets and the matter inside neutron stars to thin films at synchrotrons and cortical neurons, conservation laws, interference, and compensating currents compress the posteriors of precise data into tiny, curved regions where Markov chains need minutes to days. We introduce PhyRSI (physics-guided recursive self-improvement), in which an AI agent coupled to the simulator writes and revises an amortized Bayesian inference algorithm for each field, scored by the importance weights of the exact likelihood because the true posterior is unknown. It evolves coordinates, symmetries, and factorizations matched to the physics: orbital elements at the best-measured epoch, Fresnel-normalized reflectivity with a chart for each of its multiple solutions, coordinates along which Na+ and K+ currents compensate, a shared neutron-star equation of state that factorizes a 32-dimensional joint analysis, and the time-rescaling symmetry of predator-prey dynamics.
