In six fields, networks trained once on simulations return 36 posteriors of real observations in seconds, reweighted by the likelihood and agreeing with converged Markov chains about as closely as two independent chains agree with each other. Such posteriors could steer synchrotron film growth and patch-clamp recordings as they run, follow X-ray transients while they are bright, update the dense-matter equation of state as neutron stars are added, and compare physical models across catalogs. Inference can thus be evolved and checked by the physics itself rather than designed by hand for each problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 在整个物理学中，从成像的系外行星的轨道和中子星内部的物质到同步加速器和皮层神经元的薄膜，守恒定律、干扰和补偿电流将精确数据的后验压缩到马尔可夫链需要几分钟到几天的微小弯曲区域中。我们引入了 PhyRSI（物理引导的递归自我改进），其中与模拟器耦合的 AI 代理为每个领域编写和修改摊销贝叶斯推理算法，通过精确似然的重要性权重进行评分，因为真实的后验未知。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在整个物理学中，从成像的系外行星的轨道和中子星内部的物质到同步加速器和皮层神经元的薄膜，守恒定律、干扰和补偿电流将精确数据的后验压缩到马尔可夫链需要几分钟到几天的微小弯曲区域中。我们引入了 PhyRSI（物理引导的递归自我改进），其中与模拟器耦合的 AI 代理为每个领域编写和修改摊销贝叶斯推理算法，通过精确似然的重要性权重进行评分，因为真实的后验未知。它演化出与物理相匹配的坐标、对称性和因式分解：最佳测量历元的轨道元素、菲涅尔归一化反射率及其多个解的图表、Na+和K+电流补偿的坐标、分解32维联合分析的共享中子星状态方程，以及捕食者-猎物动力学的时间重新缩放对称性。在六个领域中，经过一次模拟训练的网络会在几秒钟内返回真实观察结果的 36 个后验，并根据可能性重新加权，并与收敛的马尔可夫链一致，就像两个独立链彼此一致一样。这样的后验可以在运行时控制同步加速器薄膜的生长和膜片钳记录，在明亮时跟踪X射线瞬变，在添加中子星时更新稠密物质状态方程，并比较不同目录的物理模型。因此，推理可以由物理学本身来发展和检查，而不是为每个问题手工设计。

articles.title: Transition-Metal Substitutions in MOF-5: A Hybrid-DFT Study of Oxygen Electrocatalysis
articles.title_zh: MOF-5 中的过渡金属取代：氧电催化的混合 DFT 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid density functional theory calculations were used to investigate the stability, electronic properties, and catalytic activity of transition-metal impurities substituting Zn sites (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) in the MOF-5 metal-organic framework [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-benzenedicarboxylate], with M = Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, and Cu. Most substitutions introduce (3d) states within the MOF-5 band gap and induce localized magnetic moments. Partially occupied (3d) states promote orbital hybridization and charge transfer with oxygenated intermediates, activating the dopant sites toward oxygen electrocatalysis. The oxygen reduction and evolution reaction (ORR and OER) activities were evaluated using the computational hydrogen electrode model. Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Fe(ᵣₘ Zₙ) exhibit calculated ORR overpotentials of 0.57~V, while Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Co(ᵣₘ Zₙ) yield OER overpotentials of 0.42 and 0.51~V, respectively, approaching those of benchmark precious-metal electrocatalysts. These findings identify Mn substitution as a promising strategy for achieving bifunctional ORR/OER activity in MOF-5 and establish a link between dopant electronic structure and catalytic performance to guide the design of MOF-based electrocatalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用混合密度泛函理论计算研究了 MOF-5 金属有机骨架 [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-苯二甲酸] 中取代 Zn 位点 (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) 的过渡金属杂质的稳定性、电子性质和催化活性，其中 M = Sc、Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni 和 Cu。大多数取代在 MOF-5 带隙内引入 (3d) 态并诱导局部磁矩。部分占据（3d）态促进轨道杂化和含氧中间体的电荷转移，激活掺杂位点以实现氧电催化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用混合密度泛函理论计算研究了 MOF-5 金属有机骨架 [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-苯二甲酸] 中取代 Zn 位点 (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) 的过渡金属杂质的稳定性、电子性质和催化活性，其中 M = Sc、Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni 和 Cu。大多数取代在 MOF-5 带隙内引入 (3d) 态并诱导局部磁矩。部分占据（3d）态促进轨道杂化和含氧中间体的电荷转移，激活掺杂位点以实现氧电催化。使用计算氢电极模型评估氧还原和析出反应（ORR 和 OER）活性。 Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ)和Fe(ᵣₘ Zₙ)的计算ORR过电势为0.57~V，而Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ)和Co(ᵣₘ Zₙ)的OER过电势分别为0.42和0.51~V，接近基准贵金属电催化剂的过电势。这些发现表明，Mn 替代是在 MOF-5 中实现双功能 ORR/OER 活性的一种有前途的策略，并在掺杂剂电子结构和催化性能之间建立联系，以指导基于 MOF 的电催化剂的设计。

articles.title: Growth and anisotropic directional dependent transport properties of Altermagnetic CrSb
articles.title_zh: 交变磁 CrSb 的生长和各向异性方向依赖输运特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CrSb is a metallic altermagnet exhibiting large momentum-dependent spin splitting and antifer- romagnetic ordering well above room temperature. Although its electronic and magnetotransport properties have attracted considerable attention, a systematic comparison of crystals prepared us- ing different growth methods remains limited. Here we investigate the structural, magnetic, and anisotropic transport properties of CrSb single crystals grown by Sb(self)-flux, Bi flux, and chem- ical vapor transport (CVT). Each of these growth reveals distinct crystal morphologies. Magne- tization measurements exhibit broadly consistent antiferromagnetic responses, with an additional low-temperature contribution observed in Bi-flux-grown crystals. All samples display metallic resis- tivity and positive, nonsaturating magnetoresistance up to 9 T. Sb-flux- and CVT-grown crystals exhibit comparable residual resistivity ratios and magnetoresistance, whereas Bi-flux-grown crys- tals show enhanced residual resistivity and a substantially reduced magnetoresistance, consistent with stronger carrier scattering. Hall measurements reveal a pronounced dependence on the field- current configuration, including nonlinear field dependence and opposite Hall polarities for different crystallographic orientations. These results establish the reproducibility of anisotropic magneto- transport across distinct growth routes while highlighting the sensitivity of carrier scattering to crystal-growth conditions. Our findings provide a comparative framework for selecting CrSb single crystals for orientation-dependent transport and spintronic investigations.
articles.abstract_zh: CrSb 是一种金属交变磁体，在远高于室温的温度下表现出较大的动量相关自旋分裂和反铁磁有序性。尽管其电子和磁输运特性引起了相当大的关注，但对使用不同生长方法制备的晶体的系统比较仍然有限。在这里，我们研究了通过 Sb(自)-通量、Bi 通量和化学气相传输 (CVT) 生长的 CrSb 单晶的结构、磁性和各向异性传输特性。每一种生长都显示出不同的晶体形态。磁化测量表现出广泛一致的反铁磁响应，并在双助熔剂生长的晶体中观察到了额外的低温贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CrSb 是一种金属交变磁体，在远高于室温的温度下表现出较大的动量相关自旋分裂和反铁磁有序性。尽管其电子和磁输运特性引起了相当大的关注，但对使用不同生长方法制备的晶体的系统比较仍然有限。在这里，我们研究了通过 Sb(自)-通量、Bi 通量和化学气相传输 (CVT) 生长的 CrSb 单晶的结构、磁性和各向异性传输特性。每一种生长都显示出不同的晶体形态。磁化测量表现出广泛一致的反铁磁响应，并在双助熔剂生长的晶体中观察到了额外的低温贡献。所有样品都显示出金属电阻率和高达 9 T 的正非饱和磁阻。Sb 助熔剂和 CVT 生长的晶体表现出相当的残余电阻率比和磁阻，而双助熔剂生长的晶体则显示出增强的残余电阻率和显着降低的磁阻，这与更强的载流子散射一致。霍尔测量揭示了对场电流配置的明显依赖性，包括非线性场依赖性和不同晶体取向的相反霍尔极性。这些结果确立了不同生长路径上各向异性磁输运的可重复性，同时强调了载流子散射对晶体生长条件的敏感性。我们的研究结果为选择 CrSb 单晶进行取向依赖输运和自旋电子学研究提供了一个比较框架。

articles.title: Quantum order by disorder among lozenge tilings: a staircase of hub-free crystals between the Lieb ferrimagnet and the antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 菱形瓷砖中的量子有序与无序：利布亚铁磁体和反铁磁体之间的无轮毂晶体阶梯
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lozenge tilings of the triangular lattice define an exponentially large family of bipartite networks, from the dice lattice, a Lieb ferrimagnet with the largest sublattice imbalance, to square-type tilings, which are compensated antiferromagnets. For the classical Heisenberg antiferromagnet all of them are degenerate. We show that quantum fluctuations lift this degeneracy through a local mechanism: the zero-point energy is, to leading order, a sum of site terms that are convex in the coordination z, so that Jensen's inequality at fixed langle zrangle=4 selects the square-type tiling. An expansion about the Ising limit explains the convexity: a site with more bonds has more channels for quantum fluctuations, but each fluctuation frustrates more bonds. A magnetic field couples to the Lieb moment and competes with this selection. Because the moment is carried most cheaply by threefold and fivefold sites, sixfold hubs are avoided, and bond counting together with the Lieb--Mattis theorem limits hub-free tilings to 3/5 of the dice moment. Quantum Monte Carlo and a complete enumeration of periodic tilings with small unit cells show that the classical jump is replaced by a staircase of periodic crystals. Its widest step is a hub-free crystal that saturates the bound; below it, threefold and fivefold defects pack ever more densely in a shallow sequence of crystals, controlled by a short-ranged attraction between defects of equal curvature and a repulsion between defects of opposite curvature. Selection energies scale as JS. In the height representation the coordination is the discrete Gaussian curvature and the Lieb moment its sublattice-staggered part. We give spectroscopic signatures and discuss realizations in nanographenes, atomic spin arrays and quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角形晶格的菱形平铺定义了一个指数级大的二分网络家族，从骰子晶格（具有最大子晶格不平衡的利布亚铁磁体）到方形平铺（补偿反铁磁体）。对于经典的海森堡反铁磁体来说，它们都是简并的。我们证明，量子涨落通过局部机制提升了这种简并性：零点能量对于前导顺序来说是在配位 z 中凸的位点项之和，因此固定 langle zrangle=4 处的 Jensen 不等式选择了方形平铺。伊辛极限的扩展解释了凸性：具有更多键的位点具有更多的量子波动通道，但每次波动都会抑制更多的键。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角形晶格的菱形平铺定义了一个指数级大的二分网络家族，从骰子晶格（具有最大子晶格不平衡的利布亚铁磁体）到方形平铺（补偿反铁磁体）。对于经典的海森堡反铁磁体来说，它们都是简并的。我们证明，量子涨落通过局部机制提升了这种简并性：零点能量对于前导顺序来说是在配位 z 中凸的位点项之和，因此固定 langle zrangle=4 处的 Jensen 不等式选择了方形平铺。伊辛极限的扩展解释了凸性：具有更多键的位点具有更多的量子波动通道，但每次波动都会抑制更多的键。磁场与利布矩耦合并与这种选择竞争。因为三重和五重位点承载力矩的成本最低，所以避免了六重轮毂，并且键计数与利布-马蒂斯定理一起将无轮毂平铺限制为骰子矩的 3/5。量子蒙特卡罗和小晶胞周期性平铺的完整枚举表明，经典跳跃被周期性晶体的阶梯所取代。它最宽的台阶是一个无轮毂的晶体，饱和了边界；在它下面，三重和五重缺陷更加密集地堆积在浅层晶体序列中，受到相同曲率缺陷之间的短程吸引力和相反曲率缺陷之间的排斥的控制。选择能量尺度为 JS。在高度表示中，协调是离散高斯曲率，利布矩是其亚晶格交错部分。我们给出光谱特征并讨论纳米石墨烯、原子自旋阵列和量子模拟器的实现。

articles.title: Axial Thermal Transport in Transition Metal Chalcogenide Nanowires from Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Simulations
articles.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学模拟中过渡金属硫族化物纳米线的轴向热传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition metal chalcogenide M6X6 nanowires (M = Mo or W; X = S, Se, or Te) are promising one-dimensional (1D) building blocks for nanowire bundles and arrays, but how elemental composition controls their intrinsic axial heat transport remains unclear. Here we develop a multicomponent neuroevolution potential (NEP) from first-principles reference data and use homogeneous nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (HNEMD) simulations to quantify the thermal conductivity of six MX6 nanowires. The Mo6X6 series show a nonmonotonic composition dependence, whereas the thermal conductivity of the W6X6 series decreases monotonically with increasing chalcogen mass. Frequency-resolved thermal conductivity and phonon mean-free path analyses show that axial heat conduction is dominated by low-frequency phonons. Vibrational density of states and spectral energy density analyses further reveal that the contrasting trends arise from a competition between metal-chalcogen vibrational matching and phonon softening induced by heavier chalcogen atoms. A phenomenological model incorporating the combined atomic mass and the relative mass difference between the metal and chalcogen atoms reproduces these trends. These results link elemental composition, phonon characteristics and axial thermal conductivity in M6X6 nanowires, providing an atomistic basis for selecting heat-conducting units in nanowire bundles and arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属硫属化物 M6X6 纳米线（M = Mo 或 W；X = S、Se 或 Te）是纳米线束和阵列的有前景的一维 (1D) 构建块，但元素组成如何控制其固有的轴向热传输仍不清楚。在这里，我们根据第一原理参考数据开发了多分量神经进化势 (NEP)，并使用均相非平衡分子动力学 (HNEMD) 模拟来量化六根 MX6 纳米线的导热率。 Mo6X6 系列表现出非单调成分依赖性，而 W6X6 系列的热导率随着硫族元素质量的增加而单调降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属硫属化物 M6X6 纳米线（M = Mo 或 W；X = S、Se 或 Te）是纳米线束和阵列的有前景的一维 (1D) 构建块，但元素组成如何控制其固有的轴向热传输仍不清楚。在这里，我们根据第一原理参考数据开发了多分量神经进化势 (NEP)，并使用均相非平衡分子动力学 (HNEMD) 模拟来量化六根 MX6 纳米线的导热率。 Mo6X6 系列表现出非单调成分依赖性，而 W6X6 系列的热导率随着硫族元素质量的增加而单调降低。频率分辨热导率和声子平均自由程分析表明，轴向热传导以低频声子为主。振动态密度和光谱能量密度分析进一步表明，对比趋势源于金属-硫族元素振动匹配和较重硫族元素原子引起的声子软化之间的竞争。结合了金属和硫族元素原子之间的组合原子质量和相对质量差的唯象模型再现了这些趋势。这些结果将 M6X6 纳米线中的元素组成、声子特性和轴向导热率联系起来，为选择纳米线束和阵列中的导热单元提供了原子基础。

articles.title: E2Former-V3: Atom-Role-Aware Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: E2Former-V3：原子角色感知等变原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials approach density-functional accuracy, but explicit-solvent atom counts are dominated by hydrogens and water. Uniform equivariant architectures still give every atom the same latent width and number of expensive block updates. To our knowledge, no prior method reallocates capacity by chemical role while retaining every atom and its first-principles force. We introduce E2Former-V3, which treats capacity as an atom-level resource: a static chemical role, assigned before the backbone runs, sets each atom's latent width and update count. No atom is removed, no coordinate is integrated out, and every force remains the gradient of one conservative energy. Standard reduces only the update count, sending hydrogen through half as many full-width block updates; on OMol25 validation it reaches a force mean absolute error (MAE) of 8.146 meV/Angstrom, against E2Former-V2's published 8.38, at 1.75-1.84x V2's throughput with lower peak memory on one H200. Flash also narrows the low-resolution stream to one eighth of the high-resolution width (32 vs 256 channels) and routes water oxygen with hydrogen, reaching 4.00-4.88x on three solvated systems (up to 5.85x in the pure-water all-low-resolution limit) at 11.272 meV/Angstrom, trading force accuracy for speed. Across 54 20 ps MD legs, a 100 ps NVE check, and a 1 ns NVT run on a 32,437-atom solvated protein, all runs complete; the MD legs show no non-finite values, clashes, or water fusion, and water O-O and Na-O RDF peak positions match experiment within 0.04 Angstrom. E2Former-V3 therefore moves the accuracy-throughput frontier for all-atom, conservative simulation, not a uniform accuracy win: Standard is worse on biomolecules and metals, better on electrolytes and organics; energy MAE is higher than E2Former-V2's; and water densities remain about 7.5% too high. Code: https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习的原子间势接近密度泛函精度，但显式溶剂原子计数以氢和水为主。统一的等变架构仍然为每个原子提供相同的潜在宽度和昂贵的块更新数量。据我们所知，现有方法还没有通过化学作用重新分配容量，同时保留每个原子及其第一原理力。我们引入了 E2Former-V3，它将容量视为原子级资源：在主干运行之前分配的静态化学角色，设置每个原子的潜在宽度和更新计数。没有原子被移除，没有坐标被积分，并且每个力仍然是一个保守能量的梯度。标准仅减少更新计数，通过一半的全角块更新发送氢；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习的原子间势接近密度泛函精度，但显式溶剂原子计数以氢和水为主。统一的等变架构仍然为每个原子提供相同的潜在宽度和昂贵的块更新数量。据我们所知，现有方法还没有通过化学作用重新分配容量，同时保留每个原子及其第一原理力。我们引入了 E2Former-V3，它将容量视为原子级资源：在主干运行之前分配的静态化学角色，设置每个原子的潜在宽度和更新计数。没有原子被移除，没有坐标被积分，并且每个力仍然是一个保守能量的梯度。标准仅减少更新计数，通过一半的全角块更新发送氢；在 OMol25 验证中，它达到了 8.146 meV/Angstrom 的力平均绝对误差 (MAE)，而 E2Former-V2 发布的值为 8.38，吞吐量为 V2 的 1.75-1.84 倍，并且一台 H200 上的峰值内存较低。 Flash 还将低分辨率流缩小到高分辨率宽度的八分之一（32 通道与 256 通道），并用氢传输水氧，在 11.272 meV/Angstrom 下在三个溶剂化系统上达到 4.00-4.88 倍（在纯水全低分辨率极限中高达 5.85 倍），以力精度换取速度。在 32,437 个原子溶剂化蛋白上运行 54 个 20 ps MD 腿、100 ps NVE 检查和 1 ns NVT，所有运行均已完成； MD腿没有表现出非有限值、冲突或水融合，并且水O-O和Na-O RDF峰位置与实验匹配在0.04埃以内。因此，E2Former-V3 移动了全原子保守模拟的精度吞吐量前沿，而不是统一的精度胜利：标准在生物分子和金属方面较差，在电解质和有机物方面较好；能量MAE高于E2Former-V2；水密度仍然高出约 7.5%。代码：https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM。

articles.title: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
articles.title_zh: 使用对称约束扩散模型在指定能量下生成晶界结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the Σ 5(210)[001] symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within ± 0.1 J/m² of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。我们将其应用于 Al 中的 Σ 5(210)[001] 对称倾斜 GB，通过机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 调节 GB 能量的生成。所有 350 个生成的结构在松弛后都保持几何等效的 GB 对。给定目标 GB 能量，模型会生成该能量的结构：对于具有许多附近训练结构的三个范围内目标，44% 到 70% 落在目标的 ± 0.1 J/m² 范围内。跟踪在较高能量下减弱，并且在训练范围之外失败。在 91 个接近目标的结构中，有 90 个在采用的几何标准下与训练结构不匹配，这表明该模型可以提出与训练结构不同的目标能量附近的配置，这种能力可以帮助识别在实验中观察到的未知亚稳态 GB 结构。将 GB 对等价性构建到生成中，从而使 GB 属性成为明确定义的设计目标，从而实现 GB 结构的逆向设计。

articles.title: Tailoring Phonon Transport in Bi-based Quaternary Half-Heusler alloys for Thermoelectric Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于热电应用的双基四元半霍斯勒合金中的声子传输定制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quaternary half-Heuslers (QHHs) are substitutionally disordered derivatives of conventional halfHeusler (HH) compounds, which offer a potential route to modify phonon transport and enhance thermoelectric performance. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric properties of the quaternary half-Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2, ZrHfIr2Bi2, Zr2RhIrBi2, and Hf2RhIrBi2 using first-principles calculations and anharmonic lattice dynamics. Among four compounds, ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2 exhibit semiconducting electronic structure and others are semimetallic in nature. Both the semiconducting compounds show favorable electronic transport properties. However, quaternary substitution substantially modifies the phonon dispersion, lowering the average phonon group velocity by about 17-22% relative to the parent compounds while leaving the anharmonic scattering rates comparable. The combination of high power factor and low kl results in high thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.28 and 2.18 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, with maximum thermoelectric power conversion efficiency 16.3% for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2. Further reducing the grain size enhances the thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.51 and 2.58 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, at a grain size of 30 nm. Our results demonstrate that combining substitutional disorder with grain boundary engineering, provides an effective strategy to enhance the thermoelectric performance of HH compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 四元half-Heusler (QHH) 是传统halfHeusler (HH) 化合物的替代无序衍生物，它提供了改变声子输运和增强热电性能的潜在途径。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和非谐晶格动力学研究了四元半 Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2、ZrHfIr2Bi2、Zr2RhIrBi2 和 Hf2RhIrBi2 的热电性质。四种化合物中，ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2表现出半导体电子结构，其他化合物本质上是半金属。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 四元half-Heusler (QHH) 是传统halfHeusler (HH) 化合物的替代无序衍生物，它提供了改变声子输运和增强热电性能的潜在途径。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和非谐晶格动力学研究了四元半 Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2、ZrHfIr2Bi2、Zr2RhIrBi2 和 Hf2RhIrBi2 的热电性质。四种化合物中，ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2表现出半导体电子结构，其他化合物本质上是半金属。这两种半导体化合物均表现出良好的电子传输特性。然而，四元取代显着改变了声子色散，相对于母体化合物，平均声子群速度降低了约 17-22%，同时保持非简谐散射率相当。高功率因数和低kl的结合导致了高热电性能，p型ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2在1000 K时的最大ZT值分别为2.28和2.18，p型ZrHfRh2Bi2的最大热电转换效率为16.3%。进一步减小晶粒尺寸可增强热电性能，晶粒尺寸为 30 nm 的 p 型 ZrHfRh2Bi2 和 Zr2RhIrBi2 在 1000 K 时的最大 ZT 值分别为 2.51 和 2.58。我们的结果表明，将取代无序与晶界工程相结合，为增强 HH 化合物的热电性能提供了一种有效的策略。

articles.title: Nonmonotonic Magnetic Correlations in Decorated Lieb-Lattice Anderson Models
articles.title_zh: 装饰利布格子安德森模型中的非单调磁相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between electronic correlations and lattice geometry can strongly modify the competition between magnetic correlations and local singlet formation in multiorbital Hamiltonians. Here we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations to investigate two periodic Anderson-like models constructed by selectively hybridizing localized orbitals to the inequivalent sites of a Lieb lattice. The resulting geometries possess partially filled flat bands and different sublattice imbalances. We examine the evolution of local spin correlations and orbital-resolved magnetic structure factors as the hybridization is increased. Although correlations between hybridized orbitals evolve relatively smoothly toward local singlet formation, the longer-range magnetic correlations exhibit a striking nonmonotonic dependence on hybridization. In particular, we observe a pronounced suppression at intermediate hybridization followed by a substantial recovery on undecorated lattice sites. We discuss these results in relation to earlier studies of depleted periodic Anderson models and the constraints imposed by Lieb's theorem. Our findings illustrate how selective hybridization and flat-band structure can produce unusual redistributions of magnetic correlations in strongly interacting multiorbital systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子关联和晶格几何之间的相互作用可以强烈改变多轨道哈密顿量中磁关联和局部单线态形成之间的竞争。在这里，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究两个周期性类安德森模型，这些模型是通过选择性地将局域轨道与利布晶格的不等位点杂交而构建的。由此产生的几何形状具有部分填充的平带和不同的亚晶格不平衡性。我们研究了随着杂化程度的增加，局部自旋相关性和轨道分辨磁结构因素的演变。尽管杂化轨道之间的相关性相对平稳地朝着局部单线态形成发展，但较长程的磁相关性表现出对杂化的惊人的非单调依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联和晶格几何之间的相互作用可以强烈改变多轨道哈密顿量中磁关联和局部单线态形成之间的竞争。在这里，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究两个周期性类安德森模型，这些模型是通过选择性地将局域轨道与利布晶格的不等位点杂交而构建的。由此产生的几何形状具有部分填充的平带和不同的亚晶格不平衡性。我们研究了随着杂化程度的增加，局部自旋相关性和轨道分辨磁结构因素的演变。尽管杂化轨道之间的相关性相对平稳地朝着局部单线态形成发展，但较长程的磁相关性表现出对杂化的惊人的非单调依赖性。特别是，我们观察到中间杂交的显着抑制，随后未修饰晶格位点的大幅恢复。我们结合早期对耗尽周期安德森模型的研究以及利布定理施加的约束来讨论这些结果。我们的研究结果说明了选择性杂化和平带结构如何在强相互作用的多轨道系统中产生不寻常的磁关联重新分布。

articles.title: Role of antisite disorder in dictating the Ising anisotropy and ferromagnetic ground state of NdGaSi
articles.title_zh: 反位无序在决定 NdGaSi 伊辛各向异性和铁磁基态中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions together set the magnetic ground state of rare-earth intermetallics, yet the role of chemical disorder on the ligand sublattice remains little explored. Here, we show that Ga/Si antisite disorder in NdGaSi stabilises the centrosymmetric I4₁/amd structure and raises the Nd³⁺ site symmetry to D₂d, which forbids all m=±2 Stevens operators in the crystalline electric field (CEF) Hamiltonian. Magnetization, specific heat, single-crystal neutron diffraction, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy establish the disordered structure and a collinear ferromagnetic order below T_Capprox11~K with Ising anisotropy along c. A CEF analysis that fits the susceptibilities along both axes and the magnetic specific heat simultaneously yields a ground-state doublet that is sim97% pure, in contrast to the strongly mixed ground state of the Al/Si-ordered NdAlSi (C₂ᵥ site symmetry of Nd³⁺). We argue that this ground-state purity makes the ordered moment rigid against the modulation due to frustrated exchange, selecting a k=0 ferromagnet in NdGaSi instead of the incommensurate ferrimagnet of NdAlSi. Antisite disorder, thus, acts as a handle on CEF ground-state purity and can, thereby, select between fundamentally different magnetic ground states.
articles.abstract_zh: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。 CEF 分析同时拟合沿两个轴的磁化率和磁比热，产生纯度为 sim97% 的基态双峰，这与 Al/Si 有序 NdAlSi 的强混合基态（Nd3⁺ 的 C2ᵥ 位点对称）形成鲜明对比。我们认为，由于交换受阻，这种基态纯度使得有序矩对调制变得刚性，选择 k=0 的 NdGaSi 铁磁体而不是 NdAlSi 的不相称亚铁磁体。因此，反位点无序充当 CEF 基态纯度的手柄，从而可以在根本不同的磁性基态之间进行选择。

articles.title: Frustration-Stabilized Hexamerons and Their Topological Magnons in Janus MXene
articles.title_zh: Janus MXene 中的挫败稳定六聚体及其拓扑磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustrated magnets on triangular lattices favour noncollinear order, and when inversion symmetry is broken they can host localized topological textures on top of that order. Here we show that the Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI is such a system. Combining first-principles calculations with atomistic spin simulations, we find that magnetism is confined to the Mn layer, where a strong antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange together with a sizable Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction stabilizes a frustrated 120 Neel ground state. On top of this ground state we identify a metastable hexameron: a composite of six merons and antimerons, one vortex-antivortex pair on each of the three sublattices, whose sublattice-resolved topological charges compensate. Linear spin-wave theory confirms that the hexameron is a local energy minimum, and its noncoplanar cores act as potential wells that bind discrete in-gap magnon modes below the bulk continuum. In a periodic hexameron array the magnon bands carry nonzero Chern numbers, and the resulting Berry curvature produces a magnon thermal Hall response whose sign depends on which of the two time-reversal partners of the hexameron is realized. Our results establish Janus MXenes as a two-dimensional platform in which frustration, broken inversion symmetry, and spin-orbit coupling combine to produce metastable antiferromagnetic solitons with distinct spectroscopic and transport fingerprints.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角形晶格上的受挫磁体有利于非共线顺序，当反演对称性被打破时，它们可以在该顺序之上承载局部拓扑纹理。在这里，我们展示了 Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI 就是这样一个系统。将第一性原理计算与原子自旋模拟相结合，我们发现磁性仅限于 Mn 层，其中强烈的反铁磁最近邻交换以及相当大的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定了受抑的 120 Neel 基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角形晶格上的受挫磁体有利于非共线顺序，当反演对称性被打破时，它们可以在该顺序之上承载局部拓扑纹理。在这里，我们展示了 Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI 就是这样一个系统。将第一性原理计算与原子自旋模拟相结合，我们发现磁性仅限于 Mn 层，其中强烈的反铁磁最近邻交换以及相当大的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定了受抑的 120 Neel 基态。在此基态之上，我们识别出亚稳态六聚子：由六个六聚子和反子组成的复合体，三个子晶格中的每一个都有一个涡旋-反涡旋对，其子晶格解析的拓扑电荷进行补偿。线性自旋波理论证实，六聚体是局部能量最小值，其非共面核心充当势阱，将离散的带隙内磁振子模式束缚在体连续体下方。在周期性六面体阵列中，磁振子带带有非零陈数，并且由此产生的贝里曲率产生磁振子热霍尔响应，其符号取决于六面体的两个时间反转伙伴中的哪一个被实现。我们的结果将 Janus MXenes 确立为一个二维平台，其中挫败性、破缺反演对称性和自旋轨道耦合相结合，产生具有独特光谱和传输指纹的亚稳态反铁磁孤子。

articles.title: Annular Terahertz Near-Field of a Breathing Charged Vortex
articles.title_zh: 呼吸带电涡旋的环形太赫兹近场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the radial electric field around a singly quantized vortex in a charged BCS superconductor, when the Higgs amplitude mode is driven by a uniform terahertz (THz) electromagnetic pulse. In a local-density approximation the pairing gap vanishes on the vortex axis at all times, so the particle density on the axis cannot oscillate, whereas the curvature of the density profile around the axis does. Starting from the electrostatic-lens formalism of our previous work, we show that this converts the electrically neutral Higgs oscillation into an alternating radial electric field that vanishes on the axis. When the electrostatic screening length is much shorter than the vortex core, we obtain the field in closed form: it has a ring-shaped profile, with a maximum at a distance of the order of the coherence length from the axis, and the Higgs drive modulates it by a fraction 2η, where η is the relative oscillation of the gap. For niobium nitride and η=0.1 the static field of the vortex is about 140~V/m and its modulation about 30~V/m, independently of the carrier density and of the dielectric constant. We also discuss how the thermodynamic factor entering the field changes toward the BCS-BEC crossover.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当希格斯振幅模式由均匀太赫兹 (THz) 电磁脉冲驱动时，带电 BCS 超导体中单量子化涡旋周围的径向电场。在局部密度近似中，涡旋轴上的配对间隙始终消失，因此轴上的粒子密度不能振荡，而绕轴的密度分布的曲率却会振荡。从我们之前工作的静电透镜形式开始，我们证明这将电中性希格斯振荡转换为在轴上消失的交变径向电场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了当希格斯振幅模式由均匀太赫兹 (THz) 电磁脉冲驱动时，带电 BCS 超导体中单量子化涡旋周围的径向电场。在局部密度近似中，涡旋轴上的配对间隙始终消失，因此轴上的粒子密度不能振荡，而绕轴的密度分布的曲率却会振荡。从我们之前工作的静电透镜形式开始，我们证明这将电中性希格斯振荡转换为在轴上消失的交变径向电场。当静电屏蔽长度比涡核短得多时，我们获得闭合形式的场：它具有环形轮廓，最大值位于距轴相干长度数量级的位置，希格斯驱动器将其调制为分数 2η，其中 η 是间隙的相对振荡。对于氮化铌且 η=0.1，涡流的静态场约为 140V/m，其调制约为 30V/m，与载流子密度和介电常数无关。我们还讨论了进入该领域的热力学因素如何朝着 BCS-BEC 交叉方向变化。

articles.title: Designing Perovskites for Chemical Looping Hydrogen Production
articles.title_zh: 设计用于化学循环制氢的钙钛矿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perovskites are promising materials for chemical looping hydrogen production (CLHP) due to their compositional flexibility and tunable redox properties. However, cation substitution opens a vast compositional space, making screening for new high-performing materials computationally demanding. Here, an autonomous active-learning framework combining a Wasserstein autoencoder (WAE) with a deep ensemble surrogate model was used to search for perovskites with a high hydrogen production capacity (HPC). In seven independent runs of 50 cycles, the mean HPC of the acquired compositions rose from 0.41 mmol H₂ g⁻¹ in the starting set to 2.05 mmol H₂ g⁻¹, and the best compositions reached 2.65-2.99 mmol H₂ g⁻¹. All runs enriched Sn on the B-site, mostly combined with Ti and with Mg, Ce, K and Y on the A-site. Twenty diverse candidates (2.22-2.84 mmol H₂ g⁻¹) were then selected by a multi-objective ranking that also accounts for raw-material price, supply resilience and potential environmental and health impacts. The approach links materials discovery with practical deployment constraints, and the methodology is transferable to other chemical looping processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿由于其成分灵活性和可调节的氧化还原特性，是用于化学循环制氢（CLHP）的有前途的材料。然而，阳离子取代开辟了广阔的组成空间，使得筛选新型高性能材料的计算要求很高。在这里，将 Wasserstein 自动编码器 (WAE) 与深度集成代理模型相结合的自主主动学习框架用于搜索具有高产氢能力 (HPC) 的钙钛矿。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿由于其成分灵活性和可调节的氧化还原特性，是用于化学循环制氢（CLHP）的有前途的材料。然而，阳离子取代开辟了广阔的组成空间，使得筛选新型高性能材料的计算要求很高。在这里，将 Wasserstein 自动编码器 (WAE) 与深度集成代理模型相结合的自主主动学习框架用于搜索具有高产氢能力 (HPC) 的钙钛矿。在 7 个独立运行的 50 个循环中，所获得的组合物的平均 HPC 从起始组中的 0.41 mmol H2 g-1 上升到 2.05 mmol H2 g-1，并且最佳组合物达到 2.65-2.99 mmol H2 g-1。所有的 B 位均富含 Sn，大部分与 Ti 结合，并且在 A 位上与 Mg、Ce、K 和 Y 结合。然后通过多目标排名选出 20 种不同的候选药物（2.22-2.84 mmol H2 g⁻1），该排名还考虑了原材料价格、供应弹性以及潜在的环境和健康影响。该方法将材料发现与实际部署限制联系起来，并且该方法可转移到其他化学循环过程。

articles.title: Closed-loop policy optimisation for cylinder wake control via differentiable simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过可微仿真进行气缸尾流控制的闭环策略优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Suppressing vortex shedding behind a circular cylinder is a classical problem in active flow control.Model-free deep reinforcement learning (DRL) learns such policies by interacting with the flow without differentiating its dynamics, which typically requires a large interaction budget. This study optimises closed-loop policies by differentiable simulation: control-loss gradients propagate through the simulated flow to the policy parameters, which are updated by reverse-mode automatic differentiation. The policy maps local velocity measurements to a jet amplitude imposed through differentiable synthetic-jet boundary conditions. In a two-dimensional confined cylinder wake at Rey=100, eight policy updates (about 78 shedding periods of forward simulation) give approximately 8% drag reduction and 99.6% suppression of lift fluctuations, the drag level being comparable to reported DRL results. Suppression is sustained by feedback: a mean-matched constant jet does not maintain it, whereas the same policy responds similarly at three activation phases and recovers after upstream disturbances. A velocity-deviation reward alone retains strong suppression, and observations of two instantaneous velocity components at one near-wake or surface location reach about 99.8% suppression, whereas a single surface pressure leaves residual oscillations. Together with related DRL results, this suggests that reward and observation requirements here are set by policy optimisation and flow physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 抑制圆柱体后面的涡流脱落是主动流动控制中的一个经典问题。无模型深度强化学习 (DRL) 通过与流动交互来学习此类策略，而不需要区分其动态，这通常需要大量的交互预算。本研究通过可微分模拟来优化闭环策略：控制损失梯度通过模拟流传播到策略参数，并通过反向模式自动微分来更新。该策略将局部速度测量映射到通过可微分合成射流边界条件施加的射流振幅。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 抑制圆柱体后面的涡流脱落是主动流动控制中的一个经典问题。无模型深度强化学习 (DRL) 通过与流动交互来学习此类策略，而不需要区分其动态，这通常需要大量的交互预算。本研究通过可微分模拟来优化闭环策略：控制损失梯度通过模拟流传播到策略参数，并通过反向模式自动微分来更新。该策略将局部速度测量映射到通过可微分合成射流边界条件施加的射流振幅。在 Rey=100 的二维受限圆柱尾流中，八次策略更新（大约 78 个正向模拟脱落期）可减少大约 8% 的阻力，并抑制 99.6% 的升力波动，阻力水平与报告的 DRL 结果相当。抑制是通过反馈来维持的：均值匹配的恒定射流不会维持抑制，而相同的策略在三个激活阶段的响应类似，并在上游扰动后恢复。单独的速度偏差奖励保留了强烈的抑制，并且在一个近尾流或表面位置处观察到的两个瞬时速度分量达到了约 99.8% 的抑制，而单个表面压力留下了残余振荡。与相关的 DRL 结果一起，这表明这里的奖励和观察要求是由策略优化和流物理设定的。

articles.title: Stall-Triggered Newton-Krylov-Assisted DIIS and Its Machine-Learning-Accelerated Variant for CCSD Convergence
articles.title_zh: 失速触发牛顿克雷洛夫辅助 DIIS 及其用于 CCSD 收敛的机器学习加速变体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The iterative solution of the non-linear amplitude equations of coupled-cluster singles doubles (CCSD) theory can encounter convergence instabilities, asymptotic convergence or outright divergence. Direct Inversion in the Iterative Subspace (DIIS) is a widely used extrapolation technique but can also exhibit slow or oscillatory convergence in challenging regimes. In this work, we introduce a robust hybrid solver: Stall-Triggered Newton-Krylov Assisted DIIS ({}stNK-DIIS) alongside its machine-learning accelerated variant {}stNKML-DIIS which leverages the robust convergence of Newton-Krylov (NK) while avoiding the high computational cost of Krylov iterations. In our methods, DIIS remains the default accelerator and a matrix-free NK procedure is activated when sustained stagnation or divergence is detected with each NK step verified using the non-linear residual before acceptance. To alleviate the cost of Krylov iterations the {}stNKML-DIIS uses a gated recurrent unit (GRU) to predict a scalar logarithmic step-size ratio along the approximately computed Newton direction. When the ML-predicted step fails residual-based verification, the method falls back to a grid-based NK line search. Using CCSD as the underlying electronic-structure theory, we evaluate these methods against conventional DIIS and pure NK for stretched molecules exhibiting convergence difficulties in terms of residual convergence, iteration counts, and wall-time performance. These protocols may be generalizable to other non-linear equation solvers as well, as the ML model learns the convergence pattern of the variables and does not require system-specific knowledge such as atom identities or molecular orbital properties. This allows transferability across atom-type, bonding character and basis-sets.
articles.abstract_zh: 耦合簇单双打 (CCSD) 理论的非线性振幅方程的迭代解可能会遇到收敛不稳定、渐近收敛或彻底发散的情况。迭代子空间中的直接反演 (DIIS) 是一种广泛使用的外推技术，但在具有挑战性的情况下也可能表现出缓慢或振荡收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耦合簇单双打 (CCSD) 理论的非线性振幅方程的迭代解可能会遇到收敛不稳定、渐近收敛或彻底发散的情况。迭代子空间中的直接反演 (DIIS) 是一种广泛使用的外推技术，但在具有挑战性的情况下也可能表现出缓慢或振荡收敛。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种强大的混合求解器：失速触发 Newton-Krylov 辅助 DIIS ({}stNK-DIIS) 及其机器学习加速变体 {}stNKML-DIIS，它利用 Newton-Krylov (NK) 的稳健收敛性，同时避免 Krylov 迭代的高计算成本。在我们的方法中，DIIS 仍然是默认加速器，并且当检测到持续停滞或发散时，将激活无矩阵 NK 程序，并且在接受之前使用非线性残差验证每个 NK 步骤。为了减轻 Krylov 迭代的成本，{}stNKML-DIIS 使用门控循环单元 (GRU) 来预测沿近似计算的牛顿方向的标量对数步长比。当 ML 预测步骤未能通过基于残差的验证时，该方法会回退到基于网格的 NK 线搜索。使用 CCSD 作为基础电子结构理论，我们针对在残余收敛、迭代计数和墙时间性能方面表现出收敛困难的拉伸分子，针对传统 DIIS 和纯 NK 评估了这些方法。这些协议也可以推广到其他非线性方程求解器，因为机器学习模型可以学习变量的收敛模式，并且不需要特定于系统的知识，例如原子身份或分子轨道属性。这允许跨原子类型、键合特征和基组的可转移性。

articles.title: Beyond the Ground State: Assessing the Machine-Learned Skala Functional in ΔSCF Calculations of Molecular Excitation Energies
articles.title_zh: 超越基态：评估分子激发能 ΔSCF 计算中的机器学习 Skala 泛函
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We assess the transferability of the machine-learned Skala exchange-correlation (XC) functional beyond ground-state energetics using molecular vertical excitation energies and singlet-triplet gaps calculated with the Δ-self-consistent-field (ΔSCF) approach. We compare Skala with PBE, r²SCAN, and PBE0 on subsets covering small-molecule excitations (QUEST1), inverted singlet-triplet gaps (ST-gap), and intramolecular charge-transfer excitations (QUEST6). Both spin-unrestricted Kohn-Sham (UKS) and restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham (ROKS) formalisms are considered. On QUEST1, Skala achieves the lowest mean absolute errors (MAEs) for singlet and triplet excitation energies with both formalisms, although PBE0 and r²SCAN provide more accurate singlet-triplet gaps through error cancellation. For ST-gap, Skala yields the lowest gap MAEs with both UKS and ROKS. Evaluating the mixed-spin and triplet energy components on the same orbitals optimized for the ROKS open-shell singlet yields negative splittings for seven of eight ST-gap molecules with Skala. Separate triplet optimization increases the gaps, but six remain negative. All three conventional functionals give positive common-orbital splittings and optimized gaps for all eight molecules. For QUEST6, treated with UKS only, Skala yields more accurate singlet excitation energies than PBE and r²SCAN but remains less accurate than PBE0. Across QUEST1 and ST-gap, Skala yields lower MAEs with UKS than ROKS. Overall, these results support Skala's transferability to molecular excited states while highlighting its dependence on the excitation class and open-shell treatment.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用分子垂直激发能和通过 Δ 自洽场 (ΔSCF) 方法计算的单重态-三重态能隙来评估机器学习的 Skala 交换相关 (XC) 函数在基态能量学之外的可传递性。我们将 Skala 与 PBE、r²SCAN 和 PBE0 在涵盖小分子激发 (QUEST1)、反向单重态-三重态间隙 (ST-gap) 和分子内电荷转移激发 (QUEST6) 的子集上进行比较。自旋无限制 Kohn-Sham (UKS) 和受限开壳 Kohn-Sham (ROKS) 形式主义均被考虑。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用分子垂直激发能和通过 Δ 自洽场 (ΔSCF) 方法计算的单重态-三重态能隙来评估机器学习的 Skala 交换相关 (XC) 函数在基态能量学之外的可传递性。我们将 Skala 与 PBE、r²SCAN 和 PBE0 在涵盖小分子激发 (QUEST1)、反向单重态-三重态间隙 (ST-gap) 和分子内电荷转移激发 (QUEST6) 的子集上进行比较。自旋无限制 Kohn-Sham (UKS) 和受限开壳 Kohn-Sham (ROKS) 形式主义均被考虑。在 QUEST1 上，Skala 通过两种形式实现了单重态和三重态激发能的最低平均绝对误差 (MAE)，尽管 PBE0 和 r²SCAN 通过误差消除提供了更准确的单重态-三重态间隙。对于 ST-gap，Skala 与 UKS 和 ROKS 的 MAE 差距最低。评估针对 ROKS 开壳层单线态优化的相同轨道上的混合自旋和三线态能量分量，可以使用 Skala 生成八个 ST 带隙分子中的七个的负分裂。单独的三元组优化增加了差距，但六项仍然为负。所有三种常规泛函都为所有八个分子提供了正的共轨道分裂和优化的间隙。对于仅用 UKS 处理的 QUEST6，Skala 产生的单线态激发能比 PBE 和 r²SCAN 更准确，但仍然不如 PBE0 准确。在 QUEST1 和 ST-gap 中，Skala 与 UKS 的 MAE 低于 ROKS。总体而言，这些结果支持 Skala 向分子激发态的可转移性，同时强调其对激发类别和开壳层处理的依赖性。

articles.title: Atomistic theory of the d-wave phonon angular momentum splitter effect
articles.title_zh: d波声子角动量分裂效应的原子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonons offer a bosonic route to angular-momentum transport in solids, but how their momentum-space textures manifest in transport remains unclear. Here we develop an atomistic theory of the phonon angular momentum splitter effect in an antiferromagnetic square lattice with checkerboard-modulated elastic couplings, analogous to the spin-splitter effect in d-wave altermagnets. We calculate the transport and accumulation of phonon angular momentum driven by a temperature gradient and find that the transverse response separates into Hall and dₓy-wave splitter contributions. The splitter contribution requires both the antiferromagnetic order and the checkerboard elastic modulation and exhibits a characteristic dₓy angular dependence, whereas the Hall contribution is nearly isotropic. Their combination enables directional control of the edge phonon angular momentum accumulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 声子为固体中的角动量输运提供了一条玻色子途径，但它们的动量空间纹理在输运中如何体现仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了具有棋盘调制弹性耦合的反铁磁方晶格中声子角动量分裂器效应的原子理论，类似于 d 波交流磁体中的自旋分裂器效应。我们计算了温度梯度驱动的声子角动量的传输和累积，发现横向响应分为霍尔和 dₓy 波分束器贡献。分束器的贡献需要反铁磁阶和棋盘弹性调制，并表现出特征 dₓy 角度依赖性，而霍尔贡献几乎是各向同性的。它们的组合能够对边缘声子角动量积累进行定向控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 声子为固体中的角动量输运提供了一条玻色子途径，但它们的动量空间纹理在输运中如何体现仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了具有棋盘调制弹性耦合的反铁磁方晶格中声子角动量分裂器效应的原子理论，类似于 d 波交流磁体中的自旋分裂器效应。我们计算了温度梯度驱动的声子角动量的传输和累积，发现横向响应分为霍尔和 dₓy 波分束器贡献。分束器的贡献需要反铁磁阶和棋盘弹性调制，并表现出特征 dₓy 角度依赖性，而霍尔贡献几乎是各向同性的。它们的组合能够对边缘声子角动量积累进行定向控制。

articles.title: Lattice-geometry dependence of Type-I and Type-II magnetic flux responses in strongly correlated bosons
articles.title_zh: 强相关玻色子中 I 型和 II 型磁通量响应的晶格几何依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superfluids and superconductors are classified into Type-I and Type-II according to their response to a magnetic flux, but this classification has hardly been addressed for lattice bosons under magnetic flux, where the Meissner and vortex phases have been studied mostly in ladder geometries. Here, we study the flux response of the extended Bose-Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor interaction V at half filling on square and triangular ladders with two to four legs by using the density-matrix renormalization group. On the square ladders, the vortex phase is confined to a region near V=0. At finite V, a magnetic flux-induced charge-density-wave (CDW) order replaces it, and the response becomes Type-I-like. In contrast, on the triangular ladders, the vortex phase persists over the whole range of V studied, and the response remains Type-II-like. By extrapolating the ladder results to two dimensions, we argue that the Type-I or Type-II character of the flux response depends on the lattice geometry, which suggests a role of geometric frustration.
articles.abstract_zh: 超流体和超导体根据其对磁通量的响应分为 I 型和 II 型，但这种分类几乎没有针对磁通量下的晶格玻色子，其中迈斯纳相和涡旋相主要在梯形几何中进行研究。在这里，我们通过使用密度矩阵重整化群，研究了带有最近邻相互作用 V 的扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型在具有两到四条腿的方形和三角形梯子半填充时的通量响应。在方梯上，涡旋相位被限制在 V=0 附近的区域。在有限 V 处，磁通感应电荷密度波 (CDW) 阶取代了它，并且响应变得类似 I 型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超流体和超导体根据其对磁通量的响应分为 I 型和 II 型，但这种分类几乎没有针对磁通量下的晶格玻色子，其中迈斯纳相和涡旋相主要在梯形几何中进行研究。在这里，我们通过使用密度矩阵重整化群，研究了带有最近邻相互作用 V 的扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型在具有两到四条腿的方形和三角形梯子半填充时的通量响应。在方梯上，涡旋相位被限制在 V=0 附近的区域。在有限 V 处，磁通感应电荷密度波 (CDW) 阶取代了它，并且响应变得类似 I 型。相比之下，在三角梯上，涡旋相在研究的 V 的整个范围内持续存在，并且响应仍然类似于 II 型。通过将阶梯结果外推到二维，我们认为通量响应的 I 型或 II 型特征取决于晶格几何形状，这表明几何挫败的作用。

articles.title: Shift current as a stacking spectroscopy of hexagonal boron nitride multilayers
articles.title_zh: 移动电流作为六方氮化硼多层膜的堆积光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Out-of-plane polarization can be tuned by sliding polar monolayers in van der Waals materials; the bulk photovoltaic effect is emerging as a natural optical probe, provided the photocurrent tracks the polarization. We test that assumption by computing the polarization and the shift-current tensor from first principles across the stacking landscape of bi-, tri-, and tetralayer hexagonal boron nitride. The two quantities share one robust property: the vertical response reverses with the polarization while the in-plane one does not. Beyond this rule, the correspondence must be read with caution: stackings with identical polarization carry vertical monochromatic photocurrents of opposite sign; the spectra reorganize and even reverse sign at some photon energies along a constant-polarization plateau; and the strongest vertical peak of the entire pathway sits where the polarization crosses zero. The reason is structural: the polarization counts polar interfaces, while the shift current reads their positions. Broadband illumination reads the domain sign; monochromatic photocurrent maps can read the stacking registry. In a sliding ferroelectric, the bulk photovoltaic effect can operate as a stacking spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 面外偏振可以通过范德华材料中的滑动极性单层来调节；如果光电流跟踪偏振，体光伏效应正在作为一种自然光学探针出现。我们通过根据双层、三层和四层六方氮化硼的堆叠景观的第一原理计算极化和位移电流张量来测试该假设。这两个量有一个共同的特性：垂直响应与偏振相反，而面内响应则不然。除了这条规则之外，必须谨慎阅读对应关系：具有相同偏振的堆叠携带符号相反的垂直单色光电流；光谱在某些光子能量上沿着恒定偏振平台重新组织甚至反转；整个路径的最强垂直峰值位于极化过零的位置。

articles.title: Magnetic-Field Response of a Hyperbolic Kitaev Spin Liquid
articles.title_zh: 双曲 Kitaev 自旋液体的磁场响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperbolic geometry can give rise to Kitaev spin liquids with distinct flux structures and Majorana spectra, raising the question of how these fractionalized states respond beyond exactly solvable limits. We address this question on the Kekulé-colored hyperbolic 8,3 lattice by developing an infinite projected entangled-pair-state approach with flux-resolved loop-gas initialization and geometry-adapted tensor-network contraction. Under uniform and staggered [111] magnetic fields, we find markedly different many-body responses. The uniform field induces a sharp change between competing variational branches at weak field, whereas the polarization and mean plaquette flux evolve over a much broader field range under the staggered field. Exchange-energy competition helps explain the different response scales, while third-order effective Majorana models in a fixed-flux background exhibit contrasting low-energy spectra. Our results connect the geometry-dependent fractionalized structure of a solvable hyperbolic spin liquid to its many-body response under physical perturbations that break flux conservation.
articles.abstract_zh: 双曲几何可以产生具有不同通量结构和马约拉纳光谱的基塔耶夫自旋液体，从而提出了这些分数态如何响应超出精确可解极限的问题。我们通过开发无限投影纠缠对态方法来解决凯库勒色双曲 8,3 晶格上的这个问题，该方法具有通量解析的环路气体初始化和几何适应的张量网络收缩。在均匀和交错的[111]磁场下，我们发现明显不同的多体响应。均匀场会在弱场下引起竞争变分分支之间的急剧变化，而偏振和平均斑块通量在交错场下在更广泛的场范围内演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双曲几何可以产生具有不同通量结构和马约拉纳光谱的基塔耶夫自旋液体，从而提出了这些分数态如何响应超出精确可解极限的问题。我们通过开发无限投影纠缠对态方法来解决凯库勒色双曲 8,3 晶格上的这个问题，该方法具有通量解析的环路气体初始化和几何适应的张量网络收缩。在均匀和交错的[111]磁场下，我们发现明显不同的多体响应。均匀场会在弱场下引起竞争变分分支之间的急剧变化，而偏振和平均斑块通量在交错场下在更广泛的场范围内演化。交换能量竞争有助于解释不同的响应尺度，而固定通量背景中的三阶有效马约拉纳模型表现出对比鲜明的低能光谱。我们的结果将可解双曲自旋液体的依赖于几何形状的分式结构与其在打破通量守恒的物理扰动下的多体响应联系起来。

articles.title: Voltage-Controlled Dielectric Cavity Magnonics in Epitaxial Fe Films on SrTiO3 Single Crystal Substrates
articles.title_zh: SrTiO3 单晶衬底上外延 Fe 薄膜中的压控介电腔磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.27837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity magnonics relies on the hybridization between collective spin excitations and well-defined photonic or mechanical cavity modes, enabling fast and efficient coupling of spintronic devices to microwave circuits and optical information carriers. In this work, we present a hybrid material heterostructure that combines an intrinsic dielectric microwave cavity with a ferromagnetic medium, establishing magnon-photon interaction with coupling rates in the order of 0.1-1 GHz. Demonstrating effective voltage-control of the hybrid mode spectrum at cryogenic temperatures, we achieve a highly tunable photo-magnonic material, that could provide significant advancements for high-performance and power-efficient cryogenic RF-applications, including hybrid quantum technology, superconducting electronics and nonlinear microwave devices for unconventional computation and signal processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔磁振子学依赖于集体自旋激发和明确的光子或机械腔模式之间的混合，从而实现自旋电子器件与微波电路和光学信息载体的快速有效耦合。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种混合材料异质结构，它将本征介电微波腔与铁磁介质相结合，以 0.1-1 GHz 量级的耦合率建立磁子-光子相互作用。通过展示低温下混合模式光谱的有效电压控制，我们实现了高度可调的光磁材料，可以为高性能和高能效的低温射频应用提供重大进步，包括混合量子技术、超导电子学和用于非常规计算和信号处理的非线性微波器件。
