articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了包含双极磁性半导体 (BMS) 的一维约瑟夫森结中的平衡电流。我们证明，自旋分辨带的固有交换分裂可以通过 BMS 化学势的栅极可调调制来实现 0--π 跃迁的纯电控制，从而无需外部磁场。这为实现电可调 π 结行为提供了一条可行的途径，并凸显了基于 BMS 的约瑟夫森器件在相控超导电子器件方面的潜力。此外，在存在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的情况下，我们发现了异常约瑟夫森效应，其特征是零相位差下的有限平衡超流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了包含双极磁性半导体 (BMS) 的一维约瑟夫森结中的平衡电流。我们证明，自旋分辨带的固有交换分裂可以通过 BMS 化学势的栅极可调调制来实现 0--π 跃迁的纯电控制，从而无需外部磁场。这为实现电可调 π 结行为提供了一条可行的途径，并凸显了基于 BMS 的约瑟夫森器件在相控超导电子器件方面的潜力。此外，在存在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的情况下，我们发现了异常约瑟夫森效应，其特征是零相位差下的有限平衡超流。这种行为源于与 BMS 的自旋极化电子结构相关的时间反转对称性的内在破坏。有趣的是，尽管时间反转和反演对称性同时被打破（通常与不可逆超导输运相关的条件），但我们没有观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应。因此，我们的结果强调了反常约瑟夫森输运和超导非互易性之间的重要区别：前者并不一定意味着相反电流方向之间的有限临界电流不对称性。

articles.title: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克超导体中的规范不变性、集体模式以及常态减法的合理性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28485v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with s-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.
articles.abstract_zh: 在狄拉克超导体中，众所周知，低能狄拉克模型的无界谱会导致深层态对电磁响应产生非物理的带间贡献。为了消除这些贡献，人们广泛采用了正常态减法（NSS），即从超导态响应中减去正常态响应。然而，NSS与规范不变电磁响应之间的关系，特别是沃德恒等式所要求的顶点修正的作用，仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们考虑了一个具有s波配对的质量狄拉克模型，并通过求解贝特-萨尔彼得方程并将集体模式对电磁顶点的贡献纳入其中，对零温度下的电磁响应进行了分析性研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在狄拉克超导体中，众所周知，低能狄拉克模型的无界谱会导致深层态对电磁响应产生非物理的带间贡献。为了消除这些贡献，人们广泛采用了正常态减法（NSS），即从超导态响应中减去正常态响应。然而，NSS与规范不变电磁响应之间的关系，特别是沃德恒等式所要求的顶点修正的作用，仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们考虑了一个具有s波配对的质量狄拉克模型，并通过求解贝特-萨尔彼得方程并将集体模式对电磁顶点的贡献纳入其中，对零温度下的电磁响应进行了分析性研究。我们表明，在静态长波极限下，顶点修正正好抵消了具有NSS的裸纵向响应，从而得到规范不变性所要求的消失的纵向响应。相比之下，在长波极限下，顶点修正的横向分量消失，因此规范不变的迈斯纳权重与从具有NSS的裸横向响应中获得的权重一致。此外，在各向同性和解析性紫外线正则化项的类别中，我们表明规范不变性将静态长波极限下的正则化项唯一地确定为NSS所规定的值。因此，我们的结果为NSS提供了微观上的论证。

articles.title: Phonon Scharnhorst effect: Acoustic analogue of the vacuum-fluctuation-boosted speed of light
articles.title_zh: 声子沙恩霍斯特效应：光速受真空涨落增强的声学类似物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.14155v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Scharnhorst effect in quantum electrodynamics predicts a superluminal velocity shift δ c>0 at low photon frequencies due to vacuum fluctuations between two mirrors. Although theoretically robust (no causality violation), the effect is extraordinarily small (δ c/capprox 10⁻³² for mirrors 1,μrm m apart) and outside current experimental reach. Here we propose a condensed matter analogue, replacing the photons in the electromagnetic vacuum by phonon excitations of a Bose-Einstein condensate. In an idealized geometry, the two-dimensional surface of a cylinder (circumference L) at zero temperature, the axial speed of sound is increased due to zero-point fluctuations of the condensate by δ c/csimeq 5× 10⁻³,tildeg at Lsimeq 2,ξ, to first order in the dimensionless interaction constant tildegsimeq 10⁻¹ of the Bose gas of healing length ξsimeq 1,μrm m. This is 28 orders of magnitude larger than the photonic effect at a comparable confinement length, basically because phonons have a self-interaction while photons only interact via massive electrons. When L drops below 1.19,ξ the velocity shift changes sign, signaling the crossover to a one-dimensional Bose gas. We discuss the prospects for observation of the acoustic Scharnhorst effect. The main obstacles are the nK temperature requirement and the need to separate the vacuum-fluctuation shift from a mean-field geometric correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电动力学中的沙恩霍斯特效应预测，由于两面镜子之间的真空涨落，在低光子频率下会出现超光速速度偏移δ c>0。尽管在理论上是稳健的（不存在因果律违背），但这种效应极其微小（对于相距1μm的镜子，δ c/c约等于10⁻³² ），并且超出了当前实验的范畴。在这里，我们提出了一种凝聚态模拟，用玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的声子激发取代了电磁真空中的光子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子电动力学中的沙恩霍斯特效应预测，由于两面镜子之间的真空涨落，在低光子频率下会出现超光速速度偏移δ c>0。尽管在理论上是稳健的（不存在因果律违背），但这种效应极其微小（对于相距1μm的镜子，δ c/c约等于10⁻³² ），并且超出了当前实验的范畴。在这里，我们提出了一种凝聚态模拟，用玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的声子激发取代了电磁真空中的光子。在理想化的几何结构中，在零温度下，圆柱体（周长L）的二维表面上，由于凝聚体的零点涨落，声波的轴向速度增加了δ c/csimeq 5× 10⁻³，tildeg at Lsimeq 2，ξ，在愈合长度ξsimeq 1，μrm m的玻色气的无量纲相互作用常数tildegsimeq 10⁻¹的一阶。这比在相当的束缚长度下的光子效应大28个数量级，其基本原因是声子具有自相互作用，而光子仅通过大质量电子相互作用。当L降至1.19,ξ以下时，速度偏移的符号发生变化，表明向一维玻色气的跃迁。我们讨论了观测声学沙恩霍斯特效应的前景。主要障碍是nK温度要求，以及需要将真空涨落位移与平均场几何校正区分开来。

articles.title: Assessing the Transferability of General-Purpose MachineLearning Interatomic Potentials for Heterogeneous Catalysis with HetCat26
articles.title_zh: 使用HetCat26评估通用机器学习原子间势在多相催化中的可迁移性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30621v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) promise near-density functional theory (DFT) accuracy across broad areas of chemistry and materials science. However, their performance in describing systems and processes relevant to heterogeneous catalysis remains underexplored. Here, we introduce HetCat26, a collection of benchmark tests designed to assess pre-trained MLIPs across key aspects of catalytic modeling, including surface energetics, metal-metal oxide interactions, adsorption, and catalytic reaction networks. Evaluating eighteen foundation models, we find that performance on existing general materials benchmarks is only weakly predictive of performance on HetCat26; transferability to heterogeneous catalysis cannot be inferred from these general benchmarks. Across the benchmark tests, current models describe surface energetics and, perhaps surprisingly, reaction barriers well, whereas larger errors are observed for adsorption, and DFT site preferences are often not reproduced. Three models, eSEN-30M-OAM, SevenNet-Omni-i12 and MACE-MH-1-OMAT, nevertheless achieve high accuracy across the properties evaluated. Beyond model benchmarking, HetCat26 highlights the importance of training data consistency: PBE and PBE+U calculations should not be mixed within a training set. Overall, we identify challenges limiting the transferability of current foundation MLIPs to heterogeneous catalysis and, more broadly, to chemical reactions at interfaces, providing guidance for the development of the next generation of foundation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）有望在化学和材料科学的广泛领域实现接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度。然而，它们在描述与多相催化相关的体系和过程方面的性能仍未得到充分探索。本文介绍了HetCat26，这是一个基准测试集，旨在评估预训练的MLIP在催化建模的关键方面（包括表面能、金属-金属氧化物相互作用、吸附和催化反应网络）的表现。在对十八个基础模型进行评估后，我们发现，在现有通用材料基准上的表现只能弱弱地预测在HetCat26上的表现；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）有望在化学和材料科学的广泛领域实现接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度。然而，它们在描述与多相催化相关的体系和过程方面的性能仍未得到充分探索。本文介绍了HetCat26，这是一个基准测试集，旨在评估预训练的MLIP在催化建模的关键方面（包括表面能、金属-金属氧化物相互作用、吸附和催化反应网络）的表现。在对十八个基础模型进行评估后，我们发现，在现有通用材料基准上的表现只能弱弱地预测在HetCat26上的表现；无法从这些通用基准推断出对异相催化的可迁移性。在所有基准测试中，当前模型对表面能量学的描述都很好，而且也许令人惊讶的是，对反应势垒的描述也很好，但在吸附方面则存在较大的误差，而且DFT位点偏好往往无法重现。然而，eSEN-30M-OAM、SevenNet-Omni-i12和MACE-MH-1-OMAT这三种模型在所评估的性质方面均实现了高准确性。除了模型基准测试之外，HetCat26还强调了训练数据一致性的重要性：PBE和PBE+U计算不应在同一个训练集中混用。总体而言，我们确定了限制当前基础MLIP向异相催化以及更广泛地向界面化学反应迁移的挑战，为下一代基础模型的开发提供了指导。

articles.title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
articles.title_zh: 强朗道能级混合下的非阿贝尔量子霍尔态：使用第一性原理人工智能寻找任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor ν = 3/2. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension sqrt2, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子是构成容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇异粒子，据预测，它们会在偶数分母填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中出现。事实证明，确定实现了哪种拓扑序是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要对真实的朗道能级混合进行准确的非微扰处理，而这迄今为止在理论研究中尚付阙如。本文首次提出了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题的完整解，该解包括所有电子和所有朗道能级，适用于填充因子ν = 3/2的自旋极化电子。我们开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，该波函数仅在微观哈密顿量上进行优化，从而可以直接获得拓扑简并基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非阿贝尔任意子是构成容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇异粒子，据预测，它们会在偶数分母填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中出现。事实证明，确定实现了哪种拓扑序是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要对真实的朗道能级混合进行准确的非微扰处理，而这迄今为止在理论研究中尚付阙如。本文首次提出了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题的完整解，该解包括所有电子和所有朗道能级，适用于填充因子ν = 3/2的自旋极化电子。我们开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，该波函数仅在微观哈密顿量上进行优化，从而可以直接获得拓扑简并基态。在没有任何关于预期结果的物理学输入的情况下，它发现了一个简并基态流形，其纠缠揭示了具有量子维数sqrt2的任意子，这是伊辛型非阿贝尔序的标志。通过直接计算与试探波函数的重叠，我们进一步表明，朗道能级混合更倾向于反普法夫态，而非其他候选态。我们的结果表明，在强朗道能级混合的条件下，神经网络波函数在从第一性原理出发寻找和表征非阿贝尔任意子方面具有强大的能力，这与许多近期实验相关。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced modulation of heat transport in CrPS₄ probed by TaIrTe₄ transverse Seebeck thermometry
articles.title_zh: 通过TaIrTe₄横向塞贝克测温法探测磁场诱导的CrPS₄中热传输调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19833v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding and controlling heat flow in low-dimensional magnetic materials is central to thermoelectrics and spin caloritronics. One of the challenges is the absence of sensitive probes of small, field-dependent modulations in thermal transport. Here we demonstrate transverse Seebeck thermometry using exfoliated TaIrTe₄ as a probe of thermal conductivity modulated by an external magnetic field on a van der Waals magnet, CrPS₄. With a temperature gradient oriented at 45^circ to its principal crystallographic axes, TaIrTe₄ exhibits a transverse thermopower exceeding 200~mathrmμ V,K⁻¹ for 900 nm wide and 30 μm long electrodes, enabling precise detection of variations in the local temperature gradients. Exploiting this with CrPS₄ in a nonlocal geometry, we resolve distinct field dependent thermal conductivity changes associated with both the spin-flip and spin-flop magnetic transitions which we attribute to variations in the magnon-phonon coupling in CrPS₄. At 5 K, the transverse Seebeck response is modulated by more than 8% by an external magnetic field, demonstrating strong magnetic control of heat transport in CrPS₄. This all van der Waals platform offers high sensitivity to modulations of thermal conductivity and a broad adaptability to a wide range of exfoliated magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解和控制低维磁性材料中的热流是热电学和自旋热电学的核心。其中一个挑战是缺乏对热输运中微小、场依赖性调制的高灵敏度探测手段。本文中，我们展示了使用剥离的TaIrTe₄作为受外加磁场调制的热导率探针，在范德瓦尔斯磁体CrPS₄上进行横向塞贝克测温。当温度梯度与其主要晶体学轴成45°角时，对于宽度为900 nm、长度为30 μm的电极，TaIrTe₄表现出超过200 μV·K⁻¹的横向热电势，从而能够精确检测局部温度梯度的变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解和控制低维磁性材料中的热流是热电学和自旋热电学的核心。其中一个挑战是缺乏对热输运中微小、场依赖性调制的高灵敏度探测手段。本文中，我们展示了使用剥离的TaIrTe₄作为受外加磁场调制的热导率探针，在范德瓦尔斯磁体CrPS₄上进行横向塞贝克测温。当温度梯度与其主要晶体学轴成45°角时，对于宽度为900 nm、长度为30 μm的电极，TaIrTe₄表现出超过200 μV·K⁻¹的横向热电势，从而能够精确检测局部温度梯度的变化。我们在非局域几何结构中利用CrPS₄，解析了与自旋翻转和自旋flop磁性跃迁相关的明显磁场依赖性热导率变化，我们认为这些变化归因于CrPS₄中磁振子-声子耦合的变化。在5 K时，横向塞贝克响应受到外加磁场的调制超过8%，这表明CrPS₄中的热输运受到强磁性控制。这种全范德华平台对热导率的调制具有高灵敏度，并对各种各样的剥离磁性系统具有广泛的适应性。

articles.title: Probing the limits of materials design via a comprehensive crystal database of 14.6 million structures with 140 properties
articles.title_zh: 通过包含1460万种结构和140种性质的综合性晶体数据库，探索材料设计的极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32678v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Forward screening and inverse design drive materials discovery, yet their limits remain unquantified because records of known crystal structures and properties are fragmented across databases. Consequently, forward screening leaves known crystals underexplored for new functions, whereas generative and autonomous discovery has repeatedly reported known phases or close variants as new materials. Here we match structures across 55 databases to assemble MateriaViva, a unified database of 14.6 million distinct crystals and over one billion property values. To provide the missing properties of every structure, a task we term property completion, we develop an equivariant Crystal Graph Transformer Network with state-of-the-art accuracy on nine benchmark tasks and apply 140 property-prediction models across the database. These predictions reveal the underestimated potential of forward screening, identifying tens of thousands of high-performance candidates among previously synthesized or computationally studied materials that lack recorded target-property values. Conversely, comparison with MateriaViva shows that the novelty of inverse design has been overestimated, as 55-100% of inverse-designed structures are not new. Under equal density functional theory verification budgets for bulk-modulus design, inverse design yields a higher fraction of qualifying candidates, whereas forward screening reaches the higher bulk modulus. MateriaViva thus provides a comprehensive reference for probing the limits of both paradigms, revealing unrecognized performance in known crystals and directing inverse design beyond reported structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 正向筛选和逆向设计推动了材料的发现，但由于已知晶体结构和性质的记录分散在各个数据库中，因此其局限性仍未得到量化。因此，正向筛选导致已知晶体的新功能未得到充分探索，而生成式和自主发现则屡次将已知相或近似变体报告为新材料。在这里，我们对55个数据库中的结构进行匹配，以构建MateriaViva，这是一个包含1460万种不同晶体和超过10亿个属性值的统一数据库。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 正向筛选和逆向设计推动了材料的发现，但由于已知晶体结构和性质的记录分散在各个数据库中，因此其局限性仍未得到量化。因此，正向筛选导致已知晶体的新功能未得到充分探索，而生成式和自主发现则屡次将已知相或近似变体报告为新材料。在这里，我们对55个数据库中的结构进行匹配，以构建MateriaViva，这是一个包含1460万种不同晶体和超过10亿个属性值的统一数据库。为了提供每个结构缺少的性质（我们称之为性质补全的任务），我们开发了一个等变晶体图变换器网络，该网络在九项基准任务上具有最先进的准确性，并在整个数据库中应用了140个性质预测模型。这些预测揭示了正向筛选被低估的潜力，在先前合成或通过计算研究的、缺乏记录的目标性质值的材料中，识别出数万种高性能候选材料。相反，与MateriaViva的比较表明，逆向设计的创新性被高估了，因为55%-100%的逆向设计结构并不新颖。在用于体模量设计的等密度泛函理论验证预算下，逆向设计可产生更高比例的合格候选物，而正向筛选则可达到更高的体模量。因此，MateriaViva为探索两种范式的极限提供了全面的参考，揭示了已知晶体中未被认识的性能，并将逆向设计引向已报道结构之外。

articles.title: Symmetries, correlation functions, and entanglement of general quantum Motzkin spin-chains
articles.title_zh: 一般量子Motzkin自旋链的对称性、关联函数和纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2408.16070v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Motzkin spin-chains, which include `colorless' (integer spin s=1) and `colorful' (s ≥ 2) variants, are one-dimensional (1D) local integer spin models notable for their lack of a conformal field theory (CFT) description of their low-energy physics, despite being gapless. The colorful variants are particularly unusual, as they exhibit power-law violation of the area-law of entanglement entropy (as sqrtn in system size n), rather than a logarithmic violation as seen in a CFT. In this work, we analytically discover several unique properties of these models, potentially suggesting a new universality class for their low-energy physics. We identify a complex structure of symmetries and unexpected scaling behavior in spin-spin correlations, which deviate from known 1D universality classes. Specifically, the s=1 chain exhibits U(1) spontaneous symmetry breaking and ferromagnetic order. Meanwhile, the s ≥ 2 chains do not appear to spontaneously break any symmetries, but display quasi-long-range algebraic order with power-law decaying correlations, inconsistent with standard Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) critical exponents. We also derive asymptotic scaling expressions, with explicit additive constants, for entanglement measures in both colorless and colorful chains, generalizing previous results of Movassagh [J. Math Phys. (2017)], while providing benchmarks for potential quantum simulation experiments. The sqrtn entanglement scaling implies that any matrix-product-state description of these ground states requires bond dimension eΩ⁽sqrtⁿ⁾; this superpolynomial cost of the standard 1D tensor-network toolkit, along with the analytical tractability of their ground state properties, positions Motzkin spin chains as intriguing testbeds for quantum simulation of many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: Motzkin自旋链包括“无色”（整数自旋s=1）和“有色”（s ≥ 2）变体，是一维（1D）局部整数自旋模型，其显著特点是尽管没有能隙，但缺乏对低能物理的共形场论（CFT）描述。“彩色”变体尤为不寻常，因为它们表现出对纠缠熵面积定律的幂律违背（在系统大小为n时为sqrtn ），而不是像在共形场论（CFT）中看到的对数违背。在本文中，我们通过分析发现了这些模型的若干独特性质，这可能表明其低能物理存在一个新的普适性类别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Motzkin自旋链包括“无色”（整数自旋s=1）和“有色”（s ≥ 2）变体，是一维（1D）局部整数自旋模型，其显著特点是尽管没有能隙，但缺乏对低能物理的共形场论（CFT）描述。“彩色”变体尤为不寻常，因为它们表现出对纠缠熵面积定律的幂律违背（在系统大小为n时为sqrtn ），而不是像在共形场论（CFT）中看到的对数违背。在本文中，我们通过分析发现了这些模型的若干独特性质，这可能表明其低能物理存在一个新的普适性类别。我们发现了自旋-自旋关联中复杂的对称性结构和出乎意料的标度行为，它们与已知的一维普适性类别有所不同。具体而言，s=1链表现出U(1)自发对称性破缺和铁磁有序。与此同时， s ≥ 2链似乎不会自发地破坏任何对称性，而是表现出具有幂律衰减相关性的准长程代数有序，这与标准的Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）临界指数不一致。我们还推导了无色链和有色链中纠缠测度的渐近标度表达式，其中包含显式加性常数，从而推广了Movassagh的先前结果[J. Math Phys.(2017)]，同时为潜在的量子模拟实验提供基准。sqrtn纠缠标度意味着对这些基态的任何矩阵积态描述都需要键维eΩ⁽sqrtⁿ⁾；标准一维张量网络工具包的这种超多项式成本，加上其基态性质的解析可解性，使Motzkin自旋链成为多体物理量子模拟的引人注目的试验平台。

articles.title: Simulating and Sampling from Quantum Circuits with 2D Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 使用二维张量网络模拟量子电路并从中采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.11424v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Classical simulations of quantum circuits play a vital role in the development of quantum computers and for taking the temperature of the field. Here, we classically simulate various physically-motivated circuits using 2D tensor network ansätze for the many-body wavefunction which match the geometry of the underlying quantum processor. We then employ a generalized version of the boundary Matrix Product State contraction algorithm to controllably generate samples from the resultant tensor network states. Our approach allows us to systematically converge both the quality of the final state and the samples drawn from it to the true distribution defined by the circuit, with GPU hardware providing us with significant speedups over CPU hardware. With these methods, we simulate the largest local unitary Jastrow ansatz circuit taken from recent IBM experiments to numerical precision. We also study a domain-wall quench in a two-dimensional discrete-time Heisenberg model on large heavy-hex and rotated square lattices, which reflect IBM's and Google's latest quantum processors respectively. We observe a rapid buildup of complex loop correlations on the Google Willow geometry which significantly impact the local properties of the system. Meanwhile, we find loop correlations build up extremely slowly on heavy-hex processors and have almost negligible impact on the local properties of the system, even at large circuit depths. Our results underscore the role the geometry of the quantum processor plays in classical simulability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路的经典模拟在量子计算机的开发以及了解该领域的发展情况方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们使用与底层量子处理器几何形状相匹配的多体波函数的二维张量网络波函数试探，对各种基于物理的电路进行经典模拟。然后，我们采用广义的边界矩阵积态收缩算法，从所得的张量网络态中可控地生成样本。我们的方法使我们能够将最终态的质量和从中抽取的样本系统地收敛到由电路定义的真实分布，并且GPU硬件比CPU硬件为我们提供了显著的加速。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子电路的经典模拟在量子计算机的开发以及了解该领域的发展情况方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们使用与底层量子处理器几何形状相匹配的多体波函数的二维张量网络波函数试探，对各种基于物理的电路进行经典模拟。然后，我们采用广义的边界矩阵积态收缩算法，从所得的张量网络态中可控地生成样本。我们的方法使我们能够将最终态的质量和从中抽取的样本系统地收敛到由电路定义的真实分布，并且GPU硬件比CPU硬件为我们提供了显著的加速。利用这些方法，我们以数值精度模拟了取自IBM近期实验的最大局部酉Jastrow ansatz电路。我们还研究了大型重六角格和旋转正方形格上的二维离散时间海森堡模型中的畴壁猝灭，它们分别反映了IBM和Google的最新量子处理器。我们观察到，在Google Willow几何结构上，复杂环路关联迅速累积，对系统的局部性质有显著影响。与此同时，我们发现，在重六边形处理器上，环路关联的积累非常缓慢，即使在较大的电路深度下，对系统的局部性质的影响也几乎可以忽略不计。我们的结果凸显了量子处理器的几何结构在经典可模拟性方面所起的作用。

articles.title: Projected evolution of quantum gates for circuit simulation with matrix product states
articles.title_zh: 使用矩阵积态进行电路仿真的量子门投影演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.10096v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tensor networks and specifically matrix product states (MPS) enable feasible classical quantum circuit simulation when entanglement remains compressible, but for this, gate updates must balance accuracy, representation size, and runtime. Conventional methods incorporate a complete gate into the MPS before compressing enlarged bonds. Here, we instead use lessons from the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) to analyze the projected action of each gate on the MPS by reducing it to a continuous generator path. We establish the spatial and state-space structure of this projected evolution and show that both the fixed-rank and two-site actions are confined to a contiguous window spanned by the gate while retaining boundary information from the surrounding MPS. Within this window characterization, we delineate when the instantaneous two-site action is exact and when variational directions can block it completely. Using standard nearest-point-projection geometry, we also show that fixed-rank TDVP and the local nearest fixed-rank projection of the exact gate endpoint agree to first order. We implement the gate-window restriction with rank-adaptive two-site TDVP and test both the projected update and a hybrid method that reserves it for long-range gates. Across the circuit benchmarks, these implementations incur runtime overhead and show no consistent accuracy--cost advantage over the tested baseline methods. The resulting framework provides a gate-specific structural analysis and a tested implementation together with explicit limits on its practical performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 当纠缠仍可压缩时，张量网络，特别是矩阵积态（MPS），可以实现可行的经典量子电路模拟，但为此，门更新必须在精度、表示大小和运行时间之间取得平衡。传统方法在压缩扩大的键之前，将一个完整的门纳入MPS。在这里，我们转而利用时间相关变分原理（TDVP）的经验，通过将其简化为连续的生成器路径来分析每个门对MPS的投影作用。我们建立了这种投影演化的空间和状态空间结构，并表明固定秩和双位点作用都局限于由门所跨越的连续窗口内，同时保留了来自周围MPS的边界信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当纠缠仍可压缩时，张量网络，特别是矩阵积态（MPS），可以实现可行的经典量子电路模拟，但为此，门更新必须在精度、表示大小和运行时间之间取得平衡。传统方法在压缩扩大的键之前，将一个完整的门纳入MPS。在这里，我们转而利用时间相关变分原理（TDVP）的经验，通过将其简化为连续的生成器路径来分析每个门对MPS的投影作用。我们建立了这种投影演化的空间和状态空间结构，并表明固定秩和双位点作用都局限于由门所跨越的连续窗口内，同时保留了来自周围MPS的边界信息。在这个窗口表征中，我们阐明了瞬时双点作用何时是精确的，以及变分方向何时可以完全阻止它。使用标准的最近点投影几何，我们还表明，固定秩TDVP和精确门端点的局部最近固定秩投影在一阶上是一致的。我们使用秩自适应的两点TDVP来实现门窗口限制，并测试了投影更新和一种将投影更新保留给长程门的混合方法。在所有电路基准测试中，这些实现都会产生运行时开销，并且与所测试的基线方法相比，在准确性-成本方面并不具备一致的优势。由此产生的框架提供了针对具体门电路的结构分析和经过测试的实现方案，并明确了其实际性能的限制。

articles.title: Spectrally Robust Photon-Pair Generation in Topological Waveguide Arrays
articles.title_zh: 拓扑波导阵列中光谱稳健的光子对产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.23796v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Harnessing topological effects offers a route to protect quantum states of light from imperfections, potentially enabling more robust platforms for quantum information processing. This capability is particularly relevant for active photonic circuits that generate quantum light directly on-chip. However, the impact of topology on the spectral properties of parametric processes, crucial for scalable quantum photonic circuits, remains largely unexplored. Here, we address this question by investigating photon-pair generation via spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in nonlinear waveguide arrays, combining experiment and theory. A systematic comparison of uniform, trivial, and topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) arrays reveals that only the topological configuration preserves a stable SPDC resonance spectrum under coupling disorder, with fluctuations in the resonance wavelength reduced by more than an order of magnitude. An analytical model captures the origin of this robustness in the band-structure properties of the interacting modes. Numerical analysis further shows that each SSH array can operate as a robust photon-pair source, enabling stable interference between multiple such sources and the generation of high-dimensional entangled states with high fidelity. These results establish nonlinear waveguide arrays as a promising platform for harnessing the interplay of topology and nonlinearity in quantum photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 利用拓扑效应提供了一种保护光量子态免受缺陷影响的途径，有可能为量子信息处理提供更强大的平台。此功能对于直接在芯片上生成量子光的有源光子电路尤其重要。然而，拓扑对参数化过程光谱特性的影响（对于可扩展的量子光子电路至关重要）在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们通过结合实验和理论研究非线性波导阵列中自发参数下转换（SPDC）产生的光子对来解决这个问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用拓扑效应提供了一种保护光量子态免受缺陷影响的途径，有可能为量子信息处理提供更强大的平台。此功能对于直接在芯片上生成量子光的有源光子电路尤其重要。然而，拓扑对参数化过程光谱特性的影响（对于可扩展的量子光子电路至关重要）在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们通过结合实验和理论研究非线性波导阵列中自发参数下转换（SPDC）产生的光子对来解决这个问题。对均匀、平凡和拓扑 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 阵列的系统比较表明，只有拓扑结构才能在耦合无序下保持稳定的 SPDC 谐振光谱，谐振波长的波动减少了一个数量级以上。分析模型捕捉了相互作用模式的能带结构特性中这种鲁棒性的根源。数值分析进一步表明，每个 SSH 阵列都可以作为强大的光子对源运行，从而实现多个此类源之间的稳定干涉，并生成高保真度的高维纠缠态。这些结果将非线性波导阵列确立为利用量子光子电路中拓扑和非线性相互作用的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Randomized Block Davidson Eigensolvers for Plane-Wave Density-Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: 平面波密度泛函理论的随机块戴维森特征求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Iterative diagonalization is the dominant cost of plane-wave density-functional theory (DFT), with search-space orthogonalization scaling particularly quickly with problem size and the number of target states. We present a randomized block Davidson-type eigensolver that replaces Euclidean orthogonalization with randomized Gram-Schmidt in a sketched inner product, requiring only a single pass over the basis while keeping its conditioning bounded independently of the input vectors. This modification changes only the Rayleigh-Ritz step, which becomes a definite generalized Hermitian eigenproblem. Ritz extraction remains exact, preserving true Ritz pairs and the interlacing property that makes each band energy an upper bound on the true one. The method is implemented in mixed precision for CPUs and GPUs from a single Julia code, interfaces matrix-free with DFTK, and is released in the open-source RandESC library. On sparse test problems with a fixed number of eigenpairs, the sketched solver overtakes its deterministic counterpart beyond matrix dimensions of about 2× 10⁴ and is 25% faster at 5× 10⁵. In full self-consistent field DFT calculations, the benefits of sketching depend on the application case. With standard pseudopotentials and plane-wave cutoffs, efficiency gains are limited. As the number of requested states grows with system size, orthogonalization savings are offset by the generalized eigenproblem. However, some highly accurate pseudopotentals require larger cutoffs, and in this regime, the randomized solver is measurably better by 6% overall. Its relative efficiency also improves as simulated systems get larger.
articles.abstract_zh: 迭代对角化是平面波密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的主要成本，搜索空间正交化缩放随着问题大小和目标状态的数量特别快。我们提出了一种随机块戴维森型特征求解器，它用草图内积中的随机 Gram-Schmidt 代替了欧几里德正交化，只需要对基础进行一次传递，同时保持其条件独立于输入向量。这种修改仅改变瑞利-里兹步骤，这成为一个确定的广义厄米特本征问题。里兹提取保持精确，保留了真正的里兹对和使每个能带能量成为真实能带能量上限的交错属性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 迭代对角化是平面波密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的主要成本，搜索空间正交化缩放随着问题大小和目标状态的数量特别快。我们提出了一种随机块戴维森型特征求解器，它用草图内积中的随机 Gram-Schmidt 代替了欧几里德正交化，只需要对基础进行一次传递，同时保持其条件独立于输入向量。这种修改仅改变瑞利-里兹步骤，这成为一个确定的广义厄米特本征问题。里兹提取保持精确，保留了真正的里兹对和使每个能带能量成为真实能带能量上限的交错属性。该方法通过单个 Julia 代码以混合精度针对 CPU 和 GPU 实现，与 DFTK 进行无矩阵接口，并在开源 RandESC 库中发布。在具有固定数量特征对的稀疏测试问题上，草图求解器在矩阵维度超过约 2× 10⁴ 时超越了其确定性对应求解器，并且在 5× 10⁵ 时速度提高了 25%。在完全自洽场 DFT 计算中，绘制草图的好处取决于应用案例。使用标准赝势和平面波截止，效率增益是有限的。随着请求状态的数量随着系统规模的增加而增加，正交化节省会被广义特征问题所抵消。然而，一些高度准确的赝势需要更大的截止值，在这种情况下，随机求解器总体上明显好于 6%。随着模拟系统变大，其相对效率也会提高。

articles.title: Euler Topological Metals in 1D
articles.title_zh: 一维欧拉拓扑金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27554v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We give a rigorous one-dimensional formulation of Kane's transport proposal for probing the Euler characteristic of a Fermi sea. For a clean, translation-invariant continuum Hamiltonian with real-analytic dispersion, a Fermi sea confined to a finite momentum range, and nonzero Fermi velocity at every Fermi point, we analyze a particular regularized transport response (obtained by tracing over the Fermi sea) and prove that its large-time limit equals the Euler characteristic. We derive an explicit finite-time formula, show that quantization requires the large-time limit, and obtain a convergence rate under additional nonstationarity assumptions. We also prove the lattice analog, where the commutator of the spatial switch with its time evolution is trace-class and a completely filled band contributes zero. Finite-volume calculations illustrate the prescribed order of the thermodynamic and large-time limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们给出了凯恩传输方案的严格一维公式，用于探测费米海的欧拉特性。对于具有实解析色散的干净、平移不变连续体哈密顿量、限制在有限动量范围内的费米海以及每个费米点处的非零费米速度，我们分析了特定的正则化输运响应（通过追踪费米海获得）并证明其大时间极限等于欧拉特性。我们推导了一个显式的有限时间公式，表明量化需要大的时间限制，并在额外的非平稳性假设下获得了收敛率。我们还证明了晶格模拟，其中空间开关的换向器及其时间演化是迹级的，并且完全填充的带贡献为零。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们给出了凯恩传输方案的严格一维公式，用于探测费米海的欧拉特性。对于具有实解析色散的干净、平移不变连续体哈密顿量、限制在有限动量范围内的费米海以及每个费米点处的非零费米速度，我们分析了特定的正则化输运响应（通过追踪费米海获得）并证明其大时间极限等于欧拉特性。我们推导了一个显式的有限时间公式，表明量化需要大的时间限制，并在额外的非平稳性假设下获得了收敛率。我们还证明了晶格模拟，其中空间开关的换向器及其时间演化是迹级的，并且完全填充的带贡献为零。有限体积计算说明了热力学和大时间极限的规定顺序。

articles.title: HAVAPlot: A Web-Based Scientific Visualization and Post-Processing Platform
articles.title_zh: HAVAPlot：基于网络的科学可视化和后处理平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents HAVAPlot, a browser-based framework for scientific visualization and post-processing of numerical simulation data. Operating entirely within the user's browser, HAVAPlot requires no software installation or data uploads while supporting mesh-based and tabular datasets beyond computational fluid dynamics. The framework directly reads native OpenFOAM cases, including polyhedral meshes, ASCII and binary fields, boundary data, and Lagrangian particles, as well as legacy and XML VTK files and tabular datasets. It provides line, contour, and three-dimensional plots; exact polyhedral slicing; boundary extraction; variable calculations; customizable color scales; symmetry mirroring; zoomed insets; streamlines; isosurfaces; particle visualization; and vector PDF/EPS and data export. The underlying numerical algorithms are independently verified. Cell centers and volumes agree with an independent implementation of OpenFOAM's geometric algorithm, while 6.1 million field values across four two-dimensional, axisymmetric, and three-dimensional production cases are reproduced to machine precision. For analytical fields on distorted hexahedral meshes, cell-to-point interpolation exhibits second-order convergence in the interior and first-order convergence at boundaries. Meshes containing 250,000 cells load in at most 1.3 seconds. Applications to an impinging supersonic jet, hypersonic cylinder flow, a hybrid particle-continuum cold-spray nozzle, a three-dimensional gas-bearing film, and supersonic cone flow demonstrate the framework's capabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 HAVAPlot，这是一个基于浏览器的框架，用于数值模拟数据的科学可视化和后处理。 HAVAPlot 完全在用户浏览器中运行，无需安装软件或上传数据，同时支持计算流体动力学之外的基于网格和表格的数据集。该框架直接读取原生 OpenFOAM 案例，包括多面体网格、ASCII 和二进制字段、边界数据和拉格朗日粒子，以及遗留和 XML VTK 文件和表格数据集。它提供线图、等高线图和三维图；精确的多面体切片；边界提取；变量计算；可定制的色标；对称镜像；放大的插图；精简；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文介绍了 HAVAPlot，这是一个基于浏览器的框架，用于数值模拟数据的科学可视化和后处理。 HAVAPlot 完全在用户浏览器中运行，无需安装软件或上传数据，同时支持计算流体动力学之外的基于网格和表格的数据集。该框架直接读取原生 OpenFOAM 案例，包括多面体网格、ASCII 和二进制字段、边界数据和拉格朗日粒子，以及遗留和 XML VTK 文件和表格数据集。它提供线图、等高线图和三维图；精确的多面体切片；边界提取；变量计算；可定制的色标；对称镜像；放大的插图；精简；等值面；粒子可视化；以及矢量 PDF/EPS 和数据导出。底层数值算法经过独立验证。单元中心和体积与 OpenFOAM 几何算法的独立实现一致，同时将四个二维、轴对称和三维生产案例中的 610 万个场值复制到机器精度。对于扭曲六面体网格上的解析场，单元到点插值在内部表现出二阶收敛，在边界表现出一阶收敛。包含 250,000 个单元的网格加载最多 1.3 秒。碰撞超音速射流、高超音速圆柱流、混合粒子连续冷喷雾喷嘴、三维气体轴承膜和超音速锥流的应用证明了该框架的功能。

articles.title: A Heterogeneous CPU-GPU Framework for Finite Element Micromagnetic Simulations on Tetrahedral Meshes
articles.title_zh: 四面体网格有限元微磁仿真的异构 CPU-GPU 框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The design of magnetic storage materials relies on repeated micromagnetic simulations. Within each simulation, the demagnetization field evaluation and the sparse linear solve are executed at every time step and together dominate the computational cost. To address these bottlenecks, we develop a heterogeneous CPU-GPU framework that exploits the complementary computational capabilities of the two processors. In the existing AFEMAG solver, developed by Yang et al [J. Comput. Phys. 431 (2021) 110142], computationally intensive boundary integral evaluations and sparse linear solves limit performance. We offload these operations to the GPU while retaining assembly and iteration control on the CPU. We validate the framework using cases from all five μMag standard problems, covering quasistatic hysteresis, equilibrium configurations, field-driven dynamics, and spin-transfer-torque dynamics. This approach accelerates simulations across the benchmark suite; notably, for Standard Problem 3 on a mesh of 137,313 nodes, augmenting the CPU with one NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a 17.1× speedup over the CPU-only configuration. The heterogeneous AFEMAG framework thus provides an efficient and practical platform for micromagnetic simulations in the design of magnetic storage materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁存储材料的设计依赖于重复的微磁模拟。在每次模拟中，退磁场评估和稀疏线性求解在每个时间步执行，并且共同主导计算成本。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们开发了一个异构 CPU-GPU 框架，利用两个处理器的互补计算能力。 In the existing AFEMAG solver, developed by Yang et al [J.计算。物理。 431 (2021) 110142]，计算密集型边界积分评估和稀疏线性求解限制了性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁存储材料的设计依赖于重复的微磁模拟。在每次模拟中，退磁场评估和稀疏线性求解在每个时间步执行，并且共同主导计算成本。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们开发了一个异构 CPU-GPU 框架，利用两个处理器的互补计算能力。 In the existing AFEMAG solver, developed by Yang et al [J.计算。物理。 431 (2021) 110142]，计算密集型边界积分评估和稀疏线性求解限制了性能。我们将这些操作卸载到 GPU，同时保留 CPU 上的组装和迭代控制。我们使用所有五个 μMag 标准问题的案例验证了该框架，涵盖准静态磁滞、平衡配置、场驱动动力学和自旋转移扭矩动力学。这种方法加速了整个基准套件的模拟；值得注意的是，对于 137,313 个节点的网格上的标准问题 3，使用一个 NVIDIA A100 GPU 增强 CPU 比仅使用 CPU 的配置可实现 17.1 倍的加速。因此，异构 AFEMAG 框架为磁存储材料设计中的微磁模拟提供了一个高效实用的平台。

articles.title: Energy transfers in decaying three-dimensional Hall-magnetohydrodynamics turbulence: Dependence on the Ion-Inertial Length and the Magnetic Prandtl Number
articles.title_zh: 衰减三维霍尔磁流体动力学湍流中的能量转移：对离子惯性长度和磁普朗特数的依赖
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of energy transfers in three-dimensional (3D) decaying Hall-magnetohydrodynamics (HMHD) turbulence. Our study has been designed to investigate the dependence of these transfers on initial energy spectra, the ion-inertial length dᵢ, and the magnetic Prandtl number Prₘ. Using shell-to-shell decomposition, we compute the energy transfer rates for (a) kinetic-to-kinetic, (b) magnetic-to-magnetic, (c) kinetic-to-magnetic, and (d) magnetic-to-kinetic interactions by carrying out extensive pseudospectral direct numerical simulations (DNSs) of 3D HMHD and its MHD counterpart. Furthermore, we examine the magnetic-to-magnetic and current-density-to-magnetic energy transfers arising from the Hall term in this framework. Energy transfers between like fields -- namely, kinetic-to-kinetic and magnetic-to-magnetic -- are predominantly local and forward in direction, cascading energy from large to small length scales. This behavior is consistent with a self-similar flow structure in the inertial range. Cross-field transfers, between kinetic and magnetic energy, are found to be forward but non-local in character. At low and high Prₘ, the transfers become local, and the nonlinear energy transfer is significantly suppressed. Moreover, we observe that the Hall term drives both inverse and forward transfers of magnetic energy, associated with local and non-local transfer, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对三维（3D）衰减霍尔磁流体动力学（HMHD）湍流中的能量转移进行了系统研究。我们的研究旨在研究这些转移对初始能谱、离子惯性长度 dᵢ 和磁普朗特数 Prₘ 的依赖性。使用壳到壳分解，我们通过对 3D HMHD 及其 MHD 对应物进行广泛的伪谱直接数值模拟 (DNS)，计算 (a) 动到动、(b) 磁到磁、(c) 动到磁和 (d) 磁到动相互作用的能量传递速率。此外，我们还研究了该框架中霍尔项引起的磁到磁和电流密度到磁的能量转移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对三维（3D）衰减霍尔磁流体动力学（HMHD）湍流中的能量转移进行了系统研究。我们的研究旨在研究这些转移对初始能谱、离子惯性长度 dᵢ 和磁普朗特数 Prₘ 的依赖性。使用壳到壳分解，我们通过对 3D HMHD 及其 MHD 对应物进行广泛的伪谱直接数值模拟 (DNS)，计算 (a) 动到动、(b) 磁到磁、(c) 动到磁和 (d) 磁到动相互作用的能量传递速率。此外，我们还研究了该框架中霍尔项引起的磁到磁和电流密度到磁的能量转移。类似场之间的能量转移（即动能到动能和磁力到磁力）主要是局部的和向前的方向，将能量从大到小长度尺度级联。这种行为与惯性范围内的自相似流动结构一致。人们发现动能和磁能之间的跨场传递是向前的，但具有非局域性。在低和高 Prₘ 下，传输变成局部的，并且非线性能量传输被显着抑制。此外，我们观察到霍尔项驱动磁能的反向和正向传输，分别与局部和非局部传输相关。

articles.title: Sign-Controlled BIC Merging and Flatband Formation in C2-symmetric Photonic Lattices
articles.title_zh: C2 对称光子晶格中符号控制的 BIC 合并和平带形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) on flatbands promise long-lived, weakly dispersive photons, yet their interplay remains elusive. Here, we develop a four-mode non-Hermitian Hamiltonian for C₂-symmetric photonic-crystal slabs. We show that the sign of the interpair coupling determines whether two Friedrich-Wintgen (FW) BICs and a symmetry-protected (SP) BIC occupy the same photonic band, a necessary condition for merging. In rectangular lattices, merging eliminates the quadratic radiative-loss term in a perfect-square form and strongly suppresses the quartic contribution, giving an effective Q sim k⁻⁶ scaling. Deviations from rectangular geometry induce noncollinear radiation polarizations, converting FW-BICs into quasi-BICs with QqBIC sim (90^circ-θ)⁻² and restoring the asymptotic Q sim k⁻² scaling. Unlike BIC band selection, quadratic band flattening is insensitive to the coupling sign and can occur without BIC merging, even in oblique lattices. Our results reveal distinct conditions governing BIC merging, higher-order radiation suppression, and band flattening.
articles.abstract_zh: 平带上的连续体束缚态（BIC）有望实现长寿命、弱色散的光子，但它们的相互作用仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们开发了一种用于 C2 对称光子晶体板的四模非厄米哈密顿量。我们证明，对间耦合的符号决定了两个 Friedrich-Wintgen (FW) BIC 和一个对称保护 (SP) BIC 是否占据相同的光子带，这是合并的必要条件。在矩形晶格中，合并消除了完美正方形形式的二次辐射损耗项，并强烈抑制了四次贡献，从而给出了有效的 Q sim k⁻⁶ 缩放。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平带上的连续体束缚态（BIC）有望实现长寿命、弱色散的光子，但它们的相互作用仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们开发了一种用于 C2 对称光子晶体板的四模非厄米哈密顿量。我们证明，对间耦合的符号决定了两个 Friedrich-Wintgen (FW) BIC 和一个对称保护 (SP) BIC 是否占据相同的光子带，这是合并的必要条件。在矩形晶格中，合并消除了完美正方形形式的二次辐射损耗项，并强烈抑制了四次贡献，从而给出了有效的 Q sim k⁻⁶ 缩放。与矩形几何形状的偏差会引起非共线辐射偏振，使用 QqBIC sim (90^circ-θ)⁻² 将 FW-BIC 转换为准 BIC，并恢复渐近 Q sim k⁻² 缩放。与 BIC 能带选择不同，二次能带平坦化对耦合符号不敏感，并且无需 BIC 合并即可发生，即使在倾斜晶格中也是如此。我们的结果揭示了控制 BIC 合并、高阶辐射抑制和能带平坦化的不同条件。

articles.title: Resonant filling for long-pulse operation of EuXFEL using iterative learning based feed forward
articles.title_zh: 使用基于迭代学习的前馈对 EuXFEL 的长脉冲操作进行谐振填充
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A future operation scenario of the European XFEL (EuXFEL) is long-pulse (LP) mode, where the 800 superconducting radio frequency (SRF) cavities of the linac are energized with RF pulse lengths of up to 500ms. Compared to the current, short-pulse (SP) mode with less than 2ms, the dominant mechanical eigenmodes of the cavities at a few hundred Hertz pose a significant control challenge, as the RF pulse extends beyond a multiple of their periods. To improve energy efficiency of LP operation, cavities are operated at bandwidths in the range of tens of Hertz, a factor of 10 narrower than in SP. Due to peak power limitation of the proposed high power amplifiers, even the fill time surpasses mechanical mode periods. This paper presents experimental evaluation of two feed forward adaptation approaches to facilitate resonant-filling despite mechanical mode transients: In a single-cavity regulation setup, the RF drive phase is adjusted to match the Lorentz force detuning induced cavity phase shift. In vector-sum RF regulation systems, the incident phase cannot be adjusted to each cavity individually, so the concept is inverted by adapting mechanical cavity tuner drives to match each individual cavity resonance trajectory with a fixed common RF drive phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 欧洲 XFEL (EuXFEL) 未来的运行场景是长脉冲 (LP) 模式，其中直线加速器的 800 个超导射频 (SRF) 腔由高达 500ms 的射频脉冲长度供电。与当前小于 2ms 的短脉冲 (SP) 模式相比，几百赫兹下腔体的主要机械本征模式构成了重大的控制挑战，因为射频脉冲超出了其周期的倍数。为了提高 LP 操作的能源效率，腔体在数十赫兹范围内的带宽下操作，比 SP 窄 10 倍。由于所提出的高功率放大器的峰值功率限制，甚至填充时间也超过了机械模式周期。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 欧洲 XFEL (EuXFEL) 未来的运行场景是长脉冲 (LP) 模式，其中直线加速器的 800 个超导射频 (SRF) 腔由高达 500ms 的射频脉冲长度供电。与当前小于 2ms 的短脉冲 (SP) 模式相比，几百赫兹下腔体的主要机械本征模式构成了重大的控制挑战，因为射频脉冲超出了其周期的倍数。为了提高 LP 操作的能源效率，腔体在数十赫兹范围内的带宽下操作，比 SP 窄 10 倍。由于所提出的高功率放大器的峰值功率限制，甚至填充时间也超过了机械模式周期。本文提出了两种前馈自适应方法的实验评估，以促进谐振填充，尽管存在机械模式瞬变：在单腔调节设置中，调整射频驱动相位以匹配洛伦兹力失谐引起的腔相移。在矢量和射频调节系统中，无法单独调整每个腔的入射相位，因此通过采用机械腔调谐器驱动器将每个单独的腔谐振轨迹与固定的公共射频驱动相位相匹配来反转这一概念。

articles.title: Triplet adiabatic potential energy surfaces for the O(³P) + C₂(X¹Σ_g⁺, a³Πᵤ) reaction and quasiclassical trajectory dynamics
articles.title_zh: O(3P) + C2(X1Σ_g⁺, a3Πᵤ) 反应的三重态绝热势能面和准经典轨迹动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present three global adiabatic potential energy surfaces (PESs) for the O(³P) + C₂(X ¹Σ_g⁺, a ³Πᵤ) to CO(X¹Σ⁺) + C(³P) reaction, computed at the icMRCI+Q/aug-cc-pVTZ level. This reaction is relevant to combustion chemistry, atmospheric processes, and astrochemistry. Since the energy difference between the ¹Σ_g⁺ and ³Πᵤ states of C₂ is smaller than the zero-point energy, both states mix upon interaction with the approaching O atom. Consequently, the PESs exhibit a double-well topography in the reactant valley. Beyond this feature, the three PESs display markedly different topographies. The 1 ³A'' PES features a deep minimum 7.16 eV below the O + C₂ entrance channel. In contrast, the 2 ³A'' and 1 ³A' surfaces possess shallower collinear wells (approx 5.7 eV) and strong angular anisotropy arising from avoided crossings with higher-lying triplet states. The analytical fits reproduce the ab initio data with root-mean-square (RMS) deviations of 0.022--0.028 eV over an energy interval exceeding 13 eV. Quasiclassical trajectory (QCT) calculations reveal higher reactivity on the barrierless 1,³A'' surface compared to the 2,³A'' PES, where an angle-dependent entrance barrier reduces the cross sections. Furthermore, cross sections for reactions initiated from C₂(X ¹Σ_g⁺) and C₂(a ³Πᵤ) are remarkably similar for the three PESs, regardless of the initial rovibrational state.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 O(3P) + C2(X 1Σ_g⁺, a 3Πᵤ) 到 CO(X1Σ⁺) + C(3P) 反应的三个全局绝热势能面 (PES)，在 icMRCI+Q/aug-cc-pVTZ 水平上计算。该反应与燃烧化学、大气过程和天体化学有关。由于 C2 的 1Σ_g⁺ 和 3Πᵤ 态之间的能量差小于零点能量，因此两种态在与接近的 O 原子相互作用时混合。因此，PES 在反应物谷中呈现出双井形貌。除了这一特征之外，三个 PES 还显示出明显不同的地形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了 O(3P) + C2(X 1Σ_g⁺, a 3Πᵤ) 到 CO(X1Σ⁺) + C(3P) 反应的三个全局绝热势能面 (PES)，在 icMRCI+Q/aug-cc-pVTZ 水平上计算。该反应与燃烧化学、大气过程和天体化学有关。由于 C2 的 1Σ_g⁺ 和 3Πᵤ 态之间的能量差小于零点能量，因此两种态在与接近的 O 原子相互作用时混合。因此，PES 在反应物谷中呈现出双井形貌。除了这一特征之外，三个 PES 还显示出明显不同的地形。 1 ³A'' PES 具有低于 O + C2 入口通道的最低深度 7.16 eV。相比之下，2“A”和1“A”表面具有较浅的共线阱（约5.7eV）和由于避免与较高位置的三重态交叉而产生的强角度各向异性。分析拟合再现了从头算数据，能量区间超过 13 eV，均方根 (RMS) 偏差为 0.022--0.028 eV。准经典轨迹 (QCT) 计算表明，与 2,3A'' PES 相比，无屏障 1,3A'' 表面的反应性更高，其中角度相关的入口势垒减少了横截面。此外，对于三种 PES，无论初始振动状态如何，由 C2(X 1Σ_g⁺) 和 C2(a 3Πᵤ) 引发的反应横截面都非常相似。

articles.title: Hybrid Plasmon-Phonon Eigenmodes and Vortex States in a Graphene Ring on a Silica Substrate
articles.title_zh: 二氧化硅基底上石墨烯环中的混合等离子体激元-声子本征模和涡旋态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate hybrid plasmon-phonon eigenmodes and localized electromagnetic vortex states in a graphene ring supported by a dispersive silica substrate. The interaction between graphene plasmons and infrared-active optical phonons of the substrate gives rise to distinct spectral branches of surface polaritons, whose dispersion characteristics are established analytically and validated by full-wave numerical simulations. Geometric confinement of these hybrid surface excitations produces spectrally separated families of localized multipolar eigenmodes with corresponding azimuthal symmetries. Particular attention is devoted to quadrupolar eigenstates, which exhibit nearly identical normalized spatial field distributions despite their substantial spectral separation and different attenuation characteristics. We demonstrate that coherent superposition of orthogonal quadrupolar field patterns gives rise to localized vortex states with opposite azimuthal phase winding. The preservation of the spatial eigenmode structure across distinct spectral branches is consistent with a quasistatic description in which the resonator geometry governs the modal symmetry, whereas the dispersive material response determines the spectral properties. These findings reveal a route toward controlling structured electromagnetic near fields through plasmon--phonon hybridization and establish a physical basis for multiband vortex states in deeply subwavelength graphene resonators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了分散二氧化硅基底支撑的石墨烯环中的混合等离子体-声子本征模式和局域电磁涡旋态。石墨烯等离子体激元和基底的红外活性光学声子之间的相互作用产生了表面极化子的不同光谱分支，其色散特性通过全波数值模拟进行分析和验证。这些混合表面激发的几何限制产生了具有相应方位角对称性的局部多极本征模式的光谱分离族。特别关注四极本征态，尽管它们具有很大的光谱分离和不同的衰减特性，但它们表现出几乎相同的归一化空间场分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了分散二氧化硅基底支撑的石墨烯环中的混合等离子体-声子本征模式和局域电磁涡旋态。石墨烯等离子体激元和基底的红外活性光学声子之间的相互作用产生了表面极化子的不同光谱分支，其色散特性通过全波数值模拟进行分析和验证。这些混合表面激发的几何限制产生了具有相应方位角对称性的局部多极本征模式的光谱分离族。特别关注四极本征态，尽管它们具有很大的光谱分离和不同的衰减特性，但它们表现出几乎相同的归一化空间场分布。我们证明，正交四极场模式的相干叠加会产生具有相反方位角相位缠绕的局部涡旋态。跨不同光谱分支的空间本征模结构的保留与准静态描述一致，其中谐振器几何形状控制模态对称性，而色散材料响应决定光谱特性。这些发现揭示了通过等离子体-声子杂化控制结构化电磁近场的途径，并为深亚波长石墨烯谐振器中的多频带涡旋态奠定了物理基础。

articles.title: Hydrodynamic modeling of liquid metal field emitter deformation under combined RF and DC magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 射频和直流磁场组合下液态金属场发射体变形的流体动力学建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) breakdowns, also known as vacuum (or electrical) arcs and breakdowns, or electrical discharges, have been studied for over decades, but the mechanisms of the RF breakdown are still questionable. This phenomenon reduces the stability of the beam, damages the RF cavities, and thus limits the achievable accelerating field in the particle accelerator. In the case of Muon Collider, the RF cavities have to withstand an electric field of the order of multi tens of MV/m and a DC magnetic field of a few tens of teslas, with a minimum rate of RF breakdown. Different models have been proposed, and some important factors that could lead to the RF breakdown have been identified, such as the field emission current, irregularity of the surface , presence of hot particles on the surface and the role of the DC magnetic field. In this paper, we give insights to the mechanism of RF breakdowns using a hydrodynamic and a magnetohydrodynamic approach, focusing on understanding the forces that deform the liquid copper emitter. We found that if the local RF electric field is sufficiently high, it could provoke the emission of hot copper droplets into the cavity. Our simulations use the computational fluid dynamics module, the magnetic and electric field module, and the level set method in the COMSOL software to simulate the behavior of a copper liquid emitter with the Navier-Stokes equation under the influence of the pressure radiation, and the surface tension force.
articles.abstract_zh: 射频 (RF) 击穿，也称为真空（或电）电弧和击穿或放电，已经研究了数十年，但射频击穿的机制仍然存在疑问。这种现象降低了光束的稳定性，损坏了射频腔，从而限制了粒子加速器中可实现的加速场。对于μ介子对撞机，射频腔必须承受几十MV/m量级的电场和几十特斯拉的直流磁场，并且射频击穿率最低。人们提出了不同的模型，并确定了一些可能导致射频击穿的重要因素，例如场发射电流、表面的不规则性、表面上热颗粒的存在以及直流磁场的作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 射频 (RF) 击穿，也称为真空（或电）电弧和击穿或放电，已经研究了数十年，但射频击穿的机制仍然存在疑问。这种现象降低了光束的稳定性，损坏了射频腔，从而限制了粒子加速器中可实现的加速场。对于μ介子对撞机，射频腔必须承受几十MV/m量级的电场和几十特斯拉的直流磁场，并且射频击穿率最低。人们提出了不同的模型，并确定了一些可能导致射频击穿的重要因素，例如场发射电流、表面的不规则性、表面上热颗粒的存在以及直流磁场的作用。在本文中，我们使用流体动力学和磁流体动力学方法深入了解射频击穿的机制，重点是了解使液态铜发射器变形的力。我们发现，如果局部射频电场足够高，可能会引起热铜滴发射到腔中。我们的模拟使用 COMSOL 软件中的计算流体动力学模块、磁场和电场模块以及水平集方法，通过纳维-斯托克斯方程来模拟铜液体发射器在压力辐射和表面张力影响下的行为。

articles.title: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
articles.title_zh: 从功率到光谱：现成的光电二极管仅通过其偏置就变成了光谱仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. Applied to an unmodified InGaAs PIN photodiode at room temperature, a 10 us waveform decoded by a neural network reconstructs spectra of one to three laser lines across the 80 nm of the telecom C+L band, locating the lines to 0.3-0.4 nm, counting them in about 99% of measurements and identifying their power levels, with line shifts tracked to tens of picometres. Because OED relies on universal semiconductor transport physics, the approach is material-agnostic and applies in principle to any off-the-shelf photodiode, turning detectors already deployed as power monitors into low-cost spectral sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算光谱仪用光谱响应可以变化的探测器取代色散光学，但每个报道的单探测器设备都通过专用制造获得这种响应：二维异质结构、分级外延结、有机堆栈、滤波器或光子电路。我们展示了一种通用的、免制造的替代方案，其中标准商用光电二极管仅通过其电力驱动即可成为光谱仪，无需修改设备，无需滤光片，也无需对光进行调制。其机制是偏置调制光电色散（OED）：不同波长的光在不同深度被吸收，正弦偏置改变了每个深度产生的载流子的收集方式，以便每个光谱在一个偏置周期内被编码为光电流波形的形状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算光谱仪用光谱响应可以变化的探测器取代色散光学，但每个报道的单探测器设备都通过专用制造获得这种响应：二维异质结构、分级外延结、有机堆栈、滤波器或光子电路。我们展示了一种通用的、免制造的替代方案，其中标准商用光电二极管仅通过其电力驱动即可成为光谱仪，无需修改设备，无需滤光片，也无需对光进行调制。其机制是偏置调制光电色散（OED）：不同波长的光在不同深度被吸收，正弦偏置改变了每个深度产生的载流子的收集方式，以便每个光谱在一个偏置周期内被编码为光电流波形的形状。应用于室温下未修改的 InGaAs PIN 光电二极管时，由神经网络解码的 10 us 波形可重建电信 C+L 波段 80 nm 上的一到三个激光线的光谱，将线定位到 0.3-0.4 nm，在大约 99% 的测量中对它们进行计数并识别其功率水平，线位移跟踪到数十皮米。由于 OED 依赖于通用半导体传输物理学，因此该方法与材料无关，并且原则上适用于任何现成的光电二极管，从而将已部署为功率监视器的探测器转变为低成本光谱传感器。

articles.title: Future avenues for precision oscillation measurements with compact movable reactors
articles.title_zh: 使用紧凑型可移动反应器进行精确振荡测量的未来途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26418v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: No planned neutrino experiment is expected to surpass Daya Bay's precision on thone. Doing so requires innovative strategies to reduce statistical and systematic uncertainties. In this study, we consider a futuristic program with a movable reactor antineutrino source placed within short distances (Llesssim 3,km) from the Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory (JUNO) detector. Due to the large fiducial mass of JUNO, even a relatively small reactor can produce a statistically significant number of events over a few years to probe the lesssim 8.7% ,nuebar disappearance set by thone. We consider two possibilities: a O(20mwth) microreactor in alcoves of the access tunnel to the underground laboratory, and a O(400 mwth) unit on the surface. In both cases the reactor is observed by a small flux monitor detector near the source, while JUNO measures the antineutrino flux at two baselines, suppressing correlated flux and detector systematics. Using the measured Daya Bay per-isotope spectra and its covariance, we model a high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) core for the microreactor and a low-enriched uranium (LEU) core for the surface unit, and discuss various potential sources of systematic uncertainties and their impact on the precision of thone. The underground microreactor could improve on JUNO's reach by a factor of three to four, to relsth simeq 4% over a decade, while the surface reactor would reach the present global-fit precision, relsth=2.5%, in about three years, provided the emission rate is monitored across reactor relocations to the sub-percent level.
articles.abstract_zh: 预计任何计划中的中微子实验都不会超过大亚湾的中微子实验精度。这样做需要创新策略来减少统计和系统的不确定性。在这项研究中，我们考虑了一个未来计划，其中一个可移动反应堆反中微子源放置在距离江门地下中微子观测站（JUNO）探测器很短的距离（Llesssim 3公里）内。由于 JUNO 的基准质量很大，即使是相对较小的反应堆也可以在几年内产生统计上显着数量的事件，以探测由 thone 设定的 lesssim 8.7% 的核粒子消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预计任何计划中的中微子实验都不会超过大亚湾的中微子实验精度。这样做需要创新策略来减少统计和系统的不确定性。在这项研究中，我们考虑了一个未来计划，其中一个可移动反应堆反中微子源放置在距离江门地下中微子观测站（JUNO）探测器很短的距离（Llesssim 3公里）内。由于 JUNO 的基准质量很大，即使是相对较小的反应堆也可以在几年内产生统计上显着数量的事件，以探测由 thone 设定的 lesssim 8.7% 的核粒子消失。我们考虑两种可能性：在通往地下实验室的通道的凹室中放置一个 O(20mwth) 微反应器，以及在地面上放置一个 O(400 mwth) 单元。在这两种情况下，反应堆都是通过源附近的小型通量监测探测器来观察的，而JUNO则测量两个基线处的反中微子通量，抑制相关的通量和探测器系统。利用测量的大亚湾同位素光谱及其协方差，我们对微反应器的高含量低浓铀（HALEU）核心和表面单元的低浓铀（LEU）核心进行了建模，并讨论了系统不确定性的各种潜在来源及其对thone精度的影响。地下微反应堆可以在十年内将 JUNO 的覆盖范围提高三到四倍，达到 relsth simeq 4%，而地面反应堆将在大约三年内达到目前的全局拟合精度，relsth=2.5%，只要将反应堆搬迁过程中的排放率监测到低于百分之一的水平。

articles.title: A time-domain adversarial example demonstrating the failure of H¹ elements in a-φ electromagnetic simulation
articles.title_zh: 时域对抗示例展示了 a-φ 电磁仿真中 H1 元素的失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26546v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frequently, H¹ continuous finite elements are used in computational electromagnetics despite it being widely known that such an interpolation is not guaranteed to furnish reliable approximations of solutions to general initial/boundary value problems. It is mathematically more natural to use H(Curl) elements (edge elements) than H¹ elements, since the former form part of a discrete complex that respects the differential-geometric structure of Maxwell's equations while the latter do not. However, most work discussing the failure of H¹ elements for electromagnetics is esoteric and concrete examples demonstrating the clear advantage of edge elements are generally restricted to quasi-static, frequency-domain, or eigenvalue problems. In this work, we summarize essential facts regarding H¹ and H(Curl) elements and present a physically feasible yet intentionally adversarial time-domain eddy-current example demonstrating the failure of gauge-penalized H¹ elements in an a-φ formulation compared to gauge-free mixed scalar/edge H¹/H(Curl) elements. The results indicate that edge elements can be used to furnish reasonable results for general loading conditions, whereas penalized H¹ elements fail (e.g., converge to an incorrect state) even with mesh refinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管众所周知，这种插值不能保证为一般初始/边界值问题提供可靠的近似解，但计算电磁学中经常使用 H1 连续有限元。从数学上来说，使用 H(Curl) 元素（边缘元素）比使用 H¹ 元素更自然，因为前者构成离散复形的一部分，该复形尊重麦克斯韦方程组的微分几何结构，而后者则不然。然而，大多数讨论 H1 元件在电磁学中失效的工作都是深奥的，而证明边缘元件明显优势的具体例子通常仅限于准静态、频域或特征值问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管众所周知，这种插值不能保证为一般初始/边界值问题提供可靠的近似解，但计算电磁学中经常使用 H1 连续有限元。从数学上来说，使用 H(Curl) 元素（边缘元素）比使用 H¹ 元素更自然，因为前者构成离散复形的一部分，该复形尊重麦克斯韦方程组的微分几何结构，而后者则不然。然而，大多数讨论 H1 元件在电磁学中失效的工作都是深奥的，而证明边缘元件明显优势的具体例子通常仅限于准静态、频域或特征值问题。在这项工作中，我们总结了有关 H1 和 H(Curl) 元素的基本事实，并提出了一个物理上可行但有意对抗的时域涡流示例，证明与无规范混合标量/边缘 H1/H(Curl) 元素相比，a-φ 公式中规范惩罚 H1 元素的失败。结果表明，边缘单元可用于为一般载荷条件提供合理的结果，而惩罚 H1 单元即使在网格细化的情况下也会失败（例如，收敛到不正确的状态）。

articles.title: Nonlinearly Causal General-Relativistic Superfluid Hydrodynamics: Simulating Vortex Dynamics in Neutron-Star Interiors
articles.title_zh: 非线性因果广义相对论超流体流体动力学：模拟中子星内部的涡动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26547v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neutron stars provide a natural laboratory for superfluid matter under extreme conditions. Its nonlinear dynamics is central to pulsar glitches, their possible links to fast radio bursts, and tidal interactions in inspiralling binaries. We develop a general-relativistic superfluid hydrodynamics framework incorporating entrainment, vortex forces, and line energy, and derive, for the first time, necessary and sufficient conditions for nonlinear causality and strong hyperbolicity. We also show that commonly used dissipative, force-balanced formulations without line tension are generically ill-posed at short wavelengths because of the Donnelly-Glaberson instability. Exploiting the analogy between vortex arrays with tension and force-free electrodynamics, we recast vortex dynamics in terms of effective electric and magnetic fields and drift velocities. This motivates a new finite-volume scheme combining constrained transport of superfluid vorticity with implicit electric-field evolution, enabling stable numerical evolution of the full system. We validate the scheme using an exact solution to the relativistic superfluid Riemann problem and Kelvin-wave dispersion relations, among other tests. Finally, we simulate dynamical, global general-relativistic two-fluid neutron-star equilibria, validate their oscillation modes, and present the first simplified calculation of superfluid interior spin-down with prescribed vortex release and repinning. The resulting stationary state retains both a net twist in the vortex array and residual differential rotation of the superfluid. Our framework thus enables nonlinear numerical studies of general-relativistic superfluid dynamics in neutron-star interiors.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子星为极端条件下的超流体物质提供了一个天然实验室。它的非线性动力学是脉冲星故障的核心，脉冲星故障可能与快速射电爆发以及吸气双星中的潮汐相互作用有关。我们开发了一个包含夹带、涡力和线能的广义相对论超流体流体动力学框架，并首次推导了非线性因果关系和强双曲性的充分必要条件。我们还表明，由于唐纳利-格拉伯森不稳定性，常用的无线张力的耗散、力平衡公式在短波长下通常不适定。利用涡流阵列与张力和无力电动力学之间的类比，我们根据有效电场、磁场和漂移速度重新构建涡流动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中子星为极端条件下的超流体物质提供了一个天然实验室。它的非线性动力学是脉冲星故障的核心，脉冲星故障可能与快速射电爆发以及吸气双星中的潮汐相互作用有关。我们开发了一个包含夹带、涡力和线能的广义相对论超流体流体动力学框架，并首次推导了非线性因果关系和强双曲性的充分必要条件。我们还表明，由于唐纳利-格拉伯森不稳定性，常用的无线张力的耗散、力平衡公式在短波长下通常不适定。利用涡流阵列与张力和无力电动力学之间的类比，我们根据有效电场、磁场和漂移速度重新构建涡流动力学。这激发了一种新的有限体积方案，将超流体涡量的约束传输与隐式电场演化相结合，从而实现整个系统的稳定数值演化。我们使用相对论超流体黎曼问题的精确解和开尔文波色散关系等测试来验证该方案。最后，我们模拟了动力学、全局广义相对论双流体中子星平衡，验证了它们的振荡模式，并提出了第一个具有规定涡旋释放和重新固定的超流体内部自旋下降的简化计算。由此产生的静止状态保留了涡流阵列中的净扭曲和超流体的残余微分旋转。因此，我们的框架能够对中子星内部的广义相对论超流体动力学进行非线性数值研究。

articles.title: Doubly resonant nonlinear metasurfaces enabling NIR-to-UV upconversion for reconfigurable Fourier optical processing
articles.title_zh: 双谐振非线性超表面可实现近红外到紫外上转换，以实现可重构傅立叶光学处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.01609v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fourier optical processing underpins optical information manipulation, yet extending such operations to short wavelengths within compact platforms remains challenging. Here, we address this challenge by embedding reconfigurable Fourier-domain processing within NIR-to-UV upconversion in a doubly resonant nonlinear metasurface. When coherently illuminated at the Fourier plane with an image-bearing signal and a spatially structured pump, the metasurface generates UV images via degenerate four-wave mixing. Crucially, the spatial-frequency content of these upconverted images is selectively shaped by the tailored spectrum of the pump. To boost the efficiency of this nonlinear process, the metasurface is designed to simultaneously support a toroidal dipole bound state in the continuum and a magnetic dipole resonance, providing spectrally aligned and independently enhanced field localization for signal and pump beams, respectively. Building on this architecture, we experimentally demonstrate directional and continuously tunable filtering at the upconverted UV wavelengths. These results establish nonlinear metasurfaces as a versatile platform for Fourier optics and reconfigurable all-optical image processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 傅里叶光学处理是光学信息处理的基础，但将此类操作扩展到紧凑平台内的短波长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过在双共振非线性超表面的近红外到紫外上转换中嵌入可重构傅里叶域处理来解决这一挑战。当用图像承载信号和空间结构泵在傅里叶平面上进行相干照明时，超表面通过简并四波混合生成紫外图像。至关重要的是，这些上转换图像的空间频率内容是由泵浦的定制频谱选择性地塑造的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 傅里叶光学处理是光学信息处理的基础，但将此类操作扩展到紧凑平台内的短波长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过在双共振非线性超表面的近红外到紫外上转换中嵌入可重构傅里叶域处理来解决这一挑战。当用图像承载信号和空间结构泵在傅里叶平面上进行相干照明时，超表面通过简并四波混合生成紫外图像。至关重要的是，这些上转换图像的空间频率内容是由泵浦的定制频谱选择性地塑造的。为了提高这种非线性过程的效率，超表面被设计为同时支持连续体中的环形偶极束缚态和磁偶极共振，分别为信号束和泵浦束提供光谱对准和独立增强的场定位。在此架构的基础上，我们通过实验演示了上转换紫外波长的定向和连续可调滤波。这些结果将非线性超表面确立为傅里叶光学和可重构全光学图像处理的通用平台。

articles.title: Optothermal Actuation of Unidirectional Thermo-osmotic Flows
articles.title_zh: 单向热渗透流的光热驱动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27735v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate the microscale direction control of thermo-osmotic flows using a focused-laser heating. The key is the off-center laser irradiation on an immobilized light-absorbing microparticle, which generates a nonuniform, asymmetric heat source. The resulting thermo-osmotic flows are evaluated using the optically trapped particle tracking velocimetry (ot-PTV), presented in our preceding paper (T. Tsuji, et al., Physical Review Fluids 11, 034901 (2026)). It is shown that the flow characteristics can be modulated by the ionic strength of a sample solution and/or the surface molecular coating of the substrate. In particular, the significance of ionic strength on thermo-osmotic flows is discussed based on the surface potential of the substrate measured by frequency-modulated atomic force microscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们通过实验证明了使用聚焦激光加热对热渗透流的微尺度方向控制。 The key is the off-center laser irradiation on an immobilized light-absorbing microparticle, which generates a nonuniform, asymmetric heat source. The resulting thermo-osmotic flows are evaluated using t…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们通过实验证明了使用聚焦激光加热对热渗透流的微尺度方向控制。 The key is the off-center laser irradiation on an immobilized light-absorbing microparticle, which generates a nonuniform, asymmetric heat source. The resulting thermo-osmotic flows are evaluated using the optically trapped particle tracking velocimetry (ot-PTV), presented in our preceding paper (T. Tsuji, et al., Physical Review Fluids 11, 034901 (2026)). It is shown that the flow characteristics can be modulated by the ionic strength of a sample solution and/or the surface molecular coating of the substrate. In particular, the significance of ionic strength on thermo-osmotic flows is discussed based on the surface potential of the substrate measured by frequency-modulated atomic force microscopy.

articles.title: Efficient Spin-Orbit Coupling in Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Theory: A State-Interaction Approach
articles.title_zh: 代数图解构造理论中的高效自旋轨道耦合：一种状态相互作用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.30772v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-orbit coupling and electron correlation play important roles in a broad range of chemical and physical phenomena. In this work, we systematically assess the performance of single-reference algebraic diagrammatic construction combined with state interaction (SI-ADC) for describing electronic structure in the presence of spin-orbit coupling. We find that second-order SI-ADC methods (SI-ADC(2)) achieve zero-field-splitting accuracies comparable to those of higher-level and more computationally demanding approaches, including variational four-component ADC and two-component ADC methods based on spin-orbit effective Hamiltonians. We further demonstrate the broad applicability of SI-ADC by evaluating a diverse range of spin-orbit-coupled properties, including electron affinities, ionization potentials, neutral excitation energies, core-ionization energies, and magnetic g-tensors, for systems ranging from small molecules to transition-metal complexes and f-block compounds. Across these applications, SI-ADC(2) methods provide consistently accurate results, likely benefiting in part from favorable error cancellation between electron-correlation and spin-orbit effects. In contrast, SI-ADC(3) methods are generally less accurate, particularly for systems containing transition-metal and heavy elements. Overall, these results establish SI-ADC as an efficient and broadly applicable framework for incorporating spin-orbit coupling into ADC calculations of electronic and spectroscopic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道耦合和电子关联在广泛的化学和物理现象中发挥着重要作用。在这项工作中，我们系统地评估了单参考代数图解构造与状态相互作用（SI-ADC）相结合的性能，用于描述存在自旋轨道耦合的电子结构。我们发现二阶 SI-ADC 方法 (SI-ADC(2)) 实现的零场分裂精度与更高级别和计算要求更高的方法相当，包括基于自旋轨道有效哈密顿量的变分四分量 ADC 和双分量 ADC 方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道耦合和电子关联在广泛的化学和物理现象中发挥着重要作用。在这项工作中，我们系统地评估了单参考代数图解构造与状态相互作用（SI-ADC）相结合的性能，用于描述存在自旋轨道耦合的电子结构。我们发现二阶 SI-ADC 方法 (SI-ADC(2)) 实现的零场分裂精度与更高级别和计算要求更高的方法相当，包括基于自旋轨道有效哈密顿量的变分四分量 ADC 和双分量 ADC 方法。我们通过评估各种自旋轨道耦合特性，包括电子亲和势、电离势、中性激发能、核心电离能和磁 g 张量，进一步证明了 SI-ADC 的广泛适用性，适用于从小分子到过渡金属配合物和 f 块化合物的系统。在这些应用中，SI-ADC(2) 方法提供一致的准确结果，这可能部分受益于电子相关效应和自旋轨道效应之间有利的误差消除。相比之下，SI-ADC(3) 方法通常不太准确，特别是对于含有过渡金属和重元素的系统。总体而言，这些结果将 SI-ADC 确立为一种有效且广泛适用的框架，可将自旋轨道耦合纳入电子和光谱特性的 ADC 计算中。

articles.title: Perturbations in the parametrized wormhole spacetime and their related quasinormal modes
articles.title_zh: 参数化虫洞时空的扰动及其相关的拟正则模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05352v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study electromagnetic perturbations and the associated quasinormal modes (QNMs) of parametrized static, spherically symmetric wormhole spacetimes, focusing on Damour-Solodukhin and braneworld geometries as well as their galactic extensions. Using the Bronnikov-Konoplya-Pappas (BKP) parametrization, we express the metric functions in terms of a compactified radial coordinate and characterize the spacetime through far-field and near-throat parameters. The far-field coefficients govern the asymptotic structure and post-Newtonian behaviour, while the near-throat continued-fraction expansion captures the strong-field geometry near the throat. We first apply the parametrization to isolated wormholes and identify its range of validity, showing that the non-analytic metric functions can limit the applicability of the BKP scheme. Moreover we have shown that such issues can indeed hamper the primary ringdown waveform. We then extend the framework to a galactic Damour-Solodukhin wormhole embedded in a Hernquist dark matter halo. Imposing observational bounds from the shadow of Sgr A^*, we constrain the galactic compactness and deformation parameters and obtain an observationally viable parametrized metric. Within the allowed parameter space, we compute the fundamental QNM frequencies using the transfer matrix method and analyze the corresponding time-domain ringdown signals. We find that the damping rate is more sensitive to galactic compactness, whereas the oscillation frequency remains comparatively stable. Although the spectral shifts are small within the shadow-allowed region, the framework provides a systematic link between geometric parametrization, shadow constraints, and dynamical response. Our results establish an observationally consistent parametrized description of wormhole perturbations for strong-field tests of horizonless compact objects.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究参数化静态、球对称虫洞时空的电磁扰动和相关的准正态模式（QNM），重点关注达穆尔-索洛杜欣和膜世界几何形状及其银河延伸。使用 Bronnikov-Konoplya-Pappas (BKP) 参数化，我们用压缩径向坐标表达度量函数，并通过远场和近喉参数来表征时空。远场系数控制渐近结构和后牛顿行为，而近喉部连分式展开则捕捉喉部附近的强场几何结构。我们首先将参数化应用于孤立虫洞并确定其有效性范围，表明非解析度量函数会限制 BKP 方案的适用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究参数化静态、球对称虫洞时空的电磁扰动和相关的准正态模式（QNM），重点关注达穆尔-索洛杜欣和膜世界几何形状及其银河延伸。使用 Bronnikov-Konoplya-Pappas (BKP) 参数化，我们用压缩径向坐标表达度量函数，并通过远场和近喉参数来表征时空。远场系数控制渐近结构和后牛顿行为，而近喉部连分式展开则捕捉喉部附近的强场几何结构。我们首先将参数化应用于孤立虫洞并确定其有效性范围，表明非解析度量函数会限制 BKP 方案的适用性。此外，我们已经表明，此类问题确实会妨碍主振铃波形。然后，我们将框架扩展到嵌入赫恩奎斯特暗物质晕中的银河达穆尔-索洛杜金虫洞。从人马座 A^* 的阴影中施加观测边界，我们限制了星系的致密性和变形参数，并获得了观测上可行的参数化度量。在允许的参数空间内，我们使用传递矩阵方法计算基本 QNM 频率并分析相应的时域振铃信号。我们发现阻尼率对星系致密性更敏感，而振荡频率保持相对稳定。尽管阴影允许区域内的光谱偏移很小，但该框架提供了几何参数化、阴影约束和动态响应之间的系统联系。我们的结果为无水平致密天体的强场测试建立了虫洞扰动的观测一致的参数化描述。

articles.title: Active Learning for Calibrating Entangling Gates via Surrogate-Based Optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过基于代理的优化进行主动学习以校准纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00284v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-fidelity quantum gates require precise tuning of many classical control parameters, and drift in these parameters necessitates periodic recalibration that takes time and qubit resources. Physics-based calibration can be efficient, but it requires a validated and high-fidelity model of the quantum gate under the given classical control and environment. A high-fidelity model is expensive to build, especially as systems scale, and will have to be periodically re-validated as system parameters drift. Here, we present a physics-agnostic active-learning framework that identifies optimal control parameters from noisy measurement outcomes. A generic Gaussian process with a heteroskedastic noise model set by quantum projection noise is used to model the score landscape of the calibration sequence. Bayesian optimization simultaneously learns the calibration landscape and locates its optimum. We validate the technique by calibrating a two-qubit trapped-ion entangling gate. In simulation, where the ground-truth landscape is known, we find that the surrogate accurately models the three-parameter landscape and the calibrated infidelity saturates at a level set by the number of shots per evaluation. Validation on the Sandia Quantum User Testbed shows that the physics-agnostic protocol works on an experimental system with four calibrated parameters, needing an average of 44± 11 evaluation points at 100 shots per point to model the calibration landscape and find the optimal parameter set. These results show that active learning with physics-agnostic surrogate models can calibrate quantum gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 高保真量子门需要精确调整许多经典控制参数，而这些参数的漂移需要定期重新校准，这需要时间和量子比特资源。基于物理的校准可能很有效，但它需要在给定的经典控制和环境下建立经过验证的高保真量子门模型。高保真模型的构建成本高昂，尤其是随着系统规模的扩大，并且随着系统参数的漂移，必须定期重新验证。在这里，我们提出了一个与物理无关的主动学习框架，可以从嘈杂的测量结果中识别最佳控制参数。使用具有由量子投影噪声设置的异方差噪声模型的通用高斯过程来对校准序列的分数景观进行建模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高保真量子门需要精确调整许多经典控制参数，而这些参数的漂移需要定期重新校准，这需要时间和量子比特资源。基于物理的校准可能很有效，但它需要在给定的经典控制和环境下建立经过验证的高保真量子门模型。高保真模型的构建成本高昂，尤其是随着系统规模的扩大，并且随着系统参数的漂移，必须定期重新验证。在这里，我们提出了一个与物理无关的主动学习框架，可以从嘈杂的测量结果中识别最佳控制参数。使用具有由量子投影噪声设置的异方差噪声模型的通用高斯过程来对校准序列的分数景观进行建模。贝叶斯优化同时学习校准环境并找到其最佳值。我们通过校准两个量子位捕获离子纠缠门来验证该技术。在模拟中，在已知地面真实景观的情况下，我们发现代理准确地模拟了三参数景观，并且校准的不忠度饱和在由每次评估的镜头数量设定的水平。桑迪亚量子用户测试平台上的验证表明，与物理无关的协议适用于具有四个校准参数的实验系统，平均需要 44±11 个评估点（每点 100 个镜头）来对校准景观进行建模并找到最佳参数集。这些结果表明，使用与物理无关的代理模型进行主动学习可以校准量子门。

articles.title: PDE-State Conditioning for Learned Optimization Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 使用物理信息神经网络进行学习优化的偏微分方程状态调节
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization depends on global properties of the underlying PDE and how the physics residual evolves across the domain. Standard optimizers such as Adam use fixed gradient-based statistics, while learned PINN optimizers replace the fixed rule with a learned update built from local parameters and optimization-history features. However, none explicitly use PDE-level information. We study two coupled design questions: what PDE-level information should a learned optimizer observe, and how should that information influence its update? We introduce an 11-dimensional PDE state-capturing operator structure, residual geometry, and short-horizon update response, and use it to condition a structured meta-learned optimizer through bounded feature-wise modulation. Repeated design studies identify the compact residual-geometry state G2 and bounded FiLM as the strongest overall choices among those tested. The resulting PDE-State-conditioned optimizer improves all evaluation metrics (relative-L2, L1, solution MSE, and physics MSE) over Adam and the unconditioned learned optimizer on Linear Advection, KdV, and Burgers.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 优化取决于基础 PDE 的全局属性以及物理残差如何在整个域中演化。 Adam 等标准优化器使用基于固定梯度的统计数据，而学习 PINN 优化器则用根据局部参数和优化历史特征构建的学习更新替换固定规则。然而，没有一个明确使用 PDE 级别的信息。我们研究两个耦合设计问题：学习的优化器应该观察哪些偏微分方程级别的信息，以及该信息应该如何影响其更新？
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 优化取决于基础 PDE 的全局属性以及物理残差如何在整个域中演化。 Adam 等标准优化器使用基于固定梯度的统计数据，而学习 PINN 优化器则用根据局部参数和优化历史特征构建的学习更新替换固定规则。然而，没有一个明确使用 PDE 级别的信息。我们研究两个耦合设计问题：学习的优化器应该观察哪些偏微分方程级别的信息，以及该信息应该如何影响其更新？我们引入了 11 维 PDE 状态捕获算子结构、残差几何和短时域更新响应，并使用它通过有界特征调制来调节结构化元学习优化器。重复设计研究确定紧凑残差几何状态 G2 和有界 FiLM 是测试中最强的总体选择。与 Adam 以及线性平流、KdV 和 Burgers 上的无条件学习优化器相比，所得的 PDE 状态条件优化器改进了所有评估指标（相对 L2、L1、解 MSE 和物理 MSE）。

articles.title: NIMIS: A Structure-Agnostic, Chemically Informed Slot-Attention Framework for Demixing 1D ¹H-NMR Mixture Spectra
articles.title_zh: NIMIS：一种与结构无关、化学信息丰富的时隙注意框架，用于分离 1D 1H-NMR 混合物谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The products of chemical reactions are usually complex mixtures that must be separated into their components before interpretable ¹H-NMR spectra can be obtained. Direct analysis of the spectra of crude mixtures would accelerate reaction analysis and facilitate the exploration of new chemical space. We present NIMIS, a structure-agnostic, attention-based deep learning framework that groups the peaks of a 1D ¹H-NMR mixture spectrum according to the component from which they originate. J-coupling information is introduced directly into the attention mechanism of a multi-head Transformer encoder, and the resulting contextualised peak embeddings are separated into components by slot attention. NIMIS was trained on 158,005 synthetic mixtures constructed from experimental spectra in the NMRexp database, covering molecules of up to 20 heavy atoms composed of C, H, N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I. On held-out molecules it reaches a peak-to-component assignment accuracy of 82.28% for noise-free input and 77.34% with 10% integral noise, with a mean NIMIS score of 0.83 for correct assignments. NIMIS outperforms a conventional Transformer and simple baselines, and its performance carries over to a scaffold-disjoint evaluation. By grouping peaks into component-level sets, NIMIS provides a foundation for more robust mixture analysis methods, including methods capable of handling overlapping signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 化学反应的产物通常是复杂的混合物，在获得可解释的 1 H-NMR 谱之前必须将其分离成各个组分。直接分析原油混合物的光谱将加速反应分析并促进新化学空间的探索。我们提出了 NIMIS，一种与结构无关、基于注意力的深度学习框架，该框架根据 1D 1H-NMR 混合光谱的来源成分对它们进行分组。 J-耦合信息被直接引入多头 Transformer 编码器的注意力机制中，并且所得到的上下文化峰值嵌入通过时隙注意力分成组件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学反应的产物通常是复杂的混合物，在获得可解释的 1 H-NMR 谱之前必须将其分离成各个组分。直接分析原油混合物的光谱将加速反应分析并促进新化学空间的探索。我们提出了 NIMIS，一种与结构无关、基于注意力的深度学习框架，该框架根据 1D 1H-NMR 混合光谱的来源成分对它们进行分组。 J-耦合信息被直接引入多头 Transformer 编码器的注意力机制中，并且所得到的上下文化峰值嵌入通过时隙注意力分成组件。 NIMIS 在 NMRexp 数据库中的实验光谱构建的 158,005 种合成混合物上进行了训练，涵盖了由 C、H、N、O、S、F、Cl、Br 和 I 组成的多达 20 个重原子的分子。在保留的分子上，它在无噪声输入下达到了 82.28% 的峰-组分分配精度，在 10% 积分噪声下达到了 77.34%，平均 NIMIS 得分为 0.83正确的作业。 NIMIS 的性能优于传统的 Transformer 和简单的基线，并且其性能可用于脚手架不相交的评估。通过将峰分组为成分级集合，NIMIS 为更稳健的混合物分析方法（包括能够处理重叠信号的方法）奠定了基础。

articles.title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
articles.title_zh: 从内部机器信号重建铣削力的轻量级混合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. This low-frequency estimation parameterizes a static milling force model that reconstructs the force behavior over one spindle revolution. Although the static model does not reproduce all dynamic effects, it captures the force distribution, load levels, and angular regions of highest tool engagement. The approach is evaluated on one milling machine across varying process parameters, engagement conditions, cutting tools, and two workpiece materials. Dynamometer measurements are required only for development and validation. Ridge regression achieves an R² of 0.984 and 0.991 for average-force prediction on the test data (barFₓ and barF_y). The reconstructed force behavior over one spindle revolution achieves an R² of 0.962 and 0.982 (Fₓ and F_y) compared with the reconstruction based on measured force features. The method provides a cost and computationally efficient basis for process monitoring, tool condition assessment, and process optimization on existing machines.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于铣削力的数据驱动监控可以实现包括工艺优化和状态监控在内的先进制造服务。然而，工业实施常常受到昂贵和侵入性硬件以及大量培训数据要求的阻碍。因此，本文提出了一种使用机器内部信号和加工元数据的混合方法，无需额外的传感器即可对棕地机器进行基于力的监控。常用的机器信号具有相对较低的采样率，并且不能直接表示高频铣削力变化，尤其是在较高主轴速度下。监督机器学习模型不是学习完整的力信号，这会增加模型复杂性、数据要求和过度拟合风险，而是仅根据选定的机器信号特征和加工参数预测平均铣削力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于铣削力的数据驱动监控可以实现包括工艺优化和状态监控在内的先进制造服务。然而，工业实施常常受到昂贵和侵入性硬件以及大量培训数据要求的阻碍。因此，本文提出了一种使用机器内部信号和加工元数据的混合方法，无需额外的传感器即可对棕地机器进行基于力的监控。常用的机器信号具有相对较低的采样率，并且不能直接表示高频铣削力变化，尤其是在较高主轴速度下。监督机器学习模型不是学习完整的力信号，这会增加模型复杂性、数据要求和过度拟合风险，而是仅根据选定的机器信号特征和加工参数预测平均铣削力。这种低频估计参数化了静态铣削力模型，该模型重建了主轴旋转一周的力行为。尽管静态模型不能再现所有动态效应，但它可以捕获力分布、负载水平和最高工具啮合的角度区域。该方法在一台铣床上通过不同的工艺参数、啮合条件、切削刀具和两种工件材料进行评估。仅在开发和验证时才需要测功机测量。对于测试数据（barFₓ 和 barF_y）的平均力预测，岭回归的 R² 为 0.984 和 0.991。与基于测量的力特征的重建相比，在主轴旋转一圈时重建的力行为实现了 0.962 和 0.982（Fₓ 和 F_y）的 R²。该方法为现有机器上的过程监控、工具状况评估和过程优化提供了成本和计算效率的基础。

articles.title: Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model
articles.title_zh: 工作区能发挥作用吗？用于验证语言模型中的全局工作空间计算的因果协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Global Workspace Theory (GWT), a leading theory of consciousness, holds that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast to specialized processes that use it. Building a workspace into a network does not reveal what the trained network computes with it: a module that reports an answer may have combined a broadcast message with its own knowledge, or merely forwarded an answer computed elsewhere, and task accuracy and ablation cannot tell these apart. We introduce a causal protocol that identifies who computes when modules communicate. Its central test transplants a message from another input, chosen so that ignoring, relaying and recombining it predict three different answers. On networks built to relay or to recombine, the test assigns the right computation in every case. Among trained workspace models it finds all three outcomes: one leaves its broadcast nearly unused, and of two models that differ only in their training data, one relays and the other recombines. In AFGW, a language model whose modules communicate only through a learned workspace, a transplanted message yields the answer that recombination predicts in 97% of cases, and its content acts by redirecting what the receiver retrieves from its own memory. The tests carry over to other communication designs and to a known interface of a pretrained Transformer, turning GWT's central claim into a testable property of trained models.
articles.abstract_zh: 全球工作空间理论（GWT）是一种领先的意识理论，认为当信息被广播到使用它的专门过程时，信息就会变得有意识。将工作空间构建到网络中并不会揭示经过训练的网络用它计算的内容：报告答案的模块可能将广播消息与其自己的知识相结合，或者只是转发在其他地方计算的答案，而任务准确性和消融无法区分这些。我们引入了一种因果协议，用于识别模块通信时由谁进行计算。它的核心测试从另一个输入中移植一条消息，经过选择，忽略、转发和重新组合它可以预测三个不同的答案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全球工作空间理论（GWT）是一种领先的意识理论，认为当信息被广播到使用它的专门过程时，信息就会变得有意识。将工作空间构建到网络中并不会揭示经过训练的网络用它计算的内容：报告答案的模块可能将广播消息与其自己的知识相结合，或者只是转发在其他地方计算的答案，而任务准确性和消融无法区分这些。我们引入了一种因果协议，用于识别模块通信时由谁进行计算。它的核心测试从另一个输入中移植一条消息，经过选择，忽略、转发和重新组合它可以预测三个不同的答案。在为中继或重组而构建的网络上，测试在每种情况下都会分配正确的计算。在经过训练的工作空间模型中，它发现了所有三种结果：一种几乎未使用其广播，而两种模型仅在训练数据上有所不同，一种是中继，另一种是重新组合。 AFGW 是一种语言模型，其模块仅通过学习的工作空间进行通信，移植的消息会产生重组在 97% 的情况下预测的答案，并且其内容通过重定向接收者从自己的内存中检索的内容来发挥作用。这些测试延续到其他通信设计和预训练 Transformer 的已知接口，将 GWT 的核心主张转变为训练模型的可测试属性。

articles.title: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
articles.title_zh: 使用 STL 派生图和零件级描述符预测激光粉末床熔合零件的表面位移场
