At the imposed 70-µm reference center, their normalized values were 2.0 and 0.5, respectively. Lorentzian and geometry-sensitivity analyses confirmed the dependence of these responses on the assumed damping relation and spatial profile. Despite identical depth-integrated excess damping, anterior, uniform, and posterior control profiles produced distinct local spectral and temporal signatures, demonstrating the importance of spatial organization within the specified model. These findings provide conditional observables and reproducible benchmarks for future quantitative investigation of a Dissipative Decoherence Structure (DDS), in which microscopic decoherence-associated information redistribution may become functionally coupled to macroscopic transport. However, the calculations did not independently establish HEZ localization, increased physical entropy production, corneal quantum decoherence, or DDS function. The resulting formulation offers a testable theoretical basis for investigating spatially organized dissipation and its possible relationship to useful transport. Future studies must identify relevant collective modes, obtain depth-resolved spectral and correlation measurements, independently quantify physical entropy production and transport, and reconstruct spatial organization without imposing a predefined HEZ geometry.

articles.title: The Runtime Half of the Safety Case Aboard Autonomous Ships: Evaluating Provisos with Claim Graphs and Warrant Records under the MASS Code
articles.abstract: A safety case makes design-time claims about a vessel that hold only while certain conditions are met in operation, and we call checking these conditions, and responding when one fails, the runtime half of the safety case. Without crew or shore link, an autonomous vessel must perform that runtime half itself. Treating the runtime half as a conformity assessment, of the kind performed in class surveys and flag certification, we derive five functions that a mechanism performing it aboard must provide. We find that the International Code of Safety for Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships requires one of these functions under any interpretation, and the other four only under certain interpretations of three of its provisions. To find out whether the five functions can be implemented, and what an assessor can establish from its record, we propose an architecture that provides all five. The safety case is held aboard as a graph of claims. On each cycle, a non-compensatory evaluator assigns each claim a standing based on its conditions of application and writes a warrant record for it. We illustrate the architecture with a staged reproduction of the Royal Majesty receiver failure, beside two composite-score policies, whose records show which source failed but not which claims it withdrew. To the Code's experience-building phase we recommend interpreting the three provisions so that all five functions are required, and list open questions on approval, change control and record keeping to be settled.

articles.title: Differential Effects of Postharvest CaCl₂, Salicylic Acid and GABA Dips on Peel Gene Expression and Antioxidant Status of Thomson Navel Orange During Storage
articles.abstract: Postharvest treatments can modulate molecular and biochemical responses in citrus fruit during storage. This study compared calcium chloride (CaCl₂, 2%), salicylic acid (SA, 2 mM), and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 5 mM) dips with a water control in Thomson Navel sweet orange (Citrus sinensis (L.) Osbeck) stored at 7–10°C for 90 days. Flavedo expression of CsACS2, CsNCED, and CsPH8, catalase (CAT) and peroxidase (POD) activities, total phenolic and flavonoid contents, and hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) levels were evaluated at 0, 30, 60, and 90 days. The treatments induced distinct temporal response patterns. CaCl₂ treatment was associated with a progressive decline in CsACS2 expression relative to its day-0 baseline and increased CAT activity, which reached 246 U g⁻¹ protein at day 90, compared with 95 U g⁻¹ protein in the control. GABA treatment increased total phenolic content by 31–52% relative to the control across days 30–90. In contrast, SA-treated fruit exhibited the highest H₂O₂ levels at days 60 and 90, indicating a distinct late-storage redox response. Together, these findings reveal treatment-specific patterns of molecular and biochemical responses in Thomson Navel orange peel. CaCl₂ was primarily associated with altered CsACS2 expression and enhanced CAT activity, whereas GABA consistently increased phenolic accumulation. These findings provide a basis for developing targeted postharvest strategies by identifying CaCl₂ and GABA as promising candidates for modulating peel physiological responses during cold storage.

articles.title: Signature of field-induced spin relaxation in the paramagnetic regime of the frustrated triangular antiferromagnet NdZnAl₁₁O₁₉
articles.abstract: Author(s): Manshi Rani, Dheeraj Ranaut, Manh Duc Le, Mohamed Aouane, G. B. G. Stenning, and K. Mukherjee This study explores the influence of positional disorder on magnetic behavior, focusing on the presence of orphan spins that are effectively decoupled from the collective spin dynamics. Here, the authors investigate the positional disorder and its impact on crystal electric field (CEF) excitations using inelastic neutron scattering measurements. Interestingly, a field-induced spin relaxation associated with the orphan spins, with an energy barrier corresponding to the CEF gap is revealed through ac susceptibility measurements. [Phys. Rev. articles.title: PSE-RepairBench: a simulator-grounded benchmark for evaluating large language model-based setpoint correction in executable chemical process flowsheets
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for applications in chemical process design support. However, a comprehensive evaluation platform for comparing the outputs of LLMs as to whether they function effectively on process simulators has not been sufficiently established. In this study, we constructed PSE-RepairBench, an execution-based benchmark targeting deviation correction in DWSIM flowsheets. We perturbed scalar parameters of existing unit operations in computable flowsheets. These parameters included temperature and pressure setpoints, reflux ratio, and feed stage. This procedure generated tasks in which the temperature, pressure, flow rate, or molar fraction of a specified component in a terminal output stream deviates from its base value. The LLMs were provided with the terminal output stream subject to evaluation and the target conditions, equipment settings, stream information, and simulator logs for these flowsheets with shifted setpoints, and were prompted to output a repair action specifying which setting values of which equipment should be corrected to which values. The generated repair actions were applied to the flowsheets, and the success of each repair was determined based on the recalculation results from headless execution. Evaluation of nine LLMs (GPT-based, Claude-based, and Gemini-based) showed repair success rates of 34–67%. Analysis of failure reasons, types of terminal output streams, and parameters targeted for repair revealed differences in LLM behavior and task difficulty. This study provides a foundation for evaluating the chemical process design support capabilities of LLMs based not on surface-level output or agreement with exemplars, but on actual simulator execution results.

articles.title: An entropic bottleneck, dynamical gating, and outward redistribution of roaming in a designed Chesnavich-type model
articles.abstract: We examine how the angular potential affects entry into the inner well and roaming in a modification of Chesnavich’s model of barrierless ion–molecule dissociation. The model has two degrees of freedom. We replace V 0 ( r )sin 2 θ by B ( r )sin 2 θ , so that the frequency of small angular oscillations has an interior maximum. With the Chesnavich radial potential V Ch ( r ), at E = 2 kcal/mol and with the same construction of inward initial conditions, the percentage entering the well falls from 57% to 15%. With B ( r )sin 2 θ , most trajectories return directly to large separation. We classify roaming by at least three crossings of a surface at a specified radius, called the classifier radius. The nonreactive roaming fractions are similar at 3.5 Å, but appreciable roaming occurs at larger sampled classifier radii with B ( r )sin 2 θ . Increasing V 0 ( r ) by a constant factor shows that an interior frequency maximum is not required for reduced entry or appreciable roaming at larger classifier radii. For V LJ ( r ) + B ( r )sin 2 θ , with V LJ ( r ) the Lennard-Jones radial potential, we locate tight, free rotor, and outer orbiting transition states as unstable periodic orbits. The directional flux through surfaces of constant radius has a local minimum defining an entropic bottleneck: angular phase space is restricted although the radial potential has no barrier. At this minimum, the flux through one of the two equivalent allowed angular intervals around θ = 0 and θ = π exceeds the dividing surface flux of one corresponding tight orbit by 0.15%. Noncaptured return time distributions are nonexponential, combining faster direct returns with slower roaming returns.

articles.title: Mineralogical, Physicochemical, and Geochemical Characterization of Swelling Clay-Rich Materials and Estimation of Sodium Carbonate Requirements for Activation: A Comparative Approach
articles.abstract: This study investigates bentonite geomaterials from the eastern part of Jbel Tidiennt, a satellite volcanic edifice of the Gourougou Massif, in the Neogene Kert Basin, northeastern Morocco. It aims to characterize their mineralogical, physicochemical, and geochemical properties and estimate their sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) requirements for sodium activation. The samples were analyzed using particle-size analysis, physicochemical measurements, X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), thermal analysis, cation exchange capacity (CEC), and elemental analyses. Results revealed a predominantly smectitic composition (58–89 wt.%), alkaline pH (8.2–9.0), and relatively high CEC, with variations in exchangeable cations. Two approaches were used to estimate Na₂CO₃ requirements: a CEC-based approach targeting 110% activation and a divalent-cation-based approach based on the potential precipitation of soluble and exchangeable Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ as carbonates. The calculated dosages ranged from 2.5 to 4.2 wt.% and 2.6 to 4.3 wt.%, respectively. Selecting the higher dosage for each sample provides a conservative preliminary estimate for subsequent activation trials. These findings contribute to assessing sodium activation requirements for Moroccan bentonite geomaterials and support further experimental investigations into their activation behavior and potential industrial applications.

articles.title: A Five-Point Method for Estimating DC, Fundamental, and Third-Harmonic Parameters of Electromagnetic-Field Signals at a Known Frequency
articles.abstract: To estimate electromagnetic-field signal parameters within a short observation window, this paper presents a five-point method for signals with a known fundamental frequency. The signal model, comprising a DC component, a fundamental component, and a third harmonic, is expressed as a linear combination of sine and cosine basis functions. Five equally spaced samples form a 5 × 5 linear system, which is solved to obtain the DC component and the amplitudes and initial phases of the fundamental and third-harmonic components. The solution matrix can be calculated in advance from the sampling interval and known frequency to reduce real-time computation; the sampling interval must be selected so that the coefficient matrix is nonsingular and suitably conditioned. MATLAB/Simulink simulations were used to examine fundamental-only, third-harmonic, and time-varying-amplitude signals, while a parallel-plate power-frequency electric-field platform was used to evaluate steady-state and dynamic measurements. The results show that, when the signal follows the assumed model and the fundamental frequency is known, the method estimates the parameters from five samples. At a sampling interval of 1 ms, the first-to-last sample span is 4 ms, allowing changes in the electric-field amplitude to be observed. The method does not estimate frequency, and its practical accuracy depends on noise, sampling interval, matrix conditioning, and sensor errors.

articles.title: Federated WGAN-GP for Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Side-Channel Trace Generation and Cryptographic Security Evaluation
articles.abstract: Side-channel attacks threaten embedded cryptographic systems by exploiting physical leakages such as power consumption, timing behavior, and electromagnetic emissions. To address the privacy risks of centralized trace collection, we propose a federated WGAN-GP framework for decentralized synthetic side-channel trace generation. Raw traces remain on client devices while local WGAN-GP training and federated averaging are performed across 20 heterogeneous clients drawn from ASCAD, ChipWhisperer, and DPAV4 in a 7-7-6 configuration. Experimental result over 10 random seeds, 12 communication rounds, 2 local epochs, and 40,000 traces show stable convergence, with a final quality score of 0.8167 ± 0.0004 and a synthetic-to-real attack success rate of 0.5% ± 0.84%. ChipWhisperer clients achieved the strongest local performance, outperforming ASCAD by 10.58%. The results confirm that balanced heterogeneous federation can support privacy-preserving trace synthesis with a significant privacy–utility trade-off.

articles.title: Study on Quantitative Modeling of Task Completion Probability in AI Agents Using DAG and State-Machine
articles.abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly decompose user instructions into task lists, but widely used approaches (AutoGPT, BabyAGI, MetaGPT) generate simple linear, ID-ordered sequences that cannot express conditional branching or parallel execution. Newer orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, the LLM Compiler, and the Claude Agent SDK add DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) or state-machine execution control for non-linear workflows, yet none provides a quantitative, probabilistic estimate of how likely a plan is to succeed, or how much a redundant (alternative) path improves that likelihood. This study integrates DAG-based dependency modeling, prompt engineering for conditional branching, and a state-machine execution engine, and formulates the resulting task-completion probability P(Goal) with reliability engineering. The model is generalized to 1-out-of-n (parallel) path redundancy and to general DAG topologies with parallel branching and AND-joins, and a cost-constrained redundancy-allocation problem and a Beta-prior estimator of path success probabilities from execution logs are given. Assuming independent task outcomes, Monte Carlo simulations (10,000–100,000 trials) of a retrieval-and-summarization task (72.7% completion for the linear model, 84.4% with redundancy) agree with the closed-form predictions to within 0.18 percentage points across 24 parameter combinations and within 1 point under all conditions. Redundancy at the bottleneck stage yields about 3.9 times the gain at the most reliable stage, as the marginal-utility formula predicts. Alternative paths help most when failures are persistent; correlated failures reduce the gain. With a real LLM agent (100 runs), completion rates predicted from probabilities estimated on half the runs fell within the 95% intervals observed on the other half.

articles.title: Diffusion correlation in polyelectrolyte solutions
articles.abstract: Under long-range electrostatic interactions, dynamics of polyelectrolytes are highly correlated, in sharp contrast to neutral polymers. In the current study, mutual motion correlation of polyelectrolytes in aqueous solutions is directly investigated by dual-color fluorescence cross-correlation spectroscopy (DC-FCCS) and photon counting histogram spectroscopy, with sodium polystyrene sulfonate (NaPSS) chosen as the model system. By dispersing a tracer amount of fluorescence-labeled NaPSS probe chains in unlabeled NaPSS matrix solutions, DC-FCCS measurements with molecular recognition demonstrate anticorrelation between neighboring charged chains at short lag times. The anticorrelation is found to weaken with increasing concentration of matrix solution due to the decrease in effective charge density through enhanced counterion adsorption, and is further suppressed progressively with increasing molecular weight of the NaPSS matrix solution, as a result of the motion restriction by the strengthening of the “cage-like” structure formed by neighboring chains. Governed by multiple factors, including chain conformation, effective charges, and the rigidity of the “cage-like” structure, the diffusivity of the charged chain exhibits nonmonotonic behavior with the concentration of the matrix solution. When the disparity in molecular weight between the probe molecule and that of the matrix chains is large enough, transient cooperative motion of multiple chains emerges, presumably as a consequence of phase separation within the solution.

articles.title: Three-phase coexistence and its critical closure in polymeric microemulsions
articles.abstract: Symmetric ternary blends of A and C homopolymers with their AC block copolymer exhibit a narrow three-phase window near the fluctuation-destroyed Lifshitz point: two homopolymer-rich excess phases (R, R′) coexist with a microstructured middle phase (M), a polymeric bicontinuous microemulsion. How this window closes as segregation decreases remains unresolved. Here, we use fluctuating field-theoretic simulations, extending the Gibbs ensemble to three-phase coexistence and combining it with canonical and grand-canonical simulations, for AC diblock and ABC triblock compatibilizers at a homopolymer/copolymer length ratio of α = 0.1. The resulting binodals are, to our knowledge, the first interface-free three-phase binodals from a fluctuating polymer field theory. The window narrows as χN decreases toward the Lifshitz point, and the copolymer content of the excess phases rises. Near χN ≈ 21.3, that content reaches the structuring onset of the dissolved copolymer. Past the onset, composition fluctuations grow into persistent domains with copolymer-enriched interfaces. The onset concentration pins the excess-phase binodal composition. The middle-phase composition keeps approaching this pinned edge and meets it at χN = 20.8 ± 0.1 ( χN /( χN ) LP ≈ 1.02). There, the coexistence terminates at a critical point, where the canonical three-phase window, the extrapolated Gibbs binodals, and the grand-canonical hysteresis close together. The closing point overlaps the measured demixing line, consistent with a tricritical point. At high segregation, the third phase becomes lamellar. The triblock window closes by the same sequence at slightly higher reduced segregation, χN /( χN ) LP ≈ 1.04, and is three to four times narrower in reduced units. Mean-field theory reproduces this narrowing of the window, while the closing points of both windows are displaced from the Lifshitz point by fluctuations.

articles.title: Density–orientational order coupling in isotropic melts of flexible linear polymers
articles.abstract: We investigate the coupling between density fluctuations and chain-orientational fluctuations in isotropic melts of linear polymers. Using TraPPE United-Atom molecular dynamics simulations of polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polystyrene (PS) as representative flexible polymers, we demonstrate that this coupling, originating from microscopic chain connectivity, persists even in highly flexible systems with persistence lengths of only a few monomer units. Although density-coupled fluctuation modes are obscured by the intrachain structure factor at the system sizes accessible in simulations, we identify and quantify the density–orientation coupling by analyzing fluctuation components uncorrelated with density fluctuations. The coupling strength is substantially larger in PS than in PEO, consistent with its greater chain rigidity. Using the Fokker–Planck equation for the worm-like chain orientational probability distribution on the unit sphere, we calculate the variance of the chain’s nematic order and derive an entropic estimate of the nematic order stiffness in an isotropic system of independent semiflexible chains, which closely reproduces previously reported values for DNA solutions spanning more than two orders of magnitude in chain length. The results highlight density–orientation coupling as a universal, measurable feature of linear polymer liquids, observable even in isotropic systems of highly flexible chains and, in principle, recoverable from fluctuation trajectories of any simulated polymer melt.

articles.title: Boson peaks and thermodynamics of amorphous phase-change materials
articles.abstract: Phase Change Materials (PCMs) are materials of interest for applications in switchable non-volatile memory devices due to their fast phase switching between crystalline and amorphous states, exhibiting high electrical and optical contrasts. The fast crystallization rate of PCMs impedes characterization through conventional methods, necessitating newer avenues of analysis. A previous study of ours demonstrated how modeling the Boson peak, a ubiquitous yet elusive contribution to the low-temperature heat capacity of amorphous solids, could serve as a new avenue. In this work, we investigate the low-temperature heat capacity and the heat flow at elevated temperatures of a greater number of PCMs and chalcogenide GeSeTe glasses. The Boson peaks in the heat capacity of an extended range of PCMs are identified, expanding this hallmark glass feature to these technologically important poor glass formers. While PCMs display no clear difference in Boson peaks from those of conventional chalcogenide glasses, they, as a group, could readily be distinguished when combining their Boson peaks with other properties, such as the glass transition temperature and kinetic fragility. We show that the Boson peaks can be modeled and understood through hybridization or coupling of transverse acoustic phonons with quasi-localized modes. Such a phonon-mode coupling picture can be supported by the correlation between the mean Einstein temperature and the product of the Debye temperature and the cube root of the coefficient of excess modes. These results provide a valuable dataset for understanding Boson peaks and the vibrational and thermodynamic properties of amorphous PCMs, laying the groundwork for investigating how the bonding environment influences their vibrational density of states.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Connectivity-governed mechanics of aerogels revealed through hierarchical deformation and the stretched-path framework
articles.abstract: We numerically investigated the mechanical response of aerogels using coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. The effect of the bond-creation probability—experimentally tunable through pH control—was examined at a fixed volume fraction. The simulated aerogels exhibited elastic behavior at small strains, followed by abrupt yielding associated with bond rupture. A clear trade-off was identified between the elastic modulus and the yield strain: when the bond-creation probability is low, the aerogel exhibits a higher modulus but a smaller yield strain. During deformation, hierarchical and nonaffine structural rearrangements were observed, whose nature depends on the bond-creation probability. These involve cooperative motions on small length scales, accompanied by large-scale transverse nonaffine displacements and stress transmission. Analysis based on the stretched and directed path provides a unified physical picture of the characteristic length scale and its role in stress transmission. These findings offer design principles for developing flexible yet mechanically robust porous materials.

articles.title: Derivation of the sample-size scaling of TWO-NN intrinsic-dimension estimates from molecular dynamics trajectories
articles.abstract: The intrinsic dimension of a dataset is the number of independent directions needed to describe the space occupied by its data. Nearest-neighbor estimators infer it from how the probability of finding a neighbor grows around each sampled point. Because the neighbor distances r decrease as the sample grows, the estimated dimension can depend strongly on the number N of available points, which in molecular dynamics is set by trajectory length and saving frequency. We derive the large-sample behavior of the TWO-NN estimator for data drawn from a smooth d -dimensional space. The typical nearest-neighbor distance scales as N −1/ d , and smooth deviations from local uniformity produce corrections in powers of N −2/ d . Isotropic noise adds a correction proportional to N +2/ d ; for a five-dimensional hyperplane in 100 noisy features, the extended expansion recovers the dimension within a few percent when noise is moderate. We test the scaling on ten independent 100 μ s simulations of alanine dipeptide, represented by the pairwise distances among its ten heavy atoms, whose geometric dimension is 3 n at − 6 = 24. Over the investigated range, the estimate does not depend systematically on the temporal spacing between configurations but increases from 7.6 to 15.6 as N grows from 10 2 to 2 × 10 5 . Extrapolations that retain corrections through r 2 , r 4 , and r 6 give limiting dimensions of 24.81, 23.47, and 25.30, respectively. All three estimates lie within 6% of the known dimension and bracket it, and their spread measures the uncertainty due to truncation. The derived scaling provides a practical route from finite-sample estimates to the geometric dimension.

articles.title: Predictive renormalization-group theory of universality classes in nonlinear systems
articles.abstract: Universal scaling behavior appears across a wide range of nonlinear systems despite substantial differences in their governing equations and physical mechanisms. We develop a renormalization-group (RG) framework that identifies two complementary RG mechanisms underlying such universality. First, scale invariance generates RG fixed points corresponding to asymptotic self-similar solutions. Second, repeated RG transformations eliminate non-scale-invariant irrelevant structures, causing broad classes of equations to flow toward the same fixed points and thereby form universality classes. The framework applies to finite-time singularities, long-time intermediate asymptotics, stochastic Edwards–Wilkinson growth, nonlinear diffusion, density-dependent biological diffusion, and fluid-interface dynamics. In each case, it reproduces known scaling behavior and identifies the associated universality class through explicit irrelevance criteria. A central feature of the framework is its predictive character. Once a scale-invariant fixed point is identified, the theory predicts whole classes of nonlinear equations sharing the same asymptotic self-similar solution. While the diffusion class is partially supported by existing mathematically rigorous results, most universality classes identified here have not previously been established and therefore constitute testable predictions. These results provide a unified RG perspective on universality in nonlinear systems and show that universality emerges from the same fundamental RG principles that underlie critical phenomena.

articles.title: Empirical Quantum Advantage in Constrained Optimization from Encoded Unitary Designs
articles.abstract: We introduce the emph{Constraint–Enhanced Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm} (CE–QAOA), a shallow, constraint-aware ansatz that operates emphinside the one–hot product space (OH=[n]^m), where (m) is the number of blocks and each block is initialized in an (n)-qubit (Wₙ) state. We give an ancilla-free, depth-optimal encoder that prepares (Wₙ) using (n-1) two-qubit rotations per block, and a two-local block-XY mixer that preserves the one–hot manifold and has a constant spectral gap on the one-excitation sector. At the level of expressivity, we establish per-block controllability, implying approximate universality per block. At the level of distributional behavior, we show that (after natural block/symbol permutation twirls) shallow CE–QAOA realizes an encoded unitary (1)-design and supports approximate second-moment ((2)-design) behavior; combined with a Paley--Zygmund argument, this yields finite-shot anticoncentration guarantees. Algorithmically, we wrap constant-depth sampling with a deterministic feasibility checker to obtain a polynomial-time hybrid quantum--classical solver (PHQC) that returns the best observed feasible solution in (O(Sn²)) time, where (S=poly n) is the shot budget. We obtain two advantages. First, when CE--QAOA fixes (rge 1) locations different from the start city, we achieve a (Θ(nr)) reduction in shot complexity even against a classical sampler that draws uniformly from the feasible set. Second, against a classical baseline restricted to raw bitstring sampling, we show an (exp(Θ(n²))) minimax separation. In noiseless circuit simulations of TSP instances with (nin4,dots,10) locations from the QOPTLib benchmark library, we recover the global optimum at (p=1) using polynomial shot budgets and coarse parameter grids defined by the problem size, as suggested by Theorem~refthm:exist-params and Algorithm~refalg:PHQC1.

articles.title: Unsupervised chemical-space organization enables identification of self-healing yet ultra-robust polyurethane elastomers
articles.abstract: Although published polyurethane formulations contain detailed structural information, inconsistent measurement protocols limit their utility in data-driven materials discovery. We introduce an unsupervised chemical-space organization strategy that maps 296 literature formulations alongside millions of virtual combinations onto a shared 13-descriptor representation. Uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) and hierarchical density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (HDBSCAN) partition the space, while a geometry-based ranking anchored to literature formulations with tensile strength > 20 MPa and healing efficiency > 0.90 generates the candidate queue. After screening for formulation plausibility, reagent availability, and synthetic accessibility, six candidates were selected for experimental comparison. The resulting formulation, PUUB (PC2000/HMDI/UPy/PBA), integrates ureidopyrimidinone quadruple hydrogen bonding with phenylboronic-acid-derived dynamic boroxine motifs. PUUB achieves a tensile strength of approximately 98 MPa at 788% elongation, a tensile work-to-fracture of 297 MJ m− 3, and 86.5% fracture-strength recovery after a four-fifths-width cut and 24 h at 80°C in the presence of water. This workflow converts heterogeneous literature data into prioritized, experimentally validated candidates, providing a generalizable strategy for designing materials with complex, coupled properties.

articles.title: Numerical Modeling of the Transient Temperature Field in Polyethylene Pipe Welding at Low Temperatures with Active Cooling
articles.abstract: Based on mathematical modeling that accounts for the latent heat of phase transformation within the temperature range and the evolution of the material's degree of crystallinity, this study investigates thermal processes during polyethylene (PE) pipe welding under various low-temperature conditions. Calculations demonstrate that preliminary heating and thermal homogenization of the welded assembly allow subsequent heating to follow the standard welding protocol. Furthermore, the results establish that maintaining a reference temperature on the outer surface of the electrofusion coupling reduces the cooling rate, ensuring the crystallization front propagates as it would under permissible ambient temperatures.

articles.title: Polarization-Controlled MHz Burst-Mode Femtosecond Laser Slicing of n-Type 4H-SiC Wafers
articles.abstract: This study demonstrates that linear polarization can tune the balance between separation load and surface height variation in MHz burst-mode femtosecond laser slicing of 4° off-axis n-type 4H-SiC. Four polarization angles were compared using dual-pulse bursts with an intraburst repetition rate of approximately 18 MHz under fixed incident-face, scanning, and burst conditions. Optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy were used to characterize internal modification, local lateral crack extension, and crack paths spanning adjacent scan lines. Tensile separation tests and laser scanning confocal microscopy were performed to measure nominal separation stress and separated-surface topography, respectively. By distinguishing local crack extension from multi-line crack morphology, these findings show that local crack length alone does not explain separation behavior and suggest contributions from crack-path continuity and residual connections.

articles.title: Exact solution of the two-dimensional one-component plasma on the truncated Beltrami pseudosphere
articles.title_zh: 截断贝尔特拉米赝球上二维单组分等离子体的精确解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We solve exactly the two-dimensional one-component plasma at coupling Γ=2 on the truncated Beltrami pseudosphere, a surface of constant negative curvature bounded by two parallels. A conformal map onto a flat cylinder leaves the particles interacting through the flat-cylinder potential, with the curvature entering only through the area element. The partition function becomes a product of incomplete gamma functions, the density is explicit, and all correlations are determinantal. Since the area is bounded, the large-N limit is taken at fixed shape. The free energy, obtained through the constant term with every coefficient in closed form, contains a bulk term (1/2)N ln N, a term linear in N, the flat hard-wall surface tension times the total boundary length, and a shape-dependent constant, with no ln N term. This is the conformal-anomaly prediction for Euler characteristic zero, tested here on a surface where the integrated Gaussian and boundary curvatures are separately nonzero and cancel. The expansion coincides term by term with the cylinder result of Shen and Forrester, whose universal constants are quadratures of the two boundary layers. At both walls the density tends to the flat contact value n_b ln 2, from opposite sides, although the circumferences differ by a factor cosh u_max. We compare the asymptotics with the exact solution up to N=4096, and Monte Carlo simulations at Γ= 1, 4 and 6, validated against the exact Γ=  2 density, show how the boundary layers evolve with coupling.

articles.title: Statistical Properties of the q-Deformed Monolayer and Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: q-变形单层和双层石墨烯的统计特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the statistical properties of the q-deformed Dirac oscillator for monolayer and bilayer graphene in the presence of a constant external magnetic field. Using q-deformed creation and annihilation operators, we obtain the corresponding energy spectra and eigenfunctions, as well as their probability current densities, recovering the conventional Landau-level structures in the undeformed limit. For bilayer graphene, the lowest Landau levels are explicitly constructed within the q-deformed framework. The partition functions for both systems are derived using zeta-function techniques and the Euler-Maclaurin formula, allowing us to determine their main thermodynamic quantities for small values of the deformation parameter. Our results show that the q-deformation modifies the energy spectra, the behavior of the probability current density components, and the thermodynamic response of the systems. A comparison between monolayer and bilayer graphene reveals distinct thermal behaviors, reflecting their different Landau-level structures and highlighting the influence of the q-deformation on their statistical properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在恒定外部磁场存在下单层和双层石墨烯的 q 变形狄拉克振荡器的统计特性。利用q变形产生和湮没算子，我们得到了相应的能谱和本征函数，以及它们的概率电流密度，恢复了未变形极限下的常规朗道能级结构。对于双层石墨烯，最低的朗道能级是在 q 变形框架内明确构建的。两个系统的配分函数都是使用 zeta 函数技术和欧拉-麦克劳林公式导出的，使我们能够在变形参数较小的情况下确定它们的主要热力学量。我们的结果表明，q 变形改变了能谱、概率电流密度分量的行为以及系统的热力学响应。

articles.title: Renormalization-Group Foundation of Critical Modes in Correlation Matrices
articles.title_zh: 相关矩阵中临界模态的重整化群基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Based on the relevant scaling operators of renormalization-group theory, we establish a theoretical framework for constructing complete families of critical-sensitive fluctuation observables and their connected correlation matrices. The corresponding eigenstates of the correlation matrices reveal a hierarchy of multiscale critical correlation patterns and the leading normalized eigenvalues and their ratios show the finite-size scaling behavior. Applying this framework to the two-dimensional Ising model, the correlation matrices associated with both spin and energy operators are constructed. The resulting energy-sector eigenstate patterns, together with the scaling behavior of the leading eigenvalues, provide further support for the proposed framework. Finally, we discuss its potential extension to systems with unknown Hamiltonians.

articles.title: Tunable Topological Charge Order in Magnetic Moiré Systems
articles.title_zh: 磁莫尔系统中的可调谐拓扑电荷顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional electrons in a strong magnetic field exhibit two seemingly incompatible ground states: incompressible quantum Hall liquids with a quantized Hall conductance, and electron crystals in which interactions drive the charge into ordered patterns. Moiré superlattices in transition-metal-dichalcogenide bilayers offer a tunable arena for this competition. Using neural quantum states (NQS) together with several methodological advances, we show how this competition unfolds. In particular, we demonstrate that the two end points are separated by an extended regime in which molecular charge order coexists with a quantized Hall response. We map the ground-state phase diagram of electrons at Landau-level filling ν_B=1 in the presence of a moiré superlattice potential, with three electrons per moiré cell. In the deep triangular potential limit, the electrons form the topologically trivial "Wigner molecular crystal'' of three-electron artificial atoms, a state recently imaged at zero magnetic field in moiré bilayers. As the potential depth is lowered, molecular charge order remains while quantized Hall response emerges. At the honeycomb point, where each cell contains three electrons and two degenerate moiré minima, wells are either singly or doubly occupied and the doublons provide an emergent Ising degree of freedom. Starting from modest interaction strength, we find short-range doublon correlations within the Chern insulator which grow with interaction strength and eventually break sublattice symmetry, forming a Néel CDW with long-range order between doublons. The topological molecular regime lies at twist angles and magnetic fields directly accessible to current experiments. The methodological advances presented provide a scalable framework for exploring a broad range of questions in correlated quantum matter in the presence of magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 强磁场中的二维电子表现出两种看似不相容的基态：具有量子化霍尔电导的不可压缩量子霍尔液体，以及相互作用将电荷驱动成有序图案的电子晶体。过渡金属二硫化物双层中的莫尔超晶格为这种竞争提供了一个可调的舞台。利用神经量子态（NQS）和一些方法论的进步，我们展示了这场竞争是如何展开的。特别是，我们证明了两个端点被一个扩展区域分开，其中分子电荷顺序与量子化霍尔响应共存。我们绘制了在存在莫尔超晶格势的情况下朗道能级填充 ν_B=1 时电子的基态相图，每个莫尔晶胞有 3 个电子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强磁场中的二维电子表现出两种看似不相容的基态：具有量子化霍尔电导的不可压缩量子霍尔液体，以及相互作用将电荷驱动成有序图案的电子晶体。过渡金属二硫化物双层中的莫尔超晶格为这种竞争提供了一个可调的舞台。利用神经量子态（NQS）和一些方法论的进步，我们展示了这场竞争是如何展开的。特别是，我们证明了两个端点被一个扩展区域分开，其中分子电荷顺序与量子化霍尔响应共存。我们绘制了在存在莫尔超晶格势的情况下朗道能级填充 ν_B=1 时电子的基态相图，每个莫尔晶胞有 3 个电子。在深三角势极限中，电子形成三电子人造原子的拓扑平凡的“维格纳分子晶体”，这是最近在莫尔双层中的零磁场下成像的一种状态。随着势深度降低，分子电荷顺序保持不变，同时出现量子化霍尔响应。在蜂窝点，每个单元包含三个电子和两个简并莫尔最小值，阱被单占据或双占据，并且双克隆提供了从适度的相互作用强度开始，我们发现陈绝缘体中的短程双子相关性随着相互作用强度的增加而增长，并最终打破亚晶格对称性，形成双子之间具有长程有序的尼尔 CDW。所提出的方法论进展为探索磁场存在下相关量子物质的广泛问题提供了一个可扩展的框架。

articles.title: Hidden convexity of the Eliashberg condensation energy: existence, uniqueness and continuity of the superconducting state
articles.title_zh: Eliashberg凝聚能的隐凸性：超导态的存在性、唯一性和连续性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kiessling, Altshuler and Yuzbashyan conjectured the thermodynamic transition picture for the isotropic Eliashberg spin-chain functional with vanishing Coulomb pseudopotential: the normal state is the unique minimizer above and at a critical temperature, the superconducting minimizer below it is unique up to gauge, and the transition is continuous. We establish the nonlinear part of this picture. In the variables ρₙ=sin²θₙ, the condensation energy restricted to the first quadrant is strictly convex, and folding any admissible chain into that quadrant cannot increase its energy. For every positive, non-increasing interaction with power-law decay, hidden convexity and a compactness estimate give existence and uniqueness of the minimizer up to gauge. The normal state minimizes the energy exactly when its quadratic form is non-negative, including marginal stability. Among admissible chains, a positive solution of the nonlinear Eliashberg equations exists exactly when the normal state is linearly unstable and is then unique. For temperature-dependent families with pointwise continuity and locally uniform decay bounds, the minimizing density is continuous in a weighted ell¹ norm. Together with uniqueness of the linear-stability temperature, these results prove the thermodynamic conjectures for the γ-model, Einstein phonons and general phonon spectra; the phonon applications use separately established spectral input. Finite-dimensional algebraic and convex-analytic components are machine-checked in Lean. The proofs were obtained independently of concurrent work that reaches overlapping conclusions.
articles.abstract_zh: Kiessling、Altshuler 和 Yuzbashyan 推测了库仑赝势消失的各向同性 Eliashberg 自旋链泛函的热力学转变图：正常态是临界温度上方和临界温度下的唯一最小化器，其下方的超导最小化器在规范范围内是唯一的，并且转变是连续的。我们建立了这张图的非线性部分。在变量 ρₙ=sin²θₙ 中，限制在第一象限的凝聚能量是严格凸的，将任何允许的链折叠到该象限中都不能增加其能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kiessling、Altshuler 和 Yuzbashyan 推测了库仑赝势消失的各向同性 Eliashberg 自旋链泛函的热力学转变图：正常态是临界温度上方和临界温度下的唯一最小化器，其下方的超导最小化器在规范范围内是唯一的，并且转变是连续的。我们建立了这张图的非线性部分。在变量 ρₙ=sin²θₙ 中，限制在第一象限的凝聚能量是严格凸的，将任何允许的链折叠到该象限中都不能增加其能量。对于每一个与幂律衰减的正的、非递增的相互作用，隐藏的凸性和紧致性估计给出了最小化器的存在性和唯一性来衡量。当其二次形式非负时，正常状态恰好最小化能量，包括边际稳定性。在允许的链中，当正常状态线性不稳定且唯一时，非线性 Eliashberg 方程的正解恰好存在。对于具有点连续性和局部均匀衰减界限的温度相关族，最小化密度在加权 ell1 范数中是连续的。结合线性稳定温度的唯一性，这些结果证明了γ模型、爱因斯坦声子和一般声子谱的热力学猜想；声子应用使用单独建立的光谱输入。有限维代数和凸分析组件在精益中进行机器检查。这些证明是独立于得出重叠结论的并发工作而获得的。

articles.title: High-resolution top-down nanopatterning of NbN thin films for superconducting metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 用于超导超材料的 NbN 薄膜的高分辨率自上而下纳米图案化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic nanopatterning offers a route to tailoring vortex motion and the electromagnetic response of superconducting films, providing a basis for superconducting metamaterials. Here, we report a high-resolution top-down nanopatterning process for ultrathin epitaxial NbN films on sapphire substrates. Electron-beam lithography using hydrogen silsesquioxane (HSQ) and ZEP 530A resists was optimized through proximity-effect correction and adhesion-layer integration. Dense superconducting nanowire grids with pitches down to 70 nm were fabricated, alongside millimeter-square areas patterned with 100-nm-pitch hole arrays with high pattern fidelity. A thin Si capping layer was found to significantly improve HSQ adhesion on epitaxial NbN. The nanopatterns were successfully transferred into 5-nm-thick NbN films by reactive ion etching (RIE). Structural and dimensional characterization was performed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and atomic force microscopy (AFM), enabling cross-validation of nanoscale feature dimensions and etch quality. Electrical transport measurements reveal periodic resistance minima and switching-current oscillations at magnetic fields set by the hole-array pitch, consistent with enhanced vortex pinning when the vortex configuration matches the patterned lattice. Cryogenic THz time-domain spectroscopy further reveals a reduced superfluid density in the nanopatterned region relative to pristine NbN, while both regions have a spectroscopic superconducting transition near 14 K. These results establish a robust fabrication platform for superconducting nanopatterns targeting vortex pinning, metamaterials, and quantum-device applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性纳米图案化提供了一种定制超导薄膜的涡流运动和电磁响应的途径，为超导超材料提供了基础。在这里，我们报告了一种用于蓝宝石衬底上超薄外延 NbN 薄膜的高分辨率自上而下纳米图案化工艺。通过邻近效应校正和粘附层集成，对使用氢倍半硅氧烷 (HSQ) 和 ZEP 530A 抗蚀剂的电子束光刻进行了优化。制造了节距低至 70 nm 的密集超导纳米线网格，以及具有高图案保真度的 100 nm 节距孔阵列图案的毫米见方区域。研究发现薄硅覆盖层可显着提高外延 NbN 上的 HSQ 粘附力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性纳米图案化提供了一种定制超导薄膜的涡流运动和电磁响应的途径，为超导超材料提供了基础。在这里，我们报告了一种用于蓝宝石衬底上超薄外延 NbN 薄膜的高分辨率自上而下纳米图案化工艺。通过邻近效应校正和粘附层集成，对使用氢倍半硅氧烷 (HSQ) 和 ZEP 530A 抗蚀剂的电子束光刻进行了优化。制造了节距低至 70 nm 的密集超导纳米线网格，以及具有高图案保真度的 100 nm 节距孔阵列图案的毫米见方区域。研究发现薄硅覆盖层可显着提高外延 NbN 上的 HSQ 粘附力。通过反应离子蚀刻 (RIE)，纳米图案成功转移到 5 纳米厚的 NbN 薄膜中。使用扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)、透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 和原子力显微镜 (AFM) 进行结构和尺寸表征，从而实现纳米级特征尺寸和蚀刻质量的交叉验证。电传输测量揭示了由孔阵列间距设置的磁场中的周期性电阻最小值和开关电流振荡，这与当涡流配置与图案晶格匹配时增强的涡流钉扎一致。低温太赫兹时域光谱进一步揭示了纳米图案区域中的超流体密度相对于原始 NbN 有所降低，而这两个区域在 14 K 附近都具有光谱超导转变。这些结果为针对涡旋钉扎、超材料和量子器件应用的超导纳米图案建立了强大的制造平台。

articles.title: Magnon-Phonon-Polariton Optomechanics in a van der Waals Magnet
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体中的磁振子-声子-极化子光力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The layered anti-ferromagnet CrSBr hosts self-hybridized exciton-polaritons that couple parametrically to coherent magnons and phonons. In this work, we explore the tripartite optomechanical interaction between these quasiparticles in suspended CrSBr membranes supporting high-Q breathing-type acoustic phonon modes. Using resonant pump-probe spectroscopy on the polariton state, we resolve the coupled dynamics in the simeq 20 GHz range while sweeping the magnon mode across the phonon resonance with an external magnetic field. We observe an attractive magnon-phonon interaction of strength V/2π = -43 MHz, which primarily leads to phonon amplification. At the magnon-phonon resonance, we find predominantly unidirectional energy flow from magnons to phonons while the possible back-action is limited by kinetic losses of coherent magnons. Our study enables direct interfacing of collective magnetic excitations with sound and light in layered van der Waals materials, paving the way for quantum-coherent transduction in the GHz range with optical readout.
articles.abstract_zh: 层状反铁磁体 CrSBr 具有自杂化激子极化子，可与相干磁振子和声子参数耦合。在这项工作中，我们探索了悬浮 CrSBr 膜中这些准粒子之间的三重光机械相互作用，支持高 Q 呼吸型声子模式。使用极化子态的共振泵浦探针光谱，我们解决了 simeq 20 GHz 范围内的耦合动力学，同时使用外部磁场在声子共振上扫描磁振子模式。我们观察到强度为 V/2π = -43 MHz 的有吸引力的磁振子-声子相互作用，这主要导致声子放大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状反铁磁体 CrSBr 具有自杂化激子极化子，可与相干磁振子和声子参数耦合。在这项工作中，我们探索了悬浮 CrSBr 膜中这些准粒子之间的三重光机械相互作用，支持高 Q 呼吸型声子模式。使用极化子态的共振泵浦探针光谱，我们解决了 simeq 20 GHz 范围内的耦合动力学，同时使用外部磁场在声子共振上扫描磁振子模式。我们观察到强度为 V/2π = -43 MHz 的有吸引力的磁振子-声子相互作用，这主要导致声子放大。在磁振子-声子共振中，我们发现主要是从磁振子到声子的单向能量流，而可能的反作用受到相干磁振子的动能损失的限制。我们的研究使得集体磁激发与层状范德华材料中的声音和光直接连接，为在 GHz 范围内通过光学读出进行量子相干转导铺平了道路。

articles.title: Magnetic tuning of odd elastic instabilities in chiral active crystals
articles.title_zh: 手性活性晶体奇弹性不稳定性的磁调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamical properties of an odd active crystal whose elementary units follow an inertial dynamics and experience a Lorentz force induced by an external magnetic field. The continuous injection of energy associated with active chirality gives rise to odd elasticity, manifested through transverse forces between the crystal constituents. We show that the interplay between the magnetic field and these transverse forces produces a distinctive long-wavelength instability at vanishing wavevector, which is absent in both non-magnetic elastic crystals and passive crystals subjected to a magnetic field. Moreover, the magnetic field provides a means of tuning the collective oscillations of the crystal, enabling the emergence of exceptional points and tuning the dynamical instability induced by odd elasticity at finite wavevectors. Our analytical results yield explicit predictions for the displacement spectrum, static structure factor, and intermediate scattering function. These findings suggest that magnetic fields could provide a powerful tool for controlling collective phenomena in high-density systems of granular or colloidal spinners.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了奇数活性晶体的动力学特性，其基本单元遵循惯性动力学并经历由外部磁场引起的洛伦兹力。与活性手性相关的能量的连续注入会产生奇数弹性，这通过晶体成分之间的横向力表现出来。我们表明，磁场和这些横向力之间的相互作用在消失波矢处产生了独特的长波长不稳定性，这在非磁性弹性晶体和受到磁场作用的无源晶体中都不存在。此外，磁场提供了一种调节晶体集体振荡的方法，能够出现异常点并调节有限波矢处奇弹性引起的动态不稳定性。我们的分析结果对位移谱、静态结构因子和中间散射函数进行了明确的预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了奇数活性晶体的动力学特性，其基本单元遵循惯性动力学并经历由外部磁场引起的洛伦兹力。与活性手性相关的能量的连续注入会产生奇数弹性，这通过晶体成分之间的横向力表现出来。我们表明，磁场和这些横向力之间的相互作用在消失波矢处产生了独特的长波长不稳定性，这在非磁性弹性晶体和受到磁场作用的无源晶体中都不存在。此外，磁场提供了一种调节晶体集体振荡的方法，能够出现异常点并调节有限波矢处奇弹性引起的动态不稳定性。我们的分析结果对位移谱、静态结构因子和中间散射函数进行了明确的预测。这些发现表明，磁场可以为控制颗粒或胶体旋转体高密度系统中的集体现象提供强大的工具。

articles.title: Dynamics and transport in LiF using classical and machine learned interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 使用经典和机器学习的原子间势研究 LiF 中的动力学和传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this we compare the melting points of these potentials. We find that the machine-learnt potentials address the significant underestimation of the melting point of the classical potentials, though the refined potential and the foundation model differ significantly between themselves. We probe the microscopic structure and dynamics of each model to further elucidate the considerable change in viscosity between classical and machine-learnt potentials. We find that, despite their lower melting temperature, classical potentials produce considerably stiffer, higher frequency, single-particle and collective charge-transport dynamics on account of their fixed charges. However, in the long-wavelength limit, the many-body machine-learnt potentials feature more elastic collective motion that governs the diffusion of momentum and is therefore responsible for the enhanced shear viscosity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对熔融氟化锂进行分子动力学模拟，将经典的 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势与机器学习的原子间势 - MACE-MP-0b3（小）基础模型势及其微调版本进行比较。我们发现，开箱即用的 MACE-MP-0b3 能够准确地再现与可极化电势相当的液态实验剪切粘度，尽管它本身不是可极化的。以前使用经典势计算的粘度预测不足，这归因于熔化温度受到抑制。受此启发，我们比较了这些电势的熔点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对熔融氟化锂进行分子动力学模拟，将经典的 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势与机器学习的原子间势 - MACE-MP-0b3（小）基础模型势及其微调版本进行比较。我们发现，开箱即用的 MACE-MP-0b3 能够准确地再现与可极化电势相当的液态实验剪切粘度，尽管它本身不是可极化的。以前使用经典势计算的粘度预测不足，这归因于熔化温度受到抑制。受此启发，我们比较了这些电势的熔点。我们发现机器学习势解决了经典势熔点的显着低估问题，尽管精炼势和基础模型之间存在显着差异。我们探讨了每个模型的微观结构和动力学，以进一步阐明经典势和机器学习势之间粘度的显着变化。我们发现，尽管它们的熔化温度较低，但经典势由于其固定电荷而产生相当僵硬、频率更高的单粒子和集体电荷传输动力学。然而，在长波长限制下，多体机器学习势具有更具弹性的集体运动，它控制动量的扩散，因此导致剪切粘度增强。

articles.title: quantEM: Quantitative Electron Microscopy Analysis from Differentiable Physics to Neural Priors
articles.title_zh: quantEM：从可微分物理到神经先验的定量电子显微镜分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantitative electron microscopy includes imaging, diffraction, spectroscopy, and tomography measurements, and the analysis of these measurements increasingly requires solving inverse problems with physical forward models. Open-source software has made many of these analyses widely available, but most packages are organized around a single modality, so that multimodal analyses require moving data between packages, and new methods cannot easily reuse the physical models and optimizers of existing ones. Here we present quantEM, an open-source Python package for quantitative electron microscopy that uses PyTorch tensors for computation and automatic differentiation, and Zarr for storage. We implement each analysis method by writing a differentiable forward model and choosing a representation, loss function, constraints, and optimizer from a library of components, so that every method runs on CPUs and GPUs, can be saved and resumed, and uses the same calibrated data structures and visualization tools. We describe the current modules, including orientation and strain mapping, direct and iterative ptychography, tomography with neural representations, and X-ray and electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and show how we assemble combined methods such as ptychographic tomography from existing components. quantEM is available under the MIT license, together with documentation, tutorials, and curated example datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 定量电子显微镜包括成像、衍射、光谱和断层扫描测量，这些测量的分析越来越需要用物理正演模型解决反演问题。开源软件已使许多此类分析得到广泛应用，但大多数包都是围绕单一模态组织的，因此多模态分析需要在包之间移动数据，并且新方法无法轻松重用现有方法的物理模型和优化器。在这里，我们展示了 quantEM，这是一个用于定量电子显微镜的开源 Python 包，它使用 PyTorch 张量进行计算和自动微分，并使用 Zarr 进行存储。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 定量电子显微镜包括成像、衍射、光谱和断层扫描测量，这些测量的分析越来越需要用物理正演模型解决反演问题。开源软件已使许多此类分析得到广泛应用，但大多数包都是围绕单一模态组织的，因此多模态分析需要在包之间移动数据，并且新方法无法轻松重用现有方法的物理模型和优化器。在这里，我们展示了 quantEM，这是一个用于定量电子显微镜的开源 Python 包，它使用 PyTorch 张量进行计算和自动微分，并使用 Zarr 进行存储。我们通过编写可微分的前向模型并从组件库中选择表示、损失函数、约束和优化器来实现每种分析方法，以便每种方法都在 CPU 和 GPU 上运行，可以保存和恢复，并使用相同的校准数据结构和可视化工具。我们描述了当前的模块，包括方向和应变映射、直接和迭代叠层成像、具有神经表示的断层扫描以及 X 射线和电子能量损失光谱，并展示了我们如何从现有组件中组装组合方法，例如叠层成像。 QuantEM 可在 MIT 许可下使用，并附有文档、教程和精选示例数据集。

articles.title: Ultrafast imprinting of fused ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic skyrmions
articles.title_zh: 熔融铁磁/反铁磁斯格明子的超快印记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are promising topologically protected entities for robust storage and THz transport of information. Their generation has so far relied on slow techniques or on specific magnetic structures, which limit their integration into spintronic devices. Here, we demonstrate the imprinting of antiferromagnetic skyrmions within a few picoseconds in a coupled ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic bilayer with a thermal laser pulse. We identify a threshold energy required to initiate the fused skyrmion phase and show that this can be modulated by a magnetic field, enabling deterministic nucleation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions. Compared to conventional slow field-cooling processes to control antiferromagnets we show that laser-induced skyrmion imprinting can be orders of magnitude faster and provides an experimentally feasible route towards ultrafast creation and manipulation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁斯格明子是有前景的拓扑保护实体，可用于稳健的信息存储和太赫兹传输。迄今为止，它们的一代依赖于缓慢的技术或特定的磁性结构，这限制了它们与自旋电子器件的集成。在这里，我们演示了用热激光脉冲在几皮秒内将反铁磁斯格明子压印在耦合的铁磁/反铁磁双层中。我们确定了启动熔融斯格明子相所需的阈值能量，并表明这可以通过磁场进行调制，从而实现反铁磁斯格明子的确定性成核。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁斯格明子是有前景的拓扑保护实体，可用于稳健的信息存储和太赫兹传输。迄今为止，它们的一代依赖于缓慢的技术或特定的磁性结构，这限制了它们与自旋电子器件的集成。在这里，我们演示了用热激光脉冲在几皮秒内将反铁磁斯格明子压印在耦合的铁磁/反铁磁双层中。我们确定了启动熔融斯格明子相所需的阈值能量，并表明这可以通过磁场进行调制，从而实现反铁磁斯格明子的确定性成核。与控制反铁磁体的传统慢速场冷却过程相比，我们表明激光诱导的斯格明子压印速度可以快几个数量级，并为超快创建和操纵反铁磁斯格明子提供了一条实验上可行的途径。

articles.title: Weight-Space Programming for Materials Science
articles.title_zh: 材料科学的权重空间规划
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A materials discovery campaign often begins with almost no measurements of the property it is searching for, and the models that rank candidates or screen the output of a generator then have to be built from those first few labels. Following recent work on weight-space programming, in which a language model writes the weights of a small network directly as text, we show that a general-purpose model, given the task in words, the names of the inputs and a network of 16 hidden units with every weight set to zero, can provide this starting point by filling in all of the weights from what it has learned about materials. With no labels, the networks of the strongest model rank experimental alloys at Spearman co-efficient = 0.64 to 0.79, where the best of five simple descriptors reaches 0.47 to 0.62. They rank the bulk modulus of crystals added during generative discovery loops at 0.95, where the inverse volume per atom reaches 0.89, and 35 phase-equilibrium targets computed with Thermo-Calc at a mean of 0.67, close to the 0.70 of an extrapolation from calculated binary and ternary data. As the prior mean of a Gaussian process they raise the ranking at five labels from 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and from 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals, and they lower the regret of Bayesian optimization significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks and on 13 to 16 of 33 computed targets, depending on how multiple tests are corrected, without raising it significantly on any. The same networks also serve as the mean of a Bayesian neural network and as a screen for the samples of two crystal generators, where they do as well as standard models trained on 400 labeled structures. The gain is confined to the first tens of labels and to targets that no rule or sub-system extrapolation already ranks.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料发现活动通常从几乎没有对其正在搜索的属性进行测量开始，然后必须根据前几个标签来构建对候选材料进行排名或筛选生成器输出的模型。最近关于权重空间编程的工作，其中语言模型将小型网络的权重直接写为文本，我们表明，一个通用模型，给定单词任务、输入名称和一个由 16 个隐藏单元组成的网络，每个权重设置为零，可以通过填充从材料中学到的所有权重来提供这个起点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料发现活动通常从几乎没有对其正在搜索的属性进行测量开始，然后必须根据前几个标签来构建对候选材料进行排名或筛选生成器输出的模型。最近关于权重空间编程的工作，其中语言模型将小型网络的权重直接写为文本，我们表明，一个通用模型，给定单词任务、输入名称和一个由 16 个隐藏单元组成的网络，每个权重设置为零，可以通过填充从材料中学到的所有权重来提供这个起点。在没有标签的情况下，最强模型的网络将实验合金排序为 Spearman 系数 = 0.64 至 0.79，其中五个简单描述符中最好的达到 0.47 至 0.62。他们将生成发现循环期间添加的晶体的体积模量排名为 0.95，其中每个原子的反体积达到 0.89，使用 Thermo-Calc 计算的 35 个相平衡目标的平均值为 0.67，接近从计算的二元和三元数据推断的 0.70。作为高斯过程的先验平均值，他们将合金上的五个标签的排名从 0.35 提高到 0.69，将晶体上的排名从 0.15 提高到 0.95，并且在 5 个实验任务中的 4 个和 33 个计算目标中的 13 到 16 个上显着降低了贝叶斯优化的遗憾，具体取决于多个测试的校正方式，但没有显着提高任何测试的遗憾。相同的网络还充当贝叶斯神经网络的平均值，并作为两个晶体发生器样本的筛选，它们的作用以及在 400 个标记结构上训练的标准模型。增益仅限于前十个标签以及没有规则或子系统外推已经排名的目标。

articles.title: Coexisting orders and dipolar Luttinger liquids in Z_N quantum torus chain
articles.title_zh: Z_N量子环链中的共存序和偶极卢廷格液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a unified ground-state phase diagram for the one-dimensional Z_N quantum torus chain, which is connected to dipolar cluster and dipolar Ising chains via noninvertible dualities. Combining tensor-network calculations with bosonization and perturbation theory, we establish a rich phase diagram governed by the local Hilbert-space dimension N and its parity. We identify phases with coexisting X and Z long-range orders (C phase), and dipolar Luttinger liquids (dLLᵣₘ I and dLLᵣₘ II) separating coexisting phases from single-order phases. Gapless dipolar excitations coexist with long-range order in dLLs. Both the C and dLL phases appear at N ≥ 5, but only the C phases persist as N→ infty. The stability of the dLL phase is understood by an emergent Luttinger liquid theory, with Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions out of it driven by competing umklapp and clock anisotropy perturbations. For odd N ≥ 5, a third dLL phase (dLLᵣₘ III) emerges near θ = π due to the low-energy dynamics inside the exponentially degenerate ground-state manifold that maps onto an effective XXZ chain. Duality considerations suggest a possible gapless dipolar symmetry-protected topological phase and spontaneous dipole-symmetry breaking in dipolar cluster chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一维Z_N量子环链的统一基态相图，该链通过不可逆对偶性连接到偶极簇和偶极Ising链。将张量网络计算与玻色子化和微扰理论相结合，我们建立了由局部希尔伯特空间维数 N 及其宇称控制的丰富相图。我们识别了共存 X 和 Z 长程有序相（C 相），以及将共存相与单阶相分开的偶极 Luttinger 液体（dLLᵣₘ I 和 dLLᵣₘ II）。无间隙偶极激发与 dLL 中的长程有序共存。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一维Z_N量子环链的统一基态相图，该链通过不可逆对偶性连接到偶极簇和偶极Ising链。将张量网络计算与玻色子化和微扰理论相结合，我们建立了由局部希尔伯特空间维数 N 及其宇称控制的丰富相图。我们识别了共存 X 和 Z 长程有序相（C 相），以及将共存相与单阶相分开的偶极 Luttinger 液体（dLLᵣₘ I 和 dLLᵣₘ II）。无间隙偶极激发与 dLL 中的长程有序共存。 C 和 dLL 相均出现在 N ≥ 5 时，但只有 C 相在 N→ infty 时持续存在。 dLL 相的稳定性可以通过新兴的 Luttinger 液体理论来理解，其中由竞争性 umklapp 和时钟各向异性扰动驱动的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变。对于奇数 N ≥ 5，由于映射到有效 XXZ 链的指数简并基态流形内部的低能动力学，在 θ = π 附近出现第三个 dLL 相 (dLLᵣₘ III)。对偶性考虑表明偶极簇链中可能存在无间隙偶极对称保护的拓扑相和自发偶极对称破缺。

articles.title: Second Harmonic Flexoelectricity
articles.title_zh: 二次谐波柔性电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flexoelectricity (polarization induced by strain gradients) is assumed to be insensitive to space inversion in all materials: flexoelectric polarization should not depend on whether a crystal is bent upwards or downwards. In this work, we show that this assumption is wrong for ferroelectrics of all thickness and at all curvatures, owing to an intrinsic quadratic contribution that persists down to strain gradients of 1 m-1 or less, which is millions of times smaller than conventional expectations for nonlinear flexoelectricity. As a consequence, ferroelectric crystals can generate second-harmonic voltage at twice the oscillation frequency of the bending.
articles.abstract_zh: 假设弯曲电性（由应变梯度引起的极化）对所有材料中的空间反转不敏感：弯曲电性极化不应取决于晶体是向上还是向下弯曲。在这项工作中，我们表明，这种假设对于所有厚度和所有曲率的铁电体来说都是错误的，因为内在的二次贡献一直持续到 1 m-1 或更小的应变梯度，这比非线性挠曲电的传统预期小数百万倍。因此，铁电晶体可以产生两倍于弯曲振荡频率的二次谐波电压。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 假设弯曲电性（由应变梯度引起的极化）对所有材料中的空间反转不敏感：弯曲电性极化不应取决于晶体是向上还是向下弯曲。在这项工作中，我们表明，这种假设对于所有厚度和所有曲率的铁电体来说都是错误的，因为内在的二次贡献一直持续到 1 m-1 或更小的应变梯度，这比非线性挠曲电的传统预期小数百万倍。因此，铁电晶体可以产生两倍于弯曲振荡频率的二次谐波电压。

articles.title: Supercell periodicity biases octahedral tilting and energetics in high-entropy perovskite oxides
articles.title_zh: 超晶胞周期性使高熵钙钛矿氧化物中的八面体倾斜和能量学产生偏差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-period supercells such as 3 × 3 × 5 are often used for equimolar five-component compositions in computational studies of high-entropy perovskite oxides (HEPOs). However, such cells are known to constrain octahedral tilting because they cannot accommodate all standard tilt patterns (Glazer tilt systems). How strongly this constraint affects HEPOs, whose octahedra respond to local cation environments, remains unclear. Here we show that supercell periodicity systematically biases computed octahedral tilting and energetics. Using a machine-learning interatomic potential, we compared odd-period and tilt-commensurate cells for 13 HEPOs. Odd-period cells yielded smaller and less coherent tilts and higher energies, even after configurational averaging. In ~1,700-atom cells, tilt differences persisted in all compositions and energy differences in most. The bias extended to defects, with lower oxygen vacancy formation energies in odd-period cells for strongly tilted compositions. Based on these findings, a simple design rule for equimolar supercells is proposed to lift this constraint.
articles.abstract_zh: 在高熵钙钛矿氧化物 (HEPO) 的计算研究中，奇数周期超级晶胞（例如 3 × 3 × 5）通常用于等摩尔五组分组合物。然而，已知此类单元会限制八面体倾斜，因为它们无法适应所有标准倾斜模式（Glazer 倾斜系统）。这种限制对 HEPO 的影响有多大，其八面体对局部阳离子环境有反应，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明超晶胞周期性系统地偏置计算的八面体倾斜和能量学。使用机器学习原子间势，我们比较了 13 个 HEPO 的奇数周期和倾斜相当细胞。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在高熵钙钛矿氧化物 (HEPO) 的计算研究中，奇数周期超级晶胞（例如 3 × 3 × 5）通常用于等摩尔五组分组合物。然而，已知此类单元会限制八面体倾斜，因为它们无法适应所有标准倾斜模式（Glazer 倾斜系统）。这种限制对 HEPO 的影响有多大，其八面体对局部阳离子环境有反应，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明超晶胞周期性系统地偏置计算的八面体倾斜和能量学。使用机器学习原子间势，我们比较了 13 个 HEPO 的奇数周期和倾斜相当细胞。即使在构型平均之后，奇数周期电池也会产生更小、更不相干的倾斜和更高的能量。在约 1,700 个原子的细胞中，所有成分中都存在倾斜差异，大多数成分中都存在能量差异。这种偏差延伸到了缺陷，奇数周期晶胞中强烈倾斜的成分具有较低的氧空位形成能。基于这些发现，提出了一种简单的等摩尔超晶胞设计规则来解除这一限制。

articles.title: Quantum Interband-Coherence-Driven Inverse Faraday Effect in Intrinsic Graphene
articles.title_zh: 本征石墨烯中量子带间相干驱动的逆法拉第效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The inverse Faraday effect converts the angular momentum of circularly polarized light into a quasistatic magnetization, providing a fundamental route to ultrafast optical control of magnetic fields. We develop an analytical quantum theory of this effect in intrinsic graphene, where massless Dirac fermions, electron-hole symmetry, and weak spin-orbit coupling suppress conventional population-based interpretations. We show that in intrinsic graphene, the helicity-dependent orbital magnetization arises from the off-diagonal zero-harmonic component of the second-order density matrix, rather than from intraband carrier circulation or diagonal population imbalance. We obtain closed expressions for the induced temporal surface magnetization, its finite-pulse dynamics, and the nonlocal stray magnetic field generated by the two-dimensional (2D) source. Optical helicity, frequency, pulse envelope, and beam profile independently control the response. Our results identify intrinsic graphene as an ideal platform for coherent orbital optomagnetism in 2D Dirac matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 反法拉第效应将圆偏振光的角动量转换为准静态磁化强度，为磁场的超快光学控制提供了基本途径。我们开发了一种关于本征石墨烯中这种效应的分析量子理论，其中无质量狄拉克费米子、电子空穴对称性和弱自旋轨道耦合抑制了传统的基于粒子群的解释。我们表明，在本征石墨烯中，螺旋性相关的轨道磁化强度来自二阶密度矩阵的非对角零谐波分量，而不是来自带内载流子循环或对角布居不平衡。我们获得了感应时间表面磁化强度、其有限脉冲动力学以及二维 (2D) 源生成的非局部杂散磁场的闭合表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反法拉第效应将圆偏振光的角动量转换为准静态磁化强度，为磁场的超快光学控制提供了基本途径。我们开发了一种关于本征石墨烯中这种效应的分析量子理论，其中无质量狄拉克费米子、电子空穴对称性和弱自旋轨道耦合抑制了传统的基于粒子群的解释。我们表明，在本征石墨烯中，螺旋性相关的轨道磁化强度来自二阶密度矩阵的非对角零谐波分量，而不是来自带内载流子循环或对角布居不平衡。我们获得了感应时间表面磁化强度、其有限脉冲动力学以及二维 (2D) 源生成的非局部杂散磁场的闭合表达式。光学螺旋度、频率、脉冲包络和光束轮廓独立地控制响应。我们的结果表明，内在石墨烯是二维狄拉克物质中相干轨道光磁的理想平台。

articles.title: Complex mobility edges from competing localization channels in non-Hermitian quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 非厄米准晶中竞争定位通道的复杂迁移率边缘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Hermitian localization transitions often accompany multiple mobility edges, but their physical origin can be ambiguous. To address the issue, we introduce an extension of the Ganeshan-Pixley-Das Sarma model with both asymmetric hopping and complex onsite potential, thereby incorporating a broad range of non-Hermitian quasiperiodic chains. Its solution reveals two energy-dependent localization contributions manifested as distinct Lyapunov growth scales, whose competition determines the structure of mobility edges. We derive exact Lyapunov exponents via Avila's global theory, obtain thresholds of the two channels on complex-energy plane, and formulate a selection rule that distinguishes physical mobility edges from suppressed analytical candidates. The channel that uniquely controls localization can switch with energy, producing complex mobility edges of non-Hermitian origins. Nonreciprocal hopping further shifts the thresholds and alters the bulk energy patterns. Numerical spectra and finite-size localization diagnostics confirm the theory. Our work thus provides a unified framework for characterizing phase transitions and mobility edges under competing localization mechanisms in non-Hermitian quasicrystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米局部化转变通常伴随多个移动边缘，但它们的物理起源可能不明确。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Ganeshan-Pixley-Das Sarma 模型的扩展，该模型具有不对称跳跃和复杂的现场势，从而合并了广泛的非厄米准周期链。其解决方案揭示了两种依赖于能量的局域化贡献，表现为不同的李雅普诺夫生长尺度，其竞争决定了移动边缘的结构。我们通过阿维拉的全局理论推导出精确的李亚普诺夫指数，获得复能量平面上两个通道的阈值，并制定一个选择规则来区分物理移动性边缘和受抑制的分析候选者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米局部化转变通常伴随多个移动边缘，但它们的物理起源可能不明确。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Ganeshan-Pixley-Das Sarma 模型的扩展，该模型具有不对称跳跃和复杂的现场势，从而合并了广泛的非厄米准周期链。其解决方案揭示了两种依赖于能量的局域化贡献，表现为不同的李雅普诺夫生长尺度，其竞争决定了移动边缘的结构。我们通过阿维拉的全局理论推导出精确的李亚普诺夫指数，获得复能量平面上两个通道的阈值，并制定一个选择规则来区分物理移动性边缘和受抑制的分析候选者。唯一控制定位的通道可以随能量切换，产生非厄米起源的复杂移动边缘。非互易跳跃进一步改变阈值并改变体能量模式。数值谱和有限尺寸定位诊断证实了这一理论。因此，我们的工作提供了一个统一的框架，用于表征非厄米准晶的竞争局域化机制下的相变和迁移边缘。

articles.title: Assessment of electric-field-induced forces for bulk solids within the projector-augmented wave method
articles.title_zh: 使用投影仪增强波方法评估散装固体的电场感应力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We assess the performance of electric-field-induced forces for bulk solids within the projector-augmented wave method. This capability allows for first-principles structural relaxations of bulk semiconductors and insulators under external electric fields, thereby enabling the calculation of linear and nonlinear responses to electric fields as well as properties associated with electric-field-driven structural changes. The approach is first validated by presenting calculated ion-clamped and unclamped dielectric and piezoelectric constants, quadratic dielectric susceptibilities, and Born effective charges for semiconductors AlX (X=P, As and Sb), showing good agreement with density functional perturbation theory calculations as well as with available experimental and theoretical data. As a further demonstration, we examine the electric-field-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric phase transition in AgNbO₃, for which our computed polarization versus electric field hysteresis loop aligns with previous calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们评估了投影仪增强波方法中散装固体的电场感应力的性能。这种能力允许在外部电场下体半导体和绝缘体的第一原理结构松弛，从而能够计算对电场的线性和非线性响应以及与电场驱动的结构变化相关的属性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们评估了投影仪增强波方法中散装固体的电场感应力的性能。这种能力允许在外部电场下体半导体和绝缘体的第一原理结构松弛，从而能够计算对电场的线性和非线性响应以及与电场驱动的结构变化相关的属性。 The approach is first validated by presenting calculated ion-clamped and unclamped dielectric and piezoelectric constants, quadratic dielectric susceptibilities, and Born effective charges for semiconductors AlX (X=P, As and Sb), showing good agreement with density functional perturbation theory calculations as well as with available experimental and theoretical data.作为进一步的演示，我们研究了 AgNbO₃ 中电场驱动的反铁电到铁电相变，为此我们计算的极化与电场磁滞回线与之前的计算一致。

articles.title: Magnetic History and Field Sweep Rate Effects on Transformation Hysteresis in Ni₄₁Co₉Mn₃₁.₅Ga₁₈.₅
articles.title_zh: 磁史和扫场速率对 Ni41Co9Mn31.5Ga18.5 相变磁滞的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hysteresis in magnetic-field-induced structural phase transformations is a major obstacle to the application of metamagnetic shape memory alloys. One promising approach to reduce hysteresis is to utilize a metastable martensitic state generated by magnetic-field cycling. However, the mechanism by which the metastable state reduces hysteresis remains unclear. Here, microsecond pulsed-field magnetization measurements are used to investigate the transformation kinetics of Ni₄₁Co₉Mn₃₁.₅Ga₁₈.₅. Magnetic-field cycling reduces the hysteresis width by approximately 50-60%, demonstrating that substantial suppression persists on a microsecond timescale. Comparison with millisecond pulsed-field measurements suggests that the reverse martensitic transformation field is more sensitive to the field sweep rate for the metastable martensite than for the initial martensite. Possible explanations include enhanced thermal activation associated with a lower effective activation barrier and differences in the athermal contribution arising from different metastable martensitic microstructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁场引起的结构相变中的磁滞是变磁形状记忆合金应用的主要障碍。减少磁滞的一种有前途的方法是利用磁场循环产生的亚稳态马氏体状态。然而，亚稳态减少滞后的机制仍不清楚。这里，微秒脉冲场磁化测量用于研究 Ni41Co9Mn31.5Ga18.5 的转变动力学。磁场循环将磁滞宽度减小了约 50-60%，表明在微秒时间尺度内仍存在显着的抑制。与毫秒脉冲场测量的比较表明，与初始马氏体相比，逆马氏体相变场对亚稳态马氏体的场扫描速率更敏感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁场引起的结构相变中的磁滞是变磁形状记忆合金应用的主要障碍。减少磁滞的一种有前途的方法是利用磁场循环产生的亚稳态马氏体状态。然而，亚稳态减少滞后的机制仍不清楚。这里，微秒脉冲场磁化测量用于研究 Ni41Co9Mn31.5Ga18.5 的转变动力学。磁场循环将磁滞宽度减小了约 50-60%，表明在微秒时间尺度内仍存在显着的抑制。与毫秒脉冲场测量的比较表明，与初始马氏体相比，逆马氏体相变场对亚稳态马氏体的场扫描速率更敏感。可能的解释包括与较低的有效激活势垒相关的热激活增强以及不同亚稳态马氏体微观结构引起的非热贡献差异。

articles.title: Efficient Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 高效的机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) reach an accuracy close to quantum mechanical reference calculations at a small fraction of the cost. Efficiency is the purpose of MLIPs, yet strategies for efficient MLIPs have not been reviewed systematically. This review takes efficiency as its guideline. To compare MLIPs on a common footing, we represent them in a complete basis expansion, the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE). The expansion is canonical, built from products of single-particle functions. Classical interatomic potentials, such as the embedded-atom method, and many modern MLIPs, including equivariant transformers, can be represented within this expansion. Much of the apparent diversity of MLIP architectures therefore reflects how non-linearity, layer coupling and optimization are handled rather than which interactions the models can represent. We show how the cost of an MLIP becomes linear in system size and, at fixed rank of the tensor decomposition, in model complexity, and we discuss the role of machine learning, which provides non-linear parameterizations and optimization. Because efficiency is meaningful only at a given accuracy, we also compare accuracy and cost. On the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, models with three to five layers approach the accuracy of deeper models, and one basis, truncated along the Pareto front of error and speed, spans more than two orders of magnitude in cost. Ultimately, training data determine the quality of any MLIP.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的精度接近量子力学参考计算，而成本仅为其一小部分。效率是多层投资计划的目的，但高效多层投资计划的策略尚未得到系统的审查。本次审查以效率为指导方针。为了在共同基础上比较 MLIP，我们用完整的基础扩展、原子簇扩展 (ACE) 及其图泛化 (GRACE) 来表示它们。该展开式是规范的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建。经典的原子间势（例如嵌入原子方法）和许多现代 MLIP（包括等变变压器）可以在此展开中表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的精度接近量子力学参考计算，而成本仅为其一小部分。效率是多层投资计划的目的，但高效多层投资计划的策略尚未得到系统的审查。本次审查以效率为指导方针。为了在共同基础上比较 MLIP，我们用完整的基础扩展、原子簇扩展 (ACE) 及其图泛化 (GRACE) 来表示它们。该展开式是规范的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建。经典的原子间势（例如嵌入原子方法）和许多现代 MLIP（包括等变变压器）可以在此展开中表示。因此，MLIP 架构的许多明显多样性反映了如何处理非线性、层耦合和优化，而不是模型可以表示哪些交互。我们展示了 MLIP 的成本如何在系统规模上以及在张量分解的固定秩下在模型复杂度上变得线性，并且我们讨论了机器学习的作用，它提供了非线性参数化和优化。由于效率仅在给定精度下才有意义，因此我们还比较了精度和成本。在 Matbench Discovery 排行榜上，三到五层的模型接近更深层次模型的精度，而一个基础（沿着误差和速度的 Pareto 前沿截断）的成本跨越两个数量级以上。最终，训练数据决定了任何 MLIP 的质量。

articles.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Domain Walls on a Racetrack: Impact of Inhomogeneity of Magnetic Anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 赛道上磁畴壁的随机动力学：磁各向异性不均匀性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Racetrack memory is a spintronic technology that stores information in current-driven magnetic domain walls (DW), offering a promising route toward non-volatile, high-density, and high-speed memory devices. In ultrathin magnetic films, atomic-scale interface disorder can produce spatially inhomogeneous magnetic anisotropy, creating a complex spatially varying energy landscape that strongly influences DW motion. In this work, we model anisotropy inhomogeneities using a two-dimensional fractal Weierstrass--Mandelbrot function, which provides independent control over the disorder amplitude and characteristic spatial scale. Micromagnetic simulations reveal pronounced stochasticity of current-driven domain-wall transport even in the absence of thermal fluctuations. Transport is quantified by the transmission fraction, defined as the fraction of DWs that successfully reach a detector after propagating through a disordered racetrack. We investigate its dependence on current density, disorder amplitude, and the spatial scale of the anisotropy inhomogeneity. The resulting transmission statistics are described by Gaussian error-function profiles and exhibit a universal scaling behavior upon normalization by the corresponding median values. Statistical analysis of DW trajectories further characterizes the disorder-induced fluctuations of the propagation process. The variance of the random DW positions shows a pronounced dependence on disorder amplitude and is well described by the proposed phenomenological model. These results provide a quantitative framework for describing stochastic DW transport in structurally disordered racetracks and establish disorder-induced reliability limits in racetrack-memory devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 赛道存储器是一种自旋电子技术，可将信息存储在电流驱动的磁畴壁 (DW) 中，为实现非易失性、高密度和高速存储设备提供了一条有前途的途径。在超薄磁性薄膜中，原子尺度的界面无序会产生空间不均匀的磁各向异性，从而形成复杂的空间变化能量景观，强烈影响 DW 运动。在这项工作中，我们使用二维分形 Weierstrass-Mandelbrot 函数对各向异性不均匀性进行建模，该函数提供对无序幅度和特征空间尺度的独立控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赛道存储器是一种自旋电子技术，可将信息存储在电流驱动的磁畴壁 (DW) 中，为实现非易失性、高密度和高速存储设备提供了一条有前途的途径。在超薄磁性薄膜中，原子尺度的界面无序会产生空间不均匀的磁各向异性，从而形成复杂的空间变化能量景观，强烈影响 DW 运动。在这项工作中，我们使用二维分形 Weierstrass-Mandelbrot 函数对各向异性不均匀性进行建模，该函数提供对无序幅度和特征空间尺度的独立控制。微磁模拟揭示了即使在没有热波动的情况下电流驱动的畴壁传输也具有明显的随机性。传输通过传输分数来量化，传输分数定义为通过无序跑道传播后成功到达检测器的 DW 的分数。我们研究了它对电流密度、无序幅度和各向异性不均匀性的空间尺度的依赖性。所得的传输统计数据由高斯误差函数轮廓描述，并在通过相应的中值归一化后表现出通用的缩放行为。 DW 轨迹的统计分析进一步表征了传播过程中无序引起的波动。随机 DW 位置的方差显示出对无序幅度的明显依赖性，并且由所提出的唯象模型很好地描述了。这些结果提供了一个定量框架，用于描述结构无序赛道中的随机 DW 传输，并在赛道存储设备中建立无序引起的可靠性限制。

articles.title: Orbital differentiation in a rare earth ion near half filling
articles.title_zh: 稀土离子接近半填充时的轨道分化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the electronic structure of rare earth ions, details can be crucial for understanding the origin of correlated states. Currently, state-of-the-art wavefunction-based methods (e.g. CASSCF) can capture single-ion properties of molecular magnets and some band insulating systems, but are expensive to perform, and cannot be applied to metallic systems. Here, we carry out full multiplet calculations for SmN with the cubic rock-salt structure using the crystal field software Quanty. The calculated experimental observables from our model agree precisely with magnetic susceptibility and inelastic neutron scattering experiments, and the spatially resolved spin density also agrees with DFT predictions. By tuning the crystal field parameters, our full multiplet-derived wavefunctions reveal the presence of orbital differentiation of the ground J=frac52 manifold into two groups, which are distinct subspaces with different orbital stiffness. This violation of Hund's rule, observed with a fast and inexpensive calculation tool, represents a step forward for microscopic models of rare earth materials, and may provide support for the claim of unconventional triplet superconductivity in SmN.
articles.abstract_zh: 在稀土离子的电子结构中，细节对于理解相关态的起源至关重要。目前，最先进的基于波函数的方法（例如 CASSCF）可以捕获分子磁体和一些带绝缘系统的单离子特性，但执行成本昂贵，并且不能应用于金属系统。在这里，我们使用晶体场软件Quanty对具有立方岩盐结构的SmN进行了完整的多重计算。我们的模型计算出的实验观测值与磁化率和非弹性中子散射实验完全一致，空间分辨自旋密度也与 DFT 预测一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在稀土离子的电子结构中，细节对于理解相关态的起源至关重要。目前，最先进的基于波函数的方法（例如 CASSCF）可以捕获分子磁体和一些带绝缘系统的单离子特性，但执行成本昂贵，并且不能应用于金属系统。在这里，我们使用晶体场软件Quanty对具有立方岩盐结构的SmN进行了完整的多重计算。我们的模型计算出的实验观测值与磁化率和非弹性中子散射实验完全一致，空间分辨自旋密度也与 DFT 预测一致。通过调整晶体场参数，我们的完整多重态导出波函数揭示了地面 J=frac52 流形的轨道分化存在两组，它们是具有不同轨道刚度的不同子空间。通过快速且廉价的计算工具观察到的这种违反洪德规则的现象代表了稀土材料微观模型的进步，并可能为 SmN 中非常规三线态超导性的主张提供支持。

articles.title: Combined magnetic and structural transition state in first-principles calculations
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理计算中的组合磁和结构过渡态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a generalized nudged elastic band (NEB) implementation within potential-based constrained density-functional theory (cDFT) for calculating transition pathways that simultaneously optimize atomic, lattice, and magnetic degrees of freedom. Unlike standard fixed-cell NEB calculations restricted to atomic displacements, our framework consistently couples atomic forces, stresses, and spin torques. The method supports fixed- and variable-cell approaches for collinear and non- collinear magnetic configurations, by incorporating magnetic torques and generalized cell coordinates within the NEB optimization. To validate the methodology, we present benchmark calculations for representative magnetostructural systems.
