Specifically, we investigate the bcc-to-hcp transformation in Fe and the antiferromagnetic-to-ferromagnetic transition in FeRh using the variable-cell formalism. Furthermore, we examine spin-reversal processes in two-dimensional CrI3 to analyze the influence of spin-orbit coupling on transition paths and their associated energy barriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在基于势的约束密度泛函理论 (cDFT) 中提出了一种广义微推弹性带 (NEB) 实现，用于计算同时优化原子、晶格和磁自由度的转变路径。与仅限于原子位移的标准固定单元 NEB 计算不同，我们的框架始终耦合原子力、应力和自旋扭矩。该方法通过将磁矩和广义单元坐标合并到 NEB 优化中，支持共线和非共线磁配置的固定和可变单元方法。为了验证该方法，我们提出了代表性磁结构系统的基准计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在基于势的约束密度泛函理论 (cDFT) 中提出了一种广义微推弹性带 (NEB) 实现，用于计算同时优化原子、晶格和磁自由度的转变路径。与仅限于原子位移的标准固定单元 NEB 计算不同，我们的框架始终耦合原子力、应力和自旋扭矩。该方法通过将磁矩和广义单元坐标合并到 NEB 优化中，支持共线和非共线磁配置的固定和可变单元方法。为了验证该方法，我们提出了代表性磁结构系统的基准计算。具体来说，我们使用可变晶胞形式研究了 Fe 中的 bcc 到 hcp 转变以及 FeRh 中的反铁磁到铁磁转变。此外，我们还研究了二维 CrI3 中的自旋反转过程，以分析自旋轨道耦合对跃迁路径及其相关能垒的影响。

articles.title: Landscape index and its boundary correspondence in inhomogeneous chiral systems
articles.title_zh: 非齐次手性系统中的景观指数及其边界对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We define a real-space topological index from the geometry of a quadratic landscape associated with the spatial dynamics, which is governed by the zero-energy eigenvalue equation of chiral systems. The landscape index remains invariant under continuous deformations preserving the uniform exponential separation between decaying and growing spatial solutions and equals the continuum winding number in the homogeneous limit. Across an inhomogeneous interface, the difference between the indices on the two sides equals the protected net chiral zero-mode count, without requiring asymptotically homogeneous bulk regions. Explicit landscape constructions yield analytical bounds on Hamiltonian parameters and their spatial gradients that determine the indices for all profiles satisfying these bounds, without specifying their detailed spatial form. Dimensional reduction extends the landscape index and its boundary correspondence to higher-dimensional systems. The resulting bounds guarantee protected radial zero modes in effective Kitaev-type systems of arbitrary transverse codimension and identify parameter and momentum regions supporting chiral edge states in periodically modulated quantum anomalous Hall systems. For the quasiperiodic interface considered, the index difference guarantees a single protected chiral branch despite persistent modulation on both sides, as confirmed by numerical calculations. Landscape geometry thus connects real-space topology to the protected net chirality of boundary states.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们根据与空间动力学相关的二次景观的几何形状定义了实空间拓扑指数，该指数由手性系统的零能量特征值方程控制。景观指数在连续变形下保持不变，保持衰减和增长空间解之间的均匀指数分离，并等于均匀极限中的连续缠绕数。在非均匀界面上，两侧指数之间的差异等于受保护的净手性零模式计数，而不需要渐近均匀的体区域。显式景观构造产生哈密顿参数及其空间梯度的分析界限，确定满足这些界限的所有剖面的指数，而不指定其详细的空间形式。降维将景观指数及其边界对应扩展到更高维度的系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们根据与空间动力学相关的二次景观的几何形状定义了实空间拓扑指数，该指数由手性系统的零能量特征值方程控制。景观指数在连续变形下保持不变，保持衰减和增长空间解之间的均匀指数分离，并等于均匀极限中的连续缠绕数。在非均匀界面上，两侧指数之间的差异等于受保护的净手性零模式计数，而不需要渐近均匀的体区域。显式景观构造产生哈密顿参数及其空间梯度的分析界限，确定满足这些界限的所有剖面的指数，而不指定其详细的空间形式。降维将景观指数及其边界对应扩展到更高维度的系统。由此产生的界限保证了任意横向余维的有效基塔耶夫型系统中受保护的径向零模式，并识别了支持周期性调制量子反常霍尔系统中的手性边缘态的参数和动量区域。对于所考虑的准周期界面，指数差异保证了单个受保护的手性分支，尽管两侧都有持续调制，正如数值计算所证实的。因此，景观几何将真实空间拓扑与边界态受保护的净手性联系起来。

articles.title: Koopmans spectral functionals for excitons in materials
articles.title_zh: 材料中激子的库普曼谱泛函
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate first-principles characterization of excitons typically relies on the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) combined with quasiparticle energies from computationally demanding GW calculations. Here, we replace the GW step with quasiparticle energies from Koopmans-compliant spectral functionals, an approach we call BSE@qKI, and implement it in an automated, reproducible AiiDA workflow. For a set of benchmark semiconductors, BSE@qKI reproduces experimental band gaps and first exciton energies with mean absolute relative errors of 13% and 4%, respectively, comparable to BSE@G0W0 for the gaps and markedly better for the excitation energies. We also apply the method to the layered magnetic semiconductor CrI3, obtaining an absorption spectrum that reproduces the main experimental features. These results establish BSE@qKI as a GW-free alternative to BSE@G0W0 for systematic studies of excitonic properties in complex materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 激子的准确第一性原理表征通常依赖于 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (BSE) 与计算要求较高的引力波计算中的准粒子能量相结合。在这里，我们用符合 Koopmans 的光谱泛函的准粒子能量取代了 GW 步骤，我们将这种方法称为 BSE@qKI，并在自动化、可重复的 AiiDA 工作流程中实现它。对于一组基准半导体，BSE@qKI 再现了实验带隙和第一激子能量，平均绝对相对误差分别为 13% 和 4%，与 BSE@G0W0 的带隙相当，并且激发能量明显更好。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激子的准确第一性原理表征通常依赖于 Bethe-Salpeter 方程 (BSE) 与计算要求较高的引力波计算中的准粒子能量相结合。在这里，我们用符合 Koopmans 的光谱泛函的准粒子能量取代了 GW 步骤，我们将这种方法称为 BSE@qKI，并在自动化、可重复的 AiiDA 工作流程中实现它。对于一组基准半导体，BSE@qKI 再现了实验带隙和第一激子能量，平均绝对相对误差分别为 13% 和 4%，与 BSE@G0W0 的带隙相当，并且激发能量明显更好。我们还将该方法应用于层状磁性半导体 CrI3，获得了再现主要实验特征的吸收光谱。这些结果确立了 BSE@qKI 作为 BSE@G0W0 的无 GW 替代品，用于系统研究复杂材料的激子特性。

articles.title: First-order correction to the self-consistent harmonic approximation free energy: Impact on the negative thermal expansion and phonon dynamics in ScF₃
articles.title_zh: 自洽谐波近似自由能的一阶修正：对 ScF₃ 负热膨胀和声子动力学的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly anharmonic crystals are often treated using the self-consistent harmonic approximation with variationally optimized Gaussian density matrices or the related self-consistent phonon theory. Both approaches capture substantial phonon renormalization but exclude connected non-Gaussian free-energy correlations. Here, we derive the first-order post-variational correction generated by the lowest non-vanishing normal-ordered residual vertex. Normal ordering the residual interaction around the optimized state shows that the linear and quadratic vertices vanish at the stationary variational solution, leaving a fluctuation-dressed cubic interaction whose second-order vacuum and two-point contractions generate the free-energy correction and the dynamical bubble self-energy, respectively. In ScF₃, the variational optimization on the full Born-Oppenheimer potential accounts for most of the shift in the thermal-expansion crossover temperature between negative and positive values relative to self-consistent phonon theory with a fourth-order potential. The connected correction changes the crossover modestly, but its volume derivative appreciably shifts the pressure-remapped cubic local-stability limit. Using the bare cubic vertex appears to improve agreement with the thermodynamic measurements, yet it systematically underestimates the measured zone-boundary tilt-mode energies at high temperatures. The fluctuation-dressed interaction gives more moderate thermodynamic corrections but yields phonon energies in better agreement with experiments. These results show that connected non-Gaussian correlations can significantly affect free-energy derivatives and soft-mode dynamics near a structural instability, and identify the optimized Gaussian state as the natural reference for constructing residual interactions beyond the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常使用具有变分优化高斯密度矩阵的自洽谐波近似或相关的自洽声子理论来处理强非谐晶体。两种方法都捕获了大量的声子重正化，但排除了相关的非高斯自由能相关性。在这里，我们推导出由最低非消失正序残差顶点生成的一阶后变分校正。对优化状态周围的剩余相互作用进行正态排序表明，线性和二次顶点在稳态变分解处消失，留下波动修饰的立方相互作用，其二阶真空和两点收缩分别产生自由能校正和动态气泡自能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常使用具有变分优化高斯密度矩阵的自洽谐波近似或相关的自洽声子理论来处理强非谐晶体。两种方法都捕获了大量的声子重正化，但排除了相关的非高斯自由能相关性。在这里，我们推导出由最低非消失正序残差顶点生成的一阶后变分校正。对优化状态周围的剩余相互作用进行正态排序表明，线性和二次顶点在稳态变分解处消失，留下波动修饰的立方相互作用，其二阶真空和两点收缩分别产生自由能校正和动态气泡自能。在 ScF₃ 中，相对于具有四阶势的自洽声子理论，全玻恩-奥本海默势的变分优化解释了热膨胀交叉温度在负值和正值之间的大部分变化。连接的校正适度改变了交叉，但其体积导数明显改变了压力重新映射的立方局部稳定性极限。使用裸立方顶点似乎可以提高与热力学测量的一致性，但它系统地低估了高温下测量的区域边界倾斜模式能量。波动修饰的相互作用给出了更温和的热力学校正，但产生的声子能量与实验更加一致。这些结果表明，连通的非高斯相关性可以显着影响结构不稳定附近的自由能导数和软模式动力学，并将优化的高斯状态确定为构建超出随机自洽谐波近似的剩余相互作用的自然参考。

articles.title: Few Dipolar Bosons in a Ring Trap: Quantum States and Transitions between Them
articles.title_zh: 环形陷阱中的偶极玻色子：量子态及其之间的跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22562v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The degenerate dipolar Bose gas has attracted great research interest for studying novel quantum states of matter due to the interplay between short-range contact and long-range dipole-dipole interactions. The superfluid, quantum droplet, and supersolid states, along with the transition between them, have been widely studied using the extended mean-field theory, which relies on the Lee-Huang-Yang correction to approximately account for the effect of quantum fluctuation. In this work, we examine the system of a few dipolar bosons trapped in a ring potential employing the exact diagonalization method, which can yield the full quantum nature of the system. By examining the quantum correlation and coherence properties of the system, we reveal a rich variety of quantum states (including Wigner crystal, superfluid, quantum droplet, and the mixed states of them) and their formation mechanisms. Furthermore, we show that transitions between these quantum states can be induced by tuning the interaction strength and particle number. The findings of this work can provide valuable insights into the dipolar gas at the microscopic quantum level, and may also find applications in the fields such as quantum sensing and quantum information.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于短程接触和长程偶极-偶极相互作用之间的相互作用，简并偶极玻色气体引起了人们对研究新型物质量子态的极大兴趣。超流体、量子液滴和超固态以及它们之间的转变已经使用扩展平均场理论进行了广泛的研究，该理论依赖于李黄杨校正来近似解释量子涨落的影响。在这项工作中，我们采用精确的对角化方法检查了一些被困在环势中的偶极玻色子系统，该方法可以产生系统的完整量子性质。通过研究系统的量子相关性和相干性特性，我们揭示了丰富多样的量子态（包括维格纳晶体、超流体、量子液滴及其混合态）及其形成机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于短程接触和长程偶极-偶极相互作用之间的相互作用，简并偶极玻色气体引起了人们对研究新型物质量子态的极大兴趣。超流体、量子液滴和超固态以及它们之间的转变已经使用扩展平均场理论进行了广泛的研究，该理论依赖于李黄杨校正来近似解释量子涨落的影响。在这项工作中，我们采用精确的对角化方法检查了一些被困在环势中的偶极玻色子系统，该方法可以产生系统的完整量子性质。通过研究系统的量子相关性和相干性特性，我们揭示了丰富多样的量子态（包括维格纳晶体、超流体、量子液滴及其混合态）及其形成机制。此外，我们表明可以通过调整相互作用强度和粒子数来诱导这些量子态之间的跃迁。这项工作的发现可以为微观量子水平上的偶极气体提供有价值的见解，并且还可能在量子传感和量子信息等领域找到应用。

articles.title: Prior-guided adaptive local refinement of foundation interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 基础原子间势的先验引导自适应局部细化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22626v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation interatomic potentials enable simulations across diverse materials, but task-specific inaccuracies can require additional first-principles data. Obtaining these data is challenging when the relevant local environments arise in large simulation cells. Here we introduce the Prior-guided Adaptive Refinement Scheme (PARS), which identifies weakly supported environments during molecular dynamics by comparing their frozen representations with prototypes of pretraining environments, without requiring initial task labels or model ensembles. Selected environments are reconstructed as compact periodic cells for first-principles labelling and iterative refinement. Applications to phase stability, surface migration and vacancy clustering show improvements in target properties, including an 81% reduction in the mean absolute error of Ti vacancy-cluster energies per vacancy relative to the pretrained model. For Si/Ge, a foundation potential refined using 800 labelled cells containing 10-128 atoms is subsequently distilled into a compact potential without additional first-principles training labels. In simulations containing approximately 362,880 atoms, the distilled model predicts an interfacial thermal resistance consistent with that of a potential trained directly on density-functional theory data. These results demonstrate a route for adapting foundation potentials to target applications through local reference calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础原子间势能实现跨不同材料的模拟，但特定任务的不准确性可能需要额外的第一原理数据。当大型模拟单元中出现相关的局部环境时，获取这些数据具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍了先验引导的自适应细化方案（PARS），该方案通过将其冻结表示与预训练环境的原型进行比较来识别分子动力学过程中的弱支持环境，而不需要初始任务标签或模型集成。选定的环境被重建为紧凑的周期单元，用于第一原理标记和迭代细化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础原子间势能实现跨不同材料的模拟，但特定任务的不准确性可能需要额外的第一原理数据。当大型模拟单元中出现相关的局部环境时，获取这些数据具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍了先验引导的自适应细化方案（PARS），该方案通过将其冻结表示与预训练环境的原型进行比较来识别分子动力学过程中的弱支持环境，而不需要初始任务标签或模型集成。选定的环境被重建为紧凑的周期单元，用于第一原理标记和迭代细化。相稳定性、表面迁移和空位簇的应用显示了目标特性的改进，包括相对于预训练模型，每个空位的 Ti 空位簇能量的平均绝对误差降低了 81%。对于 Si/Ge，使用 800 个包含 10-128 个原子的标记单元精炼的基础势随后被蒸馏成紧凑势，无需额外的第一性原理训练标签。在包含大约 362,880 个原子的模拟中，蒸馏模型预测的界面热阻与直接根据密度泛函理论数据训练的势一致。这些结果展示了通过局部参考计算使基础潜力适应目标应用的途径。

articles.title: Computational Modeling of Sublattice Magnetization in CoTb/Co/CoTb Magnetic Multilayer Nanojunctions Between Cobalt Leads
articles.title_zh: 钴引线之间 CoTb/Co/CoTb 磁性多层纳米结中亚晶格磁化的计算模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22644v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we study the sublattice nano-magnetic behavior of CoTb/Co/CoTb sandwiched between semi-infinite cobalt leads. To perform the analysis, we use the Ising spin-based effective field theory (EFT), which enables us to determine the relevant magnetic exchange parameters for elemental cobalt JCo-Co and terbium JTb-Tb. The exchange interaction parameters are determined by fitting the magnetization calculated using the Ising effective-field theory to the experimentally measured temperature-dependent magnetization curves. This fitting procedure yields the exchange constants for Co and Tb, along with their respective Curie temperatures. We use the magnetic exchange parameter obtained using Ising EFT-based method is then seeded on to mean field theory (MFT) to calculate the sublattice magnetizations of CoTb/Co/CoTb arranged between semi-infinite cobalt leads. The sublattice magnetizations for every atomic layer and corresponding lattice sites in the layered ferrimagnetic nanostructures are computed separately. This allows us to analyze spin-site-specific parameters, magnetic moments, magnetization, and ferrimagnetic compensation behavior for varying eutectic compositions, particularly for (c ≤ 0.5). The results give enhanced insight into magnetic phenomena at the local level and their general relevance in the ultra-thin layered ferrimagnetic structure dynamics confined between semi-infinite cobalt electrodes. These results are needed for the understanding of magnon transport phenomena and consequent magnetic amplification effects and are crucial to the development of spintronic technologies. Most importantly, to date, no first-principles or density functional theory research exists for sublattice magnetization in such multilayered systems. The versatile approach established in this work can also be applied to other nanostructured magnetic systems
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了夹在半无限钴引线之间的 CoTb/Co/CoTb 的亚晶格纳米磁性行为。为了进行分析，我们使用基于伊辛自旋的有效场理论 (EFT)，这使我们能够确定元素钴 JCo-Co 和铽 JTb-Tb 的相关磁交换参数。通过将使用伊辛有效场理论计算的磁化强度与实验测量的温度相关磁化强度曲线进行拟合来确定交换相互作用参数。该拟合过程得出 Co 和 Tb 的交换常数以及它们各自的居里温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了夹在半无限钴引线之间的 CoTb/Co/CoTb 的亚晶格纳米磁性行为。为了进行分析，我们使用基于伊辛自旋的有效场理论 (EFT)，这使我们能够确定元素钴 JCo-Co 和铽 JTb-Tb 的相关磁交换参数。通过将使用伊辛有效场理论计算的磁化强度与实验测量的温度相关磁化强度曲线进行拟合来确定交换相互作用参数。该拟合过程得出 Co 和 Tb 的交换常数以及它们各自的居里温度。我们使用基于 Ising EFT 的方法获得的磁交换参数，然后将其引入平均场理论 (MFT) 来计算排列在半无限钴引线之间的 CoTb/Co/CoTb 的亚晶格磁化强度。分别计算层状亚铁磁纳米结构中每个原子层和相应晶格位置的亚晶格磁化强度。这使我们能够分析不同共晶成分的自旋位点特定参数、磁矩、磁化强度和亚铁磁补偿行为，特别是 (c ≤ 0.5)。这些结果增强了对局部水平磁现象及其与限制在半无限钴电极之间的超薄层状亚铁磁结构动力学的一般相关性的了解。这些结果对于理解磁振子输运现象和随之而来的磁放大效应是必要的，并且对于自旋电子技术的发展至关重要。最重要的是，迄今为止，这种多层系统中的亚晶格磁化还没有第一原理或密度泛函理论研究。这项工作中建立的通用方法也可以应用于其他纳米结构磁性系统

articles.title: Domain walls of a spin-chirality ferroelectric as tunable quantum particles
articles.title_zh: 作为可调谐量子粒子的自旋手性铁电体的畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In frustrated spin chains with competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor exchange, the vector spin chirality sets the electric polarization, so a ferroelectric domain wall is a domain wall of the chirality. The semiclassical picture suggests nonlocal switching dynamics due to topological constraints on the spins, but little is known about such domain walls in a quantum spin chain. Using density-matrix renormalization group calculations for a frustrated spin-1/2 XXZ chain in which a bond alternation δ opens a spin gap, we show that the wall then becomes a quantum particle. In a finite chain, it has the energy levels and wave functions of a particle in a box, and it moves under an electric field as a particle under a constant force does. In the infinite chain, its mass grows by more than two orders of magnitude as δ decreases and diverges at δ^*approx0.012, where the bottom of its band becomes flat; below δ^* the band has two degenerate minima away from its center. The large mass results from a near cancellation of in-plane and out-of-plane exchange energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有竞争性最近邻和次近邻交换的受挫自旋链中，矢量自旋手性决定了电极化，因此铁电畴壁是手性的畴壁。半经典图表明由于自旋的拓扑约束而产生的非局域切换动力学，但人们对量子自旋链中的此类畴壁知之甚少。使用密度矩阵重正化群计算受挫的自旋 1/2 XXZ 链（其中键交替 δ 打开自旋间隙），我们表明壁随后变成了量子粒子。在有限链中，它具有盒子中粒子的能级和波函数，并且它在电场下移动，就像粒子在恒定力下一样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有竞争性最近邻和次近邻交换的受挫自旋链中，矢量自旋手性决定了电极化，因此铁电畴壁是手性的畴壁。半经典图表明由于自旋的拓扑约束而产生的非局域切换动力学，但人们对量子自旋链中的此类畴壁知之甚少。使用密度矩阵重正化群计算受挫的自旋 1/2 XXZ 链（其中键交替 δ 打开自旋间隙），我们表明壁随后变成了量子粒子。在有限链中，它具有盒子中粒子的能级和波函数，并且它在电场下移动，就像粒子在恒定力下一样。在无限链中，随着 δ 减小，其质量增加两个数量级以上，并在 δ^*approx0.012 处发散，此时带的底部变得平坦；低于 δ^* 时，能带有两个远离其中心的简并极小值。大质量是由于面内和面外交换能量几乎抵消而产生的。

articles.title: Altermagnetism-induced magneto-optical effects
articles.title_zh: 交变磁感应磁光效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22750v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets break time-reversal symmetry despite their zero net magnetization, enabling time-reversal-odd responses while retaining the advantages of antiferromagnets. However, magneto-optical (MO) effects are not universal among altermagnets because MO effects typically arise from magnetic dipole order (ferromagnetism), which is generally absent in altermagnets. In this work, we address this limitation by establishing octupolar MO effects, which arise from magnetic octupole order through spatial dispersion. Owing to this distinct origin, octupolar MO effects do not necessarily require spin-orbit coupling even in collinear magnets and can arise without an external magnetic field in antiferromagnets where conventional MO effects are symmetry-forbidden. Such antiferromagnets include d-wave altermagnets such as RuO₂ and KV₂Se₂O, certain g- and i-wave altermagnets, including CrSb, as well as noncoplanar antiferromagnets such as MnTe₂ and pyrochlore iridates with all-in-all-out magnetic order. From an experimental perspective, octupolar MO effects can reach detectable magnitudes and offer potential for magnetic-domain imaging, as supported by numerical calculations showing μrad-scale Faraday rotation for a 100-nm-thick sample in the visible-light range and a sign reversal between opposite domains. Furthermore, octupolar MO effects are linked to an f-sum rule, enabling a quantitative estimate of the spin magnetic octupole moment from optical measurements. These results extend the scope of MO effects to a broad class of antiferromagnets, including altermagnets, and open a field-free optical route to exploring magnetic octupole order.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管交变磁体的净磁化强度为零，但它打破了时间反转对称性，从而实现了时间反转奇响应，同时保留了反铁磁体的优点。然而，磁光 (MO) 效应在交流磁体中并不普遍，因为 MO 效应通常源自磁偶极级（铁磁性），而磁偶极级在交流磁体中通常不存在。在这项工作中，我们通过建立八极 MO 效应来解决这一限制，该效应是通过空间色散产生的磁性八极秩序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管交变磁体的净磁化强度为零，但它打破了时间反转对称性，从而实现了时间反转奇响应，同时保留了反铁磁体的优点。然而，磁光 (MO) 效应在交流磁体中并不普遍，因为 MO 效应通常源自磁偶极级（铁磁性），而磁偶极级在交流磁体中通常不存在。在这项工作中，我们通过建立八极 MO 效应来解决这一限制，该效应是通过空间色散产生的磁性八极秩序。由于这种独特的起源，即使在共线磁体中，八极 MO 效应也不一定需要自旋轨道耦合，并且在反铁磁体中无需外部磁场即可产生，而传统 MO 效应是对称禁止的。这种反铁磁体包括 d 波交变磁体，如 RuO2 和 KV2Se2O，某些 g 波和 i 波交变磁体，包括 CrSb，以及非共面反铁磁体，如 MnTe2 和具有全进全出磁序的烧绿石铱酸盐。从实验角度来看，八极 MO 效应可以达到可检测的幅度，并为磁域成像提供潜力，数值计算显示 100 nm 厚的样品在可见光范围内发生 μrad 级法拉第旋转，以及相反域之间的符号反转。此外，八极磁矩效应与 f-sum 规则相关，可以通过光学测量定量估计自旋磁八极矩。这些结果将 MO 效应的范围扩展到广泛的反铁磁体，包括交流磁体，并为探索磁性八极秩序开辟了一条无场光学途径。

articles.title: Interfacial electrostatics: From polar insulators to charged-layer metals
articles.title_zh: 界面静电：从极性绝缘体到带电层金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polar discontinuities are typically described as arising from charged atomic planes, a spontaneous polarization, or a combination, in insulating films interfaced with vacuum, nonpolar insulators or metals. The resulting electrostatics are well established for systems such as LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃, BaTiO₃/SrRuO₃, and BiFeO₃/SrRuO₃. However, recent observations of "polar-discontinuity-like" behavior at interfaces in which the metal contains formally charged layers (e.g., rare-earth nickelates) challenge this picture. In this work, we summarize the theoretical framework used to define and quantify interface charge, layer polarization, and screening in the three reference systems above, and then discuss signatures attributed to the formal-charge polar discontinuity arising when SmNiO₃, a metal with formally charged (001) layers, is interfaced with ferroelectric BaTiO₃. We show how concepts developed for polar discontinuities between two insulators and for screening at metallic interfaces can rationalize the reported effects and identify where our understanding of these systems leaves open questions.
articles.abstract_zh: 极性不连续性通常被描述为由与真空、非极性绝缘体或金属接触的绝缘膜中的带电原子平面、自发极化或它们的组合引起。由此产生的静电对于 LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃、BaTiO₃/SrRuO₃ 和 BiFeO₃/SrRuO₃ 等系统来说是很好的。然而，最近在金属包含正式带电层（例如稀土镍酸盐）的界面处观察到的“类极性不连续”行为对这一观点提出了挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极性不连续性通常被描述为由与真空、非极性绝缘体或金属接触的绝缘膜中的带电原子平面、自发极化或它们的组合引起。由此产生的静电对于 LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃、BaTiO₃/SrRuO₃ 和 BiFeO₃/SrRuO₃ 等系统来说是很好的。然而，最近在金属包含正式带电层（例如稀土镍酸盐）的界面处观察到的“类极性不连续”行为对这一观点提出了挑战。在这项工作中，我们总结了用于定义和量化上述三个参考系统中的界面电荷、层极化和屏蔽的理论框架，然后讨论了当 SmNiO₃（一种具有形式电荷 (001) 层的金属）与铁电 BaTiO₃ 界面时产生的形式电荷极性不连续性的特征。我们展示了为两个绝缘体之间的极性不连续性和金属界面屏蔽而开发的概念如何合理化所报告的效应，并确定我们对这些系统的理解在哪些方面留下了悬而未决的问题。

articles.title: Performance limits and benchmarking of ideal 2D topological insulator field-effect transistors
articles.title_zh: 理想二维拓扑绝缘体场效应晶体管的性能限制和基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological insulator field-effect transistors (TIFETs) have emerged as a promising alternative to overcome the scaling limits of silicon-based field-effect transistors (Si-based FETs). In this study, we establish the performance limits of ideal TIFETs and present a comprehensive benchmarking of the switching energy-delay performance of TIFETs against Si-based FETs (FinFET and LGAA) and 2-D material-based FETs (MoS₂ and InSe) under equivalent and realistic conditions. Furthermore, we analyze the key factors influencing the switching energy-delay performance of TIFETs, including contact resistance (RC), parasitic capacitance (Cₚₐᵣ), channel length (L), and channel width (W). Notably, TIFETs achieve substantially lower switching energy and delay time, outperforming both Si-based FETs and 2-D material-based FETs, where a transition from 1-stack to 3-stack yields approximately a sixfold reduction. This benchmarking study shows that TIFETs exhibit competitive switching performance and hold strong potential for future topological electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑绝缘体场效应晶体管 (TIFET) 已成为克服硅基场效应晶体管（Si 基 FET）尺寸限制的有前景的替代方案。在这项研究中，我们确定了理想 TIFET 的性能极限，并在等效和现实条件下对 TIFET 的开关能量延迟性能与硅基 FET（FinFET 和 LGAA）和二维材料基 FET（MoS2 和 InSe）进行了全面的基准测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑绝缘体场效应晶体管 (TIFET) 已成为克服硅基场效应晶体管（Si 基 FET）尺寸限制的有前景的替代方案。在这项研究中，我们确定了理想 TIFET 的性能极限，并在等效和现实条件下对 TIFET 的开关能量延迟性能与硅基 FET（FinFET 和 LGAA）和二维材料基 FET（MoS2 和 InSe）进行了全面的基准测试。此外，我们分析了影响 TIFET 开关能量延迟性能的关键因素，包括接触电阻 (RC)、寄生电容 (Cₚₐᵣ)、沟道长度 (L) 和沟道宽度 (W)。值得注意的是，TIFET 实现了显着降低的开关能量和延迟时间，优于硅基 FET 和基于 2D 材料的 FET，其中从 1 堆栈过渡到 3 堆栈大约减少了六倍。这项基准测试研究表明，TIFET 表现出有竞争力的开关性能，并在未来拓扑电子器件方面具有强大的潜力。

articles.title: Canonical spin glass behavior and memory effects in van der Waals magnet (Fe0.55Ni0.45)3GaTe2
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体 (Fe0.55Ni0.45)3GaTe2 中的规范自旋玻璃行为和记忆效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the canonical spin-glass behavior and non-equilibrium dynamics in a single-crystalline Ni-doped van der Waals magnet (Fe0.55Ni0.45)3GaTe2 with a freezing temperature T_f approx 45.5 K from detailed ac susceptibility and dc magnetization measurements. The temperature-dependent dc magnetization exhibits strong magnetic irreversibility and the ac susceptibility shows that the peak at T_f shifts towards higher temperatures with increase in ac frequency, indicating the presence of a spin glass state. The relative shift of the freezing temperature δ T_f per decade of frequency in ac susceptibility is estimated to be 0.0072. Dynamic scaling analysis of the frequency-dependent freezing temperature using the power law reveals the single spin flip relaxation time τ₀=2×10⁻¹³ s and critical exponent zν=8.1, while the Vogel-Fulcher law yields Vogel-Fulcher temperature T₀=43 K and activation energy Eₐ/k_B=81 K with Eₐ/k_BT₀=1.88. The obtained values of these characteristic parameters lie well within the range associated with a canonical spin glass. The detailed non-equilibrium dynamics study, involving the magnetic relaxation and memory effect, further confirms the glassy behavior. The memory effect in zero-field-cooled magnetization establishes that the glassy state arises from the cooperative spin-spin interaction and not from superparamagnetism. The asymmetric response of magnetic relaxation with respect to negative and positive temperature cycle favors the hierarchical model of memory effects over the droplet model.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过详细的交流磁化率和直流磁化强度测量，证明了单晶 Ni 掺杂范德华磁体 (Fe0.55Ni0.45)3GaTe2 的典型自旋玻璃行为和非平衡动力学，其凝固温度 T_f 约为 45.5 K。与温度相关的直流磁化强度表现出很强的磁不可逆性，而交流磁化率表明，随着交流频率的增加，T_f 处的峰值向更高的温度移动，表明存在自旋玻璃态。交流磁化率中每十倍频的冻结温度 δ T_f 的相对偏移估计为 0.0072。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过详细的交流磁化率和直流磁化强度测量，证明了单晶 Ni 掺杂范德华磁体 (Fe0.55Ni0.45)3GaTe2 的典型自旋玻璃行为和非平衡动力学，其凝固温度 T_f 约为 45.5 K。与温度相关的直流磁化强度表现出很强的磁不可逆性，而交流磁化率表明，随着交流频率的增加，T_f 处的峰值向更高的温度移动，表明存在自旋玻璃态。交流磁化率中每十倍频的冻结温度 δ T_f 的相对偏移估计为 0.0072。使用幂律对频率相关的冻结温度进行动态标度分析，得出单次自旋翻转弛豫时间 τ₀=2×10⁻13 s 和临界指数 zν=8.1，而 Vogel-Fulcher 定律得出 Vogel-Fulcher 温度 T₀=43 K 和活化能 Eₐ/k_B=81 K，其中 Eₐ/k_BT₀=1.88。获得的这些特征参数的值完全在与标准旋转玻璃相关的范围内。详细的非平衡动力学研究，包括磁弛豫和记忆效应，进一步证实了玻璃态行为。零场冷却磁化中的记忆效应表明，玻璃态是由自旋-自旋协同相互作用产生的，而不是由超顺磁性产生的。磁弛豫相对于正负温度循环的不对称响应有利于记忆效应的分层模型而不是液滴模型。

articles.title: From a High-Trm_C Spin-Gapless Semiconductor to a Spin-Glass: The Role of Disorder in NiMnCrAl
articles.title_zh: 从高 Trm_C 自旋无隙半导体到自旋玻璃：无序在 NiMnCrAl 中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combine first-principles calculations with structural, magnetic, and transport measurements to investigate the influence of chemical disorder on the quaternary Heusler alloy NiMnCrAl. For the ordered Y-type structure, density-functional-theory calculations predict a ferrimagnetic spin-gapless-semiconducting state with a total magnetic moment of 1.99,μB/f.u. and a mean-field ordering temperature of approximately 1300~K. Polycrystalline NiMnCrAl forms in a single average cubic phase; however, combined x-ray diffraction, neutron diffraction, and extended x-ray absorption fine-structure measurements reveal substantial antisite disorder, characterized by predominantly B2-like disorder with additional cross-sublattice mixing. No long-range ferrimagnetic transition is observed up to 700~K. Instead, the compound exhibits a broad magnetic anomaly near 37~K, frequency-dependent ac susceptibility, slow stretched-exponential relaxation, and field-cooled and zero-field-cooled memory effects, establishing a glassy magnetic state. The electrical resistivity is metallic and the Seebeck coefficient is negative, consistent with the loss of the ideal spin-gapless electronic structure. Exchange-interaction calculations show that antisite disorder introduces short Mn--Mn separations and competing antiferromagnetic Mn--Mn and Mn--Cr interactions, providing a microscopic basis for magnetic frustration. These results demonstrate the strong sensitivity to the predicted spin-gapless and ferrimagnetic states of NiMnCrAl to chemical disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将第一性原理计算与结构、磁性和输运测量相结合，研究化学无序对四元 Heusler 合金 NiMnCrAl 的影响。对于有序 Y 型结构，密度泛函理论计算预测总磁矩为 1.99,μB/f.u 的亚铁磁自旋无间隙半导体状态。平均场有序温度约为1300~K。多晶 NiMnCrAl 形成单一平均立方相；然而，组合的 X 射线衍射、中子衍射和扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构测量揭示了明显的反位无序，其特征主要是 B2 类无序以及额外的跨亚晶格混合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将第一性原理计算与结构、磁性和输运测量相结合，研究化学无序对四元 Heusler 合金 NiMnCrAl 的影响。对于有序 Y 型结构，密度泛函理论计算预测总磁矩为 1.99,μB/f.u 的亚铁磁自旋无间隙半导体状态。平均场有序温度约为1300~K。多晶 NiMnCrAl 形成单一平均立方相；然而，组合的 X 射线衍射、中子衍射和扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构测量揭示了明显的反位无序，其特征主要是 B2 类无序以及额外的跨亚晶格混合。在 700~K 温度以下没有观察到长程亚铁磁转变。相反，该化合物在 37~K 附近表现出广泛的磁异常、频率相关的交流磁化率、缓慢的拉伸指数弛豫以及场冷却和零场冷却记忆效应，从而建立了玻璃磁态。电阻率为金属性，塞贝克系数为负，与理想自旋无隙电子结构的损失一致。交换相互作用计算表明，反位无序引入了短的 Mn-Mn 分离和竞争性反铁磁 Mn-Mn 和 Mn-Cr 相互作用，为磁挫败提供了微观基础。这些结果表明 NiMnCrAl 的预测自旋无隙和亚铁磁态对化学无序具有很强的敏感性。

articles.title: Axion electrodynamics and the advection-diffusion structure of TEM modes in hollow-conductor waveguides
articles.title_zh: 空心导体波导中轴子电动力学和TEM模式的平流扩散结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic investigation of transverse electromagnetic (TEM) modes in hollow-conductor waveguides filled with a dielectric medium described by axion electrodynamics. While such modes do not propagate in conventional single-conductor waveguides, the coupling of the axion field to an external magnetic field enables their propagation. We show that the resulting TEM modes are governed by an advection-diffusion-type equation for the transverse electrostatic potential, establishing a direct mathematical connection between axion electrodynamics and advection-diffusion phenomena. We illustrate this connection through explicit solutions and field profiles for cylindrical waveguides, considering uniform and rigid rotational drift fields, both individually and in combination, as well as different values of the parameter controlling the advection-to-diffusion ratio (Péclet number). These results establish a transport-based framework for understanding how spatial variations of the axion-electrodynamics background shape the transverse electromagnetic fields in hollow-conductor waveguides.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对填充有轴子电动力学描述的介电介质的空心导体波导中的横向电磁（TEM）模式进行了系统研究。虽然这种模式不会在传统的单导体波导中传播，但轴子场与外部磁场的耦合使得它们能够传播。我们表明，由此产生的 TEM 模式受横向静电势的平流扩散型方程控制，在轴子电动力学和平流扩散现象之间建立了直接的数学联系。我们通过圆柱形波导的显式解和场分布来说明这种联系，考虑均匀和刚性的旋转漂移场，无论是单独的还是组合的，以及控制平流扩散比（佩克莱特数）的参数的不同值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对填充有轴子电动力学描述的介电介质的空心导体波导中的横向电磁（TEM）模式进行了系统研究。虽然这种模式不会在传统的单导体波导中传播，但轴子场与外部磁场的耦合使得它们能够传播。我们表明，由此产生的 TEM 模式受横向静电势的平流扩散型方程控制，在轴子电动力学和平流扩散现象之间建立了直接的数学联系。我们通过圆柱形波导的显式解和场分布来说明这种联系，考虑均匀和刚性的旋转漂移场，无论是单独的还是组合的，以及控制平流扩散比（佩克莱特数）的参数的不同值。这些结果建立了一个基于传输的框架，用于理解轴子电动力学背景的空间变化如何塑造空心导体波导中的横向电磁场。

articles.title: AlCoCuFeNi High-Entropy Alloy Nanoparticle Melting and Solidification: A Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulation Study
articles.title_zh: AlCoCuFeNi 高熵合金纳米颗粒熔化与凝固：经典分子动力学模拟研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The processes of melting and solidification of an AlCoCuFeNi high-entropy alloy nanoparticle with a diameter of about 10 nm were studied by classical molecular dynamics simulation using an embedded atom model potential. Three cooling rates, 10¹¹, 10¹², and 10¹³ K/s, were considered. Melting and crystallization behavior were characterized through the temperature dependence of the potential energy. Structural evolution was analyzed using adaptive common-neighbor analysis (CNA) and radial distribution functions (RDF). The results show that the final structure changes from amorphous to crystalline as the cooling rate decreases. A pronounced temperature hysteresis associated with melting and crystallization was also observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用嵌入原子模型势进行经典分子动力学模拟，研究了直径约10 nm的AlCoCuFeNi高熵合金纳米颗粒的熔化和凝固过程。考虑了三种冷却速率：1011、1012 和 1013 K/s。通过势能的温度依赖性来表征熔化和结晶行为。使用自适应共邻分析（CNA）和径向分布函数（RDF）来分析结构演化。结果表明，随着冷却速率的降低，最终结构从非晶态转变为晶态。还观察到与熔化和结晶相关的明显温度滞后。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用嵌入原子模型势进行经典分子动力学模拟，研究了直径约10 nm的AlCoCuFeNi高熵合金纳米颗粒的熔化和凝固过程。考虑了三种冷却速率：1011、1012 和 1013 K/s。通过势能的温度依赖性来表征熔化和结晶行为。使用自适应共邻分析（CNA）和径向分布函数（RDF）来分析结构演化。结果表明，随着冷却速率的降低，最终结构从非晶态转变为晶态。还观察到与熔化和结晶相关的明显温度滞后。

articles.title: Engineering antiferromagnetic (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n superlattices
articles.title_zh: 工程反铁磁 (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n 超晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the atomic-scale engineering of antiferromagnetic (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n superlattices grown by MBE on (001)-oriented SrTiO3 substrates. Our work achieved a precise layer-by-layer control, revealing how interface-driven structural distortions can be systematically tuned. X-ray diffraction and reciprocal space mapping confirm both the epitaxial strain state and the high crystalline quality of the superlattices. High-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy further uncovers layer-resolved atomic displacements, where La3+ and Pr3+ exhibit antipolar motions modulated by the superlattice periodicity. The alternate stackings of LaVO3 and PrVO3 yield a unique antiferromagnetic transition temperature, which can be tuned by adjusting their relative proportions. This behavior exists despite the distinct spin ordering temperatures observed in the constituent materials. Layer-resolved spectroscopic measurements reveal that the hybridization of La and Pr 5d orbitals with O 2p orbitals is also modulated and directly correlated to the oxygen octahedra rotations. By determining the orbital hybridization and mapping the cation displacements as proxies, we can visualize indirectly the trilinear coupling between oxygen octahedra rotations and antipolar rare earth displacements. Notably, the interfacial oxygen octahedra connectivity between cubic SrTiO3 substrate and orthorhombic vanadate layers significantly influences the structural distortions. These distortions, almost quenched near the interface, relax over few unit cells, demonstrating how strain and interfacial effects propagate through the superlattice. This study illustrates how artificial superlattices can be engineered to control structural distortions at the atomic scale, offering a pathway to tune the magnetic properties through strain-distortion relationships in perovskite oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们展示了通过 MBE 在 (001) 取向 SrTiO3 基底上生长的反铁磁 (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n 超晶格的原子级工程。我们的工作实现了精确的逐层控制，揭示了如何系统地调整界面驱动的结构扭曲。 X 射线衍射和倒易空间映射证实了超晶格的外延应变状态和高结晶质量。高分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜进一步揭示了层分辨原子位移，其中 La3+ 和 Pr3+ 表现出受超晶格周期性调制的反极运动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项研究中，我们展示了通过 MBE 在 (001) 取向 SrTiO3 基底上生长的反铁磁 (LaVO3)m/(PrVO3)n 超晶格的原子级工程。我们的工作实现了精确的逐层控制，揭示了如何系统地调整界面驱动的结构扭曲。 X 射线衍射和倒易空间映射证实了超晶格的外延应变状态和高结晶质量。高分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜进一步揭示了层分辨原子位移，其中 La3+ 和 Pr3+ 表现出受超晶格周期性调制的反极运动。 LaVO3 和 PrVO3 的交替堆叠产生独特的反铁磁转变温度，可以通过调整它们的相对比例来调节。尽管在组成材料中观察到不同的自旋排序温度，但这种行为仍然存在。层分辨光谱测量表明，La 和 Pr 5d 轨道与 O 2p 轨道的杂化也受到调制，并且与氧八面体旋转直接相关。通过确定轨道杂化并将阳离子位移映射为代理，我们可以间接可视化氧八面体旋转和反极稀土位移之间的三线性耦合。值得注意的是，立方 SrTiO3 基底和斜方钒酸盐层之间的界面氧八面体连通性显着影响结构变形。这些扭曲在界面附近几乎被淬灭，在几个晶胞上松弛，展示了应变和界面效应如何通过超晶格传播。这项研究说明了如何设计人造超晶格来控制原子尺度的结构扭曲，提供了一种通过钙钛矿氧化物中的应变扭曲关系来调整磁性的途径。

articles.title: Electrical addressing of compensated magnetic order in artificial spin ice
articles.title_zh: 人造自旋冰中补偿磁序的电寻址
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compensated magnetic systems, such as antiferromagnets, hold immense potential for spintronic devices thanks to vanishing stray fields, robustness to perturbations, and ultrafast dynamics. Yet, electrical writing and reading of their order remains a major challenge. Here we use artificial spin ice as a mesoscale platform in which compensated order can be engineered, directly imaged, and electrically controlled. Specifically, we demonstrate combined electrical writing and reading of a compensated state in a triangular artificial spin ice. Exploiting the orientation dependence of the spin-orbit torque switching current, we independently switch three nanomagnet sublattices through a single current channel, with the planar Hall effect providing sublattice-resolved readout. This grants access to all eight magnetization states of the triangular plaquette, including its fully compensated state, yielding a nonlinear, history-dependent electrical response. Our results establish an approach to electrically programmable compensated magnetic systems and provide an important foundation for reconfigurable magnetic devices and unconventional computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于杂散场消失、对扰动的鲁棒性和超快动力学，补偿磁系统（例如反铁磁体）在自旋电子器件方面具有巨大的潜力。然而，电子书写和阅读订单仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们使用人造自旋冰作为中尺度平台，可以在其中设计、直接成像和电控制补偿顺序。具体来说，我们演示了三角形人造自旋冰中补偿状态的组合电写入和读取。利用自旋轨道扭矩切换电流的方向依赖性，我们通过单个电流通道独立切换三个纳米磁体子晶格，平面霍尔效应提供亚晶格解析的读数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于杂散场消失、对扰动的鲁棒性和超快动力学，补偿磁系统（例如反铁磁体）在自旋电子器件方面具有巨大的潜力。然而，电子书写和阅读订单仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们使用人造自旋冰作为中尺度平台，可以在其中设计、直接成像和电控制补偿顺序。具体来说，我们演示了三角形人造自旋冰中补偿状态的组合电写入和读取。利用自旋轨道扭矩切换电流的方向依赖性，我们通过单个电流通道独立切换三个纳米磁体子晶格，平面霍尔效应提供亚晶格解析的读数。这允许访问三角形板的所有八种磁化状态，包括其完全补偿的状态，从而产生非线性的、依赖于历史的电响应。我们的研究结果建立了一种电可编程补偿磁性系统的方法，并为可重构磁性设备和非常规计算提供了重要基础。

articles.title: Indentation of pre-tensioned cortex-like fibre networks: tension, local stretching and the signature of defect architecture
articles.title_zh: 预张紧皮质状纤维网络的压痕：张力、局部拉伸和缺陷结构的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Indentation is widely used to infer the mechanical state of biological materials like the actomyosin cortex. It reduces a single force-indentation curve to an apparent modulus. The cortex, however, is a pre-tensioned, heterogeneous fibre network. We show that this inference is ambiguous. The same amount of weakening can leave the indentation force unchanged or lower it tenfold, depending on where it lies relative to the probe. The force reflects how the probe couples to the tensioned, load-bearing structure, not the amount of weakening. We combine molecular dynamics simulations of a pressure-loaded, crosslinked fibre network indented by a rigid sphere with a continuum membrane solution. We represent the simulated force-depth response by a two-term fit, Fpropto aδ+bδ³/², with a reflecting the global tension, and b the stiffening with depth. At a fixed fraction of weakened bonds, diffuse weakening lowers the force by a factor of about 1.5. A weak cluster beneath the probe lowers it 8-12-fold, because the slack cluster decouples the probe from the tension. When the clusters are displaced from the contact, the force returns to within 15% of the healthy value. Two opposite effects cancel. The clusters soften the whole layer, which lowers its tension and the force. But they also channel the load through the intact network beneath the probe, which stiffens it locally and raises the force. The shape of the curve retains what the force level hides. The coefficient a reflects the softened layer when clusters beside the probe keep the force near the healthy value. The local exponent α=dln F/dlnδ increases with depth in every configuration except when a cluster lies beneath the probe, where the two-term form no longer applies. Detecting localised weakening requires spatial sampling and analysis of the curve shape, not a single fitted modulus.
articles.abstract_zh: 压痕广泛用于推断肌动球蛋白皮层等生物材料的机械状态。它将单个力-压痕曲线简化为表观模量。然而，皮质是一个预张紧的异质纤维网络。我们证明这个推论是不明确的。相同程度的弱化可以使压痕力保持不变或降低十倍，具体取决于压痕力相对于探针的位置。该力反映了探头如何与张紧的承载结构耦合，而不是减弱的程度。我们将刚性球体压入的压力加载交联纤维网络的分子动力学模拟与连续膜解决方案结合起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压痕广泛用于推断肌动球蛋白皮层等生物材料的机械状态。它将单个力-压痕曲线简化为表观模量。然而，皮质是一个预张紧的异质纤维网络。我们证明这个推论是不明确的。相同程度的弱化可以使压痕力保持不变或降低十倍，具体取决于压痕力相对于探针的位置。该力反映了探头如何与张紧的承载结构耦合，而不是减弱的程度。我们将刚性球体压入的压力加载交联纤维网络的分子动力学模拟与连续膜解决方案结合起来。我们通过两项拟合 Fpropto aδ+bδ³/² 来表示模拟的力-深度响应，其中 a 反映全局张力，b 反映深度的刚度。当弱化键的比例固定时，扩散弱化会使力降低约 1.5 倍。探针下方的弱簇会将其降低 8-12 倍，因为松弛的簇使探针与张力解耦。当簇从接触处移开时，力恢复到正常值的 15% 以内。两种相反的效果相互抵消。这些簇软化了整个层，从而降低了其张力和力量。但它们还通过探头下方完整的网络引导负载，从而局部硬化并提高力。曲线的形状保留了力水平隐藏的内容。系数 a 反映了当探头旁边的簇将力保持在健康值附近时的软化层。在每种配置中，局部指数 α=dln F/dlnδ 都随着深度的增加而增加，除非簇位于探针下方，此时两项形式不再适用。检测局部弱化需要对曲线形状进行空间采样和分析，而不是单个拟合模量。

articles.title: Ab initio Engineering of Topological Superconductivity in Substrate-Supported Magnetic Chains
articles.title_zh: 基片支撑磁链中拓扑超导性的从头算工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we employ a combination of several first-principles-based approaches to systematically scan chains of several types of magnetic atoms in different chain geometries on top of various overlayers on the Nb(110) surface, to develop a pathway to engineer topological Majorana edge states. Using atomistic spin-model calculations, we first identify a rich variety of magnetic configurations, including ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, spin-spiral, and exotic up-up-down-down states stabilized solely within a second-order Heisenberg model. In the next step, we solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations using a band-theoretical method. Depending on the magnetic structure and atomic configuration, the superconducting spectra may exhibit topologically trivial minigaps, broad overlapping Shiba bands, or localized zero-energy edge states accompanied by sizable topological minigaps. In particular, Fe chains on Ag/Nb(110) are found to display pronounced signatures associated with topological superconductivity, including strongly localized zero-energy edge states and indications of Shiba band inversion. We further demonstrate that changes in the spin structure or a small amount of spatial relaxation can substantially modify the superconducting band structure and the localization properties of the edge states.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们采用几种基于第一性原理的方法相结合，系统地扫描 Nb(110) 表面上各种覆盖层顶部不同链几何形状的几种类型磁性原子的链，以开发一种设计拓扑马约拉纳边缘态的途径。使用原子自旋模型计算，我们首先识别出丰富多样的磁性配置，包括铁磁、反铁磁、自旋螺旋和仅在二阶海森堡模型内稳定的奇异的上下状态。下一步，我们使用能带理论方法求解 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们采用几种基于第一性原理的方法相结合，系统地扫描 Nb(110) 表面上各种覆盖层顶部不同链几何形状的几种类型磁性原子的链，以开发一种设计拓扑马约拉纳边缘态的途径。使用原子自旋模型计算，我们首先识别出丰富多样的磁性配置，包括铁磁、反铁磁、自旋螺旋和仅在二阶海森堡模型内稳定的奇异的上下状态。下一步，我们使用能带理论方法求解 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程。根据磁结构和原子构型，超导光谱可能表现出拓扑微不足道的微能隙、宽重叠的 Shiba 能带或伴随相当大的拓扑微能隙的局部零能量边缘态。特别是，Ag/Nb(110) 上的 Fe 链被发现显示出与拓扑超导性相关的明显特征，包括强局域化的零能量边缘态和 Shiba 能带反转的迹象。我们进一步证明，自旋结构的变化或少量的空间弛豫可以显着改变超导带结构和边缘态的局域特性。

articles.title: Atomic-scale Imaging of Time Reversal Breaking Supercurrents in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈
articles.title_zh: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中时间反转断裂超电流的原子尺度成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A persistent mystery of CuO₂-based high temperature superconductivity has been the mechanism and consequences of time reversal (T)-symmetry breaking. Although theoretical hypotheses focus upon persistent electronic currents as a potential cause, these have been invisible to direct experimental probes. That impasse has recently been removed by development of techniques for atomic-scale supercurrent visualization. Here, by imaging the energy-resolved density of electronic states N(r,E) in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈, we search for the specific signatures of flowing supercurrents in a disordered d-wave superconductor. Employing the strategy of artificial neural networks (ANN) for complex quantum matter visualization, we designed a dual-ANN (VMAP) to efficiently implement d-wave supercurrent visualization, achieving imaging of supercurrent speeds V(r) at magnetic fields |B| ≤ μ T in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈. Correspondence between specific characteristics of N(r,E) around each supercurrent loop and a quantum "Rosetta Stone" which translates N(r,E) to V(r), emphasizes the validity of V(r) detection and visualization. Then, for hole-densities 0.17 ≤ p ≤ 0.22 we observe statistically repeatable networks of supercurrent flows. Crucially, these supercurrents satisfy Kirchhoff's law at junctions within each network. Further, theoretical predictions for supercurrent speeds V in disordered d-wave superconductors are consistent with measured 1250 m/s < V < 4000 m/s, and with reported magnetic field amplitudes |B| approx 0.1 mT Thus, detection and visualization of these supercurrent loop networks provides unique perspectives on T-symmetry breaking in cuprates. It also emphasizes the accelerating utility of ANN techniques for physics discovery from high data volume quantum matter research.
articles.abstract_zh: CuO2 基高温超导性的一个长期谜团是时间反转 (T) 对称性破缺的机制和后果。尽管理论假设集中于持续电子电流作为潜在原因，但这些对于直接实验探针来说是不可见的。最近，原子级超电流可视化技术的发展打破了这一僵局。在这里，通过对 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中电子态 N(r,E) 的能量分辨密度进行成像，我们寻找无序 d 波超导体中流动超电流的特定特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: CuO2 基高温超导性的一个长期谜团是时间反转 (T) 对称性破缺的机制和后果。尽管理论假设集中于持续电子电流作为潜在原因，但这些对于直接实验探针来说是不可见的。最近，原子级超电流可视化技术的发展打破了这一僵局。在这里，通过对 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中电子态 N(r,E) 的能量分辨密度进行成像，我们寻找无序 d 波超导体中流动超电流的特定特征。采用人工神经网络（ANN）进行复杂量子物质可视化的策略，我们设计了双神经网络（VMAP）来有效实现d波超电流可视化，实现磁场|B|下超电流速度V(r)的成像。 ≤ Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中的 μT。每个超电流回路周围的 N(r,E) 的具体特征与将 N(r,E) 转换为 V(r) 的量子“罗塞塔石碑”之间的对应关系，强调了 V(r) 检测和可视化的有效性。然后，对于空穴密度 0.17 ≤ p ≤ 0.22，我们观察到统计上可重复的超电流网络。至关重要的是，这些超电流在每个网络的交汇处都满足基尔霍夫定律。此外，无序 d 波超导体中超电流速度 V 的理论预测与测量的 1250 m/s < V < 4000 m/s 以及报告的磁场幅度 |B| 一致。约 0.1 mT 因此，这些超电流环路网络的检测和可视化为铜酸盐中 T 对称性破缺提供了独特的视角。它还强调了人工神经网络技术在高数据量量子物质研究中的物理发现的加速应用。

articles.title: Quasi-long-range order in the quantum XY model on Sierpiński gaskets
articles.title_zh: Sierpiński 垫片量子 XY 模型中的准长程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractal geometry has recently been shown to enhance the amplitude of the superconducting order parameter, but the fate of the superconducting phase on such lattices is far less clear. Classical XY models on finitely ramified fractals have no finite-temperature transition, as the energy of a vortex stays bounded as the system grows. However, that statement concerns an infinite gasket and thermal vortices, while real fractal structures are finite by construction. It also leaves open what happens at T = 0, where the phase competes not with temperature but with its own quantum fluctuations. In this work we address whether superconducting phase coherence survives at T=0. %Whether coherence survives those is the prior question, and the one we address here. To that end, we study the spin-1/2 XY ferromagnet, the phase sector of a Josephson network with at most one Cooper pair per island, thus capturing the maximum effect of quantum phase fluctuations, on both triangular and honeycomb Sierpiński gaskets. By using vision-transformer neural quantum states optimized by variational Monte Carlo, we reach generations up to G = 5, that is 366 sites for the triangular gasket and 609 for the honeycomb one, well beyond the reach of exact diagonalization. We find that the transverse two-point correlator decays algebraically, Cₓy(r) sim r⁻η with η simeq 0.12!-!0.32, independent of distance measured along the graph, along the fractal boundary, or in the embedding plane. Quantum phase fluctuations thus leave quasi-long-range order intact in the ground state. We further discuss the implication of these results for the superconducting response of a finite gasket at low but nonzero temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，分形几何被证明可以增强超导有序参数的幅度，但超导相在这种晶格上的命运还不太清楚。有限分形上的经典 XY 模型没有有限温度转变，因为随着系统的增长，涡旋的能量保持有界。然而，该陈述涉及无限垫圈和热涡流，而真正的分形结构是有限的。它还对 T = 0 时发生的情况开放，其中相位不与温度竞争，而是与其自身的量子涨落竞争。在这项工作中，我们讨论了超导相位相干性在 T=0 时是否仍然存在。 %一致性是否仍然存在是首要问题，也是我们在这里讨论的问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，分形几何被证明可以增强超导有序参数的幅度，但超导相在这种晶格上的命运还不太清楚。有限分形上的经典 XY 模型没有有限温度转变，因为随着系统的增长，涡旋的能量保持有界。然而，该陈述涉及无限垫圈和热涡流，而真正的分形结构是有限的。它还对 T = 0 时发生的情况开放，其中相位不与温度竞争，而是与其自身的量子涨落竞争。在这项工作中，我们讨论了超导相位相干性在 T=0 时是否仍然存在。 %一致性是否仍然存在是首要问题，也是我们在这里讨论的问题。为此，我们研究了自旋 1/2 XY 铁磁体，这是约瑟夫森网络的相位扇区，每个岛最多有一对库珀对，从而在三角形和蜂窝状 Sierpiński 垫片上捕获量子相位涨落的最大影响。通过使用通过变分蒙特卡罗优化的视觉变换器神经量子态，我们达到了高达 G = 5 的世代，即三角形垫片有 366 个位点，蜂窝垫片有 609 个位点，远远超出了精确对角化的范围。我们发现横向两点相关器以代数方式衰减，Cₓy(r) sim r⁻η，其中 η simeq 0.12!-!0.32，与沿图、沿分形边界或嵌入平面测量的距离无关。因此，量子相位涨落使基态下的准长程有序保持完整。我们进一步讨论这些结果对有限垫片在低温但非零温度下的超导响应的影响。

articles.title: Charge-transfer excitation drives cooperative phonon-assisted exciton self-trapping in NiPS₃
articles.title_zh: 电荷转移激发驱动 NiPS₃ 中协同声子辅助激子自捕获
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Carrier self-trapping is a fundamental relaxation pathway in strongly correlated quantum materials, yet the microscopic lattice motions that drive it have remained largely inaccessible to direct observation. Here we investigate the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiPS₃ upon excitation across its ligand-to-metal charge-transfer gap, and reveal a nonequilibrium pathway that initially generates unbound carriers before they evolve into correlated excitonic states. Using ultrabroadband optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy, we simultaneously track carrier localization and the associated lattice dynamics in real time. The transient conductive response quenches with a time constant of sim109 fs and evolves into a localized exciton state, accompanied by pronounced renormalization of Ni-S optical phonons and the emergence of a transient 2.7 THz vibrational mode. Temperature-dependent measurements, together with mode-resolved dielectric dynamics and symmetry analysis, identify the 2.7 and 8.0 THz responses as spectroscopic indicators of exciton self-trapping and point to a cooperative two-phonon mechanism. These findings establish the excitation pathway as a key parameter controlling carrier localization and many-body relaxation in strongly coupled quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 载流子自捕获是强相关量子材料中的基本弛豫途径，但驱动它的微观晶格运动在很大程度上仍然无法直接观察到。在这里，我们研究了范德华反铁磁体 NiPS₃ 在其配体到金属电荷转移间隙的激发时，并揭示了一条非平衡途径，该途径最初产生未结合的载流子，然后演化为相关的激子态。使用超宽带光泵太赫兹探针光谱，我们同时实时跟踪载流子定位和相关的晶格动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 载流子自捕获是强相关量子材料中的基本弛豫途径，但驱动它的微观晶格运动在很大程度上仍然无法直接观察到。在这里，我们研究了范德华反铁磁体 NiPS₃ 在其配体到金属电荷转移间隙的激发时，并揭示了一条非平衡途径，该途径最初产生未结合的载流子，然后演化为相关的激子态。使用超宽带光泵太赫兹探针光谱，我们同时实时跟踪载流子定位和相关的晶格动力学。瞬态传导响应以 sim109 fs 的时间常数猝灭，并演变成局域激子态，伴随着 Ni-S 光学声子的显着重整化和瞬态 2.7 THz 振动模式的出现。温度相关测量以及模式分辨介电动力学和对称性分析，将 2.7 和 8.0 THz 响应识别为激子自捕获的光谱指标，并指出了协作的双声子机制。这些发现将激发路径确立为控制强耦合量子材料中载流子局域化和多体弛豫的关键参数。

articles.title: Dynamics of a Single-Domain Dissipative Magnetic Gyroscope in Electric and Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 电场和磁场中单域耗散磁陀螺的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate the coupled spin--rotation dynamics of a single-domain symmetric top ferromagnetic needle (a magnetic gyroscope) in static magnetic and electric fields. The conservative Hamiltonian contains the rotational kinetic energy, the magnetocrystalline and shape anisotropy, the Zeeman energy, the electrostatic energy of the dipole induced in the conducting needle, the linear magnetoelectric coupling, and the relativistic motional (spin-orbit) coupling. Gilbert damping is introduced, and in an electric field, Debye relaxation of the induced electric dipole of the conducting needle also results in dissipation. We give the equations of motion in the laboratory and body-fixed frames, with singularity-free quaternion kinematics. For a 120-nm-long single-domain cobalt needle in a 0.5~T field we find: (i) because the anisotropy field (approx 1.3~T) exceeds the applied magnetic field, the spin reverses direction several times during the initial Gilbert-damping transient, and the parity of the number of reversals determines whether the easy axis ends up parallel or antiparallel to the spin; (ii) after the transient the needle librates about the field---precession accompanied by nutation at twice the precession frequency---with a period of about 20~ns, consistent with the libration period 2π(I₁/μ B)¹/², while the Zeeman and rotational kinetic energies oscillate out of phase and the total energy is conserved; (iii) a static electric field mathbf E exerts on the conducting needle a shape-dependent polarization torque that tends to align the long axis of the needle with mathbf E. The torques due to the magnetoelectric interaction and motional magnetic fields (lesssim1~μT) are negligible compared with the polarization torque. A conducting needle can therefore serve as a magnetometer only if Ell E_c.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们制定了静态磁场和电场中单域对称顶部铁磁针（磁陀螺仪）的耦合自旋-旋转动力学。保守哈密顿量包含旋转动能、磁晶和形状各向异性、塞曼能量、导电针中感应的偶极子静电能、线性磁电耦合和相对论运动（自旋轨道）耦合。引入了吉尔伯特阻尼，并且在电场中，导电针的感应电偶极子的德拜弛豫也会导致耗散。我们给出了实验室和身体固定框架中的运动方程，具有无奇点四元数运动学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们制定了静态磁场和电场中单域对称顶部铁磁针（磁陀螺仪）的耦合自旋-旋转动力学。保守哈密顿量包含旋转动能、磁晶和形状各向异性、塞曼能量、导电针中感应的偶极子静电能、线性磁电耦合和相对论运动（自旋轨道）耦合。引入了吉尔伯特阻尼，并且在电场中，导电针的感应电偶极子的德拜弛豫也会导致耗散。我们给出了实验室和身体固定框架中的运动方程，具有无奇点四元数运动学。对于 0.5~T 场中的 120 nm 长的单畴钴针，我们发现：（i）由于各向异性场（约 1.3~T）超过了施加的磁场，自旋在初始吉尔伯特阻尼瞬态过程中多次反转方向，反转次数的奇偶性决定了易轴最终是否与自旋平行或反平行； (ii) 瞬态后，针围绕场进行振动——进动伴随着两倍进动频率的章动——周期约为20ns，与振动周期2π(I₁/μB)1/2一致，而塞曼和旋转动能异相振荡，总能量守恒； (iii) 静电场 mathbf E 对导电针施加形状相关的极化扭矩，该扭矩倾向于使针的长轴与 mathbf E 对齐。与极化扭矩相比，磁电相互作用和运动磁场 (lesssim1~μT) 产生的扭矩可以忽略不计。因此，只有当 Ell E_c 时，导电针才能充当磁力计。

articles.title: Competing Magnetic Orders and Continuously Varying Exponents in U(1) Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: U(1) 自旋液体中的竞争磁序和连续变化的指数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unequal couplings to a common emergent gauge field provide a continuous way to tune competing magnetic instabilities in an effective description of U(1) spin-liquid mixtures. We study this mechanism in quantum electrodynamics in 2+1 dimensions with two families of four-component Dirac fermions. Combining a leading large-N treatment with Schwinger--Dyson equations, we obtain chiral condensates representing Néel order in the two sectors. At fixed fermion number, the coupling ratio κ=e₂²/e₁² controls which condensates develop. Depending on N, the phases with a single condensate are connected through either coexistence or a finite interval in which both fermion families remain gapless. The mass-generation thresholds are reciprocal, and the fermion gaps close with Miransky essential singularities. The renormalization group flow has a circular line of fixed points parametrized by the invariant ratio κ. At the calculated order, gauge-invariant staggered magnetization correlations have continuously varying exponents in the gapless regime, while the exponent for correlations between the two sectors is independent of κ. These results connect the competition between magnetic orders to a continuous family of critical theories and identify magnetic correlation signatures of the intervening gapless regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 与常见的新兴规范场的不等耦合提供了一种连续的方法来调整 U(1) 自旋液体混合物的有效描述中竞争的磁不稳定性。我们用两个四组分狄拉克费米子族在 2+1 维的量子电动力学中研究这一机制。将领先的大 N 处理与 Schwinger-Dyson 方程相结合，我们获得了代表两个扇区 Néel 级的手性凝聚态。在费米子数固定时，耦合比 κ=e22/e22 控制凝聚态的形成。根据 N，具有单一凝聚体的相通过共存或有限间隔连接，其中两个费米子族保持无间隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与常见的新兴规范场的不等耦合提供了一种连续的方法来调整 U(1) 自旋液体混合物的有效描述中竞争的磁不稳定性。我们用两个四组分狄拉克费米子族在 2+1 维的量子电动力学中研究这一机制。将领先的大 N 处理与 Schwinger-Dyson 方程相结合，我们获得了代表两个扇区 Néel 级的手性凝聚态。在费米子数固定时，耦合比 κ=e22/e22 控制凝聚态的形成。根据 N，具有单一凝聚体的相通过共存或有限间隔连接，其中两个费米子族保持无间隙。质量产生阈值是倒数的，并且费米子间隙与米兰斯基本质奇点接近。重整化群流具有由不变比 κ 参数化的固定点环形线。在计算的顺序上，规范不变的交错磁化强度相关性在无间隙状态下具有连续变化的指数，而两个扇区之间的相关性的指数与κ无关。这些结果将磁序之间的竞争与一系列连续的批判理论联系起来，并确定了干预无间隙状态的磁相关特征。

articles.title: Photon condensation driven by scalar spin chirality
articles.title_zh: 由标量自旋手性驱动的光子凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gauge invariance forbids equilibrium photon condensation for spatially uniform electric-dipole coupling, motivating alternative routes based on orbital magnetic response. We show that triangular molecular magnets coupled to a cavity support photon condensation driven by emergent scalar spin chirality. Starting from the half-filled Hubbard model in the Mott regime, we derive an effective Hamiltonian in which virtual ring exchange couples the cavity flux directly to scalar spin chirality. Mean-field theory, collective-fluctuation calculations, and finite-size exact diagonalization reveal a phase with spontaneous chirality ordering and a macroscopic cavity displacement, together with hybrid chirality-photon excitations. The condensation threshold can be tuned electrically through the molecular chirality splitting. Our results establish emergent orbital degrees of freedom in frustrated magnets as a route to equilibrium light-matter ordering beyond conventional dipolar cavity quantum electrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 规范不变性禁止空间均匀电偶极子耦合的平衡光子凝聚，从而激发了基于轨道磁响应的替代路线。我们表明，与空腔耦合的三角形分子磁体支持由涌现标量自旋手性驱动的光子凝聚。从莫特体系中的半填充哈伯德模型开始，我们推导出一个有效的哈密顿量，其中虚拟环交换将腔通量直接耦合到标量自旋手性。平均场理论、集体涨落计算和有限尺寸精确对角化揭示了具有自发手性排序和宏观空腔位移以及混合手性光子激发的相。凝聚阈值可以通过分子手性分裂进行电调节。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 规范不变性禁止空间均匀电偶极子耦合的平衡光子凝聚，从而激发了基于轨道磁响应的替代路线。我们表明，与空腔耦合的三角形分子磁体支持由涌现标量自旋手性驱动的光子凝聚。从莫特体系中的半填充哈伯德模型开始，我们推导出一个有效的哈密顿量，其中虚拟环交换将腔通量直接耦合到标量自旋手性。平均场理论、集体涨落计算和有限尺寸精确对角化揭示了具有自发手性排序和宏观空腔位移以及混合手性光子激发的相。凝聚阈值可以通过分子手性分裂进行电调节。我们的结果建立了受挫磁体中的涌现轨道自由度，作为超越传统偶极腔量子电动力学的平衡光物质排序的途径。

articles.title: Multiple Field-Induced Transitions, Magnetocaloric Response and Anisotropic Magnetotransport in Orthorhombic RAlGe (R = Dy, Ho)
articles.title_zh: 正交晶系 RAlGe (R = Dy, Ho) 中的多重场诱导跃迁、磁热响应和各向异性磁输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive study of the magnetic, thermodynamic, and magnetocaloric properties of single-crystalline DyAlGe and HoAlGe, both members of the RAlGe Weyl semimetal family. Magnetization, heat capacity and transport measurements reveal multiple magnetic phase transitions associated with the evolution of complex magnetic structures. For DyAlGe, the primary magnetic ordering occurs at textitTN₁= 30.5 K , while HoAlGe orders at a much lower temperature of textitTN₁= 11.5 K, followed by additional first-order magnetic transitions at 6.6 K and 8 K, respectively. The magnetization isotherms display pronounced anisotropy for the B parallel a, consistent with competing exchange and crystal-field interactions. The magnetic entropy change (Δ S_M) derived from isothermal magnetization demonstrates a significant magnetocaloric effect (MCE) with sign change in both systems, with a maximum Δ S_M of approx 5-23 J/kg-K along B parallel a for a field change of 0-7 T. The sign reversal of Δ S_M across field-induced transitions highlights the complex field-tuned spin configurations. The moderate MCE and magnetic anisotropy suggest that these materials may serve as model systems for studying magnetocaloric effects in topologically nontrivial intermetallics with interplay between localized 4f magnetism and crystal symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对单晶 DyAlGe 和 HoAlGe 的磁性、热力学和磁热特性进行了全面的研究，这两种材料都是 RAlGe Weyl 半金属家族的成员。磁化强度、热容量和输运测量揭示了与复杂磁结构演化相关的多个磁相变。对于 DyAlGe，初级磁有序化发生在 textitTN₁= 30.5 K 处，而 HoAlGe 有序化发生在低得多的温度下，textitTN₁= 11.5 K，随后分别在 6.6 K 和 8 K 处发生额外的一阶磁转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对单晶 DyAlGe 和 HoAlGe 的磁性、热力学和磁热特性进行了全面的研究，这两种材料都是 RAlGe Weyl 半金属家族的成员。磁化强度、热容量和输运测量揭示了与复杂磁结构演化相关的多个磁相变。对于 DyAlGe，初级磁有序化发生在 textitTN₁= 30.5 K 处，而 HoAlGe 有序化发生在低得多的温度下，textitTN₁= 11.5 K，随后分别在 6.6 K 和 8 K 处发生额外的一阶磁转变。 B 平行 a 的磁化等温线显示出明显的各向异性，与竞争交换和晶体场相互作用一致。来自等温磁化的磁熵变化 (Δ S_M) 表现出显着的磁热效应 (MCE)，在两个系统中都存在符号变化，对于 0-7 T 的场变化，沿着 B 平行 a 的最大 Δ S_M 约为 5-23 J/kg-K。跨越场诱导跃迁的 Δ S_M 的符号反转突出了复杂的场调谐自旋配置。适度的 MCE 和磁各向异性表明这些材料可以作为模型系统来研究拓扑非平凡金属间化合物中的磁热效应以及局域 4f 磁性和晶体对称性之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Quantum vacuum inversion and multi-kink unbinding in the non-degenerate double sine-Gordon model
articles.title_zh: 非简并双正弦戈登模型中的量子真空反演和多扭结解束缚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.24861v5 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum fluctuations can unbind a composite soliton while the correction to its mass stays small. We show this beyond perturbation theory for the multi-kinks of the non-degenerate double sine-Gordon model. At one loop the vacuum at the centre of the multi-kink becomes the true vacuum at a coupling of order the classical lifting of the vacua. Tensor-network calculations of the lattice theory show that this inversion survives beyond one loop and has a continuum limit, and that the Gaussian effective potential captures it. On finite chains the multi-kink unbinds when the tension of the string of central vacuum between its two halves falls through zero
articles.abstract_zh: 量子涨落可以解除复合孤子的束缚，同时对其质量的修正保持较小。我们展示了非简并双正弦戈登模型的多重扭结的超越微扰理论。在一个循环中，多扭结中心的真空在真空的经典提升的阶次耦合下变成真正的真空。晶格理论的张量网络计算表明，这种反演在一个循环之外仍然存在，并且具有连续极限，并且高斯有效势捕获了它。在有限链上，当两半之间的中央真空绳的张力降至零时，多扭结就会解开
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子涨落可以解除复合孤子的束缚，同时对其质量的修正保持较小。我们展示了非简并双正弦戈登模型的多重扭结的超越微扰理论。在一个循环中，多扭结中心的真空在真空的经典提升的阶次耦合下变成真正的真空。晶格理论的张量网络计算表明，这种反演在一个循环之外仍然存在，并且具有连续极限，并且高斯有效势捕获了它。在有限链上，当两半之间的中央真空绳的张力降至零时，多扭结就会解开

articles.title: Robust Passive Quantum Memory in Three Dimensions, Part I: Thermal and Zero-Temperature Perturbative Stability
articles.title_zh: 稳健的三维无源量子存储器，第一部分：热和零温微扰稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whether a three-dimensional quantum many-body system with geometrically local, bounded-degree interactions can passively protect encoded quantum information has remained a central open question since Kitaev introduced topological quantum computation. Passive protection requires stability against both thermal noise at nonzero temperature and generic static Hamiltonian perturbations Balasubramanian, Davydova, and Lin (BDL) recently established unperturbed three-dimensional thermal self-correction using a recursively defined family of stabilizer Hamiltonians. However, they left open whether their construction remains stable against quantum perturbations, even at zero temperature. In this paper, we show that a slight variant of the BDL code family achieves stability along both boundary axes of the perturbation-temperature phase diagram as the system size grows. Following BDL, in the absence of perturbation it is thermally stable below a critical temperature, achieving a stretched-exponentially long memory lifetime when coupled to any local Markovian thermal bath generated by single-site system-bath interactions satisfying detailed balance with bounded coupling rates. At zero temperature under arbitrary weak, superpolynomially decaying quantum perturbations, the family maintains a uniform bulk spectral gap, superpolynomially small ground-space splitting, and a superpolynomially long closed-system unitary memory lifetime for quasi-locally dressed logical observables. To prove this zero-temperature stability, we establish local topological quantum order across the multiscale hierarchy using a linearly dilated relaxation of the usual Bravyi-Hastings-Michalakis criteria. In the companion paper, we combine the tools developed here with finite-temperature worldline cluster expansions to establish passive self-correction throughout the phase diagram's positive-temperature perturbed interior.
articles.abstract_zh: 自从基塔耶夫引入拓扑量子计算以来，具有几何局部、有界度相互作用的三维量子多体系统是否能够被动地保护编码的量子信息仍然是一个核心悬而未决的问题。被动保护需要针对非零温度下的热噪声和通用静态哈密顿扰动保持稳定。Balasubramanian、Davydova 和 Lin (BDL) 最近使用递归定义的稳定器哈密顿量族建立了不受扰动的三维热自校正。然而，他们对于他们的结构是否在量子扰动下保持稳定（即使在零温度下）仍持开放态度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自从基塔耶夫引入拓扑量子计算以来，具有几何局部、有界度相互作用的三维量子多体系统是否能够被动地保护编码的量子信息仍然是一个核心悬而未决的问题。被动保护需要针对非零温度下的热噪声和通用静态哈密顿扰动保持稳定。Balasubramanian、Davydova 和 Lin (BDL) 最近使用递归定义的稳定器哈密顿量族建立了不受扰动的三维热自校正。然而，他们对于他们的结构是否在量子扰动下保持稳定（即使在零温度下）仍持开放态度。在本文中，我们表明，随着系统尺寸的增大，BDL 代码族的一个微小变体可以沿着扰动-温度相图的两个边界轴实现稳定性。 BDL 之后，在没有扰动的情况下，它在临界温度以下是热稳定的，当耦合到由单点系统-浴相互作用产生的任何局部马尔可夫热浴时，可实现指数级长的记忆寿命，满足有限耦合率的详细平衡。在零温度下，在任意弱、超多项式衰减的量子扰动下，该族保持均匀的体光谱间隙、超多项式的小地面空间分裂，以及准局部修饰逻辑可观测量的超多项式长的封闭系统酉存储寿命。为了证明这种零温度稳定性，我们使用通常的 Bravyi-Hastings-Michalakis 准则的线性扩张松弛在多尺度层次上建立局部拓扑量子序。在配套论文中，我们将此处开发的工具与有限温度世界线簇扩展相结合，在整个相图的正温度扰动内部建立被动自校正。

articles.title: Symmetry-reduced k-point sampling and Wannier analysis with localized Gaussian orbitals
articles.title_zh: 对称性降低的 k 点采样和使用局域高斯轨道的 Wannier 分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Brillouin-zone sampling with localized orbitals requires consistent transformations between sparse real-space matrices and complex Bloch states. Symmetry reduces the number of reciprocal-space problems, but scalar integration weights alone cannot reconstruct the matrices and wavefunctions needed for densities and orbital analysis. We develop a unified formulation of these transformations for nonorthogonal Gaussian bases and describe its implementation in CP2K. Atom permutations, local orbital rotations, and lattice phases connect irreducible-point solutions to full symmetry orbits while preserving the overlap metric. Direct and fast lattice transforms couple this construction to self-consistent calculations, including complex orbital optimization and finite-temperature occupations. Gauge-consistent full-mesh orbitals and directed inter-point overlaps support Wannier90 export, Wannier construction, and Hamiltonian interpolation. In silicon and aluminium tests, symmetry reduces a 64-point mesh to four representatives while retaining cell energies or electronic free energies within 1.5×10⁻¹² hartree of the unreduced calculation. Hybrid exchange and many-body applications illustrate the additional role of auxiliary bases and transfer momenta. The resulting framework connects symmetry-reduced integration to gauge-consistent analysis of periodic electronic states within a localized-orbital representation.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有局域轨道的布里渊区采样需要稀疏实空间矩阵和复杂布洛赫状态之间的一致变换。对称性减少了倒易空间问题的数量，但仅标量积分权重无法重建密度和轨道分析所需的矩阵和波函数。我们为非正交高斯基开发了这些变换的统一公式，并描述了其在 CP2K 中的实现。原子排列、局部轨道旋转和晶格相位将不可约点解连接到完全对称轨道，同时保留重叠度量。直接和快速的晶格变换将这种结构与自洽计算结合起来，包括复杂的轨道优化和有限温度占据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有局域轨道的布里渊区采样需要稀疏实空间矩阵和复杂布洛赫状态之间的一致变换。对称性减少了倒易空间问题的数量，但仅标量积分权重无法重建密度和轨道分析所需的矩阵和波函数。我们为非正交高斯基开发了这些变换的统一公式，并描述了其在 CP2K 中的实现。原子排列、局部轨道旋转和晶格相位将不可约点解连接到完全对称轨道，同时保留重叠度量。直接和快速的晶格变换将这种结构与自洽计算结合起来，包括复杂的轨道优化和有限温度占据。规范一致的全网格轨道和定向点间重叠支持 Wannier90 导出、Wannier 构造和哈密顿插值。在硅和铝测试中，对称性将 64 点网格减少到四个代表，同时将电池能量或电子自由能保留在未减少计算的 1.5×10⁻12 hartree 内。混合交换和多体应用说明了辅助基础和传递动量的附加作用。由此产生的框架将对称性降低的积分与局域轨道表示内的周期性电子态的规范一致分析联系起来。

articles.title: Shortest-path percolation and structural robustness of quantum internet networks
articles.title_zh: 量子互联网的最短路径渗透和结构鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21855v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study shortest-path percolation on spatial networks that model the quantum internet based on optical fibers. In this process, the removal of paths describes the consumption of the entangled links used for communication. We compare finite and unrestricted path-length bounds for networks whose average degree either increases with system size or remains approximately constant. We show that networks become more robust as the average degree increases, whereas networks with approximately constant average degree exhibit a data collapse for the fixed finite bounds considered. Using Monte Carlo sampling of the shortest-path-length distribution, we estimate an equivalent path cost, a finite bound that approximately reproduces the degradation of the network in the unrestricted case. For networks with fixed average degree, this cost grows approximately as the square root of the number of nodes. Increasing the bound beyond this value requires additional computation time without appreciably changing the percolation dynamics. As a complementary result, for Erdős-Rényi random networks, we find an empirical relation between the initial average degree and the approximately common crossing point of the percolation curves for different path-length bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究空间网络上的最短路径渗透，该网络模拟基于光纤的量子互联网。在这个过程中，路径的移除描述了用于通信的纠缠链路的消耗。我们比较了网络的有限和无限制路径长度界限，其平均度要么随着系统规模的增加而增加，要么保持近似恒定。我们表明，随着平均度数的增加，网络变得更加鲁棒，而平均度数近似恒定的网络在所考虑的固定有限范围内表现出数据崩溃。使用最短路径长度分布的蒙特卡罗采样，我们估计等效路径成本，即近似再现不受限制情况下网络退化的有限界限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究空间网络上的最短路径渗透，该网络模拟基于光纤的量子互联网。在这个过程中，路径的移除描述了用于通信的纠缠链路的消耗。我们比较了网络的有限和无限制路径长度界限，其平均度要么随着系统规模的增加而增加，要么保持近似恒定。我们表明，随着平均度数的增加，网络变得更加鲁棒，而平均度数近似恒定的网络在所考虑的固定有限范围内表现出数据崩溃。使用最短路径长度分布的蒙特卡罗采样，我们估计等效路径成本，即近似再现不受限制情况下网络退化的有限界限。对于具有固定平均度的网络，该成本大约随着节点数量的平方根而增长。将界限增加到超出该值需要额外的计算时间，而不会明显改变渗滤动力学。作为补充结果，对于 Erdős-Rényi 随机网络，我们发现了不同路径长度边界的初始平均度与渗流曲线的近似公共交叉点之间的经验关系。

articles.title: Generalized Schrieffer-Wolff transformation
articles.title_zh: 广义施里弗-沃尔夫变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Schrieffer-Wolff transformation (SWT) is a cornerstone of effective-Hamiltonian theory. However, the SWT is predominantly used for weak-coupling problems, while a systematic counterpart for strongly coupled regimes remains largely unexplored. A general closed-form SWT generator and a clear physical principle for gauge fixing remain elusive, obscuring the transformation's underlying structure. We introduce the dual SWT to deal with the strong-coupling problems. The generalized SWT (gSWT) is formulated for any Hermitian operator and block partition. We establish the geodesic principle for its canonical gauge. Furthermore, we derive an exact closed-form solution of the gSWT generator at every order as a finite nested-commutator sum whose only input is the active gap set. Both the geometric and algebraic aspects of the SWT physics are revealed. The gSWT framework is illustrated in two quantum many-body models, the collective spin model and the transverse-field Ising model.
articles.abstract_zh: 施里弗-沃尔夫变换 (SWT) 是有效哈密尔顿理论的基石。然而，SWT 主要用于弱耦合问题，而强耦合机制的系统对应物在很大程度上仍未被探索。通用的封闭式 SWT 生成器和用于规范固定的明确物理原理仍然难以捉摸，从而模糊了转换的基础结构。我们引入对偶SWT来处理强耦合问题。广义 SWT (gSWT) 是针对任何 Hermitian 算子和块划分而制定的。我们为其规范规范建立了测地线原理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 施里弗-沃尔夫变换 (SWT) 是有效哈密尔顿理论的基石。然而，SWT 主要用于弱耦合问题，而强耦合机制的系统对应物在很大程度上仍未被探索。通用的封闭式 SWT 生成器和用于规范固定的明确物理原理仍然难以捉摸，从而模糊了转换的基础结构。我们引入对偶SWT来处理强耦合问题。广义 SWT (gSWT) 是针对任何 Hermitian 算子和块划分而制定的。我们为其规范规范建立了测地线原理。此外，我们推导了 gSWT 生成器在每个阶上的精确闭式解，作为有限嵌套换向器和，其唯一输入是有效间隙集。揭示了 SWT 物理的几何和代数方面。 gSWT 框架以两个量子多体模型、集体自旋模型和横向场伊辛模型来说明。

articles.title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
articles.title_zh: DSADiff：通过减轻复杂性和不平衡引起的偏差进行晶体结构预测的数据结构感知扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. Experiments on three CSP benchmark datasets, including Carbon-24, demonstrate that DSADiff consistently improves both Match Rate and RMSE, with a maximum Match Rate improvement of 9%, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods and achieving new state-of-the-art performance. This work deepens the understanding of diffusion-based CSP models from the perspective of generation bias and provides a new direction for designing less biased generative models for complex materials spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料产生和发现的重要一步。近年来，基于扩散的 CSP 方法取得了重大进展。然而，现有模型在面对不同的材料空间时仍然存在生成偏差，而追踪此类性能变化来源的系统方法仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一种机制分析框架，将晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡确定为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示它们与模型生成性能的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料产生和发现的重要一步。近年来，基于扩散的 CSP 方法取得了重大进展。然而，现有模型在面对不同的材料空间时仍然存在生成偏差，而追踪此类性能变化来源的系统方法仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一种机制分析框架，将晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡确定为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示它们与模型生成性能的关系。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了 DSADiff（Data Structure-Aware Diffusion），一种数据结构感知扩散模型，它将 LAS 识别的关键因素转化为统一的生成难度表示，并用其共同驱动特征建模和训练策略优化。这使得模型能够适应具有不同数据结构和难度级别的样本的表示和生成能力，从而减轻样本之间的学习偏差。在包括 Carbon-24 在内的三个 CSP 基准数据集上进行的实验表明，DSADiff 持续改进了匹配率和 RMSE，最大匹配率改进为 9%，超越了现有的最先进方法并实现了新的最先进性能。这项工作从生成偏差的角度加深了对基于扩散的 CSP 模型的理解，并为复杂材料空间设计偏差较小的生成模型提供了新的方向。

articles.title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于材料特性预测中扩散预训练的合成晶体数据生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22140v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control with continuous-time variance-preserving (VP) and sub-VP diffusion objectives using a randomly initialized Orb-v2 backbone. The source comparison covers seven MatBench property-prediction tasks, and an eighth task, textttmp_gap, is included in the protostructure scaling study. Every synthetic-pretraining condition numerically outperforms random initialization on all seven source-comparison tasks. Scaling the protostructure corpus from 20k to 165k under a fixed 400-epoch schedule numerically matches or exceeds MP-20k pretraining on most tasks; because this protocol increases both data diversity and optimization updates, the result reflects joint data-and-compute scaling.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的预训练已成为一种强大的策略，用于学习图神经网络中的可转移表示以进行材料属性预测，而无需每个预训练结构的能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法保留了一个关键的依赖性：它需要位于势能表面局部最小值附近的结构，这些结构传统上是通过已知或物理合成化合物的昂贵的 DFT 弛豫获得的。这种依赖性限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，导致晶体结构空间的大片区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成联系起来，以减少这一瓶颈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于扩散的预训练已成为一种强大的策略，用于学习图神经网络中的可转移表示以进行材料属性预测，而无需每个预训练结构的能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法保留了一个关键的依赖性：它需要位于势能表面局部最小值附近的结构，这些结构传统上是通过已知或物理合成化合物的昂贵的 DFT 弛豫获得的。这种依赖性限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，导致晶体结构空间的大片区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成联系起来，以减少这一瓶颈。我们引入了一种综合数据生成管道，结合了三种互补策略：扰动和放松、通过 MatterGen 生成采样以及原型结构枚举。在需要结构弛豫的情况下，我们使用快速机器学习的原子间势，而不是对每个生成的结构执行新的 DFT 弛豫。我们使用随机初始化的 Orb-v2 主干网络进一步将坐标去噪控制与连续时间方差保持 (VP) 和子 VP 扩散目标进行比较。源比较涵盖七个 MatBench 属性预测任务，第八个任务 textttmp_gap 包含在原型结构缩放研究中。在所有七个源比较任务上，每个合成预训练条件在数值上都优于随机初始化。在固定的 400 epoch 计划下将原型语料库从 20k 扩展到 165k，在大多数任务上在数字上匹配或超过 MP-20k 预训练；由于该协议增加了数据多样性和优化更新，因此结果反映了数据和计算的联合扩展。

articles.title: Nonlocal regularization of sharp-crack energetics: a variational bridge from Griffith geometry to emergent constitutive degradation
articles.title_zh: 锐裂纹能量学的非局部正则化：从格里菲斯几何到新兴本构退化的变分桥梁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22284v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a variational diffuse-crack model based on nonlocal averaging of tensile strain energy. A bounded potential acts on the scaled average, while the compressive energy remains local. The initial slope preserves the averaged tensile strain-energy density to leading order. The first variation yields a constitutive stress in which the tensile contribution is multiplied by the adjoint average of the derivative of the saturation potential. The resulting degradation is therefore determined by the stored-energy functional, without introducing an independent fracture field or prescribing a separate degradation law. For fixed smooth displacement fields with bounded strain, the energy density converges to the classical elastic strain-energy density as the averaging radius tends to zero. The Griffith surface-energy coefficient is recovered for planar opening transitions. A structure-preserving scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) scheme satisfies an exact discrete balance between the modified-energy increment and external work. We compare SAV and velocity-Verlet solutions for dynamic crack branching and Kalthoff--Winkler impact.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于拉伸应变能非局部平均的变分扩散裂纹模型。有界势作用于缩放平均值，而压缩能仍然是局部的。初始斜率将平均拉伸应变能量密度保留为前导顺序。第一种变化产生本构应力，其中拉伸贡献乘以饱和电势导数的伴随平均值。因此，所产生的退化由存储能量泛函决定，无需引入独立的断裂场或规定单独的退化定律。对于具有有界应变的固定平滑位移场，当平均半径趋于零时，能量密度收敛到经典弹性应变能量密度。恢复平面开口过渡的格里菲斯表面能系数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种基于拉伸应变能非局部平均的变分扩散裂纹模型。有界势作用于缩放平均值，而压缩能仍然是局部的。初始斜率将平均拉伸应变能量密度保留为前导顺序。第一种变化产生本构应力，其中拉伸贡献乘以饱和电势导数的伴随平均值。因此，所产生的退化由存储能量泛函决定，无需引入独立的断裂场或规定单独的退化定律。对于具有有界应变的固定平滑位移场，当平均半径趋于零时，能量密度收敛到经典弹性应变能量密度。恢复平面开口过渡的格里菲斯表面能系数。结构保持标量辅助变量（SAV）方案满足修正能量增量和外部功之间的精确离散平衡。我们比较了动态裂纹分支和 Kalthoff-Winkler 冲击的 SAV 和速度-Verlet 解决方案。

articles.title: Revisiting structured-light propagation in screw-dislocation geometries: Landau dynamics and gradient-induced polarization textures
articles.title_zh: 重新审视螺旋位错几何结构中的结构光传播：朗道动力学和梯度诱导偏振纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22789v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We derive the propagation of finite electromagnetic beams in the effective metric of a continuous distribution of screw dislocations from gauge-invariant, minimally coupled Maxwell theory with F=dA. The Burgers flux fixes the metric profile through σ(ρ)=f'(ρ)/(bρ), which separates true density gradients from coordinate factors. In geometric optics, both polarizations share one light cone, and a uniform density rotates the polarization uniformly relative to the geometry-adapted frame; laboratory polarimetry also requires matching at the interfaces. At leading paraxial order, the orbital motion is of Landau type, with a closed propagator for arbitrary inputs, and for a uniform density the polarization evolution factorizes exactly. For an arbitrary smooth axisymmetric density, the polarization texture initially grows in proportion to the standard deviation of the density weighted by the beam intensity; the local-phase coherence is the characteristic function of that distribution. For a coherent transverse Jones field, an exact relation links the linear-Stokes texture and the local circular polarization to spatial--polarization nonseparability. For linearly polarized, real axisymmetric input beams, diffraction produces local circular polarization at second order in the propagation distance, while the integrated circular Stokes component is conserved in the lossless leading-paraxial theory. Exact Maxwell eigenmodes, analytic results for a saturating profile, and numerical propagation test the approximation. We propose a full-Stokes measurement that compares uniform and graded samples with the same mean twist, with a closed-form criterion for the beam waist. These predictions apply to the ideal metric-Maxwell model or to a transformation-optics medium that realizes it, not to natural dislocated crystals without further constitutive modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从规范不变、最小耦合麦克斯韦理论（F=dA）导出了有限电磁束在螺旋位错连续分布的有效度量中的传播。伯格斯通量通过 σ(ρ)=f'(ρ)/(bρ) 固定度量分布，从而将真实密度梯度与坐标因子分开。在几何光学中，两种偏振共享一个光锥，均匀的密度使偏振相对于几何适应框架均匀旋转；实验室偏振测量也需要在界面处进行匹配。在前导近轴阶上，轨道运动为朗道型，具有用于任意输入的闭合传播器，并且对于均匀密度，极化演化精确分解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从规范不变、最小耦合麦克斯韦理论（F=dA）导出了有限电磁束在螺旋位错连续分布的有效度量中的传播。伯格斯通量通过 σ(ρ)=f'(ρ)/(bρ) 固定度量分布，从而将真实密度梯度与坐标因子分开。在几何光学中，两种偏振共享一个光锥，均匀的密度使偏振相对于几何适应框架均匀旋转；实验室偏振测量也需要在界面处进行匹配。在前导近轴阶上，轨道运动为朗道型，具有用于任意输入的闭合传播器，并且对于均匀密度，极化演化精确分解。对于任意光滑的轴对称密度，偏振纹理最初与光束强度加权的密度的标准偏差成比例增长；局部相位相干性是该分布的特征函数。对于相干横向琼斯场，线性斯托克斯纹理和局部圆偏振与空间偏振不可分离性之间存在精确的关系。对于线偏振、实轴对称输入光束，衍射在传播距离内产生二阶局部圆偏振，而积分圆斯托克斯分量在无损前导近轴理论中是守恒的。精确的麦克斯韦本征模、饱和分布的分析结果以及数值传播测试了近似值。我们提出了一种全斯托克斯测量方法，通过束腰的封闭形式标准来比较具有相同平均扭曲的均匀样品和分级样品。这些预测适用于理想的度量麦克斯韦模型或实现它的变换光学介质，而不适用于没有进一步本构建模的自然位错晶体。

articles.title: Sobolev theory for the inverse problem of time-dependent density functional theory on the torus
articles.title_zh: 环面瞬态密度泛函理论反问题的索博列夫理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22942v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that, given a sufficiently regular time-dependent density, there exists a unique potential such that the Schrödinger equation with this external potential has the prescribed one-particle density. We treat densities that are twice differentiable in time and of finite Sobolev regularity in space; the resulting potentials are continuous in time and of finite Sobolev regularity in space. Our method of proof is to rewrite the problem as a nonlinear Schrödinger equation with a loss of derivatives, which we in turn handle with a completion-of-the-square argument.
