This is a refinement of our recent work [Lauritsen, Lewin, and Oldenburg, arXiv:2609.08984], which handled this loss of derivatives using the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem and treated analytic-in-space densities and potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，给定一个足够规则的时间相关密度，存在一个独特的势，使得具有该外部势的薛定谔方程具有规定的单粒子密度。我们处理时间上二次可微的密度和空间上有限索博列夫正则性的密度；由此产生的势在时间上是连续的，并且在空间上具有有限的索博列夫正则性。我们的证明方法是将问题重写为具有导数损失的非线性薛定谔方程，然后我们用平方完成论证来处理它。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，给定一个足够规则的时间相关密度，存在一个独特的势，使得具有该外部势的薛定谔方程具有规定的单粒子密度。我们处理时间上二次可微的密度和空间上有限索博列夫正则性的密度；由此产生的势在时间上是连续的，并且在空间上具有有限的索博列夫正则性。我们的证明方法是将问题重写为具有导数损失的非线性薛定谔方程，然后我们用平方完成论证来处理它。这是我们最近工作的改进 [Lauritsen、Lewin 和 Oldenburg，arXiv：2609.08984]，该工作使用 Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理处理导数损失，并处理空间分析密度和势。

articles.title: Strange-Metal Magnetotransport without a Strange-Metal Ground State
articles.title_zh: 无奇异金属基态的奇异金属磁输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22985v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strange metals display a linear-in-temperature resistivity, ρₓₓsim T, and a quadratic inverse Hall angle, cotΘ_Hsim T². These seemingly universal laws are often attributed to quantum criticality, yet no controlled theory realizes both at an asymptotic zero-temperature fixed point, and experimentally they persist only over finite temperature windows. Here, we show that these properties can arise from an intermediate critical regime that does not govern the ground state. Using a minimal class of holographic models, we construct a fully backreacted realization of both scalings, which appear within a finite temperature window controlled by an emergent intermediate scaling geometry. The window is bounded by relevant deformations of the corresponding fixed point: momentum relaxation sets the upper edge, while the magnetic field B closes it from below at Tₘᵢₙsim B²/³, up to logarithmic corrections. At Tₘᵢₙ, strange-metal transport, the scaling geometry, and critical thermodynamics break down together. Our results point to intermediate criticality as a distinct route to strange-metal transport, and suggest that it can be identified by the simultaneous breakdown of transport and thermodynamic scaling under a magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 奇怪的金属表现出线性温度电阻率 ρₓₓsim T 和二次反霍尔角 cotθ_Hsim T²。这些看似普遍的定律通常归因于量子临界性，但没有受控理论能够在渐近零温度固定点实现这两个定律，并且在实验上它们仅在有限的温度窗口内持续存在。在这里，我们证明这些性质可以来自不控制基态的中间临界状态。使用最小类的全息模型，我们构建了两种缩放的完全反反应实现，它们出现在由新兴中间缩放几何控制的有限温度窗口内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奇怪的金属表现出线性温度电阻率 ρₓₓsim T 和二次反霍尔角 cotθ_Hsim T²。这些看似普遍的定律通常归因于量子临界性，但没有受控理论能够在渐近零温度固定点实现这两个定律，并且在实验上它们仅在有限的温度窗口内持续存在。在这里，我们证明这些性质可以来自不控制基态的中间临界状态。使用最小类的全息模型，我们构建了两种缩放的完全反反应实现，它们出现在由新兴中间缩放几何控制的有限温度窗口内。该窗口以相应固定点的相关变形为界：动量弛豫设置上边缘，而磁场 B 在 Tₘᵢₙsim B²/³ 处从下方关闭它，直至对数校正。在 Tₘᵢₙ 处，奇异金属输运、缩放几何和临界热力学一起崩溃。我们的结果指出中间临界度是奇异金属输运的独特途径，并表明它可以通过磁场下输运和热力学缩放的同时破坏来识别。

articles.title: Unique continuation for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: Pauli-Fierz 哈密顿量的独特延续
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23062v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove a unique continuation property for eigenstates of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, viewed as functions of the electron configuration with values in the spin-photon space. The vector potential may lie in L⁶_loc, with its divergence, curl, and the scalar potential in L^p_loc for some p>2. As an application, we prove a Hohenberg-Kohn theorem at positive coupling strength: the spin-summed ground-state density and combined current density determine the external potentials up to a gauge transformation and an additive constant.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了泡利-菲尔兹哈密顿量本征态的独特连续性质，将其视为具有自旋光子空间中的值的电子构型的函数。对于某些 p>2，矢量势可能位于 L⁶_loc 中，其散度、旋度和标量势位于 L^p_loc 中。作为一个应用，我们证明了正耦合强度下的霍恩伯格-科恩定理：自旋求和的基态密度和组合电流密度决定了规范变换和加性常数的外部电势。

articles.title: An Effective Theory for Hot Lines
articles.title_zh: 热线的有效理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23169v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a high-temperature effective theory for spatial conformal line defects in theories with thermal screening. The defect partition function admits a local geometric expansion, whose leading terms describe the effective tension and bending response of the line. Using a convergent bulk OPE for heavy-state defect matrix elements, we derive asymptotic relations for averaged products of defect one-point coefficients and bulk OPE coefficients in the regime 1 ll Δ_χ ll Δ¹/d. We compute the leading EFT coefficients for a twisted free scalar and for the magnetic line at the O(N) Wilson-Fisher fixed point, large-N Gross--Neveu model and mathcal N = 2 Chern-Simons-matter theory. For the three-dimensional Ising model, Monte Carlo simulations yield a perimeter coefficient in good agreement with a Padé interpolation of our ε-expansion result.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在热筛选理论中开发了一种空间共形线缺陷的高温有效理论。缺陷分配函数允许局部几何展开，其主导项描述了线的有效张力和弯曲响应。使用重态缺陷矩阵元素的收敛体 OPE，我们推导出 1 ll Δ_χ ll Δ1/d 范围内缺陷单点系数和体 OPE 系数的平均乘积的渐近关系。我们计算了扭曲自由标量和 O(N) Wilson-Fisher 不动点处的磁力线、大 N Gross-Neveu 模型和数学 N = 2 Chern-Simons 物质理论的主要 EFT 系数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在热筛选理论中开发了一种空间共形线缺陷的高温有效理论。缺陷分配函数允许局部几何展开，其主导项描述了线的有效张力和弯曲响应。使用重态缺陷矩阵元素的收敛体 OPE，我们推导出 1 ll Δ_χ ll Δ1/d 范围内缺陷单点系数和体 OPE 系数的平均乘积的渐近关系。我们计算了扭曲自由标量和 O(N) Wilson-Fisher 不动点处的磁力线、大 N Gross-Neveu 模型和数学 N = 2 Chern-Simons 物质理论的主要 EFT 系数。对于三维伊辛模型，蒙特卡洛模拟产生的周长系数与我们的 ε 展开结果的 Padé 插值非常一致。

articles.title: Local interference algorithms for observables in large random circuits
articles.title_zh: 大型随机电路中可观测量的局部干扰算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In quantum dynamics, it is generally believed that interference effects lead to a sign problem for classical Monte Carlo sampling methods, rendering sampling ineffective. In this paper we show that this is generically not the case for the task of simulating the evolution of observables in random instances of circuit dynamics. Specifically, we consider two examples of observables which give large signals despite the randomness of the dynamics: first order out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs) in unstructured random circuits without conservation laws and time-ordered charge-charge correlators (TOCs) in particle number-preserving random circuits. We show that these observables can be approximated by classical stochastic processes and that these approximations can be systematically improved with a series expansion that incorporates coherent corrections associated with clusters of gates. We design and implement algorithms that combine Monte Carlo sampling and tensor network methods to approximate the series. We observe numerically that the computational complexity of approximating TOCs and OTOCs scales polynomially in the circuit size and in the target precision. We study the accuracy of these algorithms by directly mapping their ensemble-averaged errors to partition functions of replica statistical models, allowing for perturbative analysis and numerics in 1d brickwork geometries. Our theoretical analysis explains the empirical observation of polynomial complexity of these algorithms and is consistent with polynomial complexity extending to arbitrarily small precision and to the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子动力学中，通常认为干涉效应会导致经典蒙特卡罗采样方法出现符号问题，导致采样无效。在本文中，我们表明，对于模拟电路动力学随机实例中可观测量演化的任务来说，通常情况并非如此。具体来说，我们考虑两个可观测量的例子，尽管动力学具有随机性，但它们仍给出大信号：没有守恒定律的非结构化随机电路中的一阶乱序相关器（OTOC）和粒子数保持随机电路中的时序电荷-电荷相关器（TOC）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在量子动力学中，通常认为干涉效应会导致经典蒙特卡罗采样方法出现符号问题，导致采样无效。在本文中，我们表明，对于模拟电路动力学随机实例中可观测量演化的任务来说，通常情况并非如此。具体来说，我们考虑两个可观测量的例子，尽管动力学具有随机性，但它们仍给出大信号：没有守恒定律的非结构化随机电路中的一阶乱序相关器（OTOC）和粒子数保持随机电路中的时序电荷-电荷相关器（TOC）。我们表明，这些可观测量可以通过经典随机过程来近似，并且可以通过包含与门簇相关的相干校正的级数展开来系统地改进这些近似。我们设计并实现了结合蒙特卡罗采样和张量网络方法的算法来近似序列。我们通过数值观察发现，近似 TOC 和 OTOC 的计算复杂度与电路尺寸和目标精度成多项式缩放。我们通过将它们的整体平均误差直接映射到副本统计模型的分区函数来研究这些算法的准确性，从而允许一维砖砌几何形状中的扰动分析和数值。我们的理论分析解释了这些算法多项式复杂性的经验观察，并且与扩展到任意小精度和热力学极限的多项式复杂性一致。

articles.title: Expressivity of two-dimensional Gaussian fermion tensor network states
articles.title_zh: 二维高斯费米子张量网络状态的表达能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23227v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tensor network states (TNS) provide a family of efficiently compressed approximations to physically relevant many-body quantum states. An important quantity that characterizes the computational resources required by a TNS is its bond dimension. While in one dimension an area law for the Renyi-0 entropy guarantees an exact matrix product state representation with a bond dimension independent of the system size, an analogous statement does not hold for general states in two dimensions (2D). This leaves open the question of how the expressivity of 2D TNS is related to the entanglement properties of the states they represent. In this work, we focus on two families of 2D translation-invariant Gaussian fermionic states: single-band BCS superconductors and half-filled two-band insulators (including semimetals). For each family, we prove that an area law for the Renyi-0 entropy is equivalent to having an exact Gaussian fermionic TNS representation with a finite bond dimension determined by the Renyi-0 entropy. We also establish equivalent characterizations in terms of compactly supported Wannier-type orbitals and the momentum-space wavefunction, relating the spatial extent of these orbitals and the structure of the wavefunction to the required bond dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络状态 (TNS) 为物理相关的多体量子态提供了一系列有效压缩的近似值。表征 TNS 所需计算资源的一个重要量是其键维数。虽然在一维中，Renyi-0 熵的面积定律保证了精确的矩阵乘积状态表示，其键维与系统大小无关，但类似的陈述不适用于二维 (2D) 中的一般状态。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：2D TNS 的表达能力如何与其所代表的状态的纠缠属性相关。在这项工作中，我们重点研究两个二维平移不变高斯费米子态族：单带BCS超导体和半填充双带绝缘体（包括半金属）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络状态 (TNS) 为物理相关的多体量子态提供了一系列有效压缩的近似值。表征 TNS 所需计算资源的一个重要量是其键维数。虽然在一维中，Renyi-0 熵的面积定律保证了精确的矩阵乘积状态表示，其键维与系统大小无关，但类似的陈述不适用于二维 (2D) 中的一般状态。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：2D TNS 的表达能力如何与其所代表的状态的纠缠属性相关。在这项工作中，我们重点研究两个二维平移不变高斯费米子态族：单带BCS超导体和半填充双带绝缘体（包括半金属）。对于每个族，我们证明 Renyi-0 熵的面积定律等价于具有由 Renyi-0 熵确定的有限键维数的精确高斯费米子 TNS 表示。我们还根据紧支撑的万尼尔型轨道和动量空间波函数建立了等效特征，将这些轨道的空间范围和波函数的结构与所需的键维数联系起来。

articles.title: Evidence for crystal-field-selected octupolar order in wolframite oxides
articles.title_zh: 黑钨矿氧化物中晶体场选择八极有序的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.18694v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic order can involve higher-rank moments such as octupoles, which are difficult to identify in strongly distorted crystals. Here we present evidence for predominantly octupolar order in the monoclinic wolframites MgReO₄ and ZnReO₄. Muon spin spectroscopy detects magnetic transitions near 83 and 126 K, respectively, with similar precession frequencies in both compounds. An ab initio effective Hamiltonian shows that strong crystal fields split the spin--orbit quartet, isolating low-energy doublets with weak dipolar character. Exchange selects octupole-dominated order in distinct collinear antiferromagnetic structures, with moments along b in MgReO₄ and tilted within the ac plane in ZnReO₄. The estimated dipole moments of 0.06 and 0.12 μB per Re, respectively, are consistent with the absence of a resolved magnetic contribution in neutron powder diffraction. A single-ion model illustrates how octupolar states generate local fields with a vanishing net dipole moment. These findings support a crystal-field route to hidden magnetism beyond double perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁序可能涉及更高阶的矩，例如八极子，这在强烈扭曲的晶体中很难识别。在这里，我们提出了单斜黑钨矿 MgReO₄ 和 ZnReO₄ 中主要是八极有序的证据。 μ 子自旋光谱分别检测到 83 K 和 126 K 附近的磁跃迁，两种化合物具有相似的进动频率。从头算有效的哈密顿量表明，强晶体场分裂了自旋轨道四重态，隔离了具有弱偶极特性的低能双态。交换在不同的共线反铁磁结构中选择八极主导的顺序，其中 MgReO₄ 中的力矩沿 b 方向，ZnReO₄ 中的力矩在 ac 平面内倾斜。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁序可能涉及更高阶的矩，例如八极子，这在强烈扭曲的晶体中很难识别。在这里，我们提出了单斜黑钨矿 MgReO₄ 和 ZnReO₄ 中主要是八极有序的证据。 μ 子自旋光谱分别检测到 83 K 和 126 K 附近的磁跃迁，两种化合物具有相似的进动频率。从头算有效的哈密顿量表明，强晶体场分裂了自旋轨道四重态，隔离了具有弱偶极特性的低能双态。交换在不同的共线反铁磁结构中选择八极主导的顺序，其中 MgReO₄ 中的力矩沿 b 方向，ZnReO₄ 中的力矩在 ac 平面内倾斜。估计的偶极矩分别为 0.06 μB/Re 和 0.12 μB/Re，这与中子粉末衍射中缺乏解析的磁贡献一致。单离子模型说明了八极态如何产生净偶极矩消失的局部场。这些发现支持了超越双钙钛矿的晶体场途径来实现隐藏磁性。

articles.title: Interference-caged quantum many-body scars: Local ETH-violation witnesses and deformation stability
articles.title_zh: 干扰笼量子多体疤痕：本地 ETH 违规目击者和变形稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.07780v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many-body interference can render an exact eigenstate locally nonthermal by canceling a microscopic process active in thermal states. We formulate the Fock-space analogue of compact flat-band localization as emphinterference caging: escape amplitudes cancel exactly across the active boundary of a set of product configurations. We give sufficient conditions to reduce this configuration-dependent cancellation to a fixed real-space region, yielding a bounded local caging operator. Its positive square vanishes on the caged eigenstate and witnesses violation of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) if its microcanonical expectation for the same Hamiltonian and energy density remains bounded away from zero in the thermodynamic limit. We call these states emph{interference-caged quantum many-body scars} (ICQMBS) when they form a vanishing fraction of a symmetry-resolved bulk energy window whose typical eigenstates are locally thermal for every bounded local observable. The mechanism is independent of quasiparticle, algebraic, or symmetry-based constructions and compatible with Hilbert-space fragmentation. Our chiral-shell search constructs exact caged eigenstates from allowed transitions without a preselected wavefunction, target subspace, or ladder operator. We identify local ETH-violation witnesses, test their deformation stability, and demonstrate thermal contrast in two systems. In the spin-1 XY chain, we recover the known scar tower, also describable through quasiparticles and projector embedding, and prove ICQMBS throughout an open interval of compatible exchange couplings in the thermodynamic limit. In the square-lattice quantum dimer model, we construct exact caged eigenstates and local operators from plaquette flips on fixed-width strips under a checkerboard phase deformation; finite-size microcanonical comparisons support thermal contrast.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体干涉可以通过消除热态下活跃的微观过程来呈现精确的局部非热本征态。我们将紧凑平带定位的福克空间模拟公式化为电磁干扰笼：逃逸幅度在一组产品配置的活动边界上完全抵消。我们给出了足够的条件来将这种依赖于配置的抵消减少到固定的实空间区域，从而产生有界的局部笼蔽算子。如果其对相同哈密顿量和能量密度的微正则期望在热力学极限中仍然远离零，则其正平方在笼中本征态上消失，并且见证了本征态热化假说（ETH）的违反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体干涉可以通过消除热态下活跃的微观过程来呈现精确的局部非热本征态。我们将紧凑平带定位的福克空间模拟公式化为电磁干扰笼：逃逸幅度在一组产品配置的活动边界上完全抵消。我们给出了足够的条件来将这种依赖于配置的抵消减少到固定的实空间区域，从而产生有界的局部笼蔽算子。如果其对相同哈密顿量和能量密度的微正则期望在热力学极限中仍然远离零，则其正平方在笼中本征态上消失，并且见证了本征态热化假说（ETH）的违反。当这些状态形成对称解析体能量窗口的消失部分时，我们将这些状态称为 emph干扰笼量子多体疤痕 (ICQMBS)，其典型本征态对于每个有界局部可观测量都是局部热的。该机制独立于准粒子、代数或基于对称的构造，并且与希尔伯特空间碎片兼容。我们的手性壳搜索根据允许的跃迁构造精确的笼状本征态，无需预先选择的波函数、目标子空间或梯形算子。我们识别本地 ETH 违规目击者，测试其变形稳定性，并演示两个系统中的热对比。在 spin-1 XY 链中，我们恢复了已知的疤痕塔，也可以通过准粒子和投影仪嵌入进行描述，并在热力学极限内的兼容交换耦合的开区间证明 ICQMBS。在方晶格量子二聚体模型中，我们通过棋盘相变形下固定宽度条带上的斑块翻转构建了精确的笼式本征态和局域算子；有限尺寸的微规范比较支持热对比。

articles.title: Phonon-mediated intrinsic topological superconductivity in Fermi arcs
articles.title_zh: 费米弧中声子介导的本征拓扑超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.03250v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose that phonons can intrinsically mediate topological superconductivity on the surface of Weyl semimetals. Weyl semimetals are gapless topological materials with nondegenerate zero energy surface states known as Fermi arcs. We derive the phonon spectrum and electron-phonon coupling in an effective model of a Weyl semimetal and apply weak-coupling Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer theory of superconductivity. In a slab geometry, we find that surface superconductivity dominates over bulk superconductivity in a range of chemical potentials around the Weyl nodes. The superconducting gap function realizes spinless chiral p-wave Cooper pairing in the Fermi arcs, leading to Majorana bound states in the core of vortices. Furthermore, we find a suppression of the absolute value of the gap in the center of the Fermi arcs, which is not captured by a local Hubbard attraction. The suppression is due to the nonlocal origin of electron-phonon coupling, leading to a layer dependence which has important consequences for topological surface states.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出声子可以本质上介导外尔半金属表面的拓扑超导性。韦尔半金属是无带隙拓扑材料，具有称为费米弧的非简并零能表面态。我们推导了外尔半金属的有效模型中的声子谱和电子-声子耦合，并应用了弱耦合超导巴丁-库珀-施里弗理论。在平板几何结构中，我们发现在外尔节点周围的一系列化学势中，表面超导性优于体超导性。超导间隙函数实现了费米弧中的无自旋手性p波库珀配对，从而在涡旋核心中产生马约拉纳束缚态。此外，我们发现费米弧中心间隙的绝对值受到抑制，而局部哈伯德吸引力没有捕获到这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出声子可以本质上介导外尔半金属表面的拓扑超导性。韦尔半金属是无带隙拓扑材料，具有称为费米弧的非简并零能表面态。我们推导了外尔半金属的有效模型中的声子谱和电子-声子耦合，并应用了弱耦合超导巴丁-库珀-施里弗理论。在平板几何结构中，我们发现在外尔节点周围的一系列化学势中，表面超导性优于体超导性。超导间隙函数实现了费米弧中的无自旋手性p波库珀配对，从而在涡旋核心中产生马约拉纳束缚态。此外，我们发现费米弧中心间隙的绝对值受到抑制，而局部哈伯德吸引力没有捕获到这一点。这种抑制是由于电子-声子耦合的非局域起源造成的，导致层依赖性，这对拓扑表面态具有重要影响。

articles.title: An open dataset of gas adsorption in deformable metal-organic frameworks for direct air capture
articles.title_zh: 用于直接空气捕获的可变形金属有机框架中气体吸附的开放数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.03162v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Engineering economical and scalable processes for direct air capture (DAC) from humid air relies on atomistic modeling to search and identify promising sorbent materials from a vast chemical space. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predicting material properties in an efficient yet accurate manner, but these models require large sets of carefully curated training data. We present the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset comprising nearly 60 million DFT single-point calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 MOFs. ODAC25 introduces functionalized MOFs, high-energy adsorbate placements, and synthetically generated frameworks to maximize the versatility of models trained on the dataset. ODAC25 improves upon the accuracy of DFT calculations in previous works and applies engineering intuition from recent work regarding the treatment of adsorbate-induced MOF flexibility. We release state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on ODAC25 and demonstrate their utility via Henry's coefficient predictions. ODAC25 enables MOF screening for DAC at a resolution previously unattainable.
articles.abstract_zh: 从潮湿空气中直接捕获空气 (DAC) 的工程经济且可扩展的工艺依赖于原子模型来从广阔的化学空间中搜索和识别有前景的吸附剂材料。机器学习已成为以高效而准确的方式预测材料特性的强大工具，但这些模型需要大量精心策划的训练数据。我们提出了 Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) 数据集，其中包含约 15,000 个 MOF 中 CO2、H2O、N2 和 O2 吸附的近 6000 万个 DFT 单点计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从潮湿空气中直接捕获空气 (DAC) 的工程经济且可扩展的工艺依赖于原子模型来从广阔的化学空间中搜索和识别有前景的吸附剂材料。机器学习已成为以高效而准确的方式预测材料特性的强大工具，但这些模型需要大量精心策划的训练数据。我们提出了 Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) 数据集，其中包含约 15,000 个 MOF 中 CO2、H2O、N2 和 O2 吸附的近 6000 万个 DFT 单点计算。 ODAC25 引入了功能化 MOF、高能吸附物放置和综合生成的框架，以最大限度地提高在数据集上训练的模型的多功能性。 ODAC25 提高了之前工作中 DFT 计算的准确性，并应用了最近有关处理吸附物引起的 MOF 灵活性的工作中的工程直觉。我们发布了在 ODAC25 上训练的最先进的机器学习原子间势，并通过亨利系数预测证明了它们的实用性。 ODAC25 能够以以前无法达到的分辨率对 DAC 进行 MOF 筛选。

articles.title: Chiral gapped states are universally non-topological
articles.title_zh: 手性有隙态普遍是非拓扑的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.23720v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an operator generalization of the Li-Haldane conjecture regarding the entanglement Hamiltonian of a disk in a 2+1D chiral gapped groundstate. The logic applies to regions with sharp corners, from which we derive several universal properties regarding corner entanglement. These universal properties follow from a set of locally-checkable conditions on the wavefunction. We also define a quantity (mathfrakcₜₒₜ)ₘᵢₙ that reflects the robustness of corner entanglement contributions, and show that it provides an obstruction to a gapped boundary. One reward from our analysis is that we can construct a local gapped Hamiltonian within the same chiral gapped phase from a given wavefunction; we conjecture that it is closer to the low-energy renormalization group fixed point than the original parent Hamiltonian. Our analysis of corner entanglement reveals the emergence of a universal conformal geometry encoded in the entanglement structure of bulk regions of chiral gapped states that is not visible in topological field theory. Our formalism also gives an explanation of the modular commutator formula for the chiral central charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了关于 2+1D 手性有隙基态盘的纠缠哈密顿量的 Li-Haldane 猜想的算子推广。该逻辑适用于具有尖角的区域，从中我们得出了有关角纠缠的几个通用属性。这些通用属性源自波函数上的一组可局部检查的条件。我们还定义了一个量 (mathfrakcₜₒₜ)ₘᵢₙ，它反映了角纠缠贡献的鲁棒性，并表明它为有间隙的边界提供了障碍。我们分析的一个回报是，我们可以根据给定的波函数在相同的手性有隙相内构造局部有隙哈密顿量；我们推测它比原始父哈密顿量更接近低能重整化群不动点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了关于 2+1D 手性有隙基态盘的纠缠哈密顿量的 Li-Haldane 猜想的算子推广。该逻辑适用于具有尖角的区域，从中我们得出了有关角纠缠的几个通用属性。这些通用属性源自波函数上的一组可局部检查的条件。我们还定义了一个量 (mathfrakcₜₒₜ)ₘᵢₙ，它反映了角纠缠贡献的鲁棒性，并表明它为有间隙的边界提供了障碍。我们分析的一个回报是，我们可以根据给定的波函数在相同的手性有隙相内构造局部有隙哈密顿量；我们推测它比原始父哈密顿量更接近低能重整化群不动点。我们对角纠缠的分析揭示了一种普遍的共形几何的出现，这种几何被编码在手性有隙态的大块区域的纠缠结构中，这在拓扑场论中是不可见的。我们的形式主义还解释了手性中心电荷的模块化换向器公式。

articles.title: Coherent high-velocity chiral magnons in the metallic altermagnet CrSb
articles.title_zh: 金属交变磁体 CrSb 中的相干高速手性磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.16086v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets combine the zero net magnetization of antiferromagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting, creating new opportunities for spintronic and magnonic technologies. The full realization of this promise necessitates a material that is simultaneously metallic and altermagnetic, yet preserves the long magnon lifetimes more often seen in insulators. Here, we use polarized neutron diffraction and inelastic neutron scattering to determine the magnetic structure and spin dynamics of the metallic altermagnet CrSb. We confirm a fully compensated, collinear magnetic structure with localized Cr moments and establish the microscopic spin Hamiltonian governing its excitations. Despite its metallicity, CrSb hosts remarkably coherent magnons across its 230 meV bandwidth, with group velocities approaching 60 km/s. Along low-symmetry momentum directions, we resolve chiral magnon splitting generated by higher-order, symmetry-inequivalent exchange interactions, providing the first experimental observation of this phenomenon in a metallic altermagnet. These results reveal a nearly complete separation between magnetic and electronic degrees of freedom in CrSb and demonstrate that metallic transport, room-temperature altermagnetic order, fast coherent magnons, and chiral spin dynamics can coexist in a single material, positioning CrSb as a compelling platform for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体将反铁磁体的零净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子和磁波束技术创造了新的机遇。要充分实现这一承诺，就需要一种同时具有金属性和交变磁性的材料，同时又能保持绝缘体中常见的长磁振子寿命。在这里，我们使用偏振中子衍射和非弹性中子散射来确定金属交变磁体 CrSb 的磁性结构和自旋动力学。我们确认了具有局部 Cr 矩的完全补偿的共线磁结构，并建立了控制其激发的微观自旋哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将反铁磁体的零净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子和磁波束技术创造了新的机遇。要充分实现这一承诺，就需要一种同时具有金属性和交变磁性的材料，同时又能保持绝缘体中常见的长磁振子寿命。在这里，我们使用偏振中子衍射和非弹性中子散射来确定金属交变磁体 CrSb 的磁性结构和自旋动力学。我们确认了具有局部 Cr 矩的完全补偿的共线磁结构，并建立了控制其激发的微观自旋哈密顿量。尽管具有金属性，CrSb 在其 230 meV 带宽内仍具有非常相干的磁振子，群速度接近 60 km/s。沿着低对称动量方向，我们解决了由高阶、对称不等价交换相互作用产生的手性磁振子分裂，首次在金属交变磁体中实验观察到这种现象。这些结果揭示了 CrSb 中磁自由度和电子自由度之间几乎完全分离，并证明金属输运、室温交变磁序、快速相干磁振子和手性自旋动力学可以在单一材料中共存，使 CrSb 成为自旋电子应用的一个引人注目的平台。

articles.title: Fractional quantization in gapless flat bands with ill-defined topology and divergent quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 拓扑不明确和量子几何发散的无间隙平带中的分数量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15041v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) effect, a zero-magnetic-field lattice analog of the fractional quantum Hall effect, offers a unique pathway toward fault-tolerant quantum computation and deep insights into the interplay of topology and strong correlations. The exploration has been successfully guided by the paradigm of ideal flat Chern bands, which mimic Landau levels in both band topology and local quantum geometry. Yet, given the boundless potential for Bloch bands in lattice systems, it remains a significant open question whether FQAH states can arise in scenarios fundamentally distinct from this paradigm. Here we turn to a class of gapless flat bands, featuring (i) ill-defined band topology, (ii) non-quantized Berry flux, (iii) divergent quantum geometry at singular band touchings, (iv) highly fluctuating and far-from-ideal quantum geometry across the Brillouin zone. Our exact diagonalization and density matrix renormalization group calculations unambiguously demonstrate an FQAH phase that is virtually independent of the interaction strength, persisting from the weak-interaction to the strong-interaction limit. We find the stability of the FQAH states does not uniquely correlate with the singularity strength. Instead, the many-body topological order can adapt to the singular and fluctuating quantum geometric landscape by spontaneously developing an inhomogeneous carrier distribution, while its quenching is accompanied by a drop in the occupation-weighted Berry flux. Our work reveals a profound interplay between local quantum geometry and many-body correlation, and significantly expands the exploration space for the FQAH effect and correlated phenomena in general.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子反常霍尔 (FQAH) 效应是分数量子霍尔效应的零磁场晶格模拟，为容错量子计算提供了独特的途径，并深入了解拓扑和强相关性的相互作用。该探索已成功地以理想平坦陈能带范式为指导，该范式在能带拓扑和局部量子几何上都模仿了朗道能级。然而，考虑到布洛赫带在晶格系统中的无限潜力，FQAH 状态是否可以在与该范式根本不同的场景中出现仍然是一个重要的悬而未决的问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子反常霍尔 (FQAH) 效应是分数量子霍尔效应的零磁场晶格模拟，为容错量子计算提供了独特的途径，并深入了解拓扑和强相关性的相互作用。该探索已成功地以理想平坦陈能带范式为指导，该范式在能带拓扑和局部量子几何上都模仿了朗道能级。然而，考虑到布洛赫带在晶格系统中的无限潜力，FQAH 状态是否可以在与该范式根本不同的场景中出现仍然是一个重要的悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们转向一类无间隙平带，其特征是（i）不明确的带拓扑，（ii）非量子化贝里通量，（iii）奇异带接触处的发散量子几何结构，（iv）整个布里渊区的高度波动和远离理想的量子几何结构。我们的精确对角化和密度矩阵重正化群计算明确地证明了 FQAH 相，该相几乎独立于相互作用强度，从弱相互作用一直持续到强相互作用极限。我们发现 FQAH 状态的稳定性与奇点强度并不唯一相关。相反，多体拓扑序可以通过自发地形成不均匀的载流子分布来适应奇异且涨落的量子几何景观，而其猝灭则伴随着占据加权贝里通量的下降。我们的工作揭示了局域量子几何与多体关联之间的深刻相互作用，并显着扩展了 FQAH 效应和一般关联现象的探索空间。

articles.title: Substrate Role in Polaron Formation on Single-layer Transition Metal Dihalides
articles.title_zh: 单层过渡金属二卤化物极化子形成中的底物作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21163v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Single-layer transition metal dihalides grown on conducting substrates were shown to host stable polarons. Here, we investigate small polarons in a single layer of the insulator MnBr₂, which was grown by molecular beam epitaxy on three different substrates: graphene on Ir(110), graphene on Ir(111), and Au(111). Polarons on these substrates can be created, converted, and moved by the STM tip when a tunneling current flows at a proper bias voltage. Four polaron species are observed in MnBr₂ grown on graphene Ir(110), three of which resemble the species previously observed for CoCl₂ on graphite, whereas MnBr₂ grown on the other substrates exhibits only two of these four species. Changing the substrate from graphene on Ir to Au(111) increases polaron number density by an order of magnitude. These large differences demonstrate that the choice of conducting substrate plays a decisive role in determining polaron phenomenology in substrate-supported single-layer insulators. Two unique observations are reported for polarons in MnBr₂ on graphene supported by Ir(110): First, mobile polarons are guided by the periodic potential originating from the super-moiré of MnBr₂ with graphene and Ir(110); second, polarons remain stable up to 300,K.
articles.abstract_zh: 在导电基底上生长的单层过渡金属二卤化物被证明具有稳定的极化子。在这里，我们研究了单层绝缘体 MnBr2 中的小极化子，该绝缘体是通过分子束外延在三种不同基板上生长的：Ir(110) 上的石墨烯、Ir(111) 上的石墨烯和 Au(111) 上的石墨烯。当隧道电流在适当的偏置电压下流动时，STM 尖端可以创建、转换和移动这些基板上的极化子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在导电基底上生长的单层过渡金属二卤化物被证明具有稳定的极化子。在这里，我们研究了单层绝缘体 MnBr2 中的小极化子，该绝缘体是通过分子束外延在三种不同基板上生长的：Ir(110) 上的石墨烯、Ir(111) 上的石墨烯和 Au(111) 上的石墨烯。当隧道电流在适当的偏置电压下流动时，STM 尖端可以创建、转换和移动这些基板上的极化子。在石墨烯 Ir(110) 上生长的 MnBr2 中观察到四种极化子物质，其中三种类似于之前在石墨上观察到的 CoCl2 物质，而在其他基材上生长的 MnBr2 仅表现出这四种物质中的两种。将衬底从 Ir 上的石墨烯更改为 Au(111) 会使极化子数密度增加一个数量级。这些巨大的差异表明，导电基板的选择在确定基板支撑的单层绝缘体中的极化子现象方面起着决定性作用。对于由 Ir(110) 支持的石墨烯上的 MnBr2 中的极化子，报告了两个独特的观察结果：首先，移动极化子受到周期性电势的引导，该周期性电势源自 MnBr2 与石墨烯和 Ir(110) 的超级莫尔条纹；其次，极化子在高达 300,K 的温度下仍保持稳定。

articles.title: Moiré Engineering of Square-Lattice Hubbard Models for Copper- and Iron-Based Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 铜基和铁基超导体方格哈伯德模型的莫尔工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.11153v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose twisted Γ-valley square-lattice homobilayers, exemplified by ZnF₂, as a tunable reference platform to emulate square lattice Hubbard-type models relevant to high-temperature superconductors. With model parameters derived from first-principles calculations, the lowest moiré band realizes a single-orbital Hubbard model underlying cuprates, while the next two realize a pₓ, p_y model with the minimal symmetry structure of pnictide dₓz, dyz Hamiltonians. Hartree-Fock analysis further predicts an antiferro-orbital ferromagnetic insulator at quarter filling.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出扭曲的 γ 谷方晶格同双层（以 ZnF2 为例）作为可调谐参考平台来模拟与高温超导体相关的方晶格哈伯德型模型。利用第一原理计算得出的模型参数，最低莫尔带实现了基于铜酸盐的单轨道哈伯德模型，而接下来的两个实现了具有 pnictide dₓz、dyz 哈密顿量最小对称结构的 pₓ、p_y 模型。 Hartree-Fock 分析进一步预测了四分之一填充时的反铁轨道铁磁绝缘体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出扭曲的 γ 谷方晶格同双层（以 ZnF2 为例）作为可调谐参考平台来模拟与高温超导体相关的方晶格哈伯德型模型。利用第一原理计算得出的模型参数，最低莫尔带实现了基于铜酸盐的单轨道哈伯德模型，而接下来的两个实现了具有 pnictide dₓz、dyz 哈密顿量最小对称结构的 pₓ、p_y 模型。 Hartree-Fock 分析进一步预测了四分之一填充时的反铁轨道铁磁绝缘体。

articles.title: A Correlated Route to Antiferromagnetic Spintronics
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁自旋电子学的相关途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16552v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnets are attractive for spintronics owing to their vanishing net magnetization and ultrafast spin dynamics, yet their spin-compensated electronic structure has long confined them to passive roles. Here we identify a symmetry selection rule that overcomes this limitation: in a collinear antiferromagnet, a spin-polarized dc charge current requires the simultaneous breaking of particle--hole symmetry and of the equivalence between the two magnetic sublattices, either one alone leaving the polarization identically zero. We demonstrate the rule in the doped antiferromagnetic Hubbard model within dynamical mean-field theory: doping and a uniform magnetic field each break one of the two symmetries, and electronic correlations convert the resulting asymmetries into a sizable, field-tunable polarization of the charge current. The polarization is largest deep in the ordered phase and reverses sign at an emergent compensation point, set by the hierarchy of spin-dependent scattering rates and not dictated by symmetry, at which the dominant conducting spin species is interchanged. In correlated altermagnetic Hubbard models, the same two symmetries are broken structurally, by the sublattice-alternating hopping pattern: the field-driven mechanism identified here and the altermagnetic one are two realizations of a single selection rule. Electronic correlations thus emerge as an active ingredient for spintronics in structurally conventional collinear antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体由于其消失的净磁化强度和超快自旋动力学而对自旋电子学很有吸引力，但其自旋补偿电子结构长期以来将它们限制在被动角色。在这里，我们确定了克服这一限制的对称选择规则：在共线反铁磁体中，自旋极化直流充电电流需要同时打破粒子-空穴对称性和两个磁性亚晶格之间的等价性，其中任何一个都使极化完全为零。我们证明了动态平均场理论中掺杂反铁磁哈伯德模型的规则：掺杂和均匀磁场各自打破了两种对称性之一，并且电子相关性将由此产生的不对称性转换为相当大的、场可调的充电电流极化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体由于其消失的净磁化强度和超快自旋动力学而对自旋电子学很有吸引力，但其自旋补偿电子结构长期以来将它们限制在被动角色。在这里，我们确定了克服这一限制的对称选择规则：在共线反铁磁体中，自旋极化直流充电电流需要同时打破粒子-空穴对称性和两个磁性亚晶格之间的等价性，其中任何一个都使极化完全为零。我们证明了动态平均场理论中掺杂反铁磁哈伯德模型的规则：掺杂和均匀磁场各自打破了两种对称性之一，并且电子相关性将由此产生的不对称性转换为相当大的、场可调的充电电流极化。极化在有序相深处最大，并在出现的补偿点处反转符号，该补偿点由自旋相关散射率的层次结构设置，而不是由对称性决定，在该补偿点，占主导地位的导电自旋物种被互换。在相关的交变磁哈伯德模型中，相同的两种对称性在结构上被亚晶格交替跳跃模式打破：此处确定的场驱动机制和交变磁机制是单一选择规则的两种实现。因此，电子相关性成为结构传统共线反铁磁体中自旋电子学的活性成分。

articles.title: Ergotropy of macroscopic classical systems
articles.title_zh: 宏观经典系统的各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28388v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We address the fundamental question of what is the maximal amount of energy (a.k.a. ergotropy) that can be extracted from a macroscopic classical system by means of a cyclical variation of an external parameter. We show that if the system is prepared in a statistical state of the form ρ = F(H), with H the Hamiltonian and F a generic limited function, then the ergotropy is vanishing in the large N limit, provided the thermodynamic entropy obeys the scaling mathcal S(E) simeq N^α s (E/N^β) with α,β>0 and s some strictly increasing function with certain reasonable properties. We stress that such ubiquitous condition also ensures the equivalence of the so-called "surface" and "volume" entropies. We illustrate this by introducing the notion of ``ergotropic rearrangement'' of a phase space density which we then apply to find the exact ergotropy expression of systems with constant (positive or negative) heat capacity being evenly distributed over energy shells in phase space. We discuss cases where the above mentioned equivalence does (does not) break and the ergotropy does (does not) vanish accordingly, in the large N limit. The presented results shed new light on the statistical-mechanical foundations of the second law of thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们解决了一个基本问题：通过外部参数的循环变化，可以从宏观经典系统中提取的最大能量（又名各向异性）是多少。我们证明，如果系统在 ρ = F(H) 形式的统计状态下准备，其中 H 是哈密顿量，F 是通用有限函数，则只要热力学熵服从标度数学 S(E) simeq N^α s (E/N^β)，且 α、β>0 且 s 是具有某些合理属性的严格递增函数，则在大 N 极限中，各向异性消失。我们强调，这种普遍存在的条件也确保了所谓的“表面”和“体积”熵的等价性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们解决了一个基本问题：通过外部参数的循环变化，可以从宏观经典系统中提取的最大能量（又名各向异性）是多少。我们证明，如果系统在 ρ = F(H) 形式的统计状态下准备，其中 H 是哈密顿量，F 是通用有限函数，则只要热力学熵服从标度数学 S(E) simeq N^α s (E/N^β)，且 α、β>0 且 s 是具有某些合理属性的严格递增函数，则在大 N 极限中，各向异性消失。我们强调，这种普遍存在的条件也确保了所谓的“表面”和“体积”熵的等价性。我们通过引入相空间密度的“各向异性重排”的概念来说明这一点，然后我们应用该概念来查找具有恒定（正或负）热容的系统的精确各向异性表达式，该系统均匀地分布在相空间的能量壳上。我们讨论在大 N 极限下上述等价性确实（没有）破坏并且各向异性相应（没有）消失的情况。所提出的结果为热力学第二定律的统计力学基础提供了新的线索。

articles.title: Spectral Softening and the Structural Breakdown of Thermodynamic Equilibrium
articles.title_zh: 光谱软化和热力学平衡的结构破坏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.10216v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reversible quasistatic thermodynamics requires normalizable instantaneous equilibrium states and dynamics allowing their attainment or tracking. We examine these requirements in a driven two-dimensional quadratic Hamiltonian with an angular-momentum coupling and a spatially uniform momentum shift p_c(t), representable by a time-dependent vector potential. Its undriven part has normal-mode frequencies ω_±=ω₁±ω₂ and the Fock--Darwin structure of a charged oscillator in a perpendicular magnetic field. At the exact soft-mode endpoint ω₋=0, confinement is lost in one normal-mode sector. For every strictly positive ω₋, the canonical Gibbs state remains normalizable; only at the endpoint does the canonical trace cease to be finite. In the quasi-soft regime, where ω₋→0⁺, exact adjacent-level couplings yield a dimensionless adiabatic parameter proportional to |dot p_c|/ω₋². The standard adiabatic criterion requires this parameter to remain much smaller than unity. At a fixed occupation and a fixed nonzero driving rate, however small, this parameter grows without bound as ω₋→0⁺, eventually violating this criterion. In an open system, thermal tracking additionally depends on relaxation relative to the driving timescale. An explicit linear system--bath coupling illustrates why the relaxation rate cannot be inferred from the soft-mode spacing alone. Finally, the thermal Wigner function and its classical limit show that phase-space confinement is lost in both descriptions at the soft-mode endpoint. Taken together, our results show that canonical equilibrium is lost at ω₋=0. For ω₋>0, the Gibbs state exists, while the ability to track it dynamically depends on the driving and dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 可逆准静态热力学需要可归一化的瞬时平衡态和允许实现或跟踪这些平衡态的动力学。我们在一个具有角动量耦合和空间均匀动量位移p_c(t)的受驱动二维二次哈密顿量中研究这些要求，该位移可以用随时间变化的矢量势表示。其未受驱动部分具有正态模式频率ω_±=ω₁±ω₂，以及带电振子在垂直磁场中的福克-达尔文结构。在精确的软模端点ω₋=0处，一个正模扇区失去了束缚。对于每个严格为正的ω₋，正则吉布斯态仍然可归一化；只有在端点处，正则迹才不再是有限的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可逆准静态热力学需要可归一化的瞬时平衡态和允许实现或跟踪这些平衡态的动力学。我们在一个具有角动量耦合和空间均匀动量位移p_c(t)的受驱动二维二次哈密顿量中研究这些要求，该位移可以用随时间变化的矢量势表示。其未受驱动部分具有正态模式频率ω_±=ω₁±ω₂，以及带电振子在垂直磁场中的福克-达尔文结构。在精确的软模端点ω₋=0处，一个正模扇区失去了束缚。对于每个严格为正的ω₋，正则吉布斯态仍然可归一化；只有在端点处，正则迹才不再是有限的。在ω₋→0⁺的准软态下，精确的邻近能级耦合产生一个与|dot p_c|/ω₋²成正比的无量纲绝热参数。标准绝热准则要求该参数保持远小于1。在固定的占有数和固定的非零驱动速率下（无论其多么小），随着ω₋→0⁺，该参数将无限制地增长，最终违反这一准则。在开放系统中，热跟踪还取决于相对于驱动时间尺度的弛豫。显式线性系统-热库耦合说明了为什么不能仅从软模间距推断弛豫速率。最后，热维格纳函数及其经典极限表明，在软模终点处，两种描述下的相空间束缚均消失。综上所述，我们的结果表明，在ω₋=0时正则平衡消失。对于ω₋>0，吉布斯态存在，而动态跟踪吉布斯态的能力取决于驱动和耗散。

articles.title: Site-selective preparation of two-dimensional dipolar quantum gases in an optical beat-note lattice
articles.title_zh: 在光学拍频光晶格中位点选择性制备二维偶极量子气体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13482v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-resolution microscopy of two-dimensional dipolar quantum gases requires selecting individual atomic layers, a task complicated for strongly magnetic lanthanide atoms by the limited applicability of standard magnetic-gradient techniques. We present an all-optical method for the deterministic spatial selection of single- and bilayer samples of cold dipolar atoms using spatially selective parametric heating within a beat-note superlattice. By utilizing a high-resolution microscope objective as a common retroreflector for both optical frequency components, the lattice planes are passively stabilized. This renders their positions exceptionally robust against experimental drifts and structure-borne vibrations, even eliminating the need for active laser stabilization over millimeter-scale separations from the reflecting surface. We validate this approach by demonstrating the robust isolation of one or two atomic layers in precise coincidence with the focal plane of our objective. This enables future single-atom-resolved studies of long-range interacting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维偶极量子气体的髙分辨率显微镜成像需要选择单个原子层，对于强磁性镧系元素原子来说，这是一项复杂的工作，因为标准磁梯度技术的适用性有限。我们提出了一种全光学方法，用于在拍频超晶格内利用空间选择性参数加热对冷偶极原子单层和双层样品进行确定性空间选择。通过使用高分辨率显微镜物镜作为两个光学频率分量的共同反射镜，晶面得到了被动稳定。这使得它们的位置在面对实验漂移和结构性振动时格外稳固，甚至在距反射面毫米级的距离范围内无需进行主动激光稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维偶极量子气体的髙分辨率显微镜成像需要选择单个原子层，对于强磁性镧系元素原子来说，这是一项复杂的工作，因为标准磁梯度技术的适用性有限。我们提出了一种全光学方法，用于在拍频超晶格内利用空间选择性参数加热对冷偶极原子单层和双层样品进行确定性空间选择。通过使用高分辨率显微镜物镜作为两个光学频率分量的共同反射镜，晶面得到了被动稳定。这使得它们的位置在面对实验漂移和结构性振动时格外稳固，甚至在距反射面毫米级的距离范围内无需进行主动激光稳定。我们通过演示一到两个原子层与物镜焦平面的精确重合，实现了稳健的隔离，从而验证了这种方法。这为未来对长程相互作用系统的单原子分辨研究提供了可能。

articles.title: Defect-trapped hydrogen couples stress-triggered atomic decohesion with explosive crack growth
articles.title_zh: 缺陷捕获的氢耦合应力诱发的原子解聚与爆炸性裂纹扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03298v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrogen embrittlement (HE) has remained a major challenge for over a century1. The prevailing view that diffusive hydrogen governs embrittlement has fostered the assumption that defect trapping mitigates HE2-7. Here, we challenge this paradigm by showing that defect-trapped hydrogen enables internal cleavage fracture under sub-threshold stress. Sequential hydrogen-isotope-plasma exposure and tungsten-ion irradiation distinguish defect decoration and mechanical triggering from the subsequent cavity growth, revealing a two-stage mechanochemical pathway for fracture initiation. First, hydrogen accumulation at dislocation cores lowers the local decohesion threshold, rendering the reconstructed core susceptible to a small external mechanical trigger for atomic bond rupture. This rupture nucleates an internal free surface and marks the onset of crack formation. We propose that hydrogen recombination could release chemical energy within the nascent crack and drive a rapid brittle growth into a mesoscopic cavity. By separating the mechanical trigger for atomic decohesion from the proposed energetic driving force for subsequent crack growth, our results establish an atomistic foundation for the classical hydrogen-enhanced decohesion model8-11 and a mechanistic framework for hydrogen-induced crack formation. Finally, shifting the focus from experimentally elusive diffusive hydrogen to accessible trapped hydrogen12-14 identifies the local trapped-hydrogen state as a potentially quantifiable control parameter for hydrogen-induced fracture.
articles.abstract_zh: 一个多世纪以来，氢脆化（HE）一直是一个重大挑战1。普遍认为扩散性氢主导脆化，这一观点促成了缺陷俘获可减轻氢脆化的假设2-7。在此，我们通过展示被缺陷捕获的氢在亚临界应力下可导致内部解理断裂，来对这一范式提出质疑。通过先后进行氢同位素等离子体辐照和钨离子辐照，将缺陷装饰和机械触发与随后的空腔生长区分开来，揭示了裂纹萌生的两阶段机械化学途径。首先，位错核处的氢积累降低了局部解聚阈值，使重构后的位错核容易受到微小外部机械触发因素的影响而发生原子键断裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个多世纪以来，氢脆化（HE）一直是一个重大挑战1。普遍认为扩散性氢主导脆化，这一观点促成了缺陷俘获可减轻氢脆化的假设2-7。在此，我们通过展示被缺陷捕获的氢在亚临界应力下可导致内部解理断裂，来对这一范式提出质疑。通过先后进行氢同位素等离子体辐照和钨离子辐照，将缺陷装饰和机械触发与随后的空腔生长区分开来，揭示了裂纹萌生的两阶段机械化学途径。首先，位错核处的氢积累降低了局部解聚阈值，使重构后的位错核容易受到微小外部机械触发因素的影响而发生原子键断裂。这种断裂形成一个内部自由表面，标志着裂纹形成的开始。我们提出，氢重组可以在新生裂纹内释放化学能，并驱动快速的脆性生长形成介观空腔。通过将原子解聚的机械触发因素与随后裂纹扩展的拟议能量驱动力区分开来，我们的研究结果为经典的氢致解聚模型8-11奠定了原子学基础，并为氢致裂纹形成提供了机理框架。最后，将重点从实验上难以捉摸的扩散性氢转移到易于研究的截留氢12-14 ，确定了局部截留氢态是氢致裂纹的潜在可量化控制参数。

articles.title: Percolation criticality of amorphous-Amorphous transitions in compressed glasses
articles.title_zh: 压缩玻璃中非晶-非晶转变的渗流临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04748v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The low-to-high-density transition in compressed silica glass is investigated using percolation theory. Large-scale molecular-dynamics simulations of SiO₂ glasses, with system sizes of up to 10⁶ atoms and pressures ranging from 0 to 35 GPa, were carried out to investigate the emergence of structural motifs and their growth to system-spanning length scales under compression. On this basis, we introduced long-range descriptors that complement conventional local and medium-range structural measures. The results reveal critical percolation transitions of SiO_Z-SiO_Z clusters with increasing coordination number Z. The critical exponents of the lowest-pressure transitions, i.e., tetrahedral and pentahedral networks, are consistent with standard percolation predictions, whereas for higher-coordinated polyhedra the data collapse suggests possible deviations that are tentatively associated with a rigidity-percolation mechanism. SiSi_Z-SiSi_Z clusters were also analyzed using the non-bonded approach. Bonded and non-bonded approaches complement each other in a particularly illuminating way for describing pressure-induced structural transformations and common mechanisms shared by bonded glasses, such as SiO₂, and non-bonded glasses, such as amorphous ice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用渗流理论研究了压缩二氧化硅玻璃中的低密度到高密度转变。对SiO₂玻璃进行了大规模分子动力学模拟，系统规模高达10⁶个原子，压力范围为0至35 GPa，以研究结构基元的出现及其在压缩下生长至跨越整个系统的长度尺度。在此基础上，我们引入了长程描述符，以补充传统的局部和中程结构测量。结果揭示了随着配位数Z的增加，SiO_Z-SiO_Z团簇的临界渗流跃迁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文使用渗流理论研究了压缩二氧化硅玻璃中的低密度到高密度转变。对SiO₂玻璃进行了大规模分子动力学模拟，系统规模高达10⁶个原子，压力范围为0至35 GPa，以研究结构基元的出现及其在压缩下生长至跨越整个系统的长度尺度。在此基础上，我们引入了长程描述符，以补充传统的局部和中程结构测量。结果揭示了随着配位数Z的增加，SiO_Z-SiO_Z团簇的临界渗流跃迁。最低压力跃迁（即四面体和五面体网络）的临界指数与标准渗流预测一致，而对于更高配位的多面体，数据坍缩表明可能存在偏差，这些偏差暂时与刚性渗流机制相关。还使用非键合方法分析了SiSi_Z-SiSi_Z团簇。键合和非键合方法以一种特别有启发性的方式相辅相成，用于描述压力诱导的结构转变以及键合玻璃（如SiO₂）和非键合玻璃（如非晶冰）所共有的常见机制。

articles.title: Open Wilson chain numerical renormalization group approach to steady-state non-equilibrium quantum transport
articles.title_zh: 稳态非平衡量子输运的开式威尔逊链数值重整化群方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14635v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The numerical renormalization group (NRG) approach was developed to identify and quantify different equilibrium regimes of quantum impurity systems (QISs) with unprecedented accuracy by a tailored finite size representation. Out of equilibrium, the steady-state density operator is not of the Boltzmannian form but one that is determined by the imposed boundary conditions. We extend the NRG to the nonequilibrium setting by augmenting each Wilson site with a reservoir, whose coupling functions are calculated via a continuous fraction expansion in order to recover the continuum limit exactly. The nonequilibrium parameters such as a finite bias as well as a finite temperature gradient enters through the Bloch-Redfield tensor (BRT), whose zero eigenvector gives the steady-state density operator. We used the resulting open chain full density matrix (OC-FDM) approach with an effective single lead description to investigate the charge and spin transport through a quantum dot (QD) under finite bias and temperature gradient. The influence of lead asymmetry and an external magnetic field on the transport properties are also studied. For completeness, we have also investigated local properties of the QD, such as charge fluctuations and find excellent agreement with real-time quantum Monte Carlo (RT-QMC) data. The OC-FDM approach was able to explore Kondo energy scales as low as T_K/D approx 10⁻⁸ in the non-equilibrium regime, as well as show convergence with the established equilibrium benchmarks, such as a quantitative agreement with full density matrix numerical renormalization group (FDM-NRG) and Fermi-liquid scaling at small bias and temperature. Owing to the effective single lead description, a single OC-FDM data point takes orders of magnitude less time on a standard laptop, compared to other state-of-the-art numerical methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 数值重整化群（NRG）方法旨在通过量身定制的有限大小表示，以前所未有的精度识别和量化量子杂质系统（QIS）的不同平衡态。在非平衡状态下，稳态密度算符不是玻尔兹曼形式的，而是由施加的边界条件决定的。我们通过在每个威尔逊格点上增加一个储器，将NRG扩展到非平衡状态，其耦合函数通过连分数展开来计算，以便精确地恢复连续极限。有限偏压和有限温度梯度等非平衡参数通过布洛赫-雷德菲尔德张量（BRT）引入，其零特征向量给出稳态密度算符。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数值重整化群（NRG）方法旨在通过量身定制的有限大小表示，以前所未有的精度识别和量化量子杂质系统（QIS）的不同平衡态。在非平衡状态下，稳态密度算符不是玻尔兹曼形式的，而是由施加的边界条件决定的。我们通过在每个威尔逊格点上增加一个储器，将NRG扩展到非平衡状态，其耦合函数通过连分数展开来计算，以便精确地恢复连续极限。有限偏压和有限温度梯度等非平衡参数通过布洛赫-雷德菲尔德张量（BRT）引入，其零特征向量给出稳态密度算符。我们使用由此产生的开链全密度矩阵（OC-FDM）方法，并采用有效的单引线描述，研究了在有限偏压和温度梯度下通过量子点（QD）的电荷和自旋输运。还研究了引线不对称性和外加磁场对输运性质的影响。为了完整起见，我们还研究了QD的局部性质，如电荷涨落，并发现与实时量子蒙特卡洛（RT-QMC）数据高度吻合。OC-FDM方法能够在非平衡态下探索低至T_K/D约10⁻⁸的近藤能标，并显示出与既定平衡态基准的收敛性，例如与全密度矩阵数值重整化群（FDM-NRG）的定量一致性，以及在小偏压和小温度下的费米液体标度。由于有效的单导联描述，与其他最先进的数值方法相比，在标准笔记本电脑上，单个 OC-FDM 数据点所需的时间要少几个数量级。

articles.title: Tunable Emergent Gauge Fields from Skyrmions in a Quasicrystalline Lattice
articles.title_zh: 准晶晶格中斯格明子产生的可调谐涌现规范场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07948v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study magnetic skyrmions in a two-dimensional quasicrystalline lattice using a classical Heisenberg model with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions and an external magnetic field. The competition between the skyrmion--skyrmion repulsion and an emergent quasiperiodic pinning landscape gives rise to a sequence of distinct skyrmion lattice configurations as a function of field. The resulting hierarchy of quasiperiodic pinning potentials, characterized by closely spaced quasi-degenerate minima, enables a quasi-continuous suppression of the skyrmion density as the saturation field is approached, in sharp contrast to the strongly first-order collapse of skyrmion crystals on periodic lattices. This provides a direct mechanism for controlling the topological charge and, consequently, the emergent gauge field for itinerant electrons. As a consequence, the Hall conductivity can be strongly modified with small changes in the magnetic field and driven smoothly to zero near saturation. This field-controlled tunability, rooted in the underlying multistability, identifies quasicrystalline magnets as a platform for tunable topological textures, with potential applications in magnetic memory and magnetoelectronic response.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用具有Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya相互作用和外加磁场的经典海森堡模型，研究二维准晶格中的磁性斯格明子。斯格明子-斯格明子排斥力与新出现的准周期性钉扎景观之间的竞争，导致了一系列随磁场变化的独特斯格明子晶格构型。由此产生的准周期性钉扎势能的层次结构以间距很近的准简并最小值为特征，使得随着接近饱和场，斯格明子密度受到准连续抑制，这与周期性晶格上斯格明子晶体的强一级坍塌形成鲜明对比。这为控制拓扑电荷提供了直接机制，进而为巡回电子提供了涌现规范场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用具有Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya相互作用和外加磁场的经典海森堡模型，研究二维准晶格中的磁性斯格明子。斯格明子-斯格明子排斥力与新出现的准周期性钉扎景观之间的竞争，导致了一系列随磁场变化的独特斯格明子晶格构型。由此产生的准周期性钉扎势能的层次结构以间距很近的准简并最小值为特征，使得随着接近饱和场，斯格明子密度受到准连续抑制，这与周期性晶格上斯格明子晶体的强一级坍塌形成鲜明对比。这为控制拓扑电荷提供了直接机制，进而为巡回电子提供了涌现规范场。因此，霍尔电导率可以通过磁场的小幅变化得到显著改变，并在接近饱和时平稳地降至零。这种场控可调性植根于潜在的多稳态，使准晶磁体成为可调拓扑织构的平台，在磁存储器和磁电子响应方面具有潜在应用。

articles.title: Field-induced first order transitions and phase coexistence in the Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate BaCo2(AsO4)2
articles.title_zh: Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料BaCo2(AsO4)2中的场致一级相变和相共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15346v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: BaCo2(AsO4)2 (BCAO) is an insulating Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate with a rich low-temperature phase diagram. Below 5 K, it exhibits double-zigzag magnetic order. Upon application of an in-plane magnetic field, the magnetic structure first transforms into an up-up-down (UUD) state near 0.12 T and then enters a fully spin-polarized ferromagnetic (FM) state near 0.5 T. In the narrow field regime close to the polarized phase, a finite residual thermal conductivity has been reported, suggesting a possible field-induced quantum spin liquid phase. Using neutron scattering, we show that the field-induced double-zigzag-to-UUD transition near 0.15 T is accompanied by the emergence of a cluster of localized UUD spin excitations that coexist with conventional spin waves. Upon further increasing field, BCAO undergoes a first-order UUD-to-FM transition with coexistence of UUD and FM phases, accompanied by a sharp response in the spin Seebeck coefficient. These results do not support a quantum spin liquid scenario near the UUD-to-FM critical field. Instead, modeling indicates that the broad excitations arise from bound spin-flip pairs, while a low-lying dispersive branch near the FM phase boundary carries the same sign of magnetization as the FM order. These excitations naturally account for the observed sign of the spin Seebeck response and are likely relevant to the thermal conductivity near the critical field.
articles.abstract_zh: BaCo2(AsO4)2 (BCAO)是一种绝缘的Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料，具有丰富的低温相图。在5 K以下，它表现出双锯齿磁序。在施加面内磁场时，磁性结构首先在接近0.12 T时转变为上-上-下（UUD）态，然后在接近0.5 T时进入完全自旋极化的铁磁（FM）态。在接近极化相的窄磁场区域，有报道称存在有限的残余热导率，这表明可能存在磁场诱导的量子自旋液体相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: BaCo2(AsO4)2 (BCAO)是一种绝缘的Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料，具有丰富的低温相图。在5 K以下，它表现出双锯齿磁序。在施加面内磁场时，磁性结构首先在接近0.12 T时转变为上-上-下（UUD）态，然后在接近0.5 T时进入完全自旋极化的铁磁（FM）态。在接近极化相的窄磁场区域，有报道称存在有限的残余热导率，这表明可能存在磁场诱导的量子自旋液体相。我们利用中子散射表明，在0.15 T附近发生的场致双锯齿-UUD相变伴随着一簇局域UUD自旋激发态的出现，这些激发态与常规自旋波共存。随着磁场的进一步增加，BCAO经历了一级UUD-to-FM相变，UUD相和FM相共存，同时伴随着自旋塞贝克系数的急剧响应。这些结果不支持UUD-to-FM临界磁场附近的量子自旋液体情景。相反，建模表明，宽激发源自束缚的自旋翻转对，而靠近铁磁相边界的低位色散分支具有与铁磁有序相同的磁化符号。这些激发自然可以解释所观察到的自旋塞贝克响应的符号，并且可能与临界磁场附近的导热率有关。

articles.title: Observation of far-from-equilibrium scaling in the transient dynamics of 2D quantum magnets
articles.title_zh: 在二维量子磁体的瞬态动力学中观察到远离平衡的标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The transient regime of far-from-equilibrium quantum many-body dynamics lacks the established organizing principles that universality and scaling provide in equilibrium. It is least understood for two-dimensional short-range interacting systems, where mean-field arguments are not expected to hold, controlled theoretical descriptions are few, and fluctuations are strong. Here we investigate the quench dynamics of the transverse-field Ising model using programmable Rydberg-atom arrays realizing honeycomb, square, kagome, and triangular lattices. Starting from a fully magnetized state, we observe a pronounced softening of the dominant collective magnetization oscillation accompanied by a maximum in the damping rate, signaling a crossover between interaction- and field-dominated transient dynamics. Even though the microscopic lattice geometries are different, both the oscillation frequencies and the damping rates collapse onto common curves under rescaling by the coordination-number-weighted interaction strength. We present a theoretical description which accounts for the collapse of both quantities and elucidates the nature of the processes responsible for the damping. The observed failure of the discrete truncated Wigner approximation to predict the damping for strong interactions shows that classical evolution of initial quantum noise is insufficient, while tree-tensor-network simulations reproduce the dynamics accurately. These results reveal a robust scaling regime governing the transient dynamics of short-range interacting two-dimensional quantum magnets. The fact that the dominant transient dynamics can be captured by a simple collective description despite the presence of fluctuations and nonlinearities characteristic of low dimensionality and small spin is an important insight in the quest for organizing principles in far-from-equilibrium quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 远离平衡态的量子多体动力学瞬态行为缺乏普遍性和标度在平衡态中提供的既定组织原理。对于二维短程相互作用系统，人们的了解最少，因为在这种系统中，平均场论证预计不成立，受控的理论描述很少，并且涨落很强。本文使用可编程的里德伯原子阵列，实现了蜂窝、方形、kagome和三角晶格，研究了横向场伊辛模型的猝灭动力学。从完全磁化状态开始，我们观察到主导性集体磁化振荡明显软化，同时伴随着阻尼率的最大值，这表明相互作用主导的瞬态动力学与磁场主导的瞬态动力学之间存在交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 远离平衡态的量子多体动力学瞬态行为缺乏普遍性和标度在平衡态中提供的既定组织原理。对于二维短程相互作用系统，人们的了解最少，因为在这种系统中，平均场论证预计不成立，受控的理论描述很少，并且涨落很强。本文使用可编程的里德伯原子阵列，实现了蜂窝、方形、kagome和三角晶格，研究了横向场伊辛模型的猝灭动力学。从完全磁化状态开始，我们观察到主导性集体磁化振荡明显软化，同时伴随着阻尼率的最大值，这表明相互作用主导的瞬态动力学与磁场主导的瞬态动力学之间存在交叉。尽管微观晶格几何形状各不相同，但在用配位数加权相互作用强度进行重标度时，振荡频率和阻尼率都会坍缩到共同的曲线上。我们提出了一种理论描述，解释了这两个量的坍缩，并阐明了导致阻尼的过程的性质。离散截断Wigner近似在预测强相互作用的阻尼方面所观察到的失败表明，初始量子噪声的经典演化是不充分的，而树张量网络模拟则能够准确地再现动力学。这些结果揭示了一种稳健的标度性机制，该机制支配着短程相互作用二维量子磁体的瞬态动力学。尽管存在低维性和小自旋所特有的涨落和非线性，但主要瞬态动力学仍可通过简单的集体描述来捕捉，这一事实是探索远离平衡态量子物质的组织原理的一个重要见解。

articles.title: Spin preservation in screw-symmetric molecules
articles.title_zh: 螺对称分子中的自旋保持
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27002v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In electronic transport through long molecules, spin is expected to be preserved only when the dwell time is much shorter than the characteristic spin-mixing timescale hbar/Δ, where Δ is the magnitude of a spin-dependent potential, such as spin-orbit coupling. We show that, in molecules featuring discrete screw symmetry, spin preservation can be enhanced far beyond this timescale owing to strong spin separation in quasi-momentum. This spin fidelity in long molecules is consistent with chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), suggesting spin-dependent transport in long, chiral molecules with amplified spin-splitting mechanisms. We provide analytical derivation of the enhanced spin preservation and test it on tight-binding models, which confirm that the effect gradually weakens when the screw symmetry is broken or changes from discrete to continuous. Furthermore, we perform transport simulations to show that a strong magnetoresistance trace of symmetry-protected spin fidelity emerges in a spin-valve setup with two magnetic leads, which we propose as an experimentally accessible signature.
articles.abstract_zh: 在通过长分子的电子输运中，只有当驻留时间比特征性自旋混合时间尺度ℏ/Δ短得多时，自旋才有可能得以保持，其中Δ是自旋相关势（如自旋轨道耦合）的强度。我们表明，在具有离散螺旋对称性的分子中，由于准动量中存在强自旋分离，自旋保持可以大大超过这一时间尺度。长分子中的这种自旋保真度与手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）一致，表明在具有放大自旋劈裂机制的长手性分子中存在自旋依赖性输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在通过长分子的电子输运中，只有当驻留时间比特征性自旋混合时间尺度ℏ/Δ短得多时，自旋才有可能得以保持，其中Δ是自旋相关势（如自旋轨道耦合）的强度。我们表明，在具有离散螺旋对称性的分子中，由于准动量中存在强自旋分离，自旋保持可以大大超过这一时间尺度。长分子中的这种自旋保真度与手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）一致，表明在具有放大自旋劈裂机制的长手性分子中存在自旋依赖性输运。我们提供了增强自旋保持的解析推导，并在紧束缚模型上进行了测试，结果证实，当螺旋对称性被破坏或从离散变为连续时，这种效应会逐渐减弱。此外，我们进行了输运模拟，以表明在具有两个磁性引线的自旋阀结构中会出现对称性保护的自旋保真度的强磁阻迹线，我们将其提议为一种可实验获得的特征。

articles.title: Quantum geometric bounds at finite temperature for one-dimensional chiral systems
articles.title_zh: 一维手性系统在有限温度下的量子几何边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27944v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The geometry and topology of quantum states are intimately related at zero temperature through exact bounds that constrain geometric quantities from below by topological invariants. At finite temperature, however, the analogous relations remain unclear. Here we establish rigorous geometric lower bounds for one-dimensional chiral-symmetric systems at finite temperature within the Uhlmann's framework for mixed states. We show that the Bures length is bounded by a continuous geometric phase angle. We further derive a temperature-dependent bound that interpolates between the zero-temperature limit and a trivial high-temperature regime. Our results are verified analytically and numerically using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model and the spinless Kitaev chain model. Finally, we discuss potential ways to detect the geometry of the density matrix in quantum circuits, with the quantum imaginary-time evolution method.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态的几何形状和拓扑结构在零温度下通过拓扑不变量从下方约束几何量的精确边界密切相关。然而，在有限温度下，类似关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们在乌尔曼混合态框架内建立了有限温度下一维手性对称系统的严格几何下界。我们证明了 Bures 长度受到连续几何相位角的限制。我们进一步推导出一个与温度相关的界限，该界限插入零温度极限和平凡的高温状态之间。我们的结果使用 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型和无旋转 Kitaev 链模型进行了分析和数值验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子态的几何形状和拓扑结构在零温度下通过拓扑不变量从下方约束几何量的精确边界密切相关。然而，在有限温度下，类似关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们在乌尔曼混合态框架内建立了有限温度下一维手性对称系统的严格几何下界。我们证明了 Bures 长度受到连续几何相位角的限制。我们进一步推导出一个与温度相关的界限，该界限插入零温度极限和平凡的高温状态之间。我们的结果使用 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型和无旋转 Kitaev 链模型进行了分析和数值验证。最后，我们讨论了使用量子虚时间演化方法检测量子电路中密度矩阵几何形状的潜在方法。

articles.title: Enhanced Multifractality Induced by Non-Hermitian Disorder in Quantum Percolation
articles.title_zh: 量子渗流中非厄米无序引起的增强多重分形
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04625v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model with reciprocal hopping and random imaginary on-site potentials, which describe spatially uncorrelated gain and loss. The localization properties of the eigenstates are characterized through the complex spacing ratio, the participation entropy, and the generalized fractal dimensions D_q. Finite-size scaling yields an effective quantum percolation threshold p_q that increases monotonically with γ, with a shift larger than that produced by a real on-site potential of equal strength. We show that the onset of extended behavior drifts toward larger occupation probabilities as the system size increases. The localization--delocalization change is therefore a crossover, consistent with the absence of a sharp transition for reciprocal non-Hermitian disorder in two dimensions. Accordingly, the interval between the classical threshold p_c and p_q constitutes an extended multifractal crossover regime and its width at accessible sizes grows with γ. Although all states are expected to localize in the thermodynamic limit, above p_q the localization length exceeds the largest system size simulated, which is already larger than current photonic samples. The size-dependent threshold and the multifractal regime, which widens with the loss strength and can therefore be reached without fine-tuning, are thus directly accessible in photonic waveguide lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有相互跳跃和随机虚位点势的二维量子位点渗流模型，该模型描述了空间上不相关的增益和损失。本征态的局部化特性通过复数间距比、参与熵和广义分形维数 D_q 来表征。有限尺寸缩放产生有效的量子渗流阈值 p_q，该阈值随 γ 单调增加，其偏移大于同等强度的真实现场势产生的偏移。我们表明，随着系统规模的增加，扩展行为的开始会趋向于更大的占用概率。因此，局域-离域变化是一个交叉，与二维互易非厄米无序没有急剧转变一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有相互跳跃和随机虚位点势的二维量子位点渗流模型，该模型描述了空间上不相关的增益和损失。本征态的局部化特性通过复数间距比、参与熵和广义分形维数 D_q 来表征。有限尺寸缩放产生有效的量子渗流阈值 p_q，该阈值随 γ 单调增加，其偏移大于同等强度的真实现场势产生的偏移。我们表明，随着系统规模的增加，扩展行为的开始会趋向于更大的占用概率。因此，局域-离域变化是一个交叉，与二维互易非厄米无序没有急剧转变一致。因此，经典阈值p_c和p_q之间的间隔构成了扩展的多重分形交叉区域，并且其在可访问尺寸处的宽度随着γ而增长。尽管所有状态都预计会局域于热力学极限，但在 p_q 以上，局域长度超过了模拟的最大系统尺寸，该尺寸已经大于当前的光子样本。因此，尺寸相关的阈值和多重分形区域随着损耗强度而变宽，因此无需微调即可达到，因此可以在光子波导晶格中直接访问。

articles.title: Hidden Rotational Dynamics from Crystal Geometry
articles.title_zh: 晶体几何中隐藏的旋转动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38317v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: From hidden spin order to electronic loop currents and frustrated fluctuations, unconventional quantum matter reveals the rich patterns that electronic and magnetic degrees of freedom form across space and time. Recent advances in chiral phononics have extended this perspective to lattice vibrations, raising the question of whether the lattice itself can generate spatially organized rotational correlations. Here we show that crystal geometry provides an autonomous mechanism for generating equilibrium angular-momentum circulation and staggered antisymmetric displacement interactions, independently of coupling to electronic or magnetic order. Our framework applies broadly to crystalline systems hosting locally symmetry-lowered environments embedded within a higher-symmetry global structure. We identify how directional elastic forces organize displacement correlations and how eliminating internal coordinates generates staggered antisymmetric interactions-a phononic analogue of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya exchange-even in globally centrosymmetric crystals. By separating intersite angular-momentum transfer from crystalline restoring torques, we show that both elastic anisotropy and the induced antisymmetric interactions together drive oppositely circulating angular-momentum currents on neighboring plaquettes, despite vanishing mean angular momentum at every site. Sustained by quantum and thermal fluctuations, this circulation preserves time-reversal and inversion symmetry and requires neither external driving nor spontaneous symmetry breaking. Our results establish lattice geometry as a microscopic source of spatially organized angular-momentum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 从隐藏的自旋顺序到电子环路电流和受抑涨落，非常规量子物质揭示了电子和磁自由度在空间和时间上形成的丰富模式。手性声子学的最新进展已将这一观点扩展到晶格振动，提出了晶格本身是否可以产生空间组织的旋转相关性的问题。在这里，我们表明晶体几何形状提供了一种自主机制，用于产生平衡角动量循环和交错反对称位移相互作用，独立于电子或磁序的耦合。我们的框架广泛适用于嵌入更高对称性全局结构中的局部对称性降低环境的晶体系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从隐藏的自旋顺序到电子环路电流和受抑涨落，非常规量子物质揭示了电子和磁自由度在空间和时间上形成的丰富模式。手性声子学的最新进展已将这一观点扩展到晶格振动，提出了晶格本身是否可以产生空间组织的旋转相关性的问题。在这里，我们表明晶体几何形状提供了一种自主机制，用于产生平衡角动量循环和交错反对称位移相互作用，独立于电子或磁序的耦合。我们的框架广泛适用于嵌入更高对称性全局结构中的局部对称性降低环境的晶体系统。我们确定了方向弹力如何组织位移相关性，以及消除内坐标如何产生交错的反对称相互作用（Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 交换的声子类似物），甚至在全局中心对称晶体中也是如此。通过将位点间角动量转移与晶体恢复扭矩分开，我们发现弹性各向异性和引起的反对称相互作用共同驱动相邻小板上相反循环的角动量电流，尽管每个位点的平均角动量都消失了。在量子和热涨落的维持下，这种循环保持了时间反转和反演对称性，既不需要外部驱动，也不需要自发对称性破缺。我们的结果将晶格几何学确立为空间组织角动量动力学的微观来源。

articles.title: Spin-Polarized Transport Tomography of a Quantum-Dot Spin Qubit via Ferromagnetic Leads
articles.title_zh: 通过铁磁引线对量子点自旋量子位进行自旋偏振传输层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2101.10821v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose a theoretical protocol for reconstructing the density matrix of a single-electron spin qubit using spin-polarized transport. The system consists of a quantum dot coupled to ferromagnetic reservoirs and subject to a magnetic field lying in the xy plane of the Bloch sphere. Spin-dependent tunneling events measured along the x±, y±, and z± quantization axes give rise to probability distributions that encode the quantum state of the qubit. The open-system dynamics are described using a Lindblad master equation, which captures the time evolution of the spin under continuous coupling to the reservoirs. By counting tunneling events for four different magnetic alignments, we formulate a scheme for reconstructing the full density matrix of the qubit. The resulting simulation data are analyzed using Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) as a supervised machine-learning post-processing tool to reconstruct smooth time-dependent density-matrix elements from the measured probability distributions. The proposed model enables complete access to the open-system density matrix, including both population probabilities and relative phase information. Successful state reconstruction demonstrates the validity and robustness of the approach, highlighting its applicability to experimentally accessible spin-transport platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用自旋极化传输重建单电子自旋量子位的密度矩阵的理论协议。该系统由与铁磁储层耦合的量子点组成，并受到位于布洛赫球体 xy 平面的磁场的影响。沿 x±、y± 和 z± 量化轴测量的自旋相关隧道事件会产生编码量子位量子态的概率分布。使用 Lindblad 主方程描述开放系统动力学，该方程捕获与储层连续耦合下自旋的时间演化。通过计算四种不同磁排列的隧道事件，我们制定了重建量子位全密度矩阵的方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种使用自旋极化传输重建单电子自旋量子位的密度矩阵的理论协议。该系统由与铁磁储层耦合的量子点组成，并受到位于布洛赫球体 xy 平面的磁场的影响。沿 x±、y± 和 z± 量化轴测量的自旋相关隧道事件会产生编码量子位量子态的概率分布。使用 Lindblad 主方程描述开放系统动力学，该方程捕获与储层连续耦合下自旋的时间演化。通过计算四种不同磁排列的隧道事件，我们制定了重建量子位全密度矩阵的方案。使用高斯过程回归 (GPR) 作为监督机器学习后处理工具来分析生成的模拟数据，以根据测量的概率分布重建平滑的时间相关密度矩阵元素。所提出的模型能够完全访问开放系统密度矩阵，包括总体概率和相对相位信息。成功的状态重建证明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性，强调了其对实验上可访问的自旋传输平台的适用性。

articles.title: Associator Defects in Non-Unitary String-Nets
articles.title_zh: 非酉弦网中的关联器缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06821v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study obstructions to realizing fusion categories in physical Hilbert spaces by varying positive inner products on elementary fusion spaces. We introduce an associator defect to measure the smallest failure of recoupling maps to preserve the induced inner products in order to do so. By using a determinant identity from the pentagon equation, we prove that the minimum is attained and vanishes when the category is unitarizable. As an example, we compute the defect for the Yang-Lee category and its double, studying its behavior under stacking and passage to Drinfeld centers, which results in a Morita-invariant measure of bulk nonunitarity. We also obtain lower bounds for quantum-group categories with fusion multiplicities. Finally, we study how these obstructions appear in physical realizations of fusion. Under the stated assumptions on local splitting operations and coherent measurements, a positive defect imposes quantitative tradeoffs between implementation errors and operator norms. We also obtain bounds on the response to local perturbations. These results show how the failure of categorical unitarity will place quantitative constraints on physical realizations of potential fusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过改变基本融合空间上的正内积来研究在物理希尔伯特空间中实现融合类别的障碍。为此，我们引入了关联器缺陷来测量重新耦合映射的最小失败，以保留诱导内积。通过使用五边形方程中的行列式恒等式，我们证明了当类别可单位化时，达到最小值并消失。作为一个例子，我们计算了 Yang-Lee 范畴及其双范畴的缺陷，研究了它在堆叠和传递到 Drinfeld 中心下的行为，从而产生了体非酉性的 Morita 不变测度。我们还获得了具有融合多重性的量子群类别的下界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过改变基本融合空间上的正内积来研究在物理希尔伯特空间中实现融合类别的障碍。为此，我们引入了关联器缺陷来测量重新耦合映射的最小失败，以保留诱导内积。通过使用五边形方程中的行列式恒等式，我们证明了当类别可单位化时，达到最小值并消失。作为一个例子，我们计算了 Yang-Lee 范畴及其双范畴的缺陷，研究了它在堆叠和传递到 Drinfeld 中心下的行为，从而产生了体非酉性的 Morita 不变测度。我们还获得了具有融合多重性的量子群类别的下界。最后，我们研究这些障碍在融合的物理实现中是如何出现的。在关于局部分裂操作和相干测量的既定假设下，正缺陷会在实现误差和操作员规范之间施加定量权衡。我们还获得了对局部扰动响应的界限。这些结果表明，绝对统一性的失败将如何对潜在融合的物理实现施加定量限制。

articles.title: Scalable spin-nematic squeezing in multi-level dipole-interacting Rydberg atom arrays
articles.title_zh: 多级偶极相互作用里德堡原子阵列中的可扩展自旋向列挤压
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00096v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the dynamical generation of metrologically useful entanglement in arrays of three-level (spin-1) systems coupled by spin-exchange interactions, as realized by dipole-interacting Rydberg atoms in optical tweezers. We quantify the metrological gain by a generalized squeezing parameter optimized over all linear SU(3) phase generators and readout observables. For equal exchange couplings on the two transitions, the dynamics reduces to one-axis twisting (OAT) of an effective two-level system. Away from this point, the full three-level structure provides a genuine advantage. For all-to-all couplings, the optimal squeezing at N=4000 exceeds the OAT value by a factor of 3.6, with a fitted scaling exponent of 0.93 compared with 0.69 for OAT over 100le Nle4000. For two-dimensional dipolar arrays, exact and tensor-network simulations up to N=49 show that the optimal three-level protocol outperforms the effective spin-1/2 dynamics, with a gain that increases with system size, and semiclassical simulations show that squeezing continues to grow up to N=10⁴. Crucially, our results demonstrate a real advantage of utilizing the full three-level SU(3) structure of the spin-1 system over SU(2) type one-axis twisting dynamics. Our results extend interaction-driven scalable squeezing beyond the well-studied qubit setting to spin-exchange-coupled qudits with dipolar interactions, and can be realized in current Rydberg tweezer experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过自旋交换相互作用耦合的三能级（spin-1）系统阵列中计量有用的纠缠的动态生成，这通过光镊中的偶极子相互作用的里德伯原子实现。我们通过对所有线性 SU(3) 相位发生器和读出可观测量进行优化的广义压缩参数来量化计量增益。对于两个转变上的等交换耦合，动力学降低为有效两级系统的单轴扭转（OAT）。从这一点来看，完整的三层结构提供了真正的优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了通过自旋交换相互作用耦合的三能级（spin-1）系统阵列中计量有用的纠缠的动态生成，这通过光镊中的偶极子相互作用的里德伯原子实现。我们通过对所有线性 SU(3) 相位发生器和读出可观测量进行优化的广义压缩参数来量化计量增益。对于两个转变上的等交换耦合，动力学降低为有效两级系统的单轴扭转（OAT）。从这一点来看，完整的三层结构提供了真正的优势。对于全对全耦合，N=4000 时的最佳挤压超过 OAT 值 3.6 倍，拟合缩放指数为 0.93，而超过 100le Nle4000 的 OAT 为 0.69。对于二维偶极阵列，高达 N=49 的精确张量网络模拟表明，最佳三级协议优于有效的自旋 1/2 动力学，增益随着系统尺寸的增加而增加，半经典模拟表明挤压继续增长到 N=10⁴。至关重要的是，我们的结果证明了利用 spin-1 系统的完整三级 SU(3) 结构相对于 SU(2) 型单轴扭转动力学的真正优势。我们的结果将相互作用驱动的可扩展挤压扩展到经过充分研究的量子位设置之外，扩展到具有偶极相互作用的自旋交换耦合量子位，并且可以在当前的里德堡镊子实验中实现。

articles.title: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
articles.title_zh: 钙钛矿前驱体添加剂发现的闭环框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20242v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. Here we show that LEAP (LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), a closed-loop framework combining a domain-specialized language model with active learning, prioritizes perovskite precursor additives under low-data conditions. The model extracts mechanism-relevant knowledge from the literature and converts it into interpretable molecular descriptors for uncertainty-aware Bayesian optimization. On an evaluation drawn from unseen literature, the specialized model provides more mechanism-consistent answers than the tested general-purpose models. In an expert-guided proof-of-concept study, two later-round additives increase average device power conversion efficiencies to 20.13% and 20.87%, compared with 19.25% for the control, and the best device reaches 21.32%. Because only a limited number of candidates are tested prospectively, these results provide preliminary evidence that literature-grounded molecular representations, Bayesian optimization, and expert assessment can support additive discovery for perovskite solar cells.
articles.abstract_zh: 有效发现前体添加剂对于提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，但巨大的化学空间使得传统的试错筛选效率低下。在这里，我们展示了 LEAP（LLM 驱动的钙钛矿主动学习探索），这是一个将领域专业语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，在低数据条件下优先考虑钙钛矿前体添加剂。该模型从文献中提取与机制相关的知识，并将其转换为可解释的分子描述符，以进行不确定性贝叶斯优化。根据从未见过的文献进行的评估，专用模型比经过测试的通用模型提供了更多机制一致的答案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有效发现前体添加剂对于提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，但巨大的化学空间使得传统的试错筛选效率低下。在这里，我们展示了 LEAP（LLM 驱动的钙钛矿主动学习探索），这是一个将领域专业语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，在低数据条件下优先考虑钙钛矿前体添加剂。该模型从文献中提取与机制相关的知识，并将其转换为可解释的分子描述符，以进行不确定性贝叶斯优化。根据从未见过的文献进行的评估，专用模型比经过测试的通用模型提供了更多机制一致的答案。在专家指导的概念验证研究中，两种后轮添加剂将平均器件功率转换效率提高到 20.13% 和 20.87%，而对照组为 19.25%，最好的器件达到 21.32%。由于只有有限数量的候选者进行了前瞻性测试，这些结果提供了初步证据，表明基于文献的分子表征、贝叶斯优化和专家评估可以支持钙钛矿太阳能电池的添加剂发现。

articles.title: Residual Nonextensivity from WIMP Freeze-Out: A Phenomenological Memory Channel
articles.title_zh: WIMP 冻结的残余非扩展性：现象学记忆通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29132v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work we formulate the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within a dynamical Tsallis framework. The parameter q_χ is promoted to a function of x=m_χ/T, describing a relaxation toward extensivity that need not be completed before chemical decoupling. We adopt a sectorial approximation during freeze-out, with an extensive Standard Model bath, and specify the statistical weights and effective kinetic closure used for the dark matter abundance. The total derivatives of the equilibrium density contain the variation of q_χ, which changes the rate at which the abundance must evolve to follow its instantaneous reference state. The residual value q_χrm fo then provides the input for a phenomenological memory channel into the electron-positron and neutrino sectors, while photons remain extensive. We derive the corresponding chain rule terms in the radiation energy and entropy balances and formulate the photon-reheating problem without assuming that comoving electromagnetic entropy is automatically conserved when q varies. The resulting construction connects the freeze-out history with the neutrino-to-photon temperature ratio and Nᵣₘ ₑff. We discuss the physical motivation, closure assumptions, and conditions under which this description can be used, without presenting numerical results or observational fits.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们在动态 Tsallis 框架内制定了弱相互作用的大质量粒子暗物质的热解耦或冻结。参数 q_χ 被提升为 x=m_χ/T 的函数，描述了化学解耦之前不需要完成的外延松弛。我们在冻结过程中采用扇形近似，并使用广泛的标准模型浴，并指定用于暗物质丰度的统计权重和有效动力学闭合。平衡密度的全导数包含 q_χ 的变化，它改变了丰度必须演化以遵循其瞬时参考状态的速率。然后，残差值 q_χrm fo 为电子-正电子和中微子扇区的唯象记忆通道提供输入，而光子仍然广泛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们在动态 Tsallis 框架内制定了弱相互作用的大质量粒子暗物质的热解耦或冻结。参数 q_χ 被提升为 x=m_χ/T 的函数，描述了化学解耦之前不需要完成的外延松弛。我们在冻结过程中采用扇形近似，并使用广泛的标准模型浴，并指定用于暗物质丰度的统计权重和有效动力学闭合。平衡密度的全导数包含 q_χ 的变化，它改变了丰度必须演化以遵循其瞬时参考状态的速率。然后，残差值 q_χrm fo 为电子-正电子和中微子扇区的唯象记忆通道提供输入，而光子仍然广泛。我们推导了辐射能量和熵平衡中相应的链式法则项，并公式化了光子再加热问题，而不假设当 q 变化时共动电磁熵自动守恒。由此产生的结构将冻结历史与中微子与光子的温度比和 Nᵣₘ ₑff 连接起来。我们讨论物理动机、闭合假设以及可以使用该描述的条件，但不提供数值结果或观察拟合。

articles.title: Super-Arrhenius relaxation of the triangular plaquette model in any dimension
articles.title_zh: 任意维度三角形斑块模型的超阿伦尼乌斯松弛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16259v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Consider the following plaquette model from statistical physics: a lamp lies at every vertex of the triangular lattice and a switch lies at every even vertex of the (bipartite) dual hexagonal lattice. Each switch toggles the three lamps on its face. The energy of a configuration is the number of ON lamps. For the Glauber dynamics associated with the Gibbs measure defined by this Hamiltonian at any inverse temperature β>0, we show that, in any dimension dge 2, the infinite volume relaxation time satisfies [eβ^²/C/C le Tᵣₑₗle Ce^eCβ] for some C>0. Our result entails that the Gibbs measure is unique. The eβ^² scaling was conjectured by Garrahan and Newman in 2000 and matches the behaviour of supercritical rooted kinetically constrained models such as the East model, thus recovering fragile glass phenomenology in the absence of kinetic constraints. More precisely, we show that, on a torus of side length 2^k, when β→infty and k/β→0, we have Tᵣₑₗ=e²β k⁽¹⁺o⁽¹⁾⁾, confirming a prediction of Newman and Moore. Quite surprisingly, however, we also prove that, on non-periodic finite domains of size nle eβ/C for large C>0, we have the much larger asymptotics ln Tᵣₑₗ=β nΘ⁽¹⁾. The main ingredients of the proofs are new results in extremal and enumerative combinatorics and rely on renormalisation ideas for the dynamics and its groundstates also known as the Ledrappier subshift. Our combinatorial results also have consequences in geometric group theory (more precisely to the complexity of the word problem for the Baumslag finitely presented group), ergodic theory and linear coding theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 考虑以下来自统计物理学的小板模型：一盏灯位于三角形晶格的每个顶点，一个开关位于（二分）双六边形晶格的每个偶数顶点。每个开关都会切换其表面的三个灯。配置的能量是ON灯的数量。对于与该哈密顿量在任何逆温度 β>0 下定义的吉布斯测度相关的格劳伯动力学，我们表明，在任何维度 dge 2 中，对于某些 C>0，无限体积弛豫时间满足 [eβ^²/C/C le Tᵣₑₗle Ce^eCβ]。我们的结果表明吉布斯测度是独一无二的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 考虑以下来自统计物理学的小板模型：一盏灯位于三角形晶格的每个顶点，一个开关位于（二分）双六边形晶格的每个偶数顶点。每个开关都会切换其表面的三个灯。配置的能量是ON灯的数量。对于与该哈密顿量在任何逆温度 β>0 下定义的吉布斯测度相关的格劳伯动力学，我们表明，在任何维度 dge 2 中，对于某些 C>0，无限体积弛豫时间满足 [eβ^²/C/C le Tᵣₑₗle Ce^eCβ]。我们的结果表明吉布斯测度是独一无二的。 eβ² 标度是 Garrahan 和 Newman 在 2000 年猜想的，它与超临界根动力学约束模型（如 East 模型）的行为相匹配，从而在没有动力学约束的情况下恢复易碎玻璃现象。更准确地说，我们证明，在边长为 2^k 的圆环上，当 β→infty 且 k/β→0 时，我们有 Tᵣₑₗ=e²β k⁽1⁺o⁽1⁾⁾，证实了 Newman 和 Moore 的预测。然而，令人惊讶的是，我们还证明，在大小为 nle eβ/C 的非周期有限域上，对于较大的 C>0，我们有更大的渐近线 ln Tᵣₑₗ=β nθ⁽1⁾。证明的主要内容是极值和枚举组合学的新结果，并依赖于动力学及其基态的重正化思想，也称为 Ledrappier 子位移。我们的组合结果也在几何群论（更准确地说是鲍姆斯拉格有限呈现群的文字问题的复杂性）、遍历理论和线性编码理论中产生影响。

articles.title: Predictive beam-lattice reduction for higher-order topological modes in a 2D SSH phononic crystal
articles.title_zh: 二维 SSH 声子晶体中高阶拓扑模式的预测束晶格缩减
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a mechanically faithful reduced model for a two-dimensional topological phononic crystal composed of rigid square masses connected by slender elastic ligaments. Exploiting Euler Bernoulli beam theory, we derive a Hermitian 12 degree of freedom dynamical matrix that retains in-plane translations, rotations, and ligament eccentricity. This reduction captures effects that are absent from scalar mass spring SSH models while remaining computationally much more tractable and more easily interpretable than full finite element simulations. Dimerizing the ligament widths produces a mechanical 2D SSH lattice with a full band gap and a quantized bulk polarization. The sign of the dimerization controls the transition from trivial to non trivial phases, while ligament eccentricity provides an additional purely geometric mechanism for changing the topology. Ribbon and finite cell calculations predict in gap edge and corner modes, quantified by localization measures and confirmed by finite element simulations. Measurements on 3D printed samples show an evanescent response in the trivial structure and enhanced boundary/corner response in the non trivial structure within the predicted gap. The results provide a validated route for designing topological elastic metamaterials using a continuum informed discrete model rather than either idealized mass spring networks or brute force numerical optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为二维拓扑声子晶体开发了一种机械忠实的简化模型，该模型由由细长弹性韧带连接的刚性方形质量组成。利用欧拉伯努利梁理论，我们推导出一个埃尔米特 12 自由度动力学矩阵，该矩阵保留了平面内平移、旋转和韧带偏心率。这种减少捕获了标量质量弹簧 SSH 模型所没有的效应，同时在计算上比完整的有限元模拟更容易处理和更容易解释。韧带宽度二聚化产生具有全带隙和量子化体极化的机械二维 SSH 晶格。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为二维拓扑声子晶体开发了一种机械忠实的简化模型，该模型由由细长弹性韧带连接的刚性方形质量组成。利用欧拉伯努利梁理论，我们推导出一个埃尔米特 12 自由度动力学矩阵，该矩阵保留了平面内平移、旋转和韧带偏心率。这种减少捕获了标量质量弹簧 SSH 模型所没有的效应，同时在计算上比完整的有限元模拟更容易处理和更容易解释。韧带宽度二聚化产生具有全带隙和量子化体极化的机械二维 SSH 晶格。二聚化的符号控制从平凡阶段到重要阶段的转变，而韧带偏心率提供了一种额外的纯几何机制来改变拓扑结构。带和有限单元计算以间隙边缘和角模式进行预测，通过定位测量进行量化并通过有限元模拟进行确认。对 3D 打印样品的测量显示，在预测间隙内，平凡结构中存在渐逝响应，而非平凡结构中的边界/角响应则增强。结果为使用连续信息离散模型而不是理想化质量弹簧网络或强力数值优化来设计拓扑弹性超材料提供了一条经过验证的途径。

articles.title: Exact Matching-Polynomial Solution of the Periodic Baxter-Fendley Z_N Clock Chain
articles.title_zh: 周期性Baxter-Fendley Z_N时钟链的精确匹配多项式解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18633v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The periodic-boundary non-Hermitian Baxter-Fendley Z_N chain does not have the same free-parafermionic structure as the open-boundary chain. We construct a matching polynomial for the corresponding cycle of its cyclic Weyl algebra. Its coefficients form conserved quantities containing the periodic Hamiltonian, while the matching polynomial itself realizes a Yang-Baxter transfer matrix. Root-of-unity fusion gives a second matching-polynomial closure and a system of spectral equations in each charge sector. The normalized energy resultant of these equations coincides with the charge-sector characteristic polynomial, yielding the complete finite-size energy spectrum with algebraic multiplicity. For positive reflection-symmetric chains, we prove that the periodic-boundary ground state is the unique analytic continuation of the open-boundary ground state. This yields an efficient large-size ground-state algorithm without enumerating the full spectrum. For the homogeneous three-state chain, seam-response asymptotics and finite-size ground-state calculations support two reciprocal candidate critical couplings distinct from the self-dual point, while the full periodic phase diagram is left for future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期边界非厄米巴克斯特-芬德利 Z_N 链不具有与开边界链相同的自由顺铁离子结构。我们为其循环韦尔代数的相应循环构造一个匹配多项式。其系数形成包含周期性哈密顿量的守恒量，而匹配多项式本身实现了 Yang-Baxter 传递矩阵。单位根融合给出了第二个匹配多项式闭包和每个电荷扇区中的谱方程组。这些方程的归一化能量结果与电荷扇区特征多项式一致，产生具有代数重数的完整有限尺寸能谱。对于正反射对称链，我们证明周期边界基态是开放边界基态的唯一解析延续。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期边界非厄米巴克斯特-芬德利 Z_N 链不具有与开边界链相同的自由顺铁离子结构。我们为其循环韦尔代数的相应循环构造一个匹配多项式。其系数形成包含周期性哈密顿量的守恒量，而匹配多项式本身实现了 Yang-Baxter 传递矩阵。单位根融合给出了第二个匹配多项式闭包和每个电荷扇区中的谱方程组。这些方程的归一化能量结果与电荷扇区特征多项式一致，产生具有代数重数的完整有限尺寸能谱。对于正反射对称链，我们证明周期边界基态是开放边界基态的唯一解析延续。这产生了一种高效的大尺寸基态算法，而无需枚举全谱。对于齐次三态链，接缝响应渐进和有限尺寸基态计算支持与自对偶点不同的两个相互候选临界耦合，而完整的周期相图则留给未来的工作。

articles.title: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
articles.title_zh: 参数超弹性的多凸神经势混合：走向基础材料模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00359v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights.
