We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.
articles.abstract_zh: 超弹性本构模型可以对弹性固体中的大变形进行建模。在通常的实践中，应变能密度函数是预先规定的，并且模型特定的参数是通过实验来校准的。然而，许多应用需要一系列相关材料的本构模型，这些材料的机械行为随成分而变化。固定的本构模型形式可能无法捕获整个家庭的全部行为，而拟合单独的形式并不能提供直接的方法来预测新组合物的响应。最近的工作开发了数据驱动的本构模型，可以学习灵活的应变能函数，同时纳入关键的物理约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超弹性本构模型可以对弹性固体中的大变形进行建模。在通常的实践中，应变能密度函数是预先规定的，并且模型特定的参数是通过实验来校准的。然而，许多应用需要一系列相关材料的本构模型，这些材料的机械行为随成分而变化。固定的本构模型形式可能无法捕获整个家庭的全部行为，而拟合单独的形式并不能提供直接的方法来预测新组合物的响应。最近的工作开发了数据驱动的本构模型，可以学习灵活的应变能函数，同时纳入关键的物理约束。在这项工作中，我们建议使用基于输入凸神经网络的凸神经势混合作为建模材料族的模块化和数据有效的方法。每个势对于多凸应变不变量都是凸的和单调的，而条件网络将材料描述符映射到混合权重。我们使用来自 PolyJet 3D 打印材料的实验数据和合成的 Gent 型基准，将该方法与整体部分输入凸神经网络进行比较。在这两个基准测试中，混合架构更好地概括了训练期间未见过的材料描述符。在 PolyJet 实验基准中，我们表明混合架构对模型超参数不太敏感，而在 Gent 型基准中，它可以更可靠地利用材料描述符空间中的稀疏数据进行泛化。这些结果表明，通过一小组共享的凸神经电位来表示材料族，为从有限的数据中学习描述符相关的本构行为提供了有用的结构先验。

articles.title: Gravitational memory, spin memory and S-duality at null infinity of the heterotic string
articles.title_zh: 异质弦零无穷大处的引力记忆、自旋记忆和 S 对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the asymptotic structure at future null infinity of heterotic string theory compactified on T⁶, in the consistent truncation to the Einstein-frame metric, the axion--dilaton τ=a+ie⁻²φ and the gauge fields descending from ten dimensions, through first order in α'. Three results stand out. First, the radiative data, balance laws and memory observables organize under the S-duality group of the four-dimensional theory: the scalar flux in the Bondi mass loss is the invariant metric of SL(2,mathbb R)/U(1) evaluated on the scalar news, the gauge flux is the norm of a self-dual radiation field, and at fixed vacuum the residual duality rotation acts with charges 0, 1 and 2 on gravitational, electromagnetic and dilaton--axion radiation, so that S-dual processes share their gravitational waveform and memories and differ in their scalar memory. Second, the spin memory receives a gauge-field contribution whose ordinary part is fixed by the Dirac--Schwinger--Zwanziger product of the total charge with the change of the charge aspect; it is generated by mutually nonlocal dyons, and its dipole part agrees in magnitude and sign with the angular momentum radiated by a charge scattered off a magnetic monopole. Third, within the four-derivative effective action, the Gauss--Bonnet and Pontryagin couplings fixed by the Green--Schwarz mechanism leave the mass-loss and angular-momentum balance laws unchanged at first order in α' and first enter the evolution of the spin-two curvature coefficient, partialᵤΨ₀⁰supsettfrac3iα'2τ₁barΨ₄⁰, which combines dilaton and axion into the complex scalar charge aspect and is not invariant under the residual duality rotation. For black holes with fixed physical charges τ₁ is of order one, so this is a first-order effect in α'/M².
articles.abstract_zh: 我们确定了在 T⁶ 上压缩的异质弦理论在未来零无穷大处的渐近结构，在爱因斯坦框架度量的一致截断中，轴子膨胀 τ=a+ie⁻²φ 和规范场从十个维度下降，通过 α' 的一阶。三个结果脱颖而出。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们确定了在 T⁶ 上压缩的异质弦理论在未来零无穷大处的渐近结构，在爱因斯坦框架度量的一致截断中，轴子膨胀 τ=a+ie⁻²φ 和规范场从十个维度下降，通过 α' 的一阶。三个结果脱颖而出。首先，辐射数据、平衡定律和记忆可观测量在四维理论的 S 对偶群下组织：邦迪质量损失中的标量通量是在标量新闻上评估的 SL(2,mathbb R)/U(1) 的不变度量，规范通量是自对偶辐射场的范数，在固定真空下，剩余对偶旋转与电荷 0、1 和 2 作用于引力、电磁和膨胀——轴子辐射，因此S-对偶过程共享它们的引力波形和记忆，但标量记忆不同。其次，自旋存储器接收规范场贡献，其普通部分由总电荷随电荷方面变化的狄拉克-施温格-兹万齐格乘积固定；它是由相互非局域的强子产生的，其偶极子部分在大小和符号上与磁单极子散射的电荷辐射的角动量一致。第三，在四导数有效作用中，格林-施瓦茨机制固定的高斯-博内特和庞特里亚金耦合使α'中的一阶质量损失和角动量平衡定律保持不变，并首先进入自旋二曲率系数partialᵤΨ₀⁰supsettfrac3iα'2τ₁barΨ₄⁰的演化，它结合了膨胀子和轴子进入复标量电荷方面，并且在剩余对偶旋转下不是不变的。对于具有固定物理电荷的黑洞，τ₁ 为一阶，因此这是 α'/M² 的一阶效应。

articles.title: When Do Tensor Product Paths Matter? A Group-Theoretic Analysis of Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 张量积路径何时重要？等变原子间势的群论分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-product (TP) layers in equivariant interatomic potentials encode angular interactions through symmetry-allowed paths. Yet local site symmetry can make an allowed path carry no signal after neighbor aggregation. We call this effect Aggregation Cancellation. In a scalar-input first layer, equal-species neighbors on a complete site-symmetry orbit share scalar and radial factors, reducing their angular contribution to a spherical-harmonic orbit sum. If the restricted degree-l representation has no trivial component, this sum and the corresponding path vanish for any learned radial weight. For an ideal Oₕ octahedral orbit, this removes the l_edge=1,2,3 classes. Beyond the first layer, the factorisation no longer holds, so cancellation is no longer guaranteed; we instead ask whether affected paths remain less important on average. We test the two levels separately in NequIP: matched-radius TiO₆ probes examine first-layer cancellation, whereas a within-model CaTiO₃ comparison and six OMat24 models examine the importance bias. We then rank paths on training frames, choose the pruning fraction on validation frames, and evaluate frozen masks on held-out tests. At the highest evaluated fraction (60% of 174 paths), force mean absolute error (MAE) changes are 1.42%, 0.04%, and 1.83% for CaTiO₃, OMat24 Oₕ-cubic, and OMat24 low-symmetry data, respectively. The masks imply 67.12-71.94% potential TP-operation reduction and 59.77% potential edge multilayer perceptron (MLP) reduction; these are structural proxies, not measured speedups. The results connect local symmetry to path redundancy and pruning robustness in NequIP; transfer to other architectures remains open.
articles.abstract_zh: 等变原子间势中的张量积 (TP) 层通过允许对称的路径对角度相互作用进行编码。然而，本地站点对称性可能会导致允许的路径在邻居聚合后不承载任何信号。我们称这种效应为聚合取消。在标量输入第一层中，完整位点对称轨道上的同种邻居共享标量和径向因子，从而减少了它们对球谐轨道和的角度贡献。如果受限的 l 度表示没有微不足道的分量，则对于任何学习的径向权重，该总和以及相应的路径都会消失。对于理想的 Oₕ 八面体轨道，这会删除 l_edge=1,2,3 类。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 等变原子间势中的张量积 (TP) 层通过允许对称的路径对角度相互作用进行编码。然而，本地站点对称性可能会导致允许的路径在邻居聚合后不承载任何信号。我们称这种效应为聚合取消。在标量输入第一层中，完整位点对称轨道上的同种邻居共享标量和径向因子，从而减少了它们对球谐轨道和的角度贡献。如果受限的 l 度表示没有微不足道的分量，则对于任何学习的径向权重，该总和以及相应的路径都会消失。对于理想的 Oₕ 八面体轨道，这会删除 l_edge=1,2,3 类。在第一层之后，因式分解不再成立，因此不再保证取消；相反，我们要问的是，平均而言，受影响的路径是否仍然不那么重要。我们在 NequIP 中分别测试这两个水平：匹配半径 TiO₆ 探针检查第一层抵消，而模型内 CaTiO₃ 比较和六个 OMat24 模型检查重要性偏差。然后，我们对训练帧上的路径进行排名，在验证帧上选择修剪分数，并在保留测试中评估冻结掩模。在最高评估分数（174 条路径中的 60%）下，CaTiO₃、OMat24 Oₕ-立方和 OMat24 低对称性数据的力平均绝对误差 (MAE) 变化分别为 1.42%、0.04% 和 1.83%。这些掩模意味着 TP 操作潜在减少 67.12-71.94%，边缘多层感知器 (MLP) 潜在减少 59.77%；这些是结构代理，而不是测量的加速。结果将局部对称性与 NequIP 中的路径冗余和修剪鲁棒性联系起来；转移到其他架构仍然开放。

articles.title: Multicomponent Adaptive Sampling Configuration Interaction method in openLOWDIN: positronic and quantum nuclear systems
articles.title_zh: openLOWDIN 中的多分量自适应采样配置交互方法：正电子和量子核系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multicomponent Selective Configuration Interaction (SCI) method based on the deterministic Adaptive Sampling CI (ASCI) algorithm for computing energies and wavefunction properties of molecular systems containing leptons of variable masses, or quantum nuclei. Near-FCI accuracy is achieved by incorporating second-order Epstein-Nesbet perturbation theory or by dressing the Hamiltonian via Davidson's and co-workers shifted-Bk method. We validate the approach through benchmark positronic (e⁺LiH, e⁺OH⁻, e⁺Mg) and quantum nuclear systems (HCN), establishing a novel protocol for accurate convergence, based on the iterative adaptation of natural orbitals starting from those obtained by considering only cross-particle CISD excitations, to those obtained from SCI variational space, surpassing the accuracy of previous SCI studies. Overall, we show that the present multi-component SCI framework offers a simple, systematically improvable, and cost-effective alternative to traditional CI approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于确定性自适应采样 CI (ASCI) 算法的多组分选择性配置相互作用 (SCI) 方法，用于计算包含可变质量轻子或量子核的分子系统的能量和波函数特性。接近 FCI 的精度是通过结合二阶 Epstein-Nesbet 微扰理论或通过戴维森及其同事的移位 Bk 方法修正哈密顿量来实现的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于确定性自适应采样 CI (ASCI) 算法的多组分选择性配置相互作用 (SCI) 方法，用于计算包含可变质量轻子或量子核的分子系统的能量和波函数特性。接近 FCI 的精度是通过结合二阶 Epstein-Nesbet 微扰理论或通过戴维森及其同事的移位 Bk 方法修正哈密顿量来实现的。我们通过基准正电子（e⁺LiH、e⁺OH⁻、e⁺Mg）和量子核系统（HCN）验证了该方法，建立了一种精确收敛的新协议，基于自然轨道的迭代适应，从仅考虑跨粒子 CISD 激励获得的轨道到从 SCI 变分空间获得的轨道，超越了以前的 SCI 研究的准确性。总的来说，我们表明目前的多组件 SCI 框架为传统 CI 方法提供了一种简单、可系统改进且经济高效的替代方案。

articles.title: Collisionality scaling of the tokamak density limit
articles.title_zh: 托卡马克密度极限的碰撞缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The threshold at which density-limiting plasma instabilities occur in tokamak fusion reactors is not well understood. Here, we present the first large-scale empirical evidence of a common collisionality threshold present across multiple devices and confinement regimes. Machine-learning-guided analysis of a diverse experimental database identifies a scaling in edge effective collisionality (ν_*) that bears resemblance to the widely utilized Greenwald limit but yields a substantially lower false positive rate. This threshold decreases with dimensionless pressure (β), consistent with theoretical expectations for enhanced transport from electromagnetic effects on resistive ballooning mode turbulence. These results suggest that future burning plasma devices such as ITER and ARC could potentially achieve higher density, and thus fusion power, than previously expected.
articles.abstract_zh: 托卡马克聚变反应堆中发生密度限制等离子体不稳定性的阈值尚不清楚。在这里，我们提出了跨多个设备和限制机制存在共同碰撞阈值的第一个大规模经验证据。对不同实验数据库的机器学习引导分析确定了边缘有效碰撞性 (ν_*) 的缩放，该缩放与广泛使用的格林沃尔德极限相似，但产生的误报率要低得多。该阈值随着无量纲压力 (β) 的增加而降低，这与电阻气球模式湍流中电磁效应增强传输的理论预期一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 托卡马克聚变反应堆中发生密度限制等离子体不稳定性的阈值尚不清楚。在这里，我们提出了跨多个设备和限制机制存在共同碰撞阈值的第一个大规模经验证据。对不同实验数据库的机器学习引导分析确定了边缘有效碰撞性 (ν_*) 的缩放，该缩放与广泛使用的格林沃尔德极限相似，但产生的误报率要低得多。该阈值随着无量纲压力 (β) 的增加而降低，这与电阻气球模式湍流中电磁效应增强传输的理论预期一致。这些结果表明，未来的燃烧等离子体装置，如 ITER 和 ARC，有可能实现比之前预期更高的密度，从而实现聚变功率。

articles.title: Kinetic-Ballooning and Resistive X-Point Dynamics in Quasicontinuous Exhaust Tokamak Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 准连续排气托卡马克等离子体中的动力学气球和电阻 X 点动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate quasicoherent modes (QCMs) and their interaction with scrape-off-layer (SOL) plasma blobs (filaments) in the type-I-ELM-free quasicontinuous exhaust (QCE) regime, extending the analysis in [K. Zhang et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 055102 (2026)]. Two-fluid electromagnetic turbulence simulations are compared for two self-consistent turbulence states with different separatrix densities. In both cases, a separatrix-spanning QCM resides within the radial-electric-field well, whereas blobs are observed only in the case with higher separatrix density. The QCM exhibits similar kinetic-ballooning-mode (KBM) signatures in both cases, with modest differences in coherence and harmonic content. The primary difference is the presence of an additional resistive X-point mode (RXM), which emerges as the near-X-point collisionality increases. The coexistence of the KBM and RXM shifts the potential--density cross-phase from its KBM-like value toward the interchange value in the SOL, allowing QCM perturbations to be ejected as blobs. These intermittent blobs account for over half of the net radial E× B transport in the far SOL. Neither QCM onset nor blob ejection requires an increase in upstream collisionality. The results distinguish the KBM-dominated mechanism that regulates the pedestal from the RXM-assisted blob-launching mechanism that enables intermittent SOL exhaust.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了准相干模式 (QCM) 及其与 I 型-ELM 无准连续排气 (QCE) 状态中的刮掉层 (SOL) 等离子体斑点（细丝）的相互作用，扩展了 [K.张等人，物理学。莱特牧师。 137, 055102 (2026)]。对具有不同分界线密度的两种自洽湍流状态进行了双流体电磁湍流模拟的比较。在这两种情况下，分界线跨越 QCM 都位于径向电场井内，而仅在分界线密度较高的情况下才能观察到斑点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了准相干模式 (QCM) 及其与 I 型-ELM 无准连续排气 (QCE) 状态中的刮掉层 (SOL) 等离子体斑点（细丝）的相互作用，扩展了 [K.张等人，物理学。莱特牧师。 137, 055102 (2026)]。对具有不同分界线密度的两种自洽湍流状态进行了双流体电磁湍流模拟的比较。在这两种情况下，分界线跨越 QCM 都位于径向电场井内，而仅在分界线密度较高的情况下才能观察到斑点。 QCM 在这两种情况下都表现出相似的动力学气球模式 (KBM) 特征，在相干性和谐波含量方面存在适度差异。主要区别是存在额外的电阻 X 点模式 (RXM)，该模式随着近 X 点碰撞性的增加而出现。 KBM 和 RXM 的共存将势密度交叉相位从其类似 KBM 的值转向 SOL 中的交换值，从而允许 QCM 扰动作为斑点喷射出来。这些间歇性斑点占远太阳系中净径向 E×B 传输的一半以上。 QCM 起始和斑点喷射都不需要增加上游碰撞性。结果将调节底座的 KBM 主导机制与实现间歇性 SOL 排放的 RXM 辅助 blob 发射机制区分开来。

articles.title: Energy partition in resonant instabilities in multi-component plasmas
articles.title_zh: 多组分等离子体共振不稳定性的能量分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Space and astrophysical plasmas are often collisionless and exhibit non-equilibrium velocity distributions. When these departures from equilibrium are sufficiently large, the plasma becomes unstable to various kinetic micro-instabilities, which provide a mechanism for transferring energy from the particles to the electromagnetic (EM) fields. In multi-component plasmas, different species interact with the generated EM waves in distinct ways, acting as sources or sinks of wave energy through resonant wave--particle interactions. Consequently, the nonlinear evolution of kinetic instabilities is governed not only by the species driving the instability but also by the resonant response of other plasma populations. In this work, considering proton-α-particle plasmas with parameters representative of the solar wind, we investigate the generation, saturation, and energy partition of kinetic micro-instabilities, such as Alfvén/ion-cyclotron and fast-magnetosonic/whistler wave instabilities. We combine linear Vlasov--Maxwell theory and hybrid particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations to analyze these instabilities and to quantify the exchange of energy and momentum between ion populations during the instability evolution. Our results demonstrate that minor ions play a fundamental role in regulating the nonlinear saturation of kinetic instabilities and the transfer of energy among plasma populations.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间和天体物理等离子体通常是无碰撞的，并且表现出非平衡速度分布。当这些偏离平衡足够大时，等离子体就会因各种动力学微观不稳定性而变得不稳定，这提供了将能量从粒子转移到电磁（EM）场的机制。在多组分等离子体中，不同的物质以不同的方式与产生的电磁波相互作用，通过共振波-粒子相互作用充当波能的源或汇。因此，动力学不稳定性的非线性演化不仅受到驱动不稳定性的物质的控制，而且还受到其他等离子体群体的共振响应的控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间和天体物理等离子体通常是无碰撞的，并且表现出非平衡速度分布。当这些偏离平衡足够大时，等离子体就会因各种动力学微观不稳定性而变得不稳定，这提供了将能量从粒子转移到电磁（EM）场的机制。在多组分等离子体中，不同的物质以不同的方式与产生的电磁波相互作用，通过共振波-粒子相互作用充当波能的源或汇。因此，动力学不稳定性的非线性演化不仅受到驱动不稳定性的物质的控制，而且还受到其他等离子体群体的共振响应的控制。在这项工作中，考虑具有代表太阳风参数的质子-α-粒子等离子体，我们研究了动力学微观不稳定性的产生、饱和和能量分配，例如阿尔芬/离子回旋加速器和快磁声波/惠斯勒波不稳定性。我们结合线性 Vlasov-Maxwell 理论和混合颗粒细胞 (PIC) 模拟来分析这些不稳定性，并量化不稳定性演化过程中离子群之间的能量和动量交换。我们的结果表明，次要离子在调节动力学不稳定性的非线性饱和和等离子体群之间的能量转移方面发挥着重要作用。

articles.title: Singular layer neural networks for the Navier-Stokes equations at small viscosity
articles.title_zh: 小粘度下纳维-斯托克斯方程的单层神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop neural network methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at a small viscosity ε > 0, whose accuracy is uniform in ε and whose residual is evaluated on a grid that does not resolve the vorticity boundary layer. In the vorticity-stream function formulation with the slip boundary conditions, a vorticity layer of width sqrtε forms along the walls. The trial function of the singular layer Physics-Informed Neural Network (sl-PINN) contains the corrector of the asymptotic analysis, together with the law that fixes its amplitude at the wall. The amplitude is tied to the wall trace of the network itself, so that the method requires no a priori knowledge of the limit solution. The sl-PINN keeps the error uniform in ε over six decades, for the Stokes and the Navier-Stokes equations alike, although in the latter the wall trace travels with the flow and is not known in advance. An enrichment that uses the thin scale but leaves the profile and the amplitude of the layer free deteriorates as ε→0. Since the corrector carries the layer analytically, the Laplacian in the residual can be discretized by a finite volume flux difference on a coarse grid. The resulting singular layer Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) attains the same uniform accuracy as the sl-PINN, to within the scatter of the random seed, at about half the cost of a training step. The combination of the asymptotic corrector with the coarse-grid finite volume discretization is the main result of this article.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了小粘度 ε > 0 下二维不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的神经网络方法，其精度在 ε 中是均匀的，并且其残差是在不解析涡度边界层的网格上评估的。在具有滑移边界条件的涡度流函数公式中，沿壁形成宽度 sqrtε 的涡度层。奇异层物理信息神经网络（sl-PINN）的试验函数包含渐近分析的校正器，以及固定其在壁上的振幅的定律。幅度与网络本身的壁迹相关，因此该方法不需要极限解的先验知识。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了小粘度 ε > 0 下二维不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的神经网络方法，其精度在 ε 中是均匀的，并且其残差是在不解析涡度边界层的网格上评估的。在具有滑移边界条件的涡度流函数公式中，沿壁形成宽度 sqrtε 的涡度层。奇异层物理信息神经网络（sl-PINN）的试验函数包含渐近分析的校正器，以及固定其在壁上的振幅的定律。幅度与网络本身的壁迹相关，因此该方法不需要极限解的先验知识。对于 Stokes 和 Navier-Stokes 方程，sl-PINN 在 6 个十年内将误差保持在 ε 范围内，尽管在后者中，壁迹随流动传播且事先未知。使用薄尺度但保留层的轮廓和振幅的富集随着ε→0而恶化。由于校正器以分析方式承载该层，因此残差中的拉普拉斯算子可以通过粗网格上的有限体积通量差来离散化。由此产生的单层有限体积神经网络 (sl-FVNN) 在随机种子的分散范围内获得与 sl-PINN 相同的统一精度，而训练步骤的成本约为训练步骤的一半。渐近校正器与粗网格有限体积离散化的结合是本文的主要成果。

articles.title: Learning Similarity-Reduced Ion Kinetics across Scales and Regimes in Capacitively Coupled Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 学习电容耦合等离子体中跨尺度和范围的相似性降低的离子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systematic kinetic investigations of discharge-mode and heating-mechanism transitions in low-pressure capacitively coupled plasmas (CCPs) are computationally expensive because particle-in-cell/Monte Carlo collision (PIC/MCC) simulations must resolve the inherently slow ion relaxation.In this Letter, we propose a similarity-reduced ion-kinetic representation and a machine learning (ML) reconstruction method for weakly ionized Boltzmann-Poisson discharge systems.Using discharge similarity, the three-dimensional control parameter space, comprising gas pressure p, gap distance d, and driving frequency f, is reduced into a two-dimensional similarity space (pd, fd).A dual-branch ML model predicts the ion density profile at the reference scale and the conditional ion velocity distribution.Taking a 1D3V argon discharge as the paradigm, we use the reconstructed ion kinetic state to initialize the PIC/MCC simulation, which then relaxes to a self-consistent periodic steady state after only a brief evolution.Compared to conventional uniform initializations, this approach achieves a maximum computational speedup of 56.8 times and a median speedup of 27.7 times.Furthermore, the physical regimes of complex nonlinear discharge transitions, including the alpha--gamma mode transition, local-to-nonlocal electron collisional heating mode transition and low-density jumps, are accurately mapped within the similarity space.Similarity transformations extend these boundaries across scales, opening a new avenue for rapid kinetic characterization and optimization of radio-frequency plasma sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 低压电容耦合等离子体（CCP）中放电模式和加热机制转变的系统动力学研究在计算上是昂贵的，因为粒子在细胞/蒙特卡罗碰撞（PIC/MCC）模拟必须解决固有的慢离子弛豫问题。在这封信中，我们提出了弱电离玻尔兹曼-泊松放电系统的相似性降低的离子动力学表示和机器学习（ML）重建方法。利用放电相似性，三维将由气体压力 p、间隙距离 d 和驱动频率 f 组成的控制参数空间简化为二维相似空间 (pd, fd)。双分支 ML 模型预测参考尺度下的离子密度分布和条件离子速度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低压电容耦合等离子体（CCP）中放电模式和加热机制转变的系统动力学研究在计算上是昂贵的，因为粒子在细胞/蒙特卡罗碰撞（PIC/MCC）模拟必须解决固有的慢离子弛豫问题。在这封信中，我们提出了弱电离玻尔兹曼-泊松放电系统的相似性降低的离子动力学表示和机器学习（ML）重建方法。利用放电相似性，三维将由气体压力 p、间隙距离 d 和驱动频率 f 组成的控制参数空间简化为二维相似空间 (pd, fd)。双分支 ML 模型预测参考尺度下的离子密度分布和条件离子速度分布。以 1D3V 氩气放电为范式，我们使用重建的离子动力学状态来初始化 PIC/MCC 模拟，然后在短暂的演化后放松到自洽的周期性稳态。与传统的均匀初始化相比，该方法实现了最大计算加速56.8倍，中值加速27.7倍。此外，复杂非线性放电转变的物理机制，包括α-γ模式转变、局域到非局域电子碰撞加热模式转变和低密度跳跃，都准确地映射在相似空间内。相似变换将这些边界扩展到尺度上，为射频的快速动力学表征和优化开辟了新途径。等离子体源。

articles.title: Neural Network Path Optimization for Finding Transition States on a Machine Learned Potential
articles.title_zh: 用于查找机器学习电位的过渡状态的神经网络路径优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition states govern chemical reaction rates and outcomes, yet locating them remains a central challenge in computational chemistry. Double-ended search methods find transition states given reactant and product structures, but generally rely on discretized path representations developed for density functional theory, where potential energy surface evaluations are expensive. Machine learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) dramatically reduce this cost and leverage automatic differentiation to access higher-order derivatives efficiently. We introduce Popcornn, a framework to find transition states by optimizing continuous neural network paths atop an MLIP with a parallelized adaptive numerical integrator. This combination eliminates path discretization artifacts, reduces hyperparameter sensitivity, and enables non-local optimization to overcome local features using second-order potential-energy-surface information. Popcornn consistently recovers more correct transition states than standard methods such as nudged elastic band and growing string, across MLIPs on thousands of organic reactions, establishing it as a robust, automation-ready method for high-throughput transition state search. Popcornn's infrastructure is flexible in path objective, integration strategy, and optimization algorithm, making it a practical tool and platform for investigating open questions in MLIP-based path optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡态控制着化学反应速率和结果，但定位它们仍然是计算化学中的一个核心挑战。双端搜索方法在给定反应物和产物结构的情况下寻找过渡态，但通常依赖于为密度泛函理论开发的离散路径表示，其中势能表面评估的成本很高。机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地降低了这种成本，并利用自动微分来有效地访问高阶导数。我们介绍了 Popcornn，这是一个通过使用并行自适应数值积分器优化 MLIP 上的连续神经网络路径来查找过渡状态的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡态控制着化学反应速率和结果，但定位它们仍然是计算化学中的一个核心挑战。双端搜索方法在给定反应物和产物结构的情况下寻找过渡态，但通常依赖于为密度泛函理论开发的离散路径表示，其中势能表面评估的成本很高。机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地降低了这种成本，并利用自动微分来有效地访问高阶导数。我们介绍了 Popcornn，这是一个通过使用并行自适应数值积分器优化 MLIP 上的连续神经网络路径来查找过渡状态的框架。这种组合消除了路径离散伪影，降低了超参数敏感性，并支持非局部优化以使用二阶势能表面信息克服局部特征。在数千个有机反应的 MLIP 中，Popcornn 始终能够比标准方法（例如轻推松紧带和增长弦）恢复更正确的过渡态，使其成为一种强大的、自动化的高通量过渡态搜索方法。 Popcornn 的基础设施在路径目标、集成策略和优化算法方面非常灵活，使其成为研究基于 MLIP 的路径优化中的开放问题的实用工具和平台。

articles.title: Modeling of basic physics issues in toroidal pinches and tools for performance control
articles.title_zh: 环形箍缩中基本物理问题的建模和性能控制工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear modelling has improved significantly in dealing with physics issues encountered in magnetically confined toroidal pinches, such as the Reversed Field Pinch and Tokamak configurations. Here, recent results relevant to the understanding of helical self-organization processes are presented: formation of internal transport barriers, temporary loss of operational point, relaxation-reconnection events, excitation of Alfvèn waves, and a possible fundamental mechanism for ion heating in plasmas. Starting from physics processes in Reversed Field Pinch plasmas, several similarities with Tokamaks are presented. In addition, data analysis tools, machine learning autoencoding techniques, are here trained for the first time on a RFP data analysis case.
articles.abstract_zh: 非线性建模在处理磁约束环形箍缩中遇到的物理问题（例如反向场箍缩和托卡马克配置）方面有了显着改进。在这里，提出了与理解螺旋自组织过程相关的最新结果：内部传输势垒的形成、工作点的暂时丢失、弛豫重连接事件、阿尔文波的激发以及等离子体中离子加热的可能基本机制。从反场箍缩等离子体的物理过程开始，提出了与托卡马克的一些相似之处。此外，数据分析工具、机器学习自动编码技术，也是首次在 RFP 数据分析案例上进行训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非线性建模在处理磁约束环形箍缩中遇到的物理问题（例如反向场箍缩和托卡马克配置）方面有了显着改进。在这里，提出了与理解螺旋自组织过程相关的最新结果：内部传输势垒的形成、工作点的暂时丢失、弛豫重连接事件、阿尔文波的激发以及等离子体中离子加热的可能基本机制。从反场箍缩等离子体的物理过程开始，提出了与托卡马克的一些相似之处。此外，数据分析工具、机器学习自动编码技术，也是首次在 RFP 数据分析案例上进行训练。

articles.title: Spin-free potential-energy curves, spectroscopic constants, and permanent dipole-moment functions for all 18 CO states correlating with the first atomic asymptote
articles.title_zh: 与第一个原子渐近线相关的所有 18 个 CO 态的无自旋势能曲线、光谱常数和永久偶极矩函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report ab initio potential-energy curves and permanent dipole-moment functions for all 18 spin-free adiabatic electronic states of ¹²C¹⁶O correlating with the lowest dissociation limit, C(³P)+O(³P). Our state-averaged CASSCF/icMRCI(+Q) calculations with the aug-cc-pV5Z basis cover the complete set of singlet, triplet, and quintet manifolds. For the ground state, we examine basis-set convergence using the aug-cc-pVnZ series (n=T,Q,5,6) and extrapolate to the complete-basis-set limit. The resulting potential-energy curves reproduce the established topology of the low-lying CO states, including the double-minimum structure of the 2¹Σ⁺ state and pronounced adiabatic mixing in several excited states. We determine rovibrational levels and spectroscopic constants for bound states and selected local minima, assess uncertainties, and compare our results with experiment and previous calculations. We find good agreement with experiment for the ground state and well-characterized low-lying singlet and triplet states. For the 1¹Σ⁺ ground state, Rₑ=1.131~Å and ωₑ=2161.04~cm⁻¹ are both within 0.5% of experiment. The dissociation energy is D₀=89473±141~cm⁻¹. The most strongly bound quintet, 1⁵Π, has Dₑ=6401~cm⁻¹ and ωₑ=982~cm⁻¹. The 1⁵Σ⁺ state has a shallow long-range well with Dₑ=849cm⁻¹, while 2⁵Σ⁺, 2⁵Π, and 1⁵Δ are predominantly repulsive. Variations in the permanent dipole moments with bond length indicate changes in electronic character and charge redistribution, particularly where adiabatic states interact strongly. These data provide a basis for interpreting rovibrational spectra and for future studies of nonadiabatic effects, spin--orbit coupling, and collision dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了 12C16O 的所有 18 个无自旋绝热电子态的从头势能曲线和永久偶极矩函数，这些电子态与最低解离极限 C(3P)+O(3P) 相关。我们以 aug-cc-pV5Z 为基础的状态平均 CASSCF/icMRCI(+Q) 计算涵盖了完整的单重态、三重态和五重态流形。对于基态，我们使用 aug-cc-pVnZ 级数 (n=T,Q,5,6) 检查基组收敛性，并外推到完整基组极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了 12C16O 的所有 18 个无自旋绝热电子态的从头势能曲线和永久偶极矩函数，这些电子态与最低解离极限 C(3P)+O(3P) 相关。我们以 aug-cc-pV5Z 为基础的状态平均 CASSCF/icMRCI(+Q) 计算涵盖了完整的单重态、三重态和五重态流形。对于基态，我们使用 aug-cc-pVnZ 级数 (n=T,Q,5,6) 检查基组收敛性，并外推到完整基组极限。由此产生的势能曲线再现了低位 CO 态的已建立拓扑，包括 21Σ⁺ 态的双最小结构和几个激发态下明显的绝热混合。我们确定束缚态的振动水平和光谱常数以及选定的局部最小值，评估不确定性，并将我们的结果与实验和之前的计算进行比较。我们发现基态和特征良好的低位单线态和三线态与实验非常一致。对于 11Σ⁺ 基态，Rₑ=1.131~Å 和 ωₑ=2161.04~cm⁻1 均在实验的 0.5% 以内。解离能为D₀=89473±141~cm⁻1。结合力最强的五重奏，1⁵Π，其 Dₑ=6401~cm⁻1 和 ωₑ=982~cm⁻1。 1⁵Σ⁺态具有浅长程阱，Dₑ=849cm⁻1，而2⁵Σ⁺、2⁵Π和1⁵Δ主要是排斥性的。永久偶极矩随键长的变化表明电子特性和电荷重新分布的变化，特别是在绝热态相互作用强烈的情况下。这些数据为解释旋转光谱以及非绝热效应、自旋轨道耦合和碰撞动力学的未来研究提供了基础。

articles.title: Stochastic Representation-Inspired Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Incompressible Fluid Flows
articles.title_zh: 用于不可压缩流体流动的随机表示启发的物理学神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effectiveness of neural networks in solving partial differential equations depends not only on their approximation capability but also on the suitability of their representations for the underlying solutions. Motivated by stochastic integral representations of incompressible fluid flows and the associated Biot--Savart kernel, we propose a Biot--Savart-informed (i.e. physics-informed) neural network (BS-PINN) for the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. By extracting a rational profile from a regularized Biot--Savart kernel, we construct a smooth activation function with fixed and learnable kernel scales. Both variants retain the conventional velocity--pressure formulation and physics-informed training framework, allowing the influence of the activation function to be examined independently. We evaluate the method on five benchmarks, including Kovasznay flow, cylinder wake, three-dimensional Beltrami flow, Taylor--Green vortex, and double shear layer. Across 21 benchmark--architecture comparisons, both variants consistently reduce the combined velocity error relative to the conventional tanh-based PINN, achieving mean relative error reductions of 31.7% and 33.2%, respectively. Improvements are also observed in reported pressure and vorticity errors. Notably, the double-shear-layer experiments demonstrate improved resolution of localized shear structures and, for BS-PINN-F, qualitatively clearer vortex-roll-up patterns in the long-time simulation. These findings highlight the potential of incorporating analytical flow structures into neural-network representations for incompressible flow simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络求解偏微分方程的有效性不仅取决于它们的逼近能力，还取决于它们的表示对于底层解的适用性。受不可压缩流体流动的随机积分表示和相关 Biot-Savart 核的启发，我们提出了用于不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程的 Biot-Savart 通知（即物理通知）神经网络（BS-PINN）。通过从正则化的 Biot-Savart 核中提取有理分布，我们构建了一个具有固定且可学习核尺度的平滑激活函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络求解偏微分方程的有效性不仅取决于它们的逼近能力，还取决于它们的表示对于底层解的适用性。受不可压缩流体流动的随机积分表示和相关 Biot-Savart 核的启发，我们提出了用于不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程的 Biot-Savart 通知（即物理通知）神经网络（BS-PINN）。通过从正则化的 Biot-Savart 核中提取有理分布，我们构建了一个具有固定且可学习核尺度的平滑激活函数。两种变体都保留了传统的速度-压力公式和物理信息训练框架，允许独立检查激活函数的影响。我们在五个基准上对该方法进行了评估，包括 Kovasznay 流、圆柱尾流、三维 Beltrami 流、Taylor--Green 涡流和双剪切层。在 21 个基准架构比较中，相对于传统的基于 tanh 的 PINN，两种变体一致降低了组合速度误差，平均相对误差分别降低了 31.7% 和 33.2%。在报告的压力和涡度误差方面也观察到了改进。值得注意的是，双剪切层实验证明了局部剪切结构分辨率的提高，并且对于 BS-PINN-F，在长时间模拟中定性上更清晰的涡旋卷起模式。这些发现凸显了将分析流结构纳入神经网络表示以进行不可压缩流模拟的潜力。

articles.title: Collisional lineshapes of an N₂-perturbed electronic transition in O₂ from first principles of quantum theory validated by accurate experimental spectra
articles.title_zh: 根据量子理论第一原理，O 中受 N 扰动的电子跃迁的碰撞线形经过精确的实验光谱验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of predicting the lineshape of an electronic molecular transition collisionally perturbed by another molecule from first principles of quantum mechanics. We consider an N₂-perturbed O₂ A-band transition, which is relevant to spectroscopic observations in Earth's atmosphere. This approach simultaneously incorporates the electronic structure, quantum scattering and lineshape effects required to accurately predict pressure- and temperature-dependence of observed lineshapes. The ab initio lineshapes reproduce measurements to better than 0.6%. Theory also provides new physical constraints on beyond-Voigt lineshape parameters in fits of high-precision data, yielding fit residuals at the 0.08% level. This work motivates advances in molecular electronic structure calculations and demonstrates the potential to generate comprehensive spectroscopic reference data from first principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了根据量子力学第一原理预测受另一个分子碰撞扰动的电子分子跃迁线形的可行性。我们考虑 N2 扰动的 O2 A 波段跃迁，这与地球大气中的光谱观测有关。这种方法同时结合了精确预测所观察到的线形的压力和温度依赖性所需的电子结构、量子散射和线形效应。从头开始的线形再现测量结果的精度优于 0.6%。理论还为高精度数据拟合中的超 Voigt 线形参数提供了新的物理约束，产生 0.08% 水平的拟合残差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了根据量子力学第一原理预测受另一个分子碰撞扰动的电子分子跃迁线形的可行性。我们考虑 N2 扰动的 O2 A 波段跃迁，这与地球大气中的光谱观测有关。这种方法同时结合了精确预测所观察到的线形的压力和温度依赖性所需的电子结构、量子散射和线形效应。从头开始的线形再现测量结果的精度优于 0.6%。理论还为高精度数据拟合中的超 Voigt 线形参数提供了新的物理约束，产生 0.08% 水平的拟合残差。这项工作推动了分子电子结构计算的进步，并展示了从第一原理生成全面光谱参考数据的潜力。

articles.title: Sub-electron noise with a buried-channel DePFET: characterisation of novel DePFET concepts
articles.title_zh: 埋沟道 DePFET 的子电子噪声：新颖 DePFET 概念的表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Depleted P-channel Field Effect Transistor (DePFET) pixel sensors combine Fano-limited energy resolution with fast, low-noise readout and are used in instruments ranging from particle tracking to X-ray astronomy. In this work, two novel DePFET technologies that address the two factors of the signal-to-noise ratio through fundamental changes to the intrinsic design are characterised: a buried-channel design aimed at reducing the limiting low-frequency noise by weakening the coupling between the channel and Si/SiO₂ interface traps, and a super-g_q design intended to increase the charge gain by reducing the effective internal-gate capacitance. Their noise and energy resolution were mapped across the transistor bias space, over a wide temperature range (100-260 K) and for integration times of 0.4-9 μs (readout times of 2-19.2 μs per row), and compared with standard DePFETs as developed for the NewAthena Wide Field Imager (WFI). All three variants reach their lowest noise at about 155 K. The buried-channel device achieves an excellent equivalent noise charge (ENC) of 0.96 e⁻ (at most 0.83 e⁻ after subtracting the readout-electronics noise), demonstrating sub-electron noise over a complete 64×64 DePFET matrix in a single readout, alongside a power consumption reduction of more than 50%. The super-g_q DePFET shows a 2.6-fold increase in charge gain (about 1100 pA/e⁻) but exhibits higher total noise due to an excess noise contribution. The results highlight the potential of the novel DePFETs, with the buried-channel technology offering immediate benefits for low-noise applications such as the WFI.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗尽型 P 沟道场效应晶体管 (DePFET) 像素传感器将 Fano 有限的能量分辨率与快速、低噪声读出相结合，可用于从粒子跟踪到 X 射线天文学的各种仪器。在这项工作中，介绍了两种新颖的 DePFET 技术，它们通过对内在设计进行根本性改变来解决信噪比的两个因素：埋入沟道设计旨在通过削弱沟道和 Si/SiO2 界面陷阱之间的耦合来减少低频噪声限制，而 super-g_q 设计旨在通过减少有效内栅电容来增加电荷增益。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耗尽型 P 沟道场效应晶体管 (DePFET) 像素传感器将 Fano 有限的能量分辨率与快速、低噪声读出相结合，可用于从粒子跟踪到 X 射线天文学的各种仪器。在这项工作中，介绍了两种新颖的 DePFET 技术，它们通过对内在设计进行根本性改变来解决信噪比的两个因素：埋入沟道设计旨在通过削弱沟道和 Si/SiO2 界面陷阱之间的耦合来减少低频噪声限制，而 super-g_q 设计旨在通过减少有效内栅电容来增加电荷增益。它们的噪声和能量分辨率在晶体管偏置空间、较宽的温度范围 (100-260 K) 和 0.4-9 μs 的积分时间（每行 2-19.2 μs 的读出时间）内进行映射，并与为 NewAthena 广域成像仪 (WFI) 开发的标准 DePFET 进行比较。所有三种变体均在约 155 K 时达到最低噪声。埋沟道器件实现了 0.96 e⁻（减去读出电子噪声后最多 0.83 e⁻）的出色等效噪声电荷 (ENC)，在单次读出中展示了完整 64×64 DePFET 矩阵上的子电子噪声，同时功耗降低了 50% 以上。 super-g_q DePFET 的电荷增益增加了 2.6 倍（约 1100 pA/e⁻），但由于噪声贡献过多而表现出更高的总噪声。结果突显了新型 DePFET 的潜力，其中埋沟道技术为 WFI 等低噪声应用提供了立竿见影的好处。

articles.title: Spin-Adapted Neural-Network Backflow Wavefunctions for Excited States of Strongly Correlated Open-Shell Systems
articles.title_zh: 强相关开壳系统激发态的自旋适应神经网络回流波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building on the success of neural-network quantum states (NQS) for molecular ground states, multi-state frameworks such as natural excited states (NES) [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] extend NQS to chemically important excited states. However, without control over total spin, such calculations can require the inclusion of many intervening states of other spins, particularly in strongly correlated systems with dense low-energy spectra. We therefore generalize our previously developed spin-adapted neural network backflow (SA-NNBF) ansatz [Li et al., arXiv:2604.06841 (2026)] to improve its variational flexibility for excited-state calculations within a prescribed spin sector. We establish the universality of this extended ansatz within the chosen orbital space and spin sector, and use numerical benchmarks to assess how parameter allocation affects the ansatz's accuracy. With the spin-adapted ansatz, we are able to directly optimize the first excited state (a singlet) of O₂ without using any multi-state frameworks. Combining the extended ansatz with NES, we obtain low-lying triplet states of O₂ and singlet states of the [Fe₂S₂(SCH₃)₄]²⁻ cluster without including intervening states of other spins. Both the single-state and NES calculations achieve chemical accuracy relative to the exact energies. Our work provides a practical NQS framework for targeting excited states of prescribed spin in strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。因此，我们概括了之前开发的自旋适应神经网络回流（SA-NNBF）ansatz [Li et al., arXiv:2604.06841 (2026)]，以提高其在指定自旋扇区内激发态计算的变分灵活性。我们在选定的轨道空间和自旋扇区内建立了这种扩展 ansatz 的普遍性，并使用数值基准来评估参数分配如何影响 ansatz 的准确性。借助自旋适应 ansatz，我们能够直接优化 O2 的第一激发态（单线态），而无需使用任何多态框架。将扩展 ansatz 与 NES 相结合，我们获得了 O2 的低位三重态和 [Fe2S2(SCH3)4]2- 团簇的单重态，而不包括其他自旋的介入态。单态和 NES 计算都实现了相对于精确能量的化学精度。我们的工作提供了一个实用的 NQS 框架，用于针对强相关系统中指定自旋的激发态。

articles.title: A free-energy approach for stochastic reaction-drift-diffusion lattice simulations of crowded biological systems
articles.title_zh: 拥挤生物系统随机反应漂移扩散晶格模拟的自由能方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22902v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular size alters spatial distributions, reaction equilibria, and transport in crowded mixtures, but resolving individual particle encounters can make large stochastic simulations computationally costly. We developed a lattice-based framework for simulating reaction-drift-diffusion systems with volume exclusion captured as a free energy functional in each voxel. Changes in this free energy, together with external one-body potentials, modify diffusion and reaction propensities. Our framework accommodates mixtures of particle sizes without resolving each particle's position within a voxel. We implemented our framework in an operator splitting scheme and compared our predictions with off-lattice interacting-particle simulations. Inclusion of the local free energy functional improved spatial occupancies and shifts in reaction equilibria relative to point-particle simulations. With separate approximations for larger spheres and polymers, we simulated crowding-induced slowing and spatial segregation. We then modeled motor proteins' traffic jams on a structured track representing a microtubule. Our results demonstrate how local composition can inform stochastic reaction and transport rates without resolving individual encounters.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子尺寸会改变拥挤混合物中的空间分布、反应平衡和传输，但解决单个粒子的相遇可能会使大型随机模拟的计算成本高昂。我们开发了一个基于晶格的框架，用于模拟反应漂移扩散系统，其中体积排斥被捕获为每个体素中的自由能函数。这种自由能的变化与外部单体电势一起改变扩散和反应倾向。我们的框架可以容纳不同尺寸的颗粒，但无需解析每个颗粒在体素内的位置。我们在算子分裂方案中实现了我们的框架，并将我们的预测与晶格外相互作用粒子模拟进行了比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子尺寸会改变拥挤混合物中的空间分布、反应平衡和传输，但解决单个粒子的相遇可能会使大型随机模拟的计算成本高昂。我们开发了一个基于晶格的框架，用于模拟反应漂移扩散系统，其中体积排斥被捕获为每个体素中的自由能函数。这种自由能的变化与外部单体电势一起改变扩散和反应倾向。我们的框架可以容纳不同尺寸的颗粒，但无需解析每个颗粒在体素内的位置。我们在算子分裂方案中实现了我们的框架，并将我们的预测与晶格外相互作用粒子模拟进行了比较。相对于点粒子模拟，包含局部自由能泛函改善了空间占用和反应平衡的变化。通过对较大球体和聚合物的单独近似，我们模拟了拥挤引起的减速和空间隔离。然后，我们在代表微管的结构化轨道上对运动蛋白的交通拥堵进行了建模。我们的结果证明了局部成分如何在不解决个体遭遇的情况下告知随机反应和传输速率。

articles.title: Quantum simulation of neutral-meson mixing and decay on a reprogrammable photonic processor
articles.title_zh: 可重编程光子处理器上中性介子混合和衰变的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutral mesons oscillate into their antiparticles while decaying, so their dynamics is generated by a non-Hermitian effective Hamiltonian which a quantum simulator restricted to unitary operations cannot implement directly. We propose a reprogrammable photonic processor that simulates this open-system evolution through dilation and analyze it at the circuit level. The effective Hamiltonian is reconstructed exactly from measured lifetimes, mass and width differences, and the CP-violation parameter |q/p|. Through a singular-value decomposition and a single ancilla that encodes the total decay probability, its propagator is embedded in a four-mode unitary, which is compiled at each time step into a rectangular interferometer on a hexagonal mesh of tunable Mach-Zehnder units. Circuit simulations including coupler, propagation, and bend losses show that one fixed device, reprogrammed only through its control voltages, reproduces the flavor oscillation and decay of neutral kaons and of B_d and Bₛ mesons, with x=Δ m/Γ from 0.77 to 26.9. Over 500 time steps per system, the mean fidelity lies between 0.99979 and 0.99982, and no step falls below 0.9996. Because every optical path crosses nine tunable units, uniform insertion loss reduces only the transmitted power, whereas unit-to-unit loss variations lower the fidelity quadratically, 1-langle Frangle simeq 0.08σ² for a loss standard deviation σ in dB. A leading-order analysis traces this coefficient to the routing of light through the mesh, reproduces the fitted value to within 2%, and explains why it is the same for all three mesons; a mean fidelity of 0.999 tolerates σ approx 0.11 dB. The ancillary outputs encode the total decay probability without postselection, and the reported probabilities are normalized to the collected optical power.
articles.abstract_zh: 中性介子在衰变时振荡成反粒子，因此它们的动力学是由非厄米有效哈密顿量生成的，仅限于酉运算的量子模拟器无法直接实现。我们提出了一种可重新编程的光子处理器，它通过膨胀来模拟这种开放系统的演化，并在电路级对其进行分析。有效哈密顿量是根据测量的寿命、质量和宽度差异以及 CP 破坏参数 |q/p| 精确重建的。通过奇异值分解和对总衰减概率进行编码的单个辅助，其传播器被嵌入到四模酉中，该四模酉在每个时间步被编译成可调谐马赫-曾德尔单元的六边形网格上的矩形干涉仪。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中性介子在衰变时振荡成反粒子，因此它们的动力学是由非厄米有效哈密顿量生成的，仅限于酉运算的量子模拟器无法直接实现。我们提出了一种可重新编程的光子处理器，它通过膨胀来模拟这种开放系统的演化，并在电路级对其进行分析。有效哈密顿量是根据测量的寿命、质量和宽度差异以及 CP 破坏参数 |q/p| 精确重建的。通过奇异值分解和对总衰减概率进行编码的单个辅助，其传播器被嵌入到四模酉中，该四模酉在每个时间步被编译成可调谐马赫-曾德尔单元的六边形网格上的矩形干涉仪。包括耦合器、传播和弯曲损耗在内的电路模拟表明，一种仅通过其控制电压重新编程的固定装置，可以再现中性 kaons 以及 B_d 和 Bₛ 介子的风味振荡和衰变，其中 x=Δ m/Γ 从 0.77 到 26.9。每个系统超过 500 个时间步长，平均保真度介于 0.99979 和 0.99982 之间，并且没有任何步长低于 0.9996。由于每条光路穿过 9 个可调谐单元，均匀的插入损耗仅会降低发射功率，而单元之间的损耗变化会以二次方式降低保真度，对于损耗标准偏差 σ（以 dB 为单位），1 角度 Frange simeq 0.08σ²。前导分析将该系数追踪到光穿过网格的路径，将拟合值再现到 2% 以内，并解释了为什么它对于所有三个介子都是相同的； 0.999 的平均保真度允许 σ 约为 0.11 dB。辅助输出对没有后选择的总衰减概率进行编码，并且报告的概率被归一化为收集的光功率。

articles.title: The MC-QTAIM: Why, How, and When?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The multi-component quantum theory of atoms in molecules (MC-QTAIM) generalizes the original QTAIM framework developed by Richard Bader and colleagues, extending atoms-in-molecules analysis beyond ab initio electronic wavefunctions. MC-QTAIM facilitates the examination of the AIM structure in systems and states that require MC wavefunctions, which describe systems containing multiple distinguishable classes of quantum particles. This advancement broadens the applicability of AIM analysis to a wide range of quantum systems and states that were previously inaccessible. These include exotic molecules, such as positronic species; exotic quantum states, such as superposed proton states in molecules with two- or multi-well potential energy surfaces; and non-adiabatic states of conventional molecules. In this review, I aim to explain the fundamental principles of MC-QTAIM analysis in accessible language and explore some of its potential applications. Additionally, the general formalism for energy partitioning in MC systems, called MC Interacting Quantum Atoms (MC-IQA), is introduced. This scheme unifies the energy partitioning of numerous quantum systems and encompasses the IQA method originally developed by Pendas and colleagues, as well as the previously developed two-component IQA (TC-IQA) scheme - developed by our group to analyze positronic systems - as special cases.

articles.title: Robust feedback control of collisional plasma dynamics in presence of uncertainties
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.19992v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic fusion aims to confine high-temperature plasma within a device, enabling the fusion of deuterium and tritium nuclei to release energy. Due to the very large temperatures involved, it is essential to isolate the plasma from the device walls to prevent structural damage and the external magnetic fields play a fundamental role in achieving this confinement. In realistic settings, the physical mechanisms governing plasma behavior are highly complex, involving numerous uncertain parameters and intricate particle interactions, such as collisions, that significantly affect both confinement efficiency and overall stability. In this work, we address particularly these challenges by proposing a robust feedback control strategy designed to steer the plasma towards a desired spatial region, despite the presence of uncertainties. From a modeling perspective, we consider a collisional plasma described by a Vlasov-Poisson-BGK system, which accounts for a self-consistent electric field and a strong external magnetic field, while incorporating uncertainty in the model. A key feature of the proposed control strategy is its independence from the random parameter, making it particularly suitable for practical applications. A series of numerical simulations confirms the effectiveness of our approach and demonstrates the ability of external magnetic fields to successfully confine plasma away from the device boundaries, even in the presence of uncertain conditions.

articles.title: Structure and asymptotic preserving deep neural surrogates for uncertainty quantification in multiscale kinetic equations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.10636v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The high dimensionality of kinetic equations with stochastic parameters poses major computational challenges for uncertainty quantification (UQ). Traditional Monte Carlo (MC) sampling methods, while widely used, suffer from slow convergence and high variance, which become increasingly severe as the dimensionality of the parameter space grows. To accelerate MC sampling, we adopt a multiscale control variates strategy that leverages low-fidelity solutions from simplified kinetic models to reduce variance. To further improve sampling efficiency and preserve the underlying physics, we introduce surrogate models based on structure and asymptotic preserving neural networks (SAPNNs). These deep neural networks are specifically designed to satisfy key physical properties, including positivity, conservation laws, entropy dissipation, and asymptotic limits. By training the SAPNNs on low-fidelity models and enriching them with selected high-fidelity samples from the full Boltzmann equation, our method achieves significant variance reduction while maintaining physical consistency and asymptotic accuracy. The proposed methodology enables efficient large-scale prediction in kinetic UQ and is validated across both homogeneous and nonhomogeneous multiscale regimes. Numerical results demonstrate improved accuracy and computational efficiency compared to standard MC techniques.

articles.title: Control strategies for magnetized plasma: a polar coordinates framework
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10214v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work, we provide an overview of various control strategies aimed at steering plasma toward desired configurations using an external magnetic field. From a modeling perspective, we focus on the Vlasov equation in a two-dimensional bounded domain, accounting for both a self-induced electric field and a strong external magnetic field. The results are presented in a polar coordinate framework, which is particularly well-suited for simulating toroidal devices such as Tokamaks and Stellarators. A key feature of the proposed control strategies is their feedback mechanism, which is based on an instantaneous prediction of the discretized system. Finally, different numerical experiments in the two-dimensional polar coordinate setting demonstrate the effectiveness of the approaches.

articles.title: Micro-Macro Tensor Neural Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Collisional Plasma
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.24205v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Plasma kinetic equations exhibit pronounced sensitivity to microscopic perturbations in model parameters and data, making reliable and efficient uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for predictive simulations. However, the cost of uncertainty sampling, the high-dimensional phase space, and multiscale stiffness pose severe challenges to both computational efficiency and error control in traditional numerical methods. These aspects are further emphasized in presence of collisions where the high-dimensional nonlocal collision integrations and conservation properties pose severe constraints. To overcome this, we present a variance-reduced Monte Carlo framework for UQ in the Vlasov--Poisson--Landau (VPL) system, in which neural network surrogates replace the multiple costly evaluations of the Landau collision term. The method couples a high-fidelity, asymptotic-preserving VPL solver with inexpensive, strongly correlated surrogates based on the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Euler--Poisson (EP) equations. For the surrogate models, we introduce a generalization of the separable physics-informed neural network (SPINN), developing a class of tensor neural networks based on an anisotropic micro-macro decomposition, to reduce velocity-moment costs, model complexity, and the curse of dimensionality. To further increase correlation with VPL, we calibrate the VPFP model and design an asymptotic-preserving SPINN whose small- and large-Knudsen limits recover the EP and VP systems, respectively. Numerical experiments show substantial variance reduction over standard Monte Carlo, accurate statistics with far fewer high-fidelity samples, and lower wall-clock time, while maintaining robustness to stochastic dimension.

articles.title: Full-horizon magnetic control of the Vlasov--Poisson system for plasma confinement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26110v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the full-horizon control of a two-dimensional Vlasov--Poisson system through an externally imposed magnetic field. The control is represented by time-dependent coefficients associated with smooth, spatially localized basis functions, and is designed to steer selected position and velocity moments of the distribution function while limiting particle dispersion and the control effort. Starting from the kinetic constrained optimization problem, we derive the continuous first-order optimality conditions, including a backward Vlasov equation, an elliptic adjoint equation, and the variational inequality associated with bounded controls. We then project this system onto a particle--grid representation and identify the resulting particle adjoints and control gradient. The full-horizon field is then computed on a reduced particle ensemble, initialized by an instantaneous control, and subsequently applied to a larger set of particles. Numerical experiments indicate that the instantaneous control field already provides an effective baseline, while the full-horizon correction can further reduce the relative thermal energy near the boundaries and improve confinement over the prescribed time interval.

articles.title: Who sees the sea? Sea-view potential by façade and floor from cadastral LoD1 models on the Costa del Sol
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21672v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Views are among the most valued and least measured attributes of a home. We present an open-data method that estimates the sea-view potential of every free façade of every residential building at three floors (ground, middle and top; other floors take the nearest of them), from cadastral footprints with floor counts and a national terrain model. Run for 158,060 buildings of 21 municipalities on Spain's Costa del Sol in under an hour on two cores, it finds that 52 % of buildings see some sea from their top floor and 36 % have an open view (20deg or more). Traced over a LiDAR surface in a pilot, scores agree with the model's inside cadastral footprints (96.7 % of viewpoints in the same class at 20deg), but structures the cadastre does not record lower the sea seen from the top floor by 6.1--9.0deg on average. Against the photographs of 93 homes for sale, labelled blind by AI models of two developers with ties decided by the author, the score has an AUC of 0.80 (95 % CI 0.70--0.89; 0.81 against the first-round labels); at 20deg it is sensitive (0.90) but not specific (0.45). Dwelling figures depend on how dwellings are allocated to façades and floors: 42 % of dwellings are on a floor with open-view potential under the main rule, and 12--45 % across the allocation, geometry and vegetation scenarios tested. As an application, higher-income census sections tend to have more modelled view potential within municipalities, with uncertain size and fragile inference (about two effective clusters); on terrain alone the difference largely disappears. Code and façade-level data reproduce the main results.

articles.title: Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean Δ pCO₂ Using Tabular Diffusion Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21769v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO₂ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO₂ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of Δ pCO₂ (the sea-air pCO₂ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 μatm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0.930), while retaining point-prediction skill comparable to a deterministic XGBoost baseline (RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 μatm; R² 0.77 vs. 0.79). These results show that conditional diffusion can provide well-calibrated, observation-level uncertainties while largely preserving point-prediction skill. Because Treeffuser is generative, its samples can support probabilistic analyses of Δ pCO₂; extending this to spatially coherent field reconstruction will require modeling dependence across grid cells and evaluation on spatially held-out data.

articles.title: On the Structure of the Nuclear-Clock Isotope ²²⁹Th Beyond Quadratic Order
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21807v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Precision measurements of the exceptionally low-energy nuclear transition of ²²⁹Th, offer an extraordinary sensitivity to a variety of new light fields. However, interpreting such measurements requires nuclear-structure information beyond what is currently constrained by spectroscopy. We develop a systematic description of the electric multipole interactions governing the hyperfine structure of {}²²⁹Th, including the hexadecapole contribution, and perform a symmetry-based analysis of the resulting hyperfine splittings in crystalline environments. Hyperfine spectroscopy generally constrains combinations of nuclear moments and crystal-field gradients, leading to degeneracies when higher multipole interactions are allowed. We then combine experimental nuclear observables, particle-rotor relations, and a deformed-Fermi charge-density model to investigate the electromagnetic contribution to the nuclear clock's sensitivity to variations in the fine-structure constant. We find that higher-order nuclear deformation and state-dependent differences in the radial charge distribution of the clock states can substantially alter the predicted sensitivity, introducing large uncertainties that are not constrained by existing measurements. Our results highlight the importance of combining nuclear and solid-state theory with complementary measurements, including spectroscopy of higher-spin states, to constrain the nuclear structure and improve predictions of the clock's sensitivity to new physics. Our symmetry-based analysis also provides a framework for using hyperfine spectroscopy to investigate local defect symmetries in crystalline hosts.

articles.title: Probing scalar-mediated Lorentz violation with hydrogen masers and spin-precession of molecules
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose using hydrogen maser spectroscopy and molecular spin-precession experiments, traditionally employed in precision frequency measurements and searches for the electron electric dipole moment, as complementary probes of light scalar-mediated, spin-dependent fifth forces. We investigate their sensitivity to Lorentz-violating interactions mediated by scalars with masses ranging from O(10⁻⁴~mueV) to O(10~keV). While hydrogen maser spectroscopy and molecular spin-precession measurements probe different combinations of Lorentz-violating couplings, we find that the strongest projected sensitivities can be achieved using spin-precession of ultracold molecules, benefiting from their extended coherence times. These experimental approaches provide access to previously unexplored regions of parameter space, probing interaction ranges extending from centimeter to sub-angstrom scales. Our proposals highlight the potential of precision atomic and molecular experiments to search for new spin-dependent scalar-mediated interactions and violations of fundamental spacetime symmetries.

articles.title: Fundamental physics with quantum sensors in space
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.21997v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum sensors such as atomic clocks, atom interferometers, and atomic magnetometers can be used as sensitive probes of physics beyond the Standard Model. Space offers microgravity, long baselines, low environmental noise, access to varying gravitational potentials, and unique opportunities involving the Sun, Moon, planets, and asteroids. These proceedings of the Aspen Center for Physics workshop on "Fundamental physics in space with quantum sensors," held February 22-27, 2026, summarize the scientific case, current capabilities, and space mission concepts for investigating dark matter, testing general relativity, and detecting gravitational waves in frequency bands inaccessible from the ground.

articles.title: QCap: a physics-corrected graph neural network for the capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting device layout
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22057v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electromagnetic simulations of device layouts to extract capacitance are computationally intensive, a major obstacle to accurate design of circuit devices. Machine learning models can bypass these simulations, but previous approaches have been restricted to layouts using only particular components, and require thousands of simulations of those same components as training data. We present QCap, a model that accurately predicts the Maxwell capacitance matrix of an arbitrary superconducting device layout in seconds, compared to minutes to hours of Ansys Q3D simulations. We develop a novel design-embedding algorithm that converts the layout into a universal graph format, allowing the model to work with any layout created with any tool. To achieve high accuracy, we obtain a coarse physics prior from a fast method of moments simulation of capacitance, then train the model to correct this prior. On 4,009 test designs withheld from training data the model outputs agree with Q3D simulations to a median error of 0.177%, and on never-seen component families it stays below 1% error. We demonstrate the model's scaling by obtaining the capacitance matrix of a 9-superconducting-qubit device in 12 seconds on a laptop (compared to 19.9 h and 228 GB of memory in Ansys) with sub-percent error, and capacitance of a (too large to simulate) 100-qubit, 781-conductor device in 3.4 min on a laptop. We provide the open-source models and data on SQuADDS and Hugging Face. Our results provide a powerful tool for large-scale accurate circuit design and guide the development of models to bypass other physical simulations.

articles.title: Perturbative Recovery of Stabilizer-Subspace Correlations for Quantum Computational Chemistry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22108v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stabilizer-based subspace methods can substantially reduce the quantum resources required for electronic structure calculations, but the resulting projection neglects Hamiltonian couplings to configurations outside the retained subspace. In this work, we introduce Stabilizer-Subspace Perturbation Theory (SSPT) to recover the associated correlation contributions, using the Contextual Subspace Variational Quantum Eigensolver (CS-VQE) as a representative application. The central idea is to exploit the Pauli terms eliminated by stabilizer projection as perturbative operators that generate an external manifold from the optimized reference state. Their energetic contributions are evaluated using an Epstein-Nesbet-type second-order correction or a resolvent-based formulation that retains couplings within the external space. By exploiting the factorized structure of the stabilizer-constrained reference state, the required matrix elements can be evaluated through Pauli expectation values on the reduced contextual register without explicitly reconstructing the full-space wave function. Molecular benchmarks demonstrate substantial reductions in projection-induced energy errors, allowing chemical precision to be achieved with fewer contextual qubits in several cases. These results establish stabilizer-guided perturbation theory as a promising strategy for improving the accuracy of resource-efficient quantum chemistry calculations.

articles.title: Magnetic Flux Eruptions in Magnetically Arrested Disks: Magnetic Reconnection and Bubble Expansion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22689v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Using a high-resolution GRMHD simulation of a magnetically arrested disk, we investigate the physical mechanism driving magnetic-flux eruption. The horizon-threading magnetic flux declines mainly in off-equatorial regions, whereas localized hot spots associated with magnetic reconnection appear near the equatorial plane around the onset of flux decline. A non-axisymmetric, magnetically supported low-density structure, which we identify as a magnetic bubble, expands radially and azimuthally within a pre-existing low-density channel in the filamentary accretion flow. Based on these findings, we propose a physical picture linking reconnection, bubble expansion, and horizon magnetic flux decline. The reconnection occurs in the pre-existing low-density channel, and may reconfigure the field and promote bubble expansion. Magnetic-pressure gradients provide broadly distributed outward support for the expansion, while magnetic tension contributes a localized outward force near the equator. Bubble expansion may limit gas replenishment, helping to maintain the low-density region and reduce the total pressure near the equator. This pressure reduction may facilitate equatorward electromagnetic energy transport. In the simulation, the polar electromagnetic energy flux reverses from poleward to equatorward near the onset of the horizon-flux decline. The equatorward transport is concentrated in the bubble sector and carries electromagnetic energy from the off-equatorial magnetosphere to the equatorial region. This energy supply may sustain localized reconnection and plasma heating as the eruption develops.

articles.title: Molecular energies from sparse quantum prolate diagonalization on a trapped-ion quantum processor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.22834v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce sparse quantum prolate diagonalization (sparse QPD), which combines the original formulation of QPD [Phys. Rev. Res., 8(3), 033177, (2026)] with compressed sensing to exploit Hamiltonian spectrum sparsity for molecular systems. We show that sparse sampling reduces the sample complexity of QPD from O(Nₛ) to O(log Nₛ), where Nₛ is the number of sampled points of the autocorrelation function (i.e. distinct circuits), without increasing circuit depth at chemical accuracy. With a two-orbital active-space-embedded Hamiltonian for an interacting arginine--tryptophan residue pair in water as an example, we show that on the Quantinuum Helios trapped-ion quantum computer, sparse QPD resolves the Hamiltonian energies to chemical accuracy with circuits of up to 448 two-qubit gates. For a suitably large quantum processor, we demonstrate numerically in the weakly correlated regime that the method extends to larger systems.

articles.title: Frequency Multiplexing of Purcell-Enhanced Optically Coherent NV Centers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23046v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Integrating optically coherent quantum emitters into nanophotonic structures is key to scalable quantum networks. Realizing them with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond is hindered by the degradation of optical coherence accompanying nanofabrication. Here, we overcome this challenge by integrating multiple NV centers into a monolithic diamond photonic crystal nanocavity while preserving near-lifetime-limited optical coherence. We observe linewidths as narrow as 19 MHz, enabling the frequency multiplexing of spectrally distinct NV centers within a common cavity mode, while maintaining charge-state stability over several minutes under resonant excitation. Tuning the cavity into resonance with the NV zero-phonon line enhances the optical emission, consistent with Purcell enhancement predicted by finite-element simulations. Additionally, individual cavities can be independently brought into resonance with NV zero-phonon lines on the same chip. These results combine bulk-like optical coherence with frequency multiplexing and cavity-enhanced emission, establishing a scalable nanophotonic platform for NV-based quantum network nodes.

articles.title: An Efficient Method for Directly Integrating the Vlasov Equation in Collisionless and Weakly-Collisional Simulations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We describe and test a new numerical method to solve the Vlasov/Boltzmann equation in systems with arbitrary levels of collisionality. The method combines recent ideas to evolve the distribution function (DF) directly in 6+1 dimensional phase-space in a manner which is Lagrangian in both position+velocity. The 'particles' of traditional Monte-Carlo/Particle-In-Cell/N-body (MC/PIC/NB) methods become mesh-generating points defining a volume partition, each of which carries a set of momentum-Lagrangian basis functions representing a local anisotropic momentum DF. The DF is then integrated between cells and bases via a higher-order reconstruction and Godunov-type method, evolving a 10 or 13-moment representation of each basis to ensure manifest mass/momentum/energy conservation. The method allows one to represent arbitrary DFs, including multiple independent streams but also collisional or phase-mixed or thermal distributions (unlike traditional 'moments' or waterbag/tessellation methods), and the cost is bounded to a modest multiplier of MC/PIC/NB costs. We provide an example implementation which uses a spatially-Lagrangian volume partition, second-order reconstruction, and simple set of bases which ensure constant cell masses and couple directly to existing MC/PIC/NB machinery, made public in the code GIZMO. We validate in a series of test problems, demonstrating manifest conservation, Galilean and translation and rotation invariance, and ability to represent complex DFs without spurious dissipation or instability. We discuss applications where this method can have advantages compared to traditional algorithms for simulations of dark matter, stellar, weakly-collisional neutral gas, and particulate/dust dynamics; multiphase/polydisperse flows; cosmic ray and radiation transport/hydrodynamics; and plasma physics.

articles.title: Quantum amplification with a linear quantum coupler
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23188v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Josephson parametric amplifiers (JPAs) are essential components for quantum-limited microwave measurement, but their dynamic range is often constrained by Kerr and other pump-induced nonlinear effects. In this work, we systematically study the performance of a parametric amplifier based on the linear inductive coupler (LINC). Starting from the driven-circuit Hamiltonian, we derive the effective three-wave-mixing amplifier model, including leading flux-driven nonlinear corrections relevant to realistic operation. We analyze the resulting gain response, saturation behavior, and intermodulation distortion, comparing them with representative state-of-the-art JPA designs. Our results show that the symmetry-protected structure of the LINC suppresses static Kerr nonlinearity. Moreover, suitable circuit-parameter optimization can further reduce the dressed-squeezing and driven-Kerr effects, leading to considerable improvements in power-handling metrics. These results identify the LINC architecture as a promising platform for high-linearity Josephson parametric amplification.

articles.title: Terahertz emission from α-W/CoFe epitaxial spintronic emitters
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.10123v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report efficient terahertz (THz) generation in epitaxial α-W/Co₆₀Fe₄₀ spintronic emitters. Two types of emitters have been investigated; epitaxial α-W(110)/Co₆₀Fe₄₀(110) and α-W(001)/Co₆₀Fe₄₀(001) deposited on single crystalline Al₂O₃(11bar20) and MgO(001) substrates, respectively. First principle calculations of the electronic band structure at the W(001) surface reveal Dirac-type surface states, similar to that reported previously for the W(110) surface. The generated THz radiation is about 10% larger for α-W(110)/Co₆₀Fe₄₀(110) grown on single crystalline Al₂O₃(11bar20), which is explained by the fact that the α-W(110)/Co₆₀Fe₄₀(110) interface for this emitter is more transparent to the spin current due to the presence of Å ngström-scale interface intermixing at the W/CoFe interface. Our results also reveal that the generation of THz radiation is larger when pumping with the laser light from the substrate side, which is explained by a larger part of the laser light due to interference effects in the film stack being absorbed in the ferromagnetic Co₆₀Fe₄₀ layer in this measurement configuration.

articles.title: Statistical State Dynamics of Couette MHD Turbulence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.19575v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The roll streak structure (RSS) is ubiquitous in shear flow turbulence and is fundamental to the dynamics of the self-sustaining process (SSP) maintaining the turbulent state. The formation and maintenance of the RSS in wall-bounded shear flow suggest the presence of an underlying instability that has recently been identified using statistical state dynamics (SSD). Due to the parallelism between the Navier-Stokes equation and the induction equation, it is reasonable to inquire whether the RSS in wall-bounded shear flow has a counterpart in the MHD equations formulated as an SSD. In this work we show that this is the case and that an analytic solution for the composite velocitymagnetic field RSS in the MHD SSD also arises from an instability, that this instability equilibrates to either a fixed point or to a turbulent state, that these turbulent statistical equilibria may be self sustaining, and that both the fixed point and the turbulent states may correspond to large scale coherent dynamos.

articles.title: Electrokinetic effects on flow and ion transport in charge-patterned corrugated nanochannels
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.22182v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The phase offset between surface charge modulation and geometric undulations in a corrugated nanochannel provides a tunable mechanism for rectified, diode-like ion transport under purely pressure-driven conditions: reversing the applied pressure gradient selectively activates transport of opposite ionic species, generating a net ionic current whose sign and magnitude are set by the charge-geometry alignment. Fully coupled Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Stokes simulations reveal the underlying two-regime structure: at low driving force (Regime I), throughput is suppressed below the Poiseuille limit by a localized streaming potential that pins counterions within the electric double layer; above a threshold pressure (Regime II), the mechanical force overcomes electrostatic resistance, producing an abrupt, orders-of-magnitude rise in mean velocity. Electroosmotically driven flow undergoes a qualitatively similar but smoother transition. Peak charge selectivity is achieved at near-complete electric double layer overlap and driving forces just below the Regime I-Regime II transition. Random walk particle tracking confirms selective rectification and quantifies the dependence of ion dispersion on surface charge placement across both regimes.

articles.title: A physics-constrained neural solver for incompressible flows without labeled data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18820v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a physics-constrained neural solver for incompressible flow that requires neither labeled data nor supervised pretraining. The solver enforces incompressibility and boundary conditions (BCs) to strict tolerances. We attribute the limited Reynolds numbers of existing physics-informed approaches to insufficient enforcement of these constraints, on which conventional finite-difference and finite-volume solvers depend. We therefore formulate incompressible flow as a constrained optimization problem within the physics- and equality-constrained artificial neural network (PECANN) framework: the pressure Poisson residual is minimized subject to the momentum equations, continuity equation, and BCs imposed as equality constraints on the primitive variables, while a conditionally adaptive augmented Lagrangian method enforces each constraint. The pressure Poisson objective proves critical. Across all benchmarks, replacing it with the momentum residual fails to converge to accurate solutions under identical architecture and constraint enforcement, which we attribute to the global elliptic coupling of pressure and velocity that local momentum-residual minimization lacks. For advection-dominated flows, we introduce an adaptive vanishing entropy viscosity that stabilizes training while leaving the converged solution unchanged. The solver predicts lid-driven cavity flow up to Re = 7,500 with centerline velocity profiles matching benchmark data, and is further validated on flow over a backward-facing step at Re = 800, 3D unsteady Beltrami flow, and steady and unsteady flow past a circular cylinder under an inflow-outflow configuration, for which an ablation study identifies admissible outlet BCs for velocity and pressure. From a randomly initialized network and without external perturbations, the solver captures the spontaneous onset of periodic vortex shedding in unsteady cylinder flow.

articles.title: Implementation of Girsanov Reweighting in CP2K
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.05419v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamical reweighting of path measures is a powerful approach for accurately evaluating slow molecular processes using modified potential energy surfaces used in enhanced sampling methods. Integrating this reweighting framework into the CP2K electronic-structure and molecular-dynamics (MD) software package delivers a robust and widely applicable tool for metadynamics, uncertainty quantification, and force-field optimisation based on both ab initio and classical MD simulations. Based on the Girsanov theorem for stochastic dynamical systems, the method is adapted to the Bussi-Donadio-Parrinello velocity-rescaling scheme. This scheme is accessible through the CSVR thermostat and can be interpreted as a Langevin OVRVO/OBABO update scheme requiring two random numbers per integration step. Comprehensive implementation details are provided, including a complete overview of the modified CP2K modules involved in the MD cycle and the computation of reweighting factors. The framework supports multiple sources of bias potentials, enabling reweighting via the PLUMED interface or CP2K-native external potentials and restraints. The feasibility of the implementation is demonstrated through rerun benchmarks, dynamical reweighting of Markov state models (MSMs) and computation of transport properties based on CP2K trajectories, showing excellent agreement with reference simulations.

articles.title: Measurement and Modeling of Structure-Induced Surface Scattering on Terahertz Channel
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.24029v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As terahertz (THz) frequencies emerge as promising candidates for next-generation wireless networks, accurate characterization of propagation mechanisms in indoor/outdoor environments becomes essential for system design and performance optimization. This article presents an experimental and theoretical investigation of structure-induced indoor surface scattering on THz channels, examining how material properties and structural configurations jointly govern channel power and angular distribution. Six representative indoor surfaces are characterized, revealing that intrinsic structural inhomogeneity - particularly the quasi-periodic earlywood-latewood arrangement in pine wood - induces measurable angular scattering whose dominant lobes and angular shifts are reproduced by a beam-propagation modeling (BPM) framework. Material-covered surface configurations are further investigated, demonstrating that thin dielectric covering layers can substantially modify reflection characteristics through thickness- and frequency- dependent thin-film interference effects. Wide-angle bistatic measurements in a conference room show that folded curtains broaden the measured angular distribution of detectable received power. These findings suggest that structure-induced surface scattering mechanisms may provide scattering-assisted propagation opportunities for indoor non-line-of-sight THz scenarios.

articles.title: System Size Dependence of Collisionless Reconnection Rate
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18787v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is a widely accepted paradigm that collisionless magnetic reconnection proceeds at a universal fast rate of sim0.1 when normalized to a properly defined reconnecting magnetic field and Alfvén speed, effectively independent of the macroscopic system size. This conclusion, derived primarily from kinetic simulations of classical Harris current sheets with kinetic-scale thickness, stands in contrast to results from forced reconnection and island coalescence, where the rate significantly depends on the system size. Here, we reconcile this disparity by performing a rigorous scaling study of Harris sheets using both particle-in-cell and Hall magnetohydrodynamic simulations. We demonstrate that when the global magnetic configuration is preserved by scaling the initial current sheet thickness proportionally with the system size, the ``universal'' fast rate disappears. Instead, the reconnection rate decreases as the system size increases. By establishing a consistent scaling trend across different magnetic configurations, these findings challenge the paradigm of scale-independent fast reconnection and necessitate a reevaluation of energy release rates in astrophysical plasmas.

articles.title: Data-driven reconstruction of band dispersion and quantum geometry via Koopman dynamic mode decomposition
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06199v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a data-driven framework for reconstructing band structures using Koopman operator analysis and dynamic mode decomposition (Koopman-DMD). Instead of deriving spectra from an explicit Hamiltonian, the approach reconstructs band dispersion and modal dynamics directly from spatiotemporal data, including wavefunctions and observables. This framework establishes a correspondence between Hamiltonian Floquet-Bloch decomposition and Koopman-DMD, whereby the extracted DMD modes encode frequencies, decay or growth rates, spatial profiles and projection weights. These quantities allow the reconstruction of spectral functions, local density of states, and delocalized-to-localized measures such as the inverse participation ratio. Also, these extended DMD modes enable inference of quantum-geometric and topological properties, including the quantum metric, Berry curvature and geometric phases.
