articles.title: Electronic, optical, and thermal properties of Pd-substituted quasi-two-dimensional C2N2O: A first-principles study
articles.abstract: The structural, electronic, optical, and thermal properties of Pd-substituted quasi-two-dimensional (quasi-2D) C2N2O are investigated using density functional theory (DFT), together with ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. Three substitutional configurations are considered: Pd replaces a carbon atom in C2N2O-1, a nitrogen atom in C2N2O-2, and an oxygen atom in C2N2O-3. The calculated formation energies are negative for all three configurations, while AIMD simulations indicate that the structures retain their integrity during simulations at 300 K. However, their phonon dispersions contain imaginary-frequency modes, showing that the structures are not dynamically stable within the harmonic approximation. The pristine C2N2O structure has an indirect band gap of approximately 2.3 eV. Pd substitution reduces this gap to 0.27, 0.25, and 1.37 eV for C2N2O-1, C2N2O-2, and C2N2O-3, respectively. This reduction is associated with the contribution and hybridization of Pd-4d states with the p states of the host lattice. The optical response is also strongly dependent on the substitution site: the calculated zero-frequency refractive indices are 2.02, 3.45, and 1.61 for the three configurations, respectively. Their optical-conductivity spectra show corresponding changes in the onset of interband transitions. At 300 K, the calculated heat capacities are approximately 397, 387, and 403 J mol −1 K −1 for C2N2O-1, C2N2O-2, and C2N2O-3, respectively. These results demonstrate that the electronic and optical properties of quasi-2D C2N2O can be modified by selecting the Pd substitution site, although the imaginary phonon modes indicate that further structural stabilization may be required before practical applications are considered.

articles.title: Nested cell-level voltage-window selection for partial-charge state-of-health estimation of lithium-ion batteries
articles.abstract: Estimating the state of health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries from a short part of the charging curve is attractive for battery management systems, because vehicles and devices are rarely charged from empty to full. Published errors are often very low, but the voltage window and the data split are usually chosen by the authors, and the sensitivity to measurement conditions is seldom reported. We study a simple pipeline: five features from a voltage window of the constant-current charging phase feed a ridge regression, and the window is selected using only the training cells (nested leave-one-cell-out). On three public datasets of LCO/NMC-type cells (lithium cobalt oxide or nickel–manganese–cobalt oxide cathodes; NASA, 4 cells; CALCE, 6 cells; Oxford, 8 cells), the mean root-mean-square error (RMSE) of SOH is 3.01, 2.28 and 0.72 %, against 5.9, 2.8 and 2.3 % for a linear model that knows only the cycle index. Ridge regression is statistically indistinguishable from random forest, gradient boosting and support-vector regression (paired Wilcoxon (:papprox:0.42), 18 cells) and is much cheaper. The best window differs between datasets; a window shift of 0.02 V increases the error by a factor of 1.6 to 3.3 on NASA and Oxford; 10 mV of voltage noise doubles the NASA error unless the voltage is filtered; and models do not transfer between datasets. On 119 lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells (Supplementary Material), ridge does not beat the cycle-index baseline, and tree ensembles are only moderately better.

articles.title: Out-of-distribution generalization of universal-database models accelerating high-entropy alloy design across the metallic periodic table
articles.abstract: Cost-effective exploration of high-entropy alloys (HEAs) with desired properties remains constrained by scarce HEA property data. We propose a Target Space Partitioning-based Prediction Enhancement Strategy (TSPPES) that enables models pre-trained on universal materials databases to achieve out-of-distribution generalization to compositionally complex HEAs without additional data for training. Coupled with multi-objective optimization, this strategy screens over 106 compositions across 60 non-radioactive metals, targeting hardness and thermal conductivity. The models reproduce experimental trends across 6 alloy families and property responses to element addition, removal, or varying content in 4 alloy systems, supporting reliable screening across most of the metallic periodic table. Two W–Re-based HEA families are identified: as-cast W28.63Re14.50Ta28.18Zr14.21Nb14.47 (wt.%) exhibits a Vickers hardness of 801 ± 9 HV and a total thermal conductivity of 18.00 ± 0.06 W·m− 1·K− 1 at 300 K, while the FCC family member W18.74Re22.31Pt31.55Pd15.30Ru12.10 (wt.%) combines 816 ± 49 HV with an equivalent room-temperature ductility of ~ 20%.

articles.title: Operationalising a proxy-based coastal One Health indicator under data constraints: weighting robustness and sensitivity in the Pagasitikos Gulf, Greece
articles.abstract: Operational coastal One Health metrics remain scarce where direct health outcomes are unavailable. We developed a proxy-based hierarchical composite One Health Indicator (OHI) for the Pagasitikos Gulf, Greece, as an operational adaptation of a published framework. The 40-month implementation (January 2023–April 2026) integrates Copernicus satellite-observation, blended-observation and marine-model products with local monitoring and administrative records in three branches: a human-exposure proxy (HHI), an Aquatic Animal Health Index retained as an operational label and interpreted as an aquatic habitat-condition proxy (AAHI), and an Environmental Health Index (EHI) containing a nested operational Water Quality Index. Equal and expert-informed intensity weights were compared in 1,000 matched Sobol-sequence quasi-Monte Carlo runs that perturbed 21 normalised score contributions using Uniform (0.9, 1.1) marginals. In April 2026, nominal OHI values were 53.69 and 51.91 under expert-informed and equal weighting; simulation means were 53.55 and 51.80, with conditional 2.5th–97.5th percentile intervals of 51.74–55.29 and 50.00–53.58. The matched difference averaged 1.76 points and was positive in all runs. Dissolved oxygen, chlorophyll-a and pH had the largest absolute SRCs at the April 2026 step. The indicator is an auditable screening synthesis, not a validated measure of human or animal health.

articles.title: The Nonlinear Self-excited Threshold Two-component Mixture Multiplicative Error Model
articles.abstract: The main purpose of the present paper is to introduce an innovative model for non-negative time series, especially for financial data, which incorporates the mixture multiplicative error models with a self-excited threshold effect. The mixture distributions are applied to the effective handling of the multimodal, asymmetric, and skewed features. The Expectation-Maximization estimation algorithm is developed to estimate the model parameters, including an unknown threshold parameter. Results from the Monte Carlo simulation indicate that the estimates of the unknown parameters are converging towards their true values. Finally, the proposed process is effectively applied to model the producer price index, with goodness-of-fit measures demonstrating its superiority over other relevant models, thereby confirming the validity of the proposed modeling.

articles.title: Embedding Boolean Circuits into Fungal Sandpile Automata with Arbitrary Update Sequences
articles.abstract: footnotetextA{Some of the results in this article were presented at MCU 2026.} The sandpile automata of Bak, Tang, and Wiesenfeld [Phys.Rev.Lett., 1987] are a simple model for particle diffusion in space. A fundamental problem related to the complexity of the model is predicting its evolution in the parallel setting. Despite decades of effort, a classification of this problem for two-dimensional sandpile automata remains outstanding. Fungal sandpile automata were recently proposed by Goles et al.~[Phys.Lett. A, 2020] as a spin-off of the model in which diffusion occurs either in horizontal (H) or vertical (V) direction according to a so-called update scheme. Goles et al.~proved that the prediction problem for this model with the update scheme H⁴V⁴ is P-complete. This result was subsequently improved by Modanese and Worsch [Algorithmica, 2024], who showed the problem is P-complete also for the simpler update scheme HV. In this work, we complete the characterization and prove the prediction problem is P-complete for any update scheme containing both H and V at least once.

articles.title: De-inking of surface printing ink on waste polypropylene (PP) milk tea cups using nonionic surfactants
articles.abstract: Printing ink on waste polypropylene (PP) milk tea cups severely hinders their high-value recycling. A novel aqueous deinking system was developed with alkyl polyglucoside (APG)/Tween-80 (T-80) as composite surfactants and an eco-friendly mixed solvent of butyl acetate and dipropylene glycol ethyl ether (DPE). Deinking parameters were optimized via single-factor experiments and Box–Behnken response surface methodology, achieving a deinking efficiency of 93.45% under the optimal conditions: 3 wt.% surfactant, 13 wt.% organic solvent, 48°C and 56 min. XRD characterization confirmed the intact α-crystal structure of PP after deinking. Mechanical properties tests showed that the impact strength of deinked PP was significantly recovered, while the bending and tensile strengths were essentially restored to the level of virgin PP. The deinking process followed a synergistic mechanism of solvent penetration, resin swelling, competitive adsorption, roll-up and emulsification. The efficient, low-damage and eco-friendly deinking system provides a promising technical approach for the high-value recycling of printed waste PP, facilitating the development of a circular plastic economy.

articles.title: Effects of Bamboo and Cocopeat-Based Cellulose Fibers on the Properties of Low-Carbon Mortar Containing Recycled Brick Aggregates
articles.abstract: This study investigates a low-carbon mortar in which 60% of the Portland composite cement (PCC) was replaced by fly ash (40%), limestone powder (15%), and metakaolin (5%), reinforced with alkali-treated bamboo cellulose (CB) or cocopeat cellulose (CCP), and containing recycled brick aggregate (RA) as a 20% replacement for natural sand. First, the CB dosage was varied from 0.5% to 2% of binder mass in plain cement mortar; 1.5% gave the highest 28-day compressive strength (29.9 MPa versus 25.3 MPa for the control) and was adopted for the second stage. Compressive (7 and 28 days) and flexural (28 days) strengths were measured, and hydration and microstructure were examined by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive spectroscopy (SEM-EDS). The pozzolanic binder and the cellulose reduced the 7-day compressive strength by up to 32%. XRD indicated that both celluloses retarded early clinker hydration but promoted carboaluminate formation by 28 days, when the fiber mixtures reached 17.2–17.4 MPa, versus 16.6 MPa for the plain pozzolan mortar and 20.0 MPa for the control. The fiber mixtures containing RA reached 20.0–20.1 MPa. Bamboo cellulose gave the highest flexural strength, 5.61 MPa, 31% above the control and 14% above the plain pozzolan mortar, and SEM showed intact bamboo fibers bridging pores, whereas cocopeat cellulose left it practically unchanged (4.98 versus 4.90 MPa). The load–displacement curves showed that bamboo cellulose raised both the peak load and the displacement at failure of the pozzolan mortar, consistent with microcrack bridging, although no mixture showed a post-peak softening branch. RA reduced the flexural strength of the bamboo and cocopeat mixtures by 33% and 28%, to 3.78 and 3.59 MPa, respectively, below that of the control. The bamboo cellulose mortar with RA therefore offers the best balance of clinker reduction, waste valorization, and strength, with flexural performance as the main limitation.

articles.title: An Innovative Thermal Decomposition Method for the Deter-mination of Exchangeable NH₄⁺ in Zeolites and SAR Estimation
articles.abstract: In this study, a thermal decomposition method (TDM) was developed for the direct determination of the concentration of exchangeable NH₄⁺ ions in zeolites, based on liquid-phase NH₄⁺ ion exchange followed by NH₃ desorption using a simultaneous thermogravimetry/differential scanning calorimetry (TG/DSC) instrument. The concentration of exchangeable NH₄⁺ determined by TDM can be correlated with the concentration of Brønsted acid sites. Compared with conventional NH₃ temperature-programmed desorption (NH₃-TPD), the proposed method avoids the direct handling of gaseous ammonia during the adsorption step and improves reproducibility by relying on the thermal decomposition of NH₄⁺ counterions introduced through ion exchange. After preliminary TG coupled with Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (TG/FTIR) experiments to identify the water and NH₃ desorption ranges, TDM was applied to commercial zeolites with SAR values ranging from 2 to 30.5. The concentration of exchangeable NH₄⁺ decreased with increasing SAR, from 13,670 ± 650 µmol NH₄⁺·g⁻¹ for 4A zeolite to 1,590 ± 90 µmol NH₄⁺·g⁻¹ for ZSM-5. Conversely, the average decomposition energy of NH₄⁺ increased with SAR, from 40 kJ·mol NH₃⁻¹ for 4A to approximately 160 kJ·mol NH₃⁻¹ for Y zeolite with a SAR of 12, consistently with its possible interpretation as an indicator of apparent acid strength. A semi-empirical model correlating the concentration of exchangeable NH₄⁺ with SAR was also calibrated using commercial crystalline zeolites. External validation using a Y zeolite with a SAR of 12 predicted a SAR of 11.04, with a relative deviation of 8%. The method was also applied to a partially amorphous X-type zeolite synthesized from coal fly ash (X/CFA), which exhibited an exchangeable NH₄⁺ concentration and average decomposition energy comparable to those of commercial 13X, equal to 11,100 µmol NH₄⁺·g⁻¹ and 70 kJ·mol NH₃⁻¹, respectively. Overall, TDM represents a practical and reproducible method for the direct determination of the concentration of exchange-able NH₄⁺ ions in zeolites, which can be correlated with the concentration of Brønsted acid sites. The method also provides information on the energy associated with the thermal decomposition of NH₄⁺ and, through the proposed semi-empirical model, enables SAR estimation from the experimentally measured concentration of exchangeable NH₄⁺.

articles.title: Symmetry Protected Bound Excitons and Spin–Orbit Coupled Optical Response in Janus GeSO Monolayers
articles.abstract: We investigate the quasiparticle and excitonic properties of the dynamically and energetically stable Janus GeSO monolayer using a first-principles G0W0--Bethe--Salpeter-equation approach with two-dimensional Coulomb truncation. The relaxed monolayer is a direct-gap semiconductor with both band edges at Γ; the quasiparticle gap is 2.066 eV without spin--orbit coupling (SOC) and 2.065 eV with SOC, in contrast to the substantially underestimated PBE gaps of 0.60 and 0.56 eV, respectively. Electron--hole correlations generate a strongly bound, doubly degenerate bright exciton at 1.7468 eV without SOC, corresponding to a binding energy of 319.2 meV and an E-symmetry doublet of the C3v point group. A nearby bound but optically dark state occurs at 1.997 eV and transforms as A2, demonstrating that the bright--dark hierarchy is governed by crystal-symmetry selection rules. SOC leaves the quasiparticle gap nearly unchanged but qualitatively reorganizes the excitonic state: the bright doublet redshifts to 1.70200--1.70223 eV, its binding energy increases to approximately 363 meV, and its electron--hole amplitude is redistributed among four spinor transition channels with substantial triplet admixture. The oscillator strength of an individual lowest bright state is consequently reduced, reflecting redistribution rather than suppression of optical activity. Momentum-space analysis shows that the lowest exciton is predominantly localized around Γ, while the calculated spectra exhibit pronounced sub-gap excitonic absorption and higher-energy resonant features. These results establish Janus GeSO as a promising platform for symmetry-controlled and spinor-engineered excitonic optoelectronics and provide a general framework for distinguishing crystal-symmetry effects from SOC- and screening-induced exciton fine structure in oxide-containing Janus monolayers.

articles.title: High-performance supercapacitor electrode material based on anthraquinone organic molecules
articles.abstract: Organic electrode materials, with their high theoretical specific capacity, structural diversity, chemical tunability, low cost and environmental benignity, are consequently favorable candidates for electrochemical energy storage. Herein, we propose a 1-aminoanthraquinone (1-AAQ) based organic molecule electrode engineered to improve energy storage efficiency. Non-covalent π-π interactions enable the immobilization of 1-AAQ molecules onto reduced graphene oxide (rGO) in the system. With a specific capacitance of 327.7 F g− 1 (1 A g− 1), the optimized 1-AAQ-rGO composite maintains a capacitance of 81.5% after 10000 cycles, clearly demonstrating robust cycling performance. To construct an asymmetric supercapacitor (ASC), the positive electrode is fabricated by synergistically integrating benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b’]dithiophene-4,8-dione (BDTD) with rGO. The ASC based on 1-AAQ-rGO//BDTD-rGO operates at 1.4 V, delivering an energy density of 18.5 Wh kg− 1 at a power density of 700 W kg− 1.The device preserves 89% capacitance retained after 5000 cycles (5 A g− 1). Via empirical substantiation, two ASCs connected in series power 42 LED bulbs. Overall, this work highlights the role of π-π interactions in concurrently boosting capacitance and cyclability, providing a viable route for designing high-performance hybrid supercapacitors.

articles.title: Robust Single-Ended Fault Location in Double-Circuit Lines with Fault Topology Identification and Uncertainty Quantification
articles.abstract: Single-ended fault location on double-circuit transmission lines is complicated by the mutual coupling between the circuits, the remote-end infeed and the decaying dc component of the fault current. This paper proposes a method in which the fault distance and the fault path conductances are estimated jointly from the condition that the remote-bus voltages calculated through the two circuits of an exact six-conductor distributed-parameter model must be equal. Thirty-one fault types, including the faulted circuit, are fitted by a weighted Huber estimator and ranked by the Bayesian information criterion; faults that cannot be located from one end are detected, and confidence intervals are obtained by Monte Carlo propagation. The phasors are estimated by a two-cycle least-squares fit that includes the decaying dc term, and instrument transformer errors and time skew between channels are corrected. The method and a recent single-ended method were applied to the same waveforms of 1658 simulated faults on a 500 kV line of 150–400 km. For the 990 noise-free cases of the main study, the median error was 0.0014 % against 0.270 %, and the fault type was identified correctly for 99.5 % of the tested observable faults. With protection-class instrument transformer errors and certificate correction, the median error was 0.071 % against 0.237 %. The coverage of the 95 % confidence interval was 98.1–100 % in all case sets. Errors in the zero-sequence impedance, an inductive fault impedance and an uncorrected current-to-voltage time skew remain the main error sources.

articles.title: Secondary-Path-Compensated FxLMS Active Control of Milling Chatter in Thin-Walled Workpieces
articles.abstract: Thin-walled workpieces are vulnerable to narrow-band milling chatter because of their low local stiffness and time-varying structural dynamics. In a piezoelectric active-control system, the controller output reaches the acceleration measurement point through the piezoelectric controller, stack actuator, plate structure, and sensing chain. The gain, phase, and delay of this physical secondary path can bias the weight-update direction of a conventional least-mean-square (LMS) controller. This study therefore develops a filtered-x least-mean-square (FxLMS) method that uses an equivalent control-force-to-acceleration model as the secondary-path estimate to prefilter the reference signal. The method is implemented on a 6061 aluminium-alloy plate (300 mm × 300 mm × 4 mm) supported at its four corners with a piezoelectric stack actuator and one acceleration measurement channel. It is evaluated using an LMS/FxLMS simulation under identical conditions, offline simulations driven by measured milling signals, and comparative milling tests. With a total delay of 0.8 ms, LMS reduces the steady-state root-mean-square (RMS) response by 8.1% and amplifies the 558.857 Hz component, whereas FxLMS reduces the RMS response by 82.9% and attenuates both target components. In milling tests at 4000, 7000, and 10000 r/min, vibration amplitudes decrease by approximately 75.0%, 66.7%, and 50.0%, while arithmetic mean surface roughness (Ra) decreases by 65.6%, 53.6%, and 15.6%, respectively. The results indicate that secondary-path compensation provides a low-complexity, implementable route for active chatter suppression on the investigated thin-plate milling platform, while the reduced high-speed benefit identifies the limitation of a fixed secondary-path estimate.

articles.title: The influence of the coincidence coefficient between the grinding direction and the dressing direction on the grinding quality
articles.abstract: In grinding wheel dressing technology, it is important to improve the grinding force of the grinding wheel. In this paper, the dressing technology of current CBN grinding wheels is studied, and the hypothesis of the influence of grinding direction and dressing direction on grinding is proposed: "Under the same conditions, when the dressing direction of the grinding wheel is the same as the grinding direction, the grinding capacity of the grinding wheel is the strongest, i.e., the required grinding force is the smallest and the grinding wheel wear is the smallest." This hypothesis is verified by establishing the coefficient of overlap between the grinding direction and the dressing direction and by building the related mathematical model. It provides a new idea for the traditional surface grinding method: the moving direction of the table will change with the dressing direction and is no longer perpendicular to the spindle direction of the grinding wheel. Finally, based on the spatial grid theory, a theoretical model of the grinding surface is established, and the influence of the coincidence coefficient on the grinding surface is analyzed to guide surface grinding and to improve the grinding capacity of the grinding wheel.

articles.title: Fatigue Damage Prediction of Hot Rolling Work Rolls Considering Surface Degradation and Damage Redistribution
articles.abstract: Hot rolling work rolls are subjected to repeated thermal and mechanical loading, while oxidation and wear alter their surface conditions. This study investigates the effects of residual stress, oxide film evolution, and material removal on fatigue damage in hot rolling work rolls. Residual stresses generated during heat treatment are introduced into a thermomechanical rolling model to determine the local near-surface strain response. Oxide film growth and removal are described using a dynamic model, with predicted thicknesses compared against high-temperature sliding wear measurements. Fatigue damage is evaluated using the Manson-Coffin strain-life relationship and Miner’s linear damage rule. Measured roll surface recession and calculated oxide film thickness are used to update the metal-oxide interface position and track fatigue damage redistribution in the remaining material through successive rolling cycles. Initial residual stress increases the peak equivalent strain from 0.0049 to 0.0077 and changes the near-surface fatigue damage distribution. The calculated oxide thickness follows the overall experimental trend, although deviations occur at intermediate wear times. Material removal reduces retained fatigue damage, while changes in oxide film thickness affect its distribution through movement of the metal-oxide interface. Sensitivity analysis shows that wear depth has the greatest influence on retained fatigue damage, with coefficients ranging from − 0.82 to -0.85, followed by residual stress and oxidation. These findings support fatigue damage assessment of worn work rolls and may assist in determining suitable regrinding depths.

articles.title: Geopolymer-Bound Recycled Waste Glass Aggregate Composite Columns for Ground Improvement
articles.abstract: This paper presents a novel composite material with recycled waste glass aggregates bound by a geopolymer, developed by combining waste materials, for ground improvement. An extension of the Mohr-Coulomb constitutive model is proposed to simulate the experimentally observed behaviour of the geopolymer-bound recycled waste glass composite (GRWGC). A case study of soft ground reinforced with stone columns in Brazil was used to examine the effectiveness of the proposed methodology with glass aggregates as a substitute for conventional stone columns, where the long-term stability of unbound aggregate columns can be adversely affected by the low lateral confinement provided by the surrounding soft soil. Three-dimensional (3D) coupled mechanical and hydraulic finite element simulations were performed for both stone and proposed GRWGC columns. Significant reductions in settlements and lateral displacements were observed when GRWGC columns were used with the same spacing as in the case study. A 3D parametric study was conducted to investigate the performance of GRWGC column-supported embankments by varying the key design parameters and the performance of the proposed ground improvement method is evaluated by comparing: (i) stress concentration ratio, (ii) arching ratio, (iii) settlement (iv) differential settlement, (v) lateral displacement and (vi) geogrid tension. The impact of each key design parameter on the overall performance of GRWGC column-supported embankments is ranked using an influencing factor, which can be used as a design guideline for the proposed ground improvement method.

articles.title: Preparation and coherent control of toroidal moments in molecules
articles.abstract: Author(s): Kieran Hymas and Alessandro Soncini Molecular states hosting noncollinear vortex spin textures give rise to a fascinating yet elusive form of molecular toroidal magnetism that is notoriously challenging to prepare and detect. Here, the authors propose a multipulse EPR protocol for coherent toroidal polarisation and manipulation, with a readout scheme based on the magnetoelectric effect. They show that the resulting toroidal polarisation remains detectable even in the presence of decoherence and disorder, establishing a promising route toward the first experimental detection of molecular toroidal moments. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 274426] Published Wed Nov 18, 2026

articles.title: Tuning Cu/diamond interfacial thermal conductance via nitrogen-termination engineering
articles.abstract: Cu–diamond composites are recognized as promising high-thermal-conductivity candidates for electronic cooling, offering tunable properties and competitive cost. However, their performance is significantly limited by the poor Cu/diamond interfacial thermal conductance (ITC). Here, we propose a nitrogen-termination strategy to tune the ITC of Cu/diamond interfaces and unravel atomistic mechanisms by which nitride interlayers tailor phonon transport. Based on the MACE machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) framework, we fine-tune the pre-trained MACE-MPA-0 foundation model by incorporating customized C–N–Cu training datasets. Incorporating non-equilibrium molecular dynamics with MLIP-driven lattice dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that anharmonic effects contribute ∼60% to the ITC, and simply introducing N-termination on the diamond surface enhances the ITC by 10% compared to the bare Cu/diamond interface. However, the enhancement of harmonic phonon transmission contributes ∼80% of the ITC improvement. Mode-resolved phonon spectroscopy reveals that the LA phonons with frequencies above 4 THz and wavevectors near the Γ–X and Γ–U directions are selectively modulated by N-termination engineering. Analyses of local vibrational states and interfacial bonding further indicate that the N-termination on diamond tunes the interfacial heat conduction via surficial mass modification and chemical bonding regulation, as evidenced by variations in LDOS overlaps and COHP spectra. These findings open venues for tuning heat transfer across Cu/diamond interfaces via non-metallic modification—which avoids the graphitization issues associated with metallic coatings—and provide novel guidelines for upgrading the phonon-mediated heat transfer in Cu–diamond composites.

articles.title: Time-like Ribbon Frames and Magnetic Curves in Minkowski 3-Space: Killing Fields, Cyclotron Motion and Spin Precession
articles.abstract: Moving frames along curves turn the Lorentz force of a magnetic field into a short list of scalar equations, and in Minkowski space they also describe charged particles moving close to the speed of light. A ribbon frame suited to curves with inflection points has been proposed for time-like curves, but its equations were copied from the Euclidean case and do not preserve the Lorentzian metric. We derive the time-like ribbon frame from the Lorentzian cross product, characterize the three families of frame-adapted magnetic curves by necessary and sufficient conditions, and prove that the Darboux field is the only field that transports the whole frame. For Killing magnetic fields we obtain a closed scalar system with two first integrals, and we show that the curvature is fixed by position through a conserved charge. Numerical integrations confirm every identity to within about one part in a hundred billion, and they show that a radial electric field drives a trajectory to infinity in finite proper time with the predicted rate. Reading curvature and torsion as rest-frame electric and magnetic fields gives relativistic cyclotron and hyperbolic motion. Adding a spin vector yields a one-line angle equation that reproduces Thomas precession, the anomalous precession frequency of storage-ring experiments, the magic muon momentum of 3.094 GeV/c and the proton value of 0.7007 GeV/c. The framework therefore links the geometry of curves with spin dynamics in particle accelerators and gives a frame that stays well defined where Frenet methods fail. articles.title: How comonomer inclusion and/or exclusion determines the SSA thermal fractionation resolution of random copolycarbonates
articles.abstract: The structural segregation and thermal fractionation of two random aliphatic copolycarbonates, poly(hexamethylene- ran -octamethylene carbonate) (PC6/PC8) and poly(heptamethylene- ran -octamethylene carbonate) (PC7/PC8), were systematically investigated using Successive Self-nucleation and Annealing (SSA). These copolymers exhibit mixed isodimorphic/isomorphic crystallization: compositions rich in either parent component crystallize isodimorphically, with partial inclusion and exclusion of the minor comonomer from the host lattice, whereas intermediate compositions crystallize isomorphically within a common γ lattice. Samples were analyzed using both individualized and constant maximum ideal self-nucleation temperatures as the starting point of the SSA protocol. SSA calorimetric profiles and analysis of relative integrated endothermic areas reveal differences in fractionation resolution associated with the comonomer’s thermodynamic role within the crystal lattice. The neat homopolymers exhibit weak secondary melting fractions, with the dominant contribution concentrated in the highest-temperature melting peak. Introducing small amounts of randomly distributed comonomer markedly enhances fractionation in the isodimorphic region: exclusion of minor co-units disrupts crystallizable sequences, producing well-resolved lower-temperature fractions. By contrast, at intermediate compositions, co-crystallization within the common γ lattice eliminates crystal-excluded comonomer defects and reduces fractionation efficiency, yielding broader and less pronounced thermal fractions. Bubble maps summarize the melting-peak temperatures and relative endothermic contributions across composition, complementing the differences in fractionation resolution observed in the SSA calorimetic traces. Combined with independent structural characterization, SSA provides complementary thermal evidence for distinguishing isodimorphic and locally isomorphic crystallization modes.

articles.title: The polymer physics of kinetoplast DNA as a polymerized membrane
articles.abstract: We analyze the conformational and dynamical properties of the kinetoplast DNA (kDNA), a massive sheet-like structure made from thousands of circular DNA molecules, found in the mitochondrion of certain parasites. The connectivity between circular DNA molecules is achieved by topological linking; hence, the kDNA may be regarded as a naturally occurring two-dimensional version of Olympic gels, whose physical properties are yet to be understood. We propose that the basic aspects of the large-scale behaviors of kDNA could be described by the physics of polymerized membranes. Our analysis indicates the relevance of the hydrodynamic interactions in the dynamics of kDNA in aqueous solution. We demonstrate that the predicted dynamical scaling scenario captures various experimental data recently obtained from in vitro imaging experiments in a unified manner. We also provide an estimate for the in-plane elastic modulus of kDNA, whose magnitude agrees well with recent measurements.

articles.title: Nonlinear quantum master equations from time-dependent projectors
articles.abstract: Simulations of the dynamics of open quantum systems often rely on various quantum master equations (QMEs). Many different forms of such equations have been developed, usually using the projection superoperator formalism. Even though time-independent projectors are used most often, the application of time-dependent projectors, which could account for the evolution of the bath state in the relevant part of the full system, is theoretically attractive. In this work, we investigate a specific form of the time-dependent projector and derive general expressions, valid for any choice of the perturbation, for second-order QMEs, which turn out to be nonlinear in the reduced density operator of the system. Closed-form expressions are derived for the cases when the electronic–vibrational interaction or the intermolecular interaction is taken as a perturbation. We perform numerical calculations and benchmark the nonlinear QMEs against the exact hierarchical equations of motion, as well as against the linear QMEs, resulting from the usual time-independent projector. Rather surprisingly, the nonlinear terms provide only very small corrections to the density operator evolution. This leads us to speculate that going beyond the mean-field dynamics of the bath, and thus, beyond the second-order QME, could be needed to fully reveal the possible effects of the time-dependent projector.

articles.title: Length-scale dependence of collective time reparameterization in swap dynamics
articles.abstract: Swap Monte Carlo dramatically accelerates the equilibration of deeply supercooled liquids while preserving the equilibrium Boltzmann distribution. Recent work has argued that swap and other accelerated algorithms act by reparameterizing time: different dynamics follow the same slow relaxation process, but with different clocks. Here, we test this idea in a continuously polydisperse glass former. We confirm that mean collective overlaps satisfy an approximate time reparameterization, in agreement with earlier results. However, the associated clock depends systematically on the collective probe length and on the relaxation stage. Thus, the observed collective collapse does not define a unique, observable-independent material time. Over the numerically accessible α -relaxation regime, swap changes not only the rate of relaxation but also its length-scale dependence. The resulting collective reparameterization is, therefore, only approximate and does not establish an exact dynamical equivalence between swap and reference relaxation.

articles.title: Competitive adsorption of aminomethylphosphonic acid and phosphate on 6-line ferrihydrite: Experimental and surface complexation modeling study
articles.abstract: Aminomethylphosphonic acid (AMPA) is a persistent degradation product of various organophosphonates. Its environmental transport is regulated not only by adsorption onto metal (hydr)oxides in soils and sediments but also by competitive interactions with phosphate. In this study, competitive batch adsorption experiments of AMPA and phosphate were conducted on synthetic 6-line ferrihydrite over a pH range of 3.5-10.5 and initial concentrations ranging from 0.130 to 1.07 mM to systematically investigate their adsorption behavior at the ferrihydrite-water interface. The adsorption edge data were interpreted using the charge distribution (CD)-MUSIC model to derive the corresponding intrinsic equilibrium constants. By accounting for both surface electrostatic interactions and chemical affinity, the model successfully predicted the competitive adsorption behavior of AMPA and phosphate. The adsorption of AMPA on ferrihydrite was dominated by three surface complexes: a bidentate binuclear complex (B), a protonated bidentate binuclear complex (BH), and a protonated monodentate mononuclear complex (MH), with intrinsic equilibrium constants (log K) of 27.9 ± 0.10, 25.2 ± 0.10, and 17.1 ± 0.1, respectively. Within the investigated concentration range, the presence of phosphate reduced the adsorption of AMPA on ferrihydrite by 4.0%-25%. Compared with phosphate, AMPA exhibited a substantially stronger affinity for the ferrihydrite surface, with the maximum adsorbed amount reaching 1.69 times that of phosphate under identical initial concentrations. The adsorption behavior in the competitive system was governed by the coupled effects of competitive inhibition and surface electrostatic promotion rather than by direct competition alone. Consequently, the adsorption percentages of both species were not determined solely by their initial concentrations, resulting in enhanced mobility of AMPA in competitive systems. This study provides a quantitative description of AMPA adsorption on ferrihydrite based on the CD-MUSIC model and offers mechanistic insights and thermodynamic parameters for predicting the environmental fate and transport of organophosphonates.

articles.title: A spline representation of material properties for laminates, with application to classical laminate theory
articles.abstract: The presented work proposes a continuous spline-based representation for the material properties through laminates. A continuous representation is useful when material properties vary over a finite region. The spline representation is applied for classical laminate theory (CLT) to calculate the extensional, coupling, and bending stiffness matrices. Within the laminate, adjacent constitutive states are connected through smooth transitions defined by arithmetic interpolation with a cubic polynomial blending function. This produces a continuously differentiable stiffness field with prescribed transition widths. Explicit expressions are derived for the differences between the spline formulation and the corresponding laminate with sharp interfaces, allowing both symmetric and asymmetric transitions. Symmetric transitions preserve extensional stiffness exactly, while coupling and bending stiffness generally differ. On the other hand, asymmetric transitions can modify all three stiffness matrices. The representation recovers the sharp interface description, as seen in CLT, when the transition widths tend to zero. This provides a framework for assessing how assumed stiffness gradients can influence laminate response. The presented representation's transition widths should be based on the material properties, physical limitations, and/or manufacturing process.

articles.title: Day-Ahead Forecasting of Sunshine and Wind for a Dust- and Heat- Prone Hyper-Arid Mini-Grid: Machine Learning against Persistence and SARIMA at Agadez, Bilma and N'Guigmi, Niger (2015-2024) A real-data benchmark with regime-aware features, cross-site transfer and conformal calibration
articles.title_zh: 易灰尘和高温的超干旱迷你电网的日照和风力预报：尼日尔阿加德兹、比尔马和恩吉格米的针对持久性和 SARIMA 的机器学习（2015-2024）具有状态感知功能、跨站点传输和共形校准的真实数据基准
articles.abstract: Sizing a mini-grid well still leaves open how to run it the next morning. Using the quality-controlled 2015–2024 record of three Nigerien stations (Agadez, Bilma, N'Guigmi), we forecast daily sunshine one to seven days ahead and 3-hourly wind speed three to 72 hours ahead with gradient boosting (HGB) and a compact neural network against persistence and SARIMA, training on 2015–2022, testing on 2023–2024, and confirming the comparison over six rolling years (2019–2024). Both beat persistence by a wide margin (RMSE skill 18–49 percent for wind, 15–30 percent for sunshine), but the margin over SARIMA is thin and site-dependent: HGB beats SARIMA for wind at every lead at Agadez in 2023–2024, though it narrows over the rolling years, is most consistent at Bilma, and is not significant at N'Guigmi. Heat-stress and wind-regime features change RMSE by about 1 percent or less for wind and up to 5.4 percent for sunshine, short of the hypothesised Harmattan gain; cross-site pooling lowers Agadez's 24-h wind RMSE by 3.1 percent when data are scarce. Raw quantile forecasts at Agadez are miscalibrated (67–72 percent coverage for nominal 80 percent intervals); conformal recalibration improves this to 76–82 percent but drifts across years. For an illustrative 100 kWp PV plus 30 kW wind plant, a better forecast lowers the CVaR95 battery buffer at Agadez from 342 to 235 kWh, narrowed further by propagating wind quantiles through the power curve. The gains are real but modest, site-dependent, and the honest measure of what an operator can count on tomorrow.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定迷你电网的规模后，第二天早上如何运行它仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。利用尼日尔三个站（Agadez、Bilma、N'Guigmi）的 2015-2024 年质量控制记录，我们利用梯度增强 (HGB) 和对抗持久性和 SARIMA 的紧凑神经网络，提前 1 至 7 天预测每日日照，并提前 3 至 72 小时预测 3 小时风速，在 2015-2022 年进行训练，在 2023-2024 年进行测试，并确认六个滚动的比较年（2019-2024）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定迷你电网的规模后，第二天早上如何运行它仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。利用尼日尔三个站（Agadez、Bilma、N'Guigmi）的 2015-2024 年质量控制记录，我们利用梯度增强 (HGB) 和对抗持久性和 SARIMA 的紧凑神经网络，提前 1 至 7 天预测每日日照，并提前 3 至 72 小时预测 3 小时风速，在 2015-2022 年进行训练，在 2023-2024 年进行测试，并确认六个滚动的比较年（2019-2024）。两者都大幅领先于持久性（风力的 RMSE 技能为 18-49%，阳光的 RMSE 技能为 15-30%），但相对于 SARIMA 的差距很小，并且取决于地点：2023-2024 年，HGB 在阿加德兹的每个领先位置上都击败了 SARIMA，尽管在滚动年份中差距缩小，但在 Bilma 最为一致，而在 N'Guigmi 并不显着。热应力和风况特征使风的 RMSE 变化约 1% 或更少，对阳光的变化高达 5.4%，低于假设的 Harmattan 增益；当数据稀缺时，跨站点池化会将 Agadez 的 24 小时风 RMSE 降低 3.1%。 Agadez 的原始分位数预测校准错误（名义 80% 区间的覆盖率为 67-72%）；保形重新校准将这一比例提高到 76-82%，但多年来会出现漂移。对于示例性的 100 kWp 光伏加 30 kW 风力发电厂，更好的预测是将阿加德兹的 CVaR95 电池缓冲从 342 kWh 降低到 235 kWh，通过在功率曲线上传播风分位数进一步缩小。收益是真实的，但适度，取决于地点，并且是运营商明天可以指望的诚实衡量标准。

articles.title: Supply Chain Disruption Risk and Credit Spead of Corporate Bond
articles.title_zh: 供应链中断风险与公司债券信用利差
articles.abstract: Supply chain disruptions have emerged as a major source of firm-level operational risk, yet their pricing implications in corporate bonds remain insufficiently understood. Using a comprehensive text-based measure of supply chain disruption risk constructed from firm-level disclosures and a large panel of transaction-level bond data in China, this paper provides systematic evidence that supply chain disruption risk significantly increases corporate bond credit spreads. Results remain robust to a battery of endogeneity and extensive robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that supply chain disruption risk increases credit spread by deteriorating firms’ operational efficiency and impairing solvency. These effects are amplified among bonds with longer maturities and lower credit ratings, non-state-owned enterprises, manufacturing firms, and firms with concentrated or opaque supply chains. Moreover, our results document strong upstream and downstream spillover effects: disruption risks originating from suppliers and customers propagate through supply chain networks and significantly elevate credit spreads for connected firms. Overall, our findings shed new light on the financial consequences of supply chain disruption risk and offer policy implications for risk management, disclosure regulation, and macro-financial stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 供应链中断已成为公司层面运营风险的主要来源，但其对公司债券定价的影响仍未被充分理解。本文利用基于公司层面披露和中国大量交易层面债券数据构建的供应链中断风险综合文本衡量标准，提供了供应链中断风险显着增加公司债券信用利差的系统证据。结果对于一系列内生性和广泛的稳健性测试仍然稳健。机制分析表明，供应链中断风险会降低企业的运营效率并损害偿付能力，从而增加信用利差。这些影响在期限较长、信用评级较低的债券、非国有企业、制造企业以及供应链集中或不透明的企业中被放大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 供应链中断已成为公司层面运营风险的主要来源，但其对公司债券定价的影响仍未被充分理解。本文利用基于公司层面披露和中国大量交易层面债券数据构建的供应链中断风险综合文本衡量标准，提供了供应链中断风险显着增加公司债券信用利差的系统证据。结果对于一系列内生性和广泛的稳健性测试仍然稳健。机制分析表明，供应链中断风险会降低企业的运营效率并损害偿付能力，从而增加信用利差。这些影响在期限较长、信用评级较低的债券、非国有企业、制造企业以及供应链集中或不透明的企业中被放大。此外，我们的结果证明了强大的上游和下游溢出效应：来自供应商和客户的破坏风险通过供应链网络传播，并显着提高了关联公司的信用利差。总体而言，我们的研究结果为供应链中断风险的财务后果提供了新的视角，并为风险管理、信息披露监管和宏观金融稳定提供了政策启示。

articles.title: Quantum simulation of open systems with bounded jump activity
articles.title_zh: 具有有界跳跃活动的开放系统的量子模拟
articles.abstract: Open quantum systems can accumulate a large dissipative action while undergoing few quantum jumps. General simulation bounds based on generator strength and evolution time do not distinguish such dynamics from sustained activity. Here we show that a supplied activity bound reduces the quantum query cost without requiring the intervening evolution to commute. With coherent access to Hamiltonian and jump factors, fixed accuracy and bounded activity give square root dependence on dissipative normalization action. Matching lower bounds hold for the reduced channel under the same oracle model. The construction extends to certified jump tails and gives a normalization-one encoding of a noncommuting accretive propagator without an activity assumption. Explicit bounds account for additional circuit, precision and discretization costs. These results identify jump activity as a resource for simulating absorption, finite excitation loss and weakly repumped dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子系统可以积累大量的耗散作用，同时经历很少的量子跃迁。基于发电机强度和演化时间的一般模拟界限无法区分这种动态与持续活动。在这里，我们展示了提供的活动范围降低了量子查询成本，而不需要干预进化来通勤。通过对哈密顿量和跳跃因子的一致访问，固定精度和有界活动给出了对耗散归一化作用的平方根依赖性。在相同的预言机模型下，匹配下限适用于缩减通道。该结构扩展到经过认证的跳尾，并在没有活动假设的情况下给出非交换增殖传播器的标准化一编码。显式边界会带来额外的电路、精度和离散化成本。

articles.title: Federated mutual learning enables consistent hierarchical sorting of retired batteries across heterogeneous testing nodes
articles.title_zh: 联合相互学习可以跨异构测试节点对退役电池进行一致的分层排序
articles.abstract: Accurate sorting is a prerequisite for the echelon utilization of retired power batteries, yet testing data are scattered across geographically distributed nodes that cannot share raw data, and the incoming battery populations differ substantially among nodes, i.e. the data are non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID). Here we propose a hierarchical sorting method based on federated mutual learning. Each node builds a local hierarchical model that combines prior-feature clustering with cluster-wise decision trees; model-output knowledge is exchanged through a shared unlabeled reference set, and distribution-discrepancy weighting together with confidence filtering enables bidirectional knowledge transfer without raw data leaving any node. Validation on 1,080 simulated retired batteries across four non-IID nodes shows that the global average sorting accuracy reaches 91.10%, 12.83 percentage points above local training alone, with a cross-node consistency of 97.13%; across 11 random-seed repeats the average accuracy is 90.17% ± 2.53%. The proposed method improves sorting accuracy and cross-node consistency under heterogeneous multi-node conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确排序是退役动力电池梯次利用的前提，但测试数据分散在不同地理位置的节点上，无法共享原始数据，节点间入库电池群体差异较大，即数据非独立同分布（非IID）。在这里，我们提出了一种基于联邦互学习的层次排序方法。每个节点构建一个本地分层模型，将先验特征聚类与聚类决策树相结合；模型输出知识通过共享的未标记参考集进行交换，分布差异加权与置信度过滤一起实现双向知识传输，而无需原始数据离开任何节点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确排序是退役动力电池梯次利用的前提，但测试数据分散在不同地理位置的节点上，无法共享原始数据，节点间入库电池群体差异较大，即数据非独立同分布（非IID）。在这里，我们提出了一种基于联邦互学习的层次排序方法。每个节点构建一个本地分层模型，将先验特征聚类与聚类决策树相结合；模型输出知识通过共享的未标记参考集进行交换，分布差异加权与置信度过滤一起实现双向知识传输，而无需原始数据离开任何节点。在四个非 IID 节点上对 1,080 个模拟退役电池进行验证表明，全局平均分选准确率达到 91.10%，比仅本地训练高出 12.83 个百分点，跨节点一致性达到 97.13%； 11 次随机种子重复的平均准确度为 90.17% ± 2.53%。该方法提高了异构多节点条件下的排序精度和跨节点一致性。

articles.title: Performance improvement of Cd-free CIGS Solar Cells Using ZnS Buffer Layers Prepared by Solvothermal Routes: Experimental and Device Simulation
articles.title_zh: 使用溶剂热路线制备的 ZnS 缓冲层提高无镉 CIGS 太阳能电池的性能：实验和器件模拟
articles.abstract: In this work, we investigate the synthesis and characterization of the ZnS layer as an alternative Cd-free buffer layer for Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS) thin film solar cells, The ZnS nanopowders were successfully prepared via solvothermal method, then employed to fabricate thin films deposited by rf-magnetron sputtering. Their structural, morphological and optical characterizations were performed. In addition, these experimental data obtained were further implemented in numerical simulations of a p-CIGS/n-ZnS heterojunction using SCAPS-1D. The impact of different buffer layer materials CdS and ZnS on the performance of CIGS solar cells was thoroughly compared and analyzed. The obtained results demonstrate that, the films crystallize in the cubic phase with grain sizes ranging from 4 to 20 nm and exhibiting high transparency (> 90%), with a tunable band gap in the range of 3.68 to 3.8 eV. The tuning of the deposition conditions allows ZnS to achieve proper band alignment with the CIGS absorber. The optimized structure revealed that, both the buffer material and their thickness significantly influence the overall device performance. The substitution of the conventional CdS buffer with ZnS this possesses a wider bandgap, resulted in lower conversion efficiency due to unfavorable energy band alignment at the interface. To overcome this limitation and enhance short-wavelength absorption, a novel CdS/ZnS double buffer layer structure was proposed. The optimization of this configuration improved the cell efficiency from 22.62% to 24.68%. These results indicate the potential of ZnS-based buffers as promising and environmentally friendly alternatives for high efficiency CIGS solar cells.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了 ZnS 层的合成和表征，作为 Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS) 薄膜太阳能电池的替代无镉缓冲层，通过溶剂热法成功制备了 ZnS 纳米粉末，然后用于通过射频磁控溅射沉积薄膜。对它们的结构、形态和光学特征进行了表征。此外，获得的这些实验数据进一步在使用 SCAPS-1D 的 p-CIGS/n-ZnS 异质结的数值模拟中得到应用。深入比较和分析了不同缓冲层材料CdS和ZnS对CIGS太阳能电池性能的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了 ZnS 层的合成和表征，作为 Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS) 薄膜太阳能电池的替代无镉缓冲层，通过溶剂热法成功制备了 ZnS 纳米粉末，然后用于通过射频磁控溅射沉积薄膜。对它们的结构、形态和光学特征进行了表征。此外，获得的这些实验数据进一步在使用 SCAPS-1D 的 p-CIGS/n-ZnS 异质结的数值模拟中得到应用。深入比较和分析了不同缓冲层材料CdS和ZnS对CIGS太阳能电池性能的影响。结果表明，薄膜以立方相结晶，晶粒尺寸为4~20 nm，具有高透明度（>90%），带隙可调范围为3.68~3.8 eV。沉积条件的调整使得 ZnS 能够与 CIGS 吸收剂实现适当的能带对准。优化的结构表明，缓冲材料及其厚度都会显着影响整体器件性能。用具有更宽带隙的 ZnS 代替传统的 CdS 缓冲剂，由于界面处的能带排列不利，导致转换效率较低。为了克服这一限制并增强短波长吸收，提出了一种新型的CdS/ZnS双缓冲层结构。该配置的优化将电池效率从22.62%提高到24.68%。这些结果表明基于 ZnS 的缓冲剂作为高效 CIGS 太阳能电池的有前途且环保的替代品的潜力。

articles.title: Entanglement Redistribution in anAtom–Plasmon–Mechanical System with ModulatedCoupling
articles.title_zh: 具有调制耦合的原子-等离子体-机械系统中的纠缠重新分布
articles.abstract: We investigate how a mechanical degree of freedom modifies entanglement generated bycoherent atom–mode exchange. The model contains a two-level atom, one effective plas-monic bosonic mode, and a mechanical oscillator. Atom–mode exchange follows a prescribedstanding-wave modulation, while the mechanical oscillator experiences an occupation-dependentforce. Starting from a separable atomic superposition and two coherent states, we propagatethe full state and evaluate the negativity of each reduced pair. In the reference calculation(0 ≤ ωmt ≤ 30), the sampled atom–mode, atom–mechanics, and mode–mechanics maxima are0.466, 0.0920, and 0.263, attained at different times. Parameter sweeps show that a changewhich raises a short-lived maximum may lower the time-window average; stronger mechani-cal coupling, in particular, has a much clearer effect on the pairs involving the oscillator thanon the mean atom–mode negativity. The atomic inversion, purity, and von Neumann entropysupply complementary information about the atom versus the remaining two subsystems. A17-point initial-phase scan gives mean atomic entropies between 0.4456 and 0.7017 bits withunchanged Hamiltonian parameters. Basis-size and integration-step comparisons test numericalconsistency. Because atomic detuning and a Zeeman-type shift appear through one effectiveoffset, they are not independent controls in this model. These results characterize finite-time,unitary dynamics of a single effective mode, not microscopic plasma response or entanglementrobustness in a dissipative device.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究机械自由度如何改变相干原子模式交换产生的纠缠。该模型包含一个两级原子、一种有效的等离激元玻色子模式和一个机械振荡器。原子模式交换遵循规定的驻波调制，而机械振荡器则经历依赖于占据的力。从可分离的原子叠加和两个相干态开始，我们传播全态并评估每个简化对的负性。在参考计算中（0≤ωmt≤30），采样的原子模式、原子力学和模式力学最大值分别为0.466、0.0920和0.263，在不同时间获得。参数扫描表明，提高短期最大值的变化可能会降低时间窗口平均值；
authors: S. Abdul Khalek S. Abdul Khalek
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究机械自由度如何改变相干原子模式交换产生的纠缠。该模型包含一个两级原子、一种有效的等离激元玻色子模式和一个机械振荡器。原子模式交换遵循规定的驻波调制，而机械振荡器则经历依赖于占据的力。从可分离的原子叠加和两个相干态开始，我们传播全态并评估每个简化对的负性。在参考计算中（0≤ωmt≤30），采样的原子模式、原子力学和模式力学最大值分别为0.466、0.0920和0.263，在不同时间获得。参数扫描表明，提高短期最大值的变化可能会降低时间窗口平均值；特别是，更强的机械耦合对涉及振荡器的对的影响比对平均原子模式负性的影响要明显得多。原子反转、纯度和冯·诺依曼熵提供了有关原子与其余两个子系统的互补信息。在哈密顿参数不变的情况下，17 点初始阶段扫描给出的平均原子熵在 0.4456 到 0.7017 位之间。基础大小和积分步骤比较测试数值一致性。由于原子失谐和塞曼型位移是通过一个有效偏移出现的，因此它们在此模型中不是独立的控制。这些结果表征了单一有效模式的有限时间、统一动力学，而不是耗散装置中的微观等离子体响应或纠缠鲁棒性。

articles.title: Structure–reactivity relationships in IBX-mediated alcohol oxidation: Insights from DFT and machine learning
