articles.title: Ultrastrong coupling between magnetoplasmons and higher cyclotron-resonance harmonics induced by spatially inhomogeneous electromagnetic fields in two-dimensional electron systems
articles.title_zh: 二维电子系统中空间不均匀电磁场引起的磁等离子与高回旋共振谐波之间的超强耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-wave-vector electromagnetic fields provide a route to accessing nonlocal collective dynamics in two-dimensional electron systems. Here, we theoretically investigate the magnetoplasmon response of a two-dimensional electron system subjected to a spatially nonuniform electromagnetic field in a perpendicular magnetic field. By combining Maxwell's equations with the Kubo formula, we derive the nonlocal magnetoconductivity tensor and obtain the self-consistent dispersion relation for collective modes. We show that a finite in-plane wave vector enables higher-order cyclotron transitions, allowing higher harmonics of the cyclotron resonance to contribute to the nonlocal conductivity. These harmonics hybridize with the magnetoplasmon mode, producing avoided crossings in the collective-mode spectrum characteristic of Bernstein modes. To quantify this hybridization, we establish a correspondence between the Maxwell-Kubo dispersion relation and a Hopfield-type Hamiltonian and derive an analytical expression for the effective coupling strength between the magnetoplasmon and the n-th cyclotron-resonance harmonic. Our analysis reveals that the normalized coupling strength exhibits a nonmonotonic dependence on the in-plane wavelength, reaching a maximum that becomes nearly independent of electron density in the high-density regime. These results establish a quantitative connection between nonlocal magnetoconductivity, Bernstein-mode physics, and effective collective-mode coupling, providing design guidelines for realizing ultrastrong coupling in terahertz magnetoplasmonic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限波矢量电磁场提供了一种获取二维电子系统中非局域集体动力学的途径。在这里，我们从理论上研究了二维电子系统在垂直磁场中受到空间不均匀电磁场的磁等离子响应。通过结合麦克斯韦方程组和Kubo公式，我们推导了非局域磁导张量，并获得了集体模式的自洽色散关系。我们证明，有限的面内波矢量能够实现高阶回旋加速器跃迁，从而允许回旋加速器共振的高次谐波有助于非局域电导率。这些谐波与磁等离子模式混合，避免了伯恩斯坦模式的集体模式频谱特征的交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限波矢量电磁场提供了一种获取二维电子系统中非局域集体动力学的途径。在这里，我们从理论上研究了二维电子系统在垂直磁场中受到空间不均匀电磁场的磁等离子响应。通过结合麦克斯韦方程组和Kubo公式，我们推导了非局域磁导张量，并获得了集体模式的自洽色散关系。我们证明，有限的面内波矢量能够实现高阶回旋加速器跃迁，从而允许回旋加速器共振的高次谐波有助于非局域电导率。这些谐波与磁等离子模式混合，避免了伯恩斯坦模式的集体模式频谱特征的交叉。为了量化这种杂化，我们建立了 Maxwell-Kubo 色散关系和 Hopfield 型哈密顿量之间的对应关系，并推导了磁等离子激元和第 n 次回旋共振谐波之间的有效耦合强度的解析表达式。我们的分析表明，归一化耦合强度表现出对面内波长的非单调依赖性，达到最大值，几乎与高密度区域中的电子密度无关。这些结果在非局域磁导性、伯恩斯坦模式物理和有效集体模式耦合之间建立了定量联系，为在太赫兹磁等离子体系统中实现超强耦合提供了设计指南。

articles.title: A Universal Algebraic Construction of Hilbert-Space Fragmentation
articles.title_zh: 希尔伯特空间破碎的通用代数构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a mechanism for obtaining Hilbert-space fragmentation from arbitrary quantum lattice Hamiltonians acting on finite-dimensional local spaces. We first express the Hamiltonian in an algebraic form using supersymmetry (SUSY) and parasupersymmetry (paraSUSY) generators. Enlarging their representations defines a lifting procedure, which we study in two forms, site-wise and bond-wise lifting. Site-wise lifting introduces immobile zero modes that generate exponentially many invariant sectors while retaining the original dynamics in the fully active sector. We determine the sector structure and establish strong fragmentation for uniform lifts at fixed intermediate zero-mode density. For nearest-neighbor chains, correlation functions reveal restricted propagation and, in the mixed-field example, persistent local memory. Bond-wise lifting produces mobile conserved strings, pair-flip dynamics and fluctuating dimers, and extends to fragmented unitary circuits. Different representations and embeddings realize different fragmentation mechanisms. Some of the fragmented models obtained by this method include lifted permutation and Ising spin chains, a lifted toric code, the (XXC) families of spin chains, and fragmented extensions derived from the integrable (H₁,₁₁) and (H₁,₃) seed densities. The last two models are derived from Hietarinta's classification of constant 4× 4 Yang-Baxter solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种从作用于有限维局部空间的任意量子晶格哈密顿量获得希尔伯特空间碎片的机制。我们首先使用超对称（SUSY）和副超对称（paraSUSY）生成器以代数形式表达哈密顿量。扩大它们的表示定义了一个提升程序，我们以两种形式进行研究，即位点提升和键向提升。逐点提升引入了固定零模式，可生成指数级数量的不变扇区，同时保留完全活跃扇区中的原始动态。我们确定扇区结构并在固定的中间零模密度下建立均匀升力的强碎片。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种从作用于有限维局部空间的任意量子晶格哈密顿量获得希尔伯特空间碎片的机制。我们首先使用超对称（SUSY）和副超对称（paraSUSY）生成器以代数形式表达哈密顿量。扩大它们的表示定义了一个提升程序，我们以两种形式进行研究，即位点提升和键向提升。逐点提升引入了固定零模式，可生成指数级数量的不变扇区，同时保留完全活跃扇区中的原始动态。我们确定扇区结构并在固定的中间零模密度下建立均匀升力的强碎片。对于最近邻链，相关函数揭示了受限的传播，在混合场示例中，揭示了持久的本地记忆。键向提升产生移动保守弦、配对翻转动力学和波动二聚体，并延伸到碎片化的单一电路。不同的表示和嵌入实现了不同的分片机制。通过这种方法获得的一些碎片模型包括提升排列和伊辛自旋链、提升复曲面码、自旋链的 (XXC) 系列以及从可积 (H₁,₁) 和 (H₁,₃) 种子密度导出的碎片扩展。最后两个模型源自 Hietarinta 对常数 4×4 Yang-Baxter 解的分类。

articles.title: Bright-Dark State Interplay Governs Vibronic Decoherence in Molecular Aggregates
articles.title_zh: 明暗态相互作用控制分子聚集体中的振动退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we establish a spectroscopy-driven framework that connects optically bright vibronic eigenstates to their subsequent decoherence dynamics in excitonic molecular aggregates. Combining the Multiparticle Holstein Formalism with explicit system--bath interactions, we demonstrate that relaxation-induced purity loss is governed by three interconnected factors: (i) the bath spectral window, which determines the accessibility of intra- and interband relaxation pathways; (ii) the local network of dark vibronic states surrounding the optically prepared bright state; and (iii) the energetic placement of the bright state, which controls downhill relaxation. Remarkably, states with different excitation energies exhibit nearly identical purity dynamics when their local relaxation networks are similar. The resulting H--J asymmetry further reveals the importance of energetic directionality. These findings establish a reliable connection between optical spectroscopy, vibronic band structure, and state-selective loss in purity.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们建立了一个光谱驱动的框架，将光学明亮的振动本征态与其随后在激子分子聚集体中的退相干动力学连接起来。将多粒子荷斯坦形式主义与显式系统-浴相互作用相结合，我们证明了弛豫引起的纯度损失受三个相互关联的因素控制：（i）浴光谱窗口，它决定带内和带间弛豫路径的可及性； (ii) 围绕光学准备的亮态的暗电子振动态的局部网络； (iii) 明亮状态的能量位置，控制下坡放松。值得注意的是，当局部弛豫网络相似时，具有不同激发能的态表现出几乎相同的纯度动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项研究中，我们建立了一个光谱驱动的框架，将光学明亮的振动本征态与其随后在激子分子聚集体中的退相干动力学连接起来。将多粒子荷斯坦形式主义与显式系统-浴相互作用相结合，我们证明了弛豫引起的纯度损失受三个相互关联的因素控制：（i）浴光谱窗口，它决定带内和带间弛豫路径的可及性； (ii) 围绕光学准备的亮态的暗电子振动态的局部网络； (iii) 明亮状态的能量位置，控制下坡放松。值得注意的是，当局部弛豫网络相似时，具有不同激发能的态表现出几乎相同的纯度动力学。由此产生的 H-J 不对称性进一步揭示了能量方向性的重要性。这些发现在光谱学、电子振动能带结构和纯度的状态选择性损失之间建立了可靠的联系。

articles.title: A Neural Density Functional for Spatial Structure and Orientational Ordering in Two-Dimensional Lattice Hard Rods
articles.title_zh: 二维晶格硬棒中空间结构和方向排序的神经密度泛函
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study spatial structure and orientational ordering of horizontal and vertical hard rods on a two-dimensional square lattice using neural classical density functional theory. We construct two convolutional architectures that exploit the symmetry relating the rod orientations: a direct-c⁽¹⁾ network (learning the map between the first functional derivative of the excess free energy and the inhomogeneous density, c⁽¹⁾ ↔ ρ) and a Φ-network (learning directly the map between free energy and density, F_ex ↔ ρ). Both networks use exactly the same inhomogeneous grand-canonical Monte Carlo density profiles and one-body direct correlation targets. Both neural representations substantially improve the predicted density profiles relative to the Lafuente--Cuesta lattice functional. The resulting free energy landscapes, however, differ between the two representations. Furthermore for the direct-c⁽¹⁾ network the integration along different density paths produces different free energies. As a result, the transition to nematic ordering for rods with aspect ratio 8 is strongly first order for the direct-c⁽¹⁾ network while only weakly discontinuous for the Φ-network. The latter is a reasonable approximation to the continuous transition found in simulations, demonstrating that subtle entropic free energy differences are accessible in neural cDFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用神经经典密度泛函理论研究二维方格上水平和垂直硬棒的空间结构和方向排序。我们构建了两个利用与杆方向相关的对称性的卷积架构：直接 c⁽1⁾ 网络（学习多余自由能的一阶函数导数与非均匀密度 c⁽1⁾ ↔ ρ 之间的映射）和 Φ 网络（直接学习自由能与密度之间的映射 F_ex ↔ ρ）。两个网络都使用完全相同的非均匀大正则蒙特卡罗密度分布和单体直接相关目标。相对于 Lafuente-Cuesta 晶格泛函，两种神经表示都显着改善了预测的密度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用神经经典密度泛函理论研究二维方格上水平和垂直硬棒的空间结构和方向排序。我们构建了两个利用与杆方向相关的对称性的卷积架构：直接 c⁽1⁾ 网络（学习多余自由能的一阶函数导数与非均匀密度 c⁽1⁾ ↔ ρ 之间的映射）和 Φ 网络（直接学习自由能与密度之间的映射 F_ex ↔ ρ）。两个网络都使用完全相同的非均匀大正则蒙特卡罗密度分布和单体直接相关目标。相对于 Lafuente-Cuesta 晶格泛函，两种神经表示都显着改善了预测的密度分布。然而，两种表示形式所产生的自由能景观有所不同。此外，对于直接 c⁽1⁾ 网络，沿不同密度路径的积分会产生不同的自由能。因此，对于长宽比为 8 的棒，向列有序的转变对于直接 c⁽1⁾ 网络来说是强一阶的，而对于 Φ 网络来说只是弱不连续的。后者是模拟中发现的连续转变的合理近似，证明神经 cDFT 中可以访问微妙的熵自由能差异。

articles.title: Tracking gas-solid hydration kinetics by non-contact in situ transflection micro-FTIR spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 通过非接触式原位透射反射显微 FTIR 光谱跟踪气固水合动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gas--solid reaction kinetics is important in applications such as thermochemical heat storage (TCHS), but experimental evaluation remains a bottleneck in materials development. This study evaluates non-contact in situ transflection micro-Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy for tracking hydration reactions between water vapor and inorganic solids. Powder layers of La₂(SO₄)₃, CaSO₄, and CaO, exhibiting different hydration mechanisms and kinetics, were deposited on an Au-coated glass substrate and exposed to humidified N₂. Evolution of water- and hydroxyl-related IR absorption band areas was compared with thermogravimetry (TG)-derived hydration numbers. The FTIR band-area profiles were broadly consistent with the TG-derived hydration trends, showing close agreement for La₂(SO₄)₃ and CaSO₄. For CaO, some differences were observed between the FTIR and TG results, possibly because CaO is sensitive to differences in gas-phase conditions, particularly the initial increase in humidity, between the two measurements. The spectra distinguished molecular-water uptake in La₂(SO₄)₃ and CaSO₄ from hydroxide formation in CaO. They also detected carbonate formation during CaO hydration. Thus, in situ time-resolved FTIR separately monitored individual chemical reactions, whereas TG recorded only their combined effect on the sample mass. These results demonstrate the potential of transflection micro-FTIR for chemically selective monitoring of gas--solid reactions in small localized samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 气固反应动力学在热化学储热（TCHS）等应用中非常重要，但实验评估仍然是材料开发的瓶颈。本研究评估了非接触式原位透反射微傅里叶变换红外 (FTIR) 光谱，用于跟踪水蒸气和无机固体之间的水合反应。将具有不同水合机制和动力学的 La2(SO4)3、CaSO4 和 CaO 粉末层沉积在镀金玻璃基板上，并暴露于湿润的 N2 中。将水和羟基相关的红外吸收带面积的演变与热重分析 (TG) 得出的水合数进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 气固反应动力学在热化学储热（TCHS）等应用中非常重要，但实验评估仍然是材料开发的瓶颈。本研究评估了非接触式原位透反射微傅里叶变换红外 (FTIR) 光谱，用于跟踪水蒸气和无机固体之间的水合反应。将具有不同水合机制和动力学的 La2(SO4)3、CaSO4 和 CaO 粉末层沉积在镀金玻璃基板上，并暴露于湿润的 N2 中。将水和羟基相关的红外吸收带面积的演变与热重分析 (TG) 得出的水合数进行比较。 FTIR 带面积分布与 TG 衍生的水合趋势大致一致，显示出 La2(SO4)3 和 CaSO4 的密切一致。对于 CaO，在 FTIR 和 TG 结果之间观察到一些差异，可能是因为 CaO 对两次测量之间的气相条件差异敏感，特别是湿度的初始增加。光谱将 La2(SO4)3 和 CaSO4 中的分子水吸收与 CaO 中的氢氧化物形成区分开来。他们还检测到 CaO 水合过程中碳酸盐的形成。因此，原位时间分辨 FTIR 单独监测各个化学反应，而 TG 仅记录它们对样品质量的综合影响。这些结果证明了半透反射微型 FTIR 在化学选择性监测小型局部样品中的气固反应方面的潜力。

articles.title: Current-driven chiral RKKY interaction in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体中电流驱动的手性 RKKY 相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interaction between magnetic moments usually requires spin--orbit coupling and broken inversion symmetry. We show that in a spin-split metal without spin--orbit coupling a charge current generates a DM interaction between localized spins. Using Keldysh Green's functions (GFs) with a drifting Fermi sea, we compute the Ruderman--Kittel--Kasuya--Yosida (RKKY) interaction between two magnetic impurities in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with an additional exchange splitting. To linear order in the current, the correction is a Fermi-surface term, and all its components are obtained in closed form in terms of Bessel functions, valid for arbitrary values of the two independent spin splittings, β and J_perp. The induced DM vector points along the spin-quantization axis, which in the present model is the out-of-plane direction hatz. At long distance it decays as 1/R, one power more slowly than the equilibrium coupling. In the altermagnet it vanishes for bonds along the nodal directions, where the two spin bands are degenerate, and, for a diagonal current, has opposite signs on bonds along the two crystal axes. This d-wave signature reverses with the Néel vector and with the current, and distinguishes the altermagnet from a ferromagnet. The current also generates symmetric couplings that are odd in the impurity separation. In low-density two-dimensional conductors, the DM coupling can reach a few percent of the equilibrium exchange.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁矩之间的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用通常需要自旋轨道耦合和破缺反演对称性。我们证明，在没有自旋轨道耦合的自旋分裂金属中，充电电流会在局部自旋之间产生 DM 相互作用。使用 Keldysh Green 函数 (GF) 和漂移的费米海，我们计算了二维 d 波交替磁体中两个磁性杂质之间的 Ruderman--Kittel--Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 相互作用，并附加了交换分裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁矩之间的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用通常需要自旋轨道耦合和破缺反演对称性。我们证明，在没有自旋轨道耦合的自旋分裂金属中，充电电流会在局部自旋之间产生 DM 相互作用。使用 Keldysh Green 函数 (GF) 和漂移的费米海，我们计算了二维 d 波交替磁体中两个磁性杂质之间的 Ruderman--Kittel--Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 相互作用，并附加了交换分裂。对于电流中的线性阶，校正是费米面项，其所有分量均以贝塞尔函数的封闭形式获得，对两个独立自旋分裂 β 和 J_perp 的任意值有效。诱导的 DM 向量沿着自旋量化轴指向，在本模型中是面外方向 hatz。在长距离处，它以 1/R 衰减，比平衡耦合慢一倍。在交变磁体中，沿着节点方向的键消失，其中两个自旋带是简并的，并且对于对角线电流，沿着两个晶轴的键具有相反的符号。该 d 波特征与尼尔矢量和电流相反，并将交变磁体与铁磁体区分开来。电流还会产生在杂质分离中奇数的对称耦合。在低密度二维导体中，DM耦合可以达到平衡交换的百分之几。

articles.title: Field-Effect Magnon Transistor
articles.title_zh: 场效应磁振子晶体管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic magnons offer a promising platform for highspeed, energy-efficient information processing. Intrinsic odd-parity spin splitting in a cycloidal magnetic order offers a route to nonvanishing magnon transport in compensated magnets. Here, we propose a magnonic field-effect device (akin to a transistor) based on a ferroelectric antiferromagnet BiFeO3 in which a gate electric field reconfigures domain boundaries to amplify/modulate magnon transport. These boundaries switch the nonlocal inverse-spin-Hall response between low- and high-signal states, with a pronounced dependence on the direction of magnon propagation. Source-drain reversal, magnetic-field measurements, symmetry analysis, and first-principles calculations reveal nonreciprocal magnon transport associated with the reversal of spin angular momentum across the domain boundaries. Our results establish an electrically programmable, non-volatile magnon transistor.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁磁振子为高速、节能的信息处理提供了一个有前景的平台。摆线磁序中的固有奇宇称自旋分裂提供了补偿磁体中不消失磁振子输运的途径。在这里，我们提出了一种基于铁电反铁磁体 BiFeO3 的磁振子场效应器件（类似于晶体管），其中栅极电场重新配置域边界以放大/调制磁振子输运。这些边界在低信号状态和高信号状态之间切换非局部逆自旋霍尔响应，并且明显依赖于磁振子传播的方向。源漏反转、磁场测量、对称分析和第一原理计算揭示了与跨域边界的自旋角动量反转相关的不可逆磁振子输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁磁振子为高速、节能的信息处理提供了一个有前景的平台。摆线磁序中的固有奇宇称自旋分裂提供了补偿磁体中不消失磁振子输运的途径。在这里，我们提出了一种基于铁电反铁磁体 BiFeO3 的磁振子场效应器件（类似于晶体管），其中栅极电场重新配置域边界以放大/调制磁振子输运。这些边界在低信号状态和高信号状态之间切换非局部逆自旋霍尔响应，并且明显依赖于磁振子传播的方向。源漏反转、磁场测量、对称分析和第一原理计算揭示了与跨域边界的自旋角动量反转相关的不可逆磁振子输运。我们的结果建立了一种电可编程、非易失性磁振子晶体管。

articles.title: Scaling laws in machine learning on non-ideal experimental data enable inverse design of radiative-cooling coatings
articles.title_zh: 机器学习中非理想实验数据的缩放定律使得辐射冷却涂层的逆向设计成为可能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials informatics increasingly targets multicomponent materials, yet experimental datasets inevitably contain non-ideal variations arising from imperfect uniformity and reproducibility in composition, coating formation, and measurement. Whether machine-learning prediction accuracy scales with amount of data under these conditions remains unclear. Here, we develop an automated platform that produced and optically characterized 11,520 radiative-cooling coatings spanning nine material and processing parameters. Forward and inverse neural networks, and a spectrum-conditioned diffusion model were trained on subsets of 10 to 10,000 samples. All models exhibited power-law scaling, with prediction errors decreasing with dataset size. Experimental inverse-design validation showed that larger datasets produced spectra closer to a broadband-emitter target. The diffusion model generated multiple candidate parameter sets, allowing selection among alternative solutions based on ease of fabrication, cost, and scalability. These results demonstrate predictable learning-curve scaling in non-ideal experimental data and provide a quantitative basis for estimating the benefit of additional experimental data, and thus the cost-effectiveness of materials-informatics.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料信息学越来越多地针对多组分材料，但实验数据集不可避免地包含由于成分、涂层形成和测量的不完善均匀性和再现性而产生的非理想变化。在这些条件下，机器学习预测的准确性是否会随着数据量的增加而变化仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了一个自动化平台，可生产 11,520 种辐射冷却涂层并对其进行光学表征，涵盖九种材料和加工参数。正向和反向神经网络以及频谱条件扩散模型在 10 到 10,000 个样本的子集上进行训练。所有模型都表现出幂律缩放，预测误差随着数据集大小而减小。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料信息学越来越多地针对多组分材料，但实验数据集不可避免地包含由于成分、涂层形成和测量的不完善均匀性和再现性而产生的非理想变化。在这些条件下，机器学习预测的准确性是否会随着数据量的增加而变化仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了一个自动化平台，可生产 11,520 种辐射冷却涂层并对其进行光学表征，涵盖九种材料和加工参数。正向和反向神经网络以及频谱条件扩散模型在 10 到 10,000 个样本的子集上进行训练。所有模型都表现出幂律缩放，预测误差随着数据集大小而减小。实验逆向设计验证表明，较大的数据集产生的光谱更接近宽带发射器目标。扩散模型生成多个候选参数集，允许根据制造的简易性、成本和可扩展性在替代解决方案中进行选择。这些结果证明了非理想实验数据中可预测的学习曲线缩放，并为估计额外实验数据的好处以及材料信息学的成本效益提供了定量基础。

articles.title: Quadrupole Origin of the Orbital Hall Effect in an sp³ Centrosymmetric Lattice: Robustness and Tunability under Disorder
articles.title_zh: sp3中心对称晶格中轨道霍尔效应的四极起源：无序下的鲁棒性和可调谐性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19651v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how disorder affects orbital Hall transport in the centrosymmetric spinless sp³ tight-binding model on a square lattice, widely used as a minimal model for the orbital Hall effect [1]. In the pristine system, the intrinsic orbital Hall response is related to the quadrupolar orbital texture generated by s-p hybridization. Using the Kubo-Bastin formalism expanded in Chebyshev polynomials, we analyze the effect of vacancies, orbital-dependent Anderson on-site disorder, and selective Vₛₚσ-bond disorder on the orbital transport. For Anderson disorder and vacancies, the longitudinal charge conductivity decreases faster than the orbital Hall conductivity over the range studied, leading to an increase of the orbital Hall angle and, in the Anderson case, saturation at stronger disorder. Selective Vₛₚσ-bond disorder behaves differently: by modifying only the s-p hybridization channel while leaving the remaining hopping network intact, it can produce a non-monotonic orbital Hall response and enhance the orbital Hall conductivity at intermediate dilution. Overall, our results show that the orbital Hall response remains sizable under vacancy and on-site disorder, while selective modification of the s-p hybridization provides an additional route to tune the orbital Hall conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了无序如何影响方形晶格上的中心对称无自旋 sp3 紧束缚模型中的轨道霍尔输运，该模型广泛用作轨道霍尔效应的最小模型 [1]。在原始系统中，本征轨道霍尔响应与 s-p 杂化产生的四极轨道纹理有关。使用切比雪夫多项式中扩展的 Kubo-Bastin 形式主义，我们分析了空位、轨道依赖的安德森原位无序和选择性 Vₛₚσ 键无序对轨道传输的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了无序如何影响方形晶格上的中心对称无自旋 sp3 紧束缚模型中的轨道霍尔输运，该模型广泛用作轨道霍尔效应的最小模型 [1]。在原始系统中，本征轨道霍尔响应与 s-p 杂化产生的四极轨道纹理有关。使用切比雪夫多项式中扩展的 Kubo-Bastin 形式主义，我们分析了空位、轨道依赖的安德森原位无序和选择性 Vₛₚσ 键无序对轨道传输的影响。对于安德森无序和空位，在研究范围内，纵向电荷电导率比轨道霍尔电导率下降得更快，导致轨道霍尔角增加，并且在安德森情况下，在更强的无序情况下饱和。选择性Vₛₚσ键无序表现不同：通过仅修改s-p杂化通道，同时保持剩余的跳跃网络完整，它可以产生非单调轨道霍尔响应并增强中间稀释时的轨道霍尔电导率。总的来说，我们的结果表明，在空位和现场无序的情况下，轨道霍尔响应仍然相当大，而 s-p 杂化的选择性修饰提供了调节轨道霍尔电导率的额外途径。

articles.title: Ferroelectric control of the K--Γ valley landscape in R-stacked bilayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: R 堆叠双层 WSe2 中 K--γ 谷地貌的铁电控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In bilayer WSe2 the valence-band maxima at K and Γ lie within a few thermal energies of one another, and gating redistributes holes between a light and a heavy valley of different mobilities on a landscape that stays fixed. We show that rhombohedral (R) stacking moves the landscape itself. The three-fold symmetry of R stacking forbids interlayer tunneling at K but not at Γ. The K coupling is therefore exactly zero, not merely small. A fit that leaves the coupling free returns an upper bound of 0.017 meV, three orders of magnitude under k_BT at room temperature, while the Γ coupling is 361.8 meV. The polarization creates a potential step between the layers and splits the K doublet. Each K state stays on a single layer, so the K edge shifts by half of that splitting, 41.7 meV, which any tunneling would reduce. Γ barely responds. Two consequences follow from symmetry alone, whatever the size of that shift. The two registries, carrying opposite out-of-plane ferroelectric polarizations, are exact mirror images along the displacement-field axis, and reversing the polarization reverses the displacement of the landscape. Their differential-mode transconductances are equal and opposite at zero field, where the response vanishes for an ideal nonpolar reference. The stored polarization is read out as a reversal of sign and not as a difference of current. Sweeping the field is a second route to the same parity. In the ideal symmetric limit the transconductance passes through zero at the field that cancels the polarization, 1.07 V/nm, at a single temperature. Both routes are limited by the symmetry of the device more than by the band structure. Stacking also renormalizes the landscape, so the polar one is not a translated copy of the nonpolar reference. Absolute offsets follow the exchange-correlation functional. The symmetry relations do not.
articles.abstract_zh: 在双层 WSe2 中，K 和 Γ 处的价带最大值彼此位于几个热能范围内，并且选通在保持固定的景观上不同迁移率的轻谷和重谷之间重新分配空穴。我们证明菱面体 (R) 堆叠会移动景观本身。 R 堆叠的三重对称性禁止 K 处的层间隧道效应，但在 Γ 处则不然。因此，K 耦合恰好为零，而不仅仅是很小。保持耦合自由的拟合返回上限为 0.017 meV，比室温下的 k_BT 高出三个数量级，而 Γ 耦合为 361.8 meV。极化在层之间产生电势台阶并分裂 K 双峰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在双层 WSe2 中，K 和 Γ 处的价带最大值彼此位于几个热能范围内，并且选通在保持固定的景观上不同迁移率的轻谷和重谷之间重新分配空穴。我们证明菱面体 (R) 堆叠会移动景观本身。 R 堆叠的三重对称性禁止 K 处的层间隧道效应，但在 Γ 处则不然。因此，K 耦合恰好为零，而不仅仅是很小。保持耦合自由的拟合返回上限为 0.017 meV，比室温下的 k_BT 高出三个数量级，而 Γ 耦合为 361.8 meV。极化在层之间产生电势台阶并分裂 K 双峰。每个 K 态都保持在单层上，因此 K 边缘移动分裂的一半，即 41.7 meV，任何隧道效应都会减少该值。 Г几乎没有反应。无论这种转变的大小如何，仅对称性就会产生两个后果。这两个登记处具有相反的面外铁电极化，是沿着位移场轴的精确镜像，并且反转极化会反转景观的位移。它们的差模跨导在零磁场下相等且相反，此时对于理想的非极性参考，响应消失。存储的极化被读出为符号反转而不是电流差。横扫市场是实现相同平价的第二条途径。在理想的对称极限中，在单一温度下，跨导在消除极化的场处穿过零，即 1.07 V/nm。两条路线更多地受到器件对称性的限制，而不是能带结构的限制。堆叠还重新规范了景观，因此极地参考不是非极地参考的翻译副本。绝对偏移遵循交换相关函数。对称关系则不然。

articles.title: High Characteristic Voltage YBCO Josephson Junctions Written With a Focused Helium Ion Beam
articles.title_zh: 用聚焦氦离子束写入的高特性电压 YBCO 约瑟夫森结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19718v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report in-plane Josephson junctions written directly into YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ (YBCO) thin films with a focused helium ion beam (He FIB). The characteristic voltage ICR of these junctions, where IC is the Josephson critical current and R is the junction resistance, sets the operating frequency and the sensitivity of the circuits built from them. A single line irradiation with a dose of SI500ions/nm across a SI4micrometre wide electrode produced a junction with ICR of 929 simicrovolt at SI1.6K, which is `higher than the 200 to 400 simicrovolt typical of junctions fabricated previously in our laboratory. Temperature dependent resistance, current-voltage characteristics, magnetic field modulation of the critical current, and Shapiro steps under 20.5~GHz microwave irradiation show Josephson behavior with an excess current below 5 percent of the critical current. The critical current falls steeply with temperature near the junction transition and saturates at low temperature. We attribute this behavior to a barrier at the metal insulator transition, where hopping conduction through localized states is active at finite temperature and freezes out on cooling. We describe the changes in surface preparation, sample selection, beam focusing, and sample storage that accompanied the improvement, although the present data do not separate their individual contributions. Larger characteristic voltages at these dimensions are an encouraging result for rapid single flux quantum and adiabatic quantum flux parametron logic and for superconducting quantum interference devices operating at elevated temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了用聚焦氦离子束（He FIB）将面内约瑟夫森结直接写入 YBa2Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）薄膜。这些结的特征电压 ICR（其中 IC 是约瑟夫森临界电流，R 是结电阻）设定了由它们构建的电路的工作频率和灵敏度。在 SI4 微米宽的电极上进行 SI500ions/nm 剂量的单线照射，在 SI1.6K 下产生了 ICR 为 929 si 微伏的结，这高于我们实验室之前制造的典型结的 200 至 400 si 微伏。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了用聚焦氦离子束（He FIB）将面内约瑟夫森结直接写入 YBa2Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）薄膜。这些结的特征电压 ICR（其中 IC 是约瑟夫森临界电流，R 是结电阻）设定了由它们构建的电路的工作频率和灵敏度。在 SI4 微米宽的电极上进行 SI500ions/nm 剂量的单线照射，在 SI1.6K 下产生了 ICR 为 929 si 微伏的结，这高于我们实验室之前制造的典型结的 200 至 400 si 微伏。温度相关电阻、电流-电压特性、临界电流的磁场调制以及 20.5~GHz 微波辐射下的夏皮罗步骤显示了约瑟夫森行为，过量电流低于临界电流的 5%。临界电流随着结转变附近的温度急剧下降，并在低温下饱和。我们将这种行为归因于金属绝缘体转变处的势垒，其中通过局域态的跳跃传导在有限温度下是活跃的，并在冷却时冻结。我们描述了伴随改进而来的表面处理、样品选择、光束聚焦和样品存储方面的变化，尽管目前的数据并未将它们各自的贡献分开。这些尺寸上较大的特征电压对于快速单通量量子和绝热量子通量参量逻辑以及在高温下运行的超导量子干涉器件来说是一个令人鼓舞的结果。

articles.title: State Diagram of Dual-Free-Layer Perpendicular Magnetic Tunnel Junctions for Artificial Spiking Neurons
articles.title_zh: 人工尖峰神经元双自由层垂直磁隧道结的状态图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The performance of perpendicular magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) depends critically on interfacial properties and layer thicknesses, small variations of which can substantially modify their magnetic and transport characteristics. This work investigates, experimentally and numerically, a perpendicular MTJ with two free layers, a configuration that preserves the precessional dynamics of the device while simplifying its fabrication. Quasi-static state diagrams measured under magnetic fields and DC or pulsed bias reveal static parallel, antiparallel, and bistable regimes, as well as a dynamical windmill regime in which the reversal of one layer triggers that of the other, giving rise to spiking neuron-like signals. Macrospin simulations reproduce these diagrams, and a stability analysis of the Landau-Lifchitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation yields an analytical description of the critical lines, including the windmill threshold voltage. The comparison also reveals a quadratic term in the voltage dependence of the spin-transfer torque that Joule heating cannot explain. The analytical model shows that the threshold voltage can be lowered either by approaching the spin-reorientation transition, at the cost of thermal stability, or by enhancing the quadratic contribution to the spin-transfer torque. These results establish guidelines for optimizing multilayer MTJ stacks for artificial spiking neurons and a broader range of neuromorphic and spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 垂直磁性隧道结 (MTJ) 的性能主要取决于界面特性和层厚度，其微小变化可能会显着改变其磁性和传输特性。这项工作通过实验和数值研究了具有两个自由层的垂直 MTJ，这种配置可以保留设备的进动动力学，同时简化其制造。在磁场和直流或脉冲偏置下测量的准静态图揭示了静态平行、反平行和双稳态状态，以及动态风车状态，其中一层的反转触发另一层的反转，从而产生类似神经元的尖峰信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 垂直磁性隧道结 (MTJ) 的性能主要取决于界面特性和层厚度，其微小变化可能会显着改变其磁性和传输特性。这项工作通过实验和数值研究了具有两个自由层的垂直 MTJ，这种配置可以保留设备的进动动力学，同时简化其制造。在磁场和直流或脉冲偏置下测量的准静态图揭示了静态平行、反平行和双稳态状态，以及动态风车状态，其中一层的反转触发另一层的反转，从而产生类似神经元的尖峰信号。 Macrospin 模拟重现了这些图，并且对 Landau-Lifchitz-Gilbert (LLG) 方程进行稳定性分析，得出关键线的分析描述，包括风车阈值电压。该比较还揭示了焦耳热无法解释的自旋转移矩的电压依赖性的二次项。分析模型表明，可以通过接近自旋重定向跃迁（以热稳定性为代价）或通过增强对自旋转移力矩的二次贡献来降低阈值电压。这些结果为优化人工尖峰神经元多层 MTJ 堆栈以及更广泛的神经形态和自旋电子学应用制定了指导方针。

articles.title: Compact Projected Pfaffian States for Rydberg-Blockaded Quantum Spin Systems
articles.title_zh: 里德堡封锁量子自旋系统的紧凑投影普法夫态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We numerically demonstrate that a compact projected Pfaffian ansatz effectively describes the ground state of the nonintegrable PXP model. The variational wave function is obtained by applying separate Gutzwiller and Rydberg-blockade projectors to a general fermionic paired state, and each blockade-allowed configuration has an amplitude given by the Pfaffian of a configuration-selected pairing matrix. The exact blockade-projected product state of a known frustration-free deformation of the PXP model lies within the variational manifold and provides a physically motivated initial state for the variational Monte Carlo optimization toward the ground state of the pure PXP model. For a one-dimensional system of N sites, optimizing all symmetry-allowed pairings in an O(N)-parameter wave function yields a near-exact ground state with a normalized energy variance (V-score) of order 10⁻⁹ despite the exponentially large blockade-constrained Hilbert space. On the square lattice, an O(N)-parameter wave function with the same amplitude structure yields relative energy errors below 0.2% for clusters accessible to exact diagonalization and produces magnetizations consistent with available benchmarks. These results show that the same projected Pfaffian construction can be applied to blockade-constrained systems in both one and two dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们用数值证明了紧凑投影普法夫 ansatz 有效地描述了不可积 PXP 模型的基态。通过将单独的 Gutzwiller 和 Rydberg 封锁投影仪应用于一般费米子配对状态来获得变分波函数，并且每个允许封锁的配置具有由配置选择的配对矩阵的普法夫给出的幅度。 PXP 模型的已知无挫败变形的精确封锁投影产物状态位于变分流形内，并为纯 PXP 模型基态的变分蒙特卡罗优化提供了物理驱动的初始状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们用数值证明了紧凑投影普法夫 ansatz 有效地描述了不可积 PXP 模型的基态。通过将单独的 Gutzwiller 和 Rydberg 封锁投影仪应用于一般费米子配对状态来获得变分波函数，并且每个允许封锁的配置具有由配置选择的配对矩阵的普法夫给出的幅度。 PXP 模型的已知无挫败变形的精确封锁投影产物状态位于变分流形内，并为纯 PXP 模型基态的变分蒙特卡罗优化提供了物理驱动的初始状态。对于 N 个位点的一维系统，优化 O(N) 参数波函数中所有允许对称的配对会产生近乎精确的基态，尽管希尔伯特空间的封锁约束呈指数级大，但归一化能量方差（V 分数）为 10⁻⁹ 级。在方晶格上，具有相同振幅结构的 O(N) 参数波函数对于可实现精确对角化的簇产生低于 0.2% 的相对能量误差，并产生与可用基准一致的磁化强度。这些结果表明，相同的投影普法夫构造可以应用于一维和二维的封锁约束系统。

articles.title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
articles.title_zh: IANN：具有用户友好实现的等变原子间神经网络的统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) now approach density functional theory (DFT) accuracy at a fraction of its cost, but the practical benefit is limited by software fragmentation: each state-of-the-art architecture is released as a separate codebase, with its own data format, configuration system, training loop and molecular-dynamics interface. Comparing two architectures on the same dataset, or moving a trained model into a production simulation, therefore requires substantial re-engineering. We introduce IANN (InterAtomic Neural Network), an open-source PyTorch framework that reimplements equivariant graph neural networks - PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA - behind a unified data object, a unified trainer and a single deployment route, so that the architecture is a one-word change in a configuration dictionary. Forces, stresses and virials are obtained for every architecture from one analytic differentiation of the energy with respect to the edge vectors of the atomic graph, exact under periodic boundary conditions. Distributed training is configured automatically from the SLURM, PBS or MPI environment, so the same script runs unchanged from a workstation to a multi-node GPU allocation. Self-describing checkpoints serve directly as ASE calculators, as ensembles reporting uncertainties, or as TorchScript models run inside LAMMPS through bundled C++ pair styles with single- and multi-GPU inference. Trained on a common dataset of millions of structures, the architectures can be compared under identical conditions. We further release PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million curated DFT structures from MPtrj, Alexandria, OMat24, MatPES, OC20, OC22, OC25, MPr2SCAN and MatPESr2SCAN, spanning the PBE, RPBE and r2SCAN functionals. Additionally, IANN provides an agent interface to facilitate integration with autonomous agents.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）现在以一小部分成本接近密度泛函理论（DFT）精度，但实际效益受到软件碎片化的限制：每个最先进的架构都作为单独的代码库发布，具有自己的数据格式、配置系统、训练循环和分子动力学接口。因此，在同一数据集上比较两种架构，或者将经过训练的模型转移到生产模拟中，都需要大量的重新设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）现在以一小部分成本接近密度泛函理论（DFT）精度，但实际效益受到软件碎片化的限制：每个最先进的架构都作为单独的代码库发布，具有自己的数据格式、配置系统、训练循环和分子动力学接口。因此，在同一数据集上比较两种架构，或者将经过训练的模型转移到生产模拟中，都需要大量的重新设计。我们引入了 IANN（InterAtomic Neural Network），这是一个开源 PyTorch 框架，它重新实现了等变图神经网络 - PaiNN、NequIP、MACE、Allegro、EquiformerV2、EquiformerV3 和 UMA - 背后有统一的数据对象、统一的训练器和单一的部署路线，因此该架构是配置字典中的一个单词的变化。对于每种结构，力、应力和维里都是通过能量相对于原子图边缘向量的一次解析微分获得的，在周期性边界条件下是精确的。分布式训练是从 SLURM、PBS 或 MPI 环境自动配置的，因此相同的脚本从工作站到多节点 GPU 分配都无需更改即可运行。自描述检查点直接用作 ASE 计算器、报告不确定性的集合，或通过捆绑的 C++ 对样式与单 GPU 和多 GPU 推理在 LAMMPS 内部运行的 TorchScript 模型。在包含数百万个结构的通用数据集上进行训练，可以在相同的条件下对架构进行比较。我们进一步发布了 PaiNN 基础模型，该模型在来自 MPtrj、Alexandria、OMat24、MatPES、OC20、OC22、OC25、MPr2SCAN 和 MatPESr2SCAN 的 4190 万个精选 DFT 结构上进行训练，涵盖 PBE、RPBE 和 r2SCAN 泛函。此外，IANN 还提供代理接口以促进与自治代理的集成。

articles.title: Mixed-Sign Kitaev Exchange in Jahn-Teller-Distorted CrI₂
articles.title_zh: Jahn-Teller 扭曲 CrI2 中的混合符号 Kitaev 交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kitaev couplings with ferromagnetic (FM) or antiferromagnetic (AFM) character shape magnetic frustration and phases differently in real materials, yet their coexistence within a single material remains unexplored. Here, we propose Jahn-Teller distortion as a route to realizing such coexistence on inequivalent bonds. First-principles calculations identify monolayer CrI₂ as such a system, with AFM and FM Kitaev couplings on the short and long bonds, respectively. These opposite signs are robust against variations in Hubbard U, functionals, and strain. A minimal tight-binding model links this sign contrast to Jahn-Teller-split t₂g orbitals and their hopping to e_g orbitals. We further adopt the cluster expansion method and develop a realistic machine-learned spin Hamiltonian, which reproduces the experimentally observed proper-screw geometry and propagation direction and reveals highly nonuniform spin rotation, with turning angles ranging from 48.0^circ to 93.9^circ. Both proper-screw anisotropy and strong anharmonic spin rotation arise from the mixed-sign Kitaev interaction. These findings not only establish Jahn-Teller distortion as a microscopic route to mixed-sign Kitaev exchange, but also open a new avenue for exploring novel magnetic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有铁磁 (FM) 或反铁磁 (AFM) 特征的 Kitaev 耦合在实际材料中形成不同的磁挫败和相位，但它们在单一材料中的共存仍未被探索。在这里，我们提出 Jahn-Teller 畸变作为实现这种不等价键共存的途径。第一性原理计算将单层 CrI2 识别为这样的系统，分别在短键和长键上具有 AFM 和 FM Kitaev 耦合。这些相反的符号对于 Hubbard U、泛函和应变的变化来说是强有力的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有铁磁 (FM) 或反铁磁 (AFM) 特征的 Kitaev 耦合在实际材料中形成不同的磁挫败和相位，但它们在单一材料中的共存仍未被探索。在这里，我们提出 Jahn-Teller 畸变作为实现这种不等价键共存的途径。第一性原理计算将单层 CrI2 识别为这样的系统，分别在短键和长键上具有 AFM 和 FM Kitaev 耦合。这些相反的符号对于 Hubbard U、泛函和应变的变化来说是强有力的。最小的紧束缚模型将这种符号对比与 Jahn-Teller 分裂 t2g 轨道及其跳跃到 e_g 轨道联系起来。我们进一步采用簇扩展方法并开发了一种现实的机器学习自旋哈密顿量，它再现了实验观察到的固有螺旋几何形状和传播方向，并揭示了高度不均匀的自旋旋转，转动角度范围从 48.0^circ 到 93.9^circ。固有螺旋各向异性和强非谐自旋旋转都是由混合符号基塔耶夫相互作用产生的。这些发现不仅确立了 Jahn-Teller 畸变作为混合符号 Kitaev 交换的微观途径，而且为探索新型磁相开辟了一条新途径。

articles.title: Spectroscopic evidence for unconventional surface magnetism in the Kondo insulator FeSb₂
articles.title_zh: 近藤绝缘体 FeSb2 中非常规表面磁性的光谱证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kondo insulators have a non-magnetic bulk due to many-body screening of local moment by conduction electrons. However, the surface of these systems has reduced density of itinerant electrons and may experience a Kondo breakdown, leading to recovery of non-zero local moments and possible magnetic order. Here we use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate the (010) surface of a d-p electron Kondo insulator FeSb₂, which is predicted to host a bulk d-wave altermagnetic state in the absence of Kondo screening. We find anisotropic splitting on the surface states with a maximum in the k_z direction and a minimum in the kₓ direction. The splitting is apparently suppressed with increasing temperature or with Te doping, suggesting that the splitting arises from a magnetic order rather than Rashba effects. Considering the proximity of the bulk to a d-wave altermagnetic state and considering the symmetry of the crystal on the surface, we postulate that our observations may be consistent with an emergent surface altermagnetic order. Such an unconventional 2-dimensional magnetic order naturally hosted on an insulating, non-magnet bulk substrate may offer a promising platform for versatile applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于传导电子对局部力矩的多体屏蔽，近藤绝缘体具有非磁性体。然而，这些系统的表面流动电子密度降低，并且可能会经历近藤击穿，从而导致非零局部矩和可能的磁序的恢复。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱来研究 d-p 电子近藤绝缘体 FeSb2 的 (010) 表面，预计在没有近藤屏蔽的情况下，该绝缘体将呈现体状 d 波交磁态。我们发现表面态的各向异性分裂在 k_z 方向上具有最大值，在 kₓ 方向上具有最小值。
authors: Erin E. Fleck Jonathan A. Sobota
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于传导电子对局部力矩的多体屏蔽，近藤绝缘体具有非磁性体。然而，这些系统的表面流动电子密度降低，并且可能会经历近藤击穿，从而导致非零局部矩和可能的磁序的恢复。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱来研究 d-p 电子近藤绝缘体 FeSb2 的 (010) 表面，预计在没有近藤屏蔽的情况下，该绝缘体将呈现体状 d 波交磁态。我们发现表面态的各向异性分裂在 k_z 方向上具有最大值，在 kₓ 方向上具有最小值。随着温度升高或碲掺杂，分裂明显受到抑制，这表明分裂是由磁序而不是拉什巴效应引起的。考虑到块体与 d 波交变磁态的接近性并考虑到表面晶体的对称性，我们假设我们的观察结果可能与出现的表面交变磁序一致。这种非常规的二维磁序自然存在于绝缘的非磁性块状基板上，可以为多功能应用提供一个有前景的平台。

articles.title: Field-Driven Active Matter Physics and Material Applications
articles.title_zh: 场驱动的活性物质物理和材料应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active matter consists of energy-consuming units that generate motion, making it a powerful platform for exploring nonequilibrium physics and engineering adaptive materials. Robotic active matter brings this physics into programmable, macroscopic agents with controllable actuation, sensing, and response, but its scalability is limited by onboard power, communication, and control complexity. Field-driven active matter addresses these limitations by shifting part of the control burden from individual agents to external or environmental fields, such as magnetic, electric, acoustic, optical, and fluidic fields, which can power, guide, and couple many agents simultaneously. Beyond applications in targeted navigation, adaptive collaboration, and flexible transport, field-driven robotic active matter offers a controllable testbed for nonequilibrium phenomena that are difficult to isolate in molecular or colloidal active matter, including tunable interactions, programmable phase transitions, solid-fluid switching, hyperuniform order, and reconfigurable collective motion. Here, we present field-driven active matter as a bridge between active matter physics and functional material engineering, organized through a unified field-to-information-to-physics-to-function framework that links field-mediated interactions, information processing, and memory to collective transport, reconfiguration, and mechanical performance. By distributing control between agents and fields, field-driven active matter offers a pathway toward intelligent materials capable of sensing, adaptation, computation, reconfiguration, and performing complex tasks, while expanding both the scientific scope of nonequilibrium physics and the practical capabilities of engineered matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 活性物质由产生运动的能量消耗单元组成，使其成为探索非平衡物理和工程适应性材料的强大平台。机器人活性物质将这种物理现象带入具有可控驱动、传感和响应的可编程宏观代理中，但其可扩展性受到机载电源、通信和控制复杂性的限制。场驱动的活性物质通过将部分控制负担从单个代理转移到外部或环境场（例如磁、电、声、光和流体场）来解决这些限制，这些场可以同时为许多代理提供动力、引导和耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 活性物质由产生运动的能量消耗单元组成，使其成为探索非平衡物理和工程适应性材料的强大平台。机器人活性物质将这种物理现象带入具有可控驱动、传感和响应的可编程宏观代理中，但其可扩展性受到机载电源、通信和控制复杂性的限制。场驱动的活性物质通过将部分控制负担从单个代理转移到外部或环境场（例如磁、电、声、光和流体场）来解决这些限制，这些场可以同时为许多代理提供动力、引导和耦合。除了定向导航、自适应协作和灵活运输方面的应用之外，场驱动机器人活性物质还为分子或胶体活性物质中难以分离的非平衡现象提供了可控的测试平台，包括可调相互作用、可编程相变、固液切换、超均匀顺序和可重构集体运动。在这里，我们将场驱动的活性物质作为活性物质物理学和功能材料工程之间的桥梁，通过统一的场到信息到物理到功能的框架来组织，该框架将场介导的相互作用、信息处理和记忆与集体运输、重新配置和机械性能联系起来。通过在主体和场之间分配控制，场驱动的活性物质提供了一条通往能够感知、适应、计算、重新配置和执行复杂任务的智能材料的途径，同时扩大了非平衡物理的科学范围和工程物质的实用能力。

articles.title: Theory of anisotropic magnetotransport beyond the constant relaxation-time approximation in multi-Weyl semimetals
articles.title_zh: 多外尔半金属中超越恒定弛豫时间近似的各向异性磁输运理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-Weyl semimetals, characterized by Weyl nodes carrying higher monopole charges, provide a platform for exploring topological magnetotransport beyond the conventional Weyl paradigm. Here, we develop a generalized semiclassical Boltzmann framework for multi-Weyl semimetals with arbitrary monopole charge N, incorporating the orbital magnetic moment (OMM) into the quasiparticle dispersion and Berry-curvature-modified dynamics, together with a momentum-dependent collision integral accounting for intra- and intervalley scattering. We investigate the longitudinal magnetoconductivity (LMC) and planar Hall conductivity (PHC) for N=1, 2, and 3, considering both nonmagnetic and magnetic impurity scattering. In the absence of OMM, the LMC remains positive and quadratic in the magnetic field throughout the investigated scattering regime, consistent with conventional chiral-anomaly-assisted transport. Including OMM, however, leads to a sign reversal of the LMC under sufficiently strong intervalley scattering for the σ₀ and σ_z impurity channels. Remarkably, the critical intervalley scattering strength decreases systematically with increasing monopole charge, indicating an enhanced tendency toward negative LMC in higher-charge Weyl systems. Furthermore, we find that the PHC also undergoes a sign reversal for N=2 and N=3 in the same impurity channels, while remaining positive for N=1 within the investigated parameter range. The angular dependences retain their characteristic sin²γ-like and sin2γ profiles for LMC and PHC, respectively, even across the sign reversal. Our results demonstrate that the interplay of Berry curvature, OMM, monopole charge, and impurity scattering can produce qualitatively distinct weak-field magnetotransport responses beyond the conventional chiral-anomaly picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 多外尔半金属的特点是带有较高单极电荷的外尔节点，为探索超越传统外尔范式的拓扑磁输运提供了平台。在这里，我们为具有任意单极电荷 N 的多外尔半金属开发了一个广义半经典玻尔兹曼框架，将轨道磁矩（OMM）纳入准粒子色散和贝里曲率修正动力学中，以及考虑粒内和粒间散射的动量相关碰撞积分。我们研究了 N=1、2 和 3 时的纵向磁导率 (LMC) 和平面霍尔电导率 (PHC)，同时考虑非磁性和磁性杂质散射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多外尔半金属的特点是带有较高单极电荷的外尔节点，为探索超越传统外尔范式的拓扑磁输运提供了平台。在这里，我们为具有任意单极电荷 N 的多外尔半金属开发了一个广义半经典玻尔兹曼框架，将轨道磁矩（OMM）纳入准粒子色散和贝里曲率修正动力学中，以及考虑粒内和粒间散射的动量相关碰撞积分。我们研究了 N=1、2 和 3 时的纵向磁导率 (LMC) 和平面霍尔电导率 (PHC)，同时考虑非磁性和磁性杂质散射。在没有 OMM 的情况下，LMC 在整个研究的散射范围内在磁场中保持正值和二次方，与传统的手性异常辅助输运一致。然而，包含 OMM 会导致 σ₀ 和 σ_z 杂质通道在足够强的层间散射下 LMC 发生符号反转。值得注意的是，临界层间散射强度随着单极子电荷的增加而系统性地降低，这表明在较高电荷的 Weyl 系统中负 LMC 的趋势增强。此外，我们发现 PHC 在相同的杂质通道中也经历了 N=2 和 N=3 的符号反转，而在研究的参数范围内 N=1 时保持正值。即使在符号反转的情况下，LMC 和 PHC 的角度依赖性也分别保留其特征性的类 sin2γ 和 sin2γ 分布。我们的结果表明，贝里曲率、OMM、单极电荷和杂质散射的相互作用可以产生超出传统手性异常图像的定性独特的弱场磁输运响应。

articles.title: Growing length scales while approaching the glass transition
articles.title_zh: 接近玻璃化转变时长度尺度不断增长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Even after decades of research, the nature of the glass transition is controversially debated: Kinetic freezing phenomena, purely local strain-mediated effects, or collective phenomena including a hidden phase transition are usually discussed. In this work, we check reports on clusters of correlated particles in supercooled liquids which grow upon approaching the glass-transition. We specifically focus on dielectric studies providing approximate access to the four-point correlation function, which allows insight into the evolution of so-called amorphous order. Existing temperature-dependent data derived from the three-point correlation function or higher-order dielectric susceptibilities are modeled using the random first-order transition theory combined with the Vogel-Fulcher-Tammann law. This ansatz enables detailed predictions concerning normalized correlation lengths or the number of correlated particles as function of temperature and fragility. It provides a good fit to the experimental data for all materials investigated, including network and molecular glass formers and polymers. We conclude that length scales and corresponding particle numbers determined by the different methods used are at least similar and closely related to those considered by the theory. Moreover, the model predictions on the fragility dependence of the number of correlated molecules are at least approximately fulfilled. Existing criticism concerning an apparent lack of criticality in the temperature dependence of experimental correlation lengths is discussed in terms of this fragility dependence: All available data are well consistent with a hidden phase transition which is best revealed for the most fragile liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 即使经过数十年的研究，玻璃化转变的本质仍然存在争议：通常讨论动力学冻结现象、纯粹的局部应变介导效应或包括隐藏相变的集体现象。在这项工作中，我们检查了有关过冷液体中相关粒子簇的报告，这些粒子簇在接近玻璃化转变时生长。我们特别专注于介电研究，提供对四点相关函数的近似访问，从而可以深入了解所谓的无定形有序的演化。使用随机一阶跃迁理论结合 Vogel-Fulcher-Tammann 定律对从三点相关函数或高阶介电磁化率导出的现有温度相关数据进行建模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 即使经过数十年的研究，玻璃化转变的本质仍然存在争议：通常讨论动力学冻结现象、纯粹的局部应变介导效应或包括隐藏相变的集体现象。在这项工作中，我们检查了有关过冷液体中相关粒子簇的报告，这些粒子簇在接近玻璃化转变时生长。我们特别专注于介电研究，提供对四点相关函数的近似访问，从而可以深入了解所谓的无定形有序的演化。使用随机一阶跃迁理论结合 Vogel-Fulcher-Tammann 定律对从三点相关函数或高阶介电磁化率导出的现有温度相关数据进行建模。该 ansatz 能够对归一化相关长度或相关粒子数量作为温度和脆性的函数进行详细预测。它非常适合所有研究材料的实验数据，包括网络和分子玻璃形成剂和聚合物。我们得出的结论是，采用不同方法确定的长度尺度和相应的粒子数至少与理论所考虑的相似且密切相关。此外，模型对相关分子数量对脆弱性的依赖性的预测至少大致实现。关于实验相关长度的温度依赖性明显缺乏关键性的现有批评是根据这种脆弱性依赖性进行讨论的：所有可用数据都与隐藏的相变非常一致，这对于最脆弱的液体来说是最好的揭示。

articles.title: Metallic or insulating magnetic phases of transition-metal oxides in light of the Slater vs Mott controversy
articles.title_zh: 斯莱特与莫特争议中过渡金属氧化物的金属或绝缘磁相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19888v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic d-electron oxides usually have a long-range-ordered ground state and an above-ground-state disordered para phase. The historical Slater-Mott controversy still reverberating to date pertains to understanding the origin of the insulating vs metallic nature of these two phases. Slater suggested that the insulating character evolved from the long-range order (LRO) antiferromagnetic (AFM) cell-doubling, leading to energy band repulsion and thus to forming a band gap. The reliance on LRO to explain gapping suggests that the absence of LRO in the spin-disordered para-phase would deprive the system from band repulsion, thus predicting a metallic paramagnetic (PM) phase. This, however, conflicts with numerous current observations. The alternative Mott-Peierls-Hubbard view abandons the mean-field-like band structure view emphasizing instead the local interelectronic repulsion U as a strong correlation signature of gapping both at the presence or absence of LRO. However, U is not an easily measured or calculated quantity in periodic systems, a situation often leading in practice to treating U as an adjustable parameter. The current work uses a parameter-free mean-field-like approach (Density Functional Theory, DFT), allowing energy-lowering symmetry breaking. This is done by considering local magnetic motifs as building blocks of the macroscopic AFM or PM phases. It is found that even when such motifs are isolated electronically from each other (i.e. vanishing LRO) by embedding them in quantum barriers (such as magnetic NiO6 octahedra surrounded locally by wide-gap MgO) they exhibit an intrinsic band gap. Thus, the origin of the band gaps in AFM or PM phases need not be LRO or strong correlation and can be understood within the mean-field-like band structure approach with symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性d电子氧化物通常具有长程有序基态和高于基态的无序对位相。迄今为止，历史上的斯莱特-莫特争议仍然存在，涉及理解这两个相的绝缘性与金属性的起源。斯莱特认为，绝缘特性是由长程有序（LRO）反铁磁（AFM）细胞倍增演变而来，导致能带排斥，从而形成带隙。依靠 LRO 来解释间隙表明，自旋无序准相中缺少 LRO 将使系统失去能带排斥力，从而预测金属顺磁 (PM) 相。然而，这与许多当前的观察相冲突。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性d电子氧化物通常具有长程有序基态和高于基态的无序对位相。迄今为止，历史上的斯莱特-莫特争议仍然存在，涉及理解这两个相的绝缘性与金属性的起源。斯莱特认为，绝缘特性是由长程有序（LRO）反铁磁（AFM）细胞倍增演变而来，导致能带排斥，从而形成带隙。依靠 LRO 来解释间隙表明，自旋无序准相中缺少 LRO 将使系统失去能带排斥力，从而预测金属顺磁 (PM) 相。然而，这与许多当前的观察相冲突。另一种 Mott-Peiierls-Hubbard 观点放弃了类平均场能带结构观点，而是强调局域电子间斥力 U 作为在存在或不存在 LRO 时带隙的强相关特征。然而，U 在周期系统中并不是一个容易测量或计算的量，这种情况在实践中常常导致将 U 视为可调节参数。当前的工作使用无参数的类平均场方法（密度泛函理论，DFT），允许能量降低的对称性破缺。这是通过将局部磁性图案视为宏观 AFM 或 PM 相的构建块来完成的。研究发现，即使当这些基序通过将它们嵌入量子势垒（例如局部被宽带隙 MgO 包围的磁性 NiO6 八面体）而彼此电子隔离（即消失的 LRO）时，它们也表现出固有的带隙。因此，AFM 或 PM 相中带隙的起源不必是 LRO 或强相关性，并且可以在具有对称性破缺的类平均场能带结构方法中理解。

articles.title: Spectral Moments of the Projected Hubbard Configuration Graph: Connectivity, Exchange, and Virtual Doublons
articles.title_zh: 投影哈伯德配置图的谱矩：连通性、交换和虚拟双倍隆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At strong on-site repulsion, the lowest band of n lattice fermions is the spectrum of the hopping projected onto configurations without double occupancy, H_infty=P₀HₜP₀. We study its moments, for few fermions in the square-lattice Hubbard model and, where the arguments allow, on any finite graph. (1) For spin-independent Hermitian hopping (no on-site terms) on any N≥2-site graph, μ₂=fracn(N-n)N(N-1)sumᵢ≠ ⱼ|tᵢⱼ|², for any spin composition. (2) On any finite graph, μ₄ is exactly linear in the same-spin pair count, as four hops permute particles by at most a transposition or 3-cycle; for uniform hopping on a simple graph with N≥4 the slope is α(N,n)=-8C₄(N-n)(8N-11n-2)/[N(N-1)(N-2)(N-3)], fixed by the number C₄ of 4-cycles. (3) At large finite U, the second-order Schrieffer-Wolff correction is Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal to H_infty on every triangle-free graph, so the band variance has no 1/U term; its U⁻² coefficient, an exact trace checked by exact diagonalization, is negative at the low fillings computed. (4) Under a Peierls flux, the exchange slope α(N,2,Φ)=-frac64N-1cosΦ_square (L× L tori, L=3 or L≥5) carries the ordinary charge-e harmonic, while the doublon (bound-pair) hopping acquires a doubled phase, t_de²ⁱAᵢⱼ: the second-order single-doublon Hamiltonian is exactly π-periodic (h/2e) under a boundary twist, and the exact two-electron U-band follows numerically, up to O((2λ)^L/UL⁻¹). Result (1), the permutation bound, the orthogonality in (3) and the doubled phase are machine-checked in Lean 4. Repulsive binding and the pair charge 2e are known; new are the exact moment structure and the derivation of the doubled phase. We make no claim about many-pair phase stiffness, off-diagonal long-range order or superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 在强现场斥力下，n个晶格费米子的最低能带是投影到没有双占据的构型上的跳跃光谱，H_infty=P₀HₜP₀。我们研究方晶格哈伯德模型中的几个费米子的矩，并且在参数允许的情况下，在任何有限图上研究它的矩。 (1) 对于任何 N≥2 位图上的自旋无关埃尔米特跳跃（无现场项），对于任何自旋组合，μ2=fracn(N-n)N(N-1)sumᵢ≠ ⱼ|tᵢⱼ|²。 (2) 在任何有限图上，μ₄ 在相同自旋对计数中完全是线性的，因为四跳最多通过一个转置或 3 个循环来排列粒子；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强现场斥力下，n个晶格费米子的最低能带是投影到没有双占据的构型上的跳跃光谱，H_infty=P₀HₜP₀。我们研究方晶格哈伯德模型中的几个费米子的矩，并且在参数允许的情况下，在任何有限图上研究它的矩。 (1) 对于任何 N≥2 位图上的自旋无关埃尔米特跳跃（无现场项），对于任何自旋组合，μ2=fracn(N-n)N(N-1)sumᵢ≠ ⱼ|tᵢⱼ|²。 (2) 在任何有限图上，μ₄ 在相同自旋对计数中完全是线性的，因为四跳最多通过一个转置或 3 个循环来排列粒子；对于 N≥4 的简单图上的均匀跳跃，斜率是 α(N,n)=-8C₄(N-n)(8N-11n-2)/[N(N-1)(N-2)(N-3)]，由 4 周期的数量 C₄ 固定。 (3) 在大有限 U 处，二阶 Schrieffer-Wolff 校正在每个无三角形图上与 H_infty 正交，因此带方差没有 1/U 项；它的 U⁻² 系数（通过精确对角化检查的精确轨迹）在计算的低填充下为负值。 (4) 在 Peierls 通量下，交换斜率 α(N,2,Φ)=-frac64N-1cosΦ_square (L× L tori, L=3 或 L≥5) 携带普通电荷 e 谐波，而双倍隆（束缚对）跳跃获得双倍相位 t_de²ⁱAᵢⱼ：二阶单双倍隆哈密顿量恰好是 π 周期 (h/2e)边界扭曲，并且精确的双电子 U 能带在数值上遵循，直到 O((2λ)^L/UL⁻1)。结果 (1)、排列束缚、(3) 中的正交性和双相在 Lean 4 中进行机器检查。排斥结合和对电荷 2e 已知；新的是精确的矩结构和双相的推导。我们没有对多对相位刚度、非对角长程有序或超导性提出任何主张。

articles.title: On the richness of metamaterials generated by recursive cell division
articles.title_zh: 论递归细胞分裂产生的超材料的丰富性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scale-rich metamaterials are one member of a family of recursive cell divisions, which differ in which cell is cut, where the cut passes and at what angle. We characterise six members of this family through three network mappings, the cell tree, the dual graph of ligaments and junctions, and the frame graph of spans, and through their elastic-wave properties: the effective refractive index n, its isotropy and the band over which it holds. The dual-graph degree law, the mean degree and the age law of the ligaments hit by new ones are the same for every rule, so they cannot distinguish the materials. The cell tree and the cell shapes do differ, and one consequence of them explains the physics: the tail of long spans in the frame graph. With the longest spans as the length scale, the bending part of the inverse squared index follows a single power law across rules, densities and numbers of ligaments, and the same spans set the lowest local resonance and the band edge. The stretching part, which caps the index, is carried by the straight frame lines of the tiling rather than by the division. Random cut angles produce elongated cells and long spans, hence high index and a narrow band; cuts perpendicular to the long axis of the cell keep the cells compact, giving low index and a wide band. Cutting through the centroid instead of a random point bounds the split fraction between 4/9 and 5/9, which removes the area hierarchy without changing the index. The cut angle interpolates continuously between these limits, and the isotropy peaks where the ligament orientations become isotropic while the cells are still compact. In three dimensions the plate and strut divisions are stretching dominated and the index stays low for every rule.
articles.abstract_zh: 富含尺度的超材料是递归细胞分裂家族的成员之一，其不同之处在于切割哪个细胞、切割经过何处以及以什么角度。我们通过三个网络映射、细胞树、韧带和连接点的对偶图以及跨度的框架图，并通过它们的弹性波特性：有效折射率 n、其各向同性及其所持有的频带来表征该家族的六个成员。新伤韧带的双图度数规律、平均度数和年龄规律对于每条规则都是相同的，因此不能区分材料。细胞树和细胞形状确实不同，它们的一个结果解释了物理原理：框架图中长跨度的尾部。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 富含尺度的超材料是递归细胞分裂家族的成员之一，其不同之处在于切割哪个细胞、切割经过何处以及以什么角度。我们通过三个网络映射、细胞树、韧带和连接点的对偶图以及跨度的框架图，并通过它们的弹性波特性：有效折射率 n、其各向同性及其所持有的频带来表征该家族的六个成员。新伤韧带的双图度数规律、平均度数和年龄规律对于每条规则都是相同的，因此不能区分材料。细胞树和细胞形状确实不同，它们的一个结果解释了物理原理：框架图中长跨度的尾部。以最长的跨度为长度尺度，平方反比指数的弯曲部分在韧带的规则、密度和数量上遵循单一幂律，并且相同的跨度设置最低的局部谐振和带边缘。覆盖索引的拉伸部分由平铺的直线框架线而不是由分割线承载。随机切割角度产生细长的单元和长的跨度，因此具有高折射率和窄带；垂直于细胞长轴的切割使细胞保持紧凑，提供低折射率和宽带。穿过质心而不是随机点将分割分数限制在 4/9 和 5/9 之间，这会在不更改索引的情况下删除区域层次结构。切割角度在这些极限之间连续插值，并且各向同性峰值，其中韧带方向变得各向同性，而细胞仍然紧凑。在三个维度中，板和支柱的划分以拉伸为主，并且每条规则的指数都保持在较低水平。

articles.title: Self-assembly of dipolar nanoclusters on an attractive substrate: A coarse-grained simulation approach
articles.title_zh: 偶极纳米团簇在有吸引力的基底上的自组装：一种粗粒度模拟方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, Thomas et al. [Nanoscale 17, 18291 (2025)] showed that bismuth oxido nanoclusters (BiO-NCs) of the type [Bi₃₈ O₄₅ (Boc-L-Phe-O)₂₄] form chains when deposited onto gold or pyrolitic graphite substrates. This chain formation is significantly enhanced when the bismuth in the BiO-NCs is partially replaced by cerium through doping. In this work, we study a simplified, coarse-grained model of this process, namely (magnetic) Stockmayer particles in the presence of an attractive substrate. The model is investigated by means of molecular dynamics simulations. The deposition experiment is mimicked by a rapid quench from high temperature to a low temperature below the bulk coexistence curve. The results are found to be qualitatively similar to the experimental observations reported earlier. In our simulations, we find significant chain formation in the bulk even at rather low concentrations, which is in contrast to the BiO-NCs in ethanol for which dynamic light scattering reveals negligible aggregation in the absence of the substrate. This lends support to a scenario, conjectured in the work of Thomas at al., where the dipole moments are induced by the particle-substrate interaction and hence there is little dipole moment in the bulk. In a second part, we study the system in equilibrium. We consider the scaling of chains, the number of layers populated as a function of two-dimensional density, and we draw analogies to polymers on interfaces, which have been extensively studied over the past decades. Most notably, it is found that the chains behave as self-avoiding walks at low densities, which gives way to rod-like scaling at higher densities.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，托马斯等人。 [Nanoscale 17, 18291 (2025)]表明[Bi38 O45 (Boc-L-Phe-O)24]类型的氧化铋纳米团簇(BiO-NC)在沉积到金或热解石墨基底上时形成链。当 BiO-NC 中的铋通过掺杂被铈部分取代时，这种链的形成会显着增强。在这项工作中，我们研究了该过程的简化、粗粒度模型，即存在有吸引力的基质时的（磁性）斯托克迈耶粒子。通过分子动力学模拟研究该模型。通过从高温到低于本体共存曲线的低温的快速淬火来模拟沉积实验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，托马斯等人。 [Nanoscale 17, 18291 (2025)]表明[Bi38 O45 (Boc-L-Phe-O)24]类型的氧化铋纳米团簇(BiO-NC)在沉积到金或热解石墨基底上时形成链。当 BiO-NC 中的铋通过掺杂被铈部分取代时，这种链的形成会显着增强。在这项工作中，我们研究了该过程的简化、粗粒度模型，即存在有吸引力的基质时的（磁性）斯托克迈耶粒子。通过分子动力学模拟研究该模型。通过从高温到低于本体共存曲线的低温的快速淬火来模拟沉积实验。结果发现在质量上与之前报道的实验观察结果相似。在我们的模拟中，我们发现即使在相当低的浓度下，大量的链形成也很明显，这与乙醇中的 BiO-NC 形成鲜明对比，后者的动态光散射显示在没有底物的情况下可以忽略不计的聚集。这支持了托马斯等人在工作中推测的一种情况，其中偶极矩是由粒子-基底相互作用引起的，因此整体中几乎没有偶极矩。在第二部分中，我们研究平衡系统。我们考虑链的缩放、填充的层数作为二维密度的函数，并与界面上的聚合物进行类比，这在过去几十年中已被广泛研究。最值得注意的是，人们发现这些链在低密度下表现为自回避行走，而在较高密度下则表现为杆状缩放。

articles.title: Two channels of magnetic renormalization in the terahertz lattice response of FePS₃
articles.title_zh: FePS₃太赫兹晶格响应中磁重正化的两个通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer vibrations probe how magnetic van der Waals layers are stacked and coupled. In the zigzag antiferromagnet FePS₃, ultrafast experiments show that the interlayer shear couples strongly to the magnetic order, but not how magnetism renormalizes the shear stiffness and damping. Here, using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we measure the anisotropic conductivity of FePS₃ from 1.6 to 300 K and in fields up to 7 T normal to the layers. We observe absorption bands at 0.6-0.8 and 1.3-2.4 THz that persist into the paramagnetic phase. The lower one is consistent with an interlayer shear resonance; the magnetic order stiffens one of its in-plane components and softens the other, reversing their splitting at the Néel temperature. We identify two channels of magnetic renormalization: frequency shifts are confined to the ordered phase, whereas the linewidths of this resonance and most oscillator strengths follow short-range spin correlations persisting well above the transition. The field acts mainly on the higher resonance in one orientation: near 3.2 T, its softening accelerates and its linewidth has a cusp-like minimum, consistent with critical slowing down of a field-induced order parameter. These results give an equilibrium view of spin-shear coupling, which is anisotropic and persists above the Néel temperature through short-range correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 层间振动探测磁性范德华层如何堆叠和耦合。在锯齿状反铁磁体 FePS₃ 中，超快实验表明层间剪切力与磁序强烈耦合，但与磁性如何使剪切刚度和阻尼重新正常化无关。在这里，我们使用太赫兹时域光谱，测量了 FePS₃ 在 1.6 至 300 K 范围内以及垂直于层的场高达 7 T 的各向异性电导率。我们观察到 0.6-0.8 和 1.3-2.4 THz 的吸收带持续进入顺磁相。下一个与层间剪切共振一致；磁序使其面内成分变硬并软化另一个成分，从而逆转它们在尼尔温度下的分裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层间振动探测磁性范德华层如何堆叠和耦合。在锯齿状反铁磁体 FePS₃ 中，超快实验表明层间剪切力与磁序强烈耦合，但与磁性如何使剪切刚度和阻尼重新正常化无关。在这里，我们使用太赫兹时域光谱，测量了 FePS₃ 在 1.6 至 300 K 范围内以及垂直于层的场高达 7 T 的各向异性电导率。我们观察到 0.6-0.8 和 1.3-2.4 THz 的吸收带持续进入顺磁相。下一个与层间剪切共振一致；磁序使其面内成分变硬并软化另一个成分，从而逆转它们在尼尔温度下的分裂。我们确定了磁重整化的两个通道：频移仅限于有序相位，而该共振的线宽和大多数振荡器强度遵循短程自旋相关性，该相关性持续远高于转变。该场主要作用于一个方向的较高共振：在 3.2 T 附近，其软化加速，并且其线宽具有尖点状最小值，与场引起的有序参数的临界减慢一致。这些结果给出了自旋剪切耦合的平衡视图，该耦合是各向异性的，并且通过短程相关性在尼尔温度以上持续存在。

articles.title: Surface-bulk magnetic dichotomy in intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 插层过渡金属二硫属化物的表面体磁二分法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20123v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetically intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides are layered materials with highly tunable magnetic orders and unconventional transport properties. Here we report a surface-bulk magnetic dichotomy in M₁/₃TX₂, in which the surface and bulk favor distinct magnetic orders. In Fe₁/₃NbS₂, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) results are reproduced by an A-type antiferromagnetic electronic structure, while neutron scattering and bulk DFT+U calculations identify stripe order as the bulk ground state. DFT+U slab calculations resolve this contradiction by showing that relaxation of an Fe-terminated surface reverses the magnetic preference from stripe to A-type order. The same dichotomy recovers the K-centered Fermi-surface pockets that are observed in Co₁/₃NbS₂ and Co₁/₃TaS₂ but absent from previous bulk calculations. Notably, the surface-stabilized magnetic phase of Fe₁/₃NbS₂ carries nonrelativistic spin splitting and can exhibit altermagnetic character. These results caution against the general association of ARPES signals with bulk magnetic states in these systems, and suggest surface-bulk magnetic dichotomy as a promising route to realize magnetic phases, including altermagnetism, that are not energetically favored in the bulk.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁插层过渡金属二硫属化物是具有高度可调磁序和非常规输运特性的层状材料。在这里，我们报告了 M₁/₃TX2 中的表面-体磁二分法，其中表面和体有利于不同的磁序。在 Fe1/3NbS2 中，角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 结果由 A 型反铁磁电子结构再现，而中子散射和体 DFT+U 计算将条带序识别为体基态。 DFT+U 平板计算通过证明 Fe 端接表面的弛豫将磁性偏好从条带反转为 A 型顺序，解决了这一矛盾。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁插层过渡金属二硫属化物是具有高度可调磁序和非常规输运特性的层状材料。在这里，我们报告了 M₁/₃TX2 中的表面-体磁二分法，其中表面和体有利于不同的磁序。在 Fe1/3NbS2 中，角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 结果由 A 型反铁磁电子结构再现，而中子散射和体 DFT+U 计算将条带序识别为体基态。 DFT+U 平板计算通过证明 Fe 端接表面的弛豫将磁性偏好从条带反转为 A 型顺序，解决了这一矛盾。同样的二分法恢复了在 Co₁/₃NbS2 和 Co₁/₃TaS2 中观察到的 K 中心费米面口袋，但在之前的体积计算中没有出现。值得注意的是，Fe1/3NbS2 的表面稳定磁相具有非相对论性自旋分裂，并且可以表现出交变磁特性。这些结果警告人们不要将 ARPES 信号与这些系统中的体磁态一般关联起来，并表明表面-体磁二分法是实现磁相（包括交变磁性）的一条有前途的途径，而这些磁相在体体中并不受到能量的青睐。

articles.title: Robust Antiferromagnetic Ordering above 500 K in a Family of Bilayer van der Waals Materials
articles.title_zh: 双层范德华材料系列中 500 K 以上的鲁棒反铁磁有序化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stabilizing magnetic order above room temperature in layered materials is highly desirable for low-dimensional spintronics applications. However, realizing room-temperature antiferromagnetism in layered magnets remains challenging. Here, we present a layered semiconducting oxyhalide material family, Sr₃Fe₂O₅X₂ (X = F, Cl, Br), which exhibits robust high-temperature antiferromagnetic ordering. The two-dimensional nature and scalability of this system are demonstrated by atomically resolving the van der Waals gap of Sr₃Fe₂O₅Br₂ and synthesizing centimeter-scale single crystals of Sr₃Fe₂O₅Cl₂. Temperature-dependent neutron scattering and magnetization measurements determine their G-type magnetic structure and transition temperature. Remarkably, the Néel temperature of Sr₃Fe₂O₅F₂ (sim580 K) is the highest among all reported layered antiferromagnets. Density functional theory calculations demonstrate that strong nearest-neighbor superexchange interactions along both out-of-plane and in-plane directions, particularly the magnetic couplings along lattice c direction within the bilayer motif, are primarily responsible for the high Néel temperatures in Sr₃Fe₂O₅X₂. In contrast, inter-bilayer spin couplings are negligibly weak, without much influence on the stabilization of the antiferromagnetic order. Therefore, theoretical calculations predict that this robust antiferromagnetic order could persist or even strengthens at room-temperature even at the monolayer limit. Our results highlight iron-based layered oxyhalides as a promising platform for exploring beyond-room-temperature antiferromagnetism in the two-dimensional limit, holding immense potential in areas like information storage and spin-based devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于低维自旋电子学应用来说，非常需要将层状材料中的磁序稳定在室温以上。然而，在层状磁体中实现室温反铁磁性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种层状半导体卤氧化物材料系列，Sr3Fe2O5X2（X = F、Cl、Br），它表现出强大的高温反铁磁有序性。通过原子解决 Sr3Fe2O5Br2 的范德华能隙并合成厘米级 Sr3Fe2O5Cl2 单晶，证明了该系统的二维性质和可扩展性。与温度相关的中子散射和磁化测量决定了它们的 G 型磁结构和转变温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于低维自旋电子学应用来说，非常需要将层状材料中的磁序稳定在室温以上。然而，在层状磁体中实现室温反铁磁性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种层状半导体卤氧化物材料系列，Sr3Fe2O5X2（X = F、Cl、Br），它表现出强大的高温反铁磁有序性。通过原子解决 Sr3Fe2O5Br2 的范德华能隙并合成厘米级 Sr3Fe2O5Cl2 单晶，证明了该系统的二维性质和可扩展性。与温度相关的中子散射和磁化测量决定了它们的 G 型磁结构和转变温度。值得注意的是，Sr3Fe2O5F2 (sim580 K) 的尼尔温度是所有报道的层状反铁磁体中最高的。密度泛函理论计算表明，沿面外和面内方向的强最近邻超交换相互作用，特别是双层基序内沿晶格 c 方向的磁耦合，是 Sr3Fe2O5X2 中尼尔温度高的主要原因。相比之下，双层间自旋耦合非常弱，可以忽略不计，对反铁磁序的稳定性没有太大影响。因此，理论计算预测，即使在单层极限下，这种强大的反铁磁有序也可以在室温下持续甚至增强。我们的研究结果强调铁基层状卤氧化物作为探索二维极限内的超室温反铁磁性的有前途的平台，在信息存储和基于自旋的设备等领域具有巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Stabilization of LaH₁₀ with Thorium: Superconductivity in (La,Th)H₁₀ up to 232 K near 1 Mbar
articles.title_zh: 用钍稳定 LaH₁₀：(La,Th)H₁₀ 中的超导性高达 232 K，接近 1 Mbar
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ternary lanthanum-based hydrides are among the best high-temperature superconductors. Here we show that substituting La with thorium stabilizes La(Th)H₁₀ clathrate structure at sim1 Mbar while only minimally suppressing superconductivity. The resulting cubic (La,Th)H₁₀ phase, synthesized from relatively air-stable La₂Th, La₃Th and La₅Th alloys, reaches an onset T_c = 232 K at 134 GPa, as confirmed by contact resistance measurements. Superconductivity was verified by two independent methods: electrical resistance and contactless radio-frequency measurements under applied magnetic fields at various pressures. Using a record-high pulsed current of 380 mA, we investigated critical phenomena in P6₃/mmc-(La,Th)H₉ at 173 GPa, which allowed for the experimental determination of a single superconducting gap within the s-wave model: Δ(0) = 37 ± 4.5 meV and 2Δ(0)/kT_c = 4.9 ± 0.6. The La-Th-H system is chemically rich: in addition to the decahydride and nonahydride mentioned above, we also identified nanocrystalline I4/mmm-(La,Th)H₄ (5-6 nm grain size), (La,Th)H₆, as well as hP13, cF80 and A15 phases with compositions of (La,Th)H₅.₇₅₋₆.₂₅ and T_c approx 83 K at 70-80 GPa, and a possible (La,Th)H₁₆ polyhydride.
articles.abstract_zh: 三元镧基氢化物是最好的高温超导体之一。在这里，我们表明，用钍取代 La 可以使 La(Th)H10 包合物结构稳定在 sim1 Mbar，同时仅最小程度地抑制超导性。由相对空气稳定的 La2Th、La3Th 和 La5Th 合金合成的立方 (La,Th)H10 相在 134 GPa 下达到起始 T_c = 232 K，这通过接触电阻测量得到证实。超导性通过两种独立的方法进行验证：电阻和在不同压力下施加磁场下的非接触式射频测量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三元镧基氢化物是最好的高温超导体之一。在这里，我们表明，用钍取代 La 可以使 La(Th)H10 包合物结构稳定在 sim1 Mbar，同时仅最小程度地抑制超导性。由相对空气稳定的 La2Th、La3Th 和 La5Th 合金合成的立方 (La,Th)H10 相在 134 GPa 下达到起始 T_c = 232 K，这通过接触电阻测量得到证实。超导性通过两种独立的方法进行验证：电阻和在不同压力下施加磁场下的非接触式射频测量。使用创纪录的 380 mA 脉冲电流，我们研究了 173 GPa 下 P6₃/mmc-(La,Th)H₉ 中的关键现象，从而可以通过实验确定 s 波模型内的单个超导间隙：Δ(0) = 37 ± 4.5 meV 和 2Δ(0)/kT_c = 4.9 ± 0.6。 La-Th-H体系化学性质丰富：除了上面提到的十氢化物和九氢化物外，我们还鉴定了纳米晶I4/mmm-(La,Th)H₄（晶粒尺寸为5-6 nm）、(La,Th)H6以及组成为(La,Th)H₅.₇5₋₆.25和T_c 在 70-80 GPa 下约为 83 K，并且可能是 (La,Th)H16 多氢化物。

articles.title: Optical spin Edelstein response of d-wave altermagnets
articles.title_zh: d 波交流磁体的光自旋埃德尔斯坦响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The momentum-dependent spin splitting and compensated magnetic order in altermagnets offer opportunities for electrical control of spin polarization. We explore the spin Edelstein effect in the frequency domain of a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with Rashba spin-orbit coupling. We calculate the spin-velocity susceptibility response function beyond the intraband response regime and find that the interband longitudinal and transverse Edelstein responses are governed by the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature, respectively. The density of states presents a logarithmic van Hove singularity at exactly the negative value of the energy below which four disconnected Fermi contours emerge. This defines three distinctive regions for the position of the Fermi level, through which the Edelstein susceptibility tensor displays characteristic spectral features, reflecting the topological change of the Fermi surface. The resulting spin magnetization shows a strong dependence on the driving frequency and on the orientation of the in-plane external electric field. Our results highlight new possibilities for electrical and optical control of the spin Edelstein effect in altermagnets that could find spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 交流磁体中动量相关的自旋分裂和补偿磁序为自旋极化的电控制提供了机会。我们探索了具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的二维 d 波交流磁体频域中的自旋 Edelstein 效应。我们计算了带内响应范围之外的自旋速度磁化率响应函数，发现带间纵向和横向 Edelstein 响应分别由塞曼量子度量和塞曼贝里曲率控制。态密度在能量的负值处呈现对数范霍夫奇点，低于该奇点会出现四个不连续的费米等值线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交流磁体中动量相关的自旋分裂和补偿磁序为自旋极化的电控制提供了机会。我们探索了具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的二维 d 波交流磁体频域中的自旋 Edelstein 效应。我们计算了带内响应范围之外的自旋速度磁化率响应函数，发现带间纵向和横向 Edelstein 响应分别由塞曼量子度量和塞曼贝里曲率控制。态密度在能量的负值处呈现对数范霍夫奇点，低于该奇点会出现四个不连续的费米等值线。这定义了费米能级位置的三个独特区域，通过这些区域，埃德尔斯坦磁化率张量显示出特征光谱特征，反映了费米表面的拓扑变化。由此产生的自旋磁化强度强烈依赖于驱动频率和面内外部电场的方向。我们的结果强调了在交流磁体中对自旋埃德尔斯坦效应进行电学和光学控制的新可能性，这可以找到自旋电子学的应用。

articles.title: Machine Learning the GW Self-Energy Operator for Real Materials
articles.title_zh: 机器学习真实材料的 GW 自能算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning of GW in solids has largely focused on prediction of scalar quasiparticle energy corrections. Here, we introduce a phase-aware many-body transformer that predicts the full k-resolved complex self-energy matrix. As a proof of principle, we apply the model to predict quasiparticle energies before and after diagonalization of the quasiparticle Hamiltonian, obtaining a test set mean absolute error (MAE) of 29 meV for a dataset of 1745 2D materials in the static COHSEX approximation and 60 meV for a more limited dataset of 433 materials calculated within a plasmon-pole model. COHSEX pretraining followed by finetuning reduces this MAE to 42 meV. The predicted matrices also accurately reproduce QP wavefunctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 固体引力波的机器学习主要集中在标量准粒子能量修正的预测上。在这里，我们引入了一个相位感知的多体变压器，它可以预测完整的 k 分辨复杂自能矩阵。作为原理证明，我们应用该模型来预测准粒子哈密顿量对角化之前和之后的准粒子能量，对于静态 COHSEX 近似中的 1745 种二维材料的数据集获得了 29 meV 的测试集平均绝对误差 (MAE)，对于在等离子体激元极模型中计算的 433 种材料的更有限的数据集获得了 60 meV 的测试集平均绝对误差 (MAE)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体引力波的机器学习主要集中在标量准粒子能量修正的预测上。在这里，我们引入了一个相位感知的多体变压器，它可以预测完整的 k 分辨复杂自能矩阵。作为原理证明，我们应用该模型来预测准粒子哈密顿量对角化之前和之后的准粒子能量，对于静态 COHSEX 近似中的 1745 种二维材料的数据集获得了 29 meV 的测试集平均绝对误差 (MAE)，对于在等离子体激元极模型中计算的 433 种材料的更有限的数据集获得了 60 meV 的测试集平均绝对误差 (MAE)。 COHSEX 预训练和微调可将此 MAE 降低至 42 meV。预测矩阵还准确地再现了 QP 波函数。

articles.title: Oxygens breathe, electrons jump
articles.title_zh: 氧气呼吸，电子跳跃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic transport in polyanionic battery cathodes proceeds through small-polaron hopping between transition-metal sites and is commonly assumed to be tightly coupled to the motion of charge-compensating mobile ions. Using olivine LiₓMnPO₄ as a prototypical platform, we use first-principles molecular dynamics with extended Hubbard functionals to follow, in real time and at finite temperature, the adiabatic evolution of Mn oxidation states and atomic sublattices. We find that polaron hopping and cation migration are dynamically decoupled: Mn²⁺/Mn³⁺ valence exchanges occur frequently while the intercalated ions remain confined to their sites, and hopping is gated by the local oxygen framework. Freezing the six oxygen atoms of an individual MnO₆ octahedron excludes that site from the hopping network, while increasing the fictitious oxygen mass slows down electronic transport. Each valence exchange coincides with a concerted breathing of the donor and acceptor octahedra (Δ V simeq 2 Å³), with their volume asymmetry crossing zero at the transition, consistent with the Holstein-Marcus coincidence condition. The hopping rate yields an activation energy of Eₐ = 0.20 ± 0.03 eV, closely matching the elastic energy scale of the two coordination cages (λ_V/4 approx 0.20 eV). These results identify the oxygen coordination cage, not the mobile cation sublattice, as the dynamical gate for small-polaron transport: a site can accept the electron only if its cage can breathe, and the barrier is governed by cage elasticity. Selective constraints and mass scaling applied to first-principles dynamics provide a general route to link electronic and lattice degrees of freedom in redox-active materials, opening the door to framework engineering in intercalation and mixed ionic-electronic conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚阴离子电池阴极中的电子传输通过过渡金属位点之间的小极化子跳跃进行，并且通常被认为与电荷补偿移动离子的运动紧密耦合。使用橄榄石 LiₓMnPO₄ 作为原型平台，我们使用第一原理分子动力学和扩展哈伯德泛函，在有限温度下实时跟踪 Mn 氧化态和原子亚晶格的绝热演化。我们发现极化子跳跃和阳离子迁移是动态解耦的：Mn2⁺/Mn3⁺价态交换频繁发生，而插层离子仍然局限于其位点，并且跳跃受到局部氧框架的门控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚阴离子电池阴极中的电子传输通过过渡金属位点之间的小极化子跳跃进行，并且通常被认为与电荷补偿移动离子的运动紧密耦合。使用橄榄石 LiₓMnPO₄ 作为原型平台，我们使用第一原理分子动力学和扩展哈伯德泛函，在有限温度下实时跟踪 Mn 氧化态和原子亚晶格的绝热演化。我们发现极化子跳跃和阳离子迁移是动态解耦的：Mn2⁺/Mn3⁺价态交换频繁发生，而插层离子仍然局限于其位点，并且跳跃受到局部氧框架的门控。冻结单个 MnO₆ 八面体的六个氧原子会将该位点排除在跳跃网络之外，同时增加虚拟氧质量会减慢电子传输。每次价交换都与供体和受体八面体的协同呼吸一致（Δ V simeq 2 Å³），其体积不对称性在转变处过零，与荷斯坦-马库斯符合条件一致。跳跃率产生的激活能 Eₐ = 0.20 ± 0.03 eV，与两个配位笼的弹性能尺度紧密匹配（λ_V/4 约 0.20 eV）。这些结果将氧配位笼（而不是移动的阳离子亚晶格）确定为小极化子传输的动态门：只有当笼子可以呼吸时，位点才能接受电子，并且势垒由笼子弹性控制。应用于第一原理动力学的选择性约束和质量缩放提供了连接氧化还原活性材料中的电子和晶格自由度的一般途径，为插层和混合离子电子导体的框架工程打开了大门。

articles.title: Strain-Engineering Giant Pseudo-Electric Fields in Multilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 多层石墨烯中的应变工程巨赝电场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electromagnetic scalar and vector potentials can be engineered in solids through lattice distortions, providing a versatile means of tuning electronic band structures. The pseudovector component, which generates pseudo-magnetic fields, has received much attention for its ability to realize a zero-field quantum Hall effect. However, the pseudoscalar component, giving rise to pseudo-electric fields to which many electronic systems are intrinsically susceptible, has not yet been experimentally explored. Here, we demonstrate the emergence and profound consequences of the pseudoscalar potential in a multilayer graphene system. Atomic relaxation reconstructs the system into large Bernalstacked domains separated by one-dimensional rhombohedral channels. Within this inter-dimensional system, we achieve the first direct atomic-scale imaging of distinct lattice deformations in graphene under strain. In rhombohedral channels, we observe that the tensile lattice deformation induces giant pseudo-electric fields, producing ultra-flat dispersion with divergent density of states and a large energy gap. This results in enhanced electronic correlations, leading to flat-band instabilities and striped modulation in the density of states that would otherwise require strong external displacement fields. Moreover, the gap opened by the pseudoscalar potential protects topological boundary states that persist in the absence of applied fields. Our results provide a comprehensive atomic-scale characterization of graphene elasticity and direct spectroscopic evidence for the nontrivial pseudo-electric field arising from lattice distortion. More broadly, it provides an intrinsic and tunable pathway to new quantum states
articles.abstract_zh: 电磁标量和矢量势可以通过晶格畸变在固体中进行设计，提供了一种调节电子能带结构的通用方法。产生赝磁场的赝矢量分量因其能够实现零场量子霍尔效应而备受关注。然而，赝标量分量会产生许多电子系统本质上容易受到赝电场影响的赝标量分量，尚未经过实验探索。在这里，我们展示了多层石墨烯系统中赝标量势的出现及其深远的影响。原子弛豫将系统重建为由一维菱面体通道分隔的大伯纳尔堆叠域。在这个多维系统中，我们首次实现了应变下石墨烯中不同晶格变形的直接原子尺度成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电磁标量和矢量势可以通过晶格畸变在固体中进行设计，提供了一种调节电子能带结构的通用方法。产生赝磁场的赝矢量分量因其能够实现零场量子霍尔效应而备受关注。然而，赝标量分量会产生许多电子系统本质上容易受到赝电场影响的赝标量分量，尚未经过实验探索。在这里，我们展示了多层石墨烯系统中赝标量势的出现及其深远的影响。原子弛豫将系统重建为由一维菱面体通道分隔的大伯纳尔堆叠域。在这个多维系统中，我们首次实现了应变下石墨烯中不同晶格变形的直接原子尺度成像。在菱面体通道中，我们观察到拉伸晶格变形会引起巨大的赝电场，产生具有不同态密度和大能隙的超平坦色散。这导致电子相关性增强，导致平带不稳定性和态密度的条纹调制，否则需要强大的外部位移场。此外，赝标量势打开的间隙可以保护在没有外加场的情况下持续存在的拓扑边界态。我们的结果提供了石墨烯弹性的全面原子尺度表征，以及晶格畸变产生的非平凡赝电场的直接光谱证据。更广泛地说，它提供了通往新量子态的内在且可调的途径

articles.title: Phase diagram and lattice structure of interlayer vortices in multilayer Ising superconductors in parallel magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 平行磁场中多层伊辛超导体层间涡旋的相图和晶格结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate layered s-wave Ising superconductors under an in-plane magnetic field using self-consistent solutions of the microscopic Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations. Comparing bilayer, four-layer, and infinite-layer systems, we determine how the phase diagram and vortex structure evolve with layer number. Compared to standard Ginzburg-Landau treatments, our approach applies over a broader parameter regime and self-consistently resolves the spatial and layer dependence of the gap amplitude without prescribing its form. We find that the field range supporting the conventional Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) phase (defined as having no interlayer vortices) is reduced with increasing layer number and is essentially absent at nonzero magnetic flux in the infinite-layer system, consistent with recent thickness-dependent experiments on multilayer 2H-NbSe₂. In the infinite-layer limit, the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) phase containing interlayer vortices persists to progressively larger in-plane fields as temperature is lowered below the zero-field critical temperature, consistent with the experimentally observed low-temperature enhancement of the upper critical field. The vortex structure also evolves with interlayer hopping: in four-layer systems, for the fluxes and system sizes considered, increasing hopping reorganizes vortices from outer to inner interlayer junctions. At larger hopping, the gap distortion associated with an interior vortex extends to the surface layers, producing gap suppression comparable to that in the interior layers. Representative six-layer calculations show that interior vortices likewise produce a finite, although weaker, modulation of the surface-layer gap. These results highlight layer number and interlayer tunneling as key parameters governing the phase diagram and vortex arrangement in multilayer Ising superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用微观 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程的自洽解研究面内磁场下的层状 s 波伊辛超导体。比较双层、四层和无限层系统，我们确定相图和涡旋结构如何随层数演变。与标准的 Ginzburg-Landau 处理相比，我们的方法适用于更广泛的参数范围，并且自洽地解决了间隙幅度的空间和层依赖性，而无需规定其形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们使用微观 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程的自洽解研究面内磁场下的层状 s 波伊辛超导体。比较双层、四层和无限层系统，我们确定相图和涡旋结构如何随层数演变。与标准的 Ginzburg-Landau 处理相比，我们的方法适用于更广泛的参数范围，并且自洽地解决了间隙幅度的空间和层依赖性，而无需规定其形式。我们发现，支持传统 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 相（定义为没有层间涡旋）的场范围随着层数的增加而减小，并且在无限层系统中的非零磁通量处基本上不存在，这与最近对多层 2H-NbSe2 的厚度相关实验一致。在无限层极限中，当温度降至零场临界温度以下时，包含层间涡旋的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) 相持续存在逐渐变大的面内场，这与实验观察到的上临界场的低温增强一致。涡旋结构也随着层间跳跃而演变：在四层系统中，对于所考虑的通量和系统尺寸，增加跳跃会重新组织从外层到内层间连接的涡旋。在较大的跳跃时，与内部涡流相关的间隙畸变延伸到表面层，产生与内部层相当的间隙抑制。代表性的六层计算表明，内部涡流同样会产生有限但较弱的表面层间隙调制。这些结果强调了层数和层间隧道效应是控制多层伊辛超导体相图和涡流排列的关键参数。

articles.title: Efficient Finite-Temperature Krylov Methods Based on Imaginary-Time Evolution
articles.title_zh: 基于虚时演化的高效有限温度Krylov方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.20506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop two finite-temperature Krylov methods that construct Krylov subspaces using imaginary-time evolution rather than direct applications of the Hamiltonian. The finite-temperature imaginary-time Lanczos method (FTiTL) applies the Lanczos method to the imaginary-time evolution operator, whereas the finite-temperature imaginary-time Krylov method (FTiTK) constructs a generalized eigenvalue problem using a nonorthogonal Krylov basis. We evaluate the accuracy and computational efficiency of these methods for the square-lattice transverse-field Ising model, using exact diagonalization for N=16 and quantum Monte Carlo results for N=32 as references. With appropriately chosen imaginary-time steps, both methods achieve higher accuracy than the conventional finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM) with fewer local operator applications in the ferromagnetic regime and near the quantum critical point. For N=32, FTiTL requires approximately half as many local operator applications as FTLM to achieve a root-mean-square error of 10⁻² or less in the specific heat C/N. Furthermore, FTiTK can be implemented using only one state vector of full Hilbert-space dimension, halving the memory required for storing state vectors relative to FTLM.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了两种有限温度Krylov方法，它们使用虚时演化而非直接应用哈密顿量来构造Krylov子空间。有限温度虚时Lanczos方法（FTiTL）将Lanczos方法应用于虚时演化算子，而有限温度虚时Krylov方法（FTiTK）则使用非正交Krylov基构造广义特征值问题。我们使用N=16的精确对角化和N=32的量子蒙特卡洛结果作为参考，评估了这些方法在处理方格子横场伊辛模型时的准确性和计算效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了两种有限温度Krylov方法，它们使用虚时演化而非直接应用哈密顿量来构造Krylov子空间。有限温度虚时Lanczos方法（FTiTL）将Lanczos方法应用于虚时演化算子，而有限温度虚时Krylov方法（FTiTK）则使用非正交Krylov基构造广义特征值问题。我们使用N=16的精确对角化和N=32的量子蒙特卡洛结果作为参考，评估了这些方法在处理方格子横场伊辛模型时的准确性和计算效率。通过适当选择虚时间步长，这两种方法在铁磁态和量子临界点附近，与传统的有限温度Lanczos方法（FTLM）相比，以更少的局部算符应用实现了更高的精度。对于N=32，FTiTL所需本地算子应用数量约为FTLM的一半，即可在比热C/N上达到10⁻²或更小的均方根误差。此外，FTiTK仅需使用一个全希尔伯特空间维度的状态向量即可实现，与FTLM相比，存储状态向量所需的内存减半。

articles.title: Inversion of magnetization anisotropy in low magnetic fields for textured Bi2223 superconductor due to magnetic responses from superconducting crystallites and intercrystalline boundaries
