We compare the certificate with a grid convergence study on the same solver. On graded grids the study is sharper for local fields but remains an estimate. On uniform grids it fails to converge at the electrode edge, where the certificate still gives a valid bracket. Solvers that deliberately solve equations other than the specified ones pass the grid convergence study, but the certificates refute their claims or leave them unsupported.
articles.abstract_zh: 脉冲场消融的计算模型将电场超过致死阈值的组织预测为病灶。它们的数值误差很少有界，并且自动化管道越来越多地运行它们，而没有专家来检查每个结果。为了验证每次运行，我们将问题“所述模型是否得到正确求解？”与回答该问题的求解器分开。不可信的求解器在返回其答案时会附上一份证书，其中包含具有正确电极和接地值的电势以及完全守恒的电流。一个小型独立检查器根据物理学的书面规范来验证证书。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脉冲场消融的计算模型将电场超过致死阈值的组织预测为病灶。它们的数值误差很少有界，并且自动化管道越来越多地运行它们，而没有专家来检查每个结果。为了验证每次运行，我们将问题“所述模型是否得到正确求解？”与回答该问题的求解器分开。不可信的求解器在返回其答案时会附上一份证书，其中包含具有正确电极和接地值的电势以及完全守恒的电流。一个小型独立检查器根据物理学的书面规范来验证证书。使用在球运算中评估的Prager-Synge超圆定理，它将证书转化为对病灶图每个网格的阻抗和均方根场（也在一系列血液/组织电导率比范围内）的保证性双侧界限。向量化版本的检查器大约需要十分之一的求解时间。对于接触的焦电极，经证明，在1000 V和700 V/cm下，对于1.7至3.75的每个比值，网格分辨深度均在3.50-3.75 mm范围内。对于双极导管，经认证的深度与已发布的体内深度重叠。如果它们与已发布的参考模型存在差异，则证书证明该差异并非我们计算中的数值误差。我们将证书与同一求解器上的网格收敛性研究进行比较。在分级网格上，对于局部场的研究更为精确，但仍是估算值。在均匀网格上，它在电极边缘处无法收敛，而证书仍给出有效的范围。故意求解非指定方程的求解器通过了网格收敛性研究，但证书驳斥了它们的说法或不予支持。

articles.title: Reconciling global and local spin models
articles.title_zh: 协调全球和本地自旋模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic interactions based on first-principles calculations can be casted either into global spin models, where the interactions are configuration-independent, or into local spin models, where the effective parameters depend explicitly on the underlying spin configuration. Although these two perspectives often yield seemingly inconsistent results, we demonstrate that they can be reconciled by restricting the analysis to transverse spin fluctuations. We develop a projection scheme that systematically removes spurious longitudinal contributions from local interaction matrices, thereby establishing a rigorous connection between the projected local interactions and the underlying global multispin Hamiltonian. Applying our approach to the prototype systems (i) a Cr trimer on Au(111) (ii) Fe and Cr dimers on Cu(001), we show that the projected local interaction parameters quantitatively reproduce those obtained from the global four-spin model. This work provides a unified framework to interpret local and global spin models on equal footing and resolves long-standing ambiguities in the identification of effective interactions such as the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in a non-collinear framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于第一性原理计算的磁相互作用可以转化为全局自旋模型（其中相互作用与构型无关），也可以转化为局部自旋模型（其中有效参数明确取决于底层的自旋构型）。尽管这两种观点往往会得出看似不一致的结果，但我们证明，通过将分析限制在横向自旋涨落上，可以使它们协调一致。我们开发了一种投影方案，该方案可系统地从局部相互作用矩阵中去除虚假的纵向贡献，从而在投影的局部相互作用与潜在的全局多自旋哈密顿量之间建立起严密的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于第一性原理计算的磁相互作用可以转化为全局自旋模型（其中相互作用与构型无关），也可以转化为局部自旋模型（其中有效参数明确取决于底层的自旋构型）。尽管这两种观点往往会得出看似不一致的结果，但我们证明，通过将分析限制在横向自旋涨落上，可以使它们协调一致。我们开发了一种投影方案，该方案可系统地从局部相互作用矩阵中去除虚假的纵向贡献，从而在投影的局部相互作用与潜在的全局多自旋哈密顿量之间建立起严密的联系。将我们的方法应用于原型系统（i）Au(111)上的Cr三聚体，（ii）Cu(001)上的Fe和Cr二聚体，我们表明投影的局部相互作用参数定量地再现了从全局四自旋模型中获得的参数。这项工作提供了一个统一的框架，可以在同等基础上解释局部和全局自旋模型，并解决了在非共线框架中识别有效相互作用（如Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI））方面长期存在的模糊性。

articles.title: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
articles.title_zh: WeatherDreamer：从多模态地球观测中学习世界模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18393v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation (GSI) DA system, WeatherDreamer's short-range departures are within 10% of GSI's at surface stations and within 25% for moisture-sensitive microwave channels, but up to five times larger for temperature-sounding channels. Never given observation errors, its learned update assumes errors close to known instrument and retrieval errors of microwave sounders and scatterometer winds. WeatherDreamer also separates viewing geometry from atmospheric state, recovering 83-96% of observed limb darkening and producing seamless nadir-view imagery. Producing an hourly global analysis in about 1.5 minutes on one GPU, WeatherDreamer shows that assimilation and forecasting can be learned together directly from observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习天气模型现在已能与业务性全球预报相媲美，但仍需以独立、昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统所产生的分析为起点，对于全球模型而言，这些分析通常每六小时更新一次。观测到观测模型避免了这种依赖性，但大多数模型都省略了递归滤波循环，该循环使DA系统能够通过稀疏、不规则的观测来传递背景状态。我们推出了WeatherDreamer，这是一个世界模型，能够从18个全球观测系统端到端地学习这一循环，无需进行再分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习天气模型现在已能与业务性全球预报相媲美，但仍需以独立、昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统所产生的分析为起点，对于全球模型而言，这些分析通常每六小时更新一次。观测到观测模型避免了这种依赖性，但大多数模型都省略了递归滤波循环，该循环使DA系统能够通过稀疏、不规则的观测来传递背景状态。我们推出了WeatherDreamer，这是一个世界模型，能够从18个全球观测系统端到端地学习这一循环，无需进行再分析。它从观测数据中推断出潜在状态，利用所学习的动力学逐小时推进该状态，每小时用新的观测数据对其进行校正，并能够预测其任何观测系统在任何位置的测量结果。在留存站点，其集合预测在温度、露点和风速方面优于 NOAA 的全球集合预报系统 (GEFS)，预测时效长达 12 小时，并且校准效果优于 GEFS 和 ECMWF 集合预测。降水、云顶高度和太阳辐照度在推理时从未作为输入，但在短期预测中，其推理结果的准确性与业务产品相当或更胜一筹。与NOAA的格点统计插值（GSI）DA系统的第一次猜测相比，WeatherDreamer的短期偏差在地面站与GSI的偏差相差10%以内，在湿度敏感的微波通道相差25%以内，但在温度探测通道相差高达5倍。在从未提供观测误差的情况下，其学习更新假设误差接近微波探测仪和散射计风的已知仪器误差和反演误差。WeatherDreamer 还将视线几何与大气状态区分开来，恢复了 83-96% 的观测边缘暗化，并生成了无缝的天顶视图图像。WeatherDreamer 在一个 GPU 上大约 1.5 分钟内即可生成每小时的全球分析，这表明同化和预测可以直接从观测数据中一起学习。

articles.title: Fuse-PINN: Combining Finite Element Methods and Physics-Informed Neural Networks to enable massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs
articles.title_zh: Fuse-PINN：将有限元方法与物理信息神经网络相结合，实现非线性PDE的大规模并行模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18409v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Research in the domain of Physics-Informed Neural Networks applied to PDE modelling has advanced significantly in recent years, providing a wide ecosystem of novel methods. However, one frequent limitation is the inability of PINNs to scale out on High-Performance Computing architectures to address more ambitious challenges, particularly non-linear physics models with turbulent dynamics in large spatial domains. Typical studies restrain demonstrations to toy models with simple physics equations, few variables, and rarely any complex non-linear dynamics evolved over long timescales. Part of the AI community has even adopted the idea that "PINNs don't scale". This work proves otherwise. We present a mathematically robust formulation of Finite-Element-Method for Neural Networks (FEM-NN) implemented into a comprehensive, modular framework: Fuse-PINN. This formulation provides the basis for a sclable parallelisation of Physics-Informed Neural Networks on GPU-based HPC systems. Furthermore, an Energy Natural Gradient Descent optimiser is implemented to allow high-precision convergence. Fuse-PINN is demonstrated on physics models relevant to Magnetic Confinement Fusion, including non-linear convective models with fine-scale dynamics. Near-perfect scaling is achieved on multi-GPU runs with increasing problem size.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，将物理信息神经网络应用于 PDE 建模领域的研究取得了显著进展，提供了一个包含各种新方法的广泛生态系统。然而，一个常见的局限性是，PINN 无法在高性能计算架构上横向扩展，以应对更具挑战性的问题，特别是在大空间域中具有湍流动力学的非线性物理模型。典型的研究将演示限制在具有简单物理方程、变量较少的玩具模型中，很少有任何复杂的非线性动力学在较长时间尺度上演化。人工智能社区的一部分人甚至采纳了“PINN 不具备可扩展性”的观点。这项工作证明事实并非如此。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，将物理信息神经网络应用于 PDE 建模领域的研究取得了显著进展，提供了一个包含各种新方法的广泛生态系统。然而，一个常见的局限性是，PINN 无法在高性能计算架构上横向扩展，以应对更具挑战性的问题，特别是在大空间域中具有湍流动力学的非线性物理模型。典型的研究将演示限制在具有简单物理方程、变量较少的玩具模型中，很少有任何复杂的非线性动力学在较长时间尺度上演化。人工智能社区的一部分人甚至采纳了“PINN 不具备可扩展性”的观点。这项工作证明事实并非如此。我们提出了一个数学上稳健的神经网络有限元方法（FEM-NN）公式，并将其实现为一个全面、模块化的框架：Fuse-PINN。该公式为基于 GPU 的 HPC 系统上物理信息神经网络的可扩展并行化奠定了基础。此外，还实施了能量自然梯度下降优化器，以实现高精度收敛。Fuse-PINN 在与磁约束聚变相关的物理模型上得到了展示，包括具有精细尺度动力学的非线性对流模型。随着问题规模的增大，在多GPU运行中实现了近乎完美的扩展。

articles.title: Restoring Consistency with Poynting's Theorem in Numerical MHD and RMHD
articles.title_zh: 在数值MHD和RMHD中恢复与坡印廷定理的一致性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18508v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For perfectly conducting plasmas, Poynting's theorem states that the time rate of change of electromagnetic energy density equals the negative of the divergence of the Poynting flux. To the best of our knowledge, this involutive theorem has never been mimetically incorporated in codes. We show that there is an inconsistency in MHD and RMHD codes that evolve face-centered magnetic fields in globally-divergence-free fashion. This is because the face-centered flux of energy density, which incorporates a Poynting vector, is evaluated using one-dimensional Riemann solvers that are applied at face-centers. However, the face-centered magnetic fields are evolved according to edge-centered electric fields that come from two-dimensional Riemann solvers that are applied to the edges of a zone. While edge-centered electric fields are used to evolve the magnetic field, they have no influence on the face-centered Poynting flux. For situations where the magnetic energy is much larger than the thermal energy, this causes a negative pressure to be evaluated at the zone-centers. This paper restores consistency by using edge-centered variables to evaluate a face-centered Poynting flux. A simple accuracy-preserving correction is made to the face-centered flux of energy density. We show that it helps considerably in simulations that have very strong magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于完美传导的等离子体，坡印廷定理指出，电磁能量密度的时间变化率等于坡印廷通量散度的负值。据我们所知，这个内卷定理从未被模拟地纳入代码中。我们表明，以全局无散度方式演化面心磁场的 MHD 和 RMHD 代码存在不一致。这是因为面心能量密度通量（包含坡印廷矢量）是使用应用于面中心的一维黎曼求解器来评估的。然而，面心磁场是根据边缘中心电场演化而来的，这些电场来自应用于区域边缘的二维黎曼求解器。虽然边缘中心电场用于演化磁场，但它们对面心坡印廷通量没有影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于完美传导的等离子体，坡印廷定理指出，电磁能量密度的时间变化率等于坡印廷通量散度的负值。据我们所知，这个内卷定理从未被模拟地纳入代码中。我们表明，以全局无散度方式演化面心磁场的 MHD 和 RMHD 代码存在不一致。这是因为面心能量密度通量（包含坡印廷矢量）是使用应用于面中心的一维黎曼求解器来评估的。然而，面心磁场是根据边缘中心电场演化而来的，这些电场来自应用于区域边缘的二维黎曼求解器。虽然边缘中心电场用于演化磁场，但它们对面心坡印廷通量没有影响。对于磁能远大于热能的情况，这会导致在区域中心评估负压。本文通过使用边缘中心变量来评估面中心坡印廷通量来恢复一致性。对面心能量密度通量进行简单的保持精度的校正。我们证明它对于具有非常强磁场的模拟有很大帮助。

articles.title: Complex fluid flow dynamics by bright scattershot boson sampling
articles.title_zh: 通过明亮的散射玻色子采样研究复杂的流体流动动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18510v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Boson sampling machines have become a fruitful tool for establishing new concepts, which connect fundamental physics with computer science applications. Here, we exploit the intrinsically high-dimensional correlations generated by the measurement outcomes of a multiphoton boson sampling machine and demonstrate how a reconfigurable architecture can be programmed to autonomously model the time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems that describe complex fluid flows. By extending on the original scattershot boson sampling (SBS) scheme to include higher photon number components -- a scheme which we label bright scattershot boson sampling (BSBS) --- this scheme overcomes scaling issues inherent to SBS-based schemes by utilizing all randomly generated input photon number distributions. We illustrate the capability of this scheme for two complex fluid-flow models: an eight-dimensional Lorenz-type model of two-dimensional thermally driven convection and a 16-dimensional model of global atmospheric circulation. Using a digital twin of the BSBS architecture based on multiphoton statistics, we show that the photonic approach accurately reproduces the temporal dynamics of both systems while being resilient to photon losses of up to 50 per cent. We also verified that the BSBS case outperforms a comparable run with coherent light. Moreover, its prediction horizon exceeds that of a classical reservoir-computing model with the same query complexity. These results highlight the potential of near-term photonic quantum computing for addressing relevant real-world tasks on noisy intermediate-scale devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色子采样机已成为建立新概念的富有成效的工具，将基础物理学与计算机科学应用联系起来。在这里，我们利用多光子玻色子采样机的测量结果生成的内在高维相关性，并演示如何对可重构架构进行编程，以自动模拟描述复杂流体流动的非线性动力系统的时间演化。通过扩展原始的散射玻色子采样 (SBS) 方案以包含更高的光子数分量（我们将这种方案标记为亮散射玻色子采样 (BSBS)），该方案通过利用所有随机生成的输入光子数分布，克服了基于 SBS 的方案固有的缩放问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 玻色子采样机已成为建立新概念的富有成效的工具，将基础物理学与计算机科学应用联系起来。在这里，我们利用多光子玻色子采样机的测量结果生成的内在高维相关性，并演示如何对可重构架构进行编程，以自动模拟描述复杂流体流动的非线性动力系统的时间演化。通过扩展原始的散射玻色子采样 (SBS) 方案以包含更高的光子数分量（我们将这种方案标记为亮散射玻色子采样 (BSBS)），该方案通过利用所有随机生成的输入光子数分布，克服了基于 SBS 的方案固有的缩放问题。我们说明了该方案对于两个复杂流体流动模型的能力：二维热驱动对流的八维洛伦兹型模型和全球大气环流的 16 维模型。使用基于多光子统计的 BSBS 架构的数字孪生，我们表明光子方法可以准确地再现两个系统的时间动态，同时能够承受高达 50% 的光子损失。我们还验证了 BSBS 案例的性能优于相干光的类似运行。此外，其预测范围超过了具有相同查询复杂度的经典油藏计算模型。这些结果凸显了近期光子量子计算在解决嘈杂的中等规模设备上的相关现实任务方面的潜力。

articles.title: CP-violating non-linear electrodynamics and corrections to blackbody radiation thermal laws
articles.title_zh: CP 破坏非线性电动力学和黑体辐射热定律修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.02054v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by ideas from effective field theories, we conduct a twofold investigation in CP-violating non-linear electrodynamics models. On the one hand, features related to field equations and wave propagation in the presence of a magnetic background field are evaluated. Interestingly, we show that the CP-violating term in our framework induces a bi-anisotropic behavior of the vacuum. On the other hand, blackbody radiation thermal laws in this situation are studied. Here, we provide a general formalism for photons at low temperature, namely, with kBTllmₑc². The deviations from standard values of the thermodynamic quantities, such as energy, pressure, entropy, and specific heat, are discussed. In addition, we investigate the modifications in the Planck distribution and the Stefan-Boltzmann law induced by a non-trivial CP-violating parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 受有效场论思想的启发，我们对 CP 破坏非线性电动力学模型进行了双重研究。一方面，评估与场方程和存在背景磁场的波传播相关的特征。有趣的是，我们表明框架中的 CP 破坏项会引起真空的双各向异性行为。另一方面，研究了这种情况下的黑体辐射热定律。在这里，我们提供了低温光子的一般形式，即 kBTllmₑc²。讨论了能量、压力、熵和比热等热力学量与标准值的偏差。此外，我们还研究了由非平凡 CP 破坏参数引起的普朗克分布和 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律的修改。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受有效场论思想的启发，我们对 CP 破坏非线性电动力学模型进行了双重研究。一方面，评估与场方程和存在背景磁场的波传播相关的特征。有趣的是，我们表明框架中的 CP 破坏项会引起真空的双各向异性行为。另一方面，研究了这种情况下的黑体辐射热定律。在这里，我们提供了低温光子的一般形式，即 kBTllmₑc²。讨论了能量、压力、熵和比热等热力学量与标准值的偏差。此外，我们还研究了由非平凡 CP 破坏参数引起的普朗克分布和 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律的修改。

articles.title: Symmetry-Engineered Magnetic Dipole Emission in Plasmonic Core-Satellite Resonators
articles.title_zh: 等离激元核心卫星谐振器中对称设计的磁偶极子发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07140v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic dipole (MD) transitions are intrinsically weak and highly sensitive to emitter orientation and position, making their controlled enhancement at optical frequencies particularly challenging. Here we show that structural symmetry provides a powerful route to robust magnetic light-matter interactions. We systematically investigate plasmonic core-satellite resonators composed of N metallic nanoparticles arranged on a dielectric core. We evaluate their performance using a unified figure of merit that accounts for magnetic Purcell enhancement, electric dipole suppression, quantum efficiency, and robustness to emitter orientation and fabrication tolerances. We find that the optimal structures correspond to the highest-symmetry geometries, which naturally produce spatially homogeneous and orientation-independent magnetic Purcell enhancement. In particular, the dodecapod configuration yields strong magnetic emission with Purcell factors approaching 590, good radiative efficiency, and suppressed electric dipole contributions. Quasinormal-mode and complex mode-volume analysis reveal that symmetry enforces uniform magnetic modal confinement within the core, explaining both the enhancement and its robustness. These results establish symmetry as a guiding principle for designing nanophotonic resonators with controlled multipolar light-matter interactions and provide a practical route toward bright and selective magnetic dipole emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁偶极子（MD）跃迁本质上很弱，并且对发射器方向和位置高度敏感，这使得它们在光频率下的受控增强特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明结构对称性为强磁光-物质相互作用提供了一条强有力的途径。我们系统地研究了由排列在介电芯上的 N 金属纳米粒子组成的等离子体核心卫星谐振器。我们使用统一的品质因数来评估它们的性能，该品质因数考虑了磁赛尔增强、电偶极子抑制、量子效率以及发射极方向和制造公差的鲁棒性。我们发现最佳结构对应于最高对称性的几何形状，这自然会产生空间均匀且与方向无关的磁赛尔增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁偶极子（MD）跃迁本质上很弱，并且对发射器方向和位置高度敏感，这使得它们在光频率下的受控增强特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明结构对称性为强磁光-物质相互作用提供了一条强有力的途径。我们系统地研究了由排列在介电芯上的 N 金属纳米粒子组成的等离子体核心卫星谐振器。我们使用统一的品质因数来评估它们的性能，该品质因数考虑了磁赛尔增强、电偶极子抑制、量子效率以及发射极方向和制造公差的鲁棒性。我们发现最佳结构对应于最高对称性的几何形状，这自然会产生空间均匀且与方向无关的磁赛尔增强。特别是，十二足结构可产生强磁发射，珀塞尔因子接近 590，具有良好的辐射效率，并抑制电偶极子贡献。准正态模式和复模体积分析表明，对称性在磁芯内强制实施均匀的磁模态限制，这解释了增强性及其鲁棒性。这些结果将对称性确立为设计具有受控多极光-物质相互作用的纳米光子谐振器的指导原则，并为实现明亮的选择性磁偶极子发射器提供了实用途径。

articles.title: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for kinetic shock waves: simultaneous accuracy of lower- and higher-order moments, with and without moment supervision
articles.title_zh: 用于动力学冲击波的物理信息神经网络 (PINN)：具有或不具有矩监督的低阶矩和高阶矩的同步精度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for one-dimensional kinetic shock waves governed by the Bhatnagar--Gross--Krook (BGK) and Shakhov collision models, with and without moment supervision. The trace-free third-order and the fourth-order moments enter the fluxes of stress and heat flux through a shock; the aim, to our knowledge not previously examined for kinetic PINNs, is simultaneous accuracy of these and the lower-order moments of one predicted distribution. Data-assisted calculations, including anchor and closure studies, combine kinetic residuals with moment observations. For the BGK shock tube, a positive eight-moment representation whose spatial envelope follows the far-field decay of the initial condition gives heat-flux, stress and higher-moment discrepancies of 0.33%, 0.67% and 1.8--2.0% against the 6400-cell discrete-velocity method (DVM) reference supplying its observations; a five-field representation leaves the latter uncontrolled. Equation-trained characteristic-integral PINNs use analytic initial and incoming-boundary distributions and their own predicted moments. Their BGK and Shakhov shock-tube heat-flux and stress discrepancies are 0.41% and 0.36% against 3200-cell references; against the 6400-cell reference the BGK values are 0.21% and 0.18%, and 0.4--0.9% for the higher moments. Stationary neural continuation covers Shakhov Mach 2--5 and BGK Mach 6--7. Characteristic correction reduces the Mach-7 heat-flux and stress discrepancies from 3.37% and 1.34% to 0.42% and 0.43%; at Mach~8 they are 0.62% and 0.79%, and at Mach~12, across references, 0.40--1.03% and 0.41--2.65%. Three independent Mach-2 initialisations assess repeatability. It is established that lower moments do not determine higher ones; the contribution is to quantify which moments each information regime recovers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) 和 Shakhov 碰撞模型控制的一维动力学冲击波的物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，有或没有力矩监督。无痕三阶和四阶矩通过激波进入应力流和热流；据我们所知，之前没有对动力学 PINN 进行过检查，其目的是同时实现这些和一个预测分布的低阶矩的准确性。数据辅助计算，包括锚定和闭合研究，将动力学残差与矩观测结合起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) 和 Shakhov 碰撞模型控制的一维动力学冲击波的物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，有或没有力矩监督。无痕三阶和四阶矩通过激波进入应力流和热流；据我们所知，之前没有对动力学 PINN 进行过检查，其目的是同时实现这些和一个预测分布的低阶矩的准确性。数据辅助计算，包括锚定和闭合研究，将动力学残差与矩观测结合起来。对于 BGK 激波管，其空间包络遵循初始条件的远场衰减的正八矩表示与提供其观测结果的 6400 单元离散速度方法 (DVM) 参考相比，给出了 0.33%、0.67% 和 1.8--2.0% 的热通量、应力和高矩差异；五场表示使后者不受控制。方程训练的特征积分 PINN 使用解析初始和传入边界分布及其自己的预测矩。与 3200 个单元的参考相比，其 BGK 和 Shakhov 激波管热通量和应力差异分别为 0.41% 和 0.36%；与 6400 单元参考相比，BGK 值为 0.21% 和 0.18%，较高矩为 0.4--0.9%。稳态神经延拓涵盖 Shakhov Mach 2--5 和 BGK Mach 6--7。特性校正将 Mach-7 热通量和应力差异从 3.37% 和 1.34% 减少到 0.42% 和 0.43%；在马赫~8 时，它们分别为 0.62% 和 0.79%，在马赫~12 时，跨参考值分别为 0.40--1.03% 和 0.41--2.65%。三个独立的 Mach-2 初始化评估可重复性。事实证明，较低的力矩并不决定较高的力矩；贡献在于量化每个信息机制恢复的时刻。

articles.title: Learning transferable event representations for charmed baryon physics at BESIII
articles.title_zh: 在 BESIII 学习粲算重子物理的可转移事件表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29088v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deep learning has become an essential tool in high-energy physics, where the ability to learn transferable event representations can significantly improve model generalization across related physics processes. In this work, we present a Particle Transformer-based framework for learning such representations for charmed baryon physics in the BESIII experiment. The framework is implemented through large-scale pre-training on Monte Carlo simulation samples and subsequent fine-tuning for downstream analyses. Using the production and decays of the charmed baryon Λ_c⁺ as a benchmark, we develop pre-trained models for both event classification and momentum-direction regression. The classification model learns discriminative event representations for the dominant physics categories, rejecting 96.90% of background events at a signal efficiency of 90.00%. Across 12 benchmark Λ_c⁺ decay channels, fine-tuning from the pre-trained model achieves performance comparable to or better than training from scratch, with particularly clear improvements in low-statistics regimes. For the regression task, the pre-trained model improves the average angular resolutions across the same benchmark channels. Further improvement is obtained after fine-tuning in the representative semileptonic decay Λ_c⁺ → p K⁻ e⁺ νₑ. In addition, the predicted momentum direction enables reconstruction of the parent kinematics without a recoil-side tag and thereby increases signal efficiency. For this semileptonic decay, the pre-trained regression model increases the signal efficiency by approximately one order of magnitude relative to the double-tag method. This strategy provides a scalable solution for a wide range of physics cases at BESIII and can be extended to other high energy experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 深度学习已成为高能物理领域的重要工具，学习可转移事件表示的能力可以显着提高相关物理过程的模型泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于粒子变换器的框架，用于学习 BESIII 实验中粲算重子物理的这种表示。该框架是通过对蒙特卡罗模拟样本进行大规模预训练以及后续下游分析的微调来实现的。使用粲算重子 Λ_c⁺ 的产生和衰变作为基准，我们开发了用于事件分类和动量方向回归的预训练模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度学习已成为高能物理领域的重要工具，学习可转移事件表示的能力可以显着提高相关物理过程的模型泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于粒子变换器的框架，用于学习 BESIII 实验中粲算重子物理的这种表示。该框架是通过对蒙特卡罗模拟样本进行大规模预训练以及后续下游分析的微调来实现的。使用粲算重子 Λ_c⁺ 的产生和衰变作为基准，我们开发了用于事件分类和动量方向回归的预训练模型。分类模型学习主要物理类别的判别性事件表示，以 90.00% 的信号效率拒绝 96.90% 的背景事件。在 12 个基准 Λ_c⁺ 衰减通道中，对预训练模型进行微调所获得的性能与从头开始的训练相当或更好，尤其是在低统计数据方面有明显的改进。对于回归任务，预训练模型提高了相同基准通道的平均角分辨率。对代表性的半轻衰变 Λ_c⁺ → p K⁻ e⁺ νₑ 进行微调后，获得了进一步的改进。此外，预测的动量方向能够在没有反冲侧标签的情况下重建母体运动学，从而提高信号效率。对于这种半轻衰变，预训练的回归模型相对于双标签方法将信号效率提高了大约一个数量级。该策略为 BESIII 的各种物理案例提供了可扩展的解决方案，并且可以扩展到其他高能实验。

articles.title: Amortized Inference of Multi-Modal Posteriors using Likelihood-Weighted Normalizing Flows
articles.title_zh: 使用似然加权归一化流的多模态后验分摊推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.04954v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a technique for posterior estimation using Normalizing Flows trained with likelihood-weighted importance sampling, the special case of neural importance sampling in which the proposal is the prior. This approach allows for the efficient inference of theoretical parameters in high-dimensional inverse problems without the need for posterior training samples. We implement the method on multi-modal benchmark tasks in 2D and 3D to check for the efficacy. A critical observation of our study is the impact of the base distribution on the modelled posteriors. We find that standard unimodal base distributions leave spurious probability bridges between well-separated modes. We demonstrate that initializing the flow with a Gaussian Mixture Model that matches the number of target modes significantly improves reconstruction fidelity, as measured by some distance and divergence metrics. Finally, we apply this method to a curated problem in heavy flavour physics --- the extraction of the Wolfenstein parameters from the CP asymmetry in B⁰→ J/ψ,K⁰; it is multimodal, non-Gaussian, and asymmetric in its mode weights --- and compare the results against a well-converged Markov Chain Monte Carlo reference and an exact reference computed by quadrature, using different metrics. Used as a proposal for importance sampling, the trained flow removes its remaining bias and gives the evidence.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用通过似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流进行后验估计的技术，这是神经重要性采样的特殊情况，其中建议是先验的。这种方法可以在高维反问题中有效地推断理论参数，而不需要后验训练样本。我们在 2D 和 3D 多模态基准任务上实现该方法以检查效果。我们研究的一个关键观察是基础分布对建模后验的影响。我们发现标准单峰基分布在分离良好的模式之间留下了虚假的概率桥。我们证明，使用与目标模式数量相匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流可以显着提高重建保真度，如通过一些距离和散度度量来衡量的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种使用通过似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流进行后验估计的技术，这是神经重要性采样的特殊情况，其中建议是先验的。这种方法可以在高维反问题中有效地推断理论参数，而不需要后验训练样本。我们在 2D 和 3D 多模态基准任务上实现该方法以检查效果。我们研究的一个关键观察是基础分布对建模后验的影响。我们发现标准单峰基分布在分离良好的模式之间留下了虚假的概率桥。我们证明，使用与目标模式数量相匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流可以显着提高重建保真度，如通过一些距离和散度度量来衡量的。最后，我们将该方法应用于重口味物理中的一个策划问题——从 B⁰→ J/ψ,K⁰ 中的 CP 不对称性中提取德军总部参数；它是多模态、非高斯且模态权重不对称的——并将结果与良好收敛的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗参考和使用不同度量通过求积计算的精确参考进行比较。作为重要性采样的建议，经过训练的流程消除了其剩余的偏差并提供了证据。

articles.title: Quantum optimal control of steady orbits
articles.title_zh: 稳定轨道的量子最优控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15383v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Periodically driven dissipative systems can settle into steady orbits - fixed infinite loops on their dynamical manifolds. In quantum mechanics, steady orbits occur in cooling engines, lasers and masers, precision metrology devices, and magnetic resonance. Steady orbits and stroboscopic steady states are a promising target for quantum optimal control, but the numerical complexity is prohibitive: infinite loops defeat state-of-the-art algorithms that use explicit numerical propagation in the time domain. We report a solution to this problem and introduce a numerically efficient quantum optimal control algorithm for steady orbits. We use this algorithm to design microwave pulse sequences that dynamically polarise nuclear spins and enhance their magnetic resonance signals, while taking into account instrumental distortions. Improved performance relative to leading current methods is demonstrated experimentally.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动的耗散系统可以进入稳定轨道——其动态流形上的固定无限循环。在量子力学中，稳定轨道出现在冷却发动机、激光器和微波激射器、精密计量设备和磁共振中。稳定轨道和频闪稳态是量子最优控制的一个有希望的目标，但数值复杂性令人望而却步：无限循环击败了在时域中使用显式数值传播的最先进算法。我们报告了该问题的解决方案，并引入了稳定轨道的数值高效量子最优控制算法。我们使用该算法来设计微波脉冲序列，动态极化核自旋并增强其磁共振信号，同时考虑仪器失真。实验证明了相对于当前领先方法的改进性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性驱动的耗散系统可以进入稳定轨道——其动态流形上的固定无限循环。在量子力学中，稳定轨道出现在冷却发动机、激光器和微波激射器、精密计量设备和磁共振中。稳定轨道和频闪稳态是量子最优控制的一个有希望的目标，但数值复杂性令人望而却步：无限循环击败了在时域中使用显式数值传播的最先进算法。我们报告了该问题的解决方案，并引入了稳定轨道的数值高效量子最优控制算法。我们使用该算法来设计微波脉冲序列，动态极化核自旋并增强其磁共振信号，同时考虑仪器失真。实验证明了相对于当前领先方法的改进性能。

articles.title: Dual-Pilot-Assisted Frequency and Phase Recovery in Experimental CV-QKD
articles.title_zh: 实验 CV-QKD 中的双导频辅助频率和相位恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07277v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) offers high secret-key rates and compatibility with optical communication infrastructure. Locally generated local oscillator (LLO) architectures reduce security vulnerabilities associated with transmitting a strong optical reference, but independent lasers introduce frequency offsets and phase fluctuations that require accurate compensation. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a Gaussian-modulated LLO CV-QKD system over 12 km of optical fiber using two frequency-multiplexed pilot tones and RF-heterodyne detection with independent lasers. The proposed digital signal processing (DSP) architecture integrates CAZAC-based frame synchronization, global and subframe-wise carrier-frequency-offset estimation, and coherent dual-pilot phase recovery. We analyze 120 experimental frames, each containing approximately 10⁶ coherent states, and directly compare single-pilot and dual-pilot processing using identical acquisitions. The dual-pilot DSP chain achieves an average input-referred excess noise of 15.56 ± 7.61 mSNU, representing reductions of 28.1% and 17.4% relative to pilots 1 and 2, respectively. Under a trusted-receiver security model, the system achieves average modeled secret-key rates of 14.98 ± 4.18 Mbit/s in the asymptotic regime and 8.17 ± 2.53 Mbit/s using conservative finite-size parameter-estimation bounds. These results demonstrate the experimental benefits of jointly exploiting two pilot references for frequency and phase recovery in LLO CV-QKD systems, supporting their development for metropolitan quantum communication networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续可变量子密钥分发 (CV-QKD) 提供高密钥速率以及与光通信基础设施的兼容性。本地生成的本地振荡器 (LLO) 架构减少了与传输强光学参考相关的安全漏洞，但独立激光器会引入需要精确补偿的频率偏移和相位波动。在这里，我们通过实验演示了一个超过 12 km 光纤的高斯调制 LLO CV-QKD 系统，使用两个频率复用导频音和独立激光器的射频外差检测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 连续可变量子密钥分发 (CV-QKD) 提供高密钥速率以及与光通信基础设施的兼容性。本地生成的本地振荡器 (LLO) 架构减少了与传输强光学参考相关的安全漏洞，但独立激光器会引入需要精确补偿的频率偏移和相位波动。在这里，我们通过实验演示了一个超过 12 km 光纤的高斯调制 LLO CV-QKD 系统，使用两个频率复用导频音和独立激光器的射频外差检测。所提出的数字信号处理 (DSP) 架构集成了基于 CAZAC 的帧同步、全局和子帧方式的载波频率偏移估计以及相干双导频相位恢复。我们分析了 120 个实验帧，每个实验帧包含大约 10⁶ 相干态，并使用相同的采集直接比较单导频和双导频处理。双导频 DSP 链实现了 15.56 ± 7.61 mSNU 的平均输入参考过量噪声，相对于导频 1 和 2 分别降低了 28.1% 和 17.4%。在可信接收器安全模型下，系统在渐进机制下实现平均建模密钥速率 14.98 ± 4.18 Mbit/s，使用保守的有限大小参数估计边界实现 8.17 ± 2.53 Mbit/s。这些结果证明了在 LLO CV-QKD 系统中联合利用两个导频参考进行频率和相位恢复的实验优势，支持其城域量子通信网络的开发。

articles.title: Intrinsic Wannier Functions for Hamiltonian downfolding
articles.title_zh: 哈密顿向下折叠的内在 Wannier 函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.15557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Downfolding ab initio material band structure into a low-energy subspace spanned by orbitals of specified atomic character, a procedure known as Wannier downfolding, is a common task in the simulation of complex materials. We introduce the Intrinsic Wannier Function (IWF) method to Wannierize bands with given atomic character. The method is non-iterative and requires only a single dimensionless parameter to disentangle bands. In benchmarks on silicon, graphene, and the three-band model of a mercury cuprate, we show that Intrinsic Wannier Functions provide high quality downfolded band structures compared to those from standard approaches such as Maximally Localized Wannier Functions, the Selected Columns of the Density Matrix method, and Projectability-Disentangled Wannier Functions. Further, their straightforward implementation and robustness position Intrinsic Wannier Functions as a general and useful tool for Wannier downfolding in materials electronic structure and in high-throughput applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 将从头开始的材料能带结构向下折叠到由指定原子特征的轨道跨越的低能子空间中，这一过程称为万尼尔向下折叠，是复杂材料模拟中的一项常见任务。我们引入了本征万尼尔函数 (IWF) 方法来对具有给定原子特征的能带进行万尼尔化。该方法是非迭代的，仅需要一个无量纲参数来解开带。在硅、石墨烯和汞铜酸盐的三能带模型的基准测试中，我们表明，与最大局部化万尼尔函数、密度矩阵方法的选定列和可投影性解缠结万尼尔函数等标准方法相比，本征万尼尔函数提供了高质量的下折叠能带结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将从头开始的材料能带结构向下折叠到由指定原子特征的轨道跨越的低能子空间中，这一过程称为万尼尔向下折叠，是复杂材料模拟中的一项常见任务。我们引入了本征万尼尔函数 (IWF) 方法来对具有给定原子特征的能带进行万尼尔化。该方法是非迭代的，仅需要一个无量纲参数来解开带。在硅、石墨烯和汞铜酸盐的三能带模型的基准测试中，我们表明，与最大局部化万尼尔函数、密度矩阵方法的选定列和可投影性解缠结万尼尔函数等标准方法相比，本征万尼尔函数提供了高质量的下折叠能带结构。此外，其简单的实现和稳健性使固有 Wannier 函数成为材料电子结构和高通量应用中 Wannier 向下折叠的通用且有用的工具。

articles.title: Coupled stochastic variational principles for multiscale surface gravity waves -- Part I: theoretical framework
articles.title_zh: 多尺度表面重力波耦合随机变分原理——第一部分：理论框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27074v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive stochastic variational framework for surface gravity waves. Starting from Luke's variational principle for irrotational, incompressible free-surface flow, we introduce a decomposition of the velocity potential into a large-scale deterministic component and a regularized stochastic noise term representing unresolved scales. A path-wise variational principle yields the stochastic counterparts of the Laplace, Bernoulli, and kinematic boundary conditions. To close the system, a second variational principle in expectation is formulated, providing evolution equations for the noise correlation functions. The resulting coupled system preserves the Hamiltonian structure of the Zakharov--Craig--Sulem formulation. We further analyze explicit solutions via WKB approximation and show that the noise correlation functions satisfy a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with ray-tracing dynamics. This framework provides a rigorous foundation for reduced stochastic models of ocean waves and for the kinetic theory developed in the companion paper.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个全面的表面重力波随机变分框架。从卢克关于无旋、不可压缩自由表面流的变分原理出发，我们将速度势分解为大尺度确定性分量和代表未解析尺度的正则化随机噪声项。路径变分原理产生拉普拉斯、伯努利和运动学边界条件的随机对应物。为了闭合系统，制定了期望的第二变分原理，提供了噪声相关函数的演化方程。由此产生的耦合系统保留了 Zakharov--Craig--Sulem 公式的哈密顿结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文开发了一个全面的表面重力波随机变分框架。从卢克关于无旋、不可压缩自由表面流的变分原理出发，我们将速度势分解为大尺度确定性分量和代表未解析尺度的正则化随机噪声项。路径变分原理产生拉普拉斯、伯努利和运动学边界条件的随机对应物。为了闭合系统，制定了期望的第二变分原理，提供了噪声相关函数的演化方程。由此产生的耦合系统保留了 Zakharov--Craig--Sulem 公式的哈密顿结构。我们通过 WKB 近似进一步分析显式解，并表明噪声相关函数满足具有射线追踪动力学的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程。该框架为海浪的简化随机模型和配套论文中开发的动力学理论提供了严格的基础。

articles.title: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
articles.title_zh: 相干磁振子介导的宏观核共振能量转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31507v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Phonon-mediated nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer (RET) in metal deuterides is severely constrained by inertial rest-mass dilution, lattice fracture limits, and thermal nuclear spin cancellation. Extending the generalized nuclear Dicke model to Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) magnons eliminates mass dilution via hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling while unlocking relativistic Dirac M2 coupling via Overhauser spin polarization. We derive a Suhl-clamped FMR scaling law predicting 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) and 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) breakup neutrons, 19.9 MeV alpha particles, and reconciled sub-keV fusion anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属氘化物中声子介导的核共振能量转移（RET）受到惯性静止质量稀释、晶格断裂极限和热核自旋抵消的严重限制。将广义核迪克模型扩展到铁磁共振 (FMR) 磁振子，可以通过超精细放大 M1 耦合消除质量稀释，同时通过 Overhauser 自旋极化解锁相对论狄拉克 M2 耦合。我们推导出 Suhl 钳位 FMR 标度定律，预测 14.2 MeV (Pd-106) 和 11.4 MeV (Ni-58) 破裂中子、19.9 MeV α 粒子和协调的亚 keV 聚变异常。

articles.title: A mesh-free deep energy method for phase-field modeling of thermally driven brittle fracture
articles.title_zh: 热驱动脆性断裂相场建模的无网格深度能量方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-field simulation of thermally driven fracture requires resolving localized crack bands whose paths are unknown in advance and thermal boundary layers whose thickness evolves during the transient. Neural energy-based computations of thermal fracture have so far started from defects placed in advance. This paper proposes a mesh-free deep energy method based on multiresolution neural representations that predicts spontaneous crack nucleation, crack spacing, and selective crack propagation and arrest under transient thermal loading. Two networks, each with its own multiresolution encoding, represent the displacement and phase fields and the transient temperature, and the mechanical energy and the incremental functional of the backward Euler heat equation are estimated on integration points redrawn at every iteration. Restricting irreversibility to the crack set, carrying the optimizer state across load steps and decaying the learning rates within each step help prevent spurious damage accumulation. On two notched plates the initiation peak loads agree closely with an independent finite element reference. On a quenched glass strip under an analytical temperature field the crack path changes from straight to oscillatory and then to branched, with an oscillation threshold close to the linear stability prediction. Under a prescribed boundary temperature a quenched ceramic slab forms a crack array of the type observed in experiment, with a spacing close to that of a published benchmark. On the slab and a quenched annulus the arrays are denser than those of a finite element computation on the same material field. No crack paths, nucleation sites or crack-adapted meshes are prescribed.
articles.abstract_zh: 热驱动断裂的相场模拟需要解析路径事先未知的局部裂纹带以及瞬态过程中厚度变化的热边界层。迄今为止，基于神经能量的热断裂计算都是从预先放置的缺陷开始的。本文提出了一种基于多分辨率神经表示的无网格深度能量方法，可预测瞬态热载荷下的自发裂纹成核、裂纹间距以及选择性裂纹扩展和停止。两个网络各自具有自己的多分辨率编码，代表位移场、相场以及瞬态温度，并且在每次迭代时重新绘制的积分点上估计机械能和后向欧拉热方程的增量函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热驱动断裂的相场模拟需要解析路径事先未知的局部裂纹带以及瞬态过程中厚度变化的热边界层。迄今为止，基于神经能量的热断裂计算都是从预先放置的缺陷开始的。本文提出了一种基于多分辨率神经表示的无网格深度能量方法，可预测瞬态热载荷下的自发裂纹成核、裂纹间距以及选择性裂纹扩展和停止。两个网络各自具有自己的多分辨率编码，代表位移场、相场以及瞬态温度，并且在每次迭代时重新绘制的积分点上估计机械能和后向欧拉热方程的增量函数。限制裂纹集的不可逆性、跨负载步骤携带优化器状态以及衰减每个步骤内的学习率有助于防止虚假损坏累积。在两个凹口板上，初始峰值载荷与独立的有限元参考非常一致。在分析温度场下的淬火玻璃条上，裂纹路径从直线变为振荡，然后变为分支，振荡阈值接近线性稳定性预测。在规定的边界温度下，淬火陶瓷板形成实验中观察到的类型的裂纹阵列，其间距接近已发布的基准的间距。在平板和淬火环上，阵列比相同材料场上的有限元计算的阵列更密集。没有规定裂纹路径、成核位置或裂纹适应网格。

articles.title: Complex Schrödinger Bridges
articles.title_zh: 复杂的薛定谔桥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I²CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩散桥已成为促进任意数据分布之间转换的通用框架。然而，这些方法受到巨大的优化空间及其底层高阶结构的阻碍。本文探讨了扩散桥的一种变体，用于解决受缩放和旋转定律（例如哈密顿结构）控制的复杂向量空间中的现实问题。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了共形最优传输（COT），这是一种复值传输框架，专为几何提升下具有几何和耗散动力学的物理系统而设计。在此基础上，我们提出了一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复杂薛定谔桥（CSB），其派生算法可以使用共形几何先验来处理基于扩散的任务。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扩散桥已成为促进任意数据分布之间转换的通用框架。然而，这些方法受到巨大的优化空间及其底层高阶结构的阻碍。本文探讨了扩散桥的一种变体，用于解决受缩放和旋转定律（例如哈密顿结构）控制的复杂向量空间中的现实问题。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了共形最优传输（COT），这是一种复值传输框架，专为几何提升下具有几何和耗散动力学的物理系统而设计。在此基础上，我们提出了一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复杂薛定谔桥（CSB），其派生算法可以使用共形几何先验来处理基于扩散的任务。为了可扩展性，我们提出了图像到图像 CSB (I²CSB)，这是一种具有解析螺旋后验的易于处理的扩散桥技术。最后，我们在量子电动力学模拟中实现了基于物理的 CSB 算法，模仿了量子逻辑门的逻辑行为。我们的广泛结果验证了基础理论，同时强调了复值扩散的优势。

articles.title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
articles.title_zh: 分布式增材制造中不可见几何形状的联合物理热场预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. Its prediction accuracy is comparable to that of a centralized model trained on the pooled geometries of all sites. These results demonstrate that federated learning lets manufacturing sites benefit from each other's geometries without sharing them, enabling rapid thermal prediction on new part designs for tasks such as shape optimization, inverse design, and uncertainty quantification.
articles.abstract_zh: 在增材制造 (AM) 中，零件几何形状的每次变化都需要新的热模拟，这使得对许多候选方案的设计评估成本高昂。几何感知模型通过使用单个学习模型预测不可见零件上的热场来降低成本，但它们假设可以集中使用不同的几何形状。当每个制造工厂仅拥有一组有限的无法共享的专有零件设计时，这种假设就具有限制性。我们提出了 Fed-PIGANO，这是一个联合框架，可以在各个站点训练物理信息几何感知神经算子 (PI-GANO) 模型，并聚合其几何编码器和预测网络，而无需共享零件几何形状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在增材制造 (AM) 中，零件几何形状的每次变化都需要新的热模拟，这使得对许多候选方案的设计评估成本高昂。几何感知模型通过使用单个学习模型预测不可见零件上的热场来降低成本，但它们假设可以集中使用不同的几何形状。当每个制造工厂仅拥有一组有限的无法共享的专有零件设计时，这种假设就具有限制性。我们提出了 Fed-PIGANO，这是一个联合框架，可以在各个站点训练物理信息几何感知神经算子 (PI-GANO) 模型，并聚合其几何编码器和预测网络，而无需共享零件几何形状。我们在金属增材制造的 2D 稳态热基准上评估该框架，其中来自五个多边形族的几何形状分布在四个场景下的三个地点，这些场景从相同到截然不同的族组成。在七次重复中，Fed-PIGANO 在所有 12 个场景站点案例中实现了 1.83% 至 2.04% 的平均相对 L2 误差，而仅本地训练的平均相对 L2 误差高达 20.46%，并且始终产生较低的 PDE 残差。其预测精度与在所有站点的汇集几何结构上训练的集中式模型相当。这些结果表明，联合学习使制造工厂能够从彼此的几何形状中受益，而无需共享它们，从而能够对新零件设计进行快速热预测，以完成形状优化、逆向设计和不确定性量化等任务。

articles.title: RiverScan: Learning to Accumulate on River Networks
articles.title_zh: RiverScan：学习在河流网络上积累
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate runoff prediction across large river basins requires models to capture heterogeneous local hydrological responses and their accumulation downstream. River-network connectivity provides a natural structure for this task, but using it effectively requires learning how to combine contributions from subcatchments of different sizes. We frame this challenge as learning to accumulate and introduce RiverScan, a spatial operator based on area-weighted selective state-space recurrence. RiverScan recursively combines local temporal representations with accumulated upstream states in topological order. Contributing-area fractions account for subcatchment size, while learned retention controls how upstream information persists downstream. Experiments on 608 stations in the Danube basin show that RiverScan outperforms the evaluated temporal and graph baselines in overall predictive performance. Structural controls and ablations demonstrate that composing heterogeneous subcatchment representations in a manner aligned with hydrological accumulation substantially improves runoff prediction, with the benefits of correct topology growing along the river-network hierarchy. These findings establish physically structured accumulation as an effective inductive bias for hydrological modeling and motivate finer-grained, fully distributed AI-based hydrological models.
articles.abstract_zh: 跨大河流域的准确径流预测需要模型能够捕获异质的局部水文响应及其下游的累积。河网连通性为这项任务提供了一个自然的结构，但有效地使用它需要学习如何结合不同规模的子流域的贡献。我们将这一挑战定义为学习积累并引入 RiverScan，这是一种基于面积加权选择性状态空间递归的空间算子。 RiverScan 以拓扑顺序递归地将局部时间表示与累积的上游状态组合起来。贡献面积分数决定了子汇水面积的大小，而学习保留则控制着上游信息如何在下游持续存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 跨大河流域的准确径流预测需要模型能够捕获异质的局部水文响应及其下游的累积。河网连通性为这项任务提供了一个自然的结构，但有效地使用它需要学习如何结合不同规模的子流域的贡献。我们将这一挑战定义为学习积累并引入 RiverScan，这是一种基于面积加权选择性状态空间递归的空间算子。 RiverScan 以拓扑顺序递归地将局部时间表示与累积的上游状态组合起来。贡献面积分数决定了子汇水面积的大小，而学习保留则控制着上游信息如何在下游持续存在。对多瑙河流域 608 个站点进行的实验表明，RiverScan 在整体预测性能方面优于评估的时间和图形基线。结构控制和消融表明，以与水文积累相一致的方式构建异质子流域表示可显着改善径流预测，并具有沿着河流网络层次结构增长的正确拓扑的好处。这些发现将物理结构积累确立为水文建模的有效归纳偏差，并激发了更细粒度、完全分布式的基于人工智能的水文模型。

articles.title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过强化学习对钙钛矿太阳能电池进行面向富集的虚拟筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental optimization of perovskite solar cells is constrained by combinatorial diversity in absorber compositions, device layers, and processing, which makes virtual screening attractive for prioritizing recipes before fabrication. We develop a surrogate-guided reinforcement-learning framework that casts recipe generation as virtual screening, enriching candidate shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors. A frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) guides recipe generation, while a reference pool of 890 measured devices enables neighborhood-based assessment. Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices shows top-ten selection raises mean power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 19.68% to 23.74%. Three learned policies are compared with six baselines under 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run. In top-100 shortlists, Proximal policy optimization (PPO) and recurrent PPO (RPPO) achieve neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23% and 24% (7.9- and 8.3-fold Pure Random's 2.9%), versus 10% (3.4-fold) for the baselines with the highest supported hit rate (L-SHADE and Ax BO, tied) at K = 100. Gains coexist with weak-support fractions. Of 9,000 recipes, 65.4% match a composition family at similarity 0.80, falling to 11.7% at 0.90. Results support enrichment-oriented prioritization but not experimental performance, seed robustness, or matched-budget advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池的实验优化受到吸收体成分、器件层和加工的组合多样性的限制，这使得虚拟筛选对于在制造之前优先考虑配方具有吸引力。我们开发了一个代理引导的强化学习框架，将食谱生成视为虚拟筛选，丰富了高性能实验邻居附近的候选候选名单。冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络 (TabPFN) 指导配方生成，而 890 个测量设备的参考池则支持基于邻域的评估。对 1,846 种器件进行五倍评估后发现，前十名器件的平均功率转换效率 (PCE) 从 19.68% 提高到 23.74%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿太阳能电池的实验优化受到吸收体成分、器件层和加工的组合多样性的限制，这使得虚拟筛选对于在制造之前优先考虑配方具有吸引力。我们开发了一个代理引导的强化学习框架，将食谱生成视为虚拟筛选，丰富了高性能实验邻居附近的候选候选名单。冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络 (TabPFN) 指导配方生成，而 890 个测量设备的参考池则支持基于邻域的评估。对 1,846 种器件进行五倍评估后发现，前十名器件的平均功率转换效率 (PCE) 从 19.68% 提高到 23.74%。在每次运行 3,000 次替代评估下，将三个学习策略与六个基线进行比较。在前 100 名入围名单中，近端策略优化 (PPO) 和循环 PPO (RPPO) 的邻域支持命中率分别为 23% 和 24%（纯随机的 2.9% 的 7.9 倍和 8.3 倍），而在 K = 100 时，具有最高支持命中率（L-SHADE 和 Ax BO，并列）的基线为 10%（3.4 倍）。增益与弱支持分数。在 9,000 个食谱中，65.4% 与相似度为 0.80 的成分系列相匹配，下降到 11.7%（相似度为 0.90）。结果支持以富集为导向的优先顺序，但不支持实验性能、种子稳健性或匹配预算优势。

articles.title: STAMP: Manufacturing-Informed Generative Design and Shape Optimization of Sheet Panels
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative design of formed sheet panels must preserve geometric manufacturing conditions while exploring layouts and improving performance. STAMP embeds these conditions directly in the shape representation. Each panel is described by its material layout and a reference surface with one height at each occupied position in a plane perpendicular to the drawing direction. Nominal thickness is prescribed along the normal. The representation allows curved surfaces, ribs, and openings. It excludes reference-surface undercuts and keeps nominal thickness fixed without manufacturing penalty terms. Because these conditions belong to the representation, every generated and optimized panel satisfies them regardless of training-set size. Boundary-conditioned diffusion generates alternative layouts, and predictor gradients guide a surface optimization that retains outlines, openings, and designated fixed regions. We demonstrate STAMP on automotive hood inner panels using CarHoods10k. With a comparable number of stored values, depth maps reconstruct surfaces more accurately than point-cloud and voxel baselines. From only five training designs, one of three training runs yields novel and varied layouts. A generator trained on 500 designs, 6.5% of the training set, already reaches the layout variety of the full-data model. Across 11 held-out design families, predictor-based selection among existing dataset designs yields an average gap of 0.18 mm to the best available FEA deformation, versus an expected 1.59 mm for random selection. It does better than random selection in all 11 families. At a 10% depth-change bound, a network not used in the search predicts an average deformation reduction of 24.8% for six generated and existing panels, with a 3.2% average mass increase computed from geometry. Engineers can thus explore and optimize panels within this manufacturing-informed design space.

articles.title: Emulating physics-based XCO2 retrievals across OCO-2 viewing modes with compact neural networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Operational full-physics retrieval of the column-averaged dry-air mole fraction of carbon dioxide from satellite spectra is computationally demanding. We use singular value decomposition to compress spectra from the Orbiting Carbon Observatory-2 separately by band. Compact multilayer perceptrons use the resulting spectral scores, prior information, and viewing geometry to predict the difference between the full-physics retrieval and its operational prior. Adding the predicted difference to the prior yields an estimate of the retrieved mole fraction. The models were trained on 2015-2019 observations and validated on 2020 observations. In 2021-2025 tests, the mean annual root-mean-square errors relative to the Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide Observations from Space retrieval product were 0.89, 1.35, and 1.43 parts per million for ocean glint, land glint, and nadir observations, respectively. On East Asian nadir observations screened using the published criteria for the spectral Transformer, our model yielded a lower mean annual error than reported for that model in 2020-2022. These results show that compact neural networks using compressed spectra can efficiently emulate the full-physics retrieval across multiple viewing modes and years.

articles.title: On numerical issues of divergences between nearly equal distributions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Barron et al. (2026) recently identified numerical issues in the softmax and soft cross-entropy loss. We show that similar issues are present in standard divergence operations between categorical distributions. This includes the forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), as well as Monte Carlo KL estimates and entropy. When the distributions are nearly equal, rounding and cancellation issues affect the forward and gradient computations. These issues can affect settings using divergences in optimization objectives, such as knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, and proximal methods. We propose numerically stable reformulations and provide example implementations for each setting, validated by property-based tests.

articles.title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17646v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are lightweight classifiers that binarize their inputs and learn by storing binary patterns in lookup memories, which makes them attractive for resource-constrained tasks such as intrusion detection. Because a small perturbation that crosses no binarization threshold leaves the binary input unchanged, WNNs may appear naturally robust to adversarial examples; a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction. We study this tension in WiSARD, the canonical RAM-based WNN, and in two variants that replace its memories with Bloom filters, Bloom WiSARD and BTHOWeN. A continuous perturbation reaches these classifiers only by crossing an encoding threshold, changing at least one binary tuple, and redirecting a memory query; we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD. Controlled MNIST experiments compare linear and data-driven thermometer encodings under model-agnostic sensitivity probes, a score-based Simulated Annealing attack, and surrogate-transfer attacks. Changing only the encoding while keeping each model otherwise fixed shows that encoding granularity can trade a small clean-accuracy loss for a large decrease in attack success. On the Bot-IoT, CICIDS, and UNSW-NB15 intrusion-detection datasets, adversarial perturbations lead WNN detectors to classify many attacks as normal traffic and to raise false alarms, even when their aggregate accuracy remains high.

articles.title: Improving Matrix Exponential for Generative AI Flows: A Taylor-Based Approach Beyond Paterson--Stockmeyer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20777v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The matrix exponential is a fundamental operator in scientific computing and system simulation, with applications ranging from control theory and quantum mechanics to modern generative machine learning. While Padé approximants combined with scaling and squaring have long served as the standard, recent Taylor-based methods, which utilize polynomial evaluation schemes that surpass the classical Paterson--Stockmeyer technique, offer superior accuracy and reduced computational complexity. This paper presents an optimized Taylor-based algorithm for the matrix exponential, specifically designed for the high-throughput requirements of generative AI flows. We provide a rigorous error analysis and develop a dynamic selection strategy for the Taylor order and scaling factor to minimize computational effort under a prescribed error tolerance. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that our approach provides significant acceleration and maintains high numerical stability compared to existing state-of-the-art implementations. These results establish the proposed method as a highly efficient tool for large-scale generative modeling.

articles.title: Retrieval of Coastal Biogeochemical Parameters From Near-Surface Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Reflectance Using Physics-Aware Meta-Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05623v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hyperspectral in situ sensing has shown promise in retrieving aquatic water quality (WQ) parameters, such as total suspended solids (TSS), dissolved organic carbon (DOC), and total chlorophyll-a (TChl-a), for cost-effective management of coastal WQ. However, generalising such retrieval algorithms across water bodies remains challenging, as the relationship between remote sensing reflectance (Rᵣₛ) and WQ parameters can vary considerably from one region to another due to regional distinctions in environmental conditions and biogeochemistry that lead to different WQ ranges and bio-optical properties. In this study, we propose a two-stage physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal WQ parameters from near-surface Rᵣₛ observations. Unlike purely data-driven approaches trained solely on paired observations, the proposed framework incorporates physical knowledge through a two-stage learning process. In the first stage, a region-agnostic base model is pretrained using meta-learning on synthetic WQ--Rᵣₛ samples generated by a bio-optical forward model parameterised with an in situ bio-optical spectral library. In the second stage, the pretrained model is fine-tuned using local samples to adapt to regional conditions. To evaluate the proposed approach, we collected in situ hyperspectral Rᵣₛ and WQ measurements from five geographically distinct sites in Australian coastal waters.

articles.title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.11578v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) is a framework for quantum information processing in which a computational task is carried out through one-qubit measurements on a highly entangled resource state. Due to the indeterminacy of the outcomes of a quantum measurement, the random outcomes of these operations, if not corrected, yield a variational quantum channel family. Traditionally, this randomness is corrected through classical processing in order to ensure deterministic unitary computations. Recently, variational measurement-based quantum computation (VMBQC) has been introduced to exploit this measurement-induced randomness to gain an advantage in generative modeling. A limitation of this approach is that the corresponding channel model has twice as many parameters compared to the unitary model, scaling as N × D, where N is the number of logical qubits (width) and D is the depth of the VMBQC model. This can often make optimization more difficult and may lead to poorly trainable models. In this paper, we present a restricted VMBQC model that extends the unitary setting to a channel-based one using only a single additional trainable parameter. We show, both numerically and algebraically, that this minimal extension is sufficient to generate probability distributions that cannot be learned by the corresponding unitary model.

articles.title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. We extend this approach to experimental multiphase pXRD through a reflexive evolution framework that learns from self-generated synthetic problems. A replaceable laboratory specification defines the sample family and measurement conditions. An evolver agent uses the known generating structures and measurement parameters to diagnose solver failures and develop persistent guidance and executable tools, which are then provided to agents on measured patterns. This supplies verifiable training experience without requiring a collection of solved experimental measurements. On 15 measured patterns from solid-state synthesis, the evolved package improves average profile agreement and transfers an analogue-substitution procedure that recovers a phase whose structure is absent from the supplied reference library. These results demonstrate how learning from verifiable synthetic experience can improve agentic characterization of experimental samples whose structures are not known in advance.

articles.title: FlexCast: Flexible Context Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) based on autoregressive (AR) next-token prediction entangle two factors: variable-context conditioning and prediction-unit factorization with autoregressive rollout. Strong AR performance therefore does not reveal whether generalization stems from the flexible training distribution, the local prediction target, the left-to-right inference process, or their combination. We propose FlexCast, a flexible context-target learning framework that disentangles these factors. FlexCast reformulates forecasting as variable-length masked prediction over time series patches: during pretraining, it dynamically samples visible context and masked target patches, exposing the model to diverse context-target configurations without sequential decoding. At inference time, the same pretrained model supports one-step forecasting, confidence-based iterative refinement, and next-token-style generation through a unified mask-and-predict interface, enabling controlled comparison of inference schedules under identical architecture, data, and objective. Evaluated on BLAST and multiple zero-shot benchmarks, FlexCast achieves accuracy competitive with or better than strong TSFM baselines while substantially reducing inference latency. Ablations confirm that context diversity and contiguous target masking drive performance, while left-to-right decoding does not yield consistent gains once flexible context-target relationships have been learned, suggesting that the key benefit of AR-style TSFMs lies in flexible training rather than sequential inference. The code is available at https://github.com/BenchCouncil/FlexCast.

articles.title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. LLM audits confirm the interpretability of the hand-crafted models. We first validate iWSP by tasking it with constructing transformers for canonical benchmarks such as arithmetic and sentiment classification, finding that LLM agents can successfully craft compact, accurate networks directly. Next, we apply iWSP to build neural encoding models across vision, language, and audition. In the visual cortex, iWSP outpredicts existing interpretable baselines, uncovers distinct computations across early/higher visual areas, and generalizes to unseen data. In language fMRI, iWSP surfaces a confound in the data and in auditory ECoG, it systematically discovers interpretable acoustic features that predict neural activity. Together, these results establish iWSP as a general paradigm for aligning high predictive performance with human-interpretable scientific discovery.

articles.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.

articles.title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18504v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling quantum computing toward practical quantum advantage is currently limited by the efficiency of circuits that operate on information encoded by quantum error-correcting codes. The full stack of quantum computing encompasses several tasks: preparation of logical code states, implementation of logical gates, logical routines on encoded qubits, etc. Yet, these circuits are largely designed by hand for individual cases, with some recent works incorporating machine learning for certain aspects. We formulate this problem as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, wherein a large language model, leveraging its pretraining knowledge and tool-use proficiency, and guided by a circuit verifier, evolves a program that defines a Clifford circuit for a wide range of curated tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and logical routines such as code-switching, code growth, etc. Our approach consistently finds fault-tolerant circuits for all of these tasks, each verified by an exhaustive check over faults.

articles.title: Entanglement Transport Across Finite Registers: Schmidt-spectrum invariance, locality boundaries, and a falsification framework
articles.abstract: Entanglement in a finite register is defined only after a bipartite tensor-product structure is supplied. For factorized isometric maps, every nonzero Schmidt weight is preserved; independent local Hamiltonians and local quantum channels likewise cannot generate entanglement from separable inputs. These standard facts yield a register-specific falsification criterion: a changed pure-state Schmidt spectrum disproves at least one of factorization, isometry, or closed-system completeness. The framework separates entanglement representation, transport, generation, no-signalling compatibility, Bell-inequality violation, and experimental realization, while identifying the additional operational assumptions required at each level.

articles.title: Phonon Scattering and Thermal Resistance Allocation in β-Silicon Nitride Nanofilms under Large Temperature Gradients
articles.abstract: Large temperature drops across nanofilms raise the question of how temperature-dependent phonon scattering distributes thermal resistance within a film of uniform composition. We combine nonequilibrium ab initio molecular dynamics with periodic-crystal phonon calculations for a 2.818 nm β-silicon nitride (β-Si₃N₄) film. Isothermal phonon responses are evaluated at actual layer temperatures to construct a mode-resolved local-temperature reference. Two independent trajectories sustain temperature differences of 446–465 K over an internal interval of 1.832 nm, with fitted gradients of 198–211 K nm⁻¹. For an acoustic mode with a thickness-matched wavelength of 2.827 nm, the mapped three-phonon rate decreases by 33.4% and 33.6% from hot to cold. Its conductivity contribution increases by factors of 1.496 and 1.501, primarily due to the longer phonon lifetime. Summing over all modes in the relaxation-time approximation gives a similar relative enhancement. Modes below 15 THz supply 91.8%–92.5% of the reference thermal conductivity along the film normal at the internal layers. Integrating the reciprocal reference conductivity yields an internal area-normalized reference resistance of approximately 4.57×10⁻¹¹ m² K W⁻¹. About 54% is allocated to the hotter half of the internal interval. Vibration–potential spectra, spatial fluctuation amplitudes, and fixed-bin information entropies characterize the associated microscopic thermal states. This local-temperature description connects modal phonon relaxation to spatial conductivity variations and resistance allocation within a film of uniform composition.

articles.title: Preparation and properties of high-dielectric-constant, heat-resistant boroxine-containing segmented copolyimides
articles.abstract: Polyimide (PI) is widely used as dielectric materials in electronic devices and power systems because of its excellent heat resistance and mechanical stability. However, the intrinsically low dielectric constant of conventional PI limits its practical application in high-energy-density dielectric capacitors. In this study, triaminocycloboroxane (TABO) was first synthesized via dehydration condensation of 3-aminophenylboronic acid (3-ABBA). TABO was then reacted with 3,3',4,4'-biphenyltetracarboxylic dianhydride (BPDA) via an amine-anhydride ring-opening addition reaction to prepare a boron-containing hard-segment polyamic acid prepolymer, which designated as PAA-a. Separately, a soft-segment polyamic acid prepolymer, designated as PAA-b, was synthesized by reacting 4,4'-diaminodiphenyl ether (ODA) with 4,4'-oxydiphthalic dianhydride (ODPA) through the same method. PAA-a and PAA-b were coupled through ring-opening polyaddition to form a soft-hard segmented polyamic acid (PAA). The resulting PAA was cast into films, dried, and thermally imidized to obtain boroxine-containing PI films. The effects of the reactant ratio on soft-hard segmented structure, dielectric, thermal, wetting and mechanical properties of the PI films were studied. The results showed that raising the molar ratio of TABO to ODA, the hard-segment content of as-prepared PI films increased, and the dielectric and thermal properties were improved. When the molar ratio of TABO to ODA was 2:27, the PI film exhibited a high dielectric constant of 5.08 at 100 kHz and a maximum decomposition rate temperature of 630°C. These results demonstrate its potential as a high dielectric material for high-energy-density capacitors.

articles.title: Three-Zone Radius Gradation and a Net Radiation Thrust Mechanism for Solar System Bodies
articles.abstract: Background This Perspective article proposes, within the framework of exchange mechanics, a three-zone radius gradation pattern and a net radiation thrust mechanism for Solar System bodies, together with explicit falsification paths. Newtonian gravity and Kepler’s laws reproduce planetary orbits, yet they do not explain the non-monotonic radius sequence, density stratification, or rotation differences of Solar System bodies from an intrinsic mechanism.Methods Using Solar System observations, we identify “three-zone gradation”: body radius varies non-monotonically with heliocentric distance, peaking near Jupiter’s and Earth’s orbits. This empirical pattern motivates a hypothesis in which a body is a bipolar inlet–outlet structure—dayside absorbs solar radiation, nightside releases its own. From the first principle that electromagnetic waves carry momentum, we derive a net thrust formula, distinguishing a complete sphere (zero net force) from a hemisphere (non-zero).Results The formula (i) unifies bodies with and without significant internal heat; (ii) explains why thrust scales as (:R) in the low-velocity zone; (iii) yields an environmental exchange relation (:Jpropto:vᵣₒₜ·:ρ:│ᵤₚₐᵣᵣₒw:dₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw:), linking rapid giant-planet rotation (low(:ρ:)) to slow terrestrial-planet rotation (high(::ρ:)); and (iv) provides a consistent dynamical account of Kuiper Belt objects, Trojans, planetary rings, and cometary orbits.Conclusions The macroscopic architecture of the Solar System may include a net thrust from dayside–nightside radiation asymmetry. This effect may have been significant during the early planetesimal stage (:(Fₙₑₜ/Fgᵣₐᵥsim:10⁻²--10⁰)) but is only a minor modulation today (:(Fₙₑₜ/Fgᵣₐᵥsim:10⁻¹⁵)). Three-zone boundaries are empirical; their theoretical critical points require future numerical work.

articles.title: Microwave-Assisted Catalytic Pyrolysis of Polypropylene Waste Plastics for Hydrogen-Rich Gas Production with Ni-Fe/γ- Al₂O₃ Catalyst
articles.abstract: Global plastic waste continues to increase, while conventional disposal methods such as landfilling and incineration both waste resources and pollute the environment. Converting polypropylene (PP) into hydrogen offers a potential route toward low-carbon hydrogen production with environmental benefits. This study used polypropylene (PP) as the feedstock and prepared the Ni-Fe/γ-Al₂O₃ bimetallic catalyst by impregnation, with activated carbon as the microwave absorber. The effects of absorber type (coconut-shell, wood-based, and coal-based), catalyst-to-absorber mass ratio (5:2, 5:3, 5:4, and 1:1), and microwave power (1200 to 1800 W) on hydrogen production were systematically examined, and XRD, SEM, and FT-IR were used to follow the phase evolution of the catalyst. Coconut-shell activated carbon offered favorable energy conditions for PP pyrolysis, as its well-developed microporous structure enabled efficient microwave absorption. Its self‑gasification also partially contributed to gas production. Under the optimal conditions of 5:4 catalyst-to-absorber mass ratio and 1600 W microwave power, H₂ yield reached 77.1 mmol/gₚₚ, H₂ efficiency 88.6%, and H₂ composition 80.1 vol.%, whereas CO, CO₂, CH₄, and C₂-C₅ were formed only as minor by-products. This study explored the synergistic behavior of the activated carbon absorber and the Ni-Fe catalyst in the microwave field, providing experimental data and process guidance for the valorization of waste plastics into hydrogen-rich gas.

articles.title: Benchmarking analysis of various Quantum computing hardware units for VQC through QAOA
articles.abstract: This study follows a holistic and highly abstracted analysis of the performance of a set of quantum computing devices for Quantum Machine Learning by proxy of running standardized Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and Variational Quantum Circuits (VQC). The aim of the study was to determine the degree of performance discrepancies between devices with different architectures from hardware providers, including IBM, IQM and IonQ. The study has concluded that device rankings stay broadly stable across QAOA and VQC, making noise floor and calibration more indicative than modality. Same-family devices diverged as much as cross-vendor ones, indicating architecture alone as a weak predictor as well. The device performance was differentiated based on factors outstretching binary accuracy, such as Hamming weight distribution, variational distance and parity error for a more complete picture.

articles.title: Mössbauer study of RFeO3 (R = Y, Tb, Dy, Ho, and Er)
articles.abstract: RFeO3 (R = Y, Tb, Dy, Ho, and Er) powders were synthesized by sol–gel auto-combustion. Diffraction and Raman measurements revealed composition-dependent structural and vibrational changes. Magnetic rare-earth compositions exhibited larger magnetization at 20 kOe but lower coercivity and remanence than YFeO3. All room-temperature Mössbauer spectra showed a single magnetic sextet, with isomer shifts of 0.24 mm/s and hyperfine fields of 497.2-500.9 kOe, consistent with high-spin Fe3+. YFeO3 displayed enhanced low-frequency permittivity accompanied by substantial loss. These results show that composition-dependent macroscopic responses coexist with broadly similar local Fe hyperfine environments.

articles.title: Microfluidically Reconfigurable Self-Diplexing Half-Mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide MIMO Antenna
articles.abstract: This paper presents a microfluidically reconfigurable Substrate-Integrated Waveguide (SIW)-based self-diplexing Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna for Wi-Fi 6/6E applications. A diagonally shielded Half-Mode SIW (HMSIW) cavity is employed to suppress electromagnetic leakage through the open magnetic wall. A rectangular slot separates the HMSIW cavity into two unequal resonant sections, enabling self-diplexing operation. The two cavities resonate at 5.45~GHz and 6.75~GHz, providing port isolation levels of 40~dB and 35~dB and realized gains of 5.60~dB and 5.65~dB, respectively. Frequency reconfiguration is achieved by incorporating liquid-dielectric pockets on the bottom surface of the cavities, with deionized (DI) water employed as the tuning medium. Adjusting the number of pockets filled with deionized (DI) water enables independent tuning of the lower and upper resonant frequencies across 5.08--5.45~GHz and 6.37--6.75~GHz, respectively. Throughout these tuning ranges, the antenna maintains a realized gain of 5.45--5.65~dB with overall efficiency exceeding 90%. Furthermore, a four-element, eight-port MIMO configuration is developed, achieving an inter-element isolation exceeding 22~dB. The calculated MIMO performance metrics remain within acceptable limits, confirming the suitability of the proposed configuration for MIMO operation. The proposed antenna is fabricated and experimentally evaluated, and the measured results closely agree with the simulated performance.

articles.title: Development and Characterization of Antimicrobial Persian Gum-Based Films Incorporated with Date Waste-Derived Carbon Quantum Dots and Shirazi Thyme Essential Oil
articles.abstract: This study developed multifunctional Persian gum (PG)-based active films incorporating carbon quantum dots (CQDs) synthesized from date seed waste and Zataria multiflora essential oil (ZMEO). CQD incorporation markedly influenced the physicochemical and mechanical performance of the films. Among the investigated concentrations, 1% CQDs provided the most favorable mechanical properties, resulting in the highest tensile strength, elongation at break, and elastic modulus, whereas increasing the CQD concentration to 1.5% reduced these parameters. Increasing CQD content also enhanced UV-shielding capacity, with the 1.5% CQD film showing nearly complete attenuation of radiation below 350 nm. The film containing both CQDs and ZMEO exhibited the highest DPPH radical-scavenging activity (63.48%) and showed antimicrobial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Listeria monocytogenes, and Salmonella typhimurium. Increasing the CQD concentration reduced ZMEO release at 4, 25, and 37°C, indicating that CQDs influenced the migration behavior of the essential oil within the PG matrix. Kinetic analysis indicated predominantly Fickian diffusion based on the Korsmeyer–Peppas model, while the Peleg model provided the best overall description of the release data (R² > 0.9). These findings demonstrate the potential of waste-derived CQDs as multifunctional components in biodegradable active films, although further validation in real food systems is required before practical packaging applications can be established.

articles.title: Helicity-Resolved Valley-Selective Second Harmonic Generation in Monolayer MoS2 for Optical Defect Metrology
articles.abstract: Structural defects critically affect the optical and electronic properties of 2D materials, yet existing characterization methods are often destructive, insufficiently sensitive, or unsuitable for large-area analysis. Here we develop a helicity-resolved second-harmonic generation (HR-SHG) microscopy method that enables quantitative evaluation of defects in monolayer MoS2 through defect-induced valley depolarization.
