articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析研究了 Little-Parks (LP) 效应，即由外加磁通量 Φ 驱动的超导转变温度 T_c 的周期性振荡，从弱耦合 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 极限到介观准一维环中的中间耦合状态。利用具有扭曲边界条件的金茨堡-朗道（GL）展开，我们正确地结合了离散有限尺寸拓扑宇称干涉和超流引起的连续质心（CM）动能移动。我们推导出 T_c(Φ) 的封闭式表达式，该表达式在 GL 框架内跨可变交互强度有效。我们证明，LP 响应包括两个不同的物理贡献：由相关长度比 ψ/R 控制的离散拓扑宇称效应，以及按 1/R² 缩放的连续动能项。随着耦合的增加和对的空间相关长度的收缩（ xi ll R ），组成对在几何上变得对全局边界约束视而不见，导致离散奇偶校验调制的指数抑制。然而，凝聚态获得依赖于通量的宏观CM动量的要求仍然存在。这确保了临界温度 T_c 保持主要由超流的宏观动能驱动的代数 LP 调制。我们通过讨论强耦合极限附近相位波动占主导地位之前平均场 GL 有效性的崩溃来限制我们的理论方法。

articles.title: Singlet-triplet superconductivity from repulsive interactions in a p-wave magnet
articles.title_zh: p 波磁体中排斥相互作用产生的单重态-三重态超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent proposals of p-wave magnets, which host odd-parity spin splitting, we study electrons near Van Hove singularities with local repulsive interactions. We demonstrate how the symmetry of the p-wave spin splitting governs the competition among instabilities. Using a parquet renormalization group (pRG) analysis of a simple one-sublattice model of a p-wave magnet, we find that superconductivity is the leading instability over the entire phase diagram for purely repulsive interactions. The resulting superconducting state is generically a mixture of spin-singlet and spin-triplet pairing and approaches an equal-weight mixture when T_c is small compared with the energy offset between each Van Hove electron and its inversion partner. Extending the pRG analysis to a more realistic two-sublattice model, we find that superconductivity remains the leading instability, while the sublattice degree of freedom leads to a competition among various singlet-triplet pairing channels and even a finite-momentum equal-spin pair-density wave. Our mechanism applies broadly to odd-parity magnets and opens a natural route to nodal topological superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 受最近提出的具有奇宇称自旋分裂的 p 波磁体的启发，我们研究了范霍夫奇点附近具有局部排斥相互作用的电子。我们证明了 p 波自旋分裂的对称性如何控制不稳定性之间的竞争。使用 p 波磁体的简单单子晶格模型的 parquet 重整化群 (pRG) 分析，我们发现超导性是纯排斥相互作用的整个相图上的主要不稳定性。由此产生的超导态通常是自旋单重态和自旋三重态配对的混合物，并且当 T_c 与每个范霍夫电子及其反演伙伴之间的能量偏移相比较小时，接近等重混合物。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受最近提出的具有奇宇称自旋分裂的 p 波磁体的启发，我们研究了范霍夫奇点附近具有局部排斥相互作用的电子。我们证明了 p 波自旋分裂的对称性如何控制不稳定性之间的竞争。使用 p 波磁体的简单单子晶格模型的 parquet 重整化群 (pRG) 分析，我们发现超导性是纯排斥相互作用的整个相图上的主要不稳定性。由此产生的超导态通常是自旋单重态和自旋三重态配对的混合物，并且当 T_c 与每个范霍夫电子及其反演伙伴之间的能量偏移相比较小时，接近等重混合物。将pRG分析扩展到更现实的二亚晶格模型，我们发现超导性仍然是主要的不稳定性，而亚晶格自由度导致各种单重态-三重态配对通道之间的竞争，甚至是有限动量等自旋对密度波。我们的机制广泛适用于奇宇称磁体，并为节点拓扑超导开辟了一条自然途径。

articles.title: Superlattice Stabilization of the Topological Quantum Hall Ferromagnet in Graphene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中拓扑量子霍尔铁磁体的超晶格稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competition between spin and valley orders makes graphene a versatile platform for engineering correlated topological phases in the quantum Hall regime. We show that a tunable superlattice potential reorganizes this competition, and stabilizes the ferromagnetic quantum Hall topological insulator at charge neutrality without requiring a large in-plane magnetic field or strong dielectric suppression of Coulomb interactions. The interaction anisotropies responsible for choosing between different competing states are first computed by a generalized renormalization group procedure that accounts for the superlattice potential. We find that the potential suppresses anisotropies that compete with spin-polarization. At the same time, the potential introduces dispersion which prefers a partly spin-polarized compensated semi-metal. Therefore, we carry out a self-consistent momentum-space Hartree-Fock computation with renormalized aniostropies to establish the regime of stability of the insulating spin-polarized ferromagnet. Finally, we verify that this ferromagnet is adiabatically connected to the quantum Hall ferromagnet, thereby confirming its topological character. Our results establish superlattice potentials as a means of controlling the phase diagram of interacting graphene and accessing its helical quantum Hall regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋和谷序之间的竞争使石墨烯成为量子霍尔体系中工程相关拓扑相的通用平台。我们证明，可调谐超晶格势重新组织了这种竞争，并将铁磁量子霍尔拓扑绝缘体稳定在电荷中性，而不需要大的面内磁场或库仑相互作用的强介电抑制。首先通过考虑超晶格势的广义重正化群过程来计算负责在不同竞争状态之间进行选择的相互作用各向异性。我们发现电势抑制了与自旋极化竞争的各向异性。同时，势引入色散，这更喜欢部分自旋极化补偿半金属。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋和谷序之间的竞争使石墨烯成为量子霍尔体系中工程相关拓扑相的通用平台。我们证明，可调谐超晶格势重新组织了这种竞争，并将铁磁量子霍尔拓扑绝缘体稳定在电荷中性，而不需要大的面内磁场或库仑相互作用的强介电抑制。首先通过考虑超晶格势的广义重正化群过程来计算负责在不同竞争状态之间进行选择的相互作用各向异性。我们发现电势抑制了与自旋极化竞争的各向异性。同时，势引入色散，这更喜欢部分自旋极化补偿半金属。因此，我们利用重正化各向异性进行自洽动量空间 Hartree-Fock 计算，以建立绝缘自旋极化铁磁体的稳定状态。最后，我们验证了该铁磁体与量子霍尔铁磁体绝热连接，从而证实了其拓扑特征。我们的结果建立了超晶格势作为控制相互作用石墨烯相图并访问其螺旋量子霍尔状态的手段。

articles.title: High-Fidelity In Silico Dataset of Ordered Binary and Ternary MXenes with Predictive Synthesis Guidance
articles.title_zh: 具有预测合成指导的有序二元和三元 MXene 的高保真计算机数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite their promise, the targeted synthesis of novel MXenes remains challenging due to their vast structural and compositional space and the lack of reliable stability descriptors that account for synthesis conditions. To address this gap, we utilized density functional theory (DFT) with the r²SCAN functional to develop a high-fidelity dataset of 1,040 ordered binary and ternary bare delaminated MXenes, including mono-transition metal MXenes, in-plane ordered double-transition metal MXenes, in-plane ordered metal-divacancy MXenes, and out-of-plane ordered double-transition-metal MXenes. For each structure, we calculated formation and decomposition Gibbs energies, decomposition products, layer symmetry groups, and energies above the hull. We find that all MXenes are thermodynamically inaccessible under equilibrium conditions. However, 115 predominantly carbide MXenes become thermodynamically stabilized at elevated temperatures (500--2000 K), and 23 are stabilized under high pressure (10 GPa). Additionally, three MXenes in the Mn--Fe--C chemical space are stabilized within an experimentally feasible range of carbon chemical potentials. These findings reveal stability trends across the MXene space and identify synthesis strategies that can guide experimental efforts. Our dataset provides a robust foundation for developing machine-learned stability descriptors and for guiding experimental efforts toward novel MXene discovery. By identifying synthesizable candidates along with their synthesis conditions, this work bridges a critical gap in data-driven approaches to MXene discovery and lays the foundation for future autonomous experimental workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管前景广阔，但由于其巨大的结构和组成空间以及缺乏解释合成条件的可靠稳定性描述符，新型 MXene 的靶向合成仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一差距，我们利用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和 r²SCAN 函数来开发 1,040 个有序二元和三元裸分层 MXene 的高保真数据集，包括单过渡金属 MXene、面内有序双过渡金属 MXene、面内有序金属双空位 MXene 和面外有序双过渡金属 MXene。对于每个结构，我们计算了形成和分解吉布斯能量、分解产物、层对称群和船体上方的能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管前景广阔，但由于其巨大的结构和组成空间以及缺乏解释合成条件的可靠稳定性描述符，新型 MXene 的靶向合成仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一差距，我们利用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和 r²SCAN 函数来开发 1,040 个有序二元和三元裸分层 MXene 的高保真数据集，包括单过渡金属 MXene、面内有序双过渡金属 MXene、面内有序金属双空位 MXene 和面外有序双过渡金属 MXene。对于每个结构，我们计算了形成和分解吉布斯能量、分解产物、层对称群和船体上方的能量。我们发现所有 MXene 在平衡条件下在热力学上都是不可接近的。然而，115 种主要为碳化物的 MXene 在高温 (500--2000 K) 下变得热力学稳定，23 种在高压 (10 GPa) 下稳定。此外，Mn--Fe--C化学空间中的三种MXene在实验可行的碳化学势范围内稳定。这些发现揭示了 MXene 领域的稳定性趋势，并确定了可以指导实验工作的合成策略。我们的数据集为开发机器学习的稳定性描述符和指导新的 MXene 发现的实验工作提供了坚实的基础。通过识别可合成的候选物及其合成条件，这项工作弥补了数据驱动的 MXene 发现方法中的关键差距，并为未来的自主实验工作流程奠定了基础。

articles.title: Zeroth persistent homology of ground-state correlations at clean and disordered quantum transitions
articles.title_zh: 干净和无序量子跃迁基态相关性的零持久同源性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The antiferromagnetic Ising chain in transverse and longitudinal fields exhibits a continuous critical point, a mixed-order transition line and, with quenched disorder, an infinite-disorder fixed point and reentrant order. Using exact free-fermion solutions and the density-matrix renormalization group, we examine what the zeroth persistent homology of staggered ground-state correlations adds to conventional responses. Its barcode records the merge scales of the single-linkage hierarchy, and the maximum of its persistence-landscape velocity defines a threshold-free pseudocritical point. This point locates the clean critical point and the mixed-order line with an accuracy comparable to conventional responses. In the reentrant regime, the global velocity misplaces the entry, which is recovered only by restricting the filtration to the ordering scale, and none of the tested estimators locates the exit. A domain wall forced by the boundary conditions suppresses the disorder-averaged reentrant lobe. For individual disordered realizations, the labelled merge tree recovers most strong-disorder renormalization-group clusters, including noncontiguous ones missed by lattice-restricted hierarchies, with increasing agreement at stronger disorder. This information resides in the full correlation matrix, while zeroth homology provides a stable, threshold-free hierarchy.
articles.abstract_zh: 横向和纵向场中的反铁磁伊辛链表现出连续临界点、混合序过渡线以及淬灭无序、无限无序不动点和重入序。使用精确的自由费米子解和密度矩阵重正化群，我们研究了交错基态相关性的第零个持久同源性对传统响应的影响。它的条形码记录了单链接层次结构的合并尺度，并且其持久景观速度的最大值定义了无阈值的伪临界点。该点以与传统响应相当的精度定位干净临界点和混合阶线。在重入状态下，全局速度错位了入口，只能通过将过滤限制在有序尺度来恢复，并且没有一个经过测试的估计器找到出口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 横向和纵向场中的反铁磁伊辛链表现出连续临界点、混合序过渡线以及淬灭无序、无限无序不动点和重入序。使用精确的自由费米子解和密度矩阵重正化群，我们研究了交错基态相关性的第零个持久同源性对传统响应的影响。它的条形码记录了单链接层次结构的合并尺度，并且其持久景观速度的最大值定义了无阈值的伪临界点。该点以与传统响应相当的精度定位干净临界点和混合阶线。在重入状态下，全局速度错位了入口，只能通过将过滤限制在有序尺度来恢复，并且没有一个经过测试的估计器找到出口。边界条件强制的磁畴壁抑制了无序平均凹凸瓣。对于个体无序实现，标记的合并树恢复了大多数强无序重整化群簇，包括被格限制层次结构遗漏的不连续簇，并且在更强的无序性方面的一致性不断增加。该信息驻留在完整的相关矩阵中，而零同源性提供了稳定的、无阈值的层次结构。

articles.title: Controlling the Vacuum: Tunable Magnonic Casimir Effect in Magnetic Moiré Systems
articles.title_zh: 控制真空：磁莫尔系统中的可调谐磁波卡西米尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that the quantum fluctuations of the magnetic degrees of freedom of moiré structures can be tuned by adjusting the moiré lattice. Using the Bistritzer-MacDonald approach, we explore the consequences of this fact for the magnonic vacuum energy and the magnonic Casimir force, which become functions of the moiré pattern parameters. This allows a prototypical engine to be run with the vacuum fluctuations as a working agent and, in that way, to furnish a novel type of magneto-mechanical effect. Our calculations focus on the moiré Ladder as an example but can be generalized to any moiré structure in a straightforward fashion. We anticipate that our results belong to a generic property of moiré structures, regardless of the physical nature of the excitations at hand.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了莫尔结构磁自由度的量子涨落可以通过调整莫尔晶格来调节。使用 Bistritzer-MacDonald 方法，我们探索了这一事实对波角真空能和波角卡西米尔力的影响，它们成为莫尔图案参数的函数。这使得原型发动机能够以真空波动作为工作介质来运行，并以这种方式提供一种新型的磁机械效应。我们的计算重点以莫尔阶梯为例，但可以以简单的方式推广到任何莫尔结构。我们预计我们的结果属于莫尔结构的通用属性，无论当前激励的物理性质如何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了莫尔结构磁自由度的量子涨落可以通过调整莫尔晶格来调节。使用 Bistritzer-MacDonald 方法，我们探索了这一事实对波角真空能和波角卡西米尔力的影响，它们成为莫尔图案参数的函数。这使得原型发动机能够以真空波动作为工作介质来运行，并以这种方式提供一种新型的磁机械效应。我们的计算重点以莫尔阶梯为例，但可以以简单的方式推广到任何莫尔结构。我们预计我们的结果属于莫尔结构的通用属性，无论当前激励的物理性质如何。

articles.title: Structural Relaxation in Supercooled Water: Hydrogen-Bond Exchange, Defect Propagation, and Power-Law Scaling
articles.title_zh: 过冷水中的结构弛豫：氢键交换、缺陷传播和幂律缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular simulations of deeply supercooled water reveal an intriguing power-law relationship between structural relaxation time and the concentration of a specific three-coordinated hydrogen-bond defect, 3'=H¹O². We develop a reaction--transport theory in which active 3' defects propagate through concerted hydrogen-bond rearrangements. An unsatisfied donor hydrogen forms a new bond, creating a transient five-coordinated intermediate; subsequent breaking of another bond transfers the defect to a neighboring molecule. The dynamics includes propagation, self-decay, and encounter-induced annihilation with five-coordinated defects. Independently acting defects yield the mean-field result τ_αpropto c₃'⁻¹. By contrast, concentration-dependent propagation, defect interactions, and correlations between successive network rearrangements can generate a larger, noninteger effective exponent α_D. Analytical results and illustrative calculations on a four-connected network show how elementary exchange kinetics, finite defect lifetimes, and repeated exploration of local environments modify the relaxation efficiency and hence the observed power law.
articles.abstract_zh: 深度过冷水的分子模拟揭示了结构弛豫时间与特定三配位氢键缺陷 3'=H1O2 浓度之间有趣的幂律关系。我们开发了一种反应-输运理论，其中活性 3' 缺陷通过协调的氢键重排传播。未满足的供体氢形成新键，产生瞬态五配位中间体；随后另一个键的断裂会将缺陷转移到邻近的分子。动力学包括传播、自衰变和五配位缺陷的遭遇诱发湮灭。独立作用的缺陷产生平均场结果 τ_αpropto c₃'⁻1。相比之下，浓度依赖性传播、缺陷相互作用以及连续网络重排之间的相关性可以生成更大的非整数有效指数 α_D。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度过冷水的分子模拟揭示了结构弛豫时间与特定三配位氢键缺陷 3'=H1O2 浓度之间有趣的幂律关系。我们开发了一种反应-输运理论，其中活性 3' 缺陷通过协调的氢键重排传播。未满足的供体氢形成新键，产生瞬态五配位中间体；随后另一个键的断裂会将缺陷转移到邻近的分子。动力学包括传播、自衰变和五配位缺陷的遭遇诱发湮灭。独立作用的缺陷产生平均场结果 τ_αpropto c₃'⁻1。相比之下，浓度依赖性传播、缺陷相互作用以及连续网络重排之间的相关性可以生成更大的非整数有效指数 α_D。四连接网络的分析结果和说明性计算显示了基本交换动力学、有限缺陷寿命和对局部环境的重复探索如何改变弛豫效率，从而改变观察到的幂律。

articles.title: The metastability of icosahedral quasicrystals assembled from one-component systems with isotropic interactions
articles.title_zh: 由具有各向同性相互作用的单组分系统组装而成的二十面体准晶体的亚稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Icosahedral quasicrystals (IQCs) are long-range ordered materials that lack translational periodicity. While they have only been observed in multi-component metallic systems, simulations have shown that one-component IQCs can robustly self-assemble using oscillatory potentials. However, their thermodynamic stability remains an open question. Here, we employ direct coexistence simulations to estimate the melting line of the competing solids for one such family of potentials. We find that the IQCs are never thermodynamically stable within the explored parameter space, being consistently outcompeted by periodic crystalline phases. This metastability is primarily driven by the higher internal energy of the IQC relative to the competing solids. Our findings suggest that the observed formation of these single-component IQCs in simulations is likely a kinetic phenomenon rather than a thermodynamic one.
articles.abstract_zh: 二十面体准晶体（IQC）是缺乏平移周期性的长程有序材料。虽然它们仅在多组分金属系统中观察到，但模拟表明单组分 IQC 可以利用振荡电位进行稳健的自组装。然而，它们的热力学稳定性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们采用直接共存模拟来估计此类势族中竞争固体的熔线。我们发现，IQC 在所探索的参数空间内从来都不是热力学稳定的，始终被周期性结晶相击败。这种亚稳定性主要是由 IQC 相对于竞争固体更高的内能驱动的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二十面体准晶体（IQC）是缺乏平移周期性的长程有序材料。虽然它们仅在多组分金属系统中观察到，但模拟表明单组分 IQC 可以利用振荡电位进行稳健的自组装。然而，它们的热力学稳定性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们采用直接共存模拟来估计此类势族中竞争固体的熔线。我们发现，IQC 在所探索的参数空间内从来都不是热力学稳定的，始终被周期性结晶相击败。这种亚稳定性主要是由 IQC 相对于竞争固体更高的内能驱动的。我们的研究结果表明，在模拟中观察到的这些单组分 IQC 的形成可能是一种动力学现象，而不是热力学现象。

articles.title: Nitride crystalline barrier epitaxial SIS Josephson junctions by MBE
articles.title_zh: MBE 氮化物晶体势垒外延 SIS 约瑟夫森结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductor-insulator-superconductor Josephson junctions with crystalline tunnel barriers have remained elusive by epitaxial techniques such as MOCVD or MBE that produce the junction materials and devices powering today's electronic and photonic systems like transistors and lasers. Here, we overcome the key materials hurdle to realize the first functional nitride crystalline barrier Josephson junctions by MBE. Despite an AlN barrier thickness of approximately 4.5 nm, the NbN/AlN/NbN trilayers exhibit coherent Josephson tunneling with critical current densities of approximately 17 A/cm2, an IcRn product of approximately 2.5 mV, and a superconducting gap voltage of approximately 3.7 mV with a BCS-like gap evolution with temperature. Hysteretic current-voltage characteristics and Fraunhofer current modulation with magnetic field establish underdamped SIS Josephson behavior. The realization of crystalline barrier Josephson junctions by MBE opens the doors to a richer materials palette with alloys and superlattice electrodes and tunnel barriers, as well as potential monolithic integration of superconducting quantum circuits with active electronic and photonic devices such as HEMTs and lasers.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有晶体隧道势垒的超导-绝缘体-超导约瑟夫森结仍然难以通过外延技术（例如 MOCVD 或 MBE）来实现，这些技术生产的结材料和器件为当今的电子和光子系统（如晶体管和激光器）提供动力。在这里，我们克服了关键材料障碍，通过 MBE 实现了第一个功能性氮化物晶体势垒约瑟夫森结。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有晶体隧道势垒的超导-绝缘体-超导约瑟夫森结仍然难以通过外延技术（例如 MOCVD 或 MBE）来实现，这些技术生产的结材料和器件为当今的电子和光子系统（如晶体管和激光器）提供动力。在这里，我们克服了关键材料障碍，通过 MBE 实现了第一个功能性氮化物晶体势垒约瑟夫森结。尽管AlN势垒厚度约为4.5 nm，NbN/AlN/NbN三层仍表现出相干约瑟夫森隧道效应，临界电流密度约为17 A/cm2，IcRn乘积约为2.5 mV，超导间隙电压约为3.7 mV，并具有类似BCS的间隙随温度的演变。磁滞电流-电压特性和磁场下的夫琅和费电流调制建立了欠阻尼 SIS 约瑟夫森行为。通过 MBE 实现晶体势垒约瑟夫森结，为合金、超晶格电极和隧道势垒等更丰富的材料选择打开了大门，也为超导量子电路与有源电子和光子器件（如 HEMT 和激光器）的潜在单片集成打开了大门。

articles.title: Reversal of the Anomalous Hall Effect by Directional In-Plane Electric Field in Strained Bilayer MoO
articles.title_zh: 应变双层 MoO 中定向面内电场逆转反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered magnetic materials with tunable valley and spin degrees of freedom hold promise for multifunctional spintronic devices. Here, we demonstrate that the orientation of an in-plane electric field enables selective switching of single-valley spin splitting and reversal of the anomalous Hall conductivity in strained bilayer MoO. In particular, electric fields along the a and b directions selectively lift the spin degeneracy at the X and Y valleys, respectively, while preserving it at the other valley. This valley-selective switching is accompanied by a redistribution of Berry curvature with opposite signs, giving rise to a reversible anomalous Hall response. These effects are realized in the energetically and dynamically stable AC2 stacking configuration, where biaxial strain induces Dirac-like band crossings that enable subsequent electric-field control. Meanwhile, the AC1 stacking configuration, which is also energetically and dynamically stable, exhibits rich strain-driven phenomena, including a transition from metal to topological insulator with quantized spin Hall conductivity, as well as valley polarization and piezomagnetism. Our findings reveal a combined effect of strain and electric fields for controlling valley-selective spin splitting and anomalous Hall responses, highlighting bilayer MoO as a promising platform for multifunctional spintronic and valleytronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有可调谷和自旋自由度的层状磁性材料有望成为多功能自旋电子器件。在这里，我们证明面内电场的方向能够选择性地切换单谷自旋分裂和应变双层 MoO 中反常霍尔电导率的反转。特别是，沿 a 和 b 方向的电场分别选择性地提升 X 和 Y 谷处的自旋简并性，同时保留其他谷处的自旋简并性。这种谷选择性切换伴随着具有相反符号的贝里曲率的重新分布，从而产生可逆的异常霍尔响应。这些效应是在能量和动态稳定的 AC2 堆叠配置中实现的，其中双轴应变引起类似狄拉克的带交叉，从而实现后续的电场控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有可调谷和自旋自由度的层状磁性材料有望成为多功能自旋电子器件。在这里，我们证明面内电场的方向能够选择性地切换单谷自旋分裂和应变双层 MoO 中反常霍尔电导率的反转。特别是，沿 a 和 b 方向的电场分别选择性地提升 X 和 Y 谷处的自旋简并性，同时保留其他谷处的自旋简并性。这种谷选择性切换伴随着具有相反符号的贝里曲率的重新分布，从而产生可逆的异常霍尔响应。这些效应是在能量和动态稳定的 AC2 堆叠配置中实现的，其中双轴应变引起类似狄拉克的带交叉，从而实现后续的电场控制。同时，AC1堆叠结构在能量和动态上也是稳定的，表现出丰富的应变驱动现象，包括从金属到具有量子化自旋霍尔电导率的拓扑绝缘体的转变，以及谷极化和压磁性。我们的研究结果揭示了应变和电场对控制谷选择性自旋分裂和反常霍尔响应的综合效应，突出了双层 MoO 作为多功能自旋电子和谷电子器件的有前景的平台。

articles.title: Interplay of the Fano-Andreev Effect and Nonlinear Screening in Electric and Thermoelectric Transport through a T-Shaped Double Quantum Dot
articles.title_zh: 通过 T 形双量子点，法诺-安德烈夫效应与非线性屏蔽在电和热电传输中的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical study of weakly nonlinear electric and thermoelectric transport through a T-shaped double quantum dot coupled to normal and superconducting leads. Nonlinear screening is treated within the characteristic-potential formalism, in which an internal electrostatic potential accounts for nonequilibrium charge redistribution on the lead-coupled central dot. The side-coupled dot induces the Fano-Andreev effect, which, together with nonlinear screening, significantly modifies the transport properties. Under voltage bias, the screening-induced level renormalization produces a pronounced bias asymmetry in the Andreev differential conductance. In response to a pure thermal bias, increasing the interdot coupling weakens the level renormalization and suppresses the quasiparticle thermoelectric response, leading to reduced thermovoltage and nonlinear Seebeck coefficient. When voltage and thermal biases are applied simultaneously, a finite subgap cross thermoelectric response emerges beyond the linear regime. The sign of this response is governed by the competition between the energy-dependent transport contribution, modified by the Fano-Andreev effect, and the nonlinear screening contribution, thereby determining whether a thermal bias enhances or suppresses the low-bias Andreev current.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了通过与普通和超导引线耦合的 T 形双量子点弱非线性电和热电传输的理论研究。非线性屏蔽在特征电势形式中进行处理，其中内部静电势解释了铅耦合中心点上的非平衡电荷重新分布。侧面耦合点会引起法诺-安德烈夫效应，该效应与非线性屏蔽一起显着改变传输特性。在电压偏置下，屏蔽引起的电平重整化在安德烈夫微分电导中产生明显的偏置不对称性。为了响应纯热偏置，增加点间耦合会削弱能级重正化并抑制准粒子热电响应，从而导致热电压和非线性塞贝克系数降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了通过与普通和超导引线耦合的 T 形双量子点弱非线性电和热电传输的理论研究。非线性屏蔽在特征电势形式中进行处理，其中内部静电势解释了铅耦合中心点上的非平衡电荷重新分布。侧面耦合点会引起法诺-安德烈夫效应，该效应与非线性屏蔽一起显着改变传输特性。在电压偏置下，屏蔽引起的电平重整化在安德烈夫微分电导中产生明显的偏置不对称性。为了响应纯热偏置，增加点间耦合会削弱能级重正化并抑制准粒子热电响应，从而导致热电压和非线性塞贝克系数降低。当同时施加电压和热偏置时，会出现超出线性状态的有限子间隙交叉热电响应。该响应的符号由受法诺-安德烈夫效应修改的能量依赖传输贡献与非线性屏蔽贡献之间的竞争控制，从而确定热偏置是增强还是抑制低偏置安德烈夫电流。

articles.title: Observing Autler--Townes splitting of an rf-dressed Feshbach resonance
articles.title_zh: 观察射频处理的费什巴赫共振的奥特勒-汤斯分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We experimentally implement the scheme introduced by Ding, D'Incao, and Greene [Phys. Rev. A bf 95, 022709 (2017)] for controlling the scattering length near a magnetic Feshbach resonance using an rf dressing field. Specifically, we observe Autler--Townes splitting of the 1007 G Feshbach resonance in dipole-trapped ⁸⁷Rb by coupling the associated quasibound molecular state to a deeper-lying bound state with a different spin projection. At a fixed magnetic field away from the bare resonance, we further demonstrate rf switching of the collisional response. Our experimental observable is atom loss, which is consistent with enhanced three-body recombination arising from an increase in the magnitude of the real part of the scattering length. Our observation of Autler--Townes splitting establishes the feasibility of generating the strong rf magnetic fields required for sufficient molecular dressing and provides an important basis for further experimental tests of the predicted elastic nature of the rf-controlled interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验实现了 Ding、D'Incao 和 Greene [Phys. Rev. A bf 95, 022709 (2017)]用于使用射频敷料场控制磁费什巴赫共振附近的散射长度。具体来说，我们通过将相关的准束缚分子态耦合到具有不同自旋投影的更深层次的束缚态，观察了偶极子捕获的 ⁸⁷Rb 中 1007 G Feshbach 共振的奥特勒-汤斯分裂。在远离裸共振的固定磁场下，我们进一步演示了碰撞响应的射频切换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过实验实现了 Ding、D'Incao 和 Greene [Phys. Rev. A bf 95, 022709 (2017)]用于使用射频敷料场控制磁费什巴赫共振附近的散射长度。具体来说，我们通过将相关的准束缚分子态耦合到具有不同自旋投影的更深层次的束缚态，观察了偶极子捕获的 ⁸⁷Rb 中 1007 G Feshbach 共振的奥特勒-汤斯分裂。在远离裸共振的固定磁场下，我们进一步演示了碰撞响应的射频切换。我们的实验观察到的是原子损失，这与散射长度实部幅度增加所引起的三体复合增强一致。我们对奥特勒-汤斯分裂的观察确立了产生足够分子修整所需的强射频磁场的可行性，并为进一步实验测试射频控制相互作用的预测弹性性质提供了重要基础。

articles.title: Momentum-Space Mismatch Enables Non-Hermitian Valley Filtering
articles.title_zh: 动量空间失配实现非厄米谷过滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Valley-selective transport is central to valleytronics, but existing valley filters are largely tailored to specific materials or lattice geometries, motivating the search for a common microscopic ingredient. Here we identify the momentum-space mismatch between the band-touching nodes of a system and its dissipative reservoir as a route to node-selective non-Hermitian skin effects (NHSE). When the two are coupled, the mismatch is encoded in the retarded self-energy, producing node-dependent dissipation and contrasting quasiparticle lifetimes. The resulting effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian exhibits opposite point-gap spectral winding at the two nodes, giving rise to a node-resolved NHSE with strongly asymmetric dissipation rates: one node decays rapidly into the reservoir while the other survives over the device, yielding a nearly valley-polarized outgoing current. We demonstrate this mechanism in a minimal one-dimensional dimer chain and in two-dimensional systems hosting genuine Dirac valleys, including π-flux rectangular and honeycomb lattices. In all cases, transport calculations yield nearly 100% valley polarization, while remaining gate-tunable and robust against disorder and edge imperfections. Our results show that momentum-space mismatch provides a route to non-Hermitian valley filtering.
articles.abstract_zh: 谷选择性传输是谷电子学的核心，但现有的谷过滤器很大程度上是针对特定材料或晶格几何形状定制的，这促使人们寻找常见的微观成分。在这里，我们将系统的带接触节点与其耗散储层之间的动量空间失配确定为节点选择性非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）的途径。当两者耦合时，失配被编码在延迟的自能中，产生依赖于节点的耗散和对比准粒子寿命。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 谷选择性传输是谷电子学的核心，但现有的谷过滤器很大程度上是针对特定材料或晶格几何形状定制的，这促使人们寻找常见的微观成分。在这里，我们将系统的带接触节点与其耗散储层之间的动量空间失配确定为节点选择性非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）的途径。当两者耦合时，失配被编码在延迟的自能中，产生依赖于节点的耗散和对比准粒子寿命。由此产生的有效非厄米哈密顿量在两个节点处表现出相反的点隙谱缠绕，从而产生具有强烈不对称耗散率的节点解析NHSE：一个节点快速衰减到储层中，而另一个节点在器件上幸存下来，产生近谷极化的输出电流。我们在最小的一维二聚体链和包含真正狄拉克谷的二维系统（包括 π 通量矩形和蜂窝晶格）中演示了这种机制。在所有情况下，输运计算都会产生近 100% 的谷极化，同时保持栅极可调且对无序和边缘缺陷具有鲁棒性。我们的结果表明动量空间失配提供了非厄米谷过滤的途径。

articles.title: Defective α-In₂Se₃ from first principles
articles.title_zh: 第一原理中的缺陷α-In2Se₃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: α-In₂Se₃ is a two-dimensional van der Waals material with promising applications involving ferroelectricity. However, the presence of native defects can significantly influence its structural and electronic properties. In this work, we employ density functional theory with a state-of-the-art meta-generalized gradient approximation (meta-GGA) exchange-correlation functional to investigate the electronic structure of bulk α-In₂Se₃ and the formation of neutral point defects, including vacancies and antisites, under Se-rich and In-rich growth conditions. Our calculations reproduce the experimental structural parameters of the pristine material and reveal that the Se vacancy in the middle layer exhibits an unexpectedly low formation energy under both chemical environments. Structural analysis shows that the neighboring tetrahedrally coordinated In atom undergoes a substantial local relaxation along the three-fold axis, which preserves its C₃ᵥ site symmetry even as its coordination is reduced from four to three, providing a microscopic explanation for the remarkable stability of this defect.
articles.abstract_zh: α-In2Se₃是一种二维范德华材料，在铁电方面具有广阔的应用前景。然而，天然缺陷的存在会显着影响其结构和电子特性。在这项工作中，我们采用密度泛函理论和最先进的元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）交换相关函数来研究富硒和富硒生长条件下块体α-In2Se3的电子结构以及中性点缺陷（包括空位和反位点）的形成。我们的计算重现了原始材料的实验结构参数，并揭示了中间层的 Se 空位在两种化学环境下都表现出出乎意料的低形成能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: α-In2Se₃是一种二维范德华材料，在铁电方面具有广阔的应用前景。然而，天然缺陷的存在会显着影响其结构和电子特性。在这项工作中，我们采用密度泛函理论和最先进的元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）交换相关函数来研究富硒和富硒生长条件下块体α-In2Se3的电子结构以及中性点缺陷（包括空位和反位点）的形成。我们的计算重现了原始材料的实验结构参数，并揭示了中间层的 Se 空位在两种化学环境下都表现出出乎意料的低形成能。结构分析表明，邻近的四面体配位 In 原子沿三重轴经历了显着的局部弛豫，即使其配位从 4 个减少到 3 个，也保留了其 C₃ᵥ 位点对称性，为该缺陷的显着稳定性提供了微观解释。

articles.title: Maximally Chiral Eigenstate from Inverse Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
articles.title_zh: 逆热力学的最大手性本征态 Bethe Ansatz
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that an ordered quantum state can support waves with a finite speed in one direction and exponentially small energies in the other. We prescribe this spectrum for a spin-1/2 Heisenberg eigenstate and reconstruct a nonlocal Hamiltonian. The thermodynamic construction selects the ordered, current-carrying state as a ground state. Its magnetic moment remains finite while its response to a weak field has a divergent slope. The entropy per spin vanishes only inversely with a logarithm of temperature, with an exact coefficient containing the golden ratio. Our spin-response calculations reveal a bound pair whose energy can be tuned without changing its intensity. Added exchange and smoother mode selection restore quadratic excitations at the lowest energies. These results connect the design of interactions to directional dynamics and unusual thermodynamics. We propose momentum-resolved spin spectroscopy, weak-field magnetometry, and low-temperature entropy measurements to probe these counterintuitive signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，有序的量子态可以支持一个方向上具有有限速度的波，而另一个方向上具有指数级小的能量的波。我们为自旋 1/2 海森堡本征态规定了这个谱，并重建了非局部哈密顿量。热力学结构选择有序的载流状态作为基态。其磁矩保持有限，而其对弱场的响应具有发散斜率。每次自旋的熵仅与温度的对数成反比消失，其中包含黄金比例的精确系数。我们的自旋响应计算揭示了一个束缚对，其能量可以在不改变其强度的情况下进行调整。增加的交换和更平滑的模式选择可恢复最低能量下的二次激励。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，有序的量子态可以支持一个方向上具有有限速度的波，而另一个方向上具有指数级小的能量的波。我们为自旋 1/2 海森堡本征态规定了这个谱，并重建了非局部哈密顿量。热力学结构选择有序的载流状态作为基态。其磁矩保持有限，而其对弱场的响应具有发散斜率。每次自旋的熵仅与温度的对数成反比消失，其中包含黄金比例的精确系数。我们的自旋响应计算揭示了一个束缚对，其能量可以在不改变其强度的情况下进行调整。增加的交换和更平滑的模式选择可恢复最低能量下的二次激励。这些结果将相互作用的设计与方向动力学和不寻常的热力学联系起来。我们提出动量分辨自旋光谱、弱场磁力测量和低温熵测量来探测这些违反直觉的特征。

articles.title: Magnetically Compensated Spin-Polarized Edge States in Coplanar Magnets
articles.title_zh: 共面磁体中的磁补偿自旋极化边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A boundary can release spin-polarized electronic states from a magnetically compensated, spin-degenerate layer. We establish the symmetry criterion governing this release in coplanar exchange magnets: the allowed even-parity edge-spin space equals the allowed uniform-magnetization space. Symmetry-protected compensation therefore selects an odd spin texture perpendicular to the moment plane. Six maximal sectors organize the possible edge textures. Orthogonal cuts of one exchange model realize odd and even sectors, while FeSe spin-vortex and NiI₂ period-four spiral Wannier models provide material realizations. Their semi-infinite boundaries exhibit complementary electrical responses: perpendicular spin accumulation at the odd edge and in-plane spin-current response at the even edge. Boundary symmetry thus connects magnetic compensation to equilibrium spin textures and electrical spin readout.
articles.abstract_zh: 边界可以从磁补偿的自旋简并层释放自旋极化电子态。我们建立了控制共面交换磁体中这种释放的对称标准：允许的偶校验边缘自旋空间等于允许的均匀磁化空间。因此，对称保护补偿选择垂直于力矩平面的奇数自旋纹理。六个最大扇区组织可能的边缘纹理。一种交换模型的正交切割实现了奇数和偶数扇区，而 FeSe 自旋涡流和 NiI2 四周期螺旋 Wannier 模型提供了材料实现。它们的半无限边界表现出互补的电响应：奇数边缘处的垂直自旋累积和偶数边缘处的面内自旋电流响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 边界可以从磁补偿的自旋简并层释放自旋极化电子态。我们建立了控制共面交换磁体中这种释放的对称标准：允许的偶校验边缘自旋空间等于允许的均匀磁化空间。因此，对称保护补偿选择垂直于力矩平面的奇数自旋纹理。六个最大扇区组织可能的边缘纹理。一种交换模型的正交切割实现了奇数和偶数扇区，而 FeSe 自旋涡流和 NiI2 四周期螺旋 Wannier 模型提供了材料实现。它们的半无限边界表现出互补的电响应：奇数边缘处的垂直自旋累积和偶数边缘处的面内自旋电流响应。因此，边界对称性将磁补偿与平衡自旋纹理和电自旋读出联系起来。

articles.title: High-Throughput Surface Screening Reveals Energetically Competitive Low-Symmetry Facets in Wurtzite Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 高通量表面筛选揭示了纤锌矿半导体中具有能量竞争力的低对称面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surfaces and interfaces govern the performance of wurtzite semiconductors in electronics, sensing, and solar-fuel conversion. To date, first-principles studies have focused mostly on high-symmetry low-index facets, owing to the computational cost and complexity of modelling low-symmetry high-index surfaces. In practice, however, surface formation energy is determined by the planar atomic density and the strength of the bonds severed upon cleavage, neither of which inherently excludes high-Miller-index surfaces from being energetically competitive. Here, we combine automated surface generation, machine-learning interatomic potential screening, and density functional theory to explore 226 clean, stoichiometric surface models of wurtzite GaN, LaN, and ZnO, spanning all Miller orientations with |h|,|k|,|l| le 3 and their inequivalent terminations. We find that low-symmetry high-index prismatic facets are energetically competitive with respect to the conventional m- and a-planes: nine of the fifteen lowest-energy nonpolar surfaces are high-index, and the five best candidates of each compound lie within only 2.5-5.3% of the minimum surface energy. Hybrid-functional calculations reveal, however, that this energetic proximity does not translate into similar electronic alignment. In GaN, the two most stable surfaces differ by just 0.08 J m⁻² in formation energy but by almost 0.8 eV in vacuum-referenced band-edge positions, whereas in LaN the nearly degenerate m- and a-planes are separated by 0.16 eV. Wurtzite facets with similar formation energies may therefore exhibit very different ionization potentials and electron affinities. Our results enable the joint, systematic assessment of stability and band alignment across the facets that can actually occur in wurtzites, and provide a map of candidate surfaces for the rational design of related nanostructure and heterointerfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面和界面决定着纤锌矿半导体在电子、传感和太阳能燃料转换方面的性能。迄今为止，由于低对称高折射率表面建模的计算成本和复杂性，第一原理研究主要集中在高对称低折射率面。然而，实际上，表面形成能是由平面原子密度和解理时切断的键的强度决定的，这两者都本质上排除了高米勒指数表面的能量竞争。在这里，我们结合自动表面生成、机器学习原子间势筛选和密度泛函理论，探索了纤锌矿 GaN、LaN 和 ZnO 的 226 个干净的化学计量表面模型，涵盖所有米勒方向 |h|、|k|、|l| 。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 表面和界面决定着纤锌矿半导体在电子、传感和太阳能燃料转换方面的性能。迄今为止，由于低对称高折射率表面建模的计算成本和复杂性，第一原理研究主要集中在高对称低折射率面。然而，实际上，表面形成能是由平面原子密度和解理时切断的键的强度决定的，这两者都本质上排除了高米勒指数表面的能量竞争。在这里，我们结合自动表面生成、机器学习原子间势筛选和密度泛函理论，探索了纤锌矿 GaN、LaN 和 ZnO 的 226 个干净的化学计量表面模型，涵盖所有米勒方向 |h|、|k|、|l| 。 le 3 及其不等价终止符。我们发现，低对称性高折射率棱柱面相对于传统的 m 面和 a 面在能量上具有竞争力：15 个能量最低的非极性表面中有 9 个是高折射率的，并且每种化合物的 5 个最佳候选面仅位于最小表面能的 2.5-5.3% 范围内。然而，混合功能计算表明，这种能量接近并不能转化为类似的电子排列。在 GaN 中，两个最稳定的表面的形成能仅相差 0.08 J m-2，但在真空参考带边缘位置相差近 0.8 eV，而在 LaN 中，近简并的 m 面和 a 面相差 0.16 eV。因此，具有相似形成能的纤锌矿晶面可能表现出非常不同的电离势和电子亲和势。我们的结果能够对纤锌矿中实际出现的晶面的稳定性和能带排列进行联合、系统的评估，并为相关纳米结构和异质界面的合理设计提供候选表面图。

articles.title: Higher-order topology induced by altermagnetism in quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 准晶中交变磁性引起的高阶拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism (AM), a novel magnetic phase featuring zero net magnetization and momentum-dependent spin splitting, provides a compelling platform for exploring exotic quantum phenomena. While recent studies have extended the concept of AM to quasicrystals, the momentum-dependent spin splitting in the absence of translational symmetry remains inadequately understood. Here, we investigate the emergence of higher-order topological phases (HOTPs) in Thue-Morse and Ammann-Beenker quasicrystals, driven by the coupling between d-wave quasicrystal AM orders and a two-dimensional topological insulator. We reveal that the dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave AM exhibits a ferromagnetism-like aspect in opening edge gaps and inducing zero-energy higher-order topological corner states. In contrast, conventional antiferromagnetic and dₓy-wave AM configurations are unable to induce the higher-order topological gaps. These findings highlight the pivotal role of altermagnetic symmetry and its alignment with lattice corners in the realization of HOTPs and establish that the emergence of HOTPs can serve as a signature for identifying altermagnetic orders in aperiodic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁性 (AM) 是一种新型磁相，具有零净磁化强度和动量相关的自旋分裂，为探索奇异的量子现象提供了一个引人注目的平台。虽然最近的研究已将增材制造的概念扩展到准晶体，但在缺乏平移对称性的情况下，动量相关的自旋分裂仍然没有得到充分的理解。在这里，我们研究了 Thue-Morse 和 Ammann-Beenker 准晶体中高阶拓扑相 (HOTP) 的出现，这是由 d 波准晶 AM 阶和二维拓扑绝缘体之间的耦合驱动的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁性 (AM) 是一种新型磁相，具有零净磁化强度和动量相关的自旋分裂，为探索奇异的量子现象提供了一个引人注目的平台。虽然最近的研究已将增材制造的概念扩展到准晶体，但在缺乏平移对称性的情况下，动量相关的自旋分裂仍然没有得到充分的理解。在这里，我们研究了 Thue-Morse 和 Ammann-Beenker 准晶体中高阶拓扑相 (HOTP) 的出现，这是由 d 波准晶 AM 阶和二维拓扑绝缘体之间的耦合驱动的。我们揭示了 dₓ²₋y² 波 AM 在打开边缘间隙和诱导零能量高阶拓扑角态方面表现出类似铁磁性的方面。相比之下，传统的反铁磁和 dₓy 波 AM 配置无法引起高阶拓扑间隙。这些发现强调了交变磁对称性及其与晶格角的对齐在实现 HOTP 中的关键作用，并证实 HOTP 的出现可以作为识别非周期系统中交变磁序的标志。

articles.title: Magnetism on emergent molecular-orbital lattices
articles.title_zh: 新兴分子轨道晶格的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In solids, strong hybridization between nearby atomic orbitals forms molecular orbitals (MOs), the range of which covers a cluster of atoms. The centers of molecular orbitals form an emergent lattice generally different from the atomic lattice. For partially filled MOs, electron interaction may induce a new type of magnetism on this emergent lattice where the local moments come from the molecular orbitals instead of single atoms. In this work, we show in a ruby-lattice tight-binding Hubbard model that frustrated and unfrustrated antiferromagnetism may appear on the same atomic lattice and at the same filling, as the emergent molecular-orbital lattice changes from triangular to honeycomb upon changing the hopping parameters. Moreover, we show that general molecular orbital magnetism may be experimentally verified in the low-energy dynamic structure factor: the molecular form factors, as the Fourier transforms of the molecular spin-density, modulate the low-energy dynamic structure factor across different Brillouin zones. Zeros of these form factors suppress low energy spectral weight irrespective of the magnetic order formed by the molecular moments. This is exemplified by random phase approximation calculations for the ruby-lattice model: the structure factor integrated over low energies exhibits minima around molecular form-factor zeros, while its ratios between selected equivalent momenta in different Brillouin zones agree with ratios of squared form factors.
articles.abstract_zh: 在固体中，附近原子轨道之间的强杂化形成分子轨道（MO），其范围覆盖原子簇。分子轨道中心形成通常不同于原子晶格的涌现晶格。对于部分填充的金属氧化物，电子相互作用可能会在这种新兴晶格上诱发一种新型磁性，其中局部力矩来自分子轨道而不是单个原子。在这项工作中，我们在红宝石晶格紧束缚哈伯德模型中表明，受挫和不受挫反铁磁性可能出现在相同的原子晶格和相同的填充处，因为在改变跳跃参数时出现的分子轨道晶格从三角形变为蜂窝状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在固体中，附近原子轨道之间的强杂化形成分子轨道（MO），其范围覆盖原子簇。分子轨道中心形成通常不同于原子晶格的涌现晶格。对于部分填充的金属氧化物，电子相互作用可能会在这种新兴晶格上诱发一种新型磁性，其中局部力矩来自分子轨道而不是单个原子。在这项工作中，我们在红宝石晶格紧束缚哈伯德模型中表明，受挫和不受挫反铁磁性可能出现在相同的原子晶格和相同的填充处，因为在改变跳跃参数时出现的分子轨道晶格从三角形变为蜂窝状。此外，我们表明，一般分子轨道磁性可以在低能动态结构因子中得到实验验证：分子形状因子作为分子自旋密度的傅里叶变换，调节不同布里渊区的低能动态结构因子。无论分子矩形成的磁序如何，这些形状因子的零点都会抑制低能谱权重。红宝石晶格模型的随机相位近似计算证明了这一点：在低能量上积分的结构因子在分子形状因子零点附近表现出最小值，而不同布里渊区中选定的等效动量之间的比率与形状因子平方的比率一致。

articles.title: Quantum-Metric-Induced Distinct Optoelectronic Responses in Triple M Valleys
articles.title_zh: Triple M 谷中量子度量诱导的独特光电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While K± valleys with contrasting optoelectronic properties have been the main focus of valleytronics, the lack of reliable manipulation methods for M valleys leaves numerous M-valley materials untapped. Here, we discover that three flavors of M valleys become distinguishable via quantum-metric-induced optoelectronic responses. The tight-binding calculations demonstrate that by tuning the electric-field orientation, opposite nonlinear Hall currents from any pair of M valleys can be chosen to realize the nonlinear valley Hall effect. Moreover, linearly polarized light allows for preferential excitation of individual M valleys, driving photoexcited valley-polarized Hall transport. Using first-principles calculations, we further validate the quantum-metric-induced optoelectronic responses in antiferromagnetic MoI₃ bilayers, which exhibit a significant nonlinear valley Hall conductivity amenable to transport measurements. Our findings extend the scope of valleytronics from conventional binary K± valleys to triple M valleys and pave the way for designing advanced optoelectronic devices with multiple quantum states of high tunability.
articles.abstract_zh: 虽然具有对比光电特性的 K± 谷一直是谷电子学的主要焦点，但由于缺乏可靠的 M 谷操纵方法，许多 M 谷材料尚未开发。在这里，我们发现 M 谷的三种风味可以通过量子度量诱导的光电响应来区分。紧束缚计算表明，通过调整电场方向，可以选择来自任意一对 M 谷的相反非线性霍尔电流来实现非线性谷霍尔效应。此外，线偏振光允许优先激发各个 M 谷，驱动光激发谷偏振霍尔传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虽然具有对比光电特性的 K± 谷一直是谷电子学的主要焦点，但由于缺乏可靠的 M 谷操纵方法，许多 M 谷材料尚未开发。在这里，我们发现 M 谷的三种风味可以通过量子度量诱导的光电响应来区分。紧束缚计算表明，通过调整电场方向，可以选择来自任意一对 M 谷的相反非线性霍尔电流来实现非线性谷霍尔效应。此外，线偏振光允许优先激发各个 M 谷，驱动光激发谷偏振霍尔传输。利用第一性原理计算，我们进一步验证了反铁磁 MoI₃ 双层中量子诱导的光电响应，该响应表现出显着的非线性谷霍尔电导率，适合传输测量。我们的研究结果将谷电子学的范围从传统的二元 K± 谷扩展到三重 M 谷，并为设计具有高可调性的多量子态的先进光电器件铺平了道路。

articles.title: Kitaev Exchange and Altermagnetism in the Double Perovskite Sr₂CoTeO₆: An Ab Initio Study
articles.title_zh: 双钙钛矿 Sr2CoTeO₆ 中的 Kitaev 交换和交变磁性：从头算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Co²⁺-based double perovskite Sr₂CoTeO₆ attracts attention due to its nontrivial magnetic properties. Ab initio density functional theory calculations reveal a substantial ferromagnetic Kitaev exchange |K|sim J/3 between nearest neighbors that, combined with the face-centered cubic lattice, leads to pronounced exchange frustration and places Sr₂CoTeO₆ among Kitaev materials with moderate Kitaev interaction strength. In addition, Sr₂CoTeO₆ is found to be altermagnetic with a sizable non-relativistic spin splitting, which can give rise to a transverse piezomagnetic effect and a nontrivial magneto-optical response.
articles.abstract_zh: Co2⁺基双钙钛矿Sr2CoTeO₆因其非凡的磁性而引起人们的关注。从头算密度泛函理论计算揭示了最近邻之间存在大量铁磁 Kitaev 交换 |K|sim J/3，与面心立方晶格相结合，导致明显的交换挫败，并将 Sr2CoTeO₆ 置于具有中等 Kitaev 相互作用强度的 Kitaev 材料中。此外，Sr2CoTeO6被发现具有交变磁性，具有相当大的非相对论性自旋分裂，这可以产生横向压磁效应和非平凡的磁光响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Co2⁺基双钙钛矿Sr2CoTeO₆因其非凡的磁性而引起人们的关注。从头算密度泛函理论计算揭示了最近邻之间存在大量铁磁 Kitaev 交换 |K|sim J/3，与面心立方晶格相结合，导致明显的交换挫败，并将 Sr2CoTeO₆ 置于具有中等 Kitaev 相互作用强度的 Kitaev 材料中。此外，Sr2CoTeO6被发现具有交变磁性，具有相当大的非相对论性自旋分裂，这可以产生横向压磁效应和非平凡的磁光响应。

articles.title: Probing Unknown Luttinger-Like Parameters and Band Structure in BAs: A 24-Band k.p and DFT Approach
articles.title_zh: 探索 BA 中未知的类 Luttinger 参数和能带结构：24 频带 k.p 和 DFT 方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, the electronic band structure and the unknown Luttinger-like parameters associated with the p-type conduction bands (CBs) of boron arsenide (BAs) are calculated and analyzed using both 24-band k.p and density functional (DFT) theories. For the DFT study, Gaussian and plane-wave basis sets implemented in the CP2K code were used. Comparison with DFT and available experimental results shows that the 24-band k.p model accurately reproduces the known electronic properties of BAs. These results demonstrate that the 24-band k.p model accurately reproduces the electronic band structure and key band parameters over the investigated energy range. In addition, the 24-band k.p Hamiltonian parameters are adjusted and we show that the effective masses and the band parameters are validated against previously published theoretical studies. These findings suggest that the k.p method is computationally more efficient than DFT, making it suitable for modeling complex nanostructures and quantum wells based on BAs semiconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，使用 24 能带 k.p 和密度泛函 (DFT) 理论计算和分析了与砷化硼 (BA) 的 p 型导带 (CB) 相关的电子能带结构和未知的类 Luttinger 参数。对于 DFT 研究，使用了 CP2K 代码中实现的高斯和平面波基组。与 DFT 和现有实验结果的比较表明，24 波段 k.p 模型准确地再现了 BA 的已知电子特性。这些结果表明，24 能带 k.p 模型准确地再现了所研究能量范围内的电子能带结构和关键能带参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，使用 24 能带 k.p 和密度泛函 (DFT) 理论计算和分析了与砷化硼 (BA) 的 p 型导带 (CB) 相关的电子能带结构和未知的类 Luttinger 参数。对于 DFT 研究，使用了 CP2K 代码中实现的高斯和平面波基组。与 DFT 和现有实验结果的比较表明，24 波段 k.p 模型准确地再现了 BA 的已知电子特性。这些结果表明，24 能带 k.p 模型准确地再现了所研究能量范围内的电子能带结构和关键能带参数。此外，还调整了 24 频带 k.p 哈密顿量参数，并且我们表明有效质量和频带参数根据之前发表的理论研究进行了验证。这些发现表明，k.p 方法在计算上比 DFT 更高效，使其适合对基于 BA 半导体的复杂纳米结构和量子阱进行建模。

articles.title: Competing Octahedral Tilting and B-Site Off-Centering Govern the Phase Diagram of CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ Perovskite Alloys
articles.title_zh: 竞争八面体倾斜和 B 位偏心控制 CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ 钙钛矿合金的相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-free halide perovskites based on Ge and Sn avoid the toxicity of Pb, but the two cations favor different structural distortions. The stereochemically active Ge 4s² lone pair drives polar B-site off-centering, whereas the larger Sn²⁺ cation favors octahedral tilting. Here, we map how these two instabilities compete across the full composition range of CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a charge-aware machine-learned interatomic potential trained on hybrid-functional data. At low temperature the alloy exhibits a morphotropic phase boundary between x=0.60 and 0.65 that separates a ferroelectric monoclinic Cc phase from a monoclinic P2₁ phase with mixed antipolar and polar off-centering, with both the tilt pattern and the off-centering order changing discontinuously. The composition-temperature phase diagram reproduces the known transition sequences and temperatures of both end members and reveals an intermediate tetragonal I4/mcm phase near the boundary that has no counterpart in either parent compound. Above the transition temperatures the B cations remain locally off-centered but orientationally disordered. The structural transition at the boundary causes a jump in the band gap at low temperature, whereas at 350 K the gap decreases smoothly with Sn content. These results establish B-site mixing as a means to tune polar and rotational order in lead-free halide perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于Ge和Sn的无铅卤化物钙钛矿避免了Pb的毒性，但这两种阳离子有利于不同的结构扭曲。具有立体化学活性的 Ge 4s² 孤对电子驱动极性 B 位点偏心，而较大的 Sn²⁺ 阳离子则有利于八面体倾斜。在这里，我们使用大规模分子动力学模拟以及在混合功能数据上训练的电荷感知机器学习原子间势，绘制了这两种不稳定性如何在 CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ 的整个组成范围内竞争。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于Ge和Sn的无铅卤化物钙钛矿避免了Pb的毒性，但这两种阳离子有利于不同的结构扭曲。具有立体化学活性的 Ge 4s² 孤对电子驱动极性 B 位点偏心，而较大的 Sn²⁺ 阳离子则有利于八面体倾斜。在这里，我们使用大规模分子动力学模拟以及在混合功能数据上训练的电荷感知机器学习原子间势，绘制了这两种不稳定性如何在 CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ 的整个组成范围内竞争。在低温下，该合金表现出 x=0.60 和 0.65 之间的同形相界，将铁电单斜 Cc 相与具有混合反极性和极性偏心的单斜 P2₁ 相分开，倾斜模式和偏心顺序均不连续变化。组成-温度相图再现了两个端元的已知转变序列和温度，并揭示了边界附近的中间四方 I4/mcm 相，该相在任一母体化合物中都没有对应物。高于转变温度时，B 阳离子仍然局部偏心，但方向无序。低温下，边界处的结构转变导致带隙跳跃，而在 350 K 时，带隙随 Sn 含量的增加而平滑减小。这些结果表明 B 位混合是调节无铅卤化物钙钛矿中极性和旋转顺序的一种手段。

articles.title: Chirality-Odd Readout of Coherence-Mediated Magnon Spin Transport
articles.title_zh: 相干介导的磁振子自旋输运的手性奇读数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural chirality is ubiquitous in magnets, yet its impact on spin transport in insulators remains largely unexplored, with only a few recent experiments offering the first glimpses. Here we predict the chiral response in the electric spin injection-detection configuration in both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic spirals. The screw symmetry of the spiral forbids any nonzero diagonal element of the magnon spin matrix: every eigenmode is linearly polarized and carries no spin, so spin transport is mediated entirely by superposition between distinct modes. Reversing chirality flips the magnon spin along the spiral axis and the injected quantum coherence in lockstep, leaving the associated injected spin current invariant. Spiral chirality acts instead at the detection interface, where electron--magnon scattering amplitude is reversed and causes the magnon accumulation to be read out as a voltage of opposite sign. This interfacial readout is consistent with reversed first-harmonic voltage under electric-field switching in multiferroic BiFeO₃, establishing structural chirality as an intrinsic control parameter for magnon coherence and its electrical readout.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构手性在磁体中无处不在，但它对绝缘体自旋输运的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索，只有最近的一些实验提供了初步的了解。在这里，我们预测了铁磁和反铁磁螺旋中电自旋注入检测配置中的手性响应。螺旋的螺旋对称性禁止磁振子自旋矩阵的任何非零对角元素：每个本征模都是线性偏振的并且不携带自旋，因此自旋输运完全由不同模式之间的叠加介导。反转手性会沿着螺旋轴翻转磁振子自旋，并同步注入量子相干性，从而使相关的注入自旋电流保持不变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构手性在磁体中无处不在，但它对绝缘体自旋输运的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索，只有最近的一些实验提供了初步的了解。在这里，我们预测了铁磁和反铁磁螺旋中电自旋注入检测配置中的手性响应。螺旋的螺旋对称性禁止磁振子自旋矩阵的任何非零对角元素：每个本征模都是线性偏振的并且不携带自旋，因此自旋输运完全由不同模式之间的叠加介导。反转手性会沿着螺旋轴翻转磁振子自旋，并同步注入量子相干性，从而使相关的注入自旋电流保持不变。相反，螺旋手性作用于检测界面，其中电子-磁振子散射幅度相反，导致磁振子累积被读出为符号相反的电压。该界面读数与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 电场切换下的反向一次谐波电压一致，将结构手性建立为磁振子相干性及其电读数的内在控制参数。

articles.title: Steering Skyrmion Diffusion with Chiral Molecules
articles.title_zh: 用手性分子控制斯格明子扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral molecules adsorbed on a magnetic film interact with its magnetization and can thereby alter the thermal motion of magnetic skyrmions. Here we develop a theoretical model in which an aligned layer of tilted molecules modifies the interfacial magnetic interactions according to its handedness. Within this model a skyrmion responds only to spatial variations of the coupling, so a uniform layer leaves its position unaffected, whereas boundaries and coverage gradients exert forces on it. Near a chiral region, these forces deflect the skyrmion transversely in a direction that reverses between enantiomers, which provides a direct signature of the chiral interaction. In extended periodic patterns, the same forces reshape the long-time diffusion, suppressing it in the direction in which the potential varies and enhancing it in the perpendicular direction. The net effect on the mean diffusion is set by the balance between the gyrotropic and dissipative responses of the skyrmion, as we show exactly for one-dimensional landscapes. Stochastic micromagnetic simulations and collective-coordinate calculations confirm these predictions and show how molecular orientation, spatial patterning, and skyrmion properties together determine the motion.
articles.abstract_zh: 吸附在磁性薄膜上的手性分子与其磁化强度相互作用，从而改变磁性斯格明子的热运动。在这里，我们开发了一个理论模型，其中倾斜分子的对齐层根据其旋向性改变界面磁相互作用。在该模型中，斯格明子仅响应耦合的空间变化，因此均匀层使其位置不受影响，而边界和覆盖梯度对其施加力。在手性区域附近，这些力使斯格明子沿对映体之间相反的方向横向偏转，这提供了手性相互作用的直接特征。在延长的周期图案中，相同的力重塑长时间扩散，在电势变化的方向上抑制它，并在垂直方向上增强它。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 吸附在磁性薄膜上的手性分子与其磁化强度相互作用，从而改变磁性斯格明子的热运动。在这里，我们开发了一个理论模型，其中倾斜分子的对齐层根据其旋向性改变界面磁相互作用。在该模型中，斯格明子仅响应耦合的空间变化，因此均匀层使其位置不受影响，而边界和覆盖梯度对其施加力。在手性区域附近，这些力使斯格明子沿对映体之间相反的方向横向偏转，这提供了手性相互作用的直接特征。在延长的周期图案中，相同的力重塑长时间扩散，在电势变化的方向上抑制它，并在垂直方向上增强它。对平均扩散的净效应是由斯格明子的回旋和耗散响应之间的平衡决定的，正如我们针对一维景观所精确显示的那样。随机微磁模拟和集体坐标计算证实了这些预测，并显示了分子取向、空间图案和斯格明子特性如何共同决定运动。

articles.title: Directed Domain Wall Motion by Radio-Frequency Currents
articles.title_zh: 射频电流定向畴壁运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic domain walls (DWs) are central to emerging spintronic technologies for memory, logic and neuromorphic computing, where their controlled displacement is a key functionality. While current-induced DW motion driven by spin-orbit torques is well established under direct currents, it remains unclear how radio-frequency (RF) currents couple to DWs and whether they can generate directed motion under a symmetric periodic drive. Here we show that RF currents drive DW oscillations, which can be rectified into directed motion through symmetry breaking. Using time-resolved and static magneto-optical Kerr microscopy, we demonstrate that RF spin-orbit torques efficiently excite low-frequency DW oscillations well below the ferromagnetic resonance frequency. Whereas these oscillations remain symmetric in the absence of perturbations, symmetry breaking by a transverse magnetic field produces self-propulsion, while symmetry breaking by an initial current pulse gives rise to sustained DW motion. We further show that in initially uniform magnetic states, RF-driven expansion of a pulse-generated edge domain ultimately results in efficient RF-assisted magnetic switching. Together, these results establish a general framework for understanding how RF-driven DW oscillations are rectified into directed motion, providing new opportunities for their high-frequency control.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁畴壁 (DW) 是用于存储器、逻辑和神经形态计算的新兴自旋电子技术的核心，其受控位移是其中的关键功能。虽然由自旋轨道扭矩驱动的电流感应 DW 运动在直流下已得到很好的证实，但仍不清楚射频 (RF) 电流如何与 DW 耦合以及它们是否可以在对称周期驱动下产生定向运动。在这里，我们展示了射频电流驱动 DW 振荡，可以通过对称性破缺将其整流为定向运动。使用时间分辨和静态磁光克尔显微镜，我们证明 RF 自旋轨道扭矩有效地激发远低于铁磁共振频率的低频 DW 振荡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁畴壁 (DW) 是用于存储器、逻辑和神经形态计算的新兴自旋电子技术的核心，其受控位移是其中的关键功能。虽然由自旋轨道扭矩驱动的电流感应 DW 运动在直流下已得到很好的证实，但仍不清楚射频 (RF) 电流如何与 DW 耦合以及它们是否可以在对称周期驱动下产生定向运动。在这里，我们展示了射频电流驱动 DW 振荡，可以通过对称性破缺将其整流为定向运动。使用时间分辨和静态磁光克尔显微镜，我们证明 RF 自旋轨道扭矩有效地激发远低于铁磁共振频率的低频 DW 振荡。虽然这些振荡在没有扰动的情况下保持对称，但横向磁场破坏对称性会产生自推进，而初始电流脉冲破坏对称性则会产生持续的 DW 运动。我们进一步表明，在最初均匀的磁状态下，射频驱动的脉冲生成边缘域的扩展最终导致有效的射频辅助磁切换。这些结果共同建立了一个通用框架，用于理解射频驱动的 DW 振荡如何被整流为定向运动，从而为其高频控制提供了新的机会。

articles.title: Anisotropy driven critical phenomena in a van der Waals ferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦尔斯铁磁体中各向异性驱动的临界现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a detailed investigation into the field-dependent critical behavior of the van der Waals ferromagnet Fe₃GeTe₂ to elucidate how applied magnetic fields (B), strong magnetocrystalline anisotropy, and emerging other energy scales modulate its critical behavior. Utilizing the recently developed method, viz., the average of normalized slope (ANS), for analysis of critical behavior, we evaluate the critical exponents (β, γ, and δ) across distinct field windows up to rm7,T. For B applied along the crystal's easy axis (Bparallel c), the system exhibits long-range interactions dominated by competing double-exchange and itinerant Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) mechanisms, which is systematically suppressed with increasing B to converge toward the long-range 3D Ising universality class (βsim0.330, γsim1.00). Conversely, under an in-plane hard-axis configuration (Bperp c), the critical behavior study exhibits a sub-unity regime (γ<1) across the measured range of B. This behavior is attributed to the intense competitive interplay between the external Zeeman energy and strong out-of-plane magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Our findings demonstrate that critical behavior in nontrivial van der Waals magnets is fundamentally modulated by the orientation of B and the strength of magnetocrystalline anisotropy, demonstrating the necessity of B-dependent critical behavior investigation over conventional frameworks.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe2 的场相关临界行为的详细研究，以阐明施加的磁场 (B)、强磁晶各向异性和新兴的其他能量尺度如何调节其临界行为。利用最近开发的方法，即归一化斜率平均值 (ANS) 来分析关键行为，我们评估了高达 rm7,T 的不同场窗口中的关键指数（β、γ 和 δ）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe2 的场相关临界行为的详细研究，以阐明施加的磁场 (B)、强磁晶各向异性和新兴的其他能量尺度如何调节其临界行为。利用最近开发的方法，即归一化斜率平均值 (ANS) 来分析关键行为，我们评估了高达 rm7,T 的不同场窗口中的关键指数（β、γ 和 δ）。对于沿晶体易轴应用的 B（Bparallel c），系统表现出由竞争性双交换和巡回 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 机制主导的长程相互作用，随着 B 的增加，系统地抑制该相互作用，以向长程 3D Ising 普适性类别收敛（βsim0.330，γsim1.00）。相反，在面内硬轴配置 (Bperp c) 下，临界行为研究在 B 的测量范围内表现出亚单位状态 (γ<1)。这种行为归因于外部塞曼能量和强面外磁晶各向异性之间的激烈竞争相互作用。我们的研究结果表明，非平凡范德华磁体的关键行为从根本上是由 B 的取向和磁晶各向异性的强度调节的，这证明了在传统框架上进行依赖于 B 的关键行为研究的必要性。

articles.title: Nonlocal multipolar spin accumulation in altermagnets beyond d-wave
articles.title_zh: d 波之外的交流磁体中的非局域多极自旋积累
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In spin-conserving models of g- and i-wave altermagnets, the uniform longitudinal conductivity has no spin-odd component. A point injector reveals higher moments of the Fermi velocity through the nonlocal spin accumulation. Boltzmann theory predicts that the rank m=2,4,6 of the first nonzero spin-odd velocity moment sets the leading angular harmonic, its asymptotic radial dependence r²⁻m, and its amplitude scaling τm⁻³ at fixed distance and injected current. For g-wave order, the fourth moment produces a fourth angular harmonic with an asymptotic r⁻² tail. Quantum transport simulations support the radial profiles predicted by finite-geometry Boltzmann theory without an amplitude fit. Across the three symmetries, the quantum amplitudes exceed the Boltzmann predictions based on the Born scattering time by 15-65% in the windows analyzed. In a two-contact ribbon, we detect the g-wave fourth harmonic at 6.8,σ in an independent set of 1800 disorder realizations using a preselected radial window. Its amplitude decreases when the altermagnetic splitting is reduced.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 g 波和 i 波交替磁体的自旋守恒模型中，均匀纵向电导率没有自旋奇数分量。点注入器通过非局部自旋积累揭示了费米速度的更高矩。玻尔兹曼理论预测，第一个非零自旋奇速度矩的阶 m=2,4,6 设置了主角谐波、其渐近径向依赖性 r2⁻m 及其在固定距离和注入电流下的振幅缩放 τm⁻3。对于 g 波阶，四阶矩产生具有渐近 r⁻² 尾部的四阶角谐波。量子输运模拟支持有限几何玻尔兹曼理论预测的径向分布，无需振幅拟合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 g 波和 i 波交替磁体的自旋守恒模型中，均匀纵向电导率没有自旋奇数分量。点注入器通过非局部自旋积累揭示了费米速度的更高矩。玻尔兹曼理论预测，第一个非零自旋奇速度矩的阶 m=2,4,6 设置了主角谐波、其渐近径向依赖性 r2⁻m 及其在固定距离和注入电流下的振幅缩放 τm⁻3。对于 g 波阶，四阶矩产生具有渐近 r⁻² 尾部的四阶角谐波。量子输运模拟支持有限几何玻尔兹曼理论预测的径向分布，无需振幅拟合。在所分析的窗口中，跨越三种对称性，量子振幅超出了基于玻恩散射时间的玻尔兹曼预测 15-65%。在双接触带中，我们使用预选的径向窗口在一组独立的 1800 个无序实现中检测 6.8,σ 处的 g 波第四谐波。当交变磁分裂减少时，其振幅减小。

articles.title: Materials research with a general-purpose agent
articles.title_zh: 使用通用代理进行材料研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the last decade we have built Alexandria, an open database of about 15 million density-functional calculations of crystals. It includes PBE, PBEsol, SCAN and TB-mBJ results, structures relaxed at pressures up to 150 GPa, dielectric tensors and about 145,000 electron-phonon calculations, together with more than 400 million structures relaxed with machine-learned potentials. On these data we trained a generative model for crystal structures, a universal interatomic potential and graph neural networks for more than ten properties, from band gaps to superconducting critical temperatures. From the convex hull we computed a reaction graph of the 17.4 billion reactions between its 193,416 stable compounds. Here we give all of this to a general-purpose language-model agent. Working unattended, the agent screens the database for a solar absorber, drops a candidate whose synthesis releases too little energy, and writes a synthesis plan with precursors, crucible and atmosphere. Asked about the well-studied Ba-Zr-S system, it finds an unreported sulfide and designs the experiment that would confirm or rule it out. Asked for an air-stable alternative, it designs one and tests it against new structures from the generative model. With web search alone, the same agent proposes what the literature already discusses. Put together, the data, the models and the reaction graph let a general agent do what none of them does alone: go from a question in plain words to an experiment that a laboratory can run and test.
articles.abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，我们建立了 Alexandria，这是一个包含约 1500 万个晶体密度泛函计算的开放数据库。它包括 PBE、PBEsol、SCAN 和 TB-mBJ 结果、在高达 150 GPa 的压力下松弛的结构、介电张量和约 145,000 个电子声子计算，以及超过 4 亿个通过机器学习势松弛的结构。根据这些数据，我们训练了晶体结构的生成模型、通用原子间势以及从带隙到超导临界温度等十多种属性的图神经网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在过去十年中，我们建立了 Alexandria，这是一个包含约 1500 万个晶体密度泛函计算的开放数据库。它包括 PBE、PBEsol、SCAN 和 TB-mBJ 结果、在高达 150 GPa 的压力下松弛的结构、介电张量和约 145,000 个电子声子计算，以及超过 4 亿个通过机器学习势松弛的结构。根据这些数据，我们训练了晶体结构的生成模型、通用原子间势以及从带隙到超导临界温度等十多种属性的图神经网络。根据凸包，我们计算了 193,416 种稳定化合物之间 174 亿次反应的反应图。在这里，我们将所有这些交给通用语言模型代理。该特工在无人值守的情况下，筛选数据库中的太阳能吸收器，放弃合成释放能量太少的候选者，并编写包含前体、坩埚和大气的合成计划。当被问及经过充分研究的 Ba-Zr-S 系统时，它发现了一种未报告的硫化物，并设计了实验来证实或排除它。当被要求提供一种空气稳定的替代方案时，它设计了一种替代方案，并根据生成模型的新结构对其进行了测试。仅通过网络搜索，同一代理人就提出了文献中已经讨论过的内容。将数据、模型和反应图放在一起，让通用智能体能够完成他们无法单独完成的事情：从简单的问题到实验室可以运行和测试的实验。

articles.title: Defect Topology Governs the Optical Response of Doped Amorphous Silicon
articles.title_zh: 缺陷拓扑控制掺杂非晶硅的光学响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The influence of defect topology and chemical doping on the optical response of amorphous silicon (a-Si) remains unresolved. In this study, hybrid-functional density functional theory and linear-response calculations are employed to examine four structurally distinct continuous random networks with substitutional boron and phosphorus doping. The calculated optical properties reproduce key experimental trends and demonstrate that dopant sensitivity is determined not only by defect concentration, but also by the character and spatial organization of defects. A configuration with fully extended 4-fold coordination shows the strongest dielectric perturbation to doping, while dopant effects in networks with pre-existing defect states are more varied. For most networks, the dielectric response is more strongly perturbed by boron than phosphorus. Notably, a network having both 3- and 5-fold defects with a total defect fraction of 7.4% reverses the typical boron-dominant response of other cases, becoming more sensitive to phosphorus. Tauc and optical sum-rule analyses further indicate that network topology defines the broader optical landscape, whereas doping primarily affects states near the gap and redistributes spectral weight. These findings establish defect topology as a microscopic control parameter that links amorphous structure, dopant activity, and optical response in amorphous silicon.
articles.abstract_zh: 缺陷拓扑和化学掺杂对非晶硅（a-Si）光学响应的影响仍未解决。在这项研究中，采用混合功能密度泛函理论和线性响应计算来检查四个结构不同的具有替代硼和磷掺杂的连续随机网络。计算出的光学特性再现了关键的实验趋势，并证明掺杂剂敏感性不仅取决于缺陷浓度，还取决于缺陷的特征和空间组织。具有完全扩展的 4 倍配位的配置显示出对掺杂的最强介电扰动，而具有预先存在的缺陷状态的网络中的掺杂剂效应则更加多样化。对于大多数网络，硼对介电响应的干扰比磷对介电响应的干扰更强烈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 缺陷拓扑和化学掺杂对非晶硅（a-Si）光学响应的影响仍未解决。在这项研究中，采用混合功能密度泛函理论和线性响应计算来检查四个结构不同的具有替代硼和磷掺杂的连续随机网络。计算出的光学特性再现了关键的实验趋势，并证明掺杂剂敏感性不仅取决于缺陷浓度，还取决于缺陷的特征和空间组织。具有完全扩展的 4 倍配位的配置显示出对掺杂的最强介电扰动，而具有预先存在的缺陷状态的网络中的掺杂剂效应则更加多样化。对于大多数网络，硼对介电响应的干扰比磷对介电响应的干扰更强烈。值得注意的是，同时具有 3 倍和 5 倍缺陷且总缺陷率为 7.4% 的网络逆转了其他情况下典型的硼主导反应，对磷变得更加敏感。 Tauc 和光学总和规则分析进一步表明，网络拓扑定义了更广泛的光学景观，而掺杂主要影响间隙附近的状态并重新分配光谱权重。这些发现将缺陷拓扑确立为一个微观控制参数，将非晶硅中的非晶结构、掺杂剂活性和光学响应联系起来。

articles.title: Cumulant dynamics of the ferromagnetic dipolar XY model
articles.title_zh: 铁磁偶极 XY 模型的累积量动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the second-order truncated cumulant dynamics for the preparation of dynamical states in the dipolar ferromagnetic XY model on the square lattice for system sizes up to linear size L = 60. The observations lead to a transparent picture in which a coherent region of finite extent and finite magnetization forms, which is possible even for diabatic but sufficiently slow ramps. These two scales are functions of the ramp constant, the initial entropy of the system, and time. Our findings put strong requirements on future experiments addressing dipolar XY equilibrium physics in bigger system sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二阶截断累积量动力学，用于在系统尺寸高达线性尺寸 L = 60 的方晶格上的偶极铁磁 XY 模型中准备动力学状态。观察结果得出了一个透明的图像，其中形成了有限范围和有限磁化强度的相干区域，这甚至对于非绝热但足够慢的斜坡也是可能的。这两个尺度是斜坡常数、系统初始熵和时间的函数。我们的研究结果对未来在更大系统尺寸中解决偶极 XY 平衡物理问题的实验提出了强烈的要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二阶截断累积量动力学，用于在系统尺寸高达线性尺寸 L = 60 的方晶格上的偶极铁磁 XY 模型中准备动力学状态。观察结果得出了一个透明的图像，其中形成了有限范围和有限磁化强度的相干区域，这甚至对于非绝热但足够慢的斜坡也是可能的。这两个尺度是斜坡常数、系统初始熵和时间的函数。我们的研究结果对未来在更大系统尺寸中解决偶极 XY 平衡物理问题的实验提出了强烈的要求。

articles.title: Symmetry-Enabled Ferroelectric Valley Transduction in Rhombohedral Bilayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 菱形双层 WSe2 中对称性铁电谷转导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15494v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric polarization couples to the layer degree of freedom in a bilayer, but a valley-selective energy response requires the valleys to carry different interlayer character. Rhombohedral bilayer WSe₂ meets that condition by symmetry: three-fold rotation forbids interlayer tunneling at the K valley, while strong hybridization remains at Γ. The resulting contrast converts the band-effective ferroelectric layer asymmetry into a shift of the K edge, and so displaces the K--Γ landscape: a finite-field fit that does not impose the rule leaves the K coupling consistent with zero, and the shift reaches polshiftdft~meV, the most that asymmetry can give a single valley. Reversing the polarization mirrors the valley landscape in displacement field, so the two registries have equal and opposite differential transconductance g_d at zero field. In the ideal symmetric limit a second parity holds about each registry's own compensation field and places a zero of g_d there. The valley-dependent screening calculated here displaces that zero by only gdnulllow% at the read point, so device asymmetry limits the accuracy. The result links a known stacking selection rule to ferroelectric valley transduction, with a quantitative valley shift and a directly testable transport signature.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电极化与双层中的层自由度耦合，但谷选择性能量响应要求谷具有不同的层间特性。菱面体双层 WSe2 通过对称性满足该条件：三重旋转禁止 K 谷处的层间隧道效应，而在 γ 处仍保持强杂化。由此产生的对比度将带效铁电层不对称性转换为 K 边缘的偏移，从而取代了 K--Γ 景观：不强加规则的有限场拟合使 K 耦合保持为零，并且偏移达到 polshiftdft~meV，这是不对称性可以给出单个谷的最大值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电极化与双层中的层自由度耦合，但谷选择性能量响应要求谷具有不同的层间特性。菱面体双层 WSe2 通过对称性满足该条件：三重旋转禁止 K 谷处的层间隧道效应，而在 γ 处仍保持强杂化。由此产生的对比度将带效铁电层不对称性转换为 K 边缘的偏移，从而取代了 K--Γ 景观：不强加规则的有限场拟合使 K 耦合保持为零，并且偏移达到 polshiftdft~meV，这是不对称性可以给出单个谷的最大值。反转偏振会镜像位移场中的山谷景观，因此两个配准在零场下具有相等且相反的微分跨导g_d。在理想的对称限制中，第二个奇偶校验保留每个注册表自己的补偿字段，并在那里放置 g_d 的零。此处计算的谷值相关筛选仅在读取点将零位移了 gdnulllow%，因此设备不对称性限制了准确性。结果将已知的堆叠选择规则与铁电谷转导联系起来，具有定量的谷偏移和可直接测试的传输特征。

articles.title: Engineering many-body tunneling dynamics of one-dimensional bosons with finite-core power-law interactions
articles.title_zh: 利用有限核幂律相互作用设计一维玻色子的多体隧道动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the many-body dynamics of a one-dimensional Bose-Josephson junction of ultracold bosons in a box-like potential with a central barrier, interacting via finite-core power-law interactions V_α(r)=g/(r^α+d^α), where d sets the short-distance scale and α controls the spatial dependence. Using the multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree method for bosons (MCTDHB), we explore how the interaction profile and strength, barrier, and initial population imbalance shape tunneling dynamics. At weak interaction, increasing α drives a crossover from Josephson oscillations to dephasing and recurrent rephasing, demonstrating the importance of the interaction kernel's spatial structure. A higher barrier suppresses recurrences, whereas a larger initial imbalance promotes relaxation toward nearly vanishing population imbalance. Increasing interaction strength progressively suppresses population-transfer fluctuations, particularly at larger α. The two-mode extended Bose-Hubbard model captures the dynamics when the lowest orbital in each well dominates, but loses accuracy as additional orbitals become populated. In the strongly interacting regime, many-body spatial structures develop and several natural orbitals are needed for converged dynamics, placing the system beyond a two-mode description. Our results establish the interaction profile and strength, barrier, and initial state as distinct control parameters for coherent, dephasing, recurrent, and suppressed many-body tunneling of one-dimensional bosons. The ability to tailor soft-core interactions via Rydberg dressing offers a promising route to exploring interaction-engineered tunneling in ultracold atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有中心势垒的盒状势中超冷玻色子一维玻色-约瑟夫森结的多体动力学，通过有限核心幂律相互作用 V_α(r)=g/(r^α+d^α) 进行相互作用，其中 d 设置短距离尺度，α 控制空间依赖性。使用玻色子的多构型时间相关 Hartree 方法 (MCTDHB)，我们探索了相互作用轮廓和强度、势垒和初始种群不平衡如何塑造隧道动力学。在弱相互作用下，增加 α 驱动从约瑟夫森振荡到移相和循环重移相的交叉，这证明了相互作用核空间结构的重要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有中心势垒的盒状势中超冷玻色子一维玻色-约瑟夫森结的多体动力学，通过有限核心幂律相互作用 V_α(r)=g/(r^α+d^α) 进行相互作用，其中 d 设置短距离尺度，α 控制空间依赖性。使用玻色子的多构型时间相关 Hartree 方法 (MCTDHB)，我们探索了相互作用轮廓和强度、势垒和初始种群不平衡如何塑造隧道动力学。在弱相互作用下，增加 α 驱动从约瑟夫森振荡到移相和循环重移相的交叉，这证明了相互作用核空间结构的重要性。较高的障碍会抑制复发，而较大的初始失衡会促进放松，直至人口失衡几乎消失。增加相互作用强度会逐渐抑制种群转移波动，特别是在较大的 α 下。当每个井中的最低轨道占主导地位时，双模扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型捕获了动态，但随着额外轨道的填充而失去了准确性。在强相互作用的情况下，多体空间结构发展，并且需要几个自然轨道来实现收敛动力学，使系统超出了两种模式的描述。我们的结果将相互作用轮廓和强度、势垒和初始状态确定为一维玻色子的相干、相干、循环和抑制多体隧道的不同控制参数。通过里德伯敷料定制软核相互作用的能力为探索超冷原子中的相互作用工程隧道提供了一条有前途的途径。

articles.title: Competing lattice instabilities in epitaxially strained BaSnO3
articles.title_zh: 外延应变 BaSnO3 中的竞争晶格不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use density functional theory to map the lattice-dynamical landscape of BaSnO3 under biaxial compressive strain and uncover the hierarchy of structural instabilities. Our results demonstrate that the phase stability of strained BaSnO3 cannot be inferred from the softening of the polar mode alone. Instead it is governed by the competition among lattice instabilities and their anharmonic coupling to structural relaxation. Two-mode energy-surface analyses show that the polar and rotational order parameters interact predominantly competitively. While A- and M-point octahedral rotations become unstable before the zone-center polar mode and dominate the harmonic response for moderate values of strain, they are related to a continuous transition without anharmonic lattice coupling and a moderate gain of energy with strain. Large strain may induce a first order transition to a supertetragonal polar state. Once this state is stabilized, the magnitude of polarization and ferroelectric energy well depth are comparable to BaTiO3 under compressive strain. Furthermore, we discuss how an electric field or electron doping may tip the balance between the different modes and favor of the supertetragonal structure over antipolar and rotational alternatives at a reduced critical strain.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用密度泛函理论来绘制双轴压缩应变下 BaSnO3 的晶格动力学图谱，并揭示结构不稳定性的层次结构。我们的结果表明，应变 BaSnO3 的相稳定性不能仅从极性模式的软化来推断。相反，它受到晶格不稳定性之间的竞争及其与结构弛豫的非和谐耦合的控制。双模式能量面分析表明，极性和旋转有序参数主要竞争性地相互作用。虽然 A 点和 M 点八面体旋转在区域中心极性模式之前变得不稳定，并且在中等应变值的谐波响应中占主导地位，但它们与无非谐晶格耦合的连续转变以及随应变的适度能量增益有关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用密度泛函理论来绘制双轴压缩应变下 BaSnO3 的晶格动力学图谱，并揭示结构不稳定性的层次结构。我们的结果表明，应变 BaSnO3 的相稳定性不能仅从极性模式的软化来推断。相反，它受到晶格不稳定性之间的竞争及其与结构弛豫的非和谐耦合的控制。双模式能量面分析表明，极性和旋转有序参数主要竞争性地相互作用。虽然 A 点和 M 点八面体旋转在区域中心极性模式之前变得不稳定，并且在中等应变值的谐波响应中占主导地位，但它们与无非谐晶格耦合的连续转变以及随应变的适度能量增益有关。大应变可能引起向超四方极性态的一级转变。一旦这种状态稳定，极化强度和铁电能井深度就与压缩应变下的 BaTiO3 相当。此外，我们讨论了电场或电子掺杂如何打破不同模式之间的平衡，并在降低临界应变的情况下，超四方结构优于反极性和旋转替代结构。

articles.title: Single Spin Hall Conversion in the Hall Response of Magnetic-Insulator/Heavy-Metal Bilayers Identified by Odd Spin-Hall-Angle Dependence
articles.title_zh: 由奇自旋霍尔角依赖性识别的磁绝缘体/重金属双层霍尔响应中的单自旋霍尔转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hall response of magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers is usually ascribed to two successive spin Hall conversions and is therefore expected to be even in the spin Hall angle. Using distinct magnetic-field windows, we separate the Hall voltage of yttrium iron garnet bilayers with Ta and Pt of opposite spin Hall angle into contributions from magnetization- and magnetic-field-driven precession as well as from ordinary Hall effect. The field-driven component reverses sign between Ta and Pt, revealing a Hall response odd-in-spin-Hall-angle. The magnetization-driven component also has opposite signs for Ta and Pt, except for the thinnest heavy-metal layers. A drift-diffusion model with interface-generated spin currents describes this behavior: the field-driven component is predominantly carried by a single spin Hall conversion, and the magnetization-driven component is consistent with one as well. Other potential explanations, based on a description with a finite imaginary spin-mixing conductance rather than interface-generated spin currents, require unusually large values of this conductance, making this mechanism unlikely. Our findings advance the understanding of Hall responses in magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers toward a more general description.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁绝缘体/重金属双层的霍尔响应通常归因于两个连续的自旋霍尔转换，因此预计自旋霍尔角是均匀的。使用不同的磁场窗口，我们将具有相反自旋霍尔角的 Ta 和 Pt 的钇铁石榴石双层的霍尔电压分为磁化和磁场驱动的进动以及普通霍尔效应的贡献。场驱动组件反转 Ta 和 Pt 之间的符号，揭示霍尔响应奇数自旋霍尔角。除了最薄的重金属层外，磁化驱动成分对于 Ta 和 Pt 也具有相反的符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁绝缘体/重金属双层的霍尔响应通常归因于两个连续的自旋霍尔转换，因此预计自旋霍尔角是均匀的。使用不同的磁场窗口，我们将具有相反自旋霍尔角的 Ta 和 Pt 的钇铁石榴石双层的霍尔电压分为磁化和磁场驱动的进动以及普通霍尔效应的贡献。场驱动组件反转 Ta 和 Pt 之间的符号，揭示霍尔响应奇数自旋霍尔角。除了最薄的重金属层外，磁化驱动成分对于 Ta 和 Pt 也具有相反的符号。具有界面生成的自旋电流的漂移扩散模型描述了这种行为：场驱动分量主要由单自旋霍尔转换承载，并且磁化驱动分量也与之一致。其他潜在的解释基于有限虚数自旋混合电导的描述，而不是界面生成的自旋电流，需要异常大的电导值，使得这种机制不太可能。我们的研究结果推进了对磁绝缘体/重金属双层中霍尔响应的理解，朝着更一般的描述方向发展。

articles.title: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
articles.title_zh: 机器加速提取实验超导参数，以实现对数千种材料的物理洞察和预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets (R² = 0.96 with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature (R²ₗₒg=0.83) and the upper critical field (R²ₗₒg=0.69), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 新的超导体可以解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但缺乏超过临界温度的经过验证的实验训练数据。在这里，我们介绍 AutoSuperCon，一个包含 8 个超导参数的数据库，其中包含 6793 个超导体的 20354 个条目。使用大型语言模型从 47000 多个 arXiv 预印本中提取数据，并根据参考数据集进行验证（NIMS SuperCon 的 R² = 0.96）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 新的超导体可以解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但缺乏超过临界温度的经过验证的实验训练数据。在这里，我们介绍 AutoSuperCon，一个包含 8 个超导参数的数据库，其中包含 6793 个超导体的 20354 个条目。使用大型语言模型从 47000 多个 arXiv 预印本中提取数据，并根据参考数据集进行验证（NIMS SuperCon 的 R² = 0.96）。使用 AutoSuperCon，我们发现中值间隙比从传统超导体的 3.6 上升到铜酸盐的 6.4，28% 的上临界场超过泡利极限，临界温度低于与超流体密度成比例的上限。此外，我们在迁移学习的推动下，训练基于成分的临界温度 (R²ₗₒg=0.83) 和上临界场 (R²ₗₒg=0.69) 的预测器。在已知的超导家族中，仅成分就足以筛选这两个参数的候选者。因此，AutoSuperCon 可以实现对数千个超导体的物理洞察和数据驱动的发现。

articles.title: Cation-intermixing driven evolution from a narrow avoided crossing to an enlarged inverted gap in Ge₂Bi₂Te₅
articles.title_zh: 阳离子混合驱动 Ge2Bi2Te5 中从狭窄的避免交叉到扩大的倒置间隙的演变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combining the building blocks and structural motifs of the topological insulator Bi₂Te₃ and the ferroelectric Rashba semiconductor GeTe, we synthesized and comprehensively characterized the resulting Ge₂Bi₂Te₅ compound, which exhibits pronounced cation intermixing. Using momentum-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and ab initio calculations, we demonstrate how cation intermixing drives the evolution of its electronic structure from a narrow avoided crossing to a substantially enlarged inverted band gap. We establish the microscopic origin of this behavior in the redistribution of Ge and Bi atoms within the cation sublattice, which increases the contribution of Bi-derived states near the valence-band maximum and enhances the effective contribution of spin-orbit coupling, thereby stabilizing the topological electronic structure. Our findings demonstrate that cation disorder, which can be controlled during crystal growth, provides an additional degree of freedom for engineering topological electronic structures, opening new opportunities for the development of functional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 结合拓扑绝缘体 Bi2Te₃ 和铁电 Rashba 半导体 GeTe 的构建模块和结构图案，我们合成并全面表征了所得的 Ge2Bi2Te5 化合物，该化合物表现出明显的阳离子混合。使用动量分辨光电子能谱和从头计算，我们演示了阳离子混合如何驱动其电子结构从狭窄的避免交叉演化到大幅扩大的倒置带隙。我们确定了这种行为的微观根源在于阳离子亚晶格内Ge和Bi原子的重新分布，这增加了价带最大值附近Bi衍生态的贡献，并增强了自旋轨道耦合的有效贡献，从而稳定了拓扑电子结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结合拓扑绝缘体 Bi2Te₃ 和铁电 Rashba 半导体 GeTe 的构建模块和结构图案，我们合成并全面表征了所得的 Ge2Bi2Te5 化合物，该化合物表现出明显的阳离子混合。使用动量分辨光电子能谱和从头计算，我们演示了阳离子混合如何驱动其电子结构从狭窄的避免交叉演化到大幅扩大的倒置带隙。我们确定了这种行为的微观根源在于阳离子亚晶格内Ge和Bi原子的重新分布，这增加了价带最大值附近Bi衍生态的贡献，并增强了自旋轨道耦合的有效贡献，从而稳定了拓扑电子结构。我们的研究结果表明，在晶体生长过程中可以控制的阳离子无序为拓扑电子结构的工程提供了额外的自由度，为功能量子材料的开发开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Brute-force molecular dynamics simulation of aging in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅
articles.title_zh: 非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的强力分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chalcogenide alloys such as the prototypical Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ compound are used in phase change electronic memories due to their ability to undergo a fast and reversible transition between the amorphous and crystalline phases upon heating. The amorphous phase is subject to aging that leads to an increase in the electrical resistance, which is detrimental to the operation of the devices. Using a machine learning interatomic potential, we have investigated the structural relaxations responsible for aging in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ in molecular dynamics simulations at temperatures slightly below the glass transition. The aging simulation, lasting about 100 ns, follows an equilibration of 24 ns at 400 K. During aging we observed an enhancement of the Peierls distortion in axial bonds which is a typical feature of these alloys that we relate to the widening of the electronic band gap computed within Density Functional Theory in smaller aged amorphous models. We also observed a marked reduction of the atomic mobility with an increase of the bond lifetimes during aging. However, we do not see a reduction in homopolar bonds, which are expected to be absent in the ideal aged glass and which should be removed on a much longer time scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 硫属化物合金，例如典型的 Ge2Sb2Te5 化合物，由于其在加热时能够在非晶相和晶相之间进行快速且可逆的转变，因此被用于相变电子存储器。非晶相容易老化，导致电阻增加，这不利于器件的运行。利用机器学习原子间势，我们在略低于玻璃化转变的温度下，在分子动力学模拟中研究了导致非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的结构弛豫。时效模拟持续约 100 ns，在 400 K 下达到 24 ns 的平衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硫属化物合金，例如典型的 Ge2Sb2Te5 化合物，由于其在加热时能够在非晶相和晶相之间进行快速且可逆的转变，因此被用于相变电子存储器。非晶相容易老化，导致电阻增加，这不利于器件的运行。利用机器学习原子间势，我们在略低于玻璃化转变的温度下，在分子动力学模拟中研究了导致非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的结构弛豫。时效模拟持续约 100 ns，在 400 K 下达到 24 ns 的平衡。在时效过程中，我们观察到轴向键中 Peierls 畸变的增强，这是这些合金的典型特征，我们将其与较小时效非晶模型中密度泛函理论计算出的电子带隙的加宽相关。我们还观察到老化过程中原子迁移率随着键寿命的增加而显着降低。然而，我们没有看到单极键的减少，预计理想的老化玻璃中不会出现单极键，并且应该在更长的时间范围内消除单极键。

articles.title: Spin Structure Factor of the classical Ising Model on the Centered Pyrochlore Lattice
articles.title_zh: 中心烧绿石晶格上经典伊辛模型的自旋结构因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the spin structure factor of the Ising model on the centered pyrochlore lattice. Generalizing Henley's method [Phys. Rev. B 71, 014424] to the case of inequivalent center and vertex spins, we obtain spin correlation functions that are in excellent agreement with Monte Carlo results and can capture sharp and broadened pinch points, also at finite temperature. Our approach can be extended to other centered lattice structures in classical frustrated magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了居中烧绿石晶格上伊辛模型的自旋结构因子。亨利方法的推广 [Phys. Rev. B 71, 014424]对于不等中心和顶点自旋的情况，我们获得了与蒙特卡罗结果非常一致的自旋相关函数，并且在有限温度下也可以捕获尖锐和加宽的夹点。我们的方法可以扩展到经典受挫磁性中的其他中心晶格结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了居中烧绿石晶格上伊辛模型的自旋结构因子。亨利方法的推广 [Phys. Rev. B 71, 014424]对于不等中心和顶点自旋的情况，我们获得了与蒙特卡罗结果非常一致的自旋相关函数，并且在有限温度下也可以捕获尖锐和加宽的夹点。我们的方法可以扩展到经典受挫磁性中的其他中心晶格结构。

articles.title: Toward Self-Driving Multi-reference Calculations: Belief-Aware Orbital Selection
articles.title_zh: 迈向自动驾驶多参考计算：信念感知轨道选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.15682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reformulate active-orbital selection as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), analogous to decision-making in autonomous driving and robot control, and couple it with quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) to emulate expert-like selection of active orbitals. The three popular types of orbital information, i.e. occupation numbers, orbital composition, and orbital entanglements, can be used separately or jointly. QUBO constructs complete candidate spaces under fixed electron and orbital counts, while the POMDP selects successive calculations, updates its belief from each completed result, and thereby corrects and refines the active orbitals. This belief-aware sequential procedure enables continuous active-space selection rather than one-shot threshold-based filtering, so the space can adapt as the calculation proceeds. We demonstrate the approach for valence-space construction in small molecules, spectral calculation of metal compound TiF₃, and active-space refinement of 1,2-dioxetanone around conical intersections. Because selection learns from calculations on the molecule of interest without requiring a pre-existing training set, it is suited to following the entire course of complex chemical reactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将主动轨道选择重新表述为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），类似于自动驾驶和机器人控制中的决策，并将其与二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）结合起来，以模拟专家般的主动轨道选择。三种流行的轨道信息类型，即占据数、轨道组成和轨道纠缠，可以单独或联合使用。 QUBO在固定的电子和轨道计数下构造完整的候选空间，而POMDP选择连续的计算，根据每个完成的结果更新其信念，从而校正和细化活性轨道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将主动轨道选择重新表述为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），类似于自动驾驶和机器人控制中的决策，并将其与二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）结合起来，以模拟专家般的主动轨道选择。三种流行的轨道信息类型，即占据数、轨道组成和轨道纠缠，可以单独或联合使用。 QUBO在固定的电子和轨道计数下构造完整的候选空间，而POMDP选择连续的计算，根据每个完成的结果更新其信念，从而校正和细化活性轨道。这种信念感知的顺序过程可以实现连续的活动空间选择，而不是基于一次性阈值的过滤，因此空间可以随着计算的进行进行调整。我们演示了小分子中价态空间构建、金属化合物 TiF₃ 的光谱计算以及圆锥形交叉点周围 1,2-二氧杂环丁酮活性空间细化的方法。由于选择是通过对感兴趣分子的计算来学习的，而不需要预先存在的训练集，因此它适合跟踪复杂化学反应的整个过程。

articles.title: ⁵⁵Mn-NMR/NQR study on the kagome metal Sc₃Mn₃Al₇Si₅: Re-examining the possibility of spin-singlet paired state
articles.title_zh: Kagome金属Sc₃Mn₃Al₇Si₅的⁵⁵Mn-NMR/NQR研究：重新审视自旋单线配对态的可能性
