This study investigated the direct effects of GLP-1 receptor ligands and the dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor sitagliptin on myocardial function in isolated hearts from streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats.Methods Diabetes was induced in male Wistar rats by a single intraperitoneal injection of streptozotocin (50 mg/kg). Hearts from control and diabetic rats were retrogradely perfused for 30 min using a Langendorff system with GLP-1 (7–36), GLP-1 (9–36), exendin-4 (1–39), sitagliptin, glimepiride, pioglitazone, or metformin. Cardiac functional parameters, plasma total and active GLP-1 concentrations and serum total antioxidant status (TAS), total oxidant status (TOS), total sulfhydryl groups (TSG), advanced oxidation protein products (AOPP), and ischemia-modified albumin (IMA) were assessed.Results Diabetic hearts exhibited significantly lower heart rates and impaired left ventricular contractility and relaxation, indicated by reduced left ventricular + dP/dtmax and -dP/dtmin values, compared with controls. GLP-1 (7–36), GLP-1 (9–36), and exendin-4 (1–39) partially improved contractility and relaxation. Compared with controls, diabetic rats exhibited significantly higher plasma total and active GLP-1 concentrations, increased serum TOS and AOPP levels, and reduced TSG levels, whereas serum TAS and IMA levels remained unchanged.Conclusion These findings suggest that GLP-1 receptor ligands partially improve myocardial contractility and relaxation in isolated hearts from streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats, although the mechanisms underlying these effects remain to be elucidated.

articles.title: Superfluid helium excitations under pressure
articles.abstract: The superfluid 4He excitation spectrum is investigated through inelastic neutron scattering withincreasing pressure. This high energy resolution experiment covers pressures from 0 bar up to 24 barsnear the solidification limit of helium at a low temperature of T=0.04 K. The high energy resolutionof the spectrometer allowed to follow precisely the energy shifts at the maxon energy in relation tothe roton excitation energy. With increasing pressure the maxon energy increases and saturates atp=15 bars whereas the roton energy continuously decreases with increasing pressure. The analysisdemonstrates that the maxon energy will not exceed twice the roton energy. At p = 15 bar,we observe a marked increase in the interactions between the maxon elementary excitation and themulti-excitation spectrum. This enhanced coupling manifests itself directly in the reduced lifetime ofthe maxon, which serves as a clear signature of stronger scattering processes between the elementaryexcitations of superfluid helium and the continuum of multi-excitation states. Given the central roleof liquid 4He as a model quantum fluid, these findings provide valuable insight not only into themicroscopic dynamics of maxons but also into the broader mechanisms governing interactions amongbosonic excitations. As such, the results contribute to a more general understanding of quasiparticlecoupling and decay processes in strongly interacting Bose systems.

articles.title: Mass transport and radial composition evolution during coagulation in dry-wet spinning of cellulose/TBAP/DMSO solutions
articles.abstract: Component exchange and radial composition changes during coagulation were investigated for cellulose filaments spun from TBAP/DMSO solutions. Here, the exchange of water, dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), and tetrabutylammonium hydrogen phosphate (TBAP) in cellulose/TBAP/DMSO filaments was quantified by gravimetry and ¹H NMR. Fick’s second law in cylindrical coordinates was used to estimate apparent diffusion coefficients and calculate radial composition paths. Experimentally determined pseudo-ternary cloud-point diagrams were then used to assess the onset of phase separation along these paths. Water exhibited the highest apparent diffusivity at low temperatures, while DMSO became the fastest at high temperatures and TBAP remained the slowest throughout. Increasing bath temperature shortened the period of net liquid uptake. At equal local water content, the maximum skin-core composition differences increased from 1.8 to 5.6 wt% for DMSO and from 2.3 to 5.8 wt% for TBAP as temperature increased from 10 to 70°C. Adding DMSO to the bath generally reduced apparent diffusion and radial composition differences. Cellulose concentration had a limited effect on apparent diffusivity. This work links component transport to local composition changes during phase separation and provides a quantitative basis for selecting coagulation conditions to reduce radial composition heterogeneity.

articles.title: Metrology-Oriented Source-Point Sampling for Feature Continuity in Industrial Laser-Scanned Point Clouds
articles.abstract: Industrial laser scans are frequently reduced before geometric inspection, registration, and pose estimation. Such reduction can preserve broad surface coverage while interrupting the source-point sequences that support the estimation of hole rims, slots, interface edges, and related functional features. This paper presents a metrology-oriented source-point sampling method for industrial laser-scanned point clouds. The method assigns retention priorities to acquired points through a topology-guided protection field that combines local feature evidence, propagation along connected boundary segments, association across separated fragments, and attenuation outside feature regions. The selected cloud therefore remains a subset of the measured coordinates, rather than a set of generated replacements. The method was evaluated on ABC-derived workpieces, a controlled standard gauge, and high-voltage battery connector scans using reconstruction-oriented error, feature retention, edge-continuity dispersion, ablation tests, transfer without target fine-tuning, and a pose-oriented connector case study. At a 25% sampling rate, connector scans achieved 99.6% normalized feature recall and an edge-continuity dispersion of 0.0008. The pose case study reported a mean angular error of 3.77 degrees for three evaluated connector features. The results show that continuity-aware source-point selection can retain measurement-relevant boundary evidence under data reduction for the evaluated industrial scans.

articles.title: Seismic performance of prefabricated self-centering frame structure: shaking table test and simulation
articles.abstract: The seismic performance of a prefabricated self-centering frame comprising concrete-filled double-skin steel tube (CFDST) columns, precast reinforced concrete main beams, prestressed steel strands, and friction energy-dissipation devices was investigated through shaking-table tests and numerical analyses. The beam steel strands were tensioned during prefabrication to eliminate on-site tensioning. A half-scale, two-story, two-bay specimen was subjected to five ground motions at four nominal acceleration levels. Floor acceleration and displacement responses, column base and beam-to-column interface openings, and strains in reinforcement, concrete surfaces, ring plates, and connecting I-section steels were examined. Peak accelerations, displacements, interface openings, and strains generally increased with input intensity, with larger floor responses occurring at the second story. The Tianjin wave produced the largest second-floor peak accelerations from 0.20 to 0.40 g. At 0.40 g, the mean peak column base and beam-to-column openings reached 2.82 and 3.14 mm, respectively. The maximum interstory drift ratio reached 1/33, while residual floor displacements remained below 2 mm. Mean peak strains were generally larger at the first story. An OpenSees model reproduced the measured initial frequencies and principal features of acceleration and displacement histories. Parametric analyses under the El Centro wave showed that increasing beam steel strand prestress raised the first-mode frequency by 13.8%, increasing column steel strand prestress from 250 to 893 MPa reduced calculated residual displacement by approximately 95%, and increasing initial bolt torque reduced calculated maximum displacement by 54%. These findings clarify the frame response and the contributions of prestress and friction resistance to seismic response control.

articles.title: Arrhenius-Based Capacity and Dispatch Optimization of a Wind–Photovoltaic–Storage Microgrid Using Task-Preserving, Degradation-Aware Refinement
articles.abstract: Feasibility repair can change the state-of-charge (SOC) trajectory used to evaluate battery degradation. We develop a cost–carbon–degradation model for a grid-connected wind–photovoltaic–storage microgrid. After correcting each schedule to meet a common daily terminal SOC, a degradation-aware refinement shifts charging and discharging between admissible hours while preserving their respective daily energy totals. An improved nondominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) combining differential evolution, adaptive variation and structured local search uses 24,000 objective evaluations in each of 12 independent runs. Across the 12 runs, the improved NSGA-II achieved a mean inverted generational distance (IGD) of 0.02840 ± 0.00168 and a normalized hypervolume (HV) of 0.84665 ± 0.00444. The corresponding mean values for standard NSGA-II were 0.08489 and 0.72758. The representative solution from the run closest to the median IGD is rated at 40.49 MW/114.97 MWh. Across 12 candidate pairs with matched ratings and daily charge and discharge totals, refinement reduces modeled first-year capacity loss by 10.70% ± 1.11% on average. Fixed-trajectory sensitivity across 17 degradation-model settings gives mean reductions in modeled first-year loss of 0.39% to 16.19%; two candidates instead show increased loss in the anchored linear case. These results show that the degradation benefit of temporal redistribution depends on the assumed aging model and that feasibility-repair choices can affect degradation assessment.

articles.title: On the Influence of the Mask Function in Volume Penalisation in Pseudo-Compressible Flow Simulations
articles.abstract: Accurately imposing boundary conditions on complex geometries remains a central challenge in computational fluid dynamics. The volume penalisation method provides a simple and flexible framework for representing arbitrarily shaped solid obstacles by a mask function without requiring body-fitted meshes. The accuracy of the method is influenced by both modelling and discretisation errors, which depend on the choice of mask function and penalisation parameter. In this work, these error sources are systematically analysed for one-, two-, and three-dimensional benchmark problems. Particular emphasis is placed on assessing the optimised smooth mask function proposed by Hester et al. [1]. While its favourable convergence properties were derived analytically and demonstrated for highly resolved grid-aligned configurations, its performance in practical simulations with non-body-conformal Cartesian grids remains insufficiently investigated. The present study therefore examines how these properties transfer to increasingly complex configurations involving non-aligned grids, fully developed turbulence, and moving boundaries. A one-dimensional Poisson problem is employed to investigate fundamental error mechanisms and convergence behaviour. The study is then extended to a two-dimensional flow past a circular cylinder at Re = 40, a three-dimensional turbulent channel flow at Reτ = 180, and a three-dimensional flapping wing with prescribed motion. The artificial compressibility method is used to relax the incompressibility constraint. The optimised mask function demonstrates improved robustness with respect to parameter variations and non-grid-aligned interfaces. In comparison, both the conventional discontinuous and cosine mask functions exhibit a stronger sensitivity to parameter tuning. For the two-dimensional cylinder flow, convergence rates of up to O(Δx1.6) are obtained for the velocity field. In the turbulent channel flow, both the discontinuous and optimised mask functions reproduce mean velocity profiles and turbulence statistics in good agreement with reference data. Overall, our results highlight the importance of mask function design for accuracy and robustness in volume penalisation methods, especially for non-grid-aligned interfaces. Further improvements in multi-dimensional and fluid-structure interactions configurations will primarily depend on continuing to mitigate discretisation errors.

articles.title: Quantum amplitude amplification of improbable futures
articles.abstract: Some consequential futures consist of plausible steps arranged into an unlikely sequence, which simulation seldom produces. Here ideal amplitude amplification, which raises the chance of drawing such futures while preserving their relative likelihoods, becomes a gate-level circuit that marks a future by its coherently accumulated surprisal, with a finite-precision analysis of the marking and the circuit’s logical cost. For a five-state Markov process six steps ahead, a 30-qubit circuit verified against exact enumeration raised the share of rare futures drawn from 2.5% to 98.0% in four iterations, leaving their relative likelihoods unchanged. The known process is an exactly verifiable testbed; the claim is a construction and a hardware demonstration, not a computational advantage. On IBM Kingston, compact reference circuits with matched controls showed the structure of amplification at 228 routed two-qubit gates ((:z=50), per-future (:ρ:=0.98)) but not at about 1,170, including after a pre-registered test of noise suppression.

articles.title: Computational Dynamics of Endogenous Pension Returns: Market Feedback, Cohort Risk, and Fiscal Backstops
articles.abstract: Large funded-pension reforms are usually evaluated under exogenous asset returns. This paper develops a quarterly computational system-dynamics model in which predictable pension contributions and withdrawals alter the market prices used to value pension assets. The model integrates pension accounting, endogenous price formation, price-insensitive ownership, cohort-specific retirement outcomes, and a finite fiscal backstop. It is implemented for 2026–2080 and evaluated through nested model variants, alternative functional forms, common-shock Monte Carlo simulations, Latin-hypercube sensitivity analysis, and regime maps. Under elastic market absorption, the funded expansion raises the 2080 replacement-rate index from about 45% to 58.3%. With the benchmark flow-price feedback, the index reaches 50.2%, and the cohort retiring in 2052 receives roughly 30% less funded income than under elastic absorption. A state backstop reduces the initial drawdown but shifts adjustment into public financing and exit risk; in the benchmark stochastic experiment, all 500 paths reach the financing trigger. Across a broader prespecified parameter sample, the trigger occurs in 57% of configurations, indicating a regime-dependent mechanism rather than a universal prediction. Wider diversification, gradual rollout, flexible payouts, countercyclical buffers, and a larger price-sensitive investor base weaken the feedback. The contribution is a reproducible computational framework for identifying the market-capacity conditions under which pension reform can endogenize its own returns. JEL classification: C63, D84, G12, G18, G41, H55, J32

articles.title: Multi-field coupling response and storage efficiency of CO₂ sequestration in deep chambers considering capillary trapping and surrounding rock damage
articles.abstract: In the face of global climate change, geological sequestration of carbon dioxide (CO₂) using underground space is a key pathway to achieving carbon emission reduction. In such engineering practices, storage efficiency and long-term safety directly constrain the technical feasibility of the project and its full life-cycle evolution. To investigate the safety, feasibility, and storage efficiency of CO₂ sequestration in deep chambers, this study combines physical experiments with numerical simulations to construct a thermal–hydraulic–mechanical (THM) three-field coupling model for CO₂ sequestration in abandoned mines, incorporating the dual effects of capillary pressure and surrounding rock damage. The storage safety and efficiency of CO₂ sequestration in deep chambers are then investigated. The results indicate that: (1) Under multi-field coupling, surrounding rock damage preferentially develops and propagates along the direction of higher initial in-situ stress, causing high-pressure CO₂ to preferentially form a dominant seepage pathway along this direction. (2) The seepage process of CO₂ is accompanied by significant heat exchange, leading to a marked temperature decrease in the surrounding rock of the chamber. This physical characteristic can serve as an important early warning indicator for monitoring concealed CO₂ leakage in practical engineering. (3) Storage depth has a significant nonlinear influence on CO₂ storage efficiency. As storage depth increases, the CO₂ storage efficiency of the chamber first increases and then decreases. When the depth increases from 500 m to 800 m, the storage efficiency increases by 0.76%; however, when the depth further increases from 800 m to 1200 m, the storage efficiency decreases by 0.24% due to factors such as high in-situ stress compaction. This study reveals the THM coupling mechanism of CO₂ sequestration in deep chambers under high-stress environments. It not only provides solid theoretical support for the large-scale resource utilization of underground space in abandoned mines, but also offers important scientific basis and engineering guidance for the scheme design and long-term safety evaluation of future deep geological carbon sequestration projects.

articles.title: Mechanical and early age performance of CO2 mineralized recycled fines from real waste stream sources compared to low calcium blends with traditional SCMs
articles.abstract: The declining availability of traditional supplementary cementitious materials (SCMs) has increased interest in alternative low-carbon binder constituents. This study evaluates CO2-mineralized recycled fines obtained from three construction and demolition waste streams as clinker replacement in binders containing 30% Portland cement and 70% SCMs. Mineralization increased calcium carbonate content and improved the reactivity of the recycled fines. The materials were investigated using calorimetry, thermogravimetric analysis, porosity measurements, and compressive strength testing on mortar bars. Compared with untreated recycled fines, mineralized materials showed greater early-age reactivity, resulting in higher heat release and calcium hydroxide consumption after calorimetry. They also refined pore structure by reducing threshold pore size. Mortars containing 70% mineralized recycled concrete fines achieved higher 28-day strength than blends containing natural pozzolan with limestone and performed similarly to limestone-calcined clay systems with the same clinker content. Environmental assessment indicated a favorable balance between strength and carbon emissions, particularly when accounting for carbon dioxide uptake during mineralization.

articles.title: Prior Colonization Shapes Bacterial Communities on Tire Wear Particles in Agricultural Soil
articles.abstract: Tire wear particles (TWPs) are an increasingly important source of microplastic contamination in agricultural soils, yet little is known about the processes governing bacterial colonization of their surfaces. We investigated how experimental pre-colonization and soil pretreatment influence TWP-associated bacterial communities across three independent 30-day greenhouse trials using agricultural soil collected adjacent to barley plots during the growing season. Initially uncolonized TWPs and TWPs pre-colonized with Pseudomonas congelans were incubated in non-autoclaved and autoclaved agricultural soil. Scanning electron microscopy, 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing, community-overlap analyses, and measurements of soil pH and carbon-to-nitrogen (C:N) ratios were used to characterize particle colonization, bacterial communities, and bulk soil responses. Treatment effects on bulk soil chemistry were limited, with no significant differences in C:N ratios and an overall pH effect in only one trial, for which adjusted pairwise comparisons were not significant. TWPs exhibited microbial attachment and biofilm-like material and supported bacterial communities that, despite sharing substantial proportions of taxa with surrounding soil, remained compositionally distinct. The genera enriched on particles varied among trials with prior colonization treatments and soil pretreatment, suggesting that colonization history and soil context contribute to variation in TWP-associated communities. Together, these findings indicate that TWPs support distinct, context-dependent bacterial communities despite limited changes in bulk soil chemistry. Further work is needed to determine whether this community variation affects soil processes and agricultural outcomes.

articles.title: Discrete anomaly inflow from SymTFT of U(1) global symmetry: the modified Villain resolution
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.16696v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a lattice SymTFT for a U(1) global symmetry with anomaly coefficient k using the modified Villain formulation, in which the spin structure required for odd k is realised explicitly by lattice Majorana fermions. We demonstrate that the same Majorana fermions sit at the junctions of the symmetry lines, exactly where the fusion of two U(1) elements wraps around the circle. From the lattice algebra of lines and junctions we derive the R- and F-symbols in the bulk and on the gapped boundary, and show that for odd k the boundary F-symbol obeys the Gu-Wen relation for the U(1) symmetry defect, without passing through a bosonic shadow. Restricting to Z₂subset U(1), we reproduce the mod-4 anomalous phase from a mapping torus and the fermionic stacking rule. As a simple application of this SymTFT, we also determine which subgroups Z_dsubset U(1) can be gauged and the symmetry of the resulting theories. This is a first step towards deriving, from the anomaly inflow of a continuous symmetry, the junction data of global anomalies beyond group cohomology.

articles.title: Symmetry-Controlled Criticality and Zeno Localization in a Monitored Quasiperiodic Superconductor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.16912v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Measurement-induced transitions of free fermions depend strongly on symmetry, but their interplay with quasiperiodic localization and superconducting pairing remains largely unexplored. We study a continuously monitored model of free fermions with pairing, where quasiperiodicity both controls localization and changes the symmetry class of the monitored field theory. Using topological entanglement entropy as a probe of nonlocal correlations in quantum state diffusion simulations, we identify a transition between a critical phase whose von Neumann entanglement entropy scales as (ln L)² and an area-law phase, whereas no transition occurs in the clean limit, consistent with the corresponding DIII and D nonlinear sigma models. The transition line exhibits strong multifractality and depends nonmonotonically on quasiperiodicity, which we associate with the symmetry crossover. Deep in the Zeno regime, we derive an effective non-Hermitian Bogoliubov-de Gennes description of individual trajectories and obtain a closed-form localization length that quantitatively agrees with numerics. Our results reveal how symmetry, quasiperiodic localization, and measurement backaction combine to determine both critical entanglement and microscopic trajectory localization in monitored superconductors.

articles.title: Higher-Group Statistics on Lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.16962v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crossing a domain wall can permute anyons, and intersecting strings can create a particle. These couplings between defects of various dimensions are specified by higher groups. We develop a lattice framework defining higher-group statistics as Berry phases of closed sequences of hopping operators, invariant under local modifications of the operators. Our central example is a closed Majorana chain, a 1-dimensional topological superconductor, embedded in 3 dimensions. We construct a loop-flip process with phase +i, refining the usual ± 1 loop-flip invariant through intermediate transfer of fermion parity between the chain and physical fermions. In two dimensions, charge-wall statistics distinguish two mathbb Z₄ toric codes enriched by mathbb Z₂ charge-conjugation symmetry, with identical anyon statistics but distinct gauged theories: the quantum doubles of the dihedral group D₄ and the quaternion group Q₈. We provide two complementary constructions of statistical processes. The first extends the Smith normal form algorithm in [Phys. Rev. X 16, 011010 (2026), arXiv:2412.01886] to higher groups, generating processes from lattice geometry and prescribed local moves. For a finite higher group mathbb G, we prove that statistical processes on a d-sphere are classified by Hd₊₂(Bmathbb G,mathbb Z). The second constructs processes directly from homology classes without examining exponentially many defect configurations, enabling us to study statistics for complex higher-group structures where the previous method is computationally prohibitive. These processes detect boundary anomalies of higher-group symmetry-protected topological phases. For example, we distinguish 2-group anomalies in 1, 2, and 3 dimensions. Higher-group statistics provide new invariants for characterizing coupled defects in quantum many-body systems.

articles.title: De Sitter Gravity and Emergent Time from Fusion Matrix Product States and SYK
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17045v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a quantum-mechanical model dual to two-dimensional de Sitter (dS) gravity. It is a quantum channel, defined by a matrix product state that fuses one spin at each step, and is related to a limit of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model without chord crossings. Its simplest part is a random walk with an emergent SL(2,mathbb R) symmetry, which we identify with the symmetry of the future boundary of dS. It selects a time variable in which the walk obeys the Schwarzian action and yields the disk amplitude of dS Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity. As the simplest case, we consider free massless scalar fields in the fixed background of dS₂. We find the agreement of the two-point function in the Bunch-Davies vacuum and the matching of symmetry. Our construction provides a concrete model for the dS/CFT correspondence for two-dimensional de Sitter gravity.

articles.title: Multi-particle quantum walk search on a two-dimensional lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17061v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the present paper we study the formulation of a search problem and the efficiency of multi-particle quantum walk search algorithms. The discrete-time evolution of each particle in space is treated according to Grover's quantum walk evolution operator. We focus on the local interactions models, where the particles' states are modified only when two or more of them appear on the same grid site. The main focus is given to the two-dimensional grid in space. We study the dependence of the search algorithm asymptotic success time and probability on the interaction strength and the generated maximal entanglement between particles. We show that the interacting and non-interacting two- and three-particle search algorithm attains a constant factor improvement over the single-particle counterpart. In addition, we provide a new generalized model of interactions for multi-particle quantum walks.

articles.title: Ensemble phase transitions in measurement-unitary hybrid quantum circuits
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17322v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The universal properties of state ensembles generated by quantum dynamics provide a refined lens into Hilbert-space ergodicity and deep thermalisation, or lack thereof. We investigate deep-ergodicity breaking transitions of an ancillary qubit entangled with a system undergoing dynamics via hybrid quantum circuits, where unitary evolution is interspersed with projective measurements. Specifically, we analyse the statistical properties of two distinct state ensembles: the trajectory ensemble (TE) conditioned on the measurement outcomes of the hybrid circuit, and the projected ensemble (PE) generated by further projective measurements of the system at the final temporal boundary. We find that both ensembles undergo non-analytic changes -- ensemble phase transitions -- at the critical point of the measurement-induced purification transition, despite their first moments remaining completely maximally mixed and blind to the transition. For Haar-random circuits, the TE transitions from a trivial identity ensemble to the uniform Haar ensemble, while the PE transitions from the Haar ensemble to a trivial singleton pure state. In Clifford circuits, absence of non-stabiliserness limits the PE to a 1-design, while the TE forms a k-design for k ≤ 3. We demonstrate that these genuine ensemble transitions offer a clear physical mechanism for the measurement-induced entanglement or purification transitions, illustrating how the capacity to ergodically steer a quantum subsystem shifts from the temporal boundary measurements in the mixed phase to the bulk trajectory measurements in the pure phase.

articles.title: Model Order Reduction for Quantum Molecular Dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07340v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum molecular dynamics (QMD) provides a high-fidelity physical framework for modeling atomic and molecular phenomena from first principles. However, its mathematical formulation requires solving iterative, high-dimensional electronic structure problems at every physical state step. Within the broader data-driven computational mechanics paradigm, we present a projection-based model order reduction framework for electronic structure calculation in QMD. By discovering a low-dimensional manifold of the electronic solution space within Kohn-Sham density functional theory, our approach projects the governing variational formulation onto an intrinsically reduced subspace. This avoids full-space iterative wavefunction optimization while preserving rigorous physical symmetries and state consistency. We demonstrate this methodology on a water molecule, demonstrating strong agreement with high-fidelity reference solutions across structural trajectories and thermodynamic observables through canonical coordinate alignment and structured manifold sampling.

articles.title: Curvature-Enhanced Polarization in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Janus Nanowrinkles
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.08295v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Strain-gradient engineering via out-of-plane wrinkling offers a powerful route to tune electronic and electromechanical properties in two-dimensional (2D) materials. Here, we systematically investigate the electronic and polarization response of wrinkled Janus MoSSe/MoSeS monolayers using density functional theory (DFT) calculations coupled with continuum elastica modeling. Exploring varying wrinkle sizes and compressive strain levels (5% -- 20%), we show that the global out-of-plane polarization follows a linear behavior when parameterized by the projected aspect ratio of the nanowrinkles. On this basis, we develop a physically grounded geometric model incorporating an effective 2D electromechanical coupling coefficient, which accurately predicts DFT polarizations without requiring higher-order nonlinear parameters. Atom- and orbital-resolved charge density analyses reveal the microscopic origin of this behavior: while the central Mo 4d projected weight remains approximately constant, local curvature drives continuous, chemically asymmetric charge transfer between the S 3p and Se 4p sublayer manifolds. Our findings establish clear geometric design rules for harnessing polarization in Janus monolayers for flexible nanoelectronics and optoelectronics.

articles.title: Multiphysics Simulation Framework for Continuous Ion Transport and Energetics in Atmospheric Pressure Interfaces
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.31258v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Optimizing atmospheric pressure interfaces requires balancing efficient ion transport with unwanted collision activation. The complex environment at the inlet region, including rapid pressure drops, RF/DC electric fields, ion-gas collisions, and space charge effects, makes simulation of this system challenging. In this work, we introduce MuCITE (Multiphysics simulation for Continuous Ion Transport and Energetics), which combines continuous ion injection, precomputed electric and gas flow fields, and particle-in-cell space charge updates. Furthermore, by employing improved impulsive collision theory, it can not only predict transport but also analyze the loss position of ions and the evolution of their kinetic energy, internal energy, and dissociation probability during transport. Transport predictions with ion currents and activation trends of in-source fragmentation were compared with experimental measurements using a custom-built source and a Q-Exactive HF source. The results show that the simulation predictions agree well with the experimental results and can serve as a reference before experiments. MuCITE allows users to derive ion transport, output beam characteristics, and ion energy through the configurable interface geometry and operating conditions. It supports simulation-guided design and tunable parameters to achieve predicted efficient ion transport or in source activation.

articles.title: Sampling methods to describe photon statistics in large ensembles of quantum emitters
articles.abstract: Photon-mediated interactions between quantum emitters can give rise to correlated and directional radiative emission. Many quantum optical phenomena can be characterized by the two-time quantum correlation function g (2) ( t , τ ), which describes the photon statistics of emitted radiation. However, the critical task of determining g (2) ( t , τ ) becomes intractable for large emitter ensembles due to the exponential scaling of the Hilbert space dimension with the number of emitters. Here, we analyze and benchmark two approximate numerical sampling methods applicable to emitter arrays embedded within electromagnetic environments, which generally provide upper and lower bounds for g (2) ( t , 0). We also introduce corrections to these methods (termed offset corrections ) that significantly improve the quality of the predictions. The optimal choice of method depends on the total number of emitters, such that, taken together, the two approaches provide accurate descriptions across a broad range of important regimes. This work, therefore, provides new theoretical tools for studying photon statistics and correlation functions in large ensembles of quantum emitters.

articles.title: A common steric effect controlling fluorescence lifetime in jellyfish- and coral-derived fluorescent proteins
articles.abstract: Fluorescent proteins (FPs) are widely used as genetically encoded probes for visualizing and analyzing biological processes. Fluorescence lifetime is an important photophysical property of FPs, yet a general principle governing lifetime across different FPs remains unclear. We previously showed that the fluorescence lifetimes of the Aequorea victoria -derived FPs enhanced yellow fluorescent protein and enhanced green fluorescent protein depend on the side chain volume at residue 145, and that this relationship also accounts for reported lifetime differences among other Aequorea victoria -derived FPs. Here, this relationship was examined in the coral-derived red FPs mOrange, mStrawberry, and mCherry. Trp143 was identified as the corresponding residue and replaced by each of the other 19 amino acids. In all three FPs, larger side chains at residue 143 generally produced longer fluorescence lifetimes, whereas smaller side chains produced shorter lifetimes, consistent with steric restriction of chromophore motion. The magnitude of lifetime modulation differed among the proteins: mOrange and mStrawberry showed large variations, whereas mCherry showed a smaller variation. Based on structural comparisons and reported molecular dynamics studies, the local environment around residue 163 is proposed to contribute to these differences. Together with previous results for Aequorea victoria -derived FPs, these findings suggest that the steric environment near the phenolate oxygen of the chromophore is a common factor controlling fluorescence lifetime through restriction of chromophore motion, while hydrogen-bonding interactions, local polarity, and packing modulate the magnitude of the response. This principle may guide the rational control of FP fluorescence lifetime and the development of FPs with improved photophysical properties.

articles.title: Force-Dependent Change of Structural Behavior Upon Pulling a Grafted Flexible Polymer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manipulating polymer chains by means of experimental instruments such as optical tweezers has helped understand better the effects of molecular forces in macromolecular structures. In this study, we simulate the influence of a pulling force on structural phases of a coarse-grained model for flexible polymers using generalized-ensemble Monte Carlo methodologies. The recently introduced microcanonical inflection-point analysis method is employed to identify and classify structural phases of the system. Specific order parameters help characterize the transition behavior in response to the present pulling force. We show that, upon increasing the pulling strength, the coil-globule transition turns from second to first order, then merges with the liquid-solid transition. An intermediate phase, separating the coil and globule phases, is identified for certain force strengths. Clear evidence of the Gough-Joule effect is found as well. Transitions do not occur at all if the pulling force exceeds a certain threshold value.

articles.title: Elicitors-induced modulation of plant performance, essential oil composition, and iridoid biosynthesis in Valeriana jatamansi Jones cultivated under controlled vertical aeroponics
articles.title_zh: 在受控垂直气培法下栽培的缬草中，诱导子诱导的植物性能、精油成分和环烯醚萜生物合成的调节
articles.abstract: The integration of aeroponic cultivation and elicitation offers an efficient strategy for enhancing biomass production and specialized metabolite accumulation in medicinal plants. In the current investigation, foliar application of fungal endophyte (FE), seaweed extract (SWE), and salicylic acid (SA) were applied to aeroponically cultivated Valeriana jatamansi to evaluate their effect on morphological growth, biomass yield, physiological performance, antioxidant defence, essential oil production, valepotriate accumulation, biosynthetic gene expression, and antimicrobial activity. SA treatment significantly enhances morphological growth, whereas FE promotes biomass accumulation. Elicitor treatment showed improved photochemical performance and antioxidant defence as indicated by reduced malondialdehyde and H₂O₂ levels and enhanced superoxide dismutase and catalase activities in leaf and root tissues. SWE produced the highest essential oil yield (2.50%) (v/w) and patchouli alcohol concentration (238.31 mg/L), while FE resulted in the highest relative abundance of patchouli alcohol (43.27%) in the oil. FE also markedly enhanced root valepotriate accumulation, with maximum acevaltrate (0.47%), didrovaltrate (0.53%), and valtrate (3.10%) contents. Consistently, qRT-PCR profiling revealed enhanced expression of iridoid pathway genes, including SLS, IS, 7DLGT and 7DLS, following elicitor treatment in leaf and root tissue. Essential oil exhibited strain-dependent antimicrobial activity, with Bacillus subtilis being the most susceptible strain (MIC 0.06 mg/mL). Overall, these findings demonstrate that combining aeroponic cultivation with targeted elicitation can effectively enhance biomass productivity, physiological resilience, essential oil quality, and valuable specialized metabolites in V. jatamansi, presenting a potential strategy for sustainable, scalable production of high-value medicinal plant products.

articles.title: Runtime Security Monitoring and Continuous Assurance for AI Agents: An Integrative Review and Systems-Management Framework
articles.title_zh: AI 代理的运行时安全监控和持续保证：综合审查和系统管理框架
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate as long-lived software actors that plan, invoke tools, access enterprise data, maintain memory, and delegate work. Their security posture can therefore change after deployment as task context, external content, tools, credentials, memory, model versions, and peer agents change. Pre-deployment evaluation alone cannot establish that an agent remains safe during execution. This paper presents a structured integrative review of runtime verification, continuous security monitoring, AI-agent security benchmarks, runtime guardrails, and autonomous-systems assurance, and synthesizes these literatures into a Runtime Security Monitoring and Continuous Assurance (RSMCA) framework for AI agents. The review distinguishes observability, runtime monitoring, runtime enforcement, and continuous assurance as related but non-equivalent functions. It identifies eight runtime monitoring surfaces: identity and configuration, input/context, task and planning state, tool invocation, data/egress, memory and retrieval, inter-agent delegation, and external dependencies. RSMCA represents each agent action as a correlated security event, evaluates it using complementary deterministic, semantic, verifier-based, and probabilistic monitors, and maps monitor output to graduated responses ranging from allow-with-audit to step-up approval, blocking, quarantine, rollback, and credential revocation. A continuous assurance state tracks monitor coverage, policy freshness, behavior risk, dependency health, incident state, and provenance completeness across time. The framework is designed for network and systems management settings in which agent security must be observable, enforceable, recoverable, and auditable. We conclude with implementation guidance, evaluation metrics, and a research agenda for measurable runtime assurance of autonomous AI services.
articles.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理越来越多地作为长期软件参与者运行，负责规划、调用工具、访问企业数据、维护内存和委派工作。因此，部署后，随着任务上下文、外部内容、工具、凭证、内存、模型版本和对等代理的变化，它们的安全状况可能会发生变化。仅部署前评估并不能确定代理在执行过程中保持安全。本文对运行时验证、持续安全监控、人工智能代理安全基准、运行时护栏和自治系统保证进行了结构化的综合审查，并将这些文献综合成人工智能代理的运行时安全监控和持续保证（RSMCA）框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理越来越多地作为长期软件参与者运行，负责规划、调用工具、访问企业数据、维护内存和委派工作。因此，部署后，随着任务上下文、外部内容、工具、凭证、内存、模型版本和对等代理的变化，它们的安全状况可能会发生变化。仅部署前评估并不能确定代理在执行过程中保持安全。本文对运行时验证、持续安全监控、人工智能代理安全基准、运行时护栏和自治系统保证进行了结构化的综合审查，并将这些文献综合成人工智能代理的运行时安全监控和持续保证（RSMCA）框架。该审查将可观察性、运行时监控、运行时执行和持续保证区分为相关但不等效的功能。它识别八个运行时监控表面：身份和配置、输入/上下文、任务和计划状态、工具调用、数据/出口、内存和检索、代理间委托以及外部依赖项。 RSMCA 将每个代理操作表示为相关的安全事件，使用互补的确定性、语义、基于验证者和概率监视器对其进行评估，并将监视器输出映射到从允许审核到逐步批准、阻止、隔离、回滚和凭证吊销的分级响应。持续保证状态跟踪监控覆盖范围、策略新鲜度、行为风险、依赖性健康状况、事件状态和来源完整性。该框架专为网络和系统管理设置而设计，其中代理安全性必须是可观察的、可强制执行的、可恢复的和可审计的。最后，我们给出了自主人工智能服务可测量运行时间保证的实施指南、评估指标和研究议程。

articles.title: Optimising Permeable Infrastructure Networks in Sponge City Design for Urban Flood Resilience Using Coupled Hydrological, Clogging and Lifecycle Modelling
articles.title_zh: 利用水文、堵塞和生命周期耦合模型优化海绵城市设计中的渗透性基础设施网络，以提高城市防洪能力
articles.abstract: Urban pluvial flooding is intensifying as impervious surfaces expand and extreme rainfall events become more frequent. Sponge city design (SCD) relies on decentralised retention and infiltration, yet planners still lack tools that (i) link the progressive, sediment-driven loss of permeability to maintenance actions, (ii) allocate permeable infrastructure across heterogeneous catchments and (iii) weigh flood-damage savings against lifecycle maintenance costs. This study couples the Storm Water Management Model (SWMM) with a Green–Ampt infiltration scheme modified by an exponential sediment-clogging factor and a lifecycle cost–benefit module. Four scenarios were tested on a synthetic 4.5 km² high-density urban catchment under a 50-year, 24-hour design storm: a pipe-only baseline, 30% permeable interlocking concrete pavers (PICP), 50% permeable infrastructure with bioretention, and an optimised network with subsurface detention and controlled underdrains. The model was calibrated against observed flow data (NSE = 0.88, PBIAS = + 4.2%, RSR = 0.32). The optimised network reduced peak runoff by 43.7% (from 42.6 to 24.0 m³ s⁻¹), reduced total runoff volume by 49.1% and delayed the runoff peak by 68 min. Without maintenance, PICP conductivity fell by 72% within three years, whereas twice-yearly vacuum sweeping sustained about 88% of the initial conductivity. Capital expenditure exceeded that of a conventional upgrade (US18.4 million versus US15.5 million), but the discounted payback period was 7.2 years and the 30-year benefit–cost ratio was 2.41; the dominant sensitivities were the flood-damage benefit and the discount rate. The results provide design, maintenance and fiscal guidance for municipal planners moving from reactive to proactive, sponge-city-based drainage planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着不透水表面的扩大和极端降雨事件的更加频繁，城市雨洪正在加剧。海绵城市设计（SCD）依赖于分散的保留和渗透，但规划者仍然缺乏工具来（i）将渐进的、沉积物驱动的渗透性损失与维护行动联系起来，（ii）在异质集水区分配可渗透的基础设施，以及（iii）权衡洪水破坏节省与生命周期维护成本。本研究将雨水管理模型 (SWMM) 与 Green-Ampt 渗透方案结合起来，该方案通过指数沉积物堵塞因子和生命周期成本效益模块进行修改。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着不透水表面的扩大和极端降雨事件的更加频繁，城市雨洪正在加剧。海绵城市设计（SCD）依赖于分散的保留和渗透，但规划者仍然缺乏工具来（i）将渐进的、沉积物驱动的渗透性损失与维护行动联系起来，（ii）在异质集水区分配可渗透的基础设施，以及（iii）权衡洪水破坏节省与生命周期维护成本。本研究将雨水管理模型 (SWMM) 与 Green-Ampt 渗透方案结合起来，该方案通过指数沉积物堵塞因子和生命周期成本效益模块进行修改。在 50 年 24 小时设计风暴下，在 4.5 平方公里的合成高密度城市集水区上测试了四种情景：纯管道基线、30% 透水性联锁混凝土摊铺机 (PICP)、50% 透水性生物滞留基础设施，以及具有地下滞留和受控暗渠的优化网络。该模型根据观测到的流量数据进行校准（NSE = 0.88，PBIAS = + 4.2%，RSR = 0.32）。优化后的管网使峰值径流减少了43.7%（从42.6 m3 s⁻1减少到24.0 m3 s⁻1），总径流量减少了49.1%，径流峰值推迟了68分钟。如果不进行维护，PICP 电导率在三年内下降了 72%，而每年两次的真空清扫则维持了初始电导率的约 88%。资本支出超过传统升级（1840 万美元对 1550 万美元），但折现投资回收期为 7.2 年，30 年效益成本比为 2.41；主要的敏感性是洪水损害赔偿和贴现率。研究结果为市政规划者从被动转向主动、基于海绵城市的排水规划提供了设计、维护和财政指导。

articles.title: Machine Learning–Driven Inverse Design of Gradient Porous Elastomers for High-Performance Flexible Pressure Sensors
articles.title_zh: 机器学习驱动的高性能柔性压力传感器梯度多孔弹性体逆向设计
articles.abstract: Introducing gradient porous microstructures offers a cost-effective and easily scalable approach for developing flexible thin-film pressure sensors. However, the vast design space arising from varying pore sizes and combinations renders the identification of optimal structural parameter nearly unattainable through conventional trial-and-error experiments. Herein, we propose a novel methodology that integrates finite element simulation with machine learning to efficiently search for the optimal solution. A finite element model of the gradient porous dielectric layer is established using COMSOL, incorporating an equivalent parameter inversion strategy. Hundreds of pressures–capacitance response datasets are generated through parametric simulations and subsequently employed to train a backpropagation (BP) neural network surrogate model. The optimized structural parameters are then experimentally validated through the fabrication of a thin-film pressure sensor. The fabricated sensor exhibits fast response and recovery time (75 ms), a low detection limit (0.2 kPa), a wide detection range (600 kPa), and outstanding long-term stability over 5,000 cycles. Furthermore, the sensor demonstrates excellent applicability in various scenarios, including human physiological signal monitoring and speech recognition. More importantly, the integrated simulation–machine learning framework presented herein is broadly applicable to other structural designs, offering a powerful alternative to traditional trial-and-error approaches and substantially reducing development costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 引入梯度多孔微结构为开发柔性薄膜压力传感器提供了一种经济有效且易于扩展的方法。然而，不同孔径和组合产生的巨大设计空间使得通过传统的试错实验几乎无法确定最佳结构参数。在此，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，将有限元模拟与机器学习相结合，以有效地搜索最佳解决方案。使用 COMSOL 建立了梯度多孔介电层的有限元模型，并结合了等效参数反演策略。通过参数模拟生成数百个压力-电容响应数据集，随后用于训练反向传播 (BP) 神经网络代理模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 引入梯度多孔微结构为开发柔性薄膜压力传感器提供了一种经济有效且易于扩展的方法。然而，不同孔径和组合产生的巨大设计空间使得通过传统的试错实验几乎无法确定最佳结构参数。在此，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，将有限元模拟与机器学习相结合，以有效地搜索最佳解决方案。使用 COMSOL 建立了梯度多孔介电层的有限元模型，并结合了等效参数反演策略。通过参数模拟生成数百个压力-电容响应数据集，随后用于训练反向传播 (BP) 神经网络代理模型。然后通过制造薄膜压力传感器对优化的结构参数进行实验验证。所制造的传感器具有快速响应和恢复时间（75 ms）、低检测限（0.2 kPa）、宽检测范围（600 kPa）以及超过 5,000 次循环的出色长期稳定性。此外，该传感器在人体生理信号监测和语音识别等多种场景中表现出出色的适用性。更重要的是，本文提出的集成仿真-机器学习框架广泛适用于其他结构设计，为传统的试错方法提供了强大的替代方案，并大大降低了开发成本。

articles.title: Optimization of Laser Ablation Resistance for Multilayer Heterogeneous Thin Films Based on Optical–Thermal–Ablation Coupling and a BP Neural Network Surrogate Model
articles.title_zh: 基于光热烧蚀耦合和BP神经网络代理模型的多层异质薄膜激光烧蚀抗性优化
articles.abstract: The thermophysical response of multilayer heterogeneous thin films under continuous-wave laser heating involves non-uniform volumetric heat generation modulated by interference-induced standing-wave absorption, which governs the layer-by-layer phase-change sequence and the ultimate thermal failure threshold—a coupling that conventional Beer–Lambert approximations fail to capture. This study develops an optical–thermal–ablation coupled model that resolves the standing-wave absorption profile and couples it to temperature-dependent transient heat conduction with latent-heat effects, validated against laser-damage experiments at seven power levels. A two-stage surrogate-based framework is constructed to explore the thermophysical design space in which discrete material choices and continuous layer thicknesses jointly control the absorption distribution and melting sequence. The optimal architecture is identified as SUS304/Ag/Si₃N₄/SiO₂/ITO with a refined thickness profile of 21 µm/0.106 µm/0.18 µm/2.35 µm/0.05 µm under a 25 µm total constraint, yielding a 209.6 K reduction in peak temperature relative to the baseline. The analysis reveals three thermophysical mechanisms: (i) in the interference layer, the order-of-magnitude reduction in volumetric optical absorption dominates over the 2.5-fold difference in thermal conductivity in determining the peak temperature; (ii) the positive temperature coefficient of thermal conductivity in the SUS304 substrate provides a self-regulating thermal-sink effect; and (iii) the Ag layer exhibits a non-monotonic thermal response beyond its optical saturation thickness, governed by the competition between cross-plane thermal resistance and in-plane thermal spreading coupled with absorption-peak shifting. These results clarify how interference-modulated heat generation governs phase-change sequences and thermal failure in multilayer thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: 多层异质薄膜在连续波激光加热下的热物理响应涉及由干涉引起的驻波吸收调制的不均匀体积发热，它控制着逐层相变序列和最终的热失效阈值——传统比尔-朗伯近似无法捕获的耦合。这项研究开发了一种光热烧蚀耦合模型，该模型可以解析驻波吸收曲线，并将其与具有潜热效应的温度相关瞬态热传导耦合，并在七个功率级别的激光损伤实验中进行了验证。构建了一个基于两阶段替代的框架来探索热物理设计空间，其中离散材料选择和连续层厚度共同控制吸收分布和熔化顺序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多层异质薄膜在连续波激光加热下的热物理响应涉及由干涉引起的驻波吸收调制的不均匀体积发热，它控制着逐层相变序列和最终的热失效阈值——传统比尔-朗伯近似无法捕获的耦合。这项研究开发了一种光热烧蚀耦合模型，该模型可以解析驻波吸收曲线，并将其与具有潜热效应的温度相关瞬态热传导耦合，并在七个功率级别的激光损伤实验中进行了验证。构建了一个基于两阶段替代的框架来探索热物理设计空间，其中离散材料选择和连续层厚度共同控制吸收分布和熔化顺序。最佳架构被确定为 SUS304/Ag/Si₃N4/SiO2/ITO，在 25 µm 总约束下，其厚度轮廓精细为 21 µm/0.106 µm/0.18 µm/2.35 µm/0.05 µm，峰值温度相对于基线降低了 209.6 K。分析揭示了三种热物理机制：(i) 在干涉层中，在确定峰值温度时，体积光学吸收的数量级降低在热导率的 2.5 倍差异中占主导地位； (ii) SUS304基板的正导热温度系数提供了自调节散热效果； (iii)Ag层表现出超出其光学饱和厚度的非单调热响应，这由跨平面热阻和面内热扩散与吸收峰偏移之间的竞争决定。这些结果阐明了干涉调制热量的产生如何控制多层薄膜中的相变序列和热失效。

articles.title: Multifunctional vortex magnetic tunnel junctions with optical and radio-frequency inputs for neuromorphic computing
articles.title_zh: 具有光学和射频输入的多功能涡旋磁隧道结，用于神经形态计算
articles.abstract: The brain co-locates memory and processing, but many neuromorphic devices need standby power or separate memory from nonlinear computation. Here we show that vortex magnetic tunnel junctions with a non-volatile, thermally programmable storage layer provide two complementary nonlinear channels in one nanopillar. The laser-induced voltage is linear in laser power but cubic in direct-current bias, making the bias current a nonlinear, programmable weight, whereas radio-frequency excitation is rectified into a frequency-dependent voltage. Crossbar simulations using measured responses classify handwritten digits with 95.4% accuracy using optical inputs and 94.9% using radio-frequency inputs, comparable to an equal-size digital single-layer network. Microlenses focusing light to sub-micrometre spots, one formed directly on a junction, and a flip-chip-mounted vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser array provide a route to on-chip optical addressing. Operating both channels together could combine optical and radio-frequency inputs within one nanoscale device, making vortex junctions reprogrammable multi-input building blocks for analog neuromorphic hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 大脑将记忆和处理放在一起，但许多神经形态设备需要备用电源或将记忆与非线性计算分开。在这里，我们展示了具有非易失性热可编程存储层的涡旋磁隧道结在一个纳米柱中提供了两个互补的非线性通道。激光感应电压与激光功率呈线性关系，但与直流偏置呈三次方关系，使得偏置电流成为非线性、可编程权重，而射频激励则被整流为与频率相关的电压。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大脑将记忆和处理放在一起，但许多神经形态设备需要备用电源或将记忆与非线性计算分开。在这里，我们展示了具有非易失性热可编程存储层的涡旋磁隧道结在一个纳米柱中提供了两个互补的非线性通道。激光感应电压与激光功率呈线性关系，但与直流偏置呈三次方关系，使得偏置电流成为非线性、可编程权重，而射频激励则被整流为与频率相关的电压。使用测量响应进行的 Crossbar 模拟对手写数字进行分类，使用光学输入时的准确度为 95.4%，使用射频输入时的准确度为 94.9%，与同等大小的数字单层网络相当。将光聚焦到亚微米点（直接形成在结上）的微透镜和倒装芯片安装的垂直腔表面发射激光器阵列提供了一种片上光学寻址的途径。同时操作两个通道可以将光学和射频输入结合在一个纳米级设备中，使涡旋结成为模拟神经形态硬件的可重新编程的多输入构建块。

articles.title: Visible-Light-Driven Degradation of Organic Dyes Using Novel β- Amino-Modified Cu-BTC MOFs: Toward Clean Water Solutions
articles.title_zh: 使用新型 β-氨基改性 Cu-BTC MOF 进行可见光驱动的有机染料降解：迈向清洁水解决方案
articles.abstract: In this study, the synthesis and characterization of novel β-amino-functionalized Cu-BTC-MOFs and their photocatalytic performance for dye degradation were carried out. The modified MOFs, denoted as MOF@3A3NP, MOF@3A4HP, and MOF@3A4H3MP, correspond to Cu-BTC functionalized with 3-amino-3-(3-nitrophenyl)propanoic acid, 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid, and 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)propanoic acid, respectively. PXRD analysis confirmed the synthesis of MOFs having a crystalline structure and FTIR spectroscopy revealed the successful grafting of β-amino functional groups onto the Cu-BTC surface, evidenced by additional peaks at 2130–2233 cm⁻¹ and 3350 cm⁻¹. The modified Cu-BTC-MOF exhibited a reduced band-gap energy compared to the unmodified Cu-BTC (2.9 eV) which indicated improved light absorption and charge separation. The β-amino-functionalized Cu-BTC-MOFs demonstrated excellent photocatalytic performance, degrading 95%, 98%, and 99% of methyl green, and 85%, 98%, and 99% of methyl orange in 70 minutes upon exposure to visible light using MOF@3A4HP, MOF@3A4H3MP, and MOF@3A3NP, respectively. This improved photocatalytic activity can be ascribed to the morphological modifications, and reduced optical band gap due to amino-functionalized MOFs. These factors highlight the potential of β-amino-functionalized Cu-BTC-MOFs as promising photocatalysts for the efficient degradation of both cationic and anionic dyes.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，进行了新型β-氨基功能化Cu-BTC-MOF的合成和表征及其对染料降解的光催化性能。修饰后的MOF分别表示为MOF@3A3NP、MOF@3A4HP和MOF@3A4H3MP，分别对应于用3-氨基-3-(3-硝基苯基)丙酸、3-氨基-3-(4-羟基苯基)丙酸和3-氨基-3-(4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯基)丙酸功能化的Cu-BTC。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本研究中，进行了新型β-氨基功能化Cu-BTC-MOF的合成和表征及其对染料降解的光催化性能。修饰后的MOF分别表示为MOF@3A3NP、MOF@3A4HP和MOF@3A4H3MP，分别对应于用3-氨基-3-(3-硝基苯基)丙酸、3-氨基-3-(4-羟基苯基)丙酸和3-氨基-3-(4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯基)丙酸功能化的Cu-BTC。 PXRD 分析证实了具有晶体结构的 MOF 的合成，FTIR 光谱显示 β-氨基官能团成功接枝到 Cu-BTC 表面，2130–2233 cm-1 和 3350 cm-1 处的附加峰证明了这一点。与未改性的 Cu-BTC (2.9 eV) 相比，改性的 Cu-BTC-MOF 显示出降低的带隙能量，这表明光吸收和电荷分离得到了改善。 β-氨基功能化的Cu-BTC-MOF表现出优异的光催化性能，使用MOF@3A4HP、MOF@3A4H3MP和MOF@3A3NP暴露在可见光下70分钟内分别降解95%、98%和99%的甲基绿，以及85%、98%和99%的甲基橙。这种光催化活性的提高可归因于氨基功能化 MOF 的形态修饰和光学带隙的减小。这些因素凸显了 β-氨基功能化 Cu-BTC-MOF 作为有效降解阳离子和阴离子染料的有前途的光催化剂的潜力。

articles.title: Optimal learning of quantum channels in diamond distance
articles.title_zh: 钻石距离量子通道的优化学习

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79595-2 Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising photonic platform, but its integration with 2D materials remains challenging. Here, the authors report the realization of TFLN-based waveguide-integrated WSe2 photodetectors, showing a 3-dB bandwidth up to 1.12 GHz, up to 10 Gbit/s data rates and responsivity up to 492 mA/W in the visible range.

articles.title: Conductivity of a non-Galilean-invariant Fermi liquid: Exact solution of the kinetic equation
articles.title_zh: 非伽利略不变费米液体的电导率：动力学方程的精确解
articles.abstract: Author(s): Tatia Kiliptari, Vladimir I. Yudson, and Dmitrii L. Maslov In a Fermi liquid, the quasiparticle scattering rate scales as T 2 , whereas the low-temperature correction to the residual resistivity can scale as T 4 , seemingly implying a strongly suppressed current-relaxation rate. The authors resolve this paradox here by solving the kinetic equation exactly for a disordered, non-Galilean-invariant Fermi liquid. They show that electron–electron collisions enter the conductivity through the quasiparticle scattering time itself, which controls the crossover between collisionless and hydrodynamic transport. The extra T 2 factor arises because momentum conservation makes the change in the total velocity of two colliding electrons vanish on the Fermi surface, so current relaxation comes only from thermally excited states away from it. The electron–electron contribution to the dc conductivity nevertheless remains parametrically small throughout the Fermi-liquid regime. By extrapolating the result toward a z = 3 quantum critical point, the authors further show that the renormalized quasiparticle scattering rate saturates the Planckian bound. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L291103] Published Thu Nov 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者：Tatia Kiliptari、Vladimir I. Yudson 和 Dmitrii L. Maslov 在费米液体中，准粒子散射率按 T 2 缩放，而对残余电阻率的低温校正可按 T 4 缩放，这似乎意味着强烈抑制的电流弛豫率。作者通过精确求解无序、非伽利略不变费米液体的动力学方程来解决这个悖论。他们表明，电子-电子碰撞通过准粒子散射时间本身进入电导率，这控制了无碰撞和流体动力传输之间的交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Tatia Kiliptari、Vladimir I. Yudson 和 Dmitrii L. Maslov 在费米液体中，准粒子散射率按 T 2 缩放，而对残余电阻率的低温校正可按 T 4 缩放，这似乎意味着强烈抑制的电流弛豫率。作者通过精确求解无序、非伽利略不变费米液体的动力学方程来解决这个悖论。他们表明，电子-电子碰撞通过准粒子散射时间本身进入电导率，这控制了无碰撞和流体动力传输之间的交叉。额外的 T 2 因子的出现是因为动量守恒使得两个碰撞电子的总速度的变化在费米表面上消失，因此电流弛豫仅来自远离它的热激发态。然而，在整个费米液体状态下，电子-电子对直流电导率的贡献仍然很小。通过将结果外推到 z = 3 量子临界点，作者进一步表明，重整化准粒子散射率使普朗克界限饱和。 [物理。修订版 B 114，L291103] 2026 年 11 月 12 日星期四发布
